steps.title: 亮度、同調分率與繞射極限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「亮度計算表（通量除以相空間）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brilliance table (flux over phase space)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取一支長 2 m、週期 λ_u = 18 mm、偏轉參數 K = 1 的波盪器裝在 6 GeV 儲存環：基頻波長 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å（光子能量 12.7 keV）。中心錐通量 F ≈ 1.43×10¹⁴·N·Q₁(K)·I = 1.43×10¹⁴×111×0.55×0.2 ≈ 1.75×10¹⁵ ph/s/0.1%BW；繞射項 σ_r ≈ 1.6 µm、σ_r' ≈ 4.9 µrad，與電子束合成後 Σx ≈ 30 µm、Σy ≈ 5.4 µm、Σx' ≈ 6.6 µrad、Σy' ≈ 5.3 µrad，代入亮度公式得 B ≈ 7.8×10²¹ ph/s/mm²/mrad²/0.1%BW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 2 m undulator with λ_u = 18 mm and K = 1 at 6 GeV gives λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å (12.7 keV). Central-cone flux F ≈ 1.43×10¹⁴·N·Q₁(K)·I = 1.43×10¹⁴×111×0.55×0.2 ≈ 1.75×10¹⁵ ph/s/0.1%BW; with σ_r ≈ 1.6 µm and σ_r' ≈ 4.9 µrad the combined values are Σx ≈ 30 µm, Σy ≈ 5.4 µm, Σx' ≈ 6.6 µrad, Σy' ≈ 5.3 µrad, so B ≈ 7.8×10²¹ ph/s/mm²/mrad²/0.1%BW. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用校正過的光二極體或量熱計量通過已知針孔的絕對通量，與 F 比較；以狹縫的 Fresnel 繞射或楊氏雙狹縫的條紋可見度量光源尺寸與橫向同調長度，反推 Σ；把計算的亮度與 ESRF 公布的升級前後比值對照，區分發射度、波盪器長度與電流各自的貢獻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure absolute flux through a known pinhole with a calibrated photodiode or calorimeter and compare with F; measure source size and transverse coherence length from Fresnel diffraction of a slit or the fringe visibility of a Young double slit and back out Σ; compare the computed brilliance with the published ESRF before/after ratio to separate the contributions of emittance, undulator length and current.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 取一支長 2 m、週期 λ_u = 18 mm、偏轉參數 K = 1 的波盪器裝在 6 GeV 儲存環：基頻波長 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å（光子能量 12.7 keV）。中心錐通量 F ≈ 1.43×10¹⁴·N·Q₁(K)·I = 1.43×10¹⁴×111×0.55×0.2 ≈ 1.75×10¹⁵ ph/s/0.1%BW；繞射項 σ_r ≈ 1.6 µm、σ_r' ≈ 4.9 µrad，與電子束合成後 Σx ≈ 30 µm、Σy ≈ 5.4 µm、Σx' ≈ 6.6 µrad、Σy' ≈ 5.3 µrad，代入亮度公式得 B ≈ 7.8×10²¹ ph/s/mm²/mrad²/0.1%BW。
knowledge.textEn: A 2 m undulator with λ_u = 18 mm and K = 1 at 6 GeV gives λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å (12.7 keV). Central-cone flux F ≈ 1.43×10¹⁴·N·Q₁(K)·I = 1.43×10¹⁴×111×0.55×0.2 ≈ 1.75×10¹⁵ ph/s/0.1%BW; with σ_r ≈ 1.6 µm and σ_r' ≈ 4.9 µrad the combined values are Σx ≈ 30 µm, Σy ≈ 5.4 µm, Σx' ≈ 6.6 µrad, Σy' ≈ 5.3 µrad, so B ≈ 7.8×10²¹ ph/s/mm²/mrad²/0.1%BW.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「亮度、同調分率與繞射極限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit", which statement holds?
options: 提高電子能量只是讓光更亮，不會改變光譜形狀。
取一支長 2 m、週期 λ_u = 18 mm、偏轉參數 K = 1 的波盪器裝在 6 GeV 儲存環：基頻波長 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å（光子能量 12.7 keV）。
永磁彎轉磁鐵不用電，所以它的場強永遠不會變。
optionsEn: Raising electron energy only makes the light brighter; it does not change the spectrum.
A 2 m undulator with λ_u = 18 mm and K = 1 at 6 GeV gives λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å (12.7 keV).
Permanent-magnet bends draw no power, so their field never changes.
quiz.explanation: 取一支長 2 m、週期 λ_u = 18 mm、偏轉參數 K = 1 的波盪器裝在 6 GeV 儲存環：基頻波長 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å（光子能量 12.7 keV）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 2 m undulator with λ_u = 18 mm and K = 1 at 6 GeV gives λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å (12.7 keV). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 亮度、同調分率與繞射極限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「亮度計算表（通量除以相空間）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Brilliance table (flux over phase space)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用校正過的光二極體或量熱計量通過已知針孔的絕對通量，與 F 比較；以狹縫的 Fresnel 繞射或楊氏雙狹縫的條紋可見度量光源尺寸與橫向同調長度，反推 Σ；把計算的亮度與 ESRF 公布的升級前後比值對照，區分發射度、波盪器長度與電流各自的貢獻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure absolute flux through a known pinhole with a calibrated photodiode or calorimeter and compare with F; measure source size and transverse coherence length from Fresnel diffraction of a slit or the fringe visibility of a Young double slit and back out Σ; compare the computed brilliance with the published ESRF before/after ratio to separate the contributions of emittance, undulator length and current. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：樑架滾轉或偏四極誤差讓耦合漂移，垂直發射度從 10 pm 升到 50 pm，Σy 加倍而亮度減半，通量計卻完全看不出異常，使用者只覺得聚焦斑變大。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Girder roll or skew-quadrupole errors let coupling drift so vertical emittance rises from 10 pm to 50 pm; Σy doubles and brilliance halves while the flux monitor shows nothing wrong, and users only notice a larger focal spot.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用校正過的光二極體或量熱計量通過已知針孔的絕對通量，與 F 比較；以狹縫的 Fresnel 繞射或楊氏雙狹縫的條紋可見度量光源尺寸與橫向同調長度，反推 Σ；把計算的亮度與 ESRF 公布的升級前後比值對照，區分發射度、波盪器長度與電流各自的貢獻。
knowledge.textEn: Measure absolute flux through a known pinhole with a calibrated photodiode or calorimeter and compare with F; measure source size and transverse coherence length from Fresnel diffraction of a slit or the fringe visibility of a Young double slit and back out Σ; compare the computed brilliance with the published ESRF before/after ratio to separate the contributions of emittance, undulator length and current.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「亮度、同調分率與繞射極限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
真空腔越小，體積越小，所以越容易抽到好真空。
用校正過的光二極體或量熱計量通過已知針孔的絕對通量，與 F 比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A smaller chamber is easier to pump because its volume is smaller.
Measure absolute flux through a known pinhole with a calibrated photodiode or calorimeter and compare with F.
quiz.explanation: 用校正過的光二極體或量熱計量通過已知針孔的絕對通量，與 F 比較；以狹縫的 Fresnel 繞射或楊氏雙狹縫的條紋可見度量光源尺寸與橫向同調長度，反推 Σ；把計算的亮度與 ESRF 公布的升級前後比值對照，區分發射度、波盪器長度與電流各自的貢獻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure absolute flux through a known pinhole with a calibrated photodiode or calorimeter and compare with F; measure source size and transverse coherence length from Fresnel diffraction of a slit or the fringe visibility of a Young double slit and back out Σ; compare the computed brilliance with the published ESRF before/after ratio to separate the contributions of emittance, undulator length and current. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 亮度、同調分率與繞射極限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「亮度計算表（通量除以相空間）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Brilliance table (flux over phase space)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 樑架滾轉或偏四極誤差讓耦合漂移，垂直發射度從 10 pm 升到 50 pm，Σy 加倍而亮度減半，通量計卻完全看不出異常，使用者只覺得聚焦斑變大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Girder roll or skew-quadrupole errors let coupling drift so vertical emittance rises from 10 pm to 50 pm; Σy doubles and brilliance halves while the flux monitor shows nothing wrong, and users only notice a larger focal spot. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：當發射度小於 λ/4π 時光源進入繞射極限：在 1 Å 這個值約 8 pm，EBS 的垂直 10 pm 幾乎達到，水平 130 pm 則仍由電子束主導，這決定了同調分率與聚焦極限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When emittance falls below λ/4π the source becomes diffraction limited: at 1 Å that is about 8 pm, which the 10 pm vertical emittance of EBS nearly reaches while the 130 pm horizontal is still electron dominated, and that sets the coherent fraction and focusing limit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「亮度就是通量，光子數越多亮度一定越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Brilliance is just flux; more photons always means more brilliance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樑架滾轉或偏四極誤差讓耦合漂移，垂直發射度從 10 pm 升到 50 pm，Σy 加倍而亮度減半，通量計卻完全看不出異常，使用者只覺得聚焦斑變大。
knowledge.textEn: Girder roll or skew-quadrupole errors let coupling drift so vertical emittance rises from 10 pm to 50 pm; Σy doubles and brilliance halves while the flux monitor shows nothing wrong, and users only notice a larger focal spot.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「亮度、同調分率與繞射極限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 樑架滾轉或偏四極誤差讓耦合漂移，垂直發射度從 10 pm 升到 50 pm，Σy 加倍而亮度減半，通量計卻完全看不出異常，使用者只覺得聚焦斑變大。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
儲存環對準一次完成後就永久有效。
optionsEn: Girder roll or skew-quadrupole errors let coupling drift so vertical emittance rises from 10 pm to 50 pm.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Once the ring is aligned, it stays aligned.
quiz.explanation: 樑架滾轉或偏四極誤差讓耦合漂移，垂直發射度從 10 pm 升到 50 pm，Σy 加倍而亮度減半，通量計卻完全看不出異常，使用者只覺得聚焦斑變大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Girder roll or skew-quadrupole errors let coupling drift so vertical emittance rises from 10 pm to 50 pm; Σy doubles and brilliance halves while the flux monitor shows nothing wrong, and users only notice a larger focal spot. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合」與「調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration" and "Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「對準網、溫控與地面振動」如何決定歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment network, thermal control and ground vibration” determines the key performance of “European Synchrotron Radiation Facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 844 m 的環由 32 個單元的樑架組成，先用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平系統建立全環網，再把相鄰磁鐵的相對誤差壓到 50 µm 等級；對束流而言相鄰元件的平滑度比絕對座標更重要。隧道溫度、冷卻水與地面振動都會透過樑架改變磁鐵位置，而磁鐵位置的誤差經閉軌放大後進入光源點，所以熱控、樑架剛性與回授頻寬必須一起設計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「對準網、溫控與地面振動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The 844 m ring is assembled from the girders of 32 cells: a laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling build the ring-wide network, then neighbouring magnets are aligned to each other at the 50 µm level, because for the beam the smoothness between neighbours matters more than absolute coordinates. Tunnel temperature, cooling water and ground vibration all move magnets through the girders, and magnet errors reach the source point amplified by the closed orbit, so thermal control, girder stiffness and feedback bandwidth must be designed together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Alignment network, thermal control and ground vibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：5 m 鋼製樑架、α = 12 ppm/K：溫度變化 0.1 K 使長度變 6 µm，1 K 變 60 µm，已超過 50 µm 的相鄰對準規格，故隧道需控溫到 ±0.1 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 5 m steel girder with α = 12 ppm/K changes length by 6 µm for 0.1 K and by 60 µm for 1 K, already beyond the 50 µm neighbour alignment specification, so the tunnel is held to ±0.1 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲存環對準一次完成後就永久有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the ring is aligned, it stays aligned." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「對準網、溫控與地面振動」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Alignment network, thermal control and ground vibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合
knowledge.titleEn: Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration
knowledge.text: 844 m 的環由 32 個單元的樑架組成，先用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平系統建立全環網，再把相鄰磁鐵的相對誤差壓到 50 µm 等級；對束流而言相鄰元件的平滑度比絕對座標更重要。隧道溫度、冷卻水與地面振動都會透過樑架改變磁鐵位置，而磁鐵位置的誤差經閉軌放大後進入光源點，所以熱控、樑架剛性與回授頻寬必須一起設計。
knowledge.textEn: The 844 m ring is assembled from the girders of 32 cells: a laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling build the ring-wide network, then neighbouring magnets are aligned to each other at the 50 µm level, because for the beam the smoothness between neighbours matters more than absolute coordinates. Tunnel temperature, cooling water and ground vibration all move magnets through the girders, and magnet errors reach the source point amplified by the closed orbit, so thermal control, girder stiffness and feedback bandwidth must be designed together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲存環對準一次完成後就永久有效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the ring is aligned, it stays aligned. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration" is correct?
options: 儲存環對準一次完成後就永久有效。
844 m 的環由 32 個單元的樑架組成，先用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平系統建立全環網，再把相鄰磁鐵的相對誤差壓到 50 µm 等級。
儲存環能存到 200 mA 就代表驗收完成。
optionsEn: Once the ring is aligned, it stays aligned.

The 844 m ring is assembled from the girders of 32 cells: a laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling build the ring-wide network, then neighbouring magnets are aligned to each other at the 50 µm level, because for the beam the smoothness between neighbours matters more than absolute coordinates.
Storing 200 mA means the ring is accepted.
quiz.explanation: 844 m 的環由 32 個單元的樑架組成，先用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平系統建立全環網，再把相鄰磁鐵的相對誤差壓到 50 µm 等級；對束流而言相鄰元件的平滑度比絕對座標更重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The 844 m ring is assembled from the girders of 32 cells: a laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling build the ring-wide network, then neighbouring magnets are aligned to each other at the 50 µm level, because for the beam the smoothness between neighbours matters more than absolute coordinates. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「對準網、溫控與地面振動」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment network, thermal control and ground vibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：5 m 鋼製樑架、α = 12 ppm/K：溫度變化 0.1 K 使長度變 6 µm，1 K 變 60 µm，已超過 50 µm 的相鄰對準規格，故隧道需控溫到 ±0.1 K。地面沉降改變周長時射頻頻率必須跟著走：ΔL = 1 mm 對 843.977 m 得 Δf = f·ΔL/L = 352.2 MHz×1.18×10⁻⁶ ≈ 417 Hz，否則束流走到離能軌道。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 5 m steel girder with α = 12 ppm/K changes length by 6 µm for 0.1 K and by 60 µm for 1 K, already beyond the 50 µm neighbour alignment specification, so the tunnel is held to ±0.1 K. When ground settlement changes the circumference the RF frequency must follow: ΔL = 1 mm on 843.977 m gives Δf = f·ΔL/L = 352.2 MHz×1.18×10⁻⁶ ≈ 417 Hz, otherwise the beam moves to an off-energy orbit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期做對準網閉合差檢查與靜水壓水平紀錄；在樑架與地板同時放地震計取得傳遞函數，確認樑架第一共振高於地面振動主要頻段；以束流量測：記錄隧道溫度激變期間的軌道與射頻頻率變化，並由軌道響應判斷哪一段樑架移動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check alignment-network closure and hydrostatic-levelling logs regularly; place seismometers on girder and floor simultaneously to get the transfer function and confirm that the first girder resonance lies above the main ground-motion band; with beam, log orbit and RF-frequency changes during tunnel temperature excursions and use the orbit response to identify which girder moved.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 5 m 鋼製樑架、α = 12 ppm/K：溫度變化 0.1 K 使長度變 6 µm，1 K 變 60 µm，已超過 50 µm 的相鄰對準規格，故隧道需控溫到 ±0.1 K。地面沉降改變周長時射頻頻率必須跟著走：ΔL = 1 mm 對 843.977 m 得 Δf = f·ΔL/L = 352.2 MHz×1.18×10⁻⁶ ≈ 417 Hz，否則束流走到離能軌道。
knowledge.textEn: A 5 m steel girder with α = 12 ppm/K changes length by 6 µm for 0.1 K and by 60 µm for 1 K, already beyond the 50 µm neighbour alignment specification, so the tunnel is held to ±0.1 K. When ground settlement changes the circumference the RF frequency must follow: ΔL = 1 mm on 843.977 m gives Δf = f·ΔL/L = 352.2 MHz×1.18×10⁻⁶ ≈ 417 Hz, otherwise the beam moves to an off-energy orbit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration", which statement holds?
options: 把彎轉磁鐵切得越多越細，發射度就能無限制下降。
真空腔越小，體積越小，所以越容易抽到好真空。
5 m 鋼製樑架、α = 12 ppm/K：溫度變化 0.1 K 使長度變 6 µm，1 K 變 60 µm，已超過 50 µm 的相鄰對準規格，故隧道需控溫到 ±0.1 K。
optionsEn: Slicing the bends ever finer lowers emittance without limit.
A smaller chamber is easier to pump because its volume is smaller.
A 5 m steel girder with α = 12 ppm/K changes length by 6 µm for 0.1 K and by 60 µm for 1 K, already beyond the 50 µm neighbour alignment specification, so the tunnel is held to ±0.1 K.
quiz.explanation: 5 m 鋼製樑架、α = 12 ppm/K：溫度變化 0.1 K 使長度變 6 µm，1 K 變 60 µm，已超過 50 µm 的相鄰對準規格，故隧道需控溫到 ±0.1 K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 5 m steel girder with α = 12 ppm/K changes length by 6 µm for 0.1 K and by 60 µm for 1 K, already beyond the 50 µm neighbour alignment specification, so the tunnel is held to ±0.1 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「對準網、溫控與地面振動」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Alignment network, thermal control and ground vibration” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 定期做對準網閉合差檢查與靜水壓水平紀錄；在樑架與地板同時放地震計取得傳遞函數，確認樑架第一共振高於地面振動主要頻段；以束流量測：記錄隧道溫度激變期間的軌道與射頻頻率變化，並由軌道響應判斷哪一段樑架移動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check alignment-network closure and hydrostatic-levelling logs regularly; place seismometers on girder and floor simultaneously to get the transfer function and confirm that the first girder resonance lies above the main ground-motion band; with beam, log orbit and RF-frequency changes during tunnel temperature excursions and use the orbit response to identify which girder moved. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把對準當成一次性的安裝工作，季節性地面沉降與冷卻水溫變化會在幾個月內讓軌道校正磁鐵的強度逐漸飽和，回授失去餘裕，最後需要停機重新對準整段。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating alignment as a one-time installation task lets seasonal ground settlement and cooling-water temperature changes saturate the orbit correctors within months, the feedback loses margin, and a shutdown to re-align a whole section becomes necessary.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期做對準網閉合差檢查與靜水壓水平紀錄；在樑架與地板同時放地震計取得傳遞函數，確認樑架第一共振高於地面振動主要頻段；以束流量測：記錄隧道溫度激變期間的軌道與射頻頻率變化，並由軌道響應判斷哪一段樑架移動。
knowledge.textEn: Check alignment-network closure and hydrostatic-levelling logs regularly; place seismometers on girder and floor simultaneously to get the transfer function and confirm that the first girder resonance lies above the main ground-motion band; with beam, log orbit and RF-frequency changes during tunnel temperature excursions and use the orbit response to identify which girder moved.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration"?
options: 定期做對準網閉合差檢查與靜水壓水平紀錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
軌道回授開著且 BPM 讀值為零，光源點就一定沒有移動。
optionsEn: Check alignment-network closure and hydrostatic-levelling logs regularly.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With feedback on and BPMs reading zero, the source point cannot have moved.
quiz.explanation: 定期做對準網閉合差檢查與靜水壓水平紀錄；在樑架與地板同時放地震計取得傳遞函數，確認樑架第一共振高於地面振動主要頻段；以束流量測：記錄隧道溫度激變期間的軌道與射頻頻率變化，並由軌道響應判斷哪一段樑架移動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check alignment-network closure and hydrostatic-levelling logs regularly; place seismometers on girder and floor simultaneously to get the transfer function and confirm that the first girder resonance lies above the main ground-motion band; with beam, log orbit and RF-frequency changes during tunnel temperature excursions and use the orbit response to identify which girder moved. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「對準網、溫控與地面振動」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Alignment network, thermal control and ground vibration” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把對準當成一次性的安裝工作，季節性地面沉降與冷卻水溫變化會在幾個月內讓軌道校正磁鐵的強度逐漸飽和，回授失去餘裕，最後需要停機重新對準整段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating alignment as a one-time installation task lets seasonal ground settlement and cooling-water temperature changes saturate the orbit correctors within months, the feedback loses margin, and a shutdown to re-align a whole section becomes necessary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：隧道溫度、冷卻水與地面振動都會透過樑架改變磁鐵位置，而磁鐵位置的誤差經閉軌放大後進入光源點，所以熱控、樑架剛性與回授頻寬必須一起設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tunnel temperature, cooling water and ground vibration all move magnets through the girders, and magnet errors reach the source point amplified by the closed orbit, so thermal control, girder stiffness and feedback bandwidth must be designed together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲存環對準一次完成後就永久有效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the ring is aligned, it stays aligned." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把對準當成一次性的安裝工作，季節性地面沉降與冷卻水溫變化會在幾個月內讓軌道校正磁鐵的強度逐漸飽和，回授失去餘裕，最後需要停機重新對準整段。
knowledge.textEn: Treating alignment as a one-time installation task lets seasonal ground settlement and cooling-water temperature changes saturate the orbit correctors within months, the feedback loses margin, and a shutdown to re-align a whole section becomes necessary.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全環對準、熱漂移與振動整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring-wide alignment, thermal drift and vibration integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若把對準當成一次性的安裝工作，季節性地面沉降與冷卻水溫變化會在幾個月內讓軌道校正磁鐵的強度逐漸飽和，回授失去餘裕，最後需要停機重新對準整段。
儲存環能存到 200 mA 就代表驗收完成。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Treating alignment as a one-time installation task lets seasonal ground settlement and cooling-water temperature changes saturate the orbit correctors within months, the feedback loses margin, and a shutdown to re-align a whole section becomes necessary.
Storing 200 mA means the ring is accepted.
quiz.explanation: 若把對準當成一次性的安裝工作，季節性地面沉降與冷卻水溫變化會在幾個月內讓軌道校正磁鐵的強度逐漸飽和，回授失去餘裕，最後需要停機重新對準整段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating alignment as a one-time installation task lets seasonal ground settlement and cooling-water temperature changes saturate the orbit correctors within months, the feedback loses margin, and a shutdown to re-align a whole section becomes necessary. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「調試里程碑與驗收報告」如何決定歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning milestones and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “European Synchrotron Radiation Facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 升級後的調試分階段推進：第一圈、儲存束流、以軌道響應矩陣（LOCO）修正線性晶格、耦合校正、電流爬到 200 mA、壽命與注入效率，最後交給使用者。驗收不是單一指標，而是發射度、壽命、軌道穩定度、注入效率與光束線通量比值的整組紀錄；頂注運轉把電流維持在 ±1% 內，使光學元件的熱負載恆定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「調試里程碑與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Post-upgrade commissioning proceeds in stages: first turn, stored beam, linear-lattice correction from the orbit response matrix (LOCO), coupling correction, current ramp to 200 mA, lifetime and injection efficiency, then user delivery. Acceptance is not one number but a set of records: emittance, lifetime, orbit stability, injection efficiency and beamline flux ratios; top-up operation keeps the current within ±1% so that the heat load on optics stays constant. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning milestones and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：均勻填充 200 mA、壽命 25 h：衰減率 dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With uniform filling at 200 mA and a 25 h lifetime, the decay rate is dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲存環能存到 200 mA 就代表驗收完成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Storing 200 mA means the ring is accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「調試里程碑與驗收報告」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Commissioning milestones and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收
knowledge.titleEn: Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance
knowledge.text: 升級後的調試分階段推進：第一圈、儲存束流、以軌道響應矩陣（LOCO）修正線性晶格、耦合校正、電流爬到 200 mA、壽命與注入效率，最後交給使用者。驗收不是單一指標，而是發射度、壽命、軌道穩定度、注入效率與光束線通量比值的整組紀錄；頂注運轉把電流維持在 ±1% 內，使光學元件的熱負載恆定。
knowledge.textEn: Post-upgrade commissioning proceeds in stages: first turn, stored beam, linear-lattice correction from the orbit response matrix (LOCO), coupling correction, current ramp to 200 mA, lifetime and injection efficiency, then user delivery. Acceptance is not one number but a set of records: emittance, lifetime, orbit stability, injection efficiency and beamline flux ratios; top-up operation keeps the current within ±1% so that the heat load on optics stays constant.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲存環能存到 200 mA 就代表驗收完成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Storing 200 mA means the ring is accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance" is correct?
options: 儲存環能存到 200 mA 就代表驗收完成。
提高電子能量只是讓光更亮，不會改變光譜形狀。
升級後的調試分階段推進：第一圈、儲存束流、以軌道響應矩陣（LOCO）修正線性晶格、耦合校正、電流爬到 200 mA、壽命與注入效率，最後交給使用者。
optionsEn: Storing 200 mA means the ring is accepted.
Raising electron energy only makes the light brighter; it does not change the spectrum.

Post-upgrade commissioning proceeds in stages: first turn, stored beam, linear-lattice correction from the orbit response matrix (LOCO), coupling correction, current ramp to 200 mA, lifetime and injection efficiency, then user delivery.
quiz.explanation: 升級後的調試分階段推進：第一圈、儲存束流、以軌道響應矩陣（LOCO）修正線性晶格、耦合校正、電流爬到 200 mA、壽命與注入效率，最後交給使用者。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Post-upgrade commissioning proceeds in stages: first turn, stored beam, linear-lattice correction from the orbit response matrix (LOCO), coupling correction, current ramp to 200 mA, lifetime and injection efficiency, then user delivery. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「調試里程碑與驗收報告」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Commissioning milestones and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：均勻填充 200 mA、壽命 25 h：衰減率 dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h。要把電流維持在 ±0.5%（1 mA）內，每 7.5 分鐘需補注 1 mA；注入效率 90% 時每次需 1.1 mA 的注入束流。4 束團模式 40 mA 壽命只有 5 h，衰減率同為 8 mA/h，但相對變化大 5 倍，頂注頻率需相應提高。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With uniform filling at 200 mA and a 25 h lifetime, the decay rate is dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h. Holding current within ±0.5% (1 mA) requires a 1 mA top-up every 7.5 minutes, and at 90% injection efficiency each top-up needs 1.1 mA of injected beam. The 4-bunch mode at 40 mA has only a 5 h lifetime: the same 8 mA/h decay but a five times larger relative change, so top-up must be more frequent. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用 DCCT 記錄每次注入前後的電流差求注入效率；以電流對時間曲線擬合壽命並拆成真空壽命與 Touschek 壽命（改變束團數比較）；在兩到三條光束線用相同的光學配置比較升級前後的通量與聚焦斑；最後把 24 小時頂注運轉的軌道、電流與溫度紀錄附進驗收報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log the current difference before and after each injection with a DCCT to get injection efficiency; fit lifetime from the current-time curve and split it into vacuum and Touschek parts by changing bunch count; compare flux and focal spot before and after the upgrade on two or three beamlines with identical optics; and attach the 24 h top-up logs of orbit, current and temperature to the acceptance record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 均勻填充 200 mA、壽命 25 h：衰減率 dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h。要把電流維持在 ±0.5%（1 mA）內，每 7.5 分鐘需補注 1 mA；注入效率 90% 時每次需 1.1 mA 的注入束流。4 束團模式 40 mA 壽命只有 5 h，衰減率同為 8 mA/h，但相對變化大 5 倍，頂注頻率需相應提高。
knowledge.textEn: With uniform filling at 200 mA and a 25 h lifetime, the decay rate is dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h. Holding current within ±0.5% (1 mA) requires a 1 mA top-up every 7.5 minutes, and at 90% injection efficiency each top-up needs 1.1 mA of injected beam. The 4-bunch mode at 40 mA has only a 5 h lifetime: the same 8 mA/h decay but a five times larger relative change, so top-up must be more frequent.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 均勻填充 200 mA、壽命 25 h：衰減率 dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h。
永磁彎轉磁鐵不用電，所以它的場強永遠不會變。
軌道回授開著且 BPM 讀值為零，光源點就一定沒有移動。
optionsEn: With uniform filling at 200 mA and a 25 h lifetime, the decay rate is dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h.
Permanent-magnet bends draw no power, so their field never changes.
With feedback on and BPMs reading zero, the source point cannot have moved.
quiz.explanation: 均勻填充 200 mA、壽命 25 h：衰減率 dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With uniform filling at 200 mA and a 25 h lifetime, the decay rate is dI/dt = I/τ = 200 mA/25 h = 8 mA/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「調試里程碑與驗收報告」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Commissioning milestones and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用 DCCT 記錄每次注入前後的電流差求注入效率；以電流對時間曲線擬合壽命並拆成真空壽命與 Touschek 壽命（改變束團數比較）；在兩到三條光束線用相同的光學配置比較升級前後的通量與聚焦斑；最後把 24 小時頂注運轉的軌道、電流與溫度紀錄附進驗收報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the current difference before and after each injection with a DCCT to get injection efficiency; fit lifetime from the current-time curve and split it into vacuum and Touschek parts by changing bunch count; compare flux and focal spot before and after the upgrade on two or three beamlines with identical optics; and attach the 24 h top-up logs of orbit, current and temperature to the acceptance record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：壽命若被殘餘耦合與高束團密度的 Touschek 散射限制，頂注頻率升高，每次注入的踢擊與輻射劑量增加，光束線快門頻繁關閉，使用者的有效束流時間反而下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If lifetime is limited by residual coupling and Touschek scattering at high bunch density, top-up frequency rises, each injection adds kicks and radiation dose, beamline shutters close often, and the users' effective beam time actually falls.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用 DCCT 記錄每次注入前後的電流差求注入效率；以電流對時間曲線擬合壽命並拆成真空壽命與 Touschek 壽命（改變束團數比較）；在兩到三條光束線用相同的光學配置比較升級前後的通量與聚焦斑；最後把 24 小時頂注運轉的軌道、電流與溫度紀錄附進驗收報告。
knowledge.textEn: Log the current difference before and after each injection with a DCCT to get injection efficiency; fit lifetime from the current-time curve and split it into vacuum and Touschek parts by changing bunch count; compare flux and focal spot before and after the upgrade on two or three beamlines with identical optics; and attach the 24 h top-up logs of orbit, current and temperature to the acceptance record.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用 DCCT 記錄每次注入前後的電流差求注入效率。
亮度就是通量，光子數越多亮度一定越高。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Log the current difference before and after each injection with a DCCT to get injection efficiency.
Brilliance is just flux; more photons always means more brilliance.
quiz.explanation: 用 DCCT 記錄每次注入前後的電流差求注入效率；以電流對時間曲線擬合壽命並拆成真空壽命與 Touschek 壽命（改變束團數比較）；在兩到三條光束線用相同的光學配置比較升級前後的通量與聚焦斑；最後把 24 小時頂注運轉的軌道、電流與溫度紀錄附進驗收報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log the current difference before and after each injection with a DCCT to get injection efficiency; fit lifetime from the current-time curve and split it into vacuum and Touschek parts by changing bunch count; compare flux and focal spot before and after the upgrade on two or three beamlines with identical optics; and attach the 24 h top-up logs of orbit, current and temperature to the acceptance record. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調試里程碑與驗收報告」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Commissioning milestones and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 壽命若被殘餘耦合與高束團密度的 Touschek 散射限制，頂注頻率升高，每次注入的踢擊與輻射劑量增加，光束線快門頻繁關閉，使用者的有效束流時間反而下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If lifetime is limited by residual coupling and Touschek scattering at high bunch density, top-up frequency rises, each injection adds kicks and radiation dose, beamline shutters close often, and the users' effective beam time actually falls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收不是單一指標，而是發射度、壽命、軌道穩定度、注入效率與光束線通量比值的整組紀錄；頂注運轉把電流維持在 ±1% 內，使光學元件的熱負載恆定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance is not one number but a set of records: emittance, lifetime, orbit stability, injection efficiency and beamline flux ratios; top-up operation keeps the current within ±1% so that the heat load on optics stays constant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲存環能存到 200 mA 就代表驗收完成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Storing 200 mA means the ring is accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「調試、頂注運轉與性能驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Commissioning, top-up operation and performance acceptance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
提高電子能量只是讓光更亮，不會改變光譜形狀。
壽命若被殘餘耦合與高束團密度的 Touschek 散射限制，頂注頻率升高，每次注入的踢擊與輻射劑量增加，光束線快門頻繁關閉，使用者的有效束流時間反而下降。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Raising electron energy only makes the light brighter; it does not change the spectrum.

quiz.explanationEn: If lifetime is limited by residual coupling and Touschek scattering at high bunch density, top-up frequency rises, each injection adds kicks and radiation dose, beamline shutters close often, and the users' effective beam time actually falls. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施
summary: 以 Diamond 的 3 GeV、561.6 m、24 單元雙彎消色散儲存環為對象，從 499.68 MHz 射頻與 936 個束團桶出發，理解中能量光源如何靠真空內波盪器的高次諧波取得硬 X 光、如何管理前端熱負載，再推導 Diamond-II 把能量提高到 3.5 GeV 並換成 DTBA 晶格後，發射度、光子能量與光束線必須同步調整的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Using Diamond's 3 GeV, 561.6 m, 24-cell double-bend achromat ring, start from the 499.68 MHz RF and 936 buckets to see how a medium-energy source reaches hard X-rays through the high harmonics of in-vacuum undulators and manages front-end heat load, then derive why Diamond-II's move to 3.5 GeV and a DTBA lattice forces emittance, photon energy and beamlines to be re-engineered together.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 大型加速器與光源設施

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 波盪器升級練習：Diamond 一支 2 m、λ_u = 23 mm（N = 87）的真空內波盪器，以經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)] 在 g = 6 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 0.90 T，K = 0.934×0.90×2.3 ≈ 1.94。3 GeV 時 γ² = 3.45×10⁷，基頻 λ₁ = 0.023×(1+1.94²/2)/(2×3.45×10⁷) ≈ 9.6 Å（1.29 keV），第 5 諧波約 6.5 keV，第 7 諧波約 9.0 keV。升到 3.5 GeV 後 γ² = 4.69×10⁷，同一間隙的所有諧波乘以 1.36：第 5 諧波變 8.8 keV、第 7 諧波變 12.3 keV。總功率 P = 0.633×E²×B₀²×L×I：3 GeV、0.3 A 時 0.633×9×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 2.8 kW；3.5 GeV 時 0.633×12.25×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 3.8 kW，前端吸收器與單色器冷卻必須按 3.8 kW 重新核算。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Undulator upgrade exercise: a Diamond 2 m in-vacuum undulator with λ_u = 23 mm (N = 87) gives, from the fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)], B₀ ≈ 0.90 T at g = 6 mm and K = 0.934×0.90×2.3 ≈ 1.94. At 3 GeV, γ² = 3.45×10⁷ and the fundamental is λ₁ = 0.023×(1+1.94²/2)/(2×3.45×10⁷) ≈ 9.6 Å (1.29 keV), with the 5th harmonic near 6.5 keV and the 7th near 9.0 keV. At 3.5 GeV, γ² = 4.69×10⁷ and every harmonic at the same gap is multiplied by 1.36: the 5th moves to 8.8 keV and the 7th to 12.3 keV. Total power P = 0.633×E²×B₀²×L×I is 0.633×9×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 2.8 kW at 3 GeV and 0.3 A, and 0.633×12.25×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 3.8 kW at 3.5 GeV, so front-end absorbers and monochromator cooling must be re-rated for 3.8 kW. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構」與「中能量環的發射度與升級標度律」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure" and "Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」如何決定Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF” determines the key performance of “Diamond Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲存環的周長與射頻頻率決定諧波數 h = C/λ_RF，也就是能放束團的桶數；Diamond 周長 561.571 m、射頻 499.680 MHz，迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz，最多 936 個束團，相鄰束團間隔 2 ns。1.4 T 的彎轉磁鐵決定臨界能量與每圈的輻射損失，而 300 mA 的儲存電流決定射頻系統必須送進束流的功率。使用者看到的時間結構（混合填充、單束團模式）全由這組參數定義。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Circumference and RF frequency fix the harmonic number h = C/λ_RF, the number of buckets that can hold bunches: Diamond has C = 561.571 m, RF at 499.680 MHz, a revolution frequency of 533.8 kHz, up to 936 bunches and a 2 ns spacing between neighbours. The 1.4 T dipoles set the critical energy and the radiation loss per turn, while the 300 mA stored current sets the power the RF system must deliver to the beam. Every time structure users see, hybrid fills or single-bunch mode, is defined by this parameter set. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: h = C·f_RF/c = 561.571 m×499.680 MHz/299 792 458 m/s = 936, and the bunch spacing is 1/f_RF = 2.00 ns.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲存環裡的電子是連續的電流，沒有時間結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Electrons in a storage ring form a continuous current with no time structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構
knowledge.titleEn: Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure
knowledge.text: 儲存環的周長與射頻頻率決定諧波數 h = C/λ_RF，也就是能放束團的桶數；Diamond 周長 561.571 m、射頻 499.680 MHz，迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz，最多 936 個束團，相鄰束團間隔 2 ns。1.4 T 的彎轉磁鐵決定臨界能量與每圈的輻射損失，而 300 mA 的儲存電流決定射頻系統必須送進束流的功率。
knowledge.textEn: Circumference and RF frequency fix the harmonic number h = C/λ_RF, the number of buckets that can hold bunches: Diamond has C = 561.571 m, RF at 499.680 MHz, a revolution frequency of 533.8 kHz, up to 936 bunches and a 2 ns spacing between neighbours. The 1.4 T dipoles set the critical energy and the radiation loss per turn, while the 300 mA stored current sets the power the RF system must deliver to the beam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲存環裡的電子是連續的電流，沒有時間結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Electrons in a storage ring form a continuous current with no time structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure" is correct?
options: 儲存環裡的電子是連續的電流，沒有時間結構。
儲存環的周長與射頻頻率決定諧波數 h = C/λ_RF，也就是能放束團的桶數。
提高電子能量一定會讓發射度變差，所以升級不該升能量。
optionsEn: Electrons in a storage ring form a continuous current with no time structure.

Circumference and RF frequency fix the harmonic number h = C/λ_RF, the number of buckets that can hold bunches: Diamond has C = 561.571 m, RF at 499.680 MHz, a revolution frequency of 533.8 kHz, up to 936 bunches and a 2 ns spacing between neighbours.
Raising electron energy always worsens emittance, so an upgrade should never raise energy.
quiz.explanation: 儲存環的周長與射頻頻率決定諧波數 h = C/λ_RF，也就是能放束團的桶數；Diamond 周長 561.571 m、射頻 499.680 MHz，迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz，最多 936 個束團，相鄰束團間隔 2 ns。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Circumference and RF frequency fix the harmonic number h = C/λ_RF, the number of buckets that can hold bunches: Diamond has C = 561.571 m, RF at 499.680 MHz, a revolution frequency of 533.8 kHz, up to 936 bunches and a 2 ns spacing between neighbours. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：h = C·f_RF/c = 561.571 m×499.680 MHz/299 792 458 m/s = 936；束團間隔 1/f_RF = 2.00 ns。臨界能量 ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×9×1.4 ≈ 8.4 keV；彎轉半徑 ρ = 7.15 m 時每圈損失 U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/7.15 ≈ 1.0 MeV，300 mA 下輻射功率 P = U₀·I ≈ 0.30 MW，尚未計入插件磁鐵。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: h = C·f_RF/c = 561.571 m×499.680 MHz/299 792 458 m/s = 936, and the bunch spacing is 1/f_RF = 2.00 ns. Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×9×1.4 ≈ 8.4 keV; with bending radius ρ = 7.15 m the loss per turn is U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/7.15 ≈ 1.0 MeV, so at 300 mA the radiated power is P = U₀·I ≈ 0.30 MW before insertion devices. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用束流位置監測器的迴轉諧波或條紋相機核對迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz 與 2 ns 束團間隔；以填充圖監視器（快速 ADC 逐桶積分）確認填充模式；把射頻送入束流的功率與 U₀·I 比較，再用彎轉磁鐵光束線的吸收片穿透曲線反推 8.4 keV 的臨界能量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm the 533.8 kHz revolution frequency and 2 ns spacing from BPM revolution harmonics or a streak camera; verify the fill pattern with a fill-pattern monitor (fast ADC integrating each bucket); compare RF power delivered to the beam with U₀·I, and back out the 8.4 keV critical energy from absorber transmission curves on a bending-magnet beamline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: h = C·f_RF/c = 561.571 m×499.680 MHz/299 792 458 m/s = 936, and the bunch spacing is 1/f_RF = 2.00 ns. Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×9×1.4 ≈ 8.4 keV; with bending radius ρ = 7.15 m the loss per turn is U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/7.15 ≈ 1.0 MeV, so at 300 mA the radiated power is P = U₀·I ≈ 0.30 MW before insertion devices.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure", which statement holds?
options: 射頻電壓只要夠補回每圈損失的能量就足夠。
單色器只挑出很窄的頻寬，所以幾乎沒有熱負載。
optionsEn: RF voltage only needs to cover the energy lost per turn.
A monochromator selects a narrow bandwidth, so it carries almost no heat load.
h = C·f_RF/c = 561.571 m×499.680 MHz/299 792 458 m/s = 936, and the bunch spacing is 1/f_RF = 2.00 ns.
quiz.explanationEn: h = C·f_RF/c = 561.571 m×499.680 MHz/299 792 458 m/s = 936, and the bunch spacing is 1/f_RF = 2.00 ns. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用束流位置監測器的迴轉諧波或條紋相機核對迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz 與 2 ns 束團間隔；以填充圖監視器（快速 ADC 逐桶積分）確認填充模式；把射頻送入束流的功率與 U₀·I 比較，再用彎轉磁鐵光束線的吸收片穿透曲線反推 8.4 keV 的臨界能量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm the 533.8 kHz revolution frequency and 2 ns spacing from BPM revolution harmonics or a streak camera; verify the fill pattern with a fill-pattern monitor (fast ADC integrating each bucket); compare RF power delivered to the beam with U₀·I, and back out the 8.4 keV critical energy from absorber transmission curves on a bending-magnet beamline. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若周長因地基沉降改變而射頻頻率未跟隨，束流被迫走離能軌道，能量偏移經色散轉成軌道偏移，所有光束線的光子能量同時微幅漂移，卻沒有任何單一設備報警。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the circumference changes through ground settlement and the RF frequency does not follow, the beam is forced onto an off-energy orbit, the energy offset turns into an orbit offset through dispersion, and the photon energy on every beamline drifts slightly at once without any single device raising an alarm.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若周長因地基沉降改變而射頻頻率未跟隨，束流被迫走離能軌道，能量偏移經色散轉成軌道偏移，所有光束線的光子能量同時微幅漂移，卻沒有任何單一設備報警。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the circumference changes through ground settlement and the RF frequency does not follow, the beam is forced onto an off-energy orbit, the energy offset turns into an orbit offset through dispersion, and the photon energy on every beamline drifts slightly at once without any single device raising an alarm. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用者看到的時間結構（混合填充、單束團模式）全由這組參數定義。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲存環裡的電子是連續的電流，沒有時間結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Electrons in a storage ring form a continuous current with no time structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 中能量環的發射度與升級標度律：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格」如何決定Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice” determines the key performance of “Diamond Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Diamond 原始晶格是 24 單元雙彎消色散，水平發射度 3.14 nm·rad，垂直 8 pm·rad。發射度隨 γ²θ³ 變化：Diamond-II 一方面把能量提高到 3.5 GeV（γ² 增加 36%），另一方面以雙三彎消色散（DTBA）把每單元彎轉數從 2 增到 6，θ³ 的縮減遠勝 γ² 的增加，同時在單元中段多出一個直線段，讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改由短插件供光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diamond's original lattice is a 24-cell double-bend achromat with 3.14 nm·rad horizontal and 8 pm·rad vertical emittance. Emittance scales as γ²θ³: Diamond-II raises the energy to 3.5 GeV, a 36% increase in γ², but the double-triple-bend achromat (DTBA) raises the bends per cell from 2 to 6, and the θ³ reduction far outweighs the γ² increase, while a new mid-cell straight lets former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³，C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³ with C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提高電子能量一定會讓發射度變差，所以升級不該升能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Raising electron energy always worsens emittance, so an upgrade should never raise energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Emittance scales as γ²θ³: Diamond-II raises the energy to 3.5 GeV, a 36% increase in γ², but the double-triple-bend achromat (DTBA) raises the bends per cell from 2 to 6, and the θ³ reduction far outweighs the γ² increase, while a new mid-cell straight lets former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices.

knowledge.text: 誤解：提高電子能量一定會讓發射度變差，所以升級不該升能量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Raising electron energy always worsens emittance, so an upgrade should never raise energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「中能量環的發射度與升級標度律」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling" is correct?
options: 提高電子能量一定會讓發射度變差，所以升級不該升能量。
波盪器只是把許多彎轉磁鐵串起來，光譜就是彎轉磁鐵光譜的疊加。
Diamond 原始晶格是 24 單元雙彎消色散，水平發射度 3.14 nm·rad，垂直 8 pm·rad。
optionsEn: Raising electron energy always worsens emittance, so an upgrade should never raise energy.
An undulator is just many bending magnets in series, so its spectrum is a sum of bend spectra.
Diamond's original lattice is a 24-cell double-bend achromat with 3.14 nm·rad horizontal and 8 pm·rad vertical emittance.
quiz.explanation: Diamond 原始晶格是 24 單元雙彎消色散，水平發射度 3.14 nm·rad，垂直 8 pm·rad。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diamond's original lattice is a 24-cell double-bend achromat with 3.14 nm·rad horizontal and 8 pm·rad vertical emittance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 中能量環的發射度與升級標度律：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³，C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m。現行 48 彎、3 GeV：γ² = 3.45×10⁷，θ = 131 mrad，F_DBA = 0.0645，得 ε ≈ 1.9 nm·rad（實際 3.14 nm，因實際光學偏離理想）。Diamond-II 144 彎、3.5 GeV：γ² = 4.69×10⁷，θ = 43.6 mrad，同一 F 給約 96 pm·rad，理論極限 F_TME = 0.0215 給約 32 pm；設計值約 160 pm·rad 等級，比現行低約 20 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³ with C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m. Present ring, 48 bends at 3 GeV: γ² = 3.45×10⁷, θ = 131 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645 gives ε ≈ 1.9 nm·rad (actual 3.14 nm because real optics depart from the ideal). Diamond-II, 144 bends at 3.5 GeV: γ² = 4.69×10⁷, θ = 43.6 mrad, the same F gives about 96 pm·rad and the TME limit F = 0.0215 about 32 pm; the design value is of order 160 pm·rad, roughly 20 times below today. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 LOCO 把量測的軌道響應矩陣擬合成晶格模型，取出各處 β 與色散，再從 X 光針孔相機的束流影像反推水平與垂直發射度；比較擬合模型的自然發射度與 γ²θ³ 標度估計值，差異應能歸因於實際的彎轉磁鐵長度與色散分佈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit the measured orbit response matrix to the lattice model with LOCO to extract β and dispersion everywhere, then infer horizontal and vertical emittance from X-ray pinhole-camera images; compare the fitted model's natural emittance with the γ²θ³ scaling estimate, and attribute the difference to the real bend lengths and dispersion distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Present ring, 48 bends at 3 GeV: γ² = 3.45×10⁷, θ = 131 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645 gives ε ≈ 1.9 nm·rad (actual 3.14 nm because real optics depart from the ideal). Diamond-II, 144 bends at 3.5 GeV: γ² = 4.69×10⁷, θ = 43.6 mrad, the same F gives about 96 pm·rad and the TME limit F = 0.0215 about 32 pm; the design value is of order 160 pm·rad, roughly 20 times below today.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「中能量環的發射度與升級標度律」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling", which statement holds?
options: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³，C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m。

steps.title: 中能量環的發射度與升級標度律：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 LOCO 把量測的軌道響應矩陣擬合成晶格模型，取出各處 β 與色散，再從 X 光針孔相機的束流影像反推水平與垂直發射度；比較擬合模型的自然發射度與 γ²θ³ 標度估計值，差異應能歸因於實際的彎轉磁鐵長度與色散分佈。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit the measured orbit response matrix to the lattice model with LOCO to extract β and dispersion everywhere, then infer horizontal and vertical emittance from X-ray pinhole-camera images; compare the fitted model's natural emittance with the γ²θ³ scaling estimate, and attribute the difference to the real bend lengths and dispersion distribution. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：提高能量卻沒有同時重算所有波盪器的光子能量表與熱負載，升級後每條光束線的諧波位置與前端功率都偏離原設計，光學元件在錯誤的功率密度下運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the energy without recomputing every undulator's photon-energy table and heat load leaves each beamline's harmonic positions and front-end power off their original design after the upgrade, with optics running at the wrong power density.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 以 LOCO 把量測的軌道響應矩陣擬合成晶格模型，取出各處 β 與色散，再從 X 光針孔相機的束流影像反推水平與垂直發射度；比較擬合模型的自然發射度與 γ²θ³ 標度估計值，差異應能歸因於實際的彎轉磁鐵長度與色散分佈。

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
