quiz.question: 要驗證「中能量環的發射度與升級標度律」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 LOCO 把量測的軌道響應矩陣擬合成晶格模型，取出各處 β 與色散，再從 X 光針孔相機的束流影像反推水平與垂直發射度。
達到設計發射度與電流就等於設施驗收完成。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Fit the measured orbit response matrix to the lattice model with LOCO to extract β and dispersion everywhere, then infer horizontal and vertical emittance from X-ray pinhole-camera images.
Reaching design emittance and current means the facility is accepted.
quiz.explanation: 以 LOCO 把量測的軌道響應矩陣擬合成晶格模型，取出各處 β 與色散，再從 X 光針孔相機的束流影像反推水平與垂直發射度；比較擬合模型的自然發射度與 γ²θ³ 標度估計值，差異應能歸因於實際的彎轉磁鐵長度與色散分佈。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit the measured orbit response matrix to the lattice model with LOCO to extract β and dispersion everywhere, then infer horizontal and vertical emittance from X-ray pinhole-camera images; compare the fitted model's natural emittance with the γ²θ³ scaling estimate, and attribute the difference to the real bend lengths and dispersion distribution. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 中能量環的發射度與升級標度律：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 提高能量卻沒有同時重算所有波盪器的光子能量表與熱負載，升級後每條光束線的諧波位置與前端功率都偏離原設計，光學元件在錯誤的功率密度下運轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the energy without recomputing every undulator's photon-energy table and heat load leaves each beamline's harmonic positions and front-end power off their original design after the upgrade, with optics running at the wrong power density. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：發射度隨 γ²θ³ 變化：Diamond-II 一方面把能量提高到 3.5 GeV（γ² 增加 36%），另一方面以雙三彎消色散（DTBA）把每單元彎轉數從 2 增到 6，θ³ 的縮減遠勝 γ² 的增加，同時在單元中段多出一個直線段，讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改由短插件供光。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Emittance scales as γ²θ³: Diamond-II raises the energy to 3.5 GeV, a 36% increase in γ², but the double-triple-bend achromat (DTBA) raises the bends per cell from 2 to 6, and the θ³ reduction far outweighs the γ² increase, while a new mid-cell straight lets former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提高電子能量一定會讓發射度變差，所以升級不該升能量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Raising electron energy always worsens emittance, so an upgrade should never raise energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 提高能量卻沒有同時重算所有波盪器的光子能量表與熱負載，升級後每條光束線的諧波位置與前端功率都偏離原設計，光學元件在錯誤的功率密度下運轉。
knowledge.textEn: Raising the energy without recomputing every undulator's photon-energy table and heat load leaves each beamline's harmonic positions and front-end power off their original design after the upgrade, with optics running at the wrong power density.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「中能量環的發射度與升級標度律」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
波盪器只是把許多彎轉磁鐵串起來，光譜就是彎轉磁鐵光譜的疊加。
提高能量卻沒有同時重算所有波盪器的光子能量表與熱負載，升級後每條光束線的諧波位置與前端功率都偏離原設計，光學元件在錯誤的功率密度下運轉。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An undulator is just many bending magnets in series, so its spectrum is a sum of bend spectra.

Raising the energy without recomputing every undulator's photon-energy table and heat load leaves each beamline's harmonic positions and front-end power off their original design after the upgrade, with optics running at the wrong power density.
quiz.explanation: 提高能量卻沒有同時重算所有波盪器的光子能量表與熱負載，升級後每條光束線的諧波位置與前端功率都偏離原設計，光學元件在錯誤的功率密度下運轉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising the energy without recomputing every undulator's photon-energy table and heat load leaves each beamline's harmonic positions and front-end power off their original design after the upgrade, with optics running at the wrong power density. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波」與「射頻電壓、同步振盪與壽命」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Undulator K, gap and high harmonics" and "RF voltage, synchrotron oscillation and lifetime": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Undulator K, gap and high harmonics: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）」如何決定Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)” determines the key performance of “Diamond Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中能量環要取得硬 X 光，依賴短週期真空內波盪器與高次諧波。NdFeB 永磁與釩鐵鈷極頭組成的混合式磁列放在真空腔內，間隙可關到 5 mm；峰值磁場隨間隙近似指數下降，偏轉參數 K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] 決定基頻波長與各諧波的相對強度。基頻與奇數諧波在軸上最強，相位誤差則優先削弱高次諧波，所以磁列的機械精度直接換成硬 X 光通量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A medium-energy ring reaches hard X-rays through short-period in-vacuum undulators and their high harmonics. A hybrid array of NdFeB magnets and vanadium-permendur poles sits inside the vacuum chamber so the gap can close to 5 mm; the peak field falls roughly exponentially with gap, and the deflection parameter K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] sets the fundamental wavelength and the relative strength of each harmonic. The fundamental and odd harmonics are strongest on axis, and phase errors weaken the high harmonics first, so the mechanical precision of the array converts directly into hard X-ray flux. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：混合式磁列的峰值磁場經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]：週期 λ_u = 23 mm、間隙 g = 5 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 1.10 T、K ≈ 2.37；間隙開到 7 mm 得 0.74 T、K ≈ 1.60。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Hybrid-array fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]: with λ_u = 23 mm, g = 5 mm gives B₀ ≈ 1.10 T and K ≈ 2.37, g = 7 mm gives 0.74 T and K ≈ 1.60.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「波盪器只是把許多彎轉磁鐵串起來，光譜就是彎轉磁鐵光譜的疊加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An undulator is just many bending magnets in series, so its spectrum is a sum of bend spectra." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波
knowledge.titleEn: Undulator K, gap and high harmonics
knowledge.text: 中能量環要取得硬 X 光，依賴短週期真空內波盪器與高次諧波。NdFeB 永磁與釩鐵鈷極頭組成的混合式磁列放在真空腔內，間隙可關到 5 mm；峰值磁場隨間隙近似指數下降，偏轉參數 K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] 決定基頻波長與各諧波的相對強度。
knowledge.textEn: A medium-energy ring reaches hard X-rays through short-period in-vacuum undulators and their high harmonics. A hybrid array of NdFeB magnets and vanadium-permendur poles sits inside the vacuum chamber so the gap can close to 5 mm; the peak field falls roughly exponentially with gap, and the deflection parameter K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] sets the fundamental wavelength and the relative strength of each harmonic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：波盪器只是把許多彎轉磁鐵串起來，光譜就是彎轉磁鐵光譜的疊加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An undulator is just many bending magnets in series, so its spectrum is a sum of bend spectra. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Undulator K, gap and high harmonics" is correct?
options: 中能量環要取得硬 X 光，依賴短週期真空內波盪器與高次諧波。
波盪器只是把許多彎轉磁鐵串起來，光譜就是彎轉磁鐵光譜的疊加。
射頻電壓只要夠補回每圈損失的能量就足夠。
optionsEn: A medium-energy ring reaches hard X-rays through short-period in-vacuum undulators and their high harmonics.
An undulator is just many bending magnets in series, so its spectrum is a sum of bend spectra.
RF voltage only needs to cover the energy lost per turn.
quiz.explanation: 中能量環要取得硬 X 光，依賴短週期真空內波盪器與高次諧波。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A medium-energy ring reaches hard X-rays through short-period in-vacuum undulators and their high harmonics. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator K, gap and high harmonics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：混合式磁列的峰值磁場經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]：週期 λ_u = 23 mm、間隙 g = 5 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 1.10 T、K ≈ 2.37；間隙開到 7 mm 得 0.74 T、K ≈ 1.60。在 3 GeV（γ² = 3.45×10⁷）取 K = 1：基頻波長 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 5.0 Å，即光子能量 2.48 keV，第 3 與第 5 諧波分別為 7.4 與 12.4 keV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Hybrid-array fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]: with λ_u = 23 mm, g = 5 mm gives B₀ ≈ 1.10 T and K ≈ 2.37, g = 7 mm gives 0.74 T and K ≈ 1.60. At 3 GeV (γ² = 3.45×10⁷) and K = 1, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 5.0 Å, that is 2.48 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 7.4 and 12.4 keV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在磁量測台用霍爾探針沿軸掃描，計算第一與第二場積分、軌跡直度與相位誤差（目標小於 3°），並以此建立 K 對間隙的查表；裝機後在光束線用單色器掃描各諧波峰位，與查表預測比對，再量間隙改變時的軌道踢角以建立前饋補償表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the axis with a Hall probe on the magnet bench, compute first and second field integrals, trajectory straightness and phase error (target below 3°), and build the K-versus-gap table from it; after installation scan each harmonic peak with the beamline monochromator, compare with the table, and measure the orbit kick as the gap changes to build the feed-forward correction table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 混合式磁列的峰值磁場經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]：週期 λ_u = 23 mm、間隙 g = 5 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 1.10 T、K ≈ 2.37；間隙開到 7 mm 得 0.74 T、K ≈ 1.60。在 3 GeV（γ² = 3.45×10⁷）取 K = 1：基頻波長 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 5.0 Å，即光子能量 2.48 keV，第 3 與第 5 諧波分別為 7.4 與 12.4 keV。
knowledge.textEn: Hybrid-array fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]: with λ_u = 23 mm, g = 5 mm gives B₀ ≈ 1.10 T and K ≈ 2.37, g = 7 mm gives 0.74 T and K ≈ 1.60. At 3 GeV (γ² = 3.45×10⁷) and K = 1, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 5.0 Å, that is 2.48 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 7.4 and 12.4 keV.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Undulator K, gap and high harmonics", which statement holds?
options: 單色器只挑出很窄的頻寬，所以幾乎沒有熱負載。
混合式磁列的峰值磁場經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]：週期 λ_u = 23 mm、間隙 g = 5 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 1.10 T、K ≈ 2.37。
達到設計發射度與電流就等於設施驗收完成。
optionsEn: A monochromator selects a narrow bandwidth, so it carries almost no heat load.
Hybrid-array fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]: with λ_u = 23 mm, g = 5 mm gives B₀ ≈ 1.10 T and K ≈ 2.37, g = 7 mm gives 0.74 T and K ≈ 1.60.
Reaching design emittance and current means the facility is accepted.
quiz.explanation: 混合式磁列的峰值磁場經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]：週期 λ_u = 23 mm、間隙 g = 5 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 1.10 T、K ≈ 2.37；間隙開到 7 mm 得 0.74 T、K ≈ 1.60。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Hybrid-array fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]: with λ_u = 23 mm, g = 5 mm gives B₀ ≈ 1.10 T and K ≈ 2.37, g = 7 mm gives 0.74 T and K ≈ 1.60. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator K, gap and high harmonics: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在磁量測台用霍爾探針沿軸掃描，計算第一與第二場積分、軌跡直度與相位誤差（目標小於 3°），並以此建立 K 對間隙的查表；裝機後在光束線用單色器掃描各諧波峰位，與查表預測比對，再量間隙改變時的軌道踢角以建立前饋補償表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the axis with a Hall probe on the magnet bench, compute first and second field integrals, trajectory straightness and phase error (target below 3°), and build the K-versus-gap table from it; after installation scan each harmonic peak with the beamline monochromator, compare with the table, and measure the orbit kick as the gap changes to build the feed-forward correction table. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：束流損失打在永磁上造成局部退磁，K 沿磁列不再均勻，相位誤差上升；基頻幾乎不受影響，但第 5、第 7 諧波的通量下降數成，使用硬 X 光的光束線先發現問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Beam losses striking the permanent magnets demagnetise them locally, K becomes non-uniform along the array and phase error grows; the fundamental is barely affected, but flux in the 5th and 7th harmonics drops by tens of percent, and hard X-ray beamlines notice first.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在磁量測台用霍爾探針沿軸掃描，計算第一與第二場積分、軌跡直度與相位誤差（目標小於 3°），並以此建立 K 對間隙的查表；裝機後在光束線用單色器掃描各諧波峰位，與查表預測比對，再量間隙改變時的軌道踢角以建立前饋補償表。
knowledge.textEn: Scan the axis with a Hall probe on the magnet bench, compute first and second field integrals, trajectory straightness and phase error (target below 3°), and build the K-versus-gap table from it; after installation scan each harmonic peak with the beamline monochromator, compare with the table, and measure the orbit kick as the gap changes to build the feed-forward correction table.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Undulator K, gap and high harmonics"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
儲存環裡的電子是連續的電流，沒有時間結構。
在磁量測台用霍爾探針沿軸掃描，計算第一與第二場積分、軌跡直度與相位誤差（目標小於 3°），並以此建立 K 對間隙的查表。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Electrons in a storage ring form a continuous current with no time structure.
Scan the axis with a Hall probe on the magnet bench, compute first and second field integrals, trajectory straightness and phase error (target below 3°), and build the K-versus-gap table from it.
quiz.explanation: 在磁量測台用霍爾探針沿軸掃描，計算第一與第二場積分、軌跡直度與相位誤差（目標小於 3°），並以此建立 K 對間隙的查表；裝機後在光束線用單色器掃描各諧波峰位，與查表預測比對，再量間隙改變時的軌道踢角以建立前饋補償表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan the axis with a Hall probe on the magnet bench, compute first and second field integrals, trajectory straightness and phase error (target below 3°), and build the K-versus-gap table from it; after installation scan each harmonic peak with the beamline monochromator, compare with the table, and measure the orbit kick as the gap changes to build the feed-forward correction table. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Undulator K, gap and high harmonics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 束流損失打在永磁上造成局部退磁，K 沿磁列不再均勻，相位誤差上升；基頻幾乎不受影響，但第 5、第 7 諧波的通量下降數成，使用硬 X 光的光束線先發現問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Beam losses striking the permanent magnets demagnetise them locally, K becomes non-uniform along the array and phase error grows; the fundamental is barely affected, but flux in the 5th and 7th harmonics drops by tens of percent, and hard X-ray beamlines notice first. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：基頻與奇數諧波在軸上最強，相位誤差則優先削弱高次諧波，所以磁列的機械精度直接換成硬 X 光通量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The fundamental and odd harmonics are strongest on axis, and phase errors weaken the high harmonics first, so the mechanical precision of the array converts directly into hard X-ray flux.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「波盪器只是把許多彎轉磁鐵串起來，光譜就是彎轉磁鐵光譜的疊加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An undulator is just many bending magnets in series, so its spectrum is a sum of bend spectra." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 束流損失打在永磁上造成局部退磁，K 沿磁列不再均勻，相位誤差上升；基頻幾乎不受影響，但第 5、第 7 諧波的通量下降數成，使用硬 X 光的光束線先發現問題。
knowledge.textEn: Beam losses striking the permanent magnets demagnetise them locally, K becomes non-uniform along the array and phase error grows; the fundamental is barely affected, but flux in the 5th and 7th harmonics drops by tens of percent, and hard X-ray beamlines notice first.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Undulator K, gap and high harmonics" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 束流損失打在永磁上造成局部退磁，K 沿磁列不再均勻，相位誤差上升；基頻幾乎不受影響，但第 5、第 7 諧波的通量下降數成，使用硬 X 光的光束線先發現問題。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
射頻電壓只要夠補回每圈損失的能量就足夠。
optionsEn: Beam losses striking the permanent magnets demagnetise them locally, K becomes non-uniform along the array and phase error grows.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
RF voltage only needs to cover the energy lost per turn.
quiz.explanation: 束流損失打在永磁上造成局部退磁，K 沿磁列不再均勻，相位誤差上升；基頻幾乎不受影響，但第 5、第 7 諧波的通量下降數成，使用硬 X 光的光束線先發現問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Beam losses striking the permanent magnets demagnetise them locally, K becomes non-uniform along the array and phase error grows; the fundamental is barely affected, but flux in the 5th and 7th harmonics drops by tens of percent, and hard X-ray beamlines notice first. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 射頻電壓、同步振盪與壽命：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: RF voltage, synchrotron oscillation and lifetime: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「射頻腔、電壓與動量接受度」如何決定Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “RF cavities, voltage and momentum acceptance” determines the key performance of “Diamond Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射頻腔不只補回每圈損失，還以電壓高度決定縱向的射頻桶大小，也就是動量接受度；Touschek 散射讓束團內電子互相把能量踢出接受度，壽命對接受度非常敏感。Diamond 以 936 個束團高電流運轉，腔體的高階模（HOM）會驅動耦合束團不穩定，因此 Diamond-II 採用高階模阻尼的常溫腔。同步振盪頻率是檢驗電壓與動量壓縮因子的直接量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻腔、電壓與動量接受度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: RF cavities do more than restore the loss per turn: the voltage sets the height of the longitudinal RF bucket, that is the momentum acceptance, and Touschek scattering inside each bunch kicks electrons out of that acceptance, so lifetime is very sensitive to it. Diamond runs 936 bunches at high current, where cavity higher-order modes (HOMs) drive coupled-bunch instabilities, which is why Diamond-II adopts HOM-damped normal-conducting cavities. The synchrotron frequency is the direct check of voltage and momentum compaction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF cavities, voltage and momentum acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取每圈損失 U₀ = 1.0 MeV、腔壓 V_RF = 2.0 MV（過壓比 q = eV/U₀ = 2）、動量壓縮因子 α = 1.7×10⁻⁴、諧波數 h = 936、能量 E = 3 GeV（教學假設）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take U₀ = 1.0 MeV, V_RF = 2.0 MV (q = eV/U₀ = 2), α = 1.7×10⁻⁴, h = 936 and E = 3 GeV (teaching assumptions).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「射頻電壓只要夠補回每圈損失的能量就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "RF voltage only needs to cover the energy lost per turn." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「射頻腔、電壓與動量接受度」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “RF cavities, voltage and momentum acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: RF voltage, synchrotron oscillation and lifetime

Diamond runs 936 bunches at high current, where cavity higher-order modes (HOMs) drive coupled-bunch instabilities, which is why Diamond-II adopts HOM-damped normal-conducting cavities.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：射頻電壓只要夠補回每圈損失的能量就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: RF voltage only needs to cover the energy lost per turn. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「射頻電壓、同步振盪與壽命」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "RF voltage, synchrotron oscillation and lifetime" is correct?
options: 射頻電壓只要夠補回每圈損失的能量就足夠。
射頻腔不只補回每圈損失，還以電壓高度決定縱向的射頻桶大小，也就是動量接受度；Touschek 散射讓束團內電子互相把能量踢出接受度，壽命對接受度非常敏感。
針孔相機影像的寬度除以放大率就是束流尺寸。
optionsEn: RF voltage only needs to cover the energy lost per turn.

RF cavities do more than restore the loss per turn: the voltage sets the height of the longitudinal RF bucket, that is the momentum acceptance, and Touschek scattering inside each bunch kicks electrons out of that acceptance, so lifetime is very sensitive to it.
The pinhole image width divided by magnification is the beam size.
quiz.explanation: 射頻腔不只補回每圈損失，還以電壓高度決定縱向的射頻桶大小，也就是動量接受度；Touschek 散射讓束團內電子互相把能量踢出接受度，壽命對接受度非常敏感。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: RF cavities do more than restore the loss per turn: the voltage sets the height of the longitudinal RF bucket, that is the momentum acceptance, and Touschek scattering inside each bunch kicks electrons out of that acceptance, so lifetime is very sensitive to it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 射頻電壓、同步振盪與壽命：定量估算
steps.titleEn: RF voltage, synchrotron oscillation and lifetime: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「射頻腔、電壓與動量接受度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “RF cavities, voltage and momentum acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取每圈損失 U₀ = 1.0 MeV、腔壓 V_RF = 2.0 MV（過壓比 q = eV/U₀ = 2）、動量壓縮因子 α = 1.7×10⁻⁴、諧波數 h = 936、能量 E = 3 GeV（教學假設）。射頻動量接受度 δ² = U₀·F(q)/(π·α·h·E)，其中 F(q) = 2[√(q²−1) − arccos(1/q)] = 1.37，得 δ ≈ 3.0%。同步振盪頻率 f_s = f_rev·√(α·h·eV·cosφ_s/(2πE)) = 533.8 kHz×√(1.7×10⁻⁴×936×2×10⁶×0.866/(2π×3×10⁹)) ≈ 2.0 kHz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take U₀ = 1.0 MeV, V_RF = 2.0 MV (q = eV/U₀ = 2), α = 1.7×10⁻⁴, h = 936 and E = 3 GeV (teaching assumptions). The RF momentum acceptance is δ² = U₀·F(q)/(π·α·h·E) with F(q) = 2[√(q²−1) − arccos(1/q)] = 1.37, giving δ ≈ 3.0%. The synchrotron frequency f_s = f_rev·√(α·h·eV·cosφ_s/(2πE)) = 533.8 kHz×√(1.7×10⁻⁴×936×2×10⁶×0.866/(2π×3×10⁹)) ≈ 2.0 kHz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用 BPM 的縱向頻譜或條紋相機量同步振盪頻率，與公式比較以反推實際腔壓；改變射頻電壓量壽命對電壓的曲線，Touschek 主導時壽命大致隨接受度的三次方上升；以逐束團回授系統的頻譜偵測耦合束團模式，確認 HOM 阻尼有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the synchrotron frequency from the longitudinal BPM spectrum or a streak camera and compare with the formula to back out the real cavity voltage; vary RF voltage and record lifetime versus voltage, which rises roughly with the cube of acceptance when Touschek dominates; and use the bunch-by-bunch feedback spectrum to detect coupled-bunch modes, confirming the HOM damping works.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Take U₀ = 1.0 MeV, V_RF = 2.0 MV (q = eV/U₀ = 2), α = 1.7×10⁻⁴, h = 936 and E = 3 GeV (teaching assumptions). The RF momentum acceptance is δ² = U₀·F(q)/(π·α·h·E) with F(q) = 2[√(q²−1) − arccos(1/q)] = 1.37, giving δ ≈ 3.0%. Electrons in a storage ring form a continuous current with no time structure.

steps.title: 射頻電壓、同步振盪與壽命：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: RF voltage, synchrotron oscillation and lifetime: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「射頻腔、電壓與動量接受度」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “RF cavities, voltage and momentum acceptance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用 BPM 的縱向頻譜或條紋相機量同步振盪頻率，與公式比較以反推實際腔壓；改變射頻電壓量壽命對電壓的曲線，Touschek 主導時壽命大致隨接受度的三次方上升；以逐束團回授系統的頻譜偵測耦合束團模式，確認 HOM 阻尼有效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the synchrotron frequency from the longitudinal BPM spectrum or a streak camera and compare with the formula to back out the real cavity voltage; vary RF voltage and record lifetime versus voltage, which rises roughly with the cube of acceptance when Touschek dominates; and use the bunch-by-bunch feedback spectrum to detect coupled-bunch modes, confirming the HOM damping works. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：腔體溫度漂移讓某個高階模掃到束團迴轉諧波上，縱向耦合束團振盪爆發，束團拉長、能散增加，所有波盪器的諧波線寬變寬，使用者看到光子通量在單色器頻寬內突然下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A cavity temperature drift sweeps one higher-order mode onto a revolution harmonic, a longitudinal coupled-bunch oscillation erupts, bunches lengthen and energy spread grows, every undulator harmonic broadens, and users see flux inside the monochromator bandwidth fall suddenly.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用 BPM 的縱向頻譜或條紋相機量同步振盪頻率，與公式比較以反推實際腔壓；改變射頻電壓量壽命對電壓的曲線，Touschek 主導時壽命大致隨接受度的三次方上升；以逐束團回授系統的頻譜偵測耦合束團模式，確認 HOM 阻尼有效。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the synchrotron frequency from the longitudinal BPM spectrum or a streak camera and compare with the formula to back out the real cavity voltage; vary RF voltage and record lifetime versus voltage, which rises roughly with the cube of acceptance when Touschek dominates; and use the bunch-by-bunch feedback spectrum to detect coupled-bunch modes, confirming the HOM damping works.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

optionsEn: Measure the synchrotron frequency from the longitudinal BPM spectrum or a streak camera and compare with the formula to back out the real cavity voltage.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Raising electron energy always worsens emittance, so an upgrade should never raise energy.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推」與「插件磁鐵熱負載與單色器熱管理」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion" and "Insertion-device heat load and monochromator thermal management": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「X 光針孔相機與發射度量測」如何決定Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement” determines the key performance of “Diamond Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Diamond 在彎轉磁鐵光口用 X 光針孔相機成像束流：針孔把光源投影到螢幕，影像寬度包含束流尺寸乘放大率、針孔繞射與幾何模糊、螢幕與鏡頭的點擴散。垂直發射度只有 8 pm·rad，束流只有十幾微米，所以必須先獨立量出系統點擴散函數再做平方相減；水平方向則還要扣除色散與能散的貢獻，否則發射度會被高估。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 光針孔相機與發射度量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diamond images the beam through an X-ray pinhole camera on a bending-magnet port: the pinhole projects the source onto a screen, and the image width contains the beam size times magnification, pinhole diffraction and geometric blur, and the point spread of screen and lens. With only 8 pm·rad vertical emittance the beam is a dozen micrometres, so the system point-spread function must be measured independently and subtracted in quadrature; horizontally the dispersion and energy-spread contribution must also be removed or emittance is overestimated. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光源到針孔 4 m、針孔到螢幕 8 m，放大率 M = 2；量得系統點擴散 σ_PSF = 15 µm，影像垂直寬度 σ_img = 31.8 µm：σ_y = √(31.8² − 15²)/2 ≈ 14 µm；光源處 β_y = 25 m 則 ε_y = σ_y²/β_y = (14 µm)²/25 m ≈ 7.8 pm·rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Source to pinhole 4 m, pinhole to screen 8 m, magnification M = 2; with a measured system point spread σ_PSF = 15 µm and an image vertical width σ_img = 31.8 µm, σ_y = √(31.8² − 15²)/2 ≈ 14 µm; with β_y = 25 m at the source, ε_y = σ_y²/β_y = (14 µm)²/25 m ≈ 7.8 pm·rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「針孔相機影像的寬度除以放大率就是束流尺寸。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The pinhole image width divided by magnification is the beam size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「X 光針孔相機與發射度量測」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推
knowledge.titleEn: Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion
knowledge.text: Diamond 在彎轉磁鐵光口用 X 光針孔相機成像束流：針孔把光源投影到螢幕，影像寬度包含束流尺寸乘放大率、針孔繞射與幾何模糊、螢幕與鏡頭的點擴散。垂直發射度只有 8 pm·rad，束流只有十幾微米，所以必須先獨立量出系統點擴散函數再做平方相減；水平方向則還要扣除色散與能散的貢獻，否則發射度會被高估。
knowledge.textEn: Diamond images the beam through an X-ray pinhole camera on a bending-magnet port: the pinhole projects the source onto a screen, and the image width contains the beam size times magnification, pinhole diffraction and geometric blur, and the point spread of screen and lens. With only 8 pm·rad vertical emittance the beam is a dozen micrometres, so the system point-spread function must be measured independently and subtracted in quadrature; horizontally the dispersion and energy-spread contribution must also be removed or emittance is overestimated.

knowledge.text: 誤解：針孔相機影像的寬度除以放大率就是束流尺寸。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

optionsEn: The pinhole image width divided by magnification is the beam size.

steps.title: 束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「X 光針孔相機與發射度量測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光源到針孔 4 m、針孔到螢幕 8 m，放大率 M = 2；量得系統點擴散 σ_PSF = 15 µm，影像垂直寬度 σ_img = 31.8 µm：σ_y = √(31.8² − 15²)/2 ≈ 14 µm；光源處 β_y = 25 m 則 ε_y = σ_y²/β_y = (14 µm)²/25 m ≈ 7.8 pm·rad。水平：β_x = 1.0 m、η = 0.1 m、σ_δ = 1×10⁻³，σ_x = √(3.14 nm×1 m + (0.1 m×10⁻³)²) = √(56² + 100²) µm ≈ 115 µm，色散項反而佔大半。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Source to pinhole 4 m, pinhole to screen 8 m, magnification M = 2; with a measured system point spread σ_PSF = 15 µm and an image vertical width σ_img = 31.8 µm, σ_y = √(31.8² − 15²)/2 ≈ 14 µm; with β_y = 25 m at the source, ε_y = σ_y²/β_y = (14 µm)²/25 m ≈ 7.8 pm·rad. Horizontally, with β_x = 1.0 m, η = 0.1 m and σ_δ = 1×10⁻³, σ_x = √(3.14 nm×1 m + (0.1 m×10⁻³)²) = √(56² + 100²) µm ≈ 115 µm, so the dispersion term actually dominates. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知尺寸的針孔陣列或以極低電流的單束團（束流尺寸幾乎純由晶格決定）標定點擴散函數；改變耦合（偏四極磁鐵）看垂直尺寸是否按預期變化；把針孔相機結果與干涉式或 X 光繞射式尺寸量測交叉比對，並與 LOCO 模型的 β、η 一起反推發射度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the point-spread function with a pinhole array of known size or with a very low-current single bunch whose size is almost purely lattice-determined; change the coupling with skew quadrupoles and check that the vertical size follows prediction; cross-check pinhole results against an interferometric or X-ray diffraction size monitor, and invert emittance together with the LOCO-model β and η.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光源到針孔 4 m、針孔到螢幕 8 m，放大率 M = 2；量得系統點擴散 σ_PSF = 15 µm，影像垂直寬度 σ_img = 31.8 µm：σ_y = √(31.8² − 15²)/2 ≈ 14 µm；光源處 β_y = 25 m 則 ε_y = σ_y²/β_y = (14 µm)²/25 m ≈ 7.8 pm·rad。水平：β_x = 1.0 m、η = 0.1 m、σ_δ = 1×10⁻³，σ_x = √(3.14 nm×1 m + (0.1 m×10⁻³)²) = √(56² + 100²) µm ≈ 115 µm，色散項反而佔大半。
knowledge.textEn: Source to pinhole 4 m, pinhole to screen 8 m, magnification M = 2; with a measured system point spread σ_PSF = 15 µm and an image vertical width σ_img = 31.8 µm, σ_y = √(31.8² − 15²)/2 ≈ 14 µm; with β_y = 25 m at the source, ε_y = σ_y²/β_y = (14 µm)²/25 m ≈ 7.8 pm·rad. Horizontally, with β_x = 1.0 m, η = 0.1 m and σ_δ = 1×10⁻³, σ_x = √(3.14 nm×1 m + (0.1 m×10⁻³)²) = √(56² + 100²) µm ≈ 115 µm, so the dispersion term actually dominates.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「X 光針孔相機與發射度量測」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知尺寸的針孔陣列或以極低電流的單束團（束流尺寸幾乎純由晶格決定）標定點擴散函數；改變耦合（偏四極磁鐵）看垂直尺寸是否按預期變化；把針孔相機結果與干涉式或 X 光繞射式尺寸量測交叉比對，並與 LOCO 模型的 β、η 一起反推發射度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the point-spread function with a pinhole array of known size or with a very low-current single bunch whose size is almost purely lattice-determined; change the coupling with skew quadrupoles and check that the vertical size follows prediction; cross-check pinhole results against an interferometric or X-ray diffraction size monitor, and invert emittance together with the LOCO-model β and η. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把影像寬度直接除以放大率而不扣點擴散，垂直發射度會被報成兩倍以上；若螢光屏因輻射老化而變厚、變模糊，同一算法會讓發射度看起來隨時間變差，其實束流根本沒變。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Dividing the image width by the magnification without subtracting the point spread reports vertical emittance more than twice too high; if the scintillator thickens and blurs with radiation ageing, the same algorithm makes emittance appear to degrade over time while the beam has not changed at all.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion"?

Calibrate the point-spread function with a pinhole array of known size or with a very low-current single bunch whose size is almost purely lattice-determined.

quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the point-spread function with a pinhole array of known size or with a very low-current single bunch whose size is almost purely lattice-determined; change the coupling with skew quadrupoles and check that the vertical size follows prediction; cross-check pinhole results against an interferometric or X-ray diffraction size monitor, and invert emittance together with the LOCO-model β and η. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「X 光針孔相機與發射度量測」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把影像寬度直接除以放大率而不扣點擴散，垂直發射度會被報成兩倍以上；若螢光屏因輻射老化而變厚、變模糊，同一算法會讓發射度看起來隨時間變差，其實束流根本沒變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing the image width by the magnification without subtracting the point spread reports vertical emittance more than twice too high; if the scintillator thickens and blurs with radiation ageing, the same algorithm makes emittance appear to degrade over time while the beam has not changed at all. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：垂直發射度只有 8 pm·rad，束流只有十幾微米，所以必須先獨立量出系統點擴散函數再做平方相減；水平方向則還要扣除色散與能散的貢獻，否則發射度會被高估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With only 8 pm·rad vertical emittance the beam is a dozen micrometres, so the system point-spread function must be measured independently and subtracted in quadrature; horizontally the dispersion and energy-spread contribution must also be removed or emittance is overestimated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「針孔相機影像的寬度除以放大率就是束流尺寸。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The pinhole image width divided by magnification is the beam size." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把影像寬度直接除以放大率而不扣點擴散，垂直發射度會被報成兩倍以上；若螢光屏因輻射老化而變厚、變模糊，同一算法會讓發射度看起來隨時間變差，其實束流根本沒變。
knowledge.textEn: Dividing the image width by the magnification without subtracting the point spread reports vertical emittance more than twice too high; if the scintillator thickens and blurs with radiation ageing, the same algorithm makes emittance appear to degrade over time while the beam has not changed at all.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
單色器只挑出很窄的頻寬，所以幾乎沒有熱負載。
把影像寬度直接除以放大率而不扣點擴散，垂直發射度會被報成兩倍以上；若螢光屏因輻射老化而變厚、變模糊，同一算法會讓發射度看起來隨時間變差，其實束流根本沒變。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A monochromator selects a narrow bandwidth, so it carries almost no heat load.
Dividing the image width by the magnification without subtracting the point spread reports vertical emittance more than twice too high.
quiz.explanation: 把影像寬度直接除以放大率而不扣點擴散，垂直發射度會被報成兩倍以上；若螢光屏因輻射老化而變厚、變模糊，同一算法會讓發射度看起來隨時間變差，其實束流根本沒變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dividing the image width by the magnification without subtracting the point spread reports vertical emittance more than twice too high; if the scintillator thickens and blurs with radiation ageing, the same algorithm makes emittance appear to degrade over time while the beam has not changed at all. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 插件磁鐵熱負載與單色器熱管理：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Insertion-device heat load and monochromator thermal management: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器」如何決定Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator” determines the key performance of “Diamond Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 300 mA 下一支波盪器的總功率達數千瓦，軸上功率密度達數十 kW/mrad²；前端的固定光闌與可動吸收器先截掉大部分功率，第一片矽晶體仍要承受數百瓦。晶體的熱變形正比於熱膨脹係數除以熱導率（α/k），矽在液氮溫度附近 α 趨近零而 k 大幅上升，所以第一晶體以液氮冷卻，把熱凸起造成的斜率誤差壓到微弧度級，保住單色器的能量解析與光束位置。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At 300 mA one undulator radiates several kilowatts in total with an on-axis power density of tens of kW/mrad²; fixed masks and movable absorbers in the front end strip most of it, but the first silicon crystal still takes hundreds of watts. Crystal thermal deformation scales with thermal expansion over conductivity (α/k), and near liquid-nitrogen temperature silicon's α approaches zero while k rises sharply, so the first crystal is cooled with liquid nitrogen to keep the slope error of the thermal bump at the microradian level, preserving monochromator energy resolution and beam position. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total power P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B₀²[T]·L[m]·I[A] = 0.633×9×1.21×2×0.3 ≈ 4.1 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單色器只挑出很窄的頻寬，所以幾乎沒有熱負載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A monochromator selects a narrow bandwidth, so it carries almost no heat load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Crystal thermal deformation scales with thermal expansion over conductivity (α/k), and near liquid-nitrogen temperature silicon's α approaches zero while k rises sharply, so the first crystal is cooled with liquid nitrogen to keep the slope error of the thermal bump at the microradian level, preserving monochromator energy resolution and beam position.

knowledge.text: 誤解：單色器只挑出很窄的頻寬，所以幾乎沒有熱負載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「插件磁鐵熱負載與單色器熱管理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 插件磁鐵熱負載與單色器熱管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Insertion-device heat load and monochromator thermal management: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總功率 P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B₀²[T]·L[m]·I[A] = 0.633×9×1.21×2×0.3 ≈ 4.1 kW。軸上功率密度 dP/dΩ ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×1.10×81×0.3×87 ≈ 25 kW/mrad²；0.2×0.1 mrad² 的光闌放行約 0.5 kW 到第一晶體。矽 300 K：α/k ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/150 ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W；80 K：約 0.5×10⁻⁶/1000 ≈ 5×10⁻¹⁰ m/W，熱變形約低 35 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total power P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B₀²[T]·L[m]·I[A] = 0.633×9×1.21×2×0.3 ≈ 4.1 kW. On-axis power density dP/dΩ ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×1.10×81×0.3×87 ≈ 25 kW/mrad²; a 0.2×0.1 mrad² aperture passes about 0.5 kW to the first crystal. Silicon at 300 K: α/k ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/150 ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W; at 80 K about 0.5×10⁻⁶/1000 ≈ 5×10⁻¹⁰ m/W, roughly 35 times less thermal deformation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以量熱法（冷卻水流量與溫升）量前端吸收器與第一晶體實際吸收的功率，與公式比較；在不同儲存電流與間隙下量單色器搖擺曲線寬度與出射光束位置，熱凸起會使寬度變寬、位置偏移；用紅外熱像儀或晶體上的熱電偶對照有限元素模型的溫度分佈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the power actually absorbed by front-end absorbers and the first crystal calorimetrically from cooling-water flow and temperature rise and compare with the formulas; record monochromator rocking-curve width and exit-beam position at different stored currents and gaps, since the thermal bump broadens the curve and shifts the beam; and compare infrared thermography or crystal thermocouples with the finite-element temperature map.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

On-axis power density dP/dΩ ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×1.10×81×0.3×87 ≈ 25 kW/mrad²; a 0.2×0.1 mrad² aperture passes about 0.5 kW to the first crystal. Silicon at 300 K: α/k ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/150 ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W; at 80 K about 0.5×10⁻⁶/1000 ≈ 5×10⁻¹⁰ m/W, roughly 35 times less thermal deformation.

steps.title: 插件磁鐵熱負載與單色器熱管理：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以量熱法（冷卻水流量與溫升）量前端吸收器與第一晶體實際吸收的功率，與公式比較；在不同儲存電流與間隙下量單色器搖擺曲線寬度與出射光束位置，熱凸起會使寬度變寬、位置偏移；用紅外熱像儀或晶體上的熱電偶對照有限元素模型的溫度分佈。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the power actually absorbed by front-end absorbers and the first crystal calorimetrically from cooling-water flow and temperature rise and compare with the formulas; record monochromator rocking-curve width and exit-beam position at different stored currents and gaps, since the thermal bump broadens the curve and shifts the beam; and compare infrared thermography or crystal thermocouples with the finite-element temperature map. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷卻水或液氮流量下降而連鎖沒有觸發，第一晶體的熱凸起斜率誤差從微弧度升到數十微弧度，單色光能量解析劣化、光束位置漂移，嚴重時晶體或吸收器局部熔損，整條光束線停機更換。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If cooling-water or liquid-nitrogen flow drops and the interlock does not trip, the slope error of the first crystal's thermal bump grows from microradians to tens of microradians, energy resolution degrades and the beam drifts; in the worst case the crystal or absorber melts locally and the whole beamline stops for replacement.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 插件磁鐵熱負載與單色器熱管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Insertion-device heat load and monochromator thermal management: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷卻水或液氮流量下降而連鎖沒有觸發，第一晶體的熱凸起斜率誤差從微弧度升到數十微弧度，單色光能量解析劣化、光束位置漂移，嚴重時晶體或吸收器局部熔損，整條光束線停機更換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If cooling-water or liquid-nitrogen flow drops and the interlock does not trip, the slope error of the first crystal's thermal bump grows from microradians to tens of microradians, energy resolution degrades and the beam drifts; in the worst case the crystal or absorber melts locally and the whole beamline stops for replacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：晶體的熱變形正比於熱膨脹係數除以熱導率（α/k），矽在液氮溫度附近 α 趨近零而 k 大幅上升，所以第一晶體以液氮冷卻，把熱凸起造成的斜率誤差壓到微弧度級，保住單色器的能量解析與光束位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Crystal thermal deformation scales with thermal expansion over conductivity (α/k), and near liquid-nitrogen temperature silicon's α approaches zero while k rises sharply, so the first crystal is cooled with liquid nitrogen to keep the slope error of the thermal bump at the microradian level, preserving monochromator energy resolution and beam position.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單色器只挑出很窄的頻寬，所以幾乎沒有熱負載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A monochromator selects a narrow bandwidth, so it carries almost no heat load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配」與「頂注運轉、可用度與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching" and "Top-up operation, availability and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「同一隧道換環：光源點與光束線匹配」如何決定Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Same-tunnel ring replacement: source points and beamline matching” determines the key performance of “Diamond Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Diamond-II 在同一隧道內更換整座儲存環，前提是保住既有光束線的光源點位置與方向，否則前端與光學全部重建。能量從 3 提高到 3.5 GeV 後，每支波盪器在相同間隙下的光子能量全部上移 36%，光束線若要維持原工作能量，必須改變 K 值（縮小間隙）或更換磁列週期；DTBA 晶格新增的中段直線段則讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改接短插件，光源特性整個改變。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同一隧道換環：光源點與光束線匹配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diamond-II replaces the entire storage ring inside the same tunnel, which only works if the source positions and directions of existing beamlines are preserved; otherwise front ends and optics would all be rebuilt. With energy raised from 3 to 3.5 GeV every undulator's photon energy at a given gap shifts up by 36%, so a beamline that must keep its working energy has to change K by closing the gap or replace the array period; the new mid-cell straights of the DTBA lattice let former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices, changing their source properties entirely. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Same-tunnel ring replacement: source points and beamline matching”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光子能量正比於 γ²/(1+K²/2)：γ² 乘以 (3.5/3)² = 1.36。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Photon energy scales as γ²/(1+K²/2), and γ² is multiplied by (3.5/3)² = 1.36.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要隧道不變，換新儲存環後光束線不用動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the tunnel is unchanged, beamlines need no changes after a new ring is installed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「同一隧道換環：光源點與光束線匹配」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Same-tunnel ring replacement: source points and beamline matching”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配
knowledge.titleEn: Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching
knowledge.text: Diamond-II 在同一隧道內更換整座儲存環，前提是保住既有光束線的光源點位置與方向，否則前端與光學全部重建。能量從 3 提高到 3.5 GeV 後，每支波盪器在相同間隙下的光子能量全部上移 36%，光束線若要維持原工作能量，必須改變 K 值（縮小間隙）或更換磁列週期；DTBA 晶格新增的中段直線段則讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改接短插件，光源特性整個改變。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要隧道不變，換新儲存環後光束線不用動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the tunnel is unchanged, beamlines need no changes after a new ring is installed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching" is correct?
options: 只要隧道不變，換新儲存環後光束線不用動。
Diamond-II 在同一隧道內更換整座儲存環，前提是保住既有光束線的光源點位置與方向，否則前端與光學全部重建。

steps.title: Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同一隧道換環：光源點與光束線匹配」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Same-tunnel ring replacement: source points and beamline matching” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光子能量正比於 γ²/(1+K²/2)：γ² 乘以 (3.5/3)² = 1.36。某光束線原以 λ_u = 23 mm、K = 1.7 的第 5 諧波取 7.6 keV（基頻 1.52 keV），升級後同一間隙變成 10.3 keV；要回到 7.6 keV 需 (1+K²/2) 也乘 1.36，即 2.445→3.33，K² = 4.66，K ≈ 2.16，從前述 B₀(g) 經驗式相當於把間隙從約 6.7 mm 關到約 5.5 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Photon energy scales as γ²/(1+K²/2), and γ² is multiplied by (3.5/3)² = 1.36. A beamline that took 7.6 keV from the 5th harmonic of a λ_u = 23 mm undulator at K = 1.7 (fundamental 1.52 keV) would get 10.3 keV at the same gap after the upgrade; returning to 7.6 keV requires (1+K²/2) to grow by 1.36 as well, from 2.445 to 3.33, so K² = 4.66 and K ≈ 2.16, which for λ_u = 23 mm with the earlier B₀(g) fit means closing the gap from about 6.7 mm to about 5.5 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：升級前以雷射追蹤儀把每條光束線的前端光闌、第一鏡與光源基準點納入同一座標網，升級後重新量測，確認光源點位移在前端可調範圍內；每支波盪器重做 K 對間隙表並在光束線掃描諧波核對；對改接短插件的光束線重新量光源尺寸、發散角與功率密度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the upgrade bring every beamline's front-end mask, first mirror and source fiducials into one laser-tracker coordinate network and re-survey afterwards to confirm the source shift lies within the front-end adjustment range; remake each undulator's K-versus-gap table and check the harmonics by scanning on the beamline; and re-measure source size, divergence and power density for beamlines moved onto short insertion devices.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光子能量正比於 γ²/(1+K²/2)：γ² 乘以 (3.5/3)² = 1.36。某光束線原以 λ_u = 23 mm、K = 1.7 的第 5 諧波取 7.6 keV（基頻 1.52 keV），升級後同一間隙變成 10.3 keV；要回到 7.6 keV 需 (1+K²/2) 也乘 1.36，即 2.445→3.33，K² = 4.66，K ≈ 2.16，從前述 B₀(g) 經驗式相當於把間隙從約 6.7 mm 關到約 5.5 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Photon energy scales as γ²/(1+K²/2), and γ² is multiplied by (3.5/3)² = 1.36. A beamline that took 7.6 keV from the 5th harmonic of a λ_u = 23 mm undulator at K = 1.7 (fundamental 1.52 keV) would get 10.3 keV at the same gap after the upgrade; returning to 7.6 keV requires (1+K²/2) to grow by 1.36 as well, from 2.445 to 3.33, so K² = 4.66 and K ≈ 2.16, which for λ_u = 23 mm with the earlier B₀(g) fit means closing the gap from about 6.7 mm to about 5.5 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching", which statement holds?
options: 提高電子能量一定會讓發射度變差，所以升級不該升能量。
射頻電壓只要夠補回每圈損失的能量就足夠。
光子能量正比於 γ²/(1+K²/2)：γ² 乘以 (3.5/3)² = 1.36。
optionsEn: Raising electron energy always worsens emittance, so an upgrade should never raise energy.
RF voltage only needs to cover the energy lost per turn.
Photon energy scales as γ²/(1+K²/2), and γ² is multiplied by (3.5/3)² = 1.36.
quiz.explanation: 光子能量正比於 γ²/(1+K²/2)：γ² 乘以 (3.5/3)² = 1.36。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Photon energy scales as γ²/(1+K²/2), and γ² is multiplied by (3.5/3)² = 1.36. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「同一隧道換環：光源點與光束線匹配」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Same-tunnel ring replacement: source points and beamline matching” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 升級前以雷射追蹤儀把每條光束線的前端光闌、第一鏡與光源基準點納入同一座標網，升級後重新量測，確認光源點位移在前端可調範圍內；每支波盪器重做 K 對間隙表並在光束線掃描諧波核對；對改接短插件的光束線重新量光源尺寸、發散角與功率密度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the upgrade bring every beamline's front-end mask, first mirror and source fiducials into one laser-tracker coordinate network and re-survey afterwards to confirm the source shift lies within the front-end adjustment range; remake each undulator's K-versus-gap table and check the harmonics by scanning on the beamline; and re-measure source size, divergence and power density for beamlines moved onto short insertion devices. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若光源點在升級後偏了幾毫米而前端光闌沒有跟著重新對準，高功率的波盪器中心錐會打在光闌邊緣或真空腔壁上，造成局部過熱與真空洩漏，同時真正到達光束線的只有邊緣的低功率光。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the source point moves a few millimetres after the upgrade and the front-end masks are not re-aligned, the high-power undulator central cone strikes a mask edge or the chamber wall, causing local overheating and a vacuum leak, while only weak edge radiation reaches the beamline.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 升級前以雷射追蹤儀把每條光束線的前端光闌、第一鏡與光源基準點納入同一座標網，升級後重新量測，確認光源點位移在前端可調範圍內；每支波盪器重做 K 對間隙表並在光束線掃描諧波核對；對改接短插件的光束線重新量光源尺寸、發散角與功率密度。
knowledge.textEn: Before the upgrade bring every beamline's front-end mask, first mirror and source fiducials into one laser-tracker coordinate network and re-survey afterwards to confirm the source shift lies within the front-end adjustment range; remake each undulator's K-versus-gap table and check the harmonics by scanning on the beamline; and re-measure source size, divergence and power density for beamlines moved onto short insertion devices.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching"?
