steps.title: 8 GeV 波盪器的基頻、諧波與功率密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator fundamentals, harmonics and power density at 8 GeV: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 32 mm，4.5 m）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 32 mm, 4.5 m)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：8 GeV、γ² = 2.45×10⁸、λ_u = 32 mm：K = 2.2 時 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å，即 5.55 keV，第 3、第 5 諧波為 16.7 與 27.8 keV；K = 1 時基頻 12.7 keV。取 B₀ = 0.8 T（K ≈ 2.4）、L = 4.5 m（N = 140）、I = 0.1 A：總功率 P = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L·I = 0.633×64×0.64×4.5×0.1 ≈ 11.7 kW，軸上功率密度 ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×0.8×4096×0.1×140 ≈ 497 kW/mrad²。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 8 GeV, γ² = 2.45×10⁸ and λ_u = 32 mm: for K = 2.2, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 16.7 and 27.8 keV; for K = 1 the fundamental is 12.7 keV. With B₀ = 0.8 T (K ≈ 2.4), L = 4.5 m (N = 140) and I = 0.1 A: total power P = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L·I = 0.633×64×0.64×4.5×0.1 ≈ 11.7 kW and on-axis power density ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×0.8×4096×0.1×140 ≈ 497 kW/mrad². Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：磁量測台上以霍爾探針取得 B₀(g)、相位誤差與場積分；裝機後用光束線單色器掃描基頻與諧波峰位核對 K(g) 表；以前端量熱式吸收器（冷卻水流量乘溫升）量總功率，與 11.7 kW 的估計比較，並用熱像儀檢查固定光闌的溫度分佈是否與有限元素模型一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain B₀(g), phase error and field integrals with a Hall probe on the magnet bench; after installation scan fundamental and harmonic peaks with the beamline monochromator to check the K(g) table; measure total power with a calorimetric front-end absorber (cooling-water flow times temperature rise) against the 11.7 kW estimate, and check the fixed-mask temperature map with a thermal camera against the finite-element model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: At 8 GeV, γ² = 2.45×10⁸ and λ_u = 32 mm: for K = 2.2, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 16.7 and 27.8 keV; for K = 1 the fundamental is 12.7 keV. With B₀ = 0.8 T (K ≈ 2.4), L = 4.5 m (N = 140) and I = 0.1 A: total power P = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L·I = 0.633×64×0.64×4.5×0.1 ≈ 11.7 kW and on-axis power density ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×0.8×4096×0.1×140 ≈ 497 kW/mrad².

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「8 GeV 波盪器的基頻、諧波與功率密度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Undulator fundamentals, harmonics and power density at 8 GeV", which statement holds?
options: 總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。
升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。
optionsEn: If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change.
At 8 GeV, γ² = 2.45×10⁸ and λ_u = 32 mm: for K = 2.2, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 16.7 and 27.8 keV.
Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.
quiz.explanation: 8 GeV、γ² = 2.45×10⁸、λ_u = 32 mm：K = 2.2 時 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å，即 5.55 keV，第 3、第 5 諧波為 16.7 與 27.8 keV；K = 1 時基頻 12.7 keV。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 8 GeV, γ² = 2.45×10⁸ and λ_u = 32 mm: for K = 2.2, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 16.7 and 27.8 keV; for K = 1 the fundamental is 12.7 keV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 8 GeV 波盪器的基頻、諧波與功率密度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator fundamentals, harmonics and power density at 8 GeV: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 32 mm，4.5 m）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 32 mm, 4.5 m)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 磁量測台上以霍爾探針取得 B₀(g)、相位誤差與場積分；裝機後用光束線單色器掃描基頻與諧波峰位核對 K(g) 表；以前端量熱式吸收器（冷卻水流量乘溫升）量總功率，與 11.7 kW 的估計比較，並用熱像儀檢查固定光闌的溫度分佈是否與有限元素模型一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain B₀(g), phase error and field integrals with a Hall probe on the magnet bench; after installation scan fundamental and harmonic peaks with the beamline monochromator to check the K(g) table; measure total power with a calorimetric front-end absorber (cooling-water flow times temperature rise) against the 11.7 kW estimate, and check the fixed-mask temperature map with a thermal camera against the finite-element model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若真空內波盪器的射頻遮蔽銅箔在小間隙下與束流失配，束流的尾場把銅箔加熱、變形甚至燒穿，碎片落在磁列上造成真空惡化與退磁，整支波盪器需拆下修復。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the RF-shielding copper foil of an in-vacuum undulator mismatches the beam at small gap, the beam wakefield heats, deforms or burns through the foil, debris lands on the magnet array, vacuum degrades and magnets demagnetise, and the whole undulator must be removed for repair.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 磁量測台上以霍爾探針取得 B₀(g)、相位誤差與場積分；裝機後用光束線單色器掃描基頻與諧波峰位核對 K(g) 表；以前端量熱式吸收器（冷卻水流量乘溫升）量總功率，與 11.7 kW 的估計比較，並用熱像儀檢查固定光闌的溫度分佈是否與有限元素模型一致。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain B₀(g), phase error and field integrals with a Hall probe on the magnet bench; after installation scan fundamental and harmonic peaks with the beamline monochromator to check the K(g) table; measure total power with a calorimetric front-end absorber (cooling-water flow times temperature rise) against the 11.7 kW estimate, and check the fixed-mask temperature map with a thermal camera against the finite-element model.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「8 GeV 波盪器的基頻、諧波與功率密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Undulator fundamentals, harmonics and power density at 8 GeV"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。
磁量測台上以霍爾探針取得 B₀(g)、相位誤差與場積分。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss.
Obtain B₀(g), phase error and field integrals with a Hall probe on the magnet bench.
quiz.explanation: 磁量測台上以霍爾探針取得 B₀(g)、相位誤差與場積分；裝機後用光束線單色器掃描基頻與諧波峰位核對 K(g) 表；以前端量熱式吸收器（冷卻水流量乘溫升）量總功率，與 11.7 kW 的估計比較，並用熱像儀檢查固定光闌的溫度分佈是否與有限元素模型一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain B₀(g), phase error and field integrals with a Hall probe on the magnet bench; after installation scan fundamental and harmonic peaks with the beamline monochromator to check the K(g) table; measure total power with a calorimetric front-end absorber (cooling-water flow times temperature rise) against the 11.7 kW estimate, and check the fixed-mask temperature map with a thermal camera against the finite-element model. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 8 GeV 波盪器的基頻、諧波與功率密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Undulator fundamentals, harmonics and power density at 8 GeV: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 32 mm，4.5 m）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 32 mm, 4.5 m)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若真空內波盪器的射頻遮蔽銅箔在小間隙下與束流失配，束流的尾場把銅箔加熱、變形甚至燒穿，碎片落在磁列上造成真空惡化與退磁，整支波盪器需拆下修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the RF-shielding copper foil of an in-vacuum undulator mismatches the beam at small gap, the beam wakefield heats, deforms or burns through the foil, debris lands on the magnet array, vacuum degrades and magnets demagnetise, and the whole undulator must be removed for repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但 8 GeV 的功率密度極高：軸上功率密度隨 E⁴ 增加，標準 4.5 m 波盪器達數百 kW/mrad²，30 m 直線段內的 25 m 超長波盪器更高一個量級，因此前端光闌、吸收器與第一光學元件的熱設計是這類光束線的核心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: But the power density at 8 GeV is extreme: the on-axis power density grows as E⁴, a standard 4.5 m undulator reaches hundreds of kW/mrad², and the 25 m undulator in a 30 m straight is another order of magnitude higher, so the thermal design of front-end masks, absorbers and first optics is the heart of these beamlines.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「波盪器的功率密度只跟電流有關，與電子能量無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Undulator power density depends only on current, not on electron energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若真空內波盪器的射頻遮蔽銅箔在小間隙下與束流失配，束流的尾場把銅箔加熱、變形甚至燒穿，碎片落在磁列上造成真空惡化與退磁，整支波盪器需拆下修復。
knowledge.textEn: If the RF-shielding copper foil of an in-vacuum undulator mismatches the beam at small gap, the beam wakefield heats, deforms or burns through the foil, debris lands on the magnet array, vacuum degrades and magnets demagnetise, and the whole undulator must be removed for repair.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「8 GeV 波盪器的基頻、諧波與功率密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Undulator fundamentals, harmonics and power density at 8 GeV" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若真空內波盪器的射頻遮蔽銅箔在小間隙下與束流失配，束流的尾場把銅箔加熱、變形甚至燒穿，碎片落在磁列上造成真空惡化與退磁，整支波盪器需拆下修復。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。
optionsEn: If the RF-shielding copper foil of an in-vacuum undulator mismatches the beam at small gap, the beam wakefield heats, deforms or burns through the foil, debris lands on the magnet array, vacuum degrades and magnets demagnetise, and the whole undulator must be removed for repair.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 若真空內波盪器的射頻遮蔽銅箔在小間隙下與束流失配，束流的尾場把銅箔加熱、變形甚至燒穿，碎片落在磁列上造成真空惡化與退磁，整支波盪器需拆下修復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the RF-shielding copper foil of an in-vacuum undulator mismatches the beam at small gap, the beam wakefield heats, deforms or burns through the foil, debris lands on the magnet array, vacuum degrades and magnets demagnetise, and the whole undulator must be removed for repair. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自 2020 年起 SPring-8 以相鄰的 SACLA 8 GeV C 頻段直線加速器直接注入儲存環，取代原本的 1 GeV 直線加速器加 8 GeV 增能環。直線加速器的束流歸一化發射度約 1 µm·rad，在 8 GeV 下幾何發射度只有數十 pm，比儲存環的接受度小得多，因此注入束流可以用很小的振幅進入，減少損失與對儲存束流的擾動；這也是 SPring-8-II 小孔徑真空腔與低發射度環所必需的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Since 2020 SPring-8 has been injected directly from the neighbouring SACLA 8 GeV C-band linac, replacing the original 1 GeV linac plus 8 GeV booster. The linac beam has a normalised emittance of about 1 µm·rad, which at 8 GeV is a geometric emittance of only tens of picometres, far below the ring acceptance, so the injected beam enters with a very small amplitude, reducing losses and disturbance to the stored beam; this is also a prerequisite for the small-aperture chambers and low-emittance ring of SPring-8-II. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：C 頻段 5.712 GHz 加速結構梯度取 35 MV/m（教學假設）：8 GeV 需 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m 的有效加速長度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking a C-band 5.712 GHz structure gradient of 35 MV/m (teaching assumption), 8 GeV needs 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m of active length.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率
knowledge.text: 自 2020 年起 SPring-8 以相鄰的 SACLA 8 GeV C 頻段直線加速器直接注入儲存環，取代原本的 1 GeV 直線加速器加 8 GeV 增能環。直線加速器的束流歸一化發射度約 1 µm·rad，在 8 GeV 下幾何發射度只有數十 pm，比儲存環的接受度小得多，因此注入束流可以用很小的振幅進入，減少損失與對儲存束流的擾動；這也是 SPring-8-II 小孔徑真空腔與低發射度環所必需的。
knowledge.textEn: Since 2020 SPring-8 has been injected directly from the neighbouring SACLA 8 GeV C-band linac, replacing the original 1 GeV linac plus 8 GeV booster. The linac beam has a normalised emittance of about 1 µm·rad, which at 8 GeV is a geometric emittance of only tens of picometres, far below the ring acceptance, so the injected beam enters with a very small amplitude, reducing losses and disturbance to the stored beam; this is also a prerequisite for the small-aperture chambers and low-emittance ring of SPring-8-II.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低發射度注入器與注入效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency" is correct?
options: 注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。
自 2020 年起 SPring-8 以相鄰的 SACLA 8 GeV C 頻段直線加速器直接注入儲存環，取代原本的 1 GeV 直線加速器加 8 GeV 增能環。
只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。
optionsEn: An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter.
Since 2020 SPring-8 has been injected directly from the neighbouring SACLA 8 GeV C-band linac, replacing the original 1 GeV linac plus 8 GeV booster.
Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity.
quiz.explanation: 自 2020 年起 SPring-8 以相鄰的 SACLA 8 GeV C 頻段直線加速器直接注入儲存環，取代原本的 1 GeV 直線加速器加 8 GeV 增能環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Since 2020 SPring-8 has been injected directly from the neighbouring SACLA 8 GeV C-band linac, replacing the original 1 GeV linac plus 8 GeV booster. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：C 頻段 5.712 GHz 加速結構梯度取 35 MV/m（教學假設）：8 GeV 需 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m 的有效加速長度。幾何發射度 ε = ε_n/γ = 1×10⁻⁶/15 656 ≈ 64 pm·rad，儲存環接受度若為 10 nm·rad，則注入束流只佔其 0.6%；能量偏差若為 0.1%，在色散 η = 0.1 m 處對應 0.1 mm 的軌道偏移，遠小於 3% 的動量接受度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking a C-band 5.712 GHz structure gradient of 35 MV/m (teaching assumption), 8 GeV needs 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m of active length. Geometric emittance ε = ε_n/γ = 1×10⁻⁶/15 656 ≈ 64 pm·rad; if the ring acceptance is 10 nm·rad the injected beam occupies 0.6% of it; an energy error of 0.1% at dispersion η = 0.1 m corresponds to a 0.1 mm orbit offset, far inside the 3% momentum acceptance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在傳輸線末端以螢光屏或 OTR 配合四極掃描量注入束流的發射度與能散；以儲存環 DCCT 的電流階梯和傳輸線的電荷監視器算注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 看注入束流在頭幾百圈的振盪振幅並確認阻尼；以束流損失監視器定位注入時的損失位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure injected-beam emittance and energy spread at the end of the transfer line with a screen or OTR and a quadrupole scan; compute injection efficiency from the ring DCCT current step and the transfer-line charge monitor; watch the injected beam's oscillation amplitude over the first few hundred turns with turn-by-turn BPMs and confirm damping; and locate injection losses with beam-loss monitors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: C 頻段 5.712 GHz 加速結構梯度取 35 MV/m（教學假設）：8 GeV 需 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m 的有效加速長度。幾何發射度 ε = ε_n/γ = 1×10⁻⁶/15 656 ≈ 64 pm·rad，儲存環接受度若為 10 nm·rad，則注入束流只佔其 0.6%；能量偏差若為 0.1%，在色散 η = 0.1 m 處對應 0.1 mm 的軌道偏移，遠小於 3% 的動量接受度。
knowledge.textEn: Taking a C-band 5.712 GHz structure gradient of 35 MV/m (teaching assumption), 8 GeV needs 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m of active length. Geometric emittance ε = ε_n/γ = 1×10⁻⁶/15 656 ≈ 64 pm·rad; if the ring acceptance is 10 nm·rad the injected beam occupies 0.6% of it; an energy error of 0.1% at dispersion η = 0.1 m corresponds to a 0.1 mm orbit offset, far inside the 3% momentum acceptance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「低發射度注入器與注入效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。
電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。
C 頻段 5.712 GHz 加速結構梯度取 35 MV/m（教學假設）：8 GeV 需 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m 的有效加速長度。
optionsEn: If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.
Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss.
Taking a C-band 5.712 GHz structure gradient of 35 MV/m (teaching assumption), 8 GeV needs 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m of active length.
quiz.explanation: C 頻段 5.712 GHz 加速結構梯度取 35 MV/m（教學假設）：8 GeV 需 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m 的有效加速長度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Taking a C-band 5.712 GHz structure gradient of 35 MV/m (teaching assumption), 8 GeV needs 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m of active length. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在傳輸線末端以螢光屏或 OTR 配合四極掃描量注入束流的發射度與能散；以儲存環 DCCT 的電流階梯和傳輸線的電荷監視器算注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 看注入束流在頭幾百圈的振盪振幅並確認阻尼；以束流損失監視器定位注入時的損失位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure injected-beam emittance and energy spread at the end of the transfer line with a screen or OTR and a quadrupole scan; compute injection efficiency from the ring DCCT current step and the transfer-line charge monitor; watch the injected beam's oscillation amplitude over the first few hundred turns with turn-by-turn BPMs and confirm damping; and locate injection losses with beam-loss monitors. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：直線加速器與儲存環的射頻相位或能量若漂移，注入束流落在射頻桶邊緣，一半以上在頭幾圈內丟失，損失打在注入段真空腔與波盪器，劑量與退磁風險同時上升。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the RF phase or energy between linac and ring drifts, the injected beam lands at the edge of the RF bucket, more than half is lost within the first turns, and the losses strike injection-section chambers and undulators, raising dose and demagnetisation risk together.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在傳輸線末端以螢光屏或 OTR 配合四極掃描量注入束流的發射度與能散；以儲存環 DCCT 的電流階梯和傳輸線的電荷監視器算注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 看注入束流在頭幾百圈的振盪振幅並確認阻尼；以束流損失監視器定位注入時的損失位置。
knowledge.textEn: Measure injected-beam emittance and energy spread at the end of the transfer line with a screen or OTR and a quadrupole scan; compute injection efficiency from the ring DCCT current step and the transfer-line charge monitor; watch the injected beam's oscillation amplitude over the first few hundred turns with turn-by-turn BPMs and confirm damping; and locate injection losses with beam-loss monitors.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低發射度注入器與注入效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency"?
options: 在傳輸線末端以螢光屏或 OTR 配合四極掃描量注入束流的發射度與能散。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。
optionsEn: Measure injected-beam emittance and energy spread at the end of the transfer line with a screen or OTR and a quadrupole scan.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy.
quiz.explanation: 在傳輸線末端以螢光屏或 OTR 配合四極掃描量注入束流的發射度與能散；以儲存環 DCCT 的電流階梯和傳輸線的電荷監視器算注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 看注入束流在頭幾百圈的振盪振幅並確認阻尼；以束流損失監視器定位注入時的損失位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure injected-beam emittance and energy spread at the end of the transfer line with a screen or OTR and a quadrupole scan; compute injection efficiency from the ring DCCT current step and the transfer-line charge monitor; watch the injected beam's oscillation amplitude over the first few hundred turns with turn-by-turn BPMs and confirm damping; and locate injection losses with beam-loss monitors. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 直線加速器與儲存環的射頻相位或能量若漂移，注入束流落在射頻桶邊緣，一半以上在頭幾圈內丟失，損失打在注入段真空腔與波盪器，劑量與退磁風險同時上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the RF phase or energy between linac and ring drifts, the injected beam lands at the edge of the RF bucket, more than half is lost within the first turns, and the losses strike injection-section chambers and undulators, raising dose and demagnetisation risk together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：直線加速器的束流歸一化發射度約 1 µm·rad，在 8 GeV 下幾何發射度只有數十 pm，比儲存環的接受度小得多，因此注入束流可以用很小的振幅進入，減少損失與對儲存束流的擾動；這也是 SPring-8-II 小孔徑真空腔與低發射度環所必需的。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The linac beam has a normalised emittance of about 1 µm·rad, which at 8 GeV is a geometric emittance of only tens of picometres, far below the ring acceptance, so the injected beam enters with a very small amplitude, reducing losses and disturbance to the stored beam; this is also a prerequisite for the small-aperture chambers and low-emittance ring of SPring-8-II.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直線加速器與儲存環的射頻相位或能量若漂移，注入束流落在射頻桶邊緣，一半以上在頭幾圈內丟失，損失打在注入段真空腔與波盪器，劑量與退磁風險同時上升。
knowledge.textEn: If the RF phase or energy between linac and ring drifts, the injected beam lands at the edge of the RF bucket, more than half is lost within the first turns, and the losses strike injection-section chambers and undulators, raising dose and demagnetisation risk together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低發射度注入器與注入效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
直線加速器與儲存環的射頻相位或能量若漂移，注入束流落在射頻桶邊緣，一半以上在頭幾圈內丟失，損失打在注入段真空腔與波盪器，劑量與退磁風險同時上升。
只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If the RF phase or energy between linac and ring drifts, the injected beam lands at the edge of the RF bucket, more than half is lost within the first turns, and the losses strike injection-section chambers and undulators, raising dose and demagnetisation risk together.
Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity.
quiz.explanation: 直線加速器與儲存環的射頻相位或能量若漂移，注入束流落在射頻桶邊緣，一半以上在頭幾圈內丟失，損失打在注入段真空腔與波盪器，劑量與退磁風險同時上升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the RF phase or energy between linac and ring drifts, the injected beam lands at the edge of the RF bucket, more than half is lost within the first turns, and the losses strike injection-section chambers and undulators, raising dose and demagnetisation risk together. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數」與「同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting" and "Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 時間解析實驗需要隔離的單束團，其相鄰桶的雜散電荷必須低到 10⁻⁹ 到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度等級。SPring-8 以時間相關單光子計數（TCSPC）量束團純度：光二極體或 APD 計數每個光子相對射頻的到達時間，建立 2436 個桶的直方圖；再以共振的 RF 擊出把不要的桶內電子激發到孔徑外。要量到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度，統計計數必須累積到 10¹¹ 以上，所以量測時間與偵測器的計數率、死時間直接相關。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Time-resolved experiments need isolated single bunches whose neighbouring buckets carry stray charge at the 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ purity level. SPring-8 measures bunch purity with time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC): a photodiode or APD timestamps each photon against the RF and builds a histogram over the 2436 buckets, and a resonant RF knock-out drives electrons in unwanted buckets out of the aperture. Measuring a purity of 10⁻¹⁰ requires more than 10¹¹ accumulated counts, so measurement time is tied directly to detector count rate and dead time. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an APD count rate of 1×10⁶ s⁻¹ and a 1 h measurement, the total is 3.6×10⁹ counts and a satellite bucket at 10⁻⁹ averages only 3.6 counts with a statistical error of √3.6 ≈ 1.9 (53%).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數
knowledge.titleEn: Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting
knowledge.text: 時間解析實驗需要隔離的單束團，其相鄰桶的雜散電荷必須低到 10⁻⁹ 到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度等級。SPring-8 以時間相關單光子計數（TCSPC）量束團純度：光二極體或 APD 計數每個光子相對射頻的到達時間，建立 2436 個桶的直方圖；再以共振的 RF 擊出把不要的桶內電子激發到孔徑外。
knowledge.textEn: Time-resolved experiments need isolated single bunches whose neighbouring buckets carry stray charge at the 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ purity level. SPring-8 measures bunch purity with time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC): a photodiode or APD timestamps each photon against the RF and builds a histogram over the 2436 buckets, and a resonant RF knock-out drives electrons in unwanted buckets out of the aperture.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting" is correct?
options: 只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。
總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。
時間解析實驗需要隔離的單束團，其相鄰桶的雜散電荷必須低到 10⁻⁹ 到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度等級。
optionsEn: Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity.
If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change.
Time-resolved experiments need isolated single bunches whose neighbouring buckets carry stray charge at the 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ purity level.
quiz.explanation: 時間解析實驗需要隔離的單束團，其相鄰桶的雜散電荷必須低到 10⁻⁹ 到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度等級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Time-resolved experiments need isolated single bunches whose neighbouring buckets carry stray charge at the 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ purity level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。要把 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度量到 10% 的相對誤差需 100 個衛星計數，即主束團 10¹² 個計數，在 10⁶ s⁻¹ 下約需 10⁶ s；實務上必須以閘控把主束團的計數衰減 10³ 倍以上，才能在數小時內完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an APD count rate of 1×10⁶ s⁻¹ and a 1 h measurement, the total is 3.6×10⁹ counts and a satellite bucket at 10⁻⁹ averages only 3.6 counts with a statistical error of √3.6 ≈ 1.9 (53%). Measuring 10⁻¹⁰ purity to 10% relative error needs 100 satellite counts, that is 10¹² main-bunch counts, about 10⁶ s at 10⁶ s⁻¹; in practice the main-bunch counts must be gated down by more than 10³ to finish within hours. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率；比較擊出前後的直方圖確認衛星桶下降幅度；核對偵測器死時間造成的堆積效應，必要時以中性密度衰減片降低計數率重複量測，純度值應不隨計數率改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite); compare histograms before and after knock-out to confirm the satellite reduction; check pile-up from detector dead time and, if needed, repeat with neutral-density attenuation at a lower count rate, where the purity value must not change with rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。要把 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度量到 10% 的相對誤差需 100 個衛星計數，即主束團 10¹² 個計數，在 10⁶ s⁻¹ 下約需 10⁶ s；實務上必須以閘控把主束團的計數衰減 10³ 倍以上，才能在數小時內完成。
knowledge.textEn: With an APD count rate of 1×10⁶ s⁻¹ and a 1 h measurement, the total is 3.6×10⁹ counts and a satellite bucket at 10⁻⁹ averages only 3.6 counts with a statistical error of √3.6 ≈ 1.9 (53%). Measuring 10⁻¹⁰ purity to 10% relative error needs 100 satellite counts, that is 10¹² main-bunch counts, about 10⁶ s at 10⁶ s⁻¹; in practice the main-bunch counts must be gated down by more than 10³ to finish within hours.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting", which statement holds?
options: APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。
升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。
降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。
optionsEn: With an APD count rate of 1×10⁶ s⁻¹ and a 1 h measurement, the total is 3.6×10⁹ counts and a satellite bucket at 10⁻⁹ averages only 3.6 counts with a statistical error of √3.6 ≈ 1.9 (53%).
Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.
Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy.
quiz.explanation: APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With an APD count rate of 1×10⁶ s⁻¹ and a 1 h measurement, the total is 3.6×10⁹ counts and a satellite bucket at 10⁻⁹ averages only 3.6 counts with a statistical error of √3.6 ≈ 1.9 (53%). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率；比較擊出前後的直方圖確認衛星桶下降幅度；核對偵測器死時間造成的堆積效應，必要時以中性密度衰減片降低計數率重複量測，純度值應不隨計數率改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite); compare histograms before and after knock-out to confirm the satellite reduction; check pile-up from detector dead time and, if needed, repeat with neutral-density attenuation at a lower count rate, where the purity value must not change with rate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團；操作人員據此加強擊出，反而把主束團的電荷也擊掉一部分，壽命與通量一起下降而純度數字沒有變好。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite; operators then strengthen the knock-out, which also removes part of the main bunch, so lifetime and flux fall while the purity figure never improves.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率；比較擊出前後的直方圖確認衛星桶下降幅度；核對偵測器死時間造成的堆積效應，必要時以中性密度衰減片降低計數率重複量測，純度值應不隨計數率改變。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite); compare histograms before and after knock-out to confirm the satellite reduction; check pile-up from detector dead time and, if needed, repeat with neutral-density attenuation at a lower count rate, where the purity value must not change with rate.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率。
波盪器的功率密度只跟電流有關，與電子能量無關。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite).
Undulator power density depends only on current, not on electron energy.
quiz.explanation: 以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率；比較擊出前後的直方圖確認衛星桶下降幅度；核對偵測器死時間造成的堆積效應，必要時以中性密度衰減片降低計數率重複量測，純度值應不隨計數率改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite); compare histograms before and after knock-out to confirm the satellite reduction; check pile-up from detector dead time and, if needed, repeat with neutral-density attenuation at a lower count rate, where the purity value must not change with rate. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團；操作人員據此加強擊出，反而把主束團的電荷也擊掉一部分，壽命與通量一起下降而純度數字沒有變好。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite; operators then strengthen the knock-out, which also removes part of the main bunch, so lifetime and flux fall while the purity figure never improves. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：要量到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度，統計計數必須累積到 10¹¹ 以上，所以量測時間與偵測器的計數率、死時間直接相關。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measuring a purity of 10⁻¹⁰ requires more than 10¹¹ accumulated counts, so measurement time is tied directly to detector count rate and dead time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團；操作人員據此加強擊出，反而把主束團的電荷也擊掉一部分，壽命與通量一起下降而純度數字沒有變好。
knowledge.textEn: Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite; operators then strengthen the knock-out, which also removes part of the main bunch, so lifetime and flux fall while the purity figure never improves.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。
偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change.
Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite.
quiz.explanation: 偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團；操作人員據此加強擊出，反而把主束團的電荷也擊掉一部分，壽命與通量一起下降而純度數字沒有變好。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite; operators then strengthen the knock-out, which also removes part of the main bunch, so lifetime and flux fall while the purity figure never improves. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「同調分率計算（1 Å）」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同調成像、X 光光子相關光譜與奈米聚焦使用的是光束中橫向同調的部分，其比例近似為 (λ/4π)² 除以電子束與繞射項合成的相空間面積。在 1 Å 波長，λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad；SPring-8 現行水平發射度 2.4 nm·rad 使同調分率只有千分之幾，而 SPring-8-II 的 50 pm·rad 把它提高數十倍，這才是升級真正的驅動力，而不是總通量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同調分率計算（1 Å）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Coherent imaging, X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy and nanofocusing use only the transversely coherent part of the beam, whose fraction is roughly (λ/4π)² divided by the phase-space area of electron beam plus diffraction terms. At 1 Å wavelength λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad; the present SPring-8 horizontal emittance of 2.4 nm·rad leaves a coherent fraction of a few tenths of a percent, while the 50 pm·rad of SPring-8-II raises it by tens of times, and that gain, not total flux, is the real driver of the upgrade. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)]，ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm（λ = 1 Å）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)] with ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm at λ = 1 Å.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「同調分率計算（1 Å）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益
knowledge.titleEn: Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain
knowledge.text: 同調成像、X 光光子相關光譜與奈米聚焦使用的是光束中橫向同調的部分，其比例近似為 (λ/4π)² 除以電子束與繞射項合成的相空間面積。在 1 Å 波長，λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad；SPring-8 現行水平發射度 2.4 nm·rad 使同調分率只有千分之幾，而 SPring-8-II 的 50 pm·rad 把它提高數十倍，這才是升級真正的驅動力，而不是總通量。
knowledge.textEn: Coherent imaging, X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy and nanofocusing use only the transversely coherent part of the beam, whose fraction is roughly (λ/4π)² divided by the phase-space area of electron beam plus diffraction terms. At 1 Å wavelength λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad; the present SPring-8 horizontal emittance of 2.4 nm·rad leaves a coherent fraction of a few tenths of a percent, while the 50 pm·rad of SPring-8-II raises it by tens of times, and that gain, not total flux, is the real driver of the upgrade.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain" is correct?
options: 同調成像、X 光光子相關光譜與奈米聚焦使用的是光束中橫向同調的部分，其比例近似為 (λ/4π)² 除以電子束與繞射項合成的相空間面積。
總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。
隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。
optionsEn: Coherent imaging, X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy and nanofocusing use only the transversely coherent part of the beam, whose fraction is roughly (λ/4π)² divided by the phase-space area of electron beam plus diffraction terms.
If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change.
If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.
quiz.explanation: 同調成像、X 光光子相關光譜與奈米聚焦使用的是光束中橫向同調的部分，其比例近似為 (λ/4π)² 除以電子束與繞射項合成的相空間面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Coherent imaging, X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy and nanofocusing use only the transversely coherent part of the beam, whose fraction is roughly (λ/4π)² divided by the phase-space area of electron beam plus diffraction terms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同調分率計算（1 Å）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)]，ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm（λ = 1 Å）。現行：ε_x = 2400 pm、ε_y = 10 pm（教學假設）→ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.0033×0.44 ≈ 0.15%。SPring-8-II：ε_x = 50 pm → (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 0.138×0.44 ≈ 6.1%，同調分率提高約 40 倍；電流 100→200 mA 再把同調通量乘 2。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)] with ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm at λ = 1 Å. Present: ε_x = 2400 pm, ε_y = 10 pm (teaching assumption) gives (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.0033×0.44 ≈ 0.15%. SPring-8-II: ε_x = 50 pm gives (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 0.138×0.44 ≈ 6.1%, about 40 times higher, and the current step from 100 to 200 mA doubles the coherent flux again. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率；與用針孔相機量到的發射度和 β 函數算出的預測值比較；以同調繞射成像的重建品質作為最終的使用者端驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction; compare with the prediction from pinhole-camera emittance and the β function; and use the reconstruction quality of coherent diffraction imaging as the final user-side verification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)] with ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm at λ = 1 Å. Present: ε_x = 2400 pm, ε_y = 10 pm (teaching assumption) gives (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.0033×0.44 ≈ 0.15%. SPring-8-II: ε_x = 50 pm gives (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 0.138×0.44 ≈ 6.1%, about 40 times higher, and the current step from 100 to 200 mA doubles the coherent flux again.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain", which statement holds?
options: 電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。
F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)]，ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm（λ = 1 Å）。
波盪器的功率密度只跟電流有關，與電子能量無關。
optionsEn: Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss.
F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)] with ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm at λ = 1 Å.
Undulator power density depends only on current, not on electron energy.
quiz.explanation: F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)]，ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm（λ = 1 Å）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)] with ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm at λ = 1 Å. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「同調分率計算（1 Å）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率；與用針孔相機量到的發射度和 β 函數算出的預測值比較；以同調繞射成像的重建品質作為最終的使用者端驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction; compare with the prediction from pinhole-camera emittance and the β function; and use the reconstruction quality of coherent diffraction imaging as the final user-side verification. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation; accepting only at the source without measuring fringe visibility at the sample lets the upgrade's coherence gain be eaten in the optics chain.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率；與用針孔相機量到的發射度和 β 函數算出的預測值比較；以同調繞射成像的重建品質作為最終的使用者端驗證。
knowledge.textEn: On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction; compare with the prediction from pinhole-camera emittance and the β function; and use the reconstruction quality of coherent diffraction imaging as the final user-side verification.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。
在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter.
On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction.
quiz.explanation: 在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率；與用針孔相機量到的發射度和 β 函數算出的預測值比較；以同調繞射成像的重建品質作為最終的使用者端驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction; compare with the prediction from pinhole-camera emittance and the β function; and use the reconstruction quality of coherent diffraction imaging as the final user-side verification. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「同調分率計算（1 Å）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation; accepting only at the source without measuring fringe visibility at the sample lets the upgrade's coherence gain be eaten in the optics chain. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在 1 Å 波長，λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad；SPring-8 現行水平發射度 2.4 nm·rad 使同調分率只有千分之幾，而 SPring-8-II 的 50 pm·rad 把它提高數十倍，這才是升級真正的驅動力，而不是總通量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At 1 Å wavelength λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad; the present SPring-8 horizontal emittance of 2.4 nm·rad leaves a coherent fraction of a few tenths of a percent, while the 50 pm·rad of SPring-8-II raises it by tens of times, and that gain, not total flux, is the real driver of the upgrade.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。
knowledge.textEn: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation; accepting only at the source without measuring fringe visibility at the sample lets the upgrade's coherence gain be eaten in the optics chain.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。
optionsEn: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.
quiz.explanation: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation; accepting only at the source without measuring fringe visibility at the sample lets the upgrade's coherence gain be eaten in the optics chain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」與「綠色升級的驗收指標與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout" and "Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。新晶格的周長 1435.428 m 比現行 1435.949 m 短 0.521 m，諧波數若維持 2436，射頻頻率必須上移；所有磁鐵與真空腔先在樑架上預組裝並完成對準，停機期只做拆舊、吊裝與連接。光束線的光源點必須保留，而降能後每支波盪器都要換成更短週期的 IVU-II 才能維持原有的光子能量範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The new lattice circumference of 1435.428 m is 0.521 m shorter than the present 1435.949 m, so with the harmonic number kept at 2436 the RF frequency must rise; all magnets and chambers are pre-assembled and aligned on girders so that the blackout covers only removal, rigging and connection. Beamline source points must be preserved, and after the energy reduction every undulator is replaced by a shorter-period IVU-II to keep its photon-energy range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機
knowledge.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout
knowledge.text: SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。新晶格的周長 1435.428 m 比現行 1435.949 m 短 0.521 m，諧波數若維持 2436，射頻頻率必須上移；所有磁鐵與真空腔先在樑架上預組裝並完成對準，停機期只做拆舊、吊裝與連接。
knowledge.textEn: SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The new lattice circumference of 1435.428 m is 0.521 m shorter than the present 1435.949 m, so with the harmonic number kept at 2436 the RF frequency must rise; all magnets and chambers are pre-assembled and aligned on girders so that the blackout covers only removal, rigging and connection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout" is correct?
options: 隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。
SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。
升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。
optionsEn: If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.
SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year.
Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.
quiz.explanation: SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_RF = h·c/C：現行 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz；新環 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz，上移約 184 kHz，腔體調諧與低階模濾波器都要涵蓋。波盪器：λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ²，8→6 GeV 時 γ² 乘 0.5625，λ_u = 32 mm、K = 2.2 的基頻從 5.55 keV 掉到 3.12 keV；要維持 5.55 keV 可改用 λ_u = 18 mm（相同 K）或維持 32 mm 把 K 降到 1.36。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover. Undulators: λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ², and going from 8 to 6 GeV multiplies γ² by 0.5625, so the 5.55 keV fundamental of λ_u = 32 mm at K = 2.2 drops to 3.12 keV; keeping 5.55 keV needs λ_u = 18 mm at the same K, or 32 mm with K lowered to 1.36. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover. Undulators: λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ², and going from 8 to 6 GeV multiplies γ² by 0.5625, so the 5.55 keV fundamental of λ_u = 32 mm at K = 2.2 drops to 3.12 keV; keeping 5.55 keV needs λ_u = 18 mm at the same K, or 32 mm with K lowered to 1.36.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout", which statement holds?
options: 降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。
注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。
optionsEn: Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy.
An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter.
quiz.explanationEn: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。
knowledge.textEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout"?
options: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。
optionsEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity.
quiz.explanation: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：光束線的光源點必須保留，而降能後每支波盪器都要換成更短週期的 IVU-II 才能維持原有的光子能量範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beamline source points must be preserved, and after the energy reduction every undulator is replaced by a shorter-period IVU-II to keep its photon-energy range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。
knowledge.textEn: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存。
升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all.
Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.
quiz.explanation: 若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPring-8-II 的驗收同時包含光源性能與用電：發射度 50 pm·rad、電流 200 mA、亮度提升、以及永磁彎轉磁鐵與降能帶來的電力節省。射頻功率由 U₀·I 決定，彎轉磁鐵改用永磁後磁鐵電源的用電歸零，但阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加的輻射損失要由射頻補回；交接文件必須把每一項性能指標對應到量測方法、不確定度與運轉條件，使用者設施才能據此排程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of SPring-8-II covers both source performance and electricity: 50 pm·rad emittance, 200 mA, the brilliance gain, and the power saved by permanent-magnet bends and the lower energy. RF power follows from U₀·I; permanent-magnet dipoles eliminate magnet power-supply consumption, but the extra radiation loss of damping wigglers must be restored by the RF; the handoff document must map every performance metric to a measurement method, an uncertainty and an operating condition before users can schedule on it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
