quiz.explanationEn: Record forward, reflected and cavity-probe waveforms of every RF station with the low-level RF (LLRF) system and confirm that fill, flat-top and decay timings agree with the relation above; then log charge and orbit bunch by bunch with charge monitors and beam-position monitors to confirm that all 2700 slots sit on the flat top and that amplitude and phase drift along the flat top stay within specification. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若負載 Q 設錯或腔體失諧，充填時間變長、平頂縮短，列尾束團在場強下降處被加速而能量偏低，波盪器共振波長跟著偏移，脈衝列後段失去雷射增益；使用者只在列的前段看到 X 光，卻常被誤判為波盪器或光學問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With a wrong loaded Q or a detuned cavity, the fill lengthens and the flat top shrinks; bunches at the end of the train are accelerated on a falling field and arrive low in energy, their undulator resonance shifts and the tail of the train loses lasing. Users see X-rays only at the start of the train, which is often misdiagnosed as an undulator or optics problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種突發模式與每秒百餘發的常溫銅腔或連續波機器是完全不同的系統邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This burst mode is a completely different system boundary from a copper linac firing about a hundred pulses per second or a continuous-wave machine.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導腔沒有損耗，所以脈衝列可以任意加長，只受電子槍限制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Superconducting cavities are lossless, so the train can be made arbitrarily long and only the gun limits it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若負載 Q 設錯或腔體失諧，充填時間變長、平頂縮短，列尾束團在場強下降處被加速而能量偏低，波盪器共振波長跟著偏移，脈衝列後段失去雷射增益；使用者只在列的前段看到 X 光，卻常被誤判為波盪器或光學問題。

Users see X-rays only at the start of the train, which is often misdiagnosed as an undulator or optics problem.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若負載 Q 設錯或腔體失諧，充填時間變長、平頂縮短，列尾束團在場強下降處被加速而能量偏低，波盪器共振波長跟著偏移，脈衝列後段失去雷射增益。
要改變 X 光光子能量就一定得改變電子束能量。

With a wrong loaded Q or a detuned cavity, the fill lengthens and the flat top shrinks.
Changing the X-ray photon energy always requires changing the electron energy.

steps.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「可變間隙波盪器共振」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Variable-gap undulator resonance” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電子在週期 λu 的交替磁場中蛇行，在電子座標中看到被勞侖茲收縮的磁場週期，發出的輻射再經都卜勒壓縮回實驗室，因此共振波長為 λ = λu/(2γ²)·(1 + K²/2)，K = 0.934·B[T]·λu[cm]。European XFEL 的 SASE1 與 SASE2 為 175 m 長的可變間隙波盪器，涵蓋約 3 keV 到 25 keV 以上；SASE3 長 105 m，涵蓋 0.26 到 3 keV。改變磁鐵間隙就改變 B 與 K，因此電子能量固定時各波盪器仍可獨立調整光子能量，這是多條光束線同時服務使用者的物理基礎。SASE 從電子的散粒雜訊起振，單程通過中指數放大並在飽和前形成微束團。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可變間隙波盪器共振」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Electrons wiggle through an alternating field of period λu; in their own frame they see a Lorentz-contracted period, and the emitted radiation is Doppler-compressed back into the laboratory, giving the resonant wavelength λ = λu/(2γ²)·(1 + K²/2) with K = 0.934·B[T]·λu[cm]. At European XFEL, SASE1 and SASE2 are 175 m variable-gap undulators covering about 3 keV to beyond 25 keV, and SASE3 is 105 m long covering 0.26 to 3 keV. Opening or closing the magnet gap changes B and K, so each undulator tunes its photon energy independently at a fixed electron energy, which is the physical basis for serving several beamlines at once. SASE starts from electron shot noise, amplifies exponentially in a single pass and microbunches the beam before saturation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Variable-gap undulator resonance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take 14 GeV electrons (γ ≈ 27,397), SASE1 period λu = 40 mm and K = 2.5: λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm, about 11.3 keV; opening the gap to K = 1.65 gives λ ≈ 0.063 nm, about 19.7 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「要改變 X 光光子能量就一定得改變電子束能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Changing the X-ray photon energy always requires changing the electron energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「可變間隙波盪器共振」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Variable-gap undulator resonance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋

steps.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可變間隙波盪器共振」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Variable-gap undulator resonance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以電子能量 14 GeV（γ ≈ 27,397）、SASE1 週期 λu = 40 mm、K = 2.5 為例：λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm，約 11.3 keV；把間隙開大到 K = 1.65 時 λ ≈ 0.063 nm，約 19.7 keV。SASE3 週期 68 mm、K = 4.0 時 λ ≈ 0.41 nm，約 3.0 keV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take 14 GeV electrons (γ ≈ 27,397), SASE1 period λu = 40 mm and K = 2.5: λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm, about 11.3 keV; opening the gap to K = 1.65 gives λ ≈ 0.063 nm, about 19.7 keV. SASE3 with a 68 mm period and K = 4.0 gives λ ≈ 0.41 nm, about 3.0 keV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由磁量測得到的間隙對 K 曲線計算預期光子能量，再以單發光譜儀或晶體單色器掃描量到的中心能量比對；接著做 K 掃描，確認共振能量隨 1/(1 + K²/2) 變化，並以電子能譜儀量到的束流能量校正 γ，把間隙、K 與光子能量三者的查表一起歸檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the expected photon energy from the measured gap-to-K curve and compare it with the centre energy from a single-shot spectrometer or a crystal-monochromator scan; then scan K to confirm that the resonant energy follows 1/(1 + K²/2), calibrate γ against the electron energy from the energy spectrometer, and archive the gap, K and photon-energy tables together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Take 14 GeV electrons (γ ≈ 27,397), SASE1 period λu = 40 mm and K = 2.5: λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm, about 11.3 keV; opening the gap to K = 1.65 gives λ ≈ 0.063 nm, about 19.7 keV. SASE3 with a 68 mm period and K = 4.0 gives λ ≈ 0.41 nm, about 3.0 keV.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage", which statement holds?

三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。

At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise.

steps.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「可變間隙波盪器共振」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Variable-gap undulator resonance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 由磁量測得到的間隙對 K 曲線計算預期光子能量，再以單發光譜儀或晶體單色器掃描量到的中心能量比對；接著做 K 掃描，確認共振能量隨 1/(1 + K²/2) 變化，並以電子能譜儀量到的束流能量校正 γ，把間隙、K 與光子能量三者的查表一起歸檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the expected photon energy from the measured gap-to-K curve and compare it with the centre energy from a single-shot spectrometer or a crystal-monochromator scan; then scan K to confirm that the resonant energy follows 1/(1 + K²/2), calibrate γ against the electron energy from the energy spectrometer, and archive the gap, K and photon-energy tables together. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：電子能量讀數若有 0.1% 誤差，因 λ ∝ 1/γ²，光子能量會偏約 0.2%，在 12 keV 約 24 eV，足以讓吸收邊附近的光譜實驗落在錯誤位置；若間隙編碼器零點漂移，則不同光束線之間的能量校正也會互相不一致。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 0.1% error in the electron-energy reading shifts the photon energy by about 0.2% because λ ∝ 1/γ², about 24 eV at 12 keV, enough to put an absorption-edge spectroscopy experiment in the wrong place; a drifting gap-encoder zero also makes the energy calibration of different beamlines disagree.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Compute the expected photon energy from the measured gap-to-K curve and compare it with the centre energy from a single-shot spectrometer or a crystal-monochromator scan; then scan K to confirm that the resonant energy follows 1/(1 + K²/2), calibrate γ against the electron energy from the energy spectrometer, and archive the gap, K and photon-energy tables together. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可變間隙波盪器共振」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Variable-gap undulator resonance” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 電子能量讀數若有 0.1% 誤差，因 λ ∝ 1/γ²，光子能量會偏約 0.2%，在 12 keV 約 24 eV，足以讓吸收邊附近的光譜實驗落在錯誤位置；若間隙編碼器零點漂移，則不同光束線之間的能量校正也會互相不一致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 0.1% error in the electron-energy reading shifts the photon energy by about 0.2% because λ ∝ 1/γ², about 24 eV at 12 keV, enough to put an absorption-edge spectroscopy experiment in the wrong place; a drifting gap-encoder zero also makes the energy calibration of different beamlines disagree. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：SASE 從電子的散粒雜訊起振，單程通過中指數放大並在飽和前形成微束團。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: SASE starts from electron shot noise, amplifies exponentially in a single pass and microbunches the beam before saturation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「要改變 X 光光子能量就一定得改變電子束能量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Changing the X-ray photon energy always requires changing the electron energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電子能量讀數若有 0.1% 誤差，因 λ ∝ 1/γ²，光子能量會偏約 0.2%，在 12 keV 約 24 eV，足以讓吸收邊附近的光譜實驗落在錯誤位置；若間隙編碼器零點漂移，則不同光束線之間的能量校正也會互相不一致。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so the cryoplant only has to cover external heat leaks.

A 0.1% error in the electron-energy reading shifts the photon energy by about 0.2% because λ ∝ 1/γ², about 24 eV at 12 keV, enough to put an absorption-edge spectroscopy experiment in the wrong place.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載」與「波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load" and "Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主加速器有 96 個低溫模組（注入器另有 2 個，其中一個是 3.9 GHz 三次諧波模組，用來線性化縱向相空間），每個模組裝 8 個 1.3 GHz 九格鈮腔。腔體以高純度鈮板深抽成型、電子束焊接，再經電解拋光、高壓超純水沖洗與無塵室組裝，任何殘留微粒都可能成為場發射源。腔體浸在約 2 K 的超流氦中，Q₀ 可達 10¹⁰，但每瓦在 2 K 移除的熱，在室溫端要付出數百瓦以上的壓縮機功率，因此 Q₀ 與工作比直接決定營運成本。腔體由 E. Zanon 與 Research Instruments 兩家廠商各製作一半，模組在 CEA Saclay 組裝後於 DESY 進行射頻測試。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main linac has 96 cryomodules (the injector has 2 more, one a 3.9 GHz third-harmonic module that linearises the longitudinal phase space), each holding eight 1.3 GHz nine-cell niobium cavities. Cavities are deep-drawn from high-purity niobium sheet, electron-beam welded, electropolished, rinsed with high-pressure ultrapure water and assembled in a clean room; any residual particle can become a field-emission site. Immersed in superfluid helium near 2 K they reach Q₀ of 10¹⁰, yet every watt removed at 2 K costs hundreds of watts or more of compressor power at room temperature, so Q₀ and duty factor set operating cost directly. Production was split between E. Zanon and Research Instruments, and modules were assembled at CEA Saclay before RF testing at DESY. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：能量增益 ≈ N·L_act·E_acc（同相加速的教學估算）：768 腔 × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Energy gain ≈ N·L_act·E_acc (on-crest teaching estimate): 768 cavities × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導腔沒有電阻，所以低溫系統只需補償外界熱漏。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so the cryoplant only has to cover external heat leaks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載

steps.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：能量增益 ≈ N·L_act·E_acc（同相加速的教學估算）：768 腔 × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV。動態熱負載 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀)：V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV，R/Q = 1036 Ω，Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰，脈衝內約 58 W；乘上 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% 工作比，每腔平均約 0.87 W，768 腔約 670 W（2 K），尚未計入靜態熱漏。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Energy gain ≈ N·L_act·E_acc (on-crest teaching estimate): 768 cavities × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV. Dynamic load P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀): V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV, R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ give about 58 W during the pulse; with a 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% duty factor that is about 0.87 W per cavity and about 670 W at 2 K for 768 cavities, before static losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光；模組測試量每腔最大可用梯度、由氦蒸發率推算的動態熱負載與勞侖茲力失諧；安裝後以能譜儀量到的束流能量反推梯度總和，與腔體資料表的加總比對，找出運轉中退化的射頻站。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Q₀ versus E_acc in a vertical test cryostat while logging field-emission X-rays with radiation detectors; in module tests record the maximum usable gradient per cavity, the dynamic load inferred from helium boil-off and the Lorentz-force detuning; after installation back out the summed gradient from the beam energy measured on the spectrometer and compare it with the summed cavity data to find RF stations that degraded in operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 能量增益 ≈ N·L_act·E_acc（同相加速的教學估算）：768 腔 × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV。動態熱負載 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀)：V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV，R/Q = 1036 Ω，Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰，脈衝內約 58 W；乘上 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% 工作比，每腔平均約 0.87 W，768 腔約 670 W（2 K），尚未計入靜態熱漏。
knowledge.textEn: Energy gain ≈ N·L_act·E_acc (on-crest teaching estimate): 768 cavities × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV. Dynamic load P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀): V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV, R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ give about 58 W during the pulse; with a 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% duty factor that is about 0.87 W per cavity and about 670 W at 2 K for 768 cavities, before static losses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load", which statement holds?
options: 每個畫素只要一組偏移與增益常數就能完成校正。
能量增益 ≈ N·L_act·E_acc（同相加速的教學估算）：768 腔 × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV。
超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。
optionsEn: One offset and one gain constant per pixel are enough to calibrate the detector.
Energy gain ≈ N·L_act·E_acc (on-crest teaching estimate): 768 cavities × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV.
A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 能量增益 ≈ N·L_act·E_acc（同相加速的教學估算）：768 腔 × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy gain ≈ N·L_act·E_acc (on-crest teaching estimate): 768 cavities × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光；模組測試量每腔最大可用梯度、由氦蒸發率推算的動態熱負載與勞侖茲力失諧；安裝後以能譜儀量到的束流能量反推梯度總和，與腔體資料表的加總比對，找出運轉中退化的射頻站。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Q₀ versus E_acc in a vertical test cryostat while logging field-emission X-rays with radiation detectors; in module tests record the maximum usable gradient per cavity, the dynamic load inferred from helium boil-off and the Lorentz-force detuning; after installation back out the summed gradient from the beam energy measured on the spectrometer and compare it with the summed cavity data to find RF stations that degraded in operation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：組裝時帶入的微粒在高場下形成場發射，產生暗電流與輻射、加熱腔體並使 Q₀ 驟降；嚴重時腔體失超，該射頻站只能降梯度運轉，整機最高電子能量下降，而硬 X 光上限隨 γ² 一起下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Particles introduced during assembly become field emitters at high field, producing dark current and radiation, heating the cavity and collapsing Q₀; in severe cases the cavity quenches and its RF station must run at reduced gradient, lowering the maximum electron energy and, with γ², the hard X-ray limit.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光；模組測試量每腔最大可用梯度、由氦蒸發率推算的動態熱負載與勞侖茲力失諧；安裝後以能譜儀量到的束流能量反推梯度總和，與腔體資料表的加總比對，找出運轉中退化的射頻站。
knowledge.textEn: Measure Q₀ versus E_acc in a vertical test cryostat while logging field-emission X-rays with radiation detectors; in module tests record the maximum usable gradient per cavity, the dynamic load inferred from helium boil-off and the Lorentz-force detuning; after installation back out the summed gradient from the beam energy measured on the spectrometer and compare it with the summed cavity data to find RF stations that degraded in operation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
超導腔沒有損耗，所以脈衝列可以任意加長，只受電子槍限制。
腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Superconducting cavities are lossless, so the train can be made arbitrarily long and only the gun limits it.
Measure Q₀ versus E_acc in a vertical test cryostat while logging field-emission X-rays with radiation detectors.
quiz.explanation: 腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光；模組測試量每腔最大可用梯度、由氦蒸發率推算的動態熱負載與勞侖茲力失諧；安裝後以能譜儀量到的束流能量反推梯度總和，與腔體資料表的加總比對，找出運轉中退化的射頻站。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure Q₀ versus E_acc in a vertical test cryostat while logging field-emission X-rays with radiation detectors; in module tests record the maximum usable gradient per cavity, the dynamic load inferred from helium boil-off and the Lorentz-force detuning; after installation back out the summed gradient from the beam energy measured on the spectrometer and compare it with the summed cavity data to find RF stations that degraded in operation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 組裝時帶入的微粒在高場下形成場發射，產生暗電流與輻射、加熱腔體並使 Q₀ 驟降；嚴重時腔體失超，該射頻站只能降梯度運轉，整機最高電子能量下降，而硬 X 光上限隨 γ² 一起下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Particles introduced during assembly become field emitters at high field, producing dark current and radiation, heating the cavity and collapsing Q₀; in severe cases the cavity quenches and its RF station must run at reduced gradient, lowering the maximum electron energy and, with γ², the hard X-ray limit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：腔體由 E. Zanon 與 Research Instruments 兩家廠商各製作一半，模組在 CEA Saclay 組裝後於 DESY 進行射頻測試。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Zanon and Research Instruments, and modules were assembled at CEA Saclay before RF testing at DESY.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導腔沒有電阻，所以低溫系統只需補償外界熱漏。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so the cryoplant only has to cover external heat leaks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 組裝時帶入的微粒在高場下形成場發射，產生暗電流與輻射、加熱腔體並使 Q₀ 驟降；嚴重時腔體失超，該射頻站只能降梯度運轉，整機最高電子能量下降，而硬 X 光上限隨 γ² 一起下降。
knowledge.textEn: Particles introduced during assembly become field emitters at high field, producing dark current and radiation, heating the cavity and collapsing Q₀; in severe cases the cavity quenches and its RF station must run at reduced gradient, lowering the maximum electron energy and, with γ², the hard X-ray limit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 組裝時帶入的微粒在高場下形成場發射，產生暗電流與輻射、加熱腔體並使 Q₀ 驟降。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要每段波盪器的 K 值都調好，段與段之間的間隔不會影響增益。
optionsEn: Particles introduced during assembly become field emitters at high field, producing dark current and radiation, heating the cavity and collapsing Q₀.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If every segment has the right K, the gaps between segments cannot affect the gain.
quiz.explanation: 組裝時帶入的微粒在高場下形成場發射，產生暗電流與輻射、加熱腔體並使 Q₀ 驟降；嚴重時腔體失超，該射頻站只能降梯度運轉，整機最高電子能量下降，而硬 X 光上限隨 γ² 一起下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Particles introduced during assembly become field emitters at high field, producing dark current and radiation, heating the cavity and collapsing Q₀; in severe cases the cavity quenches and its RF station must run at reduced gradient, lowering the maximum electron energy and, with γ², the hard X-ray limit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SASE1 與 SASE2 各由 35 段 5 m 長的永久磁鐵波盪器組成，段與段之間留 1.1 m 間隔，放置四極磁鐵、束流位置監測器與相位移相器。每段的間隙由馬達與編碼器控制，微米級的間隙差就會改變 K；磁量測後以墊片修正電子軌跡與相位誤差。電子在無磁場的間隔中相對於光的落後量與在波盪器中不同，若不補償，各段的輻射以錯誤相位疊加，增益長度變長甚至無法飽和。相位移相器是一個小型磁鐵彎道，加長電子路徑使總落後量為波長的整數倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SASE1 and SASE2 each consist of 35 permanent-magnet undulator segments 5 m long, separated by 1.1 m intersections that hold a quadrupole, a beam-position monitor and a phase shifter. Each gap is driven by motors with encoders, and a micrometre gap difference already changes K; after magnetic measurement, shims correct the electron trajectory and phase errors. In the field-free intersection the electron falls behind the light by a different amount than inside the undulator, so without compensation the segments radiate with the wrong relative phase, the gain length grows and saturation may never be reached. The phase shifter is a small magnetic chicane that lengthens the electron path so the total slippage is an integer number of wavelengths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：忽略段端邊緣場，長 L_d 的自由漂移中電子相對光落後 ΔL = L_d/(2γ²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Neglecting segment end fields, an electron in a free drift of length L_d falls behind the light by ΔL = L_d/(2γ²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每段波盪器的 K 值都調好，段與段之間的間隔不會影響增益。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every segment has the right K, the gaps between segments cannot affect the gain." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配
knowledge.titleEn: Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching
knowledge.text: SASE1 與 SASE2 各由 35 段 5 m 長的永久磁鐵波盪器組成，段與段之間留 1.1 m 間隔，放置四極磁鐵、束流位置監測器與相位移相器。每段的間隙由馬達與編碼器控制，微米級的間隙差就會改變 K；磁量測後以墊片修正電子軌跡與相位誤差。
knowledge.textEn: SASE1 and SASE2 each consist of 35 permanent-magnet undulator segments 5 m long, separated by 1.1 m intersections that hold a quadrupole, a beam-position monitor and a phase shifter. Each gap is driven by motors with encoders, and a micrometre gap difference already changes K; after magnetic measurement, shims correct the electron trajectory and phase errors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每段波盪器的 K 值都調好，段與段之間的間隔不會影響增益。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every segment has the right K, the gaps between segments cannot affect the gain. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching" is correct?
options: 只要每段波盪器的 K 值都調好，段與段之間的間隔不會影響增益。
SASE1 與 SASE2 各由 35 段 5 m 長的永久磁鐵波盪器組成，段與段之間留 1.1 m 間隔，放置四極磁鐵、束流位置監測器與相位移相器。
掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。
optionsEn: If every segment has the right K, the gaps between segments cannot affect the gain.
SASE1 and SASE2 each consist of 35 permanent-magnet undulator segments 5 m long, separated by 1.1 m intersections that hold a quadrupole, a beam-position monitor and a phase shifter.
At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise.
quiz.explanation: SASE1 與 SASE2 各由 35 段 5 m 長的永久磁鐵波盪器組成，段與段之間留 1.1 m 間隔，放置四極磁鐵、束流位置監測器與相位移相器。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: SASE1 and SASE2 each consist of 35 permanent-magnet undulator segments 5 m long, separated by 1.1 m intersections that hold a quadrupole, a beam-position monitor and a phase shifter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：忽略段端邊緣場，長 L_d 的自由漂移中電子相對光落後 ΔL = L_d/(2γ²)。取 L_d = 1.1 m、γ = 27,397（14 GeV）：ΔL ≈ 0.733 nm；若 λ = 0.110 nm（K = 2.5），相當於 6.67 個波長，移相器需再補約 0.33λ ≈ 0.037 nm，使總落後為 7λ。光子能量改變時補償量也改變，因此移相器設定必須與 K 值連動查表。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Neglecting segment end fields, an electron in a free drift of length L_d falls behind the light by ΔL = L_d/(2γ²). With L_d = 1.1 m and γ = 27,397 (14 GeV), ΔL ≈ 0.733 nm; for λ = 0.110 nm (K = 2.5) that is 6.67 wavelengths, so the phase shifter adds about 0.33λ ≈ 0.037 nm to make the total slip 7λ. The required delay changes with photon energy, so the shifter setting must be tabulated together with K. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在磁量測台上以霍爾探頭與拉線線圈量每段的 K 值、軌跡與相位誤差均方根，並量移相器的相位積分對間隙曲線；上線後以逐段開啟法量 X 光脈衝能量對段數的增長曲線，並在每個段間掃描移相器，確認脈衝能量的極大值落在查表預測的設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the magnetic bench measure each segment's K, trajectory and RMS phase error with Hall probes and stretched-wire coils, and record the phase-shifter phase integral versus gap; on the machine, measure the gain curve of X-ray pulse energy versus number of closed segments and scan the phase shifter at each intersection, confirming that the pulse-energy maximum lands on the tabulated setting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 忽略段端邊緣場，長 L_d 的自由漂移中電子相對光落後 ΔL = L_d/(2γ²)。取 L_d = 1.1 m、γ = 27,397（14 GeV）：ΔL ≈ 0.733 nm；若 λ = 0.110 nm（K = 2.5），相當於 6.67 個波長，移相器需再補約 0.33λ ≈ 0.037 nm，使總落後為 7λ。光子能量改變時補償量也改變，因此移相器設定必須與 K 值連動查表。
knowledge.textEn: Neglecting segment end fields, an electron in a free drift of length L_d falls behind the light by ΔL = L_d/(2γ²). With L_d = 1.1 m and γ = 27,397 (14 GeV), ΔL ≈ 0.733 nm; for λ = 0.110 nm (K = 2.5) that is 6.67 wavelengths, so the phase shifter adds about 0.33λ ≈ 0.037 nm to make the total slip 7λ. The required delay changes with photon energy, so the shifter setting must be tabulated together with K.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching", which statement holds?
options: 三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。
超導腔沒有損耗，所以脈衝列可以任意加長，只受電子槍限制。
忽略段端邊緣場，長 L_d 的自由漂移中電子相對光落後 ΔL = L_d/(2γ²)。
optionsEn: The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent.
Superconducting cavities are lossless, so the train can be made arbitrarily long and only the gun limits it.
Neglecting segment end fields, an electron in a free drift of length L_d falls behind the light by ΔL = L_d/(2γ²).
quiz.explanation: 忽略段端邊緣場，長 L_d 的自由漂移中電子相對光落後 ΔL = L_d/(2γ²)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Neglecting segment end fields, an electron in a free drift of length L_d falls behind the light by ΔL = L_d/(2γ²). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在磁量測台上以霍爾探頭與拉線線圈量每段的 K 值、軌跡與相位誤差均方根，並量移相器的相位積分對間隙曲線；上線後以逐段開啟法量 X 光脈衝能量對段數的增長曲線，並在每個段間掃描移相器，確認脈衝能量的極大值落在查表預測的設定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the magnetic bench measure each segment's K, trajectory and RMS phase error with Hall probes and stretched-wire coils, and record the phase-shifter phase integral versus gap; on the machine, measure the gain curve of X-ray pulse energy versus number of closed segments and scan the phase shifter at each intersection, confirming that the pulse-energy maximum lands on the tabulated setting. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某個段間相位錯了半個波長時，下一段的輻射與前段破壞性干涉，增益曲線出現平台或停滯；若換能量後移相器查表沒有跟著 K 更新，脈衝能量大幅掉落，看起來像電子束品質問題而誤導調機方向。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If one intersection is off by half a wavelength, the next segment radiates destructively against the previous one and the gain curve shows a plateau or stall; if the phase-shifter table is not updated with K after an energy change, pulse energy collapses and looks like an electron-beam quality problem, sending tuning in the wrong direction.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在磁量測台上以霍爾探頭與拉線線圈量每段的 K 值、軌跡與相位誤差均方根，並量移相器的相位積分對間隙曲線；上線後以逐段開啟法量 X 光脈衝能量對段數的增長曲線，並在每個段間掃描移相器，確認脈衝能量的極大值落在查表預測的設定。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching"?
options: 在磁量測台上以霍爾探頭與拉線線圈量每段的 K 值、軌跡與相位誤差均方根，並量移相器的相位積分對間隙曲線。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
要改變 X 光光子能量就一定得改變電子束能量。
optionsEn: On the magnetic bench measure each segment's K, trajectory and RMS phase error with Hall probes and stretched-wire coils, and record the phase-shifter phase integral versus gap.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Changing the X-ray photon energy always requires changing the electron energy.

quiz.explanationEn: On the magnetic bench measure each segment's K, trajectory and RMS phase error with Hall probes and stretched-wire coils, and record the phase-shifter phase integral versus gap; on the machine, measure the gain curve of X-ray pulse energy versus number of closed segments and scan the phase shifter at each intersection, confirming that the pulse-energy maximum lands on the tabulated setting. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某個段間相位錯了半個波長時，下一段的輻射與前段破壞性干涉，增益曲線出現平台或停滯；若換能量後移相器查表沒有跟著 K 更新，脈衝能量大幅掉落，看起來像電子束品質問題而誤導調機方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If one intersection is off by half a wavelength, the next segment radiates destructively against the previous one and the gain curve shows a plateau or stall; if the phase-shifter table is not updated with K after an energy change, pulse energy collapses and looks like an electron-beam quality problem, sending tuning in the wrong direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相位移相器是一個小型磁鐵彎道，加長電子路徑使總落後量為波長的整數倍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The phase shifter is a small magnetic chicane that lengthens the electron path so the total slippage is an integer number of wavelengths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每段波盪器的 K 值都調好，段與段之間的間隔不會影響增益。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every segment has the right K, the gaps between segments cannot affect the gain." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某個段間相位錯了半個波長時，下一段的輻射與前段破壞性干涉，增益曲線出現平台或停滯；若換能量後移相器查表沒有跟著 K 更新，脈衝能量大幅掉落，看起來像電子束品質問題而誤導調機方向。
knowledge.textEn: If one intersection is off by half a wavelength, the next segment radiates destructively against the previous one and the gain curve shows a plateau or stall; if the phase-shifter table is not updated with K after an energy change, pulse energy collapses and looks like an electron-beam quality problem, sending tuning in the wrong direction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
某個段間相位錯了半個波長時，下一段的輻射與前段破壞性干涉，增益曲線出現平台或停滯。
掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If one intersection is off by half a wavelength, the next segment radiates destructively against the previous one and the gain curve shows a plateau or stall.
At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起」與「MHz 偵測器：增益切換、記憶格與逐格校正」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps" and "MHz detectors: gain switching, memory cells and per-cell calibration": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: X 光在材料中的折射率為 n = 1 − δ，只有在掠射角小於臨界角 θc ≈ √(2δ) 時才會全外反射，所以 European XFEL 以約 1 m 長、B₄C 鍍膜的矽鏡在數 mrad 的掠射角下導光、偏移與分流。光束在鏡面上的足跡被拉長為 w/θ，因此鏡長要以公尺計；高度誤差 h 在反射時造成 2h·sinθ 的光程差，對 0.1 nm 的波長，奈米級的高度誤差就足以破壞聚焦與同調波前。突發模式在 0.6 ms 內送來數千發脈衝，鏡面局部吸熱形成熱凸起，需要以冷卻設計與幾何最佳化控制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inside matter X-rays see n = 1 − δ and are totally externally reflected only below the critical angle θc ≈ √(2δ), so European XFEL steers, offsets and distributes its beams with B₄C-coated silicon mirrors about 1 m long at grazing angles of a few milliradians. The footprint on the mirror stretches to w/θ, which is why the mirrors are metre-scale, and a height error h produces a path difference 2h·sinθ on reflection; at a 0.1 nm wavelength, nanometre height errors already spoil focusing and the coherent wavefront. Burst mode delivers thousands of pulses within 0.6 ms, so local absorption raises a thermal bump that must be managed by cooling design and geometry. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：B₄C（2.52 g/cm³、每分子 26 個電子）在 12 keV（λ ≈ 0.103 nm）時 δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，θc ≈ 2.6 mrad，24 keV 時降到約 1.3 mrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For B₄C (2.52 g/cm³, 26 electrons per formula unit) at 12 keV (λ ≈ 0.103 nm), δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶ and θc ≈ 2.6 mrad, falling to about 1.3 mrad at 24 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The footprint on the mirror stretches to w/θ, which is why the mirrors are metre-scale, and a height error h produces a path difference 2h·sinθ on reflection; at a 0.1 nm wavelength, nanometre height errors already spoil focusing and the coherent wavefront.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps" is correct?
options: 掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。
每個畫素只要一組偏移與增益常數就能完成校正。
X 光在材料中的折射率為 n = 1 − δ，只有在掠射角小於臨界角 θc ≈ √(2δ) 時才會全外反射，所以 European XFEL 以約 1 m 長、B₄C 鍍膜的矽鏡在數 mrad 的掠射角下導光、偏移與分流。
optionsEn: At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise.
One offset and one gain constant per pixel are enough to calibrate the detector.

Inside matter X-rays see n = 1 − δ and are totally externally reflected only below the critical angle θc ≈ √(2δ), so European XFEL steers, offsets and distributes its beams with B₄C-coated silicon mirrors about 1 m long at grazing angles of a few milliradians.
quiz.explanation: X 光在材料中的折射率為 n = 1 − δ，只有在掠射角小於臨界角 θc ≈ √(2δ) 時才會全外反射，所以 European XFEL 以約 1 m 長、B₄C 鍍膜的矽鏡在數 mrad 的掠射角下導光、偏移與分流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Inside matter X-rays see n = 1 − δ and are totally externally reflected only below the critical angle θc ≈ √(2δ), so European XFEL steers, offsets and distributes its beams with B₄C-coated silicon mirrors about 1 m long at grazing angles of a few milliradians. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：B₄C（2.52 g/cm³、每分子 26 個電子）在 12 keV（λ ≈ 0.103 nm）時 δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，θc ≈ 2.6 mrad，24 keV 時降到約 1.3 mrad。取 θ = 2.0 mrad，Maréchal 判準 2h·θ ≤ λ/14 給出 h_rms ≤ λ/(28θ) ≈ 1.8 nm；光束寬 0.8 mm（假設）時足跡為 0.8/0.002 = 400 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For B₄C (2.52 g/cm³, 26 electrons per formula unit) at 12 keV (λ ≈ 0.103 nm), δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶ and θc ≈ 2.6 mrad, falling to about 1.3 mrad at 24 keV. At θ = 2.0 mrad the Maréchal condition 2h·θ ≤ λ/14 gives h_rms ≤ λ/(28θ) ≈ 1.8 nm, and an assumed 0.8 mm beam leaves a 0.8/0.002 = 400 mm footprint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：出廠與安裝前以長行程輪廓儀或拼接干涉儀量測鏡面高度與斜率誤差，以功率譜密度分頻段估算對焦斑與同調性的影響；上線後以光柵剪切干涉或刀口掃描量聚焦光斑，並在不同列長下重複，觀察焦點是否隨列內累積熱負載漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before shipment and installation measure height and slope errors with a long-trace profiler or stitching interferometer and use the power spectral density, band by band, to estimate the effect on focal spot and coherence; on the beamline, measure the focus with grating-based shearing interferometry or knife-edge scans and repeat at several train lengths to see whether the focus drifts with the heat load accumulated during a train.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

At θ = 2.0 mrad the Maréchal condition 2h·θ ≤ λ/14 gives h_rms ≤ λ/(28θ) ≈ 1.8 nm, and an assumed 0.8 mm beam leaves a 0.8/0.002 = 400 mm footprint.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps", which statement holds?
options: B₄C（2.52 g/cm³、每分子 26 個電子）在 12 keV（λ ≈ 0.103 nm）時 δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，θc ≈ 2.6 mrad，24 keV 時降到約 1.3 mrad。
超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。
要改變 X 光光子能量就一定得改變電子束能量。

A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary.
