steps.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主鏡曲率半徑約 28.8 m，焦距 14.4 m，焦比 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76。若 Nasmyth 焦比約 f/15，副鏡放大率 m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5，焦面位移 ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz：副鏡移動 10 µm 使焦點移 0.74 mm，而 500 nm 的焦深 ±2λN² 只有 ±0.23 mm。等效焦距 123 m 對應底片比例尺 ≈ 1.68″/mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76. With a Nasmyth ratio near f/15 the secondary magnification is m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5 and the focal shift is ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz: a 10 µm secondary move shifts focus by 0.74 mm, while the 500 nm depth of focus ±2λN² is only ±0.23 mm. The 123 m effective focal length gives a plate scale ≈ 1.68″/mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主鏡曲率半徑約 28.8 m，焦距 14.4 m，焦比 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76。若 Nasmyth 焦比約 f/15，副鏡放大率 m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5，焦面位移 ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz：副鏡移動 10 µm 使焦點移 0.74 mm，而 500 nm 的焦深 ±2λN² 只有 ±0.23 mm。等效焦距 123 m 對應底片比例尺 ≈ 1.68″/mm。
knowledge.textEn: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76. With a Nasmyth ratio near f/15 the secondary magnification is m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5 and the focal shift is ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz: a 10 µm secondary move shifts focus by 0.74 mm, while the 500 nm depth of focus ±2λN² is only ±0.23 mm. The 123 m effective focal length gives a plate scale ≈ 1.68″/mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci", which statement holds?
options: 有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。
只要解析度夠高，徑向速度精度就不受儀器穩定度限制。
optionsEn: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76.
With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all.
With high enough resolving power, radial-velocity precision is not limited by instrument stability.
quiz.explanation: 主鏡曲率半徑約 28.8 m，焦距 14.4 m，焦比 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。
knowledge.textEn: Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較。
鏡面反射率降低幾個百分點，對望遠鏡效能幾乎沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction.
A few percent of lost reflectance hardly affects telescope performance.
quiz.explanation: 在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：副鏡單元以五個自由度定位：一軸對焦、兩軸置中、兩軸指向；因為副鏡把主鏡焦比放大約 8 倍，副鏡的微小軸向位移會在焦面被放大，所以副鏡對焦是主動光學閉環中最頻繁的修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the secondary magnifies the primary focal ratio about eightfold, small axial secondary motions are amplified at the focal plane, which makes secondary focus the most frequent correction in the active-optics loop.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The secondary only folds the beam, so tens of micrometres of position error do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。
knowledge.textEn: A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。
副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A thicker, stiffer primary always gives better image quality.
A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma.
quiz.explanation: 副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數」與「可變形副鏡：薄殼、音圈致動器與散熱」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant" and "Deformable secondary: thin shell, voice coils and heat removal": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: UT 主鏡是直徑 8.2 m、厚約 177 mm 的 Zerodur 彎月鏡，成品重約 23 t；每片由 SCHOTT 澆鑄約 45 t 的玻璃陶瓷，經約 3 個月退火與 9 個月陶瓷化，膨脹係數規格 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K，交貨量測約 −0.03 到 −0.04×10⁻⁶/K。REOSC 在模擬最終鏡室的 150 點氣動支撐上研磨拋光，因為薄鏡本身不保形，驗收必須在主動模式下進行：允許致動器以有限的力修正低階面形，交付的波前約 40 nm RMS。薄鏡的另一個好處是熱慣量小，能跟上夜間氣溫，減少鏡面視寧度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each UT primary is a Zerodur meniscus 8.2 m across and about 177 mm thick, weighing about 23 t finished; SCHOTT cast about 45 t of glass ceramic per blank, followed by roughly 3 months of annealing and 9 months of ceramisation, to a thermal-expansion specification of 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K, with delivered blanks measuring about −0.03 to −0.04×10⁻⁶/K. REOSC ground and polished on a 150-point pneumatic support that mimics the final cell; because a thin mirror cannot hold its own shape, acceptance is done in active mode, letting actuators correct low-order figure with limited forces, and delivered wavefronts were about 40 nm RMS. The thin mirror's low thermal inertia also lets it follow the night-time air temperature, reducing mirror seeing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Zerodur 熱擴散率 κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s，厚度 t 的熱時間常數 τ ≈ t²/(π²κ)：t = 0.177 m 時約 1.3 h；若用 1:6 厚徑比的傳統鏡（t ≈ 1.37 m）則約 75 h，重量也從 23 t 增加到約 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Zerodur's diffusivity is κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s, and the thermal time constant of thickness t is τ ≈ t²/(π²κ): about 1.3 h for t = 0.177 m, but about 75 h for a conventional 1:6 mirror (t ≈ 1.37 m), whose mass would also rise from 23 t to about 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thicker, stiffer primary always gives better image quality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Zerodur 熱擴散率 κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s，厚度 t 的熱時間常數 τ ≈ t²/(π²κ)：t = 0.177 m 時約 1.3 h；若用 1:6 厚徑比的傳統鏡（t ≈ 1.37 m）則約 75 h，重量也從 23 t 增加到約 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Zerodur's diffusivity is κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s, and the thermal time constant of thickness t is τ ≈ t²/(π²κ): about 1.3 h for t = 0.177 m, but about 75 h for a conventional 1:6 mirror (t ≈ 1.37 m), whose mass would also rise from 23 t to about 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：拋光驗收時在多個支撐方位量全口徑干涉相位圖，扣除主動光學可修正的低階模態後計算殘差 RMS、斜率與中心強度比；營運中以鏡面溫度感測器與氣溫的差值追蹤熱平衡，並比對該差值與影像 FWHM 的相關性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For polishing acceptance, take full-aperture interferometric phase maps at several support orientations, remove the low-order modes that active optics can correct and compute residual RMS, slope error and central-intensity ratio; in operation, track the mirror-to-air temperature difference with surface sensors and correlate it with image FWHM.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 拋光驗收時在多個支撐方位量全口徑干涉相位圖，扣除主動光學可修正的低階模態後計算殘差 RMS、斜率與中心強度比；營運中以鏡面溫度感測器與氣溫的差值追蹤熱平衡，並比對該差值與影像 FWHM 的相關性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For polishing acceptance, take full-aperture interferometric phase maps at several support orientations, remove the low-order modes that active optics can correct and compute residual RMS, slope error and central-intensity ratio; in operation, track the mirror-to-air temperature difference with surface sensors and correlate it with image FWHM. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：支撐點的力誤差或吊運時的局部應力會在薄鏡上直接留下面形印記；若鏡面比夜間空氣溫度高 1 K 以上，鏡面上方形成上升熱羽，影像 FWHM 增加，被誤判為大氣視寧度變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Force errors at support points or local stress during handling print directly into the figure of a thin mirror; if the mirror runs more than about 1 K warmer than the night air, a rising thermal plume forms above it and image FWHM grows, often misread as worse atmospheric seeing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 拋光驗收時在多個支撐方位量全口徑干涉相位圖，扣除主動光學可修正的低階模態後計算殘差 RMS、斜率與中心強度比；營運中以鏡面溫度感測器與氣溫的差值追蹤熱平衡，並比對該差值與影像 FWHM 的相關性。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 可變形副鏡：薄殼、音圈致動器與散熱：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Deformable secondary: thin shell, voice coils and heat removal: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1170-actuator deformable secondary” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: UT4 的自適應光學設施把原本的剛性副鏡換成直徑 1120 mm、厚約 2 mm 的 Zerodur 薄殼可變形副鏡，背後以 1170 個音圈致動器推動；薄殼由 SAGEM 製作，參考體由 SESO 以輕量化 Zerodur 製造，系統由 Microgate 與 ADS International 整合。每個致動器旁有電容感測器量測薄殼與參考體的約 90 µm 間隙，內迴路以 80 kHz 維持形狀，這層空氣膜同時提供阻尼。把自適應元件放在副鏡，讓所有焦點共用修正且不增加額外反射面與熱背景。致動器與電子機箱的熱必須以液冷帶走，否則副鏡附近形成局部湍流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility replaced the rigid secondary with a deformable secondary: a Zerodur shell 1120 mm across and about 2 mm thick, pushed by 1170 voice-coil actuators. SAGEM produced the shell, SESO the lightweighted Zerodur reference body, and Microgate with ADS International integrated the system. A capacitive sensor beside each actuator measures the roughly 90 µm gap between shell and reference body, an internal loop at 80 kHz holds the shape, and the air film provides damping. Putting the adaptive element at the secondary lets all foci share the correction without extra reflections or thermal background. Heat from actuators and electronics must be carried away by liquid cooling, or local turbulence forms around the secondary. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1170-actuator deformable secondary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：致動器最小間距約 28 mm，投影到 8.2 m 瞳面約 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The minimum actuator pitch of about 28 mm projects to about 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m on the 8.2 m pupil.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器越多越好，與觀測波長無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More actuators are always better, regardless of the observing wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1170-actuator deformable secondary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 可變形副鏡：薄殼、音圈致動器與散熱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deformable secondary: thin shell, voice coils and heat removal: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1170-actuator deformable secondary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：致動器最小間距約 28 mm，投影到 8.2 m 瞳面約 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m。連續面形的擬合誤差 σ² ≈ 0.28(d/r₀)^5/3：K 波段 r₀ ≈ 0.89 m（由 500 nm 的 0.15 m 以 λ^6/5 換算）時 σ² ≈ 0.024 rad²，只看擬合項 Strehl ≈ 0.98；可見光 r₀ = 0.15 m 時 σ² ≈ 0.47、Strehl ≈ 0.62。散熱 1326 W、流量 4.5 L/min 的水冷液溫升約 4.2 K。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The minimum actuator pitch of about 28 mm projects to about 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m on the 8.2 m pupil. The continuous-facesheet fitting error σ² ≈ 0.28(d/r₀)^5/3 gives σ² ≈ 0.024 rad² and a fitting-only Strehl ≈ 0.98 in K band with r₀ ≈ 0.89 m (scaled from 0.15 m at 500 nm by λ^6/5), but σ² ≈ 0.47 and Strehl ≈ 0.62 in the visible with r₀ = 0.15 m. Removing 1326 W with 4.5 L/min of water raises the coolant by about 4.2 K. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在實驗室以干涉儀量薄殼在每個致動器單位推力下的影響函數，建立影響矩陣並量測平面化後的殘差；上機前用專用測試台以人工光源量閉迴路的擬合誤差與頻寬；上機後比較冷卻液出入口溫差與副鏡周圍的溫度感測器，確認沒有熱羽進入光路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the laboratory measure the shell's influence function for a unit force on each actuator with an interferometer, build the influence matrix and measure the flattened residual; before installation measure closed-loop fitting error and bandwidth on a dedicated test bench with an artificial source; after installation compare coolant inlet-outlet temperatures with sensors around the secondary to make sure no thermal plume enters the beam.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 致動器最小間距約 28 mm，投影到 8.2 m 瞳面約 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m。連續面形的擬合誤差 σ² ≈ 0.28(d/r₀)^5/3：K 波段 r₀ ≈ 0.89 m（由 500 nm 的 0.15 m 以 λ^6/5 換算）時 σ² ≈ 0.024 rad²，只看擬合項 Strehl ≈ 0.98；可見光 r₀ = 0.15 m 時 σ² ≈ 0.47、Strehl ≈ 0.62。散熱 1326 W、流量 4.5 L/min 的水冷液溫升約 4.2 K。
knowledge.textEn: The minimum actuator pitch of about 28 mm projects to about 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m on the 8.2 m pupil. The continuous-facesheet fitting error σ² ≈ 0.28(d/r₀)^5/3 gives σ² ≈ 0.024 rad² and a fitting-only Strehl ≈ 0.98 in K band with r₀ ≈ 0.89 m (scaled from 0.15 m at 500 nm by λ^6/5), but σ² ≈ 0.47 and Strehl ≈ 0.62 in the visible with r₀ = 0.15 m. Removing 1326 W with 4.5 L/min of water raises the coolant by about 4.2 K.

steps.title: 可變形副鏡：薄殼、音圈致動器與散熱：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deformable secondary: thin shell, voice coils and heat removal: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “1170-actuator deformable secondary” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在實驗室以干涉儀量薄殼在每個致動器單位推力下的影響函數，建立影響矩陣並量測平面化後的殘差；上機前用專用測試台以人工光源量閉迴路的擬合誤差與頻寬；上機後比較冷卻液出入口溫差與副鏡周圍的溫度感測器，確認沒有熱羽進入光路。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the laboratory measure the shell's influence function for a unit force on each actuator with an interferometer, build the influence matrix and measure the flattened residual; before installation measure closed-loop fitting error and bandwidth on a dedicated test bench with an artificial source; after installation compare coolant inlet-outlet temperatures with sensors around the secondary to make sure no thermal plume enters the beam. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：灰塵或顆粒卡在 90 µm 間隙中會讓局部致動器無法到位，薄殼出現凸點甚至破裂；冷卻流量不足時，電子機箱發熱使副鏡附近溫度上升，影像品質在自適應光學閉迴路中仍無法改善。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Dust or particles caught in the 90 µm gap stop local actuators from reaching position, leaving a bump or even cracking the shell; with insufficient coolant flow, electronics heat raises the temperature near the secondary and image quality fails to improve even with the AO loop closed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在實驗室以干涉儀量薄殼在每個致動器單位推力下的影響函數，建立影響矩陣並量測平面化後的殘差；上機前用專用測試台以人工光源量閉迴路的擬合誤差與頻寬；上機後比較冷卻液出入口溫差與副鏡周圍的溫度感測器，確認沒有熱羽進入光路。

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長」與「VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation" and "VLTI baselines, delay lines and the OPD budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四雷射導引星設施」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Four Laser Guide Star Facility” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自然亮星很少落在目標附近，因此 UT4 以四雷射導引星設施在約 90 km 高的鈉層激發四顆人造星。四顆導引星環繞視場，GRAAL 模組把地表層湍流修正後的影像送給 HAWK-I，GALACSI 則為 MUSE 做地表層或雷射斷層修正。雷射星位於有限高度，光錐只取樣部分湍流（錐效應），且鈉層有約 10 km 厚度，從望遠鏡不同位置看到的雷射光點會被拉長，次孔徑離發射點越遠拉得越長。雷射星也無法量測整體傾斜，所以仍需要一顆暗的自然星提供傾斜資訊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四雷射導引星設施」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bright natural stars rarely lie near a target, so UT4 uses the Four Laser Guide Star Facility to excite four artificial stars in the sodium layer at about 90 km. The four guide stars surround the field; the GRAAL module feeds ground-layer-corrected images to HAWK-I, and GALACSI provides ground-layer or laser-tomography correction for MUSE. Because a laser star sits at finite altitude, its light cone samples only part of the turbulence (the cone effect), and because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, the spot seen from different parts of the pupil is elongated, more so for subapertures farther from the launch point. Laser stars also cannot measure overall tilt, so a faint natural star is still needed for tip-tilt. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four Laser Guide Star Facility”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光點拉長角 ≈ b·Δh/H²：次孔徑距發射點 b = 8 m（假設）、鈉層厚 Δh = 10 km、高度 H = 90 km 時，拉長 ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″，遠大於次孔徑繞射寬度，量測斜率的雜訊因而在拉長方向變大。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Spot elongation ≈ b·Δh/H²: for a subaperture b = 8 m from the launch point (assumption), a 10 km thick sodium layer at H = 90 km gives ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″, far wider than a subaperture's diffraction width, so slope noise grows along the elongation direction.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四雷射導引星設施」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Four Laser Guide Star Facility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長
knowledge.titleEn: Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation
knowledge.text: 自然亮星很少落在目標附近，因此 UT4 以四雷射導引星設施在約 90 km 高的鈉層激發四顆人造星。四顆導引星環繞視場，GRAAL 模組把地表層湍流修正後的影像送給 HAWK-I，GALACSI 則為 MUSE 做地表層或雷射斷層修正。
knowledge.textEn: Bright natural stars rarely lie near a target, so UT4 uses the Four Laser Guide Star Facility to excite four artificial stars in the sodium layer at about 90 km. The four guide stars surround the field; the GRAAL module feeds ground-layer-corrected images to HAWK-I, and GALACSI provides ground-layer or laser-tomography correction for MUSE.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation" is correct?
options: 有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。
只要基線夠長，干涉儀的角解析度就自動實現，與光程穩定度無關。
自然亮星很少落在目標附近，因此 UT4 以四雷射導引星設施在約 90 km 高的鈉層激發四顆人造星。
optionsEn: With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all.
With a long enough baseline the interferometer's resolution is achieved automatically, regardless of path stability.
Bright natural stars rarely lie near a target, so UT4 uses the Four Laser Guide Star Facility to excite four artificial stars in the sodium layer at about 90 km.
quiz.explanation: 自然亮星很少落在目標附近，因此 UT4 以四雷射導引星設施在約 90 km 高的鈉層激發四顆人造星。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bright natural stars rarely lie near a target, so UT4 uses the Four Laser Guide Star Facility to excite four artificial stars in the sodium layer at about 90 km. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四雷射導引星設施」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Four Laser Guide Star Facility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光點拉長角 ≈ b·Δh/H²：次孔徑距發射點 b = 8 m（假設）、鈉層厚 Δh = 10 km、高度 H = 90 km 時，拉長 ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″，遠大於次孔徑繞射寬度，量測斜率的雜訊因而在拉長方向變大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Spot elongation ≈ b·Δh/H²: for a subaperture b = 8 m from the launch point (assumption), a 10 km thick sodium layer at H = 90 km gives ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″, far wider than a subaperture's diffraction width, so slope noise grows along the elongation direction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以波前感測器影像量各次孔徑雷射光點的長軸與短軸寬度，對次孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，檢查是否符合 b·Δh/H² 的線性關係並反推鈉層厚度；再與同時段的鈉層剖面或回波強度紀錄比對，確認重心演算法的加權設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure long- and short-axis widths of the laser spot in each subaperture from wavefront-sensor frames, plot them against distance from the launch point to check the linear b·Δh/H² relation and back out the sodium-layer thickness; compare with contemporaneous sodium-profile or return-flux records to confirm the weighting used by the centroid algorithm.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光點拉長角 ≈ b·Δh/H²：次孔徑距發射點 b = 8 m（假設）、鈉層厚 Δh = 10 km、高度 H = 90 km 時，拉長 ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″，遠大於次孔徑繞射寬度，量測斜率的雜訊因而在拉長方向變大。
knowledge.textEn: Spot elongation ≈ b·Δh/H²: for a subaperture b = 8 m from the launch point (assumption), a 10 km thick sodium layer at H = 90 km gives ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″, far wider than a subaperture's diffraction width, so slope noise grows along the elongation direction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation", which statement holds?
options: 光點拉長角 ≈ b·Δh/H²：次孔徑距發射點 b = 8 m（假設）、鈉層厚 Δh = 10 km、高度 H = 90 km 時，拉長 ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″，遠大於次孔徑繞射寬度，量測斜率的雜訊因而在拉長方向變大。
鏡面反射率降低幾個百分點，對望遠鏡效能幾乎沒有影響。
副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。
optionsEn: Spot elongation ≈ b·Δh/H²: for a subaperture b = 8 m from the launch point (assumption), a 10 km thick sodium layer at H = 90 km gives ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″, far wider than a subaperture's diffraction width, so slope noise grows along the elongation direction.
A few percent of lost reflectance hardly affects telescope performance.
The secondary only folds the beam, so tens of micrometres of position error do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 光點拉長角 ≈ b·Δh/H²：次孔徑距發射點 b = 8 m（假設）、鈉層厚 Δh = 10 km、高度 H = 90 km 時，拉長 ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″，遠大於次孔徑繞射寬度，量測斜率的雜訊因而在拉長方向變大。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Spot elongation ≈ b·Δh/H²: for a subaperture b = 8 m from the launch point (assumption), a 10 km thick sodium layer at H = 90 km gives ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(9×10⁴)² ≈ 9.9×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 2.0″, far wider than a subaperture's diffraction width, so slope noise grows along the elongation direction. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四雷射導引星設施」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Four Laser Guide Star Facility” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以波前感測器影像量各次孔徑雷射光點的長軸與短軸寬度，對次孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，檢查是否符合 b·Δh/H² 的線性關係並反推鈉層厚度；再與同時段的鈉層剖面或回波強度紀錄比對，確認重心演算法的加權設定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure long- and short-axis widths of the laser spot in each subaperture from wavefront-sensor frames, plot them against distance from the launch point to check the linear b·Δh/H² relation and back out the sodium-layer thickness; compare with contemporaneous sodium-profile or return-flux records to confirm the weighting used by the centroid algorithm. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鈉層高度在夜間變化數公里時，雷射星的對焦也跟著改變；若沒有以自然星的慢速對焦感測修正，系統會把鈉層高度變化誤當成望遠鏡離焦，科學影像持續失焦。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the sodium-layer altitude changes by kilometres during the night, the laser-star focus changes with it; without slow natural-star focus sensing, the system interprets sodium-height changes as telescope defocus and the science image stays out of focus.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以波前感測器影像量各次孔徑雷射光點的長軸與短軸寬度，對次孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，檢查是否符合 b·Δh/H² 的線性關係並反推鈉層厚度；再與同時段的鈉層剖面或回波強度紀錄比對，確認重心演算法的加權設定。
knowledge.textEn: Measure long- and short-axis widths of the laser spot in each subaperture from wavefront-sensor frames, plot them against distance from the launch point to check the linear b·Δh/H² relation and back out the sodium-layer thickness; compare with contemporaneous sodium-profile or return-flux records to confirm the weighting used by the centroid algorithm.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以波前感測器影像量各次孔徑雷射光點的長軸與短軸寬度，對次孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，檢查是否符合 b·Δh/H² 的線性關係並反推鈉層厚度。
主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Measure long- and short-axis widths of the laser spot in each subaperture from wavefront-sensor frames, plot them against distance from the launch point to check the linear b·Δh/H² relation and back out the sodium-layer thickness.
A thicker, stiffer primary always gives better image quality.
quiz.explanation: 以波前感測器影像量各次孔徑雷射光點的長軸與短軸寬度，對次孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，檢查是否符合 b·Δh/H² 的線性關係並反推鈉層厚度；再與同時段的鈉層剖面或回波強度紀錄比對，確認重心演算法的加權設定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure long- and short-axis widths of the laser spot in each subaperture from wavefront-sensor frames, plot them against distance from the launch point to check the linear b·Δh/H² relation and back out the sodium-layer thickness; compare with contemporaneous sodium-profile or return-flux records to confirm the weighting used by the centroid algorithm. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「四雷射導引星設施」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Four Laser Guide Star Facility” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鈉層高度在夜間變化數公里時，雷射星的對焦也跟著改變；若沒有以自然星的慢速對焦感測修正，系統會把鈉層高度變化誤當成望遠鏡離焦，科學影像持續失焦。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the sodium-layer altitude changes by kilometres during the night, the laser-star focus changes with it; without slow natural-star focus sensing, the system interprets sodium-height changes as telescope defocus and the science image stays out of focus. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雷射星也無法量測整體傾斜，所以仍需要一顆暗的自然星提供傾斜資訊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Laser stars also cannot measure overall tilt, so a faint natural star is still needed for tip-tilt.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鈉層高度在夜間變化數公里時，雷射星的對焦也跟著改變；若沒有以自然星的慢速對焦感測修正，系統會把鈉層高度變化誤當成望遠鏡離焦，科學影像持續失焦。
knowledge.textEn: When the sodium-layer altitude changes by kilometres during the night, the laser-star focus changes with it; without slow natural-star focus sensing, the system interprets sodium-height changes as telescope defocus and the science image stays out of focus.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Laser guide stars, ground-layer correction and spot elongation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要基線夠長，干涉儀的角解析度就自動實現，與光程穩定度無關。
鈉層高度在夜間變化數公里時，雷射星的對焦也跟著改變；若沒有以自然星的慢速對焦感測修正，系統會把鈉層高度變化誤當成望遠鏡離焦，科學影像持續失焦。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
With a long enough baseline the interferometer's resolution is achieved automatically, regardless of path stability.
When the sodium-layer altitude changes by kilometres during the night, the laser-star focus changes with it.
quiz.explanation: 鈉層高度在夜間變化數公里時，雷射星的對焦也跟著改變；若沒有以自然星的慢速對焦感測修正，系統會把鈉層高度變化誤當成望遠鏡離焦，科學影像持續失焦。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When the sodium-layer altitude changes by kilometres during the night, the laser-star focus changes with it; without slow natural-star focus sensing, the system interprets sodium-height changes as telescope defocus and the science image stays out of focus. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: VLTI baselines, delay lines and the OPD budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「VLTI 延遲線隧道」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “VLTI delay-line tunnel” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VLTI 把兩到四座望遠鏡的光經地下光管送到延遲線，延遲線是放在長軌道上的貓眼反射車，隨地球自轉連續移動以補償幾何光程差，使各路光在合光器處等光程而產生干涉條紋。UT 間基線可達約 130 m，輔助望遠鏡可移到不同基座組成約 200 m 的基線。條紋對比（可見度）攜帶目標的空間頻率資訊，但只要各路光程差抖動接近波長的十分之一，可見度就明顯下降；GRAVITY 等儀器以條紋追蹤器在 K 波段即時量測並回授到延遲線，再以雷射計量量測內部光程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「VLTI 延遲線隧道」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: VLTI sends light from two to four telescopes through underground light ducts to the delay lines, cat's-eye carriages on long rails that move continuously with Earth rotation to cancel the geometric path difference so that all beams arrive at the combiner with equal path and form fringes. Baselines between UTs reach about 130 m, and the Auxiliary Telescopes can be moved between stations to form baselines of about 200 m. Fringe contrast (visibility) carries the target's spatial-frequency information, but once the path-difference jitter approaches a tenth of the wavelength the visibility drops markedly; instruments such as GRAVITY measure fringes in K band with a fringe tracker that feeds back to the delay lines, and laser metrology measures internal paths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “VLTI delay-line tunnel”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：幾何延遲變化率最大約 B·Ω⊕：B = 130 m 時 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The geometric delay rate peaks near B·Ω⊕: for B = 130 m, 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要基線夠長，干涉儀的角解析度就自動實現，與光程穩定度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a long enough baseline the interferometer's resolution is achieved automatically, regardless of path stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「VLTI 延遲線隧道」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “VLTI delay-line tunnel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: VLTI baselines, delay lines and the OPD budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「VLTI 延遲線隧道」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “VLTI delay-line tunnel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：幾何延遲變化率最大約 B·Ω⊕：B = 130 m 時 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s。K 波段角解析度 λ/(2B) ≈ 2.2 µm/260 m ≈ 1.7 mas，200 m 時約 1.1 mas。光程差抖動 σ = 150 nm 時相位抖動 2πσ/λ ≈ 0.43 rad，可見度衰減因子 exp(−σφ²/2) ≈ 0.91。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The geometric delay rate peaks near B·Ω⊕: for B = 130 m, 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s. K-band resolution λ/(2B) ≈ 2.2 µm/260 m ≈ 1.7 mas, and about 1.1 mas at 200 m. An OPD jitter σ = 150 nm gives phase jitter 2πσ/λ ≈ 0.43 rad and a visibility loss factor exp(−σφ²/2) ≈ 0.91. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以內部光源量測各延遲線的光程差功率譜，找出機械共振與振動源；在天上觀測已知直徑的校準星，比較量到的可見度與預期值得到系統傳遞函數，再以望遠鏡上的加速度計量測各鏡面振動，追蹤哪一座望遠鏡貢獻最多光程差抖動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the OPD power spectrum of each delay line with an internal source to locate mechanical resonances and vibration sources; observe calibrator stars of known diameter and compare measured with expected visibility to obtain the system transfer function; use accelerometers on the telescope mirrors to track which telescope contributes most of the OPD jitter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 幾何延遲變化率最大約 B·Ω⊕：B = 130 m 時 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s。K 波段角解析度 λ/(2B) ≈ 2.2 µm/260 m ≈ 1.7 mas，200 m 時約 1.1 mas。光程差抖動 σ = 150 nm 時相位抖動 2πσ/λ ≈ 0.43 rad，可見度衰減因子 exp(−σφ²/2) ≈ 0.91。
knowledge.textEn: The geometric delay rate peaks near B·Ω⊕: for B = 130 m, 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s. K-band resolution λ/(2B) ≈ 2.2 µm/260 m ≈ 1.7 mas, and about 1.1 mas at 200 m. An OPD jitter σ = 150 nm gives phase jitter 2πσ/λ ≈ 0.43 rad and a visibility loss factor exp(−σφ²/2) ≈ 0.91.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "VLTI baselines, delay lines and the OPD budget", which statement holds?
options: 望遠鏡口徑加倍，地面影像的解析度就一定加倍。
幾何延遲變化率最大約 B·Ω⊕：B = 130 m 時 130 × 7.29×10⁻⁵ rad/s ≈ 9.5 mm/s。
主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。

steps.title: VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: VLTI baselines, delay lines and the OPD budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「VLTI 延遲線隧道」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “VLTI delay-line tunnel” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以內部光源量測各延遲線的光程差功率譜，找出機械共振與振動源；在天上觀測已知直徑的校準星，比較量到的可見度與預期值得到系統傳遞函數，再以望遠鏡上的加速度計量測各鏡面振動，追蹤哪一座望遠鏡貢獻最多光程差抖動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the OPD power spectrum of each delay line with an internal source to locate mechanical resonances and vibration sources; observe calibrator stars of known diameter and compare measured with expected visibility to obtain the system transfer function; use accelerometers on the telescope mirrors to track which telescope contributes most of the OPD jitter. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：機房泵浦或冷卻機的數十 Hz 振動經基座傳到鏡面，光程差抖動達數百奈米，條紋追蹤器跟不上而反覆失鎖，可見度被系統性壓低，若不以校準星修正，會被誤解為目標被解析。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Pump or chiller vibration at tens of hertz travels through the foundations to the mirrors and drives hundreds of nanometres of OPD jitter; the fringe tracker repeatedly loses lock and visibilities are systematically depressed, which without calibrator correction is misread as a resolved target.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以內部光源量測各延遲線的光程差功率譜，找出機械共振與振動源；在天上觀測已知直徑的校準星，比較量到的可見度與預期值得到系統傳遞函數，再以望遠鏡上的加速度計量測各鏡面振動，追蹤哪一座望遠鏡貢獻最多光程差抖動。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the OPD power spectrum of each delay line with an internal source to locate mechanical resonances and vibration sources; observe calibrator stars of known diameter and compare measured with expected visibility to obtain the system transfer function; use accelerometers on the telescope mirrors to track which telescope contributes most of the OPD jitter.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "VLTI baselines, delay lines and the OPD budget"?

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算：失效診斷

steps.observation: 連結機制：條紋對比（可見度）攜帶目標的空間頻率資訊，但只要各路光程差抖動接近波長的十分之一，可見度就明顯下降；GRAVITY 等儀器以條紋追蹤器在 K 波段即時量測並回授到延遲線，再以雷射計量量測內部光程。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要基線夠長，干涉儀的角解析度就自動實現，與光程穩定度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: coudé 光路與 10 cm/s 徑向速度量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Coudé trains and 10 cm/s radial-velocity measurement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ESPRESSO 與合併 coudé 實驗室」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ESPRESSO and the combined coudé laboratory” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ESPRESSO 位於合併 coudé 實驗室，可經 coudé 光路收單一 UT 的光，或同時收四座 UT 的光（非同調合併），以換取更暗目標的訊雜比。它的目標是在十年尺度上達到 10 cm/s 的徑向速度精度，解析度依模式約 70,000、140,000 或 190,000。要量到如此小的都卜勒位移，光譜儀必須放在真空、毫開爾文級溫控的環境中，以光纖與散射器穩定照明，並以頻率梳或 Fabry–Pérot 標準具同時記錄波長參考；望遠鏡端的導星與大氣色散補償則決定光纖入口的照明穩定性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ESPRESSO 與合併 coudé 實驗室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: ESPRESSO sits in the combined coudé laboratory and receives light from one UT through its coudé train, or from all four UTs at once (incoherent combination) to gain signal-to-noise on fainter targets. Its goal is 10 cm/s radial-velocity precision over a decade, with resolving power of about 70,000, 140,000 or 190,000 depending on mode. Measuring such tiny Doppler shifts requires the spectrograph to sit in vacuum with millikelvin-class temperature control, fibre feeds with scramblers to stabilise illumination, and a frequency comb or Fabry–Pérot etalon recorded simultaneously as wavelength reference; guiding and atmospheric-dispersion correction at the telescope set how stable the fibre entrance illumination is. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ESPRESSO and the combined coudé laboratory”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Δλ/λ = v/c：v = 0.10 m/s 在 550 nm 時 Δλ ≈ 550 nm × 3.3×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 1.8×10⁻¹⁶ m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Δλ/λ = v/c: v = 0.10 m/s at 550 nm gives Δλ ≈ 550 nm × 3.3×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 1.8×10⁻¹⁶ m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要解析度夠高，徑向速度精度就不受儀器穩定度限制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With high enough resolving power, radial-velocity precision is not limited by instrument stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「ESPRESSO 與合併 coudé 實驗室」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “ESPRESSO and the combined coudé laboratory”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: coudé 光路與 10 cm/s 徑向速度量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Coudé trains and 10 cm/s radial-velocity measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ESPRESSO 與合併 coudé 實驗室」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ESPRESSO and the combined coudé laboratory” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Δλ/λ = v/c：v = 0.10 m/s 在 550 nm 時 Δλ ≈ 550 nm × 3.3×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 1.8×10⁻¹⁶ m。R = 140,000 的解析元素為 3.9 pm，若以 4 像素取樣，每像素約 0.98 pm，位移只有 1.9×10⁻⁴ 像素；以 15 µm 像素計約 2.8 nm 的焦面位移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Δλ/λ = v/c: v = 0.10 m/s at 550 nm gives Δλ ≈ 550 nm × 3.3×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 1.8×10⁻¹⁶ m. At R = 140,000 the resolution element is 3.9 pm; sampled by 4 pixels, each pixel spans about 0.98 pm, so the shift is only 1.9×10⁻⁴ pixel, about 2.8 nm on the focal plane for 15 µm pixels. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同時參考通道記錄頻率梳或標準具譜線的漂移，與科學通道的漂移相減；長期觀測已知穩定的標準星，計算數月到數年的徑向速度散佈，並以太陽或標準星的晝夜資料檢查是否有與溫度、壓力或光纖照明相關的系統項。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record the drift of comb or etalon lines in the simultaneous reference channel and subtract it from the science-channel drift; monitor standard stars known to be quiet over months to years and compute the radial-velocity scatter, checking solar or standard-star data for systematics correlated with temperature, pressure or fibre illumination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「coudé 光路與 10 cm/s 徑向速度量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Coudé trains and 10 cm/s radial-velocity measurement", which statement holds?

More actuators are always better, regardless of the observing wavelength.
Δλ/λ = v/c: v = 0.10 m/s at 550 nm gives Δλ ≈ 550 nm × 3.3×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 1.8×10⁻¹⁶ m.

steps.title: coudé 光路與 10 cm/s 徑向速度量測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coudé trains and 10 cm/s radial-velocity measurement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ESPRESSO 與合併 coudé 實驗室」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ESPRESSO and the combined coudé laboratory” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同時參考通道記錄頻率梳或標準具譜線的漂移，與科學通道的漂移相減；長期觀測已知穩定的標準星，計算數月到數年的徑向速度散佈，並以太陽或標準星的晝夜資料檢查是否有與溫度、壓力或光纖照明相關的系統項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record the drift of comb or etalon lines in the simultaneous reference channel and subtract it from the science-channel drift; monitor standard stars known to be quiet over months to years and compute the radial-velocity scatter, checking solar or standard-star data for systematics correlated with temperature, pressure or fibre illumination. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：導星偏差讓星像在光纖入口移動，若散射不足，光譜線輪廓隨之改變，產生數十 cm/s 的假速度訊號；真空槽溫度漂移 0.01 K 也可透過光柵與鏡座膨脹造成同量級的偏移，被誤認為行星訊號。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Guiding errors move the star on the fibre entrance; with insufficient scrambling the line profile changes and produces spurious velocities of tens of cm/s, and a 0.01 K drift of the vacuum vessel can cause shifts of similar size through grating and mount expansion that are mistaken for a planet signal.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同時參考通道記錄頻率梳或標準具譜線的漂移，與科學通道的漂移相減；長期觀測已知穩定的標準星，計算數月到數年的徑向速度散佈，並以太陽或標準星的晝夜資料檢查是否有與溫度、壓力或光纖照明相關的系統項。
knowledge.textEn: Record the drift of comb or etalon lines in the simultaneous reference channel and subtract it from the science-channel drift; monitor standard stars known to be quiet over months to years and compute the radial-velocity scatter, checking solar or standard-star data for systematics correlated with temperature, pressure or fibre illumination.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「coudé 光路與 10 cm/s 徑向速度量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coudé trains and 10 cm/s radial-velocity measurement"?
options: 以同時參考通道記錄頻率梳或標準具譜線的漂移，與科學通道的漂移相減。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。
optionsEn: Record the drift of comb or etalon lines in the simultaneous reference channel and subtract it from the science-channel drift.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all.
quiz.explanation: 以同時參考通道記錄頻率梳或標準具譜線的漂移，與科學通道的漂移相減；長期觀測已知穩定的標準星，計算數月到數年的徑向速度散佈，並以太陽或標準星的晝夜資料檢查是否有與溫度、壓力或光纖照明相關的系統項。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record the drift of comb or etalon lines in the simultaneous reference channel and subtract it from the science-channel drift; monitor standard stars known to be quiet over months to years and compute the radial-velocity scatter, checking solar or standard-star data for systematics correlated with temperature, pressure or fibre illumination. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.titleEn: Coudé trains and 10 cm/s radial-velocity measurement: failure diagnosis

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要解析度夠高，徑向速度精度就不受儀器穩定度限制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With high enough resolving power, radial-velocity precision is not limited by instrument stability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導星偏差讓星像在光纖入口移動，若散射不足，光譜線輪廓隨之改變，產生數十 cm/s 的假速度訊號；真空槽溫度漂移 0.01 K 也可透過光柵與鏡座膨脹造成同量級的偏移，被誤認為行星訊號。

steps.titleEn: Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「主鏡單元維護與鍍膜」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 四座 UT 各有不同焦點的常駐儀器，營運上要協調哪座望遠鏡做 VLTI、哪座做自適應光學、哪座提供 coudé 光，維護計畫也必須錯開。主鏡單元約 50 t，需從望遠鏡卸下送到山上的鍍膜廠清洗並重鍍鋁膜；灰塵沉積會逐步降低反射率並增加熱輻射背景，對中紅外儀器尤其不利。交接紀錄要包含每座望遠鏡的影像品質、主動光學力圖、自適應光學性能、延遲線狀態與反射率歷史，才能讓下一個觀測期的排程以實際能力為準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主鏡單元維護與鍍膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The four UTs carry resident instruments at different foci, so operations must coordinate which telescope serves VLTI, which runs adaptive optics and which feeds the coudé laboratory, and maintenance must be staggered. The roughly 50 t primary-mirror unit is removed from the telescope and taken to the on-site coating plant for cleaning and aluminium recoating; dust gradually lowers reflectance and raises thermal background, which hurts mid-infrared instruments in particular. The handoff record must include each telescope's image quality, active-optics force maps, AO performance, delay-line status and reflectance history so that the next period's schedule rests on actual capability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Nasmyth 光路經 M1、M2、M3 三次反射。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Nasmyth train has three reflections, M1, M2 and M3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡面反射率降低幾個百分點，對望遠鏡效能幾乎沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A few percent of lost reflectance hardly affects telescope performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「主鏡單元維護與鍍膜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主鏡單元維護與鍍膜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Nasmyth 光路經 M1、M2、M3 三次反射。新鍍鋁膜反射率取 0.92（假設）時通量 0.92³ ≈ 0.779；每面因灰塵降到 0.90 時為 0.90³ ≈ 0.729，同樣訊雜比所需積分時間增加約 0.779/0.729 ≈ 1.068 倍，即約 7%。中紅外每面發射率若因灰塵從 0.02 增至 0.03（假設），三面合計約從 0.06 增至 0.09，10 µm 熱背景增加約 50%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Nasmyth train has three reflections, M1, M2 and M3. With freshly coated aluminium at 0.92 reflectance (assumption) throughput is 0.92³ ≈ 0.779; if dust lowers each to 0.90 it becomes 0.90³ ≈ 0.729, so integration time for the same signal-to-noise grows by about 0.779/0.729 ≈ 1.068, about 7%. If dust raises the mid-infrared emissivity of each mirror from 0.02 to 0.03 (assumption), the three-mirror total grows from about 0.06 to 0.09 and the 10 µm thermal background by about 50%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以攜帶式反射率計定期量測主鏡多個位置的反射率與散射，並以標準星的光度零點追蹤整體通量；重鍍後重新量測主動光學力圖與影像品質，確認卸裝與再安裝沒有改變支撐與對準，再把結果寫入營運交接紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure reflectance and scatter at several points on the primary periodically with a portable reflectometer and track overall throughput through photometric zero points of standard stars; after recoating, remeasure active-optics force maps and image quality to confirm that removal and reinstallation did not change support or alignment, and enter the results in the operational handoff record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Nasmyth 光路經 M1、M2、M3 三次反射。新鍍鋁膜反射率取 0.92（假設）時通量 0.92³ ≈ 0.779；每面因灰塵降到 0.90 時為 0.90³ ≈ 0.729，同樣訊雜比所需積分時間增加約 0.779/0.729 ≈ 1.068 倍，即約 7%。中紅外每面發射率若因灰塵從 0.02 增至 0.03（假設），三面合計約從 0.06 增至 0.09，10 µm 熱背景增加約 50%。
knowledge.textEn: The Nasmyth train has three reflections, M1, M2 and M3. With freshly coated aluminium at 0.92 reflectance (assumption) throughput is 0.92³ ≈ 0.779; if dust lowers each to 0.90 it becomes 0.90³ ≈ 0.729, so integration time for the same signal-to-noise grows by about 0.779/0.729 ≈ 1.068, about 7%. If dust raises the mid-infrared emissivity of each mirror from 0.02 to 0.03 (assumption), the three-mirror total grows from about 0.06 to 0.09 and the 10 µm thermal background by about 50%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff", which statement holds?
options: Nasmyth 光路經 M1、M2、M3 三次反射。
主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。
有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。
optionsEn: The Nasmyth train has three reflections, M1, M2 and M3.
A thicker, stiffer primary always gives better image quality.
With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all.
quiz.explanation: Nasmyth 光路經 M1、M2、M3 三次反射。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The Nasmyth train has three reflections, M1, M2 and M3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「主鏡單元維護與鍍膜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以攜帶式反射率計定期量測主鏡多個位置的反射率與散射，並以標準星的光度零點追蹤整體通量；重鍍後重新量測主動光學力圖與影像品質，確認卸裝與再安裝沒有改變支撐與對準，再把結果寫入營運交接紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure reflectance and scatter at several points on the primary periodically with a portable reflectometer and track overall throughput through photometric zero points of standard stars; after recoating, remeasure active-optics force maps and image quality to confirm that removal and reinstallation did not change support or alignment, and enter the results in the operational handoff record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：重鍍排程若只看反射率而不看中紅外背景，熱紅外儀器的靈敏度會在數月內悄悄下降；主鏡重新安裝後若沒有重做主動光學查表，早期觀測會帶著殘餘像散，浪費寶貴的觀測時段。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If recoating is scheduled on reflectance alone and ignores mid-infrared background, thermal-infrared sensitivity quietly degrades over months; if active-optics look-up tables are not redone after reinstallation, early observations carry residual astigmatism and waste valuable observing time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以攜帶式反射率計定期量測主鏡多個位置的反射率與散射，並以標準星的光度零點追蹤整體通量；重鍍後重新量測主動光學力圖與影像品質，確認卸裝與再安裝沒有改變支撐與對準，再把結果寫入營運交接紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Measure reflectance and scatter at several points on the primary periodically with a portable reflectometer and track overall throughput through photometric zero points of standard stars; after recoating, remeasure active-optics force maps and image quality to confirm that removal and reinstallation did not change support or alignment, and enter the results in the operational handoff record.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以攜帶式反射率計定期量測主鏡多個位置的反射率與散射，並以標準星的光度零點追蹤整體通量。
只要基線夠長，干涉儀的角解析度就自動實現，與光程穩定度無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure reflectance and scatter at several points on the primary periodically with a portable reflectometer and track overall throughput through photometric zero points of standard stars.
With a long enough baseline the interferometer's resolution is achieved automatically, regardless of path stability.
quiz.explanation: 以攜帶式反射率計定期量測主鏡多個位置的反射率與散射，並以標準星的光度零點追蹤整體通量；重鍍後重新量測主動光學力圖與影像品質，確認卸裝與再安裝沒有改變支撐與對準，再把結果寫入營運交接紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure reflectance and scatter at several points on the primary periodically with a portable reflectometer and track overall throughput through photometric zero points of standard stars; after recoating, remeasure active-optics force maps and image quality to confirm that removal and reinstallation did not change support or alignment, and enter the results in the operational handoff record. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主鏡單元維護與鍍膜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 重鍍排程若只看反射率而不看中紅外背景，熱紅外儀器的靈敏度會在數月內悄悄下降；主鏡重新安裝後若沒有重做主動光學查表，早期觀測會帶著殘餘像散，浪費寶貴的觀測時段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If recoating is scheduled on reflectance alone and ignores mid-infrared background, thermal-infrared sensitivity quietly degrades over months; if active-optics look-up tables are not redone after reinstallation, early observations carry residual astigmatism and waste valuable observing time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要包含每座望遠鏡的影像品質、主動光學力圖、自適應光學性能、延遲線狀態與反射率歷史，才能讓下一個觀測期的排程以實際能力為準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must include each telescope's image quality, active-optics force maps, AO performance, delay-line status and reflectance history so that the next period's schedule rests on actual capability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡面反射率降低幾個百分點，對望遠鏡效能幾乎沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A few percent of lost reflectance hardly affects telescope performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重鍍排程若只看反射率而不看中紅外背景，熱紅外儀器的靈敏度會在數月內悄悄下降；主鏡重新安裝後若沒有重做主動光學查表，早期觀測會帶著殘餘像散，浪費寶貴的觀測時段。
knowledge.textEn: If recoating is scheduled on reflectance alone and ignores mid-infrared background, thermal-infrared sensitivity quietly degrades over months; if active-optics look-up tables are not redone after reinstallation, early observations carry residual astigmatism and waste valuable observing time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
望遠鏡口徑加倍，地面影像的解析度就一定加倍。
重鍍排程若只看反射率而不看中紅外背景，熱紅外儀器的靈敏度會在數月內悄悄下降；主鏡重新安裝後若沒有重做主動光學查表，早期觀測會帶著殘餘像散，浪費寶貴的觀測時段。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Doubling the aperture always doubles the resolution of ground-based images.
If recoating is scheduled on reflectance alone and ignores mid-infrared background, thermal-infrared sensitivity quietly degrades over months.
quiz.explanation: 重鍍排程若只看反射率而不看中紅外背景，熱紅外儀器的靈敏度會在數月內悄悄下降；主鏡重新安裝後若沒有重做主動光學查表，早期觀測會帶著殘餘像散，浪費寶貴的觀測時段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If recoating is scheduled on reflectance alone and ignores mid-infrared background, thermal-infrared sensitivity quietly degrades over months; if active-optics look-up tables are not redone after reinstallation, early observations carry residual astigmatism and waste valuable observing time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT
summary: 以 Cerro Armazones 上的 39 m ELT 為對象，從繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度出發，拆解五鏡設計、798 片六角鏡段的 133 種段型與 8 nm 拋光、六片 1.95 mm 薄殼組成的 M4、約 9000 個邊緣感測器的共相控制、M4／M5 的頻段分工，以及分段重鍍與初光驗收的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Taking the 39 m ELT on Cerro Armazones, start from the diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity, then work through the five-mirror design, the 133 segment types and 8 nm polish of 798 hexagonal segments, the M4 built from six 1.95 mm shells, phasing control with about 9000 edge sensors, the M4/M5 frequency split, and the engineering logic of segment recoating and first-light acceptance.
