steps.title: 水汽相位起伏與輻射計校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water-vapour phase fluctuations and radiometric correction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「183 GHz 水汽輻射計」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “183 GHz water-vapour radiometer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對強校正源做長時間相位追蹤，分別計算套用 WVR 修正前後的相位 RMS 與相干損失，並畫出相位結構函數對基線長度的關係；WVR 修正應使長基線的相位 RMS 明顯下降，而殘餘量應與輻射計的路徑雜訊規格（約 10 µm 加上 2% 的起伏量）相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track the phase of a strong calibrator for a long interval, compute the phase RMS and coherence loss with and without the WVR correction, and plot the phase structure function against baseline length; the WVR correction should clearly reduce the long-baseline phase RMS, and the residual should match the radiometer path-noise specification of about 10 µm plus 2% of the fluctuation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雲層或液態水出現時，183 GHz 發射不再只來自水汽，輻射計推算的濕路徑偏高，套用修正反而把相位弄得更差；若流程沒有偵測液態水並關閉修正，長基線影像會模糊且峰值流量下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When clouds or liquid water are present the 183 GHz emission no longer comes only from vapour, the inferred wet path is too large and applying the correction makes the phase worse; if the pipeline does not detect liquid water and disable the correction, long-baseline images blur and peak fluxes drop.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 水汽相位起伏與輻射計校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water-vapour phase fluctuations and radiometric correction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「183 GHz 水汽輻射計」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “183 GHz water-vapour radiometer” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 雲層或液態水出現時，183 GHz 發射不再只來自水汽，輻射計推算的濕路徑偏高，套用修正反而把相位弄得更差；若流程沒有偵測液態水並關閉修正，長基線影像會模糊且峰值流量下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When clouds or liquid water are present the 183 GHz emission no longer comes only from vapour, the inferred wet path is too large and applying the correction makes the phase worse; if the pipeline does not detect liquid water and disable the correction, long-baseline images blur and peak fluxes drop. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每座 12 m 天線因此裝有 183 GHz 水汽輻射計，以約 1 s 的節奏量測視線上的水汽發射，推算瞬時濕路徑並在相關後資料中逐一修正相位；殘餘的慢變化再以快速切換校正源（phase referencing）去除。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each 12 m antenna therefore carries a 183 GHz water-vapour radiometer that measures line-of-sight vapour emission about once per second, infers the instantaneous wet path and corrects the phase of the correlated data sample by sample; the remaining slow drift is removed by fast switching to a phase calibrator.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「乾燥站址上的大氣相位是穩定的，只要校正一次即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "At a dry site the atmospheric phase is stable, so one calibration is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「校正鏈與誤差預算表」如何決定ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Calibration chain and error-budget table” determines the key performance of “Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ALMA 的每次觀測都包含一組校正：以行星或衛星與監測過的類星體定流量尺度，以強連續譜源定頻寬響應，以鄰近類星體做相位參考，並定期做指向與焦點校正。天線在搬移後的位置（基線向量）要以多個類星體的相位解到次毫米精度，否則校正源與目標之間的相位會隨角距離產生系統誤差。工程師要把這些項目列成誤差預算，量化每一項對振幅與相位的貢獻，才知道影像的流量不確定度（通常 5–10%）由誰主導。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正鏈與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every ALMA observation carries a calibration set: the flux scale from planets or moons and monitored quasars, the bandpass from a strong continuum source, phase referencing on a nearby quasar, and periodic pointing and focus checks. After antennas are moved, their positions (baseline vectors) must be solved from the phases of several quasars to submillimetre precision, otherwise the phase between calibrator and target drifts systematically with their angular separation. The engineer tabulates these items in an error budget, quantifying each contribution to amplitude and phase, to learn which term dominates the image flux uncertainty, typically 5–10%. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibration chain and error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：指向損失（高斯波束）≈ exp[−4ln2·(δ/θ_PB)²]：δ = 0.6″ 在 345 GHz（θ_PB = 16.9″）時損失僅 0.35%，在 950 GHz（θ_PB ≈ 6.2″）時損失 2.6%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pointing loss (Gaussian beam) ≈ exp[−4ln2·(δ/θ_PB)²]: δ = 0.6″ costs only 0.35% at 345 GHz (θ_PB = 16.9″) but 2.6% at 950 GHz (θ_PB ≈ 6.2″).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流量校正用的行星是理想點源，不需要模型。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Planets used for flux calibration are ideal point sources and need no model." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「校正鏈與誤差預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Calibration chain and error-budget table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「校正鏈與誤差預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Calibration chain and error-budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：指向損失（高斯波束）≈ exp[−4ln2·(δ/θ_PB)²]：δ = 0.6″ 在 345 GHz（θ_PB = 16.9″）時損失僅 0.35%，在 950 GHz（θ_PB ≈ 6.2″）時損失 2.6%。基線誤差 ε_b 造成的相位誤差 φ ≈ 2π·ε_b·sinθ_sep/λ：ε_b = 0.1 mm、校正源與目標相距 2°、λ = 0.87 mm 時 φ ≈ 0.025 rad ≈ 1.4°。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pointing loss (Gaussian beam) ≈ exp[−4ln2·(δ/θ_PB)²]: δ = 0.6″ costs only 0.35% at 345 GHz (θ_PB = 16.9″) but 2.6% at 950 GHz (θ_PB ≈ 6.2″). A baseline error ε_b gives a phase error φ ≈ 2π·ε_b·sinθ_sep/λ: with ε_b = 0.1 mm, a calibrator 2° from the target and λ = 0.87 mm, φ ≈ 0.025 rad ≈ 1.4°. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一觀測中交替觀測兩個已知流量的校正源，把其中一個當成「未知目標」做完整校正流程，比較回復流量與目錄值的偏差；同時檢查相位參考後目標相位的殘餘斜率是否隨校正源角距離增長，若是則重解天線位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Within one observation alternate between two calibrators of known flux, treat one as an unknown target, run the full calibration and compare the recovered flux with the catalogue value; also check whether the residual phase slope on the target after phase referencing grows with calibrator separation, and if so re-solve the antenna positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「校正鏈與誤差預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Calibration chain and error-budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同一觀測中交替觀測兩個已知流量的校正源，把其中一個當成「未知目標」做完整校正流程，比較回復流量與目錄值的偏差；同時檢查相位參考後目標相位的殘餘斜率是否隨校正源角距離增長，若是則重解天線位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Within one observation alternate between two calibrators of known flux, treat one as an unknown target, run the full calibration and compare the recovered flux with the catalogue value; also check whether the residual phase slope on the target after phase referencing grows with calibrator separation, and if so re-solve the antenna positions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把流量不確定度的各項以線性相加、或在預算表中同時列入 WVR 殘餘與相位參考殘餘而重複計算，會讓文件看起來保守，實際卻掩蓋了主導項；相反地忘記列入天線位置誤差，會讓長基線的相位系統誤差一路傳到科學影像。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Adding flux-uncertainty terms linearly, or double counting the WVR residual and the phase-referencing residual in the budget, makes the document look conservative while hiding the dominant term; conversely, omitting antenna-position error lets a systematic long-baseline phase error propagate all the way into the science image.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一觀測中交替觀測兩個已知流量的校正源，把其中一個當成「未知目標」做完整校正流程，比較回復流量與目錄值的偏差；同時檢查相位參考後目標相位的殘餘斜率是否隨校正源角距離增長，若是則重解天線位置。
knowledge.textEn: Within one observation alternate between two calibrators of known flux, treat one as an unknown target, run the full calibration and compare the recovered flux with the catalogue value; also check whether the residual phase slope on the target after phase referencing grows with calibrator separation, and if so re-solve the antenna positions.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
接收機冷到 4 K 之後，系統溫度就只剩天空的貢獻。
在同一觀測中交替觀測兩個已知流量的校正源，把其中一個當成「未知目標」做完整校正流程，比較回復流量與目錄值的偏差。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Once the receiver is at 4 K, the system temperature is only the sky's contribution.
Within one observation alternate between two calibrators of known flux, treat one as an unknown target, run the full calibration and compare the recovered flux with the catalogue value.
quiz.explanation: 在同一觀測中交替觀測兩個已知流量的校正源，把其中一個當成「未知目標」做完整校正流程，比較回復流量與目錄值的偏差；同時檢查相位參考後目標相位的殘餘斜率是否隨校正源角距離增長，若是則重解天線位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Within one observation alternate between two calibrators of known flux, treat one as an unknown target, run the full calibration and compare the recovered flux with the catalogue value; also check whether the residual phase slope on the target after phase referencing grows with calibrator separation, and if so re-solve the antenna positions. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「校正鏈與誤差預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Calibration chain and error-budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把流量不確定度的各項以線性相加、或在預算表中同時列入 WVR 殘餘與相位參考殘餘而重複計算，會讓文件看起來保守，實際卻掩蓋了主導項；相反地忘記列入天線位置誤差，會讓長基線的相位系統誤差一路傳到科學影像。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Adding flux-uncertainty terms linearly, or double counting the WVR residual and the phase-referencing residual in the budget, makes the document look conservative while hiding the dominant term; conversely, omitting antenna-position error lets a systematic long-baseline phase error propagate all the way into the science image. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工程師要把這些項目列成誤差預算，量化每一項對振幅與相位的貢獻，才知道影像的流量不確定度（通常 5–10%）由誰主導。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The engineer tabulates these items in an error budget, quantifying each contribution to amplitude and phase, to learn which term dominates the image flux uncertainty, typically 5–10%.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流量校正用的行星是理想點源，不需要模型。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Planets used for flux calibration are ideal point sources and need no model." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把流量不確定度的各項以線性相加、或在預算表中同時列入 WVR 殘餘與相位參考殘餘而重複計算，會讓文件看起來保守，實際卻掩蓋了主導項；相反地忘記列入天線位置誤差，會讓長基線的相位系統誤差一路傳到科學影像。
knowledge.textEn: Adding flux-uncertainty terms linearly, or double counting the WVR residual and the phase-referencing residual in the budget, makes the document look conservative while hiding the dominant term; conversely, omitting antenna-position error lets a systematic long-baseline phase error propagate all the way into the science image.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把流量不確定度的各項以線性相加、或在預算表中同時列入 WVR 殘餘與相位參考殘餘而重複計算，會讓文件看起來保守，實際卻掩蓋了主導項。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
天線數加倍，靈敏度就恰好加倍。
optionsEn: Adding flux-uncertainty terms linearly, or double counting the WVR residual and the phase-referencing residual in the budget, makes the document look conservative while hiding the dominant term.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Doubling the number of antennas exactly doubles the sensitivity.
quiz.explanation: 把流量不確定度的各項以線性相加、或在預算表中同時列入 WVR 殘餘與相位參考殘餘而重複計算，會讓文件看起來保守，實際卻掩蓋了主導項；相反地忘記列入天線位置誤差，會讓長基線的相位系統誤差一路傳到科學影像。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding flux-uncertainty terms linearly, or double counting the WVR residual and the phase-referencing residual in the budget, makes the document look conservative while hiding the dominant term; conversely, omitting antenna-position error lets a systematic long-baseline phase error propagate all the way into the science image. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程」與「天線整合、重組與陣列驗收」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation" and "Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「高原相關器與資料傳輸」如何決定ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plateau correlator and data transport” determines the key performance of “Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每座天線把 4 個 2 GHz 基頻、兩個極化的中頻以 3 位元、4 GS/s 取樣，約 96 Gb/s 的資料經光纖送到海拔 5000 m 的陣列運作站（AOS）相關器；相關器對每一對天線在每個頻道做乘積累加，產生可見度，再以 ACA 相關器處理緊湊陣列。相關器的運算量隨基線數 N(N−1)/2 與頻道數成長，而陣列靈敏度則隨 √(N(N−1)·Δν·τ) 改善，因此天線數、頻寬與整合時間是同一條方程式的三個旋鈕。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高原相關器與資料傳輸」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each antenna samples four 2 GHz basebands in two polarisations at 3 bits and 4 GS/s, and about 96 Gb/s of data travel over fibre to the correlator at the 5000 m Array Operations Site (AOS); the correlator multiplies and accumulates every antenna pair in every channel to produce visibilities, with a separate ACA correlator for the compact array. Correlator load grows with the number of baselines N(N−1)/2 and with channel count, while array sensitivity improves as √(N(N−1)·Δν·τ), so antenna count, bandwidth and integration time are three knobs on the same equation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Plateau correlator and data transport”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：基線數為 N(N−1)/2：50 座天線有 1225 條基線，66 座有 2145 條。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Baselines N(N−1)/2: 1225 for 50 antennas, 2145 for 66.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「天線數加倍，靈敏度就恰好加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling the number of antennas exactly doubles the sensitivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「高原相關器與資料傳輸」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Plateau correlator and data transport”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程
knowledge.titleEn: Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation
knowledge.text: 每座天線把 4 個 2 GHz 基頻、兩個極化的中頻以 3 位元、4 GS/s 取樣，約 96 Gb/s 的資料經光纖送到海拔 5000 m 的陣列運作站（AOS）相關器；相關器對每一對天線在每個頻道做乘積累加，產生可見度，再以 ACA 相關器處理緊湊陣列。相關器的運算量隨基線數 N(N−1)/2 與頻道數成長，而陣列靈敏度則隨 √(N(N−1)·Δν·τ) 改善，因此天線數、頻寬與整合時間是同一條方程式的三個旋鈕。
knowledge.textEn: Each antenna samples four 2 GHz basebands in two polarisations at 3 bits and 4 GS/s, and about 96 Gb/s of data travel over fibre to the correlator at the 5000 m Array Operations Site (AOS); the correlator multiplies and accumulates every antenna pair in every channel to produce visibilities, with a separate ACA correlator for the compact array. Correlator load grows with the number of baselines N(N−1)/2 and with channel count, while array sensitivity improves as √(N(N−1)·Δν·τ), so antenna count, bandwidth and integration time are three knobs on the same equation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：天線數加倍，靈敏度就恰好加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling the number of antennas exactly doubles the sensitivity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation" is correct?
options: 天線數加倍，靈敏度就恰好加倍。
每座天線把 4 個 2 GHz 基頻、兩個極化的中頻以 3 位元、4 GS/s 取樣，約 96 Gb/s 的資料經光纖送到海拔 5000 m 的陣列運作站（AOS）相關器。
每座天線各自通過驗收，陣列就自動可以做科學觀測。
optionsEn: Doubling the number of antennas exactly doubles the sensitivity.
Each antenna samples four 2 GHz basebands in two polarisations at 3 bits and 4 GS/s, and about 96 Gb/s of data travel over fibre to the correlator at the 5000 m Array Operations Site (AOS).
If every antenna passes its own acceptance, the array is automatically ready for science.
quiz.explanation: 每座天線把 4 個 2 GHz 基頻、兩個極化的中頻以 3 位元、4 GS/s 取樣，約 96 Gb/s 的資料經光纖送到海拔 5000 m 的陣列運作站（AOS）相關器；相關器對每一對天線在每個頻道做乘積累加，產生可見度，再以 ACA 相關器處理緊湊陣列。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each antenna samples four 2 GHz basebands in two polarisations at 3 bits and 4 GS/s, and about 96 Gb/s of data travel over fibre to the correlator at the 5000 m Array Operations Site (AOS); the correlator multiplies and accumulates every antenna pair in every channel to produce visibilities, with a separate ACA correlator for the compact array. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高原相關器與資料傳輸」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plateau correlator and data transport” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：基線數為 N(N−1)/2：50 座天線有 1225 條基線，66 座有 2145 條。點源靈敏度（熱雜訊）ΔS ≈ 2k·T_sys/[η_c·η_a·A·√(N(N−1)·n_p·Δν·τ)]，其中 η_c 為相關器量化效率、η_a 為口徑效率、n_p 為極化數。取系統溫度 T_sys = 123 K、η_c = 0.88、η_a = 0.70、單天線面積 A = 113 m²（12 m）、N = 50、n_p = 2、頻寬 Δν = 7.5 GHz、整合時間 τ = 60 s：分母為 69.7×√(2.2×10¹⁵) = 69.7×4.7×10⁷ = 3.27×10⁹，得 ΔS ≈ 3.40×10⁻²¹/3.27×10⁹ ≈ 1.0×10⁻³⁰ W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 0.10 mJy。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Baselines N(N−1)/2: 1225 for 50 antennas, 2145 for 66. Point-source sensitivity ΔS ≈ 2k·T_sys/[η_c·η_a·A·√(N(N−1)·n_p·Δν·τ)]. With T_sys = 123 K, η_c = 0.88, η_a = 0.70, A = 113 m² (12 m), N = 50, n_p = 2, Δν = 7.5 GHz and τ = 60 s: the denominator is 69.7×√(2.2×10¹⁵) = 69.7×4.7×10⁷ = 3.27×10⁹, so ΔS ≈ 3.40×10⁻²¹/3.27×10⁹ ≈ 1.0×10⁻³⁰ W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 0.10 mJy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把一段無源的空天區資料成像，量測影像的 RMS 雜訊並與靈敏度方程的預測比較，差異應在 20% 內；再檢查相關器輸出的量化修正（3 位元取樣的 η_c）與資料傳輸的遺失封包率，確認雜訊不是來自資料鏈而是熱雜訊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image an empty region of sky, measure the image RMS noise and compare it with the sensitivity-equation prediction, expecting agreement within 20%; then check the quantisation correction applied to the correlator output (η_c for 3-bit sampling) and the packet-loss rate of the data link to confirm that the noise is thermal and not from the data chain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 基線數為 N(N−1)/2：50 座天線有 1225 條基線，66 座有 2145 條。點源靈敏度（熱雜訊）ΔS ≈ 2k·T_sys/[η_c·η_a·A·√(N(N−1)·n_p·Δν·τ)]，其中 η_c 為相關器量化效率、η_a 為口徑效率、n_p 為極化數。取系統溫度 T_sys = 123 K、η_c = 0.88、η_a = 0.70、單天線面積 A = 113 m²（12 m）、N = 50、n_p = 2、頻寬 Δν = 7.5 GHz、整合時間 τ = 60 s：分母為 69.7×√(2.2×10¹⁵) = 69.7×4.7×10⁷ = 3.27×10⁹，得 ΔS ≈ 3.40×10⁻²¹/3.27×10⁹ ≈ 1.0×10⁻³⁰ W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 0.10 mJy。
knowledge.textEn: Baselines N(N−1)/2: 1225 for 50 antennas, 2145 for 66. Point-source sensitivity ΔS ≈ 2k·T_sys/[η_c·η_a·A·√(N(N−1)·n_p·Δν·τ)]. With T_sys = 123 K, η_c = 0.88, η_a = 0.70, A = 113 m² (12 m), N = 50, n_p = 2, Δν = 7.5 GHz and τ = 60 s: the denominator is 69.7×√(2.2×10¹⁵) = 69.7×4.7×10⁷ = 3.27×10⁹, so ΔS ≈ 3.40×10⁻²¹/3.27×10⁹ ≈ 1.0×10⁻³⁰ W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 0.10 mJy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation", which statement holds?
options: 基線越長影像品質一定越好，短基線只是備用。
接收機冷到 4 K 之後，系統溫度就只剩天空的貢獻。
基線數為 N(N−1)/2：50 座天線有 1225 條基線，66 座有 2145 條。
optionsEn: Longer baselines always give better images; short baselines are just backup.
Once the receiver is at 4 K, the system temperature is only the sky's contribution.
Baselines N(N−1)/2: 1225 for 50 antennas, 2145 for 66.
quiz.explanation: 基線數為 N(N−1)/2：50 座天線有 1225 條基線，66 座有 2145 條。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Baselines N(N−1)/2: 1225 for 50 antennas, 2145 for 66. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「高原相關器與資料傳輸」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Plateau correlator and data transport” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把一段無源的空天區資料成像，量測影像的 RMS 雜訊並與靈敏度方程的預測比較，差異應在 20% 內；再檢查相關器輸出的量化修正（3 位元取樣的 η_c）與資料傳輸的遺失封包率，確認雜訊不是來自資料鏈而是熱雜訊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image an empty region of sky, measure the image RMS noise and compare it with the sensitivity-equation prediction, expecting agreement within 20%; then check the quantisation correction applied to the correlator output (η_c for 3-bit sampling) and the packet-loss rate of the data link to confirm that the noise is thermal and not from the data chain. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：數位化器的取樣電平未隨 IF 功率調整時，3 位元量化落到非線性區，η_c 從 0.88 掉到 0.7 以下，而且強源附近出現假訊號；靈敏度預測與實測差距擴大卻找不到天氣或接收機原因。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If digitiser sampling thresholds are not adjusted to the IF power, 3-bit quantisation falls into its nonlinear range, η_c drops from 0.88 to below 0.7 and spurious signals appear near strong sources; the gap between predicted and measured sensitivity widens with no weather or receiver cause to blame.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把一段無源的空天區資料成像，量測影像的 RMS 雜訊並與靈敏度方程的預測比較，差異應在 20% 內；再檢查相關器輸出的量化修正（3 位元取樣的 η_c）與資料傳輸的遺失封包率，確認雜訊不是來自資料鏈而是熱雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: Image an empty region of sky, measure the image RMS noise and compare it with the sensitivity-equation prediction, expecting agreement within 20%; then check the quantisation correction applied to the correlator output (η_c for 3-bit sampling) and the packet-loss rate of the data link to confirm that the noise is thermal and not from the data chain.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation"?
options: 把一段無源的空天區資料成像，量測影像的 RMS 雜訊並與靈敏度方程的預測比較，差異應在 20% 內。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
乾燥站址上的大氣相位是穩定的，只要校正一次即可。
optionsEn: Image an empty region of sky, measure the image RMS noise and compare it with the sensitivity-equation prediction, expecting agreement within 20%.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
At a dry site the atmospheric phase is stable, so one calibration is enough.
quiz.explanation: 把一段無源的空天區資料成像，量測影像的 RMS 雜訊並與靈敏度方程的預測比較，差異應在 20% 內；再檢查相關器輸出的量化修正（3 位元取樣的 η_c）與資料傳輸的遺失封包率，確認雜訊不是來自資料鏈而是熱雜訊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Image an empty region of sky, measure the image RMS noise and compare it with the sensitivity-equation prediction, expecting agreement within 20%; then check the quantisation correction applied to the correlator output (η_c for 3-bit sampling) and the packet-loss rate of the data link to confirm that the noise is thermal and not from the data chain. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高原相關器與資料傳輸」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Plateau correlator and data transport” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 數位化器的取樣電平未隨 IF 功率調整時，3 位元量化落到非線性區，η_c 從 0.88 掉到 0.7 以下，而且強源附近出現假訊號；靈敏度預測與實測差距擴大卻找不到天氣或接收機原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If digitiser sampling thresholds are not adjusted to the IF power, 3-bit quantisation falls into its nonlinear range, η_c drops from 0.88 to below 0.7 and spurious signals appear near strong sources; the gap between predicted and measured sensitivity widens with no weather or receiver cause to blame. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相關器的運算量隨基線數 N(N−1)/2 與頻道數成長，而陣列靈敏度則隨 √(N(N−1)·Δν·τ) 改善，因此天線數、頻寬與整合時間是同一條方程式的三個旋鈕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlator load grows with the number of baselines N(N−1)/2 and with channel count, while array sensitivity improves as √(N(N−1)·Δν·τ), so antenna count, bandwidth and integration time are three knobs on the same equation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「天線數加倍，靈敏度就恰好加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling the number of antennas exactly doubles the sensitivity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 數位化器的取樣電平未隨 IF 功率調整時，3 位元量化落到非線性區，η_c 從 0.88 掉到 0.7 以下，而且強源附近出現假訊號；靈敏度預測與實測差距擴大卻找不到天氣或接收機原因。
knowledge.textEn: If digitiser sampling thresholds are not adjusted to the IF power, 3-bit quantisation falls into its nonlinear range, η_c drops from 0.88 to below 0.7 and spurious signals appear near strong sources; the gap between predicted and measured sensitivity widens with no weather or receiver cause to blame.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「數位化、相關器與靈敏度方程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Digitisation, the correlator and the sensitivity equation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
數位化器的取樣電平未隨 IF 功率調整時，3 位元量化落到非線性區，η_c 從 0.88 掉到 0.7 以下，而且強源附近出現假訊號。
每座天線各自通過驗收，陣列就自動可以做科學觀測。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If digitiser sampling thresholds are not adjusted to the IF power, 3-bit quantisation falls into its nonlinear range, η_c drops from 0.88 to below 0.7 and spurious signals appear near strong sources.
If every antenna passes its own acceptance, the array is automatically ready for science.
quiz.explanation: 數位化器的取樣電平未隨 IF 功率調整時，3 位元量化落到非線性區，η_c 從 0.88 掉到 0.7 以下，而且強源附近出現假訊號；靈敏度預測與實測差距擴大卻找不到天氣或接收機原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If digitiser sampling thresholds are not adjusted to the IF power, 3-bit quantisation falls into its nonlinear range, η_c drops from 0.88 to below 0.7 and spurious signals appear near strong sources; the gap between predicted and measured sensitivity widens with no weather or receiver cause to blame. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 天線整合、重組與陣列驗收：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「陣列重組與系統驗收紀錄」如何決定ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Array reconfiguration and system-acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 天線先在 OSF 組裝並完成全像、指向與伺服測試，再由 28 輪的運輸車載上 5000 m 高原的 192 個基座之一；每次重組後要重解天線位置、確認光纖長度補償（線長校正器）與 LO 鎖相，並以閉合相位檢驗相關器與資料鏈。陣列的驗收不是逐天線合格，而是以整體指標判定：相位穩定度對基線長度的關係、影像動態範圍、流量尺度一致性與可觀測時間比例，這些數字進入系統驗證紀錄並成為每個觀測週期的基準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「陣列重組與系統驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An antenna is first assembled at the OSF, passing holography, pointing and servo tests, then carried by a 28-wheel transporter to one of 192 pads on the 5000 m plateau; after each reconfiguration the antenna positions are re-solved, the fibre length compensation (line-length corrector) and LO phase lock are confirmed, and closure phases check the correlator and data chain. The array is accepted not antenna by antenna but on system metrics: phase stability versus baseline length, image dynamic range, flux-scale consistency and the fraction of usable observing time, all recorded in the system-verification record that becomes the baseline for each observing cycle. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Array reconfiguration and system-acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：快照影像動態範圍的粗估 D ≈ √(N_bl·N_t)/σ_φ：N_bl = 1225、N_t = 100 個時間取樣、殘餘天線相位 σ_φ = 5°（0.087 rad）時 D ≈ 350/0.087 ≈ 4000:1；若 σ_φ = 20°（0.35 rad）則 D ≈ 1000:1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A rough snapshot dynamic range is D ≈ √(N_bl·N_t)/σ_φ: with N_bl = 1225, N_t = 100 time samples and a residual antenna phase σ_φ = 5° (0.087 rad), D ≈ 350/0.087 ≈ 4000:1; with σ_φ = 20° (0.35 rad), D ≈ 1000:1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每座天線各自通過驗收，陣列就自動可以做科學觀測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every antenna passes its own acceptance, the array is automatically ready for science." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「陣列重組與系統驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Array reconfiguration and system-acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 天線整合、重組與陣列驗收
knowledge.titleEn: Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance
knowledge.text: 天線先在 OSF 組裝並完成全像、指向與伺服測試，再由 28 輪的運輸車載上 5000 m 高原的 192 個基座之一；每次重組後要重解天線位置、確認光纖長度補償（線長校正器）與 LO 鎖相，並以閉合相位檢驗相關器與資料鏈。陣列的驗收不是逐天線合格，而是以整體指標判定：相位穩定度對基線長度的關係、影像動態範圍、流量尺度一致性與可觀測時間比例，這些數字進入系統驗證紀錄並成為每個觀測週期的基準。

The array is accepted not antenna by antenna but on system metrics: phase stability versus baseline length, image dynamic range, flux-scale consistency and the fraction of usable observing time, all recorded in the system-verification record that becomes the baseline for each observing cycle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每座天線各自通過驗收，陣列就自動可以做科學觀測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「天線整合、重組與陣列驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance" is correct?
options: 每座天線各自通過驗收，陣列就自動可以做科學觀測。
只要天線夠大，站址高度對毫米波觀測影響不大。
天線先在 OSF 組裝並完成全像、指向與伺服測試，再由 28 輪的運輸車載上 5000 m 高原的 192 個基座之一。

With big enough antennas, site altitude hardly matters at millimetre wavelengths.

steps.title: 天線整合、重組與陣列驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「陣列重組與系統驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Array reconfiguration and system-acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：快照影像動態範圍的粗估 D ≈ √(N_bl·N_t)/σ_φ：N_bl = 1225、N_t = 100 個時間取樣、殘餘天線相位 σ_φ = 5°（0.087 rad）時 D ≈ 350/0.087 ≈ 4000:1；若 σ_φ = 20°（0.35 rad）則 D ≈ 1000:1。三天線閉合相位 φ₁₂ + φ₂₃ + φ₃₁ 與天線相位誤差無關，應在雜訊內為 0。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A rough snapshot dynamic range is D ≈ √(N_bl·N_t)/σ_φ: with N_bl = 1225, N_t = 100 time samples and a residual antenna phase σ_φ = 5° (0.087 rad), D ≈ 350/0.087 ≈ 4000:1; with σ_φ = 20° (0.35 rad), D ≈ 1000:1. The three-antenna closure phase φ₁₂ + φ₂₃ + φ₃₁ is independent of antenna-based errors and should be zero within noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重組後先對強類星體做短觀測：檢查所有三角形的閉合相位是否為零、各天線的相位解是否連續，再對同一源自校正（self-calibration）量影像動態範圍；把相位 RMS 對基線的曲線、動態範圍與流量尺度寫入驗收紀錄，與前一次配置比較，差異超過預期者回頭查天線位置或線長補償。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After a reconfiguration make a short observation of a strong quasar: check that closure phases on all triangles are zero, that each antenna's phase solution is continuous, then self-calibrate the same source and measure image dynamic range; enter the phase-RMS-versus-baseline curve, dynamic range and flux scale into the acceptance record, compare with the previous configuration, and trace any excess to antenna positions or line-length compensation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 快照影像動態範圍的粗估 D ≈ √(N_bl·N_t)/σ_φ：N_bl = 1225、N_t = 100 個時間取樣、殘餘天線相位 σ_φ = 5°（0.087 rad）時 D ≈ 350/0.087 ≈ 4000:1；若 σ_φ = 20°（0.35 rad）則 D ≈ 1000:1。三天線閉合相位 φ₁₂ + φ₂₃ + φ₃₁ 與天線相位誤差無關，應在雜訊內為 0。
knowledge.textEn: A rough snapshot dynamic range is D ≈ √(N_bl·N_t)/σ_φ: with N_bl = 1225, N_t = 100 time samples and a residual antenna phase σ_φ = 5° (0.087 rad), D ≈ 350/0.087 ≈ 4000:1; with σ_φ = 20° (0.35 rad), D ≈ 1000:1. The three-antenna closure phase φ₁₂ + φ₂₃ + φ₃₁ is independent of antenna-based errors and should be zero within noise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「天線整合、重組與陣列驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 快照影像動態範圍的粗估 D ≈ √(N_bl·N_t)/σ_φ：N_bl = 1225、N_t = 100 個時間取樣、殘餘天線相位 σ_φ = 5°（0.087 rad）時 D ≈ 350/0.087 ≈ 4000:1。
25 µm 的面形精度對 ALMA 所有波段都綽綽有餘。
乾燥站址上的大氣相位是穩定的，只要校正一次即可。

A 25 µm surface is more than good enough for every ALMA band.
At a dry site the atmospheric phase is stable, so one calibration is enough.

steps.title: 天線整合、重組與陣列驗收：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「陣列重組與系統驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Array reconfiguration and system-acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 重組後先對強類星體做短觀測：檢查所有三角形的閉合相位是否為零、各天線的相位解是否連續，再對同一源自校正（self-calibration）量影像動態範圍；把相位 RMS 對基線的曲線、動態範圍與流量尺度寫入驗收紀錄，與前一次配置比較，差異超過預期者回頭查天線位置或線長補償。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After a reconfiguration make a short observation of a strong quasar: check that closure phases on all triangles are zero, that each antenna's phase solution is continuous, then self-calibrate the same source and measure image dynamic range; enter the phase-RMS-versus-baseline curve, dynamic range and flux scale into the acceptance record, compare with the previous configuration, and trace any excess to antenna positions or line-length compensation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一座天線在搬移後位置誤差 1 mm 未被重解，所有含該天線的基線相位隨時間緩慢旋轉；自校正會把誤差吸收進增益解而掩蓋問題，但目標源的位置會系統性偏移，直到有人比對校正源位置才發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An antenna whose position is off by 1 mm after a move and not re-solved makes every baseline containing it rotate slowly in phase; self-calibration absorbs the error into gain solutions and hides the problem, but target positions shift systematically until someone compares calibrator positions.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「天線整合、重組與陣列驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 天線整合、重組與陣列驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「陣列重組與系統驗收紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Array reconfiguration and system-acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一座天線在搬移後位置誤差 1 mm 未被重解，所有含該天線的基線相位隨時間緩慢旋轉；自校正會把誤差吸收進增益解而掩蓋問題，但目標源的位置會系統性偏移，直到有人比對校正源位置才發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An antenna whose position is off by 1 mm after a move and not re-solved makes every baseline containing it rotate slowly in phase; self-calibration absorbs the error into gain solutions and hides the problem, but target positions shift systematically until someone compares calibrator positions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：陣列的驗收不是逐天線合格，而是以整體指標判定：相位穩定度對基線長度的關係、影像動態範圍、流量尺度一致性與可觀測時間比例，這些數字進入系統驗證紀錄並成為每個觀測週期的基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The array is accepted not antenna by antenna but on system metrics: phase stability versus baseline length, image dynamic range, flux-scale consistency and the fraction of usable observing time, all recorded in the system-verification record that becomes the baseline for each observing cycle.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每座天線各自通過驗收，陣列就自動可以做科學觀測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every antenna passes its own acceptance, the array is automatically ready for science." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT
summary: 以 ESO 1989 年啟用的 NTT 為對象，解析為何 24 cm 厚的 3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡必須靠 75 個軸向主動支撐與離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 分析儀維持面形，八角形旋轉圓頂與鏡面溫控如何壓低局部視寧度，以及如何把光學、追蹤、鏡面視寧度與大氣視寧度合成可驗收的影像品質預算。
summaryEn: Using ESO's NTT, commissioned in 1989, this course explains why a 3.58 m Zerodur meniscus only 24 cm thick must rely on 75 active axial supports and an off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann analyser to hold its figure, how the octagonal rotating enclosure and mirror temperature control suppress local seeing, and how optics, tracking, mirror seeing and atmospheric seeing combine into an acceptable image-quality budget.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Image-quality budget exercise (teaching assumptions): atmospheric seeing 0.65″, optical residual 0.20″, tracking jitter 0.08″ RMS (equivalent FWHM 2.355×0.08 = 0.19″), dome seeing 0.10″, and mirror seeing 0.38×0.5^1.2 = 0.38×0.435 = 0.165″ for a mirror ΔT = 0.5 K warmer than the air. Telescope term RSS = √(0.20² + 0.19² + 0.165² + 0.10²) = √0.113 = 0.335″; combined with the atmosphere, FWHM = (0.65^(5/3) + 0.335^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.488 + 0.162)^(0.6) = 0.77″. If daytime temperature control fails and ΔT = 2 K, mirror seeing rises to 0.38×2.30 = 0.87″, the telescope RSS becomes √(0.04 + 0.035 + 0.76 + 0.01) = 0.92″ and the combined FWHM = (0.488 + 0.870)^(0.6) = 1.20″. A 1.5 K mirror temperature excess therefore damages the image far more than polishing the optical residual from 0.20″ to 0.10″ could ever recover. Values are teaching assumptions, not telescope specifications.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯」與「影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why a thin mirror needs active optics" and "Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Why a thin mirror needs active optics: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “3.58 m Zerodur meniscus” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 傳統望遠鏡主鏡以直徑／厚度約 6 到 8 的厚鏡坯靠自身剛性維持面形，但重量與熱慣性隨尺寸急速增長。NTT 改用厚度僅 24 cm、直徑 3.58 m 的 Zerodur 彎月薄鏡，重量約 6 t，自重彎曲與溫度梯度造成的面形誤差不再靠剛性抵抗，而是由支撐系統中的主動力與量測回授來修正。這把望遠鏡從「做得夠硬」改成「量得準、修得快」，是主動光學的核心轉變，也讓後來 8 m 級 VLT 的 17.5 cm 薄鏡成為可能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A classical primary with diameter-to-thickness ratio of about 6 to 8 holds its figure by stiffness alone, but mass and thermal inertia grow rapidly with size. The NTT instead uses a Zerodur meniscus 3.58 m across and only 24 cm thick, about 6 t, whose self-weight bending and thermal-gradient errors are no longer resisted by stiffness but corrected by active forces in the support system under measurement feedback. This shifts the telescope from being built stiff enough to being measured accurately and corrected quickly, the central change of active optics, and it made the 17.5 cm meniscus of the later 8 m VLT possible. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “3.58 m Zerodur meniscus”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Blank mass m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t: with ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and D = 3.58 m, a classical D/t = 8 blank (t = 0.45 m) weighs 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t, while the NTT's t = 0.24 m gives 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “3.58 m Zerodur meniscus”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Why a thin mirror needs active optics
knowledge.text: 傳統望遠鏡主鏡以直徑／厚度約 6 到 8 的厚鏡坯靠自身剛性維持面形，但重量與熱慣性隨尺寸急速增長。NTT 改用厚度僅 24 cm、直徑 3.58 m 的 Zerodur 彎月薄鏡，重量約 6 t，自重彎曲與溫度梯度造成的面形誤差不再靠剛性抵抗，而是由支撐系統中的主動力與量測回授來修正。
knowledge.textEn: A classical primary with diameter-to-thickness ratio of about 6 to 8 holds its figure by stiffness alone, but mass and thermal inertia grow rapidly with size. The NTT instead uses a Zerodur meniscus 3.58 m across and only 24 cm thick, about 6 t, whose self-weight bending and thermal-gradient errors are no longer resisted by stiffness but corrected by active forces in the support system under measurement feedback.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Why a thin mirror needs active optics" is correct?
options: 鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。
傳統望遠鏡主鏡以直徑／厚度約 6 到 8 的厚鏡坯靠自身剛性維持面形，但重量與熱慣性隨尺寸急速增長。
主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。
optionsEn: Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images.
A classical primary with diameter-to-thickness ratio of about 6 to 8 holds its figure by stiffness alone, but mass and thermal inertia grow rapidly with size.
Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds.
quiz.explanation: 傳統望遠鏡主鏡以直徑／厚度約 6 到 8 的厚鏡坯靠自身剛性維持面形，但重量與熱慣性隨尺寸急速增長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A classical primary with diameter-to-thickness ratio of about 6 to 8 holds its figure by stiffness alone, but mass and thermal inertia grow rapidly with size. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why a thin mirror needs active optics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “3.58 m Zerodur meniscus” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鏡坯質量 m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t：ρ = 2530 kg/m³、D = 3.58 m 時，傳統 D/t = 8（t = 0.45 m）的鏡坯重 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t，NTT 的 t = 0.24 m 則為 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t。板的彎曲撓度正比於 D⁴/t²，所以在同直徑下薄鏡的柔度是厚鏡的 (0.45/0.24)² ≈ 3.5 倍，必須由主動支撐補償。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Blank mass m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t: with ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and D = 3.58 m, a classical D/t = 8 blank (t = 0.45 m) weighs 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t, while the NTT's t = 0.24 m gives 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t. Plate bending deflection scales as D⁴/t², so at the same diameter the thin mirror is (0.45/0.24)² ≈ 3.5 times more compliant and must be compensated by active support. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在天頂與 60° 天頂距下的自重變形，分解成 Zernike 項並與望遠鏡在相同姿態下由影像分析儀量到的像散與三葉像差比較；兩者的低階項應在數十奈米內吻合，否則檢查支撐邊界條件的建模。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the self-weight deformation of the blank at zenith and at 60° zenith distance with a finite-element model, decompose it into Zernike terms and compare with the astigmatism and trefoil measured by the image analyser at the same attitudes; the low-order terms should agree within tens of nanometres, otherwise revisit the modelled support boundary conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鏡坯質量 m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t：ρ = 2530 kg/m³、D = 3.58 m 時，傳統 D/t = 8（t = 0.45 m）的鏡坯重 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t，NTT 的 t = 0.24 m 則為 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t。板的彎曲撓度正比於 D⁴/t²，所以在同直徑下薄鏡的柔度是厚鏡的 (0.45/0.24)² ≈ 3.5 倍，必須由主動支撐補償。
knowledge.textEn: Blank mass m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t: with ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and D = 3.58 m, a classical D/t = 8 blank (t = 0.45 m) weighs 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t, while the NTT's t = 0.24 m gives 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t. Plate bending deflection scales as D⁴/t², so at the same diameter the thin mirror is (0.45/0.24)² ≈ 3.5 times more compliant and must be compensated by active support.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Why a thin mirror needs active optics", which statement holds?
options: 只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。
指向越準，星像就越銳利。
optionsEn: With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter.
The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images.
Blank mass m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t: with ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and D = 3.58 m, a classical D/t = 8 blank (t = 0.45 m) weighs 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t, while the NTT's t = 0.24 m gives 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t.
quiz.explanationEn: Blank mass m = ρ·π(D/2)²·t: with ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and D = 3.58 m, a classical D/t = 8 blank (t = 0.45 m) weighs 2530×10.07×0.45 ≈ 11.4 t, while the NTT's t = 0.24 m gives 2530×10.07×0.24 ≈ 6.1 t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why a thin mirror needs active optics: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “3.58 m Zerodur meniscus” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在天頂與 60° 天頂距下的自重變形，分解成 Zernike 項並與望遠鏡在相同姿態下由影像分析儀量到的像散與三葉像差比較；兩者的低階項應在數十奈米內吻合，否則檢查支撐邊界條件的建模。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the self-weight deformation of the blank at zenith and at 60° zenith distance with a finite-element model, decompose it into Zernike terms and compare with the astigmatism and trefoil measured by the image analyser at the same attitudes; the low-order terms should agree within tens of nanometres, otherwise revisit the modelled support boundary conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把薄鏡當成剛性鏡安裝、支撐力只按靜態平均分配時，鏡面隨天頂距變化會出現數微米的像散，星像變成橢圓並隨指向方向轉動，任何固定的光學校準都無法消除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Mounting the thin mirror as if it were rigid, with support forces set only to the static average, produces micrometres of astigmatism that change with zenith distance; star images become elliptical and rotate with pointing direction, and no fixed optical alignment can remove it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在天頂與 60° 天頂距下的自重變形，分解成 Zernike 項並與望遠鏡在相同姿態下由影像分析儀量到的像散與三葉像差比較；兩者的低階項應在數十奈米內吻合，否則檢查支撐邊界條件的建模。
knowledge.textEn: Compute the self-weight deformation of the blank at zenith and at 60° zenith distance with a finite-element model, decompose it into Zernike terms and compare with the astigmatism and trefoil measured by the image analyser at the same attitudes; the low-order terms should agree within tens of nanometres, otherwise revisit the modelled support boundary conditions.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Why a thin mirror needs active optics"?
options: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在天頂與 60° 天頂距下的自重變形，分解成 Zernike 項並與望遠鏡在相同姿態下由影像分析儀量到的像散與三葉像差比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
閉環修正後就不需要開環查表了。
optionsEn: Compute the self-weight deformation of the blank at zenith and at 60° zenith distance with a finite-element model, decompose it into Zernike terms and compare with the astigmatism and trefoil measured by the image analyser at the same attitudes.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在天頂與 60° 天頂距下的自重變形，分解成 Zernike 項並與望遠鏡在相同姿態下由影像分析儀量到的像散與三葉像差比較；兩者的低階項應在數十奈米內吻合，否則檢查支撐邊界條件的建模。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute the self-weight deformation of the blank at zenith and at 60° zenith distance with a finite-element model, decompose it into Zernike terms and compare with the astigmatism and trefoil measured by the image analyser at the same attitudes; the low-order terms should agree within tens of nanometres, otherwise revisit the modelled support boundary conditions. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Why a thin mirror needs active optics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “3.58 m Zerodur meniscus” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把薄鏡當成剛性鏡安裝、支撐力只按靜態平均分配時，鏡面隨天頂距變化會出現數微米的像散，星像變成橢圓並隨指向方向轉動，任何固定的光學校準都無法消除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Mounting the thin mirror as if it were rigid, with support forces set only to the static average, produces micrometres of astigmatism that change with zenith distance; star images become elliptical and rotate with pointing direction, and no fixed optical alignment can remove it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這把望遠鏡從「做得夠硬」改成「量得準、修得快」，是主動光學的核心轉變，也讓後來 8 m 級 VLT 的 17.5 cm 薄鏡成為可能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This shifts the telescope from being built stiff enough to being measured accurately and corrected quickly, the central change of active optics, and it made the 17.5 cm meniscus of the later 8 m VLT possible.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把薄鏡當成剛性鏡安裝、支撐力只按靜態平均分配時，鏡面隨天頂距變化會出現數微米的像散，星像變成橢圓並隨指向方向轉動，任何固定的光學校準都無法消除。
knowledge.textEn: Mounting the thin mirror as if it were rigid, with support forces set only to the static average, produces micrometres of astigmatism that change with zenith distance; star images become elliptical and rotate with pointing direction, and no fixed optical alignment can remove it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Why a thin mirror needs active optics" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把薄鏡當成剛性鏡安裝、支撐力只按靜態平均分配時，鏡面隨天頂距變化會出現數微米的像散，星像變成橢圓並隨指向方向轉動，任何固定的光學校準都無法消除。
主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Mounting the thin mirror as if it were rigid, with support forces set only to the static average, produces micrometres of astigmatism that change with zenith distance.
Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds.
quiz.explanation: 把薄鏡當成剛性鏡安裝、支撐力只按靜態平均分配時，鏡面隨天頂距變化會出現數微米的像散，星像變成橢圓並隨指向方向轉動，任何固定的光學校準都無法消除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mounting the thin mirror as if it were rigid, with support forces set only to the static average, produces micrometres of astigmatism that change with zenith distance; star images become elliptical and rotate with pointing direction, and no fixed optical alignment can remove it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與 Nasmyth 焦點」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ritchey–Chrétien train and Nasmyth foci” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: NTT 是 f/2.2 主鏡、f/11 Nasmyth 焦點的 Ritchey–Chrétien 經緯儀望遠鏡，兩個 Nasmyth 平台各掛一組儀器。地面望遠鏡的影像由大氣視寧度主導，主動光學的目標不是達到繞射極限，而是讓望遠鏡本身的像差、追蹤與局部視寧度貢獻遠小於大氣項。主動修正的對象是重力、溫度與製造殘差這些變化慢的低階像差，因此修正週期以數十秒到數分鐘計；高頻的大氣擾動留給之後的自適應光學。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與 Nasmyth 焦點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The NTT is an alt-azimuth Ritchey–Chrétien telescope with an f/2.2 primary and f/11 Nasmyth foci, with an instrument on each Nasmyth platform. Ground-based images are dominated by atmospheric seeing, so the aim of active optics is not the diffraction limit but to keep the telescope's own aberrations, tracking and local seeing far below the atmospheric term. Active correction targets slowly varying low-order aberrations from gravity, temperature and manufacturing residuals, so the correction cycle is tens of seconds to minutes; fast atmospheric turbulence is left to later adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ritchey–Chrétien train and Nasmyth foci”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Kolmogorov 視寧度與望遠鏡像質的合成常以 5/3 次方相加：FWHM_total ≈ (θ_seeing^(5/3) + θ_tel^(5/3))^(3/5)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Kolmogorov seeing and telescope image quality are commonly combined in 5/3 power: FWHM_total ≈ (θ_seeing^(5/3) + θ_tel^(5/3))^(3/5).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與 Nasmyth 焦點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Ritchey–Chrétien train and Nasmyth foci”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬
knowledge.titleEn: Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction
knowledge.text: NTT 是 f/2.2 主鏡、f/11 Nasmyth 焦點的 Ritchey–Chrétien 經緯儀望遠鏡，兩個 Nasmyth 平台各掛一組儀器。地面望遠鏡的影像由大氣視寧度主導，主動光學的目標不是達到繞射極限，而是讓望遠鏡本身的像差、追蹤與局部視寧度貢獻遠小於大氣項。
knowledge.textEn: The NTT is an alt-azimuth Ritchey–Chrétien telescope with an f/2.2 primary and f/11 Nasmyth foci, with an instrument on each Nasmyth platform. Ground-based images are dominated by atmospheric seeing, so the aim of active optics is not the diffraction limit but to keep the telescope's own aberrations, tracking and local seeing far below the atmospheric term.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction" is correct?
options: 主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。
支撐點越多，主動光學就能修正任意高階的像差。
NTT 是 f/2.2 主鏡、f/11 Nasmyth 焦點的 Ritchey–Chrétien 經緯儀望遠鏡，兩個 Nasmyth 平台各掛一組儀器。
optionsEn: Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds.
With enough support points active optics can correct arbitrarily high-order aberrations.
The NTT is an alt-azimuth Ritchey–Chrétien telescope with an f/2.2 primary and f/11 Nasmyth foci, with an instrument on each Nasmyth platform.
quiz.explanation: NTT 是 f/2.2 主鏡、f/11 Nasmyth 焦點的 Ritchey–Chrétien 經緯儀望遠鏡，兩個 Nasmyth 平台各掛一組儀器。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The NTT is an alt-azimuth Ritchey–Chrétien telescope with an f/2.2 primary and f/11 Nasmyth foci, with an instrument on each Nasmyth platform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與 Nasmyth 焦點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ritchey–Chrétien train and Nasmyth foci” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Kolmogorov 視寧度與望遠鏡像質的合成常以 5/3 次方相加：FWHM_total ≈ (θ_seeing^(5/3) + θ_tel^(5/3))^(3/5)。θ_seeing = 0.60″、θ_tel = 0.15″ 時 (0.4268 + 0.0424)^(0.6) ≈ 0.635″，望遠鏡只增加 0.035″；若 θ_tel = 0.40″ 則 (0.4268 + 0.2172)^(0.6) ≈ 0.768″。作為對照，Maréchal 判準 λ/14 在 500 nm 約為 36 nm RMS 波前。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Kolmogorov seeing and telescope image quality are commonly combined in 5/3 power: FWHM_total ≈ (θ_seeing^(5/3) + θ_tel^(5/3))^(3/5). With θ_seeing = 0.60″ and θ_tel = 0.15″, (0.4268 + 0.0424)^(0.6) ≈ 0.635″, so the telescope adds only 0.035″; with θ_tel = 0.40″ it becomes (0.4268 + 0.2172)^(0.6) ≈ 0.768″. For reference the Maréchal criterion λ/14 at 500 nm is about 36 nm RMS wavefront. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一夜以站址的差分影像運動監測儀（DIMM）記錄視寧度，同時量焦面上星像的 FWHM，把兩者以 5/3 次方相減反推望遠鏡項；若反推的 θ_tel 隨天頂距或時間系統性變化，就把主動光學的殘餘像差紀錄對照，找出是光學、追蹤還是熱的貢獻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On one night record the seeing with the site differential image motion monitor (DIMM) while measuring stellar FWHM at the focal plane, then subtract in 5/3 power to back out the telescope term; if the inferred θ_tel varies systematically with zenith distance or time, compare it with the active-optics residual log to attribute it to optics, tracking or thermal effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Kolmogorov seeing and telescope image quality are commonly combined in 5/3 power: FWHM_total ≈ (θ_seeing^(5/3) + θ_tel^(5/3))^(3/5). With θ_seeing = 0.60″ and θ_tel = 0.15″, (0.4268 + 0.0424)^(0.6) ≈ 0.635″, so the telescope adds only 0.035″; with θ_tel = 0.40″ it becomes (0.4268 + 0.2172)^(0.6) ≈ 0.768″. For reference the Maréchal criterion λ/14 at 500 nm is about 36 nm RMS wavefront.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD.
Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary.

steps.title: 影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與 Nasmyth 焦點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ritchey–Chrétien train and Nasmyth foci” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同一夜以站址的差分影像運動監測儀（DIMM）記錄視寧度，同時量焦面上星像的 FWHM，把兩者以 5/3 次方相減反推望遠鏡項；若反推的 θ_tel 隨天頂距或時間系統性變化，就把主動光學的殘餘像差紀錄對照，找出是光學、追蹤還是熱的貢獻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On one night record the seeing with the site differential image motion monitor (DIMM) while measuring stellar FWHM at the focal plane, then subtract in 5/3 power to back out the telescope term; if the inferred θ_tel varies systematically with zenith distance or time, compare it with the active-optics residual log to attribute it to optics, tracking or thermal effects. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把主動光學迴路頻寬提高到試圖跟上大氣像散，量測雜訊會被放大注入鏡面，支撐力不停振盪，星像反而比開環更差，還會讓致動器提前磨損。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the active-optics loop bandwidth to chase atmospheric astigmatism injects amplified measurement noise into the mirror; support forces oscillate, images become worse than open loop and the actuators wear out early.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一夜以站址的差分影像運動監測儀（DIMM）記錄視寧度，同時量焦面上星像的 FWHM，把兩者以 5/3 次方相減反推望遠鏡項；若反推的 θ_tel 隨天頂距或時間系統性變化，就把主動光學的殘餘像差紀錄對照，找出是光學、追蹤還是熱的貢獻。
knowledge.textEn: On one night record the seeing with the site differential image motion monitor (DIMM) while measuring stellar FWHM at the focal plane, then subtract in 5/3 power to back out the telescope term; if the inferred θ_tel varies systematically with zenith distance or time, compare it with the active-optics residual log to attribute it to optics, tracking or thermal effects.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在同一夜以站址的差分影像運動監測儀（DIMM）記錄視寧度，同時量焦面上星像的 FWHM，把兩者以 5/3 次方相減反推望遠鏡項。
望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
On one night record the seeing with the site differential image motion monitor (DIMM) while measuring stellar FWHM at the focal plane, then subtract in 5/3 power to back out the telescope term.
Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image.

quiz.explanationEn: On one night record the seeing with the site differential image motion monitor (DIMM) while measuring stellar FWHM at the focal plane, then subtract in 5/3 power to back out the telescope term; if the inferred θ_tel varies systematically with zenith distance or time, compare it with the active-optics residual log to attribute it to optics, tracking or thermal effects. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與 Nasmyth 焦點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ritchey–Chrétien train and Nasmyth foci” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把主動光學迴路頻寬提高到試圖跟上大氣像散，量測雜訊會被放大注入鏡面，支撐力不停振盪，星像反而比開環更差，還會讓致動器提前磨損。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the active-optics loop bandwidth to chase atmospheric astigmatism injects amplified measurement noise into the mirror; support forces oscillate, images become worse than open loop and the actuators wear out early. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：主動修正的對象是重力、溫度與製造殘差這些變化慢的低階像差，因此修正週期以數十秒到數分鐘計；高頻的大氣擾動留給之後的自適應光學。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Active correction targets slowly varying low-order aberrations from gravity, temperature and manufacturing residuals, so the correction cycle is tens of seconds to minutes; fast atmospheric turbulence is left to later adaptive optics.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若把主動光學迴路頻寬提高到試圖跟上大氣像散，量測雜訊會被放大注入鏡面，支撐力不停振盪，星像反而比開環更差，還會讓致動器提前磨損。
