knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「影像品質判準與主動修正的頻寬」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Image-quality criteria and the bandwidth of active correction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
支撐點越多，主動光學就能修正任意高階的像差。
若把主動光學迴路頻寬提高到試圖跟上大氣像散，量測雜訊會被放大注入鏡面，支撐力不停振盪，星像反而比開環更差，還會讓致動器提前磨損。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
With enough support points active optics can correct arbitrarily high-order aberrations.
Raising the active-optics loop bandwidth to chase atmospheric astigmatism injects amplified measurement noise into the mirror.
quiz.explanation: 若把主動光學迴路頻寬提高到試圖跟上大氣像散，量測雜訊會被放大注入鏡面，支撐力不停振盪，星像反而比開環更差，還會讓致動器提前磨損。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising the active-optics loop bandwidth to chase atmospheric astigmatism injects amplified measurement noise into the mirror; support forces oscillate, images become worse than open loop and the actuators wear out early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力」與「圓頂熱設計與鏡面視寧度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces" and "Enclosure thermal design and mirror seeing": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「75 個軸向主動支撐」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “75 active axial supports” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: NTT 主鏡坯由 Schott 製造的 Zerodur 玻璃陶瓷鑄成，熱膨脹係數接近零，研磨拋光後裝在 75 個軸向支撐與一組側向支撐上。每個軸向支撐是帶可動配重的靜力槓桿（astatic lever），被動地承擔隨姿態變化的大部分重量，再由電動致動器疊加一個小的修正力；三個固定點定義鏡面位置。修正力的空間分佈決定能產生哪些彎曲模態：像散、三葉、四葉等低階模態只需要幾十牛頓級的力，而高階模態需要的力迅速增大且會引入支撐印痕。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「75 個軸向主動支撐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The NTT primary is cast in Zerodur glass ceramic by Schott, with near-zero thermal expansion, and after figuring it rests on 75 axial supports plus a set of lateral supports. Each axial support is an astatic lever with a movable counterweight that passively carries most of the attitude-dependent load, while an electric actuator superimposes a small correction force; three fixed points define the mirror position. The spatial pattern of the correction forces determines which bending modes can be generated: low-order modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and quadrafoil need only tens of newtons, while higher modes demand rapidly growing forces and introduce support print-through. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “75 active axial supports”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平均軸向力 F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mean axial force F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐點越多，主動光學就能修正任意高階的像差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough support points active optics can correct arbitrarily high-order aberrations." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「75 個軸向主動支撐」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “75 active axial supports”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Each axial support is an astatic lever with a movable counterweight that passively carries most of the attitude-dependent load, while an electric actuator superimposes a small correction force; three fixed points define the mirror position.

steps.title: 鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「75 個軸向主動支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “75 active axial supports” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平均軸向力 F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N。產生 1 µm PV 像散（振幅 a = 0.5 µm）所需的彎矩 M = D_f(1−ν)·2a/R²，其中板剛度 D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] = 90.3×10⁹×0.24³/(12×0.942) ≈ 1.1×10⁸ N·m，R = 1.79 m，得 M ≈ 1.1×10⁸×0.76×3.1×10⁻⁷ ≈ 26 N·m/m；以外圈兩環支撐相距 0.4 m 形成力偶、外圈支撐間距約 0.25 m，每個支撐約需 ±17 N，只占平均負載的 2%（教學估計）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mean axial force F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N. Generating 1 µm PV astigmatism (amplitude a = 0.5 µm) needs a bending moment M = D_f(1−ν)·2a/R², with plate stiffness D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] = 90.3×10⁹×0.24³/(12×0.942) ≈ 1.1×10⁸ N·m and R = 1.79 m, giving M ≈ 1.1×10⁸×0.76×3.1×10⁻⁷ ≈ 26 N·m/m; with a force couple across the outer two support rings 0.4 m apart and an outer-ring spacing of about 0.25 m, each support needs about ±17 N, only 2% of the mean load (teaching estimate). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鏡室測試台上以荷重元逐一校正每個致動器的力對指令曲線，確認解析度與遲滯；再施加設計的像散力型並用干涉儀或影像分析儀量鏡面響應，比較實測的模態增益（nm/N）與有限元素預測，建立影響矩陣供控制迴路使用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the mirror-cell test stand calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve with a load cell, confirming resolution and hysteresis; then apply the designed astigmatism force pattern and measure the mirror response with an interferometer or the image analyser, comparing the measured modal gain (nm/N) with the finite-element prediction to build the influence matrix used by the control loop.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平均軸向力 F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N。產生 1 µm PV 像散（振幅 a = 0.5 µm）所需的彎矩 M = D_f(1−ν)·2a/R²，其中板剛度 D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] = 90.3×10⁹×0.24³/(12×0.942) ≈ 1.1×10⁸ N·m，R = 1.79 m，得 M ≈ 1.1×10⁸×0.76×3.1×10⁻⁷ ≈ 26 N·m/m；以外圈兩環支撐相距 0.4 m 形成力偶、外圈支撐間距約 0.25 m，每個支撐約需 ±17 N，只占平均負載的 2%（教學估計）。
knowledge.textEn: Mean axial force F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N. Generating 1 µm PV astigmatism (amplitude a = 0.5 µm) needs a bending moment M = D_f(1−ν)·2a/R², with plate stiffness D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] = 90.3×10⁹×0.24³/(12×0.942) ≈ 1.1×10⁸ N·m and R = 1.79 m, giving M ≈ 1.1×10⁸×0.76×3.1×10⁻⁷ ≈ 26 N·m/m; with a force couple across the outer two support rings 0.4 m apart and an outer-ring spacing of about 0.25 m, each support needs about ±17 N, only 2% of the mean load (teaching estimate).

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces", which statement holds?
options: 指向越準，星像就越銳利。
望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。
optionsEn: The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images.
Mean axial force F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N.
Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image.
quiz.explanation: 平均軸向力 F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean axial force F = mg/N = 6100×9.81/75 ≈ 800 N. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「75 個軸向主動支撐」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “75 active axial supports” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在鏡室測試台上以荷重元逐一校正每個致動器的力對指令曲線，確認解析度與遲滯；再施加設計的像散力型並用干涉儀或影像分析儀量鏡面響應，比較實測的模態增益（nm/N）與有限元素預測，建立影響矩陣供控制迴路使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the mirror-cell test stand calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve with a load cell, confirming resolution and hysteresis; then apply the designed astigmatism force pattern and measure the mirror response with an interferometer or the image analyser, comparing the measured modal gain (nm/N) with the finite-element prediction to build the influence matrix used by the control loop. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某個致動器卡死或荷重元漂移時，該點力誤差數十牛頓會在鏡面留下局部印痕，星像出現三葉或高階結構；若控制迴路仍以該致動器正常為前提求解，修正量會錯誤分配到鄰近支撐，越修越差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A stuck actuator or a drifting load cell leaves a local print-through from a force error of tens of newtons, and star images show trefoil or higher-order structure; if the loop keeps solving as though that actuator worked, corrections are misallocated to neighbouring supports and the figure gets worse with each cycle.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在鏡室測試台上以荷重元逐一校正每個致動器的力對指令曲線，確認解析度與遲滯；再施加設計的像散力型並用干涉儀或影像分析儀量鏡面響應，比較實測的模態增益（nm/N）與有限元素預測，建立影響矩陣供控制迴路使用。
knowledge.textEn: On the mirror-cell test stand calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve with a load cell, confirming resolution and hysteresis; then apply the designed astigmatism force pattern and measure the mirror response with an interferometer or the image analyser, comparing the measured modal gain (nm/N) with the finite-element prediction to build the influence matrix used by the control loop.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。
在鏡室測試台上以荷重元逐一校正每個致動器的力對指令曲線，確認解析度與遲滯。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images.
On the mirror-cell test stand calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve with a load cell, confirming resolution and hysteresis.
quiz.explanation: 在鏡室測試台上以荷重元逐一校正每個致動器的力對指令曲線，確認解析度與遲滯；再施加設計的像散力型並用干涉儀或影像分析儀量鏡面響應，比較實測的模態增益（nm/N）與有限元素預測，建立影響矩陣供控制迴路使用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On the mirror-cell test stand calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve with a load cell, confirming resolution and hysteresis; then apply the designed astigmatism force pattern and measure the mirror response with an interferometer or the image analyser, comparing the measured modal gain (nm/N) with the finite-element prediction to build the influence matrix used by the control loop. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「75 個軸向主動支撐」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “75 active axial supports” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某個致動器卡死或荷重元漂移時，該點力誤差數十牛頓會在鏡面留下局部印痕，星像出現三葉或高階結構；若控制迴路仍以該致動器正常為前提求解，修正量會錯誤分配到鄰近支撐，越修越差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A stuck actuator or a drifting load cell leaves a local print-through from a force error of tens of newtons, and star images show trefoil or higher-order structure; if the loop keeps solving as though that actuator worked, corrections are misallocated to neighbouring supports and the figure gets worse with each cycle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修正力的空間分佈決定能產生哪些彎曲模態：像散、三葉、四葉等低階模態只需要幾十牛頓級的力，而高階模態需要的力迅速增大且會引入支撐印痕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The spatial pattern of the correction forces determines which bending modes can be generated: low-order modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and quadrafoil need only tens of newtons, while higher modes demand rapidly growing forces and introduce support print-through.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐點越多，主動光學就能修正任意高階的像差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With enough support points active optics can correct arbitrarily high-order aberrations." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某個致動器卡死或荷重元漂移時，該點力誤差數十牛頓會在鏡面留下局部印痕，星像出現三葉或高階結構；若控制迴路仍以該致動器正常為前提求解，修正量會錯誤分配到鄰近支撐，越修越差。
knowledge.textEn: A stuck actuator or a drifting load cell leaves a local print-through from a force error of tens of newtons, and star images show trefoil or higher-order structure; if the loop keeps solving as though that actuator worked, corrections are misallocated to neighbouring supports and the figure gets worse with each cycle.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鏡坯、軸向與側向支撐與致動力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Blank, axial and lateral supports and actuator forces" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 某個致動器卡死或荷重元漂移時，該點力誤差數十牛頓會在鏡面留下局部印痕，星像出現三葉或高階結構。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。
optionsEn: A stuck actuator or a drifting load cell leaves a local print-through from a force error of tens of newtons, and star images show trefoil or higher-order structure.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 某個致動器卡死或荷重元漂移時，該點力誤差數十牛頓會在鏡面留下局部印痕，星像出現三葉或高階結構；若控制迴路仍以該致動器正常為前提求解，修正量會錯誤分配到鄰近支撐，越修越差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A stuck actuator or a drifting load cell leaves a local print-through from a force error of tens of newtons, and star images show trefoil or higher-order structure; if the loop keeps solving as though that actuator worked, corrections are misallocated to neighbouring supports and the figure gets worse with each cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 圓頂熱設計與鏡面視寧度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Enclosure thermal design and mirror seeing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「八角形旋轉圓頂與通風百葉」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Octagonal rotating enclosure and ventilation louvres” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: NTT 的圓頂是高約 18 m、直徑約 17 m 的八角形建築，整棟隨望遠鏡旋轉，牆面靠近望遠鏡以減少內部熱源與滯留空氣，側壁的通風百葉與擋風網讓夜風以可控方式流過主鏡，把鏡面與周圍空氣的溫差帶走。鏡面比空氣熱時，貼近鏡面的空氣層產生對流與折射率擾動，形成所謂鏡面視寧度，其影響可超過光學誤差；因此白天把鏡室降溫至預期夜間氣溫、夜間維持通風，是影像品質預算的一部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「八角形旋轉圓頂與通風百葉」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The NTT enclosure is an octagonal building about 18 m high and 17 m across that rotates with the telescope; its walls sit close to the telescope to limit internal heat sources and trapped air, and side louvres with a windscreen let the night wind flush the primary in a controlled way, carrying off the temperature difference between mirror and air. A mirror warmer than the air drives convection and refractive-index turbulence in the boundary layer, the so-called mirror seeing, whose effect can exceed the optical errors; cooling the mirror cell by day to the expected night temperature and ventilating at night is therefore part of the image-quality budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Octagonal rotating enclosure and ventilation louvres”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鏡面視寧度的經驗關係 θ_mirror ≈ 0.38·ΔT^1.2 角秒（ΔT 為鏡面高於空氣的溫度，K；教學用經驗值）：ΔT = 0.3 K 時 θ ≈ 0.09″，1 K 時 0.38″，2 K 時 0.87″。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An empirical mirror-seeing relation is θ_mirror ≈ 0.38·ΔT^1.2 arcseconds (ΔT the mirror excess over air in K; a teaching value): ΔT = 0.3 K gives θ ≈ 0.09″, 1 K gives 0.38″ and 2 K gives 0.87″.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「八角形旋轉圓頂與通風百葉」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Octagonal rotating enclosure and ventilation louvres”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 圓頂熱設計與鏡面視寧度
knowledge.titleEn: Enclosure thermal design and mirror seeing
knowledge.text: NTT 的圓頂是高約 18 m、直徑約 17 m 的八角形建築，整棟隨望遠鏡旋轉，牆面靠近望遠鏡以減少內部熱源與滯留空氣，側壁的通風百葉與擋風網讓夜風以可控方式流過主鏡，把鏡面與周圍空氣的溫差帶走。鏡面比空氣熱時，貼近鏡面的空氣層產生對流與折射率擾動，形成所謂鏡面視寧度，其影響可超過光學誤差；因此白天把鏡室降溫至預期夜間氣溫、夜間維持通風，是影像品質預算的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: The NTT enclosure is an octagonal building about 18 m high and 17 m across that rotates with the telescope; its walls sit close to the telescope to limit internal heat sources and trapped air, and side louvres with a windscreen let the night wind flush the primary in a controlled way, carrying off the temperature difference between mirror and air. A mirror warmer than the air drives convection and refractive-index turbulence in the boundary layer, the so-called mirror seeing, whose effect can exceed the optical errors; cooling the mirror cell by day to the expected night temperature and ventilating at night is therefore part of the image-quality budget.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「圓頂熱設計與鏡面視寧度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Enclosure thermal design and mirror seeing" is correct?
options: 只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。
NTT 的圓頂是高約 18 m、直徑約 17 m 的八角形建築，整棟隨望遠鏡旋轉，牆面靠近望遠鏡以減少內部熱源與滯留空氣，側壁的通風百葉與擋風網讓夜風以可控方式流過主鏡，把鏡面與周圍空氣的溫差帶走。
參考星越暗越好，因為亮星會讓 CCD 飽和。
optionsEn: With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter.
The NTT enclosure is an octagonal building about 18 m high and 17 m across that rotates with the telescope.
Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD.
quiz.explanation: NTT 的圓頂是高約 18 m、直徑約 17 m 的八角形建築，整棟隨望遠鏡旋轉，牆面靠近望遠鏡以減少內部熱源與滯留空氣，側壁的通風百葉與擋風網讓夜風以可控方式流過主鏡，把鏡面與周圍空氣的溫差帶走。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The NTT enclosure is an octagonal building about 18 m high and 17 m across that rotates with the telescope; its walls sit close to the telescope to limit internal heat sources and trapped air, and side louvres with a windscreen let the night wind flush the primary in a controlled way, carrying off the temperature difference between mirror and air. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 圓頂熱設計與鏡面視寧度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Enclosure thermal design and mirror seeing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「八角形旋轉圓頂與通風百葉」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Octagonal rotating enclosure and ventilation louvres” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鏡面視寧度的經驗關係 θ_mirror ≈ 0.38·ΔT^1.2 角秒（ΔT 為鏡面高於空氣的溫度，K；教學用經驗值）：ΔT = 0.3 K 時 θ ≈ 0.09″，1 K 時 0.38″，2 K 時 0.87″。24 cm Zerodur 的熱時間常數 τ ≈ t²/(π²α)，α = κ/(ρc) = 1.46/(2530×800) ≈ 7.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s，得 τ ≈ 0.0576/(9.87×7.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 8100 s ≈ 2.3 h，所以鏡面跟不上黃昏的快速降溫。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An empirical mirror-seeing relation is θ_mirror ≈ 0.38·ΔT^1.2 arcseconds (ΔT the mirror excess over air in K; a teaching value): ΔT = 0.3 K gives θ ≈ 0.09″, 1 K gives 0.38″ and 2 K gives 0.87″. The thermal time constant of 24 cm of Zerodur is τ ≈ t²/(π²α) with α = κ/(ρc) = 1.46/(2530×800) ≈ 7.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s, so τ ≈ 0.0576/(9.87×7.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 8100 s ≈ 2.3 h, and the mirror cannot follow the rapid cooling at dusk. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鏡面邊緣與背面裝多點溫度感測器並記錄圓頂內外氣溫，夜間每小時量一次星像 FWHM；把 FWHM 減去 DIMM 視寧度後對 ΔT 作圖，應呈現接近 ΔT^1.2 的趨勢，並據此設定白天鏡室空調的目標溫度與夜間百葉開度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit several temperature sensors at the mirror edge and back, log the air temperature inside and outside the enclosure and measure stellar FWHM hourly; plot FWHM minus DIMM seeing against ΔT, expect a trend close to ΔT^1.2, and use it to set the daytime mirror-cell air-conditioning target and the night-time louvre opening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 圓頂熱設計與鏡面視寧度：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「八角形旋轉圓頂與通風百葉」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Octagonal rotating enclosure and ventilation louvres” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在鏡面邊緣與背面裝多點溫度感測器並記錄圓頂內外氣溫，夜間每小時量一次星像 FWHM；把 FWHM 減去 DIMM 視寧度後對 ΔT 作圖，應呈現接近 ΔT^1.2 的趨勢，並據此設定白天鏡室空調的目標溫度與夜間百葉開度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit several temperature sensors at the mirror edge and back, log the air temperature inside and outside the enclosure and measure stellar FWHM hourly; plot FWHM minus DIMM seeing against ΔT, expect a trend close to ΔT^1.2, and use it to set the daytime mirror-cell air-conditioning target and the night-time louvre opening. steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 圓頂熱設計與鏡面視寧度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Enclosure thermal design and mirror seeing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「八角形旋轉圓頂與通風百葉」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Octagonal rotating enclosure and ventilation louvres” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 白天圓頂空調失效或設定溫度比夜間氣溫高 3 K 時，入夜後鏡面持續放熱數小時，星像 FWHM 比視寧度差 0.5″ 以上，主動光學再怎麼修正面形也救不回來，整夜的高解析度觀測作廢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the daytime enclosure air conditioning fails or is set 3 K above the night air temperature, the mirror keeps releasing heat for hours after dark, stellar FWHM exceeds the seeing by more than 0.5″, no amount of active figure correction recovers it and the night's high-resolution observations are lost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鏡面比空氣熱時，貼近鏡面的空氣層產生對流與折射率擾動，形成所謂鏡面視寧度，其影響可超過光學誤差；因此白天把鏡室降溫至預期夜間氣溫、夜間維持通風，是影像品質預算的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A mirror warmer than the air drives convection and refractive-index turbulence in the boundary layer, the so-called mirror seeing, whose effect can exceed the optical errors; cooling the mirror cell by day to the expected night temperature and ventilating at night is therefore part of the image-quality budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解」與「追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition" and "Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 影像分析儀」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann image analyser” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: NTT 的影像分析儀在科學視場之外取一顆參考星，用微透鏡陣列把出瞳分成子孔徑，每個子孔徑在 CCD 上成一個光點，光點相對參考位置的位移正比於該處的波前斜率。把所有斜率最小平方擬合成 Zernike 或鏡面的彈性模態後，離焦交給副鏡的軸向位移、彗差交給副鏡的橫向位移或傾斜，像散、三葉與球差則轉成主鏡的支撐力修正。量測在數十秒的積分中把大氣擾動平均掉，因此參考星的亮度與積分時間共同決定波前精度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 影像分析儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The NTT image analyser picks a reference star outside the science field, divides the exit pupil into sub-apertures with a lenslet array and forms one spot per sub-aperture on a CCD; each spot's displacement from its reference position is proportional to the local wavefront slope. After least-squares fitting the slopes to Zernike or mirror elastic modes, defocus is assigned to the axial motion of the secondary, coma to its lateral motion or tilt, and astigmatism, trefoil and spherical to primary-support force corrections. The integration of tens of seconds averages atmospheric turbulence, so the reference star brightness and the integration time together set the wavefront accuracy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann image analyser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：子孔徑斜率雜訊換算成波前誤差：σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N，其中 d_sub 為子孔徑在主鏡上的尺寸、θ_spot 為光點角尺寸、N 為光子數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Converting sub-aperture slope noise into wavefront error: σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N, with d_sub the sub-aperture size on the primary, θ_spot the angular spot size and N the photon count.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「參考星越暗越好，因為亮星會讓 CCD 飽和。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 影像分析儀」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann image analyser”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

After least-squares fitting the slopes to Zernike or mirror elastic modes, defocus is assigned to the axial motion of the secondary, coma to its lateral motion or tilt, and astigmatism, trefoil and spherical to primary-support force corrections.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：參考星越暗越好，因為亮星會讓 CCD 飽和。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition" is correct?
options: 參考星越暗越好，因為亮星會讓 CCD 飽和。
指向越準，星像就越銳利。
NTT 的影像分析儀在科學視場之外取一顆參考星，用微透鏡陣列把出瞳分成子孔徑，每個子孔徑在 CCD 上成一個光點，光點相對參考位置的位移正比於該處的波前斜率。
optionsEn: Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD.
The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images.
The NTT image analyser picks a reference star outside the science field, divides the exit pupil into sub-apertures with a lenslet array and forms one spot per sub-aperture on a CCD.
quiz.explanation: NTT 的影像分析儀在科學視場之外取一顆參考星，用微透鏡陣列把出瞳分成子孔徑，每個子孔徑在 CCD 上成一個光點，光點相對參考位置的位移正比於該處的波前斜率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The NTT image analyser picks a reference star outside the science field, divides the exit pupil into sub-apertures with a lenslet array and forms one spot per sub-aperture on a CCD; each spot's displacement from its reference position is proportional to the local wavefront slope. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 影像分析儀」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann image analyser” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：子孔徑斜率雜訊換算成波前誤差：σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N，其中 d_sub 為子孔徑在主鏡上的尺寸、θ_spot 為光點角尺寸、N 為光子數。取 20×20 子孔徑（d_sub = 0.18 m）、θ_spot = 1″ = 4.85×10⁻⁶ rad、V ≈ 12 的星在 200 nm 頻寬、30% 效率下 30 s 約收到 N ≈ 9000 個光子：σ_θ = 4.85×10⁻⁶/95 ≈ 5.1×10⁻⁸ rad，σ_W ≈ 0.18×5.1×10⁻⁸ ≈ 9 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Converting sub-aperture slope noise into wavefront error: σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N, with d_sub the sub-aperture size on the primary, θ_spot the angular spot size and N the photon count. For 20×20 sub-apertures (d_sub = 0.18 m), θ_spot = 1″ = 4.85×10⁻⁶ rad and a V ≈ 12 star delivering N ≈ 9000 photons in 30 s over a 200 nm band at 30% efficiency: σ_θ = 4.85×10⁻⁶/95 ≈ 5.1×10⁻⁸ rad and σ_W ≈ 0.18×5.1×10⁻⁸ ≈ 9 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以內部參考光源建立微透鏡光點的零點位置，再對一顆星連續取十組 30 s 量測，計算各 Zernike 係數的重複性，應與 σ_W 預測同量級；接著故意讓副鏡偏離焦點 50 µm，確認分析儀量到的離焦與幾何預測一致，驗證標定比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish the lenslet spot reference positions with an internal calibration source, then take ten consecutive 30 s measurements on one star and compute the repeatability of each Zernike coefficient, which should be of the same order as the predicted σ_W; next defocus the secondary deliberately by 50 µm and confirm that the measured defocus matches the geometric prediction, verifying the calibration scale.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 子孔徑斜率雜訊換算成波前誤差：σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N，其中 d_sub 為子孔徑在主鏡上的尺寸、θ_spot 為光點角尺寸、N 為光子數。取 20×20 子孔徑（d_sub = 0.18 m）、θ_spot = 1″ = 4.85×10⁻⁶ rad、V ≈ 12 的星在 200 nm 頻寬、30% 效率下 30 s 約收到 N ≈ 9000 個光子：σ_θ = 4.85×10⁻⁶/95 ≈ 5.1×10⁻⁸ rad，σ_W ≈ 0.18×5.1×10⁻⁸ ≈ 9 nm。
knowledge.textEn: Converting sub-aperture slope noise into wavefront error: σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N, with d_sub the sub-aperture size on the primary, θ_spot the angular spot size and N the photon count. For 20×20 sub-apertures (d_sub = 0.18 m), θ_spot = 1″ = 4.85×10⁻⁶ rad and a V ≈ 12 star delivering N ≈ 9000 photons in 30 s over a 200 nm band at 30% efficiency: σ_θ = 4.85×10⁻⁶/95 ≈ 5.1×10⁻⁸ rad and σ_W ≈ 0.18×5.1×10⁻⁸ ≈ 9 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition", which statement holds?
options: 子孔徑斜率雜訊換算成波前誤差：σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N，其中 d_sub 為子孔徑在主鏡上的尺寸、θ_spot 為光點角尺寸、N 為光子數。
望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。
主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。
optionsEn: Converting sub-aperture slope noise into wavefront error: σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N, with d_sub the sub-aperture size on the primary, θ_spot the angular spot size and N the photon count.
Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image.
Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds.
quiz.explanation: 子孔徑斜率雜訊換算成波前誤差：σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N，其中 d_sub 為子孔徑在主鏡上的尺寸、θ_spot 為光點角尺寸、N 為光子數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Converting sub-aperture slope noise into wavefront error: σ_W ≈ d_sub·θ_spot/√N, with d_sub the sub-aperture size on the primary, θ_spot the angular spot size and N the photon count. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 影像分析儀」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann image analyser” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以內部參考光源建立微透鏡光點的零點位置，再對一顆星連續取十組 30 s 量測，計算各 Zernike 係數的重複性，應與 σ_W 預測同量級；接著故意讓副鏡偏離焦點 50 µm，確認分析儀量到的離焦與幾何預測一致，驗證標定比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish the lenslet spot reference positions with an internal calibration source, then take ten consecutive 30 s measurements on one star and compute the repeatability of each Zernike coefficient, which should be of the same order as the predicted σ_W; next defocus the secondary deliberately by 50 µm and confirm that the measured defocus matches the geometric prediction, verifying the calibration scale. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：參考星附近有伴星或分析儀出瞳對不準微透鏡陣列時，部分子孔徑的光點質心偏移，擬合出假的三葉像差並送到主鏡支撐，星像被修出三角形；只看殘差 RMS 不看光點品質的流程不會發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A companion star near the reference or a pupil misregistered on the lenslet array shifts the centroids of some sub-apertures, the fit produces false trefoil that is sent to the primary supports and star images are corrected into triangles; a procedure that watches only the residual RMS and not spot quality never notices.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以內部參考光源建立微透鏡光點的零點位置，再對一顆星連續取十組 30 s 量測，計算各 Zernike 係數的重複性，應與 σ_W 預測同量級；接著故意讓副鏡偏離焦點 50 µm，確認分析儀量到的離焦與幾何預測一致，驗證標定比例。
knowledge.textEn: Establish the lenslet spot reference positions with an internal calibration source, then take ten consecutive 30 s measurements on one star and compute the repeatability of each Zernike coefficient, which should be of the same order as the predicted σ_W; next defocus the secondary deliberately by 50 µm and confirm that the measured defocus matches the geometric prediction, verifying the calibration scale.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以內部參考光源建立微透鏡光點的零點位置，再對一顆星連續取十組 30 s 量測，計算各 Zernike 係數的重複性，應與 σ_W 預測同量級。
支撐點越多，主動光學就能修正任意高階的像差。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Establish the lenslet spot reference positions with an internal calibration source, then take ten consecutive 30 s measurements on one star and compute the repeatability of each Zernike coefficient, which should be of the same order as the predicted σ_W.
With enough support points active optics can correct arbitrarily high-order aberrations.
quiz.explanation: 以內部參考光源建立微透鏡光點的零點位置，再對一顆星連續取十組 30 s 量測，計算各 Zernike 係數的重複性，應與 σ_W 預測同量級；接著故意讓副鏡偏離焦點 50 µm，確認分析儀量到的離焦與幾何預測一致，驗證標定比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish the lenslet spot reference positions with an internal calibration source, then take ten consecutive 30 s measurements on one star and compute the repeatability of each Zernike coefficient, which should be of the same order as the predicted σ_W; next defocus the secondary deliberately by 50 µm and confirm that the measured defocus matches the geometric prediction, verifying the calibration scale. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「離軸星 Shack–Hartmann 影像分析儀」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Off-axis-star Shack–Hartmann image analyser” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 參考星附近有伴星或分析儀出瞳對不準微透鏡陣列時，部分子孔徑的光點質心偏移，擬合出假的三葉像差並送到主鏡支撐，星像被修出三角形；只看殘差 RMS 不看光點品質的流程不會發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A companion star near the reference or a pupil misregistered on the lenslet array shifts the centroids of some sub-apertures, the fit produces false trefoil that is sent to the primary supports and star images are corrected into triangles; a procedure that watches only the residual RMS and not spot quality never notices. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測在數十秒的積分中把大氣擾動平均掉，因此參考星的亮度與積分時間共同決定波前精度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The integration of tens of seconds averages atmospheric turbulence, so the reference star brightness and the integration time together set the wavefront accuracy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「參考星越暗越好，因為亮星會讓 CCD 飽和。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 參考星附近有伴星或分析儀出瞳對不準微透鏡陣列時，部分子孔徑的光點質心偏移，擬合出假的三葉像差並送到主鏡支撐，星像被修出三角形；只看殘差 RMS 不看光點品質的流程不會發現。
knowledge.textEn: A companion star near the reference or a pupil misregistered on the lenslet array shifts the centroids of some sub-apertures, the fit produces false trefoil that is sent to the primary supports and star images are corrected into triangles; a procedure that watches only the residual RMS and not spot quality never notices.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
指向越準，星像就越銳利。
參考星附近有伴星或分析儀出瞳對不準微透鏡陣列時，部分子孔徑的光點質心偏移，擬合出假的三葉像差並送到主鏡支撐，星像被修出三角形。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images.

A companion star near the reference or a pupil misregistered on the lenslet array shifts the centroids of some sub-apertures, the fit produces false trefoil that is sent to the primary supports and star images are corrected into triangles.
quiz.explanation: 參考星附近有伴星或分析儀出瞳對不準微透鏡陣列時，部分子孔徑的光點質心偏移，擬合出假的三葉像差並送到主鏡支撐，星像被修出三角形；只看殘差 RMS 不看光點品質的流程不會發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A companion star near the reference or a pupil misregistered on the lenslet array shifts the centroids of some sub-apertures, the fit produces false trefoil that is sent to the primary supports and star images are corrected into triangles; a procedure that watches only the residual RMS and not spot quality never notices. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「影像品質預算表與指向模型」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Image-quality budget and pointing model” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: NTT 的指向誤差約 1.5″ RMS，由含數十項幾何與撓曲項的指向模型修正；追蹤抖動、風荷載與軸承摩擦則以導星回授壓低。影像品質預算把光學殘差、追蹤抖動、鏡面視寧度與圓頂視寧度各自換成等效的 FWHM 貢獻，先以均方根合成望遠鏡項，再與大氣視寧度以 5/3 次方合成；每一項都要有量測方法與允收值，才能在影像變差時快速定位責任項目。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影像品質預算表與指向模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The NTT points to about 1.5″ RMS using a pointing model with tens of geometric and flexure terms, while tracking jitter, wind load and bearing friction are suppressed by autoguider feedback. The image-quality budget converts optical residual, tracking jitter, mirror seeing and dome seeing into equivalent FWHM contributions, combines them root-sum-square into a telescope term and then combines that with atmospheric seeing in 5/3 power; every item needs a measurement method and an allowance so that a degraded image can be traced quickly to the responsible term. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Image-quality budget and pointing model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tracking jitter of σ = 0.10″ RMS is an equivalent FWHM of ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″; root-sum-squared with a 0.20″ optical residual and 0.15″ mirror seeing: √(0.235² + 0.20² + 0.15²) = √0.118 ≈ 0.34″.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「指向越準，星像就越銳利。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「影像品質預算表與指向模型」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Image-quality budget and pointing model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: NTT 的指向誤差約 1.5″ RMS，由含數十項幾何與撓曲項的指向模型修正；追蹤抖動、風荷載與軸承摩擦則以導星回授壓低。影像品質預算把光學殘差、追蹤抖動、鏡面視寧度與圓頂視寧度各自換成等效的 FWHM 貢獻，先以均方根合成望遠鏡項，再與大氣視寧度以 5/3 次方合成；每一項都要有量測方法與允收值，才能在影像變差時快速定位責任項目。
knowledge.textEn: The NTT points to about 1.5″ RMS using a pointing model with tens of geometric and flexure terms, while tracking jitter, wind load and bearing friction are suppressed by autoguider feedback. The image-quality budget converts optical residual, tracking jitter, mirror seeing and dome seeing into equivalent FWHM contributions, combines them root-sum-square into a telescope term and then combines that with atmospheric seeing in 5/3 power; every item needs a measurement method and an allowance so that a degraded image can be traced quickly to the responsible term.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：指向越準，星像就越銳利。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget" is correct?
options: NTT 的指向誤差約 1.5″ RMS，由含數十項幾何與撓曲項的指向模型修正；追蹤抖動、風荷載與軸承摩擦則以導星回授壓低。
指向越準，星像就越銳利。
閉環修正後就不需要開環查表了。
optionsEn: The NTT points to about 1.5″ RMS using a pointing model with tens of geometric and flexure terms, while tracking jitter, wind load and bearing friction are suppressed by autoguider feedback.
The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images.
Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: NTT 的指向誤差約 1.5″ RMS，由含數十項幾何與撓曲項的指向模型修正；追蹤抖動、風荷載與軸承摩擦則以導星回授壓低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The NTT points to about 1.5″ RMS using a pointing model with tens of geometric and flexure terms, while tracking jitter, wind load and bearing friction are suppressed by autoguider feedback. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「影像品質預算表與指向模型」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Image-quality budget and pointing model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：追蹤抖動 σ = 0.10″ RMS 的等效 FWHM ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″；與光學殘差 0.20″、鏡面視寧度 0.15″ 做 RSS：√(0.235² + 0.20² + 0.15²) = √0.118 ≈ 0.34″。再與 0.60″ 視寧度合成：(0.60^(5/3) + 0.34^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.427 + 0.166)^(0.6) ≈ 0.73″。指向模型殘差 1.5″ 不進入 FWHM，但決定目標能否落入導星與狹縫範圍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tracking jitter of σ = 0.10″ RMS is an equivalent FWHM of ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″; root-sum-squared with a 0.20″ optical residual and 0.15″ mirror seeing: √(0.235² + 0.20² + 0.15²) = √0.118 ≈ 0.34″. Combined with 0.60″ seeing: (0.60^(5/3) + 0.34^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.427 + 0.166)^(0.6) ≈ 0.73″. The 1.5″ pointing residual does not enter the FWHM but decides whether targets land within the guider and slit acquisition range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：全天指向校正：對均勻分佈的 50 到 100 顆星量指向偏差並擬合模型，紀錄殘差 RMS 與其對天頂距的趨勢；追蹤抖動則以導星 CCD 高頻取樣星像質心的功率譜量得，並確認風速增加時抖動的增量與預算相符。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: All-sky pointing calibration: measure the pointing offsets of 50 to 100 stars distributed over the sky, fit the model and record the residual RMS and its trend with zenith distance; measure tracking jitter from the power spectrum of star centroids sampled at high rate on the guider CCD, and confirm that the jitter increase with wind speed stays within the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Tracking jitter of σ = 0.10″ RMS is an equivalent FWHM of ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″; root-sum-squared with a 0.20″ optical residual and 0.15″ mirror seeing: √(0.235² + 0.20² + 0.15²) = √0.118 ≈ 0.34″. Combined with 0.60″ seeing: (0.60^(5/3) + 0.34^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.427 + 0.166)^(0.6) ≈ 0.73″. The 1.5″ pointing residual does not enter the FWHM but decides whether targets land within the guider and slit acquisition range.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget", which statement holds?
options: 鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。
追蹤抖動 σ = 0.10″ RMS 的等效 FWHM ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″。
支撐點越多，主動光學就能修正任意高階的像差。
optionsEn: Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images.
Tracking jitter of σ = 0.10″ RMS is an equivalent FWHM of ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″.
With enough support points active optics can correct arbitrarily high-order aberrations.
quiz.explanationEn: Tracking jitter of σ = 0.10″ RMS is an equivalent FWHM of ≈ 2.355σ = 0.235″; root-sum-squared with a 0.20″ optical residual and 0.15″ mirror seeing: √(0.235² + 0.20² + 0.15²) = √0.118 ≈ 0.34″. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「影像品質預算表與指向模型」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Image-quality budget and pointing model” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 全天指向校正：對均勻分佈的 50 到 100 顆星量指向偏差並擬合模型，紀錄殘差 RMS 與其對天頂距的趨勢；追蹤抖動則以導星 CCD 高頻取樣星像質心的功率譜量得，並確認風速增加時抖動的增量與預算相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: All-sky pointing calibration: measure the pointing offsets of 50 to 100 stars distributed over the sky, fit the model and record the residual RMS and its trend with zenith distance; measure tracking jitter from the power spectrum of star centroids sampled at high rate on the guider CCD, and confirm that the jitter increase with wind speed stays within the budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把指向殘差 1.5″ 當成影像模糊項直接加進預算，或把 PV 與 RMS 混用，會讓預算表顯示不合格而引發錯誤的硬體更換；反過來漏掉圓頂視寧度，則在低風夜晚出現無法解釋的影像劣化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Entering the 1.5″ pointing residual as a blur term, or mixing peak-to-valley with RMS, makes the budget appear to fail and triggers needless hardware replacement; omitting dome seeing instead leaves unexplained image degradation on calm nights.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 全天指向校正：對均勻分佈的 50 到 100 顆星量指向偏差並擬合模型，紀錄殘差 RMS 與其對天頂距的趨勢；追蹤抖動則以導星 CCD 高頻取樣星像質心的功率譜量得，並確認風速增加時抖動的增量與預算相符。
knowledge.textEn: All-sky pointing calibration: measure the pointing offsets of 50 to 100 stars distributed over the sky, fit the model and record the residual RMS and its trend with zenith distance; measure tracking jitter from the power spectrum of star centroids sampled at high rate on the guider CCD, and confirm that the jitter increase with wind speed stays within the budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。
全天指向校正：對均勻分佈的 50 到 100 顆星量指向偏差並擬合模型，紀錄殘差 RMS 與其對天頂距的趨勢。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter.
All-sky pointing calibration: measure the pointing offsets of 50 to 100 stars distributed over the sky, fit the model and record the residual RMS and its trend with zenith distance.
quiz.explanation: 全天指向校正：對均勻分佈的 50 到 100 顆星量指向偏差並擬合模型，紀錄殘差 RMS 與其對天頂距的趨勢；追蹤抖動則以導星 CCD 高頻取樣星像質心的功率譜量得，並確認風速增加時抖動的增量與預算相符。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: All-sky pointing calibration: measure the pointing offsets of 50 to 100 stars distributed over the sky, fit the model and record the residual RMS and its trend with zenith distance; measure tracking jitter from the power spectrum of star centroids sampled at high rate on the guider CCD, and confirm that the jitter increase with wind speed stays within the budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「影像品質預算表與指向模型」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Image-quality budget and pointing model” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把指向殘差 1.5″ 當成影像模糊項直接加進預算，或把 PV 與 RMS 混用，會讓預算表顯示不合格而引發錯誤的硬體更換；反過來漏掉圓頂視寧度，則在低風夜晚出現無法解釋的影像劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Entering the 1.5″ pointing residual as a blur term, or mixing peak-to-valley with RMS, makes the budget appear to fail and triggers needless hardware replacement; omitting dome seeing instead leaves unexplained image degradation on calm nights. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：影像品質預算把光學殘差、追蹤抖動、鏡面視寧度與圓頂視寧度各自換成等效的 FWHM 貢獻，先以均方根合成望遠鏡項，再與大氣視寧度以 5/3 次方合成；每一項都要有量測方法與允收值，才能在影像變差時快速定位責任項目。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The image-quality budget converts optical residual, tracking jitter, mirror seeing and dome seeing into equivalent FWHM contributions, combines them root-sum-square into a telescope term and then combines that with atmospheric seeing in 5/3 power; every item needs a measurement method and an allowance so that a degraded image can be traced quickly to the responsible term.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「指向越準，星像就越銳利。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把指向殘差 1.5″ 當成影像模糊項直接加進預算，或把 PV 與 RMS 混用，會讓預算表顯示不合格而引發錯誤的硬體更換；反過來漏掉圓頂視寧度，則在低風夜晚出現無法解釋的影像劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Entering the 1.5″ pointing residual as a blur term, or mixing peak-to-valley with RMS, makes the budget appear to fail and triggers needless hardware replacement; omitting dome seeing instead leaves unexplained image degradation on calm nights.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「追蹤、指向與影像品質誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tracking, pointing and the image-quality error budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把指向殘差 1.5″ 當成影像模糊項直接加進預算，或把 PV 與 RMS 混用，會讓預算表顯示不合格而引發錯誤的硬體更換。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
閉環修正後就不需要開環查表了。
optionsEn: Entering the 1.5″ pointing residual as a blur term, or mixing peak-to-valley with RMS, makes the budget appear to fail and triggers needless hardware replacement.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 把指向殘差 1.5″ 當成影像模糊項直接加進預算，或把 PV 與 RMS 混用，會讓預算表顯示不合格而引發錯誤的硬體更換；反過來漏掉圓頂視寧度，則在低風夜晚出現無法解釋的影像劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Entering the 1.5″ pointing residual as a blur term, or mixing peak-to-valley with RMS, makes the budget appear to fail and triggers needless hardware replacement; omitting dome seeing instead leaves unexplained image degradation on calm nights. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均」與「調試、驗收與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging" and "Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「主動光學控制迴路與查表」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active-optics control loop and lookup tables” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主動光學的控制分兩層：開環以天頂距與溫度為索引的查表預先設定支撐力與副鏡位置，閉環則用影像分析儀每隔數十秒量一次殘餘像差並以低增益修正。閉環量測中混有大氣造成的低階像差，其相關時間約為口徑除以風速，所以積分時間越長，大氣項平均得越乾淨；增益則在收斂速度與雜訊放大之間取捨。NTT 在 1997 年的全面升級中把控制系統改成 VLT 架構，成為後者的原型。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動光學控制迴路與查表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Active-optics control has two layers: an open-loop table indexed by zenith distance and temperature presets the support forces and secondary position, and a closed loop measures the residual aberration with the image analyser every few tens of seconds and corrects it with low gain. The closed-loop measurement is contaminated by atmospheric low-order aberrations whose correlation time is roughly the aperture divided by wind speed, so longer integrations average the atmosphere more cleanly, while the gain trades convergence speed against noise amplification. In its 1997 overhaul the NTT control system was rebuilt on the VLT architecture and became its prototype. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active-optics control loop and lookup tables”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Noll 公式給出單一像散模態的大氣變異數約 0.023·(D/r₀)^(5/3) rad²：D = 3.58 m、r₀ = 0.15 m 時 (23.9)^(5/3) ≈ 198，變異數 ≈ 4.6 rad²，σ ≈ 2.1 rad ≈ 170 nm（λ = 500 nm）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Noll's result gives an atmospheric variance of about 0.023·(D/r₀)^(5/3) rad² for one astigmatism mode: with D = 3.58 m and r₀ = 0.15 m, (23.9)^(5/3) ≈ 198, the variance ≈ 4.6 rad² and σ ≈ 2.1 rad ≈ 170 nm at λ = 500 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閉環修正後就不需要開環查表了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「主動光學控制迴路與查表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Active-optics control loop and lookup tables”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均
knowledge.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging
knowledge.text: 主動光學的控制分兩層：開環以天頂距與溫度為索引的查表預先設定支撐力與副鏡位置，閉環則用影像分析儀每隔數十秒量一次殘餘像差並以低增益修正。閉環量測中混有大氣造成的低階像差，其相關時間約為口徑除以風速，所以積分時間越長，大氣項平均得越乾淨；增益則在收斂速度與雜訊放大之間取捨。

The closed-loop measurement is contaminated by atmospheric low-order aberrations whose correlation time is roughly the aperture divided by wind speed, so longer integrations average the atmosphere more cleanly, while the gain trades convergence speed against noise amplification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：閉環修正後就不需要開環查表了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging" is correct?
options: 閉環修正後就不需要開環查表了。
主動光學的控制分兩層：開環以天頂距與溫度為索引的查表預先設定支撐力與副鏡位置，閉環則用影像分析儀每隔數十秒量一次殘餘像差並以低增益修正。
望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。
optionsEn: Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary.

Active-optics control has two layers: an open-loop table indexed by zenith distance and temperature presets the support forces and secondary position, and a closed loop measures the residual aberration with the image analyser every few tens of seconds and corrects it with low gain.
Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image.
quiz.explanation: 主動光學的控制分兩層：開環以天頂距與溫度為索引的查表預先設定支撐力與副鏡位置，閉環則用影像分析儀每隔數十秒量一次殘餘像差並以低增益修正。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Active-optics control has two layers: an open-loop table indexed by zenith distance and temperature presets the support forces and secondary position, and a closed loop measures the residual aberration with the image analyser every few tens of seconds and corrects it with low gain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主動光學控制迴路與查表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active-optics control loop and lookup tables” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Noll 公式給出單一像散模態的大氣變異數約 0.023·(D/r₀)^(5/3) rad²：D = 3.58 m、r₀ = 0.15 m 時 (23.9)^(5/3) ≈ 198，變異數 ≈ 4.6 rad²，σ ≈ 2.1 rad ≈ 170 nm（λ = 500 nm）。相關時間 τ₀ ≈ D/v = 3.58/10 ≈ 0.36 s，30 s 積分含約 83 個獨立樣本，平均後殘餘 ≈ 170/√83 ≈ 19 nm，已低於 36 nm 的 λ/14 判準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Noll's result gives an atmospheric variance of about 0.023·(D/r₀)^(5/3) rad² for one astigmatism mode: with D = 3.58 m and r₀ = 0.15 m, (23.9)^(5/3) ≈ 198, the variance ≈ 4.6 rad² and σ ≈ 2.1 rad ≈ 170 nm at λ = 500 nm. The correlation time is τ₀ ≈ D/v = 3.58/10 ≈ 0.36 s, so a 30 s integration holds about 83 independent samples and the averaged residual is ≈ 170/√83 ≈ 19 nm, below the 36 nm λ/14 criterion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：閉環運轉時記錄每次量測的像散與離焦係數時間序列，計算其功率譜：主動修正應只壓低低於迴路頻寬的成分，高於頻寬的部分應與大氣模型預測一致；再改變積分時間（10 s、30 s、60 s）確認殘餘雜訊按 1/√T 下降。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: While the loop is closed, log the time series of astigmatism and defocus coefficients from each measurement and compute their power spectra: active correction should suppress only components below the loop bandwidth, and the part above it should match the atmospheric model; then change the integration time (10 s, 30 s, 60 s) and confirm that the residual noise falls as 1/√T.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging", which statement holds?
options: 主動光學和自適應光學只是修正速度不同，原理完全一樣。
只要圓頂開口夠大，鏡面溫度就不重要。

optionsEn: Active and adaptive optics are the same thing, only at different speeds.
With a wide enough enclosure opening the mirror temperature does not matter.

steps.title: 開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「主動光學控制迴路與查表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Active-optics control loop and lookup tables” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 閉環運轉時記錄每次量測的像散與離焦係數時間序列，計算其功率譜：主動修正應只壓低低於迴路頻寬的成分，高於頻寬的部分應與大氣模型預測一致；再改變積分時間（10 s、30 s、60 s）確認殘餘雜訊按 1/√T 下降。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: While the loop is closed, log the time series of astigmatism and defocus coefficients from each measurement and compute their power spectra: active correction should suppress only components below the loop bandwidth, and the part above it should match the atmospheric model; then change the integration time (10 s, 30 s, 60 s) and confirm that the residual noise falls as 1/√T. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：開環查表若以錯誤的溫度感測器為索引，入夜降溫時預設力偏離數十牛頓，閉環需要多個週期才能追回，期間星像帶著明顯像散；若此時操作員手動提高增益，迴路可能進入振盪。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the open-loop table is indexed by a faulty temperature sensor, the preset forces drift by tens of newtons as the night cools, the closed loop needs several cycles to catch up and star images carry visible astigmatism meanwhile; an operator who raises the gain by hand can push the loop into oscillation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 閉環運轉時記錄每次量測的像散與離焦係數時間序列，計算其功率譜：主動修正應只壓低低於迴路頻寬的成分，高於頻寬的部分應與大氣模型預測一致；再改變積分時間（10 s、30 s、60 s）確認殘餘雜訊按 1/√T 下降。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging"?
options: 閉環運轉時記錄每次量測的像散與離焦係數時間序列，計算其功率譜：主動修正應只壓低低於迴路頻寬的成分，高於頻寬的部分應與大氣模型預測一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
參考星越暗越好，因為亮星會讓 CCD 飽和。
optionsEn: While the loop is closed, log the time series of astigmatism and defocus coefficients from each measurement and compute their power spectra: active correction should suppress only components below the loop bandwidth, and the part above it should match the atmospheric model.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD.
quiz.explanation: 閉環運轉時記錄每次量測的像散與離焦係數時間序列，計算其功率譜：主動修正應只壓低低於迴路頻寬的成分，高於頻寬的部分應與大氣模型預測一致；再改變積分時間（10 s、30 s、60 s）確認殘餘雜訊按 1/√T 下降。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: While the loop is closed, log the time series of astigmatism and defocus coefficients from each measurement and compute their power spectra: active correction should suppress only components below the loop bandwidth, and the part above it should match the atmospheric model; then change the integration time (10 s, 30 s, 60 s) and confirm that the residual noise falls as 1/√T. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主動光學控制迴路與查表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Active-optics control loop and lookup tables” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 開環查表若以錯誤的溫度感測器為索引，入夜降溫時預設力偏離數十牛頓，閉環需要多個週期才能追回，期間星像帶著明顯像散；若此時操作員手動提高增益，迴路可能進入振盪。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the open-loop table is indexed by a faulty temperature sensor, the preset forces drift by tens of newtons as the night cools, the closed loop needs several cycles to catch up and star images carry visible astigmatism meanwhile; an operator who raises the gain by hand can push the loop into oscillation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：NTT 在 1997 年的全面升級中把控制系統改成 VLT 架構，成為後者的原型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In its 1997 overhaul the NTT control system was rebuilt on the VLT architecture and became its prototype.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉環修正後就不需要開環查表了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the closed loop works, the open-loop lookup table is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 調試、驗收與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning log and accepted image quality” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 望遠鏡交接時，工程師要交付的不是一台「裝好的機器」，而是一套可重現的狀態：致動器校正曲線、影響矩陣、查表、指向模型、影像分析儀零點與影像品質驗收數據。驗收以全系統指標進行：在量測視寧度下的星像 FWHM 與 80% 能量集中直徑、主動光學從大誤差起始的收斂時間、指向與追蹤殘差，以及儀器更換（Nasmyth 兩側）後的重現性。NTT 之後持續承接 EFOSC2、SOXS 等儀器，每次換裝都要重做這組驗證。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At handoff the engineer delivers not an assembled machine but a reproducible state: actuator calibration curves, the influence matrix, lookup tables, the pointing model, image-analyser zero points and the image-quality acceptance data. Acceptance uses whole-system metrics: stellar FWHM and 80% encircled-energy diameter at the measured seeing, the convergence time of active optics from a large initial error, pointing and tracking residuals, and repeatability after instrument changes between the two Nasmyth sides. The NTT went on to host instruments such as EFOSC2 and SOXS, and each installation repeats this verification set. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning log and accepted image quality”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：低增益迭代的收斂：殘餘 = (1 − g)^k × 初始誤差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Convergence of a low-gain iteration: residual = (1 − g)^k × initial error.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Commissioning log and accepted image quality”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
