steps.title: 光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VISTA 的每張影像都含有數百顆 2MASS 星表中的星，可直接解出零點與消光，不必另拍標準星；但 2MASS 到 VISTA 濾鏡系統的顏色轉換、偵測器之間的量子效率差異、平場的「照明修正」與視場邊緣的徑向畸變，都是系統誤差來源。天文定位同樣以 2MASS 為參考框架，畸變以徑向多項式建模，殘差的統計要分別記錄為每顆星的隨機誤差與整片偵測器的系統誤差，形成可追溯的誤差預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every VISTA frame contains hundreds of 2MASS catalogue stars, so zero point and extinction can be solved directly without separate standard-star fields; but the colour transformation from 2MASS to the VISTA filter system, quantum-efficiency differences between detectors, the illumination correction to the flat field and radial distortion at the field edge are all systematic error sources. Astrometry uses 2MASS as the reference frame as well, distortion is modelled with a radial polynomial, and the residual statistics are logged separately as per-star random error and per-detector systematic error, forming a traceable error budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：零點誤差預算以 RSS 合成：2MASS 參考系統 0.02 等、照明修正殘餘 0.01 等、平場 0.01 等、消光時間變化 0.01 等，總和 √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 等。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The zero-point budget combines in RSS: 2MASS reference system 0.02 mag, illumination-correction residual 0.01 mag, flat field 0.01 mag and extinction variation 0.01 mag, giving √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 mag.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有了 2MASS 星，VISTA 的光度校正就不會有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With 2MASS stars in every frame, VISTA photometry has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets" is correct?

With 2MASS stars in every frame, VISTA photometry has no systematic error.
One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field.

quiz.explanationEn: Every VISTA frame contains hundreds of 2MASS catalogue stars, so zero point and extinction can be solved directly without separate standard-star fields; but the colour transformation from 2MASS to the VISTA filter system, quantum-efficiency differences between detectors, the illumination correction to the flat field and radial distortion at the field edge are all systematic error sources. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：零點誤差預算以 RSS 合成：2MASS 參考系統 0.02 等、照明修正殘餘 0.01 等、平場 0.01 等、消光時間變化 0.01 等，總和 √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 等。天文定位單星隨機誤差 σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/SNR：FWHM = 0.9″、SNR = 100 時 ≈ 0.0038″ ≈ 4 mas，遠小於 2MASS 參考框架本身約 70 mas 的單星誤差，因此整體精度受參考框架限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The zero-point budget combines in RSS: 2MASS reference system 0.02 mag, illumination-correction residual 0.01 mag, flat field 0.01 mag and extinction variation 0.01 mag, giving √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 mag. The per-star astrometric random error is σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/SNR: with FWHM = 0.9″ and SNR = 100 it is ≈ 0.0038″ ≈ 4 mas, far below the roughly 70 mas per-star error of the 2MASS frame itself, so overall precision is limited by the reference frame. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內；天文定位則比較重疊區的位置殘差，檢查是否隨視場半徑增長，若是則更新畸變模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget; for astrometry compare position residuals in the overlap regions and check whether they grow with field radius, updating the distortion model if they do.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 零點誤差預算以 RSS 合成：2MASS 參考系統 0.02 等、照明修正殘餘 0.01 等、平場 0.01 等、消光時間變化 0.01 等，總和 √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 等。天文定位單星隨機誤差 σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/SNR：FWHM = 0.9″、SNR = 100 時 ≈ 0.0038″ ≈ 4 mas，遠小於 2MASS 參考框架本身約 70 mas 的單星誤差，因此整體精度受參考框架限制。
knowledge.textEn: The zero-point budget combines in RSS: 2MASS reference system 0.02 mag, illumination-correction residual 0.01 mag, flat field 0.01 mag and extinction variation 0.01 mag, giving √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 mag. The per-star astrometric random error is σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/SNR: with FWHM = 0.9″ and SNR = 100 it is ≈ 0.0038″ ≈ 4 mas, far below the roughly 70 mas per-star error of the 2MASS frame itself, so overall precision is limited by the reference frame.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

optionsEn: A larger aperture always means a faster survey.

quiz.explanation: 零點誤差預算以 RSS 合成：2MASS 參考系統 0.02 等、照明修正殘餘 0.01 等、平場 0.01 等、消光時間變化 0.01 等，總和 √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 等。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The zero-point budget combines in RSS: 2MASS reference system 0.02 mag, illumination-correction residual 0.01 mag, flat field 0.01 mag and extinction variation 0.01 mag, giving √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 mag. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內；天文定位則比較重疊區的位置殘差，檢查是否隨視場半徑增長，若是則更新畸變模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget; for astrometry compare position residuals in the overlap regions and check whether they grow with field radius, updating the distortion model if they do. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries; stellar-population analysis built on it finds spurious density gradients.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內；天文定位則比較重疊區的位置殘差，檢查是否隨視場半徑增長，若是則更新畸變模型。
knowledge.textEn: Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget; for astrometry compare position residuals in the overlap regions and check whether they grow with field radius, updating the distortion model if they do.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
紅外偵測器只要夠冷，曝光越長影像越深。
把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
As long as the infrared detector is cold enough, longer exposures always go deeper.

Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget.
quiz.explanation: 把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內；天文定位則比較重疊區的位置殘差，檢查是否隨視場半徑增長，若是則更新畸變模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget; for astrometry compare position residuals in the overlap regions and check whether they grow with field radius, updating the distortion model if they do. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries; stellar-population analysis built on it finds spurious density gradients. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：天文定位同樣以 2MASS 為參考框架，畸變以徑向多項式建模，殘差的統計要分別記錄為每顆星的隨機誤差與整片偵測器的系統誤差，形成可追溯的誤差預算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Astrometry uses 2MASS as the reference frame as well, distortion is modelled with a radial polynomial, and the residual statistics are logged separately as per-star random error and per-detector systematic error, forming a traceable error budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有了 2MASS 星，VISTA 的光度校正就不會有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With 2MASS stars in every frame, VISTA photometry has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries; stellar-population analysis built on it finds spurious density gradients.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。
optionsEn: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field.
quiz.explanation: 忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries; stellar-population analysis built on it finds spurious density gradients. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巡天觀測策略與資料流」與「驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline" and "Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 因為偵測器之間有約 0.9 與 0.425 片的間隙，VISTA 以 6 個互相偏移的 pawprint 拼成一個約 1.5 deg² 的連續 tile，每個天區至少被覆蓋兩次；再加上小幅抖動（jitter）去除壞像素與偵測器特徵，Ks 波段用短曝光多幀疊加避免飽和。資料先在帕拉納爾做即時品質檢查，再送到英國 CASU 與 WFAU 的 VISTA 資料流系統做校正、堆疊、目錄抽取與品質分級，公開巡天如 VVV、VHS、VIKING、UltraVISTA 都以此流程產生資料釋出。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because the detectors are separated by gaps of about 0.9 and 0.425 detector widths, VISTA combines 6 offset pawprints into one contiguous tile of about 1.5 deg², covering every point at least twice; small jitter offsets remove bad pixels and detector features, and Ks uses many short exposures stacked to avoid saturation. Data pass a real-time quality check at Paranal and then flow to the VISTA data-flow system at CASU and WFAU in the UK for calibration, stacking, catalogue extraction and quality grading; public surveys such as VVV, VHS, VIKING and UltraVISTA produce their data releases through this pipeline. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流
knowledge.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline
knowledge.text: 因為偵測器之間有約 0.9 與 0.425 片的間隙，VISTA 以 6 個互相偏移的 pawprint 拼成一個約 1.5 deg² 的連續 tile，每個天區至少被覆蓋兩次；再加上小幅抖動（jitter）去除壞像素與偵測器特徵，Ks 波段用短曝光多幀疊加避免飽和。資料先在帕拉納爾做即時品質檢查，再送到英國 CASU 與 WFAU 的 VISTA 資料流系統做校正、堆疊、目錄抽取與品質分級，公開巡天如 VVV、VHS、VIKING、UltraVISTA 都以此流程產生資料釋出。
knowledge.textEn: Because the detectors are separated by gaps of about 0.9 and 0.425 detector widths, VISTA combines 6 offset pawprints into one contiguous tile of about 1.5 deg², covering every point at least twice; small jitter offsets remove bad pixels and detector features, and Ks uses many short exposures stacked to avoid saturation. Data pass a real-time quality check at Paranal and then flow to the VISTA data-flow system at CASU and WFAU in the UK for calibration, stacking, catalogue extraction and quality grading; public surveys such as VVV, VHS, VIKING and UltraVISTA produce their data releases through this pipeline.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巡天觀測策略與資料流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline" is correct?
options: 一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。
因為偵測器之間有約 0.9 與 0.425 片的間隙，VISTA 以 6 個互相偏移的 pawprint 拼成一個約 1.5 deg² 的連續 tile，每個天區至少被覆蓋兩次。
望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。
optionsEn: One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field.
Because the detectors are separated by gaps of about 0.9 and 0.425 detector widths, VISTA combines 6 offset pawprints into one contiguous tile of about 1.5 deg², covering every point at least twice.
Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification.
quiz.explanation: 因為偵測器之間有約 0.9 與 0.425 片的間隙，VISTA 以 6 個互相偏移的 pawprint 拼成一個約 1.5 deg² 的連續 tile，每個天區至少被覆蓋兩次；再加上小幅抖動（jitter）去除壞像素與偵測器特徵，Ks 波段用短曝光多幀疊加避免飽和。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because the detectors are separated by gaps of about 0.9 and 0.425 detector widths, VISTA combines 6 offset pawprints into one contiguous tile of about 1.5 deg², covering every point at least twice; small jitter offsets remove bad pixels and detector features, and Ks uses many short exposures stacked to avoid saturation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。資料量：每幀 16×2048²×2 位元組 ≈ 134 MB；以 12 s 的節奏（10 s 曝光加讀出）在 10 小時夜晚取得約 3000 幀，原始資料約 400 GB，因此需要專用的網路與歸檔。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average. Data volume: each frame is 16×2048²×2 bytes ≈ 134 MB; at a 12 s cadence (10 s exposure plus readout) a 10 hour night yields about 3000 frames and roughly 400 GB of raw data, which demands dedicated networking and archiving. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿；統計每夜的原始資料量與傳輸延遲，確認歸檔在隔日完成；並抽樣比對 pipeline 輸出目錄與獨立測光結果，檢查堆疊與目錄抽取沒有引入偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps; record the nightly raw data volume and transfer latency to confirm archiving completes by the next day; and spot-check the pipeline catalogue against independent photometry to make sure stacking and extraction introduce no bias.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。資料量：每幀 16×2048²×2 位元組 ≈ 134 MB；以 12 s 的節奏（10 s 曝光加讀出）在 10 小時夜晚取得約 3000 幀，原始資料約 400 GB，因此需要專用的網路與歸檔。
knowledge.textEn: A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average. Data volume: each frame is 16×2048²×2 bytes ≈ 134 MB; at a 12 s cadence (10 s exposure plus readout) a 10 hour night yields about 3000 frames and roughly 400 GB of raw data, which demands dedicated networking and archiving.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「巡天觀測策略與資料流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline", which statement holds?
options: 焦比快只是讓曝光更短，對機械與熱設計沒有影響。
紅外偵測器只要夠冷，曝光越長影像越深。
一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。
optionsEn: A fast focal ratio only shortens exposures and has no mechanical or thermal consequences.
As long as the infrared detector is cold enough, longer exposures always go deeper.
A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average.
quiz.explanation: 一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿；統計每夜的原始資料量與傳輸延遲，確認歸檔在隔日完成；並抽樣比對 pipeline 輸出目錄與獨立測光結果，檢查堆疊與目錄抽取沒有引入偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps; record the nightly raw data volume and transfer latency to confirm archiving completes by the next day; and spot-check the pipeline catalogue against independent photometry to make sure stacking and extraction introduce no bias. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若 6 個 pawprint 的偏移量輸入錯誤 10%，tile 中出現未覆蓋的條狀間隙，而且某些區域只有單次覆蓋無法去除壞像素；問題往往在資料釋出前的覆蓋檢查才被發現，該天區必須整個重拍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the 6 pawprint offsets are entered 10% wrong, uncovered strips appear in the tile and some areas receive only single coverage so bad pixels cannot be rejected; the problem is often found only at the coverage check before data release, and the whole field must be re-observed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿；統計每夜的原始資料量與傳輸延遲，確認歸檔在隔日完成；並抽樣比對 pipeline 輸出目錄與獨立測光結果，檢查堆疊與目錄抽取沒有引入偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps; record the nightly raw data volume and transfer latency to confirm archiving completes by the next day; and spot-check the pipeline catalogue against independent photometry to make sure stacking and extraction introduce no bias.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「巡天觀測策略與資料流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline"?
options: 對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
副鏡對準只需要在白天用雷射做一次。
optionsEn: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Secondary alignment only needs to be done once by day with a laser.
quiz.explanation: 對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿；統計每夜的原始資料量與傳輸延遲，確認歸檔在隔日完成；並抽樣比對 pipeline 輸出目錄與獨立測光結果，檢查堆疊與目錄抽取沒有引入偏差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps; record the nightly raw data volume and transfer latency to confirm archiving completes by the next day; and spot-check the pipeline catalogue against independent photometry to make sure stacking and extraction introduce no bias. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若 6 個 pawprint 的偏移量輸入錯誤 10%，tile 中出現未覆蓋的條狀間隙，而且某些區域只有單次覆蓋無法去除壞像素；問題往往在資料釋出前的覆蓋檢查才被發現，該天區必須整個重拍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the 6 pawprint offsets are entered 10% wrong, uncovered strips appear in the tile and some areas receive only single coverage so bad pixels cannot be rejected; the problem is often found only at the coverage check before data release, and the whole field must be re-observed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：資料先在帕拉納爾做即時品質檢查，再送到英國 CASU 與 WFAU 的 VISTA 資料流系統做校正、堆疊、目錄抽取與品質分級，公開巡天如 VVV、VHS、VIKING、UltraVISTA 都以此流程產生資料釋出。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Data pass a real-time quality check at Paranal and then flow to the VISTA data-flow system at CASU and WFAU in the UK for calibration, stacking, catalogue extraction and quality grading; public surveys such as VVV, VHS, VIKING and UltraVISTA produce their data releases through this pipeline.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VISTA 由英國大學聯盟以實物貢獻方式建造，2009 年 12 月通過 ESO 臨時驗收並取得首光；驗收不只看單張影像，而是把量得的星像 FWHM 扣除當時的大氣視寧度後反推望遠鏡加相機的貢獻，並與設計的 50% 能量集中直徑等指標比對。VIRCAM 於 2023 年退役，卡塞格林焦點改裝 4MOST 多目標光纖光譜儀，這次換裝再度要求重做焦面幾何、波前感測與指向的全套驗證並更新交接文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: VISTA was built by a UK university consortium as an in-kind contribution and passed ESO's provisional acceptance in December 2009, when it saw first light; acceptance did not rely on single images but on subtracting the atmospheric seeing of the moment from the measured stellar FWHM to back out the telescope-plus-camera contribution and comparing it with design metrics such as the 50% encircled-energy diameter. VIRCAM was decommissioned in 2023 and the Cassegrain focus was refitted with the 4MOST multi-object fibre spectrograph, a changeover that again demanded the full verification set for focal-plane geometry, wavefront sensing and pointing, with updated handover documents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Seeing scales with wavelength as λ^(−1/5): a 0.75″ DIMM seeing at 500 nm becomes 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″ in Ks (2.15 µm).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：視寧度隨波長按 λ^(−1/5) 變化：500 nm 的 DIMM 視寧度 0.75″ 換算到 Ks（2.15 µm）為 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″。若 Ks 影像量到 FWHM 0.90″，以 5/3 次方相減得望遠鏡加相機項 = (0.90^(5/3) − 0.56^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.839 − 0.380)^(0.6) ≈ 0.63″，高於例如 0.45″ 的分配值，表示須檢查對焦、準直或追蹤而非歸咎天氣。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Seeing scales with wavelength as λ^(−1/5): a 0.75″ DIMM seeing at 500 nm becomes 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″ in Ks (2.15 µm). If the Ks images show FWHM 0.90″, subtracting in 5/3 power gives a telescope-plus-camera term of (0.90^(5/3) − 0.56^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.839 − 0.380)^(0.6) ≈ 0.63″, above an allocation of, say, 0.45″, which means focus, collimation or tracking must be checked rather than blaming the weather. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收夜以同步的 DIMM 紀錄與各偵測器的星像 FWHM 建立表格，逐偵測器反推望遠鏡項並檢查是否在視場內均勻；將指向模型殘差、波前感測器零點、六足平台校正與氣動支撐力表一併歸檔，換裝 4MOST 後重做同一套量測並與舊紀錄比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On acceptance nights tabulate synchronous DIMM records against stellar FWHM on every detector, back out the telescope term detector by detector and check uniformity across the field; archive the pointing-model residuals, wavefront-sensor zero points, hexapod calibration and pneumatic force table together, and after the 4MOST changeover repeat the same measurements and compare with the old record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Seeing scales with wavelength as λ^(−1/5): a 0.75″ DIMM seeing at 500 nm becomes 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″ in Ks (2.15 µm). If the Ks images show FWHM 0.90″, subtracting in 5/3 power gives a telescope-plus-camera term of (0.90^(5/3) − 0.56^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.839 − 0.380)^(0.6) ≈ 0.63″, above an allocation of, say, 0.45″, which means focus, collimation or tracking must be checked rather than blaming the weather.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收夜以同步的 DIMM 紀錄與各偵測器的星像 FWHM 建立表格，逐偵測器反推望遠鏡項並檢查是否在視場內均勻；將指向模型殘差、波前感測器零點、六足平台校正與氣動支撐力表一併歸檔，換裝 4MOST 後重做同一套量測並與舊紀錄比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On acceptance nights tabulate synchronous DIMM records against stellar FWHM on every detector, back out the telescope term detector by detector and check uniformity across the field; archive the pointing-model residuals, wavefront-sensor zero points, hexapod calibration and pneumatic force table together, and after the 4MOST changeover repeat the same measurements and compare with the old record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：換裝新儀器時若沿用舊相機的波前感測器零點，閉環把副鏡對準到錯誤的位置，整個視場帶著固定的彗差，而操作團隊誤以為是新儀器的光學問題，調試時間拖長數週。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reusing the old camera's wavefront-sensor zero points after installing a new instrument makes the closed loop align the secondary to the wrong position, the whole field carries a fixed coma, and the operations team blames the new instrument's optics while commissioning drags on for weeks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收夜以同步的 DIMM 紀錄與各偵測器的星像 FWHM 建立表格，逐偵測器反推望遠鏡項並檢查是否在視場內均勻；將指向模型殘差、波前感測器零點、六足平台校正與氣動支撐力表一併歸檔，換裝 4MOST 後重做同一套量測並與舊紀錄比對。
knowledge.textEn: On acceptance nights tabulate synchronous DIMM records against stellar FWHM on every detector, back out the telescope term detector by detector and check uniformity across the field; archive the pointing-model residuals, wavefront-sensor zero points, hexapod calibration and pneumatic force table together, and after the 4MOST changeover repeat the same measurements and compare with the old record.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: VIRCAM was decommissioned in 2023 and the Cassegrain focus was refitted with the 4MOST multi-object fibre spectrograph, a changeover that again demanded the full verification set for focal-plane geometry, wavefront sensing and pointing, with updated handover documents.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

title: LIGO 重力波觀測站
summary: 以漢福德與利文斯頓兩座 4 km 的 Advanced LIGO 干涉儀為對象，從應變 h = ΔL/L 與 1064 nm 雷射的相位讀出出發，推導臂腔精細度、循環功率、鍍膜熱雜訊、四重擺隔振、散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光的效果，再以光子校正器、雜訊預算、鎖定流程與觀測運行交接把 10⁻²³/√Hz 等級的靈敏度做成可驗證的工程。
summaryEn: Using the two 4 km Advanced LIGO interferometers at Hanford and Livingston, this course starts from strain h = ΔL/L and phase readout with a 1064 nm laser, derives arm-cavity finesse, recycled power, coating thermal noise, quadruple-pendulum isolation, the shot-noise amplitude spectral density and the gain from squeezed light, then turns a sensitivity of order 10⁻²³/√Hz into verifiable engineering through photon calibrators, noise budgets, lock acquisition and observing-run handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 100 Hz 雜訊預算練習（教學假設）：量子雜訊以第 5 單元的 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz 為起點，3 dB 壓縮後為 2.6×10⁻²⁴；鍍膜布朗雜訊 3.2×10⁻²⁴；懸吊熱雜訊 0.5×10⁻²⁴；技術雜訊（雷射、控制、散射光）合計 1.0×10⁻²⁴。總雜訊 = √(2.6² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²)×10⁻²⁴ = √18.25×10⁻²⁴ ≈ 4.3×10⁻²⁴/√Hz；若無壓縮則 √(3.7² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²) = √25.2 ≈ 5.0×10⁻²⁴。對一個峰值應變 10⁻²¹、有效頻寬約 100 Hz 的雙黑洞合併訊號，粗估訊噪比 SNR ≈ h/(ASD×√Δf) = 10⁻²¹/(4.3×10⁻²⁴×10) ≈ 23，無壓縮時約 20。這說明壓縮光在此頻段帶來約 15% 的訊噪比提升，但鍍膜熱雜訊才是下一個要攻克的主導項。數值為教學假設，不代表任何觀測運行的實際曲線。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-budget exercise at 100 Hz (teaching assumptions): start from the quantum noise of unit 5, 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz, reduced to 2.6×10⁻²⁴ by 3 dB of squeezing; coating Brownian noise 3.2×10⁻²⁴; suspension thermal noise 0.5×10⁻²⁴; technical noise (laser, control, scattered light) 1.0×10⁻²⁴ in total. Total noise = √(2.6² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²)×10⁻²⁴ = √18.25×10⁻²⁴ ≈ 4.3×10⁻²⁴/√Hz; without squeezing √(3.7² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²) = √25.2 ≈ 5.0×10⁻²⁴. For a binary-black-hole merger with peak strain 10⁻²¹ and an effective bandwidth of about 100 Hz, a rough signal-to-noise ratio is SNR ≈ h/(ASD×√Δf) = 10⁻²¹/(4.3×10⁻²⁴×10) ≈ 23, or about 20 without squeezing. Squeezing therefore buys about 15% in this band, while coating thermal noise is the dominant term to attack next. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual curve of any observing run.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」與「臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout" and "Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。干涉儀以 1064 nm 的 Nd:YAG 雷射從分光鏡送入兩臂，回程光在輸出埠以接近暗紋的狀態干涉，微小的臂長差轉成輸出光功率的變化；DC 讀出法刻意保留約 10 pm 的偏移量，讓訊號與載波在光電二極體上線性混合。整個系統的邊界是：真空中的四面測試質量定義了臂長，其餘一切都是為了讓這四面鏡子只受重力波推動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals; LIGO's 4 km is a compromise between site, vacuum cost and signal. A 1064 nm Nd:YAG laser is split at the beam splitter into the two arms, the returning beams interfere near a dark fringe at the output port and a tiny arm-length difference becomes a change in output power; DC readout deliberately keeps an offset of about 10 pm so that signal and carrier mix linearly on the photodiode. The system boundary is that four test masses in vacuum define the arm lengths, and everything else exists to make those four mirrors move only under gravitational waves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：h = ΔL/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: h = ΔL/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出
knowledge.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout
knowledge.text: 重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。干涉儀以 1064 nm 的 Nd:YAG 雷射從分光鏡送入兩臂，回程光在輸出埠以接近暗紋的狀態干涉，微小的臂長差轉成輸出光功率的變化；DC 讀出法刻意保留約 10 pm 的偏移量，讓訊號與載波在光電二極體上線性混合。
knowledge.textEn: A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals; LIGO's 4 km is a compromise between site, vacuum cost and signal. A 1064 nm Nd:YAG laser is split at the beam splitter into the two arms, the returning beams interfere near a dark fringe at the output port and a tiny arm-length difference becomes a change in output power; DC readout deliberately keeps an offset of about 10 pm so that signal and carrier mix linearly on the photodiode.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout" is correct?
options: 重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。
重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。
精細度越高越好，可以無限提高靈敏度。
optionsEn: A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything.
A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals.
Higher finesse is always better and raises sensitivity without limit.
quiz.explanation: 重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals; LIGO's 4 km is a compromise between site, vacuum cost and signal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：h = ΔL/L。對 h = 10⁻²¹ 與 L = 4000 m，差動臂長變化 ΔL = 4×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的四千分之一。單純麥克森的輸出相位差 Δφ = 4π·ΔL/λ = 4π×4×10⁻¹⁸/1.064×10⁻⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹¹ rad；加上臂腔約 2F/π ≈ 286 次等效往返後約 1.3×10⁻⁸ rad，仍需以 kW 級功率的光子統計才能讀出。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: h = ΔL/L. For h = 10⁻²¹ and L = 4000 m the differential arm change is ΔL = 4×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one four-thousandth of a proton diameter. A simple Michelson gives an output phase difference Δφ = 4π·ΔL/λ = 4π×4×10⁻¹⁸/1.064×10⁻⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹¹ rad; with the arm cavities' roughly 2F/π ≈ 286 effective round trips it is about 1.3×10⁻⁸ rad, still readable only with the photon statistics of kilowatt-class power. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知振幅的測試質量驅動（例如光子校正器施加的 10⁻¹⁹ 等級應變）注入訊號，確認輸出埠光功率的變化與 h·L 及讀出鏈的轉換函數一致；比較漢福德與利文斯頓兩站對同一注入模板的響應，兩者的振幅校正應在 10% 內一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject a known test-mass drive, such as a strain of order 10⁻¹⁹ applied with the photon calibrator, and confirm that the output-port power change matches h·L and the readout-chain transfer function; compare the responses of Hanford and Livingston to the same injection template, whose amplitude calibrations should agree within 10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: h = ΔL/L。對 h = 10⁻²¹ 與 L = 4000 m，差動臂長變化 ΔL = 4×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的四千分之一。單純麥克森的輸出相位差 Δφ = 4π·ΔL/λ = 4π×4×10⁻¹⁸/1.064×10⁻⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹¹ rad；加上臂腔約 2F/π ≈ 286 次等效往返後約 1.3×10⁻⁸ rad，仍需以 kW 級功率的光子統計才能讀出。
knowledge.textEn: h = ΔL/L. For h = 10⁻²¹ and L = 4000 m the differential arm change is ΔL = 4×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one four-thousandth of a proton diameter. A simple Michelson gives an output phase difference Δφ = 4π·ΔL/λ = 4π×4×10⁻¹⁸/1.064×10⁻⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹¹ rad; with the arm cavities' roughly 2F/π ≈ 286 effective round trips it is about 1.3×10⁻⁸ rad, still readable only with the photon statistics of kilowatt-class power.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout", which statement holds?
options: 只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。
靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。
h = ΔL/L。
optionsEn: Building the interferometer somewhere quiet removes the need for complex isolation.
The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed.
h = ΔL/L.
quiz.explanation: h = ΔL/L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: h = ΔL/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知振幅的測試質量驅動（例如光子校正器施加的 10⁻¹⁹ 等級應變）注入訊號，確認輸出埠光功率的變化與 h·L 及讀出鏈的轉換函數一致；比較漢福德與利文斯頓兩站對同一注入模板的響應，兩者的振幅校正應在 10% 內一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject a known test-mass drive, such as a strain of order 10⁻¹⁹ applied with the photon calibrator, and confirm that the output-port power change matches h·L and the readout-chain transfer function; compare the responses of Hanford and Livingston to the same injection template, whose amplitude calibrations should agree within 10%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若輸出埠不在設計的暗紋偏移量上（例如偏移漂到 30 pm），載波功率過大使散粒雜訊與雷射強度雜訊同時上升，應變靈敏度在 100 Hz 附近劣化數十個百分比，而且訊號對臂長的線性關係也變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the output port drifts off the designed dark-fringe offset (for example to 30 pm), the excess carrier power raises both shot noise and laser-intensity coupling, strain sensitivity near 100 Hz degrades by tens of percent and the signal's linearity with arm length also suffers.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

knowledge.textEn: Inject a known test-mass drive, such as a strain of order 10⁻¹⁹ applied with the photon calibrator, and confirm that the output-port power change matches h·L and the readout-chain transfer function; compare the responses of Hanford and Livingston to the same injection template, whose amplitude calibrations should agree within 10%.

steps.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若輸出埠不在設計的暗紋偏移量上（例如偏移漂到 30 pm），載波功率過大使散粒雜訊與雷射強度雜訊同時上升，應變靈敏度在 100 Hz 附近劣化數十個百分比，而且訊號對臂長的線性關係也變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the output port drifts off the designed dark-fringe offset (for example to 30 pm), the excess carrier power raises both shot noise and laser-intensity coupling, strain sensitivity near 100 Hz degrades by tens of percent and the signal's linearity with arm length also suffers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整個系統的邊界是：真空中的四面測試質量定義了臂長，其餘一切都是為了讓這四面鏡子只受重力波推動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system boundary is that four test masses in vacuum define the arm lengths, and everything else exists to make those four mirrors move only under gravitational waves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每條臂由輸入測試質量（ITM，透射率約 1.4%）與末端測試質量（ETM，透射率數 ppm）組成 Fabry–Pérot 腔，光在腔內共振來回，使臂長變化造成的相位被放大約 2F/π 倍，但高於腔極點頻率的訊號會被平均掉。功率循環鏡把從暗紋輸出埠「反射」回雷射方向的光再送回干涉儀，使分光鏡處的功率提高數十倍；訊號循環鏡則調整輸出埠的頻率響應。這三層共振把 50 到 125 W 的入射功率轉成臂內數百 kW 的循環功率，代價是熱透鏡、輻射壓與鎖定的困難。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each arm is a Fabry–Pérot cavity formed by the input test mass (ITM, transmission about 1.4%) and the end test mass (ETM, transmission of a few ppm); light resonates back and forth so the phase from an arm-length change is amplified by about 2F/π, while signals above the cavity-pole frequency are averaged away. The power-recycling mirror returns light that the dark output port reflects toward the laser back into the interferometer, raising the beam-splitter power tens of times, and the signal-recycling mirror shapes the frequency response at the output port. These three layers of resonance convert 50 to 125 W of input into hundreds of kilowatts circulating in the arms, at the price of thermal lensing, radiation pressure and difficult lock acquisition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：精細度 F ≈ 2π/(T_ITM + 損耗) ≈ 2π/0.014 ≈ 450，等效往返 2F/π ≈ 286 次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Finesse F ≈ 2π/(T_ITM + losses) ≈ 2π/0.014 ≈ 450, giving 2F/π ≈ 286 effective round trips.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「精細度越高越好，可以無限提高靈敏度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher finesse is always better and raises sensitivity without limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：精細度 F ≈ 2π/(T_ITM + 損耗) ≈ 2π/0.014 ≈ 450，等效往返 2F/π ≈ 286 次。腔極點 f_p = c/(4·L·F) = 3×10⁸/(4×4000×450) ≈ 42 Hz。功率：50 W 入射 × 功率循環增益 40 = 2 kW 在分光鏡，每臂 1 kW，臂腔增益 ≈ 4/T_ITM ≈ 286，臂內功率 ≈ 286 kW；125 W 入射時約 715 kW，接近 750 kW 的設計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Finesse F ≈ 2π/(T_ITM + losses) ≈ 2π/0.014 ≈ 450, giving 2F/π ≈ 286 effective round trips. The cavity pole is f_p = c/(4·L·F) = 3×10⁸/(4×4000×450) ≈ 42 Hz. Power: 50 W input × power-recycling gain 40 = 2 kW at the beam splitter, 1 kW per arm, arm-cavity gain ≈ 4/T_ITM ≈ 286, so about 286 kW in each arm; with 125 W input it is about 715 kW, near the 750 kW design value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量臂腔的衰盪時間（ring-down）：關閉輸入光後透射功率以 τ_s = L·F/(π·c) 衰減，從 τ_s 反推 F 並與 T_ITM 的鍍膜規格比較；以 ETM 透射光與 ITM 透射光的功率監視器估算臂內功率，再用頻率響應量測（掃頻注入）確認腔極點落在 42 Hz 附近。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the arm-cavity ring-down: after the input light is blocked the transmitted power decays with τ_s = L·F/(π·c), from which F is inferred and compared with the ITM coating specification; estimate arm power from the ETM and ITM transmission power monitors, and confirm with a swept-sine frequency-response measurement that the cavity pole lies near 42 Hz.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊」與「四重擺、熔融石英纖維與地震隔離」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise" and "Quadruple pendulum, fused-silica fibres and seismic isolation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Advanced LIGO 的四面測試質量各重 40 kg、直徑 34 cm、厚 20 cm，由低吸收的熔融石英製成，正面鍍上數十層 SiO₂ 與摻鈦 Ta₂O₅ 的四分之一波長堆疊，反射率只讓每五百萬個光子穿透一個，吸收低於 1 ppm。鍍膜材料的機械損耗 φ 在室溫下透過漲落耗散定理產生布朗熱雜訊，使鏡面在雷射光斑範圍內隨機起伏，這是 50 到 500 Hz 最重要的雜訊之一；加大光斑半徑 w 與降低 φ 是僅有的兩條路。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Advanced LIGO's four test masses each weigh 40 kg, measure 34 cm across and 20 cm thick, and are made of low-absorption fused silica; their front faces carry tens of quarter-wave layers of SiO₂ and titania-doped Ta₂O₅ that let only one photon in five million through and absorb below 1 ppm. The mechanical loss φ of the coating materials produces Brownian thermal noise at room temperature through the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, making the surface fluctuate randomly within the laser spot; it is among the most important noises between 50 and 500 Hz, and enlarging the spot radius w or lowering φ are the only two remedies. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鍍膜布朗雜訊的近似式 S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An approximate coating Brownian noise is S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡面只要拋得夠光滑，熱雜訊就不存在。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A mirror polished smoothly enough has no thermal noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鍍膜布朗雜訊的近似式 S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y)。取 T = 295 K（k_BT = 4.07×10⁻²¹ J）、鍍膜厚度 d = 6 µm、光斑半徑 w = 6.2 cm、φ_c = 2.3×10⁻⁴、Y = 72 GPa、f = 100 Hz：S_x ≈ 8.25×10⁻²⁴×1.56×10⁻³×3.19×10⁻¹⁵ ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁴¹ m²/Hz，單鏡 √S_x ≈ 6.4×10⁻²¹ m/√Hz；四面鏡子不相關相加 ×2，除以 L = 4000 m 得 h_coat ≈ 3.2×10⁻²⁴/√Hz，隨 f^(−1/2) 下降。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An approximate coating Brownian noise is S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y). With T = 295 K (k_BT = 4.07×10⁻²¹ J), coating thickness d = 6 µm, spot radius w = 6.2 cm, φ_c = 2.3×10⁻⁴, Y = 72 GPa and f = 100 Hz: S_x ≈ 8.25×10⁻²⁴×1.56×10⁻³×3.19×10⁻¹⁵ ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁴¹ m²/Hz, so one mirror gives √S_x ≈ 6.4×10⁻²¹ m/√Hz; four uncorrelated mirrors multiply by 2, and dividing by L = 4000 m gives h_coat ≈ 3.2×10⁻²⁴/√Hz, falling as f^(−1/2). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鍍膜樣品上以衰盪法量機械損耗 φ_c（懸掛薄片或節點支撐的圓盤，記錄各模態的 Q 值），以光熱共路干涉量吸收，並以散射儀量總積分散射；把量得的 φ_c 代入熱雜訊公式，與干涉儀實測雜訊曲線在 100–300 Hz 的平台比較，差異應在 20% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the coating mechanical loss φ_c on witness samples by ring-down (suspended thin disks or nodally supported disks, recording the Q of each mode), measure absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry and total integrated scatter with a scatterometer; insert the measured φ_c into the thermal-noise formula and compare with the interferometer's measured noise plateau at 100–300 Hz, expecting agreement within 20%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise", which statement holds?
options: 靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。
鍍膜布朗雜訊的近似式 S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y)。
只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。
optionsEn: The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed.
An approximate coating Brownian noise is S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y).
One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own.
quiz.explanation: 鍍膜布朗雜訊的近似式 S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An approximate coating Brownian noise is S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在鍍膜樣品上以衰盪法量機械損耗 φ_c（懸掛薄片或節點支撐的圓盤，記錄各模態的 Q 值），以光熱共路干涉量吸收，並以散射儀量總積分散射；把量得的 φ_c 代入熱雜訊公式，與干涉儀實測雜訊曲線在 100–300 Hz 的平台比較，差異應在 20% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the coating mechanical loss φ_c on witness samples by ring-down (suspended thin disks or nodally supported disks, recording the Q of each mode), measure absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry and total integrated scatter with a scatterometer; insert the measured φ_c into the thermal-noise formula and compare with the interferometer's measured noise plateau at 100–300 Hz, expecting agreement within 20%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鍍膜吸收從 0.5 ppm 升到 2 ppm 時，臂內數百 kW 的功率在鏡面中心產生更強的熱透鏡與面形變化，功率循環腔的模式匹配劣化，循環增益下降，而且熱補償系統可能超出調整範圍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If coating absorption rises from 0.5 ppm to 2 ppm, the hundreds of kilowatts in the arm produce a stronger thermal lens and surface deformation at the mirror centre, the recycling cavity's mode matching degrades, the recycling gain falls and the thermal compensation system can run out of range.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在鍍膜樣品上以衰盪法量機械損耗 φ_c（懸掛薄片或節點支撐的圓盤，記錄各模態的 Q 值），以光熱共路干涉量吸收，並以散射儀量總積分散射；把量得的 φ_c 代入熱雜訊公式，與干涉儀實測雜訊曲線在 100–300 Hz 的平台比較，差異應在 20% 內。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the coating mechanical loss φ_c on witness samples by ring-down (suspended thin disks or nodally supported disks, recording the Q of each mode), measure absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry and total integrated scatter with a scatterometer; insert the measured φ_c into the thermal-noise formula and compare with the interferometer's measured noise plateau at 100–300 Hz, expecting agreement within 20%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。
在鍍膜樣品上以衰盪法量機械損耗 φ_c（懸掛薄片或節點支撐的圓盤，記錄各模態的 Q 值），以光熱共路干涉量吸收，並以散射儀量總積分散射。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything.

Measure the coating mechanical loss φ_c on witness samples by ring-down (suspended thin disks or nodally supported disks, recording the Q of each mode), measure absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry and total integrated scatter with a scatterometer.
quiz.explanation: 在鍍膜樣品上以衰盪法量機械損耗 φ_c（懸掛薄片或節點支撐的圓盤，記錄各模態的 Q 值），以光熱共路干涉量吸收，並以散射儀量總積分散射；把量得的 φ_c 代入熱雜訊公式，與干涉儀實測雜訊曲線在 100–300 Hz 的平台比較，差異應在 20% 內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the coating mechanical loss φ_c on witness samples by ring-down (suspended thin disks or nodally supported disks, recording the Q of each mode), measure absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry and total integrated scatter with a scatterometer; insert the measured φ_c into the thermal-noise formula and compare with the interferometer's measured noise plateau at 100–300 Hz, expecting agreement within 20%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜吸收從 0.5 ppm 升到 2 ppm 時，臂內數百 kW 的功率在鏡面中心產生更強的熱透鏡與面形變化，功率循環腔的模式匹配劣化，循環增益下降，而且熱補償系統可能超出調整範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If coating absorption rises from 0.5 ppm to 2 ppm, the hundreds of kilowatts in the arm produce a stronger thermal lens and surface deformation at the mirror centre, the recycling cavity's mode matching degrades, the recycling gain falls and the thermal compensation system can run out of range. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鍍膜材料的機械損耗 φ 在室溫下透過漲落耗散定理產生布朗熱雜訊，使鏡面在雷射光斑範圍內隨機起伏，這是 50 到 500 Hz 最重要的雜訊之一；加大光斑半徑 w 與降低 φ 是僅有的兩條路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The mechanical loss φ of the coating materials produces Brownian thermal noise at room temperature through the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, making the surface fluctuate randomly within the laser spot; it is among the most important noises between 50 and 500 Hz, and enlarging the spot radius w or lowering φ are the only two remedies.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡面只要拋得夠光滑，熱雜訊就不存在。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A mirror polished smoothly enough has no thermal noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 鍍膜吸收從 0.5 ppm 升到 2 ppm 時，臂內數百 kW 的功率在鏡面中心產生更強的熱透鏡與面形變化，功率循環腔的模式匹配劣化，循環增益下降，而且熱補償系統可能超出調整範圍。

optionsEn: If coating absorption rises from 0.5 ppm to 2 ppm, the hundreds of kilowatts in the arm produce a stronger thermal lens and surface deformation at the mirror centre, the recycling cavity's mode matching degrades, the recycling gain falls and the thermal compensation system can run out of range.

steps.title: 四重擺、熔融石英纖維與地震隔離：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Quadruple pendulum, fused-silica fibres and seismic isolation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每面測試質量掛在四級擺的最下層：上兩級為金屬質量，下兩級為熔融石英，最下一級以四根直徑約 400 µm 的熔融石英纖維與倒數第二級焊成單體懸吊，避免金屬絲的摩擦損耗。每一級擺在共振頻率以上提供 1/f² 的隔離，四級合起來約 1/f⁸；擺的上方還有主動隔振平台（ISI），以地震計與慣性感測器回授抵消地面與潮汐的低頻運動。這套組合把地面微米等級的震動在 10 Hz 以上壓到 10⁻¹⁹ m 以下，使測試質量成為近乎自由的慣性質量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each test mass hangs at the bottom of a four-stage pendulum: the top two stages are metal, the lower two fused silica, and the final stage is welded to the penultimate mass through four fused-silica fibres about 400 µm in diameter, forming a monolithic suspension that avoids the frictional loss of metal wires. Each stage isolates as 1/f² above its resonance, so four stages give roughly 1/f⁸; above the pendulum an active isolation platform (ISI) uses seismometers and inertial sensors in feedback to cancel low-frequency ground and tidal motion. Together they reduce micrometre-scale ground vibration to below 10⁻¹⁹ m above 10 Hz, making the test mass an almost free inertial mass. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：四級擺在共振頻率 f₀ 以上的傳遞率近似 (f₀/f)⁸：f₀ = 0.6 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The transmissibility of a four-stage pendulum above its resonance f₀ is roughly (f₀/f)⁸: with f₀ = 0.6 Hz and f = 10 Hz, (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Building the interferometer somewhere quiet removes the need for complex isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Quadruple pendulum, fused-silica fibres and seismic isolation" is correct?
options: 只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。
每面測試質量掛在四級擺的最下層：上兩級為金屬質量，下兩級為熔融石英，最下一級以四根直徑約 400 µm 的熔融石英纖維與倒數第二級焊成單體懸吊，避免金屬絲的摩擦損耗。

steps.title: 四重擺、熔融石英纖維與地震隔離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Quadruple pendulum, fused-silica fibres and seismic isolation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四級擺在共振頻率 f₀ 以上的傳遞率近似 (f₀/f)⁸：f₀ = 0.6 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰。安靜站址地面在 10 Hz 約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz，主動平台再衰減 10³ 倍至 10⁻¹² m/√Hz，經四級擺後約 1.7×10⁻²² m/√Hz，對應 h ≈ 4×10⁻²⁶/√Hz，遠低於 10 Hz 處約 10⁻²³ 的設計靈敏度，因此低頻真正的限制是懸吊熱雜訊與控制雜訊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The transmissibility of a four-stage pendulum above its resonance f₀ is roughly (f₀/f)⁸: with f₀ = 0.6 Hz and f = 10 Hz, (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰. Ground motion at a quiet site is about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, the active platform attenuates a further 10³ to 10⁻¹² m/√Hz, and after the quad about 1.7×10⁻²² m/√Hz remains, corresponding to h ≈ 4×10⁻²⁶/√Hz, far below the design sensitivity of about 10⁻²³ at 10 Hz; the real low-frequency limits are therefore suspension thermal and control noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在懸吊測試架上以位移感測器與電磁致動器量每一級的傳遞函數，確認共振頻率與高頻滾降斜率；在干涉儀中把地面地震計訊號與差動臂長訊號做相干分析，10 Hz 以上的相干性應接近零，否則表示某級被短路（例如纜線或擋塊接觸）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the suspension test stand measure each stage's transfer function with displacement sensors and electromagnetic actuators, confirming resonance frequencies and the high-frequency roll-off slope; in the interferometer compute the coherence between ground seismometers and the differential arm signal, which should be near zero above 10 Hz, otherwise a stage is shorted, for example by a cable or an earthquake stop touching.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 四級擺在共振頻率 f₀ 以上的傳遞率近似 (f₀/f)⁸：f₀ = 0.6 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰。安靜站址地面在 10 Hz 約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz，主動平台再衰減 10³ 倍至 10⁻¹² m/√Hz，經四級擺後約 1.7×10⁻²² m/√Hz，對應 h ≈ 4×10⁻²⁶/√Hz，遠低於 10 Hz 處約 10⁻²³ 的設計靈敏度，因此低頻真正的限制是懸吊熱雜訊與控制雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: The transmissibility of a four-stage pendulum above its resonance f₀ is roughly (f₀/f)⁸: with f₀ = 0.6 Hz and f = 10 Hz, (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰. Ground motion at a quiet site is about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, the active platform attenuates a further 10³ to 10⁻¹² m/√Hz, and after the quad about 1.7×10⁻²² m/√Hz remains, corresponding to h ≈ 4×10⁻²⁶/√Hz, far below the design sensitivity of about 10⁻²³ at 10 Hz; the real low-frequency limits are therefore suspension thermal and control noise.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 四重擺、熔融石英纖維與地震隔離：量測與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在懸吊測試架上以位移感測器與電磁致動器量每一級的傳遞函數，確認共振頻率與高頻滾降斜率；在干涉儀中把地面地震計訊號與差動臂長訊號做相干分析，10 Hz 以上的相干性應接近零，否則表示某級被短路（例如纜線或擋塊接觸）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the suspension test stand measure each stage's transfer function with displacement sensors and electromagnetic actuators, confirming resonance frequencies and the high-frequency roll-off slope; in the interferometer compute the coherence between ground seismometers and the differential arm signal, which should be near zero above 10 Hz, otherwise a stage is shorted, for example by a cable or an earthquake stop touching. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
