steps.instruction: 一根石英纖維在焊點附近有微裂紋時，纖維的損耗角上升並在小提琴模態（約 500 Hz）附近產生尖峰，最終可能斷裂使鏡子落到擋塊上；斷裂前的徵兆是模態 Q 值下降，必須由懸吊的共振監測發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光」與「絕對校正與雜訊預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light" and "Absolute calibration and the noise budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輸出埠的光子到達是泊松過程，功率起伏換算成等效的臂長雜訊，就是散粒雜訊；它與功率的平方根成反比，而臂腔極點以上的訊號響應下降，使散粒雜訊的等效應變在高頻隨頻率上升。LIGO 從 O3 起把壓縮真空態從輸出埠注入，把量子相位起伏壓低數 dB；O4 加入 300 m 的濾波腔產生頻率相依的壓縮，使低頻的輻射壓雜訊不因壓縮而惡化。散粒雜訊與輻射壓雜訊合稱量子雜訊，是靈敏度曲線在 100 Hz 以上的主要邊界。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Photon arrivals at the output port form a Poisson process, and the power fluctuation expressed as equivalent arm-length noise is shot noise; it scales inversely with the square root of power, and because the signal response falls above the arm-cavity pole, the equivalent strain noise rises with frequency. Since O3 LIGO injects a squeezed vacuum into the output port, reducing the quantum phase fluctuation by several dB; O4 added a 300 m filter cavity for frequency-dependent squeezing so that low-frequency radiation-pressure noise is not worsened by the squeezing. Shot and radiation-pressure noise together form quantum noise, the main boundary of the sensitivity curve above 100 Hz. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單純麥克森的散粒雜訊應變 h_shot = √(ħcλ/(2π·P_bs))/L：P_bs = 2 kW 時 √(2.68×10⁻³⁶) ≈ 1.64×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz，除以 4000 m 得 4.1×10⁻²²/√Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The shot-noise strain of a simple Michelson is h_shot = √(ħcλ/(2π·P_bs))/L: with P_bs = 2 kW, √(2.68×10⁻³⁶) ≈ 1.64×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz, which over 4000 m is 4.1×10⁻²²/√Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「散粒雜訊是偵測器電子雜訊，換更好的光電二極體就能消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shot noise is detector electronic noise that a better photodiode removes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在壓縮光開與關兩種狀態下各量一段靈敏度曲線，1 kHz 附近的雜訊比應等於壓縮量（dB）；再改變入射功率（例如 25 W 與 50 W）確認高頻雜訊按 1/√P 變化，低頻（20–40 Hz）則觀察輻射壓雜訊是否隨功率上升，驗證濾波腔的旋轉角度設定正確。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sensitivity curves with the squeezer on and off; the noise ratio near 1 kHz should equal the squeezing level in dB. Then change the input power (for example 25 W and 50 W) to confirm that high-frequency noise scales as 1/√P, and watch whether radiation-pressure noise at 20–40 Hz rises with power, verifying that the filter-cavity rotation angle is set correctly. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：輸出鏈的光學損耗從 10% 升到 30%（例如法拉第隔離器退化或模式匹配變差）時，壓縮態被真空態稀釋，原本 6 dB 的壓縮只剩 2 dB，高頻靈敏度明顯退步，而單看雷射功率與鎖定狀態都正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If optical loss in the output chain rises from 10% to 30%, for example from a degraded Faraday isolator or worse mode matching, the squeezed state is diluted by vacuum, 6 dB of squeezing collapses to 2 dB and high-frequency sensitivity visibly regresses while laser power and lock status look normal.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 輸出鏈的光學損耗從 10% 升到 30%（例如法拉第隔離器退化或模式匹配變差）時，壓縮態被真空態稀釋，原本 6 dB 的壓縮只剩 2 dB，高頻靈敏度明顯退步，而單看雷射功率與鎖定狀態都正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 絕對校正與雜訊預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Absolute calibration and the noise budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 應變資料要有絕對刻度，LIGO 以光子校正器（Pcal）把一束功率調變的輔助雷射打在 ETM 上，用輻射壓產生已知的力，功率以可追溯到國家標準實驗室的功率計量測，使應變校正的不確定度達到百分之一等級；校正線連續注入，讓時間相依的讀出鏈增益可以即時追蹤。雜訊預算則把量子、鍍膜與懸吊熱雜訊、地震、牛頓、雷射頻率與強度、散射光與控制雜訊逐項以模型或注入量測估算，與實測靈敏度曲線相減，剩下的「未解釋雜訊」是調試的優先目標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strain data need an absolute scale, so LIGO uses the photon calibrator (Pcal): a power-modulated auxiliary laser hits the ETM and its radiation pressure applies a known force, with the power measured by meters traceable to national metrology laboratories, bringing strain calibration uncertainty to the percent level; calibration lines are injected continuously so that time-dependent readout gains can be tracked. The noise budget estimates quantum, coating and suspension thermal, seismic, Newtonian, laser frequency and intensity, scattered-light and control noise term by term from models or injections, subtracts them from the measured curve, and the remaining unexplained noise becomes the commissioning priority. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.explanation: 應變資料要有絕對刻度，LIGO 以光子校正器（Pcal）把一束功率調變的輔助雷射打在 ETM 上，用輻射壓產生已知的力，功率以可追溯到國家標準實驗室的功率計量測，使應變校正的不確定度達到百分之一等級；校正線連續注入，讓時間相依的讀出鏈增益可以即時追蹤。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Strain data need an absolute scale, so LIGO uses the photon calibrator (Pcal): a power-modulated auxiliary laser hits the ETM and its radiation pressure applies a known force, with the power measured by meters traceable to national metrology laboratories, bringing strain calibration uncertainty to the percent level; calibration lines are injected continuously so that time-dependent readout gains can be tracked. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 絕對校正與雜訊預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Absolute calibration and the noise budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。40 kg 自由質量在 100 Hz 的位移 x = F/(M·(2πf)²) = 6.6×10⁻⁹/(40×3.95×10⁵) ≈ 4.2×10⁻¹⁶ m，對應 h = x/L ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹⁹。功率計 0.5% 的不確定度直接成為應變尺度的 0.5%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N. A 40 kg free mass moves x = F/(M·(2πf)²) = 6.6×10⁻⁹/(40×3.95×10⁵) ≈ 4.2×10⁻¹⁶ m at 100 Hz, corresponding to h = x/L ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹⁹. A 0.5% uncertainty in the power meter becomes directly 0.5% in the strain scale. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩種獨立方法交叉校正：光子校正器與以雷射波長為尺的「自由擺」法（以已知的鏡子驅動在低頻掃過條紋），兩者在 100 Hz 的應變刻度應一致於 2% 內；雜訊預算則逐項做注入（例如強度雜訊注入後量耦合係數）並確認各項以均方和疊加後與實測曲線相差不超過 20%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check with two independent methods: the photon calibrator and the free-swinging-Michelson method that uses the laser wavelength as a ruler by sweeping fringes with a known mirror drive; their strain scales at 100 Hz should agree within 2%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。40 kg 自由質量在 100 Hz 的位移 x = F/(M·(2πf)²) = 6.6×10⁻⁹/(40×3.95×10⁵) ≈ 4.2×10⁻¹⁶ m，對應 h = x/L ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹⁹。功率計 0.5% 的不確定度直接成為應變尺度的 0.5%。
knowledge.textEn: The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N. A 40 kg free mass moves x = F/(M·(2πf)²) = 6.6×10⁻⁹/(40×3.95×10⁵) ≈ 4.2×10⁻¹⁶ m at 100 Hz, corresponding to h = x/L ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹⁹. A 0.5% uncertainty in the power meter becomes directly 0.5% in the strain scale.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「絕對校正與雜訊預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Absolute calibration and the noise budget", which statement holds?
options: 重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。
光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。
鏡面只要拋得夠光滑，熱雜訊就不存在。
optionsEn: A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything.
The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N.
A mirror polished smoothly enough has no thermal noise.
quiz.explanation: 光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 絕對校正與雜訊預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Absolute calibration and the noise budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以兩種獨立方法交叉校正：光子校正器與以雷射波長為尺的「自由擺」法（以已知的鏡子驅動在低頻掃過條紋），兩者在 100 Hz 的應變刻度應一致於 2% 內；雜訊預算則逐項做注入（例如強度雜訊注入後量耦合係數）並確認各項以均方和疊加後與實測曲線相差不超過 20%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check with two independent methods: the photon calibrator and the free-swinging-Michelson method that uses the laser wavelength as a ruler by sweeping fringes with a known mirror drive; their strain scales at 100 Hz should agree within 2%. For the noise budget inject each term (for example measure the coupling after an intensity-noise injection) and confirm that the quadrature sum of all terms matches the measured curve within 20%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光子校正器光束未對準 ETM 的指定位置，輻射壓除了平移還激發鏡面的鼓面模態與傾斜，校正線的響應偏離自由質量模型，整段觀測資料的振幅校正出現數個百分比的系統誤差，波源距離的推算也跟著偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the photon-calibrator beams are misaligned from their designated positions on the ETM, the radiation pressure excites drumhead modes and tilt in addition to translation, the calibration-line response departs from the free-mass model, the amplitude calibration of the whole data segment carries a systematic error of several percent and inferred source distances shift with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以兩種獨立方法交叉校正：光子校正器與以雷射波長為尺的「自由擺」法（以已知的鏡子驅動在低頻掃過條紋），兩者在 100 Hz 的應變刻度應一致於 2% 內；雜訊預算則逐項做注入（例如強度雜訊注入後量耦合係數）並確認各項以均方和疊加後與實測曲線相差不超過 20%。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check with two independent methods: the photon calibrator and the free-swinging-Michelson method that uses the laser wavelength as a ruler by sweeping fringes with a known mirror drive; their strain scales at 100 Hz should agree within 2%. For the noise budget inject each term (for example measure the coupling after an intensity-noise injection) and confirm that the quadrature sum of all terms matches the measured curve within 20%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「絕對校正與雜訊預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Absolute calibration and the noise budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。
以兩種獨立方法交叉校正：光子校正器與以雷射波長為尺的「自由擺」法（以已知的鏡子驅動在低頻掃過條紋），兩者在 100 Hz 的應變刻度應一致於 2% 內。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Building the interferometer somewhere quiet removes the need for complex isolation.
Cross-check with two independent methods: the photon calibrator and the free-swinging-Michelson method that uses the laser wavelength as a ruler by sweeping fringes with a known mirror drive.
quiz.explanation: 以兩種獨立方法交叉校正：光子校正器與以雷射波長為尺的「自由擺」法（以已知的鏡子驅動在低頻掃過條紋），兩者在 100 Hz 的應變刻度應一致於 2% 內；雜訊預算則逐項做注入（例如強度雜訊注入後量耦合係數）並確認各項以均方和疊加後與實測曲線相差不超過 20%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check with two independent methods: the photon calibrator and the free-swinging-Michelson method that uses the laser wavelength as a ruler by sweeping fringes with a known mirror drive; their strain scales at 100 Hz should agree within 2%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 絕對校正與雜訊預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Absolute calibration and the noise budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 光子校正器光束未對準 ETM 的指定位置，輻射壓除了平移還激發鏡面的鼓面模態與傾斜，校正線的響應偏離自由質量模型，整段觀測資料的振幅校正出現數個百分比的系統誤差，波源距離的推算也跟著偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the photon-calibrator beams are misaligned from their designated positions on the ETM, the radiation pressure excites drumhead modes and tilt in addition to translation, the calibration-line response departs from the free-mass model, the amplitude calibration of the whole data segment carries a systematic error of several percent and inferred source distances shift with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雜訊預算則把量子、鍍膜與懸吊熱雜訊、地震、牛頓、雷射頻率與強度、散射光與控制雜訊逐項以模型或注入量測估算，與實測靈敏度曲線相減，剩下的「未解釋雜訊」是調試的優先目標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The noise budget estimates quantum, coating and suspension thermal, seismic, Newtonian, laser frequency and intensity, scattered-light and control noise term by term from models or injections, subtracts them from the measured curve, and the remaining unexplained noise becomes the commissioning priority.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 光子校正器光束未對準 ETM 的指定位置，輻射壓除了平移還激發鏡面的鼓面模態與傾斜，校正線的響應偏離自由質量模型，整段觀測資料的振幅校正出現數個百分比的系統誤差，波源距離的推算也跟著偏移。
knowledge.textEn: If the photon-calibrator beams are misaligned from their designated positions on the ETM, the radiation pressure excites drumhead modes and tilt in addition to translation, the calibration-line response departs from the free-mass model, the amplitude calibration of the whole data segment carries a systematic error of several percent and inferred source distances shift with it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「絕對校正與雜訊預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Absolute calibration and the noise budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 光子校正器光束未對準 ETM 的指定位置，輻射壓除了平移還激發鏡面的鼓面模態與傾斜，校正線的響應偏離自由質量模型，整段觀測資料的振幅校正出現數個百分比的系統誤差，波源距離的推算也跟著偏移。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。
optionsEn: If the photon-calibrator beams are misaligned from their designated positions on the ETM, the radiation pressure excites drumhead modes and tilt in addition to translation, the calibration-line response departs from the free-mass model, the amplitude calibration of the whole data segment carries a systematic error of several percent and inferred source distances shift with it.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Locking just means holding the mirrors still.

quiz.explanationEn: If the photon-calibrator beams are misaligned from their designated positions on the ETM, the radiation pressure excites drumhead modes and tilt in addition to translation, the calibration-line response departs from the free-mass model, the amplitude calibration of the whole data segment carries a systematic error of several percent and inferred source distances shift with it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」與「觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lock acquisition and length and alignment control" and "Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀有五個長度自由度（兩臂共模與差模、麥克森、功率循環腔、訊號循環腔）與數十個角度自由度，都要同時鎖在共振點上才能工作。高精細度臂腔的共振寬度只有約 1 nm，自由擺動的鏡子以微米每秒的速度掃過它，紅外光來不及建立共振，因此先用 532 nm 的倍頻光經臂長穩定系統（ALS）把臂長鎖到數奈米內，再切換到紅外鎖定、逐步提高功率。鎖定後由 Pound–Drever–Hall 式的射頻感測與波前感測器提供誤差訊號，數位控制系統以每秒 16384 次的速率驅動懸吊各級的致動器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The interferometer has five length degrees of freedom (common and differential arm, Michelson, power-recycling and signal-recycling cavities) and tens of angular ones, all of which must sit on resonance simultaneously. A high-finesse arm resonance is only about 1 nm wide and a freely swinging mirror sweeps through it at micrometres per second, too fast for the infrared light to build up, so 532 nm frequency-doubled light through the arm-length stabilisation system (ALS) first holds the arms within a few nanometres, after which the infrared lock is handed over and the power raised in steps. Once locked, Pound–Drever–Hall-type radio-frequency sensing and wavefront sensors provide error signals, and the digital control system drives the suspension actuators at 16384 samples per second. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The arm linewidth expressed in length is λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm and the storage time τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Locking just means holding the mirrors still." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control
knowledge.text: 干涉儀有五個長度自由度（兩臂共模與差模、麥克森、功率循環腔、訊號循環腔）與數十個角度自由度，都要同時鎖在共振點上才能工作。高精細度臂腔的共振寬度只有約 1 nm，自由擺動的鏡子以微米每秒的速度掃過它，紅外光來不及建立共振，因此先用 532 nm 的倍頻光經臂長穩定系統（ALS）把臂長鎖到數奈米內，再切換到紅外鎖定、逐步提高功率。
knowledge.textEn: The interferometer has five length degrees of freedom (common and differential arm, Michelson, power-recycling and signal-recycling cavities) and tens of angular ones, all of which must sit on resonance simultaneously. A high-finesse arm resonance is only about 1 nm wide and a freely swinging mirror sweeps through it at micrometres per second, too fast for the infrared light to build up, so 532 nm frequency-doubled light through the arm-length stabilisation system (ALS) first holds the arms within a few nanometres, after which the infrared lock is handed over and the power raised in steps.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Locking just means holding the mirrors still. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lock acquisition and length and alignment control" is correct?
options: 鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。
干涉儀有五個長度自由度（兩臂共模與差模、麥克森、功率循環腔、訊號循環腔）與數十個角度自由度，都要同時鎖在共振點上才能工作。
只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。
optionsEn: Locking just means holding the mirrors still.

The interferometer has five length degrees of freedom (common and differential arm, Michelson, power-recycling and signal-recycling cavities) and tens of angular ones, all of which must sit on resonance simultaneously.
One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own.
quiz.explanation: 干涉儀有五個長度自由度（兩臂共模與差模、麥克森、功率循環腔、訊號循環腔）與數十個角度自由度，都要同時鎖在共振點上才能工作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The interferometer has five length degrees of freedom (common and differential arm, Michelson, power-recycling and signal-recycling cavities) and tens of angular ones, all of which must sit on resonance simultaneously. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臂腔線寬以長度表示為 λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm；儲存時間 τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms。鏡子穿越線寬的速度若超過約 1.2 nm/3.8 ms ≈ 0.3 µm/s，腔內功率來不及建立；自由擺動的測試質量速度約 1 µm/s，所以必須先用 ALS 把相對速度壓到 0.1 µm/s 以下。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The arm linewidth expressed in length is λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm and the storage time τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms. If the mirror crosses the linewidth faster than about 1.2 nm/3.8 ms ≈ 0.3 µm/s the intracavity power cannot build up; a freely swinging test mass moves at about 1 µm/s, so the ALS must first bring the relative velocity below 0.1 µm/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄每次鎖定獲取的各步驟時間與失敗點，統計臂長在 ALS 階段的殘餘 RMS（應為奈米級）與紅外切換時的功率建立曲線；對每個長度迴路量開迴路轉移函數，確認單位增益頻率與相位裕度（例如差模迴路約 50–100 Hz、相位裕度大於 30°），並在觀測前存檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log the timing of each lock-acquisition step and its failure points, and record the residual arm-length RMS during the ALS stage (nanometre level) and the power build-up curve at the infrared handover; measure the open-loop transfer function of every length loop, confirming unity-gain frequency and phase margin (for example about 50–100 Hz and more than 30° for the differential loop), and archive them before the run.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臂腔線寬以長度表示為 λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm；儲存時間 τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms。鏡子穿越線寬的速度若超過約 1.2 nm/3.8 ms ≈ 0.3 µm/s，腔內功率來不及建立；自由擺動的測試質量速度約 1 µm/s，所以必須先用 ALS 把相對速度壓到 0.1 µm/s 以下。
knowledge.textEn: The arm linewidth expressed in length is λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm and the storage time τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms. If the mirror crosses the linewidth faster than about 1.2 nm/3.8 ms ≈ 0.3 µm/s the intracavity power cannot build up; a freely swinging test mass moves at about 1 µm/s, so the ALS must first bring the relative velocity below 0.1 µm/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lock acquisition and length and alignment control", which statement holds?
options: 精細度越高越好，可以無限提高靈敏度。
只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。
optionsEn: Higher finesse is always better and raises sensitivity without limit.
Building the interferometer somewhere quiet removes the need for complex isolation.
The arm linewidth expressed in length is λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm and the storage time τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms.
quiz.explanation: 臂腔線寬以長度表示為 λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm；儲存時間 τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The arm linewidth expressed in length is λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm and the storage time τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄每次鎖定獲取的各步驟時間與失敗點，統計臂長在 ALS 階段的殘餘 RMS（應為奈米級）與紅外切換時的功率建立曲線；對每個長度迴路量開迴路轉移函數，確認單位增益頻率與相位裕度（例如差模迴路約 50–100 Hz、相位裕度大於 30°），並在觀測前存檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the timing of each lock-acquisition step and its failure points, and record the residual arm-length RMS during the ALS stage (nanometre level) and the power build-up curve at the infrared handover; measure the open-loop transfer function of every length loop, confirming unity-gain frequency and phase margin (for example about 50–100 Hz and more than 30° for the differential loop), and archive them before the run. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：輔助雷射的倍頻光功率下降一半時，ALS 的誤差訊號訊噪比不足，臂長殘餘從 1 nm 升到數 nm，紅外切換屢屢失敗，干涉儀整夜無法鎖定；若值班人員只重複嘗試而不查綠光功率，會損失整個觀測夜。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the frequency-doubled auxiliary laser power halves, the ALS error signal lacks signal-to-noise, the residual arm length grows from 1 nm to several nanometres, the infrared handover fails repeatedly and the interferometer cannot lock all night; an operator who simply retries without checking the green power loses the whole observing night.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄每次鎖定獲取的各步驟時間與失敗點，統計臂長在 ALS 階段的殘餘 RMS（應為奈米級）與紅外切換時的功率建立曲線；對每個長度迴路量開迴路轉移函數，確認單位增益頻率與相位裕度（例如差模迴路約 50–100 Hz、相位裕度大於 30°），並在觀測前存檔。
knowledge.textEn: Log the timing of each lock-acquisition step and its failure points, and record the residual arm-length RMS during the ALS stage (nanometre level) and the power build-up curve at the infrared handover; measure the open-loop transfer function of every length loop, confirming unity-gain frequency and phase margin (for example about 50–100 Hz and more than 30° for the differential loop), and archive them before the run.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lock acquisition and length and alignment control"?
options: 記錄每次鎖定獲取的各步驟時間與失敗點，統計臂長在 ALS 階段的殘餘 RMS（應為奈米級）與紅外切換時的功率建立曲線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
散粒雜訊是偵測器電子雜訊，換更好的光電二極體就能消除。
optionsEn: Log the timing of each lock-acquisition step and its failure points, and record the residual arm-length RMS during the ALS stage (nanometre level) and the power build-up curve at the infrared handover.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Shot noise is detector electronic noise that a better photodiode removes.
quiz.explanation: 記錄每次鎖定獲取的各步驟時間與失敗點，統計臂長在 ALS 階段的殘餘 RMS（應為奈米級）與紅外切換時的功率建立曲線；對每個長度迴路量開迴路轉移函數，確認單位增益頻率與相位裕度（例如差模迴路約 50–100 Hz、相位裕度大於 30°），並在觀測前存檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log the timing of each lock-acquisition step and its failure points, and record the residual arm-length RMS during the ALS stage (nanometre level) and the power build-up curve at the infrared handover; measure the open-loop transfer function of every length loop, confirming unity-gain frequency and phase margin (for example about 50–100 Hz and more than 30° for the differential loop), and archive them before the run. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 輔助雷射的倍頻光功率下降一半時，ALS 的誤差訊號訊噪比不足，臂長殘餘從 1 nm 升到數 nm，紅外切換屢屢失敗，干涉儀整夜無法鎖定；若值班人員只重複嘗試而不查綠光功率，會損失整個觀測夜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the frequency-doubled auxiliary laser power halves, the ALS error signal lacks signal-to-noise, the residual arm length grows from 1 nm to several nanometres, the infrared handover fails repeatedly and the interferometer cannot lock all night; an operator who simply retries without checking the green power loses the whole observing night. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鎖定後由 Pound–Drever–Hall 式的射頻感測與波前感測器提供誤差訊號，數位控制系統以每秒 16384 次的速率驅動懸吊各級的致動器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Once locked, Pound–Drever–Hall-type radio-frequency sensing and wavefront sensors provide error signals, and the digital control system drives the suspension actuators at 16384 samples per second.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Locking just means holding the mirrors still." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 輔助雷射的倍頻光功率下降一半時，ALS 的誤差訊號訊噪比不足，臂長殘餘從 1 nm 升到數 nm，紅外切換屢屢失敗，干涉儀整夜無法鎖定；若值班人員只重複嘗試而不查綠光功率，會損失整個觀測夜。
knowledge.textEn: When the frequency-doubled auxiliary laser power halves, the ALS error signal lacks signal-to-noise, the residual arm length grows from 1 nm to several nanometres, the infrared handover fails repeatedly and the interferometer cannot lock all night; an operator who simply retries without checking the green power loses the whole observing night.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lock acquisition and length and alignment control" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
輔助雷射的倍頻光功率下降一半時，ALS 的誤差訊號訊噪比不足，臂長殘餘從 1 nm 升到數 nm，紅外切換屢屢失敗，干涉儀整夜無法鎖定。
只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

When the frequency-doubled auxiliary laser power halves, the ALS error signal lacks signal-to-noise, the residual arm length grows from 1 nm to several nanometres, the infrared handover fails repeatedly and the interferometer cannot lock all night.
One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own.
quiz.explanation: 輔助雷射的倍頻光功率下降一半時，ALS 的誤差訊號訊噪比不足，臂長殘餘從 1 nm 升到數 nm，紅外切換屢屢失敗，干涉儀整夜無法鎖定；若值班人員只重複嘗試而不查綠光功率，會損失整個觀測夜。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When the frequency-doubled auxiliary laser power halves, the ALS error signal lacks signal-to-noise, the residual arm length grows from 1 nm to several nanometres, the infrared handover fails repeatedly and the interferometer cannot lock all night; an operator who simply retries without checking the green power loses the whole observing night. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一次觀測運行的交接包含：校正模型與不確定度、各頻段的雜訊預算、鎖定與重鎖程序、環境監測（地震計、麥克風、磁力計）通道清單、資料品質旗標定義，以及兩站的時間同步（GPS 對時至微秒以內）。偵測器的科學價值以雙中子星可探測距離（BNS range）與工作週期（duty cycle）量化，兩站同時運作才能壓低假警報率並做到天區定位；因此工程交接的目標不是單站的最佳靈敏度，而是網路的穩定與可重現性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The handoff for an observing run includes the calibration model and its uncertainty, the noise budget per frequency band, lock and relock procedures, the list of environmental channels (seismometers, microphones, magnetometers), data-quality flag definitions and the time synchronisation of the two sites (GPS to better than a microsecond). A detector's scientific value is quantified by the binary-neutron-star range and the duty cycle, and both sites must run together to suppress false alarms and localise sources on the sky; the goal of the engineering handoff is therefore not one site's best sensitivity but the stability and reproducibility of the network. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：可探測體積隨距離的三次方：BNS range 從 130 Mpc 提高到 160 Mpc，事件率乘以 (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86；靈敏度每改善 10%，事件率約增加 33%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Detectable volume scales as the cube of range: raising the BNS range from 130 Mpc to 160 Mpc multiplies the event rate by (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86, and every 10% improvement in sensitivity adds about 33% more events.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 一次觀測運行的交接包含：校正模型與不確定度、各頻段的雜訊預算、鎖定與重鎖程序、環境監測（地震計、麥克風、磁力計）通道清單、資料品質旗標定義，以及兩站的時間同步（GPS 對時至微秒以內）。偵測器的科學價值以雙中子星可探測距離（BNS range）與工作週期（duty cycle）量化，兩站同時運作才能壓低假警報率並做到天區定位；因此工程交接的目標不是單站的最佳靈敏度，而是網路的穩定與可重現性。
knowledge.textEn: The handoff for an observing run includes the calibration model and its uncertainty, the noise budget per frequency band, lock and relock procedures, the list of environmental channels (seismometers, microphones, magnetometers), data-quality flag definitions and the time synchronisation of the two sites (GPS to better than a microsecond). A detector's scientific value is quantified by the binary-neutron-star range and the duty cycle, and both sites must run together to suppress false alarms and localise sources on the sky; the goal of the engineering handoff is therefore not one site's best sensitivity but the stability and reproducibility of the network.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：可探測體積隨距離的三次方：BNS range 從 130 Mpc 提高到 160 Mpc，事件率乘以 (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86；靈敏度每改善 10%，事件率約增加 33%。兩站各 75% 的工作週期若彼此獨立，雙站同時運作的時間比例為 0.75² ≈ 0.56，因此工作週期的提升與靈敏度同等重要。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Detectable volume scales as the cube of range: raising the BNS range from 130 Mpc to 160 Mpc multiplies the event rate by (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86, and every 10% improvement in sensitivity adds about 33% more events. With independent duty cycles of 75% at each site, both run together only 0.75² ≈ 0.56 of the time, so duty-cycle gains matter as much as sensitivity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：運行前做硬體注入：在兩站同時注入已知波形，確認離線分析管線以正確的時間差、振幅與相位回復訊號；統計一週的 BNS range、工作週期與每個資料品質旗標移除的時間比例，寫入交接紀錄並與上一次運行比較，任何退步都要有對應的工程單據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the run perform hardware injections: inject a known waveform at both sites simultaneously and confirm that the offline analysis pipelines recover it with the correct time delay, amplitude and phase; over one week tabulate the BNS range, duty cycle and the fraction of time removed by each data-quality flag, enter them in the handoff record and compare with the previous run, with an engineering ticket for every regression.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Detectable volume scales as the cube of range: raising the BNS range from 130 Mpc to 160 Mpc multiplies the event rate by (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86, and every 10% improvement in sensitivity adds about 33% more events. With independent duty cycles of 75% at each site, both run together only 0.75² ≈ 0.56 of the time, so duty-cycle gains matter as much as sensitivity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

鏡面只要拋得夠光滑，熱雜訊就不存在。

steps.title: 觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 運行前做硬體注入：在兩站同時注入已知波形，確認離線分析管線以正確的時間差、振幅與相位回復訊號；統計一週的 BNS range、工作週期與每個資料品質旗標移除的時間比例，寫入交接紀錄並與上一次運行比較，任何退步都要有對應的工程單據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the run perform hardware injections: inject a known waveform at both sites simultaneously and confirm that the offline analysis pipelines recover it with the correct time delay, amplitude and phase; over one week tabulate the BNS range, duty cycle and the fraction of time removed by each data-quality flag, enter them in the handoff record and compare with the previous run, with an engineering ticket for every regression. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：站內某台冷卻機或空調造成的 60 Hz 諧波散射光雜訊未被標成資料品質旗標，離線搜尋把它當成候選事件或拉高背景，雙站符合分析的假警報率上升，最終迫使團隊重新處理整段資料。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A chiller or air-handler at one site producing 60 Hz harmonic scattered-light noise that is not flagged for data quality lets the offline search treat it as a candidate or raises the background, the false-alarm rate of the two-site coincidence analysis climbs and the team is forced to reprocess the whole data segment.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 運行前做硬體注入：在兩站同時注入已知波形，確認離線分析管線以正確的時間差、振幅與相位回復訊號；統計一週的 BNS range、工作週期與每個資料品質旗標移除的時間比例，寫入交接紀錄並與上一次運行比較，任何退步都要有對應的工程單據。
knowledge.textEn: Before the run perform hardware injections: inject a known waveform at both sites simultaneously and confirm that the offline analysis pipelines recover it with the correct time delay, amplitude and phase; over one week tabulate the BNS range, duty cycle and the fraction of time removed by each data-quality flag, enter them in the handoff record and compare with the previous run, with an engineering ticket for every regression.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 站內某台冷卻機或空調造成的 60 Hz 諧波散射光雜訊未被標成資料品質旗標，離線搜尋把它當成候選事件或拉高背景，雙站符合分析的假警報率上升，最終迫使團隊重新處理整段資料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：偵測器的科學價值以雙中子星可探測距離（BNS range）與工作週期（duty cycle）量化，兩站同時運作才能壓低假警報率並做到天區定位；因此工程交接的目標不是單站的最佳靈敏度，而是網路的穩定與可重現性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A detector's scientific value is quantified by the binary-neutron-star range and the duty cycle, and both sites must run together to suppress false alarms and localise sources on the sky; the goal of the engineering handoff is therefore not one site's best sensitivity but the stability and reproducibility of the network.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

title: Virgo 重力波干涉儀
summary: 以義大利卡希納 EGO 的 Advanced Virgo 為對象，從 3 km 臂腔的自由光譜範圍與線寬出發，解析卡希納近海站址的地震雜訊為何需要約 9 m 高、以倒立擺預隔離的超級衰減器，42 kg 熔融石英鏡的熱透鏡如何用 CO₂ 雷射補償，牛頓雜訊、牛頓校正器與 1.2 m 真空管殘氣如何進入靈敏度預算，以及三站網路的天區定位與運行交接。
summaryEn: Using Advanced Virgo at EGO in Cascina, Italy, this course starts from the free spectral range and linewidth of 3 km arm cavities, explains why the seismic noise of the near-coastal Cascina site demands a superattenuator about 9 m tall with inverted-pendulum pre-isolation, how the thermal lens in 42 kg fused-silica mirrors is compensated with CO₂ lasers, how Newtonian noise, the Newtonian calibrator and residual gas in the 1.2 m vacuum tubes enter the sensitivity budget, and how three-detector sky localisation and run handoff are organised.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 超級衰減器隔振預算練習（教學假設）：10 Hz 的地面位移 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz。倒立擺調到 0.04 Hz，傳遞率 (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵；五級機械濾波器各 0.4 Hz，傳遞率 (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴；理論總衰減 1.7×10⁻¹⁹，鏡子水平殘餘 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz。實際上交叉耦合把衰減限制在約 10⁻¹²，殘餘 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，對應 h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz，仍比 10 Hz 處約 10⁻²³ 的設計目標低 30 倍。垂直方向：若垂直殘餘也為 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，地球曲率使兩端局部鉛垂線相差 L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad，加上機械失準取總耦合 1%，水平等效為 10⁻²³ m/√Hz，可忽略。結論是 10 Hz 的真正邊界不是地震而是懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊與牛頓雜訊。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Superattenuator isolation-budget exercise (teaching assumptions): ground displacement at 10 Hz is 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz. The inverted pendulum tuned to 0.04 Hz transmits (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵; five mechanical filters at 0.4 Hz each transmit (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴; the theoretical total attenuation is 1.7×10⁻¹⁹ and the residual horizontal mirror motion 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz. In practice cross-couplings cap the attenuation near 10⁻¹², leaving 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, or h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz, still 30 times below the design target of about 10⁻²³ at 10 Hz. Vertically: if the vertical residual is also 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, Earth curvature makes the local verticals at the two ends differ by L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad, and taking 1% total coupling including mechanical misalignment gives a horizontal equivalent of 10⁻²³ m/√Hz, negligible. The conclusion is that the real boundary at 10 Hz is not seismic motion but suspension thermal, control and Newtonian noise. Values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度」與「地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms" and "Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 是臂長 3 km 的功率循環 Fabry–Pérot 麥克森干涉儀，兩臂互相垂直，1064 nm 雷射在分光鏡分成兩束，臂端鏡把光送回分光鏡在輸出埠以暗紋干涉。臂腔的自由光譜範圍由臂長決定，線寬由精細度決定，腔極點則是訊號響應開始下降的頻率；臂長 3 km 而非 4 km，表示在相同精細度與功率下，對同一應變的相位訊號小 25%，因此 Virgo 的設計更倚重低頻隔振與高功率來補償。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Virgo is a power-recycled Fabry–Pérot Michelson interferometer with perpendicular 3 km arms; a 1064 nm laser is split at the beam splitter and the end mirrors return the light to interfere on a dark fringe at the output port. The free spectral range of an arm cavity is set by its length, the linewidth by its finesse and the cavity pole is the frequency where signal response begins to fall; arms of 3 km rather than 4 km mean that for the same finesse and power the phase signal from a given strain is 25% smaller, so the Virgo design leans harder on low-frequency isolation and high power to compensate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：自由光譜範圍 FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz；精細度 F ≈ 450 時線寬 FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz，腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Free spectral range FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz; with finesse F ≈ 450 the linewidth is FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz and the cavity pole f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臂長 3 km 與 4 km 的差別只是場地大小，與靈敏度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：自由光譜範圍 FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz；精細度 F ≈ 450 時線寬 FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz，腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz。應變 h = 3.3×10⁻²² 對應 ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的千分之一。散粒雜訊應變正比於 1/(F·L)，故同精細度、同功率下 3 km 臂的散粒雜訊比 4 km 臂高 4/3 ≈ 1.33 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Free spectral range FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz; with finesse F ≈ 450 the linewidth is FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz and the cavity pole f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz. A strain h = 3.3×10⁻²² corresponds to ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one thousandth of a proton diameter. Shot-noise strain scales as 1/(F·L), so at equal finesse and power 3 km arms carry 4/3 ≈ 1.33 times the shot noise of 4 km arms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雷射頻率掃描臂腔，記錄透射峰的間距與寬度：峰距應為 50 kHz、峰寬約 111 Hz，由此得到實際精細度；再以已知的末端鏡驅動做掃頻，量差動臂長到輸出訊號的轉移函數，確認腔極點在 56 Hz 附近且與精細度一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sweep the laser frequency across an arm cavity and record the spacing and width of the transmission peaks: the spacing should be 50 kHz and the width about 111 Hz, giving the actual finesse; then drive an end mirror with a swept sine and measure the transfer function from differential arm length to the output signal, confirming a cavity pole near 56 Hz consistent with the finesse.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 自由光譜範圍 FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz；精細度 F ≈ 450 時線寬 FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz，腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz。應變 h = 3.3×10⁻²² 對應 ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的千分之一。散粒雜訊應變正比於 1/(F·L)，故同精細度、同功率下 3 km 臂的散粒雜訊比 4 km 臂高 4/3 ≈ 1.33 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Free spectral range FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz; with finesse F ≈ 450 the linewidth is FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz and the cavity pole f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz. A strain h = 3.3×10⁻²² corresponds to ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one thousandth of a proton diameter. knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.title: 3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以雷射頻率掃描臂腔，記錄透射峰的間距與寬度：峰距應為 50 kHz、峰寬約 111 Hz，由此得到實際精細度；再以已知的末端鏡驅動做掃頻，量差動臂長到輸出訊號的轉移函數，確認腔極點在 56 Hz 附近且與精細度一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sweep the laser frequency across an arm cavity and record the spacing and width of the transmission peaks: the spacing should be 50 kHz and the width about 111 Hz, giving the actual finesse; then drive an end mirror with a swept sine and measure the transfer function from differential arm length to the output signal, confirming a cavity pole near 56 Hz consistent with the finesse. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若臂腔內的散射或吸收損耗升高使精細度從 450 掉到 300，線寬變寬、訊號增益下降三分之一，同時功率循環增益也降低；靈敏度曲線整體上移，但單看雷射與鎖定狀態不會顯示異常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If scatter or absorption loss inside an arm raises and the finesse drops from 450 to 300, the linewidth broadens, the signal gain falls by a third and the power-recycling gain drops as well; the whole sensitivity curve shifts up while laser and lock status show nothing unusual.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以雷射頻率掃描臂腔，記錄透射峰的間距與寬度：峰距應為 50 kHz、峰寬約 111 Hz，由此得到實際精細度；再以已知的末端鏡驅動做掃頻，量差動臂長到輸出訊號的轉移函數，確認腔極點在 56 Hz 附近且與精細度一致。
knowledge.textEn: Sweep the laser frequency across an arm cavity and record the spacing and width of the transmission peaks: the spacing should be 50 kHz and the width about 111 Hz, giving the actual finesse; then drive an end mirror with a swept sine and measure the transfer function from differential arm length to the output signal, confirming a cavity pole near 56 Hz consistent with the finesse.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms"?

steps.instructionEn: If scatter or absorption loss inside an arm raises and the finesse drops from 450 to 300, the linewidth broadens, the signal gain falls by a third and the power-recycling gain drops as well; the whole sensitivity curve shifts up while laser and lock status show nothing unusual. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：臂腔的自由光譜範圍由臂長決定，線寬由精細度決定，腔極點則是訊號響應開始下降的頻率；臂長 3 km 而非 4 km，表示在相同精細度與功率下，對同一應變的相位訊號小 25%，因此 Virgo 的設計更倚重低頻隔振與高功率來補償。

steps.title: 地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 卡希納位於比薩附近的平原、距海岸不遠，地面在 0.2–0.5 Hz 的海洋微震振幅達微米等級，在 10 Hz 附近約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz，且隨天氣與人類活動變化。重力波頻帶從約 10 Hz 開始，而測試質量在 10 Hz 允許的運動只有 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz 等級，所以隔振系統必須提供十個數量級的衰減，並且在遠低於 10 Hz 的地方就開始生效；這就是 Virgo 從一開始便把低頻性能當作核心設計目標、發展超級衰減器的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cascina lies on the plain near Pisa not far from the coast; ground motion from ocean microseism at 0.2–0.5 Hz reaches micrometre amplitudes, near 10 Hz it is about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz, and it varies with weather and human activity. The gravitational-wave band starts near 10 Hz, where the test mass may move only at the 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz level, so the isolation must provide ten orders of magnitude of attenuation and must start acting far below 10 Hz; this is why Virgo made low-frequency performance a core design goal from the outset and developed the superattenuator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：所需衰減 A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰（10 Hz）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Required attenuation A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰ at 10 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震雜訊只在地震發生時才重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Seismic noise only matters when an earthquake happens." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The gravitational-wave band starts near 10 Hz, where the test mass may move only at the 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz level, so the isolation must provide ten orders of magnitude of attenuation and must start acting far below 10 Hz; this is why Virgo made low-frequency performance a core design goal from the outset and developed the superattenuator.

steps.title: 地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：所需衰減 A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰（10 Hz）。單級擺在共振 f₀ 以上的傳遞率 ≈ (f₀/f)²：f₀ = 0.5 Hz 時在 10 Hz 為 2.5×10⁻³；要達到 10⁻¹⁰ 需要 n 級使 (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰，即 n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9，至少四級；六級則給出 (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶ 的理論餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Required attenuation A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰ at 10 Hz. One pendulum stage transmits ≈ (f₀/f)² above its resonance: with f₀ = 0.5 Hz that is 2.5×10⁻³ at 10 Hz; reaching 10⁻¹⁰ needs n stages with (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰, that is n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9, at least four, while six stages give a theoretical margin of (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以站址地震計記錄一年中安靜與風暴日的地面位移譜，建立 10%、50%、90% 百分位曲線；把它乘以隔振系統的量測傳遞函數，與干涉儀中測試質量的實際殘餘運動（由控制訊號反推）比較，兩者在 1–10 Hz 應一致，否則存在未建模的耦合路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record ground-displacement spectra on quiet and stormy days through a year with the site seismometers and build 10th, 50th and 90th percentile curves; multiply them by the measured transfer function of the isolation system and compare with the actual residual test-mass motion inferred from control signals, which should agree between 1 and 10 Hz, otherwise an unmodelled coupling path exists.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

One pendulum stage transmits ≈ (f₀/f)² above its resonance: with f₀ = 0.5 Hz that is 2.5×10⁻³ at 10 Hz; reaching 10⁻¹⁰ needs n stages with (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰, that is n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9, at least four, while six stages give a theoretical margin of (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以站址地震計記錄一年中安靜與風暴日的地面位移譜，建立 10%、50%、90% 百分位曲線；把它乘以隔振系統的量測傳遞函數，與干涉儀中測試質量的實際殘餘運動（由控制訊號反推）比較，兩者在 1–10 Hz 應一致，否則存在未建模的耦合路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record ground-displacement spectra on quiet and stormy days through a year with the site seismometers and build 10th, 50th and 90th percentile curves; multiply them by the measured transfer function of the isolation system and compare with the actual residual test-mass motion inferred from control signals, which should agree between 1 and 10 Hz, otherwise an unmodelled coupling path exists. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冬季風暴期間海洋微震升高十倍，若控制迴路的動態範圍是依安靜日設計，致動器飽和、干涉儀反覆失鎖，工作週期在一週內從 80% 掉到 40%，而靈敏度曲線本身看似正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: During winter storms the ocean microseism rises tenfold; if the control loops' dynamic range was designed for quiet days, the actuators saturate, the interferometer loses lock repeatedly and the duty cycle drops from 80% to 40% within a week while the sensitivity curve itself looks normal.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.instruction: 冬季風暴期間海洋微震升高十倍，若控制迴路的動態範圍是依安靜日設計，致動器飽和、干涉儀反覆失鎖，工作週期在一週內從 80% 掉到 40%，而靈敏度曲線本身看似正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: During winter storms the ocean microseism rises tenfold; if the control loops' dynamic range was designed for quiet days, the actuators saturate, the interferometer loses lock repeatedly and the duty cycle drops from 80% to 40% within a week while the sensitivity curve itself looks normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重力波頻帶從約 10 Hz 開始，而測試質量在 10 Hz 允許的運動只有 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz 等級，所以隔振系統必須提供十個數量級的衰減，並且在遠低於 10 Hz 的地方就開始生效；這就是 Virgo 從一開始便把低頻性能當作核心設計目標、發展超級衰減器的原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The gravitational-wave band starts near 10 Hz, where the test mass may move only at the 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz level, so the isolation must provide ten orders of magnitude of attenuation and must start acting far below 10 Hz; this is why Virgo made low-frequency performance a core design goal from the outset and developed the superattenuator.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地震雜訊只在地震發生時才重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Seismic noise only matters when an earthquake happens." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器」與「鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters" and "Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超級衰減器高約 9 m：頂端是三根彈性接頭支撐的倒立擺，把水平共振頻率調到數十毫赫茲作為預隔離並提供低頻主動控制的介面；其下串接數級機械濾波器，每級以鋼製刀口懸吊提供水平擺動隔離，並以磁性反彈簧把垂直共振壓到 0.4 Hz 以下，解決垂直振動透過地球曲率與機械耦合漏進水平方向的問題；最下方是操縱盤（marionette）、反作用質量與鏡子。整條鏈以被動方式在 10 Hz 以上提供超過十個數量級的衰減，主動控制只負責抑制共振與低頻漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The superattenuator is about 9 m tall: at the top an inverted pendulum on three flexural joints tunes the horizontal resonance to tens of millihertz as pre-isolation and the interface for low-frequency active control; below it hang several mechanical filters, each suspended on steel blades for horizontal pendulum isolation and fitted with magnetic anti-springs that push the vertical resonance below 0.4 Hz, addressing vertical vibration that leaks into the horizontal direction through Earth curvature and mechanical coupling; at the bottom are the marionette, the reaction mass and the mirror. The whole chain provides more than ten orders of magnitude of passive attenuation above 10 Hz, while active control only damps resonances and low-frequency drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：倒立擺的角頻率 ω² = k/M − g/L：腿長 L = 6 m 時 g/L = 1.635 s⁻²，要得到 f = 0.03 Hz（ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²）需 k/M = 1.671 s⁻²，即彈性接頭剛度只能比重力反彈簧大 2.2%，靠配重微調。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The inverted pendulum's angular frequency obeys ω² = k/M − g/L: with leg length L = 6 m, g/L = 1.635 s⁻², and reaching f = 0.03 Hz (ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²) needs k/M = 1.671 s⁻², so the flexure stiffness may exceed the gravitational anti-spring by only 2.2%, trimmed with counterweights.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「倒立擺越高越好，因為擺越長共振頻率越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A taller inverted pendulum is always better because a longer pendulum has a lower resonance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：倒立擺的角頻率 ω² = k/M − g/L：腿長 L = 6 m 時 g/L = 1.635 s⁻²，要得到 f = 0.03 Hz（ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²）需 k/M = 1.671 s⁻²，即彈性接頭剛度只能比重力反彈簧大 2.2%，靠配重微調。衰減：倒立擺在 10 Hz 給 (0.03/10)² = 9×10⁻⁶，五級 0.4 Hz 濾波器給 (0.4/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁴，理論乘積約 10⁻¹⁹；實際受交叉耦合限制在 10⁻¹² 等級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The inverted pendulum's angular frequency obeys ω² = k/M − g/L: with leg length L = 6 m, g/L = 1.635 s⁻², and reaching f = 0.03 Hz (ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²) needs k/M = 1.671 s⁻², so the flexure stiffness may exceed the gravitational anti-spring by only 2.2%, trimmed with counterweights. Attenuation: the inverted pendulum gives (0.03/10)² = 9×10⁻⁶ at 10 Hz, five 0.4 Hz filters give (0.4/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁴, a theoretical product near 10⁻¹⁹; in practice cross-couplings limit it to the 10⁻¹² level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在組裝時以加速度計與位移感測器量每一級的水平與垂直傳遞函數，確認倒立擺與濾波器的共振頻率；整鏈完成後在頂端施加已知的正弦激振，在鏡子端以光學槓桿或干涉儀量殘餘運動，繪出 0.1–100 Hz 的衰減曲線並與模型比較，特別檢查垂直到水平的耦合比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During assembly measure the horizontal and vertical transfer functions of each stage with accelerometers and displacement sensors, confirming the resonances of the inverted pendulum and filters; once the chain is complete apply a known sinusoidal excitation at the top, measure the residual motion at the mirror with an optical lever or the interferometer, plot the attenuation from 0.1 to 100 Hz against the model and check the vertical-to-horizontal coupling ratio in particular.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在組裝時以加速度計與位移感測器量每一級的水平與垂直傳遞函數，確認倒立擺與濾波器的共振頻率；整鏈完成後在頂端施加已知的正弦激振，在鏡子端以光學槓桿或干涉儀量殘餘運動，繪出 0.1–100 Hz 的衰減曲線並與模型比較，特別檢查垂直到水平的耦合比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During assembly measure the horizontal and vertical transfer functions of each stage with accelerometers and displacement sensors, confirming the resonances of the inverted pendulum and filters; once the chain is complete apply a known sinusoidal excitation at the top, measure the residual motion at the mirror with an optical lever or the interferometer, plot the attenuation from 0.1 to 100 Hz against the model and check the vertical-to-horizontal coupling ratio in particular. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一級濾波器的磁性反彈簧因溫度變化而偏離工作點，垂直共振從 0.4 Hz 升到 1 Hz 以上，該級垂直隔離退化百倍，經耦合漏進水平方向後在 10–20 Hz 出現原本不存在的雜訊平台。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a filter's magnetic anti-spring drifts off its working point with temperature, its vertical resonance rises from 0.4 Hz to above 1 Hz, that stage's vertical isolation degrades a hundredfold and, after coupling into the horizontal direction, a noise plateau appears between 10 and 20 Hz that was never there before.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
