knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在組裝時以加速度計與位移感測器量每一級的水平與垂直傳遞函數，確認倒立擺與濾波器的共振頻率；整鏈完成後在頂端施加已知的正弦激振，在鏡子端以光學槓桿或干涉儀量殘餘運動，繪出 0.1–100 Hz 的衰減曲線並與模型比較，特別檢查垂直到水平的耦合比例。
knowledge.textEn: During assembly measure the horizontal and vertical transfer functions of each stage with accelerometers and displacement sensors, confirming the resonances of the inverted pendulum and filters; once the chain is complete apply a known sinusoidal excitation at the top, measure the residual motion at the mirror with an optical lever or the interferometer, plot the attenuation from 0.1 to 100 Hz against the model and check the vertical-to-horizontal coupling ratio in particular.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一級濾波器的磁性反彈簧因溫度變化而偏離工作點，垂直共振從 0.4 Hz 升到 1 Hz 以上，該級垂直隔離退化百倍，經耦合漏進水平方向後在 10–20 Hz 出現原本不存在的雜訊平台。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a filter's magnetic anti-spring drifts off its working point with temperature, its vertical resonance rises from 0.4 Hz to above 1 Hz, that stage's vertical isolation degrades a hundredfold and, after coupling into the horizontal direction, a noise plateau appears between 10 and 20 Hz that was never there before. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整條鏈以被動方式在 10 Hz 以上提供超過十個數量級的衰減，主動控制只負責抑制共振與低頻漂移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The whole chain provides more than ten orders of magnitude of passive attenuation above 10 Hz, while active control only damps resonances and low-frequency drift.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「倒立擺越高越好，因為擺越長共振頻率越低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A taller inverted pendulum is always better because a longer pendulum has a lower resonance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Advanced Virgo 的測試質量是直徑 35 cm、厚 20 cm、重 42 kg 的熔融石英鏡，以熔融石英纖維從操縱盤單體懸吊，鍍膜由里昂的 LMA 完成。臂內數十到數百 kW 的功率即使只被鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，也會在鏡面中心形成溫度梯度，透過 dn/dT 在輸入鏡基板產生熱透鏡、並使鏡面曲率改變，破壞循環腔的模式匹配。熱補償系統用 CO₂ 雷射在補償板上投射環狀加熱圖案，並以環形加熱器微調鏡面曲率，把熱透鏡抵消到設計公差內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Advanced Virgo's test masses are fused-silica mirrors 35 cm across, 20 cm thick and 42 kg, hung monolithically from the marionette by fused-silica fibres, with coatings made at LMA in Lyon. Tens to hundreds of kilowatts in the arms, even with coating absorption below 1 ppm, create a temperature gradient at the mirror centre that forms a thermal lens in the input-mirror substrate through dn/dT and changes the surface curvature, spoiling the mode matching of the recycling cavities. The thermal compensation system projects ring-shaped heating patterns from CO₂ lasers onto compensation plates and trims mirror curvature with ring heaters, cancelling the thermal lens to within the design tolerance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The thin-disk thermal-lens focal length is approximately f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，所以熱效應可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With coating absorption under 1 ppm, thermal effects are negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。取熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K、光斑半徑 w = 5 cm、臂內 100 kW 被鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm 得 P_abs = 50 mW：f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m。對邊際穩定的循環腔，18 km 的透鏡已足以改變腔的高斯模態，所以補償必須把等效焦距推到數百 km 以上。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The thin-disk thermal-lens focal length is approximately f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT). With fused silica κ = 1.38 W/(m·K), dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K, spot radius w = 5 cm and P_abs = 50 mW from 100 kW in the arm absorbed at 0.5 ppm by the coating: f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m. For a marginally stable recycling cavity an 18 km lens already changes the cavity's Gaussian mode, so compensation must push the effective focal length beyond several hundred kilometres. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化；開啟熱補償後確認殘餘光程差低於數十奈米，並以循環腔的高階模態含量（由相機看模式形狀）與循環增益回升來佐證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the optical-path-difference map of the thermal lens through the input mirror with a Hartmann wavefront sensor, logging the curvature change as power rises; after enabling thermal compensation confirm that the residual optical path is below tens of nanometres, supported by the higher-order-mode content of the recycling cavity (mode shape on a camera) and the recovery of recycling gain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。取熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K、光斑半徑 w = 5 cm、臂內 100 kW 被鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm 得 P_abs = 50 mW：f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m。對邊際穩定的循環腔，18 km 的透鏡已足以改變腔的高斯模態，所以補償必須把等效焦距推到數百 km 以上。

steps.instruction: 以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化；開啟熱補償後確認殘餘光程差低於數十奈米，並以循環腔的高階模態含量（由相機看模式形狀）與循環增益回升來佐證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，所以熱效應可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合」與「校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling" and "Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地面的地震波使附近岩土的密度分佈隨時間變化，對測試質量產生直接的重力擾動，這種牛頓雜訊無法用任何機械隔振擋住，只能靠地震計陣列估算並從資料中減除，或把偵測器建在地下。對 Virgo 而言，牛頓雜訊在 10–20 Hz 與懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊同為低頻的邊界；此外散射光從真空管壁或擋板回到主光束會以非線性方式注入相位雜訊，磁場起伏則透過致動器磁鐵耦合，這些環境項都要以感測器陣列監測並計算耦合係數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seismic waves make the density distribution of nearby soil and rock vary in time, which perturbs the test masses gravitationally; this Newtonian noise cannot be blocked by any mechanical isolation and can only be estimated with seismometer arrays and subtracted from the data, or avoided by going underground. For Virgo, Newtonian noise at 10–20 Hz shares the low-frequency boundary with suspension thermal and control noise; in addition, light scattered from tube walls or baffles that returns into the main beam injects phase noise nonlinearly, and magnetic-field fluctuations couple through the actuator magnets, so each environmental term is monitored with sensor arrays and assigned a measured coupling coefficient. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。取 ρ = 1800 kg/m³、G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹ 得 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²；f = 10 Hz 時 (2πf)² ≈ 3950，地面位移 ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz：h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz；f = 20 Hz、ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ 時約 1×10⁻²³/√Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1. With ρ = 1800 kg/m³ and G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹, 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²; at f = 10 Hz, (2πf)² ≈ 3950 and ground displacement ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz give h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz; at f = 20 Hz with ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ it is about 1×10⁻²³/√Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在末端站周圍布設數十台地震計，量地震波的相干長度與傳播方向，用維納濾波從應變資料中估算可減除的牛頓雜訊比例；散射光則以人為搖晃擋板或真空管區段的方式注入，觀察應變譜中出現的拱形特徵並算出耦合係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deploy tens of seismometers around the end stations, measure the coherence length and propagation direction of seismic waves and use Wiener filtering to estimate the fraction of Newtonian noise that can be subtracted from the strain data; for scattered light, shake a baffle or a tube section deliberately, watch the arch-shaped features that appear in the strain spectrum and compute the coupling coefficient.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.explanationEn: An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在末端站周圍布設數十台地震計，量地震波的相干長度與傳播方向，用維納濾波從應變資料中估算可減除的牛頓雜訊比例；散射光則以人為搖晃擋板或真空管區段的方式注入，觀察應變譜中出現的拱形特徵並算出耦合係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deploy tens of seismometers around the end stations, measure the coherence length and propagation direction of seismic waves and use Wiener filtering to estimate the fraction of Newtonian noise that can be subtracted from the strain data; for scattered light, shake a baffle or a tube section deliberately, watch the arch-shaped features that appear in the strain spectrum and compute the coupling coefficient. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：末端站附近的機房風扇或鄰近道路產生 10–20 Hz 的地面振動，透過牛頓耦合與散射光同時進入資料，而且兩者耦合係數隨鏡子位置變化；若只依賴單一地震計做減除，剩餘的非穩態雜訊會產生假的短暫訊號。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Fans in an equipment room or traffic on a nearby road produce 10–20 Hz ground vibration that enters the data through Newtonian coupling and scattered light at once, with coupling coefficients that change with mirror position; relying on a single seismometer for subtraction leaves non-stationary residuals that mimic short transient signals.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 末端站附近的機房風扇或鄰近道路產生 10–20 Hz 的地面振動，透過牛頓耦合與散射光同時進入資料，而且兩者耦合係數隨鏡子位置變化；若只依賴單一地震計做減除，剩餘的非穩態雜訊會產生假的短暫訊號。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Fans in an equipment room or traffic on a nearby road produce 10–20 Hz ground vibration that enters the data through Newtonian coupling and scattered light at once, with coupling coefficients that change with mirror position; relying on a single seismometer for subtraction leaves non-stationary residuals that mimic short transient signals. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對 Virgo 而言，牛頓雜訊在 10–20 Hz 與懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊同為低頻的邊界；此外散射光從真空管壁或擋板回到主光束會以非線性方式注入相位雜訊，磁場起伏則透過致動器磁鐵耦合，這些環境項都要以感測器陣列監測並計算耦合係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For Virgo, Newtonian noise at 10–20 Hz shares the low-frequency boundary with suspension thermal and control noise; in addition, light scattered from tube walls or baffles that returns into the main beam injects phase noise nonlinearly, and magnetic-field fluctuations couple through the actuator magnets, so each environmental term is monitored with sensor arrays and assigned a measured coupling coefficient.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「牛頓校正器轉子」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Newtonian-calibrator rotor” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 除了以輻射壓推動末端鏡的光子校正器，還發展牛頓校正器（NCal）：在末端鏡外數公尺處放置內含偏心質量的轉子，以穩定轉速旋轉，對鏡子產生頻率為轉速兩倍的重力作用力，其大小只由質量、幾何與萬有引力常數決定，不經過任何光學或電子鏈路，是與光子校正器完全獨立的絕對刻度。兩種校正器注入不同頻率的連續校正線，離線分析用它們追蹤讀出鏈增益並給出應變資料的振幅、相位與時間不確定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「牛頓校正器轉子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Besides a photon calibrator that pushes the end mirror with radiation pressure, Virgo developed the Newtonian calibrator (NCal): a rotor containing eccentric masses placed a few metres from the end mirror spins at a stable rate and exerts on the mirror a gravitational force at twice the rotation frequency, whose magnitude depends only on mass, geometry and the gravitational constant and passes through no optical or electronic chain, giving an absolute scale fully independent of the photon calibrator. The two calibrators inject continuous lines at different frequencies, which offline analysis uses to track readout gain and to state the amplitude, phase and timing uncertainty of the strain data. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Newtonian-calibrator rotor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重力太弱，不可能用它來校正干涉儀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gravity is far too weak to calibrate an interferometer with." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「牛頓校正器轉子」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Newtonian-calibrator rotor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The two calibrators inject continuous lines at different frequencies, which offline analysis uses to track readout gain and to state the amplitude, phase and timing uncertainty of the strain data.

steps.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牛頓校正器轉子」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Newtonian-calibrator rotor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。取 M = 42 kg、m = 1 kg、r = 0.1 m、d = 1.7 m：F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N。轉速 18 Hz 時力的頻率 36 Hz，鏡子位移 x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m，應變 h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹，比 36 Hz 處的雜訊高一個數量級以上，可做為清楚的校正線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴. With M = 42 kg, m = 1 kg, r = 0.1 m and d = 1.7 m: F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N. At 18 Hz rotation the force is at 36 Hz, the mirror moves x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m and the strain is h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹, more than an order of magnitude above the noise at 36 Hz, a clear calibration line. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時以光子校正器與牛頓校正器在相近頻率注入，比較兩者推得的應變振幅，差異應在 2% 內；改變轉子到鏡子的距離 d 並確認訊號按 d⁻⁴ 變化，再以多個轉速驗證頻率響應與自由質量模型一致，最後把兩套校正的不確定度寫入校正報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject with the photon and Newtonian calibrators at nearby frequencies at the same time and compare the strain amplitudes each implies, which should agree within 2%; change the rotor-to-mirror distance d and confirm the signal scales as d⁻⁴, then verify at several rotation speeds that the frequency response follows the free-mass model, and record the uncertainties of both calibrations in the calibration report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。取 M = 42 kg、m = 1 kg、r = 0.1 m、d = 1.7 m：F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N。轉速 18 Hz 時力的頻率 36 Hz，鏡子位移 x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m，應變 h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹，比 36 Hz 處的雜訊高一個數量級以上，可做為清楚的校正線。
knowledge.textEn: Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴. With M = 42 kg, m = 1 kg, r = 0.1 m and d = 1.7 m: F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N. At 18 Hz rotation the force is at 36 Hz, the mirror moves x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m and the strain is h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹, more than an order of magnitude above the noise at 36 Hz, a clear calibration line.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator", which statement holds?
options: 臂長 3 km 與 4 km 的差別只是場地大小，與靈敏度無關。
量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。
倒立擺越高越好，因為擺越長共振頻率越低。
optionsEn: The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity.
Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴.
A taller inverted pendulum is always better because a longer pendulum has a lower resonance.
quiz.explanation: 量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「牛頓校正器轉子」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Newtonian-calibrator rotor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 同時以光子校正器與牛頓校正器在相近頻率注入，比較兩者推得的應變振幅，差異應在 2% 內；改變轉子到鏡子的距離 d 並確認訊號按 d⁻⁴ 變化，再以多個轉速驗證頻率響應與自由質量模型一致，最後把兩套校正的不確定度寫入校正報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject with the photon and Newtonian calibrators at nearby frequencies at the same time and compare the strain amplitudes each implies, which should agree within 2%; change the rotor-to-mirror distance d and confirm the signal scales as d⁻⁴, then verify at several rotation speeds that the frequency response follows the free-mass model, and record the uncertainties of both calibrations in the calibration report. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：轉子安裝位置量錯 2 cm（d 從 1.70 m 變成 1.72 m）會讓預期力偏差約 5%，若無人復核幾何量測，整個運行的應變刻度帶有同樣的系統誤差，事件的光度距離估計跟著偏差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A rotor position measured 2 cm wrong (d of 1.72 m instead of 1.70 m) biases the expected force by about 5%; without a second check of the geometry, the strain scale of the whole run carries the same systematic error and the luminosity distances of events are biased with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時以光子校正器與牛頓校正器在相近頻率注入，比較兩者推得的應變振幅，差異應在 2% 內；改變轉子到鏡子的距離 d 並確認訊號按 d⁻⁴ 變化，再以多個轉速驗證頻率響應與自由質量模型一致，最後把兩套校正的不確定度寫入校正報告。
knowledge.textEn: Inject with the photon and Newtonian calibrators at nearby frequencies at the same time and compare the strain amplitudes each implies, which should agree within 2%; change the rotor-to-mirror distance d and confirm the signal scales as d⁻⁴, then verify at several rotation speeds that the frequency response follows the free-mass model, and record the uncertainties of both calibrations in the calibration report.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，所以熱效應可以忽略。
同時以光子校正器與牛頓校正器在相近頻率注入，比較兩者推得的應變振幅，差異應在 2% 內。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
With coating absorption under 1 ppm, thermal effects are negligible.
Inject with the photon and Newtonian calibrators at nearby frequencies at the same time and compare the strain amplitudes each implies, which should agree within 2%.
quiz.explanation: 同時以光子校正器與牛頓校正器在相近頻率注入，比較兩者推得的應變振幅，差異應在 2% 內；改變轉子到鏡子的距離 d 並確認訊號按 d⁻⁴ 變化，再以多個轉速驗證頻率響應與自由質量模型一致，最後把兩套校正的不確定度寫入校正報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inject with the photon and Newtonian calibrators at nearby frequencies at the same time and compare the strain amplitudes each implies, which should agree within 2%; change the rotor-to-mirror distance d and confirm the signal scales as d⁻⁴, then verify at several rotation speeds that the frequency response follows the free-mass model, and record the uncertainties of both calibrations in the calibration report. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「牛頓校正器轉子」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Newtonian-calibrator rotor” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 轉子安裝位置量錯 2 cm（d 從 1.70 m 變成 1.72 m）會讓預期力偏差約 5%，若無人復核幾何量測，整個運行的應變刻度帶有同樣的系統誤差，事件的光度距離估計跟著偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A rotor position measured 2 cm wrong (d of 1.72 m instead of 1.70 m) biases the expected force by about 5%; without a second check of the geometry, the strain scale of the whole run carries the same systematic error and the luminosity distances of events are biased with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩種校正器注入不同頻率的連續校正線，離線分析用它們追蹤讀出鏈增益並給出應變資料的振幅、相位與時間不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The two calibrators inject continuous lines at different frequencies, which offline analysis uses to track readout gain and to state the amplitude, phase and timing uncertainty of the strain data.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重力太弱，不可能用它來校正干涉儀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gravity is far too weak to calibrate an interferometer with." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 轉子安裝位置量錯 2 cm（d 從 1.70 m 變成 1.72 m）會讓預期力偏差約 5%，若無人復核幾何量測，整個運行的應變刻度帶有同樣的系統誤差，事件的光度距離估計跟著偏差。
knowledge.textEn: A rotor position measured 2 cm wrong (d of 1.72 m instead of 1.70 m) biases the expected force by about 5%; without a second check of the geometry, the strain scale of the whole run carries the same systematic error and the luminosity distances of events are biased with it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 轉子安裝位置量錯 2 cm（d 從 1.70 m 變成 1.72 m）會讓預期力偏差約 5%，若無人復核幾何量測，整個運行的應變刻度帶有同樣的系統誤差，事件的光度距離估計跟著偏差。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。
optionsEn: A rotor position measured 2 cm wrong (d of 1.72 m instead of 1.70 m) biases the expected force by about 5%.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve.
quiz.explanation: 轉子安裝位置量錯 2 cm（d 從 1.70 m 變成 1.72 m）會讓預期力偏差約 5%，若無人復核幾何量測，整個運行的應變刻度帶有同樣的系統誤差，事件的光度距離估計跟著偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A rotor position measured 2 cm wrong (d of 1.72 m instead of 1.70 m) biases the expected force by about 5%; without a second check of the geometry, the strain scale of the whole run carries the same systematic error and the luminosity distances of events are biased with it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施」與「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure" and "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 的兩條 3 km 真空管直徑 1.2 m，總體積約數千立方公尺，是歐洲最大的超高真空系統之一；管壁經過約 150 °C 的烘烤以釋出氫氣，再由渦輪分子泵、離子泵與管端的低溫捕集器維持 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級的壓力。殘留分子以熱速度穿越光束時，其極化率使局部折射率隨機起伏，造成與分子數密度平方根成正比的相位雜訊；壓力每升高百倍，此雜訊升高十倍，因此真空是靈敏度的直接組成部分，而非只是避免散射的附帶條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Virgo's two 3 km vacuum tubes are 1.2 m in diameter with a total volume of several thousand cubic metres, one of the largest ultra-high-vacuum systems in Europe; the walls were baked at about 150 °C to release hydrogen, and turbomolecular pumps, ion pumps and cryogenic traps at the tube ends hold pressures at the 10⁻⁹ mbar level. Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：殘氣相位雜訊的近似式 S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w)，α 為分子極化率體積、n 為數密度、v₀ 為熱速度、w 為光束半徑。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An approximate residual-gas phase noise is S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w), with α the molecular polarisability volume, n the number density, v₀ the thermal speed and w the beam radius.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施
knowledge.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure
knowledge.text: Virgo 的兩條 3 km 真空管直徑 1.2 m，總體積約數千立方公尺，是歐洲最大的超高真空系統之一；管壁經過約 150 °C 的烘烤以釋出氫氣，再由渦輪分子泵、離子泵與管端的低溫捕集器維持 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級的壓力。殘留分子以熱速度穿越光束時，其極化率使局部折射率隨機起伏，造成與分子數密度平方根成正比的相位雜訊；壓力每升高百倍，此雜訊升高十倍，因此真空是靈敏度的直接組成部分，而非只是避免散射的附帶條件。
knowledge.textEn: Virgo's two 3 km vacuum tubes are 1.2 m in diameter with a total volume of several thousand cubic metres, one of the largest ultra-high-vacuum systems in Europe; the walls were baked at about 150 °C to release hydrogen, and turbomolecular pumps, ion pumps and cryogenic traps at the tube ends hold pressures at the 10⁻⁹ mbar level. Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure" is correct?
options: 真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。
Virgo 的兩條 3 km 真空管直徑 1.2 m，總體積約數千立方公尺，是歐洲最大的超高真空系統之一。
三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。
optionsEn: Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve.
Virgo's two 3 km vacuum tubes are 1.2 m in diameter with a total volume of several thousand cubic metres, one of the largest ultra-high-vacuum systems in Europe.
What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit.
quiz.explanation: Virgo 的兩條 3 km 真空管直徑 1.2 m，總體積約數千立方公尺，是歐洲最大的超高真空系統之一；管壁經過約 150 °C 的烘烤以釋出氫氣，再由渦輪分子泵、離子泵與管端的低溫捕集器維持 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級的壓力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Virgo's two 3 km vacuum tubes are 1.2 m in diameter with a total volume of several thousand cubic metres, one of the largest ultra-high-vacuum systems in Europe; the walls were baked at about 150 °C to release hydrogen, and turbomolecular pumps, ion pumps and cryogenic traps at the tube ends hold pressures at the 10⁻⁹ mbar level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：殘氣相位雜訊的近似式 S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w)，α 為分子極化率體積、n 為數密度、v₀ 為熱速度、w 為光束半徑。H₂ 在 10⁻⁹ mbar（10⁻⁷ Pa、295 K）時 n = p/(kT) ≈ 2.5×10¹³ m⁻³，α ≈ 8×10⁻³¹ m³，v₀ ≈ 1.6×10³ m/s，w = 0.05 m，L = 3000 m：S_x ≈ 4×(5×10⁻³⁰)²×2.5×10¹³×3000/(1.6×10³×0.05) ≈ 1×10⁻⁴³ m²/Hz，√S_x ≈ 3×10⁻²² m/√Hz，h ≈ 1×10⁻²⁵/√Hz；若壓力升到 10⁻⁶ mbar 則乘以 √1000 ≈ 32，達 3×10⁻²⁴，已與設計靈敏度同量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An approximate residual-gas phase noise is S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w), with α the molecular polarisability volume, n the number density, v₀ the thermal speed and w the beam radius. For H₂ at 10⁻⁹ mbar (10⁻⁷ Pa, 295 K), n = p/(kT) ≈ 2.5×10¹³ m⁻³, α ≈ 8×10⁻³¹ m³, v₀ ≈ 1.6×10³ m/s, w = 0.05 m and L = 3000 m: S_x ≈ 4×(5×10⁻³⁰)²×2.5×10¹³×3000/(1.6×10³×0.05) ≈ 1×10⁻⁴³ m²/Hz, so √S_x ≈ 3×10⁻²² m/√Hz and h ≈ 1×10⁻²⁵/√Hz; at 10⁻⁶ mbar multiply by √1000 ≈ 32 to reach 3×10⁻²⁴, already comparable with the design sensitivity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure"?
options: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。
optionsEn: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise.
quiz.explanation: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter. Monitoring only total pressure rather than composition confuses a leak with outgassing and delays the repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：殘留分子以熱速度穿越光束時，其極化率使局部折射率隨機起伏，造成與分子數密度平方根成正比的相位雜訊；壓力每升高百倍，此雜訊升高十倍，因此真空是靈敏度的直接組成部分，而非只是避免散射的附帶條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。

Monitoring only total pressure rather than composition confuses a leak with outgassing and delays the repair.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射。
三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar.
What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit.
quiz.explanation: 一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。2017 年 8 月的雙中子星事件 GW170817 正是因為加入 Virgo 才把定位縮到約 30 平方度，使光學望遠鏡能找到對應的電磁訊號。運行交接因此包含與其他站共享的校正模型、GPS 對時、資料品質旗標與低延遲警報鏈，而不僅是本站的靈敏度紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information. The binary-neutron-star event GW170817 in August 2017 was localised to about 30 square degrees only because Virgo was part of the network, which let optical telescopes find its electromagnetic counterpart. Run handoff therefore includes the calibration model shared with the other sites, GPS timing, data-quality flags and the low-latency alert chain, not only the local sensitivity record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-detector time delays and run handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Three-detector time delays and run handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。2017 年 8 月的雙中子星事件 GW170817 正是因為加入 Virgo 才把定位縮到約 30 平方度，使光學望遠鏡能找到對應的電磁訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information. The binary-neutron-star event GW170817 in August 2017 was localised to about 30 square degrees only because Virgo was part of the network, which let optical telescopes find its electromagnetic counterpart.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。
臂長 3 km 與 4 km 的差別只是場地大小，與靈敏度無關。
Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。
optionsEn: What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit.
The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity.

Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information.
quiz.explanation: Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。Virgo 與漢福德相距約 8000 km（光程約 27 ms），角度精度 σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°；兩條獨立基線使定位區域縮到數平方度到數十平方度，若只有兩站則退化為跨越數百平方度的環帶。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s. Virgo and Hanford are about 8000 km apart (a light-travel time of about 27 ms), so the angular precision is σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°; two independent baselines shrink the sky region to between a few and tens of square degrees, whereas two sites alone leave a ring spanning hundreds of square degrees. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。Virgo 與漢福德相距約 8000 km（光程約 27 ms），角度精度 σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°；兩條獨立基線使定位區域縮到數平方度到數十平方度，若只有兩站則退化為跨越數百平方度的環帶。
knowledge.textEn: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s. Virgo and Hanford are about 8000 km apart (a light-travel time of about 27 ms), so the angular precision is σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°; two independent baselines shrink the sky region to between a few and tens of square degrees, whereas two sites alone leave a ring spanning hundreds of square degrees.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。
倒立擺越高越好，因為擺越長共振頻率越低。
只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。
optionsEn: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s.
A taller inverted pendulum is always better because a longer pendulum has a lower resonance.
Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise.
quiz.explanation: 到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs。
重力太弱，不可能用它來校正干涉儀。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs.
Gravity is far too weak to calibrate an interferometer with.
quiz.explanation: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：運行交接因此包含與其他站共享的校正模型、GPS 對時、資料品質旗標與低延遲警報鏈，而不僅是本站的靈敏度紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Run handoff therefore includes the calibration model shared with the other sites, GPS timing, data-quality flags and the low-latency alert chain, not only the local sensitivity record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。
knowledge.textEn: A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
臂長 3 km 與 4 km 的差別只是場地大小，與靈敏度無關。
某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity.
A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region.
quiz.explanation: 某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡
summary: 以神岡礦山地下超過 200 m 的 KAGRA 為對象，理解它如何用地底低地動與把 22.8 kg 藍寶石測試質量冷到約 20 K 兩個策略壓低雜訊，再把 3 km Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與訊號擷取、藍寶石光學、低溫懸吊導熱、熱連結振動、網路觀測與冷凝污染整合成可交接的觀測站工程。
summaryEn: Taking KAGRA, more than 200 m underground in the Kamioka mine, see how it lowers noise with two strategies, a quiet underground site and 22.8 kg sapphire test masses cooled to about 20 K, then integrate 3 km Fabry–Pérot arms with signal extraction, sapphire optics, cryogenic heat extraction, heat-link vibration, network observing and cryo-contamination into a transferable observatory engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
