steps.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：自由空間損耗 FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB。若某設備在單一 7.63 kHz 通道內洩漏 −60 dBm，經 0 dBi 旁瓣收到 −169.4 dBm；輻射計雜訊 k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) 在 1 s 為 −165.4 dBm、積分 1 小時為 −183.2 dBm，干擾高出 14 dB，足以污染長積分的譜線觀測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB. A device leaking −60 dBm into one 7.63 kHz channel arrives at −169.4 dBm through a 0 dBi sidelobe; radiometer noise k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) is −165.4 dBm in 1 s and −183.2 dBm after 1 hour, so the interference sits 14 dB above it and spoils long spectral-line integrations. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較；逐一開關站內子系統（促動器驅動器、艙內電子、冷頭壓縮機）找出自生干擾；最後依固定順序填寫驗收表：效率、T_sys、指向、增益穩定度與干擾統計，每項附上量測日期、ζ 範圍與允收值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history; switch on-site subsystems on and off one at a time, including actuator drivers, cabin electronics and cryocooler compressors, to find self-generated interference; finally fill the acceptance table in fixed order with efficiency, T_sys, pointing, gain stability and interference statistics, each with measurement date, ζ range and allowance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 自由空間損耗 FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB。若某設備在單一 7.63 kHz 通道內洩漏 −60 dBm，經 0 dBi 旁瓣收到 −169.4 dBm；輻射計雜訊 k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) 在 1 s 為 −165.4 dBm、積分 1 小時為 −183.2 dBm，干擾高出 14 dB，足以污染長積分的譜線觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB. A device leaking −60 dBm into one 7.63 kHz channel arrives at −169.4 dBm through a 0 dBi sidelobe; radiometer noise k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) is −165.4 dBm in 1 s and −183.2 dBm after 1 hour, so the interference sits 14 dB above it and spoils long spectral-line integrations.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。
optionsEn: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB.
The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.
A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.
quiz.explanation: 自由空間損耗 FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較；逐一開關站內子系統（促動器驅動器、艙內電子、冷頭壓縮機）找出自生干擾；最後依固定順序填寫驗收表：效率、T_sys、指向、增益穩定度與干擾統計，每項附上量測日期、ζ 範圍與允收值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history; switch on-site subsystems on and off one at a time, including actuator drivers, cabin electronics and cryocooler compressors, to find self-generated interference; finally fill the acceptance table in fixed order with efficiency, T_sys, pointing, gain stability and interference statistics, each with measurement date, ζ range and allowance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己；L 波段的導航衛星無法被地形與寧靜區擋住，強訊號使 ADC 飽和，該時段整個頻帶都必須剔除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較；逐一開關站內子系統（促動器驅動器、艙內電子、冷頭壓縮機）找出自生干擾；最後依固定順序填寫驗收表：效率、T_sys、指向、增益穩定度與干擾統計，每項附上量測日期、ζ 範圍與允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history; switch on-site subsystems on and off one at a time, including actuator drivers, cabin electronics and cryocooler compressors, to find self-generated interference; finally fill the acceptance table in fixed order with efficiency, T_sys, pointing, gain stability and interference statistics, each with measurement date, ζ range and allowance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較。
相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history.
A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length.
quiz.explanation: 以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較；逐一開關站內子系統（促動器驅動器、艙內電子、冷頭壓縮機）找出自生干擾；最後依固定順序填寫驗收表：效率、T_sys、指向、增益穩定度與干擾統計，每項附上量測日期、ζ 範圍與允收值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history; switch on-site subsystems on and off one at a time, including actuator drivers, cabin electronics and cryocooler compressors, to find self-generated interference; finally fill the acceptance table in fixed order with efficiency, T_sys, pointing, gain stability and interference statistics, each with measurement date, ζ range and allowance. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己；L 波段的導航衛星無法被地形與寧靜區擋住，強訊號使 ADC 飽和，該時段整個頻帶都必須剔除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要包含各波束與天頂角的增益曲線、雜訊二極體校正表、指向模型版本、面形控制狀態與干擾目錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must hold gain curves per beam and zenith angle, noise-diode calibration tables, the pointing-model version, surface-control status and the interference catalogue.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己；L 波段的導航衛星無法被地形與寧靜區擋住，強訊號使 ADC 飽和，該時段整個頻帶都必須剔除。
knowledge.textEn: Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。
兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing.
Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself.
quiz.explanation: 兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己；L 波段的導航衛星無法被地形與寧靜區擋住，強訊號使 ADC 飽和，該時段整個頻帶都必須剔除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 1915 恰納卡萊大橋
summary: 1915 恰納卡萊大橋以 2,023 m 主跨橫跨達達尼爾海峽，2022 年通車，鋼塔高 318 m。本課從垂跨比與塔高的取捨出發，計算 1,960 MPa 級平行鋼絲主纜的斷面，說明在地震帶海床上以乾塢預製、拖航沉放的沉箱作為隔震式基礎，再處理索鞍預偏、87 個橋面節塊吊裝、雙箱梁風洞試驗、吊索力量測、鋼橋面疲勞與伸縮縫交接。
summaryEn: The 1915 Çanakkale Bridge crosses the Dardanelles with a 2,023 m main span and 318 m steel towers, opening in 2022. The course starts from the trade-off between sag ratio and tower height, sizes a parallel-wire cable of 1,960 MPa class wire, explains caissons built in dry dock, towed and set on a seismic seabed as an isolated foundation, then covers saddle presetting, lifting 87 deck blocks, twin-box wind-tunnel testing, hanger-force measurement, steel-deck fatigue and expansion-joint handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 懸索橋巨作與主纜系統

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：主跨 l = 2,023 m，每條主纜承受恆載 w = 137.3 kN/m（兩纜合計 28 t/m），主纜鋼絲面積 A = 0.4749 m²，鋼絲強度 1,960 MPa。方案甲垂跨比 1/8.5：f = 238.0 m，H = w·l²/(8f) = 137.3×2,023²/(8×238.0) ≈ 295 MN，塔頂張力 T = H·√(1+16n²) ≈ 295×1.105 ≈ 326 MN，應力 326/0.4749 ≈ 687 MPa，恆載安全係數約 2.85，塔高約 317 m。方案乙垂跨比 1/10：f = 202.3 m，H ≈ 347 MN，T ≈ 374 MN，應力約 788 MPa，係數約 2.49，塔高約 281 m。降低塔高約 36 m 的代價是主纜張力增加約 15%，若要維持相同安全係數，鋼絲面積須增加約 15%，自重再推高張力。數值為教學假設，不代表 1915 恰納卡萊大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: main span l = 2,023 m, dead load per cable w = 137.3 kN/m (28 t/m for both cables), wire area per cable A = 0.4749 m², wire strength 1,960 MPa. Option A, sag ratio 1/8.5: f = 238.0 m, H = w·l²/(8f) = 137.3×2,023²/(8×238.0) ≈ 295 MN, tower-top tension T = H·√(1+16n²) ≈ 295×1.105 ≈ 326 MN, stress 326/0.4749 ≈ 687 MPa, dead-load safety factor about 2.85, tower about 317 m. Option B, sag ratio 1/10: f = 202.3 m, H ≈ 347 MN, T ≈ 374 MN, stress about 788 MPa, factor about 2.49, tower about 281 m. Cutting about 36 m of tower height costs about 15% more cable tension; keeping the same safety factor needs about 15% more wire, whose weight pushes tension up again. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」與「寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Main span, sag ratio and tower height" and "Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Main span, sag ratio and tower height: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」如何影響1915 恰納卡萊大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” governs force, deformation or durability in “1915 Canakkale Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸索橋的主纜幾何由三個數字綁在一起：主跨、垂度與航道淨空。業主公開的配置為 770 m + 2,023 m + 770 m，鋼塔高 318 m（含頂部砲彈造型裝飾為 334 m），垂直航行淨空 70 m、水平航行淨空 1,600 m。垂度越大，主纜水平張力越小、鋼絲用量越省，但塔必須更高、塔與基礎承受更大的彎矩與風載；垂度越小則塔較矮但主纜更重。2,023 m 這個數字具有建國百年的象徵意義，工程團隊需要在此限制下用垂跨比平衡塔高與纜索張力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main-cable geometry of a suspension bridge ties three numbers together: main span, sag and navigation clearance. The owner's published layout is 770 m + 2,023 m + 770 m, with 318 m steel towers (334 m including the shell-shaped finials), 70 m vertical and 1,600 m horizontal navigation clearance. More sag lowers horizontal cable tension and saves wire, but the towers must be taller and the towers and foundations carry larger moments and wind loads; less sag gives shorter towers but heavier cables. The 2,023 m figure carries the symbolism of the Republic's centenary, so the team had to balance tower height and cable tension through the sag ratio within that constraint. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：塔頂高程 ≈ 跨中橋面高程 + 纜梁最小間距 + 垂度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tower-top level ≈ mid-span deck level + minimum cable-to-girder gap + sag.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔越高越好，因為主纜張力一定會跟著變小，整座橋就越省。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Taller towers are always better because lower cable tension makes the whole bridge cheaper." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sag ratio and 318 m towers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨
knowledge.titleEn: Main span, sag ratio and tower height
knowledge.text: 懸索橋的主纜幾何由三個數字綁在一起：主跨、垂度與航道淨空。業主公開的配置為 770 m + 2,023 m + 770 m，鋼塔高 318 m（含頂部砲彈造型裝飾為 334 m），垂直航行淨空 70 m、水平航行淨空 1,600 m。
knowledge.textEn: The main-cable geometry of a suspension bridge ties three numbers together: main span, sag and navigation clearance. The owner's published layout is 770 m + 2,023 m + 770 m, with 318 m steel towers (334 m including the shell-shaped finials), 70 m vertical and 1,600 m horizontal navigation clearance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塔越高越好，因為主纜張力一定會跟著變小，整座橋就越省。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Taller towers are always better because lower cable tension makes the whole bridge cheaper. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Main span, sag ratio and tower height" is correct?
options: 塔越高越好，因為主纜張力一定會跟著變小，整座橋就越省。
懸索橋的主纜幾何由三個數字綁在一起：主跨、垂度與航道淨空。
橋面中間開口會削弱橋梁，因此對抗風一定不利。
optionsEn: Taller towers are always better because lower cable tension makes the whole bridge cheaper.
The main-cable geometry of a suspension bridge ties three numbers together: main span, sag and navigation clearance.
An opening in the middle of the deck weakens the bridge and must be bad for wind resistance.
quiz.explanation: 懸索橋的主纜幾何由三個數字綁在一起：主跨、垂度與航道淨空。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The main-cable geometry of a suspension bridge ties three numbers together: main span, sag and navigation clearance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Main span, sag ratio and tower height: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塔頂高程 ≈ 跨中橋面高程 + 纜梁最小間距 + 垂度。取橋面 72.8 m、間距 6 m、垂跨比 1/8.5：f = 2,023/8.5 = 238.0 m，塔高約 72.8 + 6 + 238 ≈ 317 m；若改為 1/10，f = 202.3 m，塔高約 281 m，但水平張力 H ∝ 1/n 增加 18%。間距與垂跨比為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tower-top level ≈ mid-span deck level + minimum cable-to-girder gap + sag. With the deck at 72.8 m, a 6 m gap and sag ratio 1/8.5: f = 2,023/8.5 = 238.0 m and the tower is about 72.8 + 6 + 238 ≈ 317 m; at 1/10, f = 202.3 m and the tower is about 281 m, but horizontal tension H ∝ 1/n rises 18%. Gap and sag ratio are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以參數研究比較不同垂跨比下的主纜鋼量、塔鋼量、基礎反力與塔頂風致位移，畫出總造價或總鋼量對垂跨比的曲線；配置定案後，以航道主管機關核准的淨空包絡線檢查最不利溫度與活載下的橋面最低點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a parametric study comparing cable steel, tower steel, foundation reactions and wind-induced tower-top displacement for several sag ratios, plotting total cost or steel against sag ratio; once fixed, check the lowest deck point under the worst temperature and live load against the clearance envelope approved by the navigation authority.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 塔頂高程 ≈ 跨中橋面高程 + 纜梁最小間距 + 垂度。取橋面 72.8 m、間距 6 m、垂跨比 1/8.5：f = 2,023/8.5 = 238.0 m，塔高約 72.8 + 6 + 238 ≈ 317 m；若改為 1/10，f = 202.3 m，塔高約 281 m，但水平張力 H ∝ 1/n 增加 18%。間距與垂跨比為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tower-top level ≈ mid-span deck level + minimum cable-to-girder gap + sag. With the deck at 72.8 m, a 6 m gap and sag ratio 1/8.5: f = 2,023/8.5 = 238.0 m and the tower is about 72.8 + 6 + 238 ≈ 317 m; at 1/10, f = 202.3 m and the tower is about 281 m, but horizontal tension H ∝ 1/n rises 18%. Gap and sag ratio are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Main span, sag ratio and tower height", which statement holds?
options: 基礎在地震中滑動就代表設計失敗。
索鞍在施工期間固定不動，主纜就會自然平衡。
塔頂高程 ≈ 跨中橋面高程 + 纜梁最小間距 + 垂度。
optionsEn: If a foundation slides in an earthquake, the design has failed.
Saddles stay fixed during construction and the cables balance themselves.
Tower-top level ≈ mid-span deck level + minimum cable-to-girder gap + sag.
quiz.explanation: 塔頂高程 ≈ 跨中橋面高程 + 纜梁最小間距 + 垂度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Tower-top level ≈ mid-span deck level + minimum cable-to-girder gap + sag. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Main span, sag ratio and tower height: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以參數研究比較不同垂跨比下的主纜鋼量、塔鋼量、基礎反力與塔頂風致位移，畫出總造價或總鋼量對垂跨比的曲線；配置定案後，以航道主管機關核准的淨空包絡線檢查最不利溫度與活載下的橋面最低點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a parametric study comparing cable steel, tower steel, foundation reactions and wind-induced tower-top displacement for several sag ratios, plotting total cost or steel against sag ratio; once fixed, check the lowest deck point under the worst temperature and live load against the clearance envelope approved by the navigation authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：總體配置階段應保存垂跨比比較表與航道淨空核准文件，並把選定的垂跨比、塔高與溫度假設寫入設計基準書，日後任何線形變更都要回到此基準重新檢核淨空與張力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At the general-arrangement stage keep the sag-ratio comparison table and the navigation clearance approval, and write the chosen sag ratio, tower height and temperature assumptions into the design basis, so any later profile change is re-checked against clearance and tension from that baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以主纜鋼量最省選擇大垂度，塔高與塔底彎矩可能增加到基礎難以承受，也延長塔施工與高空作業時間；反之垂度過小，主纜張力與錨碇規模暴增，錨碇基礎可能成為控制造價的瓶頸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing a large sag only to minimise cable steel can raise tower height and base moment beyond what the foundations can comfortably take and lengthen high-level tower work; too little sag inflates cable tension and anchorage size, making anchorage foundations the cost bottleneck. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以參數研究比較不同垂跨比下的主纜鋼量、塔鋼量、基礎反力與塔頂風致位移，畫出總造價或總鋼量對垂跨比的曲線；配置定案後，以航道主管機關核准的淨空包絡線檢查最不利溫度與活載下的橋面最低點。
knowledge.textEn: Run a parametric study comparing cable steel, tower steel, foundation reactions and wind-induced tower-top displacement for several sag ratios, plotting total cost or steel against sag ratio; once fixed, check the lowest deck point under the worst temperature and live load against the clearance envelope approved by the navigation authority.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 總體配置階段應保存垂跨比比較表與航道淨空核准文件，並把選定的垂跨比、塔高與溫度假設寫入設計基準書，日後任何線形變更都要回到此基準重新檢核淨空與張力。
knowledge.textEn: At the general-arrangement stage keep the sag-ratio comparison table and the navigation clearance approval, and write the chosen sag ratio, tower height and temperature assumptions into the design basis, so any later profile change is re-checked against clearance and tension from that baseline.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Main span, sag ratio and tower height"?
options: 以參數研究比較不同垂跨比下的主纜鋼量、塔鋼量、基礎反力與塔頂風致位移，畫出總造價或總鋼量對垂跨比的曲線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要量到吊索的一個頻率，就能精確算出張力。
optionsEn: Run a parametric study comparing cable steel, tower steel, foundation reactions and wind-induced tower-top displacement for several sag ratios, plotting total cost or steel against sag ratio.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One measured hanger frequency is enough to compute tension precisely.
quiz.explanation: 以參數研究比較不同垂跨比下的主纜鋼量、塔鋼量、基礎反力與塔頂風致位移，畫出總造價或總鋼量對垂跨比的曲線；配置定案後，以航道主管機關核准的淨空包絡線檢查最不利溫度與活載下的橋面最低點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a parametric study comparing cable steel, tower steel, foundation reactions and wind-induced tower-top displacement for several sag ratios, plotting total cost or steel against sag ratio; once fixed, check the lowest deck point under the worst temperature and live load against the clearance envelope approved by the navigation authority. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Main span, sag ratio and tower height: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以主纜鋼量最省選擇大垂度，塔高與塔底彎矩可能增加到基礎難以承受，也延長塔施工與高空作業時間；反之垂度過小，主纜張力與錨碇規模暴增，錨碇基礎可能成為控制造價的瓶頸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing a large sag only to minimise cable steel can raise tower height and base moment beyond what the foundations can comfortably take and lengthen high-level tower work; too little sag inflates cable tension and anchorage size, making anchorage foundations the cost bottleneck. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2,023 m 這個數字具有建國百年的象徵意義，工程團隊需要在此限制下用垂跨比平衡塔高與纜索張力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The 2,023 m figure carries the symbolism of the Republic's centenary, so the team had to balance tower height and cable tension through the sag ratio within that constraint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔越高越好，因為主纜張力一定會跟著變小，整座橋就越省。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Taller towers are always better because lower cable tension makes the whole bridge cheaper." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以主纜鋼量最省選擇大垂度，塔高與塔底彎矩可能增加到基礎難以承受，也延長塔施工與高空作業時間；反之垂度過小，主纜張力與錨碇規模暴增，錨碇基礎可能成為控制造價的瓶頸。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing a large sag only to minimise cable steel can raise tower height and base moment beyond what the foundations can comfortably take and lengthen high-level tower work; too little sag inflates cable tension and anchorage size, making anchorage foundations the cost bottleneck.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Main span, sag ratio and tower height" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只以主纜鋼量最省選擇大垂度，塔高與塔底彎矩可能增加到基礎難以承受，也延長塔施工與高空作業時間。
橋面中間開口會削弱橋梁，因此對抗風一定不利。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Choosing a large sag only to minimise cable steel can raise tower height and base moment beyond what the foundations can comfortably take and lengthen high-level tower work.
An opening in the middle of the deck weakens the bridge and must be bad for wind resistance.
quiz.explanation: 若只以主纜鋼量最省選擇大垂度，塔高與塔底彎矩可能增加到基礎難以承受，也延長塔施工與高空作業時間；反之垂度過小，主纜張力與錨碇規模暴增，錨碇基礎可能成為控制造價的瓶頸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing a large sag only to minimise cable steel can raise tower height and base moment beyond what the foundations can comfortably take and lengthen high-level tower work; too little sag inflates cable tension and anchorage size, making anchorage foundations the cost bottleneck. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「45 m 寬鋼箱梁」如何影響1915 恰納卡萊大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “45 m wide steel deck” governs force, deformation or durability in “1915 Canakkale Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主跨超過 2 km 時，扭轉頻率更低，單一流線形箱梁難以單靠形狀把顫振風速推得夠高。本橋橋面寬約 45 m、最大梁深約 3.5 m，提供雙向六車道與兩側維修走道，鋼箱以約 24 m 間距的橫梁連接，形成中央開口的雙箱斷面。中央開口讓上下表面的壓力在開口處部分平衡，降低驅動扭轉的氣動力矩，是近年超長跨懸索橋常用的顫振對策；代價是橫梁與開口邊緣更容易引發渦流振動，需要導流板或其他細部處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「45 m 寬鋼箱梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Beyond 2 km the torsional frequency falls further and a single streamlined box can hardly push the flutter speed high enough by shape alone. This deck is about 45 m wide and up to about 3.5 m deep, carrying six traffic lanes and maintenance walkways, with steel boxes linked by cross-beams at about 24 m spacing to form a twin-box section with a central opening. The opening partly equalises pressure between upper and lower surfaces, reducing the aerodynamic moment that drives torsion, a common flutter measure on recent super-long suspension spans; the price is that cross-beams and opening edges are more prone to vortex-induced vibration, needing guide vanes or other detailing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “45 m wide steel deck” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：顫振臨界折減風速 V_r = U_F/(f_T·B)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical reduced flutter velocity V_r = U_F/(f_T·B).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋面中間開口會削弱橋梁，因此對抗風一定不利。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An opening in the middle of the deck weakens the bridge and must be bad for wind resistance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「45 m 寬鋼箱梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “45 m wide steel deck”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略
knowledge.titleEn: Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck
knowledge.text: 主跨超過 2 km 時，扭轉頻率更低，單一流線形箱梁難以單靠形狀把顫振風速推得夠高。本橋橋面寬約 45 m、最大梁深約 3.5 m，提供雙向六車道與兩側維修走道，鋼箱以約 24 m 間距的橫梁連接，形成中央開口的雙箱斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Beyond 2 km the torsional frequency falls further and a single streamlined box can hardly push the flutter speed high enough by shape alone. This deck is about 45 m wide and up to about 3.5 m deep, carrying six traffic lanes and maintenance walkways, with steel boxes linked by cross-beams at about 24 m spacing to form a twin-box section with a central opening.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋面中間開口會削弱橋梁，因此對抗風一定不利。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An opening in the middle of the deck weakens the bridge and must be bad for wind resistance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck" is correct?
options: 橋面中間開口會削弱橋梁，因此對抗風一定不利。
只要鋼絲抗拉強度夠高，其他性能指標都不重要。
主跨超過 2 km 時，扭轉頻率更低，單一流線形箱梁難以單靠形狀把顫振風速推得夠高。
optionsEn: An opening in the middle of the deck weakens the bridge and must be bad for wind resistance.
As long as tensile strength is high enough, the wire's other properties do not matter.
Beyond 2 km the torsional frequency falls further and a single streamlined box can hardly push the flutter speed high enough by shape alone.
quiz.explanation: 主跨超過 2 km 時，扭轉頻率更低，單一流線形箱梁難以單靠形狀把顫振風速推得夠高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Beyond 2 km the torsional frequency falls further and a single streamlined box can hardly push the flutter speed high enough by shape alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「45 m 寬鋼箱梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “45 m wide steel deck” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：顫振臨界折減風速 V_r = U_F/(f_T·B)。取 f_T = 0.12 Hz、B = 45 m：若斷面 V_r = 13，U_F = 13×0.12×45 ≈ 70 m/s；中央開口若把 V_r 提高到 15，U_F ≈ 81 m/s，提升約 15%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical reduced flutter velocity V_r = U_F/(f_T·B). With f_T = 0.12 Hz and B = 45 m: a section with V_r = 13 gives U_F = 13×0.12×45 ≈ 70 m/s; if the central opening raises V_r to 15, U_F ≈ 81 m/s, about 15% higher. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較封閉單箱與不同開口寬度的斷面模型，量測氣動導數與渦振鎖定風速範圍；選定斷面後檢查各風攻角的顫振臨界風速與渦振振幅，並以使用性準則（例如行車舒適的加速度限值）評估渦振。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare section models of a closed single box and several opening widths, measuring aerodynamic derivatives and vortex lock-in ranges; for the chosen section check flutter onset at each angle of attack and vortex amplitudes against serviceability criteria such as driver-comfort acceleration limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 顫振臨界折減風速 V_r = U_F/(f_T·B)。取 f_T = 0.12 Hz、B = 45 m：若斷面 V_r = 13，U_F = 13×0.12×45 ≈ 70 m/s；中央開口若把 V_r 提高到 15，U_F ≈ 81 m/s，提升約 15%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Critical reduced flutter velocity V_r = U_F/(f_T·B). With f_T = 0.12 Hz and B = 45 m: a section with V_r = 13 gives U_F = 13×0.12×45 ≈ 70 m/s; if the central opening raises V_r to 15, U_F ≈ 81 m/s, about 15% higher. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck", which statement holds?
options: 顫振臨界折減風速 V_r = U_F/(f_T·B)。
沉箱很重，所以漂浮時一定很穩定，不需要穩性計算。
模型做得越精細，雷諾數差異就不重要。
optionsEn: Critical reduced flutter velocity V_r = U_F/(f_T·B).
A caisson is so heavy that it is always stable afloat and needs no stability check.
If the model is detailed enough, the Reynolds-number mismatch does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 顫振臨界折減風速 V_r = U_F/(f_T·B)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Critical reduced flutter velocity V_r = U_F/(f_T·B). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「45 m 寬鋼箱梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “45 m wide steel deck” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較封閉單箱與不同開口寬度的斷面模型，量測氣動導數與渦振鎖定風速範圍；選定斷面後檢查各風攻角的顫振臨界風速與渦振振幅，並以使用性準則（例如行車舒適的加速度限值）評估渦振。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare section models of a closed single box and several opening widths, measuring aerodynamic derivatives and vortex lock-in ranges; for the chosen section check flutter onset at each angle of attack and vortex amplitudes against serviceability criteria such as driver-comfort acceleration limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：欄杆、隔音牆、維修車軌道等附屬物的形狀與透空率必須在風洞試驗前凍結；施工期間任何附屬物變更都須回送風工程師確認，並在竣工圖中標明經試驗的斷面版本。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Freeze the shape and porosity of railings, screens and gantry rails before wind-tunnel testing; any change during construction goes back to the wind engineer, and the as-built drawings must identify the tested section version.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：開口斷面若未處理橫梁與欄杆細部，中低風速時可能出現持續的豎向渦振，雖不危及強度卻造成用路人不適與疲勞循環；大貝爾特東橋通車後即因箱梁渦振加裝導流板。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If cross-beams and railings on a twin-box section are not detailed, persistent vertical vortex vibration can appear at moderate wind speeds, harmless to strength but uncomfortable for drivers and a source of fatigue cycles; the Great Belt East Bridge had guide vanes added after opening for box-girder vortex vibration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較封閉單箱與不同開口寬度的斷面模型，量測氣動導數與渦振鎖定風速範圍；選定斷面後檢查各風攻角的顫振臨界風速與渦振振幅，並以使用性準則（例如行車舒適的加速度限值）評估渦振。
knowledge.textEn: Compare section models of a closed single box and several opening widths, measuring aerodynamic derivatives and vortex lock-in ranges; for the chosen section check flutter onset at each angle of attack and vortex amplitudes against serviceability criteria such as driver-comfort acceleration limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 欄杆、隔音牆、維修車軌道等附屬物的形狀與透空率必須在風洞試驗前凍結；施工期間任何附屬物變更都須回送風工程師確認，並在竣工圖中標明經試驗的斷面版本。
knowledge.textEn: Freeze the shape and porosity of railings, screens and gantry rails before wind-tunnel testing; any change during construction goes back to the wind engineer, and the as-built drawings must identify the tested section version.

quiz.question: 要驗證「寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較封閉單箱與不同開口寬度的斷面模型，量測氣動導數與渦振鎖定風速範圍。
主跨越長，橋面承受的車輛荷重比例越小，所以鋼橋面不會疲勞。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compare section models of a closed single box and several opening widths, measuring aerodynamic derivatives and vortex lock-in ranges.
The longer the span, the smaller the share of vehicle load, so the steel deck cannot suffer fatigue.
quiz.explanation: 比較封閉單箱與不同開口寬度的斷面模型，量測氣動導數與渦振鎖定風速範圍；選定斷面後檢查各風攻角的顫振臨界風速與渦振振幅，並以使用性準則（例如行車舒適的加速度限值）評估渦振。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare section models of a closed single box and several opening widths, measuring aerodynamic derivatives and vortex lock-in ranges; for the chosen section check flutter onset at each angle of attack and vortex amplitudes against serviceability criteria such as driver-comfort acceleration limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「45 m 寬鋼箱梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “45 m wide steel deck” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 開口斷面若未處理橫梁與欄杆細部，中低風速時可能出現持續的豎向渦振，雖不危及強度卻造成用路人不適與疲勞循環；大貝爾特東橋通車後即因箱梁渦振加裝導流板。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If cross-beams and railings on a twin-box section are not detailed, persistent vertical vortex vibration can appear at moderate wind speeds, harmless to strength but uncomfortable for drivers and a source of fatigue cycles; the Great Belt East Bridge had guide vanes added after opening for box-girder vortex vibration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：中央開口讓上下表面的壓力在開口處部分平衡，降低驅動扭轉的氣動力矩，是近年超長跨懸索橋常用的顫振對策；代價是橫梁與開口邊緣更容易引發渦流振動，需要導流板或其他細部處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The opening partly equalises pressure between upper and lower surfaces, reducing the aerodynamic moment that drives torsion, a common flutter measure on recent super-long suspension spans; the price is that cross-beams and opening edges are more prone to vortex-induced vibration, needing guide vanes or other detailing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋面中間開口會削弱橋梁，因此對抗風一定不利。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An opening in the middle of the deck weakens the bridge and must be bad for wind resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 開口斷面若未處理橫梁與欄杆細部，中低風速時可能出現持續的豎向渦振，雖不危及強度卻造成用路人不適與疲勞循環；大貝爾特東橋通車後即因箱梁渦振加裝導流板。
knowledge.textEn: If cross-beams and railings on a twin-box section are not detailed, persistent vertical vortex vibration can appear at moderate wind speeds, harmless to strength but uncomfortable for drivers and a source of fatigue cycles; the Great Belt East Bridge had guide vanes added after opening for box-girder vortex vibration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要鋼絲抗拉強度夠高，其他性能指標都不重要。
開口斷面若未處理橫梁與欄杆細部，中低風速時可能出現持續的豎向渦振，雖不危及強度卻造成用路人不適與疲勞循環；大貝爾特東橋通車後即因箱梁渦振加裝導流板。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
As long as tensile strength is high enough, the wire's other properties do not matter.

If cross-beams and railings on a twin-box section are not detailed, persistent vertical vortex vibration can appear at moderate wind speeds, harmless to strength but uncomfortable for drivers and a source of fatigue cycles.
quiz.explanation: 開口斷面若未處理橫梁與欄杆細部，中低風速時可能出現持續的豎向渦振，雖不危及強度卻造成用路人不適與疲勞循環；大貝爾特東橋通車後即因箱梁渦振加裝導流板。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If cross-beams and railings on a twin-box section are not detailed, persistent vertical vortex vibration can appear at moderate wind speeds, harmless to strength but uncomfortable for drivers and a source of fatigue cycles; the Great Belt East Bridge had guide vanes added after opening for box-girder vortex vibration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面」與「地震帶上的重力式沉箱」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Main-cable section with 1,960 MPa wire" and "Gravity caissons in a seismic zone": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Main-cable section with 1,960 MPa wire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1,960 MPa 平行鋼絲」如何影響1915 恰納卡萊大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1,960 MPa parallel wire” governs force, deformation or durability in “1915 Canakkale Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主刊物列出主纜鋼絲抗拉強度為 1,960 MPa 級，資料庫記載每條主纜在主跨由 144 股、每股 127 根 5.75 mm 鋼絲組成（邊跨增至 148 股以承受較大張力）。相較明石海峽大橋的約 1,770 MPa 級鋼絲，強度提高約 11%，同一張力所需鋼絲面積與自重都下降，而自重下降又回饋減少張力，這是主跨能超過 2 km 的關鍵之一。代價是鋼絲對缺口、氫脆與疲勞更敏感，對鍍層、製造品管與防蝕的要求同步提高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1,960 MPa 平行鋼絲」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner's publication gives the cable wire strength as the 1,960 MPa class, and a structures database records each main cable in the main span as 144 strands of 127 wires of 5.75 mm (rising to 148 strands in the side spans to carry their higher tension). Compared with the roughly 1,770 MPa class wire of Akashi Kaikyo this is about 11% stronger, so the wire area and self-weight for a given tension fall, and the lower self-weight feeds back into lower tension, one of the keys to exceeding 2 km. The price is greater sensitivity to notches, hydrogen embrittlement and fatigue, raising demands on coating, manufacturing control and corrosion protection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1,960 MPa parallel wire” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wire area π/4×5.75² = 25.97 mm², with 144×127 = 18,288 wires, A ≈ 474,900 mm² and breaking force ≈ 474,900×1,960 ≈ 931 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要鋼絲抗拉強度夠高，其他性能指標都不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as tensile strength is high enough, the wire's other properties do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1,960 MPa 平行鋼絲」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “1,960 MPa parallel wire”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面
knowledge.text: 業主刊物列出主纜鋼絲抗拉強度為 1,960 MPa 級，資料庫記載每條主纜在主跨由 144 股、每股 127 根 5.75 mm 鋼絲組成（邊跨增至 148 股以承受較大張力）。相較明石海峽大橋的約 1,770 MPa 級鋼絲，強度提高約 11%，同一張力所需鋼絲面積與自重都下降，而自重下降又回饋減少張力，這是主跨能超過 2 km 的關鍵之一。
knowledge.textEn: The owner's publication gives the cable wire strength as the 1,960 MPa class, and a structures database records each main cable in the main span as 144 strands of 127 wires of 5.75 mm (rising to 148 strands in the side spans to carry their higher tension). Compared with the roughly 1,770 MPa class wire of Akashi Kaikyo this is about 11% stronger, so the wire area and self-weight for a given tension fall, and the lower self-weight feeds back into lower tension, one of the keys to exceeding 2 km.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要鋼絲抗拉強度夠高，其他性能指標都不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

基礎在地震中滑動就代表設計失敗。
optionsEn: The owner's publication gives the cable wire strength as the 1,960 MPa class, and a structures database records each main cable in the main span as 144 strands of 127 wires of 5.75 mm (rising to 148 strands in the side spans to carry their higher tension).
As long as tensile strength is high enough, the wire's other properties do not matter.
If a foundation slides in an earthquake, the design has failed.

quiz.explanationEn: The owner's publication gives the cable wire strength as the 1,960 MPa class, and a structures database records each main cable in the main span as 144 strands of 127 wires of 5.75 mm (rising to 148 strands in the side spans to carry their higher tension). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Main-cable section with 1,960 MPa wire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1,960 MPa 平行鋼絲」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1,960 MPa parallel wire” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單絲面積 π/4×5.75² = 25.97 mm²，144×127 = 18,288 根，A ≈ 474,900 mm²，破斷力 ≈ 474,900×1,960 ≈ 931 MN。若空隙率 20%，主纜外徑 ≈ √(4×0.594/π) ≈ 0.87 m；鋼絲自重 0.4749×7,850 ≈ 3.73 t/m。改用 1,770 MPa 鋼絲提供同破斷力需面積多約 10.7%。空隙率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wire area π/4×5.75² = 25.97 mm², with 144×127 = 18,288 wires, A ≈ 474,900 mm² and breaking force ≈ 474,900×1,960 ≈ 931 MN. With a 20% void ratio the cable diameter is ≈ √(4×0.594/π) ≈ 0.87 m; wire self-weight is 0.4749×7,850 ≈ 3.73 t/m. Supplying the same force with 1,770 MPa wire needs about 10.7% more area. The void ratio is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼絲規格須涵蓋抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與彎曲試驗、鍍層附著量與均勻性；每股完成後檢查長度標記與錨頭灌注，抽樣做錨頭拉拔與疲勞試驗；架設後以纜徑與周長量測核算空隙率是否在設計範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The wire specification must cover tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and bend tests, coating mass and uniformity; check length marks and socket filling on every strand, sample sockets for pull-out and fatigue tests, and after erection compute void ratio from measured diameter and circumference against the design range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With a 20% void ratio the cable diameter is ≈ √(4×0.594/π) ≈ 0.87 m; wire self-weight is 0.4749×7,850 ≈ 3.73 t/m. Supplying the same force with 1,770 MPa wire needs about 10.7% more area. The void ratio is a teaching assumption.

Wire area π/4×5.75² = 25.97 mm², with 144×127 = 18,288 wires, A ≈ 474,900 mm² and breaking force ≈ 474,900×1,960 ≈ 931 MN.

steps.title: 1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Main-cable section with 1,960 MPa wire: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1,960 MPa 平行鋼絲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1,960 MPa parallel wire” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋼絲規格須涵蓋抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與彎曲試驗、鍍層附著量與均勻性；每股完成後檢查長度標記與錨頭灌注，抽樣做錨頭拉拔與疲勞試驗；架設後以纜徑與周長量測核算空隙率是否在設計範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The wire specification must cover tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and bend tests, coating mass and uniformity; check length marks and socket filling on every strand, sample sockets for pull-out and fatigue tests, and after erection compute void ratio from measured diameter and circumference against the design range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對 1,960 MPa 級鋼絲，採購應要求製程資格試驗、批次追溯與第三方見證，並把延性、扭轉與鍍層試驗的不合格處理流程寫清楚；運輸與牽引機具接觸面須加保護墊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For 1,960 MPa class wire, procurement should require process qualification tests, batch traceability and third-party witnessing, with a written procedure for ductility, torsion or coating test failures; protect every contact surface of transport and hauling equipment with pads.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：超高強度鋼絲若伸長率或扭轉性能不足，會在索鞍或索夾附近的局部彎曲處提早斷絲；鍍層不均或運輸刮傷則讓腐蝕坑成為疲勞與氫脆的起點，斷絲往往在多年後才在內部檢查中發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ultra-high-strength wire with inadequate elongation or torsion performance can break early where it bends locally at saddles or cable bands; uneven coating or transport scratches make corrosion pits the starting point for fatigue and hydrogen embrittlement, and broken wires are often found only years later during internal inspection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Main-cable section with 1,960 MPa wire"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.title: 1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Main-cable section with 1,960 MPa wire: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1,960 MPa 平行鋼絲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “1,960 MPa parallel wire” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 超高強度鋼絲若伸長率或扭轉性能不足，會在索鞍或索夾附近的局部彎曲處提早斷絲；鍍層不均或運輸刮傷則讓腐蝕坑成為疲勞與氫脆的起點，斷絲往往在多年後才在內部檢查中發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ultra-high-strength wire with inadequate elongation or torsion performance can break early where it bends locally at saddles or cable bands; uneven coating or transport scratches make corrosion pits the starting point for fatigue and hydrogen embrittlement, and broken wires are often found only years later during internal inspection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是鋼絲對缺口、氫脆與疲勞更敏感，對鍍層、製造品管與防蝕的要求同步提高。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is greater sensitivity to notches, hydrogen embrittlement and fatigue, raising demands on coating, manufacturing control and corrosion protection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要鋼絲抗拉強度夠高，其他性能指標都不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as tensile strength is high enough, the wire's other properties do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 地震帶上的重力式沉箱：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「隔震式沉箱基礎」如何影響1915 恰納卡萊大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isolated caisson foundation” governs force, deformation or durability in “1915 Canakkale Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 達達尼爾海峽位於北安那托利亞斷層系統附近的地震活躍區，主塔基礎必須在不可預期的地震中保護 318 m 鋼塔。業主刊物指出本橋採用「隔震式基礎」以提高耐震性；這類重力式沉箱放在整平的碎石墊層上而不以樁與岩盤固接，地震時若水平力超過墊層摩擦抗力，沉箱允許少量滑動，等於為傳入塔身的水平力設定上限。設計要同時檢核承載、沉陷、滑動位移與滑動後的殘餘傾斜。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隔震式沉箱基礎」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Dardanelles lie in an active seismic region near the North Anatolian Fault system, and the tower foundations must protect 318 m steel towers in unpredictable earthquakes. Design must check bearing, settlement, sliding displacement and residual tilt after sliding together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Isolated caisson foundation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The owner's publication states that an isolated foundation was used to improve seismic resistance; such gravity caissons rest on a levelled gravel bed rather than being fixed to rock by piles, so if the horizontal force exceeds the bed's friction resistance in an earthquake the caisson may slide slightly, capping the horizontal force passed into the tower.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基礎在地震中滑動就代表設計失敗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a foundation slides in an earthquake, the design has failed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震帶上的重力式沉箱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gravity caissons in a seismic zone" is correct?
options: 基礎在地震中滑動就代表設計失敗。
達達尼爾海峽位於北安那托利亞斷層系統附近的地震活躍區，主塔基礎必須在不可預期的地震中保護 318 m 鋼塔。
沉箱很重，所以漂浮時一定很穩定，不需要穩性計算。
optionsEn: If a foundation slides in an earthquake, the design has failed.
The Dardanelles lie in an active seismic region near the North Anatolian Fault system, and the tower foundations must protect 318 m steel towers in unpredictable earthquakes.
A caisson is so heavy that it is always stable afloat and needs no stability check.
quiz.explanation: 達達尼爾海峽位於北安那托利亞斷層系統附近的地震活躍區，主塔基礎必須在不可預期的地震中保護 318 m 鋼塔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Dardanelles lie in an active seismic region near the North Anatolian Fault system, and the tower foundations must protect 318 m steel towers in unpredictable earthquakes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震帶上的重力式沉箱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gravity caissons in a seismic zone: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔震式沉箱基礎」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Isolated caisson foundation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：滑動上限 H_max = μ·N'。取有效垂直力 N' = 2,000 MN、碎石墊層摩擦係數 μ = 0.6，H_max = 1,200 MN。若沉箱含附加水質量 M = 280,000 t、地表加速度 0.5 g，剛性需求 M·a = 280×10⁶×4.905 ≈ 1,373 MN > 1,200 MN，沉箱會滑動，傳入上部的力被限制在約 1,200 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sliding cap H_max = μ·N'. With effective vertical force N' = 2,000 MN and gravel-bed friction μ = 0.6, H_max = 1,200 MN. For a caisson with added-water mass M = 280,000 t and 0.5 g ground acceleration the rigid demand M·a = 280×10⁶×4.905 ≈ 1,373 MN > 1,200 MN, so the caisson slides and the force passed upward is limited to about 1,200 MN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層與遠域地震紀錄，求滑動位移、轉角與塔頂殘餘位移，與容許值比較；碎石墊層的摩擦係數以大型直剪或現地試驗確認，鋪設後以多音束測深檢查平整度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several near-fault and far-field records to obtain sliding displacement, rotation and residual tower-top offset against allowable values; confirm gravel-bed friction by large direct-shear or field tests, and check bed flatness by multibeam survey after placement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 滑動上限 H_max = μ·N'。取有效垂直力 N' = 2,000 MN、碎石墊層摩擦係數 μ = 0.6，H_max = 1,200 MN。若沉箱含附加水質量 M = 280,000 t、地表加速度 0.5 g，剛性需求 M·a = 280×10⁶×4.905 ≈ 1,373 MN > 1,200 MN，沉箱會滑動，傳入上部的力被限制在約 1,200 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Sliding cap H_max = μ·N'. With effective vertical force N' = 2,000 MN and gravel-bed friction μ = 0.6, H_max = 1,200 MN. For a caisson with added-water mass M = 280,000 t and 0.5 g ground acceleration the rigid demand M·a = 280×10⁶×4.905 ≈ 1,373 MN > 1,200 MN, so the caisson slides and the force passed upward is limited to about 1,200 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地震帶上的重力式沉箱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gravity caissons in a seismic zone", which statement holds?
options: 模型做得越精細，雷諾數差異就不重要。
主跨越長，橋面承受的車輛荷重比例越小，所以鋼橋面不會疲勞。
滑動上限 H_max = μ·N'。
optionsEn: If the model is detailed enough, the Reynolds-number mismatch does not matter.
The longer the span, the smaller the share of vehicle load, so the steel deck cannot suffer fatigue.
Sliding cap H_max = μ·N'.
quiz.explanation: 滑動上限 H_max = μ·N'。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Sliding cap H_max = μ·N'. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地震帶上的重力式沉箱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gravity caissons in a seismic zone: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔震式沉箱基礎」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isolated caisson foundation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層與遠域地震紀錄，求滑動位移、轉角與塔頂殘餘位移，與容許值比較；碎石墊層的摩擦係數以大型直剪或現地試驗確認，鋪設後以多音束測深檢查平整度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several near-fault and far-field records to obtain sliding displacement, rotation and residual tower-top offset against allowable values; confirm gravel-bed friction by large direct-shear or field tests, and check bed flatness by multibeam survey after placement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：墊層材料、級配、鋪設厚度與平整度允差應作為沉箱沉放前的停留點，由設計者與第三方驗證單位共同簽認；營運期應保存基礎座標與傾斜基準，以便地震後快速比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Gravel material, grading, thickness and flatness tolerance should be a hold point before caisson placement, signed jointly by the designer and the independent checker; in service keep foundation coordinate and tilt baselines for rapid post-earthquake comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若墊層摩擦係數被高估，實際滑動門檻偏高，塔身承受比設計更大的地震力；若墊層不平或局部軟弱，沉箱沉放後可能產生初始傾斜，地震滑動時再放大殘餘傾斜，影響主纜幾何與伸縮縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overestimating bed friction raises the real sliding threshold so the tower sees larger seismic forces than designed; an uneven or locally soft bed can give the caisson an initial tilt after placement that grows during seismic sliding, disturbing cable geometry and expansion joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層與遠域地震紀錄，求滑動位移、轉角與塔頂殘餘位移，與容許值比較；碎石墊層的摩擦係數以大型直剪或現地試驗確認，鋪設後以多音束測深檢查平整度。
knowledge.textEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several near-fault and far-field records to obtain sliding displacement, rotation and residual tower-top offset against allowable values; confirm gravel-bed friction by large direct-shear or field tests, and check bed flatness by multibeam survey after placement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 墊層材料、級配、鋪設厚度與平整度允差應作為沉箱沉放前的停留點，由設計者與第三方驗證單位共同簽認；營運期應保存基礎座標與傾斜基準，以便地震後快速比對。
knowledge.textEn: Gravel material, grading, thickness and flatness tolerance should be a hold point before caisson placement, signed jointly by the designer and the independent checker; in service keep foundation coordinate and tilt baselines for rapid post-earthquake comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地震帶上的重力式沉箱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gravity caissons in a seismic zone"?
options: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層與遠域地震紀錄，求滑動位移、轉角與塔頂殘餘位移，與容許值比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
塔越高越好，因為主纜張力一定會跟著變小，整座橋就越省。
optionsEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several near-fault and far-field records to obtain sliding displacement, rotation and residual tower-top offset against allowable values.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Taller towers are always better because lower cable tension makes the whole bridge cheaper.
quiz.explanation: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層與遠域地震紀錄，求滑動位移、轉角與塔頂殘餘位移，與容許值比較；碎石墊層的摩擦係數以大型直剪或現地試驗確認，鋪設後以多音束測深檢查平整度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several near-fault and far-field records to obtain sliding displacement, rotation and residual tower-top offset against allowable values; confirm gravel-bed friction by large direct-shear or field tests, and check bed flatness by multibeam survey after placement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地震帶上的重力式沉箱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gravity caissons in a seismic zone: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔震式沉箱基礎」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Isolated caisson foundation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若墊層摩擦係數被高估，實際滑動門檻偏高，塔身承受比設計更大的地震力；若墊層不平或局部軟弱，沉箱沉放後可能產生初始傾斜，地震滑動時再放大殘餘傾斜，影響主纜幾何與伸縮縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overestimating bed friction raises the real sliding threshold so the tower sees larger seismic forces than designed; an uneven or locally soft bed can give the caisson an initial tilt after placement that grows during seismic sliding, disturbing cable geometry and expansion joints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計要同時檢核承載、沉陷、滑動位移與滑動後的殘餘傾斜。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design must check bearing, settlement, sliding displacement and residual tilt after sliding together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基礎在地震中滑動就代表設計失敗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a foundation slides in an earthquake, the design has failed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若墊層摩擦係數被高估，實際滑動門檻偏高，塔身承受比設計更大的地震力；若墊層不平或局部軟弱，沉箱沉放後可能產生初始傾斜，地震滑動時再放大殘餘傾斜，影響主纜幾何與伸縮縫。
knowledge.textEn: Overestimating bed friction raises the real sliding threshold so the tower sees larger seismic forces than designed; an uneven or locally soft bed can give the caisson an initial tilt after placement that grows during seismic sliding, disturbing cable geometry and expansion joints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地震帶上的重力式沉箱」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gravity caissons in a seismic zone" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若墊層摩擦係數被高估，實際滑動門檻偏高，塔身承受比設計更大的地震力。
沉箱很重，所以漂浮時一定很穩定，不需要穩性計算。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Overestimating bed friction raises the real sliding threshold so the tower sees larger seismic forces than designed.
A caisson is so heavy that it is always stable afloat and needs no stability check.
quiz.explanation: 若墊層摩擦係數被高估，實際滑動門檻偏高，塔身承受比設計更大的地震力；若墊層不平或局部軟弱，沉箱沉放後可能產生初始傾斜，地震滑動時再放大殘餘傾斜，影響主纜幾何與伸縮縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overestimating bed friction raises the real sliding threshold so the tower sees larger seismic forces than designed; an uneven or locally soft bed can give the caisson an initial tilt after placement that grows during seismic sliding, disturbing cable geometry and expansion joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉箱乾塢預製、拖航與沉放」與「橋面節塊吊裝與索鞍預偏」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Caisson casting, towing and immersion" and "Deck-block lifting and saddle presetting": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉箱乾塢預製、拖航與沉放：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Caisson casting, towing and immersion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「乾塢預製與拖航」如何影響1915 恰納卡萊大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dry-dock casting and tow” governs force, deformation or durability in “1915 Canakkale Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主時間軸記載 2019 年 1 月沉箱由乾塢拖往濕塢，同年 4 月與 5 月分別完成歐洲側與亞洲側沉箱上的鋼塔基段安裝。這種流程讓大部分混凝土在乾塢或靠岸位置完成，再以拖船把漂浮沉箱拖到塔位、逐艙灌水沉放到預先整平的墊層上。漂浮期間沉箱必須有足夠穩性抵抗風浪傾覆，沉放時則要控制各艙水位使沉箱水平下降，最後就位誤差通常以公分計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「乾塢預製與拖航」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner's timeline records the caissons being towed from the dry dock to the wet dock in January 2019, with the steel shaft installation on the European and Asian caissons completed in April and May of that year. This sequence completes most concrete in the dry dock or alongside a quay, after which tugs tow the floating caisson to the tower site and it is ballasted compartment by compartment onto the levelled bed. Afloat, the caisson needs enough stability to resist capsizing in wind and waves; during immersion compartment water levels are controlled so it descends level, and final positioning error is usually measured in centimetres. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dry-dock casting and tow” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：吃水 d = W/(ρ_w·A_p)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Draft d = W/(ρ_w·A_p).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉箱很重，所以漂浮時一定很穩定，不需要穩性計算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A caisson is so heavy that it is always stable afloat and needs no stability check." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「乾塢預製與拖航」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dry-dock casting and tow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉箱乾塢預製、拖航與沉放
knowledge.text: 業主時間軸記載 2019 年 1 月沉箱由乾塢拖往濕塢，同年 4 月與 5 月分別完成歐洲側與亞洲側沉箱上的鋼塔基段安裝。這種流程讓大部分混凝土在乾塢或靠岸位置完成，再以拖船把漂浮沉箱拖到塔位、逐艙灌水沉放到預先整平的墊層上。
knowledge.textEn: The owner's timeline records the caissons being towed from the dry dock to the wet dock in January 2019, with the steel shaft installation on the European and Asian caissons completed in April and May of that year. This sequence completes most concrete in the dry dock or alongside a quay, after which tugs tow the floating caisson to the tower site and it is ballasted compartment by compartment onto the levelled bed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沉箱很重，所以漂浮時一定很穩定，不需要穩性計算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A caisson is so heavy that it is always stable afloat and needs no stability check. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉箱乾塢預製、拖航與沉放」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Caisson casting, towing and immersion" is correct?
options: 沉箱很重，所以漂浮時一定很穩定，不需要穩性計算。
索鞍在施工期間固定不動，主纜就會自然平衡。
業主時間軸記載 2019 年 1 月沉箱由乾塢拖往濕塢，同年 4 月與 5 月分別完成歐洲側與亞洲側沉箱上的鋼塔基段安裝。
optionsEn: A caisson is so heavy that it is always stable afloat and needs no stability check.
Saddles stay fixed during construction and the cables balance themselves.

The owner's timeline records the caissons being towed from the dry dock to the wet dock in January 2019, with the steel shaft installation on the European and Asian caissons completed in April and May of that year.
