steps.title: 沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing and pylon climbing formwork: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「32,000 t 塔基沉箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “32,000 t pylon caissons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每節澆置前以全站儀與 GNSS 量測模板位置，並以溫度與日照修正塔柱傾斜；混凝土以試體與溫度計監測強度發展後才爬升；拖航前由海事檢驗確認穩性與氣象，沉放後量測沉箱位置與高程作為塔柱放樣的基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each lift survey formwork position by total station and GNSS, correcting pylon lean for temperature and sun; climb only after cubes and thermocouples confirm strength gain; before towing a marine surveyor confirms stability and weather, and after placement the caisson position and level become the setting-out datum for the legs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：爬模施工計畫要規定量測時段、溫度修正方法、爬升前最低混凝土強度與錨固檢查，作為每一節的停留點，由現場工程師與模板供應商共同簽認後才可爬升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The climbing-form plan must set survey windows, temperature-correction method, minimum concrete strength before climbing and anchor checks as a hold point for every lift, signed jointly by the site engineer and the formwork supplier before climbing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：日照造成塔柱單側受熱彎曲，若在午後量測放樣，誤差會逐節累積成明顯的傾斜；混凝土強度不足時爬升，模板錨固點可能拉脫，造成高空墜落與結構損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sun heating one face bends the pylon, so setting out in the afternoon accumulates error lift by lift into a visible lean; climbing before the concrete is strong enough can pull out formwork anchors, causing falls from height and structural damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每節澆置前以全站儀與 GNSS 量測模板位置，並以溫度與日照修正塔柱傾斜；混凝土以試體與溫度計監測強度發展後才爬升；拖航前由海事檢驗確認穩性與氣象，沉放後量測沉箱位置與高程作為塔柱放樣的基準。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 爬模施工計畫要規定量測時段、溫度修正方法、爬升前最低混凝土強度與錨固檢查，作為每一節的停留點，由現場工程師與模板供應商共同簽認後才可爬升。

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing and pylon climbing formwork: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「32,000 t 塔基沉箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “32,000 t pylon caissons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 日照造成塔柱單側受熱彎曲，若在午後量測放樣，誤差會逐節累積成明顯的傾斜；混凝土強度不足時爬升，模板錨固點可能拉脫，造成高空墜落與結構損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sun heating one face bends the pylon, so setting out in the afternoon accumulates error lift by lift into a visible lean; climbing before the concrete is strong enough can pull out formwork anchors, causing falls from height and structural damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把基礎移到岸上預製，可在受控環境下完成大量混凝土並縮短海上作業；塔柱以爬模施工則把每一段的鋼筋、預埋件與幾何量測變成重複的循環，垂直度與斷面尺寸靠每一節的測量與修正累積控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moving foundations ashore lets large volumes of concrete be cast under controlled conditions and shortens marine work; climbing formwork turns each lift's reinforcement, embedded items and geometry survey into a repeated cycle, with verticality and section size controlled by surveying and correcting every lift.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔柱只要每節都垂直，整座塔就一定垂直。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every lift is vertical, the whole pylon is automatically vertical." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「沉箱拖航與橋塔爬升模板」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Welding each box segment as soon as it is lifted saves time without affecting the structure.

quiz.explanation: 日照造成塔柱單側受熱彎曲，若在午後量測放樣，誤差會逐節累積成明顯的傾斜；混凝土強度不足時爬升，模板錨固點可能拉脫，造成高空墜落與結構損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sun heating one face bends the pylon, so setting out in the afternoon accumulates error lift by lift into a visible lean; climbing before the concrete is strong enough can pull out formwork anchors, causing falls from height and structural damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面節段臨時鉸接」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary deck-segment hinges” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料記載東橋鋼箱梁由法國 Alsthom Sdem 製造組裝，荷蘭 Ballast Nedam 以浮吊吊放節段。懸索橋橋面在架設初期只有部分節段掛上吊索，主纜仍在變形，相鄰節段之間的角度與完工狀態差異很大。因此節段之間通常先以頂部臨時鉸接，底部保持開口，讓節段隨主纜幾何自由轉動；待大部分節段就位、主纜接近完工線形，開口逐漸閉合後才焊接成連續梁。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面節段臨時鉸接」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public records show the East Bridge box sections were fabricated and assembled by Alsthom Sdem of France, and Ballast Nedam of the Netherlands placed them with a floating crane. Early in erection only some segments hang from the hangers and the cables are still deforming, so the angle between neighbouring segments differs greatly from the final state. Segments are therefore usually pinned at the top with the bottom left open, so they rotate freely with the cable geometry; only when most segments are in place and the cable nears its final profile do the gaps close and get welded into a continuous girder. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary deck-segment hinges” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線曲率 κ = 8f/l² 估算局部轉角。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate local rotation from parabolic curvature κ = 8f/l².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼箱梁節段吊上去就立即焊接，可以縮短工期而不影響結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Welding each box segment as soon as it is lifted saves time without affecting the structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面節段臨時鉸接」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Temporary deck-segment hinges”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接
knowledge.text: 公開資料記載東橋鋼箱梁由法國 Alsthom Sdem 製造組裝，荷蘭 Ballast Nedam 以浮吊吊放節段。懸索橋橋面在架設初期只有部分節段掛上吊索，主纜仍在變形，相鄰節段之間的角度與完工狀態差異很大。
knowledge.textEn: Public records show the East Bridge box sections were fabricated and assembled by Alsthom Sdem of France, and Ballast Nedam of the Netherlands placed them with a floating crane. Early in erection only some segments hang from the hangers and the cables are still deforming, so the angle between neighbouring segments differs greatly from the final state.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼箱梁節段吊上去就立即焊接，可以縮短工期而不影響結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Welding each box segment as soon as it is lifted saves time without affecting the structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges" is correct?
options: 公開資料記載東橋鋼箱梁由法國 Alsthom Sdem 製造組裝，荷蘭 Ballast Nedam 以浮吊吊放節段。
鋼箱梁節段吊上去就立即焊接，可以縮短工期而不影響結構。
導流板只是外觀裝飾或擋雨板，拆掉不影響結構。
optionsEn: Public records show the East Bridge box sections were fabricated and assembled by Alsthom Sdem of France, and Ballast Nedam of the Netherlands placed them with a floating crane.
Welding each box segment as soon as it is lifted saves time without affecting the structure.
Guide vanes are cosmetic or rain shields and can be removed without structural effect.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料記載東橋鋼箱梁由法國 Alsthom Sdem 製造組裝，荷蘭 Ballast Nedam 以浮吊吊放節段。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public records show the East Bridge box sections were fabricated and assembled by Alsthom Sdem of France, and Ballast Nedam of the Netherlands placed them with a floating crane. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面節段臨時鉸接」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary deck-segment hinges” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線曲率 κ = 8f/l² 估算局部轉角。取 l = 1,624 m、f = l/9 ≈ 180.4 m：κ ≈ 5.47×10⁻⁴ 1/m；節段長 48 m 時相鄰轉角 θ = 48×κ ≈ 0.026 rad，梁深 4 m 時底部開口約 4×0.026 ≈ 0.105 m（約 105 mm）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate local rotation from parabolic curvature κ = 8f/l². With l = 1,624 m and f = l/9 ≈ 180.4 m: κ ≈ 5.47×10⁻⁴ 1/m; for 48 m segments the angle between neighbours is θ = 48×κ ≈ 0.026 rad, and with a 4 m deep girder the bottom gap is about 4×0.026 ≈ 0.105 m (about 105 mm). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每吊裝一個節段後量測各接縫上下開口、節段高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較；焊接封閉前確認開口已在容許範圍並記錄溫度，焊後以超音波檢測接縫並複測線形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each lift measure top and bottom gaps at every joint, segment levels and cable sag against the stage analysis; before welding confirm gaps are within tolerance and record temperature, then test the welds ultrasonically and re-survey the profile.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以拋物線曲率 κ = 8f/l² 估算局部轉角。取 l = 1,624 m、f = l/9 ≈ 180.4 m：κ ≈ 5.47×10⁻⁴ 1/m；節段長 48 m 時相鄰轉角 θ = 48×κ ≈ 0.026 rad，梁深 4 m 時底部開口約 4×0.026 ≈ 0.105 m（約 105 mm）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate local rotation from parabolic curvature κ = 8f/l². With l = 1,624 m and f = l/9 ≈ 180.4 m: κ ≈ 5.47×10⁻⁴ 1/m; for 48 m segments the angle between neighbours is θ = 48×κ ≈ 0.026 rad, and with a 4 m deep girder the bottom gap is about 4×0.026 ≈ 0.105 m (about 105 mm). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges", which statement holds?
options: 橋梁通車後，撞擊風險就固定不變，不需要再評估。
以拋物線曲率 κ = 8f/l² 估算局部轉角。
大型懸索橋的橋塔很粗，船撞上去也不會有問題。
optionsEn: Once a bridge opens, its collision risk is fixed and needs no reassessment.
Estimate local rotation from parabolic curvature κ = 8f/l².
Large suspension-bridge pylons are so massive that a ship strike cannot matter.
quiz.explanation: 以拋物線曲率 κ = 8f/l² 估算局部轉角。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate local rotation from parabolic curvature κ = 8f/l². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面節段臨時鉸接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary deck-segment hinges” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每吊裝一個節段後量測各接縫上下開口、節段高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較；焊接封閉前確認開口已在容許範圍並記錄溫度，焊後以超音波檢測接縫並複測線形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each lift measure top and bottom gaps at every joint, segment levels and cable sag against the stage analysis; before welding confirm gaps are within tolerance and record temperature, then test the welds ultrasonically and re-survey the profile. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：架設手冊應列出每一階段允許焊接的接縫、臨時鉸接件的設計風速與檢查頻率，以及停工風速；焊接封閉的順序須由設計者依施工階段分析核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection manual should list which joints may be welded at each stage, the design wind speed and inspection frequency of temporary hinges, and the stop-work wind speed; the welding closure sequence must be approved by the designer from the stage analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在主纜尚未接近完工線形時就提早焊接，後續吊裝會在已焊接頭產生強迫彎矩，可能使焊道或腹板開裂；臨時鉸接件強度不足時，強風中的節段擺動可能使接頭損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding before the cable nears its final profile forces bending into finished joints during later lifts and can crack welds or webs; undersized temporary hinges can be damaged as segments swing in strong wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每吊裝一個節段後量測各接縫上下開口、節段高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較；焊接封閉前確認開口已在容許範圍並記錄溫度，焊後以超音波檢測接縫並複測線形。
knowledge.textEn: After each lift measure top and bottom gaps at every joint, segment levels and cable sag against the stage analysis; before welding confirm gaps are within tolerance and record temperature, then test the welds ultrasonically and re-survey the profile.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 架設手冊應列出每一階段允許焊接的接縫、臨時鉸接件的設計風速與檢查頻率，以及停工風速；焊接封閉的順序須由設計者依施工階段分析核准。
knowledge.textEn: The erection manual should list which joints may be welded at each stage, the design wind speed and inspection frequency of temporary hinges, and the stop-work wind speed; the welding closure sequence must be approved by the designer from the stage analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
主纜直徑越粗代表鋼絲越多，空隙率不影響性能。
每吊裝一個節段後量測各接縫上下開口、節段高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較；焊接封閉前確認開口已在容許範圍並記錄溫度，焊後以超音波檢測接縫並複測線形。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A fatter cable just means more wire; void ratio does not affect performance.
After each lift measure top and bottom gaps at every joint, segment levels and cable sag against the stage analysis.
quiz.explanation: 每吊裝一個節段後量測各接縫上下開口、節段高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較；焊接封閉前確認開口已在容許範圍並記錄溫度，焊後以超音波檢測接縫並複測線形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each lift measure top and bottom gaps at every joint, segment levels and cable sag against the stage analysis; before welding confirm gaps are within tolerance and record temperature, then test the welds ultrasonically and re-survey the profile. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面節段臨時鉸接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary deck-segment hinges” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在主纜尚未接近完工線形時就提早焊接，後續吊裝會在已焊接頭產生強迫彎矩，可能使焊道或腹板開裂；臨時鉸接件強度不足時，強風中的節段擺動可能使接頭損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding before the cable nears its final profile forces bending into finished joints during later lifts and can crack welds or webs; undersized temporary hinges can be damaged as segments swing in strong wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此節段之間通常先以頂部臨時鉸接，底部保持開口，讓節段隨主纜幾何自由轉動；待大部分節段就位、主纜接近完工線形，開口逐漸閉合後才焊接成連續梁。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Segments are therefore usually pinned at the top with the bottom left open, so they rotate freely with the cable geometry; only when most segments are in place and the cable nears its final profile do the gaps close and get welded into a continuous girder.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼箱梁節段吊上去就立即焊接，可以縮短工期而不影響結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Welding each box segment as soon as it is lifted saves time without affecting the structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在主纜尚未接近完工線形時就提早焊接，後續吊裝會在已焊接頭產生強迫彎矩，可能使焊道或腹板開裂；臨時鉸接件強度不足時，強風中的節段擺動可能使接頭損壞。
knowledge.textEn: Welding before the cable nears its final profile forces bending into finished joints during later lifts and can crack welds or webs; undersized temporary hinges can be damaged as segments swing in strong wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼箱梁吊裝與臨時鉸接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Box-girder lifting and temporary hinges" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若在主纜尚未接近完工線形時就提早焊接，後續吊裝會在已焊接頭產生強迫彎矩，可能使焊道或腹板開裂；臨時鉸接件強度不足時，強風中的節段擺動可能使接頭損壞。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
導流板只是外觀裝飾或擋雨板，拆掉不影響結構。
optionsEn: Welding before the cable nears its final profile forces bending into finished joints during later lifts and can crack welds or webs.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

quiz.explanationEn: Welding before the cable nears its final profile forces bending into finished joints during later lifts and can crack welds or webs; undersized temporary hinges can be damaged as segments swing in strong wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」與「主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance" and "Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導流板效果與舒適度驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「導流板減振驗證」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Guide-vane verification” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 導流板是裝在箱梁下緣轉角附近的細長板，改變流經下緣的流線，延遲或打散規則的渦流脫落，降低豎向渦振的驅動力，而不需要增加質量或阻尼器。它的效果高度依賴位置、角度與與梁面的間隙，因此必須在風洞中比較多種配置，再以實橋監測確認。驗收的對象不是應力，而是用路人感受到的豎向加速度與長期疲勞循環數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「導流板減振驗證」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Guide vanes are slender plates mounted near the lower corners of the box that redirect flow past the bottom edge, delaying or breaking up regular vortex shedding and reducing the forcing of vertical vortex vibration without adding mass or dampers. Their effect depends strongly on position, angle and gap to the girder, so several configurations must be compared in the wind tunnel and then confirmed by monitoring on the bridge. Acceptance targets not stress but the vertical acceleration felt by road users and the long-term number of fatigue cycles. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Guide-vane verification” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導流板只是外觀裝飾或擋雨板，拆掉不影響結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Guide vanes are cosmetic or rain shields and can be removed without structural effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「導流板減振驗證」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Guide-vane verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導流板效果與舒適度驗收
knowledge.text: 導流板是裝在箱梁下緣轉角附近的細長板，改變流經下緣的流線，延遲或打散規則的渦流脫落，降低豎向渦振的驅動力，而不需要增加質量或阻尼器。它的效果高度依賴位置、角度與與梁面的間隙，因此必須在風洞中比較多種配置，再以實橋監測確認。
knowledge.textEn: Guide vanes are slender plates mounted near the lower corners of the box that redirect flow past the bottom edge, delaying or breaking up regular vortex shedding and reducing the forcing of vertical vortex vibration without adding mass or dampers. Their effect depends strongly on position, angle and gap to the girder, so several configurations must be compared in the wind tunnel and then confirmed by monitoring on the bridge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：導流板只是外觀裝飾或擋雨板，拆掉不影響結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Guide vanes are cosmetic or rain shields and can be removed without structural effect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance" is correct?
options: 導流板只是外觀裝飾或擋雨板，拆掉不影響結構。
導流板是裝在箱梁下緣轉角附近的細長板，改變流經下緣的流線，延遲或打散規則的渦流脫落，降低豎向渦振的驅動力，而不需要增加質量或阻尼器。
主纜沒有生鏽就不需要除濕，等出現鏽蝕再處理比較經濟。
optionsEn: Guide vanes are cosmetic or rain shields and can be removed without structural effect.

Guide vanes are slender plates mounted near the lower corners of the box that redirect flow past the bottom edge, delaying or breaking up regular vortex shedding and reducing the forcing of vertical vortex vibration without adding mass or dampers.
If a cable shows no rust there is no need to dehumidify; it is cheaper to wait for corrosion.
quiz.explanation: 導流板是裝在箱梁下緣轉角附近的細長板，改變流經下緣的流線，延遲或打散規則的渦流脫落，降低豎向渦振的驅動力，而不需要增加質量或阻尼器。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Guide vanes are slender plates mounted near the lower corners of the box that redirect flow past the bottom edge, delaying or breaking up regular vortex shedding and reducing the forcing of vertical vortex vibration without adding mass or dampers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導流板效果與舒適度驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導流板減振驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Guide-vane verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。若 f = 0.13 Hz、振幅 A = 0.30 m：a = (0.817)²×0.30 ≈ 0.20 m/s²（約 2% g）；若導流板把振幅降到 0.05 m，a ≈ 0.033 m/s²。Scruton 數 Sc = 2mδ/(ρD²)，m = 16,000 kg/m、δ = 0.031、D = 4 m 時 Sc ≈ 50。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A. With f = 0.13 Hz and amplitude A = 0.30 m: a = (0.817)²×0.30 ≈ 0.20 m/s² (about 2% g); if guide vanes cut the amplitude to 0.05 m, a ≈ 0.033 m/s². The Scruton number Sc = 2mδ/(ρD²) with m = 16,000 kg/m, δ = 0.031 and D = 4 m is about 50. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：風洞中以相同 Scruton 數比較有無導流板及不同間隙、角度的振幅—風速曲線；安裝後在跨中與四分點設置加速度計，統計每一風速區間的最大加速度與振動持續時間，並與舒適度準則和安裝前資料比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the wind tunnel compare amplitude–wind speed curves with and without vanes and at different gaps and angles at the same Scruton number; after installation place accelerometers at mid-span and quarter points, compiling peak acceleration and vibration duration per wind-speed bin against comfort criteria and pre-installation data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。若 f = 0.13 Hz、振幅 A = 0.30 m：a = (0.817)²×0.30 ≈ 0.20 m/s²（約 2% g）；若導流板把振幅降到 0.05 m，a ≈ 0.033 m/s²。Scruton 數 Sc = 2mδ/(ρD²)，m = 16,000 kg/m、δ = 0.031、D = 4 m 時 Sc ≈ 50。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A. With f = 0.13 Hz and amplitude A = 0.30 m: a = (0.817)²×0.30 ≈ 0.20 m/s² (about 2% g); if guide vanes cut the amplitude to 0.05 m, a ≈ 0.033 m/s². The Scruton number Sc = 2mδ/(ρD²) with m = 16,000 kg/m, δ = 0.031 and D = 4 m is about 50. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土橋塔不會生鏽，延壽只需處理鋼主纜與鋼箱梁。
能抵抗顫振的流線形箱梁就不會有任何風致振動。
簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。
optionsEn: Concrete pylons cannot rust, so life extension only concerns the steel cables and box girder.
A streamlined box that resists flutter cannot have any wind-induced vibration.
Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A.
quiz.explanation: 簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 導流板效果與舒適度驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導流板減振驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Guide-vane verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 風洞中以相同 Scruton 數比較有無導流板及不同間隙、角度的振幅—風速曲線；安裝後在跨中與四分點設置加速度計，統計每一風速區間的最大加速度與振動持續時間，並與舒適度準則和安裝前資料比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the wind tunnel compare amplitude–wind speed curves with and without vanes and at different gaps and angles at the same Scruton number; after installation place accelerometers at mid-span and quarter points, compiling peak acceleration and vibration duration per wind-speed bin against comfort criteria and pre-installation data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：導流板應列為結構構件，納入定期檢查清單與竣工圖，標明位置、間隙與允差；任何拆除或修改必須事先取得風工程師核可，並在恢復後複核振動監測資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat guide vanes as structural components on the inspection checklist and as-built drawings, with position, gap and tolerance marked; any removal or modification needs prior approval from the wind engineer, and vibration monitoring data must be reviewed after reinstatement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導流板若安裝位置偏差或支撐鬆脫，效果可能大幅下降甚至引發新的振動；長期腐蝕或被維修作業移除而未恢復，渦振會在數年後重新出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Vanes installed out of position or with loose supports can lose much of their effect or even trigger new vibration; corrosion or removal during maintenance without reinstatement lets vortex vibration return years later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 風洞中以相同 Scruton 數比較有無導流板及不同間隙、角度的振幅—風速曲線；安裝後在跨中與四分點設置加速度計，統計每一風速區間的最大加速度與振動持續時間，並與舒適度準則和安裝前資料比較。
knowledge.textEn: In the wind tunnel compare amplitude–wind speed curves with and without vanes and at different gaps and angles at the same Scruton number; after installation place accelerometers at mid-span and quarter points, compiling peak acceleration and vibration duration per wind-speed bin against comfort criteria and pre-installation data.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 導流板應列為結構構件，納入定期檢查清單與竣工圖，標明位置、間隙與允差；任何拆除或修改必須事先取得風工程師核可，並在恢復後複核振動監測資料。
knowledge.textEn: Treat guide vanes as structural components on the inspection checklist and as-built drawings, with position, gap and tolerance marked; any removal or modification needs prior approval from the wind engineer, and vibration monitoring data must be reviewed after reinstatement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance"?
options: 風洞中以相同 Scruton 數比較有無導流板及不同間隙、角度的振幅—風速曲線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
錨碇只要夠重就好，浮力與主纜上拔分量可以忽略。
optionsEn: In the wind tunnel compare amplitude–wind speed curves with and without vanes and at different gaps and angles at the same Scruton number.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An anchor block just has to be heavy; buoyancy and cable uplift can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 風洞中以相同 Scruton 數比較有無導流板及不同間隙、角度的振幅—風速曲線；安裝後在跨中與四分點設置加速度計，統計每一風速區間的最大加速度與振動持續時間，並與舒適度準則和安裝前資料比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In the wind tunnel compare amplitude–wind speed curves with and without vanes and at different gaps and angles at the same Scruton number; after installation place accelerometers at mid-span and quarter points, compiling peak acceleration and vibration duration per wind-speed bin against comfort criteria and pre-installation data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導流板效果與舒適度驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導流板減振驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Guide-vane verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導流板若安裝位置偏差或支撐鬆脫，效果可能大幅下降甚至引發新的振動；長期腐蝕或被維修作業移除而未恢復，渦振會在數年後重新出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Vanes installed out of position or with loose supports can lose much of their effect or even trigger new vibration; corrosion or removal during maintenance without reinstatement lets vortex vibration return years later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收的對象不是應力，而是用路人感受到的豎向加速度與長期疲勞循環數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance targets not stress but the vertical acceleration felt by road users and the long-term number of fatigue cycles.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「導流板只是外觀裝飾或擋雨板，拆掉不影響結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Guide vanes are cosmetic or rain shields and can be removed without structural effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導流板若安裝位置偏差或支撐鬆脫，效果可能大幅下降甚至引發新的振動；長期腐蝕或被維修作業移除而未恢復，渦振會在數年後重新出現。
knowledge.textEn: Vanes installed out of position or with loose supports can lose much of their effect or even trigger new vibration; corrosion or removal during maintenance without reinstatement lets vortex vibration return years later.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
導流板若安裝位置偏差或支撐鬆脫，效果可能大幅下降甚至引發新的振動；長期腐蝕或被維修作業移除而未恢復，渦振會在數年後重新出現。
主纜沒有生鏽就不需要除濕，等出現鏽蝕再處理比較經濟。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Vanes installed out of position or with loose supports can lose much of their effect or even trigger new vibration.
If a cable shows no rust there is no need to dehumidify; it is cheaper to wait for corrosion.
quiz.explanation: 導流板若安裝位置偏差或支撐鬆脫，效果可能大幅下降甚至引發新的振動；長期腐蝕或被維修作業移除而未恢復，渦振會在數年後重新出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Vanes installed out of position or with loose supports can lose much of their effect or even trigger new vibration; corrosion or removal during maintenance without reinstatement lets vortex vibration return years later. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主纜除濕改造驗收」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 營運單位記載，東橋主纜除濕系統於 2014 年開始安裝、2015 年 9 月完成：主纜外層以 Cableguard 強化彈性體包覆，並在索夾周圍密封，使乾燥空氣能從進氣套筒沿纜內空隙流到排氣套筒。公開資料指出，通車約 15 年時主纜尚未發現鏽蝕，業主仍參考其他橋梁（例如福斯公路橋）的腐蝕教訓，選擇以除濕取代單純重新塗裝。改造成敗取決於包覆與索夾密封的氣密性，因此驗收以壓力與流量試驗為核心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主纜除濕改造驗收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The operator records that the East Bridge cable dehumidification system was installed from 2014 and completed in September 2015: the cables were wrapped in Cableguard reinforced elastomer and sealed around the cable clamps so dry air can flow through the cable voids from inlet sleeves to exhaust sleeves. Public accounts note that no rust had been found after about 15 years in service, yet the owner, drawing on corrosion found on other bridges such as the Forth Road Bridge, chose dehumidification over repainting alone. Success depends on the airtightness of the wrapping and clamp seals, so acceptance centres on pressure and flow tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主纜空隙面積 = 0.541 − 0.424 ≈ 0.117 m²，150 m 區段空隙體積約 17.6 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cable void area = 0.541 − 0.424 ≈ 0.117 m², so a 150 m section holds about 17.6 m³ of voids.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜沒有生鏽就不需要除濕，等出現鏽蝕再處理比較經濟。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a cable shows no rust there is no need to dehumidify; it is cheaper to wait for corrosion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主纜除濕改造驗收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主纜空隙面積 = 0.541 − 0.424 ≈ 0.117 m²，150 m 區段空隙體積約 17.6 m³。壓力衰減試驗中若 10 分鐘內由 3,000 Pa 降到 2,000 Pa，洩漏量 Q ≈ (V/p_a)·Δp/Δt = (17.6/101,325)×1,000/600 ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁴ m³/s，約 17 L/min。允收門檻須事先約定。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cable void area = 0.541 − 0.424 ≈ 0.117 m², so a 150 m section holds about 17.6 m³ of voids. If a pressure-decay test falls from 3,000 Pa to 2,000 Pa in 10 minutes, the leakage Q ≈ (V/p_a)·Δp/Δt = (17.6/101,325)×1,000/600 ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁴ m³/s, about 17 L/min. The acceptance threshold must be agreed in advance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一區段包覆完成後封閉進、排氣口做壓力衰減試驗，必要時以肥皂水或聲波檢漏定位洩漏點；系統啟動後記錄各排氣口的流量、溫度與相對濕度，直到排氣濕度穩定低於目標值，才算完成調試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each section is wrapped, close the inlet and exhaust and run a pressure-decay test, locating leaks with soapy water or acoustic detection where needed; after start-up log flow, temperature and relative humidity at every exhaust until exhaust humidity settles below target before commissioning is complete.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主纜除濕改造驗收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一區段包覆完成後封閉進、排氣口做壓力衰減試驗，必要時以肥皂水或聲波檢漏定位洩漏點；系統啟動後記錄各排氣口的流量、溫度與相對濕度，直到排氣濕度穩定低於目標值，才算完成調試。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each section is wrapped, close the inlet and exhaust and run a pressure-decay test, locating leaks with soapy water or acoustic detection where needed; after start-up log flow, temperature and relative humidity at every exhaust until exhaust humidity settles below target before commissioning is complete. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：除濕改造合約應明定每區段的氣密試驗方法、允收洩漏量、包覆熔接的環境條件與見證程序，並把各區段的調試數據納入資產系統，作為日後偵測劣化的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The dehumidification contract should define the airtightness test per section, allowable leakage, environmental limits for wrap fusion and the witnessing procedure, and put each section's commissioning data into the asset system as the baseline for detecting later deterioration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：索夾邊緣密封不良是最常見的洩漏點，乾燥空氣在第一個索夾就逸出，下游區段仍然潮濕；包覆搭接若在低溫時施作而熔合不足，日後溫度循環下會開裂進水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor seals at cable-clamp edges are the commonest leaks, letting dry air escape at the first clamp while downstream sections stay wet; wrapping laps fused at low temperature without full bonding can crack and admit water under later thermal cycling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每一區段包覆完成後封閉進、排氣口做壓力衰減試驗，必要時以肥皂水或聲波檢漏定位洩漏點；系統啟動後記錄各排氣口的流量、溫度與相對濕度，直到排氣濕度穩定低於目標值，才算完成調試。

knowledge.textEn: The dehumidification contract should define the airtightness test per section, allowable leakage, environmental limits for wrap fusion and the witnessing procedure, and put each section's commissioning data into the asset system as the baseline for detecting later deterioration.

steps.title: 主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主纜除濕改造驗收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dehumidification retrofit acceptance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 索夾邊緣密封不良是最常見的洩漏點，乾燥空氣在第一個索夾就逸出，下游區段仍然潮濕；包覆搭接若在低溫時施作而熔合不足，日後溫度循環下會開裂進水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor seals at cable-clamp edges are the commonest leaks, letting dry air escape at the first clamp while downstream sections stay wet; wrapping laps fused at low temperature without full bonding can crack and admit water under later thermal cycling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改造成敗取決於包覆與索夾密封的氣密性，因此驗收以壓力與流量試驗為核心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Success depends on the airtightness of the wrapping and clamp seals, so acceptance centres on pressure and flow tests.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜沒有生鏽就不需要除濕，等出現鏽蝕再處理比較經濟。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a cable shows no rust there is no need to dehumidify; it is cheaper to wait for corrosion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 索夾邊緣密封不良是最常見的洩漏點，乾燥空氣在第一個索夾就逸出，下游區段仍然潮濕；包覆搭接若在低溫時施作而熔合不足，日後溫度循環下會開裂進水。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜除濕改造的氣密驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Airtightness acceptance of the cable dehumidification retrofit" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

索夾邊緣密封不良是最常見的洩漏點，乾燥空氣在第一個索夾就逸出，下游區段仍然潮濕；包覆搭接若在低溫時施作而熔合不足，日後溫度循環下會開裂進水。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once a bridge opens, its collision risk is fixed and needs no reassessment.
Poor seals at cable-clamp edges are the commonest leaks, letting dry air escape at the first clamp while downstream sections stay wet.
quiz.explanation: 索夾邊緣密封不良是最常見的洩漏點，乾燥空氣在第一個索夾就逸出，下游區段仍然潮濕；包覆搭接若在低溫時施作而熔合不足，日後溫度循環下會開裂進水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor seals at cable-clamp edges are the commonest leaks, letting dry air escape at the first clamp while downstream sections stay wet; wrapping laps fused at low temperature without full bonding can crack and admit water under later thermal cycling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理」與「延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Managing ship-collision risk in operation" and "Life-extension assessment and marine concrete": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Managing ship-collision risk in operation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「船舶監控與偏航風險」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計時的撞擊機率假設會隨船隊、航速與航道使用改變，因此營運期的風險管理與結構本身同樣重要。營運單位設有船舶監控系統，確保大型船舶使用東航道；當船舶偏離航線時，監控中心可以警告、通知海軍或海巡，並在必要時封閉橋梁。1991 年芬蘭曾向國際法院主張 65 m 淨空會妨礙芬蘭建造的鑽探平台通過，此案於 1992 年和解撤回，顯示淨空與航道規則本身就是長期的營運約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「船舶監控與偏航風險」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Collision probabilities assumed at design change with the fleet, ship speeds and channel use, so risk management in operation matters as much as the structure. The operator runs a ship-monitoring system to keep large vessels in the East Channel; when a ship strays, the centre can warn it, alert the navy or coastguard and close the bridge if needed. In 1991 Finland told the International Court of Justice that the 65 m clearance would block drilling rigs built in Finland; the case was settled and withdrawn in 1992, showing that clearance and channel rules are themselves long-term operating constraints. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：年撞擊頻率 F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Annual collision frequency F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁通車後，撞擊風險就固定不變，不需要再評估。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a bridge opens, its collision risk is fixed and needs no reassessment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「船舶監控與偏航風險」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理
knowledge.text: 設計時的撞擊機率假設會隨船隊、航速與航道使用改變，因此營運期的風險管理與結構本身同樣重要。營運單位設有船舶監控系統，確保大型船舶使用東航道；當船舶偏離航線時，監控中心可以警告、通知海軍或海巡，並在必要時封閉橋梁。
knowledge.textEn: Collision probabilities assumed at design change with the fleet, ship speeds and channel use, so risk management in operation matters as much as the structure. The operator runs a ship-monitoring system to keep large vessels in the East Channel; when a ship strays, the centre can warn it, alert the navy or coastguard and close the bridge if needed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁通車後，撞擊風險就固定不變，不需要再評估。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a bridge opens, its collision risk is fixed and needs no reassessment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Managing ship-collision risk in operation" is correct?
options: 設計時的撞擊機率假設會隨船隊、航速與航道使用改變，因此營運期的風險管理與結構本身同樣重要。
橋梁通車後，撞擊風險就固定不變，不需要再評估。
混凝土橋塔不會生鏽，延壽只需處理鋼主纜與鋼箱梁。
optionsEn: Collision probabilities assumed at design change with the fleet, ship speeds and channel use, so risk management in operation matters as much as the structure.
Once a bridge opens, its collision risk is fixed and needs no reassessment.
Concrete pylons cannot rust, so life extension only concerns the steel cables and box girder.
quiz.explanation: 設計時的撞擊機率假設會隨船隊、航速與航道使用改變，因此營運期的風險管理與結構本身同樣重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Collision probabilities assumed at design change with the fleet, ship speeds and channel use, so risk management in operation matters as much as the structure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Managing ship-collision risk in operation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「船舶監控與偏航風險」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：年撞擊頻率 F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F。取 N = 23,750 艘/年、偏航機率 P_A = 1×10⁻⁴、幾何撞擊機率 P_G = 0.01、未能及時攔阻機率 P_F = 0.2：F ≈ 23,750×10⁻⁴×0.01×0.2 ≈ 4.75×10⁻³，回歸期約 210 年；監控若使 P_F 減半，回歸期約 420 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Annual collision frequency F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F. With N = 23,750 ships a year, aberrancy probability P_A = 1×10⁻⁴, geometric probability P_G = 0.01 and failure-to-intervene P_F = 0.2: F ≈ 23,750×10⁻⁴×0.01×0.2 ≈ 4.75×10⁻³, a return period of about 210 years; halving P_F by monitoring gives about 420 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以船舶自動識別系統（AIS）資料更新船型、尺寸與航跡統計，重新計算各構件的撞擊頻率；演練偏航船舶的通報與封橋程序，記錄反應時間，並檢查防撞設施與錨碇外緣的損傷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically update ship type, size and track statistics from AIS data and recompute impact frequency for each element; drill the reporting and bridge-closure procedure for errant ships, recording response times, and inspect fenders and anchor-block edges for damage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 年撞擊頻率 F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F。取 N = 23,750 艘/年、偏航機率 P_A = 1×10⁻⁴、幾何撞擊機率 P_G = 0.01、未能及時攔阻機率 P_F = 0.2：F ≈ 23,750×10⁻⁴×0.01×0.2 ≈ 4.75×10⁻³，回歸期約 210 年；監控若使 P_F 減半，回歸期約 420 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Annual collision frequency F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F. With N = 23,750 ships a year, aberrancy probability P_A = 1×10⁻⁴, geometric probability P_G = 0.01 and failure-to-intervene P_F = 0.2: F ≈ 23,750×10⁻⁴×0.01×0.2 ≈ 4.75×10⁻³, a return period of about 210 years; halving P_F by monitoring gives about 420 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Managing ship-collision risk in operation", which statement holds?
options: 能抵抗顫振的流線形箱梁就不會有任何風致振動。
年撞擊頻率 F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F。
錨碇只要夠重就好，浮力與主纜上拔分量可以忽略。
optionsEn: A streamlined box that resists flutter cannot have any wind-induced vibration.
Annual collision frequency F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F.
An anchor block just has to be heavy; buoyancy and cable uplift can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 年撞擊頻率 F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual collision frequency F = N·P_A·P_G·P_F. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Managing ship-collision risk in operation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「船舶監控與偏航風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以船舶自動識別系統（AIS）資料更新船型、尺寸與航跡統計，重新計算各構件的撞擊頻率；演練偏航船舶的通報與封橋程序，記錄反應時間，並檢查防撞設施與錨碇外緣的損傷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Periodically update ship type, size and track statistics from AIS data and recompute impact frequency for each element; drill the reporting and bridge-closure procedure for errant ships, recording response times, and inspect fenders and anchor-block edges for damage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應把船舶撞擊風險評估列為定期更新的文件，訂出觸發重新評估的條件（例如設計船型以上船舶的通過次數增加），並與海事主管機關簽訂聯合應變程序與演練頻率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should treat the ship-collision risk assessment as a periodically updated document, define triggers for reassessment such as more transits by ships larger than the design vessel, and agree a joint response procedure and drill frequency with the maritime authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若船隊大型化而風險評估多年未更新，實際撞擊能量與頻率可能超出原設計假設；監控中心與海事單位的通報流程不清，則可能在偏航事件中錯失攔阻時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the fleet grows larger while the risk assessment stays unrevised for years, actual impact energy and frequency may exceed design assumptions; unclear reporting between the monitoring centre and maritime agencies can lose the time needed to intercept an errant ship. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期以船舶自動識別系統（AIS）資料更新船型、尺寸與航跡統計，重新計算各構件的撞擊頻率；演練偏航船舶的通報與封橋程序，記錄反應時間，並檢查防撞設施與錨碇外緣的損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Periodically update ship type, size and track statistics from AIS data and recompute impact frequency for each element; drill the reporting and bridge-closure procedure for errant ships, recording response times, and inspect fenders and anchor-block edges for damage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主應把船舶撞擊風險評估列為定期更新的文件，訂出觸發重新評估的條件（例如設計船型以上船舶的通過次數增加），並與海事主管機關簽訂聯合應變程序與演練頻率。
knowledge.textEn: The owner should treat the ship-collision risk assessment as a periodically updated document, define triggers for reassessment such as more transits by ships larger than the design vessel, and agree a joint response procedure and drill frequency with the maritime authority.

quiz.question: 要驗證「營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Managing ship-collision risk in operation"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
鋼箱梁節段吊上去就立即焊接，可以縮短工期而不影響結構。
定期以船舶自動識別系統（AIS）資料更新船型、尺寸與航跡統計，重新計算各構件的撞擊頻率。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Welding each box segment as soon as it is lifted saves time without affecting the structure.
Periodically update ship type, size and track statistics from AIS data and recompute impact frequency for each element.
quiz.explanation: 定期以船舶自動識別系統（AIS）資料更新船型、尺寸與航跡統計，重新計算各構件的撞擊頻率；演練偏航船舶的通報與封橋程序，記錄反應時間，並檢查防撞設施與錨碇外緣的損傷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Periodically update ship type, size and track statistics from AIS data and recompute impact frequency for each element; drill the reporting and bridge-closure procedure for errant ships, recording response times, and inspect fenders and anchor-block edges for damage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Managing ship-collision risk in operation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「船舶監控與偏航風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ship monitoring and aberrancy risk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若船隊大型化而風險評估多年未更新，實際撞擊能量與頻率可能超出原設計假設；監控中心與海事單位的通報流程不清，則可能在偏航事件中錯失攔阻時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the fleet grows larger while the risk assessment stays unrevised for years, actual impact energy and frequency may exceed design assumptions; unclear reporting between the monitoring centre and maritime agencies can lose the time needed to intercept an errant ship. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：1991 年芬蘭曾向國際法院主張 65 m 淨空會妨礙芬蘭建造的鑽探平台通過，此案於 1992 年和解撤回，顯示淨空與航道規則本身就是長期的營運約束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In 1991 Finland told the International Court of Justice that the 65 m clearance would block drilling rigs built in Finland; the case was settled and withdrawn in 1992, showing that clearance and channel rules are themselves long-term operating constraints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁通車後，撞擊風險就固定不變，不需要再評估。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a bridge opens, its collision risk is fixed and needs no reassessment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若船隊大型化而風險評估多年未更新，實際撞擊能量與頻率可能超出原設計假設；監控中心與海事單位的通報流程不清，則可能在偏航事件中錯失攔阻時間。
knowledge.textEn: If the fleet grows larger while the risk assessment stays unrevised for years, actual impact energy and frequency may exceed design assumptions; unclear reporting between the monitoring centre and maritime agencies can lose the time needed to intercept an errant ship.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「營運期的船舶撞擊風險管理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Managing ship-collision risk in operation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若船隊大型化而風險評估多年未更新，實際撞擊能量與頻率可能超出原設計假設；監控中心與海事單位的通報流程不清，則可能在偏航事件中錯失攔阻時間。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
混凝土橋塔不會生鏽，延壽只需處理鋼主纜與鋼箱梁。
optionsEn: If the fleet grows larger while the risk assessment stays unrevised for years, actual impact energy and frequency may exceed design assumptions.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Concrete pylons cannot rust, so life extension only concerns the steel cables and box girder.

steps.title: 延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Life-extension assessment and marine concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「200 年使用年限評估」如何影響大貝爾特東橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “200-year service-life assessment” governs force, deformation or durability in “Great Belt East Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 營運單位公開說明，2020 年 Rambøll 的評估認為大貝爾特橋梁的使用年限可透過最佳化維護、數據與數位工具倍增到 200 年以上，僅計混凝土與鋼材即可避免約 750,000 t 的二氧化碳排放。延壽的關鍵不只是鋼構防蝕，也包括海中橋塔、錨碇與橋墩的混凝土：氯離子從海水滲入保護層，到達鋼筋位置並超過臨界濃度後，鋼筋才開始腐蝕。延壽評估要以實測氯離子剖面、保護層厚度與電化學量測，預測何時需要介入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「200 年使用年限評估」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The operator states that a 2020 assessment by Rambøll found that the Great Belt bridge's service life could be doubled to more than 200 years through optimised maintenance, data and digital tools, avoiding about 750,000 t of CO2 for concrete and steel alone. Life extension depends not only on steel corrosion protection but also on the concrete of marine pylons, anchor blocks and piers: chlorides from seawater penetrate the cover, and reinforcement corrodes only after they reach the bar at more than a critical concentration. The assessment must use measured chloride profiles, cover thickness and electrochemical readings to predict when intervention will be needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “200-year service-life assessment” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土橋塔不會生鏽，延壽只需處理鋼主纜與鋼箱梁。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete pylons cannot rust, so life extension only concerns the steel cables and box girder." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Life-extension assessment and marine concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「200 年使用年限評估」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “200-year service-life assessment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。取 C_s = 0.6%（膠結材重）、D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、保護層 x = 75 mm：100 年 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.112 m，C ≈ 0.6×0.345 ≈ 0.21%；200 年 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.159 m，C ≈ 0.6×0.504 ≈ 0.30%，仍低於假設門檻 0.4%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. With C_s = 0.6% by binder, D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and cover x = 75 mm: at 100 years 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.112 m and C ≈ 0.6×0.345 ≈ 0.21%; at 200 years 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.159 m and C ≈ 0.6×0.504 ≈ 0.30%, still below an assumed 0.4% threshold. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在潮差區、浪濺區與水下區分別鑽取粉末或岩心，量測氯離子剖面並擬合擴散係數與表面濃度；以保護層測定儀抽查保護層厚度，配合半電池電位與電阻率量測，把預測時間與檢測結果寫入資產管理系統，逐年更新。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Drill powder samples or cores in the tidal, splash and submerged zones, measure chloride profiles and fit diffusion coefficient and surface concentration; survey cover with a covermeter alongside half-cell potential and resistivity readings, and enter predictions and results into the asset-management system for annual updating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. With C_s = 0.6% by binder, D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and cover x = 75 mm: at 100 years 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.112 m and C ≈ 0.6×0.345 ≈ 0.21%; at 200 years 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.159 m and C ≈ 0.6×0.504 ≈ 0.30%, still below an assumed 0.4% threshold. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Life-extension assessment and marine concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「200 年使用年限評估」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “200-year service-life assessment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在潮差區、浪濺區與水下區分別鑽取粉末或岩心，量測氯離子剖面並擬合擴散係數與表面濃度；以保護層測定儀抽查保護層厚度，配合半電池電位與電阻率量測，把預測時間與檢測結果寫入資產管理系統，逐年更新。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Drill powder samples or cores in the tidal, splash and submerged zones, measure chloride profiles and fit diffusion coefficient and surface concentration; survey cover with a covermeter alongside half-cell potential and resistivity readings, and enter predictions and results into the asset-management system for annual updating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：延壽計畫應把每類構件的劣化模型、檢測頻率、介入門檻與資料格式寫成可審查的文件，並在每次大型檢測後更新預測；資產管理系統中的紀錄須能追溯到構件編號與檢測位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The life-extension plan should set out deterioration models, inspection frequencies, intervention thresholds and data formats for each element type as a reviewable document, updating predictions after every major inspection; records in the asset system must trace to element numbers and test locations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以設計時的擴散係數預測而不實測，浪濺區的實際氯離子累積可能遠快於假設，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹造成保護層剝落；局部保護層不足的位置會比平均值早數十年出現劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Predicting from design diffusion coefficients without measurement can miss much faster chloride build-up in the splash zone, where corroding bars spall the cover; spots with thin cover deteriorate decades earlier than the average suggests. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 在潮差區、浪濺區與水下區分別鑽取粉末或岩心，量測氯離子剖面並擬合擴散係數與表面濃度；以保護層測定儀抽查保護層厚度，配合半電池電位與電阻率量測，把預測時間與檢測結果寫入資產管理系統，逐年更新。

steps.title: 延壽評估與海洋環境混凝土：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Life-extension assessment and marine concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「200 年使用年限評估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “200-year service-life assessment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以設計時的擴散係數預測而不實測，浪濺區的實際氯離子累積可能遠快於假設，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹造成保護層剝落；局部保護層不足的位置會比平均值早數十年出現劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Predicting from design diffusion coefficients without measurement can miss much faster chloride build-up in the splash zone, where corroding bars spall the cover; spots with thin cover deteriorate decades earlier than the average suggests. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：延壽評估要以實測氯離子剖面、保護層厚度與電化學量測，預測何時需要介入。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete pylons cannot rust, so life extension only concerns the steel cables and box girder." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

若只以設計時的擴散係數預測而不實測，浪濺區的實際氯離子累積可能遠快於假設，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹造成保護層剝落；局部保護層不足的位置會比平均值早數十年出現劣化。
大型懸索橋的橋塔很粗，船撞上去也不會有問題。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Predicting from design diffusion coefficients without measurement can miss much faster chloride build-up in the splash zone, where corroding bars spall the cover.
Large suspension-bridge pylons are so massive that a ship strike cannot matter.
quiz.explanation: 若只以設計時的擴散係數預測而不實測，浪濺區的實際氯離子累積可能遠快於假設，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹造成保護層剝落；局部保護層不足的位置會比平均值早數十年出現劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Predicting from design diffusion coefficients without measurement can miss much faster chloride build-up in the splash zone, where corroding bars spall the cover; spots with thin cover deteriorate decades earlier than the average suggests. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 青馬大橋
summary: 青馬大橋主跨 1,377 m，1997 年通車，上層六線公路、下層兩條鐵路軌道與兩條有遮蔽的車道，是承載鐵路的最長跨徑懸索橋。本課從鐵路對橋面坡度與變位的要求、颱風下的行車安全出發，計算空中紡線主纜的主跨與邊跨鋼絲數差異，說明滑模混凝土塔、96 個橋面模組吊裝、伸縮縫與軌道銜接，再以香港路政署的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS）、交通量與水上淨空管制，說明營運維護。
summaryEn: Tsing Ma Bridge has a 1,377 m main span and opened in 1997, carrying six road lanes above and two rail tracks plus two sheltered carriageways below, the longest-span suspension bridge carrying rail. The course starts from rail demands on deck gradient and deflection and from vehicle safety in typhoons, derives the difference in wire count between main and side spans of the air-spun cables, explains slipformed concrete towers, lifting 96 deck modules, expansion joints and track continuity, then uses the Highways Department's Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS), traffic data and marine air-draft control to explain operation and maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算青馬大橋型懸索橋在公路與鐵路同時加載時的主纜張力增量。假設主跨 l = 1,377 m、垂跨比 1/11（f ≈ 125.2 m），每條主纜主跨鋼絲面積 A ≈ 0.759 m²。公路六車道各 20 kN/m 的 30% 同時作用（36 kN/m），加上兩軌列車各 60 kN/m 的 50%（60 kN/m），總活載 96 kN/m，每纜 48 kN/m。張力增量 ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 48×1,377²/(8×125.2) ≈ 90,900 kN ≈ 91 MN，鋼絲應力增量 ≈ 91/0.759 ≈ 120 N/mm²。若列車改為兩軌全滿（120 kN/m），每纜活載 78 kN/m，ΔH ≈ 148 MN、應力增量約 195 N/mm²，顯示鐵路荷載假設對主纜應力幅與疲勞評估的影響。數值為教學假設，不代表青馬大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the main-cable tension increase on a Tsing Ma type suspension bridge under combined road and rail loading. Assume main span l = 1,377 m, sag ratio 1/11 (f ≈ 125.2 m) and main-span wire area per cable A ≈ 0.759 m². Take 30% of 20 kN/m on each of six road lanes acting together (36 kN/m) plus 50% of 60 kN/m on each of two tracks (60 kN/m), a total live load of 96 kN/m, or 48 kN/m per cable. The tension increase ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 48×1,377²/(8×125.2) ≈ 90,900 kN ≈ 91 MN, a wire stress increase of about 91/0.759 ≈ 120 N/mm². With both tracks fully loaded (120 kN/m) the live load per cable becomes 78 kN/m, ΔH ≈ 148 MN and the stress increase about 195 N/mm², showing how rail-load assumptions drive cable stress range and fatigue assessment. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of Tsing Ma Bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制」與「颱風強風與行車安全」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rail loading and deck deflection limits" and "Typhoon winds and vehicle safety": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail loading and deck deflection limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「下層鐵路軌道坡度」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lower-deck rail gradient” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公路車輛可以容忍懸索橋在活載下數公尺的起伏，鐵路卻對縱坡變化、軌道扭曲與橋端轉角非常敏感，因為列車的懸吊與輪軌接觸需要平順的幾何。青馬大橋把鐵路放在下層、位於加勁梁的剪力中心附近，並以深桁架提供足夠的彎曲與扭轉勁度；但懸索橋的豎向勁度主要仍來自主纜，半跨加載時的反對稱變形最為不利，會在跨內形成一升一降的波形，使局部坡度增加。設計必須把這種變形換算成軌道坡度與豎曲線半徑，與鐵路營運限值比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「下層鐵路軌道坡度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Road vehicles tolerate several metres of live-load movement on a suspension bridge, but rail is very sensitive to gradient change, track twist and end rotation, because train suspension and wheel–rail contact need smooth geometry. Tsing Ma places the railway on the lower deck near the shear centre of the stiffening girder and uses a deep truss for bending and torsional stiffness; yet vertical stiffness still comes mainly from the cables, and half-span loading producing antisymmetric deformation is most adverse, forming a rise and a dip within the span that steepens local gradients. Design must convert this deformation into track gradient and vertical-curve radius and compare them with railway operating limits. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lower-deck rail gradient” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設反對稱變形為正弦半波，半波長 λ = l/2 = 688.5 m、振幅 A = 2.35 m，最大附加坡度 = π·A/λ = π×2.35/688.5 ≈ 0.0107，即約 1.07%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treat the antisymmetric deformation as a sine half-wave with λ = l/2 = 688.5 m and amplitude A = 2.35 m: the maximum added gradient = π·A/λ = π×2.35/688.5 ≈ 0.0107, about 1.07%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸索橋只要強度夠，鐵路就可以像在地面一樣行駛。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a suspension bridge is strong enough, trains can run on it as on the ground." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「下層鐵路軌道坡度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lower-deck rail gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制
knowledge.titleEn: Rail loading and deck deflection limits
knowledge.text: 公路車輛可以容忍懸索橋在活載下數公尺的起伏，鐵路卻對縱坡變化、軌道扭曲與橋端轉角非常敏感，因為列車的懸吊與輪軌接觸需要平順的幾何。青馬大橋把鐵路放在下層、位於加勁梁的剪力中心附近，並以深桁架提供足夠的彎曲與扭轉勁度；但懸索橋的豎向勁度主要仍來自主纜，半跨加載時的反對稱變形最為不利，會在跨內形成一升一降的波形，使局部坡度增加。
knowledge.textEn: Road vehicles tolerate several metres of live-load movement on a suspension bridge, but rail is very sensitive to gradient change, track twist and end rotation, because train suspension and wheel–rail contact need smooth geometry.
