steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pure thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫的行程只要按溫度變化計算就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Expansion-joint travel only needs to be calculated from temperature change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「伸縮縫與鐵路調節器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joints and rail expansion devices”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續
knowledge.text: 懸索橋橋面的縱向位移包括溫度、活載下主纜變形帶動的位移與風、地震造成的移動。資料庫記載青馬大橋伸縮縫的溫度位移約 ±835 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Longitudinal movement of a suspension deck comes from temperature, from cable deformation under live load and from wind and earthquake. A structures database records the thermal movement at Tsing Ma's expansion joints as about ±835 mm.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫的行程只要按溫度變化計算就夠了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Expansion-joint travel only needs to be calculated from temperature change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity" is correct?
options: 懸索橋橋面的縱向位移包括溫度、活載下主纜變形帶動的位移與風、地震造成的移動。
伸縮縫的行程只要按溫度變化計算就夠了。
感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。
optionsEn: Longitudinal movement of a suspension deck comes from temperature, from cable deformation under live load and from wind and earthquake.
Expansion-joint travel only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety.
quiz.explanation: 懸索橋橋面的縱向位移包括溫度、活載下主纜變形帶動的位移與風、地震造成的移動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Longitudinal movement of a suspension deck comes from temperature, from cable deformation under live load and from wind and earthquake. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮縫與鐵路調節器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joints and rail expansion devices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：純溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取等效長度 L = 1,000 m、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、相對於安裝溫度 ±20 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,000×20 = ±0.24 m。與 ±835 mm 比較，可知其餘大部分位移來自活載與風引起的縱向移動，因此不能只用溫度決定裝置行程。L 與 ΔT 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pure thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With an effective length L = 1,000 m, α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C and ±20 °C from the installation temperature: ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,000×20 = ±0.24 m. Compared with about ±835 mm, most of the remaining movement comes from longitudinal motion under live load and wind, so device travel cannot be set from temperature alone. L and ΔT are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前以溫度計量測橋面與鋼構溫度，依預設表計算開口並由監造見證；通車前以列車與車隊試驗量測伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的位移、軌距與高差，並以長期位移計確認位移—溫度關係符合預測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation measure deck and steel temperatures, compute the opening from the preset table and have it witnessed; before opening measure joint and rail-device movement, gauge and level difference under train and vehicle tests, and confirm with long-term displacement transducers that movement follows the predicted temperature relation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 純溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取等效長度 L = 1,000 m、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、相對於安裝溫度 ±20 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,000×20 = ±0.24 m。與 ±835 mm 比較，可知其餘大部分位移來自活載與風引起的縱向移動，因此不能只用溫度決定裝置行程。L 與 ΔT 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Pure thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With an effective length L = 1,000 m, α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C and ±20 °C from the installation temperature: ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,000×20 = ±0.24 m. Compared with about ±835 mm, most of the remaining movement comes from longitudinal motion under live load and wind, so device travel cannot be set from temperature alone. L and ΔT are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity", which statement holds?
options: 疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。
純溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
懸索橋只要強度夠，鐵路就可以像在地面一樣行駛。
optionsEn: Fatigue depends only on the heaviest vehicle, not on how much traffic there is.
Pure thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
If a suspension bridge is strong enough, trains can run on it as on the ground.
quiz.explanation: 純溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Pure thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮縫與鐵路調節器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joints and rail expansion devices” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝前以溫度計量測橋面與鋼構溫度，依預設表計算開口並由監造見證；通車前以列車與車隊試驗量測伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的位移、軌距與高差，並以長期位移計確認位移—溫度關係符合預測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before installation measure deck and steel temperatures, compute the opening from the preset table and have it witnessed; before opening measure joint and rail-device movement, gauge and level difference under train and vehicle tests, and confirm with long-term displacement transducers that movement follows the predicted temperature relation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的安裝程序要由橋梁與鐵路兩方共同簽認，記錄安裝溫度、開口與當時的施工荷重狀態；營運期把兩者的位移資料放在同一監測平台判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The installation procedure for road joints and rail expansion devices should be signed by both bridge and railway parties, recording installation temperature, opening and the construction-load state at the time; in service interpret both sets of movement data on one monitoring platform.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預設開口錯誤時，夏季或強風下裝置頂死，產生大縱向力推動塔與錨碇；鋼軌調節器若位移超出範圍，軌距變化與高差可能導致列車限速甚至停駛。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong preset opening can bottom out the device in summer or strong wind, pushing large longitudinal forces into towers and anchorages; a rail expansion device moving beyond its range can change gauge and level enough to force speed restrictions or stop trains. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝前以溫度計量測橋面與鋼構溫度，依預設表計算開口並由監造見證；通車前以列車與車隊試驗量測伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的位移、軌距與高差，並以長期位移計確認位移—溫度關係符合預測。
knowledge.textEn: Before installation measure deck and steel temperatures, compute the opening from the preset table and have it witnessed; before opening measure joint and rail-device movement, gauge and level difference under train and vehicle tests, and confirm with long-term displacement transducers that movement follows the predicted temperature relation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的安裝程序要由橋梁與鐵路兩方共同簽認，記錄安裝溫度、開口與當時的施工荷重狀態；營運期把兩者的位移資料放在同一監測平台判讀。
knowledge.textEn: The installation procedure for road joints and rail expansion devices should be signed by both bridge and railway parties, recording installation temperature, opening and the construction-load state at the time; in service interpret both sets of movement data on one monitoring platform.

quiz.question: 要驗證「伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
主纜從錨碇到錨碇的鋼絲數一定相同。
安裝前以溫度計量測橋面與鋼構溫度，依預設表計算開口並由監造見證。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A main cable always has the same number of wires from anchorage to anchorage.
Before installation measure deck and steel temperatures, compute the opening from the preset table and have it witnessed.
quiz.explanation: 安裝前以溫度計量測橋面與鋼構溫度，依預設表計算開口並由監造見證；通車前以列車與車隊試驗量測伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的位移、軌距與高差，並以長期位移計確認位移—溫度關係符合預測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before installation measure deck and steel temperatures, compute the opening from the preset table and have it witnessed; before opening measure joint and rail-device movement, gauge and level difference under train and vehicle tests, and confirm with long-term displacement transducers that movement follows the predicted temperature relation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮縫與鐵路調節器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joints and rail expansion devices” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預設開口錯誤時，夏季或強風下裝置頂死，產生大縱向力推動塔與錨碇；鋼軌調節器若位移超出範圍，軌距變化與高差可能導致列車限速甚至停駛。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A wrong preset opening can bottom out the device in summer or strong wind, pushing large longitudinal forces into towers and anchorages; a rail expansion device moving beyond its range can change gauge and level enough to force speed restrictions or stop trains. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：安裝時必須依當時的橋面溫度設定開口，並確認全橋完工荷重已到位，否則溫度與荷重造成的位移會讓裝置在一端提早頂死。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At installation the opening must be set for the deck temperature at the time, and the full completed dead load must already be in place, otherwise thermal and load movement will make the device bottom out early at one end.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫的行程只要按溫度變化計算就夠了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Expansion-joint travel only needs to be calculated from temperature change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預設開口錯誤時，夏季或強風下裝置頂死，產生大縱向力推動塔與錨碇；鋼軌調節器若位移超出範圍，軌距變化與高差可能導致列車限速甚至停駛。
knowledge.textEn: A wrong preset opening can bottom out the device in summer or strong wind, pushing large longitudinal forces into towers and anchorages; a rail expansion device moving beyond its range can change gauge and level enough to force speed restrictions or stop trains.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 預設開口錯誤時，夏季或強風下裝置頂死，產生大縱向力推動塔與錨碇；鋼軌調節器若位移超出範圍，軌距變化與高差可能導致列車限速甚至停駛。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。
optionsEn: A wrong preset opening can bottom out the device in summer or strong wind, pushing large longitudinal forces into towers and anchorages.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety.
quiz.explanation: 預設開口錯誤時，夏季或強風下裝置頂死，產生大縱向力推動塔與錨碇；鋼軌調節器若位移超出範圍，軌距變化與高差可能導致列車限速甚至停駛。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A wrong preset opening can bottom out the device in summer or strong wind, pushing large longitudinal forces into towers and anchorages; a rail expansion device moving beyond its range can change gauge and level enough to force speed restrictions or stop trains. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風與結構健康監測系統的設計」與「以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system" and "Checking buffeting response against typhoon records": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風與結構健康監測系統的設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「WASHMS 感測網」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “WASHMS sensor network” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 香港路政署為策略性長跨橋梁維持一套專用的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS），青馬大橋與汀九橋、汲水門大橋同在其中。系統以風速計量測來流，加速度計、GNSS、位移計、溫度計與應變計記錄橋梁反應，並把資料集中處理。不同感測器各有適用頻帶：GNSS 直接量測位移，適合長週期的大變位；加速度計對高頻敏感，但積分成低頻位移時誤差會快速累積。設計監測系統就是讓每一個要回答的工程問題都有適合的感測器。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「WASHMS 感測網」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hong Kong's Highways Department maintains a dedicated Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS) for strategic long-span bridges, with Tsing Ma alongside Ting Kau and Kap Shui Mun. Anemometers measure incoming wind; accelerometers, GNSS, displacement transducers, thermometers and strain gauges record the bridge's response, and data are processed centrally. Each sensor has its own useful frequency band: GNSS measures displacement directly and suits large long-period movement, while accelerometers are sensitive at high frequency but accumulate error quickly when integrated to low-frequency displacement. Designing a monitoring system means giving each engineering question a suitable sensor. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “WASHMS sensor network” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡諧運動位移 A = a/(2πf)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Harmonic displacement A = a/(2πf)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「WASHMS 感測網」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “WASHMS sensor network”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風與結構健康監測系統的設計
knowledge.titleEn: Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system
knowledge.text: 香港路政署為策略性長跨橋梁維持一套專用的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS），青馬大橋與汀九橋、汲水門大橋同在其中。系統以風速計量測來流，加速度計、GNSS、位移計、溫度計與應變計記錄橋梁反應，並把資料集中處理。
knowledge.textEn: Hong Kong's Highways Department maintains a dedicated Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS) for strategic long-span bridges, with Tsing Ma alongside Ting Kau and Kap Shui Mun. Anemometers measure incoming wind; accelerometers, GNSS, displacement transducers, thermometers and strain gauges record the bridge's response, and data are processed centrally.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風與結構健康監測系統的設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system" is correct?
options: 感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。
香港路政署為策略性長跨橋梁維持一套專用的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS），青馬大橋與汀九橋、汲水門大橋同在其中。
颱風過後橋梁沒有損壞，監測資料就沒有分析的必要。
optionsEn: The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety.
Hong Kong's Highways Department maintains a dedicated Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS) for strategic long-span bridges, with Tsing Ma alongside Ting Kau and Kap Shui Mun.
If a bridge is undamaged after a typhoon, its monitoring data need not be analysed.
quiz.explanation: 香港路政署為策略性長跨橋梁維持一套專用的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS），青馬大橋與汀九橋、汲水門大橋同在其中。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hong Kong's Highways Department maintains a dedicated Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS) for strategic long-span bridges, with Tsing Ma alongside Ting Kau and Kap Shui Mun. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風與結構健康監測系統的設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「WASHMS 感測網」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “WASHMS sensor network” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡諧運動位移 A = a/(2πf)²。若某模態 f = 0.10 Hz、加速度振幅 a = 0.02 m/s²：(2πf)² = 0.395，A = 0.02/0.395 ≈ 0.051 m（約 5 cm）。GNSS 精度約 1 至 2 cm 即可分辨；若同樣加速度發生在 1.0 Hz，位移只有約 0.5 mm，必須靠加速度計。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Harmonic displacement A = a/(2πf)². For a mode at f = 0.10 Hz with acceleration amplitude a = 0.02 m/s²: (2πf)² = 0.395 and A = 0.02/0.395 ≈ 0.051 m (about 5 cm), which GNSS at 1 to 2 cm accuracy can resolve; the same acceleration at 1.0 Hz gives only about 0.5 mm, which needs accelerometers. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每類感測器在安裝前做出廠校正，安裝後以已知事件（例如列車通過、溫度日循環）檢查訊號合理性；GNSS 與加速度計在重疊頻帶內互相比對，風速計則比對不同位置的平均風速；建立資料完整率與異常值的每月報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate every sensor type before installation, then check signal plausibility against known events such as train passages and daily temperature cycles; compare GNSS and accelerometers in their overlapping band and anemometers across locations; issue monthly reports on data completeness and outliers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 簡諧運動位移 A = a/(2πf)²。若某模態 f = 0.10 Hz、加速度振幅 a = 0.02 m/s²：(2πf)² = 0.395，A = 0.02/0.395 ≈ 0.051 m（約 5 cm）。GNSS 精度約 1 至 2 cm 即可分辨；若同樣加速度發生在 1.0 Hz，位移只有約 0.5 mm，必須靠加速度計。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Harmonic displacement A = a/(2πf)². For a mode at f = 0.10 Hz with acceleration amplitude a = 0.02 m/s²: (2πf)² = 0.395 and A = 0.02/0.395 ≈ 0.051 m (about 5 cm), which GNSS at 1 to 2 cm accuracy can resolve; the same acceleration at 1.0 Hz gives only about 0.5 mm, which needs accelerometers. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風與結構健康監測系統的設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system", which statement holds?
options: 橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。
橋梁設計能抵抗颱風，車輛在颱風中通過就一定安全。
簡諧運動位移 A = a/(2πf)²。
optionsEn: Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping.
If the bridge is designed for typhoons, vehicles crossing in a typhoon must be safe.
Harmonic displacement A = a/(2πf)².
quiz.explanation: 簡諧運動位移 A = a/(2πf)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Harmonic displacement A = a/(2πf)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 風與結構健康監測系統的設計：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「WASHMS 感測網」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “WASHMS sensor network” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每類感測器在安裝前做出廠校正，安裝後以已知事件（例如列車通過、溫度日循環）檢查訊號合理性；GNSS 與加速度計在重疊頻帶內互相比對，風速計則比對不同位置的平均風速；建立資料完整率與異常值的每月報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate every sensor type before installation, then check signal plausibility against known events such as train passages and daily temperature cycles; compare GNSS and accelerometers in their overlapping band and anemometers across locations; issue monthly reports on data completeness and outliers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測系統規格應從「要回答哪些問題」出發，列出每個問題的感測器、取樣率、精度與判讀責任人；資料格式、時間同步與後設資料（位置、方向、校正）須文件化，以便感測器更換後仍能延續長期序列。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify the monitoring system from the questions it must answer, listing for each the sensors, sampling rate, accuracy and the person responsible for interpretation; document data format, time synchronisation and metadata (location, orientation, calibration) so long-term series continue after sensor replacement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若感測器配置只追求數量而沒有對應的工程問題，系統會累積大量無人判讀的資料；時間不同步或座標方向錯誤，則會讓模態辨識與風—反應關係完全失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A layout driven by sensor count rather than engineering questions piles up data nobody interprets; unsynchronised clocks or wrong axis orientation completely distort mode identification and wind–response relationships. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每類感測器在安裝前做出廠校正，安裝後以已知事件（例如列車通過、溫度日循環）檢查訊號合理性；GNSS 與加速度計在重疊頻帶內互相比對，風速計則比對不同位置的平均風速；建立資料完整率與異常值的每月報告。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate every sensor type before installation, then check signal plausibility against known events such as train passages and daily temperature cycles; compare GNSS and accelerometers in their overlapping band and anemometers across locations; issue monthly reports on data completeness and outliers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測系統規格應從「要回答哪些問題」出發，列出每個問題的感測器、取樣率、精度與判讀責任人；資料格式、時間同步與後設資料（位置、方向、校正）須文件化，以便感測器更換後仍能延續長期序列。
knowledge.textEn: Specify the monitoring system from the questions it must answer, listing for each the sensors, sampling rate, accuracy and the person responsible for interpretation; document data format, time synchronisation and metadata (location, orientation, calibration) so long-term series continue after sensor replacement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「風與結構健康監測系統的設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system"?
options: 每類感測器在安裝前做出廠校正，安裝後以已知事件（例如列車通過、溫度日循環）檢查訊號合理性。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
滑模越快越好，只要混凝土能泵送上去就行。
optionsEn: Calibrate every sensor type before installation, then check signal plausibility against known events such as train passages and daily temperature cycles.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Faster slipforming is always better as long as concrete can be pumped up.
quiz.explanation: 每類感測器在安裝前做出廠校正，安裝後以已知事件（例如列車通過、溫度日循環）檢查訊號合理性；GNSS 與加速度計在重疊頻帶內互相比對，風速計則比對不同位置的平均風速；建立資料完整率與異常值的每月報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate every sensor type before installation, then check signal plausibility against known events such as train passages and daily temperature cycles; compare GNSS and accelerometers in their overlapping band and anemometers across locations; issue monthly reports on data completeness and outliers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 風與結構健康監測系統的設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「WASHMS 感測網」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “WASHMS sensor network” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若感測器配置只追求數量而沒有對應的工程問題，系統會累積大量無人判讀的資料；時間不同步或座標方向錯誤，則會讓模態辨識與風—反應關係完全失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A layout driven by sensor count rather than engineering questions piles up data nobody interprets; unsynchronised clocks or wrong axis orientation completely distort mode identification and wind–response relationships. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計監測系統就是讓每一個要回答的工程問題都有適合的感測器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Designing a monitoring system means giving each engineering question a suitable sensor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若感測器配置只追求數量而沒有對應的工程問題，系統會累積大量無人判讀的資料；時間不同步或座標方向錯誤，則會讓模態辨識與風—反應關係完全失真。
knowledge.textEn: A layout driven by sensor count rather than engineering questions piles up data nobody interprets; unsynchronised clocks or wrong axis orientation completely distort mode identification and wind–response relationships.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風與結構健康監測系統的設計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若感測器配置只追求數量而沒有對應的工程問題，系統會累積大量無人判讀的資料；時間不同步或座標方向錯誤，則會讓模態辨識與風—反應關係完全失真。
颱風過後橋梁沒有損壞，監測資料就沒有分析的必要。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A layout driven by sensor count rather than engineering questions piles up data nobody interprets.
If a bridge is undamaged after a typhoon, its monitoring data need not be analysed.
quiz.explanation: 若感測器配置只追求數量而沒有對應的工程問題，系統會累積大量無人判讀的資料；時間不同步或座標方向錯誤，則會讓模態辨識與風—反應關係完全失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A layout driven by sensor count rather than engineering questions piles up data nobody interprets; unsynchronised clocks or wrong axis orientation completely distort mode identification and wind–response relationships. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Checking buffeting response against typhoon records: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「颱風抖振紀錄」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Typhoon buffeting records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 抖振是紊流中的陣風對橋面持續施加隨機力所引起的振動，不會像顫振那樣發散，但決定了颱風中橋面的位移、加速度與構件應力循環。準靜態理論顯示，抖振力與平均風速平方成正比，因此反應的均方根值大致隨風速平方增長；若某次颱風的實測反應明顯偏離歷次紀錄的趨勢，可能代表風向特殊、感測器問題，或結構阻尼、勁度出現變化。長期累積的颱風紀錄因此成為判斷橋梁狀態的重要基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「颱風抖振紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Buffeting is vibration caused by gusts in turbulent wind applying a continuous random force to the deck; it does not diverge like flutter, but it sets deck displacement, acceleration and member stress cycles in a typhoon. Quasi-steady theory makes buffeting force proportional to the square of mean wind speed, so the RMS response grows roughly with wind speed squared; if a typhoon's measured response departs clearly from the trend of earlier records, it may indicate an unusual wind direction, a sensor problem or a change in structural damping or stiffness. Accumulated typhoon records therefore become an important baseline for judging the bridge's condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Typhoon buffeting records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：準靜態近似 σ ≈ k·U²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Quasi-steady approximation σ ≈ k·U².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「颱風過後橋梁沒有損壞，監測資料就沒有分析的必要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a bridge is undamaged after a typhoon, its monitoring data need not be analysed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「颱風抖振紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Typhoon buffeting records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應
knowledge.titleEn: Checking buffeting response against typhoon records
knowledge.text: 抖振是紊流中的陣風對橋面持續施加隨機力所引起的振動，不會像顫振那樣發散，但決定了颱風中橋面的位移、加速度與構件應力循環。準靜態理論顯示，抖振力與平均風速平方成正比，因此反應的均方根值大致隨風速平方增長；若某次颱風的實測反應明顯偏離歷次紀錄的趨勢，可能代表風向特殊、感測器問題，或結構阻尼、勁度出現變化。
knowledge.textEn: Buffeting is vibration caused by gusts in turbulent wind applying a continuous random force to the deck; it does not diverge like flutter, but it sets deck displacement, acceleration and member stress cycles in a typhoon. Quasi-steady theory makes buffeting force proportional to the square of mean wind speed, so the RMS response grows roughly with wind speed squared; if a typhoon's measured response departs clearly from the trend of earlier records, it may indicate an unusual wind direction, a sensor problem or a change in structural damping or stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：颱風過後橋梁沒有損壞，監測資料就沒有分析的必要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a bridge is undamaged after a typhoon, its monitoring data need not be analysed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Checking buffeting response against typhoon records" is correct?
options: 颱風過後橋梁沒有損壞，監測資料就沒有分析的必要。
疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。
抖振是紊流中的陣風對橋面持續施加隨機力所引起的振動，不會像顫振那樣發散，但決定了颱風中橋面的位移、加速度與構件應力循環。
optionsEn: If a bridge is undamaged after a typhoon, its monitoring data need not be analysed.
Fatigue depends only on the heaviest vehicle, not on how much traffic there is.
Buffeting is vibration caused by gusts in turbulent wind applying a continuous random force to the deck.
quiz.explanation: 抖振是紊流中的陣風對橋面持續施加隨機力所引起的振動，不會像顫振那樣發散，但決定了颱風中橋面的位移、加速度與構件應力循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Buffeting is vibration caused by gusts in turbulent wind applying a continuous random force to the deck; it does not diverge like flutter, but it sets deck displacement, acceleration and member stress cycles in a typhoon. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Checking buffeting response against typhoon records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「颱風抖振紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Typhoon buffeting records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：準靜態近似 σ ≈ k·U²。若平均風速 20 m/s 時側向位移均方根 σ = 0.05 m，則 35 m/s 時 σ ≈ 0.05×(35/20)² ≈ 0.153 m；若實測為 0.25 m，比趨勢高約 63%，應先排查風向與紊流，再檢查阻尼與支承狀態。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Quasi-steady approximation σ ≈ k·U². If the lateral RMS displacement is σ = 0.05 m at a 20 m/s mean wind, at 35 m/s σ ≈ 0.05×(35/20)² ≈ 0.153 m; a measured 0.25 m would be about 63% above trend, prompting checks first of wind direction and turbulence, then of damping and bearing condition. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每次颱風的資料按 10 分鐘平均風速、風向與紊流強度分段，繪出反應均方根與風速的對數圖，擬合指數與係數；新事件落在歷史信賴區間之外時，啟動資料品質檢查與結構檢查，並比較辨識出的模態頻率與阻尼。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Bin each typhoon's data by 10-minute mean wind speed, direction and turbulence intensity, plot RMS response against wind speed on log axes and fit exponent and coefficient; when a new event falls outside the historical confidence band, start data-quality and structural checks and compare identified modal frequencies and damping.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 準靜態近似 σ ≈ k·U²。若平均風速 20 m/s 時側向位移均方根 σ = 0.05 m，則 35 m/s 時 σ ≈ 0.05×(35/20)² ≈ 0.153 m；若實測為 0.25 m，比趨勢高約 63%，應先排查風向與紊流，再檢查阻尼與支承狀態。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Quasi-steady approximation σ ≈ k·U². If the lateral RMS displacement is σ = 0.05 m at a 20 m/s mean wind, at 35 m/s σ ≈ 0.05×(35/20)² ≈ 0.153 m; a measured 0.25 m would be about 63% above trend, prompting checks first of wind direction and turbulence, then of damping and bearing condition. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Checking buffeting response against typhoon records", which statement holds?
options: 準靜態近似 σ ≈ k·U²。
懸索橋只要強度夠，鐵路就可以像在地面一樣行駛。
主纜從錨碇到錨碇的鋼絲數一定相同。
optionsEn: Quasi-steady approximation σ ≈ k·U².
If a suspension bridge is strong enough, trains can run on it as on the ground.
A main cable always has the same number of wires from anchorage to anchorage.
quiz.explanation: 準靜態近似 σ ≈ k·U²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Quasi-steady approximation σ ≈ k·U². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Checking buffeting response against typhoon records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「颱風抖振紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Typhoon buffeting records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每次颱風的資料按 10 分鐘平均風速、風向與紊流強度分段，繪出反應均方根與風速的對數圖，擬合指數與係數；新事件落在歷史信賴區間之外時，啟動資料品質檢查與結構檢查，並比較辨識出的模態頻率與阻尼。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Bin each typhoon's data by 10-minute mean wind speed, direction and turbulence intensity, plot RMS response against wind speed on log axes and fit exponent and coefficient; when a new event falls outside the historical confidence band, start data-quality and structural checks and compare identified modal frequencies and damping. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次達到預設風速門檻的颱風都應產出事件報告，包含風況、反應統計、與歷史趨勢的比較及現場檢查結果，並歸檔於資產管理系統；趨勢模型每數年依新資料更新。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every typhoon above a preset wind threshold should produce an event report with wind conditions, response statistics, comparison with the historical trend and field inspection findings, filed in the asset system; update the trend model every few years with new data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若不分風向、紊流就把所有紀錄混在一起擬合，趨勢線過於分散而失去預警能力；只看最大值而不看統計，也容易把單一陣風或感測器尖峰誤判為結構異常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fitting all records together without separating wind direction and turbulence makes the trend too scattered to give warning; looking only at maxima rather than statistics easily mistakes a single gust or sensor spike for a structural anomaly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把每次颱風的資料按 10 分鐘平均風速、風向與紊流強度分段，繪出反應均方根與風速的對數圖，擬合指數與係數；新事件落在歷史信賴區間之外時，啟動資料品質檢查與結構檢查，並比較辨識出的模態頻率與阻尼。
knowledge.textEn: Bin each typhoon's data by 10-minute mean wind speed, direction and turbulence intensity, plot RMS response against wind speed on log axes and fit exponent and coefficient; when a new event falls outside the historical confidence band, start data-quality and structural checks and compare identified modal frequencies and damping.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每次達到預設風速門檻的颱風都應產出事件報告，包含風況、反應統計、與歷史趨勢的比較及現場檢查結果，並歸檔於資產管理系統；趨勢模型每數年依新資料更新。
knowledge.textEn: Every typhoon above a preset wind threshold should produce an event report with wind conditions, response statistics, comparison with the historical trend and field inspection findings, filed in the asset system; update the trend model every few years with new data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Checking buffeting response against typhoon records"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把每次颱風的資料按 10 分鐘平均風速、風向與紊流強度分段，繪出反應均方根與風速的對數圖，擬合指數與係數。
模組在工廠做得越大越好，吊裝風險不會因此增加。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Bin each typhoon's data by 10-minute mean wind speed, direction and turbulence intensity, plot RMS response against wind speed on log axes and fit exponent and coefficient.
The bigger the factory-made module the better; lifting risk does not grow.
quiz.explanation: 把每次颱風的資料按 10 分鐘平均風速、風向與紊流強度分段，繪出反應均方根與風速的對數圖，擬合指數與係數；新事件落在歷史信賴區間之外時，啟動資料品質檢查與結構檢查，並比較辨識出的模態頻率與阻尼。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Bin each typhoon's data by 10-minute mean wind speed, direction and turbulence intensity, plot RMS response against wind speed on log axes and fit exponent and coefficient; when a new event falls outside the historical confidence band, start data-quality and structural checks and compare identified modal frequencies and damping. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Checking buffeting response against typhoon records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「颱風抖振紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Typhoon buffeting records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若不分風向、紊流就把所有紀錄混在一起擬合，趨勢線過於分散而失去預警能力；只看最大值而不看統計，也容易把單一陣風或感測器尖峰誤判為結構異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fitting all records together without separating wind direction and turbulence makes the trend too scattered to give warning; looking only at maxima rather than statistics easily mistakes a single gust or sensor spike for a structural anomaly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長期累積的颱風紀錄因此成為判斷橋梁狀態的重要基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Accumulated typhoon records therefore become an important baseline for judging the bridge's condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「颱風過後橋梁沒有損壞，監測資料就沒有分析的必要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a bridge is undamaged after a typhoon, its monitoring data need not be analysed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若不分風向、紊流就把所有紀錄混在一起擬合，趨勢線過於分散而失去預警能力；只看最大值而不看統計，也容易把單一陣風或感測器尖峰誤判為結構異常。
knowledge.textEn: Fitting all records together without separating wind direction and turbulence makes the trend too scattered to give warning; looking only at maxima rather than statistics easily mistakes a single gust or sensor spike for a structural anomaly.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Checking buffeting response against typhoon records" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。
若不分風向、紊流就把所有紀錄混在一起擬合，趨勢線過於分散而失去預警能力；只看最大值而不看統計，也容易把單一陣風或感測器尖峰誤判為結構異常。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Fatigue depends only on the heaviest vehicle, not on how much traffic there is.
Fitting all records together without separating wind direction and turbulence makes the trend too scattered to give warning.
quiz.explanation: 若不分風向、紊流就把所有紀錄混在一起擬合，趨勢線過於分散而失去預警能力；只看最大值而不看統計，也容易把單一陣風或感測器尖峰誤判為結構異常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fitting all records together without separating wind direction and turbulence makes the trend too scattered to give warning; looking only at maxima rather than statistics easily mistakes a single gust or sensor spike for a structural anomaly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「交通成長與疲勞壽命」與「橋下維修與航運協調」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Traffic growth and fatigue life" and "Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Traffic growth and fatigue life: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Road and rail fatigue cycles” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 青馬大橋同時承受公路車流與鐵路列車，鋼桁架節點、吊索端部與橋面系統焊道都在每次重車或列車通過時經歷應力循環。運輸署統計顯示，大嶼山幹線在 2016 年的日均車流約 87,764 架次，全年約 3,210 萬架次，且十年間持續成長。疲勞設計通常以設計當時的交通預測為基礎，若實際交通量與重車比例增長更快，累積損傷會提早到達，因此營運期要以實際交通與應變量測更新剩餘壽命。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tsing Ma carries both road traffic and trains, and steel truss joints, hanger ends and deck welds go through a stress cycle with every heavy vehicle or train. Transport Department statistics show an average daily flow of about 87,764 vehicles on the Lantau Link in 2016, about 32.1 million a year, growing steadily over the decade. Fatigue design is usually based on traffic forecasts made at design time; if traffic and the heavy-vehicle share grow faster, accumulated damage arrives early, so remaining life must be updated in service with actual traffic and strain measurements. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Road and rail fatigue cycles” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fatigue depends only on the heaviest vehicle, not on how much traffic there is." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Road and rail fatigue cycles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命
knowledge.text: 青馬大橋同時承受公路車流與鐵路列車，鋼桁架節點、吊索端部與橋面系統焊道都在每次重車或列車通過時經歷應力循環。運輸署統計顯示，大嶼山幹線在 2016 年的日均車流約 87,764 架次，全年約 3,210 萬架次，且十年間持續成長。
knowledge.textEn: Tsing Ma carries both road traffic and trains, and steel truss joints, hanger ends and deck welds go through a stress cycle with every heavy vehicle or train. Transport Department statistics show an average daily flow of about 87,764 vehicles on the Lantau Link in 2016, about 32.1 million a year, growing steadily over the decade.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fatigue depends only on the heaviest vehicle, not on how much traffic there is. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「交通成長與疲勞壽命」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Traffic growth and fatigue life" is correct?
options: 青馬大橋同時承受公路車流與鐵路列車，鋼桁架節點、吊索端部與橋面系統焊道都在每次重車或列車通過時經歷應力循環。
疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。
橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。
optionsEn: Tsing Ma carries both road traffic and trains, and steel truss joints, hanger ends and deck welds go through a stress cycle with every heavy vehicle or train.
Fatigue depends only on the heaviest vehicle, not on how much traffic there is.
Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping.
quiz.explanation: 青馬大橋同時承受公路車流與鐵路列車，鋼桁架節點、吊索端部與橋面系統焊道都在每次重車或列車通過時經歷應力循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tsing Ma carries both road traffic and trains, and steel truss joints, hanger ends and deck welds go through a stress cycle with every heavy vehicle or train. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traffic growth and fatigue life: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Road and rail fatigue cycles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。取細部類別 Δσ_C = 90 MPa、等效應力範圍 Δσ = 15 MPa：N = 2×10⁶×(90/15)³ = 4.32×10⁸ 次。若每年 3.2×10⁶ 次有效重車循環，壽命約 135 年；若重車循環增加 50% 到 4.8×10⁶ 次/年，壽命降為約 90 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. With detail category Δσ_C = 90 MPa and equivalent stress range Δσ = 15 MPa: N = 2×10⁶×(90/15)³ = 4.32×10⁸ cycles. At 3.2×10⁶ effective heavy-vehicle cycles a year the life is about 135 years; if heavy cycles grow 50% to 4.8×10⁶ a year, the life falls to about 90 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性疲勞熱點貼應變計做長期監測，以雨流計數法得到應力範圍直方圖，計算等效應力範圍與年損傷；同時取得動態地磅或交通統計，建立車流與損傷的關係，定期以磁粉或超音波檢查熱點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install strain gauges at representative fatigue hot spots for long-term monitoring, derive stress-range histograms by rainflow counting, and compute the equivalent stress range and annual damage; obtain weigh-in-motion or traffic statistics to relate traffic to damage, and inspect hot spots periodically by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。取細部類別 Δσ_C = 90 MPa、等效應力範圍 Δσ = 15 MPa：N = 2×10⁶×(90/15)³ = 4.32×10⁸ 次。若每年 3.2×10⁶ 次有效重車循環，壽命約 135 年；若重車循環增加 50% 到 4.8×10⁶ 次/年，壽命降為約 90 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. With detail category Δσ_C = 90 MPa and equivalent stress range Δσ = 15 MPa: N = 2×10⁶×(90/15)³ = 4.32×10⁸ cycles. At 3.2×10⁶ effective heavy-vehicle cycles a year the life is about 135 years; if heavy cycles grow 50% to 4.8×10⁶ a year, the life falls to about 90 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「交通成長與疲勞壽命」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Traffic growth and fatigue life", which statement holds?
options: 橋梁設計能抵抗颱風，車輛在颱風中通過就一定安全。
S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。
滑模越快越好，只要混凝土能泵送上去就行。
optionsEn: If the bridge is designed for typhoons, vehicles crossing in a typhoon must be safe.
S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³.
Faster slipforming is always better as long as concrete can be pumped up.
quiz.explanation: S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traffic growth and fatigue life: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Road and rail fatigue cycles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性疲勞熱點貼應變計做長期監測，以雨流計數法得到應力範圍直方圖，計算等效應力範圍與年損傷；同時取得動態地磅或交通統計，建立車流與損傷的關係，定期以磁粉或超音波檢查熱點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install strain gauges at representative fatigue hot spots for long-term monitoring, derive stress-range histograms by rainflow counting, and compute the equivalent stress range and annual damage; obtain weigh-in-motion or traffic statistics to relate traffic to damage, and inspect hot spots periodically by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運單位應每年把交通統計與疲勞監測資料送交結構工程師更新剩餘壽命，並依結果調整熱點檢查頻率；重大交通政策改變（例如收費或路網調整）前後，應比較重車循環數的變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The operator should send traffic statistics and fatigue monitoring data to the structural engineer each year to update remaining life and adjust hot-spot inspection frequency; before and after major traffic-policy changes such as tolling or network changes, compare the number of heavy-vehicle cycles.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：疲勞裂縫多從焊趾或螺栓孔開始，初期很小且被塗層遮蔽，若檢查頻率不足，裂縫可能擴展到主要構件；鐵路列車的軸重與頻率若高於設計假設，橋面系統的縱梁與橫梁連接最先受影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fatigue cracks usually start at weld toes or bolt holes, small and hidden by coating at first; with infrequent inspection they can grow into primary members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表性疲勞熱點貼應變計做長期監測，以雨流計數法得到應力範圍直方圖，計算等效應力範圍與年損傷；同時取得動態地磅或交通統計，建立車流與損傷的關係，定期以磁粉或超音波檢查熱點。
knowledge.textEn: Install strain gauges at representative fatigue hot spots for long-term monitoring, derive stress-range histograms by rainflow counting, and compute the equivalent stress range and annual damage; obtain weigh-in-motion or traffic statistics to relate traffic to damage, and inspect hot spots periodically by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 營運單位應每年把交通統計與疲勞監測資料送交結構工程師更新剩餘壽命，並依結果調整熱點檢查頻率；重大交通政策改變（例如收費或路網調整）前後，應比較重車循環數的變化。
knowledge.textEn: The operator should send traffic statistics and fatigue monitoring data to the structural engineer each year to update remaining life and adjust hot-spot inspection frequency; before and after major traffic-policy changes such as tolling or network changes, compare the number of heavy-vehicle cycles.

quiz.question: 要驗證「交通成長與疲勞壽命」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Traffic growth and fatigue life"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
伸縮縫的行程只要按溫度變化計算就夠了。
在代表性疲勞熱點貼應變計做長期監測，以雨流計數法得到應力範圍直方圖，計算等效應力範圍與年損傷。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Expansion-joint travel only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
Install strain gauges at representative fatigue hot spots for long-term monitoring, derive stress-range histograms by rainflow counting, and compute the equivalent stress range and annual damage.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性疲勞熱點貼應變計做長期監測，以雨流計數法得到應力範圍直方圖，計算等效應力範圍與年損傷；同時取得動態地磅或交通統計，建立車流與損傷的關係，定期以磁粉或超音波檢查熱點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Install strain gauges at representative fatigue hot spots for long-term monitoring, derive stress-range histograms by rainflow counting, and compute the equivalent stress range and annual damage; obtain weigh-in-motion or traffic statistics to relate traffic to damage, and inspect hot spots periodically by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Traffic growth and fatigue life: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Road and rail fatigue cycles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 疲勞裂縫多從焊趾或螺栓孔開始，初期很小且被塗層遮蔽，若檢查頻率不足，裂縫可能擴展到主要構件；鐵路列車的軸重與頻率若高於設計假設，橋面系統的縱梁與橫梁連接最先受影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue cracks usually start at weld toes or bolt holes, small and hidden by coating at first; with infrequent inspection they can grow into primary members. If train axle loads and frequency exceed design assumptions, stringer-to-floor-beam connections in the deck system are affected first. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：疲勞設計通常以設計當時的交通預測為基礎，若實際交通量與重車比例增長更快，累積損傷會提早到達，因此營運期要以實際交通與應變量測更新剩餘壽命。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fatigue design is usually based on traffic forecasts made at design time; if traffic and the heavy-vehicle share grow faster, accumulated damage arrives early, so remaining life must be updated in service with actual traffic and strain measurements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fatigue depends only on the heaviest vehicle, not on how much traffic there is." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 疲勞裂縫多從焊趾或螺栓孔開始，初期很小且被塗層遮蔽，若檢查頻率不足，裂縫可能擴展到主要構件；鐵路列車的軸重與頻率若高於設計假設，橋面系統的縱梁與橫梁連接最先受影響。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue cracks usually start at weld toes or bolt holes, small and hidden by coating at first; with infrequent inspection they can grow into primary members. If train axle loads and frequency exceed design assumptions, stringer-to-floor-beam connections in the deck system are affected first.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「交通成長與疲勞壽命」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Traffic growth and fatigue life" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 疲勞裂縫多從焊趾或螺栓孔開始，初期很小且被塗層遮蔽，若檢查頻率不足，裂縫可能擴展到主要構件。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。
optionsEn: Fatigue cracks usually start at weld toes or bolt holes, small and hidden by coating at first; with infrequent inspection they can grow into primary members.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping.
quiz.explanation: 疲勞裂縫多從焊趾或螺栓孔開始，初期很小且被塗層遮蔽，若檢查頻率不足，裂縫可能擴展到主要構件；鐵路列車的軸重與頻率若高於設計假設，橋面系統的縱梁與橫梁連接最先受影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue cracks usually start at weld toes or bolt holes, small and hidden by coating at first; with infrequent inspection they can grow into primary members. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 橋下維修與航運協調：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「水上淨空管制時段」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Marine air-draft control hours” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸索橋的橋面下方檢查、塗裝與構件更換常需要吊籃、工作平台或移動式維修門架，它們會降低橋下的有效淨空。香港路政署依《船舶及港口管制規例》與《商船（本地船隻）（一般）規例》發布公告，指定船舶進入青馬大橋範圍須遵守的時段，分全日與部分時段管制，並設 24 小時熱線。維修規劃因此不只是結構問題，而是要把作業高度、時段與航道使用協調起來，並讓船公司提前知道。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「水上淨空管制時段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under-deck inspection, painting and component replacement on a suspension bridge often need cradles, platforms or travelling gantries that reduce the effective clearance beneath the deck. Hong Kong's Highways Department issues notices under the Shipping and Port Control Regulations and the Merchant Shipping (Local Vessels)(General) Regulation specifying hours that apply to vessels entering the Tsing Ma Bridge area, with full-day and part-day restrictions and a 24-hour hotline. Maintenance planning is thus not only a structural question but one of coordinating working heights, hours and channel use, and telling ship operators in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Marine air-draft control hours” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橋面下表面積估算 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Deck underside area ≈ 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「水上淨空管制時段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Marine air-draft control hours”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋下維修與航運協調
knowledge.text: 懸索橋的橋面下方檢查、塗裝與構件更換常需要吊籃、工作平台或移動式維修門架，它們會降低橋下的有效淨空。香港路政署依《船舶及港口管制規例》與《商船（本地船隻）（一般）規例》發布公告，指定船舶進入青馬大橋範圍須遵守的時段，分全日與部分時段管制，並設 24 小時熱線。
knowledge.textEn: Under-deck inspection, painting and component replacement on a suspension bridge often need cradles, platforms or travelling gantries that reduce the effective clearance beneath the deck. Hong Kong's Highways Department issues notices under the Shipping and Port Control Regulations and the Merchant Shipping (Local Vessels)(General) Regulation specifying hours that apply to vessels entering the Tsing Ma Bridge area, with full-day and part-day restrictions and a 24-hour hotline.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「橋下維修與航運協調」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination" is correct?
options: 橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。
懸索橋的橋面下方檢查、塗裝與構件更換常需要吊籃、工作平台或移動式維修門架，它們會降低橋下的有效淨空。
懸索橋只要強度夠，鐵路就可以像在地面一樣行駛。
optionsEn: Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping.
Under-deck inspection, painting and component replacement on a suspension bridge often need cradles, platforms or travelling gantries that reduce the effective clearance beneath the deck.
If a suspension bridge is strong enough, trains can run on it as on the ground.
quiz.explanation: 懸索橋的橋面下方檢查、塗裝與構件更換常需要吊籃、工作平台或移動式維修門架，它們會降低橋下的有效淨空。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Under-deck inspection, painting and component replacement on a suspension bridge often need cradles, platforms or travelling gantries that reduce the effective clearance beneath the deck. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橋下維修與航運協調：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水上淨空管制時段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Marine air-draft control hours” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橋面下表面積估算 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m²。若一部維修門架每夜可完成約 600 m² 的近距離檢查，全面檢查需約 88,560/600 ≈ 148 個夜間作業；若只能在每月約 17 個全日管制日中工作，約需 9 個月。產能與管制日數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Deck underside area ≈ 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m². If one maintenance gantry completes close inspection of about 600 m² a night, a full inspection needs about 88,560/600 ≈ 148 night shifts; if work is allowed only on about 17 full-restriction days a month, it takes about 9 months. Productivity and restriction days are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次作業前確認公告時段、門架與吊籃的最低點高程，並以實測高程換算當時潮位下的淨空；作業後記錄檢查覆蓋範圍與發現事項，納入構件資料庫，並追蹤未完成區域的排程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each shift confirm the notified hours and the lowest point of gantries and cradles, converting measured levels to clearance at the current tide; afterwards record inspection coverage and findings in the component database and track the schedule for areas not yet done.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橋面下表面積估算 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m²。若一部維修門架每夜可完成約 600 m² 的近距離檢查，全面檢查需約 88,560/600 ≈ 148 個夜間作業；若只能在每月約 17 個全日管制日中工作，約需 9 個月。產能與管制日數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Deck underside area ≈ 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m². If one maintenance gantry completes close inspection of about 600 m² a night, a full inspection needs about 88,560/600 ≈ 148 night shifts; if work is allowed only on about 17 full-restriction days a month, it takes about 9 months. Productivity and restriction days are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「橋下維修與航運協調」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination", which statement holds?
options: 主纜從錨碇到錨碇的鋼絲數一定相同。
模組在工廠做得越大越好，吊裝風險不會因此增加。
橋面下表面積估算 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m²。
optionsEn: A main cable always has the same number of wires from anchorage to anchorage.
The bigger the factory-made module the better; lifting risk does not grow.
Deck underside area ≈ 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m².
quiz.explanation: 橋面下表面積估算 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Deck underside area ≈ 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 橋下維修與航運協調：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水上淨空管制時段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Marine air-draft control hours” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次作業前確認公告時段、門架與吊籃的最低點高程，並以實測高程換算當時潮位下的淨空；作業後記錄檢查覆蓋範圍與發現事項，納入構件資料庫，並追蹤未完成區域的排程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each shift confirm the notified hours and the lowest point of gantries and cradles, converting measured levels to clearance at the current tide; afterwards record inspection coverage and findings in the component database and track the schedule for areas not yet done. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長期維修計畫應包含年度的水上淨空管制時段需求，提前與海事主管協調並公告；交接文件要列出維修門架的運行範圍、最低高程與緊急收回程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The long-term maintenance plan should include the annual need for air-draft control hours, coordinated and announced early with the marine authority; handover documents should list the operating range, lowest level and emergency retraction procedure of the maintenance gantries.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若維修設備在非管制時段伸出橋下或高度超出預告，可能與通過的船舶碰撞；檢查只在方便的區段進行而沒有覆蓋紀錄，則某些區段可能多年未被近距離檢查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Maintenance equipment protruding below the deck outside notified hours or above announced levels can be struck by passing ships; inspections done only where convenient, without coverage records, can leave some zones uninspected at close range for years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次作業前確認公告時段、門架與吊籃的最低點高程，並以實測高程換算當時潮位下的淨空；作業後記錄檢查覆蓋範圍與發現事項，納入構件資料庫，並追蹤未完成區域的排程。
knowledge.textEn: Before each shift confirm the notified hours and the lowest point of gantries and cradles, converting measured levels to clearance at the current tide; afterwards record inspection coverage and findings in the component database and track the schedule for areas not yet done.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 長期維修計畫應包含年度的水上淨空管制時段需求，提前與海事主管協調並公告；交接文件要列出維修門架的運行範圍、最低高程與緊急收回程序。
knowledge.textEn: The long-term maintenance plan should include the annual need for air-draft control hours, coordinated and announced early with the marine authority; handover documents should list the operating range, lowest level and emergency retraction procedure of the maintenance gantries.

quiz.question: 要驗證「橋下維修與航運協調」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination"?
options: 每次作業前確認公告時段、門架與吊籃的最低點高程，並以實測高程換算當時潮位下的淨空；作業後記錄檢查覆蓋範圍與發現事項，納入構件資料庫，並追蹤未完成區域的排程。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。
optionsEn: Before each shift confirm the notified hours and the lowest point of gantries and cradles, converting measured levels to clearance at the current tide.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety.
quiz.explanation: 每次作業前確認公告時段、門架與吊籃的最低點高程，並以實測高程換算當時潮位下的淨空；作業後記錄檢查覆蓋範圍與發現事項，納入構件資料庫，並追蹤未完成區域的排程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each shift confirm the notified hours and the lowest point of gantries and cradles, converting measured levels to clearance at the current tide; afterwards record inspection coverage and findings in the component database and track the schedule for areas not yet done. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 橋下維修與航運協調：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水上淨空管制時段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Marine air-draft control hours” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若維修設備在非管制時段伸出橋下或高度超出預告，可能與通過的船舶碰撞；檢查只在方便的區段進行而沒有覆蓋紀錄，則某些區段可能多年未被近距離檢查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Maintenance equipment protruding below the deck outside notified hours or above announced levels can be struck by passing ships; inspections done only where convenient, without coverage records, can leave some zones uninspected at close range for years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維修規劃因此不只是結構問題，而是要把作業高度、時段與航道使用協調起來，並讓船公司提前知道。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance planning is thus not only a structural question but one of coordinating working heights, hours and channel use, and telling ship operators in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 瀨戶大橋橋群
summary: 瀨戶大橋是連接本州岡山與四國香川的六座橋梁，海峽段約 9.4 km，全部為上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層結構，1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。本課從如何沿海峽配置三座懸索橋、兩座斜張橋與一座桁架橋出發，說明南北備讚瀨戶大橋的三跨連續構造與索股交叉的共用錨碇、11 座設置沉箱與預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與工廠全尺寸預組，最後談鍍鋅鋼絲防蝕、乾燥空氣與公路鐵路並存下的維護。
summaryEn: Seto Ohashi is a group of six bridges linking Okayama on Honshu with Kagawa on Shikoku across about 9.4 km of sea, all double-deck with road above and rail below, opened together on 10 April 1988. The course starts from how three suspension bridges, two cable-stayed bridges and a truss bridge were arranged along the strait, explains the three-span continuous Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto bridges and their shared anchorage where strands cross, eleven placed caissons with prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and full factory trial assembly, and ends with galvanised-wire protection, dry air and maintenance with road and rail side by side.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
