workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較南備讚瀨戶大橋型懸索橋在不同鋼絲直徑下的主纜狀態。主纜 271 股×127 根 = 34,417 根鋼絲，張力約 45,000 t（≈ 441 MN），主纜直徑 107 cm（毛面積 0.899 m²）。若鋼絲直徑 5.10 mm，單絲面積 20.4 mm²，總面積 ≈ 0.703 m²，應力 ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm²，對 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲的安全係數 ≈ 2.50，空隙率 ≈ 22%。若直徑為 5.00 mm，單絲 19.6 mm²、總面積 ≈ 0.676 m²，應力 ≈ 653 N/mm²、係數 ≈ 2.40，空隙率 ≈ 25%；若為 5.20 mm，總面積 ≈ 0.731 m²、係數 ≈ 2.60、空隙率 ≈ 19%。可見「約 5 mm」的 0.1 mm 差異就會改變安全係數約 4% 與空隙率約 3 個百分點。除公開的股數、直徑與張力外，數值為教學假設，不代表瀨戶大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare the cable state of a Minami Bisan-Seto type suspension bridge for different wire diameters. The cable has 271 strands × 127 wires = 34,417 wires, a tension of about 45,000 t (≈ 441 MN) and a diameter of 107 cm (gross area 0.899 m²). With 5.10 mm wire, each wire is 20.4 mm², the total area ≈ 0.703 m², the stress ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm², the safety factor on 1,570 N/mm² wire ≈ 2.50 and the void ratio ≈ 22%. With 5.00 mm wire, each is 19.6 mm², the total ≈ 0.676 m², the stress ≈ 653 N/mm², the factor ≈ 2.40 and voids ≈ 25%; with 5.20 mm, the total ≈ 0.731 m², the factor ≈ 2.60 and voids ≈ 19%. A 0.1 mm difference within ‘about 5 mm’ changes the safety factor by about 4% and the void ratio by about 3 points. Apart from the published strand count, diameter and tension, values are teaching assumptions, not Seto Ohashi design calculations.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數」與「鐵路通行與連續懸索橋」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait" and "Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Type layout over 9.4 km” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 瀨戶大橋並非單一橋梁，而是一條跨越塩飽諸島的鏈：下津井瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，中央跨 940 m）、櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋（斜張橋，各 420 m）、與島橋（桁架橋，最大跨 245 m）、北備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，990 m）與南備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，1,100 m）。主要航道與深水處用懸索橋大跨越過，島嶼之間較淺且船舶較小的水道用斜張橋與桁架橋，讓每一段的跨徑與基礎數量都配合水深、航道與島嶼位置。海中基礎是最昂貴、最受潮流與天候限制的工作，因此減少海中基礎數量是配置的核心考量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seto Ohashi is not one bridge but a chain across the Shiwaku Islands: Shimotsui-Seto (suspension, 940 m centre span), the Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima bridges (cable-stayed, 420 m each), Yoshima (truss, 245 m maximum span), Kita Bisan-Seto (suspension, 990 m) and Minami Bisan-Seto (suspension, 1,100 m). Main channels and deep water are crossed by long suspension spans, while shallower inter-island waters with smaller ships use cable-stayed and truss bridges, so each segment's span and foundation count fit water depth, navigation and island positions. Marine foundations are the most expensive work and the most constrained by currents and weather, so reducing their number is central to the layout. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Type layout over 9.4 km” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Type layout over 9.4 km”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數
knowledge.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait
knowledge.text: 瀨戶大橋並非單一橋梁，而是一條跨越塩飽諸島的鏈：下津井瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，中央跨 940 m）、櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋（斜張橋，各 420 m）、與島橋（桁架橋，最大跨 245 m）、北備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，990 m）與南備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，1,100 m）。主要航道與深水處用懸索橋大跨越過，島嶼之間較淺且船舶較小的水道用斜張橋與桁架橋，讓每一段的跨徑與基礎數量都配合水深、航道與島嶼位置。
knowledge.textEn: Seto Ohashi is not one bridge but a chain across the Shiwaku Islands: Shimotsui-Seto (suspension, 940 m centre span), the Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima bridges (cable-stayed, 420 m each), Yoshima (truss, 245 m maximum span), Kita Bisan-Seto (suspension, 990 m) and Minami Bisan-Seto (suspension, 1,100 m). Main channels and deep water are crossed by long suspension spans, while shallower inter-island waters with smaller ships use cable-stayed and truss bridges, so each segment's span and foundation count fit water depth, navigation and island positions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait" is correct?
options: 跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。
瀨戶大橋並非單一橋梁，而是一條跨越塩飽諸島的鏈：下津井瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，中央跨 940 m）、櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋（斜張橋，各 420 m）、與島橋（桁架橋，最大跨 245 m）、北備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，990 m）與南備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，1,100 m）。
懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。
optionsEn: A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout.

Seto Ohashi is not one bridge but a chain across the Shiwaku Islands: Shimotsui-Seto (suspension, 940 m centre span), the Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima bridges (cable-stayed, 420 m each), Yoshima (truss, 245 m maximum span), Kita Bisan-Seto (suspension, 990 m) and Minami Bisan-Seto (suspension, 1,100 m).
A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation.
quiz.explanation: 瀨戶大橋並非單一橋梁，而是一條跨越塩飽諸島的鏈：下津井瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，中央跨 940 m）、櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋（斜張橋，各 420 m）、與島橋（桁架橋，最大跨 245 m）、北備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，990 m）與南備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，1,100 m）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seto Ohashi is not one bridge but a chain across the Shiwaku Islands: Shimotsui-Seto (suspension, 940 m centre span), the Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima bridges (cable-stayed, 420 m each), Yoshima (truss, 245 m maximum span), Kita Bisan-Seto (suspension, 990 m) and Minami Bisan-Seto (suspension, 1,100 m). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Type layout over 9.4 km” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。若懸索橋垂跨比取 1/10，三座懸索橋主纜垂度約為 94 m、99 m 與 110 m，決定了塔高的主要部分。垂跨比為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations. With a 1/10 sag ratio, the three suspension bridges' cable sags would be about 94 m, 99 m and 110 m, setting most of each tower's height. The sag ratio is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以航道主管機關核定的航道寬度與淨空、海底地形與地質鑽探資料，比較不同橋型配置的海中基礎數、施工天數與風險；定案後把每座橋的橋型、跨徑與基礎位置列入整體配置圖，作為各橋設計的共同基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layouts by marine foundation count, construction days and risk, using channel widths and clearances approved by the navigation authority, seabed topography and borehole data; once fixed, record each bridge's type, spans and foundation locations on a master layout as the common basis for all individual designs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。若懸索橋垂跨比取 1/10，三座懸索橋主纜垂度約為 94 m、99 m 與 110 m，決定了塔高的主要部分。垂跨比為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations. With a 1/10 sag ratio, the three suspension bridges' cable sags would be about 94 m, 99 m and 110 m, setting most of each tower's height. The sag ratio is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait", which statement holds?

加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。
若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎。
optionsEn: Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough.
If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure.
Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations.
quiz.explanation: 若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Type layout over 9.4 km” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以航道主管機關核定的航道寬度與淨空、海底地形與地質鑽探資料，比較不同橋型配置的海中基礎數、施工天數與風險；定案後把每座橋的橋型、跨徑與基礎位置列入整體配置圖，作為各橋設計的共同基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layouts by marine foundation count, construction days and risk, using channel widths and clearances approved by the navigation authority, seabed topography and borehole data; once fixed, record each bridge's type, spans and foundation locations on a master layout as the common basis for all individual designs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型跨海工程的配置報告應以表格比較各段的水深、航道、基礎數與橋型方案，並保存被淘汰方案的理由；日後若有新增航道需求或維修策略變更，可回到此基準評估影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The layout report for a major sea crossing should tabulate water depth, channel, foundation count and type options for each segment and keep the reasons for rejected options, so later new channel demands or maintenance strategy changes can be assessed against that baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為追求單一橋型而在淺水區也使用大跨懸索橋，錨碇與塔的成本會不成比例；反之在主航道使用短跨，海中基礎增加，不僅工期與潮流風險上升，也增加船舶撞擊機率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using long suspension spans even in shallow water for the sake of a single type makes anchorages and towers disproportionately costly; short spans in the main channel multiply marine foundations, raising schedule and tidal risk as well as ship-collision probability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Type layout over 9.4 km” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若為追求單一橋型而在淺水區也使用大跨懸索橋，錨碇與塔的成本會不成比例；反之在主航道使用短跨，海中基礎增加，不僅工期與潮流風險上升，也增加船舶撞擊機率。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using long suspension spans even in shallow water for the sake of a single type makes anchorages and towers disproportionately costly; short spans in the main channel multiply marine foundations, raising schedule and tidal risk as well as ship-collision probability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：海中基礎是最昂貴、最受潮流與天候限制的工作，因此減少海中基礎數量是配置的核心考量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Marine foundations are the most expensive work and the most constrained by currents and weather, so reducing their number is central to the layout.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 鐵路通行與連續懸索橋：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三跨連續加勁桁」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-span continuous truss” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主將北、南備讚瀨戶大橋描述為三跨連續加勁桁架懸索橋。一般公路懸索橋常在橋塔處把加勁梁分開以鉸接或伸縮縫連接，鐵路卻難以接受橋塔處的折角：列車通過時主跨下垂、邊跨上揚，兩側梁端轉角相加，形成軌道的突然轉折。把加勁桁在塔處做成連續，能大幅減少這個折角，代價是塔處的彎矩與支承反力增加，以及溫度與活載下更複雜的縱向位移。這是瀨戶大橋作為公路鐵路兩用懸索橋的關鍵選擇之一。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三跨連續加勁桁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner describes Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto as three-span continuous truss-stiffened suspension bridges. Road suspension bridges often separate the stiffening girder at the towers with hinges or expansion joints, but rail cannot easily accept an angle break there: as a train crosses, the main span sags and the side span rises, and the two girder-end rotations add up to a sudden kink in the track. Making the stiffening truss continuous over the towers greatly reduces this kink, at the price of larger bending moments and bearing reactions at the towers and more complex longitudinal movement under temperature and live load. This was one of the key choices that made Seto Ohashi a road–rail suspension bridge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Three-span continuous truss” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線撓度形狀估算梁端轉角 θ ≈ 4δ/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate girder-end rotation from a parabolic deflection shape, θ ≈ 4δ/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「三跨連續加勁桁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Three-span continuous truss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans
knowledge.text: 業主將北、南備讚瀨戶大橋描述為三跨連續加勁桁架懸索橋。一般公路懸索橋常在橋塔處把加勁梁分開以鉸接或伸縮縫連接，鐵路卻難以接受橋塔處的折角：列車通過時主跨下垂、邊跨上揚，兩側梁端轉角相加，形成軌道的突然轉折。

Road suspension bridges often separate the stiffening girder at the towers with hinges or expansion joints, but rail cannot easily accept an angle break there: as a train crosses, the main span sags and the side span rises, and the two girder-end rotations add up to a sudden kink in the track.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鐵路通行與連續懸索橋」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans" is correct?
options: 懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。
兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。
業主將北、南備讚瀨戶大橋描述為三跨連續加勁桁架懸索橋。
optionsEn: A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation.
With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small.
The owner describes Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto as three-span continuous truss-stiffened suspension bridges.
quiz.explanation: 業主將北、南備讚瀨戶大橋描述為三跨連續加勁桁架懸索橋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The owner describes Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto as three-span continuous truss-stiffened suspension bridges. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鐵路通行與連續懸索橋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三跨連續加勁桁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-span continuous truss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線撓度形狀估算梁端轉角 θ ≈ 4δ/L。取主跨 L = 1,100 m、列車荷重下最大撓度 δ = 2.0 m：θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad；若塔處為鉸接，兩側轉角相加的折角可達約 0.0145 rad。連續構造把折角限制在梁的連續曲率內，鐵路容許折角則遠小於此值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate girder-end rotation from a parabolic deflection shape, θ ≈ 4δ/L. With main span L = 1,100 m and maximum deflection under train load δ = 2.0 m: θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad; with a hinge at the tower the two rotations add to a kink of about 0.0145 rad. Continuity keeps the angle within the girder's smooth curvature, while the permissible rail kink is far smaller. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型針對單線與雙線列車、公路車隊與溫度組合，輸出塔處與梁端的軌道折角、縱向位移與支承反力，與鐵路軌道標準比較；通車前以試運轉列車量測軌道高低差與加速度，確認乘坐品質。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the finite-element model with single- and double-track trains, road traffic and temperature combinations to output track angle breaks, longitudinal movement and bearing reactions at towers and girder ends against railway track standards; before opening measure track irregularity and car-body acceleration with test trains to confirm ride quality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以拋物線撓度形狀估算梁端轉角 θ ≈ 4δ/L。取主跨 L = 1,100 m、列車荷重下最大撓度 δ = 2.0 m：θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad；若塔處為鉸接，兩側轉角相加的折角可達約 0.0145 rad。連續構造把折角限制在梁的連續曲率內，鐵路容許折角則遠小於此值。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate girder-end rotation from a parabolic deflection shape, θ ≈ 4δ/L. With main span L = 1,100 m and maximum deflection under train load δ = 2.0 m: θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad; with a hinge at the tower the two rotations add to a kink of about 0.0145 rad. Continuity keeps the angle within the girder's smooth curvature, while the permissible rail kink is far smaller. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design.

steps.title: 鐵路通行與連續懸索橋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三跨連續加勁桁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Three-span continuous truss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型針對單線與雙線列車、公路車隊與溫度組合，輸出塔處與梁端的軌道折角、縱向位移與支承反力，與鐵路軌道標準比較；通車前以試運轉列車量測軌道高低差與加速度，確認乘坐品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the finite-element model with single- and double-track trains, road traffic and temperature combinations to output track angle breaks, longitudinal movement and bearing reactions at towers and girder ends against railway track standards; before opening measure track irregularity and car-body acceleration with test trains to confirm ride quality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：公路鐵路兩用橋應由橋梁與鐵路單位共同制定軌道折角、伸縮量與支承反力的設計表，並在竣工後建立塔處與梁端的長期位移與轉角監測，作為維護與限速決策的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For road–rail bridges the bridge and railway parties should jointly fix design tables for track kink, expansion and bearing reaction, and after completion set up long-term movement and rotation monitoring at towers and girder ends as the basis for maintenance and speed decisions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以公路標準設計塔處接頭，列車通過時的折角與衝擊會加速軌道部件、支承與伸縮裝置的損耗，嚴重時需要限速；連續梁在塔處的負彎矩若低估，上弦或下弦構件可能疲勞開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing tower joints only to road standards lets train-induced kinks and impact wear track components, bearings and expansion devices quickly, possibly forcing speed limits; underestimating negative moment at the towers in a continuous girder can lead to fatigue cracking of chord members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鐵路通行與連續懸索橋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三跨連續加勁桁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Three-span continuous truss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以公路標準設計塔處接頭，列車通過時的折角與衝擊會加速軌道部件、支承與伸縮裝置的損耗，嚴重時需要限速；連續梁在塔處的負彎矩若低估，上弦或下弦構件可能疲勞開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing tower joints only to road standards lets train-induced kinks and impact wear track components, bearings and expansion devices quickly, possibly forcing speed limits; underestimating negative moment at the towers in a continuous girder can lead to fatigue cracking of chord members. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是瀨戶大橋作為公路鐵路兩用懸索橋的關鍵選擇之一。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇」與「設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage" and "Placed caissons and prepacked concrete": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「共用錨碇索股交叉」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shared anchorage strand crossing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 北、南備讚瀨戶大橋相鄰而建，兩橋之間共用一座錨碇，兩側主纜的索股在錨碇內交叉錨定：北備讚為 234 股、南備讚為 271 股，業主稱這種構造為世界首例。每股由 127 根直徑約 5 mm 的平行鋼絲排成六角形，不扭絞。南備讚瀨戶大橋的主纜最大，直徑 107 cm，承受約 45,000 t 的張力。共用錨碇節省了一座巨大的重力式構造，但必須同時承受兩橋方向相反的主纜力，並在兩橋荷重不平衡時保持穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「共用錨碇索股交叉」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto stand side by side and share one anchorage between them, where the strands of both cables cross and are anchored: 234 strands for Kita Bisan-Seto and 271 for Minami Bisan-Seto, a structure the owner calls a world first. Each strand is 127 parallel wires of about 5 mm laid in a hexagon, not twisted. Minami Bisan-Seto's cable is the largest, 107 cm in diameter and carrying about 45,000 t of tension. The shared anchorage saved one huge gravity structure, but it must resist cable forces from both bridges in opposite directions and stay stable when their loads are unbalanced. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shared anchorage strand crossing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「共用錨碇索股交叉」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shared anchorage strand crossing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage

Each strand is 127 parallel wires of about 5 mm laid in a hexagon, not twisted.

steps.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共用錨碇索股交叉」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shared anchorage strand crossing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：南備讚 271×127 = 34,417 根。張力 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN；若鋼絲強度 1,570 N/mm²、安全係數取 2.5，所需面積 A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m²，每根約 20.4 mm²，對應直徑 ≈ 5.10 mm，與公開的「約 5 mm」一致；毛面積 π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m²，空隙率 ≈ 22%。強度與安全係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires. A tension of 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN, with wire strength 1,570 N/mm² and safety factor 2.5, needs A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m², about 20.4 mm² per wire, a diameter ≈ 5.10 mm, consistent with the published ‘about 5 mm’; gross area π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 22%. Strength and safety factor are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：共用錨碇的穩定檢核要包含兩橋同時滿載、單橋滿載另一橋空載、溫度差與地震等組合，計算合力方向與基底反力分布；施工時逐股量測錨固力與索股垂度，確認兩側索股交叉排列與錨頭位置符合圖說。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution; during construction measure anchoring force and sag strand by strand, confirming the crossing arrangement and socket positions match the drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 南備讚 271×127 = 34,417 根。張力 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN；若鋼絲強度 1,570 N/mm²、安全係數取 2.5，所需面積 A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m²，每根約 20.4 mm²，對應直徑 ≈ 5.10 mm，與公開的「約 5 mm」一致；毛面積 π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m²，空隙率 ≈ 22%。強度與安全係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires. A tension of 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN, with wire strength 1,570 N/mm² and safety factor 2.5, needs A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m², about 20.4 mm² per wire, a diameter ≈ 5.10 mm, consistent with the published ‘about 5 mm’; gross area π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 22%. Strength and safety factor are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires.

steps.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共用錨碇索股交叉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shared anchorage strand crossing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 共用錨碇的穩定檢核要包含兩橋同時滿載、單橋滿載另一橋空載、溫度差與地震等組合，計算合力方向與基底反力分布；施工時逐股量測錨固力與索股垂度，確認兩側索股交叉排列與錨頭位置符合圖說。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution; during construction measure anchoring force and sag strand by strand, confirming the crossing arrangement and socket positions match the drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：共用錨碇的設計基準應列出所有不平衡荷重組合與容許偏心，並在錨碇內保留足夠的檢查通道與照明，讓每一個索股錨頭都能定期目視與量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis for a shared anchorage should list every unbalanced load combination and the allowable eccentricity, and the anchorage must keep enough inspection access and lighting so every strand socket can be seen and measured periodically.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只檢核兩橋對稱受力，單側滿載時錨碇的合力偏心可能使基底一側壓力過大或另一側脫開；索股交叉區排列錯誤則造成錨頭擁擠、受力不均，日後也難以檢查與更換。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only symmetric loading can miss the eccentric resultant when one bridge is loaded, overstressing one side of the base or lifting the other; misarranged strands in the crossing zone crowd sockets, share load unevenly and are hard to inspect or replace later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共用錨碇索股交叉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shared anchorage strand crossing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只檢核兩橋對稱受力，單側滿載時錨碇的合力偏心可能使基底一側壓力過大或另一側脫開；索股交叉區排列錯誤則造成錨頭擁擠、受力不均，日後也難以檢查與更換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only symmetric loading can miss the eccentric resultant when one bridge is loaded, overstressing one side of the base or lifting the other; misarranged strands in the crossing zone crowd sockets, share load unevenly and are hard to inspect or replace later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用錨碇節省了一座巨大的重力式構造，但必須同時承受兩橋方向相反的主纜力，並在兩橋荷重不平衡時保持穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The shared anchorage saved one huge gravity structure, but it must resist cable forces from both bridges in opposite directions and stay stable when their loads are unbalanced.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只檢核兩橋對稱受力，單側滿載時錨碇的合力偏心可能使基底一側壓力過大或另一側脫開；索股交叉區排列錯誤則造成錨頭擁擠、受力不均，日後也難以檢查與更換。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。
optionsEn: Checking only symmetric loading can miss the eccentric resultant when one bridge is loaded, overstressing one side of the base or lifting the other.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Placed caissons and prepacked concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「11 座設置沉箱」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eleven placed caissons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 瀨戶大橋的海中基礎採用設置沉箱工法：在完成整平的岩盤上放置巨大的箱形鋼製模板，再在內部填充水中混凝土，共製作 11 座。以其中一例而言，沉箱寬 59 m、長 75 m、高 55 m、重約 18,000 t，在造船廠船塢製作近 2 年，與現場作業平行進行以縮短工期。沉箱內的水中混凝土採用預壘骨材工法：先在海水中投放 80 至 150 mm 的大粒徑骨材，再從注入管壓入砂漿，把骨材間的海水擠出；砂漿船「世紀」每日最多可製造 5,800 m³ 砂漿，一旦開始注入就必須三晝夜連續作業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「11 座設置沉箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seto Ohashi's marine foundations used the placed-caisson method: a huge box-shaped steel form is set on a levelled rock surface and filled with underwater concrete, eleven in all. One example caisson is 59 m wide, 75 m long and 55 m high, weighs about 18,000 t and took nearly two years to build in a shipyard dock, in parallel with site work to shorten the schedule. The underwater concrete inside used the prepacked-aggregate method: 80 to 150 mm aggregate is first placed in the seawater, then mortar is pumped in through injection pipes to displace the water between stones; the mortar plant ship Seiki could produce up to 5,800 m³ a day, and once injection started it ran continuously for three days and nights. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Eleven placed caissons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預壘骨材的空隙率取 40%，每日 5,800 m³ 砂漿可完成約 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ 的混凝土；三晝夜約 43,500 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking a 40% void ratio for the prepacked aggregate, 5,800 m³ of mortar a day completes about 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ of concrete, about 43,500 m³ in three days and nights.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「11 座設置沉箱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Eleven placed caissons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土
knowledge.text: 瀨戶大橋的海中基礎採用設置沉箱工法：在完成整平的岩盤上放置巨大的箱形鋼製模板，再在內部填充水中混凝土，共製作 11 座。以其中一例而言，沉箱寬 59 m、長 75 m、高 55 m、重約 18,000 t，在造船廠船塢製作近 2 年，與現場作業平行進行以縮短工期。
knowledge.textEn: Seto Ohashi's marine foundations used the placed-caisson method: a huge box-shaped steel form is set on a levelled rock surface and filled with underwater concrete, eleven in all. One example caisson is 59 m wide, 75 m long and 55 m high, weighs about 18,000 t and took nearly two years to build in a shipyard dock, in parallel with site work to shorten the schedule.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Placed caissons and prepacked concrete" is correct?
options: 預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。
瀨戶大橋的海中基礎採用設置沉箱工法：在完成整平的岩盤上放置巨大的箱形鋼製模板，再在內部填充水中混凝土，共製作 11 座。
貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。

Seto Ohashi's marine foundations used the placed-caisson method: a huge box-shaped steel form is set on a levelled rock surface and filled with underwater concrete, eleven in all.
A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design.

steps.title: 設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Placed caissons and prepacked concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「11 座設置沉箱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eleven placed caissons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預壘骨材的空隙率取 40%，每日 5,800 m³ 砂漿可完成約 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ 的混凝土；三晝夜約 43,500 m³。沉箱外廓體積 59×75×55 ≈ 243,000 m³，扣除隔艙與鋼殼仍需多次分層注入。若空隙率為 45%，每日完成量降為約 12,900 m³。空隙率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking a 40% void ratio for the prepacked aggregate, 5,800 m³ of mortar a day completes about 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ of concrete, about 43,500 m³ in three days and nights. The caisson envelope is 59×75×55 ≈ 243,000 m³, so even after deducting partitions and shell it needs several injection lifts. At 45% voids the daily output drops to about 12,900 m³. The void ratio is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：注入過程中以測深與注入管周邊的砂漿面計量測砂漿上升高度，確認注入管埋入深度與各區均勻上升；完成後鑽心取樣檢查骨材間是否充填密實、有無海水夾層或泥膜，並以試體確認砂漿強度與流動性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During injection measure mortar rise with soundings and gauges around the pipes, confirming pipe embedment and even rise in every zone; afterwards core to check that voids between stones are fully filled without seawater pockets or silt films, and confirm mortar strength and flow with specimens.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 預壘骨材的空隙率取 40%，每日 5,800 m³ 砂漿可完成約 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ 的混凝土；三晝夜約 43,500 m³。沉箱外廓體積 59×75×55 ≈ 243,000 m³，扣除隔艙與鋼殼仍需多次分層注入。若空隙率為 45%，每日完成量降為約 12,900 m³。空隙率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Taking a 40% void ratio for the prepacked aggregate, 5,800 m³ of mortar a day completes about 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ of concrete, about 43,500 m³ in three days and nights. The caisson envelope is 59×75×55 ≈ 243,000 m³, so even after deducting partitions and shell it needs several injection lifts. At 45% voids the daily output drops to about 12,900 m³. The void ratio is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Placed caissons and prepacked concrete", which statement holds?
options: 每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。
鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。
預壘骨材的空隙率取 40%，每日 5,800 m³ 砂漿可完成約 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ 的混凝土；三晝夜約 43,500 m³。
optionsEn: If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately.
Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem.
Taking a 40% void ratio for the prepacked aggregate, 5,800 m³ of mortar a day completes about 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ of concrete, about 43,500 m³ in three days and nights.
quiz.explanation: 預壘骨材的空隙率取 40%，每日 5,800 m³ 砂漿可完成約 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ 的混凝土；三晝夜約 43,500 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Taking a 40% void ratio for the prepacked aggregate, 5,800 m³ of mortar a day completes about 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ of concrete, about 43,500 m³ in three days and nights. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Placed caissons and prepacked concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「11 座設置沉箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eleven placed caissons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 注入過程中以測深與注入管周邊的砂漿面計量測砂漿上升高度，確認注入管埋入深度與各區均勻上升；完成後鑽心取樣檢查骨材間是否充填密實、有無海水夾層或泥膜，並以試體確認砂漿強度與流動性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During injection measure mortar rise with soundings and gauges around the pipes, confirming pipe embedment and even rise in every zone; afterwards core to check that voids between stones are fully filled without seawater pockets or silt films, and confirm mortar strength and flow with specimens. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預壘骨材工法應訂定骨材清洗與投放後的最長等待時間、注入管間距、連續作業的備援（第二套泵與發電機）與中斷處理程序，並以鑽心結果作為驗收停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The prepacked method needs limits on aggregate washing and the maximum wait after placement, injection-pipe spacing, back-up for continuous work (spare pumps and generators) and a procedure for interruptions, with core results as the acceptance hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：骨材在投放後若被潮流帶入泥砂或生物附著，砂漿無法與骨材緊密結合，形成弱面；注入若中斷超過允許時間，新舊砂漿之間產生冷縫，基礎內部出現不連續面，降低抗剪與耐久性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If silt or marine growth coats the aggregate after placement, mortar cannot bond tightly and weak planes form; interrupting injection beyond the allowable time leaves cold joints between old and new mortar, creating internal discontinuities that cut shear capacity and durability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 注入過程中以測深與注入管周邊的砂漿面計量測砂漿上升高度，確認注入管埋入深度與各區均勻上升；完成後鑽心取樣檢查骨材間是否充填密實、有無海水夾層或泥膜，並以試體確認砂漿強度與流動性。
knowledge.textEn: During injection measure mortar rise with soundings and gauges around the pipes, confirming pipe embedment and even rise in every zone; afterwards core to check that voids between stones are fully filled without seawater pockets or silt films, and confirm mortar strength and flow with specimens.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預壘骨材工法應訂定骨材清洗與投放後的最長等待時間、注入管間距、連續作業的備援（第二套泵與發電機）與中斷處理程序，並以鑽心結果作為驗收停留點。
knowledge.textEn: The prepacked method needs limits on aggregate washing and the maximum wait after placement, injection-pipe spacing, back-up for continuous work (spare pumps and generators) and a procedure for interruptions, with core results as the acceptance hold point.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Placed caissons and prepacked concrete"?
options: 注入過程中以測深與注入管周邊的砂漿面計量測砂漿上升高度，確認注入管埋入深度與各區均勻上升。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。
optionsEn: During injection measure mortar rise with soundings and gauges around the pipes, confirming pipe embedment and even rise in every zone.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout.
quiz.explanation: 注入過程中以測深與注入管周邊的砂漿面計量測砂漿上升高度，確認注入管埋入深度與各區均勻上升；完成後鑽心取樣檢查骨材間是否充填密實、有無海水夾層或泥膜，並以試體確認砂漿強度與流動性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During injection measure mortar rise with soundings and gauges around the pipes, confirming pipe embedment and even rise in every zone; afterwards core to check that voids between stones are fully filled without seawater pockets or silt films, and confirm mortar strength and flow with specimens. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Placed caissons and prepacked concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「11 座設置沉箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eleven placed caissons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 骨材在投放後若被潮流帶入泥砂或生物附著，砂漿無法與骨材緊密結合，形成弱面；注入若中斷超過允許時間，新舊砂漿之間產生冷縫，基礎內部出現不連續面，降低抗剪與耐久性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If silt or marine growth coats the aggregate after placement, mortar cannot bond tightly and weak planes form; interrupting injection beyond the allowable time leaves cold joints between old and new mortar, creating internal discontinuities that cut shear capacity and durability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沉箱內的水中混凝土採用預壘骨材工法：先在海水中投放 80 至 150 mm 的大粒徑骨材，再從注入管壓入砂漿，把骨材間的海水擠出；砂漿船「世紀」每日最多可製造 5,800 m³ 砂漿，一旦開始注入就必須三晝夜連續作業。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The underwater concrete inside used the prepacked-aggregate method: 80 to 150 mm aggregate is first placed in the seawater, then mortar is pumped in through injection pipes to displace the water between stones; the mortar plant ship Seiki could produce up to 5,800 m³ a day, and once injection started it ran continuously for three days and nights.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 骨材在投放後若被潮流帶入泥砂或生物附著，砂漿無法與骨材緊密結合，形成弱面；注入若中斷超過允許時間，新舊砂漿之間產生冷縫，基礎內部出現不連續面，降低抗剪與耐久性。
knowledge.textEn: If silt or marine growth coats the aggregate after placement, mortar cannot bond tightly and weak planes form; interrupting injection beyond the allowable time leaves cold joints between old and new mortar, creating internal discontinuities that cut shear capacity and durability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Placed caissons and prepacked concrete" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
骨材在投放後若被潮流帶入泥砂或生物附著，砂漿無法與骨材緊密結合，形成弱面；注入若中斷超過允許時間，新舊砂漿之間產生冷縫，基礎內部出現不連續面，降低抗剪與耐久性。
貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If silt or marine growth coats the aggregate after placement, mortar cannot bond tightly and weak planes form.
A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design.
quiz.explanation: 骨材在投放後若被潮流帶入泥砂或生物附著，砂漿無法與骨材緊密結合，形成弱面；注入若中斷超過允許時間，新舊砂漿之間產生冷縫，基礎內部出現不連續面，降低抗剪與耐久性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If silt or marine growth coats the aggregate after placement, mortar cannot bond tightly and weak planes form; interrupting injection beyond the allowable time leaves cold joints between old and new mortar, creating internal discontinuities that cut shear capacity and durability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤」與「加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels" and "Truss erection and the jacked-open closure": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「起重船牽引導索」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crane-ship pilot rope” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 過去的懸索橋把第一條導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過海峽，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋航道繁忙，因此改以起重船把導索吊在高處跨越。導索就位後，約 10 條較粗的鋼索架在其上，鋪上鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，形成寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m 的貓道，貓道之間以橫向便橋連接。索股在架設前 4 年以上就開始製造，每股捲在重近 40 t 的捲盤上，以貨運列車陸運，再以牽引索在兩座錨碇間拉送。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「起重船牽引導索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Earlier suspension bridges floated the first pilot rope on buoys and towed it across by boat, which meant closing the channel; Seto Ohashi's channels were too busy, so a crane ship held the pilot rope high as it crossed. With the pilot rope in place, about ten heavier ropes were laid on it and covered with wire mesh and a double fibre net to form a catwalk 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges. Strand fabrication began more than four years before erection; each strand was wound on a reel weighing nearly 40 t, carried overland by freight train and hauled between the anchorages by a traction rope. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crane-ship pilot rope” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單股重量 W = n·a·L·ρ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Strand weight W = n·a·L·ρ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「起重船牽引導索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Crane-ship pilot rope”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤
knowledge.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels
knowledge.text: 過去的懸索橋把第一條導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過海峽，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋航道繁忙，因此改以起重船把導索吊在高處跨越。導索就位後，約 10 條較粗的鋼索架在其上，鋪上鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，形成寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m 的貓道，貓道之間以橫向便橋連接。
knowledge.textEn: Earlier suspension bridges floated the first pilot rope on buoys and towed it across by boat, which meant closing the channel; Seto Ohashi's channels were too busy, so a crane ship held the pilot rope high as it crossed. With the pilot rope in place, about ten heavier ropes were laid on it and covered with wire mesh and a double fibre net to form a catwalk 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels" is correct?
options: 貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。
加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。
過去的懸索橋把第一條導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過海峽，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋航道繁忙，因此改以起重船把導索吊在高處跨越。
optionsEn: A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design.
If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure.
Earlier suspension bridges floated the first pilot rope on buoys and towed it across by boat, which meant closing the channel.
quiz.explanation: 過去的懸索橋把第一條導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過海峽，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋航道繁忙，因此改以起重船把導索吊在高處跨越。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Earlier suspension bridges floated the first pilot rope on buoys and towed it across by boat, which meant closing the channel; Seto Ohashi's channels were too busy, so a crane ship held the pilot rope high as it crossed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「起重船牽引導索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crane-ship pilot rope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單股重量 W = n·a·L·ρ。取 127 根、每根 20.4 mm²、索股長 1,800 m、鋼密度 7,850 kg/m³：W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t，加上捲盤後接近公開的「近 40 t」。若索股長 2,000 m，單股約 40.7 t，可能超過捲盤與運輸限制。索股長度與單絲面積為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Strand weight W = n·a·L·ρ. With 127 wires of 20.4 mm², a strand length of 1,800 m and steel at 7,850 kg/m³: W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t, close to the published ‘nearly 40 t’ once the reel is added. A 2,000 m strand would weigh about 40.7 t and could exceed reel and transport limits. Strand length and wire area are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：導索跨越前與航道主管機關確認作業時段與起重船位置，跨越中量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後做荷重與防風試驗、檢查網片與扶手；每股牽引前核對捲盤編號、長度標記與錨頭，牽引後量測垂度並記錄溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the crossing confirm working hours and crane-ship position with the navigation authority and measure the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built carry out load and wind checks and inspect mesh and handrails; before hauling each strand check reel number, length marks and sockets, and after hauling measure sag and record temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單股重量 W = n·a·L·ρ。取 127 根、每根 20.4 mm²、索股長 1,800 m、鋼密度 7,850 kg/m³：W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t，加上捲盤後接近公開的「近 40 t」。若索股長 2,000 m，單股約 40.7 t，可能超過捲盤與運輸限制。索股長度與單絲面積為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Strand weight W = n·a·L·ρ. With 127 wires of 20.4 mm², a strand length of 1,800 m and steel at 7,850 kg/m³: W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t, close to the published ‘nearly 40 t’ once the reel is added. A 2,000 m strand would weigh about 40.7 t and could exceed reel and transport limits. Strand length and wire area are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels", which statement holds?
options: 單股重量 W = n·a·L·ρ。
沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。
鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。
optionsEn: Strand weight W = n·a·L·ρ.
A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it.
Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 單股重量 W = n·a·L·ρ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Strand weight W = n·a·L·ρ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「起重船牽引導索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crane-ship pilot rope” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 導索跨越前與航道主管機關確認作業時段與起重船位置，跨越中量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後做荷重與防風試驗、檢查網片與扶手；每股牽引前核對捲盤編號、長度標記與錨頭，牽引後量測垂度並記錄溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the crossing confirm working hours and crane-ship position with the navigation authority and measure the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built carry out load and wind checks and inspect mesh and handrails; before hauling each strand check reel number, length marks and sockets, and after hauling measure sag and record temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：貓道與牽引設備屬於臨時結構，必須有獨立的設計計算、風速停工準則與每日檢查表，並由臨時工程設計者與施工主管共同簽認；導索跨越作業須取得海事主管機關的許可與航行警告。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Catwalks and hauling gear are temporary structures needing their own design calculations, stop-work wind speeds and daily checklists, signed by the temporary-works designer and the site manager; the pilot-rope crossing requires marine-authority approval and a navigation warning.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導索若在跨越時下垂到航道淨空以下，可能與船舶勾掛；貓道網片或橫向便橋固定不良，強風中晃動劇烈，危及作業人員並損傷已架設索股；捲盤運輸或展開時刮傷鋼絲鍍鋅層，日後成為腐蝕起點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A pilot rope sagging below the clearance during the crossing can snag a ship; poorly fixed catwalk mesh or cross-bridges swing violently in strong wind, endangering workers and damaging strands already erected; scratching galvanising during reel transport or unwinding creates future corrosion sites. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 導索跨越前與航道主管機關確認作業時段與起重船位置，跨越中量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後做荷重與防風試驗、檢查網片與扶手；每股牽引前核對捲盤編號、長度標記與錨頭，牽引後量測垂度並記錄溫度。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 貓道與牽引設備屬於臨時結構，必須有獨立的設計計算、風速停工準則與每日檢查表，並由臨時工程設計者與施工主管共同簽認；導索跨越作業須取得海事主管機關的許可與航行警告。
knowledge.textEn: Catwalks and hauling gear are temporary structures needing their own design calculations, stop-work wind speeds and daily checklists, signed by the temporary-works designer and the site manager; the pilot-rope crossing requires marine-authority approval and a navigation warning.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
導索跨越前與航道主管機關確認作業時段與起重船位置，跨越中量測導索最低點高程。
懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before the crossing confirm working hours and crane-ship position with the navigation authority and measure the rope's lowest point during the crossing.
A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation.
quiz.explanation: 導索跨越前與航道主管機關確認作業時段與起重船位置，跨越中量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後做荷重與防風試驗、檢查網片與扶手；每股牽引前核對捲盤編號、長度標記與錨頭，牽引後量測垂度並記錄溫度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the crossing confirm working hours and crane-ship position with the navigation authority and measure the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built carry out load and wind checks and inspect mesh and handrails; before hauling each strand check reel number, length marks and sockets, and after hauling measure sag and record temperature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「起重船牽引導索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crane-ship pilot rope” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導索若在跨越時下垂到航道淨空以下，可能與船舶勾掛；貓道網片或橫向便橋固定不良，強風中晃動劇烈，危及作業人員並損傷已架設索股；捲盤運輸或展開時刮傷鋼絲鍍鋅層，日後成為腐蝕起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A pilot rope sagging below the clearance during the crossing can snag a ship; poorly fixed catwalk mesh or cross-bridges swing violently in strong wind, endangering workers and damaging strands already erected; scratching galvanising during reel transport or unwinding creates future corrosion sites. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：索股在架設前 4 年以上就開始製造，每股捲在重近 40 t 的捲盤上，以貨運列車陸運，再以牽引索在兩座錨碇間拉送。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Strand fabrication began more than four years before erection; each strand was wound on a reel weighing nearly 40 t, carried overland by freight train and hauled between the anchorages by a traction rope.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導索若在跨越時下垂到航道淨空以下，可能與船舶勾掛；貓道網片或橫向便橋固定不良，強風中晃動劇烈，危及作業人員並損傷已架設索股；捲盤運輸或展開時刮傷鋼絲鍍鋅層，日後成為腐蝕起點。
knowledge.textEn: A pilot rope sagging below the clearance during the crossing can snag a ship; poorly fixed catwalk mesh or cross-bridges swing violently in strong wind, endangering workers and damaging strands already erected; scratching galvanising during reel transport or unwinding creates future corrosion sites.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。
導索若在跨越時下垂到航道淨空以下，可能與船舶勾掛。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure.
A pilot rope sagging below the clearance during the crossing can snag a ship.
quiz.explanation: 導索若在跨越時下垂到航道淨空以下，可能與船舶勾掛；貓道網片或橫向便橋固定不良，強風中晃動劇烈，危及作業人員並損傷已架設索股；捲盤運輸或展開時刮傷鋼絲鍍鋅層，日後成為腐蝕起點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A pilot rope sagging below the clearance during the crossing can snag a ship; poorly fixed catwalk mesh or cross-bridges swing violently in strong wind, endangering workers and damaging strands already erected; scratching galvanising during reel transport or unwinding creates future corrosion sites. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Truss erection and the jacked-open closure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1,500 t tower blocks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主記載加勁桁在工廠先做全尺寸立體預組以確認精度，再塗裝並依現場進度出貨。南備讚瀨戶大橋把每座塔附近四個格間約 1,500 t 在工廠組成大塊，由起重船一次吊放，提早騰出橋上空間給後續的架設設備；之後以兩個格間為一組，以船運到塔邊吊起、用台車往前送，再由前端吊機安裝，反覆循環。隨著架設推進主纜形狀大幅變化，需要測量並平衡兩側進度。架設約一年後兩側在跨中會合，最後一段合龍前以塔邊的千斤頂把桁架往塔方向拉，擴大合龍間隙，嵌入後再放鬆。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner records that the stiffening truss was fully trial-assembled in three dimensions at the factory to confirm accuracy before painting and shipping to suit the site schedule. At Minami Bisan-Seto the four panels near each tower, about 1,500 t, were assembled into a large block and set by a crane ship in one lift, clearing the deck early for the following erection equipment; after that two-panel units were shipped to the tower, lifted, moved forward on carriages and placed by a crane at the leading end, in a repeating cycle. The cable shape changed greatly as erection advanced, requiring surveys and balanced progress on both sides. After about a year the two fronts met at mid-span; before the closure panel went in, jacks at the towers pulled the truss toward the towers to widen the gap, then were released. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1,500 t tower blocks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：合龍間隙對溫度敏感：兩側各約 550 m 的桁架，溫度上升 10 °C 時間隙縮小 ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The closure gap is temperature sensitive: with about 550 m of truss on each side, a 10 °C rise closes the gap by ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “1,500 t tower blocks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開
knowledge.titleEn: Truss erection and the jacked-open closure
knowledge.text: 業主記載加勁桁在工廠先做全尺寸立體預組以確認精度，再塗裝並依現場進度出貨。南備讚瀨戶大橋把每座塔附近四個格間約 1,500 t 在工廠組成大塊，由起重船一次吊放，提早騰出橋上空間給後續的架設設備；之後以兩個格間為一組，以船運到塔邊吊起、用台車往前送，再由前端吊機安裝，反覆循環。
knowledge.textEn: The owner records that the stiffening truss was fully trial-assembled in three dimensions at the factory to confirm accuracy before painting and shipping to suit the site schedule. At Minami Bisan-Seto the four panels near each tower, about 1,500 t, were assembled into a large block and set by a crane ship in one lift, clearing the deck early for the following erection equipment; after that two-panel units were shipped to the tower, lifted, moved forward on carriages and placed by a crane at the leading end, in a repeating cycle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Truss erection and the jacked-open closure" is correct?
options: 業主記載加勁桁在工廠先做全尺寸立體預組以確認精度，再塗裝並依現場進度出貨。
加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。
每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。
optionsEn: The owner records that the stiffening truss was fully trial-assembled in three dimensions at the factory to confirm accuracy before painting and shipping to suit the site schedule.
If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure.
If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately.
quiz.explanation: 業主記載加勁桁在工廠先做全尺寸立體預組以確認精度，再塗裝並依現場進度出貨。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The owner records that the stiffening truss was fully trial-assembled in three dimensions at the factory to confirm accuracy before painting and shipping to suit the site schedule. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Truss erection and the jacked-open closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1,500 t tower blocks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：合龍間隙對溫度敏感：兩側各約 550 m 的桁架，溫度上升 10 °C 時間隙縮小 ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m。若合龍段需要 50 mm 的安裝餘裕，而當時溫度比設計高 5 °C（間隙少約 66 mm），就必須以千斤頂拉開約 116 mm 或等待降溫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The closure gap is temperature sensitive: with about 550 m of truss on each side, a 10 °C rise closes the gap by ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m. If the closure panel needs 50 mm of fitting clearance and the temperature is 5 °C above design (gap about 66 mm short), jacks must open about 116 mm or the team must wait for cooling. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個架設循環後量測主纜垂度、桁架高程與兩側進度差，與施工階段分析比較；合龍前連續數小時量測間隙與桁架溫度，建立間隙—溫度關係，選定合龍時段，並記錄千斤頂拉力與行程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each cycle measure cable sag, truss levels and the progress difference between sides against the stage analysis; before closure measure gap and truss temperature continuously for several hours to build a gap–temperature relation, choose the closure window, and log jack force and stroke.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 合龍間隙對溫度敏感：兩側各約 550 m 的桁架，溫度上升 10 °C 時間隙縮小 ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m。若合龍段需要 50 mm 的安裝餘裕，而當時溫度比設計高 5 °C（間隙少約 66 mm），就必須以千斤頂拉開約 116 mm 或等待降溫。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The closure gap is temperature sensitive: with about 550 m of truss on each side, a 10 °C rise closes the gap by ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m. If the closure panel needs 50 mm of fitting clearance and the temperature is 5 °C above design (gap about 66 mm short), jacks must open about 116 mm or the team must wait for cooling.
