knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Truss erection and the jacked-open closure", which statement holds?
options: 鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。
合龍間隙對溫度敏感：兩側各約 550 m 的桁架，溫度上升 10 °C 時間隙縮小 ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m。
跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。
optionsEn: Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem.
The closure gap is temperature sensitive: with about 550 m of truss on each side, a 10 °C rise closes the gap by ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m.
A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout.
quiz.explanation: 合龍間隙對溫度敏感：兩側各約 550 m 的桁架，溫度上升 10 °C 時間隙縮小 ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The closure gap is temperature sensitive: with about 550 m of truss on each side, a 10 °C rise closes the gap by ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Truss erection and the jacked-open closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1,500 t tower blocks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個架設循環後量測主纜垂度、桁架高程與兩側進度差，與施工階段分析比較；合龍前連續數小時量測間隙與桁架溫度，建立間隙—溫度關係，選定合龍時段，並記錄千斤頂拉力與行程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each cycle measure cable sag, truss levels and the progress difference between sides against the stage analysis; before closure measure gap and truss temperature continuously for several hours to build a gap–temperature relation, choose the closure window, and log jack force and stroke. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合龍作業應有書面的溫度窗口、千斤頂容許拉力、間隙量測方法與停止條件，並由設計者確認合龍時的結構狀態；工廠全尺寸預組的量測紀錄須隨構件交付，作為現場比對依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Closure needs a written temperature window, allowable jack force, gap measurement method and stop conditions, with the designer confirming the structural state at closure; factory trial-assembly measurements should travel with the members as the reference for site checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若兩側架設進度不平衡，塔頂受不平衡水平力而偏位，主纜形狀偏離預測，合龍時兩端高程與角度對不上；在溫度上升時強行嵌入合龍段，可能使接頭產生強迫應力或無法栓接。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unbalanced progress pulls the tower tops out of position and the cable away from its predicted shape, so the two ends do not match in level or angle at closure; forcing the closure panel in while temperature is rising can lock in stresses or prevent bolting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個架設循環後量測主纜垂度、桁架高程與兩側進度差，與施工階段分析比較；合龍前連續數小時量測間隙與桁架溫度，建立間隙—溫度關係，選定合龍時段，並記錄千斤頂拉力與行程。
knowledge.textEn: After each cycle measure cable sag, truss levels and the progress difference between sides against the stage analysis; before closure measure gap and truss temperature continuously for several hours to build a gap–temperature relation, choose the closure window, and log jack force and stroke.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合龍作業應有書面的溫度窗口、千斤頂容許拉力、間隙量測方法與停止條件，並由設計者確認合龍時的結構狀態；工廠全尺寸預組的量測紀錄須隨構件交付，作為現場比對依據。
knowledge.textEn: Closure needs a written temperature window, allowable jack force, gap measurement method and stop conditions, with the designer confirming the structural state at closure; factory trial-assembly measurements should travel with the members as the reference for site checks.

quiz.question: 要驗證「加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Truss erection and the jacked-open closure"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。
每個架設循環後量測主纜垂度、桁架高程與兩側進度差，與施工階段分析比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small.
After each cycle measure cable sag, truss levels and the progress difference between sides against the stage analysis.
quiz.explanation: 每個架設循環後量測主纜垂度、桁架高程與兩側進度差，與施工階段分析比較；合龍前連續數小時量測間隙與桁架溫度，建立間隙—溫度關係，選定合龍時段，並記錄千斤頂拉力與行程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each cycle measure cable sag, truss levels and the progress difference between sides against the stage analysis; before closure measure gap and truss temperature continuously for several hours to build a gap–temperature relation, choose the closure window, and log jack force and stroke. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Truss erection and the jacked-open closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “1,500 t tower blocks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若兩側架設進度不平衡，塔頂受不平衡水平力而偏位，主纜形狀偏離預測，合龍時兩端高程與角度對不上；在溫度上升時強行嵌入合龍段，可能使接頭產生強迫應力或無法栓接。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unbalanced progress pulls the tower tops out of position and the cable away from its predicted shape, so the two ends do not match in level or angle at closure; forcing the closure panel in while temperature is rising can lock in stresses or prevent bolting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：架設約一年後兩側在跨中會合，最後一段合龍前以塔邊的千斤頂把桁架往塔方向拉，擴大合龍間隙，嵌入後再放鬆。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After about a year the two fronts met at mid-span; before the closure panel went in, jacks at the towers pulled the truss toward the towers to widen the gap, then were released.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若兩側架設進度不平衡，塔頂受不平衡水平力而偏位，主纜形狀偏離預測，合龍時兩端高程與角度對不上；在溫度上升時強行嵌入合龍段，可能使接頭產生強迫應力或無法栓接。
knowledge.textEn: Unbalanced progress pulls the tower tops out of position and the cable away from its predicted shape, so the two ends do not match in level or angle at closure; forcing the closure panel in while temperature is rising can lock in stresses or prevent bolting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Truss erection and the jacked-open closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若兩側架設進度不平衡，塔頂受不平衡水平力而偏位，主纜形狀偏離預測，合龍時兩端高程與角度對不上；在溫度上升時強行嵌入合龍段，可能使接頭產生強迫應力或無法栓接。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。
optionsEn: Unbalanced progress pulls the tower tops out of position and the cable away from its predicted shape, so the two ends do not match in level or angle at closure.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately.
quiz.explanation: 若兩側架設進度不平衡，塔頂受不平衡水平力而偏位，主纜形狀偏離預測，合龍時兩端高程與角度對不上；在溫度上升時強行嵌入合龍段，可能使接頭產生強迫應力或無法栓接。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unbalanced progress pulls the tower tops out of position and the cable away from its predicted shape, so the two ends do not match in level or angle at closure; forcing the closure panel in while temperature is rising can lock in stresses or prevent bolting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預組量測與誤差累積控制」與「沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation" and "Caisson towing window and placement acceptance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「工廠全尺寸預組」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full factory trial assembly” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸索橋加勁桁由數百個構件與接頭組成，每個接頭的小誤差在長跨中累積，最後決定合龍處能否對上、吊索位置是否與索夾一致，以及鐵路軌道是否平順。工廠全尺寸立體預組讓誤差在地面上就被發現並修正，而不是到了海上高空才發現孔位不合。誤差分為隨機誤差與系統誤差：隨機誤差會部分互相抵消，系統誤差（例如量尺溫度未修正、模具偏差）則每一節都朝同一方向累積，是預組最需要抓出來的對象。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「工廠全尺寸預組」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A suspension stiffening truss is made of hundreds of members and joints, and small errors at each joint accumulate along a long span, deciding whether the closure fits, whether hanger positions match the cable bands and whether the rail track is smooth. Full three-dimensional trial assembly in the factory finds and fixes errors on the ground rather than discovering mismatched holes high above the sea. Errors are random or systematic: random errors partly cancel, while systematic ones, such as an uncorrected tape temperature or a jig offset, accumulate in the same direction at every panel and are what trial assembly most needs to catch. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full factory trial assembly” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「工廠全尺寸預組」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full factory trial assembly”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制
knowledge.text: 懸索橋加勁桁由數百個構件與接頭組成，每個接頭的小誤差在長跨中累積，最後決定合龍處能否對上、吊索位置是否與索夾一致，以及鐵路軌道是否平順。工廠全尺寸立體預組讓誤差在地面上就被發現並修正，而不是到了海上高空才發現孔位不合。
knowledge.textEn: A suspension stiffening truss is made of hundreds of members and joints, and small errors at each joint accumulate along a long span, deciding whether the closure fits, whether hanger positions match the cable bands and whether the rail track is smooth. Full three-dimensional trial assembly in the factory finds and fixes errors on the ground rather than discovering mismatched holes high above the sea.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預組量測與誤差累積控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation" is correct?
options: 每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。
懸索橋加勁桁由數百個構件與接頭組成，每個接頭的小誤差在長跨中累積，最後決定合龍處能否對上、吊索位置是否與索夾一致，以及鐵路軌道是否平順。
沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。
optionsEn: If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately.

A suspension stiffening truss is made of hundreds of members and joints, and small errors at each joint accumulate along a long span, deciding whether the closure fits, whether hanger positions match the cable bands and whether the rail track is smooth.
A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it.
quiz.explanation: 懸索橋加勁桁由數百個構件與接頭組成，每個接頭的小誤差在長跨中累積，最後決定合龍處能否對上、吊索位置是否與索夾一致，以及鐵路軌道是否平順。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A suspension stiffening truss is made of hundreds of members and joints, and small errors at each joint accumulate along a long span, deciding whether the closure fits, whether hanger positions match the cable bands and whether the rail track is smooth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「工廠全尺寸預組」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full factory trial assembly” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。若系統誤差在預組中被找出並修正到 0.2 mm，累積只剩 20 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part. If trial assembly finds the systematic error and cuts it to 0.2 mm, the accumulation is only 20 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預組時在固定溫度下以全站儀與鋼尺量測節點座標、全長、拱度與對角線，並修正量具溫度；把量測結果與設計座標比較，統計每節誤差的平均（系統）與標準差（隨機），超出允差的構件在出廠前修正並重新量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During trial assembly survey node coordinates, overall length, camber and diagonals by total station and steel tape at a stable temperature, correcting instrument temperature; compare results with design coordinates, separating the mean (systematic) and standard deviation (random) of panel errors, and correct and re-measure members outside tolerance before shipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。若系統誤差在預組中被找出並修正到 0.2 mm，累積只剩 20 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part. If trial assembly finds the systematic error and cuts it to 0.2 mm, the accumulation is only 20 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預組量測與誤差累積控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation", which statement holds?
options: 鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。
懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。
100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm。
optionsEn: Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary.
A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation.
With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm.
quiz.explanation: 100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「工廠全尺寸預組」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full factory trial assembly” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預組時在固定溫度下以全站儀與鋼尺量測節點座標、全長、拱度與對角線，並修正量具溫度；把量測結果與設計座標比較，統計每節誤差的平均（系統）與標準差（隨機），超出允差的構件在出廠前修正並重新量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During trial assembly survey node coordinates, overall length, camber and diagonals by total station and steel tape at a stable temperature, correcting instrument temperature; compare results with design coordinates, separating the mean (systematic) and standard deviation (random) of panel errors, and correct and re-measure members outside tolerance before shipment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製造規範應同時規定單構件允差與累積允差，並要求以統計方式報告預組誤差；量具校正、量測溫度與參考點須有紀錄，預組報告是出廠放行的停留點文件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Fabrication specifications should set both member tolerances and accumulated tolerances and require trial-assembly errors to be reported statistically; instrument calibration, survey temperature and reference points must be recorded, and the trial-assembly report is the hold-point document for release from the factory.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點；鐵路軌道也可能因累積線形誤差而需要大量調整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints; accumulated profile error may also require extensive rail-track adjustment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 預組時在固定溫度下以全站儀與鋼尺量測節點座標、全長、拱度與對角線，並修正量具溫度；把量測結果與設計座標比較，統計每節誤差的平均（系統）與標準差（隨機），超出允差的構件在出廠前修正並重新量測。
knowledge.textEn: During trial assembly survey node coordinates, overall length, camber and diagonals by total station and steel tape at a stable temperature, correcting instrument temperature; compare results with design coordinates, separating the mean (systematic) and standard deviation (random) of panel errors, and correct and re-measure members outside tolerance before shipment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 製造規範應同時規定單構件允差與累積允差，並要求以統計方式報告預組誤差；量具校正、量測溫度與參考點須有紀錄，預組報告是出廠放行的停留點文件。
knowledge.textEn: Fabrication specifications should set both member tolerances and accumulated tolerances and require trial-assembly errors to be reported statistically; instrument calibration, survey temperature and reference points must be recorded, and the trial-assembly report is the hold-point document for release from the factory.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預組量測與誤差累積控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation"?
options: 預組時在固定溫度下以全站儀與鋼尺量測節點座標、全長、拱度與對角線，並修正量具溫度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。
optionsEn: During trial assembly survey node coordinates, overall length, camber and diagonals by total station and steel tape at a stable temperature, correcting instrument temperature.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 預組時在固定溫度下以全站儀與鋼尺量測節點座標、全長、拱度與對角線，並修正量具溫度；把量測結果與設計座標比較，統計每節誤差的平均（系統）與標準差（隨機），超出允差的構件在出廠前修正並重新量測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During trial assembly survey node coordinates, overall length, camber and diagonals by total station and steel tape at a stable temperature, correcting instrument temperature; compare results with design coordinates, separating the mean (systematic) and standard deviation (random) of panel errors, and correct and re-measure members outside tolerance before shipment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「工廠全尺寸預組」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full factory trial assembly” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點；鐵路軌道也可能因累積線形誤差而需要大量調整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints; accumulated profile error may also require extensive rail-track adjustment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：誤差分為隨機誤差與系統誤差：隨機誤差會部分互相抵消，系統誤差（例如量尺溫度未修正、模具偏差）則每一節都朝同一方向累積，是預組最需要抓出來的對象。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Errors are random or systematic: random errors partly cancel, while systematic ones, such as an uncorrected tape temperature or a jig offset, accumulate in the same direction at every panel and are what trial assembly most needs to catch.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點；鐵路軌道也可能因累積線形誤差而需要大量調整。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints; accumulated profile error may also require extensive rail-track adjustment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預組量測與誤差累積控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點。
沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints.
A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it.
quiz.explanation: 若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點；鐵路軌道也可能因累積線形誤差而需要大量調整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints; accumulated profile error may also require extensive rail-track adjustment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing window and placement acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「沉箱沉放繫留」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Caisson mooring during sinking” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主記載沉箱出塢後以 12 艘拖船慢速拖到橋位，一旦開始拖航就不能中途停下，因此只在氣象與海象資料顯示至少 4 天穩定時才出發。沉放時先在海底預埋重約 900 t 的錨，沉箱上的絞車以鋼索連到錨上抵抗潮流，一邊注水下沉一邊調整位置，最後由大型起重船扶持控制姿態軟著陸。容許的設置誤差為 50 cm，業主指出所有沉箱都在此範圍內完成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「沉箱沉放繫留」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner records that after leaving the dock each caisson was towed slowly to site by 12 tugs; once towing began it could not stop, so departure waited for weather and sea data showing at least four stable days. For sinking, an anchor of about 900 t was pre-placed on the seabed and winches on the caisson pulled on wires to it against the tide, adjusting position as water was admitted, with a large crane vessel finally holding the caisson to control its attitude for a soft landing. The allowable placement error was 50 cm, and the owner states every caisson was placed within it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Caisson mooring during sinking” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「沉箱沉放繫留」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Caisson mooring during sinking”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收
knowledge.titleEn: Caisson towing window and placement acceptance
knowledge.text: 業主記載沉箱出塢後以 12 艘拖船慢速拖到橋位，一旦開始拖航就不能中途停下，因此只在氣象與海象資料顯示至少 4 天穩定時才出發。沉放時先在海底預埋重約 900 t 的錨，沉箱上的絞車以鋼索連到錨上抵抗潮流，一邊注水下沉一邊調整位置，最後由大型起重船扶持控制姿態軟著陸。
knowledge.textEn: The owner records that after leaving the dock each caisson was towed slowly to site by 12 tugs; once towing began it could not stop, so departure waited for weather and sea data showing at least four stable days. For sinking, an anchor of about 900 t was pre-placed on the seabed and winches on the caisson pulled on wires to it against the tide, adjusting position as water was admitted, with a large crane vessel finally holding the caisson to control its attitude for a soft landing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Caisson towing window and placement acceptance" is correct?
options: 沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。
鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。
業主記載沉箱出塢後以 12 艘拖船慢速拖到橋位，一旦開始拖航就不能中途停下，因此只在氣象與海象資料顯示至少 4 天穩定時才出發。
optionsEn: A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it.
Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem.
The owner records that after leaving the dock each caisson was towed slowly to site by 12 tugs.
quiz.explanation: 業主記載沉箱出塢後以 12 艘拖船慢速拖到橋位，一旦開始拖航就不能中途停下，因此只在氣象與海象資料顯示至少 4 天穩定時才出發。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The owner records that after leaving the dock each caisson was towed slowly to site by 12 tugs; once towing began it could not stop, so departure waited for weather and sea data showing at least four stable days. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing window and placement acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉箱沉放繫留」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Caisson mooring during sinking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。取沉放中迎流面積 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m²、C_D = 1.2、流速 1.5 m/s：F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN（約 317 t 力），須由絞車、錨與起重船共同抵抗；流速增為 2.0 m/s 時 F 增為約 5.5 MN。面積、係數與流速為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U². With a projected area during sinking of 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m², C_D = 1.2 and current 1.5 m/s: F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN (about 317 t-force), resisted jointly by winches, anchor and crane vessel; at 2.0 m/s F rises to about 5.5 MN. Area, coefficient and current are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沉放全程以測量系統即時追蹤沉箱平面位置、高程與傾斜，並與潮流預報比對選擇平潮時段；著地後立即量測四角高程與中心座標，與 50 cm 容許誤差比較，合格後才開始投放骨材與注入砂漿。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track plan position, level and tilt in real time throughout sinking, choosing slack-water windows from tidal forecasts; immediately after landing measure corner levels and centre coordinates against the 50 cm tolerance, and begin aggregate placement and mortar injection only after acceptance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。取沉放中迎流面積 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m²、C_D = 1.2、流速 1.5 m/s：F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN（約 317 t 力），須由絞車、錨與起重船共同抵抗；流速增為 2.0 m/s 時 F 增為約 5.5 MN。面積、係數與流速為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U². With a projected area during sinking of 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m², C_D = 1.2 and current 1.5 m/s: F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN (about 317 t-force), resisted jointly by winches, anchor and crane vessel; at 2.0 m/s F rises to about 5.5 MN. Area, coefficient and current are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Caisson towing window and placement acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。
跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。
兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。
optionsEn: Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U².
A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout.
With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small.
quiz.explanation: 潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing window and placement acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉箱沉放繫留」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Caisson mooring during sinking” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沉放全程以測量系統即時追蹤沉箱平面位置、高程與傾斜，並與潮流預報比對選擇平潮時段；著地後立即量測四角高程與中心座標，與 50 cm 容許誤差比較，合格後才開始投放骨材與注入砂漿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track plan position, level and tilt in real time throughout sinking, choosing slack-water windows from tidal forecasts; immediately after landing measure corner levels and centre coordinates against the 50 cm tolerance, and begin aggregate placement and mortar injection only after acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：拖航與沉放計畫要明列氣象窗口條件、潮流上限、繫留系統容量、通訊與緊急程序，並在出塢前舉行由業主、承包商與海事單位參加的放行會議；著地測量結果是後續工作的停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The towing and sinking plan must state weather-window conditions, current limits, mooring capacity, communications and emergency procedures, with a go/no-go meeting of owner, contractor and marine authorities before leaving the dock; the landing survey is the hold point for following work.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若低估潮流拖曳力，繫留鋼索或錨可能拖動，沉箱偏離預定位置甚至撞上已整平的岩盤邊緣；著地後才發現偏差超限時，重新浮起與再沉放的成本與風險都很高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underestimating tidal drag can drag mooring wires or the anchor, pushing the caisson off position or onto the edge of the levelled rock; discovering excess error only after landing makes refloating and re-sinking costly and risky. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沉放全程以測量系統即時追蹤沉箱平面位置、高程與傾斜，並與潮流預報比對選擇平潮時段；著地後立即量測四角高程與中心座標，與 50 cm 容許誤差比較，合格後才開始投放骨材與注入砂漿。
knowledge.textEn: Track plan position, level and tilt in real time throughout sinking, choosing slack-water windows from tidal forecasts; immediately after landing measure corner levels and centre coordinates against the 50 cm tolerance, and begin aggregate placement and mortar injection only after acceptance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 拖航與沉放計畫要明列氣象窗口條件、潮流上限、繫留系統容量、通訊與緊急程序，並在出塢前舉行由業主、承包商與海事單位參加的放行會議；著地測量結果是後續工作的停留點。
knowledge.textEn: The towing and sinking plan must state weather-window conditions, current limits, mooring capacity, communications and emergency procedures, with a go/no-go meeting of owner, contractor and marine authorities before leaving the dock; the landing survey is the hold point for following work.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Caisson towing window and placement acceptance"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
沉放全程以測量系統即時追蹤沉箱平面位置、高程與傾斜，並與潮流預報比對選擇平潮時段。
貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Track plan position, level and tilt in real time throughout sinking, choosing slack-water windows from tidal forecasts.
A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design.
quiz.explanation: 沉放全程以測量系統即時追蹤沉箱平面位置、高程與傾斜，並與潮流預報比對選擇平潮時段；著地後立即量測四角高程與中心座標，與 50 cm 容許誤差比較，合格後才開始投放骨材與注入砂漿。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track plan position, level and tilt in real time throughout sinking, choosing slack-water windows from tidal forecasts; immediately after landing measure corner levels and centre coordinates against the 50 cm tolerance, and begin aggregate placement and mortar injection only after acceptance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing window and placement acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉箱沉放繫留」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Caisson mooring during sinking” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若低估潮流拖曳力，繫留鋼索或錨可能拖動，沉箱偏離預定位置甚至撞上已整平的岩盤邊緣；著地後才發現偏差超限時，重新浮起與再沉放的成本與風險都很高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underestimating tidal drag can drag mooring wires or the anchor, pushing the caisson off position or onto the edge of the levelled rock; discovering excess error only after landing makes refloating and re-sinking costly and risky. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：容許的設置誤差為 50 cm，業主指出所有沉箱都在此範圍內完成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The allowable placement error was 50 cm, and the owner states every caisson was placed within it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若低估潮流拖曳力，繫留鋼索或錨可能拖動，沉箱偏離預定位置甚至撞上已整平的岩盤邊緣；著地後才發現偏差超限時，重新浮起與再沉放的成本與風險都很高。
knowledge.textEn: Underestimating tidal drag can drag mooring wires or the anchor, pushing the caisson off position or onto the edge of the levelled rock; discovering excess error only after landing makes refloating and re-sinking costly and risky.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Caisson towing window and placement acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。
若低估潮流拖曳力，繫留鋼索或錨可能拖動，沉箱偏離預定位置甚至撞上已整平的岩盤邊緣；著地後才發現偏差超限時，重新浮起與再沉放的成本與風險都很高。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem.
Underestimating tidal drag can drag mooring wires or the anchor, pushing the caisson off position or onto the edge of the levelled rock.
quiz.explanation: 若低估潮流拖曳力，繫留鋼索或錨可能拖動，沉箱偏離預定位置甚至撞上已整平的岩盤邊緣；著地後才發現偏差超限時，重新浮起與再沉放的成本與風險都很高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Underestimating tidal drag can drag mooring wires or the anchor, pushing the caisson off position or onto the edge of the levelled rock; discovering excess error only after landing makes refloating and re-sinking costly and risky. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善」與「塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection" and "Coating management and night-time inspection coordination": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Galvanised wire and dry air” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主說明，因島、大鳴門、大島與瀨戶大橋等較早的懸索橋，主纜採用鍍鋅鋼絲加防鏽劑與纏絲包覆；後來檢查舊有懸索橋時，拆開纏絲發現鋼絲已有鏽蝕，於是開發把乾燥空氣送入主纜的系統，並裝設在本州四國連絡橋的所有懸索橋。鍍鋅層是犧牲性的：只要纜內潮濕，鋅就逐年消耗，耗盡後鋼絲本體才開始生鏽。乾燥空氣不是取代鍍鋅，而是把鋅的消耗速度降到幾乎為零，讓既有的保護層長期有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner explains that earlier suspension bridges such as Innoshima, Ohnaruto, Ohshima and Seto Ohashi used galvanised wire with a rust inhibitor and wrapping; later inspections of existing suspension bridges found rust on wires once the wrapping was removed, so a system blowing dry air into the main cables was developed and installed on all the Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges. Galvanising is sacrificial: while the cable interior is damp, zinc is consumed year by year, and only when it is gone does the steel itself rust. Dry air does not replace galvanising; it cuts zinc consumption to nearly zero so the existing protection stays effective for the long term. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Galvanised wire and dry air” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 相當於厚度 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A zinc mass of 300 g/m² corresponds to 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Galvanised wire and dry air”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善
knowledge.titleEn: Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection
knowledge.text: 業主說明，因島、大鳴門、大島與瀨戶大橋等較早的懸索橋，主纜採用鍍鋅鋼絲加防鏽劑與纏絲包覆；後來檢查舊有懸索橋時，拆開纏絲發現鋼絲已有鏽蝕，於是開發把乾燥空氣送入主纜的系統，並裝設在本州四國連絡橋的所有懸索橋。鍍鋅層是犧牲性的：只要纜內潮濕，鋅就逐年消耗，耗盡後鋼絲本體才開始生鏽。
knowledge.textEn: The owner explains that earlier suspension bridges such as Innoshima, Ohnaruto, Ohshima and Seto Ohashi used galvanised wire with a rust inhibitor and wrapping; later inspections of existing suspension bridges found rust on wires once the wrapping was removed, so a system blowing dry air into the main cables was developed and installed on all the Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges. Galvanising is sacrificial: while the cable interior is damp, zinc is consumed year by year, and only when it is gone does the steel itself rust.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection" is correct?
options: 業主說明，因島、大鳴門、大島與瀨戶大橋等較早的懸索橋，主纜採用鍍鋅鋼絲加防鏽劑與纏絲包覆。
鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。
鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。
optionsEn: The owner explains that earlier suspension bridges such as Innoshima, Ohnaruto, Ohshima and Seto Ohashi used galvanised wire with a rust inhibitor and wrapping.
Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem.
Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 業主說明，因島、大鳴門、大島與瀨戶大橋等較早的懸索橋，主纜採用鍍鋅鋼絲加防鏽劑與纏絲包覆；後來檢查舊有懸索橋時，拆開纏絲發現鋼絲已有鏽蝕，於是開發把乾燥空氣送入主纜的系統，並裝設在本州四國連絡橋的所有懸索橋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The owner explains that earlier suspension bridges such as Innoshima, Ohnaruto, Ohshima and Seto Ohashi used galvanised wire with a rust inhibitor and wrapping; later inspections of existing suspension bridges found rust on wires once the wrapping was removed, so a system blowing dry air into the main cables was developed and installed on all the Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Galvanised wire and dry air” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 相當於厚度 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm。若潮濕纜內鋅的消耗率為 4 μm/年，約 42/4 ≈ 10.5 年即耗盡；若乾燥空氣把消耗率降到 0.1 μm/年，約需 420 年。消耗率為教學假設，實際值依濕度、氯鹽與溫度而定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A zinc mass of 300 g/m² corresponds to 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm. If zinc is consumed at 4 μm a year in a damp cable, it is gone in about 42/4 ≈ 10.5 years; if dry air cuts the rate to 0.1 μm a year, it lasts about 420 years. Rates are teaching assumptions; real values depend on humidity, chlorides and temperature. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期在主纜低點與索夾附近開窗，以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查鍍鋅層與鏽蝕等級，並取樣量測剩餘鋅量；同時比較送氣與排氣口的濕度紀錄，確認改善後的乾燥空氣系統讓各區段維持在管理目標以下。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically open inspection windows at cable low points and near bands, wedge wires apart to grade zinc condition and rust, and sample remaining zinc; compare humidity records at inlets and outlets to confirm the improved dry-air system keeps every section below the management target.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 相當於厚度 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm。若潮濕纜內鋅的消耗率為 4 μm/年，約 42/4 ≈ 10.5 年即耗盡；若乾燥空氣把消耗率降到 0.1 μm/年，約需 420 年。消耗率為教學假設，實際值依濕度、氯鹽與溫度而定。
knowledge.textEn: A zinc mass of 300 g/m² corresponds to 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm. If zinc is consumed at 4 μm a year in a damp cable, it is gone in about 42/4 ≈ 10.5 years; if dry air cuts the rate to 0.1 μm a year, it lasts about 420 years. Rates are teaching assumptions; real values depend on humidity, chlorides and temperature.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection", which statement holds?
options: 懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。
鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 相當於厚度 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm。
預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。
optionsEn: A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation.
A zinc mass of 300 g/m² corresponds to 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm.
Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 相當於厚度 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A zinc mass of 300 g/m² corresponds to 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Galvanised wire and dry air” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期在主纜低點與索夾附近開窗，以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查鍍鋅層與鏽蝕等級，並取樣量測剩餘鋅量；同時比較送氣與排氣口的濕度紀錄，確認改善後的乾燥空氣系統讓各區段維持在管理目標以下。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Periodically open inspection windows at cable low points and near bands, wedge wires apart to grade zinc condition and rust, and sample remaining zinc; compare humidity records at inlets and outlets to confirm the improved dry-air system keeps every section below the management target. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每座懸索橋應保存主纜開窗檢查的位置、等級與鋅量紀錄，並與乾燥空氣系統的濕度資料一起分析；送氣系統改善或擴充後，須重新確認每個區段的排氣濕度與流量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep records of every cable inspection window, its grade and remaining zinc for each suspension bridge, analysed together with dry-air humidity data; after improving or extending the injection system, re-verify exhaust humidity and flow for every section.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以為鍍鋅加纏絲就足以長期保護，水分可能在主纜低點與索夾下累積多年，鋅層耗盡後鋼絲開始點蝕甚至斷絲；送氣系統若只照顧容易到達的區段，遠端與高處可能仍維持潮濕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming galvanising and wrapping are enough lets water collect for years at low points and under bands, until zinc runs out and wires pit or break; a dry-air system that serves only easily reached sections can leave remote and high zones damp. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期在主纜低點與索夾附近開窗，以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查鍍鋅層與鏽蝕等級，並取樣量測剩餘鋅量；同時比較送氣與排氣口的濕度紀錄，確認改善後的乾燥空氣系統讓各區段維持在管理目標以下。
knowledge.textEn: Periodically open inspection windows at cable low points and near bands, wedge wires apart to grade zinc condition and rust, and sample remaining zinc; compare humidity records at inlets and outlets to confirm the improved dry-air system keeps every section below the management target.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每座懸索橋應保存主纜開窗檢查的位置、等級與鋅量紀錄，並與乾燥空氣系統的濕度資料一起分析；送氣系統改善或擴充後，須重新確認每個區段的排氣濕度與流量。
knowledge.textEn: Keep records of every cable inspection window, its grade and remaining zinc for each suspension bridge, analysed together with dry-air humidity data; after improving or extending the injection system, re-verify exhaust humidity and flow for every section.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。
定期在主纜低點與索夾附近開窗，以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查鍍鋅層與鏽蝕等級，並取樣量測剩餘鋅量。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure.
Periodically open inspection windows at cable low points and near bands, wedge wires apart to grade zinc condition and rust, and sample remaining zinc.
quiz.explanation: 定期在主纜低點與索夾附近開窗，以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查鍍鋅層與鏽蝕等級，並取樣量測剩餘鋅量；同時比較送氣與排氣口的濕度紀錄，確認改善後的乾燥空氣系統讓各區段維持在管理目標以下。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Periodically open inspection windows at cable low points and near bands, wedge wires apart to grade zinc condition and rust, and sample remaining zinc; compare humidity records at inlets and outlets to confirm the improved dry-air system keeps every section below the management target. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Galvanised wire and dry air” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以為鍍鋅加纏絲就足以長期保護，水分可能在主纜低點與索夾下累積多年，鋅層耗盡後鋼絲開始點蝕甚至斷絲；送氣系統若只照顧容易到達的區段，遠端與高處可能仍維持潮濕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming galvanising and wrapping are enough lets water collect for years at low points and under bands, until zinc runs out and wires pit or break; a dry-air system that serves only easily reached sections can leave remote and high zones damp. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：乾燥空氣不是取代鍍鋅，而是把鋅的消耗速度降到幾乎為零，讓既有的保護層長期有效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dry air does not replace galvanising; it cuts zinc consumption to nearly zero so the existing protection stays effective for the long term.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以為鍍鋅加纏絲就足以長期保護，水分可能在主纜低點與索夾下累積多年，鋅層耗盡後鋼絲開始點蝕甚至斷絲；送氣系統若只照顧容易到達的區段，遠端與高處可能仍維持潮濕。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming galvanising and wrapping are enough lets water collect for years at low points and under bands, until zinc runs out and wires pit or break; a dry-air system that serves only easily reached sections can leave remote and high zones damp.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若以為鍍鋅加纏絲就足以長期保護，水分可能在主纜低點與索夾下累積多年，鋅層耗盡後鋼絲開始點蝕甚至斷絲；送氣系統若只照顧容易到達的區段，遠端與高處可能仍維持潮濕。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。
optionsEn: Assuming galvanising and wrapping are enough lets water collect for years at low points and under bands, until zinc runs out and wires pit or break.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 若以為鍍鋅加纏絲就足以長期保護，水分可能在主纜低點與索夾下累積多年，鋅層耗盡後鋼絲開始點蝕甚至斷絲；送氣系統若只照顧容易到達的區段，遠端與高處可能仍維持潮濕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
