Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Coating management and night-time inspection coordination: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「公路鐵路並存的維護」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maintenance with road and rail” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 本州四國連絡橋共約 400 萬 m² 的塗裝面積，業主預估塗裝將佔未來維護費用約一半，因此延長重塗週期是生命週期成本的主要策略；瀨戶大橋使用了抗紫外線的塗料，並以在固定點定期量測塗膜厚度決定重塗時機。加勁桁上設有供檢修車行駛的軌道，維護人員可沿桁架移動檢查。瀨戶大橋上層是高速公路、下層是鐵路，任何檢查或修繕都要同時協調道路交通管制與鐵路的夜間作業時段，近年業主仍持續進行夜間的打音檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「公路鐵路並存的維護」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Honshu-Shikoku bridges have about 4 million m² of painted surface, and the owner expects painting to make up about half of future maintenance cost, so extending the repainting cycle is the main life-cycle cost strategy; Seto Ohashi used a UV-resistant paint, and repainting is timed by periodically measuring film thickness at fixed points. Rails on the stiffening truss carry maintenance vehicles so crews can travel along it. With an expressway above and a railway below, every inspection or repair must coordinate road traffic management with night-time railway work windows, and the owner continues night-time hammer-sounding inspections. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Maintenance with road and rail” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：塗膜壽命 t = (d₀ − d_min)/r。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Coating life t = (d₀ − d_min)/r.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「公路鐵路並存的維護」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Maintenance with road and rail”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調
knowledge.titleEn: Coating management and night-time inspection coordination
knowledge.text: 本州四國連絡橋共約 400 萬 m² 的塗裝面積，業主預估塗裝將佔未來維護費用約一半，因此延長重塗週期是生命週期成本的主要策略；瀨戶大橋使用了抗紫外線的塗料，並以在固定點定期量測塗膜厚度決定重塗時機。加勁桁上設有供檢修車行駛的軌道，維護人員可沿桁架移動檢查。
knowledge.textEn: The Honshu-Shikoku bridges have about 4 million m² of painted surface, and the owner expects painting to make up about half of future maintenance cost, so extending the repainting cycle is the main life-cycle cost strategy; Seto Ohashi used a UV-resistant paint, and repainting is timed by periodically measuring film thickness at fixed points. Rails on the stiffening truss carry maintenance vehicles so crews can travel along it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Coating management and night-time inspection coordination" is correct?
options: 鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。
本州四國連絡橋共約 400 萬 m² 的塗裝面積，業主預估塗裝將佔未來維護費用約一半，因此延長重塗週期是生命週期成本的主要策略。
跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。
optionsEn: Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary.

The Honshu-Shikoku bridges have about 4 million m² of painted surface, and the owner expects painting to make up about half of future maintenance cost, so extending the repainting cycle is the main life-cycle cost strategy.
A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout.
quiz.explanation: 本州四國連絡橋共約 400 萬 m² 的塗裝面積，業主預估塗裝將佔未來維護費用約一半，因此延長重塗週期是生命週期成本的主要策略；瀨戶大橋使用了抗紫外線的塗料，並以在固定點定期量測塗膜厚度決定重塗時機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Honshu-Shikoku bridges have about 4 million m² of painted surface, and the owner expects painting to make up about half of future maintenance cost, so extending the repainting cycle is the main life-cycle cost strategy; Seto Ohashi used a UV-resistant paint, and repainting is timed by periodically measuring film thickness at fixed points. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Coating management and night-time inspection coordination: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「公路鐵路並存的維護」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Maintenance with road and rail” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塗膜壽命 t = (d₀ − d_min)/r。設面漆初始厚度 d₀ = 30 μm、重塗門檻 d_min = 5 μm、年損耗 r = 1.0 μm/年：t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 年；若抗紫外線塗料把 r 降到 0.6 μm/年，t ≈ 42 年，重塗次數減少約四成。厚度與損耗率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Coating life t = (d₀ − d_min)/r. With an initial top-coat thickness d₀ = 30 μm, a repaint threshold d_min = 5 μm and wear r = 1.0 μm a year: t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 years; if a UV-resistant paint cuts r to 0.6 μm a year, t ≈ 42 years and the number of repaints falls by about 40%. Thicknesses and wear rates are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在各橋固定測點定期以膜厚計量測塗膜厚度，建立每個區位的損耗率並預測重塗時程；檢查作業前由道路與鐵路兩方確認作業時段、檢修車行駛路線與緊急撤離程序，作業後把發現事項輸入檢查資料庫並以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure film thickness at fixed points on every bridge periodically, deriving wear rates per zone to forecast repainting; before inspection confirm work windows, maintenance-vehicle routes and emergency withdrawal with both road and rail parties, and afterwards enter findings into the inspection database and update the plan through a PDCA cycle.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 塗膜壽命 t = (d₀ − d_min)/r。設面漆初始厚度 d₀ = 30 μm、重塗門檻 d_min = 5 μm、年損耗 r = 1.0 μm/年：t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 年；若抗紫外線塗料把 r 降到 0.6 μm/年，t ≈ 42 年，重塗次數減少約四成。厚度與損耗率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Coating life t = (d₀ − d_min)/r. With an initial top-coat thickness d₀ = 30 μm, a repaint threshold d_min = 5 μm and wear r = 1.0 μm a year: t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 years; if a UV-resistant paint cuts r to 0.6 μm a year, t ≈ 42 years and the number of repaints falls by about 40%. Thicknesses and wear rates are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Coating management and night-time inspection coordination", which statement holds?
options: 兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。
貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。
塗膜壽命 t = (d₀ − d_min)/r。
optionsEn: With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small.
A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design.
Coating life t = (d₀ − d_min)/r.
quiz.explanation: 塗膜壽命 t = (d₀ − d_min)/r。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Coating life t = (d₀ − d_min)/r. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coating management and night-time inspection coordination: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「公路鐵路並存的維護」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Maintenance with road and rail” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在各橋固定測點定期以膜厚計量測塗膜厚度，建立每個區位的損耗率並預測重塗時程；檢查作業前由道路與鐵路兩方確認作業時段、檢修車行駛路線與緊急撤離程序，作業後把發現事項輸入檢查資料庫並以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure film thickness at fixed points on every bridge periodically, deriving wear rates per zone to forecast repainting; before inspection confirm work windows, maintenance-vehicle routes and emergency withdrawal with both road and rail parties, and afterwards enter findings into the inspection database and update the plan through a PDCA cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護計畫應把塗膜量測點、損耗率、預測重塗年份與實際作業紀錄放在同一系統，並與鐵路營運單位簽訂年度作業時段協議；交接文件須包含檢修軌道與檢修車的檢查與維修程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance plan should keep film-thickness points, wear rates, forecast repaint years and actual work records in one system and agree annual work windows with the railway operator; handover documents must include inspection and maintenance procedures for the maintenance rails and vehicles.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若重塗時機只依年數而不量測膜厚，可能在塗膜仍良好時過早重塗，或在已露底時才處理，鋼材開始鏽蝕；道路與鐵路的作業時段未協調，檢查覆蓋率不足，部分區段長期未被近距離檢查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Timing repainting by age without measuring film thickness either repaints too early while coatings are fine or too late after steel is exposed and rusting; uncoordinated road and rail work windows reduce inspection coverage, leaving some zones without close inspection for years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在各橋固定測點定期以膜厚計量測塗膜厚度，建立每個區位的損耗率並預測重塗時程；檢查作業前由道路與鐵路兩方確認作業時段、檢修車行駛路線與緊急撤離程序，作業後把發現事項輸入檢查資料庫並以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Measure film thickness at fixed points on every bridge periodically, deriving wear rates per zone to forecast repainting; before inspection confirm work windows, maintenance-vehicle routes and emergency withdrawal with both road and rail parties, and afterwards enter findings into the inspection database and update the plan through a PDCA cycle.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護計畫應把塗膜量測點、損耗率、預測重塗年份與實際作業紀錄放在同一系統，並與鐵路營運單位簽訂年度作業時段協議；交接文件須包含檢修軌道與檢修車的檢查與維修程序。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance plan should keep film-thickness points, wear rates, forecast repaint years and actual work records in one system and agree annual work windows with the railway operator; handover documents must include inspection and maintenance procedures for the maintenance rails and vehicles.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coating management and night-time inspection coordination"?
options: 在各橋固定測點定期以膜厚計量測塗膜厚度，建立每個區位的損耗率並預測重塗時程。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。
optionsEn: Measure film thickness at fixed points on every bridge periodically, deriving wear rates per zone to forecast repainting.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately.
quiz.explanation: 在各橋固定測點定期以膜厚計量測塗膜厚度，建立每個區位的損耗率並預測重塗時程；檢查作業前由道路與鐵路兩方確認作業時段、檢修車行駛路線與緊急撤離程序，作業後把發現事項輸入檢查資料庫並以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure film thickness at fixed points on every bridge periodically, deriving wear rates per zone to forecast repainting; before inspection confirm work windows, maintenance-vehicle routes and emergency withdrawal with both road and rail parties, and afterwards enter findings into the inspection database and update the plan through a PDCA cycle. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coating management and night-time inspection coordination: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「公路鐵路並存的維護」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance with road and rail” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若重塗時機只依年數而不量測膜厚，可能在塗膜仍良好時過早重塗，或在已露底時才處理，鋼材開始鏽蝕；道路與鐵路的作業時段未協調，檢查覆蓋率不足，部分區段長期未被近距離檢查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Timing repainting by age without measuring film thickness either repaints too early while coatings are fine or too late after steel is exposed and rusting; uncoordinated road and rail work windows reduce inspection coverage, leaving some zones without close inspection for years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：瀨戶大橋上層是高速公路、下層是鐵路，任何檢查或修繕都要同時協調道路交通管制與鐵路的夜間作業時段，近年業主仍持續進行夜間的打音檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With an expressway above and a railway below, every inspection or repair must coordinate road traffic management with night-time railway work windows, and the owner continues night-time hammer-sounding inspections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若重塗時機只依年數而不量測膜厚，可能在塗膜仍良好時過早重塗，或在已露底時才處理，鋼材開始鏽蝕；道路與鐵路的作業時段未協調，檢查覆蓋率不足，部分區段長期未被近距離檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Timing repainting by age without measuring film thickness either repaints too early while coatings are fine or too late after steel is exposed and rusting; uncoordinated road and rail work windows reduce inspection coverage, leaving some zones without close inspection for years.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coating management and night-time inspection coordination" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若重塗時機只依年數而不量測膜厚，可能在塗膜仍良好時過早重塗，或在已露底時才處理，鋼材開始鏽蝕。
跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Timing repainting by age without measuring film thickness either repaints too early while coatings are fine or too late after steel is exposed and rusting.
A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout.
quiz.explanation: 若重塗時機只依年數而不量測膜厚，可能在塗膜仍良好時過早重塗，或在已露底時才處理，鋼材開始鏽蝕；道路與鐵路的作業時段未協調，檢查覆蓋率不足，部分區段長期未被近距離檢查。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Timing repainting by age without measuring film thickness either repaints too early while coatings are fine or too late after steel is exposed and rusting; uncoordinated road and rail work windows reduce inspection coverage, leaving some zones without close inspection for years. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 懸索橋主纜架設
summary: 主纜是懸索橋唯一幾乎無法更換的主構件，它的品質在架設時就已決定。本課比較空中紡線（金門大橋、大貝爾特東橋）與預製平行鋼絲索股（明石海峽大橋、瀨戶大橋、1915 恰納卡萊大橋）兩種工法，計算裸纜懸鏈線、索鞍彎曲應力、貓道張力與擠壓後直徑，說明鋼絲等級與鍍層、索股量測與統計允收，並依美國聯邦公路總署的指引談開纜檢查、腐蝕分級與剩餘強度評估。
summaryEn: The main cable is the one primary member of a suspension bridge that can almost never be replaced, and its quality is fixed during erection. This course compares aerial spinning (Golden Gate, Great Belt East) with prefabricated parallel-wire strands (Akashi Kaikyo, Seto Ohashi, 1915 Çanakkale), computes bare-cable catenaries, saddle bending stress, catwalk tension and compacted diameter, explains wire grades and coatings, strand survey and statistical acceptance, and, following US Federal Highway Administration guidance, covers cable openings, corrosion staging and remaining-strength evaluation.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 懸索橋巨作與主纜系統

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較兩種工法完成同一條主纜的現場作業量。主纜需 36,000 根直徑 5.4 mm 的鋼絲，鋼絲面積 36,000×22.90 mm² ≈ 824,000 mm²，以 1,770 N/mm² 計破斷力 ≈ 1,459 MN。PWS 方案每股 127 根，需 284 股（最後一股不足 127 根時仍要一個完整錨頭），兩端共 568 個錨頭；若每夜牽引 4 股，約需 71 夜。空中紡線方案每束約 500 根，需 72 束、144 個索靴；若每日可鋪 1,600 根全長鋼絲，約需 36,000/1,600 ≈ 23 個有效工作日，但若可作業日比例只有 60%，實際約需 38 日曆天，並需加上每束垂度調整。擠壓後空隙率 20% 時主纜直徑 ≈ √(4×0.824/(π×0.80)) ≈ 1.15 m。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的施工紀錄。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare site effort for the two methods on the same cable. The cable needs 36,000 wires of 5.4 mm, a steel area of 36,000×22.90 mm² ≈ 824,000 mm² and, at 1,770 N/mm², a breaking force ≈ 1,459 MN. The PWS option with 127 wires per strand needs 284 strands (the last, though short of 127 wires, still needs a full socket), 568 sockets at the two ends; at 4 strands a night it takes about 71 nights. The aerial-spinning option with about 500 wires per bundle needs 72 bundles and 144 strand shoes; laying 1,600 full-length wires a day takes about 36,000/1,600 ≈ 23 working days, but if only 60% of days are workable it takes about 38 calendar days, plus sag adjustment for each bundle. With 20% voids after compaction the cable diameter is ≈ √(4×0.824/(π×0.80)) ≈ 1.15 m. Values are teaching assumptions, not construction records of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主纜架設工法的選擇」與「裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Choosing the cable erection method" and "Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主纜架設工法的選擇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Choosing the cable erection method: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「空中紡線與預製索股」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aerial spinning versus PWS” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 空中紡線法讓紡線輪沿貓道上方往返，每趟帶著鋼絲環從一座錨碇走到另一座，在現場把數百根鋼絲累積成一束：金門大橋每纜 61 束、平均每束約 452 根；大貝爾特東橋每纜 18,648 根鋼絲分成 37 束。預製平行鋼絲索股（PWS）則在工廠把鋼絲排成六角形索股並預裝錨頭，再整股牽引過海峽：明石海峽大橋每纜 290 股、瀨戶大橋與 1915 恰納卡萊大橋每股都是 127 根。空中紡線運輸輕便、錨固點少，但現場時間長且受風影響；PWS 現場快、品質在工廠控制，但索股重、錨頭多，需要大型捲盤與牽引設備。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「空中紡線與預製索股」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aerial spinning runs spinning wheels back and forth above the catwalk, each trip carrying a loop of wire from one anchorage to the other, building bundles of several hundred wires on site: Golden Gate has 61 strands per cable averaging about 452 wires, and the Great Belt East Bridge splits 18,648 wires per cable into 37 bundles. Prefabricated parallel-wire strands (PWS) are laid up in the factory into hexagonal strands with sockets already fitted, then hauled across whole: Akashi Kaikyo has 290 strands per cable, and Seto Ohashi and the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge both use 127 wires per strand. Aerial spinning needs only light transport and few anchorage points but long, wind-sensitive site work; PWS is fast on site with factory-controlled quality but has heavy strands and many sockets, needing large reels and hauling gear. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Aerial spinning versus PWS” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設主纜需 36,000 根鋼絲。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Suppose a cable needs 36,000 wires.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「空中紡線與預製索股」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Aerial spinning versus PWS”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜架設工法的選擇
knowledge.text: 空中紡線法讓紡線輪沿貓道上方往返，每趟帶著鋼絲環從一座錨碇走到另一座，在現場把數百根鋼絲累積成一束：金門大橋每纜 61 束、平均每束約 452 根；大貝爾特東橋每纜 18,648 根鋼絲分成 37 束。預製平行鋼絲索股（PWS）則在工廠把鋼絲排成六角形索股並預裝錨頭，再整股牽引過海峽：明石海峽大橋每纜 290 股、瀨戶大橋與 1915 恰納卡萊大橋每股都是 127 根。
knowledge.textEn: Aerial spinning runs spinning wheels back and forth above the catwalk, each trip carrying a loop of wire from one anchorage to the other, building bundles of several hundred wires on site: Golden Gate has 61 strands per cable averaging about 452 wires, and the Great Belt East Bridge splits 18,648 wires per cable into 37 bundles. Prefabricated parallel-wire strands (PWS) are laid up in the factory into hexagonal strands with sockets already fitted, then hauled across whole: Akashi Kaikyo has 290 strands per cable, and Seto Ohashi and the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge both use 127 wires per strand.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜架設工法的選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Choosing the cable erection method" is correct?
options: 預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。
空中紡線法讓紡線輪沿貓道上方往返，每趟帶著鋼絲環從一座錨碇走到另一座，在現場把數百根鋼絲累積成一束：金門大橋每纜 61 束、平均每束約 452 根。
主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。
optionsEn: Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge.

Aerial spinning runs spinning wheels back and forth above the catwalk, each trip carrying a loop of wire from one anchorage to the other, building bundles of several hundred wires on site: Golden Gate has 61 strands per cable averaging about 452 wires, and the Great Belt East Bridge splits 18,648 wires per cable into 37 bundles.
The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible.
quiz.explanation: 空中紡線法讓紡線輪沿貓道上方往返，每趟帶著鋼絲環從一座錨碇走到另一座，在現場把數百根鋼絲累積成一束：金門大橋每纜 61 束、平均每束約 452 根；大貝爾特東橋每纜 18,648 根鋼絲分成 37 束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Aerial spinning runs spinning wheels back and forth above the catwalk, each trip carrying a loop of wire from one anchorage to the other, building bundles of several hundred wires on site: Golden Gate has 61 strands per cable averaging about 452 wires, and the Great Belt East Bridge splits 18,648 wires per cable into 37 bundles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜架設工法的選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Choosing the cable erection method: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空中紡線與預製索股」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aerial spinning versus PWS” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設主纜需 36,000 根鋼絲。PWS 每股 127 根需 36,000/127 ≈ 284 股、兩端共 568 個錨頭；空中紡線每束約 500 根只需 72 束、144 個索靴。若紡線輪每趟鋪 4 根鋼絲，空中紡線需約 36,000/4 = 9,000 趟，而 PWS 只需 284 次牽引。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Suppose a cable needs 36,000 wires. PWS with 127 per strand needs 36,000/127 ≈ 284 strands and 568 sockets at the two ends; aerial spinning with about 500 per bundle needs only 72 bundles and 144 strand shoes. If each wheel trip lays 4 wires, spinning needs about 36,000/4 = 9,000 trips, against 284 hauls for PWS. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以工期、氣象紀錄（可作業風速天數）、航道限制、運輸路線承重、錨碇空間與錨頭數量做工法比選矩陣，並估算每種工法的現場人時與風險；選定後由設計者確認錨碇與索鞍細部符合所選工法。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a comparison matrix of programme, weather records (days with workable wind), navigation limits, transport-route capacity, anchorage space and socket count, estimating site man-hours and risk for each method; once chosen, the designer confirms that anchorage and saddle details suit the method.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 設主纜需 36,000 根鋼絲。PWS 每股 127 根需 36,000/127 ≈ 284 股、兩端共 568 個錨頭；空中紡線每束約 500 根只需 72 束、144 個索靴。若紡線輪每趟鋪 4 根鋼絲，空中紡線需約 36,000/4 = 9,000 趟，而 PWS 只需 284 次牽引。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Suppose a cable needs 36,000 wires. PWS with 127 per strand needs 36,000/127 ≈ 284 strands and 568 sockets at the two ends; aerial spinning with about 500 per bundle needs only 72 bundles and 144 strand shoes. If each wheel trip lays 4 wires, spinning needs about 36,000/4 = 9,000 trips, against 284 hauls for PWS. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜架設工法的選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Choosing the cable erection method", which statement holds?
options: 鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。
主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。
設主纜需 36,000 根鋼絲。
optionsEn: Cable wires carry only axial tension, so saddle shape does not affect stress.
Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability.
Suppose a cable needs 36,000 wires.
quiz.explanation: 設主纜需 36,000 根鋼絲。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Suppose a cable needs 36,000 wires. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜架設工法的選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Choosing the cable erection method: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空中紡線與預製索股」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aerial spinning versus PWS” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以工期、氣象紀錄（可作業風速天數）、航道限制、運輸路線承重、錨碇空間與錨頭數量做工法比選矩陣，並估算每種工法的現場人時與風險；選定後由設計者確認錨碇與索鞍細部符合所選工法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a comparison matrix of programme, weather records (days with workable wind), navigation limits, transport-route capacity, anchorage space and socket count, estimating site man-hours and risk for each method; once chosen, the designer confirms that anchorage and saddle details suit the method. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：工法比選應在基本設計階段完成，並把結果寫入錨碇、索鞍與貓道的設計條件；投標文件可允許替代工法，但必須要求承包商提出相應的錨固與幾何控制方案，並經設計者核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Settle the method comparison at basic design and write the outcome into the design conditions for anchorages, saddles and catwalks; tender documents may allow alternatives, but the contractor must then submit matching anchorage and geometry-control proposals for the designer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在強風頻繁的海峽採用空中紡線而未預留停工天數，進度落後時容易壓縮垂度調整時間；採用 PWS 卻低估捲盤重量與運輸限制，可能必須縮短索股長度或增加接頭，影響錨固設計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing aerial spinning over a windy strait without allowing for downtime tempts crews to cut sag adjustment when behind; choosing PWS while underestimating reel weight and transport limits may force shorter strands or extra splices that affect anchorage design. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以工期、氣象紀錄（可作業風速天數）、航道限制、運輸路線承重、錨碇空間與錨頭數量做工法比選矩陣，並估算每種工法的現場人時與風險；選定後由設計者確認錨碇與索鞍細部符合所選工法。
knowledge.textEn: Build a comparison matrix of programme, weather records (days with workable wind), navigation limits, transport-route capacity, anchorage space and socket count, estimating site man-hours and risk for each method; once chosen, the designer confirms that anchorage and saddle details suit the method.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 工法比選應在基本設計階段完成，並把結果寫入錨碇、索鞍與貓道的設計條件；投標文件可允許替代工法，但必須要求承包商提出相應的錨固與幾何控制方案，並經設計者核可。
knowledge.textEn: Settle the method comparison at basic design and write the outcome into the design conditions for anchorages, saddles and catwalks; tender documents may allow alternatives, but the contractor must then submit matching anchorage and geometry-control proposals for the designer's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主纜架設工法的選擇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Choosing the cable erection method"?
options: 以工期、氣象紀錄（可作業風速天數）、航道限制、運輸路線承重、錨碇空間與錨頭數量做工法比選矩陣，並估算每種工法的現場人時與風險。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。
optionsEn: Build a comparison matrix of programme, weather records (days with workable wind), navigation limits, transport-route capacity, anchorage space and socket count, estimating site man-hours and risk for each method.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes.
quiz.explanation: 以工期、氣象紀錄（可作業風速天數）、航道限制、運輸路線承重、錨碇空間與錨頭數量做工法比選矩陣，並估算每種工法的現場人時與風險；選定後由設計者確認錨碇與索鞍細部符合所選工法。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a comparison matrix of programme, weather records (days with workable wind), navigation limits, transport-route capacity, anchorage space and socket count, estimating site man-hours and risk for each method; once chosen, the designer confirms that anchorage and saddle details suit the method. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主纜架設工法的選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Choosing the cable erection method: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空中紡線與預製索股」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aerial spinning versus PWS” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在強風頻繁的海峽採用空中紡線而未預留停工天數，進度落後時容易壓縮垂度調整時間；採用 PWS 卻低估捲盤重量與運輸限制，可能必須縮短索股長度或增加接頭，影響錨固設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing aerial spinning over a windy strait without allowing for downtime tempts crews to cut sag adjustment when behind; choosing PWS while underestimating reel weight and transport limits may force shorter strands or extra splices that affect anchorage design. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：空中紡線運輸輕便、錨固點少，但現場時間長且受風影響；PWS 現場快、品質在工廠控制，但索股重、錨頭多，需要大型捲盤與牽引設備。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Aerial spinning needs only light transport and few anchorage points but long, wind-sensitive site work; PWS is fast on site with factory-controlled quality but has heavy strands and many sockets, needing large reels and hauling gear.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在強風頻繁的海峽採用空中紡線而未預留停工天數，進度落後時容易壓縮垂度調整時間；採用 PWS 卻低估捲盤重量與運輸限制，可能必須縮短索股長度或增加接頭，影響錨固設計。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing aerial spinning over a windy strait without allowing for downtime tempts crews to cut sag adjustment when behind; choosing PWS while underestimating reel weight and transport limits may force shorter strands or extra splices that affect anchorage design.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜架設工法的選擇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Choosing the cable erection method" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
在強風頻繁的海峽採用空中紡線而未預留停工天數，進度落後時容易壓縮垂度調整時間。
主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Choosing aerial spinning over a windy strait without allowing for downtime tempts crews to cut sag adjustment when behind.
The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible.
quiz.explanation: 在強風頻繁的海峽採用空中紡線而未預留停工天數，進度落後時容易壓縮垂度調整時間；採用 PWS 卻低估捲盤重量與運輸限制，可能必須縮短索股長度或增加接頭，影響錨固設計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing aerial spinning over a windy strait without allowing for downtime tempts crews to cut sag adjustment when behind; choosing PWS while underestimating reel weight and transport limits may force shorter strands or extra splices that affect anchorage design. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「裸纜懸鏈線」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bare-cable catenary” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜在橋面掛上之前只承受自重，自重沿纜長均勻分布，形狀是懸鏈線；掛上沿水平均勻分布的橋面後，形狀才接近拋物線。設計者先決定完工狀態的線形，再以逆向分析扣除橋面荷重與彈性伸長，求出主纜在無應力狀態下的長度，以及裸纜階段各跨應有的垂度與索鞍位置。架設時第一根基準索股或基準鋼絲就是按這個裸纜幾何設定，之後所有鋼絲都以它為準，因此裸纜計算的誤差會一路傳到完工線形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「裸纜懸鏈線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before the deck is hung, the main cable carries only its own weight, distributed evenly along its length, so its shape is a catenary; once a deck load distributed evenly along the horizontal is added, the shape approaches a parabola. Designers fix the completed profile first, then back-analyse by removing deck load and elastic stretch to find the unstressed cable length and the bare-cable sag and saddle positions for each span. The first reference strand or reference wire is set to this bare-cable geometry and every later wire follows it, so errors in the bare-cable calculation pass straight into the final profile. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bare-cable catenary” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取裸纜自重 w = 35 kN/m、水平張力 H = 70,000 kN、跨徑 l = 1,600 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take bare-cable weight w = 35 kN/m, horizontal tension H = 70,000 kN and span l = 1,600 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「裸纜懸鏈線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bare-cable catenary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Designers fix the completed profile first, then back-analyse by removing deck load and elastic stretch to find the unstressed cable length and the bare-cable sag and saddle positions for each span.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola" is correct?
options: 主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。
鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。

optionsEn: The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible.
Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life.
Before the deck is hung, the main cable carries only its own weight, distributed evenly along its length, so its shape is a catenary.
quiz.explanation: 主纜在橋面掛上之前只承受自重，自重沿纜長均勻分布，形狀是懸鏈線；掛上沿水平均勻分布的橋面後，形狀才接近拋物線。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the deck is hung, the main cable carries only its own weight, distributed evenly along its length, so its shape is a catenary; once a deck load distributed evenly along the horizontal is added, the shape approaches a parabola. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裸纜懸鏈線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bare-cable catenary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取裸纜自重 w = 35 kN/m、水平張力 H = 70,000 kN、跨徑 l = 1,600 m。拋物線 f_p = w·l²/(8H) = 35×1,600²/560,000 = 160.0 m；懸鏈線 f_c = (H/w)·[cosh(w·l/(2H)) − 1] = 2,000×(cosh 0.4 − 1) = 2,000×0.0811 ≈ 162.1 m，相差約 2.1 m（1.3%）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take bare-cable weight w = 35 kN/m, horizontal tension H = 70,000 kN and span l = 1,600 m. The parabola gives f_p = w·l²/(8H) = 35×1,600²/560,000 = 160.0 m; the catenary gives f_c = (H/w)·[cosh(w·l/(2H)) − 1] = 2,000×(cosh 0.4 − 1) = 2,000×0.0811 ≈ 162.1 m, a difference of about 2.1 m (1.3%). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩套獨立程式（例如設計者與承包商各自的非線性分析）計算無應力纜長與裸纜垂度，比較結果；基準索股架設後量測各跨垂度與索鞍位置，經溫度修正後與計算值比較，差異超過允差時先複核計算假設再調整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute unstressed cable length and bare-cable sag with two independent programs, such as the designer's and the contractor's nonlinear analyses, and compare; after the reference strand is erected, measure sag in each span and saddle positions, correct for temperature and compare with calculation, re-checking assumptions before adjusting when differences exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Take bare-cable weight w = 35 kN/m, horizontal tension H = 70,000 kN and span l = 1,600 m. The parabola gives f_p = w·l²/(8H) = 35×1,600²/560,000 = 160.0 m; the catenary gives f_c = (H/w)·[cosh(w·l/(2H)) − 1] = 2,000×(cosh 0.4 − 1) = 2,000×0.0811 ≈ 162.1 m, a difference of about 2.1 m (1.3%). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola", which statement holds?
options: 取裸纜自重 w = 35 kN/m、水平張力 H = 70,000 kN、跨徑 l = 1,600 m。
貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。
儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。
optionsEn: Take bare-cable weight w = 35 kN/m, horizontal tension H = 70,000 kN and span l = 1,600 m.
A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding.
With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 取裸纜自重 w = 35 kN/m、水平張力 H = 70,000 kN、跨徑 l = 1,600 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take bare-cable weight w = 35 kN/m, horizontal tension H = 70,000 kN and span l = 1,600 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裸纜懸鏈線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bare-cable catenary” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以兩套獨立程式（例如設計者與承包商各自的非線性分析）計算無應力纜長與裸纜垂度，比較結果；基準索股架設後量測各跨垂度與索鞍位置，經溫度修正後與計算值比較，差異超過允差時先複核計算假設再調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute unstressed cable length and bare-cable sag with two independent programs, such as the designer's and the contractor's nonlinear analyses, and compare; after the reference strand is erected, measure sag in each span and saddle positions, correct for temperature and compare with calculation, re-checking assumptions before adjusting when differences exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：架設手冊應列出裸纜階段的目標垂度、索鞍預偏量、參考溫度與量測點位置，並附上兩套獨立計算的比對結果；基準索股定位是全工程最重要的停留點之一，須由設計者與監造共同見證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection manual should list target bare-cable sags, saddle offsets, reference temperature and survey points, with the comparison of two independent calculations; setting the reference strand is one of the most important hold points of the whole job and must be witnessed jointly by the designer and the supervising engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若裸纜階段直接用拋物線公式設定基準索股，在大跨中會產生公尺級的垂度誤差，完工後橋面高程與吊索長度都對不上；忽略索鞍與錨碇處的實際幾何（切點位置、分束長度）也會造成同樣的系統誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting the reference strand with the parabola formula in the bare-cable stage creates sag errors of the order of metres on a long span, so deck levels and hanger lengths do not match at completion; ignoring the real geometry at saddles and anchorages, such as tangent points and splay lengths, causes similar systematic errors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以兩套獨立程式（例如設計者與承包商各自的非線性分析）計算無應力纜長與裸纜垂度，比較結果；基準索股架設後量測各跨垂度與索鞍位置，經溫度修正後與計算值比較，差異超過允差時先複核計算假設再調整。
knowledge.textEn: Compute unstressed cable length and bare-cable sag with two independent programs, such as the designer's and the contractor's nonlinear analyses, and compare; after the reference strand is erected, measure sag in each span and saddle positions, correct for temperature and compare with calculation, re-checking assumptions before adjusting when differences exceed tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 架設手冊應列出裸纜階段的目標垂度、索鞍預偏量、參考溫度與量測點位置，並附上兩套獨立計算的比對結果；基準索股定位是全工程最重要的停留點之一，須由設計者與監造共同見證。
knowledge.textEn: The erection manual should list target bare-cable sags, saddle offsets, reference temperature and survey points, with the comparison of two independent calculations; setting the reference strand is one of the most important hold points of the whole job and must be witnessed jointly by the designer and the supervising engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以兩套獨立程式（例如設計者與承包商各自的非線性分析）計算無應力纜長與裸纜垂度，比較結果。
主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compute unstressed cable length and bare-cable sag with two independent programs, such as the designer's and the contractor's nonlinear analyses, and compare.

quiz.explanation: 以兩套獨立程式（例如設計者與承包商各自的非線性分析）計算無應力纜長與裸纜垂度，比較結果；基準索股架設後量測各跨垂度與索鞍位置，經溫度修正後與計算值比較，差異超過允差時先複核計算假設再調整。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute unstressed cable length and bare-cable sag with two independent programs, such as the designer's and the contractor's nonlinear analyses, and compare; after the reference strand is erected, measure sag in each span and saddle positions, correct for temperature and compare with calculation, re-checking assumptions before adjusting when differences exceed tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裸纜懸鏈線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bare-cable catenary” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若裸纜階段直接用拋物線公式設定基準索股，在大跨中會產生公尺級的垂度誤差，完工後橋面高程與吊索長度都對不上；忽略索鞍與錨碇處的實際幾何（切點位置、分束長度）也會造成同樣的系統誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting the reference strand with the parabola formula in the bare-cable stage creates sag errors of the order of metres on a long span, so deck levels and hanger lengths do not match at completion; ignoring the real geometry at saddles and anchorages, such as tangent points and splay lengths, causes similar systematic errors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：架設時第一根基準索股或基準鋼絲就是按這個裸纜幾何設定，之後所有鋼絲都以它為準，因此裸纜計算的誤差會一路傳到完工線形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The first reference strand or reference wire is set to this bare-cable geometry and every later wire follows it, so errors in the bare-cable calculation pass straight into the final profile.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若裸纜階段直接用拋物線公式設定基準索股，在大跨中會產生公尺級的垂度誤差，完工後橋面高程與吊索長度都對不上；忽略索鞍與錨碇處的實際幾何（切點位置、分束長度）也會造成同樣的系統誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Setting the reference strand with the parabola formula in the bare-cable stage creates sag errors of the order of metres on a long span, so deck levels and hanger lengths do not match at completion; ignoring the real geometry at saddles and anchorages, such as tangent points and splay lengths, causes similar systematic errors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。
若裸纜階段直接用拋物線公式設定基準索股，在大跨中會產生公尺級的垂度誤差，完工後橋面高程與吊索長度都對不上。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life.
Setting the reference strand with the parabola formula in the bare-cable stage creates sag errors of the order of metres on a long span, so deck levels and hanger lengths do not match at completion.
quiz.explanation: 若裸纜階段直接用拋物線公式設定基準索股，在大跨中會產生公尺級的垂度誤差，完工後橋面高程與吊索長度都對不上；忽略索鞍與錨碇處的實際幾何（切點位置、分束長度）也會造成同樣的系統誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting the reference strand with the parabola formula in the bare-cable stage creates sag errors of the order of metres on a long span, so deck levels and hanger lengths do not match at completion; ignoring the real geometry at saddles and anchorages, such as tangent points and splay lengths, causes similar systematic errors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層」與「索鞍、分束與錨固細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strength grades and coatings of cable wire" and "Saddles, splay and anchorage details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength grades and coatings of cable wire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼絲等級與鍍鋅層」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wire grade and zinc coating” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜鋼絲是經鉛浴或替代熱處理、冷拉成形的高碳鋼絲，再熱浸鍍鋅。日本製鐵的技術報告指出，日本約半世紀使用 1,570 MPa 級鋼絲，1,770 MPa 級 5 mm 鋼絲首次用於明石海峽大橋，近年已試製 1,960 MPa 級；長大橋鋼絲的鍍鋅量一般在 300 g/m² 以上，近年也採用鋅鋁合金鍍層。強度越高，所需鋼絲越少、自重越輕，但對缺口、氫脆與彎曲越敏感，扭轉與伸長率等延性指標必須同時控制。鍍層是犧牲性防蝕，架設時的刮傷會成為日後腐蝕的起點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼絲等級與鍍鋅層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cable wire is high-carbon steel, heat-treated by lead patenting or an alternative, cold-drawn and hot-dip galvanised. A Nippon Steel technical report notes that Japan used 1,570 MPa wire for about half a century, that 1,770 MPa 5 mm wire was first used on the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, and that 1,960 MPa wire has since been trial-produced; long-span bridge wire usually carries 300 g/m² or more of zinc, with zinc–aluminium coatings used in recent years. Higher strength means fewer wires and less self-weight but more sensitivity to notches, hydrogen embrittlement and bending, so ductility indicators such as torsion and elongation must be controlled too. The coating is sacrificial, and scratches during erection become future corrosion sites. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wire grade and zinc coating” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：金門大橋鋼絲鍍鋅厚度約 0.002 in = 50.8 μm，以鋅密度 7.14 g/cm³ 換算約 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m²，符合 300 g/m² 以上的常見水準。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Golden Gate wire carries about 0.002 in = 50.8 μm of zinc, which at a zinc density of 7.14 g/cm³ is about 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m², in line with the usual 300 g/m² or more.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼絲等級與鍍鋅層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wire grade and zinc coating”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strength grades and coatings of cable wire" is correct?
options: 主纜鋼絲是經鉛浴或替代熱處理、冷拉成形的高碳鋼絲，再熱浸鍍鋅。
鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。
鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。
optionsEn: Cable wire is high-carbon steel, heat-treated by lead patenting or an alternative, cold-drawn and hot-dip galvanised.
Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life.
Cable wires carry only axial tension, so saddle shape does not affect stress.
quiz.explanation: 主纜鋼絲是經鉛浴或替代熱處理、冷拉成形的高碳鋼絲，再熱浸鍍鋅。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cable wire is high-carbon steel, heat-treated by lead patenting or an alternative, cold-drawn and hot-dip galvanised. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strength grades and coatings of cable wire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼絲等級與鍍鋅層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wire grade and zinc coating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：金門大橋鋼絲鍍鋅厚度約 0.002 in = 50.8 μm，以鋅密度 7.14 g/cm³ 換算約 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m²，符合 300 g/m² 以上的常見水準。若同一主纜由 1,570 MPa 改用 1,960 MPa 鋼絲而破斷力不變，鋼絲面積可減少 1 − 1,570/1,960 ≈ 20%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Golden Gate wire carries about 0.002 in = 50.8 μm of zinc, which at a zinc density of 7.14 g/cm³ is about 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m², in line with the usual 300 g/m² or more. Replacing 1,570 MPa wire with 1,960 MPa wire at the same breaking force cuts wire area by 1 − 1,570/1,960 ≈ 20%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每捲鋼絲抽驗直徑、抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗、鍍層附著量與附著性；架設前後在牽引路徑上的導輪、索鞍槽與擠壓機接觸面檢查刮傷，並抽樣量測鍍層厚度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample each coil for diameter, tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and wrapping tests, coating mass and adhesion; before and after erection inspect rollers, saddle grooves and compactor contact surfaces along the hauling path for scratches, sampling coating thickness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 金門大橋鋼絲鍍鋅厚度約 0.002 in = 50.8 μm，以鋅密度 7.14 g/cm³ 換算約 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m²，符合 300 g/m² 以上的常見水準。若同一主纜由 1,570 MPa 改用 1,960 MPa 鋼絲而破斷力不變，鋼絲面積可減少 1 − 1,570/1,960 ≈ 20%。
knowledge.textEn: Golden Gate wire carries about 0.002 in = 50.8 μm of zinc, which at a zinc density of 7.14 g/cm³ is about 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m², in line with the usual 300 g/m² or more. Replacing 1,570 MPa wire with 1,960 MPa wire at the same breaking force cuts wire area by 1 − 1,570/1,960 ≈ 20%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strength grades and coatings of cable wire", which statement holds?
options: 主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。
金門大橋鋼絲鍍鋅厚度約 0.002 in = 50.8 μm，以鋅密度 7.14 g/cm³ 換算約 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m²，符合 300 g/m² 以上的常見水準。
只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。
optionsEn: Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability.
Golden Gate wire carries about 0.002 in = 50.8 μm of zinc, which at a zinc density of 7.14 g/cm³ is about 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m², in line with the usual 300 g/m² or more.
If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes.
quiz.explanation: 金門大橋鋼絲鍍鋅厚度約 0.002 in = 50.8 μm，以鋅密度 7.14 g/cm³ 換算約 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m²，符合 300 g/m² 以上的常見水準。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Golden Gate wire carries about 0.002 in = 50.8 μm of zinc, which at a zinc density of 7.14 g/cm³ is about 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m², in line with the usual 300 g/m² or more. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strength grades and coatings of cable wire: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼絲等級與鍍鋅層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wire grade and zinc coating” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每捲鋼絲抽驗直徑、抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗、鍍層附著量與附著性；架設前後在牽引路徑上的導輪、索鞍槽與擠壓機接觸面檢查刮傷，並抽樣量測鍍層厚度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample each coil for diameter, tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and wrapping tests, coating mass and adhesion; before and after erection inspect rollers, saddle grooves and compactor contact surfaces along the hauling path for scratches, sampling coating thickness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼絲規格須同時訂定強度、延性與鍍層指標及抽樣頻率，並要求從線材爐號到成品捲號的完整追溯；牽引與擠壓設備的接觸面材料與狀態應列入每日檢查表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The wire specification must set strength, ductility and coating requirements with sampling frequencies and require full traceability from rod heat to finished coil; the material and condition of contact surfaces on hauling and compaction equipment belong on the daily checklist.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鍍鋅層在牽引或擠壓時被大面積刮除，日後在纜內潮濕環境中最先出現鏽點；超高強度鋼絲若延性不足，在索鞍或索夾附近的局部彎曲處可能脆斷，而且斷絲藏在纜內不易被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Large areas of zinc scraped off during hauling or compaction are where rust first appears in a damp cable; ultra-high-strength wire with poor ductility can break brittly where it bends locally at saddles or bands, hidden inside the cable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每捲鋼絲抽驗直徑、抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗、鍍層附著量與附著性；架設前後在牽引路徑上的導輪、索鞍槽與擠壓機接觸面檢查刮傷，並抽樣量測鍍層厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Sample each coil for diameter, tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and wrapping tests, coating mass and adhesion; before and after erection inspect rollers, saddle grooves and compactor contact surfaces along the hauling path for scratches, sampling coating thickness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋼絲規格須同時訂定強度、延性與鍍層指標及抽樣頻率，並要求從線材爐號到成品捲號的完整追溯；牽引與擠壓設備的接觸面材料與狀態應列入每日檢查表。
knowledge.textEn: The wire specification must set strength, ductility and coating requirements with sampling frequencies and require full traceability from rod heat to finished coil; the material and condition of contact surfaces on hauling and compaction equipment belong on the daily checklist.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strength grades and coatings of cable wire"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。
每捲鋼絲抽驗直徑、抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗、鍍層附著量與附著性。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards.
Sample each coil for diameter, tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and wrapping tests, coating mass and adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 每捲鋼絲抽驗直徑、抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗、鍍層附著量與附著性；架設前後在牽引路徑上的導輪、索鞍槽與擠壓機接觸面檢查刮傷，並抽樣量測鍍層厚度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample each coil for diameter, tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and wrapping tests, coating mass and adhesion; before and after erection inspect rollers, saddle grooves and compactor contact surfaces along the hauling path for scratches, sampling coating thickness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strength grades and coatings of cable wire: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼絲等級與鍍鋅層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wire grade and zinc coating” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鍍鋅層在牽引或擠壓時被大面積刮除，日後在纜內潮濕環境中最先出現鏽點；超高強度鋼絲若延性不足，在索鞍或索夾附近的局部彎曲處可能脆斷，而且斷絲藏在纜內不易被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Large areas of zinc scraped off during hauling or compaction are where rust first appears in a damp cable; ultra-high-strength wire with poor ductility can break brittly where it bends locally at saddles or bands, hidden inside the cable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 索鞍、分束與錨固細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Saddles, splay and anchorage details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索鞍半徑與彎曲應力」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Saddle radius and bending stress” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜在塔頂索鞍處改變方向，在錨碇前的分束鞍處散開成一束束，再以索靴（空中紡線）或錨頭（預製索股）連接到錨碇拉桿。鋼絲繞過彎曲面時，除了軸向應力外還有與曲率成正比的彎曲應力，並在接觸面上承受側壓與摩擦；索鞍槽的半徑、隔板與填充材決定這些附加應力的大小，也決定主纜在索鞍內是否會滑動。分束處的鋼絲排列若與錨固點對不上，部分鋼絲會被拉長、部分鬆弛。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索鞍半徑與彎曲應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main cable changes direction at the tower-top saddles and fans out at splay saddles in front of the anchorages, where bundles connect to anchor rods through strand shoes (aerial spinning) or sockets (PWS). Where wires pass over a curved surface they carry bending stress proportional to curvature on top of axial stress, plus side pressure and friction at the contact; saddle groove radius, spacers and fillers set the size of these extra stresses and whether the cable slips in the saddle. If the wire arrangement at the splay does not match the anchorage points, some wires are stretched and others go slack. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Saddle radius and bending stress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鋼絲繞過半徑 R 的彎曲面時，表面彎曲應力 σ_b = E·d/(2R)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A wire bent over radius R has surface bending stress σ_b = E·d/(2R).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cable wires carry only axial tension, so saddle shape does not affect stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索鞍半徑與彎曲應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Saddle radius and bending stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Where wires pass over a curved surface they carry bending stress proportional to curvature on top of axial stress, plus side pressure and friction at the contact; saddle groove radius, spacers and fillers set the size of these extra stresses and whether the cable slips in the saddle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「索鞍、分束與錨固細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Saddles, splay and anchorage details" is correct?
options: 鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。

A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding.

quiz.explanationEn: The main cable changes direction at the tower-top saddles and fans out at splay saddles in front of the anchorages, where bundles connect to anchor rods through strand shoes (aerial spinning) or sockets (PWS). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 索鞍、分束與錨固細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Saddles, splay and anchorage details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索鞍半徑與彎曲應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Saddle radius and bending stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋼絲繞過半徑 R 的彎曲面時，表面彎曲應力 σ_b = E·d/(2R)。取 E = 200,000 N/mm²、d = 5.4 mm：R = 3.0 m 時 σ_b = 200,000×5.4/6,000 = 180 N/mm²；R = 1.0 m 時增為 540 N/mm²，加上約 700 N/mm² 的軸向應力就逼近降伏。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A wire bent over radius R has surface bending stress σ_b = E·d/(2R). With E = 200,000 N/mm² and d = 5.4 mm: R = 3.0 m gives σ_b = 200,000×5.4/6,000 = 180 N/mm²; R = 1.0 m gives 540 N/mm², which on top of about 700 N/mm² axial stress approaches yield. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：索鞍與分束鞍以鑄造或焊接製造後，量測槽半徑、隔板位置與表面粗糙度，並以全尺寸或縮尺模型試驗確認抗滑係數；錨頭（澆鑄鋅或環氧樹脂鋼球）抽樣做靜力與疲勞拉拔試驗，記錄錨頭回縮量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After casting or welding saddles and splay saddles, measure groove radius, spacer positions and surface roughness, and confirm slip resistance by full- or reduced-scale tests; sample sockets, whether zinc-cast or epoxy–steel-ball, for static and fatigue pull-out tests, recording socket draw-in.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鋼絲繞過半徑 R 的彎曲面時，表面彎曲應力 σ_b = E·d/(2R)。取 E = 200,000 N/mm²、d = 5.4 mm：R = 3.0 m 時 σ_b = 200,000×5.4/6,000 = 180 N/mm²；R = 1.0 m 時增為 540 N/mm²，加上約 700 N/mm² 的軸向應力就逼近降伏。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A wire bent over radius R has surface bending stress σ_b = E·d/(2R). With E = 200,000 N/mm² and d = 5.4 mm: R = 3.0 m gives σ_b = 200,000×5.4/6,000 = 180 N/mm²; R = 1.0 m gives 540 N/mm², which on top of about 700 N/mm² axial stress approaches yield. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「索鞍、分束與錨固細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Saddles, splay and anchorage details", which statement holds?
options: 儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。
主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。
鋼絲繞過半徑 R 的彎曲面時，表面彎曲應力 σ_b = E·d/(2R)。
optionsEn: With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary.
If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded.
A wire bent over radius R has surface bending stress σ_b = E·d/(2R).
quiz.explanation: 鋼絲繞過半徑 R 的彎曲面時，表面彎曲應力 σ_b = E·d/(2R)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A wire bent over radius R has surface bending stress σ_b = E·d/(2R). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 索鞍、分束與錨固細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Saddles, splay and anchorage details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「索鞍半徑與彎曲應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Saddle radius and bending stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 索鞍與分束鞍以鑄造或焊接製造後，量測槽半徑、隔板位置與表面粗糙度，並以全尺寸或縮尺模型試驗確認抗滑係數；錨頭（澆鑄鋅或環氧樹脂鋼球）抽樣做靜力與疲勞拉拔試驗，記錄錨頭回縮量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After casting or welding saddles and splay saddles, measure groove radius, spacer positions and surface roughness, and confirm slip resistance by full- or reduced-scale tests; sample sockets, whether zinc-cast or epoxy–steel-ball, for static and fatigue pull-out tests, recording socket draw-in. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索鞍、分束鞍與錨固細部應在設計圖中標明最小彎曲半徑、鋼絲排列圖與抗滑檢核，並把錨頭試驗、錨頭回縮量與錨固位置列為停留點；完工後保留可目視錨頭與索靴的檢查通道。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings for saddles, splay saddles and anchorage details should show minimum bending radius, wire arrangement and slip checks, with socket tests, draw-in and anchorage positions as hold points; keep inspection access to see sockets and strand shoes after completion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：索鞍槽半徑過小或邊緣倒角不足，鋼絲在長期車流與溫度循環下於彎曲處疲勞斷絲；鞍內填充不實時，主纜在不平衡荷重下滑動，改變兩側垂度並損傷鍍層；錨頭灌注不良則可能使鋼絲從錨頭拔出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A saddle groove with too small a radius or poor edge rounding lets wires fatigue and break at the bend under years of traffic and thermal cycles; incomplete filling in the saddle lets the cable slip under unbalanced load, changing sags on both sides and damaging coating; poorly filled sockets can let wires pull out. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 索鞍與分束鞍以鑄造或焊接製造後，量測槽半徑、隔板位置與表面粗糙度，並以全尺寸或縮尺模型試驗確認抗滑係數；錨頭（澆鑄鋅或環氧樹脂鋼球）抽樣做靜力與疲勞拉拔試驗，記錄錨頭回縮量。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 索鞍、分束鞍與錨固細部應在設計圖中標明最小彎曲半徑、鋼絲排列圖與抗滑檢核，並把錨頭試驗、錨頭回縮量與錨固位置列為停留點；完工後保留可目視錨頭與索靴的檢查通道。

quiz.question: 要驗證「索鞍、分束與錨固細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 索鞍與分束鞍以鑄造或焊接製造後，量測槽半徑、隔板位置與表面粗糙度，並以全尺寸或縮尺模型試驗確認抗滑係數。

optionsEn: After casting or welding saddles and splay saddles, measure groove radius, spacer positions and surface roughness, and confirm slip resistance by full- or reduced-scale tests.

Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge.

quiz.explanationEn: After casting or welding saddles and splay saddles, measure groove radius, spacer positions and surface roughness, and confirm slip resistance by full- or reduced-scale tests; sample sockets, whether zinc-cast or epoxy–steel-ball, for static and fatigue pull-out tests, recording socket draw-in. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 索鞍、分束與錨固細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Saddles, splay and anchorage details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索鞍半徑與彎曲應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Saddle radius and bending stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 索鞍槽半徑過小或邊緣倒角不足，鋼絲在長期車流與溫度循環下於彎曲處疲勞斷絲；鞍內填充不實時，主纜在不平衡荷重下滑動，改變兩側垂度並損傷鍍層；錨頭灌注不良則可能使鋼絲從錨頭拔出。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A saddle groove with too small a radius or poor edge rounding lets wires fatigue and break at the bend under years of traffic and thermal cycles; incomplete filling in the saddle lets the cable slip under unbalanced load, changing sags on both sides and damaging coating; poorly filled sockets can let wires pull out. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分束處的鋼絲排列若與錨固點對不上，部分鋼絲會被拉長、部分鬆弛。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If the wire arrangement at the splay does not match the anchorage points, some wires are stretched and others go slack.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cable wires carry only axial tension, so saddle shape does not affect stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 索鞍槽半徑過小或邊緣倒角不足，鋼絲在長期車流與溫度循環下於彎曲處疲勞斷絲；鞍內填充不實時，主纜在不平衡荷重下滑動，改變兩側垂度並損傷鍍層；錨頭灌注不良則可能使鋼絲從錨頭拔出。
knowledge.textEn: A saddle groove with too small a radius or poor edge rounding lets wires fatigue and break at the bend under years of traffic and thermal cycles; incomplete filling in the saddle lets the cable slip under unbalanced load, changing sags on both sides and damaging coating; poorly filled sockets can let wires pull out.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「索鞍、分束與錨固細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Saddles, splay and anchorage details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
索鞍槽半徑過小或邊緣倒角不足，鋼絲在長期車流與溫度循環下於彎曲處疲勞斷絲。
貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。
