optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A saddle groove with too small a radius or poor edge rounding lets wires fatigue and break at the bend under years of traffic and thermal cycles.
A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding.
quiz.explanation: 索鞍槽半徑過小或邊緣倒角不足，鋼絲在長期車流與溫度循環下於彎曲處疲勞斷絲；鞍內填充不實時，主纜在不平衡荷重下滑動，改變兩側垂度並損傷鍍層；錨頭灌注不良則可能使鋼絲從錨頭拔出。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A saddle groove with too small a radius or poor edge rounding lets wires fatigue and break at the bend under years of traffic and thermal cycles; incomplete filling in the saddle lets the cable slip under unbalanced load, changing sags on both sides and damaging coating; poorly filled sockets can let wires pull out. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導索、貓道與牽引系統」與「主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system" and "Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與牽引系統：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「導索跨越與貓道」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pilot-rope crossing and catwalk” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜架設的第一步是把一條細導索跨過兩座塔：早期做法是讓導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋改以起重船把導索吊高跨越，本州四國連絡橋在潮流強、船多的海域也以直升機牽引導索。導索就位後依序拉上較粗的鋼索，架成貓道：瀨戶大橋的貓道由約 10 條鋼索承托，鋪鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m，並以橫向便橋連接。貓道本身就是一座臨時懸索橋，其線形必須與主纜平行，並能承受作業荷重與強風。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「導索跨越與貓道」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first step of cable erection is to get a thin pilot rope across the two towers: the old way floated it on buoys and towed it across by boat, closing the channel; Seto Ohashi held it high from a crane ship instead, and in Honshu-Shikoku waters with strong currents and heavy traffic it was also flown across by helicopter. Heavier ropes are then pulled across in turn to build the catwalk: Seto Ohashi's catwalks rested on about ten ropes with wire mesh and a double fibre net, 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges. A catwalk is itself a temporary suspension bridge whose profile must parallel the main cable and carry working loads and strong wind. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pilot-rope crossing and catwalk” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：貓道承載索水平張力 H = w·l²/(8f)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Catwalk rope horizontal tension H = w·l²/(8f).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「導索跨越與貓道」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pilot-rope crossing and catwalk”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導索、貓道與牽引系統
knowledge.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system
knowledge.text: 主纜架設的第一步是把一條細導索跨過兩座塔：早期做法是讓導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋改以起重船把導索吊高跨越，本州四國連絡橋在潮流強、船多的海域也以直升機牽引導索。導索就位後依序拉上較粗的鋼索，架成貓道：瀨戶大橋的貓道由約 10 條鋼索承托，鋪鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m，並以橫向便橋連接。
knowledge.textEn: The first step of cable erection is to get a thin pilot rope across the two towers: the old way floated it on buoys and towed it across by boat, closing the channel; Seto Ohashi held it high from a crane ship instead, and in Honshu-Shikoku waters with strong currents and heavy traffic it was also flown across by helicopter. Heavier ropes are then pulled across in turn to build the catwalk: Seto Ohashi's catwalks rested on about ten ropes with wire mesh and a double fibre net, 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導索、貓道與牽引系統」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system" is correct?
options: 貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。
主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。
主纜架設的第一步是把一條細導索跨過兩座塔：早期做法是讓導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過，必須封閉航道。
optionsEn: A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding.
Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability.
The first step of cable erection is to get a thin pilot rope across the two towers: the old way floated it on buoys and towed it across by boat, closing the channel.
quiz.explanation: 主纜架設的第一步是把一條細導索跨過兩座塔：早期做法是讓導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋改以起重船把導索吊高跨越，本州四國連絡橋在潮流強、船多的海域也以直升機牽引導索。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The first step of cable erection is to get a thin pilot rope across the two towers: the old way floated it on buoys and towed it across by boat, closing the channel; Seto Ohashi held it high from a crane ship instead, and in Honshu-Shikoku waters with strong currents and heavy traffic it was also flown across by helicopter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與牽引系統：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導索跨越與貓道」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pilot-rope crossing and catwalk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：貓道承載索水平張力 H = w·l²/(8f)。取每座貓道自重加作業荷重 w = 1.2 kN/m、跨徑 l = 1,500 m、垂度 f = 150 m：H = 1.2×1,500²/(8×150) = 2,250 kN；若分由 10 條鋼索承擔，每條約 225 kN。垂度若減為 140 m，H 增為約 2,411 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Catwalk rope horizontal tension H = w·l²/(8f). With self-weight plus working load w = 1.2 kN/m per catwalk, span l = 1,500 m and sag f = 150 m: H = 1.2×1,500²/(8×150) = 2,250 kN, about 225 kN for each of ten ropes. Reducing the sag to 140 m raises H to about 2,411 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：導索跨越前取得海事主管機關的作業許可與航行警告，跨越時量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後檢查網片、扶手與橫向便橋的固定，量測貓道線形與主纜設計線形的間距，並以風速計設定作業與撤離門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the crossing obtain marine-authority approval and a navigation warning, measuring the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built inspect mesh, handrails and cross-bridge fixings, measure the gap between catwalk profile and the design cable profile, and set work and evacuation thresholds with anemometers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 貓道承載索水平張力 H = w·l²/(8f)。取每座貓道自重加作業荷重 w = 1.2 kN/m、跨徑 l = 1,500 m、垂度 f = 150 m：H = 1.2×1,500²/(8×150) = 2,250 kN；若分由 10 條鋼索承擔，每條約 225 kN。垂度若減為 140 m，H 增為約 2,411 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Catwalk rope horizontal tension H = w·l²/(8f). With self-weight plus working load w = 1.2 kN/m per catwalk, span l = 1,500 m and sag f = 150 m: H = 1.2×1,500²/(8×150) = 2,250 kN, about 225 kN for each of ten ropes. Reducing the sag to 140 m raises H to about 2,411 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「導索、貓道與牽引系統」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system", which statement holds?
options: 貓道承載索水平張力 H = w·l²/(8f)。
只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。
主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。
optionsEn: Catwalk rope horizontal tension H = w·l²/(8f).
If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes.
Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards.
quiz.explanation: 貓道承載索水平張力 H = w·l²/(8f)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Catwalk rope horizontal tension H = w·l²/(8f). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與牽引系統：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導索跨越與貓道」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pilot-rope crossing and catwalk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 導索跨越前取得海事主管機關的作業許可與航行警告，跨越時量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後檢查網片、扶手與橫向便橋的固定，量測貓道線形與主纜設計線形的間距，並以風速計設定作業與撤離門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the crossing obtain marine-authority approval and a navigation warning, measuring the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built inspect mesh, handrails and cross-bridge fixings, measure the gap between catwalk profile and the design cable profile, and set work and evacuation thresholds with anemometers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：貓道屬於臨時結構，須有獨立設計計算、抗風穩定檢核、每日檢查表與撤離程序，並由臨時工程設計者簽認；牽引系統的最大拉力、制動與通訊要在試運轉中驗證後才可牽引第一股。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A catwalk is temporary works needing its own design calculations, wind-stability check, daily checklist and evacuation procedure signed by the temporary-works designer; the hauling system's maximum pull, braking and communications must be proven in a trial run before the first strand is hauled.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導索在跨越時下垂進入航道淨空可能勾到船舶；貓道與主纜線形不平行，鋼絲在某些區段會摩擦網片或被迫偏折；強風中貓道過度擺動，曾在多座橋的施工中造成停工與設備損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A pilot rope sagging into the navigation clearance can snag a ship; a catwalk not parallel to the cable makes wires rub the mesh or bend in places; excessive catwalk sway in strong wind has stopped work and damaged equipment on many bridge projects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 導索跨越前取得海事主管機關的作業許可與航行警告，跨越時量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後檢查網片、扶手與橫向便橋的固定，量測貓道線形與主纜設計線形的間距，並以風速計設定作業與撤離門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Before the crossing obtain marine-authority approval and a navigation warning, measuring the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built inspect mesh, handrails and cross-bridge fixings, measure the gap between catwalk profile and the design cable profile, and set work and evacuation thresholds with anemometers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 貓道屬於臨時結構，須有獨立設計計算、抗風穩定檢核、每日檢查表與撤離程序，並由臨時工程設計者簽認；牽引系統的最大拉力、制動與通訊要在試運轉中驗證後才可牽引第一股。
knowledge.textEn: A catwalk is temporary works needing its own design calculations, wind-stability check, daily checklist and evacuation procedure signed by the temporary-works designer; the hauling system's maximum pull, braking and communications must be proven in a trial run before the first strand is hauled.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導索、貓道與牽引系統」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
導索跨越前取得海事主管機關的作業許可與航行警告，跨越時量測導索最低點高程。
主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before the crossing obtain marine-authority approval and a navigation warning, measuring the rope's lowest point during the crossing.
The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible.
quiz.explanation: 導索跨越前取得海事主管機關的作業許可與航行警告，跨越時量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後檢查網片、扶手與橫向便橋的固定，量測貓道線形與主纜設計線形的間距，並以風速計設定作業與撤離門檻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the crossing obtain marine-authority approval and a navigation warning, measuring the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built inspect mesh, handrails and cross-bridge fixings, measure the gap between catwalk profile and the design cable profile, and set work and evacuation thresholds with anemometers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與牽引系統：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導索跨越與貓道」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pilot-rope crossing and catwalk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導索在跨越時下垂進入航道淨空可能勾到船舶；貓道與主纜線形不平行，鋼絲在某些區段會摩擦網片或被迫偏折；強風中貓道過度擺動，曾在多座橋的施工中造成停工與設備損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A pilot rope sagging into the navigation clearance can snag a ship; a catwalk not parallel to the cable makes wires rub the mesh or bend in places; excessive catwalk sway in strong wind has stopped work and damaged equipment on many bridge projects. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：貓道本身就是一座臨時懸索橋，其線形必須與主纜平行，並能承受作業荷重與強風。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A catwalk is itself a temporary suspension bridge whose profile must parallel the main cable and carry working loads and strong wind.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導索在跨越時下垂進入航道淨空可能勾到船舶；貓道與主纜線形不平行，鋼絲在某些區段會摩擦網片或被迫偏折；強風中貓道過度擺動，曾在多座橋的施工中造成停工與設備損壞。
knowledge.textEn: A pilot rope sagging into the navigation clearance can snag a ship; a catwalk not parallel to the cable makes wires rub the mesh or bend in places; excessive catwalk sway in strong wind has stopped work and damaged equipment on many bridge projects.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導索、貓道與牽引系統」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。
導索在跨越時下垂進入航道淨空可能勾到船舶；貓道與主纜線形不平行，鋼絲在某些區段會摩擦網片或被迫偏折；強風中貓道過度擺動，曾在多座橋的施工中造成停工與設備損壞。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability.
A pilot rope sagging into the navigation clearance can snag a ship.
quiz.explanation: 導索在跨越時下垂進入航道淨空可能勾到船舶；貓道與主纜線形不平行，鋼絲在某些區段會摩擦網片或被迫偏折；強風中貓道過度擺動，曾在多座橋的施工中造成停工與設備損壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A pilot rope sagging into the navigation clearance can snag a ship; a catwalk not parallel to the cable makes wires rub the mesh or bend in places; excessive catwalk sway in strong wind has stopped work and damaged equipment on many bridge projects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「擠壓與纏絲」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compaction and wrapping” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 所有鋼絲架好後，主纜還是由許多六角形或圓形的束鬆散組成，需要以液壓擠壓機沿全長逐段把它壓成接近圓形的緊密斷面，並暫時以鋼帶綁住。擠壓品質決定空隙率：空隙太大，水分容易進入並滯留在纜內；擠壓不均則讓索夾無法均勻夾緊。之後安裝索夾（兩個半圓柱以螺栓夾緊，坡度越陡需要越多螺栓），掛上吊索，最後以纏絲機把鍍鋅軟鋼線（美國常用 No. 9 線）緊密纏繞在主纜外，並塗上防蝕膏與塗料，或改用彈性體包覆配合乾燥空氣。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「擠壓與纏絲」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once all wires are in place, the cable is still a loose group of hexagonal or round bundles, and hydraulic compactors work along its length to press it into a dense, nearly round section, temporarily banded with steel straps. Compaction sets the void ratio: too many voids let water enter and stay in the cable, and uneven compaction stops cable bands from clamping evenly. Cable bands are then installed, two half-cylinders bolted together, with more bolts on steeper slopes, the hangers are hung, and finally a wrapping machine winds soft galvanised wire (No. 9 wire in US practice) tightly around the cable over a corrosion-inhibiting paste and paint, or an elastomeric wrap is used with dry air. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Compaction and wrapping” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主纜直徑 D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cable diameter D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「擠壓與纏絲」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Compaction and wrapping”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝
knowledge.text: 所有鋼絲架好後，主纜還是由許多六角形或圓形的束鬆散組成，需要以液壓擠壓機沿全長逐段把它壓成接近圓形的緊密斷面，並暫時以鋼帶綁住。擠壓品質決定空隙率：空隙太大，水分容易進入並滯留在纜內；擠壓不均則讓索夾無法均勻夾緊。
knowledge.textEn: Once all wires are in place, the cable is still a loose group of hexagonal or round bundles, and hydraulic compactors work along its length to press it into a dense, nearly round section, temporarily banded with steel straps. Compaction sets the void ratio: too many voids let water enter and stay in the cable, and uneven compaction stops cable bands from clamping evenly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation" is correct?
options: 所有鋼絲架好後，主纜還是由許多六角形或圓形的束鬆散組成，需要以液壓擠壓機沿全長逐段把它壓成接近圓形的緊密斷面，並暫時以鋼帶綁住。
主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。
儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。
optionsEn: Once all wires are in place, the cable is still a loose group of hexagonal or round bundles, and hydraulic compactors work along its length to press it into a dense, nearly round section, temporarily banded with steel straps.
Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability.
With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 所有鋼絲架好後，主纜還是由許多六角形或圓形的束鬆散組成，需要以液壓擠壓機沿全長逐段把它壓成接近圓形的緊密斷面，並暫時以鋼帶綁住。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once all wires are in place, the cable is still a loose group of hexagonal or round bundles, and hydraulic compactors work along its length to press it into a dense, nearly round section, temporarily banded with steel straps. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「擠壓與纏絲」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compaction and wrapping” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主纜直徑 D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]。取 18,000 根 5.4 mm 鋼絲，a = 22.90 mm²，鋼絲面積 0.4122 m²：空隙率 v = 18% 時 D ≈ √(4×0.4122/(π×0.82)) ≈ 0.800 m；v = 22% 時 D ≈ 0.820 m。直徑差 20 mm 就代表索夾內徑與螺栓夾緊量需要重新核對。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cable diameter D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]. With 18,000 wires of 5.4 mm, a = 22.90 mm² and a steel area of 0.4122 m²: a void ratio v = 18% gives D ≈ √(4×0.4122/(π×0.82)) ≈ 0.800 m, while v = 22% gives D ≈ 0.820 m. A 20 mm difference means cable-band bore and bolt clamping must be re-checked. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：擠壓後沿全長以周長尺或雷射量測直徑與橢圓度，換算空隙率並與允收範圍比較；索夾安裝時依程序分次張拉螺栓並記錄，纏絲時量測纏絲張力、搭接與間距，逐段拍照存檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After compaction measure diameter and ovality along the length with a circumference tape or laser, convert to void ratio and compare with the acceptance range; tension cable-band bolts in stages per procedure and record them, and during wrapping measure wrapping tension, laps and pitch, photographing each section for the record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主纜直徑 D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]。取 18,000 根 5.4 mm 鋼絲，a = 22.90 mm²，鋼絲面積 0.4122 m²：空隙率 v = 18% 時 D ≈ √(4×0.4122/(π×0.82)) ≈ 0.800 m；v = 22% 時 D ≈ 0.820 m。直徑差 20 mm 就代表索夾內徑與螺栓夾緊量需要重新核對。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cable diameter D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]. With 18,000 wires of 5.4 mm, a = 22.90 mm² and a steel area of 0.4122 m²: a void ratio v = 18% gives D ≈ √(4×0.4122/(π×0.82)) ≈ 0.800 m, while v = 22% gives D ≈ 0.820 m. A 20 mm difference means cable-band bore and bolt clamping must be re-checked. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation", which statement holds?
options: 主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。
預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。
optionsEn: If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded.
Cable diameter D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))].
Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge.
quiz.explanation: 主纜直徑 D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cable diameter D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「擠壓與纏絲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compaction and wrapping” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 擠壓後沿全長以周長尺或雷射量測直徑與橢圓度，換算空隙率並與允收範圍比較；索夾安裝時依程序分次張拉螺栓並記錄，纏絲時量測纏絲張力、搭接與間距，逐段拍照存檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After compaction measure diameter and ovality along the length with a circumference tape or laser, convert to void ratio and compare with the acceptance range; tension cable-band bolts in stages per procedure and record them, and during wrapping measure wrapping tension, laps and pitch, photographing each section for the record. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：擠壓與纏絲應列為逐段驗收項目，直徑、空隙率、螺栓張力與纏絲紀錄須能追溯到區段編號；索夾螺栓應在完工後一定期間（例如數月內）複測一次預力，以補償初期壓密造成的損失。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make compaction and wrapping section-by-section acceptance items, with diameter, void ratio, bolt tension and wrapping records traceable to section numbers; re-check cable-band bolt preload within a set period after completion, for example within a few months, to make up for losses from early consolidation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：擠壓不足的區段在完工後仍持續壓密，索夾螺栓預力隨之流失，索夾可能下滑；纏絲間隙或防蝕膏不連續處成為水分入口，主纜低點與索夾下方最先出現腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Under-compacted sections keep consolidating after completion, so cable-band bolt preload is lost and bands may slip; gaps in wrapping or breaks in the paste become water entry points, and corrosion appears first at cable low points and under bands. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 擠壓後沿全長以周長尺或雷射量測直徑與橢圓度，換算空隙率並與允收範圍比較；索夾安裝時依程序分次張拉螺栓並記錄，纏絲時量測纏絲張力、搭接與間距，逐段拍照存檔。
knowledge.textEn: After compaction measure diameter and ovality along the length with a circumference tape or laser, convert to void ratio and compare with the acceptance range; tension cable-band bolts in stages per procedure and record them, and during wrapping measure wrapping tension, laps and pitch, photographing each section for the record.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 擠壓與纏絲應列為逐段驗收項目，直徑、空隙率、螺栓張力與纏絲紀錄須能追溯到區段編號；索夾螺栓應在完工後一定期間（例如數月內）複測一次預力，以補償初期壓密造成的損失。
knowledge.textEn: Make compaction and wrapping section-by-section acceptance items, with diameter, void ratio, bolt tension and wrapping records traceable to section numbers; re-check cable-band bolt preload within a set period after completion, for example within a few months, to make up for losses from early consolidation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。
擠壓後沿全長以周長尺或雷射量測直徑與橢圓度，換算空隙率並與允收範圍比較；索夾安裝時依程序分次張拉螺栓並記錄，纏絲時量測纏絲張力、搭接與間距，逐段拍照存檔。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life.
After compaction measure diameter and ovality along the length with a circumference tape or laser, convert to void ratio and compare with the acceptance range.
quiz.explanation: 擠壓後沿全長以周長尺或雷射量測直徑與橢圓度，換算空隙率並與允收範圍比較；索夾安裝時依程序分次張拉螺栓並記錄，纏絲時量測纏絲張力、搭接與間距，逐段拍照存檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After compaction measure diameter and ovality along the length with a circumference tape or laser, convert to void ratio and compare with the acceptance range; tension cable-band bolts in stages per procedure and record them, and during wrapping measure wrapping tension, laps and pitch, photographing each section for the record. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「擠壓與纏絲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compaction and wrapping” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 擠壓不足的區段在完工後仍持續壓密，索夾螺栓預力隨之流失，索夾可能下滑；纏絲間隙或防蝕膏不連續處成為水分入口，主纜低點與索夾下方最先出現腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Under-compacted sections keep consolidating after completion, so cable-band bolt preload is lost and bands may slip; gaps in wrapping or breaks in the paste become water entry points, and corrosion appears first at cable low points and under bands. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：之後安裝索夾（兩個半圓柱以螺栓夾緊，坡度越陡需要越多螺栓），掛上吊索，最後以纏絲機把鍍鋅軟鋼線（美國常用 No. 9 線）緊密纏繞在主纜外，並塗上防蝕膏與塗料，或改用彈性體包覆配合乾燥空氣。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cable bands are then installed, two half-cylinders bolted together, with more bolts on steeper slopes, the hangers are hung, and finally a wrapping machine winds soft galvanised wire (No. 9 wire in US practice) tightly around the cable over a corrosion-inhibiting paste and paint, or an elastomeric wrap is used with dry air.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 擠壓不足的區段在完工後仍持續壓密，索夾螺栓預力隨之流失，索夾可能下滑；纏絲間隙或防蝕膏不連續處成為水分入口，主纜低點與索夾下方最先出現腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Under-compacted sections keep consolidating after completion, so cable-band bolt preload is lost and bands may slip; gaps in wrapping or breaks in the paste become water entry points, and corrosion appears first at cable low points and under bands.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 擠壓不足的區段在完工後仍持續壓密，索夾螺栓預力隨之流失，索夾可能下滑；纏絲間隙或防蝕膏不連續處成為水分入口，主纜低點與索夾下方最先出現腐蝕。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。
optionsEn: Under-compacted sections keep consolidating after completion, so cable-band bolt preload is lost and bands may slip.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 擠壓不足的區段在完工後仍持續壓密，索夾螺栓預力隨之流失，索夾可能下滑；纏絲間隙或防蝕膏不連續處成為水分入口，主纜低點與索夾下方最先出現腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Under-compacted sections keep consolidating after completion, so cable-band bolt preload is lost and bands may slip; gaps in wrapping or breaks in the paste become water entry points, and corrosion appears first at cable low points and under bands. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基準索股與相對垂度量測」與「鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reference strand and relative sag survey" and "Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基準索股與相對垂度量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Reference strand and relative sag survey: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索股垂度量測精度」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strand sag survey accuracy” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜每一股（或每一束）都要與基準索股的垂度一致，量測分兩層：基準索股以全站儀或精密水準做絕對量測，其餘索股則以安裝在跨中與邊跨的量規或雷射，量測與基準索股的相對高差。絕對量測的誤差主要來自儀器角度精度、距離、大氣折射與目標偏心；相對量測較不受大氣影響，但量規本身的定位與讀值方法必須統一。量測結果要與溫度紀錄一起判讀，並在調整後重新量測確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索股垂度量測精度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every strand or bundle must match the sag of the reference strand, and the survey works in two layers: the reference strand is measured absolutely by total station or precise levelling, while the others are measured relative to it with gauges or lasers mounted at mid-span and in the side spans. Absolute survey error comes mainly from instrument angular accuracy, distance, atmospheric refraction and target eccentricity; relative measurement is less affected by the atmosphere, but gauge positioning and reading method must be standardised. Results are interpreted with temperature records and re-measured after adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Strand sag survey accuracy” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：角度誤差造成的位置誤差 e ≈ D·θ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Position error from angular error e ≈ D·θ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索股垂度量測精度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Strand sag survey accuracy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基準索股與相對垂度量測
knowledge.titleEn: Reference strand and relative sag survey
knowledge.text: 主纜每一股（或每一束）都要與基準索股的垂度一致，量測分兩層：基準索股以全站儀或精密水準做絕對量測，其餘索股則以安裝在跨中與邊跨的量規或雷射，量測與基準索股的相對高差。絕對量測的誤差主要來自儀器角度精度、距離、大氣折射與目標偏心；相對量測較不受大氣影響，但量規本身的定位與讀值方法必須統一。
knowledge.textEn: Every strand or bundle must match the sag of the reference strand, and the survey works in two layers: the reference strand is measured absolutely by total station or precise levelling, while the others are measured relative to it with gauges or lasers mounted at mid-span and in the side spans. Absolute survey error comes mainly from instrument angular accuracy, distance, atmospheric refraction and target eccentricity; relative measurement is less affected by the atmosphere, but gauge positioning and reading method must be standardised.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基準索股與相對垂度量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reference strand and relative sag survey" is correct?
options: 儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。
主纜每一股（或每一束）都要與基準索股的垂度一致，量測分兩層：基準索股以全站儀或精密水準做絕對量測，其餘索股則以安裝在跨中與邊跨的量規或雷射，量測與基準索股的相對高差。
只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。
optionsEn: With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary.

Every strand or bundle must match the sag of the reference strand, and the survey works in two layers: the reference strand is measured absolutely by total station or precise levelling, while the others are measured relative to it with gauges or lasers mounted at mid-span and in the side spans.
If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes.
quiz.explanation: 主纜每一股（或每一束）都要與基準索股的垂度一致，量測分兩層：基準索股以全站儀或精密水準做絕對量測，其餘索股則以安裝在跨中與邊跨的量規或雷射，量測與基準索股的相對高差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every strand or bundle must match the sag of the reference strand, and the survey works in two layers: the reference strand is measured absolutely by total station or precise levelling, while the others are measured relative to it with gauges or lasers mounted at mid-span and in the side spans. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基準索股與相對垂度量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reference strand and relative sag survey: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索股垂度量測精度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strand sag survey accuracy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：角度誤差造成的位置誤差 e ≈ D·θ。全站儀角度精度 1″（4.85×10⁻⁶ rad）、視距 800 m：e ≈ 800×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.9 mm；若視距 1,600 m，e ≈ 7.8 mm。若索股相對高差允差為 ±10 mm，絕對量測在長視距下就會吃掉大部分允差，因此其他索股改用相對量測。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Position error from angular error e ≈ D·θ. With 1″ angular accuracy (4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) at 800 m, e ≈ 800×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.9 mm; at 1,600 m, e ≈ 7.8 mm. With a ±10 mm tolerance on relative strand level, absolute survey over long sights consumes most of the tolerance, which is why the other strands are measured relatively. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測前以已知點校核儀器與量規，量測時記錄氣溫、索股溫度、風速與時間，同一點由兩組人員獨立讀值；每股調整後的相對高差與基準索股的絕對量測定期交叉核對，發現系統偏差時追查量規或基準點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check instruments and gauges against known points before surveying; during the survey log air and strand temperature, wind and time, with two crews reading the same point independently; periodically cross-check adjusted relative levels against absolute surveys of the reference strand and trace gauges or benchmarks when a systematic offset appears.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 角度誤差造成的位置誤差 e ≈ D·θ。全站儀角度精度 1″（4.85×10⁻⁶ rad）、視距 800 m：e ≈ 800×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.9 mm；若視距 1,600 m，e ≈ 7.8 mm。若索股相對高差允差為 ±10 mm，絕對量測在長視距下就會吃掉大部分允差，因此其他索股改用相對量測。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Position error from angular error e ≈ D·θ. With 1″ angular accuracy (4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) at 800 m, e ≈ 800×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.9 mm; at 1,600 m, e ≈ 7.8 mm. With a ±10 mm tolerance on relative strand level, absolute survey over long sights consumes most of the tolerance, which is why the other strands are measured relatively. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基準索股與相對垂度量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reference strand and relative sag survey", which statement holds?
options: 主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。
主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。
角度誤差造成的位置誤差 e ≈ D·θ。
optionsEn: Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards.
The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible.
Position error from angular error e ≈ D·θ.
quiz.explanation: 角度誤差造成的位置誤差 e ≈ D·θ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Position error from angular error e ≈ D·θ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基準索股與相對垂度量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reference strand and relative sag survey: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「索股垂度量測精度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strand sag survey accuracy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測前以已知點校核儀器與量規，量測時記錄氣溫、索股溫度、風速與時間，同一點由兩組人員獨立讀值；每股調整後的相對高差與基準索股的絕對量測定期交叉核對，發現系統偏差時追查量規或基準點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check instruments and gauges against known points before surveying; during the survey log air and strand temperature, wind and time, with two crews reading the same point independently; periodically cross-check adjusted relative levels against absolute surveys of the reference strand and trace gauges or benchmarks when a systematic offset appears. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：量測程序書應明訂儀器精度、量測時段、兩組獨立讀值、允差與交叉核對頻率；任何連續數股同向偏差都應觸發停工檢查，由測量主管與設計代表共同判定後才繼續。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The survey procedure should define instrument accuracy, measuring windows, two independent readings, tolerances and cross-check frequency; any run of strands deviating the same way should trigger a stop, resumed only after the survey lead and the designer's representative agree.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若基準索股量測含系統誤差，之後所有索股都會跟著錯，最後整條主纜垂度偏離設計；相對量規若在多股之後鬆動未被發現，造成一連串索股同向偏差，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲受力過大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A systematic error in the reference-strand survey carries into every strand that follows, leaving the whole cable off design sag; a relative gauge that loosens unnoticed after several strands produces a run of strands offset the same way, overloading some wires once compacted. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測前以已知點校核儀器與量規，量測時記錄氣溫、索股溫度、風速與時間，同一點由兩組人員獨立讀值；每股調整後的相對高差與基準索股的絕對量測定期交叉核對，發現系統偏差時追查量規或基準點。
knowledge.textEn: Check instruments and gauges against known points before surveying; during the survey log air and strand temperature, wind and time, with two crews reading the same point independently; periodically cross-check adjusted relative levels against absolute surveys of the reference strand and trace gauges or benchmarks when a systematic offset appears.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 量測程序書應明訂儀器精度、量測時段、兩組獨立讀值、允差與交叉核對頻率；任何連續數股同向偏差都應觸發停工檢查，由測量主管與設計代表共同判定後才繼續。
knowledge.textEn: The survey procedure should define instrument accuracy, measuring windows, two independent readings, tolerances and cross-check frequency; any run of strands deviating the same way should trigger a stop, resumed only after the survey lead and the designer's representative agree.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基準索股與相對垂度量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reference strand and relative sag survey"?
options: 量測前以已知點校核儀器與量規，量測時記錄氣溫、索股溫度、風速與時間，同一點由兩組人員獨立讀值。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。
optionsEn: Check instruments and gauges against known points before surveying.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Cable wires carry only axial tension, so saddle shape does not affect stress.
quiz.explanation: 量測前以已知點校核儀器與量規，量測時記錄氣溫、索股溫度、風速與時間，同一點由兩組人員獨立讀值；每股調整後的相對高差與基準索股的絕對量測定期交叉核對，發現系統偏差時追查量規或基準點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check instruments and gauges against known points before surveying; during the survey log air and strand temperature, wind and time, with two crews reading the same point independently; periodically cross-check adjusted relative levels against absolute surveys of the reference strand and trace gauges or benchmarks when a systematic offset appears. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基準索股與相對垂度量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reference strand and relative sag survey: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索股垂度量測精度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strand sag survey accuracy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若基準索股量測含系統誤差，之後所有索股都會跟著錯，最後整條主纜垂度偏離設計；相對量規若在多股之後鬆動未被發現，造成一連串索股同向偏差，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲受力過大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A systematic error in the reference-strand survey carries into every strand that follows, leaving the whole cable off design sag; a relative gauge that loosens unnoticed after several strands produces a run of strands offset the same way, overloading some wires once compacted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測結果要與溫度紀錄一起判讀，並在調整後重新量測確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Results are interpreted with temperature records and re-measured after adjustment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若基準索股量測含系統誤差，之後所有索股都會跟著錯，最後整條主纜垂度偏離設計；相對量規若在多股之後鬆動未被發現，造成一連串索股同向偏差，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲受力過大。
knowledge.textEn: A systematic error in the reference-strand survey carries into every strand that follows, leaving the whole cable off design sag; a relative gauge that loosens unnoticed after several strands produces a run of strands offset the same way, overloading some wires once compacted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基準索股與相對垂度量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reference strand and relative sag survey" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若基準索股量測含系統誤差，之後所有索股都會跟著錯，最後整條主纜垂度偏離設計。
只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A systematic error in the reference-strand survey carries into every strand that follows, leaving the whole cable off design sag.
If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes.
quiz.explanation: 若基準索股量測含系統誤差，之後所有索股都會跟著錯，最後整條主纜垂度偏離設計；相對量規若在多股之後鬆動未被發現，造成一連串索股同向偏差，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲受力過大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A systematic error in the reference-strand survey carries into every strand that follows, leaving the whole cable off design sag; a relative gauge that loosens unnoticed after several strands produces a run of strands offset the same way, overloading some wires once compacted. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼絲批次允收」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wire lot acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲組成，設計使用的是規格的最低強度或特徵值，而不是平均值；鋼絲強度呈統計分布，同一批次內也有差異。因此允收不能只看平均值，必須估計低分位值是否高於規格，並同時檢查伸長率、扭轉次數等延性指標與鍍層。製造過程任一環節（線材成分、熱處理、拉拔、鍍鋅）改變，都可能讓分布偏移，所以批次劃分與追溯同樣重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼絲批次允收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A main cable contains tens of thousands of wires, and design uses the specified minimum or characteristic strength rather than the mean; wire strength follows a statistical distribution and varies within a lot. Acceptance therefore cannot rely on the mean alone: the lower fractile must be shown to exceed the specification, while ductility indicators such as elongation and torsion turns and the coating are checked too. A change in any manufacturing step, whether rod chemistry, heat treatment, drawing or galvanising, can shift the distribution, so lot definition and traceability matter as much. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wire lot acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以常態分布估算 5% 分位值 f_k = f_m − 1.645·s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate the 5% fractile from a normal distribution f_k = f_m − 1.645·s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼絲批次允收」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wire lot acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收
knowledge.titleEn: Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance
knowledge.text: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲組成，設計使用的是規格的最低強度或特徵值，而不是平均值；鋼絲強度呈統計分布，同一批次內也有差異。因此允收不能只看平均值，必須估計低分位值是否高於規格，並同時檢查伸長率、扭轉次數等延性指標與鍍層。
knowledge.textEn: A main cable contains tens of thousands of wires, and design uses the specified minimum or characteristic strength rather than the mean; wire strength follows a statistical distribution and varies within a lot. Acceptance therefore cannot rely on the mean alone: the lower fractile must be shown to exceed the specification, while ductility indicators such as elongation and torsion turns and the coating are checked too.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance" is correct?
options: 只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。
主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。
主纜由數萬根鋼絲組成，設計使用的是規格的最低強度或特徵值，而不是平均值；鋼絲強度呈統計分布，同一批次內也有差異。
optionsEn: If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes.
If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded.
A main cable contains tens of thousands of wires, and design uses the specified minimum or characteristic strength rather than the mean.
quiz.explanation: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲組成，設計使用的是規格的最低強度或特徵值，而不是平均值；鋼絲強度呈統計分布，同一批次內也有差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A main cable contains tens of thousands of wires, and design uses the specified minimum or characteristic strength rather than the mean; wire strength follows a statistical distribution and varies within a lot. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼絲批次允收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wire lot acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以常態分布估算 5% 分位值 f_k = f_m − 1.645·s。若某批平均強度 f_m = 1,860 N/mm²、標準差 s = 30 N/mm²：f_k = 1,860 − 1.645×30 ≈ 1,811 N/mm²，高於 1,770 N/mm² 的規格值；若 s 增為 55 N/mm²，f_k ≈ 1,770 N/mm²，剛好落在門檻。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate the 5% fractile from a normal distribution f_k = f_m − 1.645·s. For a lot with mean f_m = 1,860 N/mm² and standard deviation s = 30 N/mm²: f_k = 1,860 − 1.645×30 ≈ 1,811 N/mm², above a 1,770 N/mm² specification; if s grows to 55 N/mm², f_k ≈ 1,770 N/mm², right at the threshold. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依規格的抽樣頻率從每捲或每批取樣，做拉伸、扭轉、捲繞與鍍層試驗，計算平均、標準差與低分位值；趨勢圖顯示批間偏移時追查製程紀錄，並由第三方見證部分試驗，結果連同捲號納入追溯資料庫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample each coil or lot at the specified frequency for tensile, torsion, wrapping and coating tests, computing mean, standard deviation and lower fractile; when trend charts show drift between lots, trace process records, have a third party witness part of the testing, and store results with coil numbers in the traceability database.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以常態分布估算 5% 分位值 f_k = f_m − 1.645·s。若某批平均強度 f_m = 1,860 N/mm²、標準差 s = 30 N/mm²：f_k = 1,860 − 1.645×30 ≈ 1,811 N/mm²，高於 1,770 N/mm² 的規格值；若 s 增為 55 N/mm²，f_k ≈ 1,770 N/mm²，剛好落在門檻。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate the 5% fractile from a normal distribution f_k = f_m − 1.645·s. For a lot with mean f_m = 1,860 N/mm² and standard deviation s = 30 N/mm²: f_k = 1,860 − 1.645×30 ≈ 1,811 N/mm², above a 1,770 N/mm² specification; if s grows to 55 N/mm², f_k ≈ 1,770 N/mm², right at the threshold. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 以常態分布估算 5% 分位值 f_k = f_m − 1.645·s。
預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。
鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。
optionsEn: Estimate the 5% fractile from a normal distribution f_k = f_m − 1.645·s.
Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge.
Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life.
quiz.explanation: 以常態分布估算 5% 分位值 f_k = f_m − 1.645·s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate the 5% fractile from a normal distribution f_k = f_m − 1.645·s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼絲批次允收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wire lot acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依規格的抽樣頻率從每捲或每批取樣，做拉伸、扭轉、捲繞與鍍層試驗，計算平均、標準差與低分位值；趨勢圖顯示批間偏移時追查製程紀錄，並由第三方見證部分試驗，結果連同捲號納入追溯資料庫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample each coil or lot at the specified frequency for tensile, torsion, wrapping and coating tests, computing mean, standard deviation and lower fractile; when trend charts show drift between lots, trace process records, have a third party witness part of the testing, and store results with coil numbers in the traceability database. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規範應明訂批次定義、抽樣頻率、統計允收準則與不合格批的處置（隔離、加倍抽樣或退貨），並要求製造商提交製程能力資料；允收紀錄須保存到橋梁使用年限結束。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The procurement specification should define lots, sampling frequency, statistical acceptance criteria and disposal of failed lots (quarantine, double sampling or rejection), and require process-capability data from the maker; acceptance records must be kept for the bridge's whole service life.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只檢查平均值的允收方式，可能放行標準差過大的批次，使一部分鋼絲實際強度低於規格；延性不合格的鋼絲在架設時看不出問題，卻可能在索鞍、索夾的局部彎曲處提早斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accepting on the mean alone can pass lots with too much scatter, leaving some wires below specification; wire with inadequate ductility looks fine during erection but may break early where it bends locally at saddles and bands. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依規格的抽樣頻率從每捲或每批取樣，做拉伸、扭轉、捲繞與鍍層試驗，計算平均、標準差與低分位值；趨勢圖顯示批間偏移時追查製程紀錄，並由第三方見證部分試驗，結果連同捲號納入追溯資料庫。
knowledge.textEn: Sample each coil or lot at the specified frequency for tensile, torsion, wrapping and coating tests, computing mean, standard deviation and lower fractile; when trend charts show drift between lots, trace process records, have a third party witness part of the testing, and store results with coil numbers in the traceability database.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購規範應明訂批次定義、抽樣頻率、統計允收準則與不合格批的處置（隔離、加倍抽樣或退貨），並要求製造商提交製程能力資料；允收紀錄須保存到橋梁使用年限結束。
knowledge.textEn: The procurement specification should define lots, sampling frequency, statistical acceptance criteria and disposal of failed lots (quarantine, double sampling or rejection), and require process-capability data from the maker; acceptance records must be kept for the bridge's whole service life.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
依規格的抽樣頻率從每捲或每批取樣，做拉伸、扭轉、捲繞與鍍層試驗，計算平均、標準差與低分位值。
貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Sample each coil or lot at the specified frequency for tensile, torsion, wrapping and coating tests, computing mean, standard deviation and lower fractile.
A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding.
quiz.explanation: 依規格的抽樣頻率從每捲或每批取樣，做拉伸、扭轉、捲繞與鍍層試驗，計算平均、標準差與低分位值；趨勢圖顯示批間偏移時追查製程紀錄，並由第三方見證部分試驗，結果連同捲號納入追溯資料庫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample each coil or lot at the specified frequency for tensile, torsion, wrapping and coating tests, computing mean, standard deviation and lower fractile; when trend charts show drift between lots, trace process records, have a third party witness part of the testing, and store results with coil numbers in the traceability database. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼絲批次允收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wire lot acceptance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只檢查平均值的允收方式，可能放行標準差過大的批次，使一部分鋼絲實際強度低於規格；延性不合格的鋼絲在架設時看不出問題，卻可能在索鞍、索夾的局部彎曲處提早斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting on the mean alone can pass lots with too much scatter, leaving some wires below specification; wire with inadequate ductility looks fine during erection but may break early where it bends locally at saddles and bands. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：製造過程任一環節（線材成分、熱處理、拉拔、鍍鋅）改變，都可能讓分布偏移，所以批次劃分與追溯同樣重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A change in any manufacturing step, whether rod chemistry, heat treatment, drawing or galvanising, can shift the distribution, so lot definition and traceability matter as much.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只檢查平均值的允收方式，可能放行標準差過大的批次，使一部分鋼絲實際強度低於規格；延性不合格的鋼絲在架設時看不出問題，卻可能在索鞍、索夾的局部彎曲處提早斷裂。
knowledge.textEn: Accepting on the mean alone can pass lots with too much scatter, leaving some wires below specification; wire with inadequate ductility looks fine during erection but may break early where it bends locally at saddles and bands.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。
只檢查平均值的允收方式，可能放行標準差過大的批次，使一部分鋼絲實際強度低於規格；延性不合格的鋼絲在架設時看不出問題，卻可能在索鞍、索夾的局部彎曲處提早斷裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded.
Accepting on the mean alone can pass lots with too much scatter, leaving some wires below specification.
quiz.explanation: 只檢查平均值的允收方式，可能放行標準差過大的批次，使一部分鋼絲實際強度低於規格；延性不合格的鋼絲在架設時看不出問題，卻可能在索鞍、索夾的局部彎曲處提早斷裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accepting on the mean alone can pass lots with too much scatter, leaving some wires below specification; wire with inadequate ductility looks fine during erection but may break early where it bends locally at saddles and bands. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級」與「主纜剩餘強度評估與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging" and "Remaining-strength evaluation and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「楔形開纜檢查」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge-opening inspection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜外表的纏絲與塗裝看不出內部狀況，唯一直接的方法是拆開包覆、以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查。美國聯邦公路總署的入門手冊建議首次內部檢查每條主纜至少三處，每處在周圍四個位置打入楔子；若腐蝕超過第 2 級，開口擴大到整個格間並使用八條楔線。腐蝕分為四級：第 1 級鋼絲表面有白點，第 2 級整個表面白色鋅氧化，第 3 級部分出現褐色鏽點，第 4 級褐色鏽點覆蓋 3 至 6 in 長度內超過 30% 的表面。實驗顯示約 60% 的第 4 級鋼絲可能含有裂紋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「楔形開纜檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wrapping and paint hide the inside of a cable, and the only direct method is to remove the covering and drive wedges to spread the wires. The US Federal Highway Administration primer recommends that a first internal inspection open at least three locations per cable, with wedges at four points around the circumference; if corrosion exceeds Stage 2, the opening extends to a full panel with eight wedge lines. Corrosion has four stages: Stage 1 white spots on the wire surface, Stage 2 white zinc oxide over the whole surface, Stage 3 some brown rust spots, and Stage 4 brown spots covering more than 30% of a 3 to 6 in length of wire. Laboratory tests showed that about 60% of Stage 4 wires may contain cracks. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wedge-opening inspection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：估算楔線可見鋼絲的比例。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate the share of wires seen along wedge lines.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「楔形開纜檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wedge-opening inspection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級
knowledge.titleEn: Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging
knowledge.text: 主纜外表的纏絲與塗裝看不出內部狀況，唯一直接的方法是拆開包覆、以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查。美國聯邦公路總署的入門手冊建議首次內部檢查每條主纜至少三處，每處在周圍四個位置打入楔子；若腐蝕超過第 2 級，開口擴大到整個格間並使用八條楔線。
knowledge.textEn: Wrapping and paint hide the inside of a cable, and the only direct method is to remove the covering and drive wedges to spread the wires. The US Federal Highway Administration primer recommends that a first internal inspection open at least three locations per cable, with wedges at four points around the circumference; if corrosion exceeds Stage 2, the opening extends to a full panel with eight wedge lines.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging" is correct?
options: 主纜外表的纏絲與塗裝看不出內部狀況，唯一直接的方法是拆開包覆、以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查。
主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。
主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。
optionsEn: Wrapping and paint hide the inside of a cable, and the only direct method is to remove the covering and drive wedges to spread the wires.
If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded.
Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards.
quiz.explanation: 主纜外表的纏絲與塗裝看不出內部狀況，唯一直接的方法是拆開包覆、以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wrapping and paint hide the inside of a cable, and the only direct method is to remove the covering and drive wedges to spread the wires. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「楔形開纜檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge-opening inspection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：估算楔線可見鋼絲的比例。主纜半徑 0.4 m、鋼絲直徑 5.4 mm，徑向約 0.4/0.0054 ≈ 74 層；每條楔線兩側各見一根，約 148 根；8 條楔線約 1,185 根，佔 18,000 根的約 6.6%。這說明開纜檢查是抽樣，需要統計推估全斷面。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate the share of wires seen along wedge lines. With a 0.4 m cable radius and 5.4 mm wire there are about 0.4/0.0054 ≈ 74 radial layers; each wedge line shows one wire on each side, about 148 wires; eight lines show about 1,185 wires, about 6.6% of 18,000. Cable openings are therefore a sample, and the whole section must be inferred statistically. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開纜位置優先選在主纜低點、索夾附近與歷史漏水處；每條楔線逐層記錄腐蝕等級與斷絲，取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸與裂紋檢查；首次基準檢查建議在約 30 年時進行，若第 4 級鋼絲超過 10%，下次間隔縮短到 5 年。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Choose openings at cable low points, near cable bands and where leaks have been recorded; log corrosion stage and broken wires layer by layer along each wedge line and remove representative wires for tensile and crack tests; the baseline internal inspection is suggested at about 30 years, with the interval shortened to five years if more than 10% of wires are Stage 4.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 估算楔線可見鋼絲的比例。主纜半徑 0.4 m、鋼絲直徑 5.4 mm，徑向約 0.4/0.0054 ≈ 74 層；每條楔線兩側各見一根，約 148 根；8 條楔線約 1,185 根，佔 18,000 根的約 6.6%。這說明開纜檢查是抽樣，需要統計推估全斷面。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate the share of wires seen along wedge lines. With a 0.4 m cable radius and 5.4 mm wire there are about 0.4/0.0054 ≈ 74 radial layers; each wedge line shows one wire on each side, about 148 wires; eight lines show about 1,185 wires, about 6.6% of 18,000. Cable openings are therefore a sample, and the whole section must be inferred statistically. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging", which statement holds?
options: 主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。
估算楔線可見鋼絲的比例。
鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。
optionsEn: The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible.
Estimate the share of wires seen along wedge lines.
Cable wires carry only axial tension, so saddle shape does not affect stress.
quiz.explanation: 估算楔線可見鋼絲的比例。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate the share of wires seen along wedge lines. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「楔形開纜檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wedge-opening inspection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 開纜位置優先選在主纜低點、索夾附近與歷史漏水處；每條楔線逐層記錄腐蝕等級與斷絲，取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸與裂紋檢查；首次基準檢查建議在約 30 年時進行，若第 4 級鋼絲超過 10%，下次間隔縮短到 5 年。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Choose openings at cable low points, near cable bands and where leaks have been recorded; log corrosion stage and broken wires layer by layer along each wedge line and remove representative wires for tensile and crack tests; the baseline internal inspection is suggested at about 30 years, with the interval shortened to five years if more than 10% of wires are Stage 4. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：開纜檢查計畫應說明位置選擇理由、楔線數量、記錄格式、取樣鋼絲數與重新包覆的品質要求，並由具主纜檢查經驗的工程師主持；所有開口位置與結果須標示在主纜展開圖上供日後比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The cable-opening plan should justify locations, wedge-line count, record format, number of sampled wires and rewrapping quality, led by an engineer experienced in cable inspection; mark every opening and its findings on a developed cable drawing for later comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只在容易到達的高處開纜，可能錯過積水最嚴重的低點；檢查後重新包覆不良，開口本身反而成為新的進水點；把第 4 級鋼絲當作完好鋼絲計算，會高估主纜強度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Opening only where access is easy can miss the wettest low points; poor rewrapping after inspection turns the opening into a new water entry; counting Stage 4 wires as sound overstates cable strength. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 開纜位置優先選在主纜低點、索夾附近與歷史漏水處；每條楔線逐層記錄腐蝕等級與斷絲，取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸與裂紋檢查；首次基準檢查建議在約 30 年時進行，若第 4 級鋼絲超過 10%，下次間隔縮短到 5 年。
knowledge.textEn: Choose openings at cable low points, near cable bands and where leaks have been recorded; log corrosion stage and broken wires layer by layer along each wedge line and remove representative wires for tensile and crack tests; the baseline internal inspection is suggested at about 30 years, with the interval shortened to five years if more than 10% of wires are Stage 4.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 開纜檢查計畫應說明位置選擇理由、楔線數量、記錄格式、取樣鋼絲數與重新包覆的品質要求，並由具主纜檢查經驗的工程師主持；所有開口位置與結果須標示在主纜展開圖上供日後比較。
knowledge.textEn: The cable-opening plan should justify locations, wedge-line count, record format, number of sampled wires and rewrapping quality, led by an engineer experienced in cable inspection; mark every opening and its findings on a developed cable drawing for later comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。
開纜位置優先選在主纜低點、索夾附近與歷史漏水處。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability.
Choose openings at cable low points, near cable bands and where leaks have been recorded.
quiz.explanation: 開纜位置優先選在主纜低點、索夾附近與歷史漏水處；每條楔線逐層記錄腐蝕等級與斷絲，取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸與裂紋檢查；首次基準檢查建議在約 30 年時進行，若第 4 級鋼絲超過 10%，下次間隔縮短到 5 年。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Choose openings at cable low points, near cable bands and where leaks have been recorded; log corrosion stage and broken wires layer by layer along each wedge line and remove representative wires for tensile and crack tests; the baseline internal inspection is suggested at about 30 years, with the interval shortened to five years if more than 10% of wires are Stage 4. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「楔形開纜檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wedge-opening inspection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只在容易到達的高處開纜，可能錯過積水最嚴重的低點；檢查後重新包覆不良，開口本身反而成為新的進水點；把第 4 級鋼絲當作完好鋼絲計算，會高估主纜強度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
