steps.instructionEn: Opening only where access is easy can miss the wettest low points; poor rewrapping after inspection turns the opening into a new water entry; counting Stage 4 wires as sound overstates cable strength. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實驗顯示約 60% 的第 4 級鋼絲可能含有裂紋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Laboratory tests showed that about 60% of Stage 4 wires may contain cracks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只在容易到達的高處開纜，可能錯過積水最嚴重的低點；檢查後重新包覆不良，開口本身反而成為新的進水點；把第 4 級鋼絲當作完好鋼絲計算，會高估主纜強度。
knowledge.textEn: Opening only where access is easy can miss the wettest low points; poor rewrapping after inspection turns the opening into a new water entry; counting Stage 4 wires as sound overstates cable strength.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只在容易到達的高處開纜，可能錯過積水最嚴重的低點；檢查後重新包覆不良，開口本身反而成為新的進水點；把第 4 級鋼絲當作完好鋼絲計算，會高估主纜強度。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。
optionsEn: Opening only where access is easy can miss the wettest low points.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards.
quiz.explanation: 若只在容易到達的高處開纜，可能錯過積水最嚴重的低點；檢查後重新包覆不良，開口本身反而成為新的進水點；把第 4 級鋼絲當作完好鋼絲計算，會高估主纜強度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Opening only where access is easy can miss the wettest low points; poor rewrapping after inspection turns the opening into a new water entry; counting Stage 4 wires as sound overstates cable strength. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主纜剩餘強度評估與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Remaining-strength evaluation and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘強度與聲學監測」如何影響懸索橋主纜架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remaining strength and acoustic monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-bridge main-cable erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜剩餘強度評估把開纜觀察、鋼絲試驗與統計模型結合起來。美國的 NCHRP 534 號報告提出三種模型：裂紋鋼絲不超過總數約 10% 時可用簡化模型，它在多數情況下低估強度，適合找出最不利格間；超過時改用脆性鋼絲模型；鋼絲強度變異異常時用有限延性模型。聯邦公路總署建議在發現第 3 級以上腐蝕時裝設聲學監測，在下次開纜前持續 12 至 18 個月；當第 4 級鋼絲超過 10% 或格間內出現斷絲時，強烈建議以聲學監測偵測斷絲。這些資料都必須在交接時從施工記錄開始累積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「剩餘強度與聲學監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Remaining-strength evaluation combines cable observations, wire tests and statistical models. US NCHRP Report 534 offers three: a simplified model when cracked wires are no more than about 10% of the total, which usually underestimates strength and is useful for finding the worst panel; a brittle-wire model beyond that; and a limited-ductility model when wire strength varies unusually. The Federal Highway Administration recommends acoustic monitoring once Stage 3 or worse corrosion is found, running 12 to 18 months before the next opening, and strongly recommends it for detecting wire breaks when Stage 4 wires exceed 10% or broken wires appear in a panel. All these data must accumulate from the construction records handed over at completion. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Remaining strength and acoustic monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡化估算：18,000 根鋼絲中 2% 斷絲（360 根）、10% 為第 4 級（1,800 根），其中 60% 含裂紋（1,080 根）且假設僅剩 50% 強度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Simplified estimate: of 18,000 wires, 2% are broken (360) and 10% are Stage 4 (1,800), of which 60% are cracked (1,080) and assumed to keep 50% strength.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「剩餘強度與聲學監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Remaining strength and acoustic monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜剩餘強度評估與交接
knowledge.text: 主纜剩餘強度評估把開纜觀察、鋼絲試驗與統計模型結合起來。美國的 NCHRP 534 號報告提出三種模型：裂紋鋼絲不超過總數約 10% 時可用簡化模型，它在多數情況下低估強度，適合找出最不利格間；超過時改用脆性鋼絲模型；鋼絲強度變異異常時用有限延性模型。
knowledge.textEn: Remaining-strength evaluation combines cable observations, wire tests and statistical models. US NCHRP Report 534 offers three: a simplified model when cracked wires are no more than about 10% of the total, which usually underestimates strength and is useful for finding the worst panel; a brittle-wire model beyond that; and a limited-ductility model when wire strength varies unusually.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜剩餘強度評估與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Remaining-strength evaluation and handover" is correct?
options: 主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。
主纜剩餘強度評估把開纜觀察、鋼絲試驗與統計模型結合起來。
預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。
optionsEn: Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards.
Remaining-strength evaluation combines cable observations, wire tests and statistical models.
Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge.
quiz.explanation: 主纜剩餘強度評估把開纜觀察、鋼絲試驗與統計模型結合起來。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Remaining-strength evaluation combines cable observations, wire tests and statistical models. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜剩餘強度評估與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Remaining-strength evaluation and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘強度與聲學監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Remaining strength and acoustic monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡化估算：18,000 根鋼絲中 2% 斷絲（360 根）、10% 為第 4 級（1,800 根），其中 60% 含裂紋（1,080 根）且假設僅剩 50% 強度。有效鋼絲 = 18,000 − 360 − 1,080×0.5 = 17,100 根，強度剩 95%；原安全係數 2.5 降為約 2.375。若斷絲增為 5%，有效鋼絲 16,560 根，係數約 2.30。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Simplified estimate: of 18,000 wires, 2% are broken (360) and 10% are Stage 4 (1,800), of which 60% are cracked (1,080) and assumed to keep 50% strength. Effective wires = 18,000 − 360 − 1,080×0.5 = 17,100, or 95% of strength, so a 2.5 safety factor falls to about 2.375. If broken wires rise to 5%, effective wires are 16,560 and the factor is about 2.30. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以開纜位置的逐層紀錄與試驗結果建立各格間的強度估計，標出最不利格間；聲學監測系統需先做斷絲模擬試驗確認偵測率與定位精度，運轉期間把事件位置與時間標在主纜展開圖上，與下一次開纜結果對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build strength estimates for each panel from layer-by-layer opening records and test results, identifying the worst panel; validate an acoustic monitoring system with simulated wire breaks to confirm detection rate and location accuracy, then plot events by position and time on the developed cable drawing and compare with the next opening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Simplified estimate: of 18,000 wires, 2% are broken (360) and 10% are Stage 4 (1,800), of which 60% are cracked (1,080) and assumed to keep 50% strength. Effective wires = 18,000 − 360 − 1,080×0.5 = 17,100, or 95% of strength, so a 2.5 safety factor falls to about 2.375. If broken wires rise to 5%, effective wires are 16,560 and the factor is about 2.30. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜剩餘強度評估與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Remaining-strength evaluation and handover", which statement holds?
options: 鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。
貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。
簡化估算：18,000 根鋼絲中 2% 斷絲（360 根）、10% 為第 4 級（1,800 根），其中 60% 含裂紋（1,080 根）且假設僅剩 50% 強度。
optionsEn: Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life.
A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding.
Simplified estimate: of 18,000 wires, 2% are broken (360) and 10% are Stage 4 (1,800), of which 60% are cracked (1,080) and assumed to keep 50% strength.
quiz.explanation: 簡化估算：18,000 根鋼絲中 2% 斷絲（360 根）、10% 為第 4 級（1,800 根），其中 60% 含裂紋（1,080 根）且假設僅剩 50% 強度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Simplified estimate: of 18,000 wires, 2% are broken (360) and 10% are Stage 4 (1,800), of which 60% are cracked (1,080) and assumed to keep 50% strength. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜剩餘強度評估與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Remaining-strength evaluation and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘強度與聲學監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining strength and acoustic monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以開纜位置的逐層紀錄與試驗結果建立各格間的強度估計，標出最不利格間；聲學監測系統需先做斷絲模擬試驗確認偵測率與定位精度，運轉期間把事件位置與時間標在主纜展開圖上，與下一次開纜結果對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build strength estimates for each panel from layer-by-layer opening records and test results, identifying the worst panel; validate an acoustic monitoring system with simulated wire breaks to confirm detection rate and location accuracy, then plot events by position and time on the developed cable drawing and compare with the next opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含主纜展開圖、各束或各股的鋼絲數與批號、量測與允收紀錄、擠壓與纏絲紀錄、索夾螺栓張力，以及建議的首次開纜時間；營運單位據此建立主纜資料庫，每次檢查與監測都回寫更新。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should contain the developed cable drawing, wire count and lot numbers per strand or bundle, survey and acceptance records, compaction and wrapping records, cable-band bolt tensions and the recommended time of the first opening; the operator builds a cable database from them and updates it after every inspection and monitoring campaign.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：缺少施工時的鋼絲批次、空隙率與纏絲紀錄，評估者只能用保守假設，可能導致不必要的限載或過晚的介入；聲學事件若未與檢查結果比對，誤報與漏報都無法被修正。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without construction records of wire lots, void ratio and wrapping, evaluators must use conservative assumptions that can cause needless load limits or late intervention; acoustic events never compared with inspection results leave false alarms and missed breaks uncorrected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以開纜位置的逐層紀錄與試驗結果建立各格間的強度估計，標出最不利格間；聲學監測系統需先做斷絲模擬試驗確認偵測率與定位精度，運轉期間把事件位置與時間標在主纜展開圖上，與下一次開纜結果對照。
knowledge.textEn: Build strength estimates for each panel from layer-by-layer opening records and test results, identifying the worst panel; validate an acoustic monitoring system with simulated wire breaks to confirm detection rate and location accuracy, then plot events by position and time on the developed cable drawing and compare with the next opening.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含主纜展開圖、各束或各股的鋼絲數與批號、量測與允收紀錄、擠壓與纏絲紀錄、索夾螺栓張力，以及建議的首次開纜時間；營運單位據此建立主纜資料庫，每次檢查與監測都回寫更新。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should contain the developed cable drawing, wire count and lot numbers per strand or bundle, survey and acceptance records, compaction and wrapping records, cable-band bolt tensions and the recommended time of the first opening; the operator builds a cable database from them and updates it after every inspection and monitoring campaign.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主纜剩餘強度評估與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Remaining-strength evaluation and handover"?
options: 以開纜位置的逐層紀錄與試驗結果建立各格間的強度估計，標出最不利格間。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。
optionsEn: Build strength estimates for each panel from layer-by-layer opening records and test results, identifying the worst panel.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 以開纜位置的逐層紀錄與試驗結果建立各格間的強度估計，標出最不利格間；聲學監測系統需先做斷絲模擬試驗確認偵測率與定位精度，運轉期間把事件位置與時間標在主纜展開圖上，與下一次開纜結果對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build strength estimates for each panel from layer-by-layer opening records and test results, identifying the worst panel; validate an acoustic monitoring system with simulated wire breaks to confirm detection rate and location accuracy, then plot events by position and time on the developed cable drawing and compare with the next opening. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主纜剩餘強度評估與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Remaining-strength evaluation and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘強度與聲學監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining strength and acoustic monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺少施工時的鋼絲批次、空隙率與纏絲紀錄，評估者只能用保守假設，可能導致不必要的限載或過晚的介入；聲學事件若未與檢查結果比對，誤報與漏報都無法被修正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without construction records of wire lots, void ratio and wrapping, evaluators must use conservative assumptions that can cause needless load limits or late intervention; acoustic events never compared with inspection results leave false alarms and missed breaks uncorrected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些資料都必須在交接時從施工記錄開始累積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: All these data must accumulate from the construction records handed over at completion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 缺少施工時的鋼絲批次、空隙率與纏絲紀錄，評估者只能用保守假設，可能導致不必要的限載或過晚的介入；聲學事件若未與檢查結果比對，誤報與漏報都無法被修正。
knowledge.textEn: Without construction records of wire lots, void ratio and wrapping, evaluators must use conservative assumptions that can cause needless load limits or late intervention; acoustic events never compared with inspection results leave false alarms and missed breaks uncorrected.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜剩餘強度評估與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Remaining-strength evaluation and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
缺少施工時的鋼絲批次、空隙率與纏絲紀錄，評估者只能用保守假設，可能導致不必要的限載或過晚的介入；聲學事件若未與檢查結果比對，誤報與漏報都無法被修正。
預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without construction records of wire lots, void ratio and wrapping, evaluators must use conservative assumptions that can cause needless load limits or late intervention.
Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge.
quiz.explanation: 缺少施工時的鋼絲批次、空隙率與纏絲紀錄，評估者只能用保守假設，可能導致不必要的限載或過晚的介入；聲學事件若未與檢查結果比對，誤報與漏報都無法被修正。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without construction records of wire lots, void ratio and wrapping, evaluators must use conservative assumptions that can cause needless load limits or late intervention; acoustic events never compared with inspection results leave false alarms and missed breaks uncorrected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 懸索橋主纜除濕系統
summary: 主纜內部的水分會先消耗鍍鋅層、再腐蝕高強度鋼絲，而主纜幾乎無法更換。本課以本州四國連絡橋首創的主纜乾燥空氣送氣（管理目標相對濕度 40%）與大貝爾特東橋 2014 至 2015 年的除濕改造為主軸，說明腐蝕門檻與露點、送氣與排氣流路、彈性體包覆與索夾密封、除濕機與預冷、改造施工與啟動乾燥曲線、感測器判讀與開纜比對，最後以能耗與生命週期比較說明業主如何決策。
summaryEn: Moisture inside a main cable first consumes the zinc and then corrodes high-strength wire, and the cable can almost never be replaced. Built around the Honshu-Shikoku bridges' pioneering dry-air cable injection (managed to 40% relative humidity) and the 2014–2015 dehumidification retrofit of the Great Belt East Bridge, this course explains corrosion thresholds and dew point, injection and exhaust flow paths, elastomeric wrapping and cable-band seals, dehumidifiers and pre-coolers, retrofit construction and the start-up dry-out curve, sensor interpretation and comparison with cable openings, and finally energy use and the life-cycle comparison behind an owner's decision.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為一段 300 m 的主纜區段規劃送氣。主纜直徑 0.87 m、空隙率 20%，空隙體積約 0.594×0.20×300 ≈ 35.7 m³。若在中央送氣、兩端排氣，每側流動距離 150 m；以等效滲透率 1×10⁻⁹ m²、流動斷面 0.6 m²、壓差 2,000 Pa 估算，每側流量約 27 L/min，合計約 53 L/min（3.2 m³/h），每天換氣約 76.8 m³，約為空隙體積的 2.2 倍。送入 25 °C、15% RH 空氣（約 3.4 g/m³），出口 40% RH（約 9.2 g/m³），每天可帶走約 0.44 kg 水。若段內殘留 10 kg 水，約需 23 天；若改為只在一端送氣、另一端排氣，流動距離 300 m 使流量減為約 13 L/min，乾燥時間增為約 91 天。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: plan injection for a 300 m cable section. The cable is 0.87 m in diameter with 20% voids, a void volume of about 0.594×0.20×300 ≈ 35.7 m³. Injecting at mid-length with exhausts at both ends gives a 150 m flow length each way; with equivalent permeability 1×10⁻⁹ m², flow section 0.6 m² and 2,000 Pa, each side carries about 27 L/min, about 53 L/min (3.2 m³/h) in total, or about 76.8 m³ a day, about 2.2 times the void volume. Injecting air at 25 °C and 15% RH (about 3.4 g/m³) with exhaust at 40% RH (about 9.2 g/m³) removes about 0.44 kg of water a day, so 10 kg of trapped water takes about 23 days. Injecting at one end and exhausting at the other makes the flow length 300 m, cutting flow to about 13 L/min and stretching drying to about 91 days. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主纜為何從內部腐蝕」與「系統構成與送氣間距」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why cables corrode from the inside" and "System layout and injection spacing": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主纜為何從內部腐蝕：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Why cables corrode from the inside: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主纜內部露點」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dew point inside the cable” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲平行排列，鋼絲之間約有兩成空隙。水分在紡線或牽引期間隨雨水進入，也會從纏絲裂縫、索夾邊緣與吊索附近滲入，並在主纜低點聚積。白天日照加熱、夜間輻射冷卻，主纜內部空氣反覆「呼吸」，帶入潮濕空氣；當鋼絲表面溫度低於空氣露點，水氣就凝結在鋼絲上。本州四國連絡橋拆開舊橋纏絲時發現鋼絲已經生鏽，大貝爾特東橋的業主也參考了福斯公路橋的腐蝕教訓，這些經驗說明外部塗裝無法保證內部乾燥。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主纜內部露點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A main cable holds tens of thousands of parallel wires with about one-fifth of its section as voids. Water enters with rain during spinning or hauling and later seeps in through cracked wrapping, cable-band edges and around hangers, collecting at low points. Daytime sun heats the cable and night-time radiation cools it, so the air inside breathes in and out, drawing in humid air; when the wire surface falls below the air's dew point, vapour condenses on the wires. The Honshu-Shikoku authority found rust on wires when it removed the wrapping of older bridges, and the Great Belt owner drew on corrosion found on the Forth Road Bridge, showing that external paint cannot guarantee a dry interior. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dew point inside the cable” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Magnus 式露點 T_d = b·γ/(a − γ)，γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T)，a = 17.62、b = 243.12 °C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Magnus dew point T_d = b·γ/(a − γ), with γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T), a = 17.62 and b = 243.12 °C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「主纜內部露點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dew point inside the cable”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜為何從內部腐蝕
knowledge.titleEn: Why cables corrode from the inside
knowledge.text: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲平行排列，鋼絲之間約有兩成空隙。水分在紡線或牽引期間隨雨水進入，也會從纏絲裂縫、索夾邊緣與吊索附近滲入，並在主纜低點聚積。
knowledge.textEn: A main cable holds tens of thousands of parallel wires with about one-fifth of its section as voids. Water enters with rain during spinning or hauling and later seeps in through cracked wrapping, cable-band edges and around hangers, collecting at low points.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜為何從內部腐蝕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Why cables corrode from the inside" is correct?
options: 主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。
主纜由數萬根鋼絲平行排列，鋼絲之間約有兩成空隙。
只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。
optionsEn: With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside.
A main cable holds tens of thousands of parallel wires with about one-fifth of its section as voids.
Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself.
quiz.explanation: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲平行排列，鋼絲之間約有兩成空隙。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A main cable holds tens of thousands of parallel wires with about one-fifth of its section as voids. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜為何從內部腐蝕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why cables corrode from the inside: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主纜內部露點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dew point inside the cable” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Magnus 式露點 T_d = b·γ/(a − γ)，γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T)，a = 17.62、b = 243.12 °C。纜內空氣 25 °C、80% RH：γ ≈ −0.223 + 1.643 = 1.420，T_d ≈ 21.3 °C，夜間鋼絲只要降到 21 °C 以下就結露；若纜內維持 40% RH，T_d ≈ 10.5 °C，結露機會大幅降低。溫濕度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Magnus dew point T_d = b·γ/(a − γ), with γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T), a = 17.62 and b = 243.12 °C. For cable air at 25 °C and 80% RH: γ ≈ −0.223 + 1.643 = 1.420 and T_d ≈ 21.3 °C, so wires cooling below 21 °C at night collect condensation; held at 40% RH, T_d ≈ 10.5 °C and condensation becomes much rarer. Temperatures and humidities are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在主纜低點與高點各置溫濕度探頭與鋼絲表面溫度計，連續記錄數週，計算每小時露點與鋼絲溫度差，統計結露時數；同時在低點開窗檢查積水與鍍鋅狀態，確認量測推論與實況一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place humidity and temperature probes and wire-surface thermometers at cable low and high points, record continuously for several weeks, compute hourly dew point against wire temperature and count condensation hours; open an inspection window at a low point to check for standing water and zinc condition, confirming that inference matches reality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Magnus 式露點 T_d = b·γ/(a − γ)，γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T)，a = 17.62、b = 243.12 °C。纜內空氣 25 °C、80% RH：γ ≈ −0.223 + 1.643 = 1.420，T_d ≈ 21.3 °C，夜間鋼絲只要降到 21 °C 以下就結露；若纜內維持 40% RH，T_d ≈ 10.5 °C，結露機會大幅降低。溫濕度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Magnus dew point T_d = b·γ/(a − γ), with γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T), a = 17.62 and b = 243.12 °C. For cable air at 25 °C and 80% RH: γ ≈ −0.223 + 1.643 = 1.420 and T_d ≈ 21.3 °C, so wires cooling below 21 °C at night collect condensation; held at 40% RH, T_d ≈ 10.5 °C and condensation becomes much rarer. Temperatures and humidities are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜為何從內部腐蝕」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Why cables corrode from the inside", which statement holds?
options: 除濕機只要選一台夠大的家用或倉庫型機器即可。
除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。
Magnus 式露點 T_d = b·γ/(a − γ)，γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T)，a = 17.62、b = 243.12 °C。
optionsEn: Any large household or warehouse dehumidifier will do.
Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days.
Magnus dew point T_d = b·γ/(a − γ), with γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T), a = 17.62 and b = 243.12 °C.
quiz.explanation: Magnus 式露點 T_d = b·γ/(a − γ)，γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T)，a = 17.62、b = 243.12 °C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnus dew point T_d = b·γ/(a − γ), with γ = ln(RH/100) + a·T/(b + T), a = 17.62 and b = 243.12 °C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜為何從內部腐蝕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why cables corrode from the inside: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主纜內部露點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dew point inside the cable” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在主纜低點與高點各置溫濕度探頭與鋼絲表面溫度計，連續記錄數週，計算每小時露點與鋼絲溫度差，統計結露時數；同時在低點開窗檢查積水與鍍鋅狀態，確認量測推論與實況一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place humidity and temperature probes and wire-surface thermometers at cable low and high points, record continuously for several weeks, compute hourly dew point against wire temperature and count condensation hours; open an inspection window at a low point to check for standing water and zinc condition, confirming that inference matches reality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：新建懸索橋應在設計階段就把主纜除濕列為防蝕系統的一部分，並在施工期間限制雨中紡線或牽引、在擠壓前排水；既有橋梁則以溫濕度量測與開窗檢查建立現況基準，再決定是否改造。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: New suspension bridges should include cable dehumidification in the corrosion-protection design from the start, limiting spinning or hauling in rain and draining before compaction; for existing bridges, establish a baseline by humidity measurement and inspection windows before deciding on a retrofit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：主纜低點長期積水時，鍍鋅層先被消耗，接著鋼絲出現點蝕與應力腐蝕裂紋；由於外層纏絲完好，問題往往在數十年後開纜檢查才被發現，屆時斷絲與強度損失可能已需要限載或補強。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Where water sits at low points for years, zinc is consumed first and then wires pit and develop stress-corrosion cracks; because the outer wrapping looks intact, the problem is often found only at a cable opening decades later, when broken wires and strength loss may already require load limits or strengthening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 主纜為何從內部腐蝕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Why cables corrode from the inside: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主纜內部露點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dew point inside the cable” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 主纜低點長期積水時，鍍鋅層先被消耗，接著鋼絲出現點蝕與應力腐蝕裂紋；由於外層纏絲完好，問題往往在數十年後開纜檢查才被發現，屆時斷絲與強度損失可能已需要限載或補強。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Where water sits at low points for years, zinc is consumed first and then wires pit and develop stress-corrosion cracks; because the outer wrapping looks intact, the problem is often found only at a cable opening decades later, when broken wires and strength loss may already require load limits or strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本州四國連絡橋拆開舊橋纏絲時發現鋼絲已經生鏽，大貝爾特東橋的業主也參考了福斯公路橋的腐蝕教訓，這些經驗說明外部塗裝無法保證內部乾燥。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Honshu-Shikoku authority found rust on wires when it removed the wrapping of older bridges, and the Great Belt owner drew on corrosion found on the Forth Road Bridge, showing that external paint cannot guarantee a dry interior.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜為何從內部腐蝕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Why cables corrode from the inside" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
主纜低點長期積水時，鍍鋅層先被消耗，接著鋼絲出現點蝕與應力腐蝕裂紋。
只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Where water sits at low points for years, zinc is consumed first and then wires pit and develop stress-corrosion cracks.
Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself.

quiz.explanationEn: Where water sits at low points for years, zinc is consumed first and then wires pit and develop stress-corrosion cracks; because the outer wrapping looks intact, the problem is often found only at a cable opening decades later, when broken wires and strength loss may already require load limits or strengthening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 系統構成與送氣間距：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: System layout and injection spacing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「送氣與排氣流路」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Injection and exhaust path” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜除濕系統由除濕機組、風機、送氣管、送氣套筒、氣密包覆、排氣套筒與感測器組成。乾燥空氣從送氣套筒進入主纜，沿鋼絲間的空隙向兩側流動，一路吸收水分，再從一定距離外的排氣套筒排出。主纜空隙像多孔介質，流量與壓差成正比、與流動距離成反比，因此送氣與排氣的間距、送氣壓力與包覆所能承受的壓力，三者必須一起設計。大貝爾特東橋的業主說明，包覆與索夾周圍的密封就是為了讓空氣能在進氣與排氣套筒之間流動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「送氣與排氣流路」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cable dehumidification system consists of dehumidifier units, fans, supply ducts, injection sleeves, an airtight wrap, exhaust sleeves and sensors. Dry air enters the cable at an injection sleeve, flows both ways through the voids between wires picking up moisture, and leaves at exhaust sleeves some distance away. The cable voids behave like a porous medium, with flow proportional to pressure difference and inversely proportional to flow distance, so sleeve spacing, supply pressure and the pressure the wrap can hold must be designed together. The Great Belt owner explains that the wrapping and the seals around the clamps exist precisely so that air can flow between the inlet and exhaust sleeves. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Injection and exhaust path” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 Darcy 式估算 Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate with Darcy's law Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「送氣與排氣流路」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Injection and exhaust path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 系統構成與送氣間距
knowledge.text: 主纜除濕系統由除濕機組、風機、送氣管、送氣套筒、氣密包覆、排氣套筒與感測器組成。乾燥空氣從送氣套筒進入主纜，沿鋼絲間的空隙向兩側流動，一路吸收水分，再從一定距離外的排氣套筒排出。
knowledge.textEn: A cable dehumidification system consists of dehumidifier units, fans, supply ducts, injection sleeves, an airtight wrap, exhaust sleeves and sensors. Dry air enters the cable at an injection sleeve, flows both ways through the voids between wires picking up moisture, and leaves at exhaust sleeves some distance away.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「系統構成與送氣間距」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System layout and injection spacing" is correct?
options: 只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。
包覆材料越厚越好，索夾處的細部影響不大。
主纜除濕系統由除濕機組、風機、送氣管、送氣套筒、氣密包覆、排氣套筒與感測器組成。
optionsEn: Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself.
The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter.
A cable dehumidification system consists of dehumidifier units, fans, supply ducts, injection sleeves, an airtight wrap, exhaust sleeves and sensors.
quiz.explanation: 主纜除濕系統由除濕機組、風機、送氣管、送氣套筒、氣密包覆、排氣套筒與感測器組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A cable dehumidification system consists of dehumidifier units, fans, supply ducts, injection sleeves, an airtight wrap, exhaust sleeves and sensors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 系統構成與送氣間距：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System layout and injection spacing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「送氣與排氣流路」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Injection and exhaust path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 Darcy 式估算 Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L)。取等效滲透率 k = 1×10⁻⁹ m²、流動斷面 A = 0.6 m²、壓差 Δp = 2,000 Pa、空氣黏滯係數 μ = 1.8×10⁻⁵ Pa·s：流動距離 L = 150 m 時 Q ≈ 4.4×10⁻⁴ m³/s（約 27 L/min）；L 增為 300 m，Q 減半為約 13 L/min。k 與壓差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate with Darcy's law Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L). With equivalent permeability k = 1×10⁻⁹ m², flow section A = 0.6 m², pressure difference Δp = 2,000 Pa and air viscosity μ = 1.8×10⁻⁵ Pa·s: a flow length L = 150 m gives Q ≈ 4.4×10⁻⁴ m³/s (about 27 L/min); doubling L to 300 m halves Q to about 13 L/min. k and the pressure difference are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性區段以不同送氣壓力量測進、排氣口流量，反算等效滲透率，確認設計間距下的流量足以在目標時間內乾燥；若不同區段的滲透率差異很大，調整送氣分配或增設套筒。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On representative sections measure inlet and exhaust flow at several supply pressures, back-calculate equivalent permeability and confirm that flow at the design spacing dries the section in the target time; where permeability varies widely between sections, rebalance supply or add sleeves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 Darcy 式估算 Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L)。取等效滲透率 k = 1×10⁻⁹ m²、流動斷面 A = 0.6 m²、壓差 Δp = 2,000 Pa、空氣黏滯係數 μ = 1.8×10⁻⁵ Pa·s：流動距離 L = 150 m 時 Q ≈ 4.4×10⁻⁴ m³/s（約 27 L/min）；L 增為 300 m，Q 減半為約 13 L/min。k 與壓差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate with Darcy's law Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L). With equivalent permeability k = 1×10⁻⁹ m², flow section A = 0.6 m², pressure difference Δp = 2,000 Pa and air viscosity μ = 1.8×10⁻⁵ Pa·s: a flow length L = 150 m gives Q ≈ 4.4×10⁻⁴ m³/s (about 27 L/min); doubling L to 300 m halves Q to about 13 L/min. k and the pressure difference are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「系統構成與送氣間距」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System layout and injection spacing", which statement holds?
options: 以 Darcy 式估算 Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L)。
除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。
只要相對濕度低於目標，主纜就不可能結露。
optionsEn: Estimate with Darcy's law Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L).
A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather.
If relative humidity is below target, the cable cannot have condensation.
quiz.explanation: 以 Darcy 式估算 Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate with Darcy's law Q = k·A·Δp/(μ·L). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統構成與送氣間距：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: System layout and injection spacing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「送氣與排氣流路」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Injection and exhaust path” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性區段以不同送氣壓力量測進、排氣口流量，反算等效滲透率，確認設計間距下的流量足以在目標時間內乾燥；若不同區段的滲透率差異很大，調整送氣分配或增設套筒。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On representative sections measure inlet and exhaust flow at several supply pressures, back-calculate equivalent permeability and confirm that flow at the design spacing dries the section in the target time; where permeability varies widely between sections, rebalance supply or add sleeves. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：系統設計報告應列出每個區段的長度、預估滲透率、設計壓力與流量、包覆容許壓力與排氣目標，並在試運轉時以實測值更新；任何區段流量偏低都要在交接前處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The system design report should list each section's length, estimated permeability, design pressure and flow, wrap pressure limit and exhaust target, updated with measured values at commissioning; any section with low flow must be resolved before handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：送氣間距過大或壓力不足，遠離送氣口的區段幾乎沒有流量，排氣口讀值卻可能因為近端空氣短路而看似乾燥；壓力過高則超過包覆與索夾密封的承受能力，造成鼓起、剝離與大量洩漏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spacing too long or pressure too low leaves sections far from the inlet with almost no flow, while exhaust readings may still look dry because air short-circuits near the inlet; pressure too high exceeds what the wrap and band seals can hold, causing bulging, debonding and heavy leakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: On representative sections measure inlet and exhaust flow at several supply pressures, back-calculate equivalent permeability and confirm that flow at the design spacing dries the section in the target time; where permeability varies widely between sections, rebalance supply or add sleeves.

knowledge.text: 系統設計報告應列出每個區段的長度、預估滲透率、設計壓力與流量、包覆容許壓力與排氣目標，並在試運轉時以實測值更新；任何區段流量偏低都要在交接前處理。

除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

On representative sections measure inlet and exhaust flow at several supply pressures, back-calculate equivalent permeability and confirm that flow at the design spacing dries the section in the target time.
Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance.

steps.title: 系統構成與送氣間距：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System layout and injection spacing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「送氣與排氣流路」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Injection and exhaust path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 送氣間距過大或壓力不足，遠離送氣口的區段幾乎沒有流量，排氣口讀值卻可能因為近端空氣短路而看似乾燥；壓力過高則超過包覆與索夾密封的承受能力，造成鼓起、剝離與大量洩漏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Spacing too long or pressure too low leaves sections far from the inlet with almost no flow, while exhaust readings may still look dry because air short-circuits near the inlet; pressure too high exceeds what the wrap and band seals can hold, causing bulging, debonding and heavy leakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大貝爾特東橋的業主說明，包覆與索夾周圍的密封就是為了讓空氣能在進氣與排氣套筒之間流動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Great Belt owner explains that the wrapping and the seals around the clamps exist precisely so that air can flow between the inlet and exhaust sleeves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 送氣間距過大或壓力不足，遠離送氣口的區段幾乎沒有流量，排氣口讀值卻可能因為近端空氣短路而看似乾燥；壓力過高則超過包覆與索夾密封的承受能力，造成鼓起、剝離與大量洩漏。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統構成與送氣間距」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System layout and injection spacing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
包覆材料越厚越好，索夾處的細部影響不大。
送氣間距過大或壓力不足，遠離送氣口的區段幾乎沒有流量，排氣口讀值卻可能因為近端空氣短路而看似乾燥。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter.
Spacing too long or pressure too low leaves sections far from the inlet with almost no flow, while exhaust readings may still look dry because air short-circuits near the inlet.
quiz.explanation: 送氣間距過大或壓力不足，遠離送氣口的區段幾乎沒有流量，排氣口讀值卻可能因為近端空氣短路而看似乾燥；壓力過高則超過包覆與索夾密封的承受能力，造成鼓起、剝離與大量洩漏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Spacing too long or pressure too low leaves sections far from the inlet with almost no flow, while exhaust readings may still look dry because air short-circuits near the inlet; pressure too high exceeds what the wrap and band seals can hold, causing bulging, debonding and heavy leakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「氣密包覆與索夾密封細部」與「除濕機組容量與預冷設備」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Airtight wrapping and cable-band seal details" and "Dehumidifier capacity and pre-coolers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 氣密包覆與索夾密封細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Airtight wrapping and cable-band seal details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「彈性體包覆與索夾密封」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastomeric wrap and band seals” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 傳統的鍍鋅軟鋼纏絲加防蝕膏與塗裝並不氣密，乾燥空氣會從纏絲縫隙大量逸出。除濕系統因此改用強化彈性體帶材包覆，以重疊纏繞並加熱熔合成連續的氣密外殼；大貝爾特東橋即以 Cableguard 強化彈性體包覆主纜，並在索夾周圍密封。系統的弱點通常不在包覆本身，而在不連續處：索夾兩端、吊索穿出處、送排氣套筒與檢查開口。這些位置要用專用的密封件與填充材，並能承受溫度循環與主纜的微小變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「彈性體包覆與索夾密封」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traditional soft galvanised wrapping wire with paste and paint is not airtight, and dry air escapes in quantity through its gaps. Dehumidification systems therefore use reinforced elastomeric tape wound with overlaps and heat-fused into a continuous airtight skin; the Great Belt East Bridge was wrapped with Cableguard reinforced elastomer and sealed around its cable clamps. The weak points are usually not the wrap itself but the discontinuities: both ends of each band, hanger exits, injection and exhaust sleeves and inspection openings. These need dedicated seals and fillers that tolerate temperature cycles and small cable movements. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Elastomeric wrap and band seals” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：洩漏口流量 Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Leak flow Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「包覆材料越厚越好，索夾處的細部影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「彈性體包覆與索夾密封」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Elastomeric wrap and band seals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 氣密包覆與索夾密封細部
knowledge.titleEn: Airtight wrapping and cable-band seal details
knowledge.text: 傳統的鍍鋅軟鋼纏絲加防蝕膏與塗裝並不氣密，乾燥空氣會從纏絲縫隙大量逸出。除濕系統因此改用強化彈性體帶材包覆，以重疊纏繞並加熱熔合成連續的氣密外殼；大貝爾特東橋即以 Cableguard 強化彈性體包覆主纜，並在索夾周圍密封。
knowledge.textEn: Traditional soft galvanised wrapping wire with paste and paint is not airtight, and dry air escapes in quantity through its gaps. Dehumidification systems therefore use reinforced elastomeric tape wound with overlaps and heat-fused into a continuous airtight skin; the Great Belt East Bridge was wrapped with Cableguard reinforced elastomer and sealed around its cable clamps.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：包覆材料越厚越好，索夾處的細部影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氣密包覆與索夾密封細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Airtight wrapping and cable-band seal details" is correct?
options: 傳統的鍍鋅軟鋼纏絲加防蝕膏與塗裝並不氣密，乾燥空氣會從纏絲縫隙大量逸出。
包覆材料越厚越好，索夾處的細部影響不大。
除濕機只要選一台夠大的家用或倉庫型機器即可。
optionsEn: Traditional soft galvanised wrapping wire with paste and paint is not airtight, and dry air escapes in quantity through its gaps.
The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter.
Any large household or warehouse dehumidifier will do.
quiz.explanation: 傳統的鍍鋅軟鋼纏絲加防蝕膏與塗裝並不氣密，乾燥空氣會從纏絲縫隙大量逸出。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Traditional soft galvanised wrapping wire with paste and paint is not airtight, and dry air escapes in quantity through its gaps. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氣密包覆與索夾密封細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Airtight wrapping and cable-band seal details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性體包覆與索夾密封」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastomeric wrap and band seals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：洩漏口流量 Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ)。取 C_d = 0.6、洩漏面積 1 cm²（1×10⁻⁴ m²）、壓差 2,000 Pa、空氣密度 1.2 kg/m³：流速 √(2×2,000/1.2) ≈ 57.7 m/s，Q ≈ 0.6×10⁻⁴×57.7 ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ m³/s（約 208 L/min），比上一單元整段主纜約 27 L/min 的流量大七倍以上。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Leak flow Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ). With C_d = 0.6, a 1 cm² leak (1×10⁻⁴ m²), 2,000 Pa and air density 1.2 kg/m³: velocity √(2×2,000/1.2) ≈ 57.7 m/s and Q ≈ 0.6×10⁻⁴×57.7 ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ m³/s (about 208 L/min), more than seven times the roughly 27 L/min flowing through a whole cable section in the previous unit. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：包覆熔合時記錄環境溫度、濕度、熔合溫度與搭接寬度，抽樣做剝離試驗；每區段完成後封閉做壓力保持試驗，以肥皂水或超音波檢漏器沿索夾邊緣與套筒逐一檢查，修補後再試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During wrap fusion log ambient temperature, humidity, fusion temperature and lap width, with sample peel tests; after each section, seal it for a pressure-hold test and check band edges and sleeves one by one with soapy water or an ultrasonic leak detector, retesting after repair.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 洩漏口流量 Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ)。取 C_d = 0.6、洩漏面積 1 cm²（1×10⁻⁴ m²）、壓差 2,000 Pa、空氣密度 1.2 kg/m³：流速 √(2×2,000/1.2) ≈ 57.7 m/s，Q ≈ 0.6×10⁻⁴×57.7 ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ m³/s（約 208 L/min），比上一單元整段主纜約 27 L/min 的流量大七倍以上。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Leak flow Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ). With C_d = 0.6, a 1 cm² leak (1×10⁻⁴ m²), 2,000 Pa and air density 1.2 kg/m³: velocity √(2×2,000/1.2) ≈ 57.7 m/s and Q ≈ 0.6×10⁻⁴×57.7 ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ m³/s (about 208 L/min), more than seven times the roughly 27 L/min flowing through a whole cable section in the previous unit. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氣密包覆與索夾密封細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Airtight wrapping and cable-band seal details", which statement holds?
options: 除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。
洩漏口流量 Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ)。
裝了除濕系統之後，主纜就不需要再開纜檢查。
optionsEn: Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days.
Leak flow Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ).
Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again.
quiz.explanation: 洩漏口流量 Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Leak flow Q = C_d·A·√(2Δp/ρ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氣密包覆與索夾密封細部：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 包覆熔合時記錄環境溫度、濕度、熔合溫度與搭接寬度，抽樣做剝離試驗；每區段完成後封閉做壓力保持試驗，以肥皂水或超音波檢漏器沿索夾邊緣與套筒逐一檢查，修補後再試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：一個未密封的索夾端或破損的搭接，就能讓大部分乾燥空氣在近端逸出，下游區段持續潮濕；包覆在低溫或潮濕時熔合，日後在溫度循環下沿搭接開裂，雨水反而從裂縫進入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 一個未密封的索夾端或破損的搭接，就能讓大部分乾燥空氣在近端逸出，下游區段持續潮濕；包覆在低溫或潮濕時熔合，日後在溫度循環下沿搭接開裂，雨水反而從裂縫進入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 除濕機組容量與預冷設備：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Dehumidifier capacity and pre-coolers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「除濕機與預冷」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dehumidifier and pre-cooler” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主纜除濕常用吸附式除濕機：空氣通過含吸濕劑的轉輪，水氣被吸附，轉輪另一側以加熱空氣再生，把水分排到外面。吸附式在低溫下仍能產生很低露點的空氣，適合送入主纜。本州四國連絡橋在夏季高濕時加裝預冷設備，先以冷卻盤管把外氣降溫凝結出一部分水，再送入除濕機，減輕轉輪負荷。機組容量必須依最不利季節的外氣條件、總送氣量與目標送氣濕度決定，並保留備援。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「除濕機與預冷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cable systems commonly use desiccant dehumidifiers: air passes through a rotor carrying a desiccant that adsorbs vapour, while the other side of the rotor is regenerated with heated air that carries the moisture outside. Desiccant units deliver very low dew-point air even at low temperatures, which suits cable injection. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges added pre-coolers for humid summers: cooling coils lower outdoor air temperature and condense part of its water before it reaches the dehumidifier, easing the load on the rotor. Unit capacity must be set from outdoor air in the worst season, total supply flow and target supply humidity, with redundancy. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dehumidifier and pre-cooler” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：水氣密度：30 °C、80% RH 約 24.2 g/m³；25 °C、20% RH 約 4.6 g/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vapour density: about 24.2 g/m³ at 30 °C and 80% RH, about 4.6 g/m³ at 25 °C and 20% RH.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「除濕機只要選一台夠大的家用或倉庫型機器即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any large household or warehouse dehumidifier will do." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「除濕機與預冷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dehumidifier and pre-cooler”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 主纜除濕常用吸附式除濕機：空氣通過含吸濕劑的轉輪，水氣被吸附，轉輪另一側以加熱空氣再生，把水分排到外面。吸附式在低溫下仍能產生很低露點的空氣，適合送入主纜。
knowledge.textEn: Cable systems commonly use desiccant dehumidifiers: air passes through a rotor carrying a desiccant that adsorbs vapour, while the other side of the rotor is regenerated with heated air that carries the moisture outside. Desiccant units deliver very low dew-point air even at low temperatures, which suits cable injection.

knowledge.text: 誤解：除濕機只要選一台夠大的家用或倉庫型機器即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any large household or warehouse dehumidifier will do. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「除濕機組容量與預冷設備」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 除濕機組容量與預冷設備：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dehumidifier capacity and pre-coolers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「除濕機與預冷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dehumidifier and pre-cooler” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：水氣密度：30 °C、80% RH 約 24.2 g/m³；25 °C、20% RH 約 4.6 g/m³。每立方公尺需除去約 19.6 g，送氣 10 m³/min 時約 11.8 kg/h。若先預冷到 15 °C 飽和（約 12.8 g/m³），凝結去除約 11.4 g/m³，吸附轉輪只需處理約 8.2 g/m³，即原負荷的約 42%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vapour density: about 24.2 g/m³ at 30 °C and 80% RH, about 4.6 g/m³ at 25 °C and 20% RH. Each cubic metre must lose about 19.6 g, about 11.8 kg/h at 10 m³/min. Pre-cooling to saturation at 15 °C (about 12.8 g/m³) condenses about 11.4 g/m³, leaving the desiccant rotor only about 8.2 g/m³, about 42% of the original load. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠驗收時量測機組在多種進氣溫濕度下的出氣露點與流量，確認符合規格曲線；現場以進、出口溫濕度與流量計算實際除濕量，與設計值比較，並記錄再生溫度與轉輪轉速，作為日後性能退化的基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At factory acceptance measure outlet dew point and flow over a range of inlet conditions against the specification curve; on site compute actual moisture removal from inlet and outlet humidity and flow, compare with design, and record regeneration temperature and rotor speed as the baseline for later degradation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Pre-cooling to saturation at 15 °C (about 12.8 g/m³) condenses about 11.4 g/m³, leaving the desiccant rotor only about 8.2 g/m³, about 42% of the original load. Values are teaching assumptions.
