quiz.explanation: 水氣密度：30 °C、80% RH 約 24.2 g/m³；25 °C、20% RH 約 4.6 g/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Vapour density: about 24.2 g/m³ at 30 °C and 80% RH, about 4.6 g/m³ at 25 °C and 20% RH. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 除濕機組容量與預冷設備：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dehumidifier capacity and pre-coolers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「除濕機與預冷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dehumidifier and pre-cooler” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 工廠驗收時量測機組在多種進氣溫濕度下的出氣露點與流量，確認符合規格曲線；現場以進、出口溫濕度與流量計算實際除濕量，與設計值比較，並記錄再生溫度與轉輪轉速，作為日後性能退化的基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At factory acceptance measure outlet dew point and flow over a range of inlet conditions against the specification curve; on site compute actual moisture removal from inlet and outlet humidity and flow, compare with design, and record regeneration temperature and rotor speed as the baseline for later degradation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規範應以設計外氣條件、送氣露點、流量、備援數量、遠端監控介面與維修可及性定義機組；機房位置要考慮維修人員的安全通道與設備吊運路線，並保留更換整台機組的空間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Define units in the procurement specification by design outdoor conditions, supply dew point, flow, redundancy, remote-monitoring interface and maintainability; locate plant rooms with safe access for maintenance staff and a lifting route, leaving space to replace a complete unit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以年平均氣候選機，夏季高濕時送氣濕度超標，纜內濕度回升；機組單點故障而無備援，維修期間整段主纜停止送氣；預冷盤管凝結水排放不良則可能結冰或回流進送氣管。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing units on annual-average climate lets supply humidity exceed target in humid summers so cable humidity climbs; a single unit failing without redundancy stops injection to a whole section during repair; poor condensate drainage from pre-cooler coils can freeze or run back into the supply duct. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 工廠驗收時量測機組在多種進氣溫濕度下的出氣露點與流量，確認符合規格曲線；現場以進、出口溫濕度與流量計算實際除濕量，與設計值比較，並記錄再生溫度與轉輪轉速，作為日後性能退化的基準。
knowledge.textEn: At factory acceptance measure outlet dew point and flow over a range of inlet conditions against the specification curve; on site compute actual moisture removal from inlet and outlet humidity and flow, compare with design, and record regeneration temperature and rotor speed as the baseline for later degradation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購規範應以設計外氣條件、送氣露點、流量、備援數量、遠端監控介面與維修可及性定義機組；機房位置要考慮維修人員的安全通道與設備吊運路線，並保留更換整台機組的空間。
knowledge.textEn: Define units in the procurement specification by design outdoor conditions, supply dew point, flow, redundancy, remote-monitoring interface and maintainability; locate plant rooms with safe access for maintenance staff and a lifting route, leaving space to replace a complete unit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「除濕機組容量與預冷設備」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dehumidifier capacity and pre-coolers"?
options: 工廠驗收時量測機組在多種進氣溫濕度下的出氣露點與流量，確認符合規格曲線。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。
optionsEn: At factory acceptance measure outlet dew point and flow over a range of inlet conditions against the specification curve.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside.
quiz.explanation: 工廠驗收時量測機組在多種進氣溫濕度下的出氣露點與流量，確認符合規格曲線；現場以進、出口溫濕度與流量計算實際除濕量，與設計值比較，並記錄再生溫度與轉輪轉速，作為日後性能退化的基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At factory acceptance measure outlet dew point and flow over a range of inlet conditions against the specification curve; on site compute actual moisture removal from inlet and outlet humidity and flow, compare with design, and record regeneration temperature and rotor speed as the baseline for later degradation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 除濕機組容量與預冷設備：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dehumidifier capacity and pre-coolers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「除濕機與預冷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dehumidifier and pre-cooler” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以年平均氣候選機，夏季高濕時送氣濕度超標，纜內濕度回升；機組單點故障而無備援，維修期間整段主纜停止送氣；預冷盤管凝結水排放不良則可能結冰或回流進送氣管。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing units on annual-average climate lets supply humidity exceed target in humid summers so cable humidity climbs; a single unit failing without redundancy stops injection to a whole section during repair; poor condensate drainage from pre-cooler coils can freeze or run back into the supply duct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：機組容量必須依最不利季節的外氣條件、總送氣量與目標送氣濕度決定，並保留備援。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unit capacity must be set from outdoor air in the worst season, total supply flow and target supply humidity, with redundancy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「除濕機只要選一台夠大的家用或倉庫型機器即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any large household or warehouse dehumidifier will do." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以年平均氣候選機，夏季高濕時送氣濕度超標，纜內濕度回升；機組單點故障而無備援，維修期間整段主纜停止送氣；預冷盤管凝結水排放不良則可能結冰或回流進送氣管。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing units on annual-average climate lets supply humidity exceed target in humid summers so cable humidity climbs; a single unit failing without redundancy stops injection to a whole section during repair; poor condensate drainage from pre-cooler coils can freeze or run back into the supply duct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「除濕機組容量與預冷設備」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dehumidifier capacity and pre-coolers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若以年平均氣候選機，夏季高濕時送氣濕度超標，纜內濕度回升；機組單點故障而無備援，維修期間整段主纜停止送氣；預冷盤管凝結水排放不良則可能結冰或回流進送氣管。
除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Sizing units on annual-average climate lets supply humidity exceed target in humid summers so cable humidity climbs.
A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather.
quiz.explanation: 若以年平均氣候選機，夏季高濕時送氣濕度超標，纜內濕度回升；機組單點故障而無備援，維修期間整段主纜停止送氣；預冷盤管凝結水排放不良則可能結冰或回流進送氣管。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing units on annual-average climate lets supply humidity exceed target in humid summers so cable humidity climbs; a single unit failing without redundancy stops injection to a whole section during repair; poor condensate drainage from pre-cooler coils can freeze or run back into the supply duct. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「既有主纜的除濕改造施工」與「啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable" and "Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 既有主纜的除濕改造施工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「既有主纜改造順序」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Retrofit sequence on a live cable” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大貝爾特東橋的主纜除濕系統於 2014 年開始安裝、2015 年 9 月完成，是在橋梁持續通車下進行的改造。典型流程是：清理既有纏絲與塗裝表面、修補局部損傷，在索夾兩端與吊索處安裝密封件，在選定位置安裝送氣與排氣套筒，然後以彈性體帶材沿主纜纏繞並熱熔，最後連接送氣管、機組與感測器。作業沿主纜在臨時平台或纜上移動式設備上進行，進度受風、雨與溫度限制，因為熔合需要乾燥表面與足夠溫度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「既有主纜改造順序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Great Belt East Bridge cable dehumidification system was installed from 2014 and completed in September 2015 while the bridge stayed open. A typical sequence is to clean the existing wrapping and paint, repair local damage, fit seals at both ends of each band and at hanger exits, install injection and exhaust sleeves at chosen positions, wind and heat-fuse elastomeric tape along the cable, then connect ducts, units and sensors. Work proceeds along the cable from temporary platforms or travelling equipment, and progress is limited by wind, rain and temperature, because fusion needs a dry surface and enough warmth. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Retrofit sequence on a live cable” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩條各約 3 km 的主纜共 6,000 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two cables of about 3 km each make 6,000 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「既有主纜改造順序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Retrofit sequence on a live cable”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 既有主纜的除濕改造施工
knowledge.titleEn: Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable
knowledge.text: 大貝爾特東橋的主纜除濕系統於 2014 年開始安裝、2015 年 9 月完成，是在橋梁持續通車下進行的改造。典型流程是：清理既有纏絲與塗裝表面、修補局部損傷，在索夾兩端與吊索處安裝密封件，在選定位置安裝送氣與排氣套筒，然後以彈性體帶材沿主纜纏繞並熱熔，最後連接送氣管、機組與感測器。
knowledge.textEn: The Great Belt East Bridge cable dehumidification system was installed from 2014 and completed in September 2015 while the bridge stayed open. A typical sequence is to clean the existing wrapping and paint, repair local damage, fit seals at both ends of each band and at hanger exits, install injection and exhaust sleeves at chosen positions, wind and heat-fuse elastomeric tape along the cable, then connect ducts, units and sensors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「既有主纜的除濕改造施工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable" is correct?
options: 除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。
除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。
大貝爾特東橋的主纜除濕系統於 2014 年開始安裝、2015 年 9 月完成，是在橋梁持續通車下進行的改造。
optionsEn: A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather.
Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days.
The Great Belt East Bridge cable dehumidification system was installed from 2014 and completed in September 2015 while the bridge stayed open.
quiz.explanation: 大貝爾特東橋的主纜除濕系統於 2014 年開始安裝、2015 年 9 月完成，是在橋梁持續通車下進行的改造。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Great Belt East Bridge cable dehumidification system was installed from 2014 and completed in September 2015 while the bridge stayed open. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 既有主纜的除濕改造施工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「既有主纜改造順序」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Retrofit sequence on a live cable” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩條各約 3 km 的主纜共 6,000 m。若每組人員每日可完成 40 m 包覆，需 6,000/40 = 150 組日；4 組同時作業約 37.5 個可施工日。若只有 50% 的日子符合熔合的天候條件，約需 75 個日曆天，尚未計入套筒與索夾密封。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two cables of about 3 km each make 6,000 m. At 40 m of wrapping per crew per day, the job needs 6,000/40 = 150 crew-days; with 4 crews working together, about 37.5 workable days. If only 50% of days meet the weather conditions for fusion, it takes about 75 calendar days, before sleeves and band seals are added. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每日記錄施工區段、天候、熔合參數與完成長度，對未達條件的日子停止熔合；每完成一個送排氣區段就做氣密試驗，合格後才能進入下一段；纜上設備的荷重、錨固與防墜措施由臨時工程設計者核可。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log section, weather, fusion parameters and length completed each day, stopping fusion when conditions are not met; test each injection–exhaust section for airtightness before moving on; have the temporary-works designer approve loads, anchorage and fall protection of on-cable equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩條各約 3 km 的主纜共 6,000 m。若每組人員每日可完成 40 m 包覆，需 6,000/40 = 150 組日；4 組同時作業約 37.5 個可施工日。若只有 50% 的日子符合熔合的天候條件，約需 75 個日曆天，尚未計入套筒與索夾密封。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Two cables of about 3 km each make 6,000 m. At 40 m of wrapping per crew per day, the job needs 6,000/40 = 150 crew-days; with 4 crews working together, about 37.5 workable days. If only 50% of days meet the weather conditions for fusion, it takes about 75 calendar days, before sleeves and band seals are added. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「既有主纜的除濕改造施工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable", which statement holds?
options: 兩條各約 3 km 的主纜共 6,000 m。
裝了除濕系統之後，主纜就不需要再開纜檢查。
主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。
optionsEn: Two cables of about 3 km each make 6,000 m.
Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again.
Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money.
quiz.explanation: 兩條各約 3 km 的主纜共 6,000 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Two cables of about 3 km each make 6,000 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 既有主纜的除濕改造施工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有主纜改造順序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Retrofit sequence on a live cable” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每日記錄施工區段、天候、熔合參數與完成長度，對未達條件的日子停止熔合；每完成一個送排氣區段就做氣密試驗，合格後才能進入下一段；纜上設備的荷重、錨固與防墜措施由臨時工程設計者核可。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log section, weather, fusion parameters and length completed each day, stopping fusion when conditions are not met; test each injection–exhaust section for airtightness before moving on; have the temporary-works designer approve loads, anchorage and fall protection of on-cable equipment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改造合約應把天候限制、熔合參數、逐段氣密試驗與纜上作業安全列為停留點，並要求承包商提交每日紀錄；交通管制與高空作業許可由業主統一協調，任何設備附掛在主纜上都需要結構工程師核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The retrofit contract should make weather limits, fusion parameters, section-by-section airtightness tests and safety of work on the cable hold points, with daily records from the contractor; the owner coordinates traffic management and work-at-height permits, and anything attached to the cable needs the structural engineer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為趕進度在潮濕或低溫天候熔合，搭接黏結不良，系統啟動後才發現大量洩漏；清理不完全時，既有塗料或防蝕膏夾在包覆下方，影響黏結並可能積水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fusing in damp or cold weather to catch up leaves weak laps that leak heavily once the system starts; incomplete cleaning traps old paint or paste under the wrap, spoiling adhesion and possibly holding water; poorly secured on-cable equipment can also scratch the wrap or wrapping wire. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每日記錄施工區段、天候、熔合參數與完成長度，對未達條件的日子停止熔合；每完成一個送排氣區段就做氣密試驗，合格後才能進入下一段；纜上設備的荷重、錨固與防墜措施由臨時工程設計者核可。
knowledge.textEn: Log section, weather, fusion parameters and length completed each day, stopping fusion when conditions are not met; test each injection–exhaust section for airtightness before moving on; have the temporary-works designer approve loads, anchorage and fall protection of on-cable equipment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 改造合約應把天候限制、熔合參數、逐段氣密試驗與纜上作業安全列為停留點，並要求承包商提交每日紀錄；交通管制與高空作業許可由業主統一協調，任何設備附掛在主纜上都需要結構工程師核可。
knowledge.textEn: The retrofit contract should make weather limits, fusion parameters, section-by-section airtightness tests and safety of work on the cable hold points, with daily records from the contractor; the owner coordinates traffic management and work-at-height permits, and anything attached to the cable needs the structural engineer's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「既有主纜的除濕改造施工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每日記錄施工區段、天候、熔合參數與完成長度，對未達條件的日子停止熔合。
只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Log section, weather, fusion parameters and length completed each day, stopping fusion when conditions are not met.
Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself.
quiz.explanation: 每日記錄施工區段、天候、熔合參數與完成長度，對未達條件的日子停止熔合；每完成一個送排氣區段就做氣密試驗，合格後才能進入下一段；纜上設備的荷重、錨固與防墜措施由臨時工程設計者核可。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log section, weather, fusion parameters and length completed each day, stopping fusion when conditions are not met; test each injection–exhaust section for airtightness before moving on; have the temporary-works designer approve loads, anchorage and fall protection of on-cable equipment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 既有主纜的除濕改造施工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有主纜改造順序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Retrofit sequence on a live cable” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為趕進度在潮濕或低溫天候熔合，搭接黏結不良，系統啟動後才發現大量洩漏；清理不完全時，既有塗料或防蝕膏夾在包覆下方，影響黏結並可能積水。纜上設備若固定不當，也可能刮傷包覆或纏絲。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fusing in damp or cold weather to catch up leaves weak laps that leak heavily once the system starts; incomplete cleaning traps old paint or paste under the wrap, spoiling adhesion and possibly holding water; poorly secured on-cable equipment can also scratch the wrap or wrapping wire. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：作業沿主纜在臨時平台或纜上移動式設備上進行，進度受風、雨與溫度限制，因為熔合需要乾燥表面與足夠溫度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Work proceeds along the cable from temporary platforms or travelling equipment, and progress is limited by wind, rain and temperature, because fusion needs a dry surface and enough warmth.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為趕進度在潮濕或低溫天候熔合，搭接黏結不良，系統啟動後才發現大量洩漏；清理不完全時，既有塗料或防蝕膏夾在包覆下方，影響黏結並可能積水。纜上設備若固定不當，也可能刮傷包覆或纏絲。
knowledge.textEn: Fusing in damp or cold weather to catch up leaves weak laps that leak heavily once the system starts; incomplete cleaning traps old paint or paste under the wrap, spoiling adhesion and possibly holding water; poorly secured on-cable equipment can also scratch the wrap or wrapping wire.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「既有主纜的除濕改造施工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Retrofitting dehumidification to an existing cable" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。
為趕進度在潮濕或低溫天候熔合，搭接黏結不良，系統啟動後才發現大量洩漏；清理不完全時，既有塗料或防蝕膏夾在包覆下方，影響黏結並可能積水。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days.
Fusing in damp or cold weather to catch up leaves weak laps that leak heavily once the system starts.
quiz.explanation: 為趕進度在潮濕或低溫天候熔合，搭接黏結不良，系統啟動後才發現大量洩漏；清理不完全時，既有塗料或防蝕膏夾在包覆下方，影響黏結並可能積水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fusing in damp or cold weather to catch up leaves weak laps that leak heavily once the system starts; incomplete cleaning traps old paint or paste under the wrap, spoiling adhesion and possibly holding water; poorly secured on-cable equipment can also scratch the wrap or wrapping wire. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「啟動乾燥曲線」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Start-up dry-out curve” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 系統啟動時，主纜內可能有多年累積的水分，排氣口的相對濕度一開始接近飽和，隨著殘留水分被帶走而逐漸下降，最後趨近由送氣濕度與持續滲入量決定的穩定值。下降曲線通常近似指數衰減，時間常數取決於殘留水量、送氣流量與水分從鋼絲間隙蒸發的速度。本州四國連絡橋以 40% RH 為管理目標，比會發生腐蝕的約 60% 留有餘裕；調試時就是看排氣濕度何時、能否穩定落在目標以下。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「啟動乾燥曲線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At start-up the cable may hold years of accumulated moisture, so exhaust relative humidity begins near saturation, falls as trapped water is carried away and finally approaches a steady value set by supply humidity and continuing ingress. The decline is usually close to exponential, with a time constant set by the amount of trapped water, supply flow and how fast water evaporates from the wire interstices. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges manage to 40% RH, a margin below the roughly 60% at which corrosion occurs; commissioning watches when, and whether, exhaust humidity settles below that target. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Start-up dry-out curve” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「啟動乾燥曲線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Start-up dry-out curve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減
knowledge.titleEn: Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay
knowledge.text: 系統啟動時，主纜內可能有多年累積的水分，排氣口的相對濕度一開始接近飽和，隨著殘留水分被帶走而逐漸下降，最後趨近由送氣濕度與持續滲入量決定的穩定值。下降曲線通常近似指數衰減，時間常數取決於殘留水量、送氣流量與水分從鋼絲間隙蒸發的速度。
knowledge.textEn: At start-up the cable may hold years of accumulated moisture, so exhaust relative humidity begins near saturation, falls as trapped water is carried away and finally approaches a steady value set by supply humidity and continuing ingress. The decline is usually close to exponential, with a time constant set by the amount of trapped water, supply flow and how fast water evaporates from the wire interstices.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay" is correct?
options: 系統啟動時，主纜內可能有多年累積的水分，排氣口的相對濕度一開始接近飽和，隨著殘留水分被帶走而逐漸下降，最後趨近由送氣濕度與持續滲入量決定的穩定值。
除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。
只要相對濕度低於目標，主纜就不可能結露。
optionsEn: At start-up the cable may hold years of accumulated moisture, so exhaust relative humidity begins near saturation, falls as trapped water is carried away and finally approaches a steady value set by supply humidity and continuing ingress.
Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days.
If relative humidity is below target, the cable cannot have condensation.
quiz.explanation: 系統啟動時，主纜內可能有多年累積的水分，排氣口的相對濕度一開始接近飽和，隨著殘留水分被帶走而逐漸下降，最後趨近由送氣濕度與持續滲入量決定的穩定值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At start-up the cable may hold years of accumulated moisture, so exhaust relative humidity begins near saturation, falls as trapped water is carried away and finally approaches a steady value set by supply humidity and continuing ingress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「啟動乾燥曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Start-up dry-out curve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ)。取 RH₀ = 90%、RH_∞ = 30%、τ = 20 天：降到 40% 所需 t = τ·ln[(90 − 30)/(40 − 30)] = 20×ln 6 ≈ 35.8 天。若某區段 τ 實測為 40 天，則需約 72 天；若 RH_∞ 高於 40%，曲線永遠到不了目標。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ). With RH₀ = 90%, RH_∞ = 30% and τ = 20 days, reaching 40% takes t = τ·ln[(90 − 30)/(40 − 30)] = 20×ln 6 ≈ 35.8 days. A section with a measured τ of 40 days needs about 72 days; if RH_∞ is above 40%, the curve never reaches the target. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個區段從啟動起逐日記錄排氣溫濕度與流量，以指數曲線擬合 τ 與 RH_∞，預測達標日期；擬合的 RH_∞ 高於目標的區段，優先檢查洩漏、送氣量與局部積水，必要時開窗排水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: From start-up log exhaust humidity, temperature and flow daily for each section, fit τ and RH_∞ to an exponential curve and forecast the date of reaching target; for sections whose fitted RH_∞ exceeds the target, check leaks, supply flow and local standing water first, opening a window to drain if needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ)。取 RH₀ = 90%、RH_∞ = 30%、τ = 20 天：降到 40% 所需 t = τ·ln[(90 − 30)/(40 − 30)] = 20×ln 6 ≈ 35.8 天。若某區段 τ 實測為 40 天，則需約 72 天；若 RH_∞ 高於 40%，曲線永遠到不了目標。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ). With RH₀ = 90%, RH_∞ = 30% and τ = 20 days, reaching 40% takes t = τ·ln[(90 − 30)/(40 − 30)] = 20×ln 6 ≈ 35.8 days. A section with a measured τ of 40 days needs about 72 days; if RH_∞ is above 40%, the curve never reaches the target. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay", which statement holds?
options: 除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。
RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ)。
主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。
optionsEn: Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance.
RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ).
With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside.
quiz.explanation: RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: RH(t) = RH_∞ + (RH₀ − RH_∞)·e^(−t/τ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「啟動乾燥曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Start-up dry-out curve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個區段從啟動起逐日記錄排氣溫濕度與流量，以指數曲線擬合 τ 與 RH_∞，預測達標日期；擬合的 RH_∞ 高於目標的區段，優先檢查洩漏、送氣量與局部積水，必要時開窗排水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: From start-up log exhaust humidity, temperature and flow daily for each section, fit τ and RH_∞ to an exponential curve and forecast the date of reaching target; for sections whose fitted RH_∞ exceeds the target, check leaks, supply flow and local standing water first, opening a window to drain if needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調試規範應定義每個區段的達標準則（例如連續 30 天排氣濕度低於目標）、擬合方法與未達標時的處理流程；調試紀錄與擬合參數納入交接文件，作為日後判斷性能退化的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The commissioning specification should define the success criterion per section, for example 30 consecutive days of exhaust humidity below target, the fitting method and the procedure when targets are missed; commissioning records and fitted parameters go into the handover file as the baseline for judging later degradation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若調試只看最初幾天的下降就宣告完成，可能遺漏下降停滯在目標以上的區段；排氣濕度長期偏高卻被歸因於天候，延誤找出洩漏或積水點，主纜持續在潮濕狀態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Declaring commissioning complete after a few days of decline can miss sections that stall above target; blaming persistently high exhaust humidity on weather delays finding leaks or standing water, and the cable stays damp. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個區段從啟動起逐日記錄排氣溫濕度與流量，以指數曲線擬合 τ 與 RH_∞，預測達標日期；擬合的 RH_∞ 高於目標的區段，優先檢查洩漏、送氣量與局部積水，必要時開窗排水。
knowledge.textEn: From start-up log exhaust humidity, temperature and flow daily for each section, fit τ and RH_∞ to an exponential curve and forecast the date of reaching target; for sections whose fitted RH_∞ exceeds the target, check leaks, supply flow and local standing water first, opening a window to drain if needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調試規範應定義每個區段的達標準則（例如連續 30 天排氣濕度低於目標）、擬合方法與未達標時的處理流程；調試紀錄與擬合參數納入交接文件，作為日後判斷性能退化的基準。
knowledge.textEn: The commissioning specification should define the success criterion per section, for example 30 consecutive days of exhaust humidity below target, the fitting method and the procedure when targets are missed; commissioning records and fitted parameters go into the handover file as the baseline for judging later degradation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
包覆材料越厚越好，索夾處的細部影響不大。
每個區段從啟動起逐日記錄排氣溫濕度與流量，以指數曲線擬合 τ 與 RH_∞，預測達標日期。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter.
From start-up log exhaust humidity, temperature and flow daily for each section, fit τ and RH_∞ to an exponential curve and forecast the date of reaching target.
quiz.explanation: 每個區段從啟動起逐日記錄排氣溫濕度與流量，以指數曲線擬合 τ 與 RH_∞，預測達標日期；擬合的 RH_∞ 高於目標的區段，優先檢查洩漏、送氣量與局部積水，必要時開窗排水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: From start-up log exhaust humidity, temperature and flow daily for each section, fit τ and RH_∞ to an exponential curve and forecast the date of reaching target; for sections whose fitted RH_∞ exceeds the target, check leaks, supply flow and local standing water first, opening a window to drain if needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「啟動乾燥曲線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Start-up dry-out curve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若調試只看最初幾天的下降就宣告完成，可能遺漏下降停滯在目標以上的區段；排氣濕度長期偏高卻被歸因於天候，延誤找出洩漏或積水點，主纜持續在潮濕狀態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Declaring commissioning complete after a few days of decline can miss sections that stall above target; blaming persistently high exhaust humidity on weather delays finding leaks or standing water, and the cable stays damp. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本州四國連絡橋以 40% RH 為管理目標，比會發生腐蝕的約 60% 留有餘裕；調試時就是看排氣濕度何時、能否穩定落在目標以下。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Honshu-Shikoku bridges manage to 40% RH, a margin below the roughly 60% at which corrosion occurs; commissioning watches when, and whether, exhaust humidity settles below that target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若調試只看最初幾天的下降就宣告完成，可能遺漏下降停滯在目標以上的區段；排氣濕度長期偏高卻被歸因於天候，延誤找出洩漏或積水點，主纜持續在潮濕狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Declaring commissioning complete after a few days of decline can miss sections that stall above target; blaming persistently high exhaust humidity on weather delays finding leaks or standing water, and the cable stays damp.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「啟動乾燥與排氣濕度衰減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Start-up dry-out and exhaust humidity decay" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若調試只看最初幾天的下降就宣告完成，可能遺漏下降停滯在目標以上的區段；排氣濕度長期偏高卻被歸因於天候，延誤找出洩漏或積水點，主纜持續在潮濕狀態。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要相對濕度低於目標，主纜就不可能結露。
optionsEn: Declaring commissioning complete after a few days of decline can miss sections that stall above target.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If relative humidity is below target, the cable cannot have condensation.
quiz.explanation: 若調試只看最初幾天的下降就宣告完成，可能遺漏下降停滯在目標以上的區段；排氣濕度長期偏高卻被歸因於天候，延誤找出洩漏或積水點，主纜持續在潮濕狀態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Declaring commissioning complete after a few days of decline can miss sections that stall above target; blaming persistently high exhaust humidity on weather delays finding leaks or standing water, and the cable stays damp. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「感測器網路與露點裕度判讀」與「成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sensor network and dew-point margin" and "Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 感測器網路與露點裕度判讀：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sensor network and dew-point margin: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「排氣溫濕度感測器」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exhaust humidity sensors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 除濕系統的效果只能透過量測看見，感測器至少包括各送氣口與排氣口的溫度、相對濕度與流量，以及代表性位置的鋼絲表面溫度。電容式濕度感測器會隨時間漂移，在高濕或含鹽環境下更快，因此需要定期校正或以可攜式參考儀比對。判讀時不應只看相對濕度，而要把空氣露點與鋼絲溫度比較：相對濕度看似達標，若夜間鋼絲溫度接近露點，仍可能結露。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「排氣溫濕度感測器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The effect of a dehumidification system can only be seen through measurement: at minimum temperature, relative humidity and flow at each injection and exhaust point, plus wire-surface temperature at representative locations. Capacitive humidity sensors drift with time, faster in humid or salty conditions, so they need periodic calibration or comparison with a portable reference. Interpretation should not rest on relative humidity alone but compare air dew point with wire temperature: humidity may look on target while night-time wire temperature approaches the dew point and condensation still occurs. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Exhaust humidity sensors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：排氣空氣 20 °C、40% RH 時露點約 6.0 °C；若夜間鋼絲 8 °C，裕度約 2.0 °C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Exhaust air at 20 °C and 40% RH has a dew point of about 6.0 °C; with wires at 8 °C at night the margin is about 2.0 °C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要相對濕度低於目標，主纜就不可能結露。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If relative humidity is below target, the cable cannot have condensation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「排氣溫濕度感測器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Exhaust humidity sensors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 感測器網路與露點裕度判讀
knowledge.text: 除濕系統的效果只能透過量測看見，感測器至少包括各送氣口與排氣口的溫度、相對濕度與流量，以及代表性位置的鋼絲表面溫度。電容式濕度感測器會隨時間漂移，在高濕或含鹽環境下更快，因此需要定期校正或以可攜式參考儀比對。
knowledge.textEn: The effect of a dehumidification system can only be seen through measurement: at minimum temperature, relative humidity and flow at each injection and exhaust point, plus wire-surface temperature at representative locations. Capacitive humidity sensors drift with time, faster in humid or salty conditions, so they need periodic calibration or comparison with a portable reference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要相對濕度低於目標，主纜就不可能結露。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If relative humidity is below target, the cable cannot have condensation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「感測器網路與露點裕度判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sensor network and dew-point margin" is correct?
options: 只要相對濕度低於目標，主纜就不可能結露。
除濕系統的效果只能透過量測看見，感測器至少包括各送氣口與排氣口的溫度、相對濕度與流量，以及代表性位置的鋼絲表面溫度。
裝了除濕系統之後，主纜就不需要再開纜檢查。
optionsEn: If relative humidity is below target, the cable cannot have condensation.

The effect of a dehumidification system can only be seen through measurement: at minimum temperature, relative humidity and flow at each injection and exhaust point, plus wire-surface temperature at representative locations.
Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again.
quiz.explanation: 除濕系統的效果只能透過量測看見，感測器至少包括各送氣口與排氣口的溫度、相對濕度與流量，以及代表性位置的鋼絲表面溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The effect of a dehumidification system can only be seen through measurement: at minimum temperature, relative humidity and flow at each injection and exhaust point, plus wire-surface temperature at representative locations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 感測器網路與露點裕度判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sensor network and dew-point margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排氣溫濕度感測器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exhaust humidity sensors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：排氣空氣 20 °C、40% RH 時露點約 6.0 °C；若夜間鋼絲 8 °C，裕度約 2.0 °C。感測器誤差 ±3% RH 時，40% 的讀值可能代表 37% 至 43%，露點約 4.9 至 7.0 °C，裕度只剩約 1.0 °C。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Exhaust air at 20 °C and 40% RH has a dew point of about 6.0 °C; with wires at 8 °C at night the margin is about 2.0 °C. With ±3% RH sensor error, a 40% reading may mean 37% to 43%, a dew point of about 4.9 to 7.0 °C, leaving a margin of only about 1.0 °C. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前逐只校正感測器並記錄序號，安裝後每年以可攜式參考儀現場比對，偏差超過允許值即更換；監控平台應同時計算露點與鋼絲溫度差，設定警報門檻，並檢查資料缺漏與時間同步。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate every sensor before installation and record serial numbers, compare annually on site with a portable reference and replace any beyond tolerance; the monitoring platform should compute dew point against wire temperature, set alarm thresholds and check for data gaps and time synchronisation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 排氣空氣 20 °C、40% RH 時露點約 6.0 °C；若夜間鋼絲 8 °C，裕度約 2.0 °C。感測器誤差 ±3% RH 時，40% 的讀值可能代表 37% 至 43%，露點約 4.9 至 7.0 °C，裕度只剩約 1.0 °C。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Exhaust air at 20 °C and 40% RH has a dew point of about 6.0 °C; with wires at 8 °C at night the margin is about 2.0 °C. With ±3% RH sensor error, a 40% reading may mean 37% to 43%, a dew point of about 4.9 to 7.0 °C, leaving a margin of only about 1.0 °C. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「感測器網路與露點裕度判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sensor network and dew-point margin", which statement holds?
options: 主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。
只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。
排氣空氣 20 °C、40% RH 時露點約 6.0 °C；若夜間鋼絲 8 °C，裕度約 2.0 °C。
optionsEn: Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money.
Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself.
Exhaust air at 20 °C and 40% RH has a dew point of about 6.0 °C; with wires at 8 °C at night the margin is about 2.0 °C.
quiz.explanation: 排氣空氣 20 °C、40% RH 時露點約 6.0 °C；若夜間鋼絲 8 °C，裕度約 2.0 °C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Exhaust air at 20 °C and 40% RH has a dew point of about 6.0 °C; with wires at 8 °C at night the margin is about 2.0 °C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 感測器網路與露點裕度判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sensor network and dew-point margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排氣溫濕度感測器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exhaust humidity sensors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝前逐只校正感測器並記錄序號，安裝後每年以可攜式參考儀現場比對，偏差超過允許值即更換；監控平台應同時計算露點與鋼絲溫度差，設定警報門檻，並檢查資料缺漏與時間同步。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate every sensor before installation and record serial numbers, compare annually on site with a portable reference and replace any beyond tolerance; the monitoring platform should compute dew point against wire temperature, set alarm thresholds and check for data gaps and time synchronisation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測規範應要求每個感測器的校正紀錄、年度現場比對、資料完整率門檻與「讀值長期不變」的異常偵測規則；警報要有明確的負責人與處理時限，並在每年的維護報告中彙整。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring specification should require calibration records for every sensor, annual field comparison, a data-completeness threshold and a rule to detect readings that never change; alarms need a named owner and response time, summarised in the annual maintenance report.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器漂移讀值偏低時，系統看似達標而主纜實際潮濕；感測器故障輸出固定值若未被偵測，可能多年沒有人發現某區段已失去送氣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sensor drifting low makes the system look on target while the cable is actually damp; a failed sensor stuck at a constant value, if undetected, can hide for years that a section has lost its supply. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 感測器網路與露點裕度判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sensor network and dew-point margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排氣溫濕度感測器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Exhaust humidity sensors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器漂移讀值偏低時，系統看似達標而主纜實際潮濕；感測器故障輸出固定值若未被偵測，可能多年沒有人發現某區段已失去送氣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sensor drifting low makes the system look on target while the cable is actually damp; a failed sensor stuck at a constant value, if undetected, can hide for years that a section has lost its supply. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判讀時不應只看相對濕度，而要把空氣露點與鋼絲溫度比較：相對濕度看似達標，若夜間鋼絲溫度接近露點，仍可能結露。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Interpretation should not rest on relative humidity alone but compare air dew point with wire temperature: humidity may look on target while night-time wire temperature approaches the dew point and condensation still occurs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要相對濕度低於目標，主纜就不可能結露。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If relative humidity is below target, the cable cannot have condensation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 感測器漂移讀值偏低時，系統看似達標而主纜實際潮濕；感測器故障輸出固定值若未被偵測，可能多年沒有人發現某區段已失去送氣。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「感測器網路與露點裕度判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sensor network and dew-point margin" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
感測器漂移讀值偏低時，系統看似達標而主纜實際潮濕；感測器故障輸出固定值若未被偵測，可能多年沒有人發現某區段已失去送氣。
裝了除濕系統之後，主纜就不需要再開纜檢查。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A sensor drifting low makes the system look on target while the cable is actually damp.
Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again.
quiz.explanation: 感測器漂移讀值偏低時，系統看似達標而主纜實際潮濕；感測器故障輸出固定值若未被偵測，可能多年沒有人發現某區段已失去送氣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A sensor drifting low makes the system look on target while the cable is actually damp; a failed sensor stuck at a constant value, if undetected, can hide for years that a section has lost its supply. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「濕潤時間與開纜比對」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time of wetness versus openings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 除濕的目的不是讀值好看，而是讓鋼絲不再腐蝕，因此最終驗證要回到鋼絲本身。ISO 9223 以相對濕度高於 80% 且溫度高於 0 °C 的累計時數定義濕潤時間，作為大氣腐蝕性的指標之一；把纜內監測資料換算成濕潤時間，可以量化除濕前後的腐蝕環境差異。美國聯邦公路總署的入門手冊指出，膜包覆與除濕在亞洲已廣泛使用、歐洲也有應用，並建議在發現第 3 級以上腐蝕時以聲學監測偵測斷絲；監測資料與下一次開纜檢查的腐蝕分級、斷絲數比對，才能確認系統真正有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「濕潤時間與開纜比對」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The aim of dehumidification is not good readings but wires that stop corroding, so final verification returns to the wires themselves. ISO 9223 defines time of wetness as accumulated hours with relative humidity above 80% and temperature above 0 °C, one indicator of atmospheric corrosivity; converting in-cable monitoring data into time of wetness quantifies the change in corrosive environment before and after dehumidification. The US Federal Highway Administration primer notes that membrane wrapping and dehumidification are widely used in Asia and also in Europe, and recommends acoustic monitoring for wire breaks once Stage 3 or worse corrosion is found; only comparing monitoring data with corrosion stages and broken-wire counts at the next cable opening confirms that the system works. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Time of wetness versus openings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若除濕前纜內每年 RH > 80% 的時數為 4,000 h（約 46% 的時間），除濕後降為 80 h（約 0.9%），濕潤時間減少約 98%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If, before dehumidification, the cable spends 4,000 h a year above 80% RH (about 46% of the time) and afterwards 80 h (about 0.9%), time of wetness falls by about 98%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裝了除濕系統之後，主纜就不需要再開纜檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「濕潤時間與開纜比對」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Time of wetness versus openings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查
knowledge.titleEn: Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings
knowledge.text: 除濕的目的不是讀值好看，而是讓鋼絲不再腐蝕，因此最終驗證要回到鋼絲本身。ISO 9223 以相對濕度高於 80% 且溫度高於 0 °C 的累計時數定義濕潤時間，作為大氣腐蝕性的指標之一；把纜內監測資料換算成濕潤時間，可以量化除濕前後的腐蝕環境差異。
knowledge.textEn: The aim of dehumidification is not good readings but wires that stop corroding, so final verification returns to the wires themselves. ISO 9223 defines time of wetness as accumulated hours with relative humidity above 80% and temperature above 0 °C, one indicator of atmospheric corrosivity; converting in-cable monitoring data into time of wetness quantifies the change in corrosive environment before and after dehumidification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裝了除濕系統之後，主纜就不需要再開纜檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings" is correct?

除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。
除濕的目的不是讀值好看，而是讓鋼絲不再腐蝕，因此最終驗證要回到鋼絲本身。
optionsEn: Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again.
Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance.
The aim of dehumidification is not good readings but wires that stop corroding, so final verification returns to the wires themselves.
quiz.explanation: 除濕的目的不是讀值好看，而是讓鋼絲不再腐蝕，因此最終驗證要回到鋼絲本身。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The aim of dehumidification is not good readings but wires that stop corroding, so final verification returns to the wires themselves. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濕潤時間與開纜比對」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Time of wetness versus openings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若除濕前纜內每年 RH > 80% 的時數為 4,000 h（約 46% 的時間），除濕後降為 80 h（約 0.9%），濕潤時間減少約 98%。若腐蝕速率約與濕潤時間成正比，鋅層消耗年數由 10 年級延長到數百年級。比例關係為教學簡化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If, before dehumidification, the cable spends 4,000 h a year above 80% RH (about 46% of the time) and afterwards 80 h (about 0.9%), time of wetness falls by about 98%. If corrosion rate scales roughly with time of wetness, zinc life stretches from the order of ten years to the order of centuries. The proportionality is a teaching simplification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個區段的監測資料逐年換算成濕潤時數與露點裕度，選擇改造前曾有腐蝕的位置在數年後開窗，以相同的楔線與分級方法記錄，與改造前結果並列比較；聲學監測事件則對照開窗位置確認是否為斷絲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert each section's monitoring data into annual wet hours and dew-point margin, reopen windows some years later at locations that showed corrosion before the retrofit, recording with the same wedge lines and staging method for side-by-side comparison; check acoustic events against opening locations to confirm whether they were wire breaks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若除濕前纜內每年 RH > 80% 的時數為 4,000 h（約 46% 的時間），除濕後降為 80 h（約 0.9%），濕潤時間減少約 98%。若腐蝕速率約與濕潤時間成正比，鋅層消耗年數由 10 年級延長到數百年級。比例關係為教學簡化。
knowledge.textEn: If, before dehumidification, the cable spends 4,000 h a year above 80% RH (about 46% of the time) and afterwards 80 h (about 0.9%), time of wetness falls by about 98%. If corrosion rate scales roughly with time of wetness, zinc life stretches from the order of ten years to the order of centuries. The proportionality is a teaching simplification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings", which statement holds?
options: 若除濕前纜內每年 RH > 80% 的時數為 4,000 h（約 46% 的時間），除濕後降為 80 h（約 0.9%），濕潤時間減少約 98%。

With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside.
The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter.

steps.titleEn: Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濕潤時間與開纜比對」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Time of wetness versus openings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個區段的監測資料逐年換算成濕潤時數與露點裕度，選擇改造前曾有腐蝕的位置在數年後開窗，以相同的楔線與分級方法記錄，與改造前結果並列比較；聲學監測事件則對照開窗位置確認是否為斷絲。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert each section's monitoring data into annual wet hours and dew-point margin, reopen windows some years later at locations that showed corrosion before the retrofit, recording with the same wedge lines and staging method for side-by-side comparison; check acoustic events against opening locations to confirm whether they were wire breaks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應把除濕系統的監測資料、聲學監測與開纜檢查整合成同一套主纜狀態評估，訂出改造後的首次複查時程（例如數年內一次），並在評估報告中分開記載改造前的既有損傷與改造後的新增變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should combine dehumidification monitoring, acoustic monitoring and cable openings into one cable-condition assessment, set the first post-retrofit re-inspection (for example within a few years), and record existing pre-retrofit damage separately from new changes in the assessment report.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以排氣濕度證明成效而從未開纜比對，可能長期誤判；已經產生裂紋的鋼絲即使在乾燥環境中也不會恢復強度，若未把改造前的劣化納入評估，可能高估剩餘安全係數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Proving effectiveness only by exhaust humidity, never by reopening the cable, can mislead for years; wires already cracked do not regain strength in dry air, so ignoring pre-retrofit damage can overstate the remaining safety factor. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把每個區段的監測資料逐年換算成濕潤時數與露點裕度，選擇改造前曾有腐蝕的位置在數年後開窗，以相同的楔線與分級方法記錄，與改造前結果並列比較。
除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Convert each section's monitoring data into annual wet hours and dew-point margin, reopen windows some years later at locations that showed corrosion before the retrofit, recording with the same wedge lines and staging method for side-by-side comparison.
A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather.
