Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濕潤時間與開纜比對」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Time of wetness versus openings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以排氣濕度證明成效而從未開纜比對，可能長期誤判；已經產生裂紋的鋼絲即使在乾燥環境中也不會恢復強度，若未把改造前的劣化納入評估，可能高估剩餘安全係數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Proving effectiveness only by exhaust humidity, never by reopening the cable, can mislead for years; wires already cracked do not regain strength in dry air, so ignoring pre-retrofit damage can overstate the remaining safety factor. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：美國聯邦公路總署的入門手冊指出，膜包覆與除濕在亞洲已廣泛使用、歐洲也有應用，並建議在發現第 3 級以上腐蝕時以聲學監測偵測斷絲；監測資料與下一次開纜檢查的腐蝕分級、斷絲數比對，才能確認系統真正有效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The US Federal Highway Administration primer notes that membrane wrapping and dehumidification are widely used in Asia and also in Europe, and recommends acoustic monitoring for wire breaks once Stage 3 or worse corrosion is found; only comparing monitoring data with corrosion stages and broken-wire counts at the next cable opening confirms that the system works.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裝了除濕系統之後，主纜就不需要再開纜檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a dehumidification system is installed, the cable never needs opening again." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以排氣濕度證明成效而從未開纜比對，可能長期誤判；已經產生裂紋的鋼絲即使在乾燥環境中也不會恢復強度，若未把改造前的劣化納入評估，可能高估剩餘安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Proving effectiveness only by exhaust humidity, never by reopening the cable, can mislead for years; wires already cracked do not regain strength in dry air, so ignoring pre-retrofit damage can overstate the remaining safety factor.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「成效驗證：濕潤時間與開纜檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Verifying effectiveness: time of wetness and cable openings" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。
只以排氣濕度證明成效而從未開纜比對，可能長期誤判；已經產生裂紋的鋼絲即使在乾燥環境中也不會恢復強度，若未把改造前的劣化納入評估，可能高估剩餘安全係數。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance.
Proving effectiveness only by exhaust humidity, never by reopening the cable, can mislead for years.
quiz.explanation: 只以排氣濕度證明成效而從未開纜比對，可能長期誤判；已經產生裂紋的鋼絲即使在乾燥環境中也不會恢復強度，若未把改造前的劣化納入評估，可能高估剩餘安全係數。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Proving effectiveness only by exhaust humidity, never by reopening the cable, can mislead for years; wires already cracked do not regain strength in dry air, so ignoring pre-retrofit damage can overstate the remaining safety factor. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「運轉能耗與設備維護」與「除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Running energy and plant maintenance" and "Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 運轉能耗與設備維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Running energy and plant maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「風機與再生能耗」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fan and regeneration energy” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 除濕系統需要數十年連續運轉，能耗與設備維護是營運成本的主要部分。能耗來自兩處：推動空氣通過管路與主纜空隙的風機，以及加熱再生空氣使吸附轉輪恢復吸濕能力的加熱器，後者通常較大。維護項目包括過濾器更換、轉輪與密封檢查、風機軸承、預冷盤管清潔與凝結水排放、控制系統與感測器校正。本州四國連絡橋的經驗也顯示，系統需要依實際運轉持續改善，例如針對夏季高濕加裝預冷設備。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「風機與再生能耗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dehumidification system runs continuously for decades, so energy and plant maintenance dominate operating cost. Energy goes in two places: fans that push air through ducts and cable voids, and heaters that warm regeneration air to restore the desiccant rotor, the latter usually being larger. Maintenance covers filter changes, rotor and seal checks, fan bearings, pre-cooler coil cleaning and condensate drainage, and control-system and sensor calibration. The Honshu-Shikoku experience also shows that a system needs continuous improvement from operating data, such as adding pre-coolers for humid summers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fan and regeneration energy” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風機功率 P = Q·Δp/η。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fan power P = Q·Δp/η.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「風機與再生能耗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fan and regeneration energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 運轉能耗與設備維護
knowledge.text: 除濕系統需要數十年連續運轉，能耗與設備維護是營運成本的主要部分。能耗來自兩處：推動空氣通過管路與主纜空隙的風機，以及加熱再生空氣使吸附轉輪恢復吸濕能力的加熱器，後者通常較大。
knowledge.textEn: A dehumidification system runs continuously for decades, so energy and plant maintenance dominate operating cost. Energy goes in two places: fans that push air through ducts and cable voids, and heaters that warm regeneration air to restore the desiccant rotor, the latter usually being larger.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「運轉能耗與設備維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Running energy and plant maintenance" is correct?
options: 除濕系統需要數十年連續運轉，能耗與設備維護是營運成本的主要部分。
除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。
主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。
optionsEn: A dehumidification system runs continuously for decades, so energy and plant maintenance dominate operating cost.
Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance.
Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money.
quiz.explanation: 除濕系統需要數十年連續運轉，能耗與設備維護是營運成本的主要部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A dehumidification system runs continuously for decades, so energy and plant maintenance dominate operating cost. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 運轉能耗與設備維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Running energy and plant maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風機與再生能耗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fan and regeneration energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風機功率 P = Q·Δp/η。取 Q = 0.2 m³/s、Δp = 3,000 Pa、效率 η = 0.5：P = 0.2×3,000/0.5 = 1,200 W。再生加熱器 10 kW、平均負載率 50%，年耗電約 10×8,760×0.5 = 43,800 kWh，遠大於風機的約 10,500 kWh。若預冷降低吸附負荷四成，再生能耗可望同步下降。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fan power P = Q·Δp/η. With Q = 0.2 m³/s, Δp = 3,000 Pa and efficiency η = 0.5: P = 0.2×3,000/0.5 = 1,200 W. A 10 kW regeneration heater at 50% average duty uses about 10×8,760×0.5 = 43,800 kWh a year, far more than the fan's roughly 10,500 kWh. If pre-cooling cuts the desiccant load by 40%, regeneration energy can fall in step. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以電錶分別記錄風機、再生加熱與預冷的耗電，與除濕量、外氣條件一起分析每公斤除濕量的能耗趨勢；能耗上升而除濕量不變時，檢查過濾器堵塞、轉輪劣化或洩漏增加。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Meter fan, regeneration and pre-cooler consumption separately and analyse energy per kilogram of moisture removed against outdoor conditions; when energy rises for the same moisture removal, check for clogged filters, rotor deterioration or increased leakage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風機功率 P = Q·Δp/η。取 Q = 0.2 m³/s、Δp = 3,000 Pa、效率 η = 0.5：P = 0.2×3,000/0.5 = 1,200 W。再生加熱器 10 kW、平均負載率 50%，年耗電約 10×8,760×0.5 = 43,800 kWh，遠大於風機的約 10,500 kWh。若預冷降低吸附負荷四成，再生能耗可望同步下降。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Fan power P = Q·Δp/η. With Q = 0.2 m³/s, Δp = 3,000 Pa and efficiency η = 0.5: P = 0.2×3,000/0.5 = 1,200 W. A 10 kW regeneration heater at 50% average duty uses about 10×8,760×0.5 = 43,800 kWh a year, far more than the fan's roughly 10,500 kWh. If pre-cooling cuts the desiccant load by 40%, regeneration energy can fall in step. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「運轉能耗與設備維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Running energy and plant maintenance", which statement holds?
options: 只要把除濕機開大，乾燥空氣就能自然流遍整條主纜。
風機功率 P = Q·Δp/η。
除濕機只要選一台夠大的家用或倉庫型機器即可。
optionsEn: Just turn the dehumidifier up and dry air will spread along the whole cable by itself.
Fan power P = Q·Δp/η.
Any large household or warehouse dehumidifier will do.
quiz.explanation: 風機功率 P = Q·Δp/η。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Fan power P = Q·Δp/η. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 運轉能耗與設備維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Running energy and plant maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風機與再生能耗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fan and regeneration energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以電錶分別記錄風機、再生加熱與預冷的耗電，與除濕量、外氣條件一起分析每公斤除濕量的能耗趨勢；能耗上升而除濕量不變時，檢查過濾器堵塞、轉輪劣化或洩漏增加。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Meter fan, regeneration and pre-cooler consumption separately and analyse energy per kilogram of moisture removed against outdoor conditions; when energy rises for the same moisture removal, check for clogged filters, rotor deterioration or increased leakage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應列出各設備的檢查週期、更換零件清單、能耗基準與性能退化判斷準則，並把能耗與除濕量的比值作為年度報告的關鍵指標；任何節能措施都必須先評估對纜內濕度的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should list inspection intervals, spare parts, energy baselines and degradation criteria for every item of plant, with energy per unit of moisture removed as a key annual indicator; any energy-saving measure must first be assessed for its effect on cable humidity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為節省能源而降低送氣量或關閉部分機組，排氣濕度在數週內回升；過濾器長期未更換使壓降增加、流量下降，而控制系統若只看風機運轉狀態，可能不會發出警報。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting supply flow or switching off units to save energy lets exhaust humidity climb within weeks; filters left unchanged raise pressure drop and cut flow, and a control system that watches only whether fans are running may never alarm. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以電錶分別記錄風機、再生加熱與預冷的耗電，與除濕量、外氣條件一起分析每公斤除濕量的能耗趨勢；能耗上升而除濕量不變時，檢查過濾器堵塞、轉輪劣化或洩漏增加。
knowledge.textEn: Meter fan, regeneration and pre-cooler consumption separately and analyse energy per kilogram of moisture removed against outdoor conditions; when energy rises for the same moisture removal, check for clogged filters, rotor deterioration or increased leakage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊應列出各設備的檢查週期、更換零件清單、能耗基準與性能退化判斷準則，並把能耗與除濕量的比值作為年度報告的關鍵指標；任何節能措施都必須先評估對纜內濕度的影響。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should list inspection intervals, spare parts, energy baselines and degradation criteria for every item of plant, with energy per unit of moisture removed as a key annual indicator; any energy-saving measure must first be assessed for its effect on cable humidity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「運轉能耗與設備維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Running energy and plant maintenance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
除濕系統一啟動，主纜內部在幾天內就會變乾。
以電錶分別記錄風機、再生加熱與預冷的耗電，與除濕量、外氣條件一起分析每公斤除濕量的能耗趨勢；能耗上升而除濕量不變時，檢查過濾器堵塞、轉輪劣化或洩漏增加。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once switched on, a dehumidification system dries the cable within a few days.
Meter fan, regeneration and pre-cooler consumption separately and analyse energy per kilogram of moisture removed against outdoor conditions.
quiz.explanation: 以電錶分別記錄風機、再生加熱與預冷的耗電，與除濕量、外氣條件一起分析每公斤除濕量的能耗趨勢；能耗上升而除濕量不變時，檢查過濾器堵塞、轉輪劣化或洩漏增加。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Meter fan, regeneration and pre-cooler consumption separately and analyse energy per kilogram of moisture removed against outdoor conditions; when energy rises for the same moisture removal, check for clogged filters, rotor deterioration or increased leakage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 運轉能耗與設備維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Running energy and plant maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風機與再生能耗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fan and regeneration energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為節省能源而降低送氣量或關閉部分機組，排氣濕度在數週內回升；過濾器長期未更換使壓降增加、流量下降，而控制系統若只看風機運轉狀態，可能不會發出警報。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting supply flow or switching off units to save energy lets exhaust humidity climb within weeks; filters left unchanged raise pressure drop and cut flow, and a control system that watches only whether fans are running may never alarm. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本州四國連絡橋的經驗也顯示，系統需要依實際運轉持續改善，例如針對夏季高濕加裝預冷設備。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Honshu-Shikoku experience also shows that a system needs continuous improvement from operating data, such as adding pre-coolers for humid summers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「除濕系統安裝後幾乎不耗能，也不需要例行維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once installed, a dehumidification system uses almost no energy and needs no routine maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為節省能源而降低送氣量或關閉部分機組，排氣濕度在數週內回升；過濾器長期未更換使壓降增加、流量下降，而控制系統若只看風機運轉狀態，可能不會發出警報。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting supply flow or switching off units to save energy lets exhaust humidity climb within weeks; filters left unchanged raise pressure drop and cut flow, and a control system that watches only whether fans are running may never alarm.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運轉能耗與設備維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Running energy and plant maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為節省能源而降低送氣量或關閉部分機組，排氣濕度在數週內回升；過濾器長期未更換使壓降增加、流量下降，而控制系統若只看風機運轉狀態，可能不會發出警報。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。
optionsEn: Cutting supply flow or switching off units to save energy lets exhaust humidity climb within weeks.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money.
quiz.explanation: 為節省能源而降低送氣量或關閉部分機組，排氣濕度在數週內回升；過濾器長期未更換使壓降增加、流量下降，而控制系統若只看風機運轉狀態，可能不會發出警報。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cutting supply flow or switching off units to save energy lets exhaust humidity climb within weeks; filters left unchanged raise pressure drop and cut flow, and a control system that watches only whether fans are running may never alarm. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「除濕與重塗的生命週期」如何影響懸索橋主纜除濕系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dehumidify-or-repaint life cycle” governs force, deformation or durability in “Suspension-cable dehumidification systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出，大貝爾特東橋通車約 15 年時主纜尚未發現鏽蝕，原本規劃的是重新塗裝，業主最後選擇投入更高的初始費用安裝密封除濕系統。這個決策的關鍵在於：重新塗裝只能維持外層，無法處理已進入主纜內部或日後滲入的水分；而主纜一旦因腐蝕需要補強或限載，代價遠高於任何防蝕措施。本州四國連絡橋以 200 年以上的使用為目標、以預防保全降低生命週期成本，也是同一邏輯。決策時必須把不確定的未來劣化風險放進比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「除濕與重塗的生命週期」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public accounts note that after about 15 years in service no rust had been found in the Great Belt East Bridge cables; repainting had been planned, but the owner chose a higher initial outlay on a sealed dehumidification system. The key is that repainting only maintains the outer skin and does nothing about water already inside the cable or entering later, while a cable that needs strengthening or load limits because of corrosion costs far more than any protection. The Honshu-Shikoku bridges' target of 200 years or more, with preventive maintenance to minimise life-cycle cost, follows the same logic. The decision must bring the uncertain risk of future deterioration into the comparison. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dehumidify-or-repaint life cycle” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以相對成本單位、折現率 3%、100 年比較。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Compare in relative cost units at 3% discount over 100 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「除濕與重塗的生命週期」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dehumidify-or-repaint life cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出，大貝爾特東橋通車約 15 年時主纜尚未發現鏽蝕，原本規劃的是重新塗裝，業主最後選擇投入更高的初始費用安裝密封除濕系統。這個決策的關鍵在於：重新塗裝只能維持外層，無法處理已進入主纜內部或日後滲入的水分；而主纜一旦因腐蝕需要補強或限載，代價遠高於任何防蝕措施。
knowledge.textEn: Public accounts note that after about 15 years in service no rust had been found in the Great Belt East Bridge cables; repainting had been planned, but the owner chose a higher initial outlay on a sealed dehumidification system. The key is that repainting only maintains the outer skin and does nothing about water already inside the cable or entering later, while a cable that needs strengthening or load limits because of corrosion costs far more than any protection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting" is correct?
options: 主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。
公開資料指出，大貝爾特東橋通車約 15 年時主纜尚未發現鏽蝕，原本規劃的是重新塗裝，業主最後選擇投入更高的初始費用安裝密封除濕系統。
主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。
optionsEn: Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money.
Public accounts note that after about 15 years in service no rust had been found in the Great Belt East Bridge cables.
With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出，大貝爾特東橋通車約 15 年時主纜尚未發現鏽蝕，原本規劃的是重新塗裝，業主最後選擇投入更高的初始費用安裝密封除濕系統。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public accounts note that after about 15 years in service no rust had been found in the Great Belt East Bridge cables; repainting had been planned, but the owner chose a higher initial outlay on a sealed dehumidification system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「除濕與重塗的生命週期」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dehumidify-or-repaint life cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以相對成本單位、折現率 3%、100 年比較。重塗每 15 年 1.0 單位：現值 ≈ 1 + 0.642 + 0.412 + 0.264 + 0.170 + 0.109 + 0.070 ≈ 2.67。除濕初設 4.7、年運轉 0.05（年金係數 31.6）、每 25 年更換設備 0.8：現值 ≈ 4.7 + 1.58 + 0.65 ≈ 6.93。差額 4.26 單位，若重塗方案在第 50 年有 50% 機率需要 37 單位的主纜介入，其期望現值 0.5×37×0.228 ≈ 4.22，兩者接近打平。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Compare in relative cost units at 3% discount over 100 years. Repainting at 1.0 unit every 15 years has a present value ≈ 1 + 0.642 + 0.412 + 0.264 + 0.170 + 0.109 + 0.070 ≈ 2.67. Dehumidification at 4.7 initial, 0.05 a year (annuity factor 31.6) and 0.8 for plant renewal every 25 years has ≈ 4.7 + 1.58 + 0.65 ≈ 6.93. The difference is 4.26 units; if the repainting option carries a 50% chance of a 37-unit cable intervention at year 50, its expected present value 0.5×37×0.228 ≈ 4.22 nearly closes the gap. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：決策文件應列出現況檢查與開纜結果、各方案的成本與時程假設、劣化與介入機率的依據，並做折現率、劣化速率與介入成本的敏感度分析；由業主的技術委員會審查，並在改造後依實測資料檢討假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The decision file should set out current inspection and opening results, cost and timing assumptions for each option, the basis for deterioration and intervention probabilities, and sensitivity analyses on discount rate, deterioration rate and intervention cost; the owner's technical committee reviews it, and assumptions are revisited with measured data after the retrofit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Compare in relative cost units at 3% discount over 100 years. Repainting at 1.0 unit every 15 years has a present value ≈ 1 + 0.642 + 0.412 + 0.264 + 0.170 + 0.109 + 0.070 ≈ 2.67. Dehumidification at 4.7 initial, 0.05 a year (annuity factor 31.6) and 0.8 for plant renewal every 25 years has ≈ 4.7 + 1.58 + 0.65 ≈ 6.93. The difference is 4.26 units; if the repainting option carries a 50% chance of a 37-unit cable intervention at year 50, its expected present value 0.5×37×0.228 ≈ 4.22 nearly closes the gap. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting", which statement holds?
options: 包覆材料越厚越好，索夾處的細部影響不大。
除濕改造只是加一層外皮，可以在任何天氣快速完成。
以相對成本單位、折現率 3%、100 年比較。
optionsEn: The thicker the wrap the better; details at cable bands hardly matter.
A dehumidification retrofit just adds a skin and can be done quickly in any weather.
Compare in relative cost units at 3% discount over 100 years.
quiz.explanation: 以相對成本單位、折現率 3%、100 年比較。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare in relative cost units at 3% discount over 100 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「除濕與重塗的生命週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dehumidify-or-repaint life cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 決策文件應列出現況檢查與開纜結果、各方案的成本與時程假設、劣化與介入機率的依據，並做折現率、劣化速率與介入成本的敏感度分析；由業主的技術委員會審查，並在改造後依實測資料檢討假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The decision file should set out current inspection and opening results, cost and timing assumptions for each option, the basis for deterioration and intervention probabilities, and sensitivity analyses on discount rate, deterioration rate and intervention cost; the owner's technical committee reviews it, and assumptions are revisited with measured data after the retrofit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應在資產管理計畫中明列主纜防蝕策略的決策準則、檢討週期與觸發條件，並把除濕系統的設計、調試、監測與維護資料作為完整的交接包，確保日後的管理者能延續同一套證據鏈。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner's asset-management plan should state the decision criteria, review cycle and triggers for cable corrosion strategy, and hand over the dehumidification design, commissioning, monitoring and maintenance records as one package so future managers inherit the same chain of evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只比較直接工程費而不考慮主纜劣化風險，會系統性地偏向延後投資；等到開纜發現大量第 4 級腐蝕或斷絲才改造，除濕雖可阻止惡化，卻無法恢復已損失的強度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing only direct works cost without cable-deterioration risk systematically favours delay; retrofitting only after openings reveal widespread Stage 4 corrosion or broken wires stops further damage but cannot restore the strength already lost. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「除濕與重塗的生命週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dehumidify-or-repaint life cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只比較直接工程費而不考慮主纜劣化風險，會系統性地偏向延後投資；等到開纜發現大量第 4 級腐蝕或斷絲才改造，除濕雖可阻止惡化，卻無法恢復已損失的強度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing only direct works cost without cable-deterioration risk systematically favours delay; retrofitting only after openings reveal widespread Stage 4 corrosion or broken wires stops further damage but cannot restore the strength already lost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：決策時必須把不確定的未來劣化風險放進比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The decision must bring the uncertain risk of future deterioration into the comparison.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主纜還沒生鏽就安裝除濕系統，是浪費預算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing dehumidification before a cable shows rust is a waste of money." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「除濕與重新塗裝的生命週期決策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Life-cycle decision: dehumidification versus repainting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只比較直接工程費而不考慮主纜劣化風險，會系統性地偏向延後投資；等到開纜發現大量第 4 級腐蝕或斷絲才改造，除濕雖可阻止惡化，卻無法恢復已損失的強度。
主纜外層有纏絲與塗裝，只要外觀完好，內部就一定乾燥。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Comparing only direct works cost without cable-deterioration risk systematically favours delay.
With wrapping and paint outside, an intact-looking cable must be dry inside.
quiz.explanation: 只比較直接工程費而不考慮主纜劣化風險，會系統性地偏向延後投資；等到開纜發現大量第 4 級腐蝕或斷絲才改造，除濕雖可阻止惡化，卻無法恢復已損失的強度。 需以量測區分可能原因。

title: 昂船洲大橋
summary: 昂船洲大橋以 1,018 m 主跨橫越香港藍巴勒海峽，主跨為中央開槽的流線形雙鋼箱梁，背跨為預力混凝土雙箱梁，兩座單柱塔下段為混凝土、上段為雙相不鏽鋼外皮的鋼—混凝土複合結構。本課從颱風風荷載、塔梁液壓緩衝器、224 根斜拉索、鋼箱梁吊裝與鋼混接頭，一路到雷諾數效應的風洞試驗、跨中撓度監測與長索維護。
summaryEn: Stonecutters Bridge crosses Hong Kong’s Rambler Channel with a 1,018 m main span of streamlined twin steel boxes separated by a central gap, prestressed concrete twin-box back spans and two monopole towers whose lower parts are concrete and upper parts steel–concrete composite with a duplex stainless skin. The course runs from typhoon wind load, tower–deck hydraulic buffers, the 224 stays, deck-segment lifting and the steel–concrete junction to Reynolds-number effects in wind testing, mid-span deflection monitoring and long-stay maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算颱風時主跨跨中的側向變形量級。取橋面側風荷載 w = 4.9 kN/m（U = 50 m/s、C_D = 0.8、D = 4 m），主跨 L = 1,018 m。若把主跨視為兩端由塔約束、中間由斜索提供有限側向勁度的梁，以簡支梁上限估計 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI)：取兩箱合計側向 EI = 2.0×10¹⁰ kN·m²，L⁴ = 1,018⁴ ≈ 1.074×10¹²，δ = 5×4.9×1.074×10¹²/(384×2.0×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.63×10¹³/7.68×10¹² ≈ 3.4 m。公開資料中風荷載跨中撓度約 2.2 m，比簡支上限小，表示斜索的擺錘效應與塔的約束分擔了約 35% 的側向變形（1 − 2.2/3.4 ≈ 0.35）。若風速降為 40 m/s，w 與 δ 都乘以 (40/50)² = 0.64。EI 與係數為教學假設，非本橋設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the order of mid-span lateral movement in a typhoon. Take a side wind load w = 4.9 kN/m (U = 50 m/s, C_D = 0.8, D = 4 m) on the L = 1,018 m main span. Treating the main span as a beam restrained by the towers with limited lateral stiffness from the stays, an upper bound from a simply supported beam is δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI); with a combined lateral EI of 2.0×10¹⁰ kN·m² for the two boxes and L⁴ = 1,018⁴ ≈ 1.074×10¹², δ = 5×4.9×1.074×10¹²/(384×2.0×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.63×10¹³/7.68×10¹² ≈ 3.4 m. The published wind deflection of about 2.2 m is smaller, implying that the pendulum action of the stays and tower restraint remove about 35% of the lateral movement (1 − 2.2/3.4 ≈ 0.35). At 40 m/s both w and δ scale by (40/50)² = 0.64. EI and coefficients are teaching assumptions, not design values for this bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁」與「混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck" and "Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「中央開槽雙箱梁」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Split twin-box deck” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 昂船洲大橋位於葵青貨櫃碼頭入口，颱風季的強風紊流度高，主跨 1,018 m 的橋面又輕又柔，風力同時造成橫向彎曲、扭轉與可能的顫振。設計者把約 53 m 寬的橋面分成兩個流線形鋼箱梁，中間留空並以橫梁連接：開槽讓上下表面的壓力差得以洩放，提高扭轉顫振的臨界風速，並降低渦流鎖定的振幅。公開設計資料顯示，零攻角無車時顫振臨界風速約 95 m/s，但攻角變為 ±5° 時降到約 50 m/s，說明颱風紊流造成的攻角變化才是控制因素。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「中央開槽雙箱梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stonecutters Bridge sits at the entrance to the Kwai Tsing container terminals, where typhoon winds are highly turbulent, and the 1,018 m main-span deck is light and flexible, so wind causes lateral bending, torsion and potentially flutter. The designers split the roughly 53 m deck into two streamlined steel boxes with an open gap between them, linked by cross girders: the gap vents the pressure difference between upper and lower surfaces, raising the torsional flutter speed and reducing vortex lock-in amplitudes. Published design data show a flutter speed of about 95 m/s at zero incidence without traffic, falling to about 50 m/s at ±5°, so the angle-of-attack changes caused by typhoon turbulence govern. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Split twin-box deck” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橋面橫向風力 w = ½ρU²·C_D·D。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lateral wind load on the deck w = ½ρU²·C_D·D.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A wider, heavier deck is always harder for wind to move, so a 1 km span only needs more weight to resist typhoons." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「中央開槽雙箱梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Split twin-box deck”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。

Stonecutters Bridge sits at the entrance to the Kwai Tsing container terminals, where typhoon winds are highly turbulent, and the 1,018 m main-span deck is light and flexible, so wind causes lateral bending, torsion and potentially flutter.
Fixing the deck rigidly to the tower always makes the bridge most stable.

quiz.explanationEn: Stonecutters Bridge sits at the entrance to the Kwai Tsing container terminals, where typhoon winds are highly turbulent, and the 1,018 m main-span deck is light and flexible, so wind causes lateral bending, torsion and potentially flutter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中央開槽雙箱梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Split twin-box deck” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橋面橫向風力 w = ½ρU²·C_D·D。取 ρ = 1.225 kg/m³、U = 50 m/s、C_D = 0.8（以箱高為參考）、D = 4 m：q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa，w = 1,531×0.8×4 ≈ 4.9 kN/m，作用於 1,018 m 主跨合計約 5.0 MN；風速降為 40 m/s 時 w ≈ 3.1 kN/m，與 U² 成正比。係數與箱高為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lateral wind load on the deck w = ½ρU²·C_D·D. With ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, U = 50 m/s, C_D = 0.8 referenced to box depth and D = 4 m, q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa and w = 1,531×0.8×4 ≈ 4.9 kN/m, about 5.0 MN over the 1,018 m main span; at 40 m/s w ≈ 3.1 kN/m, scaling with U². Coefficient and depth are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞斷面模型量測不同攻角下的阻力、升力與扭矩係數，並做顫振導數識別；把颱風紊流的攻角分布代入顫振分析，確認在最不利攻角下的臨界風速仍高於設計要求，再以全橋分析計算跨中側向撓度與塔底彎矩。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients at several angles of attack on section models and identify flutter derivatives; feed the typhoon turbulence distribution of incidence into the flutter analysis to confirm that the critical speed at the worst angle still exceeds the requirement, then compute mid-span lateral deflection and tower-base moments globally.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橋面橫向風力 w = ½ρU²·C_D·D。取 ρ = 1.225 kg/m³、U = 50 m/s、C_D = 0.8（以箱高為參考）、D = 4 m：q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa，w = 1,531×0.8×4 ≈ 4.9 kN/m，作用於 1,018 m 主跨合計約 5.0 MN；風速降為 40 m/s 時 w ≈ 3.1 kN/m，與 U² 成正比。係數與箱高為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Lateral wind load on the deck w = ½ρU²·C_D·D. With ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, U = 50 m/s, C_D = 0.8 referenced to box depth and D = 4 m, q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa and w = 1,531×0.8×4 ≈ 4.9 kN/m, about 5.0 MN over the 1,018 m main span; at 40 m/s w ≈ 3.1 kN/m, scaling with U². Coefficient and depth are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck", which statement holds?
options: 同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。
鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。
橋面橫向風力 w = ½ρU²·C_D·D。
optionsEn: All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance.
Bolting the steel girder end to the concrete girder end transfers force evenly.
Lateral wind load on the deck w = ½ρU²·C_D·D.
quiz.explanation: 橋面橫向風力 w = ½ρU²·C_D·D。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Lateral wind load on the deck w = ½ρU²·C_D·D. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中央開槽雙箱梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Split twin-box deck” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞斷面模型量測不同攻角下的阻力、升力與扭矩係數，並做顫振導數識別；把颱風紊流的攻角分布代入顫振分析，確認在最不利攻角下的臨界風速仍高於設計要求，再以全橋分析計算跨中側向撓度與塔底彎矩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients at several angles of attack on section models and identify flutter derivatives; feed the typhoon turbulence distribution of incidence into the flutter analysis to confirm that the critical speed at the worst angle still exceeds the requirement, then compute mid-span lateral deflection and tower-base moments globally. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風工程報告應明列各攻角的顫振臨界風速、有無交通的差異與試驗模型所含的附屬物；任何欄杆、防撞護欄或檢修軌道的形狀變更都要回到風工程顧問複核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The wind report should tabulate flutter speeds by angle of attack, with and without traffic, and list the attachments modelled; any change to railings, barriers or inspection rails goes back to the wind consultant for review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以零攻角的試驗結果判定顫振安全，強紊流下的實際攻角可能使臨界風速降低近一半；開槽寬度或橫梁形狀在細部設計中被修改而未重新試驗，也可能出現未預期的渦振或扭轉不穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Judging flutter safety only from zero-incidence results can overlook that real angles of attack in strong turbulence nearly halve the critical speed; altering the gap width or cross-girder shape in detailed design without retesting can introduce unexpected vortex vibration or torsional instability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞斷面模型量測不同攻角下的阻力、升力與扭矩係數，並做顫振導數識別；把颱風紊流的攻角分布代入顫振分析，確認在最不利攻角下的臨界風速仍高於設計要求，再以全橋分析計算跨中側向撓度與塔底彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients at several angles of attack on section models and identify flutter derivatives; feed the typhoon turbulence distribution of incidence into the flutter analysis to confirm that the critical speed at the worst angle still exceeds the requirement, then compute mid-span lateral deflection and tower-base moments globally.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風工程報告應明列各攻角的顫振臨界風速、有無交通的差異與試驗模型所含的附屬物；任何欄杆、防撞護欄或檢修軌道的形狀變更都要回到風工程顧問複核。
knowledge.textEn: The wind report should tabulate flutter speeds by angle of attack, with and without traffic, and list the attachments modelled; any change to railings, barriers or inspection rails goes back to the wind consultant for review.

quiz.question: 要驗證「颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck"?
options: 以風洞斷面模型量測不同攻角下的阻力、升力與扭矩係數，並做顫振導數識別。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。
optionsEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients at several angles of attack on section models and identify flutter derivatives.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 以風洞斷面模型量測不同攻角下的阻力、升力與扭矩係數，並做顫振導數識別；把颱風紊流的攻角分布代入顫振分析，確認在最不利攻角下的臨界風速仍高於設計要求，再以全橋分析計算跨中側向撓度與塔底彎矩。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients at several angles of attack on section models and identify flutter derivatives; feed the typhoon turbulence distribution of incidence into the flutter analysis to confirm that the critical speed at the worst angle still exceeds the requirement, then compute mid-span lateral deflection and tower-base moments globally. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中央開槽雙箱梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Split twin-box deck” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以零攻角的試驗結果判定顫振安全，強紊流下的實際攻角可能使臨界風速降低近一半；開槽寬度或橫梁形狀在細部設計中被修改而未重新試驗，也可能出現未預期的渦振或扭轉不穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Judging flutter safety only from zero-incidence results can overlook that real angles of attack in strong turbulence nearly halve the critical speed; altering the gap width or cross-girder shape in detailed design without retesting can introduce unexpected vortex vibration or torsional instability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：公開設計資料顯示，零攻角無車時顫振臨界風速約 95 m/s，但攻角變為 ±5° 時降到約 50 m/s，說明颱風紊流造成的攻角變化才是控制因素。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Published design data show a flutter speed of about 95 m/s at zero incidence without traffic, falling to about 50 m/s at ±5°, so the angle-of-attack changes caused by typhoon turbulence govern.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A wider, heavier deck is always harder for wind to move, so a 1 km span only needs more weight to resist typhoons." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以零攻角的試驗結果判定顫振安全，強紊流下的實際攻角可能使臨界風速降低近一半；開槽寬度或橫梁形狀在細部設計中被修改而未重新試驗，也可能出現未預期的渦振或扭轉不穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Judging flutter safety only from zero-incidence results can overlook that real angles of attack in strong turbulence nearly halve the critical speed; altering the gap width or cross-girder shape in detailed design without retesting can introduce unexpected vortex vibration or torsional instability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只以零攻角的試驗結果判定顫振安全，強紊流下的實際攻角可能使臨界風速降低近一半。
塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Judging flutter safety only from zero-incidence results can overlook that real angles of attack in strong turbulence nearly halve the critical speed.
Fixing the deck rigidly to the tower always makes the bridge most stable.
quiz.explanation: 若只以零攻角的試驗結果判定顫振安全，強紊流下的實際攻角可能使臨界風速降低近一半；開槽寬度或橫梁形狀在細部設計中被修改而未重新試驗，也可能出現未預期的渦振或扭轉不穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Judging flutter safety only from zero-incidence results can overlook that real angles of attack in strong turbulence nearly halve the critical speed; altering the gap width or cross-girder shape in detailed design without retesting can introduce unexpected vortex vibration or torsional instability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔–梁液壓緩衝器」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower–deck hydraulic buffers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 昂船洲大橋兩側背跨各長 289 m，由 79.75、70、70、69.25 m 四跨預力混凝土雙箱梁組成，混凝土的重量提供平衡主跨鋼梁的壓重，密布的背跨橋墩則讓背索錨固點接近固定，提高整體勁度。主跨與背跨連成連續橋面，溫度造成的伸縮必須能自由發生；但颱風陣風、地震與煞車屬於快速荷載，橋面不能任意滑動。因此塔與梁之間在橋面高程設置液壓緩衝器：慢速溫度位移時油可通過孔道，幾乎不產生力；快速荷載時閥門鎖住，緩衝器像剛性連桿把縱向力傳給橋塔。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔–梁液壓緩衝器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each back span of Stonecutters Bridge is 289 m long, made of four prestressed concrete twin-box spans of 79.75, 70, 70 and 69.25 m; the concrete weight ballasts the steel main span, and the closely spaced back-span piers make the back-stay anchor points nearly fixed, raising global stiffness. The main and back spans form a continuous deck whose thermal expansion must occur freely, but typhoon gusts, earthquakes and braking are fast loads under which the deck must not slide. Hydraulic buffers between tower and deck at deck level therefore let oil pass through orifices during slow thermal movement, producing almost no force, and lock under fast loads so the buffer acts as a rigid link carrying longitudinal force to the tower. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tower–deck hydraulic buffers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、L = 560 m、ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.269 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 560 m and ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.269 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fixing the deck rigidly to the tower always makes the bridge most stable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔–梁液壓緩衝器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tower–deck hydraulic buffers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接
knowledge.titleEn: Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection
knowledge.text: 昂船洲大橋兩側背跨各長 289 m，由 79.75、70、70、69.25 m 四跨預力混凝土雙箱梁組成，混凝土的重量提供平衡主跨鋼梁的壓重，密布的背跨橋墩則讓背索錨固點接近固定，提高整體勁度。主跨與背跨連成連續橋面，溫度造成的伸縮必須能自由發生；但颱風陣風、地震與煞車屬於快速荷載，橋面不能任意滑動。
knowledge.textEn: Each back span of Stonecutters Bridge is 289 m long, made of four prestressed concrete twin-box spans of 79.75, 70, 70 and 69.25 m; the concrete weight ballasts the steel main span, and the closely spaced back-span piers make the back-stay anchor points nearly fixed, raising global stiffness. The main and back spans form a continuous deck whose thermal expansion must occur freely, but typhoon gusts, earthquakes and braking are fast loads under which the deck must not slide.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fixing the deck rigidly to the tower always makes the bridge most stable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection" is correct?
options: 塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。
不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。

optionsEn: Fixing the deck rigidly to the tower always makes the bridge most stable.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔–梁液壓緩衝器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tower–deck hydraulic buffers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、L = 560 m、ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.269 m。若這 40 °C 在 6 小時內發生，平均速度 0.269/21,600 ≈ 1.2×10⁻⁵ m/s，遠低於陣風下橋面約 0.1 m/s 的擺動速度，緩衝器可據此區分兩種荷載。背跨與主跨長度比 289/1,018 ≈ 0.28。L 與 ΔT 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 560 m and ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.269 m. If the 40 °C change occurs over 6 hours, the mean velocity is 0.269/21,600 ≈ 1.2×10⁻⁵ m/s, far below the roughly 0.1 m/s deck motion in gusts, so the buffer can distinguish the two. The back-to-main span ratio is 289/1,018 ≈ 0.28. L and ΔT are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：緩衝器出廠以低速蠕動試驗確認溫度位移下的阻力上限，以高速試驗確認鎖定力與鎖定位移；安裝後量測不同季節的塔梁相對位移與溫度回歸，並在颱風事件後檢視紀錄，確認鎖定行為與設計一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Factory-test the buffers at creep speeds to confirm the resistance limit under thermal movement, and at high speed to confirm lock-up force and lock-up displacement; after installation regress tower–deck relative displacement against temperature across seasons and review records after each typhoon to confirm lock-up as designed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、L = 560 m、ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.269 m。若這 40 °C 在 6 小時內發生，平均速度 0.269/21,600 ≈ 1.2×10⁻⁵ m/s，遠低於陣風下橋面約 0.1 m/s 的擺動速度，緩衝器可據此區分兩種荷載。背跨與主跨長度比 289/1,018 ≈ 0.28。L 與 ΔT 為教學假設。

If the 40 °C change occurs over 6 hours, the mean velocity is 0.269/21,600 ≈ 1.2×10⁻⁵ m/s, far below the roughly 0.1 m/s deck motion in gusts, so the buffer can distinguish the two. The back-to-main span ratio is 289/1,018 ≈ 0.28. L and ΔT are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。

steps.title: 混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔–梁液壓緩衝器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tower–deck hydraulic buffers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 緩衝器出廠以低速蠕動試驗確認溫度位移下的阻力上限，以高速試驗確認鎖定力與鎖定位移；安裝後量測不同季節的塔梁相對位移與溫度回歸，並在颱風事件後檢視紀錄，確認鎖定行為與設計一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Factory-test the buffers at creep speeds to confirm the resistance limit under thermal movement, and at high speed to confirm lock-up force and lock-up displacement; after installation regress tower–deck relative displacement against temperature across seasons and review records after each typhoon to confirm lock-up as designed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應規定緩衝器的檢查頻率、漏油判定、行程刻度讀數與颱風後的專項檢查；更換緩衝器時須有臨時縱向約束方案與交通管制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should set buffer inspection frequency, leak criteria, stroke-scale readings and post-typhoon special checks; buffer replacement needs a temporary longitudinal restraint scheme and traffic management.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若緩衝器密封漏油或閥門卡滯，可能在溫度變化時產生不應有的大力，使塔或支承受額外彎矩；反之若鎖定失效，颱風陣風使橋面縱向往復移動，加速伸縮縫與支承磨耗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Leaking seals or a stuck valve can generate large unintended forces during temperature change, adding moment to the tower or bearings; conversely, failed lock-up lets typhoon gusts shuttle the deck longitudinally, accelerating joint and bearing wear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 緩衝器出廠以低速蠕動試驗確認溫度位移下的阻力上限，以高速試驗確認鎖定力與鎖定位移；安裝後量測不同季節的塔梁相對位移與溫度回歸，並在颱風事件後檢視紀錄，確認鎖定行為與設計一致。
knowledge.textEn: Factory-test the buffers at creep speeds to confirm the resistance limit under thermal movement, and at high speed to confirm lock-up force and lock-up displacement; after installation regress tower–deck relative displacement against temperature across seasons and review records after each typhoon to confirm lock-up as designed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊應規定緩衝器的檢查頻率、漏油判定、行程刻度讀數與颱風後的專項檢查；更換緩衝器時須有臨時縱向約束方案與交通管制。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should set buffer inspection frequency, leak criteria, stroke-scale readings and post-typhoon special checks; buffer replacement needs a temporary longitudinal restraint scheme and traffic management.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
緩衝器出廠以低速蠕動試驗確認溫度位移下的阻力上限，以高速試驗確認鎖定力與鎖定位移。
只要混凝土強度高，海水環境下就不會有鋼筋腐蝕問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Factory-test the buffers at creep speeds to confirm the resistance limit under thermal movement, and at high speed to confirm lock-up force and lock-up displacement.
High-strength concrete alone prevents reinforcement corrosion in seawater.
quiz.explanation: 緩衝器出廠以低速蠕動試驗確認溫度位移下的阻力上限，以高速試驗確認鎖定力與鎖定位移；安裝後量測不同季節的塔梁相對位移與溫度回歸，並在颱風事件後檢視紀錄，確認鎖定行為與設計一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Factory-test the buffers at creep speeds to confirm the resistance limit under thermal movement, and at high speed to confirm lock-up force and lock-up displacement; after installation regress tower–deck relative displacement against temperature across seasons and review records after each typhoon to confirm lock-up as designed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔–梁液壓緩衝器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tower–deck hydraulic buffers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若緩衝器密封漏油或閥門卡滯，可能在溫度變化時產生不應有的大力，使塔或支承受額外彎矩；反之若鎖定失效，颱風陣風使橋面縱向往復移動，加速伸縮縫與支承磨耗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Leaking seals or a stuck valve can generate large unintended forces during temperature change, adding moment to the tower or bearings; conversely, failed lock-up lets typhoon gusts shuttle the deck longitudinally, accelerating joint and bearing wear. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此塔與梁之間在橋面高程設置液壓緩衝器：慢速溫度位移時油可通過孔道，幾乎不產生力；快速荷載時閥門鎖住，緩衝器像剛性連桿把縱向力傳給橋塔。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic buffers between tower and deck at deck level therefore let oil pass through orifices during slow thermal movement, producing almost no force, and lock under fast loads so the buffer acts as a rigid link carrying longitudinal force to the tower.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fixing the deck rigidly to the tower always makes the bridge most stable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若緩衝器密封漏油或閥門卡滯，可能在溫度變化時產生不應有的大力，使塔或支承受額外彎矩；反之若鎖定失效，颱風陣風使橋面縱向往復移動，加速伸縮縫與支承磨耗。
knowledge.textEn: Leaking seals or a stuck valve can generate large unintended forces during temperature change, adding moment to the tower or bearings; conversely, failed lock-up lets typhoon gusts shuttle the deck longitudinally, accelerating joint and bearing wear.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。
若緩衝器密封漏油或閥門卡滯，可能在溫度變化時產生不應有的大力，使塔或支承受額外彎矩；反之若鎖定失效，颱風陣風使橋面縱向往復移動，加速伸縮縫與支承磨耗。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load.
Leaking seals or a stuck valve can generate large unintended forces during temperature change, adding moment to the tower or bearings.

quiz.explanationEn: Leaking seals or a stuck valve can generate large unintended forces during temperature change, adding moment to the tower or bearings; conversely, failed lock-up lets typhoon gusts shuttle the deck longitudinally, accelerating joint and bearing wear.
