stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面」與「224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section" and "The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙相不鏽鋼外皮」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duplex stainless skin” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 昂船洲大橋的塔為中空單柱，斷面由下方的橢圓形逐漸收成上方的圓形，塔頂達主水平基準以上約 298 m。約 +175 m 以下為鋼筋混凝土，以上改為鋼—混凝土複合段，外層是雙相不鏽鋼板，不只是飾面，而是與內部混凝土共同受力的結構元件。斜索錨固集中在上塔，需要高勁度與高強度；不鏽鋼外皮同時省去日後高空重新塗裝，降低維護成本與風險。複合段設計重點在剪力釘或連接件把鋼皮與混凝土結合，避免溫差與乾縮使兩者分離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙相不鏽鋼外皮」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Stonecutters towers are hollow monopoles whose section tapers from an ellipse below to a circle above, reaching about +298 mPD. Below about +175 m they are reinforced concrete; above, a steel–concrete composite section with a duplex stainless steel outer skin that is a structural element acting with the concrete, not cladding. Stay anchorages concentrate in the upper tower and need high stiffness and strength, and the stainless skin avoids repainting at height, reducing maintenance cost and risk. The composite design hinges on studs or connectors that bond skin and concrete so temperature differences and shrinkage do not separate them. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Duplex stainless skin” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：換算斷面軸向勁度 EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Transformed axial stiffness EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙相不鏽鋼外皮」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Duplex stainless skin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面
knowledge.titleEn: Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section
knowledge.text: 昂船洲大橋的塔為中空單柱，斷面由下方的橢圓形逐漸收成上方的圓形，塔頂達主水平基準以上約 298 m。約 +175 m 以下為鋼筋混凝土，以上改為鋼—混凝土複合段，外層是雙相不鏽鋼板，不只是飾面，而是與內部混凝土共同受力的結構元件。
knowledge.textEn: The Stonecutters towers are hollow monopoles whose section tapers from an ellipse below to a circle above, reaching about +298 mPD. Below about +175 m they are reinforced concrete; above, a steel–concrete composite section with a duplex stainless steel outer skin that is a structural element acting with the concrete, not cladding.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section" is correct?
options: 昂船洲大橋的塔為中空單柱，斷面由下方的橢圓形逐漸收成上方的圓形，塔頂達主水平基準以上約 298 m。
不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。
同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。
optionsEn: The Stonecutters towers are hollow monopoles whose section tapers from an ellipse below to a circle above, reaching about +298 mPD.
The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load.
All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 昂船洲大橋的塔為中空單柱，斷面由下方的橢圓形逐漸收成上方的圓形，塔頂達主水平基準以上約 298 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Stonecutters towers are hollow monopoles whose section tapers from an ellipse below to a circle above, reaching about +298 mPD. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙相不鏽鋼外皮」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duplex stainless skin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：換算斷面軸向勁度 EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s。取周長 30 m、外皮 20 mm，A_s = 0.6 m²；混凝土 A_c = 18 m²，E_c = 40 GPa、E_s = 200 GPa：E_c·A_c = 720 GN，E_s·A_s = 120 GN，外皮貢獻 120/840 ≈ 14% 的軸向勁度。尺寸為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Transformed axial stiffness EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s. With a 30 m perimeter and 20 mm skin, A_s = 0.6 m²; with A_c = 18 m², E_c = 40 GPa and E_s = 200 GPa, E_c·A_c = 720 GN and E_s·A_s = 120 GN, so the skin supplies 120/840 ≈ 14% of the axial stiffness. Dimensions are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼皮分段在工廠製作時量測真圓度與焊接變形，現場吊裝後以測量確認軸線；剪力連接件做抽樣拉拔或彎曲試驗，混凝土灌注後以敲擊或超音波檢查鋼皮與混凝土是否脫空。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure roundness and weld distortion of skin segments in the shop and survey the axis after erection; proof-test sample shear connectors by pull-out or bend tests, and after concreting check for voids between skin and concrete by tapping or ultrasonic testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 換算斷面軸向勁度 EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s。取周長 30 m、外皮 20 mm，A_s = 0.6 m²；混凝土 A_c = 18 m²，E_c = 40 GPa、E_s = 200 GPa：E_c·A_c = 720 GN，E_s·A_s = 120 GN，外皮貢獻 120/840 ≈ 14% 的軸向勁度。尺寸為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Transformed axial stiffness EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s. With a 30 m perimeter and 20 mm skin, A_s = 0.6 m²; with A_c = 18 m², E_c = 40 GPa and E_s = 200 GPa, E_c·A_c = 720 GN and E_s·A_s = 120 GN, so the skin supplies 120/840 ≈ 14% of the axial stiffness. Dimensions are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section", which statement holds?
options: 鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。
換算斷面軸向勁度 EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s。
大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。
optionsEn: Bolting the steel girder end to the concrete girder end transfers force evenly.
Transformed axial stiffness EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s.
A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 換算斷面軸向勁度 EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Transformed axial stiffness EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙相不鏽鋼外皮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duplex stainless skin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋼皮分段在工廠製作時量測真圓度與焊接變形，現場吊裝後以測量確認軸線；剪力連接件做抽樣拉拔或彎曲試驗，混凝土灌注後以敲擊或超音波檢查鋼皮與混凝土是否脫空。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure roundness and weld distortion of skin segments in the shop and survey the axis after erection; proof-test sample shear connectors by pull-out or bend tests, and after concreting check for voids between skin and concrete by tapping or ultrasonic testing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：複合塔段的施工計畫要規定每節鋼皮的定位公差、混凝土分層澆置高度與側壓限制，以及脫空檢測的抽樣比例；不同金屬接觸點的絕緣細部須在圖上標示。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The composite-tower method statement should set positioning tolerances for each skin segment, concrete lift heights and lateral-pressure limits, and the sampling rate for void detection; insulation details at dissimilar-metal contacts must be shown on the drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若鋼皮與混凝土間灌漿不密實或連接件不足，鋼皮在日照溫差下局部鼓起，複合作用消失，錨固區的應力集中提高；不同金屬接觸處若未隔離，也可能出現電化學腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incomplete concrete fill or too few connectors lets the skin bulge locally under solar temperature differences, losing composite action and raising stress concentrations in the anchorage zone; contact between dissimilar metals without isolation can also cause galvanic corrosion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鋼皮分段在工廠製作時量測真圓度與焊接變形，現場吊裝後以測量確認軸線；剪力連接件做抽樣拉拔或彎曲試驗，混凝土灌注後以敲擊或超音波檢查鋼皮與混凝土是否脫空。
knowledge.textEn: Measure roundness and weld distortion of skin segments in the shop and survey the axis after erection; proof-test sample shear connectors by pull-out or bend tests, and after concreting check for voids between skin and concrete by tapping or ultrasonic testing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 複合塔段的施工計畫要規定每節鋼皮的定位公差、混凝土分層澆置高度與側壓限制，以及脫空檢測的抽樣比例；不同金屬接觸點的絕緣細部須在圖上標示。
knowledge.textEn: The composite-tower method statement should set positioning tolerances for each skin segment, concrete lift heights and lateral-pressure limits, and the sampling rate for void detection; insulation details at dissimilar-metal contacts must be shown on the drawings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
斜拉索索力一旦施工完成就不會再改變，不需要追蹤。
鋼皮分段在工廠製作時量測真圓度與焊接變形，現場吊裝後以測量確認軸線；剪力連接件做抽樣拉拔或彎曲試驗，混凝土灌注後以敲擊或超音波檢查鋼皮與混凝土是否脫空。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Stay forces never change after construction, so they need no tracking.
Measure roundness and weld distortion of skin segments in the shop and survey the axis after erection.
quiz.explanation: 鋼皮分段在工廠製作時量測真圓度與焊接變形，現場吊裝後以測量確認軸線；剪力連接件做抽樣拉拔或彎曲試驗，混凝土灌注後以敲擊或超音波檢查鋼皮與混凝土是否脫空。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure roundness and weld distortion of skin segments in the shop and survey the axis after erection; proof-test sample shear connectors by pull-out or bend tests, and after concreting check for voids between skin and concrete by tapping or ultrasonic testing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙相不鏽鋼外皮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duplex stainless skin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若鋼皮與混凝土間灌漿不密實或連接件不足，鋼皮在日照溫差下局部鼓起，複合作用消失，錨固區的應力集中提高；不同金屬接觸處若未隔離，也可能出現電化學腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incomplete concrete fill or too few connectors lets the skin bulge locally under solar temperature differences, losing composite action and raising stress concentrations in the anchorage zone; contact between dissimilar metals without isolation can also cause galvanic corrosion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：複合段設計重點在剪力釘或連接件把鋼皮與混凝土結合，避免溫差與乾縮使兩者分離。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The composite design hinges on studs or connectors that bond skin and concrete so temperature differences and shrinkage do not separate them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若鋼皮與混凝土間灌漿不密實或連接件不足，鋼皮在日照溫差下局部鼓起，複合作用消失，錨固區的應力集中提高；不同金屬接觸處若未隔離，也可能出現電化學腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Incomplete concrete fill or too few connectors lets the skin bulge locally under solar temperature differences, losing composite action and raising stress concentrations in the anchorage zone; contact between dissimilar metals without isolation can also cause galvanic corrosion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若鋼皮與混凝土間灌漿不密實或連接件不足，鋼皮在日照溫差下局部鼓起，複合作用消失，錨固區的應力集中提高；不同金屬接觸處若未隔離，也可能出現電化學腐蝕。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。
optionsEn: Incomplete concrete fill or too few connectors lets the skin bulge locally under solar temperature differences, losing composite action and raising stress concentrations in the anchorage zone.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 若鋼皮與混凝土間灌漿不密實或連接件不足，鋼皮在日照溫差下局部鼓起，複合作用消失，錨固區的應力集中提高；不同金屬接觸處若未隔離，也可能出現電化學腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Incomplete concrete fill or too few connectors lets the skin bulge locally under solar temperature differences, losing composite action and raising stress concentrations in the anchorage zone; contact between dissimilar metals without isolation can also cause galvanic corrosion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔內錨箱」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower anchor boxes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 全橋 224 根斜拉索以雙索面修正扇形配置，主跨錨距約 18 m、背跨約 10 m，最長約 540 m、單根約 70 t，全部斜索合計約 7,200 t。公開設計資料顯示索的外徑由塔附近的 113 mm（163 根鋼線）增到背跨端的 192 mm（499 根鋼線），因為越靠背跨端的背索要平衡越多主跨重量。上塔內約 1,200 t 的鋼錨箱把各索的集中力分散到塔壁，同時讓張拉設備有作業空間。索徑與鋼線數的變化正好反映了扇形配置下索力的分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔內錨箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bridge has 224 stays in two planes in a modified fan, anchored at about 18 m spacing in the main span and about 10 m in the back spans; the longest is about 540 m and about 70 t, and all stays total about 7,200 t. Published design data show outside diameters rising from 113 mm (163 wires) near the towers to 192 mm (499 wires) toward the back-span ends, because the back stays nearest the ends balance the most main-span weight. Steel anchor boxes of about 1,200 t in the upper towers spread each concentrated stay force into the tower walls and give room for stressing equipment. The change of diameter and wire count mirrors the force distribution in a fan arrangement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tower anchor boxes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assuming 7 mm wires of 1,770 MPa: 499 wires give A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm² and a breaking force of about 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN, with 0.45 of that about 15,300 kN; 163 wires give A ≈ 6,270 mm² and about 11,100 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔內錨箱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tower anchor boxes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置
knowledge.titleEn: The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes
knowledge.text: 全橋 224 根斜拉索以雙索面修正扇形配置，主跨錨距約 18 m、背跨約 10 m，最長約 540 m、單根約 70 t，全部斜索合計約 7,200 t。公開設計資料顯示索的外徑由塔附近的 113 mm（163 根鋼線）增到背跨端的 192 mm（499 根鋼線），因為越靠背跨端的背索要平衡越多主跨重量。
knowledge.textEn: The bridge has 224 stays in two planes in a modified fan, anchored at about 18 m spacing in the main span and about 10 m in the back spans; the longest is about 540 m and about 70 t, and all stays total about 7,200 t. Published design data show outside diameters rising from 113 mm (163 wires) near the towers to 192 mm (499 wires) toward the back-span ends, because the back stays nearest the ends balance the most main-span weight.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes" is correct?
options: 同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。
全橋 224 根斜拉索以雙索面修正扇形配置，主跨錨距約 18 m、背跨約 10 m，最長約 540 m、單根約 70 t，全部斜索合計約 7,200 t。
成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。
optionsEn: All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance.
The bridge has 224 stays in two planes in a modified fan, anchored at about 18 m spacing in the main span and about 10 m in the back spans.
If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too.
quiz.explanation: 全橋 224 根斜拉索以雙索面修正扇形配置，主跨錨距約 18 m、背跨約 10 m，最長約 540 m、單根約 70 t，全部斜索合計約 7,200 t。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bridge has 224 stays in two planes in a modified fan, anchored at about 18 m spacing in the main span and about 10 m in the back spans; the longest is about 540 m and about 70 t, and all stays total about 7,200 t. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔內錨箱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tower anchor boxes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設鋼線直徑 7 mm、抗拉強度 1,770 MPa：499 根 A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm²，破斷力約 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN，0.45 倍約 15,300 kN；163 根 A ≈ 6,270 mm²，破斷力約 11,100 kN。最長索 70 t/540 m ≈ 130 kg/m。鋼線直徑與強度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assuming 7 mm wires of 1,770 MPa: 499 wires give A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm² and a breaking force of about 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN, with 0.45 of that about 15,300 kN; 163 wires give A ≈ 6,270 mm² and about 11,100 kN. The longest stay averages 70 t/540 m ≈ 130 kg/m. Wire size and strength are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：斜索與錨具依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞、破斷與防水試驗，並在 1:1 索段做風雨振試驗；錨箱焊道以超音波檢測，安裝後量測每根索的最終力與錨頭位置，與設計表逐一比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test stay and anchorage assemblies for fatigue, ultimate strength and watertightness under stay-cable recommendations, and test full-scale cable sections for wind and rain vibration; inspect anchor-box welds ultrasonically and after installation compare each stay’s final force and anchor-head position with the design table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設鋼線直徑 7 mm、抗拉強度 1,770 MPa：499 根 A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm²，破斷力約 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN，0.45 倍約 15,300 kN；163 根 A ≈ 6,270 mm²，破斷力約 11,100 kN。最長索 70 t/540 m ≈ 130 kg/m。鋼線直徑與強度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming 7 mm wires of 1,770 MPa: 499 wires give A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm² and a breaking force of about 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN, with 0.45 of that about 15,300 kN; 163 wires give A ≈ 6,270 mm² and about 11,100 kN. The longest stay averages 70 t/540 m ≈ 130 kg/m. Wire size and strength are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes", which statement holds?
options: 風洞模型只要幾何縮尺正確，試驗結果就能直接放大套用到實橋。
只要混凝土強度高，海水環境下就不會有鋼筋腐蝕問題。
optionsEn: If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge.
High-strength concrete alone prevents reinforcement corrosion in seawater.
Assuming 7 mm wires of 1,770 MPa: 499 wires give A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm² and a breaking force of about 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN, with 0.45 of that about 15,300 kN.
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming 7 mm wires of 1,770 MPa: 499 wires give A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm² and a breaking force of about 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN, with 0.45 of that about 15,300 kN; 163 wires give A ≈ 6,270 mm² and about 11,100 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔內錨箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tower anchor boxes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 斜索與錨具依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞、破斷與防水試驗，並在 1:1 索段做風雨振試驗；錨箱焊道以超音波檢測，安裝後量測每根索的最終力與錨頭位置，與設計表逐一比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test stay and anchorage assemblies for fatigue, ultimate strength and watertightness under stay-cable recommendations, and test full-scale cable sections for wind and rain vibration; inspect anchor-box welds ultrasonically and after installation compare each stay’s final force and anchor-head position with the design table. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時要留下每根索的編號、鋼線數、外徑、設計與實測索力、錨具型號及出廠試驗報告；錨箱內要設照明、通風與檢查通道，確保日後能接近錨頭。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover keep each stay’s number, wire count, diameter, design and measured force, anchorage type and test reports; anchor boxes need lighting, ventilation and access so anchor heads can be reached later.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨箱焊道或承壓板細節不當時，反覆的索力變化會在焊趾處產生疲勞裂縫；錨頭防水失效則讓水進入索內，鋼線在錨口附近腐蝕，這個位置正是目視最難檢查的地方。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor anchor-box welds or bearing-plate details let repeated force changes start fatigue cracks at weld toes; failed anchor-head sealing lets water into the cable and corrodes wires near the socket, exactly where visual inspection is hardest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 斜索與錨具依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞、破斷與防水試驗，並在 1:1 索段做風雨振試驗；錨箱焊道以超音波檢測，安裝後量測每根索的最終力與錨頭位置，與設計表逐一比對。
knowledge.textEn: Test stay and anchorage assemblies for fatigue, ultimate strength and watertightness under stay-cable recommendations, and test full-scale cable sections for wind and rain vibration; inspect anchor-box welds ultrasonically and after installation compare each stay’s final force and anchor-head position with the design table.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時要留下每根索的編號、鋼線數、外徑、設計與實測索力、錨具型號及出廠試驗報告；錨箱內要設照明、通風與檢查通道，確保日後能接近錨頭。
knowledge.textEn: At handover keep each stay’s number, wire count, diameter, design and measured force, anchorage type and test reports; anchor boxes need lighting, ventilation and access so anchor heads can be reached later.

quiz.question: 要驗證「224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes"?
options: 斜索與錨具依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞、破斷與防水試驗，並在 1:1 索段做風雨振試驗；錨箱焊道以超音波檢測，安裝後量測每根索的最終力與錨頭位置，與設計表逐一比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。
optionsEn: Test stay and anchorage assemblies for fatigue, ultimate strength and watertightness under stay-cable recommendations, and test full-scale cable sections for wind and rain vibration.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A wider, heavier deck is always harder for wind to move, so a 1 km span only needs more weight to resist typhoons.
quiz.explanation: 斜索與錨具依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞、破斷與防水試驗，並在 1:1 索段做風雨振試驗；錨箱焊道以超音波檢測，安裝後量測每根索的最終力與錨頭位置，與設計表逐一比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test stay and anchorage assemblies for fatigue, ultimate strength and watertightness under stay-cable recommendations, and test full-scale cable sections for wind and rain vibration; inspect anchor-box welds ultrasonically and after installation compare each stay’s final force and anchor-head position with the design table. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔內錨箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tower anchor boxes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨箱焊道或承壓板細節不當時，反覆的索力變化會在焊趾處產生疲勞裂縫；錨頭防水失效則讓水進入索內，鋼線在錨口附近腐蝕，這個位置正是目視最難檢查的地方。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor anchor-box welds or bearing-plate details let repeated force changes start fatigue cracks at weld toes; failed anchor-head sealing lets water into the cable and corrodes wires near the socket, exactly where visual inspection is hardest. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：索徑與鋼線數的變化正好反映了扇形配置下索力的分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The change of diameter and wire count mirrors the force distribution in a fan arrangement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨箱焊道或承壓板細節不當時，反覆的索力變化會在焊趾處產生疲勞裂縫；錨頭防水失效則讓水進入索內，鋼線在錨口附近腐蝕，這個位置正是目視最難檢查的地方。
knowledge.textEn: Poor anchor-box welds or bearing-plate details let repeated force changes start fatigue cracks at weld toes; failed anchor-head sealing lets water into the cable and corrodes wires near the socket, exactly where visual inspection is hardest.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
錨箱焊道或承壓板細節不當時，反覆的索力變化會在焊趾處產生疲勞裂縫；錨頭防水失效則讓水進入索內，鋼線在錨口附近腐蝕，這個位置正是目視最難檢查的地方。
成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Poor anchor-box welds or bearing-plate details let repeated force changes start fatigue cracks at weld toes.
If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too.
quiz.explanation: 錨箱焊道或承壓板細節不當時，反覆的索力變化會在焊趾處產生疲勞裂縫；錨頭防水失效則讓水進入索內，鋼線在錨口附近腐蝕，這個位置正是目視最難檢查的地方。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor anchor-box welds or bearing-plate details let repeated force changes start fatigue cracks at weld toes; failed anchor-head sealing lets water into the cable and corrodes wires near the socket, exactly where visual inspection is hardest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定」與「鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability" and "Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「起重門架與最大懸臂」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lifting gantries and maximum cantilever” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 昂船洲大橋主跨鋼梁在工廠分片製造、再組成節段，以駁船運到橋下，由懸臂端的起重門架垂直吊升，逐段焊接並安裝對應的斜索；靠近塔的一小段鋼梁則在臨時支架上架設。懸臂越伸越長時，結構是兩支各約 500 m 的懸臂，橫向只有塔與斜索支撐，對颱風最為脆弱；吊裝作業又受海峽航運與潮流限制。施工團隊必須規劃颱風來臨前的停工、門架固定與臨時抗風措施，並預估懸臂端在風中的位移與塔底的附加彎矩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「起重門架與最大懸臂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main-span steel was fabricated as panels, assembled into segments, barged under the bridge and lifted vertically by gantries at the cantilever tips, each segment welded in and its stays installed; the short section next to each tower was erected on temporary falsework. As the cantilevers grow, the structure becomes two cantilevers of roughly 500 m supported laterally only by the tower and stays, its most typhoon-vulnerable state, while lifts are also constrained by channel shipping and currents. The team must plan stoppages, gantry tie-downs and temporary wind measures before a typhoon and predict cantilever-tip displacement and the added moment at the tower base. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lifting gantries and maximum cantilever” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂受均布側風 w 時，塔處側向彎矩 M = w·L²/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a cantilever under uniform side wind w, the lateral moment at the tower is M = w·L²/2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「起重門架與最大懸臂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lifting gantries and maximum cantilever”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定
knowledge.titleEn: Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability
knowledge.text: 昂船洲大橋主跨鋼梁在工廠分片製造、再組成節段，以駁船運到橋下，由懸臂端的起重門架垂直吊升，逐段焊接並安裝對應的斜索；靠近塔的一小段鋼梁則在臨時支架上架設。懸臂越伸越長時，結構是兩支各約 500 m 的懸臂，橫向只有塔與斜索支撐，對颱風最為脆弱；吊裝作業又受海峽航運與潮流限制。
knowledge.textEn: The main-span steel was fabricated as panels, assembled into segments, barged under the bridge and lifted vertically by gantries at the cantilever tips, each segment welded in and its stays installed; the short section next to each tower was erected on temporary falsework. As the cantilevers grow, the structure becomes two cantilevers of roughly 500 m supported laterally only by the tower and stays, its most typhoon-vulnerable state, while lifts are also constrained by channel shipping and currents.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability" is correct?
options: 成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。
鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。
昂船洲大橋主跨鋼梁在工廠分片製造、再組成節段，以駁船運到橋下，由懸臂端的起重門架垂直吊升，逐段焊接並安裝對應的斜索；靠近塔的一小段鋼梁則在臨時支架上架設。
optionsEn: If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too.
Bolting the steel girder end to the concrete girder end transfers force evenly.

The main-span steel was fabricated as panels, assembled into segments, barged under the bridge and lifted vertically by gantries at the cantilever tips, each segment welded in and its stays installed.
quiz.explanation: 昂船洲大橋主跨鋼梁在工廠分片製造、再組成節段，以駁船運到橋下，由懸臂端的起重門架垂直吊升，逐段焊接並安裝對應的斜索；靠近塔的一小段鋼梁則在臨時支架上架設。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The main-span steel was fabricated as panels, assembled into segments, barged under the bridge and lifted vertically by gantries at the cantilever tips, each segment welded in and its stays installed; the short section next to each tower was erected on temporary falsework. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「起重門架與最大懸臂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lifting gantries and maximum cantilever” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂受均布側風 w 時，塔處側向彎矩 M = w·L²/2。取 w = 4.9 kN/m、L = 500 m：M = 4.9×500²/2 ≈ 612,500 kN·m；若施工期設計風速使 w 降為 3.9 kN/m，M ≈ 490,000 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a cantilever under uniform side wind w, the lateral moment at the tower is M = w·L²/2. With w = 4.9 kN/m and L = 500 m, M = 4.9×500²/2 ≈ 612,500 kN·m; if the construction-stage design wind reduces w to 3.9 kN/m, M ≈ 490,000 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工階段分析逐一檢查每個懸臂長度下的抗風安全與顫振臨界風速，並在現場設風速計與懸臂端 GNSS；每次吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道封閉，門架與吊具由第三方檢驗，吊裝後量測節段高程與斜索力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The staged analysis checks wind safety and flutter speed at each cantilever length, with anemometers and GNSS at the tip on site; before each lift confirm wind, current and channel closure, have gantries and rigging third-party inspected, and after the lift measure segment levels and stay forces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸臂受均布側風 w 時，塔處側向彎矩 M = w·L²/2。取 w = 4.9 kN/m、L = 500 m：M = 4.9×500²/2 ≈ 612,500 kN·m；若施工期設計風速使 w 降為 3.9 kN/m，M ≈ 490,000 kN·m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a cantilever under uniform side wind w, the lateral moment at the tower is M = w·L²/2. With w = 4.9 kN/m and L = 500 m, M = 4.9×500²/2 ≈ 612,500 kN·m; if the construction-stage design wind reduces w to 3.9 kN/m, M ≈ 490,000 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability", which statement holds?
options: 懸臂受均布側風 w 時，塔處側向彎矩 M = w·L²/2。
大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。
斜拉索索力一旦施工完成就不會再改變，不需要追蹤。
optionsEn: For a cantilever under uniform side wind w, the lateral moment at the tower is M = w·L²/2.
A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe.
Stay forces never change after construction, so they need no tracking.
quiz.explanation: 懸臂受均布側風 w 時，塔處側向彎矩 M = w·L²/2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a cantilever under uniform side wind w, the lateral moment at the tower is M = w·L²/2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「起重門架與最大懸臂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lifting gantries and maximum cantilever” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工階段分析逐一檢查每個懸臂長度下的抗風安全與顫振臨界風速，並在現場設風速計與懸臂端 GNSS；每次吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道封閉，門架與吊具由第三方檢驗，吊裝後量測節段高程與斜索力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The staged analysis checks wind safety and flutter speed at each cantilever length, with anemometers and GNSS at the tip on site; before each lift confirm wind, current and channel closure, have gantries and rigging third-party inspected, and after the lift measure segment levels and stay forces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要訂出各懸臂長度的作業風速上限、颱風警報分級對應的固定程序與人員撤離時點，並把最大懸臂的抗風措施列為停留檢查點，由設計與施工工程師共同確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The method statement should set working wind limits for each cantilever length, securing procedures and evacuation times for each typhoon-signal level, with the maximum-cantilever wind measures a hold point confirmed jointly by the design and construction engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：颱風預警時若懸臂端門架或未焊完的節段沒有可靠固定，強風可能使吊具擺動撞擊結構；最大懸臂狀態下若臨時抗風措施不足，側向位移與塔底彎矩可能超出設計，甚至出現施工期的氣彈振動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If gantries or partly welded segments at the tip are not secured when a typhoon warning is issued, rigging can swing into the structure; at the maximum cantilever, inadequate temporary wind measures can push lateral displacement and tower-base moment beyond design or even trigger construction-stage aeroelastic motion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工階段分析逐一檢查每個懸臂長度下的抗風安全與顫振臨界風速，並在現場設風速計與懸臂端 GNSS；每次吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道封閉，門架與吊具由第三方檢驗，吊裝後量測節段高程與斜索力。
knowledge.textEn: The staged analysis checks wind safety and flutter speed at each cantilever length, with anemometers and GNSS at the tip on site; before each lift confirm wind, current and channel closure, have gantries and rigging third-party inspected, and after the lift measure segment levels and stay forces.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要訂出各懸臂長度的作業風速上限、颱風警報分級對應的固定程序與人員撤離時點，並把最大懸臂的抗風措施列為停留檢查點，由設計與施工工程師共同確認。
knowledge.textEn: The method statement should set working wind limits for each cantilever length, securing procedures and evacuation times for each typhoon-signal level, with the maximum-cantilever wind measures a hold point confirmed jointly by the design and construction engineers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
施工階段分析逐一檢查每個懸臂長度下的抗風安全與顫振臨界風速，並在現場設風速計與懸臂端 GNSS。
塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
The staged analysis checks wind safety and flutter speed at each cantilever length, with anemometers and GNSS at the tip on site.

quiz.explanationEn: The staged analysis checks wind safety and flutter speed at each cantilever length, with anemometers and GNSS at the tip on site; before each lift confirm wind, current and channel closure, have gantries and rigging third-party inspected, and after the lift measure segment levels and stay forces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「起重門架與最大懸臂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lifting gantries and maximum cantilever” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 颱風預警時若懸臂端門架或未焊完的節段沒有可靠固定，強風可能使吊具擺動撞擊結構；最大懸臂狀態下若臨時抗風措施不足，側向位移與塔底彎矩可能超出設計，甚至出現施工期的氣彈振動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If gantries or partly welded segments at the tip are not secured when a typhoon warning is issued, rigging can swing into the structure; at the maximum cantilever, inadequate temporary wind measures can push lateral displacement and tower-base moment beyond design or even trigger construction-stage aeroelastic motion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工團隊必須規劃颱風來臨前的停工、門架固定與臨時抗風措施，並預估懸臂端在風中的位移與塔底的附加彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The team must plan stoppages, gantry tie-downs and temporary wind measures before a typhoon and predict cantilever-tip displacement and the added moment at the tower base.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 颱風預警時若懸臂端門架或未焊完的節段沒有可靠固定，強風可能使吊具擺動撞擊結構；最大懸臂狀態下若臨時抗風措施不足，側向位移與塔底彎矩可能超出設計，甚至出現施工期的氣彈振動。
knowledge.textEn: If gantries or partly welded segments at the tip are not secured when a typhoon warning is issued, rigging can swing into the structure; at the maximum cantilever, inadequate temporary wind measures can push lateral displacement and tower-base moment beyond design or even trigger construction-stage aeroelastic motion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。
颱風預警時若懸臂端門架或未焊完的節段沒有可靠固定，強風可能使吊具擺動撞擊結構。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Bolting the steel girder end to the concrete girder end transfers force evenly.
If gantries or partly welded segments at the tip are not secured when a typhoon warning is issued, rigging can swing into the structure.
quiz.explanation: 颱風預警時若懸臂端門架或未焊完的節段沒有可靠固定，強風可能使吊具擺動撞擊結構；最大懸臂狀態下若臨時抗風措施不足，側向位移與塔底彎矩可能超出設計，甚至出現施工期的氣彈振動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If gantries or partly welded segments at the tip are not secured when a typhoon warning is issued, rigging can swing into the structure; at the maximum cantilever, inadequate temporary wind measures can push lateral displacement and tower-base moment beyond design or even trigger construction-stage aeroelastic motion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「背跨鋼混接頭」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-span steel–concrete junction” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 昂船洲大橋的鋼主梁並不在塔處結束，而是伸入背跨約 49.75 m 後才與混凝土雙箱梁接合。接頭位置選在彎矩與剪力相對溫和處，但仍要傳遞斜索在橋面累積的巨大水平壓力、彎矩與剪力。常見做法是在鋼梁端部設承壓板與格室，內部填混凝土，以剪力釘、開孔鋼板連接件與預力鋼腱把鋼與混凝土綁成一體。接頭兩側勁度差異很大，溫度、乾縮與徐變都會在界面集中應力，因此是全橋細部最複雜的區域之一。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「背跨鋼混接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Stonecutters steel girder does not stop at the towers; it extends about 49.75 m into each back span before joining the concrete twin boxes. The junction is placed where moment and shear are relatively moderate but must still transfer the large horizontal compression accumulated from the stays, plus moment and shear. A common solution uses end bearing plates and cells filled with concrete, with shear studs, perforated-plate connectors and prestressing tendons binding steel and concrete together. Stiffness changes sharply across the junction, and temperature, shrinkage and creep concentrate stress at the interface, making it one of the most complex details of the bridge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Back-span steel–concrete junction” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若接頭需傳遞 100 MN 的水平壓力，其中由剪力釘承擔的部分以每支 150 kN 的設計強度計，需約 100,000/150 ≈ 667 支；若改由承壓板直接承擔一半，剪力釘只需約 334 支。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the junction must transfer 100 MN of horizontal compression and studs carry it at 150 kN design resistance each, about 100,000/150 ≈ 667 studs are needed; if bearing plates take half directly, only about 334 studs are needed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bolting the steel girder end to the concrete girder end transfers force evenly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「背跨鋼混接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Back-span steel–concrete junction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞

knowledge.textEn: The Stonecutters steel girder does not stop at the towers; it extends about 49.75 m into each back span before joining the concrete twin boxes. The junction is placed where moment and shear are relatively moderate but must still transfer the large horizontal compression accumulated from the stays, plus moment and shear.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction" is correct?
options: 昂船洲大橋的鋼主梁並不在塔處結束，而是伸入背跨約 49.75 m 後才與混凝土雙箱梁接合。
鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。
