optionsEn: The Stonecutters steel girder does not stop at the towers; it extends about 49.75 m into each back span before joining the concrete twin boxes.
Bolting the steel girder end to the concrete girder end transfers force evenly.
If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge.
quiz.explanation: 昂船洲大橋的鋼主梁並不在塔處結束，而是伸入背跨約 49.75 m 後才與混凝土雙箱梁接合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Stonecutters steel girder does not stop at the towers; it extends about 49.75 m into each back span before joining the concrete twin boxes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背跨鋼混接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-span steel–concrete junction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若接頭需傳遞 100 MN 的水平壓力，其中由剪力釘承擔的部分以每支 150 kN 的設計強度計，需約 100,000/150 ≈ 667 支；若改由承壓板直接承擔一半，剪力釘只需約 334 支。力量與釘強度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the junction must transfer 100 MN of horizontal compression and studs carry it at 150 kN design resistance each, about 100,000/150 ≈ 667 studs are needed; if bearing plates take half directly, only about 334 studs are needed. Force and stud resistance are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以局部有限元素模型分析承壓板、格室與連接件的應力分布，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證荷重—滑移行為；現場檢查剪力釘焊接（彎曲試驗）、格室混凝土密實度與預力鋼腱的伸長量紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse bearing plates, cells and connectors with a local finite-element model and verify load–slip behaviour on scaled or full-size specimens; on site check stud welds by bend testing, concrete compaction in the cells and elongation records of the tendons.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若接頭需傳遞 100 MN 的水平壓力，其中由剪力釘承擔的部分以每支 150 kN 的設計強度計，需約 100,000/150 ≈ 667 支；若改由承壓板直接承擔一半，剪力釘只需約 334 支。力量與釘強度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the junction must transfer 100 MN of horizontal compression and studs carry it at 150 kN design resistance each, about 100,000/150 ≈ 667 studs are needed; if bearing plates take half directly, only about 334 studs are needed. Force and stud resistance are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction", which statement holds?
options: 只要混凝土強度高，海水環境下就不會有鋼筋腐蝕問題。
若接頭需傳遞 100 MN 的水平壓力，其中由剪力釘承擔的部分以每支 150 kN 的設計強度計，需約 100,000/150 ≈ 667 支。
橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。
optionsEn: High-strength concrete alone prevents reinforcement corrosion in seawater.
If the junction must transfer 100 MN of horizontal compression and studs carry it at 150 kN design resistance each, about 100,000/150 ≈ 667 studs are needed.
A wider, heavier deck is always harder for wind to move, so a 1 km span only needs more weight to resist typhoons.
quiz.explanation: 若接頭需傳遞 100 MN 的水平壓力，其中由剪力釘承擔的部分以每支 150 kN 的設計強度計，需約 100,000/150 ≈ 667 支；若改由承壓板直接承擔一半，剪力釘只需約 334 支。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the junction must transfer 100 MN of horizontal compression and studs carry it at 150 kN design resistance each, about 100,000/150 ≈ 667 studs are needed; if bearing plates take half directly, only about 334 studs are needed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背跨鋼混接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Back-span steel–concrete junction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以局部有限元素模型分析承壓板、格室與連接件的應力分布，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證荷重—滑移行為；現場檢查剪力釘焊接（彎曲試驗）、格室混凝土密實度與預力鋼腱的伸長量紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse bearing plates, cells and connectors with a local finite-element model and verify load–slip behaviour on scaled or full-size specimens; on site check stud welds by bend testing, concrete compaction in the cells and elongation records of the tendons. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接頭格室的混凝土澆置要有排氣孔與觀察孔，並以試拌與模擬澆置確認流動性；施工紀錄要保存剪力釘檢測與預力張拉資料，作為日後評估接頭狀態的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Cells at the junction need vent and inspection holes, with flowability proven by trial mixes and mock-up pours; keep stud-test and tendon-stressing records as the basis for later condition assessment of the junction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：格室混凝土不密實或剪力釘焊接不良，會讓接頭出現界面滑移與裂縫，水分沿界面滲入造成鋼材與鋼筋腐蝕；長期徐變重分配若未納入設計，接頭附近的混凝土可能開裂，鋼梁端部出現疲勞熱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poorly compacted cell concrete or bad stud welds let the interface slip and crack, admitting water that corrodes steel and reinforcement; if long-term creep redistribution is not designed for, concrete near the junction can crack and fatigue hot spots appear at the steel ends. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以局部有限元素模型分析承壓板、格室與連接件的應力分布，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證荷重—滑移行為；現場檢查剪力釘焊接（彎曲試驗）、格室混凝土密實度與預力鋼腱的伸長量紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse bearing plates, cells and connectors with a local finite-element model and verify load–slip behaviour on scaled or full-size specimens; on site check stud welds by bend testing, concrete compaction in the cells and elongation records of the tendons.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接頭格室的混凝土澆置要有排氣孔與觀察孔，並以試拌與模擬澆置確認流動性；施工紀錄要保存剪力釘檢測與預力張拉資料，作為日後評估接頭狀態的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Cells at the junction need vent and inspection holes, with flowability proven by trial mixes and mock-up pours; keep stud-test and tendon-stressing records as the basis for later condition assessment of the junction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。
以局部有限元素模型分析承壓板、格室與連接件的應力分布，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證荷重—滑移行為。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load.
Analyse bearing plates, cells and connectors with a local finite-element model and verify load–slip behaviour on scaled or full-size specimens.
quiz.explanation: 以局部有限元素模型分析承壓板、格室與連接件的應力分布，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證荷重—滑移行為；現場檢查剪力釘焊接（彎曲試驗）、格室混凝土密實度與預力鋼腱的伸長量紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyse bearing plates, cells and connectors with a local finite-element model and verify load–slip behaviour on scaled or full-size specimens; on site check stud welds by bend testing, concrete compaction in the cells and elongation records of the tendons. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背跨鋼混接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Back-span steel–concrete junction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 格室混凝土不密實或剪力釘焊接不良，會讓接頭出現界面滑移與裂縫，水分沿界面滲入造成鋼材與鋼筋腐蝕；長期徐變重分配若未納入設計，接頭附近的混凝土可能開裂，鋼梁端部出現疲勞熱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poorly compacted cell concrete or bad stud welds let the interface slip and crack, admitting water that corrodes steel and reinforcement; if long-term creep redistribution is not designed for, concrete near the junction can crack and fatigue hot spots appear at the steel ends. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接頭兩側勁度差異很大，溫度、乾縮與徐變都會在界面集中應力，因此是全橋細部最複雜的區域之一。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stiffness changes sharply across the junction, and temperature, shrinkage and creep concentrate stress at the interface, making it one of the most complex details of the bridge.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bolting the steel girder end to the concrete girder end transfers force evenly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 格室混凝土不密實或剪力釘焊接不良，會讓接頭出現界面滑移與裂縫，水分沿界面滲入造成鋼材與鋼筋腐蝕；長期徐變重分配若未納入設計，接頭附近的混凝土可能開裂，鋼梁端部出現疲勞熱點。
knowledge.textEn: Poorly compacted cell concrete or bad stud welds let the interface slip and crack, admitting water that corrodes steel and reinforcement; if long-term creep redistribution is not designed for, concrete near the junction can crack and fatigue hot spots appear at the steel ends.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 格室混凝土不密實或剪力釘焊接不良，會讓接頭出現界面滑移與裂縫，水分沿界面滲入造成鋼材與鋼筋腐蝕。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
風洞模型只要幾何縮尺正確，試驗結果就能直接放大套用到實橋。
optionsEn: Poorly compacted cell concrete or bad stud welds let the interface slip and crack, admitting water that corrodes steel and reinforcement.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge.
quiz.explanation: 格室混凝土不密實或剪力釘焊接不良，會讓接頭出現界面滑移與裂縫，水分沿界面滲入造成鋼材與鋼筋腐蝕；長期徐變重分配若未納入設計，接頭附近的混凝土可能開裂，鋼梁端部出現疲勞熱點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poorly compacted cell concrete or bad stud welds let the interface slip and crack, admitting water that corrodes steel and reinforcement; if long-term creep redistribution is not designed for, concrete near the junction can crack and fatigue hot spots appear at the steel ends. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形」與「跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain" and "Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雷諾數效應」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reynolds-number effects” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開設計資料指出，昂船洲大橋做了 1:80 與 1:20 兩種比例的橋面斷面風洞試驗、1:1 的斜索試驗以及 1:1,500 的地形模型試驗。原因在於風洞模型無法同時滿足所有相似律：小比例模型的雷諾數比實橋小數百倍，流線形箱梁圓角處的分離點可能與實橋不同，使渦振與氣動係數失真；較大的 1:20 模型提高雷諾數以檢核這種敏感性。地形模型則用來取得周邊山體與城市對來風的紊流與風速剖面，作為斷面試驗的輸入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雷諾數效應」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Published design data state that Stonecutters Bridge was tested with deck section models at 1:80 and 1:20, full-scale 1:1 stay tests and a 1:1,500 terrain model. No wind-tunnel model can satisfy every similarity law: a small model’s Reynolds number is hundreds of times below full scale, so flow separation at the rounded corners of a streamlined box may differ from reality and distort vortex response and aerodynamic coefficients; the larger 1:20 model raises the Reynolds number to check this sensitivity. The terrain model provides turbulence and wind profiles from the surrounding hills and city as input to the section tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Reynolds-number effects” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雷諾數 Re = U·D/ν，ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Reynolds number Re = U·D/ν with ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風洞模型只要幾何縮尺正確，試驗結果就能直接放大套用到實橋。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雷諾數效應」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Reynolds-number effects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形
knowledge.titleEn: Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain
knowledge.text: 公開設計資料指出，昂船洲大橋做了 1:80 與 1:20 兩種比例的橋面斷面風洞試驗、1:1 的斜索試驗以及 1:1,500 的地形模型試驗。原因在於風洞模型無法同時滿足所有相似律：小比例模型的雷諾數比實橋小數百倍，流線形箱梁圓角處的分離點可能與實橋不同，使渦振與氣動係數失真；較大的 1:20 模型提高雷諾數以檢核這種敏感性。
knowledge.textEn: Published design data state that Stonecutters Bridge was tested with deck section models at 1:80 and 1:20, full-scale 1:1 stay tests and a 1:1,500 terrain model. No wind-tunnel model can satisfy every similarity law: a small model’s Reynolds number is hundreds of times below full scale, so flow separation at the rounded corners of a streamlined box may differ from reality and distort vortex response and aerodynamic coefficients; the larger 1:20 model raises the Reynolds number to check this sensitivity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風洞模型只要幾何縮尺正確，試驗結果就能直接放大套用到實橋。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain" is correct?
options: 風洞模型只要幾何縮尺正確，試驗結果就能直接放大套用到實橋。
公開設計資料指出，昂船洲大橋做了 1:80 與 1:20 兩種比例的橋面斷面風洞試驗、1:1 的斜索試驗以及 1:1,500 的地形模型試驗。
大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。
optionsEn: If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge.
Published design data state that Stonecutters Bridge was tested with deck section models at 1:80 and 1:20, full-scale 1:1 stay tests and a 1:1,500 terrain model.
A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 公開設計資料指出，昂船洲大橋做了 1:80 與 1:20 兩種比例的橋面斷面風洞試驗、1:1 的斜索試驗以及 1:1,500 的地形模型試驗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Published design data state that Stonecutters Bridge was tested with deck section models at 1:80 and 1:20, full-scale 1:1 stay tests and a 1:1,500 terrain model. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷諾數效應」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reynolds-number effects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雷諾數 Re = U·D/ν，ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s。1:80 模型 D = 0.05 m、U = 10 m/s：Re ≈ 3.3×10⁴；實橋 D = 4 m、U = 50 m/s：Re ≈ 1.3×10⁷，相差約 400 倍；1:20 模型 D = 0.2 m、U = 10 m/s 時 Re ≈ 1.3×10⁵，差距縮小到約 100 倍。尺寸與風速為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Reynolds number Re = U·D/ν with ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s. A 1:80 model with D = 0.05 m at 10 m/s gives Re ≈ 3.3×10⁴; the bridge with D = 4 m at 50 m/s gives Re ≈ 1.3×10⁷, about 400 times higher; a 1:20 model with D = 0.2 m at 10 m/s gives Re ≈ 1.3×10⁵, narrowing the gap to about 100 times. Dimensions and speeds are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較兩種比例模型在相同折算風速下的氣動係數與渦振振幅，若差異顯著，以較大比例或表面粗糙化處理推估實橋行為；地形模型量測的紊流強度與積分尺度要與現場風速計長期資料互相校核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare aerodynamic coefficients and vortex amplitudes of the two model scales at the same reduced velocity; where they differ significantly, infer full-scale behaviour from the larger scale or with surface roughening; cross-check turbulence intensity and integral scales from the terrain model against long-term site anemometer data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 雷諾數 Re = U·D/ν，ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s。1:80 模型 D = 0.05 m、U = 10 m/s：Re ≈ 3.3×10⁴；實橋 D = 4 m、U = 50 m/s：Re ≈ 1.3×10⁷，相差約 400 倍；1:20 模型 D = 0.2 m、U = 10 m/s 時 Re ≈ 1.3×10⁵，差距縮小到約 100 倍。尺寸與風速為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Reynolds number Re = U·D/ν with ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s. A 1:80 model with D = 0.05 m at 10 m/s gives Re ≈ 3.3×10⁴; the bridge with D = 4 m at 50 m/s gives Re ≈ 1.3×10⁷, about 400 times higher; a 1:20 model with D = 0.2 m at 10 m/s gives Re ≈ 1.3×10⁵, narrowing the gap to about 100 times. Dimensions and speeds are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain", which statement holds?
options: 斜拉索索力一旦施工完成就不會再改變，不需要追蹤。
塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。
雷諾數 Re = U·D/ν，ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s。
optionsEn: Stay forces never change after construction, so they need no tracking.
Fixing the deck rigidly to the tower always makes the bridge most stable.
Reynolds number Re = U·D/ν with ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s.
quiz.explanation: 雷諾數 Re = U·D/ν，ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Reynolds number Re = U·D/ν with ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雷諾數效應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reynolds-number effects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較兩種比例模型在相同折算風速下的氣動係數與渦振振幅，若差異顯著，以較大比例或表面粗糙化處理推估實橋行為；地形模型量測的紊流強度與積分尺度要與現場風速計長期資料互相校核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare aerodynamic coefficients and vortex amplitudes of the two model scales at the same reduced velocity; where they differ significantly, infer full-scale behaviour from the larger scale or with surface roughening; cross-check turbulence intensity and integral scales from the terrain model against long-term site anemometer data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風洞試驗規範應寫明模型比例、相似律取捨、雷諾數敏感性檢核與附屬物細節；通車後安排實橋風速與加速度監測，回饋驗證試驗推估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The wind-testing specification should state model scales, which similarity laws are relaxed, Reynolds-sensitivity checks and attachment details; after opening, arrange full-scale wind and acceleration monitoring to validate the test predictions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依小比例模型認定沒有渦振，實橋在較高雷諾數下的分離行為改變，可能出現模型未預測的振動；反之也可能因模型過度保守而增加不必要的導流板或阻尼裝置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Relying on a small model alone to rule out vortex vibration can miss oscillation that appears at full-scale Reynolds numbers where separation changes; the opposite error adds unnecessary fairings or dampers because the model was over-conservative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較兩種比例模型在相同折算風速下的氣動係數與渦振振幅，若差異顯著，以較大比例或表面粗糙化處理推估實橋行為；地形模型量測的紊流強度與積分尺度要與現場風速計長期資料互相校核。
knowledge.textEn: Compare aerodynamic coefficients and vortex amplitudes of the two model scales at the same reduced velocity; where they differ significantly, infer full-scale behaviour from the larger scale or with surface roughening; cross-check turbulence intensity and integral scales from the terrain model against long-term site anemometer data.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風洞試驗規範應寫明模型比例、相似律取捨、雷諾數敏感性檢核與附屬物細節；通車後安排實橋風速與加速度監測，回饋驗證試驗推估。
knowledge.textEn: The wind-testing specification should state model scales, which similarity laws are relaxed, Reynolds-sensitivity checks and attachment details; after opening, arrange full-scale wind and acceleration monitoring to validate the test predictions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain"?
options: 比較兩種比例模型在相同折算風速下的氣動係數與渦振振幅，若差異顯著，以較大比例或表面粗糙化處理推估實橋行為。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。
optionsEn: Compare aerodynamic coefficients and vortex amplitudes of the two model scales at the same reduced velocity.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 比較兩種比例模型在相同折算風速下的氣動係數與渦振振幅，若差異顯著，以較大比例或表面粗糙化處理推估實橋行為；地形模型量測的紊流強度與積分尺度要與現場風速計長期資料互相校核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare aerodynamic coefficients and vortex amplitudes of the two model scales at the same reduced velocity; where they differ significantly, infer full-scale behaviour from the larger scale or with surface roughening; cross-check turbulence intensity and integral scales from the terrain model against long-term site anemometer data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷諾數效應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reynolds-number effects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依小比例模型認定沒有渦振，實橋在較高雷諾數下的分離行為改變，可能出現模型未預測的振動；反之也可能因模型過度保守而增加不必要的導流板或阻尼裝置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Relying on a small model alone to rule out vortex vibration can miss oscillation that appears at full-scale Reynolds numbers where separation changes; the opposite error adds unnecessary fairings or dampers because the model was over-conservative. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地形模型則用來取得周邊山體與城市對來風的紊流與風速剖面，作為斷面試驗的輸入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The terrain model provides turbulence and wind profiles from the surrounding hills and city as input to the section tests.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風洞模型只要幾何縮尺正確，試驗結果就能直接放大套用到實橋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依小比例模型認定沒有渦振，實橋在較高雷諾數下的分離行為改變，可能出現模型未預測的振動；反之也可能因模型過度保守而增加不必要的導流板或阻尼裝置。
knowledge.textEn: Relying on a small model alone to rule out vortex vibration can miss oscillation that appears at full-scale Reynolds numbers where separation changes; the opposite error adds unnecessary fairings or dampers because the model was over-conservative.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只依小比例模型認定沒有渦振，實橋在較高雷諾數下的分離行為改變，可能出現模型未預測的振動；反之也可能因模型過度保守而增加不必要的導流板或阻尼裝置。
大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Relying on a small model alone to rule out vortex vibration can miss oscillation that appears at full-scale Reynolds numbers where separation changes.
A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 若只依小比例模型認定沒有渦振，實橋在較高雷諾數下的分離行為改變，可能出現模型未預測的振動；反之也可能因模型過度保守而增加不必要的導流板或阻尼裝置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Relying on a small model alone to rule out vortex vibration can miss oscillation that appears at full-scale Reynolds numbers where separation changes; the opposite error adds unnecessary fairings or dampers because the model was over-conservative. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「跨中 GNSS 測點」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mid-span GNSS stations” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 香港路政署公開資料指出，昂船洲大橋跨中在交通荷載下撓度可達約 1.8 m，在風荷載下可達約 2.2 m。這樣大的位移是千米跨斜張橋的正常行為，而非缺陷，但也代表伸縮縫、支承、緩衝器與路面都必須容許相應的變形。監測系統以 GNSS、加速度計、應變計、溫度計與風速計記錄橋梁反應，工程師要把實測撓度依溫度、交通與風況分類，才能和設計預測公平比較，並從長期趨勢找出支承卡滯、索力變化或基礎沉陷的徵兆。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跨中 GNSS 測點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hong Kong Highways Department data state that Stonecutters Bridge can deflect about 1.8 m at mid-span under traffic and about 2.2 m under wind. Such movements are normal for a 1 km cable-stayed span, not defects, but they require joints, bearings, buffers and surfacing to accommodate them. The monitoring system records response with GNSS, accelerometers, strain gauges, thermometers and anemometers, and engineers must sort measured deflections by temperature, traffic and wind before comparing them fairly with predictions, then look for signs of seized bearings, stay-force change or foundation settlement in long-term trends. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mid-span GNSS stations” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Deflection-to-span ratios are 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566 for traffic and 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463 for wind.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「跨中 GNSS 測點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mid-span GNSS stations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀
knowledge.text: 香港路政署公開資料指出，昂船洲大橋跨中在交通荷載下撓度可達約 1.8 m，在風荷載下可達約 2.2 m。這樣大的位移是千米跨斜張橋的正常行為，而非缺陷，但也代表伸縮縫、支承、緩衝器與路面都必須容許相應的變形。
knowledge.textEn: Hong Kong Highways Department data state that Stonecutters Bridge can deflect about 1.8 m at mid-span under traffic and about 2.2 m under wind. Such movements are normal for a 1 km cable-stayed span, not defects, but they require joints, bearings, buffers and surfacing to accommodate them.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation" is correct?
options: 大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。
只要混凝土強度高，海水環境下就不會有鋼筋腐蝕問題。
香港路政署公開資料指出，昂船洲大橋跨中在交通荷載下撓度可達約 1.8 m，在風荷載下可達約 2.2 m。
optionsEn: A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe.
High-strength concrete alone prevents reinforcement corrosion in seawater.
Hong Kong Highways Department data state that Stonecutters Bridge can deflect about 1.8 m at mid-span under traffic and about 2.2 m under wind.
quiz.explanation: 香港路政署公開資料指出，昂船洲大橋跨中在交通荷載下撓度可達約 1.8 m，在風荷載下可達約 2.2 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hong Kong Highways Department data state that Stonecutters Bridge can deflect about 1.8 m at mid-span under traffic and about 2.2 m under wind. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨中 GNSS 測點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mid-span GNSS stations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：撓跨比：交通 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566，風 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463。若 GNSS 定位精度 ±15 mm，相對交通撓度的量測誤差約 15/1,800 ≈ 0.8%，足以追蹤 5% 量級的勁度變化。精度為教學假設，撓度為公開資料。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Deflection-to-span ratios are 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566 for traffic and 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463 for wind. With ±15 mm GNSS precision, the error relative to the traffic deflection is about 15/1,800 ≈ 0.8%, enough to track stiffness changes of the order of 5%. The precision is a teaching assumption; the deflections are published values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以動態地磅或交通攝影辨識重車事件，計算單位車重的撓度影響線並與模型比較；以颱風事件資料比對風速—撓度曲線；感測器每年校正，GNSS 基準站設在穩定地點，並與精密水準定期比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify heavy-vehicle events with weigh-in-motion or traffic cameras, compute deflection influence lines per unit vehicle weight and compare with the model; compare wind speed–deflection curves from typhoon records; calibrate sensors yearly, place the GNSS reference station on stable ground and cross-check periodically with precise levelling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 撓跨比：交通 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566，風 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463。若 GNSS 定位精度 ±15 mm，相對交通撓度的量測誤差約 15/1,800 ≈ 0.8%，足以追蹤 5% 量級的勁度變化。精度為教學假設，撓度為公開資料。
knowledge.textEn: Deflection-to-span ratios are 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566 for traffic and 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463 for wind. With ±15 mm GNSS precision, the error relative to the traffic deflection is about 15/1,800 ≈ 0.8%, enough to track stiffness changes of the order of 5%. The precision is a teaching assumption; the deflections are published values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。
不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。
optionsEn: Deflection-to-span ratios are 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566 for traffic and 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463 for wind.
A wider, heavier deck is always harder for wind to move, so a 1 km span only needs more weight to resist typhoons.
The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load.
quiz.explanationEn: Deflection-to-span ratios are 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566 for traffic and 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463 for wind. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨中 GNSS 測點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mid-span GNSS stations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以動態地磅或交通攝影辨識重車事件，計算單位車重的撓度影響線並與模型比較；以颱風事件資料比對風速—撓度曲線；感測器每年校正，GNSS 基準站設在穩定地點，並與精密水準定期比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify heavy-vehicle events with weigh-in-motion or traffic cameras, compute deflection influence lines per unit vehicle weight and compare with the model; compare wind speed–deflection curves from typhoon records; calibrate sensors yearly, place the GNSS reference station on stable ground and cross-check periodically with precise levelling. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測報告要以「荷載分類後的殘差趨勢」呈現，而不是原始讀數；警戒值應依設計預測加上量測不確定度設定，並寫明超限時的通報對象與現場複核程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Monitoring reports should present residual trends after load classification, not raw readings; alert levels should be set from design predictions plus measurement uncertainty, stating who is notified and how field verification proceeds when exceeded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把颱風或高溫時的大撓度誤判為結構劣化，可能做出不必要的封橋決策；反之若未做溫度與交通分類，真正的勁度下降可能隱藏在日常變動中，直到伸縮縫行程不足才被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misreading large typhoon or hot-weather deflections as deterioration can trigger unnecessary closures; without temperature and traffic sorting, a genuine stiffness loss can hide in daily variation until joint travel runs out. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以動態地磅或交通攝影辨識重車事件，計算單位車重的撓度影響線並與模型比較；以颱風事件資料比對風速—撓度曲線；感測器每年校正，GNSS 基準站設在穩定地點，並與精密水準定期比對。
knowledge.textEn: Identify heavy-vehicle events with weigh-in-motion or traffic cameras, compute deflection influence lines per unit vehicle weight and compare with the model; compare wind speed–deflection curves from typhoon records; calibrate sensors yearly, place the GNSS reference station on stable ground and cross-check periodically with precise levelling.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測報告要以「荷載分類後的殘差趨勢」呈現，而不是原始讀數；警戒值應依設計預測加上量測不確定度設定，並寫明超限時的通報對象與現場複核程序。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring reports should present residual trends after load classification, not raw readings; alert levels should be set from design predictions plus measurement uncertainty, stating who is notified and how field verification proceeds when exceeded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以動態地磅或交通攝影辨識重車事件，計算單位車重的撓度影響線並與模型比較。
成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Identify heavy-vehicle events with weigh-in-motion or traffic cameras, compute deflection influence lines per unit vehicle weight and compare with the model.
If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too.
quiz.explanation: 以動態地磅或交通攝影辨識重車事件，計算單位車重的撓度影響線並與模型比較；以颱風事件資料比對風速—撓度曲線；感測器每年校正，GNSS 基準站設在穩定地點，並與精密水準定期比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify heavy-vehicle events with weigh-in-motion or traffic cameras, compute deflection influence lines per unit vehicle weight and compare with the model; compare wind speed–deflection curves from typhoon records; calibrate sensors yearly, place the GNSS reference station on stable ground and cross-check periodically with precise levelling. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨中 GNSS 測點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mid-span GNSS stations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把颱風或高溫時的大撓度誤判為結構劣化，可能做出不必要的封橋決策；反之若未做溫度與交通分類，真正的勁度下降可能隱藏在日常變動中，直到伸縮縫行程不足才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Misreading large typhoon or hot-weather deflections as deterioration can trigger unnecessary closures; without temperature and traffic sorting, a genuine stiffness loss can hide in daily variation until joint travel runs out. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測系統以 GNSS、加速度計、應變計、溫度計與風速計記錄橋梁反應，工程師要把實測撓度依溫度、交通與風況分類，才能和設計預測公平比較，並從長期趨勢找出支承卡滯、索力變化或基礎沉陷的徵兆。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The monitoring system records response with GNSS, accelerometers, strain gauges, thermometers and anemometers, and engineers must sort measured deflections by temperature, traffic and wind before comparing them fairly with predictions, then look for signs of seized bearings, stay-force change or foundation settlement in long-term trends.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把颱風或高溫時的大撓度誤判為結構劣化，可能做出不必要的封橋決策；反之若未做溫度與交通分類，真正的勁度下降可能隱藏在日常變動中，直到伸縮縫行程不足才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Misreading large typhoon or hot-weather deflections as deterioration can trigger unnecessary closures; without temperature and traffic sorting, a genuine stiffness loss can hide in daily variation until joint travel runs out.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要混凝土強度高，海水環境下就不會有鋼筋腐蝕問題。
若把颱風或高溫時的大撓度誤判為結構劣化，可能做出不必要的封橋決策；反之若未做溫度與交通分類，真正的勁度下降可能隱藏在日常變動中，直到伸縮縫行程不足才被發現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High-strength concrete alone prevents reinforcement corrosion in seawater.
Misreading large typhoon or hot-weather deflections as deterioration can trigger unnecessary closures.
quiz.explanation: 若把颱風或高溫時的大撓度誤判為結構劣化，可能做出不必要的封橋決策；反之若未做溫度與交通分類，真正的勁度下降可能隱藏在日常變動中，直到伸縮縫行程不足才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Misreading large typhoon or hot-weather deflections as deterioration can trigger unnecessary closures; without temperature and traffic sorting, a genuine stiffness loss can hide in daily variation until joint travel runs out. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「海洋環境下塔與基礎的耐久設計」與「長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Durability of lower towers and foundations in a marine setting" and "Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 海洋環境下塔與基礎的耐久設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Durability of lower towers and foundations in a marine setting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「下塔不鏽鋼鋼筋」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stainless reinforcement in the lower tower” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 昂船洲大橋下塔位於海水飛濺與潮汐乾濕交替區，氯離子是鋼筋腐蝕的主要驅動力。公開資料指出下塔為使用不鏽鋼鋼筋的鋼筋混凝土，基礎為擴底鑽掘樁，岩盤深度約在 −40 m 至 −90 m 之間，並考慮負摩擦力。氯離子由表面向內擴散，到達鋼筋位置且濃度超過臨界值後，碳鋼鋼筋開始腐蝕並膨脹剝落；不鏽鋼鋼筋的臨界氯離子濃度高得多，可大幅延後腐蝕起始，適合用在最難維修的高風險區。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「下塔不鏽鋼鋼筋」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Stonecutters lower towers sit in the seawater splash and tidal zone, where chloride drives reinforcement corrosion. Published data state the lower towers are reinforced concrete with stainless steel bars, and the foundations are bored piles with enlarged bases, with bedrock at roughly −40 m to −90 m and negative skin friction considered. Chlorides diffuse inward from the surface, and once they reach the bars above a threshold, carbon-steel bars start corroding, expand and spall the cover; stainless bars tolerate a much higher chloride threshold, greatly delaying corrosion onset, which suits the highest-risk zones that are hardest to repair. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stainless reinforcement in the lower tower” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：氯離子前緣深度約 x ≈ 2√(D·t)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The chloride front depth is roughly x ≈ 2√(D·t).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要混凝土強度高，海水環境下就不會有鋼筋腐蝕問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High-strength concrete alone prevents reinforcement corrosion in seawater." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stainless reinforcement in the lower tower”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 海洋環境下塔與基礎的耐久設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Durability of lower towers and foundations in a marine setting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「下塔不鏽鋼鋼筋」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stainless reinforcement in the lower tower” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：氯離子前緣深度約 x ≈ 2√(D·t)。取 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、t = 120 年（約 3.79×10⁹ s）：x ≈ 2√(3.79×10⁻³) ≈ 0.123 m；若以低滲透混凝土使 D = 3×10⁻¹³ m²/s，x ≈ 0.067 m。前者已超過 75 mm 保護層，說明需搭配不鏽鋼鋼筋或更低滲透率。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The chloride front depth is roughly x ≈ 2√(D·t). With D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and t = 120 years (about 3.79×10⁹ s), x ≈ 2√(3.79×10⁻³) ≈ 0.123 m; a low-permeability concrete with D = 3×10⁻¹³ m²/s gives x ≈ 0.067 m. The first exceeds a 75 mm cover, showing the need for stainless bars or lower permeability. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工時以試體量測氯離子擴散係數與保護層厚度（鋼筋掃描儀），營運期定期鑽取粉末或岩心量測氯離子剖面，擬合表面濃度與擴散係數，推估腐蝕起始時間；基礎則以沉陷監測與水下檢查確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During construction measure chloride diffusion on specimens and cover with a covermeter; in service periodically sample dust or cores for chloride profiles, fit surface concentration and diffusion coefficient and project corrosion onset; check foundations with settlement monitoring and underwater inspection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and t = 120 years (about 3.79×10⁹ s), x ≈ 2√(3.79×10⁻³) ≈ 0.123 m; a low-permeability concrete with D = 3×10⁻¹³ m²/s gives x ≈ 0.067 m. The first exceeds a 75 mm cover, showing the need for stainless bars or lower permeability. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 海洋環境下塔與基礎的耐久設計：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Durability of lower towers and foundations in a marine setting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下塔不鏽鋼鋼筋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stainless reinforcement in the lower tower” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工時以試體量測氯離子擴散係數與保護層厚度（鋼筋掃描儀），營運期定期鑽取粉末或岩心量測氯離子剖面，擬合表面濃度與擴散係數，推估腐蝕起始時間；基礎則以沉陷監測與水下檢查確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During construction measure chloride diffusion on specimens and cover with a covermeter; in service periodically sample dust or cores for chloride profiles, fit surface concentration and diffusion coefficient and project corrosion onset; check foundations with settlement monitoring and underwater inspection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐久設計報告要依暴露分區列出保護層、混凝土配比、鋼筋材質與設計年限內的腐蝕起始推估，並在交接時提供監測取樣位置圖，使後續量測能在相同位置重複比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The durability report should list cover, mix, bar type and projected corrosion onset within the design life for each exposure zone, and handover should include a sampling-location map so later measurements repeat at the same spots.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：飛濺區保護層不足或混凝土蜂窩，會讓氯離子提早到達鋼筋，造成鏽脹裂縫與剝落；若不同材質鋼筋混用而未隔離，接觸處也可能加速碳鋼腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient cover or honeycombing in the splash zone lets chlorides reach the bars early, causing rust cracking and spalling; mixing reinforcement types without isolation can accelerate carbon-steel corrosion at contacts. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工時以試體量測氯離子擴散係數與保護層厚度（鋼筋掃描儀），營運期定期鑽取粉末或岩心量測氯離子剖面，擬合表面濃度與擴散係數，推估腐蝕起始時間；基礎則以沉陷監測與水下檢查確認。

quiz.question: 要驗證「海洋環境下塔與基礎的耐久設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 海洋環境下塔與基礎的耐久設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Durability of lower towers and foundations in a marine setting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「下塔不鏽鋼鋼筋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stainless reinforcement in the lower tower” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 飛濺區保護層不足或混凝土蜂窩，會讓氯離子提早到達鋼筋，造成鏽脹裂縫與剝落；若不同材質鋼筋混用而未隔離，接觸處也可能加速碳鋼腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient cover or honeycombing in the splash zone lets chlorides reach the bars early, causing rust cracking and spalling; mixing reinforcement types without isolation can accelerate carbon-steel corrosion at contacts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：氯離子由表面向內擴散，到達鋼筋位置且濃度超過臨界值後，碳鋼鋼筋開始腐蝕並膨脹剝落；不鏽鋼鋼筋的臨界氯離子濃度高得多，可大幅延後腐蝕起始，適合用在最難維修的高風險區。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Chlorides diffuse inward from the surface, and once they reach the bars above a threshold, carbon-steel bars start corroding, expand and spall the cover; stainless bars tolerate a much higher chloride threshold, greatly delaying corrosion onset, which suits the highest-risk zones that are hardest to repair.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要混凝土強度高，海水環境下就不會有鋼筋腐蝕問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High-strength concrete alone prevents reinforcement corrosion in seawater." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「540 m 最長索」如何影響昂船洲大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The 540 m longest stay” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stonecutters Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 最長約 540 m 的斜拉索質量大、垂度明顯，第一振動頻率只有零點幾赫茲，容易受風雨激振，也不易以千斤頂直接量測索力。營運期最實用的方法是以加速度計量測索的自然頻率，再以張緊弦公式換算索力，長索需另行修正垂度與彎曲勁度的影響。定期比對索力趨勢可以發現錨具滑移、鋼線斷絲或阻尼器失效；交接文件則要把每根索的基準頻率、溫度與量測方法完整保存，讓下一代維護工程師能重複同樣的量測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「540 m 最長索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The longest stay, about 540 m, is heavy and sags noticeably, with a first natural frequency of only a few tenths of a hertz; it is prone to wind–rain excitation and hard to measure directly with jacks. The most practical in-service method measures the natural frequency with an accelerometer and converts it to force with the taut-string formula, with corrections for sag and bending stiffness on long stays. Comparing force trends over time reveals anchor slip, broken wires or damper failure, and the handover file must preserve each stay’s baseline frequency, temperature and method so the next generation of engineers can repeat the measurement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “The 540 m longest stay” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：張緊弦 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taut string f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜拉索索力一旦施工完成就不會再改變，不需要追蹤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stay forces never change after construction, so they need no tracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「540 m 最長索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “The 540 m longest stay”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接
knowledge.titleEn: Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover
knowledge.text: 最長約 540 m 的斜拉索質量大、垂度明顯，第一振動頻率只有零點幾赫茲，容易受風雨激振，也不易以千斤頂直接量測索力。營運期最實用的方法是以加速度計量測索的自然頻率，再以張緊弦公式換算索力，長索需另行修正垂度與彎曲勁度的影響。
knowledge.textEn: The longest stay, about 540 m, is heavy and sags noticeably, with a first natural frequency of only a few tenths of a hertz; it is prone to wind–rain excitation and hard to measure directly with jacks. The most practical in-service method measures the natural frequency with an accelerometer and converts it to force with the taut-string formula, with corrections for sag and bending stiffness on long stays.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜拉索索力一旦施工完成就不會再改變，不需要追蹤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stay forces never change after construction, so they need no tracking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover" is correct?
options: 斜拉索索力一旦施工完成就不會再改變，不需要追蹤。
最長約 540 m 的斜拉索質量大、垂度明顯，第一振動頻率只有零點幾赫茲，容易受風雨激振，也不易以千斤頂直接量測索力。
橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。
optionsEn: Stay forces never change after construction, so they need no tracking.
The longest stay, about 540 m, is heavy and sags noticeably, with a first natural frequency of only a few tenths of a hertz.
A wider, heavier deck is always harder for wind to move, so a 1 km span only needs more weight to resist typhoons.
quiz.explanation: 最長約 540 m 的斜拉索質量大、垂度明顯，第一振動頻率只有零點幾赫茲，容易受風雨激振，也不易以千斤頂直接量測索力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The longest stay, about 540 m, is heavy and sags noticeably, with a first natural frequency of only a few tenths of a hertz; it is prone to wind–rain excitation and hard to measure directly with jacks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「540 m 最長索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The 540 m longest stay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：張緊弦 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。取 L = 540 m、m = 70,000/540 ≈ 129.6 kg/m、T = 9,000 kN：√(9×10⁶/129.6) ≈ 263.5 m/s，f₁ ≈ 263.5/1,080 ≈ 0.244 Hz；若索力降 10%，f₁ 只降到約 0.231 Hz（√0.9 ≈ 0.949），量測需要足夠的頻率解析度。索力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taut string f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With L = 540 m, m = 70,000/540 ≈ 129.6 kg/m and T = 9,000 kN, √(9×10⁶/129.6) ≈ 263.5 m/s and f₁ ≈ 263.5/1,080 ≈ 0.244 Hz; a 10% force loss lowers f₁ only to about 0.231 Hz (√0.9 ≈ 0.949), so adequate frequency resolution is essential. The force is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每根索以至少約 10 分鐘的環境振動紀錄取得多階頻率，以高階頻率比值檢查垂度與彎曲勁度修正，再與施工完成時以千斤頂或荷重計標定的索力比較；量測同時記錄索溫與氣溫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record at least about 10 minutes of ambient vibration per stay to obtain several modal frequencies, use ratios of higher modes to check sag and bending corrections, and compare with forces calibrated by jacks or load cells at completion; record cable and air temperature simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Taut string f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With L = 540 m, m = 70,000/540 ≈ 129.6 kg/m and T = 9,000 kN, √(9×10⁶/129.6) ≈ 263.5 m/s and f₁ ≈ 263.5/1,080 ≈ 0.244 Hz; a 10% force loss lowers f₁ only to about 0.231 Hz (√0.9 ≈ 0.949), so adequate frequency resolution is essential. The force is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover", which statement holds?
options: 不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。
成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。
張緊弦 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。
optionsEn: The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load.
If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too.
Taut string f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m).
quiz.explanation: 張緊弦 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Taut string f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「540 m 最長索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “The 540 m longest stay” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每根索以至少約 10 分鐘的環境振動紀錄取得多階頻率，以高階頻率比值檢查垂度與彎曲勁度修正，再與施工完成時以千斤頂或荷重計標定的索力比較；量測同時記錄索溫與氣溫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record at least about 10 minutes of ambient vibration per stay to obtain several modal frequencies, use ratios of higher modes to check sag and bending corrections, and compare with forces calibrated by jacks or load cells at completion; record cable and air temperature simultaneously. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接資料應包含每根索的基準頻率表、計算參數（長度、單位質量、垂度修正）、量測位置與照片；維護單位每次量測都要沿用相同程序，差異超過警戒時先複測再啟動調查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover data should include a baseline frequency table for every stay, calculation parameters (length, mass per metre, sag correction), measurement locations and photographs; the maintainer must follow the same procedure each time and repeat a measurement before launching an investigation when a deviation exceeds the alert level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用第一頻率而不修正垂度，長索索力可能被高估或低估數個百分點，使真正的錨具滑移被誤判；量測時段若遇陣風或交通激振，頻譜出現交雜峰值，也會造成錯誤判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using only the first frequency without sag correction can mis-estimate long-stay force by several percent and mask real anchor slip; gusts or traffic excitation during the record add confusing spectral peaks and lead to misreading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每根索以至少約 10 分鐘的環境振動紀錄取得多階頻率，以高階頻率比值檢查垂度與彎曲勁度修正，再與施工完成時以千斤頂或荷重計標定的索力比較；量測同時記錄索溫與氣溫。
knowledge.textEn: Record at least about 10 minutes of ambient vibration per stay to obtain several modal frequencies, use ratios of higher modes to check sag and bending corrections, and compare with forces calibrated by jacks or load cells at completion; record cable and air temperature simultaneously.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接資料應包含每根索的基準頻率表、計算參數（長度、單位質量、垂度修正）、量測位置與照片；維護單位每次量測都要沿用相同程序，差異超過警戒時先複測再啟動調查。
knowledge.textEn: Handover data should include a baseline frequency table for every stay, calculation parameters (length, mass per metre, sag correction), measurement locations and photographs; the maintainer must follow the same procedure each time and repeat a measurement before launching an investigation when a deviation exceeds the alert level.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover"?
options: 每根索以至少約 10 分鐘的環境振動紀錄取得多階頻率，以高階頻率比值檢查垂度與彎曲勁度修正，再與施工完成時以千斤頂或荷重計標定的索力比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
風洞模型只要幾何縮尺正確，試驗結果就能直接放大套用到實橋。
optionsEn: Record at least about 10 minutes of ambient vibration per stay to obtain several modal frequencies, use ratios of higher modes to check sag and bending corrections, and compare with forces calibrated by jacks or load cells at completion.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge.
quiz.explanation: 每根索以至少約 10 分鐘的環境振動紀錄取得多階頻率，以高階頻率比值檢查垂度與彎曲勁度修正，再與施工完成時以千斤頂或荷重計標定的索力比較；量測同時記錄索溫與氣溫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record at least about 10 minutes of ambient vibration per stay to obtain several modal frequencies, use ratios of higher modes to check sag and bending corrections, and compare with forces calibrated by jacks or load cells at completion; record cable and air temperature simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「540 m 最長索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “The 540 m longest stay” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用第一頻率而不修正垂度，長索索力可能被高估或低估數個百分點，使真正的錨具滑移被誤判；量測時段若遇陣風或交通激振，頻譜出現交雜峰值，也會造成錯誤判讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using only the first frequency without sag correction can mis-estimate long-stay force by several percent and mask real anchor slip; gusts or traffic excitation during the record add confusing spectral peaks and lead to misreading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定期比對索力趨勢可以發現錨具滑移、鋼線斷絲或阻尼器失效；交接文件則要把每根索的基準頻率、溫度與量測方法完整保存，讓下一代維護工程師能重複同樣的量測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Comparing force trends over time reveals anchor slip, broken wires or damper failure, and the handover file must preserve each stay’s baseline frequency, temperature and method so the next generation of engineers can repeat the measurement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜拉索索力一旦施工完成就不會再改變，不需要追蹤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stay forces never change after construction, so they need no tracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用第一頻率而不修正垂度，長索索力可能被高估或低估數個百分點，使真正的錨具滑移被誤判；量測時段若遇陣風或交通激振，頻譜出現交雜峰值，也會造成錯誤判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Using only the first frequency without sag correction can mis-estimate long-stay force by several percent and mask real anchor slip; gusts or traffic excitation during the record add confusing spectral peaks and lead to misreading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只用第一頻率而不修正垂度，長索索力可能被高估或低估數個百分點，使真正的錨具滑移被誤判；量測時段若遇陣風或交通激振，頻譜出現交雜峰值，也會造成錯誤判讀。
橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using only the first frequency without sag correction can mis-estimate long-stay force by several percent and mask real anchor slip.
A wider, heavier deck is always harder for wind to move, so a 1 km span only needs more weight to resist typhoons.
quiz.explanation: 只用第一頻率而不修正垂度，長索索力可能被高估或低估數個百分點，使真正的錨具滑移被誤判；量測時段若遇陣風或交通激振，頻譜出現交雜峰值，也會造成錯誤判讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using only the first frequency without sag correction can mis-estimate long-stay force by several percent and mask real anchor slip; gusts or traffic excitation during the record add confusing spectral peaks and lead to misreading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 蘇通長江公路大橋
summary: 蘇通長江公路大橋以 1,088 m 主跨跨越寬約 6 km 的長江口，主橋孔跨為 (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m，倒 Y 形混凝土塔高 300.4 m，鋼箱梁含風嘴寬約 41 m，最長斜索約 577 m。本課從縱向阻尼限位體系、高空風剖面、每塔 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁、鋼錨箱錨固區出發，經施工平台與節段同步提升，到氣彈模型、沖刷監測、塔柱徐變與長索多模態振動。
summaryEn: Sutong Yangtze River Bridge spans the roughly 6 km wide Yangtze estuary with a 1,088 m main span in a (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m arrangement, 300.4 m inverted-Y concrete towers, a steel box deck about 41 m wide including fairings and stays up to about 577 m long. The course runs from the longitudinal damper–limiter system, wind profiles at height, the 131 bored friction piles per tower and steel anchor boxes, through work platforms and synchronised segment lifting, to aeroelastic testing, scour monitoring, tower creep and multi-mode vibration of long stays.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算塔頂在風荷載下的附加彎矩。取塔上段迎風寬 b = 10 m，以單元 2 的指數律求 z = 300 m 時 U ≈ 57.2 m/s，q = ½ρU² = 0.5×1.225×57.2² ≈ 2,004 Pa；取阻力係數 C_D = 1.3，每公尺風力 w = 2,004×1.3×10 ≈ 26.1 kN/m。若塔上 100 m 平均承受此風力、合力作用於塔頂以下 50 m，對 200 m 高程處的彎矩 M = 26.1×100×50 ≈ 130,300 kN·m。若改用橋面高度 70 m 的風速 48.0 m/s，q ≈ 1,411 Pa，w ≈ 18.3 kN/m，M ≈ 91,700 kN·m，低估約 30%（1 − 91,700/130,300 ≈ 0.30）。若塔寬改為 8 m，兩者都乘以 0.8。數值為教學假設，不代表蘇通大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the extra moment from wind on the upper tower. Take an upper-tower width b = 10 m; from the unit 2 power law U ≈ 57.2 m/s at z = 300 m, so q = ½ρU² = 0.5×1.225×57.2² ≈ 2,004 Pa; with C_D = 1.3 the force per metre is w = 2,004×1.3×10 ≈ 26.1 kN/m. If the top 100 m of tower carries this on average with the resultant 50 m below the top, the moment at the 200 m level is M = 26.1×100×50 ≈ 130,300 kN·m. Using the deck-level speed of 48.0 m/s at 70 m instead gives q ≈ 1,411 Pa, w ≈ 18.3 kN/m and M ≈ 91,700 kN·m, an underestimate of about 30% (1 − 91,700/130,300 ≈ 0.30). If the tower width becomes 8 m, both scale by 0.8. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Sutong design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位」與「長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters" and "Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower–deck viscous dampers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩；若完全漂浮，颱風、船撞與地震又會讓橋面大幅縱飄，撞壞伸縮縫。設計團隊比較多種體系後，採用附加位移限制裝置的超大型液體黏滯阻尼器，公開論文指出這是此類裝置在橋梁工程的首次應用。慢速的溫度位移幾乎不受阻；快速的風振與地震由阻尼器耗能；位移一旦達到限位值，限位裝置接手，防止極端事件中橋面超出伸縮縫與支承的行程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long. Fixing the deck to the towers would let thermal movement and tower creep create huge tower-base moments; a fully floating deck would let typhoons, ship impact and earthquakes push it far enough to wreck the expansion joints. After comparing systems, the design team adopted very large fluid viscous dampers with an added displacement limiter, described in a published paper as the first use of such a device in bridge engineering. Slow thermal movement is almost unresisted, fast wind and seismic motion is dissipated by the dampers, and once displacement reaches the limit the limiter takes over so the deck cannot exceed joint and bearing travel in an extreme event. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tower–deck viscous dampers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、自中點起算 L = 1,044 m、ΔT = 50 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.63 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 1,044 m from mid-length and ΔT = 50 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.63 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tower–deck viscous dampers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位
knowledge.titleEn: Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters
knowledge.text: 蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩；若完全漂浮，颱風、船撞與地震又會讓橋面大幅縱飄，撞壞伸縮縫。設計團隊比較多種體系後，採用附加位移限制裝置的超大型液體黏滯阻尼器，公開論文指出這是此類裝置在橋梁工程的首次應用。
knowledge.textEn: The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long. Fixing the deck to the towers would let thermal movement and tower creep create huge tower-base moments; a fully floating deck would let typhoons, ship impact and earthquakes push it far enough to wreck the expansion joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters" is correct?
options: 黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。
蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩。
同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。
optionsEn: A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity.
The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long.
Wind speed is the same at every height on a bridge, so one design speed is enough.
