steps.title: 長江口河床沖刷監測與防護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scour monitoring and protection in the Yangtze estuary: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔基沖刷防護層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scour-protection apron” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多音束測深在汛期前後與颱風後掃描承台周圍，建立數值地形並與基準比較沖刷坑深度與範圍；聲速依水溫鹽度校正，潮位以同步潮位站修正；護底層以側掃聲納或潛水檢查完整性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey around the caps with multibeam sounding before and after flood seasons and after typhoons, build digital terrain and compare scour-hole depth and extent with the baseline; correct sound speed for temperature and salinity and water level from a synchronised tide gauge; check apron integrity by side-scan sonar or divers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護計畫要規定定期與事件後的測深頻率、沖刷警戒深度與補拋石的啟動條件；測深資料以相同座標系統與基準面保存，便於多年比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance plan should set routine and post-event sounding frequencies, a scour alert depth and the trigger for replenishing riprap; store soundings in one coordinate system and datum for multi-year comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：護底層邊緣被掏空後拋石滑落，沖刷坑會快速擴大到承台下方；若只在平水期測深，可能錯過汛期最深的沖刷而在回淤後誤判為安全。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Once the apron edge is undermined and stones slide, the scour hole can grow rapidly under the cap; sounding only in low-flow periods can miss the deepest flood-season scour and wrongly conclude safety after refilling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多音束測深在汛期前後與颱風後掃描承台周圍，建立數值地形並與基準比較沖刷坑深度與範圍；聲速依水溫鹽度校正，潮位以同步潮位站修正；護底層以側掃聲納或潛水檢查完整性。
knowledge.textEn: Survey around the caps with multibeam sounding before and after flood seasons and after typhoons, build digital terrain and compare scour-hole depth and extent with the baseline; correct sound speed for temperature and salinity and water level from a synchronised tide gauge; check apron integrity by side-scan sonar or divers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護計畫要規定定期與事件後的測深頻率、沖刷警戒深度與補拋石的啟動條件；測深資料以相同座標系統與基準面保存，便於多年比較。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance plan should set routine and post-event sounding frequencies, a scour alert depth and the trigger for replenishing riprap; store soundings in one coordinate system and datum for multi-year comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長江口河床沖刷監測與防護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scour monitoring and protection in the Yangtze estuary"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以多音束測深在汛期前後與颱風後掃描承台周圍，建立數值地形並與基準比較沖刷坑深度與範圍。
施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Survey around the caps with multibeam sounding before and after flood seasons and after typhoons, build digital terrain and compare scour-hole depth and extent with the baseline.
A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure.
quiz.explanation: 以多音束測深在汛期前後與颱風後掃描承台周圍，建立數值地形並與基準比較沖刷坑深度與範圍；聲速依水溫鹽度校正，潮位以同步潮位站修正；護底層以側掃聲納或潛水檢查完整性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey around the caps with multibeam sounding before and after flood seasons and after typhoons, build digital terrain and compare scour-hole depth and extent with the baseline; correct sound speed for temperature and salinity and water level from a synchronised tide gauge; check apron integrity by side-scan sonar or divers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長江口河床沖刷監測與防護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scour monitoring and protection in the Yangtze estuary: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔基沖刷防護層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scour-protection apron” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 護底層邊緣被掏空後拋石滑落，沖刷坑會快速擴大到承台下方；若只在平水期測深，可能錯過汛期最深的沖刷而在回淤後誤判為安全。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Once the apron edge is undermined and stones slide, the scour hole can grow rapidly under the cap; sounding only in low-flow periods can miss the deepest flood-season scour and wrongly conclude safety after refilling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大型深水基礎因此常在施工前後鋪設拋石或袋裝砂的護底層，並在營運期定期測深，確認防護層沒有被掏空。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large deep-water foundations therefore commonly receive riprap or sand-bag aprons before and after construction, with periodic soundings in service to confirm the apron has not been undermined.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沖刷坑在洪水後會自然回淤，所以不會影響基樁承載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Scour holes refill naturally after floods, so they never affect pile capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 護底層邊緣被掏空後拋石滑落，沖刷坑會快速擴大到承台下方；若只在平水期測深，可能錯過汛期最深的沖刷而在回淤後誤判為安全。
knowledge.textEn: Once the apron edge is undermined and stones slide, the scour hole can grow rapidly under the cap; sounding only in low-flow periods can miss the deepest flood-season scour and wrongly conclude safety after refilling.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長江口河床沖刷監測與防護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scour monitoring and protection in the Yangtze estuary" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土塔完工後高度就固定不變，不需要預留壓縮量。
護底層邊緣被掏空後拋石滑落，沖刷坑會快速擴大到承台下方；若只在平水期測深，可能錯過汛期最深的沖刷而在回淤後誤判為安全。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A concrete tower’s height is fixed once complete, so no allowance for shortening is needed.
Once the apron edge is undermined and stones slide, the scour hole can grow rapidly under the cap.
quiz.explanation: 護底層邊緣被掏空後拋石滑落，沖刷坑會快速擴大到承台下方；若只在平水期測深，可能錯過汛期最深的沖刷而在回淤後誤判為安全。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Once the apron edge is undermined and stones slide, the scour hole can grow rapidly under the cap; sounding only in low-flow periods can miss the deepest flood-season scour and wrongly conclude safety after refilling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形」與「超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers" and "Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔柱預抬量」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower pre-elevation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土塔在自重、斜索垂直分力與後期鋪面荷載下會彈性壓縮，之後還有收縮與徐變持續縮短。300 m 高的塔累積縮短量可達十公分量級，直接使錨點下降、斜索幾何改變，進而影響橋面線形與索力。公開論文把塔形控制列為蘇通大橋塔施工的重點之一。施工時要以預抬量把每個錨點設在略高的位置，讓長期縮短後回到設計高程；營運期則需追蹤塔頂高程與索力的長期趨勢，分辨徐變造成的正常變化與異常沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔柱預抬量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A concrete tower shortens elastically under self-weight, the vertical components of stay forces and later surfacing loads, and then keeps shortening by shrinkage and creep. In a 300 m tower the accumulated shortening can reach the order of ten centimetres, lowering anchor points, changing stay geometry and thus the deck profile and stay forces. Published papers list tower shape control as a key issue in building the Sutong towers. During construction anchor points are set higher by a pre-elevation so they return to design level after long-term shortening; in service, long-term trends in tower-top level and stay forces must be tracked to separate normal creep from abnormal settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tower pre-elevation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：應力由頂部 0 線性增加到底部 σ = 10 MPa 時，彈性縮短 δ = σ·H/(2E)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With stress rising linearly from zero at the top to σ = 10 MPa at the base, elastic shortening is δ = σ·H/(2E).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土塔完工後高度就固定不變，不需要預留壓縮量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A concrete tower’s height is fixed once complete, so no allowance for shortening is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔柱預抬量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tower pre-elevation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形
knowledge.titleEn: Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers
knowledge.text: 混凝土塔在自重、斜索垂直分力與後期鋪面荷載下會彈性壓縮，之後還有收縮與徐變持續縮短。300 m 高的塔累積縮短量可達十公分量級，直接使錨點下降、斜索幾何改變，進而影響橋面線形與索力。
knowledge.textEn: A concrete tower shortens elastically under self-weight, the vertical components of stay forces and later surfacing loads, and then keeps shortening by shrinkage and creep. In a 300 m tower the accumulated shortening can reach the order of ten centimetres, lowering anchor points, changing stay geometry and thus the deck profile and stay forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土塔完工後高度就固定不變，不需要預留壓縮量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A concrete tower’s height is fixed once complete, so no allowance for shortening is needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers" is correct?
options: 混凝土塔在自重、斜索垂直分力與後期鋪面荷載下會彈性壓縮，之後還有收縮與徐變持續縮短。
混凝土塔完工後高度就固定不變，不需要預留壓縮量。
超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。
optionsEn: A concrete tower shortens elastically under self-weight, the vertical components of stay forces and later surfacing loads, and then keeps shortening by shrinkage and creep.
A concrete tower’s height is fixed once complete, so no allowance for shortening is needed.
Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土塔在自重、斜索垂直分力與後期鋪面荷載下會彈性壓縮，之後還有收縮與徐變持續縮短。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A concrete tower shortens elastically under self-weight, the vertical components of stay forces and later surfacing loads, and then keeps shortening by shrinkage and creep. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔柱預抬量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tower pre-elevation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：應力由頂部 0 線性增加到底部 σ = 10 MPa 時，彈性縮短 δ = σ·H/(2E)。取 H = 300 m、E = 36 GPa：δ = 10×300,000/(2×36,000) ≈ 41.7 mm；徐變係數 φ = 1.5 時總縮短約 41.7×2.5 ≈ 104 mm。應力與材料參數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With stress rising linearly from zero at the top to σ = 10 MPa at the base, elastic shortening is δ = σ·H/(2E). With H = 300 m and E = 36 GPa, δ = 10×300,000/(2×36,000) ≈ 41.7 mm; with a creep coefficient φ = 1.5 the total is about 41.7×2.5 ≈ 104 mm. Stress and material values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在塔身埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計，分離彈性、溫度、收縮與徐變應變；以精密水準與 GNSS 定期量測塔頂與錨點高程，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較，偏差超過門檻時檢討索力調整需求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the tower to separate elastic, thermal, shrinkage and creep strains; survey tower-top and anchor levels periodically by precise levelling and GNSS and compare with time-dependent analysis predictions, reviewing the need for stay adjustment when deviations exceed thresholds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 應力由頂部 0 線性增加到底部 σ = 10 MPa 時，彈性縮短 δ = σ·H/(2E)。取 H = 300 m、E = 36 GPa：δ = 10×300,000/(2×36,000) ≈ 41.7 mm；徐變係數 φ = 1.5 時總縮短約 41.7×2.5 ≈ 104 mm。應力與材料參數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With stress rising linearly from zero at the top to σ = 10 MPa at the base, elastic shortening is δ = σ·H/(2E). With H = 300 m and E = 36 GPa, δ = 10×300,000/(2×36,000) ≈ 41.7 mm; with a creep coefficient φ = 1.5 the total is about 41.7×2.5 ≈ 104 mm. Stress and material values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers", which statement holds?
options: 同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。
應力由頂部 0 線性增加到底部 σ = 10 MPa 時，彈性縮短 δ = σ·H/(2E)。
鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。
optionsEn: Wind speed is the same at every height on a bridge, so one design speed is enough.
With stress rising linearly from zero at the top to σ = 10 MPa at the base, elastic shortening is δ = σ·H/(2E).
Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force.
quiz.explanation: 應力由頂部 0 線性增加到底部 σ = 10 MPa 時，彈性縮短 δ = σ·H/(2E)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With stress rising linearly from zero at the top to σ = 10 MPa at the base, elastic shortening is δ = σ·H/(2E). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔柱預抬量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tower pre-elevation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在塔身埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計，分離彈性、溫度、收縮與徐變應變；以精密水準與 GNSS 定期量測塔頂與錨點高程，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較，偏差超過門檻時檢討索力調整需求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the tower to separate elastic, thermal, shrinkage and creep strains; survey tower-top and anchor levels periodically by precise levelling and GNSS and compare with time-dependent analysis predictions, reviewing the need for stay adjustment when deviations exceed thresholds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工控制文件要列出每個錨點的預抬量組成（彈性、收縮、徐變、基礎沉陷），並在交接時提供時間相依分析的預測曲線，讓維護單位能把實測值放在同一張圖上比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construction-control documents should break down each anchor’s pre-elevation into elastic, shrinkage, creep and foundation settlement parts, and handover should provide the time-dependent prediction curves so the maintainer can plot measurements against them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若預抬量只算彈性縮短而忽略徐變，數年後錨點持續下沉，主跨跨中下撓、索力重分配，鋪面與伸縮縫出現異常；若量測不分離溫度效應，又可能把季節變化誤判為徐變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pre-elevation based on elastic shortening only lets anchors keep sinking for years, sagging the main span, redistributing stay forces and distressing surfacing and joints; measurements that do not separate temperature may also mistake seasonal change for creep. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在塔身埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計，分離彈性、溫度、收縮與徐變應變；以精密水準與 GNSS 定期量測塔頂與錨點高程，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較，偏差超過門檻時檢討索力調整需求。
knowledge.textEn: Embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the tower to separate elastic, thermal, shrinkage and creep strains; survey tower-top and anchor levels periodically by precise levelling and GNSS and compare with time-dependent analysis predictions, reviewing the need for stay adjustment when deviations exceed thresholds.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工控制文件要列出每個錨點的預抬量組成（彈性、收縮、徐變、基礎沉陷），並在交接時提供時間相依分析的預測曲線，讓維護單位能把實測值放在同一張圖上比較。
knowledge.textEn: Construction-control documents should break down each anchor’s pre-elevation into elastic, shrinkage, creep and foundation settlement parts, and handover should provide the time-dependent prediction curves so the maintainer can plot measurements against them.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔柱預抬量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tower pre-elevation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若預抬量只算彈性縮短而忽略徐變，數年後錨點持續下沉，主跨跨中下撓、索力重分配，鋪面與伸縮縫出現異常；若量測不分離溫度效應，又可能把季節變化誤判為徐變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pre-elevation based on elastic shortening only lets anchors keep sinking for years, sagging the main span, redistributing stay forces and distressing surfacing and joints; measurements that do not separate temperature may also mistake seasonal change for creep. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工時要以預抬量把每個錨點設在略高的位置，讓長期縮短後回到設計高程；營運期則需追蹤塔頂高程與索力的長期趨勢，分辨徐變造成的正常變化與異常沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During construction anchor points are set higher by a pre-elevation so they return to design level after long-term shortening; in service, long-term trends in tower-top level and stay forces must be tracked to separate normal creep from abnormal settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土塔完工後高度就固定不變，不需要預留壓縮量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A concrete tower’s height is fixed once complete, so no allowance for shortening is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Pre-elevation based on elastic shortening only lets anchors keep sinking for years, sagging the main span, redistributing stay forces and distressing surfacing and joints; measurements that do not separate temperature may also mistake seasonal change for creep.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若預抬量只算彈性縮短而忽略徐變，數年後錨點持續下沉，主跨跨中下撓、索力重分配，鋪面與伸縮縫出現異常；若量測不分離溫度效應，又可能把季節變化誤判為徐變。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。
optionsEn: Pre-elevation based on elastic shortening only lets anchors keep sinking for years, sagging the main span, redistributing stay forces and distressing surfacing and joints.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1.
quiz.explanation: 若預抬量只算彈性縮短而忽略徐變，數年後錨點持續下沉，主跨跨中下撓、索力重分配，鋪面與伸縮縫出現異常；若量測不分離溫度效應，又可能把季節變化誤判為徐變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pre-elevation based on elastic shortening only lets anchors keep sinking for years, sagging the main span, redistributing stay forces and distressing surfacing and joints; measurements that do not separate temperature may also mistake seasonal change for creep. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「577 m 最長索」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The 577 m longest stay” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 蘇通大橋最長斜索約 577 m，第一頻率極低，風雨、渦流與橋面運動可能激發其第 5 階甚至第 10 階以上的模態。外置阻尼器只能裝在靠近橋面錨點的位置，而每個模態的最佳阻尼係數不同：對低階模態最佳的係數，對高階模態可能太硬或太軟。因此長索的減振設計要先找出可能被激發的頻率範圍，再選擇在該範圍內都能提供足夠附加阻尼的阻尼器參數，並在營運期定期檢查阻尼器是否漏油、卡滯或支架鬆動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「577 m 最長索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The longest Sutong stay is about 577 m, with a very low first frequency, so rain, wind, vortices and deck motion can excite its fifth or even tenth mode and above. External dampers can only be installed near the deck anchorage, and the optimum damping coefficient differs for each mode: a value optimal for low modes can be too stiff or too soft for higher ones. Vibration control for long stays therefore starts by identifying the frequency range likely to be excited, then chooses damper parameters that give enough added damping across that range, with periodic in-service checks for leaks, seizure or loose brackets. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “The 577 m longest stay” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m); with L = 577 m, T = 8,000 kN and m = 110 kg/m, √(8×10⁶/110) ≈ 269.7 m/s and f₁ ≈ 269.7/1,154 ≈ 0.234 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「577 m 最長索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “The 577 m longest stay”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護
knowledge.titleEn: Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays
knowledge.text: 蘇通大橋最長斜索約 577 m，第一頻率極低，風雨、渦流與橋面運動可能激發其第 5 階甚至第 10 階以上的模態。外置阻尼器只能裝在靠近橋面錨點的位置，而每個模態的最佳阻尼係數不同：對低階模態最佳的係數，對高階模態可能太硬或太軟。
knowledge.textEn: The longest Sutong stay is about 577 m, with a very low first frequency, so rain, wind, vortices and deck motion can excite its fifth or even tenth mode and above. External dampers can only be installed near the deck anchorage, and the optimum damping coefficient differs for each mode: a value optimal for low modes can be too stiff or too soft for higher ones.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays" is correct?
options: 超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。
蘇通大橋最長斜索約 577 m，第一頻率極低，風雨、渦流與橋面運動可能激發其第 5 階甚至第 10 階以上的模態。
黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。
optionsEn: Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1.
The longest Sutong stay is about 577 m, with a very low first frequency, so rain, wind, vortices and deck motion can excite its fifth or even tenth mode and above.
A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity.
quiz.explanation: 蘇通大橋最長斜索約 577 m，第一頻率極低，風雨、渦流與橋面運動可能激發其第 5 階甚至第 10 階以上的模態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The longest Sutong stay is about 577 m, with a very low first frequency, so rain, wind, vortices and deck motion can excite its fifth or even tenth mode and above. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「577 m 最長索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The 577 m longest stay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)，取 L = 577 m、T = 8,000 kN、m = 110 kg/m：√(8×10⁶/110) ≈ 269.7 m/s，f₁ ≈ 269.7/1,154 ≈ 0.234 Hz。風雨振常見的 1 至 3 Hz 對應 n ≈ 1/0.234 至 3/0.234，即約第 5 至第 12 階；最佳阻尼係數與 1/n 成正比，第 12 階只需第 1 階的約 1/12。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m); with L = 577 m, T = 8,000 kN and m = 110 kg/m, √(8×10⁶/110) ≈ 269.7 m/s and f₁ ≈ 269.7/1,154 ≈ 0.234 Hz. The 1 to 3 Hz band typical of rain–wind vibration corresponds to n ≈ 1/0.234 to 3/0.234, roughly modes 5 to 12; since the optimum damping coefficient scales with 1/n, mode 12 needs only about 1/12 of the mode-1 value. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以加速度計記錄索在風雨事件中的頻譜，確認實際被激發的模態；裝設阻尼器後做自由衰減或強迫振動試驗，逐階量測附加阻尼比，確認目標範圍內各階都達到設計值，並每年抽查阻尼器行程與漏油狀況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record cable spectra during wind–rain events with accelerometers to confirm which modes are excited; after damper installation run free-decay or forced tests to measure added damping mode by mode, confirming the design value across the target range, and spot-check damper stroke and leakage yearly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m); with L = 577 m, T = 8,000 kN and m = 110 kg/m, √(8×10⁶/110) ≈ 269.7 m/s and f₁ ≈ 269.7/1,154 ≈ 0.234 Hz. The 1 to 3 Hz band typical of rain–wind vibration corresponds to n ≈ 1/0.234 to 3/0.234, roughly modes 5 to 12; since the optimum damping coefficient scales with 1/n, mode 12 needs only about 1/12 of the mode-1 value. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays", which statement holds?
options: 基樁一定要打到岩盤才可靠，摩擦樁不適合大橋主塔。
施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。
optionsEn: Piles must reach rock to be reliable; friction piles are unsuitable for major bridge towers.
A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure.
quiz.explanationEn: f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m); with L = 577 m, T = 8,000 kN and m = 110 kg/m, √(8×10⁶/110) ≈ 269.7 m/s and f₁ ≈ 269.7/1,154 ≈ 0.234 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「577 m 最長索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “The 577 m longest stay” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以加速度計記錄索在風雨事件中的頻譜，確認實際被激發的模態；裝設阻尼器後做自由衰減或強迫振動試驗，逐階量測附加阻尼比，確認目標範圍內各階都達到設計值，並每年抽查阻尼器行程與漏油狀況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record cable spectra during wind–rain events with accelerometers to confirm which modes are excited; after damper installation run free-decay or forced tests to measure added damping mode by mode, confirming the design value across the target range, and spot-check damper stroke and leakage yearly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長索阻尼器的規格書應寫明目標模態範圍、各階最低附加阻尼與溫度範圍內的性能變化；監測系統保留幾根代表性長索的長期加速度紀錄，作為檢討是否需要加裝交叉索或更換阻尼器的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Long-stay damper specifications should state the target mode range, minimum added damping per mode and performance change over temperature; keep long-term acceleration records on a few representative long stays as the basis for deciding on cross-ties or damper replacement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：阻尼器只針對第一階調整，結果在 1 至 3 Hz 的高階模態幾乎沒有效果，風雨天長索仍大幅振動；長期振動使錨口彎曲應力與 HDPE 套管磨損增加，造成防護失效與疲勞風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tuning dampers to mode 1 only leaves them nearly ineffective for the higher modes at 1 to 3 Hz, so long stays still vibrate heavily in wind and rain; sustained vibration increases bending stress at the anchor exit and wear of the HDPE duct, compromising protection and adding fatigue risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以加速度計記錄索在風雨事件中的頻譜，確認實際被激發的模態；裝設阻尼器後做自由衰減或強迫振動試驗，逐階量測附加阻尼比，確認目標範圍內各階都達到設計值，並每年抽查阻尼器行程與漏油狀況。
knowledge.textEn: Record cable spectra during wind–rain events with accelerometers to confirm which modes are excited; after damper installation run free-decay or forced tests to measure added damping mode by mode, confirming the design value across the target range, and spot-check damper stroke and leakage yearly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 長索阻尼器的規格書應寫明目標模態範圍、各階最低附加阻尼與溫度範圍內的性能變化；監測系統保留幾根代表性長索的長期加速度紀錄，作為檢討是否需要加裝交叉索或更換阻尼器的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Long-stay damper specifications should state the target mode range, minimum added damping per mode and performance change over temperature; keep long-term acceleration records on a few representative long stays as the basis for deciding on cross-ties or damper replacement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays"?
options: 以加速度計記錄索在風雨事件中的頻譜，確認實際被激發的模態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
風洞模型只要外形相似，不需要考慮質量與勁度的縮尺。
optionsEn: Record cable spectra during wind–rain events with accelerometers to confirm which modes are excited.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A wind-tunnel model only needs the right shape; mass and stiffness scaling do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以加速度計記錄索在風雨事件中的頻譜，確認實際被激發的模態；裝設阻尼器後做自由衰減或強迫振動試驗，逐階量測附加阻尼比，確認目標範圍內各階都達到設計值，並每年抽查阻尼器行程與漏油狀況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record cable spectra during wind–rain events with accelerometers to confirm which modes are excited; after damper installation run free-decay or forced tests to measure added damping mode by mode, confirming the design value across the target range, and spot-check damper stroke and leakage yearly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「577 m 最長索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “The 577 m longest stay” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器只針對第一階調整，結果在 1 至 3 Hz 的高階模態幾乎沒有效果，風雨天長索仍大幅振動；長期振動使錨口彎曲應力與 HDPE 套管磨損增加，造成防護失效與疲勞風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Tuning dampers to mode 1 only leaves them nearly ineffective for the higher modes at 1 to 3 Hz, so long stays still vibrate heavily in wind and rain; sustained vibration increases bending stress at the anchor exit and wear of the HDPE duct, compromising protection and adding fatigue risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此長索的減振設計要先找出可能被激發的頻率範圍，再選擇在該範圍內都能提供足夠附加阻尼的阻尼器參數，並在營運期定期檢查阻尼器是否漏油、卡滯或支架鬆動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Vibration control for long stays therefore starts by identifying the frequency range likely to be excited, then chooses damper parameters that give enough added damping across that range, with periodic in-service checks for leaks, seizure or loose brackets.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 阻尼器只針對第一階調整，結果在 1 至 3 Hz 的高階模態幾乎沒有效果，風雨天長索仍大幅振動；長期振動使錨口彎曲應力與 HDPE 套管磨損增加，造成防護失效與疲勞風險。
knowledge.textEn: Tuning dampers to mode 1 only leaves them nearly ineffective for the higher modes at 1 to 3 Hz, so long stays still vibrate heavily in wind and rain; sustained vibration increases bending stress at the anchor exit and wear of the HDPE duct, compromising protection and adding fatigue risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
阻尼器只針對第一階調整，結果在 1 至 3 Hz 的高階模態幾乎沒有效果，風雨天長索仍大幅振動。
黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Tuning dampers to mode 1 only leaves them nearly ineffective for the higher modes at 1 to 3 Hz, so long stays still vibrate heavily in wind and rain.
A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器只針對第一階調整，結果在 1 至 3 Hz 的高階模態幾乎沒有效果，風雨天長索仍大幅振動；長期振動使錨口彎曲應力與 HDPE 套管磨損增加，造成防護失效與疲勞風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tuning dampers to mode 1 only leaves them nearly ineffective for the higher modes at 1 to 3 Hz, so long stays still vibrate heavily in wind and rain; sustained vibration increases bending stress at the anchor exit and wear of the HDPE duct, compromising protection and adding fatigue risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋
summary: 里翁—安提里翁大橋以 286+3×560+286 m 共 2,252 m 的連續全懸吊橋面跨越希臘科林斯灣口，四座塔立在直徑 90 m、坐於 3 m 礫石層上的基礎，下方以 2 m 鋼管插入物加勁軟弱海床。本課從 0.48 g 地震與 2 m 斷層位移、熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器、加勁土壤與沉箱浮運，到張力腿駁船的海床整備、平衡懸臂架設、WEASHM 監測、雷擊斷索與混凝土耐久。
summaryEn: The Rion–Antirion Bridge crosses the mouth of the Gulf of Corinth with a 2,252 m continuous fully suspended deck of 286+3×560+286 m; its four pylons stand on 90 m diameter footings resting on a 3 m gravel layer above soft seabed reinforced with 2 m steel-pipe inclusions. The course runs from 0.48 g shaking and 2 m fault movement, fuse restrainers and viscous dampers, reinforced soil and floating caissons, to seabed preparation from a tension-leg barge, balanced-cantilever erection, the WEASHM monitoring system, the lightning-caused stay failure and concrete durability.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 斜張橋與斜索系統

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較一座 90 m 基礎在地震中「不滑移」與「可滑移」時傳到上部結構的水平力。設基礎與塔座、墩身的有效質量 M = 80,000 t，若完全固定，以譜加速度 1.2 g 估算慣性力 F = M·S_a = 80,000×1.2×9.81 ≈ 941,800 kN。若基礎坐在礫石層上、摩擦係數 μ = tan35° ≈ 0.70、有效垂直力 N = 600,000 kN（扣除浮力），滑移前最大水平力 H = μ·N ≈ 420,000 kN，只有固定時的 420,000/941,800 ≈ 45%。代價是滑移位移：若地震造成 0.5 m 永久滑移，需確認伸縮縫與阻尼器的位移預算仍足夠（主墩阻尼器行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm）。若礫石摩擦角改為 30°（tan30° ≈ 0.577），H ≈ 346,400 kN，力量更低但滑移量會增加。質量、垂直力與摩擦角為教學假設，非本橋設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare the horizontal force passed to the superstructure by a 90 m footing that cannot slide with one that can. Take an effective mass of footing, base and shaft M = 80,000 t; if fully fixed, a spectral acceleration of 1.2 g gives an inertia force F = M·S_a = 80,000×1.2×9.81 ≈ 941,800 kN. If the footing rests on gravel with friction coefficient μ = tan35° ≈ 0.70 and effective vertical force N = 600,000 kN after buoyancy, the largest horizontal force before sliding is H = μ·N ≈ 420,000 kN, only 420,000/941,800 ≈ 45% of the fixed case. The price is sliding displacement: if the earthquake leaves 0.5 m of permanent slip, the displacement budget of joints and dampers must still suffice (main-pier damper stroke −1,650 to +1,850 mm). With a 30° gravel friction angle (tan30° ≈ 0.577), H ≈ 346,400 kN, a lower force but more sliding. Mass, vertical force and friction angle are teaching assumptions, not design values for this bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」與「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait" and "Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩間相對位移」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative pier movement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。這些需求使傳統「把結構牢牢固定」的做法行不通：基礎必須能在海床上滑移，橋面必須與塔分離懸吊，讓地震與構造位移由可控制的滑動、擺動與阻尼吸收，而不是由構件強度硬抗。最不利的設計組合是設計地震加上 50% 的構造位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩間相對位移」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth. The operator’s published design criteria include a peak ground acceleration of 0.48 g, maximum spectral acceleration of 1.2 g for periods of 0.2 to 1.0 s, a 2,000-year return period (5% exceedance in the 120-year design life), up to 2 m of fault movement in any direction between adjacent piers and a pylon tilt allowance of 1/500. These demands rule out simply fixing the structure firmly: the foundations must be able to slide on the seabed and the deck must hang free of the pylons, so that seismic and tectonic movement is absorbed by controlled sliding, swinging and damping rather than resisted by member strength. The governing combination is the design earthquake plus 50% of the tectonic movements. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Relative pier movement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墩間相對位移」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Relative pier movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求
knowledge.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait
knowledge.text: 橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。這些需求使傳統「把結構牢牢固定」的做法行不通：基礎必須能在海床上滑移，橋面必須與塔分離懸吊，讓地震與構造位移由可控制的滑動、擺動與阻尼吸收，而不是由構件強度硬抗。
knowledge.textEn: The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth. The operator’s published design criteria include a peak ground acceleration of 0.48 g, maximum spectral acceleration of 1.2 g for periods of 0.2 to 1.0 s, a 2,000-year return period (5% exceedance in the 120-year design life), up to 2 m of fault movement in any direction between adjacent piers and a pylon tilt allowance of 1/500.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait" is correct?
options: 抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。
橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。
橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。
optionsEn: The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed.
The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth.
If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩間相對位移」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative pier movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。若擴張速率取 15 mm/年，累積 1.8 m，餘裕只剩 0.2 m，說明構造位移與地震位移需一併規劃。擴張速率為教學假設，2 m 為公開設計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance. At 15 mm a year the total is 1.8 m with only 0.2 m to spare, showing that tectonic and seismic displacements must be planned together. The widening rate is a teaching assumption; 2 m is the published design value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。若擴張速率取 15 mm/年，累積 1.8 m，餘裕只剩 0.2 m，說明構造位移與地震位移需一併規劃。擴張速率為教學假設，2 m 為公開設計值。
knowledge.textEn: If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance. At 15 mm a year the total is 1.8 m with only 0.2 m to spare, showing that tectonic and seismic displacements must be planned together. The widening rate is a teaching assumption; 2 m is the published design value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。
平衡懸臂只要最後兩側長度相同，中間的施工順序不重要。
若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。
optionsEn: Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea.
In balanced cantilever erection only the final equal lengths matter, not the order in between.
If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance.
quiz.explanation: 若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩間相對位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative pier movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準文件要同時列出地震、構造位移、溫度與風的位移需求，並以「位移預算」逐項分配給基礎滑移、阻尼器行程、伸縮縫與支承；任何預算超支都需設計者書面確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should list displacement demands from earthquake, tectonic movement, temperature and wind together and allocate them in a displacement budget to foundation sliding, damper stroke, joints and bearings; any overrun requires the designer’s written confirmation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。
knowledge.textEn: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準文件要同時列出地震、構造位移、溫度與風的位移需求，並以「位移預算」逐項分配給基礎滑移、阻尼器行程、伸縮縫與支承；任何預算超支都需設計者書面確認。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should list displacement demands from earthquake, tectonic movement, temperature and wind together and allocate them in a displacement budget to foundation sliding, damper stroke, joints and bearings; any overrun requires the designer’s written confirmation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait"?
options: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
有了即時感測器，就不需要定期做傳統測量。
optionsEn: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With real-time sensors there is no need for periodic conventional surveys.
quiz.explanation: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩間相對位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative pier movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最不利的設計組合是設計地震加上 50% 的構造位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The governing combination is the design earthquake plus 50% of the tectonic movements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。
knowledge.textEn: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。
橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses.
If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「熔斷限制器」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fuse restrainers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。營運單位公開的配置是：主墩設 10.5 MN、過渡墩設 3.5 MN 的熔斷限制器，平時在強風下把橋面固定，地震時降伏斷開；同時並聯每支 3.5 MN 的黏滯阻尼器，塔位 4 支、過渡墩 2 支，主墩行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm，過渡墩 ±2,600 mm。熔斷限制器提供常時剛度，阻尼器在熔斷後限制擺幅並消耗能量，兩者分工讓風與地震的需求不必用同一個元件妥協。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「熔斷限制器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them. The operator’s published layout has fuse restrainers of 10.5 MN at the main piers and 3.5 MN at the transition piers that hold the deck in strong wind and yield in an earthquake, in parallel with viscous dampers of 3.5 MN each, 4 at the pylons and 2 at the transition piers, with strokes of −1,650 to +1,850 mm at main piers and ±2,600 mm at transition piers. The fuses provide everyday stiffness and the dampers limit swing and dissipate energy after the fuses break, so wind and seismic demands need not be compromised in one device. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fuse restrainers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Damper force F = C·v^α; with α = 0.15 and F = 3,500 kN at v = 1.6 m/s, C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15, and at v = 0.1 m/s F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN: a sixteen-fold drop in speed lowers force by only about 34%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「熔斷限制器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fuse restrainers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器
knowledge.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers
knowledge.text: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。營運單位公開的配置是：主墩設 10.5 MN、過渡墩設 3.5 MN 的熔斷限制器，平時在強風下把橋面固定，地震時降伏斷開；同時並聯每支 3.5 MN 的黏滯阻尼器，塔位 4 支、過渡墩 2 支，主墩行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm，過渡墩 ±2,600 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them. The operator’s published layout has fuse restrainers of 10.5 MN at the main piers and 3.5 MN at the transition piers that hold the deck in strong wind and yield in an earthquake, in parallel with viscous dampers of 3.5 MN each, 4 at the pylons and 2 at the transition piers, with strokes of −1,650 to +1,850 mm at main piers and ±2,600 mm at transition piers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers" is correct?
options: 橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。
軟弱海床上的大橋基礎一定要用長樁打到岩盤。
里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。
optionsEn: If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake.
Bridge foundations on soft seabed must always use long piles driven to rock.
The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them.
quiz.explanation: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熔斷限制器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fuse restrainers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：阻尼力 F = C·v^α，取 α = 0.15、在 v = 1.6 m/s 時 F = 3,500 kN：C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15；v = 0.1 m/s 時 F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN，速度降為 1/16 力只降約 34%。主墩熔斷力 10.5 MN 是單支阻尼器容量的 3 倍。α 與速度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Damper force F = C·v^α; with α = 0.15 and F = 3,500 kN at v = 1.6 m/s, C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15, and at v = 0.1 m/s F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN: a sixteen-fold drop in speed lowers force by only about 34%. The 10.5 MN main-pier fuse is 3 times one damper’s capacity. α and velocities are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：熔斷元件以抽樣破壞試驗確認斷開力在設計範圍內，阻尼器做全尺寸力—速度與行程試驗；營運期以限制器上的荷重計長期記錄風力與溫度造成的力，確認遠低於熔斷值；地震後依荷重計資料判斷是否需要更換熔斷元件並重新校準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm fuse break force by sample destructive tests and test dampers full-size for force–velocity and stroke; in service record wind- and temperature-induced forces on the restrainer load cells to confirm they stay well below the fuse value, and after an earthquake use the load-cell data to decide whether fuses must be replaced and recalibrated.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

The 10.5 MN main-pier fuse is 3 times one damper’s capacity. α and velocities are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熔斷限制器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fuse restrainers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 熔斷元件以抽樣破壞試驗確認斷開力在設計範圍內，阻尼器做全尺寸力—速度與行程試驗；營運期以限制器上的荷重計長期記錄風力與溫度造成的力，確認遠低於熔斷值；地震後依荷重計資料判斷是否需要更換熔斷元件並重新校準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm fuse break force by sample destructive tests and test dampers full-size for force–velocity and stroke; in service record wind- and temperature-induced forces on the restrainer load cells to confirm they stay well below the fuse value, and after an earthquake use the load-cell data to decide whether fuses must be replaced and recalibrated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：熔斷元件應設計為地震後可快速更換的消耗件，並在現場或倉庫保留備品；監測系統要把限制器荷重與阻尼器行程列為事件後自動報告的必要內容。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design fuses as sacrificial parts that can be replaced quickly after an earthquake, keep spares on site or in store, and make restrainer loads and damper strokes mandatory content of automatic post-event reports.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：熔斷值設得太低，強風或溫度力就會讓限制器斷開，橋面在日常風中擺動；設得太高，地震時不斷開，巨大的慣性力經限制器傳到塔與基礎。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fuse set too low breaks in strong wind or under temperature force and lets the deck swing in everyday wind; set too high it does not break in an earthquake and sends huge inertia forces through to the pylons and foundations; insufficient damper stroke can hit the end stops late in a major quake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 熔斷元件應設計為地震後可快速更換的消耗件，並在現場或倉庫保留備品；監測系統要把限制器荷重與阻尼器行程列為事件後自動報告的必要內容。
knowledge.textEn: Design fuses as sacrificial parts that can be replaced quickly after an earthquake, keep spares on site or in store, and make restrainer loads and damper strokes mandatory content of automatic post-event reports.

quiz.question: 要驗證「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

斜索是由許多鋼絞線組成的，所以整根斜索不可能突然失效。

Because a stay is made of many strands, the whole stay can never fail suddenly.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熔斷限制器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fuse restrainers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 熔斷值設得太低，強風或溫度力就會讓限制器斷開，橋面在日常風中擺動；設得太高，地震時不斷開，巨大的慣性力經限制器傳到塔與基礎。阻尼器行程不足則可能在大地震末段撞擊止擋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fuse set too low breaks in strong wind or under temperature force and lets the deck swing in everyday wind; set too high it does not break in an earthquake and sends huge inertia forces through to the pylons and foundations; insufficient damper stroke can hit the end stops late in a major quake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熔斷限制器提供常時剛度，阻尼器在熔斷後限制擺幅並消耗能量，兩者分工讓風與地震的需求不必用同一個元件妥協。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The fuses provide everyday stiffness and the dampers limit swing and dissipate energy after the fuses break, so wind and seismic demands need not be compromised in one device.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「加勁土壤與可滑移基礎」與「90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reinforced soil and sliding foundations" and "Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 加勁土壤與可滑移基礎：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Reinforced soil and sliding foundations: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼管插入物」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel-pipe inclusions” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 海床沉積層厚度超過 500 m，以黏土為主夾砂與粉土，調查至海床下 100 m 仍未見岩盤，打樁到岩盤不可行。營運單位公開資料指出，設計在每座墩下打入約 150 至 200 根直徑 2 m、長 25 至 30 m、間距 7 m 的中空鋼管，改良上部 20 m 土層，再鋪 3 m 厚礫石層，基礎直接坐在礫石上而不與鋼管連接。鋼管提高土壤的剪力強度與承載，避免基礎傾覆或大量沉陷；礫石層則讓基礎在強震時可以水平滑移，限制傳入上部結構的力量，這是「容量設計」觀念在基礎上的應用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼管插入物」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The seabed sediments are over 500 m thick, mainly clay with sand and silt, and no rock was found within 100 m below the seabed, so piling to rock was not possible. Operator data state that about 150 to 200 hollow steel pipes, 2 m in diameter, 25 to 30 m long and 7 m apart, were driven under each pier to improve the top 20 m of soil, then a 3 m gravel layer was placed and the footing rests on the gravel without connection to the pipes. The inclusions raise the soil’s shear strength and bearing to prevent overturning or large settlement, while the gravel lets the footing slide horizontally in a strong earthquake, capping the force transmitted to the superstructure: capacity design applied to a foundation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Steel-pipe inclusions” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：面積置換率 a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Area replacement ratio a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「軟弱海床上的大橋基礎一定要用長樁打到岩盤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bridge foundations on soft seabed must always use long piles driven to rock." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼管插入物」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Steel-pipe inclusions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：軟弱海床上的大橋基礎一定要用長樁打到岩盤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「加勁土壤與可滑移基礎」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
