Bridge foundations on soft seabed must always use long piles driven to rock.
Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea.
quiz.explanation: 海床沉積層厚度超過 500 m，以黏土為主夾砂與粉土，調查至海床下 100 m 仍未見岩盤，打樁到岩盤不可行。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The seabed sediments are over 500 m thick, mainly clay with sand and silt, and no rock was found within 100 m below the seabed, so piling to rock was not possible. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 加勁土壤與可滑移基礎：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reinforced soil and sliding foundations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼管插入物」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel-pipe inclusions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面積置換率 a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%。基礎滑移前可傳遞的最大水平力 H = N·tanφ：取有效垂直力 N = 600,000 kN、礫石摩擦角 φ = 35°（tanφ ≈ 0.700），H ≈ 420,000 kN；超過此值基礎滑移，上部力量不再增加。N 與 φ 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Area replacement ratio a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%. The largest horizontal force before the footing slides is H = N·tanφ; with an effective vertical force N = 600,000 kN and gravel friction angle φ = 35° (tanφ ≈ 0.700), H ≈ 420,000 kN, beyond which the footing slides and the force on the superstructure stops rising. N and φ are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以離心機模型或數值分析驗證加勁土壤在反覆荷載下的承載與滑移行為；施工時逐根記錄插入物的貫入深度與位置，礫石層以水下測深確認厚度與平整度；營運期以測地與沉陷量測確認基礎沉陷落在預期的 0.1 至 0.2 m 範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify the bearing and sliding behaviour of the reinforced soil under cyclic loading with centrifuge models or numerical analysis; record each inclusion’s penetration and position during construction and confirm gravel thickness and flatness by underwater survey; in service confirm footing settlement stays within the expected 0.1 to 0.2 m by geodetic and settlement measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 面積置換率 a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%。基礎滑移前可傳遞的最大水平力 H = N·tanφ：取有效垂直力 N = 600,000 kN、礫石摩擦角 φ = 35°（tanφ ≈ 0.700），H ≈ 420,000 kN；超過此值基礎滑移，上部力量不再增加。N 與 φ 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Area replacement ratio a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%. The largest horizontal force before the footing slides is H = N·tanφ; with an effective vertical force N = 600,000 kN and gravel friction angle φ = 35° (tanφ ≈ 0.700), H ≈ 420,000 kN, beyond which the footing slides and the force on the superstructure stops rising. N and φ are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「加勁土壤與可滑移基礎」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reinforced soil and sliding foundations", which statement holds?
options: 平衡懸臂只要最後兩側長度相同，中間的施工順序不重要。
面積置換率 a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%。
有了即時感測器，就不需要定期做傳統測量。
optionsEn: In balanced cantilever erection only the final equal lengths matter, not the order in between.
Area replacement ratio a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%.
With real-time sensors there is no need for periodic conventional surveys.
quiz.explanation: 面積置換率 a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Area replacement ratio a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 加勁土壤與可滑移基礎：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reinforced soil and sliding foundations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼管插入物」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel-pipe inclusions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以離心機模型或數值分析驗證加勁土壤在反覆荷載下的承載與滑移行為；施工時逐根記錄插入物的貫入深度與位置，礫石層以水下測深確認厚度與平整度；營運期以測地與沉陷量測確認基礎沉陷落在預期的 0.1 至 0.2 m 範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify the bearing and sliding behaviour of the reinforced soil under cyclic loading with centrifuge models or numerical analysis; record each inclusion’s penetration and position during construction and confirm gravel thickness and flatness by underwater survey; in service confirm footing settlement stays within the expected 0.1 to 0.2 m by geodetic and settlement measurements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：基礎設計報告要清楚區分「加勁土壤」與「樁基礎」的力學假設，並在圖上註明礫石層與基礎之間不得有任何連接；水下施工記錄（插入物位置、礫石厚度）要完整交接給營運單位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The foundation report must clearly separate the mechanics of reinforced soil from piled foundations and the drawings must state that nothing connects the footing to the gravel; underwater construction records of inclusion positions and gravel thickness must be handed over completely to the operator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把插入物當成樁並與基礎剛接，地震時樁頭承受巨大剪力與彎矩，可能破壞；礫石層摩擦過高則基礎不滑移，上部結構承受遠超預期的地震力；插入物不足則基礎可能傾覆或產生不均勻沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the inclusions as piles rigidly tied to the footing would load their heads with huge shear and moment in an earthquake; gravel friction that is too high prevents sliding and exposes the superstructure to far larger forces; too few inclusions risk overturning or differential settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以離心機模型或數值分析驗證加勁土壤在反覆荷載下的承載與滑移行為；施工時逐根記錄插入物的貫入深度與位置，礫石層以水下測深確認厚度與平整度；營運期以測地與沉陷量測確認基礎沉陷落在預期的 0.1 至 0.2 m 範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Verify the bearing and sliding behaviour of the reinforced soil under cyclic loading with centrifuge models or numerical analysis; record each inclusion’s penetration and position during construction and confirm gravel thickness and flatness by underwater survey; in service confirm footing settlement stays within the expected 0.1 to 0.2 m by geodetic and settlement measurements.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 基礎設計報告要清楚區分「加勁土壤」與「樁基礎」的力學假設，並在圖上註明礫石層與基礎之間不得有任何連接；水下施工記錄（插入物位置、礫石厚度）要完整交接給營運單位。
knowledge.textEn: The foundation report must clearly separate the mechanics of reinforced soil from piled foundations and the drawings must state that nothing connects the footing to the gravel; underwater construction records of inclusion positions and gravel thickness must be handed over completely to the operator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「加勁土壤與可滑移基礎」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reinforced soil and sliding foundations"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
高強度海工混凝土在 120 年內不需要任何耐久性檢測。
以離心機模型或數值分析驗證加勁土壤在反覆荷載下的承載與滑移行為。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
High-strength marine concrete needs no durability testing over 120 years.
Verify the bearing and sliding behaviour of the reinforced soil under cyclic loading with centrifuge models or numerical analysis.
quiz.explanation: 以離心機模型或數值分析驗證加勁土壤在反覆荷載下的承載與滑移行為；施工時逐根記錄插入物的貫入深度與位置，礫石層以水下測深確認厚度與平整度；營運期以測地與沉陷量測確認基礎沉陷落在預期的 0.1 至 0.2 m 範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify the bearing and sliding behaviour of the reinforced soil under cyclic loading with centrifuge models or numerical analysis; record each inclusion’s penetration and position during construction and confirm gravel thickness and flatness by underwater survey; in service confirm footing settlement stays within the expected 0.1 to 0.2 m by geodetic and settlement measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 加勁土壤與可滑移基礎：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reinforced soil and sliding foundations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼管插入物」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel-pipe inclusions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把插入物當成樁並與基礎剛接，地震時樁頭承受巨大剪力與彎矩，可能破壞；礫石層摩擦過高則基礎不滑移，上部結構承受遠超預期的地震力；插入物不足則基礎可能傾覆或產生不均勻沉陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the inclusions as piles rigidly tied to the footing would load their heads with huge shear and moment in an earthquake; gravel friction that is too high prevents sliding and exposes the superstructure to far larger forces; too few inclusions risk overturning or differential settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼管提高土壤的剪力強度與承載，避免基礎傾覆或大量沉陷；礫石層則讓基礎在強震時可以水平滑移，限制傳入上部結構的力量，這是「容量設計」觀念在基礎上的應用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The inclusions raise the soil’s shear strength and bearing to prevent overturning or large settlement, while the gravel lets the footing slide horizontally in a strong earthquake, capping the force transmitted to the superstructure: capacity design applied to a foundation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「軟弱海床上的大橋基礎一定要用長樁打到岩盤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bridge foundations on soft seabed must always use long piles driven to rock." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把插入物當成樁並與基礎剛接，地震時樁頭承受巨大剪力與彎矩，可能破壞；礫石層摩擦過高則基礎不滑移，上部結構承受遠超預期的地震力；插入物不足則基礎可能傾覆或產生不均勻沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the inclusions as piles rigidly tied to the footing would load their heads with huge shear and moment in an earthquake; gravel friction that is too high prevents sliding and exposes the superstructure to far larger forces; too few inclusions risk overturning or differential settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「加勁土壤與可滑移基礎」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reinforced soil and sliding foundations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若把插入物當成樁並與基礎剛接，地震時樁頭承受巨大剪力與彎矩，可能破壞。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。
optionsEn: Treating the inclusions as piles rigidly tied to the footing would load their heads with huge shear and moment in an earthquake.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea.
quiz.explanation: 若把插入物當成樁並與基礎剛接，地震時樁頭承受巨大剪力與彎矩，可能破壞；礫石層摩擦過高則基礎不滑移，上部結構承受遠超預期的地震力；插入物不足則基礎可能傾覆或產生不均勻沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the inclusions as piles rigidly tied to the footing would load their heads with huge shear and moment in an earthquake; gravel friction that is too high prevents sliding and exposes the superstructure to far larger forces; too few inclusions risk overturning or differential settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「90 m 直徑基礎」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “90 m diameter footings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每座塔基礎直徑 90 m，上接由 38 m 漸縮到 26 m 的錐形墩身，再接邊長 38 m、由四支 4 m × 4 m 混凝土腿組成的塔座。營運單位公開資料指出，基礎底部在長 200 m、寬 100 m、深 14 m 的乾塢中製作，可同時做兩座；底部澆到約 15 m 高、具備足夠浮力後灌水浮出，拖到濕塢繼續在浮動狀態下接高錐形段，最後拖到墩位以壓艙水下沉就位。這個方法把大量混凝土作業移到岸邊受控環境，但浮運期間的吃水、穩定性與拖航條件都必須精確計算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「90 m 直徑基礎」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each pylon footing is 90 m in diameter, topped by a conical shaft tapering from 38 m to 26 m and a 38 m square pylon base with four 4 m × 4 m concrete legs. Operator data state that the footing bases were cast in a dry dock 200 m long, 100 m wide and 14 m deep, two at a time; once about 15 m high and buoyant, they were floated out, towed to a wet dock where the conical part was built while floating, then towed to position and sunk with ballast water. The method moves most concrete work to a controlled shore site, but draft, stability and towing conditions while afloat must be calculated precisely. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “90 m diameter footings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：吃水 d = W/(ρ_w·A)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Draft d = W/(ρ_w·A).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「90 m 直徑基礎」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “90 m diameter footings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運
knowledge.titleEn: Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons
knowledge.text: 每座塔基礎直徑 90 m，上接由 38 m 漸縮到 26 m 的錐形墩身，再接邊長 38 m、由四支 4 m × 4 m 混凝土腿組成的塔座。營運單位公開資料指出，基礎底部在長 200 m、寬 100 m、深 14 m 的乾塢中製作，可同時做兩座；底部澆到約 15 m 高、具備足夠浮力後灌水浮出，拖到濕塢繼續在浮動狀態下接高錐形段，最後拖到墩位以壓艙水下沉就位。
knowledge.textEn: Each pylon footing is 90 m in diameter, topped by a conical shaft tapering from 38 m to 26 m and a 38 m square pylon base with four 4 m × 4 m concrete legs. Operator data state that the footing bases were cast in a dry dock 200 m long, 100 m wide and 14 m deep, two at a time; once about 15 m high and buoyant, they were floated out, towed to a wet dock where the conical part was built while floating, then towed to position and sunk with ballast water.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons" is correct?
options: 混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。
每座塔基礎直徑 90 m，上接由 38 m 漸縮到 26 m 的錐形墩身，再接邊長 38 m、由四支 4 m × 4 m 混凝土腿組成的塔座。
深海的礫石墊層只是填料，平整度要求可以放寬。
optionsEn: Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea.
Each pylon footing is 90 m in diameter, topped by a conical shaft tapering from 38 m to 26 m and a 38 m square pylon base with four 4 m × 4 m concrete legs.
A deep-water gravel bed is just fill, so its flatness can be relaxed.
quiz.explanation: 每座塔基礎直徑 90 m，上接由 38 m 漸縮到 26 m 的錐形墩身，再接邊長 38 m、由四支 4 m × 4 m 混凝土腿組成的塔座。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each pylon footing is 90 m in diameter, topped by a conical shaft tapering from 38 m to 26 m and a 38 m square pylon base with four 4 m × 4 m concrete legs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「90 m 直徑基礎」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “90 m diameter footings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吃水 d = W/(ρ_w·A)。底面積 A = π×45² ≈ 6,362 m²，每公尺吃水排水約 6,362×1.025 ≈ 6,521 t；若浮出時結構重 60,000 t，d ≈ 60,000/6,521 ≈ 9.2 m，低於乾塢 14 m 深度，留有約 4.8 m 餘裕。重量為教學假設，尺寸為公開資料。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Draft d = W/(ρ_w·A). The base area A = π×45² ≈ 6,362 m² displaces about 6,362×1.025 ≈ 6,521 t per metre of draft; a 60,000 t structure at float-out draws d ≈ 60,000/6,521 ≈ 9.2 m, below the 14 m dock depth with about 4.8 m to spare. The weight is a teaching assumption; dimensions are published values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次澆置後以實際混凝土量與密度更新重量與重心，計算吃水、穩心高度與拖航時的傾斜；浮出與下沉作業前確認潮位、波浪與拖船配置，下沉過程以壓艙水量與四周吃水尺同步監控，確保均勻下沉。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each pour update weight and centre of gravity from actual quantities and density and compute draft, metacentric height and heel under tow; before float-out and sinking confirm tide, waves and tug arrangement, and during sinking monitor ballast volumes and draft marks around the perimeter to keep the descent level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 吃水 d = W/(ρ_w·A)。底面積 A = π×45² ≈ 6,362 m²，每公尺吃水排水約 6,362×1.025 ≈ 6,521 t；若浮出時結構重 60,000 t，d ≈ 60,000/6,521 ≈ 9.2 m，低於乾塢 14 m 深度，留有約 4.8 m 餘裕。重量為教學假設，尺寸為公開資料。
knowledge.textEn: Draft d = W/(ρ_w·A). The base area A = π×45² ≈ 6,362 m² displaces about 6,362×1.025 ≈ 6,521 t per metre of draft; a 60,000 t structure at float-out draws d ≈ 60,000/6,521 ≈ 9.2 m, below the 14 m dock depth with about 4.8 m to spare. The weight is a teaching assumption; dimensions are published values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons", which statement holds?
options: 感測器越多、取樣越快，監測系統就一定越有用。
斜索是由許多鋼絞線組成的，所以整根斜索不可能突然失效。
吃水 d = W/(ρ_w·A)。
optionsEn: More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful.
Because a stay is made of many strands, the whole stay can never fail suddenly.
Draft d = W/(ρ_w·A).
quiz.explanation: 吃水 d = W/(ρ_w·A)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Draft d = W/(ρ_w·A). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「90 m 直徑基礎」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “90 m diameter footings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次澆置後以實際混凝土量與密度更新重量與重心，計算吃水、穩心高度與拖航時的傾斜；浮出與下沉作業前確認潮位、波浪與拖船配置，下沉過程以壓艙水量與四周吃水尺同步監控，確保均勻下沉。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each pour update weight and centre of gravity from actual quantities and density and compute draft, metacentric height and heel under tow; before float-out and sinking confirm tide, waves and tug arrangement, and during sinking monitor ballast volumes and draft marks around the perimeter to keep the descent level. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：浮運與下沉計畫要由海事工程師與結構設計者共同簽認，列出每個階段的重量、吃水、穩定性、氣象門檻與中止條件；乾塢閘門與排水系統的檢查要列為浮出前的停留檢查點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Float-out and sinking plans need joint sign-off by the marine engineer and the structural designer, listing weight, draft, stability, weather limits and abort criteria for each stage; inspection of the dock gate and dewatering systems is a hold point before float-out.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重量或重心估算錯誤，可能使結構在乾塢內擱淺無法浮出，或在拖航中傾斜過大；下沉時壓艙不均造成傾斜就位，會讓基礎在礫石層上偏心受力，並使塔的初始傾斜超出 1/500 的容許值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wrong weight or centre-of-gravity estimates can leave the structure grounded in the dock or heeling excessively under tow; uneven ballasting during sinking lands it tilted, loading the gravel eccentrically and pushing the pylon’s initial tilt beyond the 1/500 allowance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次澆置後以實際混凝土量與密度更新重量與重心，計算吃水、穩心高度與拖航時的傾斜；浮出與下沉作業前確認潮位、波浪與拖船配置，下沉過程以壓艙水量與四周吃水尺同步監控，確保均勻下沉。
knowledge.textEn: After each pour update weight and centre of gravity from actual quantities and density and compute draft, metacentric height and heel under tow; before float-out and sinking confirm tide, waves and tug arrangement, and during sinking monitor ballast volumes and draft marks around the perimeter to keep the descent level.

knowledge.textEn: Float-out and sinking plans need joint sign-off by the marine engineer and the structural designer, listing weight, draft, stability, weather limits and abort criteria for each stage; inspection of the dock gate and dewatering systems is a hold point before float-out.

quiz.question: 要驗證「90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons"?
options: 每次澆置後以實際混凝土量與密度更新重量與重心，計算吃水、穩心高度與拖航時的傾斜。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。
optionsEn: After each pour update weight and centre of gravity from actual quantities and density and compute draft, metacentric height and heel under tow.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed.

quiz.explanationEn: After each pour update weight and centre of gravity from actual quantities and density and compute draft, metacentric height and heel under tow; before float-out and sinking confirm tide, waves and tug arrangement, and during sinking monitor ballast volumes and draft marks around the perimeter to keep the descent level. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「90 m 直徑基礎」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “90 m diameter footings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重量或重心估算錯誤，可能使結構在乾塢內擱淺無法浮出，或在拖航中傾斜過大；下沉時壓艙不均造成傾斜就位，會讓基礎在礫石層上偏心受力，並使塔的初始傾斜超出 1/500 的容許值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wrong weight or centre-of-gravity estimates can leave the structure grounded in the dock or heeling excessively under tow; uneven ballasting during sinking lands it tilted, loading the gravel eccentrically and pushing the pylon’s initial tilt beyond the 1/500 allowance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個方法把大量混凝土作業移到岸邊受控環境，但浮運期間的吃水、穩定性與拖航條件都必須精確計算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The method moves most concrete work to a controlled shore site, but draft, stability and towing conditions while afloat must be calculated precisely.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重量或重心估算錯誤，可能使結構在乾塢內擱淺無法浮出，或在拖航中傾斜過大；下沉時壓艙不均造成傾斜就位，會讓基礎在礫石層上偏心受力，並使塔的初始傾斜超出 1/500 的容許值。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
重量或重心估算錯誤，可能使結構在乾塢內擱淺無法浮出，或在拖航中傾斜過大。
深海的礫石墊層只是填料，平整度要求可以放寬。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Wrong weight or centre-of-gravity estimates can leave the structure grounded in the dock or heeling excessively under tow.
A deep-water gravel bed is just fill, so its flatness can be relaxed.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「65 m 水深的海床整備與礫石鋪設公差」與「組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seabed preparation at 65 m depth and gravel-bed tolerances" and "Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 65 m 水深的海床整備與礫石鋪設公差：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Seabed preparation at 65 m depth and gravel-bed tolerances: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「張力腿駁船」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tension-leg barge” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 在水深達 65 m 的海峽中，浚挖海床、打入數百根鋼管插入物並鋪設 3 m 礫石層，都必須在穩定的平台上進行。營運單位公開資料指出，承包團隊為此打造專用的張力腿駁船：以錨鏈或錨索拉緊固定在海床上的重物，使駁船在波浪中幾乎不上下起伏，成為深水中的穩定工作平台。礫石層的平整度直接決定沉箱坐落後的傾斜，而塔的傾斜容許只有 1/500，所以水下鋪設的公差比一般海事工程嚴格得多，需要以精密測深與耙平工具反覆修整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「張力腿駁船」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a strait up to 65 m deep, dredging the seabed, driving hundreds of steel inclusions and placing a 3 m gravel layer all need a stable platform. Operator data state that the team built a purpose-made tension-leg barge, held down by taut lines to anchors on the seabed so it barely heaves in waves, giving a stable work platform in deep water. The flatness of the gravel bed determines the tilt of the caisson once landed, and the pylon tilt allowance is only 1/500, so underwater placement tolerances are much tighter than in ordinary marine work and need repeated precise soundings and screeding. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tension-leg barge” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：基礎直徑 90 m，若礫石面兩端高差 Δ，傾斜 = Δ/90。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 90 m footing, a level difference Δ across the gravel gives a tilt of Δ/90.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「深海的礫石墊層只是填料，平整度要求可以放寬。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A deep-water gravel bed is just fill, so its flatness can be relaxed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「張力腿駁船」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tension-leg barge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 65 m 水深的海床整備與礫石鋪設公差
knowledge.titleEn: Seabed preparation at 65 m depth and gravel-bed tolerances
knowledge.text: 在水深達 65 m 的海峽中，浚挖海床、打入數百根鋼管插入物並鋪設 3 m 礫石層，都必須在穩定的平台上進行。營運單位公開資料指出，承包團隊為此打造專用的張力腿駁船：以錨鏈或錨索拉緊固定在海床上的重物，使駁船在波浪中幾乎不上下起伏，成為深水中的穩定工作平台。
knowledge.textEn: In a strait up to 65 m deep, dredging the seabed, driving hundreds of steel inclusions and placing a 3 m gravel layer all need a stable platform. Operator data state that the team built a purpose-made tension-leg barge, held down by taut lines to anchors on the seabed so it barely heaves in waves, giving a stable work platform in deep water.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：深海的礫石墊層只是填料，平整度要求可以放寬。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A deep-water gravel bed is just fill, so its flatness can be relaxed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「65 m 水深的海床整備與礫石鋪設公差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seabed preparation at 65 m depth and gravel-bed tolerances" is correct?
options: 深海的礫石墊層只是填料，平整度要求可以放寬。
平衡懸臂只要最後兩側長度相同，中間的施工順序不重要。

In balanced cantilever erection only the final equal lengths matter, not the order in between.
In a strait up to 65 m deep, dredging the seabed, driving hundreds of steel inclusions and placing a 3 m gravel layer all need a stable platform.
quiz.explanation: 在水深達 65 m 的海峽中，浚挖海床、打入數百根鋼管插入物並鋪設 3 m 礫石層，都必須在穩定的平台上進行。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a strait up to 65 m deep, dredging the seabed, driving hundreds of steel inclusions and placing a 3 m gravel layer all need a stable platform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 65 m 水深的海床整備與礫石鋪設公差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seabed preparation at 65 m depth and gravel-bed tolerances: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「張力腿駁船」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tension-leg barge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：基礎直徑 90 m，若礫石面兩端高差 Δ，傾斜 = Δ/90。容許 1/500 時 Δ = 90/500 = 0.18 m；若只允許用掉一半預算給礫石面，Δ 須小於約 0.09 m。高差 0.10 m 對應傾斜 0.10/90 ≈ 1/900。預算分配為教學假設，1/500 為公開設計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 90 m footing, a level difference Δ across the gravel gives a tilt of Δ/90. The 1/500 allowance corresponds to Δ = 90/500 = 0.18 m; if only half that budget may be spent on the gravel bed, Δ must stay below about 0.09 m. A 0.10 m difference corresponds to 0.10/90 ≈ 1/900. The budget split is a teaching assumption; 1/500 is the published design value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋪設前後以多音束或高精度單音束測深建立礫石面的數值地形，網格點高差與整體平面度逐項比對公差；必要時以水下攝影或潛水員確認局部異常，沉箱就位後量測塔座傾斜，回算實際礫石面效果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before and after placement build a digital terrain of the gravel surface by multibeam or high-precision single-beam sounding, checking grid-point differences and overall flatness against tolerance; confirm local anomalies by underwater video or divers, and after landing measure the pylon base tilt to back-calculate the gravel-bed outcome.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

The 1/500 allowance corresponds to Δ = 90/500 = 0.18 m; if only half that budget may be spent on the gravel bed, Δ must stay below about 0.09 m. A 0.10 m difference corresponds to 0.10/90 ≈ 1/900. The budget split is a teaching assumption; 1/500 is the published design value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 65 m 水深的海床整備與礫石鋪設公差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seabed preparation at 65 m depth and gravel-bed tolerances: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「張力腿駁船」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tension-leg barge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋪設前後以多音束或高精度單音束測深建立礫石面的數值地形，網格點高差與整體平面度逐項比對公差；必要時以水下攝影或潛水員確認局部異常，沉箱就位後量測塔座傾斜，回算實際礫石面效果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before and after placement build a digital terrain of the gravel surface by multibeam or high-precision single-beam sounding, checking grid-point differences and overall flatness against tolerance; confirm local anomalies by underwater video or divers, and after landing measure the pylon base tilt to back-calculate the gravel-bed outcome. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：水下作業的檢查計畫要訂出測深頻率、網格大小、容許高差與重整條件，並把礫石面驗收列為沉箱下沉前的停留檢查點，由業主代表與設計者共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The underwater inspection plan should set sounding frequency, grid size, allowable differences and rework triggers, with gravel-bed acceptance a hold point before caisson sinking, signed jointly by the owner’s representative and the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：礫石面不平或局部鬆散，沉箱坐落後產生初始傾斜與不均勻接觸，地震時滑移行為也偏離設計；張力腿系統若失效，駁船起伏使插入物定位與打設深度出現誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An uneven or locally loose gravel surface gives the landed caisson an initial tilt and uneven contact, and makes its seismic sliding behaviour depart from design; if the tension-leg system fails, barge heave introduces errors in inclusion position and driving depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 65 m 水深的海床整備與礫石鋪設公差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seabed preparation at 65 m depth and gravel-bed tolerances: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「張力腿駁船」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tension-leg barge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 礫石面不平或局部鬆散，沉箱坐落後產生初始傾斜與不均勻接觸，地震時滑移行為也偏離設計；張力腿系統若失效，駁船起伏使插入物定位與打設深度出現誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An uneven or locally loose gravel surface gives the landed caisson an initial tilt and uneven contact, and makes its seismic sliding behaviour depart from design; if the tension-leg system fails, barge heave introduces errors in inclusion position and driving depth. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：礫石層的平整度直接決定沉箱坐落後的傾斜，而塔的傾斜容許只有 1/500，所以水下鋪設的公差比一般海事工程嚴格得多，需要以精密測深與耙平工具反覆修整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The flatness of the gravel bed determines the tilt of the caisson once landed, and the pylon tilt allowance is only 1/500, so underwater placement tolerances are much tighter than in ordinary marine work and need repeated precise soundings and screeding.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「深海的礫石墊層只是填料，平整度要求可以放寬。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A deep-water gravel bed is just fill, so its flatness can be relaxed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 礫石面不平或局部鬆散，沉箱坐落後產生初始傾斜與不均勻接觸，地震時滑移行為也偏離設計；張力腿系統若失效，駁船起伏使插入物定位與打設深度出現誤差。
knowledge.textEn: An uneven or locally loose gravel surface gives the landed caisson an initial tilt and uneven contact, and makes its seismic sliding behaviour depart from design; if the tension-leg system fails, barge heave introduces errors in inclusion position and driving depth.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「12 m 預製節段」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “12 m precast segments” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的組合橋面寬 27.2 m，每側兩根 2.2 m 高的鋼板梁，每 4 m 一道橫梁，上覆混凝土橋面板。營運單位公開資料指出，橋面以 12 m 長、約 340 t 的預製節段由浮吊放置，從每座塔向兩側平衡懸臂推進，最快每週約 60 m。平衡懸臂的關鍵在於兩側重量與斜索力保持對稱：只要一側先放節段，塔就要承受一個節段重量乘上懸臂長度的不平衡彎矩，懸臂愈長愈大。因此架設順序、臨時配重與斜索張拉步驟都必須事先排定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「12 m 預製節段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Rion–Antirion composite deck is 27.2 m wide, with two 2.2 m deep steel plate girders on each side, cross girders every 4 m and a concrete deck slab. Operator data state that it was erected in 12 m precast segments of about 340 t placed by floating crane, advancing as balanced cantilevers from each pylon at up to about 60 m a week. The key is keeping weights and stay forces symmetrical on both sides: whenever one side receives a segment first, the pylon carries an unbalanced moment equal to a segment’s weight times the cantilever length, growing as the cantilever lengthens. Erection order, temporary counterweights and stay-stressing steps must therefore be planned in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “12 m precast segments” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一個 340 t 節段約 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN，若在懸臂長 280 m 處先單側放置，不平衡彎矩 M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m；每週 60 m 相當於 60/12 = 5 個節段。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One 340 t segment weighs about 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN; placed on one side at a 280 m cantilever, it creates an unbalanced moment M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平衡懸臂只要最後兩側長度相同，中間的施工順序不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In balanced cantilever erection only the final equal lengths matter, not the order in between." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「12 m 預製節段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “12 m precast segments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

optionsEn: The Rion–Antirion composite deck is 27.2 m wide, with two 2.2 m deep steel plate girders on each side, cross girders every 4 m and a concrete deck slab.
In balanced cantilever erection only the final equal lengths matter, not the order in between.
More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful.
quiz.explanation: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的組合橋面寬 27.2 m，每側兩根 2.2 m 高的鋼板梁，每 4 m 一道橫梁，上覆混凝土橋面板。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Rion–Antirion composite deck is 27.2 m wide, with two 2.2 m deep steel plate girders on each side, cross girders every 4 m and a concrete deck slab. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「12 m 預製節段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “12 m precast segments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一個 340 t 節段約 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN，若在懸臂長 280 m 處先單側放置，不平衡彎矩 M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m；每週 60 m 相當於 60/12 = 5 個節段。若兩側交替並以臨時配重平衡，可把 M 控制在一半以下。懸臂長度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One 340 t segment weighs about 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN; placed on one side at a 280 m cantilever, it creates an unbalanced moment M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m. Sixty metres a week is 60/12 = 5 segments. Alternating sides with temporary counterweights can keep M below half that. The cantilever length is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個節段就位後量測兩側懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與新裝斜索的索力，與施工控制模型比較；超出容許時先調整斜索力再進行下一節段；浮吊作業前確認風浪條件與吊重紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each segment is placed, survey both cantilever-tip levels, pylon-top displacement and the new stay’s force and compare with the construction-control model; if outside tolerance, adjust stay forces before the next segment; confirm wind and wave conditions and lift records before each floating-crane operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一個 340 t 節段約 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN，若在懸臂長 280 m 處先單側放置，不平衡彎矩 M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m；每週 60 m 相當於 60/12 = 5 個節段。若兩側交替並以臨時配重平衡，可把 M 控制在一半以下。懸臂長度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: One 340 t segment weighs about 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN; placed on one side at a 280 m cantilever, it creates an unbalanced moment M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m. Sixty metres a week is 60/12 = 5 segments. Alternating sides with temporary counterweights can keep M below half that. The cantilever length is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck", which statement holds?
options: 斜索是由許多鋼絞線組成的，所以整根斜索不可能突然失效。
一個 340 t 節段約 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN，若在懸臂長 280 m 處先單側放置，不平衡彎矩 M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m。
抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。
optionsEn: Because a stay is made of many strands, the whole stay can never fail suddenly.
One 340 t segment weighs about 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN; placed on one side at a 280 m cantilever, it creates an unbalanced moment M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m.
The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed.
quiz.explanation: 一個 340 t 節段約 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN，若在懸臂長 280 m 處先單側放置，不平衡彎矩 M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m；每週 60 m 相當於 60/12 = 5 個節段。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: One 340 t segment weighs about 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN; placed on one side at a 280 m cantilever, it creates an unbalanced moment M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「12 m 預製節段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “12 m precast segments” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個節段就位後量測兩側懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與新裝斜索的索力，與施工控制模型比較；超出容許時先調整斜索力再進行下一節段；浮吊作業前確認風浪條件與吊重紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each segment is placed, survey both cantilever-tip levels, pylon-top displacement and the new stay’s force and compare with the construction-control model; if outside tolerance, adjust stay forces before the next segment; confirm wind and wave conditions and lift records before each floating-crane operation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：架設計畫要列出每一步的容許不平衡彎矩、臨時配重位置與量測項目，並規定強風或浮吊故障時的懸臂臨時固定方式；每座塔的合龍視為停留檢查點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection plan should list the allowable unbalanced moment, temporary counterweight positions and measurements for every step and define how cantilevers are secured in strong wind or if the floating crane fails; each closure is a hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不平衡架設超過塔的設計容量，會使塔頂偏位過大、塔身開裂；若相鄰兩個懸臂在合龍時高差過大，需強制頂壓才能對接，會在橋面留下殘餘應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unbalanced erection beyond the pylon’s capacity causes excessive pylon sway and cracking; a large level difference between adjacent cantilevers at closure forces jacking to align them, leaving residual stress in the deck. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個節段就位後量測兩側懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與新裝斜索的索力，與施工控制模型比較；超出容許時先調整斜索力再進行下一節段；浮吊作業前確認風浪條件與吊重紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: After each segment is placed, survey both cantilever-tip levels, pylon-top displacement and the new stay’s force and compare with the construction-control model; if outside tolerance, adjust stay forces before the next segment; confirm wind and wave conditions and lift records before each floating-crane operation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 架設計畫要列出每一步的容許不平衡彎矩、臨時配重位置與量測項目，並規定強風或浮吊故障時的懸臂臨時固定方式；每座塔的合龍視為停留檢查點。
knowledge.textEn: The erection plan should list the allowable unbalanced moment, temporary counterweight positions and measurements for every step and define how cantilevers are secured in strong wind or if the floating crane fails; each closure is a hold point.

quiz.question: 要驗證「組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
軟弱海床上的大橋基礎一定要用長樁打到岩盤。
每個節段就位後量測兩側懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與新裝斜索的索力，與施工控制模型比較；超出容許時先調整斜索力再進行下一節段；浮吊作業前確認風浪條件與吊重紀錄。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Bridge foundations on soft seabed must always use long piles driven to rock.
After each segment is placed, survey both cantilever-tip levels, pylon-top displacement and the new stay’s force and compare with the construction-control model.
quiz.explanation: 每個節段就位後量測兩側懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與新裝斜索的索力，與施工控制模型比較；超出容許時先調整斜索力再進行下一節段；浮吊作業前確認風浪條件與吊重紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each segment is placed, survey both cantilever-tip levels, pylon-top displacement and the new stay’s force and compare with the construction-control model; if outside tolerance, adjust stay forces before the next segment; confirm wind and wave conditions and lift records before each floating-crane operation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「12 m 預製節段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “12 m precast segments” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不平衡架設超過塔的設計容量，會使塔頂偏位過大、塔身開裂；若相鄰兩個懸臂在合龍時高差過大，需強制頂壓才能對接，會在橋面留下殘餘應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unbalanced erection beyond the pylon’s capacity causes excessive pylon sway and cracking; a large level difference between adjacent cantilevers at closure forces jacking to align them, leaving residual stress in the deck. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此架設順序、臨時配重與斜索張拉步驟都必須事先排定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Erection order, temporary counterweights and stay-stressing steps must therefore be planned in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平衡懸臂只要最後兩側長度相同，中間的施工順序不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In balanced cantilever erection only the final equal lengths matter, not the order in between." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不平衡架設超過塔的設計容量，會使塔頂偏位過大、塔身開裂；若相鄰兩個懸臂在合龍時高差過大，需強制頂壓才能對接，會在橋面留下殘餘應力。
knowledge.textEn: Unbalanced erection beyond the pylon’s capacity causes excessive pylon sway and cracking; a large level difference between adjacent cantilevers at closure forces jacking to align them, leaving residual stress in the deck.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 不平衡架設超過塔的設計容量，會使塔頂偏位過大、塔身開裂；若相鄰兩個懸臂在合龍時高差過大，需強制頂壓才能對接，會在橋面留下殘餘應力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
感測器越多、取樣越快，監測系統就一定越有用。
optionsEn: Unbalanced erection beyond the pylon’s capacity causes excessive pylon sway and cracking.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful.
quiz.explanation: 不平衡架設超過塔的設計容量，會使塔頂偏位過大、塔身開裂；若相鄰兩個懸臂在合龍時高差過大，需強制頂壓才能對接，會在橋面留下殘餘應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unbalanced erection beyond the pylon’s capacity causes excessive pylon sway and cracking; a large level difference between adjacent cantilevers at closure forces jacking to align them, leaving residual stress in the deck. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告」與「測地監測、塔傾斜與構造位移追蹤」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports" and "Geodetic monitoring, pylon tilt and tectonic tracking": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「限制器荷重計」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrainer load cells” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 營運單位公開資料指出，大橋的監測系統（WEASHM）有超過 100 個感測器、約 300 個通道，分布於塔、橋面、斜索與伸縮縫，以 100 Hz 取樣，量測荷重、斜索振動、橋面與塔振動、伸縮縫位移，以及風速風向與氣溫、橋面溫度。資料在四座塔內先以硬體處理並與門檻比較，再經光纖送到營運大樓與控制室；地震或強風等特殊事件開始 5 分鐘後會自動寄出報告。限制器上的荷重計特別重要，因為它直接告訴營運者熔斷元件是否接近或已經斷開，以及地震後是否需要重新校準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「限制器荷重計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Operator data state that the bridge’s monitoring system (WEASHM) has more than 100 sensors and about 300 channels on pylons, deck, stays and expansion joints, sampling at 100 Hz to measure loads, stay vibration, deck and pylon vibration and joint displacement, as well as wind speed and direction, air and deck temperature. Data are processed in hardware inside the four pylons and compared with thresholds, then sent by optical fibre to the operations building and control room; an automatic report is emailed 5 minutes after a special event such as an earthquake or high wind begins. The load cells on the restrainers are especially important, telling the operator whether the fuses are near breaking or have broken and whether recalibration is needed after an earthquake. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Restrainer load cells” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 位元組 × 秒數 = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes，約 10.4 GB/日；100 Hz 取樣的可用頻寬上限（奈奎斯特頻率）為 50 Hz，足以涵蓋斜索與橋面的主要模態。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes × seconds = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes, about 10.4 GB per day; 100 Hz sampling gives a usable bandwidth up to the 50 Hz Nyquist frequency, enough for the main stay and deck modes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器越多、取樣越快，監測系統就一定越有用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「限制器荷重計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Restrainer load cells”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告
knowledge.titleEn: The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports
knowledge.text: 營運單位公開資料指出，大橋的監測系統（WEASHM）有超過 100 個感測器、約 300 個通道，分布於塔、橋面、斜索與伸縮縫，以 100 Hz 取樣，量測荷重、斜索振動、橋面與塔振動、伸縮縫位移，以及風速風向與氣溫、橋面溫度。資料在四座塔內先以硬體處理並與門檻比較，再經光纖送到營運大樓與控制室；地震或強風等特殊事件開始 5 分鐘後會自動寄出報告。
knowledge.textEn: Operator data state that the bridge’s monitoring system (WEASHM) has more than 100 sensors and about 300 channels on pylons, deck, stays and expansion joints, sampling at 100 Hz to measure loads, stay vibration, deck and pylon vibration and joint displacement, as well as wind speed and direction, air and deck temperature. Data are processed in hardware inside the four pylons and compared with thresholds, then sent by optical fibre to the operations building and control room; an automatic report is emailed 5 minutes after a special event such as an earthquake or high wind begins.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器越多、取樣越快，監測系統就一定越有用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports" is correct?
options: 感測器越多、取樣越快，監測系統就一定越有用。
營運單位公開資料指出，大橋的監測系統（WEASHM）有超過 100 個感測器、約 300 個通道，分布於塔、橋面、斜索與伸縮縫，以 100 Hz 取樣，量測荷重、斜索振動、橋面與塔振動、伸縮縫位移，以及風速風向與氣溫、橋面溫度。
有了即時感測器，就不需要定期做傳統測量。
optionsEn: More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful.

Operator data state that the bridge’s monitoring system (WEASHM) has more than 100 sensors and about 300 channels on pylons, deck, stays and expansion joints, sampling at 100 Hz to measure loads, stay vibration, deck and pylon vibration and joint displacement, as well as wind speed and direction, air and deck temperature.
With real-time sensors there is no need for periodic conventional surveys.
quiz.explanation: 營運單位公開資料指出，大橋的監測系統（WEASHM）有超過 100 個感測器、約 300 個通道，分布於塔、橋面、斜索與伸縮縫，以 100 Hz 取樣，量測荷重、斜索振動、橋面與塔振動、伸縮縫位移，以及風速風向與氣溫、橋面溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Operator data state that the bridge’s monitoring system (WEASHM) has more than 100 sensors and about 300 channels on pylons, deck, stays and expansion joints, sampling at 100 Hz to measure loads, stay vibration, deck and pylon vibration and joint displacement, as well as wind speed and direction, air and deck temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「限制器荷重計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrainer load cells” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 位元組 × 秒數 = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes，約 10.4 GB/日；100 Hz 取樣的可用頻寬上限（奈奎斯特頻率）為 50 Hz，足以涵蓋斜索與橋面的主要模態。每點 4 bytes 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes × seconds = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes, about 10.4 GB per day; 100 Hz sampling gives a usable bandwidth up to the 50 Hz Nyquist frequency, enough for the main stay and deck modes. Four bytes per sample is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以人工量測（例如振動法索力、手持加速度計）比對感測器讀值，檢查漂移與時間同步；以已知事件（強風日、重車通過）驗證門檻與自動報告流程是否正確觸發，並保存原始資料與處理參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically compare sensor readings with manual measurements such as vibration-based stay force or handheld accelerometers, checking drift and time synchronisation; use known events such as high-wind days or heavy vehicles to confirm thresholds and automatic reporting trigger correctly, and archive raw data with processing parameters.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Four bytes per sample is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports", which statement holds?
options: 高強度海工混凝土在 120 年內不需要任何耐久性檢測。
橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。
資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 位元組 × 秒數 = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes，約 10.4 GB/日。
optionsEn: High-strength marine concrete needs no durability testing over 120 years.
If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake.
Data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes × seconds = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes, about 10.4 GB per day.
quiz.explanation: 資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 位元組 × 秒數 = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes，約 10.4 GB/日；100 Hz 取樣的可用頻寬上限（奈奎斯特頻率）為 50 Hz，足以涵蓋斜索與橋面的主要模態。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes × seconds = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes, about 10.4 GB per day; 100 Hz sampling gives a usable bandwidth up to the 50 Hz Nyquist frequency, enough for the main stay and deck modes. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「限制器荷重計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrainer load cells” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以人工量測（例如振動法索力、手持加速度計）比對感測器讀值，檢查漂移與時間同步；以已知事件（強風日、重車通過）驗證門檻與自動報告流程是否正確觸發，並保存原始資料與處理參數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Periodically compare sensor readings with manual measurements such as vibration-based stay force or handheld accelerometers, checking drift and time synchronisation; use known events such as high-wind days or heavy vehicles to confirm thresholds and automatic reporting trigger correctly, and archive raw data with processing parameters. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測系統交接要包含感測器清單、校正紀錄、門檻邏輯、自動報告格式與事件後的檢查流程，並明訂誰在收到報告後多少時間內決定封橋或放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Monitoring handover should include the sensor list, calibration records, threshold logic, report format and post-event inspection procedure, and state who decides closure or reopening and within what time after a report arrives.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：門檻設定只依設計值而未考慮正常季節變化，會產生大量誤報，使營運人員忽略警報；感測器失效或時間不同步若未被發現，地震後的報告可能遺漏關鍵資訊，延誤檢查與交通管制決策。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thresholds set from design values without normal seasonal variation generate floods of false alarms that operators learn to ignore; undetected sensor failure or loss of synchronisation can leave key information out of a post-earthquake report, delaying inspection and traffic decisions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 定期以人工量測（例如振動法索力、手持加速度計）比對感測器讀值，檢查漂移與時間同步；以已知事件（強風日、重車通過）驗證門檻與自動報告流程是否正確觸發，並保存原始資料與處理參數。
knowledge.textEn: Periodically compare sensor readings with manual measurements such as vibration-based stay force or handheld accelerometers, checking drift and time synchronisation; use known events such as high-wind days or heavy vehicles to confirm thresholds and automatic reporting trigger correctly, and archive raw data with processing parameters.

knowledge.text: 監測系統交接要包含感測器清單、校正紀錄、門檻邏輯、自動報告格式與事件後的檢查流程，並明訂誰在收到報告後多少時間內決定封橋或放行。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring handover should include the sensor list, calibration records, threshold logic, report format and post-event inspection procedure, and state who decides closure or reopening and within what time after a report arrives.

quiz.question: 要驗證「WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports"?
options: 定期以人工量測（例如振動法索力、手持加速度計）比對感測器讀值，檢查漂移與時間同步。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。
optionsEn: Periodically compare sensor readings with manual measurements such as vibration-based stay force or handheld accelerometers, checking drift and time synchronisation.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea.
quiz.explanation: 定期以人工量測（例如振動法索力、手持加速度計）比對感測器讀值，檢查漂移與時間同步；以已知事件（強風日、重車通過）驗證門檻與自動報告流程是否正確觸發，並保存原始資料與處理參數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Periodically compare sensor readings with manual measurements such as vibration-based stay force or handheld accelerometers, checking drift and time synchronisation; use known events such as high-wind days or heavy vehicles to confirm thresholds and automatic reporting trigger correctly, and archive raw data with processing parameters. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「限制器荷重計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrainer load cells” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 門檻設定只依設計值而未考慮正常季節變化，會產生大量誤報，使營運人員忽略警報；感測器失效或時間不同步若未被發現，地震後的報告可能遺漏關鍵資訊，延誤檢查與交通管制決策。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Thresholds set from design values without normal seasonal variation generate floods of false alarms that operators learn to ignore; undetected sensor failure or loss of synchronisation can leave key information out of a post-earthquake report, delaying inspection and traffic decisions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：限制器上的荷重計特別重要，因為它直接告訴營運者熔斷元件是否接近或已經斷開，以及地震後是否需要重新校準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The load cells on the restrainers are especially important, telling the operator whether the fuses are near breaking or have broken and whether recalibration is needed after an earthquake.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器越多、取樣越快，監測系統就一定越有用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 門檻設定只依設計值而未考慮正常季節變化，會產生大量誤報，使營運人員忽略警報；感測器失效或時間不同步若未被發現，地震後的報告可能遺漏關鍵資訊，延誤檢查與交通管制決策。
knowledge.textEn: Thresholds set from design values without normal seasonal variation generate floods of false alarms that operators learn to ignore; undetected sensor failure or loss of synchronisation can leave key information out of a post-earthquake report, delaying inspection and traffic decisions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
門檻設定只依設計值而未考慮正常季節變化，會產生大量誤報，使營運人員忽略警報。
有了即時感測器，就不需要定期做傳統測量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Thresholds set from design values without normal seasonal variation generate floods of false alarms that operators learn to ignore.
With real-time sensors there is no need for periodic conventional surveys.
quiz.explanation: 門檻設定只依設計值而未考慮正常季節變化，會產生大量誤報，使營運人員忽略警報；感測器失效或時間不同步若未被發現，地震後的報告可能遺漏關鍵資訊，延誤檢查與交通管制決策。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thresholds set from design values without normal seasonal variation generate floods of false alarms that operators learn to ignore; undetected sensor failure or loss of synchronisation can leave key information out of a post-earthquake report, delaying inspection and traffic decisions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 測地監測、塔傾斜與構造位移追蹤：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Geodetic monitoring, pylon tilt and tectonic tracking: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「岸邊與墩位測地點」如何影響里翁—安提里翁大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shore and pier geodetic points” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rion–Antirion Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 感測器擅長記錄動態反應，但緩慢的構造位移、基礎沉陷與塔的傾斜需要另一種工具。營運單位公開資料指出，大橋定期以傳統測地方法（非永久系統）量測橋梁幾何以及兩岸與各墩位的構造位移。這些量測把每座塔、每個基礎放進同一個座標系統，追蹤多年下來的相對位移、沉陷與傾斜是否仍在設計預算內。塔高很大，即使很小的傾斜也會在塔頂放大成明顯位移，進而改變斜索幾何與索力，因此傾斜量測同時是結構與斜索系統的健康指標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「岸邊與墩位測地點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sensors excel at dynamic response, but slow tectonic movement, foundation settlement and pylon tilt need another tool. Operator data state that bridge geometry and tectonic movements at the shores and pier locations are measured at regular intervals by classical geodetic survey rather than a permanent system. These surveys place every pylon and footing in one coordinate system and track whether relative displacement, settlement and tilt over the years remain within the design budget. Because the pylons are tall, even a small tilt is magnified into a visible top displacement that changes stay geometry and forces, so tilt is a health indicator for both the structure and its stay system. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shore and pier geodetic points” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：塔頂偏位 = 傾斜 × 高度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pylon-top offset = tilt × height.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有了即時感測器，就不需要定期做傳統測量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With real-time sensors there is no need for periodic conventional surveys." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「岸邊與墩位測地點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shore and pier geodetic points”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測地監測、塔傾斜與構造位移追蹤
knowledge.titleEn: Geodetic monitoring, pylon tilt and tectonic tracking
knowledge.text: 感測器擅長記錄動態反應，但緩慢的構造位移、基礎沉陷與塔的傾斜需要另一種工具。營運單位公開資料指出，大橋定期以傳統測地方法（非永久系統）量測橋梁幾何以及兩岸與各墩位的構造位移。
knowledge.textEn: Sensors excel at dynamic response, but slow tectonic movement, foundation settlement and pylon tilt need another tool. Operator data state that bridge geometry and tectonic movements at the shores and pier locations are measured at regular intervals by classical geodetic survey rather than a permanent system.
