knowledge.textEn: The two pylons are prestressed concrete inverted Y shapes about 214 m tall and about 20,000 t each, with legs leaning inward so the pylon works mainly in compression. The two cable planes rise from both deck edges and converge at the pylon head; in cross-section, stays, deck and pylon legs form a triangle, so twisting the deck requires one plane of stays to lengthen and the other to shorten, and their axial stiffness directly supplies torsional stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes" is correct?
options: 塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。
斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。
兩座塔高約 214 m、各重約 20,000 t，為預力混凝土倒 Y 形，兩肢向內傾斜，使塔以受壓為主。
optionsEn: Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance.
As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter.
The two pylons are prestressed concrete inverted Y shapes about 214 m tall and about 20,000 t each, with legs leaning inward so the pylon works mainly in compression.
quiz.explanation: 兩座塔高約 214 m、各重約 20,000 t，為預力混凝土倒 Y 形，兩肢向內傾斜，使塔以受壓為主。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The two pylons are prestressed concrete inverted Y shapes about 214 m tall and about 20,000 t each, with legs leaning inward so the pylon works mainly in compression. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「倒 Y 形混凝土塔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inverted-Y concrete pylons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塔肢軸力 N = V/(2cosθ)。若塔頂合計垂直力 V = 400 MN、肢與鉛垂夾角 θ = 10°：N = 400/(2×0.985) ≈ 203 MN；若 θ 增為 20°，N = 400/(2×0.940) ≈ 213 MN，但肢底的水平推力 N·sinθ 由約 35 MN 增至約 73 MN，需由橫梁或基礎承擔。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Leg force N = V/(2cosθ). With a total vertical force V = 400 MN at the head and legs at θ = 10° from vertical, N = 400/(2×0.985) ≈ 203 MN; at θ = 20°, N = 400/(2×0.940) ≈ 213 MN, but the horizontal thrust at the leg base, N·sinθ, grows from about 35 MN to about 73 MN, to be carried by a cross beam or the foundation. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模態分析取得橋面一階垂直彎曲與一階扭轉頻率，計算頻率比並與風洞顫振試驗結果比較；施工中量測兩肢的垂直度與交會點座標，確認斜索錨點位置與設計一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the first vertical bending and torsional frequencies from modal analysis, compute their ratio and compare with flutter test results; during construction survey the verticality of both legs and the coordinates of their meeting point to confirm stay anchor positions match the design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 塔肢軸力 N = V/(2cosθ)。若塔頂合計垂直力 V = 400 MN、肢與鉛垂夾角 θ = 10°：N = 400/(2×0.985) ≈ 203 MN；若 θ 增為 20°，N = 400/(2×0.940) ≈ 213 MN，但肢底的水平推力 N·sinθ 由約 35 MN 增至約 73 MN，需由橫梁或基礎承擔。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Leg force N = V/(2cosθ). With a total vertical force V = 400 MN at the head and legs at θ = 10° from vertical, N = 400/(2×0.985) ≈ 203 MN; at θ = 20°, N = 400/(2×0.940) ≈ 213 MN, but the horizontal thrust at the leg base, N·sinθ, grows from about 35 MN to about 73 MN, to be carried by a cross beam or the foundation. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes", which statement holds?
options: 塔肢軸力 N = V/(2cosθ)。
混凝土橋面澆好後形狀就固定了，不需要考慮之後的變形。
只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。
optionsEn: Leg force N = V/(2cosθ).
A concrete deck’s shape is fixed once cast; later deformation need not be considered.
Knowing the mean wind speed is enough to determine the wind load on a long bridge.
quiz.explanation: 塔肢軸力 N = V/(2cosθ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Leg force N = V/(2cosθ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「倒 Y 形混凝土塔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inverted-Y concrete pylons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以模態分析取得橋面一階垂直彎曲與一階扭轉頻率，計算頻率比並與風洞顫振試驗結果比較；施工中量測兩肢的垂直度與交會點座標，確認斜索錨點位置與設計一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the first vertical bending and torsional frequencies from modal analysis, compute their ratio and compare with flutter test results; during construction survey the verticality of both legs and the coordinates of their meeting point to confirm stay anchor positions match the design. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塔型選擇報告應同時列出頻率比、顫振臨界風速與塔肢內力的比較；塔肢交會區與錨固區的鋼筋、預力配置要以三維模型檢查施工可行性，避免混凝土澆置不密實。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The pylon-form study should compare frequency ratio, flutter speed and leg forces together; reinforcement and prestress at the leg junction and anchorage zone should be checked for buildability in a 3D model to avoid poorly compacted concrete.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低；塔肢交會處的局部應力若設計不足，預力或鋼筋配置不當會出現裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed; inadequate design of the leg junction leads to cracking where prestress or reinforcement is poorly arranged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以模態分析取得橋面一階垂直彎曲與一階扭轉頻率，計算頻率比並與風洞顫振試驗結果比較；施工中量測兩肢的垂直度與交會點座標，確認斜索錨點位置與設計一致。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain the first vertical bending and torsional frequencies from modal analysis, compute their ratio and compare with flutter test results; during construction survey the verticality of both legs and the coordinates of their meeting point to confirm stay anchor positions match the design.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 塔型選擇報告應同時列出頻率比、顫振臨界風速與塔肢內力的比較；塔肢交會區與錨固區的鋼筋、預力配置要以三維模型檢查施工可行性，避免混凝土澆置不密實。
knowledge.textEn: The pylon-form study should compare frequency ratio, flutter speed and leg forces together; reinforcement and prestress at the leg junction and anchorage zone should be checked for buildability in a 3D model to avoid poorly compacted concrete.

quiz.question: 要驗證「倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以模態分析取得橋面一階垂直彎曲與一階扭轉頻率，計算頻率比並與風洞顫振試驗結果比較；施工中量測兩肢的垂直度與交會點座標，確認斜索錨點位置與設計一致。
斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Obtain the first vertical bending and torsional frequencies from modal analysis, compute their ratio and compare with flutter test results.
With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode.
quiz.explanation: 以模態分析取得橋面一階垂直彎曲與一階扭轉頻率，計算頻率比並與風洞顫振試驗結果比較；施工中量測兩肢的垂直度與交會點座標，確認斜索錨點位置與設計一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain the first vertical bending and torsional frequencies from modal analysis, compute their ratio and compare with flutter test results; during construction survey the verticality of both legs and the coordinates of their meeting point to confirm stay anchor positions match the design. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「倒 Y 形混凝土塔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inverted-Y concrete pylons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低；塔肢交會處的局部應力若設計不足，預力或鋼筋配置不當會出現裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed; inadequate design of the leg junction leads to cracking where prestress or reinforcement is poorly arranged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這對主跨 856 m、寬約 23.6 m 的細長橋面非常重要，因為扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率的比值越高，扭轉顫振越不容易發生。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This matters greatly for an 856 m main span with a deck only about 23.6 m wide, because the higher the ratio of torsional to bending frequency, the less likely torsional flutter becomes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低；塔肢交會處的局部應力若設計不足，預力或鋼筋配置不當會出現裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed; inadequate design of the leg junction leads to cracking where prestress or reinforcement is poorly arranged.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。
若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter.
Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed.
quiz.explanation: 若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低；塔肢交會處的局部應力若設計不足，預力或鋼筋配置不當會出現裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed; inadequate design of the leg junction leads to cracking where prestress or reinforcement is poorly arranged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力」與「塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays" and "Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「184 根鋼絞線斜索」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “184 strand stays” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 官方技術資料列出全橋 184 根斜索（8 組 × 23 根），每根由 31 至 53 股直徑 15.7 mm 的鋼絞線組成，長度約 95 m 至 460 m。每股鋼絞線破斷力約 27 t，使用拉力約 10 t。平行鋼絞線斜索的優點是可以逐股安裝與張拉，不需要一次吊起整根數十噸的成品索，日後也可以逐股抽換；缺點是每股之間的力量必須均勻，否則受力最大的那股會先疲勞或鬆弛。斜索在中央鋼梁段與混凝土段的錨固方式不同，錨具要分別配合鋼錨箱與混凝土錨塊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「184 根鋼絞線斜索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The official technical sheet lists 184 stays (8 groups × 23), each made of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm diameter and about 95 m to 460 m long. Each strand has a breaking load of about 27 t and a service tension of about 10 t. Parallel-strand stays can be installed and stressed strand by strand, avoiding lifting a finished cable weighing tens of tonnes, and strands can later be replaced one at a time; the catch is that force must be even among strands, or the most heavily loaded one fatigues or relaxes first. Anchorage differs between the central steel zone and the concrete zones, so anchorages must suit steel anchor boxes and concrete anchor blocks respectively. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “184 strand stays” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：使用應力比 = 10/27 ≈ 37% 的破斷力；最大 53 股斜索破斷力 53×27 = 1,431 t、使用力 53×10 = 530 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Service ratio = 10/27 ≈ 37% of breaking load; the largest 53-strand stay has 53×27 = 1,431 t breaking and 53×10 = 530 t service force.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「184 根鋼絞線斜索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “184 strand stays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力
knowledge.titleEn: Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays
knowledge.text: 官方技術資料列出全橋 184 根斜索（8 組 × 23 根），每根由 31 至 53 股直徑 15.7 mm 的鋼絞線組成，長度約 95 m 至 460 m。每股鋼絞線破斷力約 27 t，使用拉力約 10 t。
knowledge.textEn: The official technical sheet lists 184 stays (8 groups × 23), each made of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm diameter and about 95 m to 460 m long. Each strand has a breaking load of about 27 t and a service tension of about 10 t.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays" is correct?
options: 官方技術資料列出全橋 184 根斜索（8 組 × 23 根），每根由 31 至 53 股直徑 15.7 mm 的鋼絞線組成，長度約 95 m 至 460 m。
斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。
塔的基礎只要總承載力夠，兩肢之間的沉陷差不重要。
optionsEn: The official technical sheet lists 184 stays (8 groups × 23), each made of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm diameter and about 95 m to 460 m long.
As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter.
If total capacity is enough, differential settlement between pylon legs does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 官方技術資料列出全橋 184 根斜索（8 組 × 23 根），每根由 31 至 53 股直徑 15.7 mm 的鋼絞線組成，長度約 95 m 至 460 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The official technical sheet lists 184 stays (8 groups × 23), each made of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm diameter and about 95 m to 460 m long. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「184 根鋼絞線斜索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “184 strand stays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：使用應力比 = 10/27 ≈ 37% 的破斷力；最大 53 股斜索破斷力 53×27 = 1,431 t、使用力 53×10 = 530 t。15.7 mm 鋼絞線截面約 150 mm²，以 1,860 MPa 計破斷力約 279 kN（約 28 t），與官方 27 t 相近。截面與強度等級為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Service ratio = 10/27 ≈ 37% of breaking load; the largest 53-strand stay has 53×27 = 1,431 t breaking and 53×10 = 530 t service force. A 15.7 mm strand of about 150 mm² at 1,860 MPa breaks at about 279 kN (about 28 t), close to the official 27 t. Section and grade are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼絞線每批做拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗，錨具組裝體依斜索規範做疲勞後破斷試驗；安裝後抽查各股力量的均勻度（例如以單股千斤頂舉升檢測），並記錄每根索的總力與各股最大偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test each strand lot for tension, relaxation and fatigue and test anchorage assemblies for residual strength after fatigue under stay-cable recommendations; after installation spot-check strand-force uniformity, for example by single-strand lift-off, and record each stay’s total force and maximum strand deviation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 使用應力比 = 10/27 ≈ 37% 的破斷力；最大 53 股斜索破斷力 53×27 = 1,431 t、使用力 53×10 = 530 t。15.7 mm 鋼絞線截面約 150 mm²，以 1,860 MPa 計破斷力約 279 kN（約 28 t），與官方 27 t 相近。截面與強度等級為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Service ratio = 10/27 ≈ 37% of breaking load; the largest 53-strand stay has 53×27 = 1,431 t breaking and 53×10 = 530 t service force. A 15.7 mm strand of about 150 mm² at 1,860 MPa breaks at about 279 kN (about 28 t), close to the official 27 t. Section and grade are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays", which statement holds?
options: 斜張橋懸臂每加一節，懸臂端的變形都相同，可以用固定的修正值。
斜索振動只是外觀問題，不會影響結構壽命。
optionsEn: Each added segment deforms the cantilever tip by the same amount, so a fixed correction can be used.
Service ratio = 10/27 ≈ 37% of breaking load; the largest 53-strand stay has 53×27 = 1,431 t breaking and 53×10 = 530 t service force.
Stay vibration is only cosmetic and does not affect structural life.
quiz.explanation: 使用應力比 = 10/27 ≈ 37% 的破斷力；最大 53 股斜索破斷力 53×27 = 1,431 t、使用力 53×10 = 530 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Service ratio = 10/27 ≈ 37% of breaking load; the largest 53-strand stay has 53×27 = 1,431 t breaking and 53×10 = 530 t service force. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「184 根鋼絞線斜索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “184 strand stays” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋼絞線每批做拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗，錨具組裝體依斜索規範做疲勞後破斷試驗；安裝後抽查各股力量的均勻度（例如以單股千斤頂舉升檢測），並記錄每根索的總力與各股最大偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test each strand lot for tension, relaxation and fatigue and test anchorage assemblies for residual strength after fatigue under stay-cable recommendations; after installation spot-check strand-force uniformity, for example by single-strand lift-off, and record each stay’s total force and maximum strand deviation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜索安裝規範要寫明各股力量容許偏差、量測方法與抽查比例，並規定錨具防水帽與填充材料的施工檢查；每根索的安裝紀錄要能追溯到鋼絞線批號。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The stay installation specification should state the allowable strand-force deviation, measurement method and sampling rate and require checks on anchorage caps and filler; each stay’s record must trace back to strand lot numbers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若各股力量不均，受力最大的鋼絞線在活載與風振下承受較大應力幅，可能先在錨口疲勞斷裂，隨後負荷轉移到其他股，形成漸進劣化；錨具夾片咬合不良則可能滑移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven strand forces subject the most loaded strand to larger stress ranges under traffic and wind vibration, so it may fatigue at the anchor exit first and shift load to others in progressive deterioration; poorly seated wedges can slip. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鋼絞線每批做拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗，錨具組裝體依斜索規範做疲勞後破斷試驗；安裝後抽查各股力量的均勻度（例如以單股千斤頂舉升檢測），並記錄每根索的總力與各股最大偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Test each strand lot for tension, relaxation and fatigue and test anchorage assemblies for residual strength after fatigue under stay-cable recommendations; after installation spot-check strand-force uniformity, for example by single-strand lift-off, and record each stay’s total force and maximum strand deviation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 斜索安裝規範要寫明各股力量容許偏差、量測方法與抽查比例，並規定錨具防水帽與填充材料的施工檢查；每根索的安裝紀錄要能追溯到鋼絞線批號。
knowledge.textEn: The stay installation specification should state the allowable strand-force deviation, measurement method and sampling rate and require checks on anchorage caps and filler; each stay’s record must trace back to strand lot numbers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。
鋼絞線每批做拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗，錨具組裝體依斜索規範做疲勞後破斷試驗。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed.
Test each strand lot for tension, relaxation and fatigue and test anchorage assemblies for residual strength after fatigue under stay-cable recommendations.
quiz.explanation: 鋼絞線每批做拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗，錨具組裝體依斜索規範做疲勞後破斷試驗；安裝後抽查各股力量的均勻度（例如以單股千斤頂舉升檢測），並記錄每根索的總力與各股最大偏差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test each strand lot for tension, relaxation and fatigue and test anchorage assemblies for residual strength after fatigue under stay-cable recommendations; after installation spot-check strand-force uniformity, for example by single-strand lift-off, and record each stay’s total force and maximum strand deviation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「184 根鋼絞線斜索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “184 strand stays” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若各股力量不均，受力最大的鋼絞線在活載與風振下承受較大應力幅，可能先在錨口疲勞斷裂，隨後負荷轉移到其他股，形成漸進劣化；錨具夾片咬合不良則可能滑移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven strand forces subject the most loaded strand to larger stress ranges under traffic and wind vibration, so it may fatigue at the anchor exit first and shift load to others in progressive deterioration; poorly seated wedges can slip. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：斜索在中央鋼梁段與混凝土段的錨固方式不同，錨具要分別配合鋼錨箱與混凝土錨塊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Anchorage differs between the central steel zone and the concrete zones, so anchorages must suit steel anchor boxes and concrete anchor blocks respectively.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若各股力量不均，受力最大的鋼絞線在活載與風振下承受較大應力幅，可能先在錨口疲勞斷裂，隨後負荷轉移到其他股，形成漸進劣化；錨具夾片咬合不良則可能滑移。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven strand forces subject the most loaded strand to larger stress ranges under traffic and wind vibration, so it may fatigue at the anchor exit first and shift load to others in progressive deterioration; poorly seated wedges can slip.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若各股力量不均，受力最大的鋼絞線在活載與風振下承受較大應力幅，可能先在錨口疲勞斷裂，隨後負荷轉移到其他股，形成漸進劣化；錨具夾片咬合不良則可能滑移。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
塔的基礎只要總承載力夠，兩肢之間的沉陷差不重要。
optionsEn: Uneven strand forces subject the most loaded strand to larger stress ranges under traffic and wind vibration, so it may fatigue at the anchor exit first and shift load to others in progressive deterioration.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If total capacity is enough, differential settlement between pylon legs does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 若各股力量不均，受力最大的鋼絞線在活載與風振下承受較大應力幅，可能先在錨口疲勞斷裂，隨後負荷轉移到其他股，形成漸進劣化；錨具夾片咬合不良則可能滑移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven strand forces subject the most loaded strand to larger stress ranges under traffic and wind vibration, so it may fatigue at the anchor exit first and shift load to others in progressive deterioration; poorly seated wedges can slip. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔基 2.10 m 樁群」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2.10 m pylon piles” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 諾曼第大橋位於塞納河口，表層為軟弱沖積層，塔的巨大垂直力必須以深樁傳到下方承載層。官方技術資料列出塔基礎共 56 根直徑 2.10 m 的樁（表列 4 × 14），總長 2,828 m，深度約 40 至 55 m，每根承載約 3,000 t；南側高架橋墩另有 52 根直徑 1.50 m 的樁。塔肢分開落在兩組樁上，樁群透過厚承台把兩肢的軸力與肢底水平推力整合起來。樁群設計除了承載，還要控制兩肢之間的不均勻沉陷，因為沉陷差會使塔頂偏移並改變斜索力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔基 2.10 m 樁群」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Pont de Normandie stands in the Seine estuary, where soft alluvium overlies the bearing strata, so the pylons’ large vertical forces must travel down deep piles. The official technical sheet lists 56 pylon piles of 2.10 m diameter (tabulated as 4 × 14), 2,828 m in total length, about 40 to 55 m deep and each carrying about 3,000 t; the southern viaduct piers have another 52 piles of 1.50 m. The pylon legs land on separate pile groups, and thick pile caps combine the leg axial forces with the horizontal thrust at the leg bases. Besides capacity, the groups must limit differential settlement between legs, which would tilt the pylon head and change stay forces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “2.10 m pylon piles” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若每座塔分配 28 根樁、塔基總垂直力 60,000 t，平均每根 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t，約為單樁承載 3,000 t 的 71%；平均樁長 2,828/56 ≈ 50.5 m，落在 40 至 55 m 範圍內。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If each pylon has 28 piles and a total vertical force of 60,000 t, each pile averages 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t, about 71% of the 3,000 t pile capacity; average pile length is 2,828/56 ≈ 50.5 m, within the 40 to 55 m range.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔的基礎只要總承載力夠，兩肢之間的沉陷差不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If total capacity is enough, differential settlement between pylon legs does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔基 2.10 m 樁群」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “2.10 m pylon piles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔基 2.10 m 樁群」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2.10 m pylon piles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若每座塔分配 28 根樁、塔基總垂直力 60,000 t，平均每根 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t，約為單樁承載 3,000 t 的 71%；平均樁長 2,828/56 ≈ 50.5 m，落在 40 至 55 m 範圍內。總垂直力與每塔樁數分配為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If each pylon has 28 piles and a total vertical force of 60,000 t, each pile averages 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t, about 71% of the 3,000 t pile capacity; average pile length is 2,828/56 ≈ 50.5 m, within the 40 to 55 m range. Total force and piles per pylon are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試樁載重試驗確認單樁承載與沉陷，施工時記錄每根樁的鑽掘深度、地層、混凝土灌注量與完整性檢測；塔施工期間量測兩肢基礎的沉陷差，並與設計預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm single-pile capacity and settlement by load tests on trial piles, record each pile’s drilled depth, strata, concrete volume and integrity test during construction, and measure differential settlement between the two leg foundations as the pylon rises, comparing with design predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若每座塔分配 28 根樁、塔基總垂直力 60,000 t，平均每根 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t，約為單樁承載 3,000 t 的 71%；平均樁長 2,828/56 ≈ 50.5 m，落在 40 至 55 m 範圍內。總垂直力與每塔樁數分配為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary", which statement holds?
options: 只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。
斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。
若每座塔分配 28 根樁、塔基總垂直力 60,000 t，平均每根 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t，約為單樁承載 3,000 t 的 71%。

With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode.

quiz.explanationEn: If each pylon has 28 piles and a total vertical force of 60,000 t, each pile averages 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t, about 71% of the 3,000 t pile capacity; average pile length is 2,828/56 ≈ 50.5 m, within the 40 to 55 m range. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔基 2.10 m 樁群」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “2.10 m pylon piles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試樁載重試驗確認單樁承載與沉陷，施工時記錄每根樁的鑽掘深度、地層、混凝土灌注量與完整性檢測；塔施工期間量測兩肢基礎的沉陷差，並與設計預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm single-pile capacity and settlement by load tests on trial piles, record each pile’s drilled depth, strata, concrete volume and integrity test during construction, and measure differential settlement between the two leg foundations as the pylon rises, comparing with design predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：樁基施工紀錄應逐根保存並與地層剖面對照，異常樁由設計者評估是否補樁；塔施工期間把兩肢沉陷差列為定期量測項目並設定警戒值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep pile records individually and compare with the ground profile, with the designer deciding on extra piles for anomalous ones; make differential settlement between legs a routine measurement with an alert value during pylon construction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若某一肢下方地層較差或樁底清孔不足，兩肢沉陷差使塔頂向一側偏移，斜索力分配隨之改變；河口沖刷若降低樁頂附近的土壤圍束，樁的側向勁度也會下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A weaker stratum or poorly cleaned pile bases under one leg cause differential settlement that tilts the pylon head and redistributes stay forces; estuary scour that reduces soil confinement near pile heads also lowers lateral stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以試樁載重試驗確認單樁承載與沉陷，施工時記錄每根樁的鑽掘深度、地層、混凝土灌注量與完整性檢測；塔施工期間量測兩肢基礎的沉陷差，並與設計預測比較。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm single-pile capacity and settlement by load tests on trial piles, record each pile’s drilled depth, strata, concrete volume and integrity test during construction, and measure differential settlement between the two leg foundations as the pylon rises, comparing with design predictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 樁基施工紀錄應逐根保存並與地層剖面對照，異常樁由設計者評估是否補樁；塔施工期間把兩肢沉陷差列為定期量測項目並設定警戒值。
knowledge.textEn: Keep pile records individually and compare with the ground profile, with the designer deciding on extra piles for anomalous ones; make differential settlement between legs a routine measurement with an alert value during pylon construction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary"?
options: 以試樁載重試驗確認單樁承載與沉陷，施工時記錄每根樁的鑽掘深度、地層、混凝土灌注量與完整性檢測；塔施工期間量測兩肢基礎的沉陷差，並與設計預測比較。

optionsEn: Confirm single-pile capacity and settlement by load tests on trial piles, record each pile’s drilled depth, strata, concrete volume and integrity test during construction, and measure differential settlement between the two leg foundations as the pylon rises, comparing with design predictions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight.

quiz.explanationEn: Confirm single-pile capacity and settlement by load tests on trial piles, record each pile’s drilled depth, strata, concrete volume and integrity test during construction, and measure differential settlement between the two leg foundations as the pylon rises, comparing with design predictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔基 2.10 m 樁群」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “2.10 m pylon piles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若某一肢下方地層較差或樁底清孔不足，兩肢沉陷差使塔頂向一側偏移，斜索力分配隨之改變；河口沖刷若降低樁頂附近的土壤圍束，樁的側向勁度也會下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A weaker stratum or poorly cleaned pile bases under one leg cause differential settlement that tilts the pylon head and redistributes stay forces; estuary scour that reduces soil confinement near pile heads also lowers lateral stiffness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：樁群設計除了承載，還要控制兩肢之間的不均勻沉陷，因為沉陷差會使塔頂偏移並改變斜索力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Besides capacity, the groups must limit differential settlement between legs, which would tilt the pylon head and change stay forces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔的基礎只要總承載力夠，兩肢之間的沉陷差不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If total capacity is enough, differential settlement between pylon legs does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若某一肢下方地層較差或樁底清孔不足，兩肢沉陷差使塔頂向一側偏移，斜索力分配隨之改變；河口沖刷若降低樁頂附近的土壤圍束，樁的側向勁度也會下降。
knowledge.textEn: A weaker stratum or poorly cleaned pile bases under one leg cause differential settlement that tilts the pylon head and redistributes stay forces; estuary scour that reduces soil confinement near pile heads also lowers lateral stiffness.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若某一肢下方地層較差或樁底清孔不足，兩肢沉陷差使塔頂向一側偏移，斜索力分配隨之改變；河口沖刷若降低樁頂附近的土壤圍束，樁的側向勁度也會下降。
混凝土橋面澆好後形狀就固定了，不需要考慮之後的變形。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A weaker stratum or poorly cleaned pile bases under one leg cause differential settlement that tilts the pylon head and redistributes stay forces.
A concrete deck’s shape is fixed once cast; later deformation need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 若某一肢下方地層較差或樁底清孔不足，兩肢沉陷差使塔頂向一側偏移，斜索力分配隨之改變；河口沖刷若降低樁頂附近的土壤圍束，樁的側向勁度也會下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A weaker stratum or poorly cleaned pile bases under one leg cause differential settlement that tilts the pylon head and redistributes stay forces; estuary scour that reduces soil confinement near pile heads also lowers lateral stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱」與「鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones" and "Steel segment lifting and closing 428 m cantilevers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「近塔混凝土懸臂」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete cantilevers near the pylons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主跨兩端的混凝土段由塔向河側伸出約 116 m，向岸側伸出約 96 m，以平衡懸臂方式逐節施作並逐對安裝斜索。混凝土懸臂在施工中持續承受自重與斜索力，彈性變形之外還有收縮與徐變，數年內會繼續下垂或上拱，影響後續鋼梁段的對接高程與完工線形。因此每一節段的模板都要設定預拱值，包含彈性撓度、徐變與收縮的預測，以及後續鋼梁、鋪面荷載造成的變形，讓最終線形符合設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「近塔混凝土懸臂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The concrete zones at each end of the main span extend about 116 m from the pylon toward the river and about 96 m toward the shore, built by balanced cantilever segment by segment with stays installed in pairs. The concrete cantilever carries self-weight and stay forces throughout construction, and beyond elastic deformation it shrinks and creeps, continuing to sag or rise for years and affecting the connection level of the steel segments and the final profile. Each segment’s formwork is therefore set to a camber that includes predicted elastic deflection, creep and shrinkage and the deformation from later steel and surfacing loads, so that the final profile matches the design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete cantilevers near the pylons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預拱 = 彈性撓度 × (1 + φ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Camber = elastic deflection × (1 + φ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土橋面澆好後形狀就固定了，不需要考慮之後的變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A concrete deck’s shape is fixed once cast; later deformation need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「近塔混凝土懸臂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete cantilevers near the pylons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱
knowledge.titleEn: Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones
knowledge.text: 主跨兩端的混凝土段由塔向河側伸出約 116 m，向岸側伸出約 96 m，以平衡懸臂方式逐節施作並逐對安裝斜索。混凝土懸臂在施工中持續承受自重與斜索力，彈性變形之外還有收縮與徐變，數年內會繼續下垂或上拱，影響後續鋼梁段的對接高程與完工線形。
knowledge.textEn: The concrete zones at each end of the main span extend about 116 m from the pylon toward the river and about 96 m toward the shore, built by balanced cantilever segment by segment with stays installed in pairs. The concrete cantilever carries self-weight and stay forces throughout construction, and beyond elastic deformation it shrinks and creeps, continuing to sag or rise for years and affecting the connection level of the steel segments and the final profile.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土橋面澆好後形狀就固定了，不需要考慮之後的變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A concrete deck’s shape is fixed once cast; later deformation need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones" is correct?
options: 混凝土橋面澆好後形狀就固定了，不需要考慮之後的變形。
斜張橋懸臂每加一節，懸臂端的變形都相同，可以用固定的修正值。
主跨兩端的混凝土段由塔向河側伸出約 116 m，向岸側伸出約 96 m，以平衡懸臂方式逐節施作並逐對安裝斜索。
optionsEn: A concrete deck’s shape is fixed once cast; later deformation need not be considered.
Each added segment deforms the cantilever tip by the same amount, so a fixed correction can be used.

The concrete zones at each end of the main span extend about 116 m from the pylon toward the river and about 96 m toward the shore, built by balanced cantilever segment by segment with stays installed in pairs.
quiz.explanation: 主跨兩端的混凝土段由塔向河側伸出約 116 m，向岸側伸出約 96 m，以平衡懸臂方式逐節施作並逐對安裝斜索。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The concrete zones at each end of the main span extend about 116 m from the pylon toward the river and about 96 m toward the shore, built by balanced cantilever segment by segment with stays installed in pairs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「近塔混凝土懸臂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete cantilevers near the pylons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預拱 = 彈性撓度 × (1 + φ)。若某節段在後續施工荷載下的彈性撓度為 60 mm、徐變係數 φ = 2.0，徐變附加 60×2.0 = 120 mm，總預拱約 180 mm；若 φ 只取 1.0，預拱 120 mm，完工後將低於設計線約 60 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Camber = elastic deflection × (1 + φ). For a segment with 60 mm elastic deflection under later loads and a creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep adds 60×2.0 = 120 mm for a total camber of about 180 mm; using φ = 1.0 gives 120 mm and leaves the finished deck about 60 mm below the design line. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實際混凝土的齡期、彈性模數與徐變試驗修正時間相依分析，每節段澆置前後與斜索張拉後量測懸臂端高程；預測與實測偏差超過容許時，調整後續節段的模板預拱或斜索力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Update the time-dependent analysis with the actual concrete age, modulus and creep tests, and survey cantilever-tip levels before and after each pour and after each stay is stressed; when predicted and measured levels diverge beyond tolerance, adjust the camber of later segments or the stay forces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 預拱 = 彈性撓度 × (1 + φ)。若某節段在後續施工荷載下的彈性撓度為 60 mm、徐變係數 φ = 2.0，徐變附加 60×2.0 = 120 mm，總預拱約 180 mm；若 φ 只取 1.0，預拱 120 mm，完工後將低於設計線約 60 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Camber = elastic deflection × (1 + φ). For a segment with 60 mm elastic deflection under later loads and a creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep adds 60×2.0 = 120 mm for a total camber of about 180 mm; using φ = 1.0 gives 120 mm and leaves the finished deck about 60 mm below the design line. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones", which statement holds?
options: 預拱 = 彈性撓度 × (1 + φ)。
斜索振動只是外觀問題，不會影響結構壽命。
斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。
optionsEn: Camber = elastic deflection × (1 + φ).
Stay vibration is only cosmetic and does not affect structural life.
A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed.
quiz.explanation: 預拱 = 彈性撓度 × (1 + φ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Camber = elastic deflection × (1 + φ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「近塔混凝土懸臂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete cantilevers near the pylons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實際混凝土的齡期、彈性模數與徐變試驗修正時間相依分析，每節段澆置前後與斜索張拉後量測懸臂端高程；預測與實測偏差超過容許時，調整後續節段的模板預拱或斜索力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Update the time-dependent analysis with the actual concrete age, modulus and creep tests, and survey cantilever-tip levels before and after each pour and after each stay is stressed; when predicted and measured levels diverge beyond tolerance, adjust the camber of later segments or the stay forces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每節段的預拱表要列出各項組成並由施工控制工程師簽認，量測固定在清晨溫度均勻時進行；混凝土配比或養護條件改變時，須重新試驗彈性模數與徐變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Each segment’s camber table should list its components and be signed by the construction-control engineer, with surveys fixed at dawn when temperature is uniform; any change in mix or curing requires new modulus and creep tests.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若徐變參數估計錯誤，混凝土懸臂端與後續鋼梁的對接高程出現誤差，需強制頂壓或加配重才能對接；完工後線形持續變化，可能造成伸縮縫與鋪面異常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wrong creep parameters leave a level mismatch between the concrete cantilever tip and the following steel segments that must be forced together by jacking or ballast; a profile that keeps changing after completion can distress joints and surfacing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實際混凝土的齡期、彈性模數與徐變試驗修正時間相依分析，每節段澆置前後與斜索張拉後量測懸臂端高程；預測與實測偏差超過容許時，調整後續節段的模板預拱或斜索力。
knowledge.textEn: Update the time-dependent analysis with the actual concrete age, modulus and creep tests, and survey cantilever-tip levels before and after each pour and after each stay is stressed; when predicted and measured levels diverge beyond tolerance, adjust the camber of later segments or the stay forces.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每節段的預拱表要列出各項組成並由施工控制工程師簽認，量測固定在清晨溫度均勻時進行；混凝土配比或養護條件改變時，須重新試驗彈性模數與徐變。
knowledge.textEn: Each segment’s camber table should list its components and be signed by the construction-control engineer, with surveys fixed at dawn when temperature is uniform; any change in mix or curing requires new modulus and creep tests.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以實際混凝土的齡期、彈性模數與徐變試驗修正時間相依分析，每節段澆置前後與斜索張拉後量測懸臂端高程；預測與實測偏差超過容許時，調整後續節段的模板預拱或斜索力。
塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Update the time-dependent analysis with the actual concrete age, modulus and creep tests, and survey cantilever-tip levels before and after each pour and after each stay is stressed.
Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance.
quiz.explanation: 以實際混凝土的齡期、彈性模數與徐變試驗修正時間相依分析，每節段澆置前後與斜索張拉後量測懸臂端高程；預測與實測偏差超過容許時，調整後續節段的模板預拱或斜索力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Update the time-dependent analysis with the actual concrete age, modulus and creep tests, and survey cantilever-tip levels before and after each pour and after each stay is stressed; when predicted and measured levels diverge beyond tolerance, adjust the camber of later segments or the stay forces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「近塔混凝土懸臂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete cantilevers near the pylons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若徐變參數估計錯誤，混凝土懸臂端與後續鋼梁的對接高程出現誤差，需強制頂壓或加配重才能對接；完工後線形持續變化，可能造成伸縮縫與鋪面異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wrong creep parameters leave a level mismatch between the concrete cantilever tip and the following steel segments that must be forced together by jacking or ballast; a profile that keeps changing after completion can distress joints and surfacing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此每一節段的模板都要設定預拱值，包含彈性撓度、徐變與收縮的預測，以及後續鋼梁、鋪面荷載造成的變形，讓最終線形符合設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each segment’s formwork is therefore set to a camber that includes predicted elastic deflection, creep and shrinkage and the deformation from later steel and surfacing loads, so that the final profile matches the design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土橋面澆好後形狀就固定了，不需要考慮之後的變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A concrete deck’s shape is fixed once cast; later deformation need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若徐變參數估計錯誤，混凝土懸臂端與後續鋼梁的對接高程出現誤差，需強制頂壓或加配重才能對接；完工後線形持續變化，可能造成伸縮縫與鋪面異常。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong creep parameters leave a level mismatch between the concrete cantilever tip and the following steel segments that must be forced together by jacking or ballast; a profile that keeps changing after completion can distress joints and surfacing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Each added segment deforms the cantilever tip by the same amount, so a fixed correction can be used.
Wrong creep parameters leave a level mismatch between the concrete cantilever tip and the following steel segments that must be forced together by jacking or ballast.

steps.title: 鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel segment lifting and closing 428 m cantilevers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「19.65 m 鋼節段」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “19.65 m steel segments” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 中央 624 m 鋼梁由 32 個長約 19.65 m 的標準節段加上中央合龍段組成，官方資料列出鋼橋面約 5,600 t、平均每節約 180 t。每個鋼節段吊上懸臂端後先與前一節焊接，再安裝並張拉對應的一對斜索。合龍前，每座塔的懸臂已伸到主跨一半約 428 m，是當時前所未見的長度：懸臂端在新節段吊掛、斜索尚未張拉時會明顯下沉，在風中也會側向擺動。合龍段必須在兩個懸臂端高程、軸線與溫度都吻合的時段放入，並先以臨時連接鎖定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「19.65 m 鋼節段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The central 624 m steel girder comprises 32 standard segments about 19.65 m long plus a central closure segment; the official sheet gives about 5,600 t of steel deck, about 180 t per segment on average. Each steel segment lifted to the cantilever tip is welded to the previous one before its pair of stays is installed and stressed. Before closure each pylon’s cantilever had reached half the main span, about 428 m, an unprecedented length: the tip drops noticeably while a new segment hangs before its stays are stressed, and it sways sideways in wind. The closure segment must go in when the two tips match in level, alignment and temperature, and be locked first with temporary connections. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “19.65 m steel segments” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：180 t 節段約 180×9.81 ≈ 1,766 kN，若斜索張拉前懸臂端的等效勁度 k = 1,500 kN/m，吊掛時懸臂端下沉 δ = 1,766/1,500 ≈ 1.18 m；斜索張拉後應恢復到預定高程。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 180 t segment weighs about 180×9.81 ≈ 1,766 kN; with an equivalent tip stiffness k = 1,500 kN/m before its stays are stressed, the tip drops δ = 1,766/1,500 ≈ 1.18 m while the segment hangs, to be recovered by stressing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜張橋懸臂每加一節，懸臂端的變形都相同，可以用固定的修正值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Each added segment deforms the cantilever tip by the same amount, so a fixed correction can be used." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「19.65 m 鋼節段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “19.65 m steel segments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel segment lifting and closing 428 m cantilevers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「19.65 m 鋼節段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “19.65 m steel segments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：180 t 節段約 180×9.81 ≈ 1,766 kN，若斜索張拉前懸臂端的等效勁度 k = 1,500 kN/m，吊掛時懸臂端下沉 δ = 1,766/1,500 ≈ 1.18 m；斜索張拉後應恢復到預定高程。若 k 提高到 2,500 kN/m，δ 約 0.71 m。勁度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 180 t segment weighs about 180×9.81 ≈ 1,766 kN; with an equivalent tip stiffness k = 1,500 kN/m before its stays are stressed, the tip drops δ = 1,766/1,500 ≈ 1.18 m while the segment hangs, to be recovered by stressing. At k = 2,500 kN/m, δ is about 0.71 m. Stiffness is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每節段吊裝前後、焊接後與斜索張拉後都量測懸臂端高程與軸線，與施工控制模型逐步比對；合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端的相對高差、間距、溫度與風速，選定合龍時段並以臨時鎖定裝置固定後再焊接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey tip level and alignment before and after each lift, after welding and after stressing, comparing step by step with the construction-control model; before closure continuously record the relative level, gap, temperature and wind at the two tips, choose the closure window and fix the segment with temporary locks before welding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 180 t 節段約 180×9.81 ≈ 1,766 kN，若斜索張拉前懸臂端的等效勁度 k = 1,500 kN/m，吊掛時懸臂端下沉 δ = 1,766/1,500 ≈ 1.18 m；斜索張拉後應恢復到預定高程。若 k 提高到 2,500 kN/m，δ 約 0.71 m。勁度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 180 t segment weighs about 180×9.81 ≈ 1,766 kN; with an equivalent tip stiffness k = 1,500 kN/m before its stays are stressed, the tip drops δ = 1,766/1,500 ≈ 1.18 m while the segment hangs, to be recovered by stressing. At k = 2,500 kN/m, δ is about 0.71 m. Stiffness is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel segment lifting and closing 428 m cantilevers", which statement holds?

steps.title: 鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel segment lifting and closing 428 m cantilevers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「19.65 m 鋼節段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “19.65 m steel segments” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每節段吊裝前後、焊接後與斜索張拉後都量測懸臂端高程與軸線，與施工控制模型逐步比對；合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端的相對高差、間距、溫度與風速，選定合龍時段並以臨時鎖定裝置固定後再焊接。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey tip level and alignment before and after each lift, after welding and after stressing, comparing step by step with the construction-control model; before closure continuously record the relative level, gap, temperature and wind at the two tips, choose the closure window and fix the segment with temporary locks before welding. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼節段的施工控制表要列出每一步的目標高程、容許偏差與對應的斜索張拉力，並規定量測時段與停工風速；合龍作業以停留檢查點管理，由設計與施工控制工程師共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The steel-segment control table should list target levels, tolerances and stay forces for every step, with survey times and stop-work wind speeds; closure is managed as a hold point signed jointly by the designer and construction-control engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若吊裝時懸臂端下沉超過預期而急於焊接，節段會以錯誤高程固定，後續斜索力需大幅調整；超長懸臂在強風中缺乏臨時抗風措施，側向擺動可能使吊具與節段碰撞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding in a hurry while the tip has dropped more than expected fixes the segment at the wrong level and forces large later stay adjustments; an extremely long cantilever without temporary wind measures can sway enough in strong wind for rigging and segments to collide. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每節段吊裝前後、焊接後與斜索張拉後都量測懸臂端高程與軸線，與施工控制模型逐步比對；合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端的相對高差、間距、溫度與風速，選定合龍時段並以臨時鎖定裝置固定後再焊接。
knowledge.textEn: Survey tip level and alignment before and after each lift, after welding and after stressing, comparing step by step with the construction-control model; before closure continuously record the relative level, gap, temperature and wind at the two tips, choose the closure window and fix the segment with temporary locks before welding.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋼節段的施工控制表要列出每一步的目標高程、容許偏差與對應的斜索張拉力，並規定量測時段與停工風速；合龍作業以停留檢查點管理，由設計與施工控制工程師共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The steel-segment control table should list target levels, tolerances and stay forces for every step, with survey times and stop-work wind speeds; closure is managed as a hold point signed jointly by the designer and construction-control engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
