quiz.explanationEn: Survey tip level and alignment before and after each lift, after welding and after stressing, comparing step by step with the construction-control model; before closure continuously record the relative level, gap, temperature and wind at the two tips, choose the closure window and fix the segment with temporary locks before welding. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel segment lifting and closing 428 m cantilevers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「19.65 m 鋼節段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “19.65 m steel segments” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若吊裝時懸臂端下沉超過預期而急於焊接，節段會以錯誤高程固定，後續斜索力需大幅調整；超長懸臂在強風中缺乏臨時抗風措施，側向擺動可能使吊具與節段碰撞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding in a hurry while the tip has dropped more than expected fixes the segment at the wrong level and forces large later stay adjustments; an extremely long cantilever without temporary wind measures can sway enough in strong wind for rigging and segments to collide. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：合龍段必須在兩個懸臂端高程、軸線與溫度都吻合的時段放入，並先以臨時連接鎖定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The closure segment must go in when the two tips match in level, alignment and temperature, and be locked first with temporary connections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜張橋懸臂每加一節，懸臂端的變形都相同，可以用固定的修正值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Each added segment deforms the cantilever tip by the same amount, so a fixed correction can be used." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若吊裝時懸臂端下沉超過預期而急於焊接，節段會以錯誤高程固定，後續斜索力需大幅調整；超長懸臂在強風中缺乏臨時抗風措施，側向擺動可能使吊具與節段碰撞。
knowledge.textEn: Welding in a hurry while the tip has dropped more than expected fixes the segment at the wrong level and forces large later stay adjustments; an extremely long cantilever without temporary wind measures can sway enough in strong wind for rigging and segments to collide.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel segment lifting and closing 428 m cantilevers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若吊裝時懸臂端下沉超過預期而急於焊接，節段會以錯誤高程固定，後續斜索力需大幅調整；超長懸臂在強風中缺乏臨時抗風措施，側向擺動可能使吊具與節段碰撞。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。
optionsEn: Welding in a hurry while the tip has dropped more than expected fixes the segment at the wrong level and forces large later stay adjustments.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Knowing the mean wind speed is enough to determine the wind load on a long bridge.
quiz.explanation: 若吊裝時懸臂端下沉超過預期而急於焊接，節段會以錯誤高程固定，後續斜索力需大幅調整；超長懸臂在強風中缺乏臨時抗風措施，側向擺動可能使吊具與節段碰撞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Welding in a hurry while the tip has dropped more than expected fixes the segment at the wrong level and forces large later stay adjustments; an extremely long cantilever without temporary wind measures can sway enough in strong wind for rigging and segments to collide. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數」與「通車後的斜索振動與阻尼器加裝」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors" and "Post-opening stay vibration and retrofitted dampers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「現地風場量測」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “On-site wind measurement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 法國建築科學技術中心（CSTB）為諾曼第大橋量測了橋址風況並模擬結構的氣動行為。河口開闊、靠近海岸，風速高且紊流明顯；設計時不能只看平均風速，還要知道紊流強度與陣風的空間相關性，因為細長的主梁與長索對短時間的陣風與紊流擾動（抖振）都會反應。現地量測提供平均風速剖面、紊流強度與頻譜，作為風洞試驗流場與抖振分析的輸入；施工期最長懸臂的抗風安全，也依這些統計判斷作業與停工的門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「現地風場量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: France’s building science centre CSTB measured the wind at the Pont de Normandie site and simulated the structure’s aerodynamic behaviour. The open estuary near the coast brings high winds with marked turbulence; design cannot look only at mean wind speed but must know turbulence intensity and the spatial correlation of gusts, because a slender deck and long stays respond to short gusts and turbulent buffeting. Site measurements provide the mean wind profile, turbulence intensity and spectra used as inputs to wind-tunnel flow and buffeting analysis, and the same statistics set working and stop-work limits for the longest construction cantilever. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “On-site wind measurement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：紊流強度 I_u = σ_u/U。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Turbulence intensity I_u = σ_u/U.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Knowing the mean wind speed is enough to determine the wind load on a long bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「現地風場量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “On-site wind measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數
knowledge.titleEn: Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors
knowledge.text: 法國建築科學技術中心（CSTB）為諾曼第大橋量測了橋址風況並模擬結構的氣動行為。河口開闊、靠近海岸，風速高且紊流明顯；設計時不能只看平均風速，還要知道紊流強度與陣風的空間相關性，因為細長的主梁與長索對短時間的陣風與紊流擾動（抖振）都會反應。
knowledge.textEn: France’s building science centre CSTB measured the wind at the Pont de Normandie site and simulated the structure’s aerodynamic behaviour. The open estuary near the coast brings high winds with marked turbulence; design cannot look only at mean wind speed but must know turbulence intensity and the spatial correlation of gusts, because a slender deck and long stays respond to short gusts and turbulent buffeting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Knowing the mean wind speed is enough to determine the wind load on a long bridge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors" is correct?
options: 只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。
法國建築科學技術中心（CSTB）為諾曼第大橋量測了橋址風況並模擬結構的氣動行為。
斜索振動只是外觀問題，不會影響結構壽命。
optionsEn: Knowing the mean wind speed is enough to determine the wind load on a long bridge.
France’s building science centre CSTB measured the wind at the Pont de Normandie site and simulated the structure’s aerodynamic behaviour.
Stay vibration is only cosmetic and does not affect structural life.
quiz.explanation: 法國建築科學技術中心（CSTB）為諾曼第大橋量測了橋址風況並模擬結構的氣動行為。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: France’s building science centre CSTB measured the wind at the Pont de Normandie site and simulated the structure’s aerodynamic behaviour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「現地風場量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “On-site wind measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：紊流強度 I_u = σ_u/U。若 10 分鐘平均 U = 32 m/s、標準差 σ_u = 4.8 m/s，I_u = 0.15；以峰值因子 g = 3.5 估算陣風風壓係數 (1 + g·I_u)² = (1 + 3.5×0.15)² ≈ 2.33，即陣風峰值風壓約為平均風壓的 2.3 倍。風速數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Turbulence intensity I_u = σ_u/U. With a 10-minute mean U = 32 m/s and standard deviation σ_u = 4.8 m/s, I_u = 0.15; with a peak factor g = 3.5, the gust pressure factor is (1 + g·I_u)² = (1 + 3.5×0.15)² ≈ 2.33, so peak gust pressure is about 2.3 times the mean pressure. Wind values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在橋址設置不同高度的超音波風速計長期記錄，計算平均風速、紊流強度、積分尺度與頻譜，與風洞流場模擬比較；施工期以懸臂端的風速計與加速度計同步記錄，驗證抖振反應與分析預測的量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install ultrasonic anemometers at several heights at the site for long-term records, computing mean speed, turbulence intensity, integral scales and spectra for comparison with the wind-tunnel flow; during construction log anemometers and accelerometers at the cantilever tip together to confirm the order of buffeting response against predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 紊流強度 I_u = σ_u/U。若 10 分鐘平均 U = 32 m/s、標準差 σ_u = 4.8 m/s，I_u = 0.15；以峰值因子 g = 3.5 估算陣風風壓係數 (1 + g·I_u)² = (1 + 3.5×0.15)² ≈ 2.33，即陣風峰值風壓約為平均風壓的 2.3 倍。風速數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Turbulence intensity I_u = σ_u/U. With a 10-minute mean U = 32 m/s and standard deviation σ_u = 4.8 m/s, I_u = 0.15; with a peak factor g = 3.5, the gust pressure factor is (1 + g·I_u)² = (1 + 3.5×0.15)² ≈ 2.33, so peak gust pressure is about 2.3 times the mean pressure. Wind values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors", which statement holds?
options: 斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。
塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。
紊流強度 I_u = σ_u/U。
optionsEn: A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed.
Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance.
Turbulence intensity I_u = σ_u/U.
quiz.explanation: 紊流強度 I_u = σ_u/U。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Turbulence intensity I_u = σ_u/U. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「現地風場量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “On-site wind measurement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在橋址設置不同高度的超音波風速計長期記錄，計算平均風速、紊流強度、積分尺度與頻譜，與風洞流場模擬比較；施工期以懸臂端的風速計與加速度計同步記錄，驗證抖振反應與分析預測的量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install ultrasonic anemometers at several heights at the site for long-term records, computing mean speed, turbulence intensity, integral scales and spectra for comparison with the wind-tunnel flow; during construction log anemometers and accelerometers at the cantilever tip together to confirm the order of buffeting response against predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風量測計畫要規定儀器高度、遮蔽距離、取樣率與資料保存，並在設計開始前累積足夠長的紀錄；施工期的停工風速應以陣風而非平均風速表示，並由現場風速計即時通報。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The wind measurement plan should fix instrument heights, clearance from obstructions, sampling rate and data retention, with records long enough before design starts; construction stop-work limits should be expressed as gust rather than mean speeds and reported live from site anemometers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以平滑流風洞試驗代替紊流場，抖振反應會被低估，施工中的大懸臂在中等風速下就出現超出預期的擺動；風速計安裝在受結構遮蔽的位置，則量測值偏低而誤導作業決策。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing in smooth flow instead of turbulent flow underestimates buffeting, so the long construction cantilever sways more than expected at moderate wind; anemometers placed in the structure’s wind shadow read low and mislead site decisions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在橋址設置不同高度的超音波風速計長期記錄，計算平均風速、紊流強度、積分尺度與頻譜，與風洞流場模擬比較；施工期以懸臂端的風速計與加速度計同步記錄，驗證抖振反應與分析預測的量級。
knowledge.textEn: Install ultrasonic anemometers at several heights at the site for long-term records, computing mean speed, turbulence intensity, integral scales and spectra for comparison with the wind-tunnel flow; during construction log anemometers and accelerometers at the cantilever tip together to confirm the order of buffeting response against predictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風量測計畫要規定儀器高度、遮蔽距離、取樣率與資料保存，並在設計開始前累積足夠長的紀錄；施工期的停工風速應以陣風而非平均風速表示，並由現場風速計即時通報。
knowledge.textEn: The wind measurement plan should fix instrument heights, clearance from obstructions, sampling rate and data retention, with records long enough before design starts; construction stop-work limits should be expressed as gust rather than mean speeds and reported live from site anemometers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors"?
options: 在橋址設置不同高度的超音波風速計長期記錄，計算平均風速、紊流強度、積分尺度與頻譜，與風洞流場模擬比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
塔的基礎只要總承載力夠，兩肢之間的沉陷差不重要。
optionsEn: Install ultrasonic anemometers at several heights at the site for long-term records, computing mean speed, turbulence intensity, integral scales and spectra for comparison with the wind-tunnel flow.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If total capacity is enough, differential settlement between pylon legs does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 在橋址設置不同高度的超音波風速計長期記錄，計算平均風速、紊流強度、積分尺度與頻譜，與風洞流場模擬比較；施工期以懸臂端的風速計與加速度計同步記錄，驗證抖振反應與分析預測的量級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Install ultrasonic anemometers at several heights at the site for long-term records, computing mean speed, turbulence intensity, integral scales and spectra for comparison with the wind-tunnel flow; during construction log anemometers and accelerometers at the cantilever tip together to confirm the order of buffeting response against predictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「現地風場量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “On-site wind measurement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以平滑流風洞試驗代替紊流場，抖振反應會被低估，施工中的大懸臂在中等風速下就出現超出預期的擺動；風速計安裝在受結構遮蔽的位置，則量測值偏低而誤導作業決策。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing in smooth flow instead of turbulent flow underestimates buffeting, so the long construction cantilever sways more than expected at moderate wind; anemometers placed in the structure’s wind shadow read low and mislead site decisions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現地量測提供平均風速剖面、紊流強度與頻譜，作為風洞試驗流場與抖振分析的輸入；施工期最長懸臂的抗風安全，也依這些統計判斷作業與停工的門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Site measurements provide the mean wind profile, turbulence intensity and spectra used as inputs to wind-tunnel flow and buffeting analysis, and the same statistics set working and stop-work limits for the longest construction cantilever.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Knowing the mean wind speed is enough to determine the wind load on a long bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以平滑流風洞試驗代替紊流場，抖振反應會被低估，施工中的大懸臂在中等風速下就出現超出預期的擺動；風速計安裝在受結構遮蔽的位置，則量測值偏低而誤導作業決策。
knowledge.textEn: Testing in smooth flow instead of turbulent flow underestimates buffeting, so the long construction cantilever sways more than expected at moderate wind; anemometers placed in the structure’s wind shadow read low and mislead site decisions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若以平滑流風洞試驗代替紊流場，抖振反應會被低估，施工中的大懸臂在中等風速下就出現超出預期的擺動；風速計安裝在受結構遮蔽的位置，則量測值偏低而誤導作業決策。
斜索振動只是外觀問題，不會影響結構壽命。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Testing in smooth flow instead of turbulent flow underestimates buffeting, so the long construction cantilever sways more than expected at moderate wind.
Stay vibration is only cosmetic and does not affect structural life.

quiz.explanationEn: Testing in smooth flow instead of turbulent flow underestimates buffeting, so the long construction cantilever sways more than expected at moderate wind; anemometers placed in the structure’s wind shadow read low and mislead site decisions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通車後的斜索振動與阻尼器加裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-opening stay vibration and retrofitted dampers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「長索阻尼器」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-stay dampers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 諾曼第大橋通車不久，最長的斜索出現過大的振動，管理單位隨即加裝了多套阻尼系統。長索的固有阻尼非常小（往往只有千分之幾），風雨、渦流或橋面運動只要提供少量能量，振幅就會累積到肉眼可見。加裝在橋面附近的外置阻尼器把索的振動能量轉成熱，可達到的最大附加阻尼大約與阻尼器到錨點距離佔索長的比例成正比，所以阻尼器位置受橋面空間限制時，效果有上限。這次經驗也讓後來的斜張橋在設計階段就預留阻尼器與防振措施。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「長索阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shortly after the Pont de Normandie opened, its longest stays showed excessive vibration, and several damping systems were quickly retrofitted. The inherent damping of long stays is very small, often only a few thousandths, so a little energy from wind and rain, vortices or deck motion can build amplitudes visible to the eye. External dampers near the deck convert cable vibration energy into heat, and the maximum added damping is roughly proportional to the damper’s distance from the anchorage as a fraction of cable length, so effectiveness has a ceiling when deck space limits the damper position. The experience led later cable-stayed bridges to provide for dampers and vibration measures from the design stage. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-stay dampers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：外置阻尼器最大附加阻尼比 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The maximum added damping of an external damper is ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索振動只是外觀問題，不會影響結構壽命。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stay vibration is only cosmetic and does not affect structural life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「長索阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Long-stay dampers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The inherent damping of long stays is very small, often only a few thousandths, so a little energy from wind and rain, vortices or deck motion can build amplitudes visible to the eye.

quiz.question: 關於「通車後的斜索振動與阻尼器加裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-opening stay vibration and retrofitted dampers" is correct?
options: 斜索振動只是外觀問題，不會影響結構壽命。
斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。
諾曼第大橋通車不久，最長的斜索出現過大的振動，管理單位隨即加裝了多套阻尼系統。
optionsEn: Stay vibration is only cosmetic and does not affect structural life.
With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode.

quiz.explanationEn: Shortly after the Pont de Normandie opened, its longest stays showed excessive vibration, and several damping systems were quickly retrofitted. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通車後的斜索振動與阻尼器加裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-opening stay vibration and retrofitted dampers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長索阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-stay dampers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：外置阻尼器最大附加阻尼比 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。若阻尼器裝在離錨點 2.5% 索長處，ζ_max ≈ 0.025/2 = 1.25%，對數遞減率 δ = 2πζ ≈ 7.9%；若空間限制只能裝在 1.5%，ζ_max ≈ 0.75%、δ ≈ 4.7%。位置比例為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The maximum added damping of an external damper is ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L). At 2.5% of cable length from the anchorage, ζ_max ≈ 0.025/2 = 1.25% and the logarithmic decrement δ = 2πζ ≈ 7.9%; if space allows only 1.5%, ζ_max ≈ 0.75% and δ ≈ 4.7%. Position ratios are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：加裝前後以人工激振或自由衰減量測代表性長索的對數遞減率，確認達到設計目標；同時以加速度計記錄風雨事件中的振幅與頻率，比較加裝前後的最大振幅，並定期檢查阻尼器漏油與支架鬆動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the logarithmic decrement of representative long stays before and after retrofit by manual excitation or free decay to confirm the target; record amplitudes and frequencies during wind–rain events with accelerometers to compare maximum amplitudes before and after, and inspect dampers for leaks and loose brackets periodically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 外置阻尼器最大附加阻尼比 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。若阻尼器裝在離錨點 2.5% 索長處，ζ_max ≈ 0.025/2 = 1.25%，對數遞減率 δ = 2πζ ≈ 7.9%；若空間限制只能裝在 1.5%，ζ_max ≈ 0.75%、δ ≈ 4.7%。位置比例為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The maximum added damping of an external damper is ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L). At 2.5% of cable length from the anchorage, ζ_max ≈ 0.025/2 = 1.25% and the logarithmic decrement δ = 2πζ ≈ 7.9%; if space allows only 1.5%, ζ_max ≈ 0.75% and δ ≈ 4.7%. Position ratios are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通車後的斜索振動與阻尼器加裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-opening stay vibration and retrofitted dampers", which statement holds?
options: 外置阻尼器最大附加阻尼比 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。
大跨徑斜張橋的主梁全部用鋼最好，混凝土太重沒有用處。
斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。
optionsEn: The maximum added damping of an external damper is ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L).
An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight.
As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 外置阻尼器最大附加阻尼比 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The maximum added damping of an external damper is ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通車後的斜索振動與阻尼器加裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-opening stay vibration and retrofitted dampers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長索阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-stay dampers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 加裝前後以人工激振或自由衰減量測代表性長索的對數遞減率，確認達到設計目標；同時以加速度計記錄風雨事件中的振幅與頻率，比較加裝前後的最大振幅，並定期檢查阻尼器漏油與支架鬆動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the logarithmic decrement of representative long stays before and after retrofit by manual excitation or free decay to confirm the target; record amplitudes and frequencies during wind–rain events with accelerometers to compare maximum amplitudes before and after, and inspect dampers for leaks and loose brackets periodically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：新設計的斜張橋應在設計階段就評估每根索的振動風險，預留阻尼器的安裝空間與錨固細部；既有橋若出現振動，先量測頻率與振幅再選擇阻尼器、交叉索或表面處理，並保存加裝前後的基準資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: New cable-stayed bridges should assess the vibration risk of every stay at the design stage and reserve damper space and anchorage details; on an existing bridge, measure frequency and amplitude before choosing dampers, cross-ties or surface treatment, and keep baseline data from before and after the retrofit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若不處理長索振動，反覆的大振幅會讓錨口附近的鋼絞線承受彎曲疲勞，HDPE 套管與防水帽磨損失效，水分進入索體；用路人看見斜索劇烈擺動，也會影響對橋梁安全的信心。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Untreated long-stay vibration subjects strands near the anchor exit to bending fatigue and wears out the HDPE duct and caps, letting water into the cable; visible violent stay motion also shakes public confidence in the bridge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若不處理長索振動，反覆的大振幅會讓錨口附近的鋼絞線承受彎曲疲勞，HDPE 套管與防水帽磨損失效，水分進入索體；用路人看見斜索劇烈擺動，也會影響對橋梁安全的信心。
knowledge.textEn: Untreated long-stay vibration subjects strands near the anchor exit to bending fatigue and wears out the HDPE duct and caps, letting water into the cable; visible violent stay motion also shakes public confidence in the bridge.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通車後的斜索振動與阻尼器加裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-opening stay vibration and retrofitted dampers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。
若不處理長索振動，反覆的大振幅會讓錨口附近的鋼絞線承受彎曲疲勞，HDPE 套管與防水帽磨損失效，水分進入索體；用路人看見斜索劇烈擺動，也會影響對橋梁安全的信心。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode.
Untreated long-stay vibration subjects strands near the anchor exit to bending fatigue and wears out the HDPE duct and caps, letting water into the cable.
quiz.explanation: 若不處理長索振動，反覆的大振幅會讓錨口附近的鋼絞線承受彎曲疲勞，HDPE 套管與防水帽磨損失效，水分進入索體；用路人看見斜索劇烈擺動，也會影響對橋梁安全的信心。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Untreated long-stay vibration subjects strands near the anchor exit to bending fatigue and wears out the HDPE duct and caps, letting water into the cable; visible violent stay motion also shakes public confidence in the bridge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜索多層防腐與耐久設計」與「逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays" and "Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜索多層防腐與耐久設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「蠟填充與 HDPE 套管」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wax filling and HDPE ducts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 諾曼第大橋的斜索以蠟與聚乙烯套管保護，外層再包上具氣動外形的護套。現代鋼絞線斜索的防腐通常是多層屏障：每根鋼絲鍍鋅、鋼絞線外包蠟或油脂並擠壓一層個別的 HDPE 護套，整束再穿入外層 HDPE 套管；錨具區另有防水帽與填充材。多層屏障的意義在於任何單一層破損都不會立即讓鋼材暴露，最外層套管受紫外線、風振磨損與車輛撞擊，最內層的鋅則在水分到達時以犧牲方式保護鋼絲。耐久設計因此重在檢查每一層是否仍完整，而不是等到鋼絲生鏽。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「蠟填充與 HDPE 套管」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Pont de Normandie stays are protected by wax and polyethylene sheathing, with an outer cladding of aerodynamic profile. Modern strand stays usually have multi-layer protection: every wire is galvanised, each strand is coated in wax or grease and extruded with its own HDPE sheath, and the bundle runs inside an outer HDPE duct, with waterproof caps and filler at the anchorages. The point of multiple barriers is that no single breach exposes steel at once: the outer duct faces UV, vibration wear and vehicle impact, while the innermost zinc sacrificially protects the wires if water arrives. Durability work therefore focuses on checking that each layer is intact, not on waiting for wires to rust. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wax filling and HDPE ducts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 約相當於 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm 的鋅層。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A zinc coating of 300 g/m² is about 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm thick.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「蠟填充與 HDPE 套管」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wax filling and HDPE ducts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斜索多層防腐與耐久設計
knowledge.titleEn: Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays
knowledge.text: 諾曼第大橋的斜索以蠟與聚乙烯套管保護，外層再包上具氣動外形的護套。現代鋼絞線斜索的防腐通常是多層屏障：每根鋼絲鍍鋅、鋼絞線外包蠟或油脂並擠壓一層個別的 HDPE 護套，整束再穿入外層 HDPE 套管；錨具區另有防水帽與填充材。
knowledge.textEn: The Pont de Normandie stays are protected by wax and polyethylene sheathing, with an outer cladding of aerodynamic profile. Modern strand stays usually have multi-layer protection: every wire is galvanised, each strand is coated in wax or grease and extruded with its own HDPE sheath, and the bundle runs inside an outer HDPE duct, with waterproof caps and filler at the anchorages.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜索多層防腐與耐久設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays" is correct?
options: 諾曼第大橋的斜索以蠟與聚乙烯套管保護，外層再包上具氣動外形的護套。
斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。
斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。
optionsEn: The Pont de Normandie stays are protected by wax and polyethylene sheathing, with an outer cladding of aerodynamic profile.
With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode.
A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed.
quiz.explanation: 諾曼第大橋的斜索以蠟與聚乙烯套管保護，外層再包上具氣動外形的護套。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Pont de Normandie stays are protected by wax and polyethylene sheathing, with an outer cladding of aerodynamic profile. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜索多層防腐與耐久設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蠟填充與 HDPE 套管」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wax filling and HDPE ducts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 約相當於 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm 的鋅層。若外層失效、鋅以每年 1 μm 的速率消耗，約 42 年耗盡；若蠟與個別護套仍完整使速率降到每年 0.1 μm，理論壽命延長到約 420 年。鍍鋅量與速率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A zinc coating of 300 g/m² is about 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm thick. If outer barriers fail and zinc is consumed at 1 μm a year, it lasts about 42 years; if wax and individual sheaths remain intact and slow the rate to 0.1 μm a year, the theoretical life extends to about 420 years. Coating mass and rates are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以繩索技術或檢修車近距離檢查外層套管的裂縫、磨損與接頭；打開錨具防水帽檢查填充物、積水與夾片狀態；依規範在服役約 10 至 20 年後抽取單股鋼絞線做拉伸與腐蝕檢驗，評估內層防護是否仍有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect outer ducts at close range by rope access or inspection vehicle for cracks, wear and joints; open anchorage caps to check filler, water and wedges; following recommendations, extract a single strand after about 10 to 20 years of service for tensile and corrosion testing to judge whether the inner protection still works.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 約相當於 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm 的鋅層。若外層失效、鋅以每年 1 μm 的速率消耗，約 42 年耗盡；若蠟與個別護套仍完整使速率降到每年 0.1 μm，理論壽命延長到約 420 年。鍍鋅量與速率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A zinc coating of 300 g/m² is about 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm thick. If outer barriers fail and zinc is consumed at 1 μm a year, it lasts about 42 years; if wax and individual sheaths remain intact and slow the rate to 0.1 μm a year, the theoretical life extends to about 420 years. Coating mass and rates are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜索多層防腐與耐久設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays", which statement holds?
options: 塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。
鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 約相當於 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm 的鋅層。
塔的基礎只要總承載力夠，兩肢之間的沉陷差不重要。
optionsEn: Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance.
A zinc coating of 300 g/m² is about 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm thick.
If total capacity is enough, differential settlement between pylon legs does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 約相當於 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm 的鋅層。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A zinc coating of 300 g/m² is about 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm thick. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜索多層防腐與耐久設計：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「蠟填充與 HDPE 套管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wax filling and HDPE ducts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以繩索技術或檢修車近距離檢查外層套管的裂縫、磨損與接頭；打開錨具防水帽檢查填充物、積水與夾片狀態；依規範在服役約 10 至 20 年後抽取單股鋼絞線做拉伸與腐蝕檢驗，評估內層防護是否仍有效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect outer ducts at close range by rope access or inspection vehicle for cracks, wear and joints; open anchorage caps to check filler, water and wedges; following recommendations, extract a single strand after about 10 to 20 years of service for tensile and corrosion testing to judge whether the inner protection still works. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢查手冊要把錨具區列為重點，規定防水帽開啟的週期與排水孔檢查；任何套管破損都應在下一個維護週期內修補，並記錄位置以追蹤是否反覆發生。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection manual should prioritise anchorage zones, set intervals for opening caps and checking drain holes, repair any duct damage within the next maintenance cycle and record its location to track recurrence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：套管接頭開裂或錨具防水帽失效，雨水沿索流入下錨頭積聚，鋼絞線在錨口附近局部腐蝕，而這個位置正是應力集中與疲勞最嚴重的地方；外層破損若長期未修補，紫外線與水分會逐層破壞內部防護。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cracked duct joints or failed caps let rainwater run down into the lower anchorage and pool, corroding strands right at the anchor exit where stress concentration and fatigue are worst; outer damage left unrepaired lets UV and water strip away the inner layers one by one. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期以繩索技術或檢修車近距離檢查外層套管的裂縫、磨損與接頭；打開錨具防水帽檢查填充物、積水與夾片狀態；依規範在服役約 10 至 20 年後抽取單股鋼絞線做拉伸與腐蝕檢驗，評估內層防護是否仍有效。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect outer ducts at close range by rope access or inspection vehicle for cracks, wear and joints; open anchorage caps to check filler, water and wedges; following recommendations, extract a single strand after about 10 to 20 years of service for tensile and corrosion testing to judge whether the inner protection still works.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢查手冊要把錨具區列為重點，規定防水帽開啟的週期與排水孔檢查；任何套管破損都應在下一個維護週期內修補，並記錄位置以追蹤是否反覆發生。
knowledge.textEn: The inspection manual should prioritise anchorage zones, set intervals for opening caps and checking drain holes, repair any duct damage within the next maintenance cycle and record its location to track recurrence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斜索多層防腐與耐久設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
斜張橋懸臂每加一節，懸臂端的變形都相同，可以用固定的修正值。
定期以繩索技術或檢修車近距離檢查外層套管的裂縫、磨損與接頭。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Each added segment deforms the cantilever tip by the same amount, so a fixed correction can be used.
Inspect outer ducts at close range by rope access or inspection vehicle for cracks, wear and joints.
quiz.explanation: 定期以繩索技術或檢修車近距離檢查外層套管的裂縫、磨損與接頭；打開錨具防水帽檢查填充物、積水與夾片狀態；依規範在服役約 10 至 20 年後抽取單股鋼絞線做拉伸與腐蝕檢驗，評估內層防護是否仍有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect outer ducts at close range by rope access or inspection vehicle for cracks, wear and joints; open anchorage caps to check filler, water and wedges; following recommendations, extract a single strand after about 10 to 20 years of service for tensile and corrosion testing to judge whether the inner protection still works. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜索多層防腐與耐久設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蠟填充與 HDPE 套管」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wax filling and HDPE ducts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 套管接頭開裂或錨具防水帽失效，雨水沿索流入下錨頭積聚，鋼絞線在錨口附近局部腐蝕，而這個位置正是應力集中與疲勞最嚴重的地方；外層破損若長期未修補，紫外線與水分會逐層破壞內部防護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cracked duct joints or failed caps let rainwater run down into the lower anchorage and pool, corroding strands right at the anchor exit where stress concentration and fatigue are worst; outer damage left unrepaired lets UV and water strip away the inner layers one by one. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：耐久設計因此重在檢查每一層是否仍完整，而不是等到鋼絲生鏽。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Durability work therefore focuses on checking that each layer is intact, not on waiting for wires to rust.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「單股鋼絞線更換」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-strand replacement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平行鋼絞線斜索的一大優點是可以在不拆除整根索的情況下逐股抽換。抽出一股時，它原本承擔的力量會平均轉移到同一根索的其餘鋼絞線，總索力幾乎不變，因此可以在維持交通的情況下進行；新股穿入後以單股千斤頂張拉到與其他股相同的力量。諾曼第大橋由業主公會管理收費與維護，與鄰近的唐卡維爾懸索橋同屬一個營運體系。營運期的交接資料必須讓維護團隊知道每根索的股數、各股原始力量、錨具型號與防護層構造，才能安全規劃抽換。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「單股鋼絞線更換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A major advantage of parallel-strand stays is that strands can be replaced one at a time without removing the whole cable. When one strand is withdrawn, its force spreads evenly over the remaining strands of the same stay and the total force barely changes, so work can proceed under traffic; the new strand is threaded in and stressed by a mono-strand jack to match the others. The Pont de Normandie’s owner manages tolls and maintenance together with the nearby Tancarville suspension bridge. Handover data must tell the maintenance team each stay’s strand count, original strand forces, anchorage type and protection build-up so that replacements can be planned safely. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Single-strand replacement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：53 股斜索每股 10 t，抽出一股後其餘 52 股各增加 1/52 ≈ 1.9%，即每股約 10×53/52 ≈ 10.19 t，仍遠低於 27 t 破斷力；若同時抽出 3 股，每股增至約 10×53/50 = 10.6 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a 53-strand stay at 10 t per strand, withdrawing one strand raises each of the other 52 by 1/52 ≈ 1.9%, to about 10×53/52 ≈ 10.19 t, far below the 27 t breaking load; withdrawing 3 at once raises each to about 10×53/50 = 10.6 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「單股鋼絞線更換」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Single-strand replacement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接
knowledge.text: 平行鋼絞線斜索的一大優點是可以在不拆除整根索的情況下逐股抽換。抽出一股時，它原本承擔的力量會平均轉移到同一根索的其餘鋼絞線，總索力幾乎不變，因此可以在維持交通的情況下進行；新股穿入後以單股千斤頂張拉到與其他股相同的力量。
knowledge.textEn: A major advantage of parallel-strand stays is that strands can be replaced one at a time without removing the whole cable. When one strand is withdrawn, its force spreads evenly over the remaining strands of the same stay and the total force barely changes, so work can proceed under traffic; the new strand is threaded in and stressed by a mono-strand jack to match the others.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover" is correct?
options: 斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。
平行鋼絞線斜索的一大優點是可以在不拆除整根索的情況下逐股抽換。
大跨徑斜張橋的主梁全部用鋼最好，混凝土太重沒有用處。
optionsEn: A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed.
A major advantage of parallel-strand stays is that strands can be replaced one at a time without removing the whole cable.
An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight.
quiz.explanation: 平行鋼絞線斜索的一大優點是可以在不拆除整根索的情況下逐股抽換。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A major advantage of parallel-strand stays is that strands can be replaced one at a time without removing the whole cable. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單股鋼絞線更換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Single-strand replacement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：53 股斜索每股 10 t，抽出一股後其餘 52 股各增加 1/52 ≈ 1.9%，即每股約 10×53/52 ≈ 10.19 t，仍遠低於 27 t 破斷力；若同時抽出 3 股，每股增至約 10×53/50 = 10.6 t。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a 53-strand stay at 10 t per strand, withdrawing one strand raises each of the other 52 by 1/52 ≈ 1.9%, to about 10×53/52 ≈ 10.19 t, far below the 27 t breaking load; withdrawing 3 at once raises each to about 10×53/50 = 10.6 t. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽換前以單股舉升檢測確認各股現況力量，抽換中監測索的總力與相鄰索變化，新股張拉後再以舉升檢測確認與其他股一致；抽出的舊股送實驗室做拉伸、腐蝕與疲勞檢驗，作為整體狀況評估依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before replacement, confirm current strand forces by single-strand lift-off; during the work monitor the stay’s total force and neighbouring stays; after stressing the new strand confirm by lift-off that it matches the others; send the removed strand to a laboratory for tensile, corrosion and fatigue tests as evidence of overall condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 53 股斜索每股 10 t，抽出一股後其餘 52 股各增加 1/52 ≈ 1.9%，即每股約 10×53/52 ≈ 10.19 t，仍遠低於 27 t 破斷力；若同時抽出 3 股，每股增至約 10×53/50 = 10.6 t。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover", which statement holds?
options: 斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。
混凝土橋面澆好後形狀就固定了，不需要考慮之後的變形。
53 股斜索每股 10 t，抽出一股後其餘 52 股各增加 1/52 ≈ 1.9%，即每股約 10×53/52 ≈ 10.19 t，仍遠低於 27 t 破斷力。

A concrete deck’s shape is fixed once cast; later deformation need not be considered.

steps.title: 逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「單股鋼絞線更換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Single-strand replacement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽換前以單股舉升檢測確認各股現況力量，抽換中監測索的總力與相鄰索變化，新股張拉後再以舉升檢測確認與其他股一致；抽出的舊股送實驗室做拉伸、腐蝕與疲勞檢驗，作為整體狀況評估依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before replacement, confirm current strand forces by single-strand lift-off; during the work monitor the stay’s total force and neighbouring stays; after stressing the new strand confirm by lift-off that it matches the others; send the removed strand to a laboratory for tensile, corrosion and fatigue tests as evidence of overall condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接資料應包含每根索的股數、安裝力量、鋼絞線批號、錨具與防護層圖說；抽換作業須有方法說明、交通與風速條件、力量容許偏差與停工條件，並由主管工程師核准後執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include each stay’s strand count, installation forces, strand lot numbers and drawings of anchorage and protection; replacement work requires a method statement, traffic and wind conditions, force tolerances and stop criteria, approved by the responsible engineer before execution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若新股張拉力與其他股差異過大，受力較大的股會成為新的弱點；抽換作業未管制交通與風速，單股千斤頂與錨具區作業可能受振動干擾，增加夾片咬合不良的風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A new strand stressed far from the others becomes a new weak point; work without traffic and wind control lets vibration disturb mono-strand jacking at the anchorage, raising the risk of poorly seated wedges. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽換前以單股舉升檢測確認各股現況力量，抽換中監測索的總力與相鄰索變化，新股張拉後再以舉升檢測確認與其他股一致；抽出的舊股送實驗室做拉伸、腐蝕與疲勞檢驗，作為整體狀況評估依據。
knowledge.textEn: Before replacement, confirm current strand forces by single-strand lift-off; during the work monitor the stay’s total force and neighbouring stays; after stressing the new strand confirm by lift-off that it matches the others; send the removed strand to a laboratory for tensile, corrosion and fatigue tests as evidence of overall condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接資料應包含每根索的股數、安裝力量、鋼絞線批號、錨具與防護層圖說；抽換作業須有方法說明、交通與風速條件、力量容許偏差與停工條件，並由主管工程師核准後執行。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include each stay’s strand count, installation forces, strand lot numbers and drawings of anchorage and protection; replacement work requires a method statement, traffic and wind conditions, force tolerances and stop criteria, approved by the responsible engineer before execution.

quiz.question: 要驗證「逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover"?
options: 抽換前以單股舉升檢測確認各股現況力量，抽換中監測索的總力與相鄰索變化，新股張拉後再以舉升檢測確認與其他股一致。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。
optionsEn: Before replacement, confirm current strand forces by single-strand lift-off.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Knowing the mean wind speed is enough to determine the wind load on a long bridge.
quiz.explanation: 抽換前以單股舉升檢測確認各股現況力量，抽換中監測索的總力與相鄰索變化，新股張拉後再以舉升檢測確認與其他股一致；抽出的舊股送實驗室做拉伸、腐蝕與疲勞檢驗，作為整體狀況評估依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before replacement, confirm current strand forces by single-strand lift-off; during the work monitor the stay’s total force and neighbouring stays; after stressing the new strand confirm by lift-off that it matches the others; send the removed strand to a laboratory for tensile, corrosion and fatigue tests as evidence of overall condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單股鋼絞線更換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Single-strand replacement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若新股張拉力與其他股差異過大，受力較大的股會成為新的弱點；抽換作業未管制交通與風速，單股千斤頂與錨具區作業可能受振動干擾，增加夾片咬合不良的風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A new strand stressed far from the others becomes a new weak point; work without traffic and wind control lets vibration disturb mono-strand jacking at the anchorage, raising the risk of poorly seated wedges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：營運期的交接資料必須讓維護團隊知道每根索的股數、各股原始力量、錨具型號與防護層構造，才能安全規劃抽換。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover data must tell the maintenance team each stay’s strand count, original strand forces, anchorage type and protection build-up so that replacements can be planned safely.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若新股張拉力與其他股差異過大，受力較大的股會成為新的弱點；抽換作業未管制交通與風速，單股千斤頂與錨具區作業可能受振動干擾，增加夾片咬合不良的風險。
knowledge.textEn: A new strand stressed far from the others becomes a new weak point; work without traffic and wind control lets vibration disturb mono-strand jacking at the anchorage, raising the risk of poorly seated wedges.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若新股張拉力與其他股差異過大，受力較大的股會成為新的弱點；抽換作業未管制交通與風速，單股千斤頂與錨具區作業可能受振動干擾，增加夾片咬合不良的風險。
大跨徑斜張橋的主梁全部用鋼最好，混凝土太重沒有用處。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A new strand stressed far from the others becomes a new weak point.
An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight.
quiz.explanation: 若新股張拉力與其他股差異過大，受力較大的股會成為新的弱點；抽換作業未管制交通與風速，單股千斤頂與錨具區作業可能受振動干擾，增加夾片咬合不良的風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A new strand stressed far from the others becomes a new weak point; work without traffic and wind control lets vibration disturb mono-strand jacking at the anchorage, raising the risk of poorly seated wedges. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 皇后渡口大橋
summary: 皇后渡口大橋含引橋全長約 2.7 km，三座約 207 m 高的單柱塔支承 221+650+650+221 m 的斜張橋段，通車時為全球最長的三塔斜張橋，也是規模最大、斜索在跨中交叉的斜張橋。本課從中塔缺乏背索錨固的問題、交叉索的勁度、鋼—混凝土組合橋面與塔基沉箱，經平衡懸臂吊裝與兩處合龍，到防風屏障與車輛穩定、約 2,000 個感測器的監測、積冰掉落與營運檢查交接。
summaryEn: The Queensferry Crossing is about 2.7 km long including approaches; three monopole towers about 207 m tall carry a 221+650+650+221 m cable-stayed section, making it, at opening, the world’s longest three-tower cable-stayed bridge and the largest with stays that cross at mid-span. The course runs from the central tower’s lack of back-stay anchorage, the stiffness of crossing stays, the composite steel–concrete deck and tower caissons, through balanced-cantilever lifting and two closures, to wind shielding and vehicle stability, monitoring with about 2,000 sensors, falling ice and operational inspection handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 斜張橋與斜索系統

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較三塔斜張橋在單跨加載時，以交叉索或加粗中塔兩種方式控制中塔頂位移。設單跨活載造成中塔頂不平衡水平力 H = 30 MN，目標位移 δ ≤ 0.5 m，所需總勁度 k = H/δ = 60 MN/m。方案 A：塔本身勁度 20 MN/m，另以交叉索補足 40 MN/m；若每根交叉索有效水平勁度約 4.8×0.5 = 2.4 MN/m，需約 40/2.4 ≈ 17 根。方案 B：完全靠塔，懸臂塔頂勁度 k = 3EI/h³，取 h = 200 m、E = 35 GPa，所需 I = k·h³/(3E) = 60,000 kN/m×8.0×10⁶ m³/(3×3.5×10⁷ kN/m²) ≈ 4,570 m⁴，約為 20 MN/m 對應 I ≈ 1,520 m⁴ 的三倍，塔斷面將大幅加粗。若目標放寬到 δ ≤ 0.75 m，所需 k = 40 MN/m，交叉索只需約 20/2.4 ≈ 9 根。數值為教學假設，非本橋設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare crossing stays with a stiffer central tower for controlling central-tower displacement under one-span loading. Live load on one span applies H = 30 MN at the central tower head; for δ ≤ 0.5 m the required stiffness is k = H/δ = 60 MN/m. Option A: the tower supplies 20 MN/m and crossing stays add 40 MN/m; at about 4.8×0.5 = 2.4 MN/m effective horizontal stiffness per crossing stay, about 40/2.4 ≈ 17 stays are needed. Option B: the tower alone, with cantilever head stiffness k = 3EI/h³; with h = 200 m and E = 35 GPa, the required I = k·h³/(3E) = 60,000 kN/m×8.0×10⁶ m³/(3×3.5×10⁷ kN/m²) ≈ 4,570 m⁴, three times the I ≈ 1,520 m⁴ that gives 20 MN/m, so the tower section grows greatly. Relaxing the target to δ ≤ 0.75 m needs k = 40 MN/m, and only about 20/2.4 ≈ 9 crossing stays. Values are teaching assumptions, not this bridge’s design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三塔體系的中塔穩定問題」與「交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system" and "Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「中塔塔頂」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Central tower head” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。三塔斜張橋的中塔兩側都是 650 m 的主跨，沒有固定的背跨可以錨索：當活載只作用在其中一跨時，那一跨下垂，中塔被拉向該側，另一跨上拱，結構整體變得很柔。若只靠中塔自身的彎曲勁度抵抗，塔必須非常粗大。皇后渡口大橋的解法是讓三座塔的斜索在兩個主跨的跨中互相交叉重疊，相鄰塔的斜索彼此牽制，使中塔頂端的位移受到相鄰塔與橋面的約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「中塔塔頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly. In a three-tower bridge the central tower has a 650 m main span on both sides and no fixed back span to anchor to: when live load occupies only one span, that span sags, the central tower is pulled toward it, the other span rises and the whole structure is soft. Resisting this by the central tower’s own bending stiffness alone would demand a massive tower. The Queensferry solution is to let stays from adjacent towers cross and overlap at mid-span of both main spans, so neighbouring towers restrain each other and the central tower head is held by the adjacent towers and the deck. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Central tower head” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「中塔塔頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Central tower head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題
knowledge.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system
knowledge.text: 兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。三塔斜張橋的中塔兩側都是 650 m 的主跨，沒有固定的背跨可以錨索：當活載只作用在其中一跨時，那一跨下垂，中塔被拉向該側，另一跨上拱，結構整體變得很柔。
knowledge.textEn: In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly. In a three-tower bridge the central tower has a 650 m main span on both sides and no fixed back span to anchor to: when live load occupies only one span, that span sags, the central tower is pulled toward it, the other span rises and the whole structure is soft.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「三塔體系的中塔穩定問題」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system" is correct?
options: 三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。
兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。
斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。
optionsEn: A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones.
In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly.
The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head.
quiz.explanation: 兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中塔塔頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Central tower head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。若無交叉索，塔頂等效勁度 k = 20 MN/m，位移 δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m；交叉索使 k 提高到 60 MN/m 時，δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m，降為三分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN. Without crossing stays, with an equivalent head stiffness k = 20 MN/m, the displacement is δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m; if crossing stays raise k to 60 MN/m, δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m, one-third as much. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全橋模型比較有無交叉索、不同重疊長度時的塔頂位移、跨中撓度與塔底彎矩，確定交叉段長度；成橋後以載重試驗只加載一個主跨，量測中塔頂位移與兩跨撓度，與模型預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare tower-head displacement, mid-span deflection and tower-base moment with and without crossing stays and for different overlap lengths in a global model to fix the crossing length; after completion load one main span only in a load test and compare measured central-tower displacement and deflections of both spans with predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。若無交叉索，塔頂等效勁度 k = 20 MN/m，位移 δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m；交叉索使 k 提高到 60 MN/m 時，δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m，降為三分之一。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN. Without crossing stays, with an equivalent head stiffness k = 20 MN/m, the displacement is δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m; if crossing stays raise k to 60 MN/m, δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m, one-third as much. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「三塔體系的中塔穩定問題」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system", which statement holds?
options: 沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。
每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。
中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。
optionsEn: Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters.
Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other.
Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN.
quiz.explanation: 中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中塔塔頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Central tower head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全橋模型比較有無交叉索、不同重疊長度時的塔頂位移、跨中撓度與塔底彎矩，確定交叉段長度；成橋後以載重試驗只加載一個主跨，量測中塔頂位移與兩跨撓度，與模型預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare tower-head displacement, mid-span deflection and tower-base moment with and without crossing stays and for different overlap lengths in a global model to fix the crossing length; after completion load one main span only in a load test and compare measured central-tower displacement and deflections of both spans with predictions. steps.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「跨中交叉斜索」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mid-span crossing stays” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 交叉斜索的作用像一條條斜向的彈簧：當中塔被拉向一側時，從相鄰塔伸到跨中、並錨在重疊區的斜索會被拉長，產生反向的水平分力，把中塔與橋面拉回。每根斜索提供的水平勁度與鋼截面積、彈性模數成正比，與索長成反比，並乘上水平夾角餘弦的平方，所以較平、較短的索效率較好。重疊段越長，參與牽制的索越多，但同一段橋面上兩組斜索的錨固點也越密集，增加錨固與檢修的複雜度。設計者以全橋分析在勁度與構造之間取得平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跨中交叉斜索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crossing stays act like inclined springs: when the central tower is pulled to one side, stays from the adjacent tower reaching into the overlap zone at mid-span are stretched and produce an opposing horizontal component that pulls the tower and deck back. Each stay’s horizontal stiffness is proportional to its steel area and modulus, inversely proportional to its length, and multiplied by the square of the cosine of its angle, so flatter and shorter stays are more effective. A longer overlap brings more stays into play but crowds two sets of anchorages on the same stretch of deck, complicating anchorage and maintenance. Designers balance stiffness against detailing with global analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mid-span crossing stays” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單索水平勁度 k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Single-stay horizontal stiffness k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「跨中交叉斜索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mid-span crossing stays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度
knowledge.titleEn: Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays
knowledge.text: 交叉斜索的作用像一條條斜向的彈簧：當中塔被拉向一側時，從相鄰塔伸到跨中、並錨在重疊區的斜索會被拉長，產生反向的水平分力，把中塔與橋面拉回。每根斜索提供的水平勁度與鋼截面積、彈性模數成正比，與索長成反比，並乘上水平夾角餘弦的平方，所以較平、較短的索效率較好。
knowledge.textEn: Crossing stays act like inclined springs: when the central tower is pulled to one side, stays from the adjacent tower reaching into the overlap zone at mid-span are stretched and produce an opposing horizontal component that pulls the tower and deck back. knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨中交叉斜索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mid-span crossing stays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單索水平勁度 k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L。取 E = 195 GPa、A = 75 股×150 mm² = 11,250 mm²、θ = 20°（cos²θ ≈ 0.883）、L = 400 m：k_h ≈ 195,000×11,250×0.883/400,000 ≈ 4,840 N/mm ≈ 4.8 MN/m。16 根交叉索合計約 77 MN/m，若橋面柔性使有效率只有 50%，增加約 39 MN/m，使單元 1 的 20 MN/m 提高到約 59 MN/m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Single-stay horizontal stiffness k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L. With E = 195 GPa, A = 75 strands×150 mm² = 11,250 mm², θ = 20° (cos²θ ≈ 0.883) and L = 400 m, k_h ≈ 195,000×11,250×0.883/400,000 ≈ 4,840 N/mm ≈ 4.8 MN/m. Sixteen crossing stays total about 77 MN/m; if deck flexibility makes them only 50% effective, they add about 39 MN/m, raising unit 1’s 20 MN/m to about 59 MN/m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以參數分析檢驗重疊長度、索截面與索力對中塔頂位移的敏感度；施工完成後量測交叉區各索的索力與錨點高程，確認兩組斜索的力量分配符合設計，並記錄作為監測基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run parametric studies of how overlap length, stay section and force affect central-tower displacement; after construction measure the forces and anchor levels of stays in the crossing zone to confirm the force split between the two sets matches the design, and record them as the monitoring baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With E = 195 GPa, A = 75 strands×150 mm² = 11,250 mm², θ = 20° (cos²θ ≈ 0.883) and L = 400 m, k_h ≈ 195,000×11,250×0.883/400,000 ≈ 4,840 N/mm ≈ 4.8 MN/m.
