quiz.explanationEn: Single-stay horizontal stiffness k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨中交叉斜索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mid-span crossing stays” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以參數分析檢驗重疊長度、索截面與索力對中塔頂位移的敏感度；施工完成後量測交叉區各索的索力與錨點高程，確認兩組斜索的力量分配符合設計，並記錄作為監測基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run parametric studies of how overlap length, stay section and force affect central-tower displacement; after construction measure the forces and anchor levels of stays in the crossing zone to confirm the force split between the two sets matches the design, and record them as the monitoring baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交叉區的錨固細部要以局部模型與疲勞評估確認，並為兩組斜索各自保留檢修與更換空間；索力驗收表應把交叉索列為獨立一組，容許偏差可比一般索更嚴格。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Verify crossing-zone anchorage details with local models and fatigue assessment and keep access and replacement space for both sets of stays; list crossing stays as a separate group in the force acceptance table, possibly with tighter tolerances than other stays.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫；交叉索若索力偏低，等效勁度下降，中塔在不對稱荷載下的位移增大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking; crossing stays with low force lose effective stiffness and the central tower moves more under unbalanced load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以參數分析檢驗重疊長度、索截面與索力對中塔頂位移的敏感度；施工完成後量測交叉區各索的索力與錨點高程，確認兩組斜索的力量分配符合設計，並記錄作為監測基準。
knowledge.textEn: Run parametric studies of how overlap length, stay section and force affect central-tower displacement; after construction measure the forces and anchor levels of stays in the crossing zone to confirm the force split between the two sets matches the design, and record them as the monitoring baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交叉區的錨固細部要以局部模型與疲勞評估確認，並為兩組斜索各自保留檢修與更換空間；索力驗收表應把交叉索列為獨立一組，容許偏差可比一般索更嚴格。
knowledge.textEn: Verify crossing-zone anchorage details with local models and fatigue assessment and keep access and replacement space for both sets of stays; list crossing stays as a separate group in the force acceptance table, possibly with tighter tolerances than other stays.

quiz.question: 要驗證「交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以參數分析檢驗重疊長度、索截面與索力對中塔頂位移的敏感度；施工完成後量測交叉區各索的索力與錨點高程，確認兩組斜索的力量分配符合設計，並記錄作為監測基準。
積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Run parametric studies of how overlap length, stay section and force affect central-tower displacement.
Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect.
quiz.explanation: 以參數分析檢驗重疊長度、索截面與索力對中塔頂位移的敏感度；施工完成後量測交叉區各索的索力與錨點高程，確認兩組斜索的力量分配符合設計，並記錄作為監測基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run parametric studies of how overlap length, stay section and force affect central-tower displacement; after construction measure the forces and anchor levels of stays in the crossing zone to confirm the force split between the two sets matches the design, and record them as the monitoring baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨中交叉斜索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mid-span crossing stays” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫；交叉索若索力偏低，等效勁度下降，中塔在不對稱荷載下的位移增大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking; crossing stays with low force lose effective stiffness and the central tower moves more under unbalanced load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計者以全橋分析在勁度與構造之間取得平衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Designers balance stiffness against detailing with global analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫；交叉索若索力偏低，等效勁度下降，中塔在不對稱荷載下的位移增大。
knowledge.textEn: Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking; crossing stays with low force lose effective stiffness and the central tower moves more under unbalanced load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。
若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action.
Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking.
quiz.explanation: 若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫；交叉索若索力偏低，等效勁度下降，中塔在不對稱荷載下的位移增大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking; crossing stays with low force lose effective stiffness and the central tower moves more under unbalanced load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接」與「海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection" and "Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「組合槽型梁」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite steel tub deck” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面寬約 39.8 m，由鋼梁（槽型箱）加上鋼筋混凝土橋面板組成；營運單位說明橋面鋼槽內設有檢修走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km。組合橋面讓混凝土承受壓力與局部輪載，鋼梁承受拉力與整體彎曲，兩者以剪力釘連成一體。斜張橋的組合橋面還要承受斜索水平分力累積的巨大軸壓，越靠近塔軸壓越大；混凝土在軸壓下的徐變與乾縮會把力量逐漸轉移給鋼梁，剪力連接件需承受這種長期重分配的界面剪力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「組合槽型梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Queensferry deck is about 39.8 m wide, made of steel girders in tub-box form with a reinforced concrete deck slab; the operator notes walkways inside the steel tubs, one about 2.7 km long. In a composite deck the concrete takes compression and local wheel loads, the steel takes tension and global bending, and shear studs make them act together. A cable-stayed composite deck also carries large axial compression accumulated from the horizontal stay components, highest near the towers; creep and shrinkage of the concrete under this compression gradually transfer force to the steel, and the shear connectors must carry the interface shear from this long-term redistribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Composite steel tub deck” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：界面縱向剪力流 v_L = V·Q/I。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Interface longitudinal shear flow v_L = V·Q/I.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「組合槽型梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Composite steel tub deck”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接
knowledge.titleEn: Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection
knowledge.text: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面寬約 39.8 m，由鋼梁（槽型箱）加上鋼筋混凝土橋面板組成；營運單位說明橋面鋼槽內設有檢修走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km。組合橋面讓混凝土承受壓力與局部輪載，鋼梁承受拉力與整體彎曲，兩者以剪力釘連成一體。
knowledge.textEn: The Queensferry deck is about 39.8 m wide, made of steel girders in tub-box form with a reinforced concrete deck slab; the operator notes walkways inside the steel tubs, one about 2.7 km long. In a composite deck the concrete takes compression and local wheel loads, the steel takes tension and global bending, and shear studs make them act together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection" is correct?
options: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面寬約 39.8 m，由鋼梁（槽型箱）加上鋼筋混凝土橋面板組成；營運單位說明橋面鋼槽內設有檢修走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km。
組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。
沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。
optionsEn: The Queensferry deck is about 39.8 m wide, made of steel girders in tub-box form with a reinforced concrete deck slab.
In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action.
Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面寬約 39.8 m，由鋼梁（槽型箱）加上鋼筋混凝土橋面板組成；營運單位說明橋面鋼槽內設有檢修走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Queensferry deck is about 39.8 m wide, made of steel girders in tub-box form with a reinforced concrete deck slab; the operator notes walkways inside the steel tubs, one about 2.7 km long. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「組合槽型梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Composite steel tub deck” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：界面縱向剪力流 v_L = V·Q/I。取斷面剪力 V = 5,000 kN、Q/I = 0.25 m⁻¹：v_L = 5,000×0.25 = 1,250 kN/m；每支剪力釘設計強度 100 kN 時，每公尺需約 1,250/100 = 12.5 支，即每公尺 13 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Interface longitudinal shear flow v_L = V·Q/I. With section shear V = 5,000 kN and Q/I = 0.25 m⁻¹, v_L = 5,000×0.25 = 1,250 kN/m; at 100 kN design resistance per stud, about 1,250/100 = 12.5 studs per metre are needed, so 13 per metre. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：剪力釘焊接後抽樣做敲彎試驗，橋面板澆置前檢查釘的數量與位置；以時間相依分析計算徐變與乾縮造成的鋼梁應力增量，與施工中在鋼梁上量測的應變比較；橋面板裂縫寬度定期量測並記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After stud welding, bend-test a sample and check stud numbers and positions before the slab is cast; compute steel stress increments from creep and shrinkage by time-dependent analysis and compare with strains measured on the girders during construction; measure and record slab crack widths periodically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 界面縱向剪力流 v_L = V·Q/I。取斷面剪力 V = 5,000 kN、Q/I = 0.25 m⁻¹：v_L = 5,000×0.25 = 1,250 kN/m；每支剪力釘設計強度 100 kN 時，每公尺需約 1,250/100 = 12.5 支，即每公尺 13 支。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Interface longitudinal shear flow v_L = V·Q/I. With section shear V = 5,000 kN and Q/I = 0.25 m⁻¹, v_L = 5,000×0.25 = 1,250 kN/m; at 100 kN design resistance per stud, about 1,250/100 = 12.5 studs per metre are needed, so 13 per metre. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection", which statement holds?
options: 每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。
界面縱向剪力流 v_L = V·Q/I。
監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。
optionsEn: Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other.
Interface longitudinal shear flow v_L = V·Q/I.
More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation.
quiz.explanation: 界面縱向剪力流 v_L = V·Q/I。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Interface longitudinal shear flow v_L = V·Q/I. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「組合槽型梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Composite steel tub deck” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘焊接後抽樣做敲彎試驗，橋面板澆置前檢查釘的數量與位置；以時間相依分析計算徐變與乾縮造成的鋼梁應力增量，與施工中在鋼梁上量測的應變比較；橋面板裂縫寬度定期量測並記錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After stud welding, bend-test a sample and check stud numbers and positions before the slab is cast; compute steel stress increments from creep and shrinkage by time-dependent analysis and compare with strains measured on the girders during construction; measure and record slab crack widths periodically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：組合橋面的施工順序（鋼梁架設、橋面板澆置、斜索張拉）要在施工控制模型中逐步模擬，並規定混凝土齡期與張拉時程的關係；防水層與排水細部須在橋面板完成後立即施作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Model the sequence of steel erection, slab casting and stay stressing step by step in construction control, linking concrete age to the stressing schedule; install waterproofing and drainage details immediately after the slab is complete.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剪力釘不足或焊接不良時，組合作用喪失，鋼梁承受超出設計的彎矩與軸力；橋面板若因乾縮與溫度產生貫穿裂縫且未處理，除冰鹽會滲入腐蝕鋼筋與鋼梁頂板。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Too few or poorly welded studs lose composite action and overload the steel girder in moment and axial force; through cracks from shrinkage and temperature left untreated let de-icing salt reach and corrode the reinforcement and the top flange. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 剪力釘焊接後抽樣做敲彎試驗，橋面板澆置前檢查釘的數量與位置；以時間相依分析計算徐變與乾縮造成的鋼梁應力增量，與施工中在鋼梁上量測的應變比較；橋面板裂縫寬度定期量測並記錄。
knowledge.textEn: After stud welding, bend-test a sample and check stud numbers and positions before the slab is cast; compute steel stress increments from creep and shrinkage by time-dependent analysis and compare with strains measured on the girders during construction; measure and record slab crack widths periodically.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 組合橋面的施工順序（鋼梁架設、橋面板澆置、斜索張拉）要在施工控制模型中逐步模擬，並規定混凝土齡期與張拉時程的關係；防水層與排水細部須在橋面板完成後立即施作。
knowledge.textEn: Model the sequence of steel erection, slab casting and stay stressing step by step in construction control, linking concrete age to the stressing schedule; install waterproofing and drainage details immediately after the slab is complete.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。
剪力釘焊接後抽樣做敲彎試驗，橋面板澆置前檢查釘的數量與位置。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later.
After stud welding, bend-test a sample and check stud numbers and positions before the slab is cast.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘焊接後抽樣做敲彎試驗，橋面板澆置前檢查釘的數量與位置；以時間相依分析計算徐變與乾縮造成的鋼梁應力增量，與施工中在鋼梁上量測的應變比較；橋面板裂縫寬度定期量測並記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After stud welding, bend-test a sample and check stud numbers and positions before the slab is cast; compute steel stress increments from creep and shrinkage by time-dependent analysis and compare with strains measured on the girders during construction; measure and record slab crack widths periodically. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「組合槽型梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Composite steel tub deck” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘不足或焊接不良時，組合作用喪失，鋼梁承受超出設計的彎矩與軸力；橋面板若因乾縮與溫度產生貫穿裂縫且未處理，除冰鹽會滲入腐蝕鋼筋與鋼梁頂板。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Too few or poorly welded studs lose composite action and overload the steel girder in moment and axial force; through cracks from shrinkage and temperature left untreated let de-icing salt reach and corrode the reinforcement and the top flange. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：斜張橋的組合橋面還要承受斜索水平分力累積的巨大軸壓，越靠近塔軸壓越大；混凝土在軸壓下的徐變與乾縮會把力量逐漸轉移給鋼梁，剪力連接件需承受這種長期重分配的界面剪力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A cable-stayed composite deck also carries large axial compression accumulated from the horizontal stay components, highest near the towers; creep and shrinkage of the concrete under this compression gradually transfer force to the steel, and the shear connectors must carry the interface shear from this long-term redistribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 剪力釘不足或焊接不良時，組合作用喪失，鋼梁承受超出設計的彎矩與軸力；橋面板若因乾縮與溫度產生貫穿裂縫且未處理，除冰鹽會滲入腐蝕鋼筋與鋼梁頂板。
knowledge.textEn: Too few or poorly welded studs lose composite action and overload the steel girder in moment and axial force; through cracks from shrinkage and temperature left untreated let de-icing salt reach and corrode the reinforcement and the top flange.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼—混凝土組合橋面與剪力連接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Composite steel–concrete deck and shear connection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 剪力釘不足或焊接不良時，組合作用喪失，鋼梁承受超出設計的彎矩與軸力；橋面板若因乾縮與溫度產生貫穿裂縫且未處理，除冰鹽會滲入腐蝕鋼筋與鋼梁頂板。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。
optionsEn: Too few or poorly welded studs lose composite action and overload the steel girder in moment and axial force.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘不足或焊接不良時，組合作用喪失，鋼梁承受超出設計的彎矩與軸力；橋面板若因乾縮與溫度產生貫穿裂縫且未處理，除冰鹽會滲入腐蝕鋼筋與鋼梁頂板。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Too few or poorly welded studs lose composite action and overload the steel girder in moment and axial force; through cracks from shrinkage and temperature left untreated let de-icing salt reach and corrode the reinforcement and the top flange. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「南北塔臨時鋼沉箱」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary steel caissons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 交通部門的專案通訊指出，南北兩座塔基以臨時鋼沉箱施作，中塔則以圍堰圍住，基礎完成後臨時構造都已移除，讓塔看起來直接從海中升起。鋼沉箱下沉到河床並坐落在岩盤或承載層後，先以水下灌注的封底混凝土封住底部，再抽水在乾燥環境中澆築基礎。封底混凝土的厚度取決於外部水頭：抽乾後，水壓從下方向上推，封底的自重加上與壁面的摩擦必須足以平衡，否則封底會上浮或破裂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「南北塔臨時鋼沉箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Project newsletters state that the north and south tower foundations were built inside temporary steel caissons and the central tower inside a cofferdam, with the temporary works removed afterwards so the towers appear to rise straight from the sea. A steel caisson is sunk to the bed and seated on rock or the bearing stratum, the base is sealed with tremie concrete placed underwater, and the water is then pumped out so the foundation can be cast in the dry. The seal thickness depends on the external head: once dewatered, water pressure pushes up from below, and the seal’s self-weight plus friction on the walls must balance it or the seal will lift or crack. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary steel caissons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：封底底面水壓 p = γ_w·h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Water pressure under the seal p = γ_w·h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「南北塔臨時鋼沉箱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Temporary steel caissons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰
knowledge.titleEn: Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam
knowledge.text: 交通部門的專案通訊指出，南北兩座塔基以臨時鋼沉箱施作，中塔則以圍堰圍住，基礎完成後臨時構造都已移除，讓塔看起來直接從海中升起。鋼沉箱下沉到河床並坐落在岩盤或承載層後，先以水下灌注的封底混凝土封住底部，再抽水在乾燥環境中澆築基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Project newsletters state that the north and south tower foundations were built inside temporary steel caissons and the central tower inside a cofferdam, with the temporary works removed afterwards so the towers appear to rise straight from the sea. A steel caisson is sunk to the bed and seated on rock or the bearing stratum, the base is sealed with tremie concrete placed underwater, and the water is then pumped out so the foundation can be cast in the dry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam" is correct?
options: 沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。
交通部門的專案通訊指出，南北兩座塔基以臨時鋼沉箱施作，中塔則以圍堰圍住，基礎完成後臨時構造都已移除，讓塔看起來直接從海中升起。
多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。
optionsEn: Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters.

Project newsletters state that the north and south tower foundations were built inside temporary steel caissons and the central tower inside a cofferdam, with the temporary works removed afterwards so the towers appear to rise straight from the sea.
With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently.
quiz.explanation: 交通部門的專案通訊指出，南北兩座塔基以臨時鋼沉箱施作，中塔則以圍堰圍住，基礎完成後臨時構造都已移除，讓塔看起來直接從海中升起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Project newsletters state that the north and south tower foundations were built inside temporary steel caissons and the central tower inside a cofferdam, with the temporary works removed afterwards so the towers appear to rise straight from the sea. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「南北塔臨時鋼沉箱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary steel caissons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：封底底面水壓 p = γ_w·h。水頭 h = 20 m 時 p = 9.81×20 ≈ 196 kPa；若僅以封底自重平衡、混凝土單位重 24 kN/m³，所需厚度 t = 196/24 ≈ 8.2 m；計入壁面摩擦或以錨樁抗浮可明顯減薄。水頭為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Water pressure under the seal p = γ_w·h. With a 20 m head, p = 9.81×20 ≈ 196 kPa; balancing by self-weight alone with concrete at 24 kN/m³ needs t = 196/24 ≈ 8.2 m, which wall friction or tension anchors can reduce considerably. The head is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沉箱下沉過程量測傾斜、刃口高程與河床接觸；封底灌注後以鑽芯或潛水檢查完整性，抽水時分階段降低水位並監測封底上浮、滲水量與沉箱變形，任何異常立即停止抽水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: While sinking, monitor caisson tilt, cutting-edge level and bed contact; after the seal pour check integrity by coring or divers; dewater in stages while monitoring seal uplift, seepage and caisson deformation, stopping immediately at any anomaly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 封底底面水壓 p = γ_w·h。水頭 h = 20 m 時 p = 9.81×20 ≈ 196 kPa；若僅以封底自重平衡、混凝土單位重 24 kN/m³，所需厚度 t = 196/24 ≈ 8.2 m；計入壁面摩擦或以錨樁抗浮可明顯減薄。水頭為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Water pressure under the seal p = γ_w·h. With a 20 m head, p = 9.81×20 ≈ 196 kPa; balancing by self-weight alone with concrete at 24 kN/m³ needs t = 196/24 ≈ 8.2 m, which wall friction or tension anchors can reduce considerably. The head is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam", which statement holds?
options: 防風屏障越高越密，對大橋和車輛都越好。
積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。
封底底面水壓 p = γ_w·h。
optionsEn: The taller and more solid the wind shielding, the better for both bridge and vehicles.
Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect.
Water pressure under the seal p = γ_w·h.
quiz.explanation: 封底底面水壓 p = γ_w·h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Water pressure under the seal p = γ_w·h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「南北塔臨時鋼沉箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary steel caissons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沉箱下沉過程量測傾斜、刃口高程與河床接觸；封底灌注後以鑽芯或潛水檢查完整性，抽水時分階段降低水位並監測封底上浮、滲水量與沉箱變形，任何異常立即停止抽水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: While sinking, monitor caisson tilt, cutting-edge level and bed contact; after the seal pour check integrity by coring or divers; dewater in stages while monitoring seal uplift, seepage and caisson deformation, stopping immediately at any anomaly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：沉箱與圍堰屬臨時工程，需有獨立的設計、檢查與簽認；抽水程序要列出分階段水位、量測項目與停止條件，並把封底驗收設為停留檢查點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Caissons and cofferdams are temporary works needing their own design, checking and sign-off; the dewatering procedure should list staged water levels, measurements and stop criteria, with acceptance of the seal a hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：封底厚度不足或灌注夾泥，抽水時封底可能突然上浮或破裂，海水湧入淹沒沉箱並危及作業人員；沉箱傾斜坐落則使基礎偏位，影響塔的幾何。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An insufficient or contaminated seal can suddenly lift or crack during dewatering, flooding the caisson and endangering the crew; a caisson seated at a tilt displaces the foundation and affects tower geometry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沉箱下沉過程量測傾斜、刃口高程與河床接觸；封底灌注後以鑽芯或潛水檢查完整性，抽水時分階段降低水位並監測封底上浮、滲水量與沉箱變形，任何異常立即停止抽水。
knowledge.textEn: While sinking, monitor caisson tilt, cutting-edge level and bed contact; after the seal pour check integrity by coring or divers; dewater in stages while monitoring seal uplift, seepage and caisson deformation, stopping immediately at any anomaly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 沉箱與圍堰屬臨時工程，需有獨立的設計、檢查與簽認；抽水程序要列出分階段水位、量測項目與停止條件，並把封底驗收設為停留檢查點。
knowledge.textEn: Caissons and cofferdams are temporary works needing their own design, checking and sign-off; the dewatering procedure should list staged water levels, measurements and stop criteria, with acceptance of the seal a hold point.

quiz.question: 要驗證「海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam"?
options: 沉箱下沉過程量測傾斜、刃口高程與河床接觸；封底灌注後以鑽芯或潛水檢查完整性，抽水時分階段降低水位並監測封底上浮、滲水量與沉箱變形，任何異常立即停止抽水。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。
optionsEn: While sinking, monitor caisson tilt, cutting-edge level and bed contact.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones.
quiz.explanation: 沉箱下沉過程量測傾斜、刃口高程與河床接觸；封底灌注後以鑽芯或潛水檢查完整性，抽水時分階段降低水位並監測封底上浮、滲水量與沉箱變形，任何異常立即停止抽水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: While sinking, monitor caisson tilt, cutting-edge level and bed contact; after the seal pour check integrity by coring or divers; dewater in stages while monitoring seal uplift, seepage and caisson deformation, stopping immediately at any anomaly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「南北塔臨時鋼沉箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary steel caissons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 封底厚度不足或灌注夾泥，抽水時封底可能突然上浮或破裂，海水湧入淹沒沉箱並危及作業人員；沉箱傾斜坐落則使基礎偏位，影響塔的幾何。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An insufficient or contaminated seal can suddenly lift or crack during dewatering, flooding the caisson and endangering the crew; a caisson seated at a tilt displaces the foundation and affects tower geometry. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：封底混凝土的厚度取決於外部水頭：抽乾後，水壓從下方向上推，封底的自重加上與壁面的摩擦必須足以平衡，否則封底會上浮或破裂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The seal thickness depends on the external head: once dewatered, water pressure pushes up from below, and the seal’s self-weight plus friction on the walls must balance it or the seal will lift or crack.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 封底厚度不足或灌注夾泥，抽水時封底可能突然上浮或破裂，海水湧入淹沒沉箱並危及作業人員；沉箱傾斜坐落則使基礎偏位，影響塔的幾何。
knowledge.textEn: An insufficient or contaminated seal can suddenly lift or crack during dewatering, flooding the caisson and endangering the crew; a caisson seated at a tilt displaces the foundation and affects tower geometry.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「海灣中的塔基：鋼沉箱與圍堰」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tower foundations in the firth: steel caissons and cofferdam" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
封底厚度不足或灌注夾泥，抽水時封底可能突然上浮或破裂，海水湧入淹沒沉箱並危及作業人員；沉箱傾斜坐落則使基礎偏位，影響塔的幾何。
多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An insufficient or contaminated seal can suddenly lift or crack during dewatering, flooding the caisson and endangering the crew.
With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently.
quiz.explanation: 封底厚度不足或灌注夾泥，抽水時封底可能突然上浮或破裂，海水湧入淹沒沉箱並危及作業人員；沉箱傾斜坐落則使基礎偏位，影響塔的幾何。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An insufficient or contaminated seal can suddenly lift or crack during dewatering, flooding the caisson and endangering the crew; a caisson seated at a tilt displaces the foundation and affects tower geometry. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝」與「兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers" and "Closing two main spans and correcting levels": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面節段吊裝」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck-segment lifting” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面鋼節段在中國與西班牙製造、海運到場，再從三座塔各向兩側以平衡懸臂吊裝，同時有六個懸臂前緣推進。每個節段吊上後焊接或栓接，安裝對應斜索並張拉，再澆築或安裝橋面板。六個前緣同時作業可縮短工期，但每座塔都必須保持兩側平衡，海灣的潮流、風與航道限制吊裝窗口；某一前緣延誤時，必須檢查其他前緣是否能繼續而不造成過大的不平衡。施工控制團隊要同時管理三組懸臂的幾何與索力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面節段吊裝」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Queensferry deck segments were made in China and Spain, shipped to site and lifted as balanced cantilevers from each of the three towers in both directions, with six cantilever fronts advancing at once. Each segment is lifted, welded or bolted, its stays installed and stressed, and its deck slab cast or placed. Six fronts shorten the programme, but every tower must stay balanced, and tides, wind and shipping limit lifting windows; when one front falls behind, the team must check whether the others can continue without excessive imbalance. Construction control must manage the geometry and stay forces of three sets of cantilevers at once. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck-segment lifting” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜張橋段 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m，以 12 m 節段計約需 1,742/12 ≈ 145 個（公開資料列約 149 個）；六個前緣平均分攤約 145/6 ≈ 24 個，若每個前緣每 4 天完成一個循環，約需 24×4 ≈ 97 天的純吊裝時間。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The cable-stayed section is 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m; in 12 m segments it needs about 1,742/12 ≈ 145 segments (public sources cite about 149).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面節段吊裝」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck-segment lifting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝
knowledge.text: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面鋼節段在中國與西班牙製造、海運到場，再從三座塔各向兩側以平衡懸臂吊裝，同時有六個懸臂前緣推進。每個節段吊上後焊接或栓接，安裝對應斜索並張拉，再澆築或安裝橋面板。
knowledge.textEn: The Queensferry deck segments were made in China and Spain, shipped to site and lifted as balanced cantilevers from each of the three towers in both directions, with six cantilever fronts advancing at once. Each segment is lifted, welded or bolted, its stays installed and stressed, and its deck slab cast or placed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers" is correct?
options: 多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。
每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。
皇后渡口大橋的橋面鋼節段在中國與西班牙製造、海運到場，再從三座塔各向兩側以平衡懸臂吊裝，同時有六個懸臂前緣推進。
optionsEn: With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently.
Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other.

The Queensferry deck segments were made in China and Spain, shipped to site and lifted as balanced cantilevers from each of the three towers in both directions, with six cantilever fronts advancing at once.
quiz.explanation: 皇后渡口大橋的橋面鋼節段在中國與西班牙製造、海運到場，再從三座塔各向兩側以平衡懸臂吊裝，同時有六個懸臂前緣推進。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Queensferry deck segments were made in China and Spain, shipped to site and lifted as balanced cantilevers from each of the three towers in both directions, with six cantilever fronts advancing at once. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面節段吊裝」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck-segment lifting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜張橋段 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m，以 12 m 節段計約需 1,742/12 ≈ 145 個（公開資料列約 149 個）；六個前緣平均分攤約 145/6 ≈ 24 個，若每個前緣每 4 天完成一個循環，約需 24×4 ≈ 97 天的純吊裝時間。循環時間為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The cable-stayed section is 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m; in 12 m segments it needs about 1,742/12 ≈ 145 segments (public sources cite about 149). Shared among six fronts, each handles about 145/6 ≈ 24; at one cycle every 4 days per front, net lifting takes about 24×4 ≈ 97 days. Cycle time is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個吊裝循環後量測懸臂端高程、軸線與塔頂偏位，並與施工控制模型比較；建立六個前緣的進度與不平衡追蹤表，任何前緣超出容許不平衡即暫停相對側作業；吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道協調。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each cycle survey cantilever-tip level, alignment and tower-head displacement and compare with the control model; keep a progress and imbalance tracker for all six fronts, pausing the opposite side when any front exceeds the allowable imbalance; confirm wind, tide and shipping coordination before each lift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 斜張橋段 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m，以 12 m 節段計約需 1,742/12 ≈ 145 個（公開資料列約 149 個）；六個前緣平均分攤約 145/6 ≈ 24 個，若每個前緣每 4 天完成一個循環，約需 24×4 ≈ 97 天的純吊裝時間。循環時間為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The cable-stayed section is 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m; in 12 m segments it needs about 1,742/12 ≈ 145 segments (public sources cite about 149). Shared among six fronts, each handles about 145/6 ≈ 24; at one cycle every 4 days per front, net lifting takes about 24×4 ≈ 97 days. Cycle time is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers", which statement holds?
options: 監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。
新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。
optionsEn: The cable-stayed section is 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m; in 12 m segments it needs about 1,742/12 ≈ 145 segments (public sources cite about 149).
More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation.
A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later.
quiz.explanation: 斜張橋段 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m，以 12 m 節段計約需 1,742/12 ≈ 145 個（公開資料列約 149 個）；六個前緣平均分攤約 145/6 ≈ 24 個，若每個前緣每 4 天完成一個循環，約需 24×4 ≈ 97 天的純吊裝時間。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The cable-stayed section is 221+650+650+221 = 1,742 m; in 12 m segments it needs about 1,742/12 ≈ 145 segments (public sources cite about 149). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面節段吊裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck-segment lifting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個吊裝循環後量測懸臂端高程、軸線與塔頂偏位，並與施工控制模型比較；建立六個前緣的進度與不平衡追蹤表，任何前緣超出容許不平衡即暫停相對側作業；吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道協調。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each cycle survey cantilever-tip level, alignment and tower-head displacement and compare with the control model; keep a progress and imbalance tracker for all six fronts, pausing the opposite side when any front exceeds the allowable imbalance; confirm wind, tide and shipping coordination before each lift. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：節段在工廠要做預拼裝與尺寸驗收，海運前記錄重量與幾何；施工控制計畫應有六個前緣的整體排程、不平衡上限與延誤時的處置規則，並每日更新。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pre-assemble and dimensionally accept segments at the factory and record weight and geometry before shipping; the construction-control plan should hold a combined schedule for all six fronts, imbalance limits and rules for delays, updated daily.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若某座塔兩側進度差太多，塔頂偏位與塔底彎矩超出施工期容許；節段製造誤差未在出廠時檢出，到現場才發現接頭不吻合，會造成延誤與強制對位的殘餘應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If one tower’s two sides drift too far apart in progress, tower-head displacement and base moment exceed construction limits; fabrication errors not caught at the factory surface as mismatched joints on site, causing delay and residual stress from forced fit-up. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個吊裝循環後量測懸臂端高程、軸線與塔頂偏位，並與施工控制模型比較；建立六個前緣的進度與不平衡追蹤表，任何前緣超出容許不平衡即暫停相對側作業；吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道協調。
knowledge.textEn: After each cycle survey cantilever-tip level, alignment and tower-head displacement and compare with the control model; keep a progress and imbalance tracker for all six fronts, pausing the opposite side when any front exceeds the allowable imbalance; confirm wind, tide and shipping coordination before each lift.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 節段在工廠要做預拼裝與尺寸驗收，海運前記錄重量與幾何；施工控制計畫應有六個前緣的整體排程、不平衡上限與延誤時的處置規則，並每日更新。
knowledge.textEn: Pre-assemble and dimensionally accept segments at the factory and record weight and geometry before shipping; the construction-control plan should hold a combined schedule for all six fronts, imbalance limits and rules for delays, updated daily.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每個吊裝循環後量測懸臂端高程、軸線與塔頂偏位，並與施工控制模型比較。
斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
After each cycle survey cantilever-tip level, alignment and tower-head displacement and compare with the control model.
The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head.
quiz.explanation: 每個吊裝循環後量測懸臂端高程、軸線與塔頂偏位，並與施工控制模型比較；建立六個前緣的進度與不平衡追蹤表，任何前緣超出容許不平衡即暫停相對側作業；吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道協調。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each cycle survey cantilever-tip level, alignment and tower-head displacement and compare with the control model; keep a progress and imbalance tracker for all six fronts, pausing the opposite side when any front exceeds the allowable imbalance; confirm wind, tide and shipping coordination before each lift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面節段吊裝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck-segment lifting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若某座塔兩側進度差太多，塔頂偏位與塔底彎矩超出施工期容許；節段製造誤差未在出廠時檢出，到現場才發現接頭不吻合，會造成延誤與強制對位的殘餘應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If one tower’s two sides drift too far apart in progress, tower-head displacement and base moment exceed construction limits; fabrication errors not caught at the factory surface as mismatched joints on site, causing delay and residual stress from forced fit-up. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工控制團隊要同時管理三組懸臂的幾何與索力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Construction control must manage the geometry and stay forces of three sets of cantilevers at once.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若某座塔兩側進度差太多，塔頂偏位與塔底彎矩超出施工期容許；節段製造誤差未在出廠時檢出，到現場才發現接頭不吻合，會造成延誤與強制對位的殘餘應力。
knowledge.textEn: If one tower’s two sides drift too far apart in progress, tower-head displacement and base moment exceed construction limits; fabrication errors not caught at the factory surface as mismatched joints on site, causing delay and residual stress from forced fit-up.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三塔同步的平衡懸臂吊裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Balanced-cantilever lifting from three towers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。
若某座塔兩側進度差太多，塔頂偏位與塔底彎矩超出施工期容許；節段製造誤差未在出廠時檢出，到現場才發現接頭不吻合，會造成延誤與強制對位的殘餘應力。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other.
If one tower’s two sides drift too far apart in progress, tower-head displacement and base moment exceed construction limits.
quiz.explanation: 若某座塔兩側進度差太多，塔頂偏位與塔底彎矩超出施工期容許；節段製造誤差未在出廠時檢出，到現場才發現接頭不吻合，會造成延誤與強制對位的殘餘應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If one tower’s two sides drift too far apart in progress, tower-head displacement and base moment exceed construction limits; fabrication errors not caught at the factory surface as mismatched joints on site, causing delay and residual stress from forced fit-up. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Closing two main spans and correcting levels: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「兩處跨中合龍」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two mid-span closures” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 三塔體系有兩個 650 m 主跨，每跨都在跨中由兩側懸臂會合。由於兩跨共用中塔，一跨合龍時的強制調整會經中塔影響另一跨；而且交叉斜索的錨點在跨中重疊，合龍段附近的斜索力與高程互相牽連。合龍前兩個懸臂端的高差來自製造誤差、溫度差、日照與風，通常以調整附近幾根斜索的索力、加減臨時配重或以千斤頂微調來消除，再以臨時鎖定裝置固定並完成接合。合龍順序與每一步的調整量必須事先模擬。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「兩處跨中合龍」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A three-tower system has two 650 m main spans, each closed at mid-span where cantilevers from both sides meet. Because both spans share the central tower, forced adjustments at one closure travel through the tower to the other span, and since crossing stays anchor in the overlap at mid-span, stay forces and levels near the closure are interlinked. Level differences between tips before closure come from fabrication error, temperature, sunshine and wind, and are usually removed by adjusting forces in a few nearby stays, adding or removing temporary ballast or fine jacking, then fixing the tips with temporary locks before joining. The closure order and every adjustment step must be simulated in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Two mid-span closures” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若影響係數顯示附近某根斜索每增加 100 kN 可使懸臂端上升 15 mm，消除 90 mm 高差需增加 90/15×100 = 600 kN；若改由兩根索分擔、每根影響係數 10 mm/100 kN，則各需約 450 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If influence coefficients show that each extra 100 kN in a nearby stay lifts the tip 15 mm, removing a 90 mm difference needs 90/15×100 = 600 kN more; sharing the correction between two stays at 10 mm per 100 kN each requires about 450 kN in each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「兩處跨中合龍」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Two mid-span closures”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正
knowledge.titleEn: Closing two main spans and correcting levels
knowledge.text: 三塔體系有兩個 650 m 主跨，每跨都在跨中由兩側懸臂會合。由於兩跨共用中塔，一跨合龍時的強制調整會經中塔影響另一跨；而且交叉斜索的錨點在跨中重疊，合龍段附近的斜索力與高程互相牽連。
knowledge.textEn: A three-tower system has two 650 m main spans, each closed at mid-span where cantilevers from both sides meet. Because both spans share the central tower, forced adjustments at one closure travel through the tower to the other span, and since crossing stays anchor in the overlap at mid-span, stay forces and levels near the closure are interlinked.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closing two main spans and correcting levels" is correct?
options: 三塔體系有兩個 650 m 主跨，每跨都在跨中由兩側懸臂會合。
每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。
防風屏障越高越密，對大橋和車輛都越好。
optionsEn: A three-tower system has two 650 m main spans, each closed at mid-span where cantilevers from both sides meet.
Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other.
The taller and more solid the wind shielding, the better for both bridge and vehicles.
quiz.explanation: 三塔體系有兩個 650 m 主跨，每跨都在跨中由兩側懸臂會合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A three-tower system has two 650 m main spans, each closed at mid-span where cantilevers from both sides meet. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closing two main spans and correcting levels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「兩處跨中合龍」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two mid-span closures” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若影響係數顯示附近某根斜索每增加 100 kN 可使懸臂端上升 15 mm，消除 90 mm 高差需增加 90/15×100 = 600 kN；若改由兩根索分擔、每根影響係數 10 mm/100 kN，則各需約 450 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If influence coefficients show that each extra 100 kN in a nearby stay lifts the tip 15 mm, removing a 90 mm difference needs 90/15×100 = 600 kN more; sharing the correction between two stays at 10 mm per 100 kN each requires about 450 kN in each. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端高程、間距、溫度與風速，選在溫度穩定的時段；每一步索力調整後量測高程與塔頂位移，與影響矩陣預測比較；第一處合龍完成後重新量測第二跨，再決定其調整量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before closure log both tip levels, gap, temperature and wind continuously and choose a thermally stable window; after each stay adjustment measure levels and tower displacement against influence-matrix predictions; after the first closure, resurvey the second span before deciding its adjustments.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若影響係數顯示附近某根斜索每增加 100 kN 可使懸臂端上升 15 mm，消除 90 mm 高差需增加 90/15×100 = 600 kN；若改由兩根索分擔、每根影響係數 10 mm/100 kN，則各需約 450 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If influence coefficients show that each extra 100 kN in a nearby stay lifts the tip 15 mm, removing a 90 mm difference needs 90/15×100 = 600 kN more; sharing the correction between two stays at 10 mm per 100 kN each requires about 450 kN in each. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closing two main spans and correcting levels", which statement holds?
options: 積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。
若影響係數顯示附近某根斜索每增加 100 kN 可使懸臂端上升 15 mm，消除 90 mm 高差需增加 90/15×100 = 600 kN。
三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。
optionsEn: Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect.
If influence coefficients show that each extra 100 kN in a nearby stay lifts the tip 15 mm, removing a 90 mm difference needs 90/15×100 = 600 kN more.
A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones.
quiz.explanation: 若影響係數顯示附近某根斜索每增加 100 kN 可使懸臂端上升 15 mm，消除 90 mm 高差需增加 90/15×100 = 600 kN；若改由兩根索分擔、每根影響係數 10 mm/100 kN，則各需約 450 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If influence coefficients show that each extra 100 kN in a nearby stay lifts the tip 15 mm, removing a 90 mm difference needs 90/15×100 = 600 kN more; sharing the correction between two stays at 10 mm per 100 kN each requires about 450 kN in each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closing two main spans and correcting levels: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩處跨中合龍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two mid-span closures” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端高程、間距、溫度與風速，選在溫度穩定的時段；每一步索力調整後量測高程與塔頂位移，與影響矩陣預測比較；第一處合龍完成後重新量測第二跨，再決定其調整量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before closure log both tip levels, gap, temperature and wind continuously and choose a thermally stable window; after each stay adjustment measure levels and tower displacement against influence-matrix predictions; after the first closure, resurvey the second span before deciding its adjustments. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合龍計畫要包含兩跨的整體順序、每一步的索力調整量與量測點、溫度與風速作業窗口，以及中止與回復程序；兩處合龍都設為停留檢查點，由設計與施工控制工程師共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The closure plan should cover the order for both spans, each step’s stay adjustments and survey points, temperature and wind windows, and abort and recovery procedures; both closures are hold points signed jointly by the designer and construction-control engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若兩處合龍各自為政，第一跨的強制調整讓中塔偏移，第二跨的高差因而變大，最後需更大的強制力才能合龍，留下殘餘應力；臨時鎖定不足時，日溫變化可能在焊接期間拉開接頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the two closures independently lets forced adjustment at the first span tilt the central tower and enlarge the level gap at the second, requiring even larger forcing and leaving residual stress; inadequate temporary locks let daily temperature change pull the joint open during welding. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端高程、間距、溫度與風速，選在溫度穩定的時段；每一步索力調整後量測高程與塔頂位移，與影響矩陣預測比較；第一處合龍完成後重新量測第二跨，再決定其調整量。
knowledge.textEn: Before closure log both tip levels, gap, temperature and wind continuously and choose a thermally stable window; after each stay adjustment measure levels and tower displacement against influence-matrix predictions; after the first closure, resurvey the second span before deciding its adjustments.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合龍計畫要包含兩跨的整體順序、每一步的索力調整量與量測點、溫度與風速作業窗口，以及中止與回復程序；兩處合龍都設為停留檢查點，由設計與施工控制工程師共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The closure plan should cover the order for both spans, each step’s stay adjustments and survey points, temperature and wind windows, and abort and recovery procedures; both closures are hold points signed jointly by the designer and construction-control engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closing two main spans and correcting levels"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。
合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端高程、間距、溫度與風速，選在溫度穩定的時段。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action.
Before closure log both tip levels, gap, temperature and wind continuously and choose a thermally stable window.
quiz.explanation: 合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端高程、間距、溫度與風速，選在溫度穩定的時段；每一步索力調整後量測高程與塔頂位移，與影響矩陣預測比較；第一處合龍完成後重新量測第二跨，再決定其調整量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before closure log both tip levels, gap, temperature and wind continuously and choose a thermally stable window; after each stay adjustment measure levels and tower displacement against influence-matrix predictions; after the first closure, resurvey the second span before deciding its adjustments. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closing two main spans and correcting levels: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩處跨中合龍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two mid-span closures” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若兩處合龍各自為政，第一跨的強制調整讓中塔偏移，第二跨的高差因而變大，最後需更大的強制力才能合龍，留下殘餘應力；臨時鎖定不足時，日溫變化可能在焊接期間拉開接頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the two closures independently lets forced adjustment at the first span tilt the central tower and enlarge the level gap at the second, requiring even larger forcing and leaving residual stress; inadequate temporary locks let daily temperature change pull the joint open during welding. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：合龍順序與每一步的調整量必須事先模擬。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The closure order and every adjustment step must be simulated in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若兩處合龍各自為政，第一跨的強制調整讓中塔偏移，第二跨的高差因而變大，最後需更大的強制力才能合龍，留下殘餘應力；臨時鎖定不足時，日溫變化可能在焊接期間拉開接頭。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the two closures independently lets forced adjustment at the first span tilt the central tower and enlarge the level gap at the second, requiring even larger forcing and leaving residual stress; inadequate temporary locks let daily temperature change pull the joint open during welding.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「兩個主跨的合龍與高程修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closing two main spans and correcting levels" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若兩處合龍各自為政，第一跨的強制調整讓中塔偏移，第二跨的高差因而變大，最後需更大的強制力才能合龍，留下殘餘應力；臨時鎖定不足時，日溫變化可能在焊接期間拉開接頭。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
防風屏障越高越密，對大橋和車輛都越好。
optionsEn: Treating the two closures independently lets forced adjustment at the first span tilt the central tower and enlarge the level gap at the second, requiring even larger forcing and leaving residual stress.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The taller and more solid the wind shielding, the better for both bridge and vehicles.
quiz.explanation: 若兩處合龍各自為政，第一跨的強制調整讓中塔偏移，第二跨的高差因而變大，最後需更大的強制力才能合龍，留下殘餘應力；臨時鎖定不足時，日溫變化可能在焊接期間拉開接頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the two closures independently lets forced adjustment at the first span tilt the central tower and enlarge the level gap at the second, requiring even larger forcing and leaving residual stress; inadequate temporary locks let daily temperature change pull the joint open during welding. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全」與「約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety" and "Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「防風屏障」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wind shielding” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 相鄰的福斯公路大橋在強風時常需限制高側車輛或封橋，影響蘇格蘭東部交通。皇后渡口大橋在兩側車道設置防風屏障，交通部門說明其設計目的是讓大橋在風速達約 115 mph（約 51 m/s）時仍能保持開放。屏障降低車道高度的風速與紊流，減少高側車輛的側向力與翻覆力矩；但屏障本身也增加橋面迎風面積與氣動阻力，並可能改變斷面的渦振特性，因此必須與橋面一起進行風洞試驗，在行車安全與結構風荷載之間取得平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「防風屏障」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The neighbouring Forth Road Bridge often had to restrict high-sided vehicles or close in strong winds, disrupting traffic in eastern Scotland. The Queensferry Crossing has wind shielding along both carriageways, which the transport agency says is designed to keep the bridge open in winds up to about 115 mph (about 51 m/s). The shielding lowers wind speed and turbulence at lane level, reducing side force and overturning moment on high-sided vehicles, but it also adds windward area and drag to the deck and can change the section’s vortex behaviour, so it must be wind-tunnel tested with the deck to balance traffic safety against structural wind load. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wind shielding” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s，q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa；高側車側面積 30 m²、側力係數 1.0 時 F ≈ 48.6 kN，作用高 2.0 m 的翻覆力矩約 97 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s, so q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa; for a high-sided vehicle with 30 m² side area and side-force coefficient 1.0, F ≈ 48.6 kN and the overturning moment at 2.0 m height is about 97 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防風屏障越高越密，對大橋和車輛都越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The taller and more solid the wind shielding, the better for both bridge and vehicles." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「防風屏障」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wind shielding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全
knowledge.titleEn: Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety
knowledge.text: 相鄰的福斯公路大橋在強風時常需限制高側車輛或封橋，影響蘇格蘭東部交通。皇后渡口大橋在兩側車道設置防風屏障，交通部門說明其設計目的是讓大橋在風速達約 115 mph（約 51 m/s）時仍能保持開放。
knowledge.textEn: The neighbouring Forth Road Bridge often had to restrict high-sided vehicles or close in strong winds, disrupting traffic in eastern Scotland. The Queensferry Crossing has wind shielding along both carriageways, which the transport agency says is designed to keep the bridge open in winds up to about 115 mph (about 51 m/s).

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防風屏障越高越密，對大橋和車輛都越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The taller and more solid the wind shielding, the better for both bridge and vehicles. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety" is correct?
options: 防風屏障越高越密，對大橋和車輛都越好。
相鄰的福斯公路大橋在強風時常需限制高側車輛或封橋，影響蘇格蘭東部交通。
監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。
optionsEn: The taller and more solid the wind shielding, the better for both bridge and vehicles.
The neighbouring Forth Road Bridge often had to restrict high-sided vehicles or close in strong winds, disrupting traffic in eastern Scotland.
More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰的福斯公路大橋在強風時常需限制高側車輛或封橋，影響蘇格蘭東部交通。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The neighbouring Forth Road Bridge often had to restrict high-sided vehicles or close in strong winds, disrupting traffic in eastern Scotland. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防風屏障」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wind shielding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s，q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa；高側車側面積 30 m²、側力係數 1.0 時 F ≈ 48.6 kN，作用高 2.0 m 的翻覆力矩約 97 kN·m。若屏障使車道風速減半為 25.7 m/s，F ≈ 12.1 kN、力矩約 24 kN·m，只有原來的四分之一。車輛參數與減風比為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s, so q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa; for a high-sided vehicle with 30 m² side area and side-force coefficient 1.0, F ≈ 48.6 kN and the overturning moment at 2.0 m height is about 97 kN·m. If shielding halves lane-level wind to 25.7 m/s, F ≈ 12.1 kN and the moment is about 24 kN·m, a quarter of the original. Vehicle values and the reduction ratio are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以含屏障的斷面模型風洞試驗量測橋面氣動係數與渦振，並在模型車道高度量測風速折減；以車輛模型量測側力與翻覆係數；通車後以橋上風速計記錄屏障內外風速，驗證折減比並建立交通管制門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test section models with shielding to measure deck aerodynamic coefficients and vortex response and the wind reduction at lane height; measure side-force and overturning coefficients on vehicle models; after opening log anemometers inside and outside the shielding to confirm the reduction ratio and set traffic-control thresholds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s，q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa；高側車側面積 30 m²、側力係數 1.0 時 F ≈ 48.6 kN，作用高 2.0 m 的翻覆力矩約 97 kN·m。若屏障使車道風速減半為 25.7 m/s，F ≈ 12.1 kN、力矩約 24 kN·m，只有原來的四分之一。車輛參數與減風比為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s, so q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa; for a high-sided vehicle with 30 m² side area and side-force coefficient 1.0, F ≈ 48.6 kN and the overturning moment at 2.0 m height is about 97 kN·m. If shielding halves lane-level wind to 25.7 m/s, F ≈ 12.1 kN and the moment is about 24 kN·m, a quarter of the original. Vehicle values and the reduction ratio are teaching assumptions.
