knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety", which statement holds?
options: 新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。
斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。
115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s，q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa。
optionsEn: A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later.
The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head.
115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s, so q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa.
quiz.explanation: 115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s，q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa；高側車側面積 30 m²、側力係數 1.0 時 F ≈ 48.6 kN，作用高 2.0 m 的翻覆力矩約 97 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 115 mph ≈ 51.4 m/s, so q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,619 Pa; for a high-sided vehicle with 30 m² side area and side-force coefficient 1.0, F ≈ 48.6 kN and the overturning moment at 2.0 m height is about 97 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防風屏障」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wind shielding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以含屏障的斷面模型風洞試驗量測橋面氣動係數與渦振，並在模型車道高度量測風速折減；以車輛模型量測側力與翻覆係數；通車後以橋上風速計記錄屏障內外風速，驗證折減比並建立交通管制門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test section models with shielding to measure deck aerodynamic coefficients and vortex response and the wind reduction at lane height; measure side-force and overturning coefficients on vehicle models; after opening log anemometers inside and outside the shielding to confirm the reduction ratio and set traffic-control thresholds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運單位應把橋上風速與交通管制門檻寫入標準作業程序，並定期檢查屏障面板與固定件；任何屏障修改都需由風工程顧問評估對橋面氣動與車輛安全的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The operator should write deck wind speeds and traffic-control thresholds into standard procedures and inspect shield panels and fixings regularly; any shielding modification needs the wind consultant’s assessment of deck aerodynamics and vehicle safety.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若屏障孔隙率或高度在施工中更改而未重新試驗，橋面可能出現新的渦振，或屏障後方的減風效果不如預期，高側車在陣風中失控；屏障固定件疲勞斷裂也可能讓面板掉落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changing shielding porosity or height during construction without retesting can introduce new vortex vibration or weaker lane-level shelter, letting high-sided vehicles lose control in gusts; fatigue failure of shield fixings can drop panels. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以含屏障的斷面模型風洞試驗量測橋面氣動係數與渦振，並在模型車道高度量測風速折減；以車輛模型量測側力與翻覆係數；通車後以橋上風速計記錄屏障內外風速，驗證折減比並建立交通管制門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Test section models with shielding to measure deck aerodynamic coefficients and vortex response and the wind reduction at lane height; measure side-force and overturning coefficients on vehicle models; after opening log anemometers inside and outside the shielding to confirm the reduction ratio and set traffic-control thresholds.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 營運單位應把橋上風速與交通管制門檻寫入標準作業程序，並定期檢查屏障面板與固定件；任何屏障修改都需由風工程顧問評估對橋面氣動與車輛安全的影響。
knowledge.textEn: The operator should write deck wind speeds and traffic-control thresholds into standard procedures and inspect shield panels and fixings regularly; any shielding modification needs the wind consultant’s assessment of deck aerodynamics and vehicle safety.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety"?
options: 以含屏障的斷面模型風洞試驗量測橋面氣動係數與渦振，並在模型車道高度量測風速折減。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。
optionsEn: Test section models with shielding to measure deck aerodynamic coefficients and vortex response and the wind reduction at lane height.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 以含屏障的斷面模型風洞試驗量測橋面氣動係數與渦振，並在模型車道高度量測風速折減；以車輛模型量測側力與翻覆係數；通車後以橋上風速計記錄屏障內外風速，驗證折減比並建立交通管制門檻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test section models with shielding to measure deck aerodynamic coefficients and vortex response and the wind reduction at lane height; measure side-force and overturning coefficients on vehicle models; after opening log anemometers inside and outside the shielding to confirm the reduction ratio and set traffic-control thresholds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防風屏障」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wind shielding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若屏障孔隙率或高度在施工中更改而未重新試驗，橋面可能出現新的渦振，或屏障後方的減風效果不如預期，高側車在陣風中失控；屏障固定件疲勞斷裂也可能讓面板掉落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing shielding porosity or height during construction without retesting can introduce new vortex vibration or weaker lane-level shelter, letting high-sided vehicles lose control in gusts; fatigue failure of shield fixings can drop panels. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：屏障降低車道高度的風速與紊流，減少高側車輛的側向力與翻覆力矩；但屏障本身也增加橋面迎風面積與氣動阻力，並可能改變斷面的渦振特性，因此必須與橋面一起進行風洞試驗，在行車安全與結構風荷載之間取得平衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The shielding lowers wind speed and turbulence at lane level, reducing side force and overturning moment on high-sided vehicles, but it also adds windward area and drag to the deck and can change the section’s vortex behaviour, so it must be wind-tunnel tested with the deck to balance traffic safety against structural wind load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防風屏障越高越密，對大橋和車輛都越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The taller and more solid the wind shielding, the better for both bridge and vehicles." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若屏障孔隙率或高度在施工中更改而未重新試驗，橋面可能出現新的渦振，或屏障後方的減風效果不如預期，高側車在陣風中失控；屏障固定件疲勞斷裂也可能讓面板掉落。
knowledge.textEn: Changing shielding porosity or height during construction without retesting can introduce new vortex vibration or weaker lane-level shelter, letting high-sided vehicles lose control in gusts; fatigue failure of shield fixings can drop panels.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若屏障孔隙率或高度在施工中更改而未重新試驗，橋面可能出現新的渦振，或屏障後方的減風效果不如預期，高側車在陣風中失控；屏障固定件疲勞斷裂也可能讓面板掉落。
監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Changing shielding porosity or height during construction without retesting can introduce new vortex vibration or weaker lane-level shelter, letting high-sided vehicles lose control in gusts.
More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation.
quiz.explanation: 若屏障孔隙率或高度在施工中更改而未重新試驗，橋面可能出現新的渦振，或屏障後方的減風效果不如預期，高側車在陣風中失控；屏障固定件疲勞斷裂也可能讓面板掉落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing shielding porosity or height during construction without retesting can introduce new vortex vibration or weaker lane-level shelter, letting high-sided vehicles lose control in gusts; fatigue failure of shield fixings can drop panels. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雲端結構健康監測」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cloud-based health monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計團隊公開資料指出，皇后渡口大橋約有 2,000 個感測器即時監測整體行為，資料送入雲端結構健康監測系統。交通部門說明路面在橋上沒有中間伸縮縫，行車因而平順，這代表溫度造成的伸縮集中在兩端的伸縮縫與支承，伸縮縫開口與溫度的關係就成為最直接的健康指標之一：若關係線斜率改變或出現遲滯，可能代表支承卡滯、阻尼器失效或結構約束改變。監測資料也用來比對設計預測的應變、索力與加速度，累積長期基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雲端結構健康監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The design team states that about 2,000 sensors monitor the Queensferry Crossing’s global behaviour in real time, feeding a cloud-based structural health monitoring system. The transport agency notes there are no intermediate road-level joints on the bridge, giving a smooth ride; this means thermal movement concentrates at the end joints and bearings, so the relation between joint opening and temperature becomes one of the most direct health indicators: a change in slope or new hysteresis may signal seized bearings, failed dampers or changed restraint. The data are also compared with predicted strains, stay forces and accelerations to build long-term baselines. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cloud-based health monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雲端結構健康監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cloud-based health monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀
knowledge.titleEn: Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation
knowledge.text: 設計團隊公開資料指出，皇后渡口大橋約有 2,000 個感測器即時監測整體行為，資料送入雲端結構健康監測系統。交通部門說明路面在橋上沒有中間伸縮縫，行車因而平順，這代表溫度造成的伸縮集中在兩端的伸縮縫與支承，伸縮縫開口與溫度的關係就成為最直接的健康指標之一：若關係線斜率改變或出現遲滯，可能代表支承卡滯、阻尼器失效或結構約束改變。
knowledge.textEn: The design team states that about 2,000 sensors monitor the Queensferry Crossing’s global behaviour in real time, feeding a cloud-based structural health monitoring system. The transport agency notes there are no intermediate road-level joints on the bridge, giving a smooth ride; this means thermal movement concentrates at the end joints and bearings, so the relation between joint opening and temperature becomes one of the most direct health indicators: a change in slope or new hysteresis may signal seized bearings, failed dampers or changed restraint.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation" is correct?
options: 監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。
積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。
設計團隊公開資料指出，皇后渡口大橋約有 2,000 個感測器即時監測整體行為，資料送入雲端結構健康監測系統。
optionsEn: More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation.
Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect.
The design team states that about 2,000 sensors monitor the Queensferry Crossing’s global behaviour in real time, feeding a cloud-based structural health monitoring system.
quiz.explanation: 設計團隊公開資料指出，皇后渡口大橋約有 2,000 個感測器即時監測整體行為，資料送入雲端結構健康監測系統。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The design team states that about 2,000 sensors monitor the Queensferry Crossing’s global behaviour in real time, feeding a cloud-based structural health monitoring system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雲端結構健康監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cloud-based health monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取組合橋面 α = 1.1×10⁻⁵/°C、自不動點到端部 L = 1,350 m：每 1 °C 伸縮約 1.1×10⁻⁵×1,350,000 mm ≈ 14.9 mm，ΔT = 45 °C 時約 0.67 m。實測斜率若只有約 10 mm/°C，表示約三分之一的伸縮被阻擋。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With α = 1.1×10⁻⁵/°C for the composite deck and L = 1,350 m from the fixed point to the end, each 1 °C gives about 1.1×10⁻⁵×1,350,000 mm ≈ 14.9 mm, and ΔT = 45 °C gives about 0.67 m. A measured slope of only about 10 mm/°C would mean about a third of the movement is being restrained. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有效橋面溫度（多點溫度計加權）對伸縮縫位移做回歸，每季更新斜率與殘差；同時比對支承位移、阻尼器行程與塔頂偏位，確認約束行為一致；感測器每年校正，異常讀值以人工量測複核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Regress joint displacement against effective deck temperature from weighted multi-point thermometers and update the slope and residuals quarterly; cross-check bearing displacement, damper stroke and tower-head displacement for consistent restraint behaviour; calibrate sensors yearly and verify anomalous readings manually.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取組合橋面 α = 1.1×10⁻⁵/°C、自不動點到端部 L = 1,350 m：每 1 °C 伸縮約 1.1×10⁻⁵×1,350,000 mm ≈ 14.9 mm，ΔT = 45 °C 時約 0.67 m。實測斜率若只有約 10 mm/°C，表示約三分之一的伸縮被阻擋。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With α = 1.1×10⁻⁵/°C for the composite deck and L = 1,350 m from the fixed point to the end, each 1 °C gives about 1.1×10⁻⁵×1,350,000 mm ≈ 14.9 mm, and ΔT = 45 °C gives about 0.67 m. A measured slope of only about 10 mm/°C would mean about a third of the movement is being restrained. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。
組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。
optionsEn: Movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones.
In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雲端結構健康監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cloud-based health monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有效橋面溫度（多點溫度計加權）對伸縮縫位移做回歸，每季更新斜率與殘差；同時比對支承位移、阻尼器行程與塔頂偏位，確認約束行為一致；感測器每年校正，異常讀值以人工量測複核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Regress joint displacement against effective deck temperature from weighted multi-point thermometers and update the slope and residuals quarterly; cross-check bearing displacement, damper stroke and tower-head displacement for consistent restraint behaviour; calibrate sensors yearly and verify anomalous readings manually. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測交接應包含每個感測器的位置、量測物理量、溫度補償方法、基準值與警戒值，以及資料異常時的人工複核流程；年度報告以趨勢與殘差呈現，並由結構工程師簽署。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Monitoring handover should include each sensor’s location, measured quantity, temperature compensation, baseline and alert values and the manual verification procedure for anomalies; annual reports present trends and residuals and are signed by a structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承或伸縮縫卡滯時，溫度伸縮被阻擋，在橋面與塔產生額外內力；若監測只看原始讀數而不做溫度回歸，這種漸進的卡滯可能多年未被發現，直到構件損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Seized bearings or joints restrain thermal movement and create extra forces in deck and towers; if monitoring looks only at raw readings without temperature regression, such gradual seizure can go unnoticed for years until a component fails. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有效橋面溫度（多點溫度計加權）對伸縮縫位移做回歸，每季更新斜率與殘差；同時比對支承位移、阻尼器行程與塔頂偏位，確認約束行為一致；感測器每年校正，異常讀值以人工量測複核。
knowledge.textEn: Regress joint displacement against effective deck temperature from weighted multi-point thermometers and update the slope and residuals quarterly; cross-check bearing displacement, damper stroke and tower-head displacement for consistent restraint behaviour; calibrate sensors yearly and verify anomalous readings manually.

quiz.question: 要驗證「約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation"?

多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Regress joint displacement against effective deck temperature from weighted multi-point thermometers and update the slope and residuals quarterly.
With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently.
quiz.explanation: 以有效橋面溫度（多點溫度計加權）對伸縮縫位移做回歸，每季更新斜率與殘差；同時比對支承位移、阻尼器行程與塔頂偏位，確認約束行為一致；感測器每年校正，異常讀值以人工量測複核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Regress joint displacement against effective deck temperature from weighted multi-point thermometers and update the slope and residuals quarterly; cross-check bearing displacement, damper stroke and tower-head displacement for consistent restraint behaviour; calibrate sensors yearly and verify anomalous readings manually. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雲端結構健康監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cloud-based health monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承或伸縮縫卡滯時，溫度伸縮被阻擋，在橋面與塔產生額外內力；若監測只看原始讀數而不做溫度回歸，這種漸進的卡滯可能多年未被發現，直到構件損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Seized bearings or joints restrain thermal movement and create extra forces in deck and towers; if monitoring looks only at raw readings without temperature regression, such gradual seizure can go unnoticed for years until a component fails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測資料也用來比對設計預測的應變、索力與加速度，累積長期基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The data are also compared with predicted strains, stay forces and accelerations to build long-term baselines.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支承或伸縮縫卡滯時，溫度伸縮被阻擋，在橋面與塔產生額外內力；若監測只看原始讀數而不做溫度回歸，這種漸進的卡滯可能多年未被發現，直到構件損壞。
knowledge.textEn: Seized bearings or joints restrain thermal movement and create extra forces in deck and towers; if monitoring looks only at raw readings without temperature regression, such gradual seizure can go unnoticed for years until a component fails.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「約 2,000 個感測器的監測與伸縮縫判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring with about 2,000 sensors and joint interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。
支承或伸縮縫卡滯時，溫度伸縮被阻擋，在橋面與塔產生額外內力；若監測只看原始讀數而不做溫度回歸，這種漸進的卡滯可能多年未被發現，直到構件損壞。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect.
Seized bearings or joints restrain thermal movement and create extra forces in deck and towers.
quiz.explanation: 支承或伸縮縫卡滯時，溫度伸縮被阻擋，在橋面與塔產生額外內力；若監測只看原始讀數而不做溫度回歸，這種漸進的卡滯可能多年未被發現，直到構件損壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Seized bearings or joints restrain thermal movement and create extra forces in deck and towers; if monitoring looks only at raw readings without temperature regression, such gradual seizure can go unnoticed for years until a component fails. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「積冰掉落的風險與營運對策」與「檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Falling-ice risk and operational response" and "Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 積冰掉落的風險與營運對策：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Falling-ice risk and operational response: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔與斜索積冰」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ice on towers and stays” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 2020 年 2 月 11 日，皇后渡口大橋通車約 30 個月後首次全面封橋，原因是塔上積冰掉落到車道並砸損 8 輛車。高聳的塔與斜索在凍雨、濕雪與低溫高濕的天氣中會結冰，日照或氣溫回升時冰層鬆脫，從百公尺以上高度落下，對車輛與人員構成直接危險。冰塊的質量與墜落高度決定撞擊能量，因此對策包括氣象預警、即時監測積冰狀態、降速或封閉車道，以及長期研究塔與斜索表面的防冰或除冰措施。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔與斜索積冰」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On 11 February 2020, about 30 months after opening, the Queensferry Crossing closed fully for the first time because ice falling from the towers onto the carriageway damaged eight vehicles. Tall towers and stays accrete ice in freezing rain, wet snow and cold humid weather, and when sunshine or rising temperature loosens it, it falls from heights above 100 m, a direct danger to vehicles and people. Ice mass and fall height determine impact energy, so responses include weather warnings, real-time monitoring of icing, speed restrictions or lane closures, and longer-term study of anti-icing or de-icing measures for tower and stay surfaces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ice on towers and stays” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：外徑 200 mm 的斜索包覆 20 mm 冰層，截面積 π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m²，以冰密度 900 kg/m³ 計每公尺約 12.4 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 200 mm stay with 20 mm of radial ice has an ice area of π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m², about 12.4 kg per metre at 900 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔與斜索積冰」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ice on towers and stays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 積冰掉落的風險與營運對策
knowledge.text: 2020 年 2 月 11 日，皇后渡口大橋通車約 30 個月後首次全面封橋，原因是塔上積冰掉落到車道並砸損 8 輛車。高聳的塔與斜索在凍雨、濕雪與低溫高濕的天氣中會結冰，日照或氣溫回升時冰層鬆脫，從百公尺以上高度落下，對車輛與人員構成直接危險。
knowledge.textEn: On 11 February 2020, about 30 months after opening, the Queensferry Crossing closed fully for the first time because ice falling from the towers onto the carriageway damaged eight vehicles. Tall towers and stays accrete ice in freezing rain, wet snow and cold humid weather, and when sunshine or rising temperature loosens it, it falls from heights above 100 m, a direct danger to vehicles and people.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「積冰掉落的風險與營運對策」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Falling-ice risk and operational response" is correct?
options: 2020 年 2 月 11 日，皇后渡口大橋通車約 30 個月後首次全面封橋，原因是塔上積冰掉落到車道並砸損 8 輛車。
積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。
新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。
optionsEn: On 11 February 2020, about 30 months after opening, the Queensferry Crossing closed fully for the first time because ice falling from the towers onto the carriageway damaged eight vehicles.
Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect.
A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later.
quiz.explanation: 2020 年 2 月 11 日，皇后渡口大橋通車約 30 個月後首次全面封橋，原因是塔上積冰掉落到車道並砸損 8 輛車。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: On 11 February 2020, about 30 months after opening, the Queensferry Crossing closed fully for the first time because ice falling from the towers onto the carriageway damaged eight vehicles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 積冰掉落的風險與營運對策：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Falling-ice risk and operational response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔與斜索積冰」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ice on towers and stays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：外徑 200 mm 的斜索包覆 20 mm 冰層，截面積 π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m²，以冰密度 900 kg/m³ 計每公尺約 12.4 kg。2 kg 冰塊自 100 m 落下（忽略空氣阻力），速度 √(2gh) ≈ 44.3 m/s，動能 = m·g·h ≈ 2×9.81×100 ≈ 1,960 J；實際受空氣阻力會較低。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 200 mm stay with 20 mm of radial ice has an ice area of π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m², about 12.4 kg per metre at 900 kg/m³. A 2 kg piece falling 100 m, ignoring drag, reaches √(2gh) ≈ 44.3 m/s with kinetic energy m·g·h ≈ 2×9.81×100 ≈ 1,960 J; air drag lowers this in reality. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以橋上氣象站的溫度、濕度、降水與風速建立積冰風險指標，搭配攝影機或積冰感測器觀察實際積冰；每次事件記錄冰塊大小、落點與天氣條件，用來修正預警門檻與交通管制決策。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build an icing-risk index from on-bridge temperature, humidity, precipitation and wind, combined with cameras or ice sensors to observe actual accretion; record ice size, landing positions and weather for each event to refine warning thresholds and traffic decisions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 外徑 200 mm 的斜索包覆 20 mm 冰層，截面積 π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m²，以冰密度 900 kg/m³ 計每公尺約 12.4 kg。2 kg 冰塊自 100 m 落下（忽略空氣阻力），速度 √(2gh) ≈ 44.3 m/s，動能 = m·g·h ≈ 2×9.81×100 ≈ 1,960 J；實際受空氣阻力會較低。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 200 mm stay with 20 mm of radial ice has an ice area of π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m², about 12.4 kg per metre at 900 kg/m³. A 2 kg piece falling 100 m, ignoring drag, reaches √(2gh) ≈ 44.3 m/s with kinetic energy m·g·h ≈ 2×9.81×100 ≈ 1,960 J; air drag lowers this in reality. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「積冰掉落的風險與營運對策」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Falling-ice risk and operational response", which statement holds?
options: 斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。
外徑 200 mm 的斜索包覆 20 mm 冰層，截面積 π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m²，以冰密度 900 kg/m³ 計每公尺約 12.4 kg。
沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。
optionsEn: The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head.
A 200 mm stay with 20 mm of radial ice has an ice area of π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m², about 12.4 kg per metre at 900 kg/m³.
Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 外徑 200 mm 的斜索包覆 20 mm 冰層，截面積 π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m²，以冰密度 900 kg/m³ 計每公尺約 12.4 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 200 mm stay with 20 mm of radial ice has an ice area of π(0.12² − 0.10²) ≈ 0.0138 m², about 12.4 kg per metre at 900 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 積冰掉落的風險與營運對策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Falling-ice risk and operational response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔與斜索積冰」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ice on towers and stays” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以橋上氣象站的溫度、濕度、降水與風速建立積冰風險指標，搭配攝影機或積冰感測器觀察實際積冰；每次事件記錄冰塊大小、落點與天氣條件，用來修正預警門檻與交通管制決策。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build an icing-risk index from on-bridge temperature, humidity, precipitation and wind, combined with cameras or ice sensors to observe actual accretion; record ice size, landing positions and weather for each event to refine warning thresholds and traffic decisions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運手冊應有積冰事件的分級應變程序：預警條件、巡查、降速、封閉車道與全面封橋的決策權責，以及事件後檢查斜索套管與屏障是否受損。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The operations manual should have a graded ice-event procedure covering warning conditions, patrols, speed limits, lane and full closures with clear decision authority, plus post-event checks of stay ducts and shielding for damage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沒有積冰預警與管制程序，冰塊落下時車輛正常高速通行，可能擊破擋風玻璃造成事故；過度保守的封橋則造成大量交通中斷與經濟損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without icing warnings and control procedures, ice falls on traffic moving at full speed and can smash windscreens and cause crashes; overly cautious closures cause major disruption and economic loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以橋上氣象站的溫度、濕度、降水與風速建立積冰風險指標，搭配攝影機或積冰感測器觀察實際積冰；每次事件記錄冰塊大小、落點與天氣條件，用來修正預警門檻與交通管制決策。
knowledge.textEn: Build an icing-risk index from on-bridge temperature, humidity, precipitation and wind, combined with cameras or ice sensors to observe actual accretion; record ice size, landing positions and weather for each event to refine warning thresholds and traffic decisions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 營運手冊應有積冰事件的分級應變程序：預警條件、巡查、降速、封閉車道與全面封橋的決策權責，以及事件後檢查斜索套管與屏障是否受損。
knowledge.textEn: The operations manual should have a graded ice-event procedure covering warning conditions, patrols, speed limits, lane and full closures with clear decision authority, plus post-event checks of stay ducts and shielding for damage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「積冰掉落的風險與營運對策」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Falling-ice risk and operational response"?

Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other.
Build an icing-risk index from on-bridge temperature, humidity, precipitation and wind, combined with cameras or ice sensors to observe actual accretion.

quiz.explanationEn: Build an icing-risk index from on-bridge temperature, humidity, precipitation and wind, combined with cameras or ice sensors to observe actual accretion; record ice size, landing positions and weather for each event to refine warning thresholds and traffic decisions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 積冰掉落的風險與營運對策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Falling-ice risk and operational response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔與斜索積冰」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ice on towers and stays” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沒有積冰預警與管制程序，冰塊落下時車輛正常高速通行，可能擊破擋風玻璃造成事故；過度保守的封橋則造成大量交通中斷與經濟損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without icing warnings and control procedures, ice falls on traffic moving at full speed and can smash windscreens and cause crashes; overly cautious closures cause major disruption and economic loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：冰塊的質量與墜落高度決定撞擊能量，因此對策包括氣象預警、即時監測積冰狀態、降速或封閉車道，以及長期研究塔與斜索表面的防冰或除冰措施。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ice mass and fall height determine impact energy, so responses include weather warnings, real-time monitoring of icing, speed restrictions or lane closures, and longer-term study of anti-icing or de-icing measures for tower and stay surfaces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「積冰只會增加結構重量，對大橋安全沒有其他影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ice only adds weight to a bridge and has no other safety effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有積冰預警與管制程序，冰塊落下時車輛正常高速通行，可能擊破擋風玻璃造成事故；過度保守的封橋則造成大量交通中斷與經濟損失。
knowledge.textEn: Without icing warnings and control procedures, ice falls on traffic moving at full speed and can smash windscreens and cause crashes; overly cautious closures cause major disruption and economic loss.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「積冰掉落的風險與營運對策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Falling-ice risk and operational response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若沒有積冰預警與管制程序，冰塊落下時車輛正常高速通行，可能擊破擋風玻璃造成事故；過度保守的封橋則造成大量交通中斷與經濟損失。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。
optionsEn: Without icing warnings and control procedures, ice falls on traffic moving at full speed and can smash windscreens and cause crashes.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有積冰預警與管制程序，冰塊落下時車輛正常高速通行，可能擊破擋風玻璃造成事故；過度保守的封橋則造成大量交通中斷與經濟損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without icing warnings and control procedures, ice falls on traffic moving at full speed and can smash windscreens and cause crashes; overly cautious closures cause major disruption and economic loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面箱內 2.7 km 走道」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2.7 km internal walkway” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 交通部門的專案通訊指出，橋面鋼槽內設有走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km，讓檢查人員在不封閉車道的情況下沿橋面內部巡查焊道、剪力連接與排水。斜張橋的長期維護重點包括 288 根斜索的錨具與套管、交叉區的錨固細部、塔內通道、伸縮縫與支承，以及防風屏障。英國公路結構物的檢查制度通常把例行的一般檢查與較深入的主要檢查分開安排，交接時要把每個構件的檢查方法、通道與基準狀態寫清楚，讓營運單位能在數十年內持續執行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面箱內 2.7 km 走道」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Project newsletters note walkways inside the steel deck tubs, one about 2.7 km long, letting inspectors patrol welds, shear connection and drainage inside the deck without closing lanes. Long-term maintenance of a cable-stayed bridge centres on the anchorages and ducts of all 288 stays, the anchorage details in the crossing zones, tower access, joints and bearings, and the wind shielding. UK highway-structure inspection regimes usually separate routine general inspections from deeper principal inspections, and handover must record each component’s inspection method, access and baseline condition so the operator can sustain the regime for decades. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “2.7 km internal walkway” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若 288 根斜索的近距離主要檢查以 6 年為一循環，每年需檢查 288/6 = 48 根，約每週 1 根；若改為 2 年一般檢查加 6 年主要檢查，且一般檢查以望遠鏡或無人機涵蓋全部斜索，主要檢查負荷不變。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If close principal inspection of all 288 stays runs on a 6-year cycle, 288/6 = 48 stays must be inspected a year, about one a week; adding 2-yearly general inspections that cover every stay by binoculars or drone leaves the principal-inspection workload unchanged.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面箱內 2.7 km 走道」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “2.7 km internal walkway”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接
knowledge.titleEn: Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover
knowledge.text: 交通部門的專案通訊指出，橋面鋼槽內設有走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km，讓檢查人員在不封閉車道的情況下沿橋面內部巡查焊道、剪力連接與排水。斜張橋的長期維護重點包括 288 根斜索的錨具與套管、交叉區的錨固細部、塔內通道、伸縮縫與支承，以及防風屏障。
knowledge.textEn: Project newsletters note walkways inside the steel deck tubs, one about 2.7 km long, letting inspectors patrol welds, shear connection and drainage inside the deck without closing lanes. Long-term maintenance of a cable-stayed bridge centres on the anchorages and ducts of all 288 stays, the anchorage details in the crossing zones, tower access, joints and bearings, and the wind shielding.

knowledge.text: 誤解：新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover" is correct?
options: 新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。
交通部門的專案通訊指出，橋面鋼槽內設有走道，其中一條長約 2.7 km，讓檢查人員在不封閉車道的情況下沿橋面內部巡查焊道、剪力連接與排水。
三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。
optionsEn: A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later.
Project newsletters note walkways inside the steel deck tubs, one about 2.7 km long, letting inspectors patrol welds, shear connection and drainage inside the deck without closing lanes.

quiz.explanationEn: Project newsletters note walkways inside the steel deck tubs, one about 2.7 km long, letting inspectors patrol welds, shear connection and drainage inside the deck without closing lanes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面箱內 2.7 km 走道」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2.7 km internal walkway” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若 288 根斜索的近距離主要檢查以 6 年為一循環，每年需檢查 288/6 = 48 根，約每週 1 根；若改為 2 年一般檢查加 6 年主要檢查，且一般檢查以望遠鏡或無人機涵蓋全部斜索，主要檢查負荷不變。循環年數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If close principal inspection of all 288 stays runs on a 6-year cycle, 288/6 = 48 stays must be inspected a year, about one a week; adding 2-yearly general inspections that cover every stay by binoculars or drone leaves the principal-inspection workload unchanged. Cycle lengths are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前完成全橋基準檢查（含斜索套管、錨具、焊道與塗裝），並以照片與數位模型記錄位置；營運後每次檢查的結果與基準比較，劣化趨勢超過門檻即排入維修計畫；檢查通道本身也要定期檢查照明、通風與安全設施。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover complete a baseline inspection of the whole bridge, including stay ducts, anchorages, welds and coatings, recorded with photographs and a digital model; compare each later inspection with the baseline and schedule repairs when deterioration trends exceed thresholds; inspect the access routes themselves for lighting, ventilation and safety equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若 288 根斜索的近距離主要檢查以 6 年為一循環，每年需檢查 288/6 = 48 根，約每週 1 根；若改為 2 年一般檢查加 6 年主要檢查，且一般檢查以望遠鏡或無人機涵蓋全部斜索，主要檢查負荷不變。循環年數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If close principal inspection of all 288 stays runs on a 6-year cycle, 288/6 = 48 stays must be inspected a year, about one a week; adding 2-yearly general inspections that cover every stay by binoculars or drone leaves the principal-inspection workload unchanged. Cycle lengths are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover", which statement holds?

多個懸臂同時施工時，各懸臂可以完全獨立安排進度。
若 288 根斜索的近距離主要檢查以 6 年為一循環，每年需檢查 288/6 = 48 根，約每週 1 根。
optionsEn: In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action.
With several cantilevers under way, each can be scheduled entirely independently.
If close principal inspection of all 288 stays runs on a 6-year cycle, 288/6 = 48 stays must be inspected a year, about one a week.
quiz.explanation: 若 288 根斜索的近距離主要檢查以 6 年為一循環，每年需檢查 288/6 = 48 根，約每週 1 根；若改為 2 年一般檢查加 6 年主要檢查，且一般檢查以望遠鏡或無人機涵蓋全部斜索，主要檢查負荷不變。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If close principal inspection of all 288 stays runs on a 6-year cycle, 288/6 = 48 stays must be inspected a year, about one a week; adding 2-yearly general inspections that cover every stay by binoculars or drone leaves the principal-inspection workload unchanged. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面箱內 2.7 km 走道」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “2.7 km internal walkway” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前完成全橋基準檢查（含斜索套管、錨具、焊道與塗裝），並以照片與數位模型記錄位置；營運後每次檢查的結果與基準比較，劣化趨勢超過門檻即排入維修計畫；檢查通道本身也要定期檢查照明、通風與安全設施。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover complete a baseline inspection of the whole bridge, including stay ducts, anchorages, welds and coatings, recorded with photographs and a digital model; compare each later inspection with the baseline and schedule repairs when deterioration trends exceed thresholds; inspect the access routes themselves for lighting, ventilation and safety equipment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含檢查與維護手冊、構件清單與編號、通道圖、基準檢查報告、感測器與監測資料格式，以及特殊構件（斜索、阻尼器、屏障）的更換方法；營運與設計單位應在通車後數年內進行一次聯合檢討。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the inspection and maintenance manual, component list and numbering, access drawings, baseline inspection report, sensor and data formats, and replacement methods for special components such as stays, dampers and shielding; operator and designer should hold a joint review a few years after opening.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若設計時沒有提供足夠的檢查通道，錨具與交叉區細部無法近距離檢查，劣化可能在多年後才被發現；交接資料不完整時，營運單位不知道哪些構件有特殊檢查需求，檢查只能流於表面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without adequate access designed in, anchorages and crossing-zone details cannot be inspected closely and deterioration may surface only years later; incomplete handover leaves the operator unaware of components with special inspection needs, so inspections stay superficial. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover"?

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

steps.title: 檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面箱內 2.7 km 走道」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “2.7 km internal walkway” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若設計時沒有提供足夠的檢查通道，錨具與交叉區細部無法近距離檢查，劣化可能在多年後才被發現；交接資料不完整時，營運單位不知道哪些構件有特殊檢查需求，檢查只能流於表面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without adequate access designed in, anchorages and crossing-zone details cannot be inspected closely and deterioration may surface only years later; incomplete handover leaves the operator unaware of components with special inspection needs, so inspections stay superficial. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：英國公路結構物的檢查制度通常把例行的一般檢查與較深入的主要檢查分開安排，交接時要把每個構件的檢查方法、通道與基準狀態寫清楚，讓營運單位能在數十年內持續執行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: UK highway-structure inspection regimes usually separate routine general inspections from deeper principal inspections, and handover must record each component’s inspection method, access and baseline condition so the operator can sustain the regime for decades.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「新橋在前幾十年不需要詳細檢查，問題都會在很久以後才出現。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A new bridge needs no detailed inspection for its first decades because problems appear only much later." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Without adequate access designed in, anchorages and crossing-zone details cannot be inspected closely and deterioration may surface only years later; incomplete handover leaves the operator unaware of components with special inspection needs, so inspections stay superficial.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢查通道、斜索檢查週期與營運交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Access, stay inspection cycles and operational handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若設計時沒有提供足夠的檢查通道，錨具與交叉區細部無法近距離檢查，劣化可能在多年後才被發現。
三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without adequate access designed in, anchorages and crossing-zone details cannot be inspected closely and deterioration may surface only years later.
A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones.
quiz.explanation: 若設計時沒有提供足夠的檢查通道，錨具與交叉區細部無法近距離檢查，劣化可能在多年後才被發現；交接資料不完整時，營運單位不知道哪些構件有特殊檢查需求，檢查只能流於表面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without adequate access designed in, anchorages and crossing-zone details cannot be inspected closely and deterioration may surface only years later; incomplete handover leaves the operator unaware of components with special inspection needs, so inspections stay superficial. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 伊拉斯謨大橋
summary: 鹿特丹的伊拉斯謨大橋全長 802 m，以 139 m 高、彎折不對稱的鋼塔支承約 284 m 的斜張主跨，南端另有 89 m 的開合橋；橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根箱形主梁與每 4.9 m 一道的橫梁組成，承載車道、電車軌道與人行自行車道。本課從背索如何降低塔的彎矩、橋面橫向受力、鋼塔焊接、開合橋配重與電車軌伸縮，到 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測、調諧液壓阻尼器、塗裝與開合機械的長期維護。
summaryEn: Rotterdam’s Erasmus Bridge is 802 m long; a bent, asymmetric 139 m steel pylon carries a cable-stayed main span of about 284 m, and an 89 m bascule sits at the south end. The 33.8 m deck, two box spines with cross beams every 4.9 m, carries traffic lanes, tram tracks, footpaths and cycle tracks. The course runs from how back stays cut pylon bending, transverse deck action, pylon welding, bascule counterweighting and tram-rail expansion, to observation of rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening, tuned hydraulic dampers and long-term care of coatings and bascule machinery.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 斜張橋與斜索系統

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算加裝阻尼器後，雨風振動中斜索振幅的變化量級。設某主跨斜索 T = 3,000 kN、m = 60 kg/m、L = 250 m，第一頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m) = (1/500)×√(50,000) ≈ 0.447 Hz。原始阻尼比 ζ₀ = 0.2%，在某風雨條件下每週期輸入的能量使振幅穩定在 A₀ = 0.30 m。若氣動輸入近似為負阻尼 ζ_a = −0.15%，淨阻尼 0.05% 時振幅受非線性限制停在 0.30 m；加裝 x_d/L = 0.02 的最佳阻尼器後，附加阻尼約 1.0%，淨阻尼 ζ = 0.2% + 1.0% − 0.15% = 1.05% 為正，振動不再成長而衰減。以對數遞減 δ = 2πζ ≈ 0.066 計，振幅從 0.30 m 衰減到 0.03 m 需要 ln(10)/0.066 ≈ 35 個週期，以第 3 模態約 1.34 Hz 計約 26 秒。若阻尼器只能裝在 x_d/L = 0.01，附加阻尼約 0.5%，淨阻尼 0.55%，衰減到同樣振幅約需 67 個週期。數值為教學假設，不代表本橋實測。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate how damper retrofit changes stay amplitude under rain–wind excitation. A main-span stay has T = 3,000 kN, m = 60 kg/m and L = 250 m, so f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m) = (1/500)×√(50,000) ≈ 0.447 Hz. With inherent damping ζ₀ = 0.2%, a wind–rain condition feeds enough energy to hold amplitude at A₀ = 0.30 m. Treating the aerodynamic input as negative damping ζ_a = −0.15%, the small net value lets nonlinear effects cap the motion at 0.30 m; adding an optimal damper at x_d/L = 0.02 gives about 1.0% added damping, so net ζ = 0.2% + 1.0% − 0.15% = 1.05% is positive and motion decays instead of growing. With logarithmic decrement δ = 2πζ ≈ 0.066, decaying from 0.30 m to 0.03 m takes ln(10)/0.066 ≈ 35 cycles, about 26 seconds in mode 3 at about 1.34 Hz. If the damper can only sit at x_d/L = 0.01, added damping is about 0.5%, net 0.55%, and the same decay takes about 67 cycles. Values are teaching assumptions, not measurements on this bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」與「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon" and "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「139 m 彎折鋼塔」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “139 m bent steel pylon” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。工程可行性檢討後改為 139 m 的鋼塔並加上背索，原因是城市橋梁的活載變化很大：60 t 級卡車與電車只停在主跨某處時，若沒有背索，主跨斜索拉力的變化全部要由塔身彎曲承受，塔底彎矩隨交通劇烈起伏。背索把塔頂連到岸側錨固點，活載造成的水平力增量大部分由背索的軸力平衡，塔主要承受壓力，彎矩與疲勞應力幅都大幅降低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「139 m 彎折鋼塔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean. After engineering review it became a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, because urban live load varies greatly: when 60 t trucks or trams stop somewhere on the main span without back stays, the entire change in main-span stay force must be resisted by pylon bending, so the base moment swings sharply with traffic. Back stays tie the pylon head to anchorage on the shore side, balancing most of the live-load horizontal increment by axial force, so the pylon works mainly in compression with much lower bending and fatigue stress ranges. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “139 m bent steel pylon” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「139 m 彎折鋼塔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “139 m bent steel pylon”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩
knowledge.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon

After engineering review it became a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, because urban live load varies greatly: when 60 t trucks or trams stop somewhere on the main span without back stays, the entire change in main-span stay force must be resisted by pylon bending, so the base moment swings sharply with traffic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon" is correct?
options: 只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。
伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。
人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。
optionsEn: If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays.
The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean.
Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.
quiz.explanation: 伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「139 m 彎折鋼塔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “139 m bent steel pylon” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。無背索時塔底附加彎矩 M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m（等於塔頂水平力 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN 乘以塔高 125 m）；若背索平衡 75% 的水平增量，M 降為約 302,500 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon. Without back stays the extra pylon-base moment is M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m (the head force 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN times a 125 m pylon height); if back stays balance 75% of the horizontal increment, M falls to about 302,500 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。無背索時塔底附加彎矩 M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m（等於塔頂水平力 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN 乘以塔高 125 m）；若背索平衡 75% 的水平增量，M 降為約 302,500 kN·m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon. Without back stays the extra pylon-base moment is M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m (the head force 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN times a 125 m pylon height); if back stays balance 75% of the horizontal increment, M falls to about 302,500 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon", which statement holds?
options: 開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。
電車軌道可以像路面一樣直接跨過伸縮縫，不需要特別裝置。
主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。
optionsEn: A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting.
Tram rails can cross an expansion joint like the road surface without special devices.
Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon.
quiz.explanation: 主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「139 m 彎折鋼塔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “139 m bent steel pylon” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以造型為主的橋梁在概念階段就要做活載與疲勞的初步檢核，並把結構需求（例如背索）回饋給建築師；造型變更須由結構設計者重新簽認塔與錨固的計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: An architecture-led bridge needs preliminary live-load and fatigue checks at concept stage, feeding structural needs such as back stays back to the architect; any change of form requires the structural designer to re-sign pylon and anchorage calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以造型為主的橋梁在概念階段就要做活載與疲勞的初步檢核，並把結構需求（例如背索）回饋給建築師；造型變更須由結構設計者重新簽認塔與錨固的計算。
knowledge.textEn: An architecture-led bridge needs preliminary live-load and fatigue checks at concept stage, feeding structural needs such as back stays back to the architect; any change of form requires the structural designer to re-sign pylon and anchorage calculations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon"?
options: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。
