阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。
optionsEn: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped.
quiz.explanation: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「139 m 彎折鋼塔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “139 m bent steel pylon” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：背索把塔頂連到岸側錨固點，活載造成的水平力增量大部分由背索的軸力平衡，塔主要承受壓力，彎矩與疲勞應力幅都大幅降低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Back stays tie the pylon head to anchorage on the shore side, balancing most of the live-load horizontal increment by axial force, so the pylon works mainly in compression with much lower bending and fatigue stress ranges.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。
knowledge.textEn: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。
人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds.
Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.
quiz.explanation: 若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「4.9 m 間距橫梁」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cross beams at 4.9 m” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伊拉斯謨大橋的橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m 的箱形主梁承擔縱向彎曲與斜索錨固，四線車道與兩條電車軌道位於兩根主梁之間；橫梁每 4.9 m 一道，並向兩側各懸出 6.7 m 支承人行道與自行車道。電車軌道把集中輪載固定在同一位置反覆通過，對軌道下方的橫梁與主梁連接造成高循環疲勞；懸臂部分雖然荷載較小，但彎矩隨懸出長度平方增加，橫梁根部是應力集中的位置。橫梁也把兩根主梁連成整體，提供抗扭能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「4.9 m 間距橫梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Erasmus deck is 33.8 m wide, with two box spines 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide carrying longitudinal bending and the stay anchorages; four traffic lanes and two tram tracks sit between the spines, and cross beams every 4.9 m cantilever 6.7 m each side to carry footpaths and cycle tracks. Tram tracks put concentrated wheel loads repeatedly on the same line, causing high-cycle fatigue at cross-beam-to-spine connections beneath the rails; the cantilevers carry lighter loads, but moment grows with the square of the overhang, concentrating stress at the cross-beam roots. The cross beams also tie the two spines together for torsional resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cross beams at 4.9 m” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「4.9 m 間距橫梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cross beams at 4.9 m”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面
knowledge.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads
knowledge.text: 伊拉斯謨大橋的橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m 的箱形主梁承擔縱向彎曲與斜索錨固，四線車道與兩條電車軌道位於兩根主梁之間；橫梁每 4.9 m 一道，並向兩側各懸出 6.7 m 支承人行道與自行車道。電車軌道把集中輪載固定在同一位置反覆通過，對軌道下方的橫梁與主梁連接造成高循環疲勞；懸臂部分雖然荷載較小，但彎矩隨懸出長度平方增加，橫梁根部是應力集中的位置。
knowledge.textEn: The Erasmus deck is 33.8 m wide, with two box spines 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide carrying longitudinal bending and the stay anchorages; four traffic lanes and two tram tracks sit between the spines, and cross beams every 4.9 m cantilever 6.7 m each side to carry footpaths and cycle tracks. Tram tracks put concentrated wheel loads repeatedly on the same line, causing high-cycle fatigue at cross-beam-to-spine connections beneath the rails; the cantilevers carry lighter loads, but moment grows with the square of the overhang, concentrating stress at the cross-beam roots.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads" is correct?
options: 人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。
電腦切割的鋼板尺寸精確，焊接後的構件尺寸就一定精確。
伊拉斯謨大橋的橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m 的箱形主梁承擔縱向彎曲與斜索錨固，四線車道與兩條電車軌道位於兩根主梁之間。
optionsEn: Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.
Because plates are computer-cut accurately, welded parts are automatically accurate.
The Erasmus deck is 33.8 m wide, with two box spines 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide carrying longitudinal bending and the stay anchorages.
quiz.explanation: 伊拉斯謨大橋的橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m 的箱形主梁承擔縱向彎曲與斜索錨固，四線車道與兩條電車軌道位於兩根主梁之間；橫梁每 4.9 m 一道，並向兩側各懸出 6.7 m 支承人行道與自行車道。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Erasmus deck is 33.8 m wide, with two box spines 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide carrying longitudinal bending and the stay anchorages; four traffic lanes and two tram tracks sit between the spines, and cross beams every 4.9 m cantilever 6.7 m each side to carry footpaths and cycle tracks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「4.9 m 間距橫梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cross beams at 4.9 m” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。荷載與跨距為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m. A 6.7 m cantilever at 11 kPa carries w = 53.9 kN/m with a root moment M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m. Loads and span are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。荷載與跨距為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m. A 6.7 m cantilever at 11 kPa carries w = 53.9 kN/m with a root moment M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m. Loads and span are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads", which statement holds?
options: 橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m。
斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。
斜索振動只會在颱風等級的強風中發生。
optionsEn: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m.
As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter.
Stay vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
quiz.explanation: 橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「4.9 m 間距橫梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cross beams at 4.9 m” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：電車軌道與橋面結構的介面（軌道扣件、減振墊、排水）要由軌道與結構工程師共同設計，並在維護手冊中把軌道下方接頭列為優先疲勞檢查區。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The interface between tram track and deck (fastenings, resilient pads, drainage) should be designed jointly by track and structural engineers, and the maintenance manual should list joints beneath the rails as priority fatigue inspection areas.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 電車軌道與橋面結構的介面（軌道扣件、減振墊、排水）要由軌道與結構工程師共同設計，並在維護手冊中把軌道下方接頭列為優先疲勞檢查區。
knowledge.textEn: The interface between tram track and deck (fastenings, resilient pads, drainage) should be designed jointly by track and structural engineers, and the maintenance manual should list joints beneath the rails as priority fatigue inspection areas.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命。
鋼橋重新油漆主要是為了好看，對結構壽命影響不大。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages.
Repainting a steel bridge is mainly cosmetic and hardly affects structural life.
quiz.explanation: 以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「4.9 m 間距橫梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cross beams at 4.9 m” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：橫梁也把兩根主梁連成整體，提供抗扭能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The cross beams also tie the two spines together for torsional resistance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。
knowledge.textEn: Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
電腦切割的鋼板尺寸精確，焊接後的構件尺寸就一定精確。
電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Because plates are computer-cut accurately, welded parts are automatically accurate.
Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web.
quiz.explanation: 電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼塔製造：電腦切割、焊接收縮與幾何控制」與「89 m 開合橋的配重平衡」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pylon fabrication: computer cutting, weld shrinkage and geometry" and "Counterweighting the 89 m bascule": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼塔製造：電腦切割、焊接收縮與幾何控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pylon fabrication: computer cutting, weld shrinkage and geometry: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔身焊接段」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Welded pylon sections” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.

steps.instructionEn: The bent steel pylon of the Erasmus Bridge is assembled from many differently shaped plates, and a Delft University of Technology study notes that the computer-aided design of the time allowed plates to be cut directly by computer so parts fitted seamlessly. The bent form gives each pylon section a different angle and cross-section, and heat shrinkage during welding shortens and distorts each section; accumulated, this can move the pylon head several centimetres or more from its design position. The fabricator must predict weld shrinkage and add length at cutting, control distortion with jigs and welding sequence, and trial-assemble at the shop to confirm section interfaces match before site joints can align. steps.title: 鋼塔製造：電腦切割、焊接收縮與幾何控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pylon fabrication: computer cutting, weld shrinkage and geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔身焊接段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Welded pylon sections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若每道橫向全滲透對接焊的收縮約 1.5 mm，沿塔高共 40 道，累積縮短約 1.5×40 = 60 mm；若下料時每段預留 1.5 mm，完工高程誤差可降到量測與溫度的不確定度範圍內。每道收縮量與焊道數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If each transverse full-penetration butt weld shrinks about 1.5 mm and there are 40 along the pylon, the accumulated shortening is about 1.5×40 = 60 mm; adding 1.5 mm per section at cutting brings the finished level error within survey and temperature uncertainty. Shrinkage per weld and weld count are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠預拼裝時以三維量測（全站儀或雷射掃描）比對節段介面與設計模型，記錄每節實際長度與角度；焊後以超音波檢測全滲透焊，現場吊裝後在清晨量測塔軸線，依累積誤差調整後續節段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During shop trial assembly compare section interfaces with the design model by 3D survey (total station or laser scanning) and record each section’s actual length and angle; test full-penetration welds ultrasonically after welding, survey the pylon axis at dawn after each erection and adjust later sections for accumulated error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Shrinkage per weld and weld count are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 鋼塔製造：電腦切割、焊接收縮與幾何控制：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔身焊接段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Welded pylon sections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 工廠預拼裝時以三維量測（全站儀或雷射掃描）比對節段介面與設計模型，記錄每節實際長度與角度；焊後以超音波檢測全滲透焊，現場吊裝後在清晨量測塔軸線，依累積誤差調整後續節段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During shop trial assembly compare section interfaces with the design model by 3D survey (total station or laser scanning) and record each section’s actual length and angle; test full-penetration welds ultrasonically after welding, survey the pylon axis at dawn after each erection and adjust later sections for accumulated error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製造規範應要求焊接程序評定、收縮預估、預拼裝與三維量測報告，並規定節段介面的容許偏差；預拼裝驗收是吊裝前的停留檢查點，由業主代表與製造廠共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The fabrication specification should require welding procedure qualification, shrinkage prediction, trial assembly and 3D survey reports and set interface tolerances; trial-assembly acceptance is a hold point before erection, co-signed by the owner’s representative and the fabricator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若未預留焊接收縮，塔頂高程與斜索錨點位置偏離，斜索長度與索力需大幅調整；焊接順序不當造成的殘餘應力與變形，可能使塔段介面無法對齊，需現場火焰矯正，增加材料受損與疲勞風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without shrinkage allowance, pylon-head level and stay anchor positions drift, forcing large changes in stay length and force; poor welding sequence leaves residual stress and distortion that misalign section interfaces and require flame straightening on site, adding risk of material damage and fatigue. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.question: 在「鋼塔製造：電腦切割、焊接收縮與幾何控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pylon fabrication: computer cutting, weld shrinkage and geometry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若未預留焊接收縮，塔頂高程與斜索錨點位置偏離，斜索長度與索力需大幅調整。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。
optionsEn: Without shrinkage allowance, pylon-head level and stay anchor positions drift, forcing large changes in stay length and force.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting.
quiz.explanation: 若未預留焊接收縮，塔頂高程與斜索錨點位置偏離，斜索長度與索力需大幅調整；焊接順序不當造成的殘餘應力與變形，可能使塔段介面無法對齊，需現場火焰矯正，增加材料受損與疲勞風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without shrinkage allowance, pylon-head level and stay anchor positions drift, forcing large changes in stay length and force; poor welding sequence leaves residual stress and distortion that misalign section interfaces and require flame straightening on site, adding risk of material damage and fatigue. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 89 m 開合橋的配重平衡：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Counterweighting the 89 m bascule: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「開合橋配重」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bascule counterweight” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伊拉斯謨大橋南端的 89 m 開合橋被描述為西歐最大、最重的開合橋，讓高桅船隻能通過。開合橋繞耳軸旋轉，橋面葉板的重量對耳軸產生很大的力矩；若完全由油壓缸或機械驅動直接抬起，所需動力與構件尺寸將非常龐大。因此在耳軸後方設配重，使葉板與配重對耳軸的力矩接近平衡，驅動系統只需克服少量不平衡、摩擦、風力與慣性。設計時通常保留一點「葉板端偏重」，讓橋在關閉狀態下穩定壓在支承上，不會被風或車輛振動抬起。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「開合橋配重」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The 89 m bascule at the south end of the Erasmus Bridge is described as the largest and heaviest in Western Europe, letting tall-masted vessels pass. A bascule rotates about trunnions, and the leaf’s weight creates a large moment about them; lifting it directly with hydraulic cylinders or machinery would need enormous power and members. A counterweight behind the trunnions therefore nearly balances the leaf’s moment, so the drive only overcomes a small imbalance, friction, wind and inertia. Designers usually leave the leaf slightly heavy so the closed bridge sits firmly on its supports and is not lifted by wind or traffic vibration. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bascule counterweight” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：配重平衡 W_c·b = W_l·a。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Counterweight balance W_c·b = W_l·a.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「開合橋配重」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bascule counterweight”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 89 m 開合橋的配重平衡
knowledge.text: 伊拉斯謨大橋南端的 89 m 開合橋被描述為西歐最大、最重的開合橋，讓高桅船隻能通過。開合橋繞耳軸旋轉，橋面葉板的重量對耳軸產生很大的力矩；若完全由油壓缸或機械驅動直接抬起，所需動力與構件尺寸將非常龐大。
knowledge.textEn: The 89 m bascule at the south end of the Erasmus Bridge is described as the largest and heaviest in Western Europe, letting tall-masted vessels pass. A bascule rotates about trunnions, and the leaf’s weight creates a large moment about them; lifting it directly with hydraulic cylinders or machinery would need enormous power and members.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「89 m 開合橋的配重平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Counterweighting the 89 m bascule" is correct?
options: 開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。
伊拉斯謨大橋南端的 89 m 開合橋被描述為西歐最大、最重的開合橋，讓高桅船隻能通過。
斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。
optionsEn: A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting.
The 89 m bascule at the south end of the Erasmus Bridge is described as the largest and heaviest in Western Europe, letting tall-masted vessels pass.
As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 伊拉斯謨大橋南端的 89 m 開合橋被描述為西歐最大、最重的開合橋，讓高桅船隻能通過。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The 89 m bascule at the south end of the Erasmus Bridge is described as the largest and heaviest in Western Europe, letting tall-masted vessels pass. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 89 m 開合橋的配重平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Counterweighting the 89 m bascule: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開合橋配重」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bascule counterweight” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：配重平衡 W_c·b = W_l·a。若葉板重 W_l = 10,000 kN、重心距耳軸 a = 40 m，配重力臂 b = 12 m，完全平衡需 W_c = 10,000×40/12 ≈ 33,300 kN；若保留 2% 的葉板端偏重，配重約 32,700 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Counterweight balance W_c·b = W_l·a. For a leaf weight W_l = 10,000 kN with its centroid a = 40 m from the trunnion and a counterweight lever b = 12 m, full balance needs W_c = 10,000×40/12 ≈ 33,300 kN; keeping the leaf 2% heavy gives about 32,700 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：完工後以驅動系統的油壓或馬達扭矩在不同開啟角度量測實際不平衡力矩，與設計比較；必要時以可調配重塊修正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After completion measure the actual imbalance moment at several opening angles from drive pressures or motor torque and compare with design, trimming with adjustable counterweight blocks if needed; inspect trunnion bearings and support contact periodically through opening cycles and record support reactions in the closed position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 配重平衡 W_c·b = W_l·a。若葉板重 W_l = 10,000 kN、重心距耳軸 a = 40 m，配重力臂 b = 12 m，完全平衡需 W_c = 10,000×40/12 ≈ 33,300 kN；若保留 2% 的葉板端偏重，配重約 32,700 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Counterweight balance W_c·b = W_l·a. For a leaf weight W_l = 10,000 kN with its centroid a = 40 m from the trunnion and a counterweight lever b = 12 m, full balance needs W_c = 10,000×40/12 ≈ 33,300 kN; keeping the leaf 2% heavy gives about 32,700 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「89 m 開合橋的配重平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Counterweighting the 89 m bascule", which statement holds?
options: 斜索振動只會在颱風等級的強風中發生。
鋼橋重新油漆主要是為了好看，對結構壽命影響不大。
配重平衡 W_c·b = W_l·a。
optionsEn: Stay vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
Repainting a steel bridge is mainly cosmetic and hardly affects structural life.
Counterweight balance W_c·b = W_l·a.
quiz.explanation: 配重平衡 W_c·b = W_l·a。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Counterweight balance W_c·b = W_l·a. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 89 m 開合橋的配重平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Counterweighting the 89 m bascule: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開合橋配重」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bascule counterweight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 完工後以驅動系統的油壓或馬達扭矩在不同開啟角度量測實際不平衡力矩，與設計比較；必要時以可調配重塊修正。耳軸軸承與支承接觸狀態在開合循環中定期檢查，並記錄關閉時的支承反力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After completion measure the actual imbalance moment at several opening angles from drive pressures or motor torque and compare with design, trimming with adjustable counterweight blocks if needed; inspect trunnion bearings and support contact periodically through opening cycles and record support reactions in the closed position. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何影響葉板重量的工程（鋪面、欄杆、照明、軌道）都要先計算重量變化並評估配重調整；維護紀錄須保存每次平衡量測結果與配重塊數量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Any work that changes leaf weight (surfacing, railings, lighting, track) must first calculate the weight change and assess counterweight adjustment; maintenance records keep every balance measurement and counterweight block count.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋪面重鋪、加裝設備或積水使葉板變重而未調整配重，不平衡力矩超出驅動能力，開合時間延長或驅動系統過載；若葉板反而過輕，關閉時可能被風掀動，與車道及電車軌接縫錯位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Resurfacing, added equipment or trapped water that make the leaf heavier without rebalancing push the imbalance beyond drive capacity, slowing operation or overloading the drive; a leaf that is too light may lift in wind when closed, misaligning the road and tram-rail joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 完工後以驅動系統的油壓或馬達扭矩在不同開啟角度量測實際不平衡力矩，與設計比較；必要時以可調配重塊修正。耳軸軸承與支承接觸狀態在開合循環中定期檢查，並記錄關閉時的支承反力。
knowledge.textEn: After completion measure the actual imbalance moment at several opening angles from drive pressures or motor torque and compare with design, trimming with adjustable counterweight blocks if needed; inspect trunnion bearings and support contact periodically through opening cycles and record support reactions in the closed position.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 任何影響葉板重量的工程（鋪面、欄杆、照明、軌道）都要先計算重量變化並評估配重調整；維護紀錄須保存每次平衡量測結果與配重塊數量。
knowledge.textEn: Any work that changes leaf weight (surfacing, railings, lighting, track) must first calculate the weight change and assess counterweight adjustment; maintenance records keep every balance measurement and counterweight block count.

quiz.question: 要驗證「89 m 開合橋的配重平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Counterweighting the 89 m bascule"?
options: 完工後以驅動系統的油壓或馬達扭矩在不同開啟角度量測實際不平衡力矩，與設計比較；必要時以可調配重塊修正。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。
optionsEn: After completion measure the actual imbalance moment at several opening angles from drive pressures or motor torque and compare with design, trimming with adjustable counterweight blocks if needed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays.
quiz.explanation: 完工後以驅動系統的油壓或馬達扭矩在不同開啟角度量測實際不平衡力矩，與設計比較；必要時以可調配重塊修正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After completion measure the actual imbalance moment at several opening angles from drive pressures or motor torque and compare with design, trimming with adjustable counterweight blocks if needed; inspect trunnion bearings and support contact periodically through opening cycles and record support reactions in the closed position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 89 m 開合橋的配重平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Counterweighting the 89 m bascule: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開合橋配重」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bascule counterweight” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋪面重鋪、加裝設備或積水使葉板變重而未調整配重，不平衡力矩超出驅動能力，開合時間延長或驅動系統過載；若葉板反而過輕，關閉時可能被風掀動，與車道及電車軌接縫錯位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Resurfacing, added equipment or trapped water that make the leaf heavier without rebalancing push the imbalance beyond drive capacity, slowing operation or overloading the drive; a leaf that is too light may lift in wind when closed, misaligning the road and tram-rail joints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計時通常保留一點「葉板端偏重」，讓橋在關閉狀態下穩定壓在支承上，不會被風或車輛振動抬起。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Designers usually leave the leaf slightly heavy so the closed bridge sits firmly on its supports and is not lifted by wind or traffic vibration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋪面重鋪、加裝設備或積水使葉板變重而未調整配重，不平衡力矩超出驅動能力，開合時間延長或驅動系統過載；若葉板反而過輕，關閉時可能被風掀動，與車道及電車軌接縫錯位。
knowledge.textEn: Resurfacing, added equipment or trapped water that make the leaf heavier without rebalancing push the imbalance beyond drive capacity, slowing operation or overloading the drive; a leaf that is too light may lift in wind when closed, misaligning the road and tram-rail joints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「89 m 開合橋的配重平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Counterweighting the 89 m bascule" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
鋪面重鋪、加裝設備或積水使葉板變重而未調整配重，不平衡力矩超出驅動能力，開合時間延長或驅動系統過載；若葉板反而過輕，關閉時可能被風掀動，與車道及電車軌接縫錯位。
斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Resurfacing, added equipment or trapped water that make the leaf heavier without rebalancing push the imbalance beyond drive capacity, slowing operation or overloading the drive.
As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 鋪面重鋪、加裝設備或積水使葉板變重而未調整配重，不平衡力矩超出驅動能力，開合時間延長或驅動系統過載；若葉板反而過輕，關閉時可能被風掀動，與車道及電車軌接縫錯位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Resurfacing, added equipment or trapped water that make the leaf heavier without rebalancing push the imbalance beyond drive capacity, slowing operation or overloading the drive; a leaf that is too light may lift in wind when closed, misaligning the road and tram-rail joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制」與「斜張段與開合橋的介面：溫度伸縮與電車軌」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control" and "The cable-stayed to bascule interface: thermal movement and tram rails": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斜索張拉順序」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stay stressing sequence” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 不對稱的彎折鋼塔在架設完成、尚未掛索時，自重偏心就會讓塔頂偏向一側；掛上主跨斜索並承受橋面重量後，塔頂又被拉向主跨。施工控制的目標是讓塔在成橋恆載下回到設計幾何，因此通常要先讓塔頂帶著預偏量，並按照預先計算的順序分批張拉前索與背索。每一批張拉都會同時改變塔頂位置、橋面高程與已張拉斜索的力量，必須用施工階段分析預測，並以量測確認後才能進行下一批。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斜索張拉順序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An asymmetric bent steel pylon leans to one side under its own eccentric weight before any stays are hung; once main-span stays carry deck weight, the head is pulled toward the main span. Construction control aims to bring the pylon to its design geometry under completed dead load, so the head is usually given a pre-offset and front and back stays are stressed in batches in a pre-computed order. Each batch changes the head position, deck levels and forces in already stressed stays, so it must be predicted by staged analysis and confirmed by measurement before the next. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stay stressing sequence” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某批張拉在塔頂造成淨水平力 H = 2,000 kN、塔頂水平勁度 k = 15,000 kN/m，塔頂移動 δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m；為使成橋時塔軸垂直，可預先讓塔頂向背跨側預偏約 133 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a stressing batch puts a net horizontal force H = 2,000 kN on the pylon head with lateral stiffness k = 15,000 kN/m, the head moves δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m; to have the pylon axis vertical at completion, the head can be pre-offset about 133 mm toward the back span.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斜索張拉順序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stay stressing sequence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制
knowledge.titleEn: Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control
knowledge.text: 不對稱的彎折鋼塔在架設完成、尚未掛索時，自重偏心就會讓塔頂偏向一側；掛上主跨斜索並承受橋面重量後，塔頂又被拉向主跨。施工控制的目標是讓塔在成橋恆載下回到設計幾何，因此通常要先讓塔頂帶著預偏量，並按照預先計算的順序分批張拉前索與背索。
knowledge.textEn: An asymmetric bent steel pylon leans to one side under its own eccentric weight before any stays are hung; once main-span stays carry deck weight, the head is pulled toward the main span. Construction control aims to bring the pylon to its design geometry under completed dead load, so the head is usually given a pre-offset and front and back stays are stressed in batches in a pre-computed order.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control" is correct?
options: 斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。
電車軌道可以像路面一樣直接跨過伸縮縫，不需要特別裝置。
不對稱的彎折鋼塔在架設完成、尚未掛索時，自重偏心就會讓塔頂偏向一側；掛上主跨斜索並承受橋面重量後，塔頂又被拉向主跨。
optionsEn: As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter.
Tram rails can cross an expansion joint like the road surface without special devices.
An asymmetric bent steel pylon leans to one side under its own eccentric weight before any stays are hung.
quiz.explanation: 不對稱的彎折鋼塔在架設完成、尚未掛索時，自重偏心就會讓塔頂偏向一側；掛上主跨斜索並承受橋面重量後，塔頂又被拉向主跨。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An asymmetric bent steel pylon leans to one side under its own eccentric weight before any stays are hung; once main-span stays carry deck weight, the head is pulled toward the main span. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜索張拉順序」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stay stressing sequence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某批張拉在塔頂造成淨水平力 H = 2,000 kN、塔頂水平勁度 k = 15,000 kN/m，塔頂移動 δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m；為使成橋時塔軸垂直，可預先讓塔頂向背跨側預偏約 133 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If a stressing batch puts a net horizontal force H = 2,000 kN on the pylon head with lateral stiffness k = 15,000 kN/m, the head moves δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m; to have the pylon axis vertical at completion, the head can be pre-offset about 133 mm toward the back span. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每批張拉前後在清晨量測塔頂座標、橋面高程與各索力（千斤頂油壓與荷重計），與施工階段分析逐步比對；偏差超出容許時先調整下一批的張拉力，而非一次大幅修正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before and after each batch survey the pylon-head coordinates and deck levels at dawn and record each stay force from jack pressures and load cells, comparing step by step with the staged analysis; when out of tolerance, adjust the next batch rather than making one large correction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若某批張拉在塔頂造成淨水平力 H = 2,000 kN、塔頂水平勁度 k = 15,000 kN/m，塔頂移動 δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m；為使成橋時塔軸垂直，可預先讓塔頂向背跨側預偏約 133 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If a stressing batch puts a net horizontal force H = 2,000 kN on the pylon head with lateral stiffness k = 15,000 kN/m, the head moves δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m; to have the pylon axis vertical at completion, the head can be pre-offset about 133 mm toward the back span. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control", which statement holds?
options: 若某批張拉在塔頂造成淨水平力 H = 2,000 kN、塔頂水平勁度 k = 15,000 kN/m，塔頂移動 δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m。
阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。
開合橋的機械只要能動就沒問題，不需要記錄每次運轉的資料。
optionsEn: If a stressing batch puts a net horizontal force H = 2,000 kN on the pylon head with lateral stiffness k = 15,000 kN/m, the head moves δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m.
The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped.
As long as bascule machinery works, there is no need to log each operation.
quiz.explanation: 若某批張拉在塔頂造成淨水平力 H = 2,000 kN、塔頂水平勁度 k = 15,000 kN/m，塔頂移動 δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m；為使成橋時塔軸垂直，可預先讓塔頂向背跨側預偏約 133 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If a stressing batch puts a net horizontal force H = 2,000 kN on the pylon head with lateral stiffness k = 15,000 kN/m, the head moves δ = 2,000/15,000 ≈ 0.133 m; to have the pylon axis vertical at completion, the head can be pre-offset about 133 mm toward the back span. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斜索張拉順序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stay stressing sequence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每批張拉前後在清晨量測塔頂座標、橋面高程與各索力（千斤頂油壓與荷重計），與施工階段分析逐步比對；偏差超出容許時先調整下一批的張拉力，而非一次大幅修正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before and after each batch survey the pylon-head coordinates and deck levels at dawn and record each stay force from jack pressures and load cells, comparing step by step with the staged analysis; when out of tolerance, adjust the next batch rather than making one large correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：張拉計畫要列出每批的索號、目標力、預期塔頂位移與橋面高程，以及容許偏差與停止條件；張拉作業由施工控制工程師在場確認量測後才可放行下一批。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The stressing plan should list each batch’s stay numbers, target forces, expected pylon-head displacement and deck levels, with tolerances and stop criteria; the construction-control engineer confirms measurements on site before releasing the next batch.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若張拉順序錯誤或一次張拉過多，塔頂偏移超出塔的彎曲容量，鋼塔可能局部挫屈或接頭受損；量測受日照影響而未修正，會導致錯誤的索力調整，完工後塔軸與橋面線形都偏離設計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong order or too much force in one batch can push the head beyond the pylon’s bending capacity, causing local buckling or joint damage; uncorrected solar effects in surveys lead to wrong force adjustments, leaving pylon axis and deck profile off design at completion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每批張拉前後在清晨量測塔頂座標、橋面高程與各索力（千斤頂油壓與荷重計），與施工階段分析逐步比對；偏差超出容許時先調整下一批的張拉力，而非一次大幅修正。
knowledge.textEn: Before and after each batch survey the pylon-head coordinates and deck levels at dawn and record each stay force from jack pressures and load cells, comparing step by step with the staged analysis; when out of tolerance, adjust the next batch rather than making one large correction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 張拉計畫要列出每批的索號、目標力、預期塔頂位移與橋面高程，以及容許偏差與停止條件；張拉作業由施工控制工程師在場確認量測後才可放行下一批。
knowledge.textEn: The stressing plan should list each batch’s stay numbers, target forces, expected pylon-head displacement and deck levels, with tolerances and stop criteria; the construction-control engineer confirms measurements on site before releasing the next batch.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每批張拉前後在清晨量測塔頂座標、橋面高程與各索力（千斤頂油壓與荷重計），與施工階段分析逐步比對；偏差超出容許時先調整下一批的張拉力，而非一次大幅修正。
人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before and after each batch survey the pylon-head coordinates and deck levels at dawn and record each stay force from jack pressures and load cells, comparing step by step with the staged analysis.
Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.
quiz.explanation: 每批張拉前後在清晨量測塔頂座標、橋面高程與各索力（千斤頂油壓與荷重計），與施工階段分析逐步比對；偏差超出容許時先調整下一批的張拉力，而非一次大幅修正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before and after each batch survey the pylon-head coordinates and deck levels at dawn and record each stay force from jack pressures and load cells, comparing step by step with the staged analysis; when out of tolerance, adjust the next batch rather than making one large correction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜索張拉順序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stay stressing sequence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若張拉順序錯誤或一次張拉過多，塔頂偏移超出塔的彎曲容量，鋼塔可能局部挫屈或接頭受損；量測受日照影響而未修正，會導致錯誤的索力調整，完工後塔軸與橋面線形都偏離設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A wrong order or too much force in one batch can push the head beyond the pylon’s bending capacity, causing local buckling or joint damage; uncorrected solar effects in surveys lead to wrong force adjustments, leaving pylon axis and deck profile off design at completion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每一批張拉都會同時改變塔頂位置、橋面高程與已張拉斜索的力量，必須用施工階段分析預測，並以量測確認後才能進行下一批。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each batch changes the head position, deck levels and forces in already stressed stays, so it must be predicted by staged analysis and confirmed by measurement before the next.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若張拉順序錯誤或一次張拉過多，塔頂偏移超出塔的彎曲容量，鋼塔可能局部挫屈或接頭受損；量測受日照影響而未修正，會導致錯誤的索力調整，完工後塔軸與橋面線形都偏離設計。
knowledge.textEn: A wrong order or too much force in one batch can push the head beyond the pylon’s bending capacity, causing local buckling or joint damage; uncorrected solar effects in surveys lead to wrong force adjustments, leaving pylon axis and deck profile off design at completion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼塔架設與斜索張拉的幾何控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pylon erection and stay-stressing geometry control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
電車軌道可以像路面一樣直接跨過伸縮縫，不需要特別裝置。
若張拉順序錯誤或一次張拉過多，塔頂偏移超出塔的彎曲容量，鋼塔可能局部挫屈或接頭受損。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Tram rails can cross an expansion joint like the road surface without special devices.
A wrong order or too much force in one batch can push the head beyond the pylon’s bending capacity, causing local buckling or joint damage.
quiz.explanation: 若張拉順序錯誤或一次張拉過多，塔頂偏移超出塔的彎曲容量，鋼塔可能局部挫屈或接頭受損；量測受日照影響而未修正，會導致錯誤的索力調整，完工後塔軸與橋面線形都偏離設計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A wrong order or too much force in one batch can push the head beyond the pylon’s bending capacity, causing local buckling or joint damage; uncorrected solar effects in surveys lead to wrong force adjustments, leaving pylon axis and deck profile off design at completion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 斜張段與開合橋的介面：溫度伸縮與電車軌：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The cable-stayed to bascule interface: thermal movement and tram rails: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「開合橋與斜張段接縫」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bascule-to-cable-stayed joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜張段的鋼橋面隨溫度伸縮，開合橋葉板則必須在每次關閉時準確落回原位，兩者之間的介面同時要容許伸縮、讓車輛平順通過，還要讓電車軌道連續。一般伸縮縫只需處理路面，但電車軌是連續鋼軌，跨越伸縮縫或開合縫時需要軌道伸縮調節器或可分離的軌道接頭，且軌頂高差必須控制在毫米級，否則電車通過時產生衝擊與脫軌風險。介面處的支承、伸縮縫、軌道接頭與鎖定裝置因此必須作為一個系統設計與調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「開合橋與斜張段接縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The steel deck of the cable-stayed part expands and contracts with temperature, while the bascule leaf must return precisely to position each time it closes; the interface between them must allow movement, give vehicles a smooth ride and keep tram rails continuous. An ordinary expansion joint deals only with the road surface, but tram rails are continuous steel, so crossing an expansion or opening gap needs rail expansion devices or separable rail joints with rail-head steps controlled to millimetres, or trams suffer impact and derailment risk. Bearings, joints, rail joints and locking devices at the interface must therefore be designed and adjusted as one system. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bascule-to-cable-stayed joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜張段自固定點到開合橋接縫的長度 L = 300 m、鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、年溫差 ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×300×40 = 0.144 m，即約 144 mm，軌道伸縮調節器的行程必須涵蓋此值並加上施工誤差與支承位移。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With L = 300 m from the fixed point of the cable-stayed part to the bascule joint, steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and an annual range ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×300×40 = 0.144 m, about 144 mm; the rail expansion device must cover this plus construction tolerance and bearing movement.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電車軌道可以像路面一樣直接跨過伸縮縫，不需要特別裝置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tram rails can cross an expansion joint like the road surface without special devices." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「開合橋與斜張段接縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bascule-to-cable-stayed joint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 斜張段與開合橋的介面：溫度伸縮與電車軌：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開合橋與斜張段接縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜張段自固定點到開合橋接縫的長度 L = 300 m、鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、年溫差 ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×300×40 = 0.144 m，即約 144 mm，軌道伸縮調節器的行程必須涵蓋此值並加上施工誤差與支承位移。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With L = 300 m from the fixed point of the cable-stayed part to the bascule joint, steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and an annual range ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×300×40 = 0.144 m, about 144 mm; the rail expansion device must cover this plus construction tolerance and bearing movement. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同季節量測接縫開口與溫度的關係，確認在設計行程內；開合橋每次關閉後檢查鎖定裝置就位與軌頂高差，並以軌道幾何量測車定期檢測；電車通過時量測接縫處的衝擊加速度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure joint opening against temperature across seasons to confirm it stays within design travel; after each bascule closure check that locks are engaged and rail-head steps are within limits, survey track geometry periodically with a recording vehicle and measure impact accelerations at the joint as trams pass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 斜張段與開合橋的介面：溫度伸縮與電車軌：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The cable-stayed to bascule interface: thermal movement and tram rails: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開合橋與斜張段接縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bascule-to-cable-stayed joint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同季節量測接縫開口與溫度的關係，確認在設計行程內；開合橋每次關閉後檢查鎖定裝置就位與軌頂高差，並以軌道幾何量測車定期檢測；電車通過時量測接縫處的衝擊加速度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure joint opening against temperature across seasons to confirm it stays within design travel; after each bascule closure check that locks are engaged and rail-head steps are within limits, survey track geometry periodically with a recording vehicle and measure impact accelerations at the joint as trams pass. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：介面設計要由結構、機械、軌道與交通營運單位共同簽認，並訂出開合橋關閉後放行電車前的檢查清單（鎖定、軌頂高差、號誌連鎖）。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The interface design needs joint sign-off by structural, mechanical, track and transit operators, with a checklist before trams are released after each closure covering locks, rail steps and signal interlocking.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：伸縮行程不足時，夏季接縫擠死、冬季拉開過大，軌道調節器損壞；開合橋關閉位置偏差使軌頂高差超限，電車衝擊增加，長期造成軌道與支承損壞，甚至需暫停電車服務。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient travel jams the joint in summer and overopens it in winter, damaging rail expansion devices; a bascule that closes slightly off position leaves rail steps beyond limits, increasing tram impact and, over time, damaging track and bearings or forcing tram suspension. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 伸縮行程不足時，夏季接縫擠死、冬季拉開過大，軌道調節器損壞；開合橋關閉位置偏差使軌頂高差超限，電車衝擊增加，長期造成軌道與支承損壞，甚至需暫停電車服務。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient travel jams the joint in summer and overopens it in winter, damaging rail expansion devices; a bascule that closes slightly off position leaves rail steps beyond limits, increasing tram impact and, over time, damaging track and bearings or forcing tram suspension.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測」與「調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening" and "Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主跨斜索振動紀錄」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Main-span stay vibration records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伊拉斯謨大橋 1996 年 10 月開放交通後不久，就被觀察到在強風中擺動，隨後主跨斜索出現大振幅的氣動不穩定，被確認為雨風共同作用的振動：雨水在斜索表面形成沿索流下的水線，改變斷面形狀與氣流分離，使原本穩定的圓形斷面在特定風速與風向下吸收能量。代爾夫特理工大學的研究也提到大橋早期在雨、風與結構共同作用下出現擺動並短暫封閉。觀測這類振動要同時記錄斜索加速度、風速風向與降雨，因為只有三者同時符合條件時才會發生。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主跨斜索振動紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soon after opening to traffic in October 1996, the Erasmus Bridge was seen to sway in strong wind, and the main-span stays then showed large-amplitude aerodynamic instability identified as rain–wind-induced vibration: rainwater forms rivulets running down the stay surface, changing the effective section and flow separation so that a normally stable circular section absorbs energy at certain wind speeds and directions. A Delft University of Technology study also notes that the bridge swayed under the combination of rain, wind and its structure early on and was briefly closed. Observing such vibration requires simultaneous records of stay acceleration, wind speed and direction and rainfall, because it occurs only when all three conditions coincide. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Main-span stay vibration records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索振動只會在颱風等級的強風中發生。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stay vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「主跨斜索振動紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Main-span stay vibration records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

A Delft University of Technology study also notes that the bridge swayed under the combination of rain, wind and its structure early on and was briefly closed.

knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索振動只會在颱風等級的強風中發生。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主跨斜索振動紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Main-span stay vibration records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。若某索以 f = 1.2 Hz、振幅 A = 0.3 m 振動，a = (2π×1.2)²×0.3 ≈ 56.8×0.3 ≈ 17.1 m/s²，約 1.74 g；加速度計量程至少需 2 g，取樣率宜高於 20 Hz。頻率與振幅為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A. A stay vibrating at f = 1.2 Hz with A = 0.3 m reaches a = (2π×1.2)²×0.3 ≈ 56.8×0.3 ≈ 17.1 m/s², about 1.74 g, so accelerometers need at least a 2 g range and sampling above about 20 Hz. Frequency and amplitude are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在數根代表性斜索上裝設雙軸加速度計，同步記錄橋上風速計與雨量計，以事件觸發方式保存高解析資料；分析振幅與風速、風向、降雨強度的關係，辨識發生區間，並以影片輔助確認振型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit biaxial accelerometers on several representative stays with synchronised deck anemometers and rain gauges, storing high-resolution data on event triggers; analyse amplitude against wind speed, direction and rainfall intensity to identify the onset envelope, and confirm mode shapes with video.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。若某索以 f = 1.2 Hz、振幅 A = 0.3 m 振動，a = (2π×1.2)²×0.3 ≈ 56.8×0.3 ≈ 17.1 m/s²，約 1.74 g；加速度計量程至少需 2 g，取樣率宜高於 20 Hz。頻率與振幅為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A. A stay vibrating at f = 1.2 Hz with A = 0.3 m reaches a = (2π×1.2)²×0.3 ≈ 56.8×0.3 ≈ 17.1 m/s², about 1.74 g, so accelerometers need at least a 2 g range and sampling above about 20 Hz. Frequency and amplitude are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening", which statement holds?
options: 開合橋的機械只要能動就沒問題，不需要記錄每次運轉的資料。
人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。
簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。
optionsEn: As long as bascule machinery works, there is no need to log each operation.
Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.
Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A.
quiz.explanation: 簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Harmonic acceleration a = (2πf)²·A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主跨斜索振動紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Main-span stay vibration records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在數根代表性斜索上裝設雙軸加速度計，同步記錄橋上風速計與雨量計，以事件觸發方式保存高解析資料；分析振幅與風速、風向、降雨強度的關係，辨識發生區間，並以影片輔助確認振型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit biaxial accelerometers on several representative stays with synchronised deck anemometers and rain gauges, storing high-resolution data on event triggers; analyse amplitude against wind speed, direction and rainfall intensity to identify the onset envelope, and confirm mode shapes with video. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：新斜張橋通車初期應保留臨時監測，至少涵蓋一個完整的風雨季；發現大振幅時立即啟動臨時措施（例如臨時連索）並保存資料，作為永久對策的設計依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep temporary monitoring on a new cable-stayed bridge for at least one full wind-and-rain season after opening; when large amplitudes appear, apply temporary measures such as temporary ties at once and preserve the data as the design basis for permanent measures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只量測風速而沒有降雨紀錄，可能誤判為一般渦振或抖振，選錯對策；若量測位置只在一根索，無法判斷是個別索的問題還是普遍現象，阻尼器的配置也會失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring wind without rainfall can misclassify the motion as ordinary vortex shedding or buffeting and lead to the wrong remedy; measuring only one stay cannot tell an individual problem from a general one, misdirecting damper deployment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在數根代表性斜索上裝設雙軸加速度計，同步記錄橋上風速計與雨量計，以事件觸發方式保存高解析資料；分析振幅與風速、風向、降雨強度的關係，辨識發生區間，並以影片輔助確認振型。
knowledge.textEn: Fit biaxial accelerometers on several representative stays with synchronised deck anemometers and rain gauges, storing high-resolution data on event triggers; analyse amplitude against wind speed, direction and rainfall intensity to identify the onset envelope, and confirm mode shapes with video.

knowledge.textEn: Keep temporary monitoring on a new cable-stayed bridge for at least one full wind-and-rain season after opening; when large amplitudes appear, apply temporary measures such as temporary ties at once and preserve the data as the design basis for permanent measures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening"?
