steps.title: 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主跨斜索振動紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Main-span stay vibration records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只量測風速而沒有降雨紀錄，可能誤判為一般渦振或抖振，選錯對策；若量測位置只在一根索，無法判斷是個別索的問題還是普遍現象，阻尼器的配置也會失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring wind without rainfall can misclassify the motion as ordinary vortex shedding or buffeting and lead to the wrong remedy; measuring only one stay cannot tell an individual problem from a general one, misdirecting damper deployment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：觀測這類振動要同時記錄斜索加速度、風速風向與降雨，因為只有三者同時符合條件時才會發生。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Observing such vibration requires simultaneous records of stay acceleration, wind speed and direction and rainfall, because it occurs only when all three conditions coincide.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索振動只會在颱風等級的強風中發生。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stay vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只量測風速而沒有降雨紀錄，可能誤判為一般渦振或抖振，選錯對策；若量測位置只在一根索，無法判斷是個別索的問題還是普遍現象，阻尼器的配置也會失準。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring wind without rainfall can misclassify the motion as ordinary vortex shedding or buffeting and lead to the wrong remedy; measuring only one stay cannot tell an individual problem from a general one, misdirecting damper deployment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只量測風速而沒有降雨紀錄，可能誤判為一般渦振或抖振，選錯對策；若量測位置只在一根索，無法判斷是個別索的問題還是普遍現象，阻尼器的配置也會失準。
阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Measuring wind without rainfall can misclassify the motion as ordinary vortex shedding or buffeting and lead to the wrong remedy.
The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped.
quiz.explanation: 若只量測風速而沒有降雨紀錄，可能誤判為一般渦振或抖振，選錯對策；若量測位置只在一根索，無法判斷是個別索的問題還是普遍現象，阻尼器的配置也會失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring wind without rainfall can misclassify the motion as ordinary vortex shedding or buffeting and lead to the wrong remedy; measuring only one stay cannot tell an individual problem from a general one, misdirecting damper deployment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「永久液壓阻尼器」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Permanent hydraulic dampers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伊拉斯謨大橋在臨時措施之後約一年，為主跨斜索加裝了永久的調諧液壓阻尼器。阻尼器連接斜索與橋面，裝在靠近錨點的位置；斜索振動時阻尼器的活塞往復運動，把能量轉成熱。阻尼器係數必須「調諧」：太小時活塞幾乎不受阻、消能少；太大時阻尼器像固定點，斜索在阻尼器處形成新的節點，振動照樣發生。最佳係數取決於索力、索的單位質量、阻尼器位置與目標模態，因此每一組索可能需要不同的設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「永久液壓阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: About a year after the temporary measures, permanent tuned hydraulic dampers were fitted to the main-span stays of the Erasmus Bridge. A damper links the stay to the deck near the anchorage; as the stay vibrates, the piston moves back and forth and converts energy into heat. The damping coefficient must be tuned: too low and the piston moves almost freely and dissipates little; too high and the damper acts like a fixed point, creating a new node so vibration continues. The optimum depends on stay force, mass per metre, damper position and target mode, so different stay groups may need different settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Permanent hydraulic dampers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：張緊弦的最佳阻尼係數 c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a taut cable the optimum damper coefficient is c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「永久液壓阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Permanent hydraulic dampers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收
knowledge.titleEn: Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers
knowledge.text: 伊拉斯謨大橋在臨時措施之後約一年，為主跨斜索加裝了永久的調諧液壓阻尼器。阻尼器連接斜索與橋面，裝在靠近錨點的位置；斜索振動時阻尼器的活塞往復運動，把能量轉成熱。
knowledge.textEn: About a year after the temporary measures, permanent tuned hydraulic dampers were fitted to the main-span stays of the Erasmus Bridge. A damper links the stay to the deck near the anchorage; as the stay vibrates, the piston moves back and forth and converts energy into heat.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers" is correct?
options: 阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。
鋼橋重新油漆主要是為了好看，對結構壽命影響不大。
伊拉斯謨大橋在臨時措施之後約一年，為主跨斜索加裝了永久的調諧液壓阻尼器。
optionsEn: The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped.
Repainting a steel bridge is mainly cosmetic and hardly affects structural life.
About a year after the temporary measures, permanent tuned hydraulic dampers were fitted to the main-span stays of the Erasmus Bridge.
quiz.explanation: 伊拉斯謨大橋在臨時措施之後約一年，為主跨斜索加裝了永久的調諧液壓阻尼器。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: About a year after the temporary measures, permanent tuned hydraulic dampers were fitted to the main-span stays of the Erasmus Bridge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「永久液壓阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Permanent hydraulic dampers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：張緊弦的最佳阻尼係數 c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L)。取 T = 3,000 kN、m = 60 kg/m、第 1 模態、x_d/L = 0.02：√(3×10⁶×60) ≈ 13,416 N·s/m，c_opt ≈ 13,416/(π×0.02) ≈ 213,500 N·s/m，此時最大附加阻尼比約 x_d/(2L) = 1.0%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a taut cable the optimum damper coefficient is c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L). With T = 3,000 kN, m = 60 kg/m, mode 1 and x_d/L = 0.02, √(3×10⁶×60) ≈ 13,416 N·s/m and c_opt ≈ 13,416/(π×0.02) ≈ 213,500 N·s/m, giving a maximum added damping ratio of about x_d/(2L) = 1.0%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：阻尼器出廠前做力—速度與溫度試驗，確認係數在規格容差內；安裝後以人工拉索激振並釋放，記錄自由衰減，計算附加阻尼比，與目標比較；再以下一個風雨季的監測資料確認振幅已受控制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery test dampers for force–velocity and temperature behaviour to confirm the coefficient is within tolerance; after installation excite a stay by hand, release it and record free decay to compute added damping against the target; then confirm controlled amplitudes with monitoring data from the next wind-and-rain season.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 張緊弦的最佳阻尼係數 c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L)。取 T = 3,000 kN、m = 60 kg/m、第 1 模態、x_d/L = 0.02：√(3×10⁶×60) ≈ 13,416 N·s/m，c_opt ≈ 13,416/(π×0.02) ≈ 213,500 N·s/m，此時最大附加阻尼比約 x_d/(2L) = 1.0%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a taut cable the optimum damper coefficient is c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L). With T = 3,000 kN, m = 60 kg/m, mode 1 and x_d/L = 0.02, √(3×10⁶×60) ≈ 13,416 N·s/m and c_opt ≈ 13,416/(π×0.02) ≈ 213,500 N·s/m, giving a maximum added damping ratio of about x_d/(2L) = 1.0%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers", which statement holds?
options: 張緊弦的最佳阻尼係數 c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L)。
只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。
電腦切割的鋼板尺寸精確，焊接後的構件尺寸就一定精確。
optionsEn: For a taut cable the optimum damper coefficient is c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L).
If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays.
Because plates are computer-cut accurately, welded parts are automatically accurate.
quiz.explanation: 張緊弦的最佳阻尼係數 c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a taut cable the optimum damper coefficient is c_opt ≈ √(T·m)/(n·π·x_d/L). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「永久液壓阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Permanent hydraulic dampers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器出廠前做力—速度與溫度試驗，確認係數在規格容差內；安裝後以人工拉索激振並釋放，記錄自由衰減，計算附加阻尼比，與目標比較；再以下一個風雨季的監測資料確認振幅已受控制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery test dampers for force–velocity and temperature behaviour to confirm the coefficient is within tolerance; after installation excite a stay by hand, release it and record free decay to compute added damping against the target; then confirm controlled amplitudes with monitoring data from the next wind-and-rain season. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：阻尼器規格書要寫明目標模態、係數與容差、溫度範圍、行程與耐久循環，並規定安裝後的衰減試驗與每年檢查；各索的阻尼器設定值要列入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The damper specification should state target mode, coefficient and tolerance, temperature range, stroke and endurance cycles and require post-installation decay tests and annual inspection; each stay’s damper setting belongs in the handover documents.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：阻尼器係數設定錯誤或支架剛度不足，阻尼器變成無效或成為節點，斜索在風雨中仍大幅振動；阻尼器漏油、銷接磨耗則在幾年內逐漸失效，若無定期檢查，振動問題會再度出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong coefficient or a flexible bracket makes the damper ineffective or turns it into a node, so the stay still vibrates heavily in wind and rain; oil leaks and pin wear degrade dampers over a few years, and without periodic checks the vibration returns. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 阻尼器出廠前做力—速度與溫度試驗，確認係數在規格容差內；安裝後以人工拉索激振並釋放，記錄自由衰減，計算附加阻尼比，與目標比較；再以下一個風雨季的監測資料確認振幅已受控制。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery test dampers for force–velocity and temperature behaviour to confirm the coefficient is within tolerance; after installation excite a stay by hand, release it and record free decay to compute added damping against the target; then confirm controlled amplitudes with monitoring data from the next wind-and-rain season.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 阻尼器規格書要寫明目標模態、係數與容差、溫度範圍、行程與耐久循環，並規定安裝後的衰減試驗與每年檢查；各索的阻尼器設定值要列入交接文件。
knowledge.textEn: The damper specification should state target mode, coefficient and tolerance, temperature range, stroke and endurance cycles and require post-installation decay tests and annual inspection; each stay’s damper setting belongs in the handover documents.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
阻尼器出廠前做力—速度與溫度試驗，確認係數在規格容差內。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Before delivery test dampers for force–velocity and temperature behaviour to confirm the coefficient is within tolerance.
As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器出廠前做力—速度與溫度試驗，確認係數在規格容差內；安裝後以人工拉索激振並釋放，記錄自由衰減，計算附加阻尼比，與目標比較；再以下一個風雨季的監測資料確認振幅已受控制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery test dampers for force–velocity and temperature behaviour to confirm the coefficient is within tolerance; after installation excite a stay by hand, release it and record free decay to compute added damping against the target; then confirm controlled amplitudes with monitoring data from the next wind-and-rain season. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「永久液壓阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Permanent hydraulic dampers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器係數設定錯誤或支架剛度不足，阻尼器變成無效或成為節點，斜索在風雨中仍大幅振動；阻尼器漏油、銷接磨耗則在幾年內逐漸失效，若無定期檢查，振動問題會再度出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A wrong coefficient or a flexible bracket makes the damper ineffective or turns it into a node, so the stay still vibrates heavily in wind and rain; oil leaks and pin wear degrade dampers over a few years, and without periodic checks the vibration returns. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最佳係數取決於索力、索的單位質量、阻尼器位置與目標模態，因此每一組索可能需要不同的設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The optimum depends on stay force, mass per metre, damper position and target mode, so different stay groups may need different settings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 阻尼器係數設定錯誤或支架剛度不足，阻尼器變成無效或成為節點，斜索在風雨中仍大幅振動；阻尼器漏油、銷接磨耗則在幾年內逐漸失效，若無定期檢查，振動問題會再度出現。
knowledge.textEn: A wrong coefficient or a flexible bracket makes the damper ineffective or turns it into a node, so the stay still vibrates heavily in wind and rain; oil leaks and pin wear degrade dampers over a few years, and without periodic checks the vibration returns.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「調諧液壓阻尼器的選型與驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Selecting and accepting tuned hydraulic dampers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼橋重新油漆主要是為了好看，對結構壽命影響不大。
阻尼器係數設定錯誤或支架剛度不足，阻尼器變成無效或成為節點，斜索在風雨中仍大幅振動；阻尼器漏油、銷接磨耗則在幾年內逐漸失效，若無定期檢查，振動問題會再度出現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Repainting a steel bridge is mainly cosmetic and hardly affects structural life.
A wrong coefficient or a flexible bracket makes the damper ineffective or turns it into a node, so the stay still vibrates heavily in wind and rain.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器係數設定錯誤或支架剛度不足，阻尼器變成無效或成為節點，斜索在風雨中仍大幅振動；阻尼器漏油、銷接磨耗則在幾年內逐漸失效，若無定期檢查，振動問題會再度出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A wrong coefficient or a flexible bracket makes the damper ineffective or turns it into a node, so the stay still vibrates heavily in wind and rain; oil leaks and pin wear degrade dampers over a few years, and without periodic checks the vibration returns. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「河港環境下鋼塔與鋼橋面的防蝕維護」與「開合橋機電、運轉紀錄與營運交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosion maintenance of steel pylon and deck in a river port" and "Bascule machinery, operating records and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 河港環境下鋼塔與鋼橋面的防蝕維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion maintenance of steel pylon and deck in a river port: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「淺藍色鋼結構塗裝」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Light-blue steel coating” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伊拉斯謨大橋以淺藍色鋼塔為城市地標，鋼塔、主梁與橫梁都依賴塗裝系統防止腐蝕。馬斯河港區的潮濕空氣、工業與交通排放，以及冬季除冰鹽，會逐年消耗塗層；塗層劣化通常從邊角、焊道、螺栓與排水不良處開始。塗裝維護的經濟性取決於時機：在塗層仍完整、只需補塗面漆時處理，成本與交通影響都遠小於等到底漆失效、鋼材生鏽後全面噴砂重塗。地標橋的顏色與外觀也是業主要維持的價值，維護計畫需同時考慮防蝕與外觀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「淺藍色鋼結構塗裝」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The light-blue steel pylon is a city landmark, and the pylon, spines and cross beams all depend on coating systems against corrosion. Humid air in the Maas port area, industrial and traffic emissions and winter de-icing salt consume the coating year by year, with breakdown usually starting at edges, welds, bolts and poorly drained spots. The economics of coating maintenance depend on timing: overcoating while the system is still intact costs far less, and disrupts traffic far less, than full blast-cleaning and recoating after the primer fails and steel rusts. The colour and appearance of a landmark bridge are also values the owner must keep, so maintenance plans address both corrosion and appearance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Light-blue steel coating” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若塗層初始乾膜厚 320 μm、需維持的最低有效厚度 160 μm、平均消耗速率 6 μm/年，到達補塗時點約 (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 年；若邊角與焊道處消耗速率為 12 μm/年，則約 13.3 年就需局部補塗。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an initial dry film of 320 μm, a minimum effective thickness of 160 μm and mean consumption of 6 μm a year, overcoating is due after about (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 years; where edges and welds consume 12 μm a year, local touch-up is needed after about 13.3 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋重新油漆主要是為了好看，對結構壽命影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Repainting a steel bridge is mainly cosmetic and hardly affects structural life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「淺藍色鋼結構塗裝」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Light-blue steel coating”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 河港環境下鋼塔與鋼橋面的防蝕維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosion maintenance of steel pylon and deck in a river port: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淺藍色鋼結構塗裝」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Light-blue steel coating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若塗層初始乾膜厚 320 μm、需維持的最低有效厚度 160 μm、平均消耗速率 6 μm/年，到達補塗時點約 (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 年；若邊角與焊道處消耗速率為 12 μm/年，則約 13.3 年就需局部補塗。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an initial dry film of 320 μm, a minimum effective thickness of 160 μm and mean consumption of 6 μm a year, overcoating is due after about (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 years; where edges and welds consume 12 μm a year, local touch-up is needed after about 13.3 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以乾膜厚度計抽測代表區域，並依標準的生鏽與起泡等級圖評定塗層狀態；邊角、焊道與排水孔附近列為重點檢查點，以照片與位置編號建立劣化歷程，作為選擇局部補塗或全面重塗的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically sample dry-film thickness in representative areas and rate coating condition against standard rust and blistering scales; prioritise edges, welds and drain holes, building a deterioration history with photographs and location numbers to choose between local touch-up and full recoating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若塗層初始乾膜厚 320 μm、需維持的最低有效厚度 160 μm、平均消耗速率 6 μm/年，到達補塗時點約 (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 年；若邊角與焊道處消耗速率為 12 μm/年，則約 13.3 年就需局部補塗。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With an initial dry film of 320 μm, a minimum effective thickness of 160 μm and mean consumption of 6 μm a year, overcoating is due after about (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 years; where edges and welds consume 12 μm a year, local touch-up is needed after about 13.3 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「河港環境下鋼塔與鋼橋面的防蝕維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrosion maintenance of steel pylon and deck in a river port", which statement holds?
options: 人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。
若塗層初始乾膜厚 320 μm、需維持的最低有效厚度 160 μm、平均消耗速率 6 μm/年，到達補塗時點約 (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 年。
開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。
optionsEn: Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.
With an initial dry film of 320 μm, a minimum effective thickness of 160 μm and mean consumption of 6 μm a year, overcoating is due after about (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 years.
A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting.

quiz.explanationEn: With an initial dry film of 320 μm, a minimum effective thickness of 160 μm and mean consumption of 6 μm a year, overcoating is due after about (320 − 160)/6 ≈ 26.7 years; where edges and welds consume 12 μm a year, local touch-up is needed after about 13.3 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 河港環境下鋼塔與鋼橋面的防蝕維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrosion maintenance of steel pylon and deck in a river port: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淺藍色鋼結構塗裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Light-blue steel coating” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以乾膜厚度計抽測代表區域，並依標準的生鏽與起泡等級圖評定塗層狀態；邊角、焊道與排水孔附近列為重點檢查點，以照片與位置編號建立劣化歷程，作為選擇局部補塗或全面重塗的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Periodically sample dry-film thickness in representative areas and rate coating condition against standard rust and blistering scales; prioritise edges, welds and drain holes, building a deterioration history with photographs and location numbers to choose between local touch-up and full recoating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含塗裝系統規格、顏色編號、原始膜厚紀錄與相容的補塗材料；維護計畫要訂出排水孔清理週期與塗層檢查週期，並在重塗時評估封閉施工對電車與交通的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the coating specification, colour reference, original film-thickness records and compatible touch-up materials; the maintenance plan should set drain-cleaning and coating-inspection intervals and assess tram and traffic impacts of enclosed recoating.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若等到大面積生鏽才處理，必須全面噴砂重塗，工程需要大型圍封與長時間交通管制；局部積水或排水孔堵塞造成的腐蝕若未及時發現，可能在主梁或橫梁接頭處削弱斷面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Waiting for widespread rust forces full blast-cleaning and recoating with large enclosures and long traffic restrictions; corrosion from ponding or blocked drains, if not caught early, can reduce sections at spine or cross-beam joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 開合橋機電、運轉紀錄與營運交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bascule machinery, operating records and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「開合橋機械」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bascule machinery” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 開合橋的耳軸、油壓缸、鎖定裝置、煞車與控制系統，是伊拉斯謨大橋除了斜張結構之外的另一個關鍵系統。每次開合都讓耳軸軸承與驅動元件承受一次荷載循環，數十年下來的循環數足以構成疲勞與磨耗問題；控制系統還要與號誌、電車與船舶交通連鎖，確保開合時橋上無車。代爾夫特理工大學的研究也記錄了 2009 至 2010 年冬季冰柱形成、大橋封閉數日的事件，說明營運單位必須同時處理機械、結構與天候風險。完整的運轉紀錄是判斷何時檢修或更換元件的依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「開合橋機械」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bascule’s trunnions, hydraulic cylinders, locks, brakes and controls form a second critical system beside the cable-stayed structure. Each opening applies one load cycle to trunnion bearings and drive components, and over decades the count becomes a fatigue and wear issue; the controls must also interlock with signals, trams and shipping so no vehicle is on the leaf when it moves. A Delft University of Technology study also records icicles forming in the winter of 2009 to 2010 and the bridge closing for several days, showing that the operator must manage mechanical, structural and weather risks together. Complete operating records are the basis for deciding when to overhaul or replace components. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bascule machinery” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若平均每天開合 6 次，30 年累積 6×365×30 = 65,700 次；耳軸與油壓元件的設計循環數若取 200,000 次，30 年使用約 33%；若開合頻率加倍為每天 12 次，則約 66%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At an average of 6 openings a day, 30 years accumulate 6×365×30 = 65,700 cycles; against a design life of 200,000 cycles for trunnions and hydraulics, that uses about 33%; doubling to 12 openings a day uses about 66%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「開合橋的機械只要能動就沒問題，不需要記錄每次運轉的資料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as bascule machinery works, there is no need to log each operation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「開合橋機械」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bascule machinery”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Each opening applies one load cycle to trunnion bearings and drive components, and over decades the count becomes a fatigue and wear issue; the controls must also interlock with signals, trams and shipping so no vehicle is on the leaf when it moves.

steps.title: 開合橋機電、運轉紀錄與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bascule machinery, operating records and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開合橋機械」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bascule machinery” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若平均每天開合 6 次，30 年累積 6×365×30 = 65,700 次；耳軸與油壓元件的設計循環數若取 200,000 次，30 年使用約 33%；若開合頻率加倍為每天 12 次，則約 66%。開合頻率與設計循環數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At an average of 6 openings a day, 30 years accumulate 6×365×30 = 65,700 cycles; against a design life of 200,000 cycles for trunnions and hydraulics, that uses about 33%; doubling to 12 openings a day uses about 66%. Opening frequency and design cycles are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：控制系統自動記錄每次開合的時間、角度、油壓、馬達電流與異常訊息；定期檢查耳軸軸承間隙、油品分析、鎖定裝置作動與連鎖測試，並把循環數與設計值比較，接近門檻時安排大修。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Have the control system log every opening’s time, angle, hydraulic pressure, motor current and alarms; periodically check trunnion bearing clearance, analyse oil, test locks and interlocks, and compare accumulated cycles with design values, scheduling overhaul as thresholds approach.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bascule machinery” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 控制系統自動記錄每次開合的時間、角度、油壓、馬達電流與異常訊息；定期檢查耳軸軸承間隙、油品分析、鎖定裝置作動與連鎖測試，並把循環數與設計值比較，接近門檻時安排大修。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Have the control system log every opening’s time, angle, hydraulic pressure, motor current and alarms; periodically check trunnion bearing clearance, analyse oil, test locks and interlocks, and compare accumulated cycles with design values, scheduling overhaul as thresholds approach. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含機電圖說、連鎖邏輯、操作程序、緊急手動操作方法、備品清單與運轉紀錄格式；任何控制邏輯修改都要經安全評估並在開放前做完整連鎖測試。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include mechanical and electrical drawings, interlock logic, operating procedures, emergency manual operation, spares list and log format; any change to control logic requires a safety assessment and a full interlock test before reopening.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：連鎖系統失效時，開合橋可能在電車或車輛仍在橋上時啟動，造成嚴重事故；耳軸軸承磨耗未被發現，可能使葉板關閉位置偏差，影響路面與軌道接縫，甚至卡在開啟狀態中斷交通。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A failed interlock could start the leaf with a tram or vehicles still on it, causing a serious accident; undetected trunnion wear can misplace the closed leaf, affecting road and rail joints or even jamming it open and cutting traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開合橋機械」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bascule machinery” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 連鎖系統失效時，開合橋可能在電車或車輛仍在橋上時啟動，造成嚴重事故；耳軸軸承磨耗未被發現，可能使葉板關閉位置偏差，影響路面與軌道接縫，甚至卡在開啟狀態中斷交通。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A failed interlock could start the leaf with a tram or vehicles still on it, causing a serious accident; undetected trunnion wear can misplace the closed leaf, affecting road and rail joints or even jamming it open and cutting traffic. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：完整的運轉紀錄是判斷何時檢修或更換元件的依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Complete operating records are the basis for deciding when to overhaul or replace components.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「開合橋的機械只要能動就沒問題，不需要記錄每次運轉的資料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as bascule machinery works, there is no need to log each operation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開合橋機電、運轉紀錄與營運交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bascule machinery, operating records and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
連鎖系統失效時，開合橋可能在電車或車輛仍在橋上時啟動，造成嚴重事故；耳軸軸承磨耗未被發現，可能使葉板關閉位置偏差，影響路面與軌道接縫，甚至卡在開啟狀態中斷交通。
只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A failed interlock could start the leaf with a tram or vehicles still on it, causing a serious accident.
If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays.
quiz.explanation: 連鎖系統失效時，開合橋可能在電車或車輛仍在橋上時啟動，造成嚴重事故；耳軸軸承磨耗未被發現，可能使葉板關閉位置偏差，影響路面與軌道接縫，甚至卡在開啟狀態中斷交通。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A failed interlock could start the leaf with a tram or vehicles still on it, causing a serious accident; undetected trunnion wear can misplace the closed leaf, affecting road and rail joints or even jamming it open and cutting traffic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 斜張橋斜索張力調整
summary: 斜張橋的線形與內力幾乎完全由斜索索力決定，索力調整是把設計意圖變成實際結構的核心工序。本課以諾曼第大橋、里翁—安提里翁大橋、蘇通大橋與亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋等公開案例為參照，說明成橋目標索力、影響矩陣法、平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉、錨具調整量、施工階段預拱、溫度修正、振動法與舉升試驗量測、長期索力漂移，以及允收準則與營運期再調整的決策流程。
summaryEn: The profile and internal forces of a cable-stayed bridge are set almost entirely by its stay forces, so tuning them is the core operation that turns design intent into the real structure. Referring to public cases such as the Pont de Normandie, Rion–Antirion, Sutong and Yavuz Sultan Selim bridges, the course explains completed-state target forces, the influence-matrix method, strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing, anchorage adjustment, construction-stage camber, temperature correction, vibration and lift-off measurement, long-term force drift, and acceptance criteria and in-service re-tuning decisions.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某斜張橋通車前複測一組 4 根索（同塔同側），溫度修正後與目標的偏差為 +3%、−7%、+2%、−1%，目標力均為 5,000 kN，即實測 5,150、4,650、5,100、4,950 kN。單索容許 ±5%：第 2 根不合格。索組總和 = 19,850 kN，對目標 20,000 kN 偏差 −0.75%，在 ±2% 內。以影響矩陣估算：若第 2 根每增加 1 MN，自身增加 1.0 MN、第 1 與第 3 根各減少 0.15 MN、錨點上升 18 mm，則把第 2 根提高 350 kN 至 5,000 kN 需要的錨具調整量，以有效勁度 6,435×0.6 ≈ 3,861 N/mm 計約 350,000/3,861 ≈ 91 mm；調整後第 1 與第 3 根各降約 0.15×350 ≈ 53 kN，分別變為約 5,097 與 5,047 kN（+1.9% 與 +0.9%），錨點上升約 0.35×18 ≈ 6.3 mm。若可用螺紋長度只剩 60 mm，必須改由相鄰索分擔或安排換索。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: before opening, a group of 4 stays on one side of one pylon is re-measured, and after temperature correction the deviations from target are +3%, −7%, +2% and −1% for 5,000 kN targets, i.e. 5,150, 4,650, 5,100 and 4,950 kN. With a ±5% single-stay tolerance, stay 2 fails. The group sum is 19,850 kN, −0.75% against 20,000 kN, within ±2%. From the influence matrix, if each extra 1 MN in stay 2 raises it by 1.0 MN, lowers stays 1 and 3 by 0.15 MN each and lifts its anchorage 18 mm, then raising stay 2 by 350 kN to 5,000 kN needs, at an effective stiffness of 6,435×0.6 ≈ 3,861 N/mm, an anchorage adjustment of about 350,000/3,861 ≈ 91 mm; stays 1 and 3 then drop about 0.15×350 ≈ 53 kN to about 5,097 and 5,047 kN (+1.9% and +0.9%), and the anchorage rises about 0.35×18 ≈ 6.3 mm. If only 60 mm of thread remains, the correction must be shared with neighbouring stays or the stay replaced. Values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」與「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method" and "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「成橋目標索力表」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Completed-state target force table” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。常見的起點是剛性支承連續梁法：假設每個斜索錨點是一個不會沉陷的支點，把橋面當成多跨連續梁計算恆載下的支點反力，再把反力除以斜索與水平面夾角的正弦，得到每根索的目標力。這樣得到的成橋狀態橋面彎矩很小、受力均勻，塔也接近純壓。之後再依活載、溫度、徐變與塔的彎矩做最佳化微調，使所有構件在各種荷載組合下都合格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「成橋目標索力表」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set. A common starting point is the rigidly supported continuous beam method: treat each stay anchorage as an unyielding support, compute the reactions of the deck as a multi-span continuous beam under dead load, then divide each reaction by the sine of its stay’s angle to the horizontal to get the target force. The resulting completed state has small, even deck moments and a pylon close to pure compression. Targets are then fine-tuned for live load, temperature, creep and pylon bending so all members pass every load combination. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Completed-state target force table” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「成橋目標索力表」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Completed-state target force table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法
knowledge.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method
knowledge.text: 斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。常見的起點是剛性支承連續梁法：假設每個斜索錨點是一個不會沉陷的支點，把橋面當成多跨連續梁計算恆載下的支點反力，再把反力除以斜索與水平面夾角的正弦，得到每根索的目標力。
knowledge.textEn: Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set. A common starting point is the rigidly supported continuous beam method: treat each stay anchorage as an unyielding support, compute the reactions of the deck as a multi-span continuous beam under dead load, then divide each reaction by the sine of its stay’s angle to the horizontal to get the target force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method" is correct?
options: 斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。
斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。
調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
optionsEn: A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics.
Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set.
Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
quiz.explanation: 斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「成橋目標索力表」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Completed-state target force table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。索角 30° 時 T = R/sinθ = 2,400/0.5 = 4,800 kN；索角 25° 時 T = 2,400/0.423 ≈ 5,680 kN，越平的長索目標力越大。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN. At a 30° stay angle T = R/sinθ = 2,400/0.5 = 4,800 kN; at 25°, T = 2,400/0.423 ≈ 5,680 kN, so flatter long stays need larger targets. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全橋模型施加目標索力，檢查恆載下橋面與塔的彎矩分布、線形與支承反力；再疊加活載、溫度與長期效應，確認所有斷面應力與索力比（例如使用上限約 0.45 GUTS）都在容許內，並由獨立檢核者複算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply the target forces in a global model and check deck and pylon moments, profile and bearing reactions under dead load; superimpose live load, temperature and long-term effects to confirm every section stress and stay ratio (for example a service limit of about 0.45 GUTS) is acceptable, with an independent checker recomputing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。索角 30° 時 T = R/sinθ = 2,400/0.5 = 4,800 kN；索角 25° 時 T = 2,400/0.423 ≈ 5,680 kN，越平的長索目標力越大。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN. At a 30° stay angle T = R/sinθ = 2,400/0.5 = 4,800 kN; at 25°, T = 2,400/0.423 ≈ 5,680 kN, so flatter long stays need larger targets. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method", which statement holds?
options: 斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。
斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。
恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。
optionsEn: Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again.
Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature.
With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN.
quiz.explanation: 恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「成橋目標索力表」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Completed-state target force table” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全橋模型施加目標索力，檢查恆載下橋面與塔的彎矩分布、線形與支承反力；再疊加活載、溫度與長期效應，確認所有斷面應力與索力比（例如使用上限約 0.45 GUTS）都在容許內，並由獨立檢核者複算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：目標索力表要附上推導方法、採用的模型版本、容許偏差與對應的成橋線形，並由設計者與施工控制單位共同確認為同一份「基準檔」，之後任何修改都要有版本紀錄。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「成橋目標索力表」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Completed-state target force table” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Targets chosen only to minimise dead-load moment, ignoring live load and creep, can leave some stays near their limit in service and others slack; if the completed-state targets and the construction-control model disagree, the site can never reach the right forces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：之後再依活載、溫度、徐變與塔的彎矩做最佳化微調，使所有構件在各種荷載組合下都合格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Targets are then fine-tuned for live load, temperature, creep and pylon bending so all members pass every load combination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。
調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Targets chosen only to minimise dead-load moment, ignoring live load and creep, can leave some stays near their limit in service and others slack.
Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
quiz.explanation: 若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索力—高程影響矩陣」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force–elevation influence matrix” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。影響矩陣法先以結構模型算出「單位索力變化對每個控制點的影響」，排成矩陣 A，實測偏差向量 Δy 與所需索力調整 ΔT 的關係就是 Δy = A·ΔT。當控制點數與調整索數相同時可直接求解；控制點較多時以最小平方法求出整體最佳的調整量，並可加上權重與限制條件（例如任何索力不得超過上限）。這讓工程師一次規劃多根索的調整，而不是逐根試誤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索力—高程影響矩陣」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once. The influence-matrix method first computes, from the structural model, the effect of a unit change in each stay force on every control point, forming a matrix A; measured deviations Δy and required adjustments ΔT are then related by Δy = A·ΔT. With as many control points as adjustable stays it can be solved directly; with more points, least squares gives the best overall adjustment, with weights and constraints such as no stay exceeding its limit. Engineers can thus plan several adjustments together instead of trial and error stay by stay. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Force–elevation influence matrix” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩根索、兩個控制點，A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN，需修正 Δy = [30, −10] mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436; ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN and ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索力—高程影響矩陣」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Force–elevation influence matrix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量
knowledge.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once
knowledge.text: 斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。影響矩陣法先以結構模型算出「單位索力變化對每個控制點的影響」，排成矩陣 A，實測偏差向量 Δy 與所需索力調整 ΔT 的關係就是 Δy = A·ΔT。
knowledge.textEn: A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once. The influence-matrix method first computes, from the structural model, the effect of a unit change in each stay force on every control point, forming a matrix A; measured deviations Δy and required adjustments ΔT are then related by Δy = A·ΔT.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once" is correct?
options: 調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。
斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。
optionsEn: Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces.
A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once.
quiz.explanation: 斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索力—高程影響矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Force–elevation influence matrix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩根索、兩個控制點，A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN，需修正 Δy = [30, −10] mm。det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436；ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN，ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN。驗算：20×1.90 + 8×(−1.01) ≈ 30 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436; ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN and ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN. Check: 20×1.90 + 8×(−1.01) ≈ 30 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模型計算的影響係數與現場小量調索的實測反應比對（例如調一根索 0.5 MN，量測附近高程變化），偏差大時修正模型勁度；調整後重新量測全部控制點，殘差需落在容許範圍，否則再做一輪。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ; after adjustment resurvey all control points and repeat the cycle if residuals exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436; ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN and ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN. Check: 20×1.90 + 8×(−1.01) ≈ 30 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once", which statement holds?
options: 兩根索、兩個控制點，A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN，需修正 Δy = [30, −10] mm。

During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force.
Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately.

quiz.explanationEn: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436; ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN and ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「索力—高程影響矩陣」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Force–elevation influence matrix” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以模型計算的影響係數與現場小量調索的實測反應比對（例如調一根索 0.5 MN，量測附近高程變化），偏差大時修正模型勁度；調整後重新量測全部控制點，殘差需落在容許範圍，否則再做一輪。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ; after adjustment resurvey all control points and repeat the cycle if residuals exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調索作業前要確認模型已更新到現況（重量、邊界、溫度），並設定每根索單次調整上限與總體停止準則；每一輪的輸入、矩陣、計算結果與實測殘差都要存檔備查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before tuning, confirm the model is updated to the current state (weights, boundaries, temperature) and set a per-stay adjustment cap and an overall stop criterion; archive each round’s inputs, matrix, results and measured residuals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪；矩陣接近奇異時，小量測誤差會放大成很大的索力調整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates; a nearly singular matrix amplifies small survey errors into very large force changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ; after adjustment resurvey all control points and repeat the cycle if residuals exceed tolerance.

optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ.

steps.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索力—高程影響矩陣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Force–elevation influence matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪；矩陣接近奇異時，小量測誤差會放大成很大的索力調整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates; a nearly singular matrix amplifies small survey errors into very large force changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這讓工程師一次規劃多根索的調整，而不是逐根試誤。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Engineers can thus plan several adjustments together instead of trial and error stay by stay.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪；矩陣接近奇異時，小量測誤差會放大成很大的索力調整。
knowledge.textEn: An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates; a nearly singular matrix amplifies small survey errors into very large force changes.
