knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。
若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces.

An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates.
quiz.explanation: 若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪；矩陣接近奇異時，小量測誤差會放大成很大的索力調整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates; a nearly singular matrix amplifies small survey errors into very large force changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉」與「錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing" and "Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「參考股荷重計」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reference-strand load cell” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平行鋼絞線斜索是逐股穿入、逐股張拉的。問題在於：每多張拉一股，整根索的勁度與力量增加，橋面與塔隨之變形，先前已張拉的股就會鬆掉一些。若每股都拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，最後第一股的力量會明顯低於最後一股。Freyssinet 公開說明其專利的等張法會自動調整各股，使整根索的力量均勻：概念上是在第一股（參考股）裝荷重計，之後每一股都拉到「當下參考股的讀數」，由於所有股在同一時刻承受相同的伸長狀態，結構後續變形會讓所有股一起變化，最後各股力量相等。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「參考股荷重計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Parallel-strand stays are threaded and stressed one strand at a time. The difficulty is that each additional stressed strand raises the stay’s stiffness and force, the deck and pylon deform, and previously stressed strands lose some force. Stressing every strand to the same jack reading leaves the first strand clearly lower than the last. Freyssinet states publicly that its patented Isotension process automatically adjusts strands so force is uniform across the cable: conceptually, a load cell sits on the first (reference) strand and each later strand is stressed to the reference strand’s current reading, so all strands share the same elongation state at that moment and later structural deformation changes them together, leaving equal forces at the end. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Reference-strand load cell” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單股 A = 150 mm²、E = 195 GPa、索長 L = 250 m，單股勁度 EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm；要讓一股達到 100 kN，伸長量 ΔL = 100,000/117 ≈ 855 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a single strand with A = 150 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m, the stiffness EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm; reaching 100 kN needs ΔL = 100,000/117 ≈ 855 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「參考股荷重計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Reference-strand load cell”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉
knowledge.text: 平行鋼絞線斜索是逐股穿入、逐股張拉的。問題在於：每多張拉一股，整根索的勁度與力量增加，橋面與塔隨之變形，先前已張拉的股就會鬆掉一些。
knowledge.textEn: Parallel-strand stays are threaded and stressed one strand at a time. The difficulty is that each additional stressed strand raises the stay’s stiffness and force, the deck and pylon deform, and previously stressed strands lose some force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing" is correct?
options: 平行鋼絞線斜索是逐股穿入、逐股張拉的。
每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。
斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。
optionsEn: Parallel-strand stays are threaded and stressed one strand at a time.
Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces.
Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again.
quiz.explanation: 平行鋼絞線斜索是逐股穿入、逐股張拉的。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Parallel-strand stays are threaded and stressed one strand at a time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「參考股荷重計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reference-strand load cell” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單股 A = 150 mm²、E = 195 GPa、索長 L = 250 m，單股勁度 EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm；要讓一股達到 100 kN，伸長量 ΔL = 100,000/117 ≈ 855 mm。若只用伸長量控制，±5 mm 的量測誤差相當於 ±0.6 kN，但錨具夾片回縮與結構變形的不確定度遠大於此，因此以荷重計直接量力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a single strand with A = 150 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m, the stiffness EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm; reaching 100 kN needs ΔL = 100,000/117 ≈ 855 mm. Controlling by elongation alone, a ±5 mm reading error is only ±0.6 kN, but uncertainty from wedge draw-in and structural deformation is far larger, so force is measured directly with a load cell. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張拉完成後隨機抽取數股以單股千斤頂做舉升試驗，量測各股實際力量的平均值與離散度，與規範或規格的均勻度要求比較；同時以振動法或總體舉升量測整根索的力量，確認與各股總和一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After stressing, lift off a random sample of strands with a mono-strand jack to measure the mean and scatter of strand forces against the uniformity requirement; measure the whole stay by vibration or full lift-off to confirm it matches the sum of strands.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單股 A = 150 mm²、E = 195 GPa、索長 L = 250 m，單股勁度 EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm；要讓一股達到 100 kN，伸長量 ΔL = 100,000/117 ≈ 855 mm。若只用伸長量控制，±5 mm 的量測誤差相當於 ±0.6 kN，但錨具夾片回縮與結構變形的不確定度遠大於此，因此以荷重計直接量力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a single strand with A = 150 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m, the stiffness EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm; reaching 100 kN needs ΔL = 100,000/117 ≈ 855 mm. Controlling by elongation alone, a ±5 mm reading error is only ±0.6 kN, but uncertainty from wedge draw-in and structural deformation is far larger, so force is measured directly with a load cell. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing", which statement holds?
options: 斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。
千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。
optionsEn: Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature.
For a single strand with A = 150 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m, the stiffness EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm.
Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force.
quiz.explanation: 單股 A = 150 mm²、E = 195 GPa、索長 L = 250 m，單股勁度 EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm；要讓一股達到 100 kN，伸長量 ΔL = 100,000/117 ≈ 855 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a single strand with A = 150 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m, the stiffness EA/L = 195,000×150/250,000 = 117 N/mm; reaching 100 kN needs ΔL = 100,000/117 ≈ 855 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「參考股荷重計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reference-strand load cell” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張拉完成後隨機抽取數股以單股千斤頂做舉升試驗，量測各股實際力量的平均值與離散度，與規範或規格的均勻度要求比較；同時以振動法或總體舉升量測整根索的力量，確認與各股總和一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After stressing, lift off a random sample of strands with a mono-strand jack to measure the mean and scatter of strand forces against the uniformity requirement; measure the whole stay by vibration or full lift-off to confirm it matches the sum of strands. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：張拉規範要指定逐股張拉方法、荷重計校正週期、各股力量容許離散度與抽驗比例；張拉人員須持有供應商或專業機構的資格，現場由監造確認每根索的張拉紀錄後才可封錨。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The stressing specification should set the strand-by-strand method, load-cell calibration interval, allowable scatter of strand forces and sampling rate; stressing crews need supplier or professional qualification, and the supervisor confirms each stay’s record before anchorages are capped.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若不採用等張或補償程序，同一根索中各股力量差異可達一成以上，受力大的股承受較高的疲勞應力幅，可能先斷裂並引發其他股依序超載；荷重計未校正則整根索的力量系統性偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without an equal-tension or compensation procedure, strand forces in one stay can differ by over a tenth, so the most loaded strands see higher fatigue stress ranges and may break first, overloading others in turn; an uncalibrated load cell biases the whole stay’s force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 張拉完成後隨機抽取數股以單股千斤頂做舉升試驗，量測各股實際力量的平均值與離散度，與規範或規格的均勻度要求比較；同時以振動法或總體舉升量測整根索的力量，確認與各股總和一致。
knowledge.textEn: After stressing, lift off a random sample of strands with a mono-strand jack to measure the mean and scatter of strand forces against the uniformity requirement; measure the whole stay by vibration or full lift-off to confirm it matches the sum of strands.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 張拉規範要指定逐股張拉方法、荷重計校正週期、各股力量容許離散度與抽驗比例；張拉人員須持有供應商或專業機構的資格，現場由監造確認每根索的張拉紀錄後才可封錨。
knowledge.textEn: The stressing specification should set the strand-by-strand method, load-cell calibration interval, allowable scatter of strand forces and sampling rate; stressing crews need supplier or professional qualification, and the supervisor confirms each stay’s record before anchorages are capped.

quiz.question: 要驗證「平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。
張拉完成後隨機抽取數股以單股千斤頂做舉升試驗，量測各股實際力量的平均值與離散度，與規範或規格的均勻度要求比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct.
After stressing, lift off a random sample of strands with a mono-strand jack to measure the mean and scatter of strand forces against the uniformity requirement.
quiz.explanation: 張拉完成後隨機抽取數股以單股千斤頂做舉升試驗，量測各股實際力量的平均值與離散度，與規範或規格的均勻度要求比較；同時以振動法或總體舉升量測整根索的力量，確認與各股總和一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After stressing, lift off a random sample of strands with a mono-strand jack to measure the mean and scatter of strand forces against the uniformity requirement; measure the whole stay by vibration or full lift-off to confirm it matches the sum of strands. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「參考股荷重計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reference-strand load cell” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若不採用等張或補償程序，同一根索中各股力量差異可達一成以上，受力大的股承受較高的疲勞應力幅，可能先斷裂並引發其他股依序超載；荷重計未校正則整根索的力量系統性偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without an equal-tension or compensation procedure, strand forces in one stay can differ by over a tenth, so the most loaded strands see higher fatigue stress ranges and may break first, overloading others in turn; an uncalibrated load cell biases the whole stay’s force. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Freyssinet 公開說明其專利的等張法會自動調整各股，使整根索的力量均勻：概念上是在第一股（參考股）裝荷重計，之後每一股都拉到「當下參考股的讀數」，由於所有股在同一時刻承受相同的伸長狀態，結構後續變形會讓所有股一起變化，最後各股力量相等。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Freyssinet states publicly that its patented Isotension process automatically adjusts strands so force is uniform across the cable: conceptually, a load cell sits on the first (reference) strand and each later strand is stressed to the reference strand’s current reading, so all strands share the same elongation state at that moment and later structural deformation changes them together, leaving equal forces at the end.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若不採用等張或補償程序，同一根索中各股力量差異可達一成以上，受力大的股承受較高的疲勞應力幅，可能先斷裂並引發其他股依序超載；荷重計未校正則整根索的力量系統性偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Without an equal-tension or compensation procedure, strand forces in one stay can differ by over a tenth, so the most loaded strands see higher fatigue stress ranges and may break first, overloading others in turn; an uncalibrated load cell biases the whole stay’s force.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若不採用等張或補償程序，同一根索中各股力量差異可達一成以上，受力大的股承受較高的疲勞應力幅，可能先斷裂並引發其他股依序超載。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。
optionsEn: Without an equal-tension or compensation procedure, strand forces in one stay can differ by over a tenth, so the most loaded strands see higher fatigue stress ranges and may break first, overloading others in turn.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again.
quiz.explanation: 若不採用等張或補償程序，同一根索中各股力量差異可達一成以上，受力大的股承受較高的疲勞應力幅，可能先斷裂並引發其他股依序超載；荷重計未校正則整根索的力量系統性偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without an equal-tension or compensation procedure, strand forces in one stay can differ by over a tenth, so the most loaded strands see higher fatigue stress ranges and may break first, overloading others in turn; an uncalibrated load cell biases the whole stay’s force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「錨具螺紋環與墊片」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor ring nut and shims” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜索完成張拉後，日後的索力微調通常不再逐股進行，而是以整束千斤頂把錨頭拉起，再旋轉錨具外的螺紋環或增減墊片，改變錨頭的有效位置。設計時必須預留足夠的調整範圍，涵蓋施工誤差、長期徐變與未來可能的線形修正；若螺紋長度或墊片空間不足，就無法在不換索的情況下調整。調整量與索力變化的關係取決於索本身的軸向勁度，也取決於橋面與塔的柔度：結構越柔，同樣的錨頭位移造成的索力變化越小，需要更大的調整量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錨具螺紋環與墊片」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once a stay is stressed, later fine adjustments are usually not done strand by strand; instead a multi-strand jack lifts the anchor head and the ring nut outside the anchorage is turned or shims added or removed, changing the head’s effective position. Design must reserve enough adjustment range to cover construction error, long-term creep and possible future profile corrections; with too little thread or shim space, adjustment is impossible without replacing the stay. The relation between adjustment and force change depends on the stay’s axial stiffness and on deck and pylon flexibility: the softer the structure, the less force change a given head movement produces, so more adjustment is needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Anchor ring nut and shims” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 55-strand stay with A = 55×150 = 8,250 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m has stiffness EA/L = 195,000×8,250/250,000 ≈ 6,435 N/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「錨具螺紋環與墊片」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Anchor ring nut and shims”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍
knowledge.titleEn: Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range
knowledge.text: 斜索完成張拉後，日後的索力微調通常不再逐股進行，而是以整束千斤頂把錨頭拉起，再旋轉錨具外的螺紋環或增減墊片，改變錨頭的有效位置。設計時必須預留足夠的調整範圍，涵蓋施工誤差、長期徐變與未來可能的線形修正；若螺紋長度或墊片空間不足，就無法在不換索的情況下調整。
knowledge.textEn: Once a stay is stressed, later fine adjustments are usually not done strand by strand; instead a multi-strand jack lifts the anchor head and the ring nut outside the anchorage is turned or shims added or removed, changing the head’s effective position. Design must reserve enough adjustment range to cover construction error, long-term creep and possible future profile corrections; with too little thread or shim space, adjustment is impossible without replacing the stay.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range" is correct?
options: 斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。
斜索完成張拉後，日後的索力微調通常不再逐股進行，而是以整束千斤頂把錨頭拉起，再旋轉錨具外的螺紋環或增減墊片，改變錨頭的有效位置。
施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。
optionsEn: Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again.
Once a stay is stressed, later fine adjustments are usually not done strand by strand.
During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force.
quiz.explanation: 斜索完成張拉後，日後的索力微調通常不再逐股進行，而是以整束千斤頂把錨頭拉起，再旋轉錨具外的螺紋環或增減墊片，改變錨頭的有效位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once a stay is stressed, later fine adjustments are usually not done strand by strand; instead a multi-strand jack lifts the anchor head and the ring nut outside the anchorage is turned or shims added or removed, changing the head’s effective position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨具螺紋環與墊片」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor ring nut and shims” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：55 股斜索 A = 55×150 = 8,250 mm²、E = 195 GPa、L = 250 m：索的勁度 EA/L = 195,000×8,250/250,000 ≈ 6,435 N/mm。增加 300 kN 只看索本身需 300,000/6,435 ≈ 46.6 mm；若結構柔度使有效勁度只剩 60%，需約 77.7 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 55-strand stay with A = 55×150 = 8,250 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m has stiffness EA/L = 195,000×8,250/250,000 ≈ 6,435 N/mm. Adding 300 kN needs 300,000/6,435 ≈ 46.6 mm considering the stay alone; if structural flexibility leaves only 60% effective stiffness, about 77.7 mm is needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在錨具設計審查時列出每根索所需的最大調整量（施工誤差、長期效應、更換工況）與實際可用的螺紋長度或墊片空間；實際調索時記錄錨頭位移與索力變化，反算有效勁度並與模型比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At anchorage design review, list each stay’s maximum required adjustment (construction error, long-term effects, replacement cases) against available thread or shim space; during actual tuning record head movement and force change, back-calculate effective stiffness and compare with the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: A 55-strand stay with A = 55×150 = 8,250 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m has stiffness EA/L = 195,000×8,250/250,000 ≈ 6,435 N/mm. Adding 300 kN needs 300,000/6,435 ≈ 46.6 mm considering the stay alone; if structural flexibility leaves only 60% effective stiffness, about 77.7 mm is needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range", which statement holds?
options: 量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。
鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。
optionsEn: Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately.
Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change.
A 55-strand stay with A = 55×150 = 8,250 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m has stiffness EA/L = 195,000×8,250/250,000 ≈ 6,435 N/mm.
quiz.explanationEn: A 55-strand stay with A = 55×150 = 8,250 mm², E = 195 GPa and L = 250 m has stiffness EA/L = 195,000×8,250/250,000 ≈ 6,435 N/mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨具螺紋環與墊片」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor ring nut and shims” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在錨具設計審查時列出每根索所需的最大調整量（施工誤差、長期效應、更換工況）與實際可用的螺紋長度或墊片空間；實際調索時記錄錨頭位移與索力變化，反算有效勁度並與模型比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At anchorage design review, list each stay’s maximum required adjustment (construction error, long-term effects, replacement cases) against available thread or shim space; during actual tuning record head movement and force change, back-calculate effective stiffness and compare with the model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接資料應記錄每根索錨具剩餘的可調範圍與目前位置，維護單位調索前須確認範圍足夠；墊片使用數量、材質與厚度要有上限規定，並由錨具供應商確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should record each anchorage’s remaining adjustment range and current position, and the maintainer must confirm enough range before tuning; set limits on shim count, material and thickness, confirmed by the anchorage supplier.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：調整範圍用盡後，若仍需提高索力，只能加長錨具或換索，工程代價大；墊片堆疊過多或不平整，會使錨頭偏心受力，局部承壓應力過高並損傷錨墊板或混凝土。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Once adjustment range is exhausted, raising force further requires longer anchorages or new stays at great cost; too many or uneven shims load the anchor head eccentrically, overstressing bearing and damaging the bearing plate or concrete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在錨具設計審查時列出每根索所需的最大調整量（施工誤差、長期效應、更換工況）與實際可用的螺紋長度或墊片空間；實際調索時記錄錨頭位移與索力變化，反算有效勁度並與模型比較。
knowledge.textEn: At anchorage design review, list each stay’s maximum required adjustment (construction error, long-term effects, replacement cases) against available thread or shim space; during actual tuning record head movement and force change, back-calculate effective stiffness and compare with the model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接資料應記錄每根索錨具剩餘的可調範圍與目前位置，維護單位調索前須確認範圍足夠；墊片使用數量、材質與厚度要有上限規定，並由錨具供應商確認。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should record each anchorage’s remaining adjustment range and current position, and the maintainer must confirm enough range before tuning; set limits on shim count, material and thickness, confirmed by the anchorage supplier.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range"?
options: 在錨具設計審查時列出每根索所需的最大調整量（施工誤差、長期效應、更換工況）與實際可用的螺紋長度或墊片空間。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。
optionsEn: At anchorage design review, list each stay’s maximum required adjustment (construction error, long-term effects, replacement cases) against available thread or shim space.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics.
quiz.explanation: 在錨具設計審查時列出每根索所需的最大調整量（施工誤差、長期效應、更換工況）與實際可用的螺紋長度或墊片空間；實際調索時記錄錨頭位移與索力變化，反算有效勁度並與模型比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At anchorage design review, list each stay’s maximum required adjustment (construction error, long-term effects, replacement cases) against available thread or shim space; during actual tuning record head movement and force change, back-calculate effective stiffness and compare with the model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨具螺紋環與墊片」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchor ring nut and shims” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 調整範圍用盡後，若仍需提高索力，只能加長錨具或換索，工程代價大；墊片堆疊過多或不平整，會使錨頭偏心受力，局部承壓應力過高並損傷錨墊板或混凝土。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Once adjustment range is exhausted, raising force further requires longer anchorages or new stays at great cost; too many or uneven shims load the anchor head eccentrically, overstressing bearing and damaging the bearing plate or concrete. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：調整量與索力變化的關係取決於索本身的軸向勁度，也取決於橋面與塔的柔度：結構越柔，同樣的錨頭位移造成的索力變化越小，需要更大的調整量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The relation between adjustment and force change depends on the stay’s axial stiffness and on deck and pylon flexibility: the softer the structure, the less force change a given head movement produces, so more adjustment is needed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 調整範圍用盡後，若仍需提高索力，只能加長錨具或換索，工程代價大；墊片堆疊過多或不平整，會使錨頭偏心受力，局部承壓應力過高並損傷錨墊板或混凝土。
knowledge.textEn: Once adjustment range is exhausted, raising force further requires longer anchorages or new stays at great cost; too many or uneven shims load the anchor head eccentrically, overstressing bearing and damaging the bearing plate or concrete.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨具調整量：螺紋環、墊片與可調範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Anchorage adjustment: ring nuts, shims and adjustment range" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
調整範圍用盡後，若仍需提高索力，只能加長錨具或換索，工程代價大；墊片堆疊過多或不平整，會使錨頭偏心受力，局部承壓應力過高並損傷錨墊板或混凝土。
施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Once adjustment range is exhausted, raising force further requires longer anchorages or new stays at great cost.
During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force.
quiz.explanation: 調整範圍用盡後，若仍需提高索力，只能加長錨具或換索，工程代價大；墊片堆疊過多或不平整，會使錨頭偏心受力，局部承壓應力過高並損傷錨墊板或混凝土。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Once adjustment range is exhausted, raising force further requires longer anchorages or new stays at great cost; too many or uneven shims load the anchor head eccentrically, overstressing bearing and damaging the bearing plate or concrete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」」與「溫度效應與量測時窗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces" and "Temperature effects and measurement windows": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「施工階段預拱表」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction-stage camber table” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 成橋目標索力是最後狀態，但施工中每一步的索力與高程都不同：新節段的重量、吊機位置、臨時荷載、混凝土徐變與鋪面都還沒全部到位。施工控制以正裝分析（依施工順序逐步加載）或倒拆分析（從成橋狀態反推）求出每一步「此時應有」的索力與高程，並把它們寫成施工控制表。現場量測與這張表比較，而不是直接與成橋目標比較。AECOM 公開資料提到其為蘇通大橋提供架設分析、線形控制與斜索安裝模擬，正是這類工作的典型範例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「施工階段預拱表」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The completed-state targets describe the final condition, but forces and levels differ at every construction step: new segment weight, crane position, temporary loads, concrete creep and surfacing are not yet all in place. Construction control uses forward analysis (adding loads in construction order) or backward analysis (dismantling from the completed state) to find the force and level each step should have, and records them in a control table. Site measurements are compared with this table, not directly with the completed targets. AECOM’s public material on Sutong, describing erection analysis, geometry control and stay-installation simulations, is a typical example of this work. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Construction-stage camber table” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某節段的製作預拱 = 後續恆載撓度 + 徐變收縮撓度 + 溫度與索垂度修正。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A segment’s fabrication camber = later dead-load deflection + creep and shrinkage deflection + temperature and stay-sag corrections, here 120 mm + 35 mm + 15 mm = 170 mm; if surfacing moved after closure is left out, about 25 mm is missed and the completed profile ends below design.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「施工階段預拱表」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Construction-stage camber table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」
knowledge.titleEn: Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces
knowledge.text: 成橋目標索力是最後狀態，但施工中每一步的索力與高程都不同：新節段的重量、吊機位置、臨時荷載、混凝土徐變與鋪面都還沒全部到位。施工控制以正裝分析（依施工順序逐步加載）或倒拆分析（從成橋狀態反推）求出每一步「此時應有」的索力與高程，並把它們寫成施工控制表。
knowledge.textEn: The completed-state targets describe the final condition, but forces and levels differ at every construction step: new segment weight, crane position, temporary loads, concrete creep and surfacing are not yet all in place. Construction control uses forward analysis (adding loads in construction order) or backward analysis (dismantling from the completed state) to find the force and level each step should have, and records them in a control table.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces" is correct?
options: 施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。
斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。
成橋目標索力是最後狀態，但施工中每一步的索力與高程都不同：新節段的重量、吊機位置、臨時荷載、混凝土徐變與鋪面都還沒全部到位。
optionsEn: During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force.
Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature.

The completed-state targets describe the final condition, but forces and levels differ at every construction step: new segment weight, crane position, temporary loads, concrete creep and surfacing are not yet all in place.
quiz.explanation: 成橋目標索力是最後狀態，但施工中每一步的索力與高程都不同：新節段的重量、吊機位置、臨時荷載、混凝土徐變與鋪面都還沒全部到位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The completed-state targets describe the final condition, but forces and levels differ at every construction step: new segment weight, crane position, temporary loads, concrete creep and surfacing are not yet all in place. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工階段預拱表」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction-stage camber table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某節段的製作預拱 = 後續恆載撓度 + 徐變收縮撓度 + 溫度與索垂度修正。取 120 mm + 35 mm + 15 mm = 170 mm；若後續鋪面延後到合龍之後才施作而未納入，則少算約 25 mm，成橋線形將低於設計。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A segment’s fabrication camber = later dead-load deflection + creep and shrinkage deflection + temperature and stay-sag corrections, here 120 mm + 35 mm + 15 mm = 170 mm; if surfacing moved after closure is left out, about 25 mm is missed and the completed profile ends below design. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一步施工後量測索力與高程，與施工控制表比較；偏差超過容許時，以影響矩陣決定在下一步修正，而非等到合龍後才一次處理；施工順序或荷載變更時重新執行施工階段分析並更新控制表版本。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After every construction step measure stay forces and levels against the control table; when deviations exceed tolerance, decide corrections for the next step using the influence matrix rather than leaving everything until closure; rerun the staged analysis and issue a new control-table version whenever sequence or loads change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某節段的製作預拱 = 後續恆載撓度 + 徐變收縮撓度 + 溫度與索垂度修正。取 120 mm + 35 mm + 15 mm = 170 mm；若後續鋪面延後到合龍之後才施作而未納入，則少算約 25 mm，成橋線形將低於設計。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A segment’s fabrication camber = later dead-load deflection + creep and shrinkage deflection + temperature and stay-sag corrections, here 120 mm + 35 mm + 15 mm = 170 mm; if surfacing moved after closure is left out, about 25 mm is missed and the completed profile ends below design. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces", which statement holds?
options: 某節段的製作預拱 = 後續恆載撓度 + 徐變收縮撓度 + 溫度與索垂度修正。
千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。
只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。
optionsEn: A segment’s fabrication camber = later dead-load deflection + creep and shrinkage deflection + temperature and stay-sag corrections, here 120 mm + 35 mm + 15 mm = 170 mm.
Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force.
If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 某節段的製作預拱 = 後續恆載撓度 + 徐變收縮撓度 + 溫度與索垂度修正。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A segment’s fabrication camber = later dead-load deflection + creep and shrinkage deflection + temperature and stay-sag corrections, here 120 mm + 35 mm + 15 mm = 170 mm; if surfacing moved after closure is left out, about 25 mm is missed and the completed profile ends below design. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工階段預拱表」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction-stage camber table” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一步施工後量測索力與高程，與施工控制表比較；偏差超過容許時，以影響矩陣決定在下一步修正，而非等到合龍後才一次處理；施工順序或荷載變更時重新執行施工階段分析並更新控制表版本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After every construction step measure stay forces and levels against the control table; when deviations exceed tolerance, decide corrections for the next step using the influence matrix rather than leaving everything until closure; rerun the staged analysis and issue a new control-table version whenever sequence or loads change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工控制表要有版本號、對應的施工順序與荷載假設，並規定任何偏離施工計畫的作業（吊機移位、材料堆放）都需先通知施工控制工程師評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The control table needs a version number, the matching construction sequence and load assumptions, and any departure from the plan, such as moving cranes or stockpiling materials, must first be referred to the construction-control engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若現場把施工中的實測索力直接與成橋目標比較並「調到目標」，等後續荷載加上後索力與線形會全面偏離；施工順序臨時改變而未更新分析，也會讓合龍口高差超出可調範圍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing mid-construction forces directly with completed targets and tuning to them leaves forces and profile wrong once later loads arrive; changing the sequence on site without updating the analysis can push the closure-gap level difference beyond the adjustable range. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: After every construction step measure stay forces and levels against the control table; when deviations exceed tolerance, decide corrections for the next step using the influence matrix rather than leaving everything until closure; rerun the staged analysis and issue a new control-table version whenever sequence or loads change.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工控制表要有版本號、對應的施工順序與荷載假設，並規定任何偏離施工計畫的作業（吊機移位、材料堆放）都需先通知施工控制工程師評估。
knowledge.textEn: The control table needs a version number, the matching construction sequence and load assumptions, and any departure from the plan, such as moving cranes or stockpiling materials, must first be referred to the construction-control engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每一步施工後量測索力與高程，與施工控制表比較。
調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
After every construction step measure stay forces and levels against the control table.
Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
quiz.explanation: 每一步施工後量測索力與高程，與施工控制表比較；偏差超過容許時，以影響矩陣決定在下一步修正，而非等到合龍後才一次處理；施工順序或荷載變更時重新執行施工階段分析並更新控制表版本。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After every construction step measure stay forces and levels against the control table; when deviations exceed tolerance, decide corrections for the next step using the influence matrix rather than leaving everything until closure; rerun the staged analysis and issue a new control-table version whenever sequence or loads change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工階段預拱表」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction-stage camber table” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若現場把施工中的實測索力直接與成橋目標比較並「調到目標」，等後續荷載加上後索力與線形會全面偏離；施工順序臨時改變而未更新分析，也會讓合龍口高差超出可調範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing mid-construction forces directly with completed targets and tuning to them leaves forces and profile wrong once later loads arrive; changing the sequence on site without updating the analysis can push the closure-gap level difference beyond the adjustable range. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：AECOM 公開資料提到其為蘇通大橋提供架設分析、線形控制與斜索安裝模擬，正是這類工作的典型範例。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: AECOM’s public material on Sutong, describing erection analysis, geometry control and stay-installation simulations, is a typical example of this work.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若現場把施工中的實測索力直接與成橋目標比較並「調到目標」，等後續荷載加上後索力與線形會全面偏離；施工順序臨時改變而未更新分析，也會讓合龍口高差超出可調範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing mid-construction forces directly with completed targets and tuning to them leaves forces and profile wrong once later loads arrive; changing the sequence on site without updating the analysis can push the closure-gap level difference beyond the adjustable range.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工階段分析、預拱與索力的「施工時應有值」」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged analysis, camber and as-built-at-stage forces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。
若現場把施工中的實測索力直接與成橋目標比較並「調到目標」，等後續荷載加上後索力與線形會全面偏離；施工順序臨時改變而未更新分析，也會讓合龍口高差超出可調範圍。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature.
Comparing mid-construction forces directly with completed targets and tuning to them leaves forces and profile wrong once later loads arrive.
quiz.explanation: 若現場把施工中的實測索力直接與成橋目標比較並「調到目標」，等後續荷載加上後索力與線形會全面偏離；施工順序臨時改變而未更新分析，也會讓合龍口高差超出可調範圍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing mid-construction forces directly with completed targets and tuning to them leaves forces and profile wrong once later loads arrive; changing the sequence on site without updating the analysis can push the closure-gap level difference beyond the adjustable range. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溫度效應與量測時窗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature effects and measurement windows: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索溫與梁溫差」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cable-to-deck temperature difference” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜索、鋼梁與混凝土塔對日照的反應速度與吸熱量都不同：深色 HDPE 套管在陽光下升溫快，鋼梁次之，混凝土塔最慢。索比梁熱時索伸長、索力下降、橋面下沉；橋面上下緣溫差又使橋面彎曲。同一根索在一天之內的索力與錨點高程都可能變化數個百分點與數公分，若在午後量測並據以調索，等於把暫時的溫度效應當成永久誤差修正。因此調索與量測通常安排在清晨日出前、溫度最均勻的時段，並同時記錄索、梁、塔與氣溫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索溫與梁溫差」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stays, steel girders and concrete pylons respond to sunshine at different speeds and with different heat gain: dark HDPE ducts heat fastest, steel next and the concrete pylon slowest. When a stay is warmer than the deck it lengthens, its force falls and the deck drops; a temperature difference through the deck bends it as well. A stay’s force and anchorage level can shift by several percent and several centimetres within a day, and tuning from afternoon readings treats temporary thermal effects as permanent errors. Tuning and measurement are therefore usually scheduled before sunrise, when temperatures are most uniform, with stay, deck, pylon and air temperatures recorded together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cable-to-deck temperature difference” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：索比梁溫度高 ΔT = 10 °C、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C：自由應變 1.2×10⁻⁴，若完全受束制，應力變化 E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa，對 8,250 mm² 的索約 193 kN；實際因結構柔度只出現其中一部分，但仍足以超過 1% 的調索精度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a stay 10 °C warmer than the deck and α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, the free strain is 1.2×10⁻⁴; fully restrained, the stress change is E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa, about 193 kN on an 8,250 mm² stay.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索溫與梁溫差」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cable-to-deck temperature difference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度效應與量測時窗
knowledge.text: 斜索、鋼梁與混凝土塔對日照的反應速度與吸熱量都不同：深色 HDPE 套管在陽光下升溫快，鋼梁次之，混凝土塔最慢。索比梁熱時索伸長、索力下降、橋面下沉；橋面上下緣溫差又使橋面彎曲。
knowledge.textEn: Stays, steel girders and concrete pylons respond to sunshine at different speeds and with different heat gain: dark HDPE ducts heat fastest, steel next and the concrete pylon slowest. When a stay is warmer than the deck it lengthens, its force falls and the deck drops; a temperature difference through the deck bends it as well.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度效應與量測時窗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temperature effects and measurement windows" is correct?
options: 斜索、鋼梁與混凝土塔對日照的反應速度與吸熱量都不同：深色 HDPE 套管在陽光下升溫快，鋼梁次之，混凝土塔最慢。
斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。
量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。
optionsEn: Stays, steel girders and concrete pylons respond to sunshine at different speeds and with different heat gain: dark HDPE ducts heat fastest, steel next and the concrete pylon slowest.
Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature.
Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately.
quiz.explanation: 斜索、鋼梁與混凝土塔對日照的反應速度與吸熱量都不同：深色 HDPE 套管在陽光下升溫快，鋼梁次之，混凝土塔最慢。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stays, steel girders and concrete pylons respond to sunshine at different speeds and with different heat gain: dark HDPE ducts heat fastest, steel next and the concrete pylon slowest. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度效應與量測時窗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature effects and measurement windows: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索溫與梁溫差」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cable-to-deck temperature difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：索比梁溫度高 ΔT = 10 °C、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C：自由應變 1.2×10⁻⁴，若完全受束制，應力變化 E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa，對 8,250 mm² 的索約 193 kN；實際因結構柔度只出現其中一部分，但仍足以超過 1% 的調索精度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a stay 10 °C warmer than the deck and α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, the free strain is 1.2×10⁻⁴; fully restrained, the stress change is E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa, about 193 kN on an 8,250 mm² stay. Structural flexibility realises only part of this, but still more than a 1% tuning precision. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性斜索的套管內外、鋼梁上下緣與塔身設置溫度計，連續數日記錄索力與高程對溫度的關係，回歸出溫度係數；正式量測時若溫度偏離基準，以回歸係數修正到基準溫度再判讀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place thermometers inside and outside representative stay ducts, on top and bottom of the girder and in the pylon, logging force and level against temperature for several days to regress temperature coefficients; if formal measurements depart from the reference temperature, correct them to it before interpretation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 索比梁溫度高 ΔT = 10 °C、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C：自由應變 1.2×10⁻⁴，若完全受束制，應力變化 E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa，對 8,250 mm² 的索約 193 kN；實際因結構柔度只出現其中一部分，但仍足以超過 1% 的調索精度。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a stay 10 °C warmer than the deck and α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, the free strain is 1.2×10⁻⁴; fully restrained, the stress change is E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa, about 193 kN on an 8,250 mm² stay. Structural flexibility realises only part of this, but still more than a 1% tuning precision. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度效應與量測時窗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature effects and measurement windows", which statement holds?
options: 鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。
索比梁溫度高 ΔT = 10 °C、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C：自由應變 1.2×10⁻⁴，若完全受束制，應力變化 E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa，對 8,250 mm² 的索約 193 kN。
斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。
optionsEn: Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change.
With a stay 10 °C warmer than the deck and α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, the free strain is 1.2×10⁻⁴.
A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics.
quiz.explanation: 索比梁溫度高 ΔT = 10 °C、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C：自由應變 1.2×10⁻⁴，若完全受束制，應力變化 E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa，對 8,250 mm² 的索約 193 kN；實際因結構柔度只出現其中一部分，但仍足以超過 1% 的調索精度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a stay 10 °C warmer than the deck and α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, the free strain is 1.2×10⁻⁴; fully restrained, the stress change is E·α·ΔT = 195,000×1.2×10⁻⁴ ≈ 23.4 MPa, about 193 kN on an 8,250 mm² stay. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度效應與量測時窗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature effects and measurement windows: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「索溫與梁溫差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cable-to-deck temperature difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性斜索的套管內外、鋼梁上下緣與塔身設置溫度計，連續數日記錄索力與高程對溫度的關係，回歸出溫度係數；正式量測時若溫度偏離基準，以回歸係數修正到基準溫度再判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place thermometers inside and outside representative stay ducts, on top and bottom of the girder and in the pylon, logging force and level against temperature for several days to regress temperature coefficients; if formal measurements depart from the reference temperature, correct them to it before interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調索作業程序要規定量測時窗（例如日出前兩小時內）、溫度紀錄點與溫差上限，超出上限時暫停作業；所有索力紀錄須附溫度資料，否則不得作為驗收依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The tuning procedure should set the measurement window, for example within two hours before sunrise, temperature recording points and a maximum temperature difference, suspending work beyond it; force records without temperature data are not valid for acceptance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在日照強烈時調索，等到夜間溫度均勻後索力與線形偏離目標，需要重新調整，浪費工時並增加錨具反覆調整的磨耗；若未記錄溫度，事後無法判斷偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tuning in strong sunshine leaves forces and profile off target once night temperatures even out, requiring rework and wearing anchorages through repeated adjustment; without temperature records the source of deviations cannot be traced afterwards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表性斜索的套管內外、鋼梁上下緣與塔身設置溫度計，連續數日記錄索力與高程對溫度的關係，回歸出溫度係數；正式量測時若溫度偏離基準，以回歸係數修正到基準溫度再判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Place thermometers inside and outside representative stay ducts, on top and bottom of the girder and in the pylon, logging force and level against temperature for several days to regress temperature coefficients; if formal measurements depart from the reference temperature, correct them to it before interpretation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調索作業程序要規定量測時窗（例如日出前兩小時內）、溫度紀錄點與溫差上限，超出上限時暫停作業；所有索力紀錄須附溫度資料，否則不得作為驗收依據。
knowledge.textEn: The tuning procedure should set the measurement window, for example within two hours before sunrise, temperature recording points and a maximum temperature difference, suspending work beyond it; force records without temperature data are not valid for acceptance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度效應與量測時窗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature effects and measurement windows"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。
在代表性斜索的套管內外、鋼梁上下緣與塔身設置溫度計，連續數日記錄索力與高程對溫度的關係，回歸出溫度係數。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces.

Place thermometers inside and outside representative stay ducts, on top and bottom of the girder and in the pylon, logging force and level against temperature for several days to regress temperature coefficients.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性斜索的套管內外、鋼梁上下緣與塔身設置溫度計，連續數日記錄索力與高程對溫度的關係，回歸出溫度係數；正式量測時若溫度偏離基準，以回歸係數修正到基準溫度再判讀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place thermometers inside and outside representative stay ducts, on top and bottom of the girder and in the pylon, logging force and level against temperature for several days to regress temperature coefficients; if formal measurements depart from the reference temperature, correct them to it before interpretation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度效應與量測時窗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature effects and measurement windows: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索溫與梁溫差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cable-to-deck temperature difference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在日照強烈時調索，等到夜間溫度均勻後索力與線形偏離目標，需要重新調整，浪費工時並增加錨具反覆調整的磨耗；若未記錄溫度，事後無法判斷偏差來源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Tuning in strong sunshine leaves forces and profile off target once night temperatures even out, requiring rework and wearing anchorages through repeated adjustment; without temperature records the source of deviations cannot be traced afterwards. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此調索與量測通常安排在清晨日出前、溫度最均勻的時段，並同時記錄索、梁、塔與氣溫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tuning and measurement are therefore usually scheduled before sunrise, when temperatures are most uniform, with stay, deck, pylon and air temperatures recorded together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在日照強烈時調索，等到夜間溫度均勻後索力與線形偏離目標，需要重新調整，浪費工時並增加錨具反覆調整的磨耗；若未記錄溫度，事後無法判斷偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Tuning in strong sunshine leaves forces and profile off target once night temperatures even out, requiring rework and wearing anchorages through repeated adjustment; without temperature records the source of deviations cannot be traced afterwards.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度效應與量測時窗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature effects and measurement windows" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在日照強烈時調索，等到夜間溫度均勻後索力與線形偏離目標，需要重新調整，浪費工時並增加錨具反覆調整的磨耗；若未記錄溫度，事後無法判斷偏差來源。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。
optionsEn: Tuning in strong sunshine leaves forces and profile off target once night temperatures even out, requiring rework and wearing anchorages through repeated adjustment.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately.
quiz.explanation: 在日照強烈時調索，等到夜間溫度均勻後索力與線形偏離目標，需要重新調整，浪費工時並增加錨具反覆調整的磨耗；若未記錄溫度，事後無法判斷偏差來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tuning in strong sunshine leaves forces and profile off target once night temperatures even out, requiring rework and wearing anchorages through repeated adjustment; without temperature records the source of deviations cannot be traced afterwards. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正」與「千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction" and "Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「加速度計頻率量測」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accelerometer frequency measurement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 直接以千斤頂量測每一根索的力量既費時又需要接近錨頭，營運期更不方便。振動法在索上裝加速度計，記錄風或人工激勵下的自由振動，從頻譜讀出各階自然頻率，再以張緊弦理論換算索力。長索可直接使用簡化公式；短而粗的索彎曲勁度不可忽略，頻率會因此偏高，需以修正公式扣除；很長的索則需考慮垂度對低階頻率的影響。實務上會用多階頻率一起擬合，同時估計索力與等效彎曲勁度，並以施工期的千斤頂讀數校正每根索的參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「加速度計頻率量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring every stay with jacks is slow and needs access to the anchor head, and is awkward in service. The vibration method fits an accelerometer to the stay, records free vibration under wind or manual excitation, reads natural frequencies from the spectrum and converts them to force with taut-string theory. Long stays can use the simplified formula; short, stocky stays have non-negligible bending stiffness that raises frequencies and must be subtracted with a corrected formula; very long stays need the effect of sag on the lowest modes. In practice several modes are fitted together to estimate force and equivalent bending stiffness, with each stay’s parameters calibrated against construction-stage jack readings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Accelerometer frequency measurement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「加速度計頻率量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Accelerometer frequency measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正
knowledge.titleEn: Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction
knowledge.text: 直接以千斤頂量測每一根索的力量既費時又需要接近錨頭，營運期更不方便。振動法在索上裝加速度計，記錄風或人工激勵下的自由振動，從頻譜讀出各階自然頻率，再以張緊弦理論換算索力。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring every stay with jacks is slow and needs access to the anchor head, and is awkward in service. The vibration method fits an accelerometer to the stay, records free vibration under wind or manual excitation, reads natural frequencies from the spectrum and converts them to force with taut-string theory.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction" is correct?
options: 量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。
直接以千斤頂量測每一根索的力量既費時又需要接近錨頭，營運期更不方便。
千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。
optionsEn: Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately.
Measuring every stay with jacks is slow and needs access to the anchor head, and is awkward in service.
Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force.
quiz.explanation: 直接以千斤頂量測每一根索的力量既費時又需要接近錨頭，營運期更不方便。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring every stay with jacks is slow and needs access to the anchor head, and is awkward in service. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「加速度計頻率量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Accelerometer frequency measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L²。長索 m = 70 kg/m、L = 180 m、f₁ = 0.62 Hz：4×70×180²×0.62² ≈ 3,487 kN，若 EI = 2×10⁵ N·m²，修正項 π²×2×10⁵/180² ≈ 61 N 可忽略。短索 L = 30 m、f₁ = 3.9 Hz：張緊弦值約 3,833 kN，若 EI = 5×10⁶ N·m²，修正項約 54.8 kN，約 1.4%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L². For a long stay with m = 70 kg/m, L = 180 m and f₁ = 0.62 Hz, 4×70×180²×0.62² ≈ 3,487 kN; with EI = 2×10⁵ N·m² the correction π²×2×10⁵/180² ≈ 61 N is negligible. For a short stay with L = 30 m and f₁ = 3.9 Hz the taut-string value is about 3,833 kN, and with EI = 5×10⁶ N·m² the correction is about 54.8 kN, about 1.4%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工完成時千斤頂或荷重計量得的索力，對每根索做頻率—索力校正，決定有效長度與彎曲勁度；營運期量測時至少記錄數分鐘、取得 3 階以上頻率，檢查各階頻率比是否接近整數倍，偏離時表示需要考慮垂度或邊界條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate frequency against force for each stay using jack or load-cell values at completion to fix effective length and bending stiffness; in service record at least several minutes and obtain three or more modes, checking that frequency ratios are close to integers, since departures signal sag or boundary effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L²。長索 m = 70 kg/m、L = 180 m、f₁ = 0.62 Hz：4×70×180²×0.62² ≈ 3,487 kN，若 EI = 2×10⁵ N·m²，修正項 π²×2×10⁵/180² ≈ 61 N 可忽略。短索 L = 30 m、f₁ = 3.9 Hz：張緊弦值約 3,833 kN，若 EI = 5×10⁶ N·m²，修正項約 54.8 kN，約 1.4%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L². For a long stay with m = 70 kg/m, L = 180 m and f₁ = 0.62 Hz, 4×70×180²×0.62² ≈ 3,487 kN; with EI = 2×10⁵ N·m² the correction π²×2×10⁵/180² ≈ 61 N is negligible. For a short stay with L = 30 m and f₁ = 3.9 Hz the taut-string value is about 3,833 kN, and with EI = 5×10⁶ N·m² the correction is about 54.8 kN, about 1.4%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction", which statement holds?
options: 只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。
調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L²。
optionsEn: If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct.
Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L².
quiz.explanation: T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n² − n²·π²·EI/L². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「加速度計頻率量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Accelerometer frequency measurement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工完成時千斤頂或荷重計量得的索力，對每根索做頻率—索力校正，決定有效長度與彎曲勁度；營運期量測時至少記錄數分鐘、取得 3 階以上頻率，檢查各階頻率比是否接近整數倍，偏離時表示需要考慮垂度或邊界條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate frequency against force for each stay using jack or load-cell values at completion to fix effective length and bending stiffness; in service record at least several minutes and obtain three or more modes, checking that frequency ratios are close to integers, since departures signal sag or boundary effects. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接資料應附每根索的校正參數（有效長度、單位質量、彎曲勁度、基準頻率）與量測位置；量測報告須說明採用的頻率階數、修正方法與估計不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include each stay’s calibration parameters (effective length, mass per metre, bending stiffness, baseline frequencies) and measurement position; reports must state the modes used, the correction method and the estimated uncertainty.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若短索直接套用張緊弦公式而不修正彎曲勁度，索力會被高估，可能誤以為索力足夠；有效長度取錯（例如忽略阻尼器或導管的束制位置），也會造成數個百分點的系統誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying the taut-string formula to short stays without bending correction overestimates force and may falsely suggest adequacy; using the wrong effective length, for example ignoring restraint at a damper or guide pipe, introduces systematic errors of several percent. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工完成時千斤頂或荷重計量得的索力，對每根索做頻率—索力校正，決定有效長度與彎曲勁度；營運期量測時至少記錄數分鐘、取得 3 階以上頻率，檢查各階頻率比是否接近整數倍，偏離時表示需要考慮垂度或邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate frequency against force for each stay using jack or load-cell values at completion to fix effective length and bending stiffness; in service record at least several minutes and obtain three or more modes, checking that frequency ratios are close to integers, since departures signal sag or boundary effects.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接資料應附每根索的校正參數（有效長度、單位質量、彎曲勁度、基準頻率）與量測位置；量測報告須說明採用的頻率階數、修正方法與估計不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include each stay’s calibration parameters (effective length, mass per metre, bending stiffness, baseline frequencies) and measurement position; reports must state the modes used, the correction method and the estimated uncertainty.

quiz.question: 要驗證「振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction"?
options: 以施工完成時千斤頂或荷重計量得的索力，對每根索做頻率—索力校正，決定有效長度與彎曲勁度。
