optionsEn: Calibrate frequency against force for each stay using jack or load-cell values at completion to fix effective length and bending stiffness.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again.
quiz.explanation: 以施工完成時千斤頂或荷重計量得的索力，對每根索做頻率—索力校正，決定有效長度與彎曲勁度；營運期量測時至少記錄數分鐘、取得 3 階以上頻率，檢查各階頻率比是否接近整數倍，偏離時表示需要考慮垂度或邊界條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate frequency against force for each stay using jack or load-cell values at completion to fix effective length and bending stiffness; in service record at least several minutes and obtain three or more modes, checking that frequency ratios are close to integers, since departures signal sag or boundary effects. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「加速度計頻率量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Accelerometer frequency measurement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若短索直接套用張緊弦公式而不修正彎曲勁度，索力會被高估，可能誤以為索力足夠；有效長度取錯（例如忽略阻尼器或導管的束制位置），也會造成數個百分點的系統誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying the taut-string formula to short stays without bending correction overestimates force and may falsely suggest adequacy; using the wrong effective length, for example ignoring restraint at a damper or guide pipe, introduces systematic errors of several percent. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實務上會用多階頻率一起擬合，同時估計索力與等效彎曲勁度，並以施工期的千斤頂讀數校正每根索的參數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In practice several modes are fitted together to estimate force and equivalent bending stiffness, with each stay’s parameters calibrated against construction-stage jack readings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若短索直接套用張緊弦公式而不修正彎曲勁度，索力會被高估，可能誤以為索力足夠；有效長度取錯（例如忽略阻尼器或導管的束制位置），也會造成數個百分點的系統誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Applying the taut-string formula to short stays without bending correction overestimates force and may falsely suggest adequacy; using the wrong effective length, for example ignoring restraint at a damper or guide pipe, introduces systematic errors of several percent.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「振動法索力量測與彎曲勁度修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vibration-based force measurement and bending correction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若短索直接套用張緊弦公式而不修正彎曲勁度，索力會被高估，可能誤以為索力足夠；有效長度取錯（例如忽略阻尼器或導管的束制位置），也會造成數個百分點的系統誤差。
千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying the taut-string formula to short stays without bending correction overestimates force and may falsely suggest adequacy.
Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force.
quiz.explanation: 若短索直接套用張緊弦公式而不修正彎曲勁度，索力會被高估，可能誤以為索力足夠；有效長度取錯（例如忽略阻尼器或導管的束制位置），也會造成數個百分點的系統誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying the taut-string formula to short stays without bending correction overestimates force and may falsely suggest adequacy; using the wrong effective length, for example ignoring restraint at a damper or guide pipe, introduces systematic errors of several percent. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「舉升試驗」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift-off test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 舉升試驗是索力量測的「直接法」：把千斤頂套在錨頭上逐步加壓，當油壓提供的力剛好等於索力時，錨頭會開始離開承壓面（或螺紋環開始可旋轉），此時的油壓換算成力就是索力。換算需要千斤頂的有效面積與經校正的壓力—力量關係，因為活塞與密封的摩擦會讓同樣油壓產生的實際力略小。舉升判定點要靠位移計或游標尺觀察錨頭的微小移動，並避免一次加壓過頭使錨頭被拉離太多，改變索力本身。這個方法準確但需要接近錨頭與移除防護蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「舉升試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A lift-off test is the direct way to measure stay force: a jack is fitted over the anchor head and pressure raised gradually until the jack force just equals the stay force, when the head starts to leave its bearing surface or the ring nut can be turned; that pressure converted to force is the stay force. Conversion needs the jack’s effective area and a calibrated pressure–force relation, because piston and seal friction make the actual force slightly less than pressure times area. The lift-off point is detected by watching tiny head movement with a dial gauge or calliper, without overshooting so far that the head is pulled away and the stay force itself changes. The method is accurate but requires access to the anchor head and removal of protective caps. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lift-off test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：F = p·A·η。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: F = p·A·η.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「舉升試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lift-off test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算
knowledge.text: 舉升試驗是索力量測的「直接法」：把千斤頂套在錨頭上逐步加壓，當油壓提供的力剛好等於索力時，錨頭會開始離開承壓面（或螺紋環開始可旋轉），此時的油壓換算成力就是索力。換算需要千斤頂的有效面積與經校正的壓力—力量關係，因為活塞與密封的摩擦會讓同樣油壓產生的實際力略小。
knowledge.textEn: A lift-off test is the direct way to measure stay force: a jack is fitted over the anchor head and pressure raised gradually until the jack force just equals the stay force, when the head starts to leave its bearing surface or the ring nut can be turned; that pressure converted to force is the stay force. Conversion needs the jack’s effective area and a calibrated pressure–force relation, because piston and seal friction make the actual force slightly less than pressure times area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion" is correct?
options: 千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。
鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。
舉升試驗是索力量測的「直接法」：把千斤頂套在錨頭上逐步加壓，當油壓提供的力剛好等於索力時，錨頭會開始離開承壓面（或螺紋環開始可旋轉），此時的油壓換算成力就是索力。
optionsEn: Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force.
Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change.

A lift-off test is the direct way to measure stay force: a jack is fitted over the anchor head and pressure raised gradually until the jack force just equals the stay force, when the head starts to leave its bearing surface or the ring nut can be turned.

quiz.explanationEn: A lift-off test is the direct way to measure stay force: a jack is fitted over the anchor head and pressure raised gradually until the jack force just equals the stay force, when the head starts to leave its bearing surface or the ring nut can be turned; that pressure converted to force is the stay force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「舉升試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift-off test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：F = p·A·η。油壓 p = 45 MPa、活塞面積 A = 0.125 m²，名目力 45×10⁶×0.125 = 5,625 kN；校正係數 η = 0.985 時實際力約 5,541 kN，相差約 84 kN（1.5%）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: F = p·A·η. With p = 45 MPa and piston area A = 0.125 m², the nominal force is 45×10⁶×0.125 = 5,625 kN; with a calibration factor η = 0.985 the actual force is about 5,541 kN, a difference of about 84 kN (1.5%). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：千斤頂與壓力錶成套送有認證的試驗室校正，取得加壓與卸壓兩條曲線；試驗時以位移計記錄錨頭位移對油壓的曲線，以斜率轉折點判定舉升，並與振動法結果比對，兩者差異應在可解釋範圍內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate jack and gauge together at an accredited laboratory for both loading and unloading curves; during the test plot head displacement against pressure with a dial gauge, take lift-off at the slope change, and compare with the vibration result, expecting an explainable difference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: F = p·A·η。油壓 p = 45 MPa、活塞面積 A = 0.125 m²，名目力 45×10⁶×0.125 = 5,625 kN；校正係數 η = 0.985 時實際力約 5,541 kN，相差約 84 kN（1.5%）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: F = p·A·η. With p = 45 MPa and piston area A = 0.125 m², the nominal force is 45×10⁶×0.125 = 5,625 kN; with a calibration factor η = 0.985 the actual force is about 5,541 kN, a difference of about 84 kN (1.5%). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion", which statement holds?
options: F = p·A·η。
斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。
每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。
optionsEn: F = p·A·η.
A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics.
Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces.
quiz.explanation: F = p·A·η。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: F = p·A·η. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「舉升試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift-off test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂與壓力錶成套送有認證的試驗室校正，取得加壓與卸壓兩條曲線；試驗時以位移計記錄錨頭位移對油壓的曲線，以斜率轉折點判定舉升，並與振動法結果比對，兩者差異應在可解釋範圍內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate jack and gauge together at an accredited laboratory for both loading and unloading curves; during the test plot head displacement against pressure with a dial gauge, take lift-off at the slope change, and compare with the vibration result, expecting an explainable difference. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：舉升試驗程序要規定校正證書有效期、加壓速率、判定方法、最大容許舉升量與試驗後錨具與防護蓋的復原檢查；高空錨頭作業須有通過審查的作業平台與安全計畫，並由主管工程師核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lift-off procedure should specify calibration validity, loading rate, detection method, maximum allowable lift and post-test checks of anchorage and caps; work at elevated anchor heads needs an approved access platform and safety plan, authorised by the responsible engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：千斤頂與壓力錶未成套校正或校正過期，量得的索力可能系統性偏差數個百分點；舉升時加壓過頭使錨頭明顯離開，卸壓後夾片重新咬合位置改變，反而造成索力損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Jacks and gauges not calibrated as a set, or with expired calibration, bias forces by several percent; overshooting so the head lifts noticeably lets wedges reseat in a new position on release, actually losing stay force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 千斤頂與壓力錶成套送有認證的試驗室校正，取得加壓與卸壓兩條曲線；試驗時以位移計記錄錨頭位移對油壓的曲線，以斜率轉折點判定舉升，並與振動法結果比對，兩者差異應在可解釋範圍內。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate jack and gauge together at an accredited laboratory for both loading and unloading curves; during the test plot head displacement against pressure with a dial gauge, take lift-off at the slope change, and compare with the vibration result, expecting an explainable difference.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 舉升試驗程序要規定校正證書有效期、加壓速率、判定方法、最大容許舉升量與試驗後錨具與防護蓋的復原檢查；高空錨頭作業須有通過審查的作業平台與安全計畫，並由主管工程師核准。
knowledge.textEn: The lift-off procedure should specify calibration validity, loading rate, detection method, maximum allowable lift and post-test checks of anchorage and caps; work at elevated anchor heads needs an approved access platform and safety plan, authorised by the responsible engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
千斤頂與壓力錶成套送有認證的試驗室校正，取得加壓與卸壓兩條曲線。
施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Calibrate jack and gauge together at an accredited laboratory for both loading and unloading curves.
During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force.
quiz.explanation: 千斤頂與壓力錶成套送有認證的試驗室校正，取得加壓與卸壓兩條曲線；試驗時以位移計記錄錨頭位移對油壓的曲線，以斜率轉折點判定舉升，並與振動法結果比對，兩者差異應在可解釋範圍內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate jack and gauge together at an accredited laboratory for both loading and unloading curves; during the test plot head displacement against pressure with a dial gauge, take lift-off at the slope change, and compare with the vibration result, expecting an explainable difference. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「舉升試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift-off test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂與壓力錶未成套校正或校正過期，量得的索力可能系統性偏差數個百分點；舉升時加壓過頭使錨頭明顯離開，卸壓後夾片重新咬合位置改變，反而造成索力損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Jacks and gauges not calibrated as a set, or with expired calibration, bias forces by several percent; overshooting so the head lifts noticeably lets wedges reseat in a new position on release, actually losing stay force. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個方法準確但需要接近錨頭與移除防護蓋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The method is accurate but requires access to the anchor head and removal of protective caps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 千斤頂與壓力錶未成套校正或校正過期，量得的索力可能系統性偏差數個百分點；舉升時加壓過頭使錨頭明顯離開，卸壓後夾片重新咬合位置改變，反而造成索力損失。
knowledge.textEn: Jacks and gauges not calibrated as a set, or with expired calibration, bias forces by several percent; overshooting so the head lifts noticeably lets wedges reseat in a new position on release, actually losing stay force.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「千斤頂舉升試驗與壓力—力量換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift-off tests and pressure-to-force conversion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。
千斤頂與壓力錶未成套校正或校正過期，量得的索力可能系統性偏差數個百分點；舉升時加壓過頭使錨頭明顯離開，卸壓後夾片重新咬合位置改變，反而造成索力損失。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change.
Jacks and gauges not calibrated as a set, or with expired calibration, bias forces by several percent.
quiz.explanation: 千斤頂與壓力錶未成套校正或校正過期，量得的索力可能系統性偏差數個百分點；舉升時加壓過頭使錨頭明顯離開，卸壓後夾片重新咬合位置改變，反而造成索力損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Jacks and gauges not calibrated as a set, or with expired calibration, bias forces by several percent; overshooting so the head lifts noticeably lets wedges reseat in a new position on release, actually losing stay force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變」與「允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep" and "Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「夾片回縮量」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge draw-in” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜索完成後索力並非永遠不變。夾片式錨具在千斤頂卸載時夾片會向錨板內縮入數毫米，這個回縮對短索的影響遠大於長索，因為同樣的長度損失在短索中代表較大的應變。低鬆弛鋼絞線在使用應力約 0.45 GUTS 下的鬆弛損失很小，但混凝土塔與混凝土橋面的徐變與收縮會使錨點逐年移動，索力因此重新分配。營運初期幾年的漂移最明顯，之後趨緩；因此不少斜張橋在通車前或通車後數年安排一次全面複測與再調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「夾片回縮量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stay forces do not stay constant after completion. With wedge anchorages, the wedges draw in a few millimetres when the jack is released, and this matters far more for short stays, since the same length loss is a larger strain. Low-relaxation strand at a service stress of about 0.45 GUTS loses little to relaxation, but creep and shrinkage of concrete pylons and decks move anchor points year by year and redistribute stay forces. Drift is most visible in the first years of service and then slows, so many cable-stayed bridges schedule a full re-measurement and re-tuning before opening or a few years after. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wedge draw-in” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：夾片回縮 6 mm 的應力損失 Δσ = E·Δ/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stress loss from 6 mm of wedge draw-in is Δσ = E·Δ/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「夾片回縮量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wedge draw-in”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變
knowledge.titleEn: Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep
knowledge.text: 斜索完成後索力並非永遠不變。夾片式錨具在千斤頂卸載時夾片會向錨板內縮入數毫米，這個回縮對短索的影響遠大於長索，因為同樣的長度損失在短索中代表較大的應變。
knowledge.textEn: Stay forces do not stay constant after completion. With wedge anchorages, the wedges draw in a few millimetres when the jack is released, and this matters far more for short stays, since the same length loss is a larger strain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep" is correct?
options: 斜索完成後索力並非永遠不變。
鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。
只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。
optionsEn: Stay forces do not stay constant after completion.
Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change.
If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 斜索完成後索力並非永遠不變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stay forces do not stay constant after completion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「夾片回縮量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge draw-in” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：夾片回縮 6 mm 的應力損失 Δσ = E·Δ/L。L = 250 m 時 Δσ = 195,000×6/250,000 ≈ 4.7 MPa；L = 40 m 時 Δσ = 195,000×6/40,000 ≈ 29.3 MPa，約為 650 MPa 使用應力的 4.5%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stress loss from 6 mm of wedge draw-in is Δσ = E·Δ/L. For L = 250 m, Δσ = 195,000×6/250,000 ≈ 4.7 MPa; for L = 40 m, Δσ = 195,000×6/40,000 ≈ 29.3 MPa, about 4.5% of a 650 MPa service stress. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張拉時記錄每根索的回縮量，短索可採用回縮補償張拉或可調式錨具；通車前與通車後定期以振動法量測全部索力，並以時間相依分析預測的漂移曲線比較，判斷偏差來自正常徐變或異常（錨具滑移、斷絲）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record draw-in for every stay during stressing and use draw-in compensation or adjustable anchorages for short stays; measure all stay forces by vibration before and periodically after opening, comparing with drift curves from time-dependent analysis to tell normal creep from anomalies such as anchor slip or broken wires.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 夾片回縮 6 mm 的應力損失 Δσ = E·Δ/L。L = 250 m 時 Δσ = 195,000×6/250,000 ≈ 4.7 MPa；L = 40 m 時 Δσ = 195,000×6/40,000 ≈ 29.3 MPa，約為 650 MPa 使用應力的 4.5%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Stress loss from 6 mm of wedge draw-in is Δσ = E·Δ/L. For L = 250 m, Δσ = 195,000×6/250,000 ≈ 4.7 MPa; for L = 40 m, Δσ = 195,000×6/40,000 ≈ 29.3 MPa, about 4.5% of a 650 MPa service stress. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep", which statement holds?
options: 調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
夾片回縮 6 mm 的應力損失 Δσ = E·Δ/L。
斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。
optionsEn: Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
Stress loss from 6 mm of wedge draw-in is Δσ = E·Δ/L.
Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again.
quiz.explanation: 夾片回縮 6 mm 的應力損失 Δσ = E·Δ/L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stress loss from 6 mm of wedge draw-in is Δσ = E·Δ/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「夾片回縮量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wedge draw-in” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張拉時記錄每根索的回縮量，短索可採用回縮補償張拉或可調式錨具；通車前與通車後定期以振動法量測全部索力，並以時間相依分析預測的漂移曲線比較，判斷偏差來自正常徐變或異常（錨具滑移、斷絲）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record draw-in for every stay during stressing and use draw-in compensation or adjustable anchorages for short stays; measure all stay forces by vibration before and periodically after opening, comparing with drift curves from time-dependent analysis to tell normal creep from anomalies such as anchor slip or broken wires. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計文件要列出每根索的預期長期漂移與再調整時點，交接時提供漂移預測曲線；營運單位依此安排複測，並把每次複測的結果與預測比較存檔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design documents should list each stay’s expected long-term drift and re-tuning time, with drift prediction curves at handover; the operator schedules re-measurements accordingly and archives each result against the prediction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若短索未補償夾片回縮，成橋索力可能低於目標數個百分點，橋面局部下沉；長期漂移若沒有被監測，部分索力逐年升高而接近上限，部分卻鬆弛並在風中振動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Short stays without draw-in compensation can end several percent below target, letting the deck sag locally; unmonitored long-term drift lets some stays creep toward their limit year by year while others slacken and vibrate in wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 張拉時記錄每根索的回縮量，短索可採用回縮補償張拉或可調式錨具；通車前與通車後定期以振動法量測全部索力，並以時間相依分析預測的漂移曲線比較，判斷偏差來自正常徐變或異常（錨具滑移、斷絲）。
knowledge.textEn: Record draw-in for every stay during stressing and use draw-in compensation or adjustable anchorages for short stays; measure all stay forces by vibration before and periodically after opening, comparing with drift curves from time-dependent analysis to tell normal creep from anomalies such as anchor slip or broken wires.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計文件要列出每根索的預期長期漂移與再調整時點，交接時提供漂移預測曲線；營運單位依此安排複測，並把每次複測的結果與預測比較存檔。
knowledge.textEn: Design documents should list each stay’s expected long-term drift and re-tuning time, with drift prediction curves at handover; the operator schedules re-measurements accordingly and archives each result against the prediction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。
張拉時記錄每根索的回縮量，短索可採用回縮補償張拉或可調式錨具。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature.
Record draw-in for every stay during stressing and use draw-in compensation or adjustable anchorages for short stays.
quiz.explanation: 張拉時記錄每根索的回縮量，短索可採用回縮補償張拉或可調式錨具；通車前與通車後定期以振動法量測全部索力，並以時間相依分析預測的漂移曲線比較，判斷偏差來自正常徐變或異常（錨具滑移、斷絲）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record draw-in for every stay during stressing and use draw-in compensation or adjustable anchorages for short stays; measure all stay forces by vibration before and periodically after opening, comparing with drift curves from time-dependent analysis to tell normal creep from anomalies such as anchor slip or broken wires. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「夾片回縮量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wedge draw-in” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若短索未補償夾片回縮，成橋索力可能低於目標數個百分點，橋面局部下沉；長期漂移若沒有被監測，部分索力逐年升高而接近上限，部分卻鬆弛並在風中振動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Short stays without draw-in compensation can end several percent below target, letting the deck sag locally; unmonitored long-term drift lets some stays creep toward their limit year by year while others slacken and vibrate in wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：營運初期幾年的漂移最明顯，之後趨緩；因此不少斜張橋在通車前或通車後數年安排一次全面複測與再調整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Drift is most visible in the first years of service and then slows, so many cable-stayed bridges schedule a full re-measurement and re-tuning before opening or a few years after.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若短索未補償夾片回縮，成橋索力可能低於目標數個百分點，橋面局部下沉；長期漂移若沒有被監測，部分索力逐年升高而接近上限，部分卻鬆弛並在風中振動。
knowledge.textEn: Short stays without draw-in compensation can end several percent below target, letting the deck sag locally; unmonitored long-term drift lets some stays creep toward their limit year by year while others slacken and vibrate in wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期索力漂移：夾片回縮、鬆弛與徐變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term force drift: draw-in, relaxation and creep" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若短索未補償夾片回縮，成橋索力可能低於目標數個百分點，橋面局部下沉；長期漂移若沒有被監測，部分索力逐年升高而接近上限，部分卻鬆弛並在風中振動。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。
optionsEn: Short stays without draw-in compensation can end several percent below target, letting the deck sag locally.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 若短索未補償夾片回縮，成橋索力可能低於目標數個百分點，橋面局部下沉；長期漂移若沒有被監測，部分索力逐年升高而接近上限，部分卻鬆弛並在風中振動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Short stays without draw-in compensation can end several percent below target, letting the deck sag locally; unmonitored long-term drift lets some stays creep toward their limit year by year while others slacken and vibrate in wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索力允收容許值」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force acceptance tolerances” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 調索不可能讓每根索都精準等於目標，因此需要明確的允收準則：通常同時規定單根索的容許偏差、同一索組（例如同一塔同一側）的總和偏差，以及橋面線形與塔頂位置的容許誤差。單根偏差反映局部問題，總和偏差反映整體受力是否正確，線形則反映使用性。營運期的再調整則是一個工程決策：要考慮偏差的趨勢、原因、對構件安全的影響、調整的風險（錨具反覆調整、交通管制）與成本。Freyssinet 公開資料把局部再張拉或放鬆列為斜索維護手段之一，並建議服役約 10 至 20 年後抽樣檢驗鋼絞線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索力允收容許值」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tuning can never make every stay exactly equal to its target, so clear acceptance criteria are needed: usually an allowable deviation for each stay, a limit on the summed deviation of a stay group such as one side of one pylon, and tolerances on deck profile and pylon position. Single-stay deviation reveals local problems, group sums reveal whether global load sharing is right, and the profile governs serviceability. In service, re-tuning is an engineering decision weighing the trend and cause of deviation, its effect on member safety, the risks of adjustment (repeated anchorage work, traffic management) and cost. Freyssinet’s public material lists partial re-tensioning or de-tensioning as a stay maintenance measure and recommends sampling strands after about 10 to 20 years of service. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Force acceptance tolerances” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若單索容許偏差 ±5%，某索目標 5,000 kN、實測 5,200 kN 為 +4%，合格；另一索實測 4,700 kN 為 −6%，不合格。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a ±5% single-stay tolerance, a stay with a 5,000 kN target measuring 5,200 kN is +4% and passes; another measuring 4,700 kN is −6% and fails.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索力允收容許值」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Force acceptance tolerances”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工
knowledge.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities
knowledge.text: 調索不可能讓每根索都精準等於目標，因此需要明確的允收準則：通常同時規定單根索的容許偏差、同一索組（例如同一塔同一側）的總和偏差，以及橋面線形與塔頂位置的容許誤差。單根偏差反映局部問題，總和偏差反映整體受力是否正確，線形則反映使用性。
knowledge.textEn: Tuning can never make every stay exactly equal to its target, so clear acceptance criteria are needed: usually an allowable deviation for each stay, a limit on the summed deviation of a stay group such as one side of one pylon, and tolerances on deck profile and pylon position. Single-stay deviation reveals local problems, group sums reveal whether global load sharing is right, and the profile governs serviceability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities" is correct?
options: 只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。
調索不可能讓每根索都精準等於目標，因此需要明確的允收準則：通常同時規定單根索的容許偏差、同一索組（例如同一塔同一側）的總和偏差，以及橋面線形與塔頂位置的容許誤差。
斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。
optionsEn: If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct.

Tuning can never make every stay exactly equal to its target, so clear acceptance criteria are needed: usually an allowable deviation for each stay, a limit on the summed deviation of a stay group such as one side of one pylon, and tolerances on deck profile and pylon position.
A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics.
quiz.explanation: 調索不可能讓每根索都精準等於目標，因此需要明確的允收準則：通常同時規定單根索的容許偏差、同一索組（例如同一塔同一側）的總和偏差，以及橋面線形與塔頂位置的容許誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tuning can never make every stay exactly equal to its target, so clear acceptance criteria are needed: usually an allowable deviation for each stay, a limit on the summed deviation of a stay group such as one side of one pylon, and tolerances on deck profile and pylon position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索力允收容許值」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Force acceptance tolerances” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若單索容許偏差 ±5%，某索目標 5,000 kN、實測 5,200 kN 為 +4%，合格；另一索實測 4,700 kN 為 −6%，不合格。若該索組 8 根的總和偏差為 +0.8%，在 ±2% 內，表示整體受力正確、只需局部調整 −6% 那根。容許值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a ±5% single-stay tolerance, a stay with a 5,000 kN target measuring 5,200 kN is +4% and passes; another measuring 4,700 kN is −6% and fails. If the summed deviation of that 8-stay group is +0.8%, within ±2%, global load sharing is correct and only the −6% stay needs local adjustment. Tolerances are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收時以溫度修正後的索力、在同一量測時窗內完成的線形測量與塔頂位置一起評估；不合格項目先複測確認，再以影響矩陣計算局部調整量並模擬其對鄰索的影響，調整後重新量測整個索組。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At acceptance assess temperature-corrected forces together with profile and pylon position surveyed in the same window; re-measure failed items first, then compute local adjustments with the influence matrix and simulate their effect on neighbours, re-measuring the whole group afterwards.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若單索容許偏差 ±5%，某索目標 5,000 kN、實測 5,200 kN 為 +4%，合格；另一索實測 4,700 kN 為 −6%，不合格。若該索組 8 根的總和偏差為 +0.8%，在 ±2% 內，表示整體受力正確、只需局部調整 −6% 那根。容許值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a ±5% single-stay tolerance, a stay with a 5,000 kN target measuring 5,200 kN is +4% and passes; another measuring 4,700 kN is −6% and fails. If the summed deviation of that 8-stay group is +0.8%, within ±2%, global load sharing is correct and only the −6% stay needs local adjustment. Tolerances are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities", which statement holds?
options: 每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。
施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。
若單索容許偏差 ±5%，某索目標 5,000 kN、實測 5,200 kN 為 +4%，合格；另一索實測 4,700 kN 為 −6%，不合格。
optionsEn: Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces.
During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force.
With a ±5% single-stay tolerance, a stay with a 5,000 kN target measuring 5,200 kN is +4% and passes; another measuring 4,700 kN is −6% and fails.
quiz.explanation: 若單索容許偏差 ±5%，某索目標 5,000 kN、實測 5,200 kN 為 +4%，合格；另一索實測 4,700 kN 為 −6%，不合格。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a ±5% single-stay tolerance, a stay with a 5,000 kN target measuring 5,200 kN is +4% and passes; another measuring 4,700 kN is −6% and fails. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「索力允收容許值」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Force acceptance tolerances” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 驗收時以溫度修正後的索力、在同一量測時窗內完成的線形測量與塔頂位置一起評估；不合格項目先複測確認，再以影響矩陣計算局部調整量並模擬其對鄰索的影響，調整後重新量測整個索組。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At acceptance assess temperature-corrected forces together with profile and pylon position surveyed in the same window; re-measure failed items first, then compute local adjustments with the influence matrix and simulate their effect on neighbours, re-measuring the whole group afterwards. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約與規範要寫明索力、索組總和、線形與塔位的允收準則、量測方法與溫度修正；營運期的再調整須由主管工程師依評估報告核准，並記錄調整前後的完整資料，作為下一次決策的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Contracts and specifications should state acceptance criteria for stay forces, group sums, profile and pylon position, with measurement methods and temperature correction; in-service re-tuning must be approved by the responsible engineer on the basis of an assessment report, with full before-and-after data recorded as the basis for the next decision.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只看單根索偏差而不看索組總和，可能出現每根都合格、但整側系統性偏高或偏低的情況，塔頂偏位與橋面線形因而超出容許；營運期頻繁小幅調整則可能損傷錨具並增加交通中斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only single-stay deviations can pass every stay while a whole side is systematically high or low, pushing pylon displacement and deck profile out of tolerance; frequent small in-service adjustments can damage anchorages and multiply traffic disruptions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收時以溫度修正後的索力、在同一量測時窗內完成的線形測量與塔頂位置一起評估；不合格項目先複測確認，再以影響矩陣計算局部調整量並模擬其對鄰索的影響，調整後重新量測整個索組。
knowledge.textEn: At acceptance assess temperature-corrected forces together with profile and pylon position surveyed in the same window; re-measure failed items first, then compute local adjustments with the influence matrix and simulate their effect on neighbours, re-measuring the whole group afterwards.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約與規範要寫明索力、索組總和、線形與塔位的允收準則、量測方法與溫度修正；營運期的再調整須由主管工程師依評估報告核准，並記錄調整前後的完整資料，作為下一次決策的基準。

quiz.question: 要驗證「允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities"?
options: 驗收時以溫度修正後的索力、在同一量測時窗內完成的線形測量與塔頂位置一起評估。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。
optionsEn: At acceptance assess temperature-corrected forces together with profile and pylon position surveyed in the same window.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately.
quiz.explanation: 驗收時以溫度修正後的索力、在同一量測時窗內完成的線形測量與塔頂位置一起評估；不合格項目先複測確認，再以影響矩陣計算局部調整量並模擬其對鄰索的影響，調整後重新量測整個索組。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At acceptance assess temperature-corrected forces together with profile and pylon position surveyed in the same window; re-measure failed items first, then compute local adjustments with the influence matrix and simulate their effect on neighbours, re-measuring the whole group afterwards. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索力允收容許值」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Force acceptance tolerances” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只看單根索偏差而不看索組總和，可能出現每根都合格、但整側系統性偏高或偏低的情況，塔頂偏位與橋面線形因而超出容許；營運期頻繁小幅調整則可能損傷錨具並增加交通中斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only single-stay deviations can pass every stay while a whole side is systematically high or low, pushing pylon displacement and deck profile out of tolerance; frequent small in-service adjustments can damage anchorages and multiply traffic disruptions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Freyssinet 公開資料把局部再張拉或放鬆列為斜索維護手段之一，並建議服役約 10 至 20 年後抽樣檢驗鋼絞線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Freyssinet’s public material lists partial re-tensioning or de-tensioning as a stay maintenance measure and recommends sampling strands after about 10 to 20 years of service.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每根斜索都在容許偏差內，整座橋的受力就一定正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every stay is within tolerance, the whole bridge’s load sharing must be correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只看單根索偏差而不看索組總和，可能出現每根都合格、但整側系統性偏高或偏低的情況，塔頂偏位與橋面線形因而超出容許；營運期頻繁小幅調整則可能損傷錨具並增加交通中斷。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only single-stay deviations can pass every stay while a whole side is systematically high or low, pushing pylon displacement and deck profile out of tolerance; frequent small in-service adjustments can damage anchorages and multiply traffic disruptions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「允收準則、再調整決策與責任分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acceptance criteria, re-tuning decisions and responsibilities" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若只看單根索偏差而不看索組總和，可能出現每根都合格、但整側系統性偏高或偏低的情況，塔頂偏位與橋面線形因而超出容許。
斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Checking only single-stay deviations can pass every stay while a whole side is systematically high or low, pushing pylon displacement and deck profile out of tolerance.
A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics.
quiz.explanation: 若只看單根索偏差而不看索組總和，可能出現每根都合格、但整側系統性偏高或偏低的情況，塔頂偏位與橋面線形因而超出容許；營運期頻繁小幅調整則可能損傷錨具並增加交通中斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only single-stay deviations can pass every stay while a whole side is systematically high or low, pushing pylon displacement and deck profile out of tolerance; frequent small in-service adjustments can damage anchorages and multiply traffic disruptions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 斜張索雨風振動抑制
titleEn: Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables
summary: 雨風振動是斜張索在中等風速與降雨同時出現時發生的大振幅振動，1980 年代在日本名港西大橋首次被系統記錄，之後在諾曼第大橋與伊拉斯謨大橋等通車初期都曾出現。本課從上緣水線的氣動機制、史庫頓數門檻、HDPE 套管的螺旋凸肋，到外置與內置阻尼器的選型、交叉索、現場監測、自由衰減驗收、錨口彎曲疲勞與阻尼器維護，建立從量測到對策與驗收的完整流程。
summaryEn: Rain–wind vibration is a large-amplitude motion of stay cables that occurs when moderate wind and rain coincide; it was first systematically recorded on Japan’s Meiko-Nishi Bridge in the 1980s and later appeared soon after opening on bridges such as the Pont de Normandie and the Erasmus Bridge. The course builds a full workflow from measurement to remedy and acceptance: the aerodynamics of the upper rivulet, the Scruton number threshold, helical ribs on HDPE ducts, selection of external and internal dampers, cross-ties, field monitoring, free-decay acceptance, bending fatigue at the anchor exit and damper maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 斜張橋與斜索系統

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為一根長 300 m 的斜索選擇抑振方案。已知 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、固有阻尼 ζ₀ = 0.15%，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m，Sc₀ = 60×0.0015/0.032 ≈ 2.8，遠低於門檻約 10。方案 A：只用外置阻尼器，需 ζ ≥ 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%，附加阻尼至少 0.38%，所需位置 x_d ≥ 2×0.0038×300 ≈ 2.3 m（以最佳係數計）；保留 50% 餘裕取 ζ_add = 0.57%，x_d ≈ 3.4 m。方案 B：採用螺旋凸肋套管，若試驗證明門檻可放寬到約 5，則需 ζ ≥ 5×0.032/60 ≈ 0.27%，附加阻尼 0.12% 即可，x_d ≈ 0.72 m，內置阻尼器就可能達到；代價是阻力係數若由 0.55 增至 0.6，50 m/s 下每根索的風力由約 1,531×0.55×0.16×300 ≈ 40.4 kN 增至約 44.1 kN（+9%）。若索長改為 450 m，方案 A 的位置需增至約 5.1 m。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: choose a suppression scheme for a 300 m stay with m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and inherent damping ζ₀ = 0.15%. With ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m, Sc₀ = 60×0.0015/0.032 ≈ 2.8, far below the threshold of about 10. Option A, external damper only: ζ ≥ 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53% requires at least 0.38% added damping, so the position is x_d ≥ 2×0.0038×300 ≈ 2.3 m at optimum coefficient; with 50% margin, ζ_add = 0.57% and x_d ≈ 3.4 m. Option B, helical-rib duct: if tests show the threshold can be relaxed to about 5, then ζ ≥ 5×0.032/60 ≈ 0.27% needs only 0.12% added damping and x_d ≈ 0.72 m, within reach of an internal damper; the price is drag rising from 0.55 to 0.6, so wind force per stay at 50 m/s goes from about 1,531×0.55×0.16×300 ≈ 40.4 kN to about 44.1 kN (+9%). For a 450 m stay, option A’s position grows to about 5.1 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」與「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay" and "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「上緣水線」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Upper water rivulet” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 乾燥的圓形斜索在一般風中很少大幅振動，因為圓形斷面沒有使振動自我放大的氣動力。下雨時，雨水沿傾斜的索面流下，在下緣與上緣各形成一條水線；上緣水線的位置由重力、表面張力與風的拖曳力共同決定，會隨索的振動在圓周方向來回移動。水線改變了斷面的有效形狀與氣流分離點，使氣動升力隨索的運動而變化，相位若恰好與速度同向，就等於負阻尼，把風的能量持續輸入索中。這種振動多發生在斜索沿風向往下傾斜、風速中等、雨量適中時，雨太大或太小、風太強都可能使水線無法穩定存在。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「上緣水線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dry circular stay rarely vibrates heavily in ordinary wind, because a circular section produces no self-amplifying aerodynamic force. In rain, water running down the inclined surface forms rivulets along the lower and upper sides; the upper rivulet’s position, set by gravity, surface tension and wind drag, oscillates around the circumference as the cable moves. The rivulet changes the effective section shape and flow separation, so lift varies with cable motion; when it is in phase with velocity it acts as negative damping and keeps feeding wind energy into the cable. The vibration typically occurs on stays inclined downward in the wind direction, at moderate wind speed and moderate rainfall; too much or too little rain, or very strong wind, can prevent a stable rivulet. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Upper water rivulet” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「上緣水線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Upper water rivulet”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定
knowledge.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay
knowledge.text: 乾燥的圓形斜索在一般風中很少大幅振動，因為圓形斷面沒有使振動自我放大的氣動力。下雨時，雨水沿傾斜的索面流下，在下緣與上緣各形成一條水線；上緣水線的位置由重力、表面張力與風的拖曳力共同決定，會隨索的振動在圓周方向來回移動。
knowledge.textEn: A dry circular stay rarely vibrates heavily in ordinary wind, because a circular section produces no self-amplifying aerodynamic force. In rain, water running down the inclined surface forms rivulets along the lower and upper sides; the upper rivulet’s position, set by gravity, surface tension and wind drag, oscillates around the circumference as the cable moves.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay" is correct?
options: 雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。
乾燥的圓形斜索在一般風中很少大幅振動，因為圓形斷面沒有使振動自我放大的氣動力。
斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。
optionsEn: Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration.
A dry circular stay rarely vibrates heavily in ordinary wind, because a circular section produces no self-amplifying aerodynamic force.
Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration.
quiz.explanation: 乾燥的圓形斜索在一般風中很少大幅振動，因為圓形斷面沒有使振動自我放大的氣動力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A dry circular stay rarely vibrates heavily in ordinary wind, because a circular section produces no self-amplifying aerodynamic force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上緣水線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Upper water rivulet” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。若 f = 1.2 Hz、D = 0.16 m，風速 U = 12 m/s 時 U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5；若觀測的發生風速範圍為 8 至 15 m/s，對應 U_r 約 42 至 78。以 U_r 表示可把不同索徑與頻率的觀測放在同一張圖比較。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D). With f = 1.2 Hz and D = 0.16 m, U = 12 m/s gives U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5; an observed onset range of 8 to 15 m/s corresponds to U_r of about 42 to 78. Expressing data as U_r lets cables of different diameters and frequencies be compared on one chart. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞人工降雨試驗或現場同步紀錄（索加速度、風速風向、雨量）辨識振動發生的風速、風向與降雨區間，並以攝影確認上緣水線的存在與移動；把結果換成折算風速與相對風向角，與文獻中的發生區間比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video; convert results to reduced velocity and relative yaw angle and compare with onset ranges in the literature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 折算風速 U_r = U/(f·D)。若 f = 1.2 Hz、D = 0.16 m，風速 U = 12 m/s 時 U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5；若觀測的發生風速範圍為 8 至 15 m/s，對應 U_r 約 42 至 78。以 U_r 表示可把不同索徑與頻率的觀測放在同一張圖比較。數值為教學假設。

With f = 1.2 Hz and D = 0.16 m, U = 12 m/s gives U_r = 12/(1.2×0.16) = 62.5; an observed onset range of 8 to 15 m/s corresponds to U_r of about 42 to 78. Expressing data as U_r lets cables of different diameters and frequencies be compared on one chart. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。
內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。

optionsEn: Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest.
Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance.
Reduced velocity U_r = U/(f·D).

steps.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上緣水線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Upper water rivulet” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞人工降雨試驗或現場同步紀錄（索加速度、風速風向、雨量）辨識振動發生的風速、風向與降雨區間，並以攝影確認上緣水線的存在與移動；把結果換成折算風速與相對風向角，與文獻中的發生區間比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video; convert results to reduced velocity and relative yaw angle and compare with onset ranges in the literature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜張橋設計階段就要依索的傾角、方位與當地盛行風雨評估雨風振動風險，並在設計報告中列出每組索的對策（表面處理、阻尼、交叉索）與預留空間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At design stage, assess rain–wind risk from each stay’s inclination, orientation and the local prevailing wind and rain, and list in the design report the remedy for each stay group (surface treatment, damping, cross-ties) with space reserved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm; sustained large amplitudes cause bending fatigue at the anchor exit, wear ducts and caps, alarm users and force traffic restrictions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Identify the wind speed, direction and rainfall range of onset by wind-tunnel tests with artificial rain or synchronised field records of cable acceleration, wind and rainfall, confirming the presence and motion of the upper rivulet by video; convert results to reduced velocity and relative yaw angle and compare with onset ranges in the literature.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上緣水線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Upper water rivulet” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm; sustained large amplitudes cause bending fatigue at the anchor exit, wear ducts and caps, alarm users and force traffic restrictions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種振動多發生在斜索沿風向往下傾斜、風速中等、雨量適中時，雨太大或太小、風太強都可能使水線無法穩定存在。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The vibration typically occurs on stays inclined downward in the wind direction, at moderate wind speed and moderate rainfall; too much or too little rain, or very strong wind, can prevent a stable rivulet.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。
斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm.
Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration.
quiz.explanation: 若把雨風振動誤判為一般渦振而只加裝針對高頻的小型阻尼，振動仍會在下一場風雨中出現；長期大振幅使錨口彎曲疲勞、套管與防水帽磨損，並引起使用者恐慌與交通管制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Misreading rain–wind vibration as ordinary vortex shedding and fitting only small high-frequency dampers leaves it to return in the next rainstorm; sustained large amplitudes cause bending fatigue at the anchor exit, wear ducts and caps, alarm users and force traffic restrictions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「史庫頓數」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scruton number” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 史庫頓數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) 把索的單位長度質量 m、阻尼比 ζ 與空氣密度 ρ、索徑 D 合成一個無因次數，表示結構消耗能量的能力相對於氣流能輸入的能量。Sc 越大，雨風振動與渦振越不容易發展。長斜索的固有阻尼通常只有千分之一到千分之幾，Sc 往往只有個位數；工程上常被引用的門檻約為 10，表面經過有效處理時可放寬。由於 m 與 D 由結構需要決定，工程師真正能調整的是阻尼比，因此 Sc 準則直接轉化為「需要多少附加阻尼」的設計目標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「史庫頓數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) combines mass per metre m, damping ratio ζ, air density ρ and diameter D into a dimensionless measure of the structure’s ability to dissipate energy relative to what the flow can feed in. The larger Sc, the less likely rain–wind or vortex vibration can develop. Long stays usually have inherent damping of only one to a few thousandths, giving Sc in single figures; a commonly cited threshold is about 10, relaxable where effective surface treatment is used. Since m and D are fixed by structural needs, the variable engineers can really change is damping, so the Sc criterion becomes a target for added damping. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Scruton number” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「史庫頓數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Scruton number”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入
knowledge.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input
knowledge.text: 史庫頓數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) 把索的單位長度質量 m、阻尼比 ζ 與空氣密度 ρ、索徑 D 合成一個無因次數，表示結構消耗能量的能力相對於氣流能輸入的能量。Sc 越大，雨風振動與渦振越不容易發展。
knowledge.textEn: The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) combines mass per metre m, damping ratio ζ, air density ρ and diameter D into a dimensionless measure of the structure’s ability to dissipate energy relative to what the flow can feed in. The larger Sc, the less likely rain–wind or vortex vibration can develop.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input" is correct?
options: 斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。

史庫頓數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) 把索的單位長度質量 m、阻尼比 ζ 與空氣密度 ρ、索徑 D 合成一個無因次數，表示結構消耗能量的能力相對於氣流能輸入的能量。
optionsEn: Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration.
The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects.

The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) combines mass per metre m, damping ratio ζ, air density ρ and diameter D into a dimensionless measure of the structure’s ability to dissipate energy relative to what the flow can feed in.
quiz.explanation: 史庫頓數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) 把索的單位長度質量 m、阻尼比 ζ 與空氣密度 ρ、索徑 D 合成一個無因次數，表示結構消耗能量的能力相對於氣流能輸入的能量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) combines mass per metre m, damping ratio ζ, air density ρ and diameter D into a dimensionless measure of the structure’s ability to dissipate energy relative to what the flow can feed in. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「史庫頓數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scruton number” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。固有阻尼 ζ = 0.2% 時 Sc = 60×0.002/0.032 = 3.75；要達到 Sc = 10，需 ζ = 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%，即至少增加約 0.33% 的附加阻尼。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m. Inherent damping ζ = 0.2% gives Sc = 60×0.002/0.032 = 3.75; reaching Sc = 10 needs ζ = 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%, at least about 0.33% of added damping. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m. Inherent damping ζ = 0.2% gives Sc = 60×0.002/0.032 = 3.75; reaching Sc = 10 needs ζ = 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%, at least about 0.33% of added damping. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input", which statement holds?
options: 取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。
交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。
只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。
optionsEn: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m.
Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation.
An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration.
quiz.explanation: 取 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³, ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「史庫頓數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scruton number” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。量測要涵蓋最可能被激發的數個模態，因為同一阻尼器在不同模態提供的阻尼不同。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜索規格書應以 Sc 或最低對數遞減率表示阻尼要求，並註明適用的模態範圍與量測方法；驗收報告須逐組列出量測的阻尼與計算的 Sc。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The stay specification should express damping requirements as Sc or a minimum logarithmic decrement, state the applicable mode range and test method, and the acceptance report should list measured damping and computed Sc for each group.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生；阻尼器只針對第一模態最佳化，較高模態的 Sc 可能仍低於門檻。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur; a damper optimised only for mode 1 can leave higher modes below the threshold. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
