knowledge.text: 以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。量測要涵蓋最可能被激發的數個模態，因為同一阻尼器在不同模態提供的阻尼不同。
knowledge.textEn: Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 斜索規格書應以 Sc 或最低對數遞減率表示阻尼要求，並註明適用的模態範圍與量測方法；驗收報告須逐組列出量測的阻尼與計算的 Sc。
knowledge.textEn: The stay specification should express damping requirements as Sc or a minimum logarithmic decrement, state the applicable mode range and test method, and the acceptance report should list measured damping and computed Sc for each group.

quiz.question: 要驗證「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。
斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance.
Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue.
quiz.explanation: 以自由衰減試驗量測每組代表性斜索的固有阻尼（未裝阻尼器時），計算 Sc 並與門檻比較；裝阻尼器後再量一次，確認 Sc 達標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure inherent damping of representative stays in each group by free decay before dampers are fitted, compute Sc against the threshold, then measure again after fitting to confirm compliance; cover the several modes most likely to be excited, because one damper gives different damping in different modes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「史庫頓數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scruton number” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生；阻尼器只針對第一模態最佳化，較高模態的 Sc 可能仍低於門檻。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur; a damper optimised only for mode 1 can leave higher modes below the threshold. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於 m 與 D 由結構需要決定，工程師真正能調整的是阻尼比，因此 Sc 準則直接轉化為「需要多少附加阻尼」的設計目標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Since m and D are fixed by structural needs, the variable engineers can really change is damping, so the Sc criterion becomes a target for added damping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生；阻尼器只針對第一模態最佳化，較高模態的 Sc 可能仍低於門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur; a damper optimised only for mode 1 can leave higher modes below the threshold.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「史庫頓數：用質量與阻尼對抗氣動輸入」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The Scruton number: mass and damping against aerodynamic input" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。
若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects.
Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur.
quiz.explanation: 若以設計假設的固有阻尼（例如 0.5%）計算 Sc 而不量測，實際只有 0.1% 至 0.2% 時，振動仍會發生；阻尼器只針對第一模態最佳化，較高模態的 Sc 可能仍低於門檻。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Computing Sc from an assumed inherent damping such as 0.5% without measurement, when the real value is only 0.1% to 0.2%, leaves vibration to occur; a damper optimised only for mode 1 can leave higher modes below the threshold. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩」與「外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples" and "External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙螺旋凸肋套管」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-helix ribbed duct” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 既然雨風振動仰賴穩定的上緣水線，最直接的對策就是讓水線無法形成。常見做法是在 HDPE 外套管表面擠出雙螺旋凸肋，雨水被凸肋打斷、沿螺旋方向分散流下；另一種做法是在表面壓出凹窩或其他紋理。供應商公開資料指出其主套管以雙螺旋凸紋打斷水流以限制雨風振動，阻力係數約 0.6；里翁—安提里翁大橋的斜索也以螺旋凸條保護。表面處理不需要維護機構，但會增加套管的風阻，使塔與橋面承受更大的風荷載，凸肋的高度與螺距需要在抑振與阻力之間取捨。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙螺旋凸肋套管」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Since rain–wind vibration depends on a stable upper rivulet, the most direct remedy is to stop it forming. A common approach extrudes a double helical rib on the HDPE outer duct, breaking up rainwater so it spreads along the spiral; another presses dimples or other textures into the surface. A supplier states that its main duct uses double spiral threads to disrupt water flow and limit rain–wind vibration, with a drag coefficient of about 0.6, and the Rion–Antirion stays are likewise protected by spiral strakes. Surface treatment has no mechanism to maintain but raises duct drag, increasing wind load on pylon and deck, so rib height and pitch trade suppression against drag. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Double-helix ribbed duct” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜索風力 F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stay wind force F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙螺旋凸肋套管」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Double-helix ribbed duct”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩
knowledge.titleEn: Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples
knowledge.text: 既然雨風振動仰賴穩定的上緣水線，最直接的對策就是讓水線無法形成。常見做法是在 HDPE 外套管表面擠出雙螺旋凸肋，雨水被凸肋打斷、沿螺旋方向分散流下；另一種做法是在表面壓出凹窩或其他紋理。
knowledge.textEn: Since rain–wind vibration depends on a stable upper rivulet, the most direct remedy is to stop it forming. A common approach extrudes a double helical rib on the HDPE outer duct, breaking up rainwater so it spreads along the spiral; another presses dimples or other textures into the surface.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples" is correct?
options: 既然雨風振動仰賴穩定的上緣水線，最直接的對策就是讓水線無法形成。
套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。
阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。
optionsEn: Since rain–wind vibration depends on a stable upper rivulet, the most direct remedy is to stop it forming.
The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects.
Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest.
quiz.explanation: 既然雨風振動仰賴穩定的上緣水線，最直接的對策就是讓水線無法形成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Since rain–wind vibration depends on a stable upper rivulet, the most direct remedy is to stop it forming. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙螺旋凸肋套管」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-helix ribbed duct” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜索風力 F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L。U = 50 m/s（q ≈ 1,531 Pa）、D = 0.2 m、L = 300 m：C_D = 0.6 時 F ≈ 1,531×0.6×0.2×300 ≈ 55.1 kN；若處理不當使 C_D = 0.75，F ≈ 68.9 kN，增加 25%，全橋數百根索累積後對塔與橋面不可忽視。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stay wind force F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L. With U = 50 m/s (q ≈ 1,531 Pa), D = 0.2 m and L = 300 m, C_D = 0.6 gives F ≈ 1,531×0.6×0.2×300 ≈ 55.1 kN; a poorly chosen treatment with C_D = 0.75 gives F ≈ 68.9 kN, 25% more, which summed over hundreds of stays is significant for pylon and deck. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以足尺或大比例的套管段在風洞中做人工降雨試驗，確認在發生區間內不再出現大振幅；同時量測不同雷諾數下的阻力係數，並把結果用於全橋風荷載計算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test full-scale or large-scale duct sections with artificial rain in a wind tunnel to confirm no large amplitudes within the onset range, measuring drag coefficients across Reynolds numbers for use in global wind loads; confirm by monitoring that amplitudes stay controlled in wind–rain events after opening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 斜索風力 F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L。U = 50 m/s（q ≈ 1,531 Pa）、D = 0.2 m、L = 300 m：C_D = 0.6 時 F ≈ 1,531×0.6×0.2×300 ≈ 55.1 kN；若處理不當使 C_D = 0.75，F ≈ 68.9 kN，增加 25%，全橋數百根索累積後對塔與橋面不可忽視。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Stay wind force F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L. With U = 50 m/s (q ≈ 1,531 Pa), D = 0.2 m and L = 300 m, C_D = 0.6 gives F ≈ 1,531×0.6×0.2×300 ≈ 55.1 kN; a poorly chosen treatment with C_D = 0.75 gives F ≈ 68.9 kN, 25% more, which summed over hundreds of stays is significant for pylon and deck. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples", which statement holds?
options: 內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。
斜索風力 F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L。
阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。
optionsEn: Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance.
Stay wind force F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L.
A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge.
quiz.explanation: 斜索風力 F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stay wind force F = ½ρU²·C_D·D·L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙螺旋凸肋套管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Double-helix ribbed duct” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以足尺或大比例的套管段在風洞中做人工降雨試驗，確認在發生區間內不再出現大振幅；同時量測不同雷諾數下的阻力係數，並把結果用於全橋風荷載計算。現場以監測確認通車後的風雨事件中振幅受控。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test full-scale or large-scale duct sections with artificial rain in a wind tunnel to confirm no large amplitudes within the onset range, measuring drag coefficients across Reynolds numbers for use in global wind loads; confirm by monitoring that amplitudes stay controlled in wind–rain events after opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：套管表面處理的選擇要同時附上抑振試驗與阻力試驗報告，並在全橋設計中採用相同的阻力係數；安裝時檢查凸肋連續性與接頭方向，損傷段須依供應商程序修補，例如補焊螺旋凸條。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Select duct treatments with both suppression and drag test reports and use the same drag coefficient in global design; during installation check rib continuity and joint orientation, repairing damaged lengths under the supplier’s procedure such as post-welding helical fillets.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：凸肋在運輸或安裝時被磨損、套管接頭處凸肋不連續，局部仍可能形成水線；若只看抑振效果而未計入增加的阻力，塔與橋面的風荷載與疲勞會被低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ribs worn in transport or installation, or discontinuous at duct joints, can still allow local rivulets; judging only vibration suppression without counting the extra drag underestimates wind load and fatigue on pylon and deck. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以足尺或大比例的套管段在風洞中做人工降雨試驗，確認在發生區間內不再出現大振幅；同時量測不同雷諾數下的阻力係數，並把結果用於全橋風荷載計算。現場以監測確認通車後的風雨事件中振幅受控。
knowledge.textEn: Test full-scale or large-scale duct sections with artificial rain in a wind tunnel to confirm no large amplitudes within the onset range, measuring drag coefficients across Reynolds numbers for use in global wind loads; confirm by monitoring that amplitudes stay controlled in wind–rain events after opening.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 套管表面處理的選擇要同時附上抑振試驗與阻力試驗報告，並在全橋設計中採用相同的阻力係數；安裝時檢查凸肋連續性與接頭方向，損傷段須依供應商程序修補，例如補焊螺旋凸條。
knowledge.textEn: Select duct treatments with both suppression and drag test reports and use the same drag coefficient in global design; during installation check rib continuity and joint orientation, repairing damaged lengths under the supplier’s procedure such as post-welding helical fillets.

quiz.question: 要驗證「套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。
以足尺或大比例的套管段在風洞中做人工降雨試驗，確認在發生區間內不再出現大振幅；同時量測不同雷諾數下的阻力係數，並把結果用於全橋風荷載計算。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Dampers are passive and last for the full design life once installed.

Test full-scale or large-scale duct sections with artificial rain in a wind tunnel to confirm no large amplitudes within the onset range, measuring drag coefficients across Reynolds numbers for use in global wind loads.
quiz.explanation: 以足尺或大比例的套管段在風洞中做人工降雨試驗，確認在發生區間內不再出現大振幅；同時量測不同雷諾數下的阻力係數，並把結果用於全橋風荷載計算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test full-scale or large-scale duct sections with artificial rain in a wind tunnel to confirm no large amplitudes within the onset range, measuring drag coefficients across Reynolds numbers for use in global wind loads; confirm by monitoring that amplitudes stay controlled in wind–rain events after opening. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙螺旋凸肋套管」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Double-helix ribbed duct” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 凸肋在運輸或安裝時被磨損、套管接頭處凸肋不連續，局部仍可能形成水線；若只看抑振效果而未計入增加的阻力，塔與橋面的風荷載與疲勞會被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ribs worn in transport or installation, or discontinuous at duct joints, can still allow local rivulets; judging only vibration suppression without counting the extra drag underestimates wind load and fatigue on pylon and deck. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：表面處理不需要維護機構，但會增加套管的風阻，使塔與橋面承受更大的風荷載，凸肋的高度與螺距需要在抑振與阻力之間取捨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface treatment has no mechanism to maintain but raises duct drag, increasing wind load on pylon and deck, so rib height and pitch trade suppression against drag.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 凸肋在運輸或安裝時被磨損、套管接頭處凸肋不連續，局部仍可能形成水線；若只看抑振效果而未計入增加的阻力，塔與橋面的風荷載與疲勞會被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Ribs worn in transport or installation, or discontinuous at duct joints, can still allow local rivulets; judging only vibration suppression without counting the extra drag underestimates wind load and fatigue on pylon and deck.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「套管表面處理：螺旋凸肋與凹窩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Duct surface treatment: helical ribs and dimples" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 凸肋在運輸或安裝時被磨損、套管接頭處凸肋不連續，局部仍可能形成水線；若只看抑振效果而未計入增加的阻力，塔與橋面的風荷載與疲勞會被低估。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。
optionsEn: Ribs worn in transport or installation, or discontinuous at duct joints, can still allow local rivulets.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest.
quiz.explanation: 凸肋在運輸或安裝時被磨損、套管接頭處凸肋不連續，局部仍可能形成水線；若只看抑振效果而未計入增加的阻力，塔與橋面的風荷載與疲勞會被低估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ribs worn in transport or installation, or discontinuous at duct joints, can still allow local rivulets; judging only vibration suppression without counting the extra drag underestimates wind load and fatigue on pylon and deck. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外置黏滯阻尼器」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “External viscous damper” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外置阻尼器裝在斜索與橋面（或塔）之間，以一支黏滯阻尼器連接索上某點與固定支架。張緊弦理論顯示，阻尼器能提供的最大附加阻尼比約為阻尼器到錨點距離佔索長比例的一半，且只有在阻尼係數最佳時才達到。長索需要的阻尼器位置因此可能離橋面數公尺，要靠高支架或控制桅桿支撐。供應商公開案例中，亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋使用 7.4 m 高的控制桅桿支撐行程 ±920 mm 的油壓活塞，正反映超長索對阻尼器位置與行程的需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外置黏滯阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An external damper links a point on the stay to a fixed bracket on the deck or pylon through a viscous unit. Taut-string theory shows that the maximum added damping ratio is about half the damper’s distance from the anchorage as a fraction of cable length, reached only at the optimum coefficient. Long stays may therefore need dampers several metres above the deck on tall brackets or control masts. In a supplier’s public case, the Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge uses 7.4 m control masts carrying hydraulic pistons with ±920 mm stroke, illustrating what very long stays demand of damper position and stroke. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “External viscous damper” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：最大附加阻尼 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Maximum added damping ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外置黏滯阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “External viscous damper”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼
knowledge.titleEn: External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping
knowledge.text: 外置阻尼器裝在斜索與橋面（或塔）之間，以一支黏滯阻尼器連接索上某點與固定支架。張緊弦理論顯示，阻尼器能提供的最大附加阻尼比約為阻尼器到錨點距離佔索長比例的一半，且只有在阻尼係數最佳時才達到。
knowledge.textEn: An external damper links a point on the stay to a fixed bracket on the deck or pylon through a viscous unit. Taut-string theory shows that the maximum added damping ratio is about half the damper’s distance from the anchorage as a fraction of cable length, reached only at the optimum coefficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping" is correct?
options: 阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。
外置阻尼器裝在斜索與橋面（或塔）之間，以一支黏滯阻尼器連接索上某點與固定支架。
交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。
optionsEn: Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest.
An external damper links a point on the stay to a fixed bracket on the deck or pylon through a viscous unit.
Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation.
quiz.explanation: 外置阻尼器裝在斜索與橋面（或塔）之間，以一支黏滯阻尼器連接索上某點與固定支架。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An external damper links a point on the stay to a fixed bracket on the deck or pylon through a viscous unit. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼：定量估算
steps.titleEn: External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外置黏滯阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “External viscous damper” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：最大附加阻尼 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。要達到單元 2 的 0.53%，需 x_d/L ≥ 2×0.0053 ≈ 1.07%；索長 L = 400 m 時 x_d ≈ 0.0107×400 ≈ 4.3 m。若橋面空間只允許 2.5 m，ζ_max ≈ 2.5/800 ≈ 0.31%，不足，需加交叉索或表面處理。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Maximum added damping ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L). Reaching unit 2’s 0.53% needs x_d/L ≥ 2×0.0053 ≈ 1.07%; for L = 400 m, x_d ≈ 0.0107×400 ≈ 4.3 m. If deck space allows only 2.5 m, ζ_max ≈ 2.5/800 ≈ 0.31%, not enough, so cross-ties or surface treatment are needed as well. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：阻尼器出廠做力—速度、行程與耐久試驗；安裝後以人工激振做自由衰減，比較有無阻尼器時的阻尼比；支架本身以模態量測確認勁度足夠，避免支架振動吃掉阻尼器的行程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Factory-test dampers for force–velocity, stroke and endurance; after installation run free-decay tests by manual excitation, comparing damping with and without the damper; confirm by modal measurement that the bracket itself is stiff enough so its own motion does not consume damper stroke.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 最大附加阻尼 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。要達到單元 2 的 0.53%，需 x_d/L ≥ 2×0.0053 ≈ 1.07%；索長 L = 400 m 時 x_d ≈ 0.0107×400 ≈ 4.3 m。若橋面空間只允許 2.5 m，ζ_max ≈ 2.5/800 ≈ 0.31%，不足，需加交叉索或表面處理。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Maximum added damping ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L). Reaching unit 2’s 0.53% needs x_d/L ≥ 2×0.0053 ≈ 1.07%; for L = 400 m, x_d ≈ 0.0107×400 ≈ 4.3 m. If deck space allows only 2.5 m, ζ_max ≈ 2.5/800 ≈ 0.31%, not enough, so cross-ties or surface treatment are needed as well. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping", which statement holds?
options: 只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。
斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。
最大附加阻尼 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。
optionsEn: An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration.
Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue.
Maximum added damping ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L).
quiz.explanation: 最大附加阻尼 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Maximum added damping ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外置黏滯阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “External viscous damper” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器出廠做力—速度、行程與耐久試驗；安裝後以人工激振做自由衰減，比較有無阻尼器時的阻尼比；支架本身以模態量測確認勁度足夠，避免支架振動吃掉阻尼器的行程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Factory-test dampers for force–velocity, stroke and endurance; after installation run free-decay tests by manual excitation, comparing damping with and without the damper; confirm by modal measurement that the bracket itself is stiff enough so its own motion does not consume damper stroke. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：阻尼器配置圖要標示每根索的阻尼器位置比例、設計係數、行程與支架勁度要求；任何因景觀或交通需求而降低阻尼器高度的變更，都要重新計算可達阻尼並由設計者核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The damper layout should show each stay’s position ratio, design coefficient, stroke and bracket stiffness; any change lowering damper height for appearance or traffic must recompute achievable damping and be approved by the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支架勁度不足時，阻尼器兩端一起移動，實際消能遠低於理論；係數偏離最佳值太多，阻尼器變成近似固定點或幾乎不受力，附加阻尼都很小。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A flexible bracket moves with the damper so actual dissipation falls far below theory; a coefficient far from optimum makes the damper act almost as a fixed point or barely engaged, and added damping is small either way. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 阻尼器出廠做力—速度、行程與耐久試驗；安裝後以人工激振做自由衰減，比較有無阻尼器時的阻尼比；支架本身以模態量測確認勁度足夠，避免支架振動吃掉阻尼器的行程。
knowledge.textEn: Factory-test dampers for force–velocity, stroke and endurance; after installation run free-decay tests by manual excitation, comparing damping with and without the damper; confirm by modal measurement that the bracket itself is stiff enough so its own motion does not consume damper stroke.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 阻尼器配置圖要標示每根索的阻尼器位置比例、設計係數、行程與支架勁度要求；任何因景觀或交通需求而降低阻尼器高度的變更，都要重新計算可達阻尼並由設計者核可。
knowledge.textEn: The damper layout should show each stay’s position ratio, design coefficient, stroke and bracket stiffness; any change lowering damper height for appearance or traffic must recompute achievable damping and be approved by the designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping"?
options: 阻尼器出廠做力—速度、行程與耐久試驗；安裝後以人工激振做自由衰減，比較有無阻尼器時的阻尼比；支架本身以模態量測確認勁度足夠，避免支架振動吃掉阻尼器的行程。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。
optionsEn: Factory-test dampers for force–velocity, stroke and endurance.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器出廠做力—速度、行程與耐久試驗；安裝後以人工激振做自由衰減，比較有無阻尼器時的阻尼比；支架本身以模態量測確認勁度足夠，避免支架振動吃掉阻尼器的行程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Factory-test dampers for force–velocity, stroke and endurance; after installation run free-decay tests by manual excitation, comparing damping with and without the damper; confirm by modal measurement that the bracket itself is stiff enough so its own motion does not consume damper stroke. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外置黏滯阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “External viscous damper” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支架勁度不足時，阻尼器兩端一起移動，實際消能遠低於理論；係數偏離最佳值太多，阻尼器變成近似固定點或幾乎不受力，附加阻尼都很小。高支架若設計不當，本身也可能成為新的振動源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A flexible bracket moves with the damper so actual dissipation falls far below theory; a coefficient far from optimum makes the damper act almost as a fixed point or barely engaged, and added damping is small either way. A poorly designed tall mast can itself become a new source of vibration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：供應商公開案例中，亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋使用 7.4 m 高的控制桅桿支撐行程 ±920 mm 的油壓活塞，正反映超長索對阻尼器位置與行程的需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a supplier’s public case, the Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge uses 7.4 m control masts carrying hydraulic pistons with ±920 mm stroke, illustrating what very long stays demand of damper position and stroke.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支架勁度不足時，阻尼器兩端一起移動，實際消能遠低於理論；係數偏離最佳值太多，阻尼器變成近似固定點或幾乎不受力，附加阻尼都很小。高支架若設計不當，本身也可能成為新的振動源。
knowledge.textEn: A flexible bracket moves with the damper so actual dissipation falls far below theory; a coefficient far from optimum makes the damper act almost as a fixed point or barely engaged, and added damping is small either way. A poorly designed tall mast can itself become a new source of vibration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外置阻尼器的位置、係數與可達阻尼」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "External damper position, coefficient and achievable damping" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
支架勁度不足時，阻尼器兩端一起移動，實際消能遠低於理論；係數偏離最佳值太多，阻尼器變成近似固定點或幾乎不受力，附加阻尼都很小。
交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A flexible bracket moves with the damper so actual dissipation falls far below theory.
Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation.
quiz.explanation: 支架勁度不足時，阻尼器兩端一起移動，實際消能遠低於理論；係數偏離最佳值太多，阻尼器變成近似固定點或幾乎不受力，附加阻尼都很小。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A flexible bracket moves with the damper so actual dissipation falls far below theory; a coefficient far from optimum makes the damper act almost as a fixed point or barely engaged, and added damping is small either way. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「交叉索：把單根長索變成索網」與「內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network" and "Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 交叉索：把單根長索變成索網：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「交叉索」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cross-ties” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 交叉索是在同一索面相鄰斜索之間加裝細索或連桿，把它們連成網。單根長索被分成較短的段落，低階模態的頻率提高，原本容易被雨風或橋面運動激發的低頻振動被移到較高頻率；不同斜索的頻率也不再各自獨立，彼此牽制，振動能量在網中分散。供應商公開資料把交叉索列為長索的選項，說明它能消耗能量、使斜索頻率與結構模態錯開並提高平面內勁度。交叉索的缺點是外觀、施工與維護較複雜，且交叉索本身在大振幅時可能鬆弛再拉緊而受衝擊，連接件要能承受反覆的拉力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「交叉索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-ties are thin cables or links fitted between neighbouring stays in the same plane, joining them into a network. A long stay is divided into shorter segments, raising the frequency of the lowest modes and moving easily excited low-frequency vibration upward; the stays’ frequencies are no longer independent but restrain one another and spread vibration energy through the network. A supplier lists cross-ties as an option for longer stays, citing energy dissipation, decorrelation of stay frequencies from structural modes and higher in-plane stiffness. The drawbacks are appearance, construction and maintenance complexity, and ties that slacken and re-tension under large amplitudes take shock loads, so connectors must withstand repeated tension. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cross-ties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：張緊弦頻率與段長成反比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taut-string frequency is inversely proportional to segment length.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「交叉索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cross-ties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 交叉索：把單根長索變成索網
knowledge.titleEn: Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network
knowledge.text: 交叉索是在同一索面相鄰斜索之間加裝細索或連桿，把它們連成網。單根長索被分成較短的段落，低階模態的頻率提高，原本容易被雨風或橋面運動激發的低頻振動被移到較高頻率；不同斜索的頻率也不再各自獨立，彼此牽制，振動能量在網中分散。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-ties are thin cables or links fitted between neighbouring stays in the same plane, joining them into a network. A long stay is divided into shorter segments, raising the frequency of the lowest modes and moving easily excited low-frequency vibration upward; the stays’ frequencies are no longer independent but restrain one another and spread vibration energy through the network.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「交叉索：把單根長索變成索網」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network" is correct?
options: 交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。
內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。
交叉索是在同一索面相鄰斜索之間加裝細索或連桿，把它們連成網。
optionsEn: Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation.
Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance.
Cross-ties are thin cables or links fitted between neighbouring stays in the same plane, joining them into a network.
quiz.explanation: 交叉索是在同一索面相鄰斜索之間加裝細索或連桿，把它們連成網。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-ties are thin cables or links fitted between neighbouring stays in the same plane, joining them into a network. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 交叉索：把單根長索變成索網：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交叉索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cross-ties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：張緊弦頻率與段長成反比。索長 250 m、第一頻率 0.25 Hz，若在中點以剛性足夠的交叉索固定，局部段長 125 m，局部第一頻率約提高到 0.25×2 = 0.5 Hz；若在三分點各加一道，段長約 83 m，局部頻率約 0.75 Hz。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taut-string frequency is inversely proportional to segment length. A 250 m stay with a 0.25 Hz first frequency, fixed at mid-length by a sufficiently stiff cross-tie, has 125 m segments with a local first frequency of about 0.25×2 = 0.5 Hz; ties at both third points give segments of about 83 m and about 0.75 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以索網模型計算加裝交叉索後的模態與頻率，並模擬大振幅時交叉索是否鬆弛；安裝時以預拉力確保交叉索在正常振幅下保持受拉，完成後量測索網的頻率與阻尼，並定期檢查連接件磨耗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute modes and frequencies of the network with cross-ties and simulate whether ties slacken at large amplitudes; pretension ties so they remain taut at normal amplitudes, measure network frequencies and damping after installation, and inspect connector wear periodically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 張緊弦頻率與段長成反比。索長 250 m、第一頻率 0.25 Hz，若在中點以剛性足夠的交叉索固定，局部段長 125 m，局部第一頻率約提高到 0.25×2 = 0.5 Hz；若在三分點各加一道，段長約 83 m，局部頻率約 0.75 Hz。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Taut-string frequency is inversely proportional to segment length. A 250 m stay with a 0.25 Hz first frequency, fixed at mid-length by a sufficiently stiff cross-tie, has 125 m segments with a local first frequency of about 0.25×2 = 0.5 Hz; ties at both third points give segments of about 83 m and about 0.75 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「交叉索：把單根長索變成索網」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network", which statement holds?
options: 張緊弦頻率與段長成反比。
阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。
阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。
optionsEn: Taut-string frequency is inversely proportional to segment length.
A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge.
Dampers are passive and last for the full design life once installed.
quiz.explanation: 張緊弦頻率與段長成反比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Taut-string frequency is inversely proportional to segment length. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 交叉索：把單根長索變成索網：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「交叉索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cross-ties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以索網模型計算加裝交叉索後的模態與頻率，並模擬大振幅時交叉索是否鬆弛；安裝時以預拉力確保交叉索在正常振幅下保持受拉，完成後量測索網的頻率與阻尼，並定期檢查連接件磨耗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute modes and frequencies of the network with cross-ties and simulate whether ties slacken at large amplitudes; pretension ties so they remain taut at normal amplitudes, measure network frequencies and damping after installation, and inspect connector wear periodically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交叉索的設計要包含預拉力、連接件疲勞與斷裂後的掉落防護，並在交接文件中列出每道交叉索的位置、預拉力與檢查方法；景觀影響要在設計初期與業主溝通。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Cross-tie design should include pretension, connector fatigue and fall protection in case of rupture, with each tie’s position, pretension and inspection method listed in the handover documents; discuss visual impact with the owner early.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交叉索預拉力不足時，大振幅下反覆鬆弛再拉緊，產生衝擊力使連接件斷裂；若交叉索斷裂掉落，可能危及車道，且原本被抑制的振動會突然恢復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficiently pretensioned ties slacken and snap taut repeatedly at large amplitudes, shock-loading connectors until they fail; a broken tie falling can endanger traffic, and the suppressed vibration suddenly returns. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以索網模型計算加裝交叉索後的模態與頻率，並模擬大振幅時交叉索是否鬆弛；安裝時以預拉力確保交叉索在正常振幅下保持受拉，完成後量測索網的頻率與阻尼，並定期檢查連接件磨耗。
knowledge.textEn: Compute modes and frequencies of the network with cross-ties and simulate whether ties slacken at large amplitudes; pretension ties so they remain taut at normal amplitudes, measure network frequencies and damping after installation, and inspect connector wear periodically.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交叉索的設計要包含預拉力、連接件疲勞與斷裂後的掉落防護，並在交接文件中列出每道交叉索的位置、預拉力與檢查方法；景觀影響要在設計初期與業主溝通。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-tie design should include pretension, connector fatigue and fall protection in case of rupture, with each tie’s position, pretension and inspection method listed in the handover documents; discuss visual impact with the owner early.

quiz.question: 要驗證「交叉索：把單根長索變成索網」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以索網模型計算加裝交叉索後的模態與頻率，並模擬大振幅時交叉索是否鬆弛。
斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compute modes and frequencies of the network with cross-ties and simulate whether ties slacken at large amplitudes.
Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration.
quiz.explanation: 以索網模型計算加裝交叉索後的模態與頻率，並模擬大振幅時交叉索是否鬆弛；安裝時以預拉力確保交叉索在正常振幅下保持受拉，完成後量測索網的頻率與阻尼，並定期檢查連接件磨耗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute modes and frequencies of the network with cross-ties and simulate whether ties slacken at large amplitudes; pretension ties so they remain taut at normal amplitudes, measure network frequencies and damping after installation, and inspect connector wear periodically. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 交叉索：把單根長索變成索網：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「交叉索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cross-ties” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交叉索預拉力不足時，大振幅下反覆鬆弛再拉緊，產生衝擊力使連接件斷裂；若交叉索斷裂掉落，可能危及車道，且原本被抑制的振動會突然恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficiently pretensioned ties slacken and snap taut repeatedly at large amplitudes, shock-loading connectors until they fail; a broken tie falling can endanger traffic, and the suppressed vibration suddenly returns. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交叉索的缺點是外觀、施工與維護較複雜，且交叉索本身在大振幅時可能鬆弛再拉緊而受衝擊，連接件要能承受反覆的拉力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The drawbacks are appearance, construction and maintenance complexity, and ties that slacken and re-tension under large amplitudes take shock loads, so connectors must withstand repeated tension.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交叉索預拉力不足時，大振幅下反覆鬆弛再拉緊，產生衝擊力使連接件斷裂；若交叉索斷裂掉落，可能危及車道，且原本被抑制的振動會突然恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficiently pretensioned ties slacken and snap taut repeatedly at large amplitudes, shock-loading connectors until they fail; a broken tie falling can endanger traffic, and the suppressed vibration suddenly returns.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「交叉索：把單根長索變成索網」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cross-ties: turning single long stays into a cable network" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。
交叉索預拉力不足時，大振幅下反覆鬆弛再拉緊，產生衝擊力使連接件斷裂；若交叉索斷裂掉落，可能危及車道，且原本被抑制的振動會突然恢復。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance.
Insufficiently pretensioned ties slacken and snap taut repeatedly at large amplitudes, shock-loading connectors until they fail.
quiz.explanation: 交叉索預拉力不足時，大振幅下反覆鬆弛再拉緊，產生衝擊力使連接件斷裂；若交叉索斷裂掉落，可能危及車道，且原本被抑制的振動會突然恢復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficiently pretensioned ties slacken and snap taut repeatedly at large amplitudes, shock-loading connectors until they fail; a broken tie falling can endanger traffic, and the suppressed vibration suddenly returns. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「導管內阻尼器」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Guide-pipe internal damper” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 較短的斜索常把阻尼器裝在錨具上方的導管內，外觀幾乎看不到。供應商公開的選型表依索長分級：內置彈性體阻尼器適用約 80 m 以下、行程約 ±10 mm；內置油壓阻尼器適用約 80 至 150 m、行程可達約 20 mm；超過約 300 m 的長索則用外置油壓阻尼器，行程可達約 500 mm 或依需求訂製。內置阻尼器距錨點很近，能提供的附加阻尼有限，而且它所在位置的振幅雖小，仍可能超過行程。安裝時導管與索的同心度必須準確，否則阻尼器偏心受力、磨耗加速，甚至在靜止時就已用掉部分行程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「導管內阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter stays often have dampers inside the guide pipe above the anchorage, nearly invisible. A supplier’s public selection table grades them by cable length: internal elastomeric dampers for stays under about 80 m with about ±10 mm stroke; internal hydraulic dampers for about 80 to 150 m with up to about 20 mm; and external hydraulic dampers for stays over about 300 m with up to about 500 mm stroke or custom values. Internal dampers sit close to the anchorage, so their added damping is limited, and although amplitude there is small it can still exceed the stroke. During installation the guide pipe must be concentric with the stay, or the damper is loaded eccentrically, wears faster and may use part of its stroke even at rest. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Guide-pipe internal damper” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第一模態振型 y(x) = A·sin(πx/L)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: First-mode shape y(x) = A·sin(πx/L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「導管內阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Guide-pipe internal damper”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差
knowledge.titleEn: Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance
knowledge.text: 較短的斜索常把阻尼器裝在錨具上方的導管內，外觀幾乎看不到。供應商公開的選型表依索長分級：內置彈性體阻尼器適用約 80 m 以下、行程約 ±10 mm；內置油壓阻尼器適用約 80 至 150 m、行程可達約 20 mm；超過約 300 m 的長索則用外置油壓阻尼器，行程可達約 500 mm 或依需求訂製。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter stays often have dampers inside the guide pipe above the anchorage, nearly invisible. A supplier’s public selection table grades them by cable length: internal elastomeric dampers for stays under about 80 m with about ±10 mm stroke; internal hydraulic dampers for about 80 to 150 m with up to about 20 mm; and external hydraulic dampers for stays over about 300 m with up to about 500 mm stroke or custom values.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance" is correct?
options: 較短的斜索常把阻尼器裝在錨具上方的導管內，外觀幾乎看不到。
內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。
只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。
optionsEn: Shorter stays often have dampers inside the guide pipe above the anchorage, nearly invisible.
Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance.
An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration.
quiz.explanation: 較短的斜索常把阻尼器裝在錨具上方的導管內，外觀幾乎看不到。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter stays often have dampers inside the guide pipe above the anchorage, nearly invisible. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導管內阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Guide-pipe internal damper” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第一模態振型 y(x) = A·sin(πx/L)。若跨中振幅 A = 0.5 m、阻尼器在 x/L = 0.02，y = 0.5×sin(0.0628) ≈ 0.0314 m ≈ 31 mm，超過約 ±10 mm 的彈性體阻尼器行程，需改用較大行程的油壓型或限制振幅的配套措施。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: First-mode shape y(x) = A·sin(πx/L). With mid-span amplitude A = 0.5 m and the damper at x/L = 0.02, y = 0.5×sin(0.0628) ≈ 0.0314 m ≈ 31 mm, beyond the roughly ±10 mm stroke of an elastomeric damper, so a longer-stroke hydraulic type or complementary amplitude limits are needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前量測導管與錨具軸線的偏差，確認在容許範圍；安裝後檢查阻尼器靜止位置是否在行程中央，並以人工激振確認阻尼器在設計振幅下不撞到行程極限；每次檢查記錄阻尼器的磨耗與漏油狀況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation measure misalignment between guide pipe and anchorage axis against tolerance; afterwards check that the damper rests at mid-stroke and confirm by manual excitation that it does not hit its stroke limits at design amplitude; record wear and leakage at each inspection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 第一模態振型 y(x) = A·sin(πx/L)。若跨中振幅 A = 0.5 m、阻尼器在 x/L = 0.02，y = 0.5×sin(0.0628) ≈ 0.0314 m ≈ 31 mm，超過約 ±10 mm 的彈性體阻尼器行程，需改用較大行程的油壓型或限制振幅的配套措施。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: First-mode shape y(x) = A·sin(πx/L). With mid-span amplitude A = 0.5 m and the damper at x/L = 0.02, y = 0.5×sin(0.0628) ≈ 0.0314 m ≈ 31 mm, beyond the roughly ±10 mm stroke of an elastomeric damper, so a longer-stroke hydraulic type or complementary amplitude limits are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance", which statement holds?
options: 斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。
第一模態振型 y(x) = A·sin(πx/L)。
雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。
optionsEn: Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue.
First-mode shape y(x) = A·sin(πx/L).
Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration.
quiz.explanation: 第一模態振型 y(x) = A·sin(πx/L)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: First-mode shape y(x) = A·sin(πx/L). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導管內阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Guide-pipe internal damper” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝前量測導管與錨具軸線的偏差，確認在容許範圍；安裝後檢查阻尼器靜止位置是否在行程中央，並以人工激振確認阻尼器在設計振幅下不撞到行程極限；每次檢查記錄阻尼器的磨耗與漏油狀況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before installation measure misalignment between guide pipe and anchorage axis against tolerance; afterwards check that the damper rests at mid-stroke and confirm by manual excitation that it does not hit its stroke limits at design amplitude; record wear and leakage at each inspection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範要訂出導管定位公差、阻尼器安裝時的索力與溫度條件，以及安裝後的行程位置檢查；維護手冊應規定開啟導管蓋檢查阻尼器的週期與判定標準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction specification should set guide-pipe positioning tolerance, the stay force and temperature at damper installation and the post-installation stroke check; the maintenance manual should set intervals and criteria for opening guide-pipe covers to inspect dampers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導管偏心造成阻尼器單側磨耗，數年內失效；行程不足時阻尼器在大振幅下撞擊止擋，反而成為衝擊來源，並把彎曲應力集中在錨口附近的鋼絞線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An eccentric guide pipe wears the damper on one side until it fails within a few years; insufficient stroke lets the damper hit its stops at large amplitude, becoming a source of impact and concentrating bending stress in strands near the anchor exit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝前量測導管與錨具軸線的偏差，確認在容許範圍；安裝後檢查阻尼器靜止位置是否在行程中央，並以人工激振確認阻尼器在設計振幅下不撞到行程極限；每次檢查記錄阻尼器的磨耗與漏油狀況。
knowledge.textEn: Before installation measure misalignment between guide pipe and anchorage axis against tolerance; afterwards check that the damper rests at mid-stroke and confirm by manual excitation that it does not hit its stroke limits at design amplitude; record wear and leakage at each inspection.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工規範要訂出導管定位公差、阻尼器安裝時的索力與溫度條件，以及安裝後的行程位置檢查；維護手冊應規定開啟導管蓋檢查阻尼器的週期與判定標準。
knowledge.textEn: The construction specification should set guide-pipe positioning tolerance, the stay force and temperature at damper installation and the post-installation stroke check; the maintenance manual should set intervals and criteria for opening guide-pipe covers to inspect dampers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。
安裝前量測導管與錨具軸線的偏差，確認在容許範圍。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects.
Before installation measure misalignment between guide pipe and anchorage axis against tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 安裝前量測導管與錨具軸線的偏差，確認在容許範圍；安裝後檢查阻尼器靜止位置是否在行程中央，並以人工激振確認阻尼器在設計振幅下不撞到行程極限；每次檢查記錄阻尼器的磨耗與漏油狀況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before installation measure misalignment between guide pipe and anchorage axis against tolerance; afterwards check that the damper rests at mid-stroke and confirm by manual excitation that it does not hit its stroke limits at design amplitude; record wear and leakage at each inspection. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導管內阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Guide-pipe internal damper” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導管偏心造成阻尼器單側磨耗，數年內失效；行程不足時阻尼器在大振幅下撞擊止擋，反而成為衝擊來源，並把彎曲應力集中在錨口附近的鋼絞線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An eccentric guide pipe wears the damper on one side until it fails within a few years; insufficient stroke lets the damper hit its stops at large amplitude, becoming a source of impact and concentrating bending stress in strands near the anchor exit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：安裝時導管與索的同心度必須準確，否則阻尼器偏心受力、磨耗加速，甚至在靜止時就已用掉部分行程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During installation the guide pipe must be concentric with the stay, or the damper is loaded eccentrically, wears faster and may use part of its stroke even at rest.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「內置阻尼器藏在導管裡，因此不需要檢查或維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Internal dampers are hidden in the guide pipe, so they need no inspection or maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導管偏心造成阻尼器單側磨耗，數年內失效；行程不足時阻尼器在大振幅下撞擊止擋，反而成為衝擊來源，並把彎曲應力集中在錨口附近的鋼絞線。
knowledge.textEn: An eccentric guide pipe wears the damper on one side until it fails within a few years; insufficient stroke lets the damper hit its stops at large amplitude, becoming a source of impact and concentrating bending stress in strands near the anchor exit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「內置阻尼器的選型、行程與安裝公差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Internal damper selection, stroke and installation tolerance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 導管偏心造成阻尼器單側磨耗，數年內失效；行程不足時阻尼器在大振幅下撞擊止擋，反而成為衝擊來源，並把彎曲應力集中在錨口附近的鋼絞線。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。
optionsEn: An eccentric guide pipe wears the damper on one side until it fails within a few years.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration.
quiz.explanation: 導管偏心造成阻尼器單側磨耗，數年內失效；行程不足時阻尼器在大振幅下撞擊止擋，反而成為衝擊來源，並把彎曲應力集中在錨口附近的鋼絞線。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An eccentric guide pipe wears the damper on one side until it fails within a few years; insufficient stroke lets the damper hit its stops at large amplitude, becoming a source of impact and concentrating bending stress in strands near the anchor exit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨」與「以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain" and "Accepting added damping by free decay": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雨量計與斜索加速度計」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rain gauge and stay accelerometers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 要確認斜索振動是否為雨風振動、判斷對策是否有效，最可靠的證據是現場同步資料。代表性斜索上裝雙軸加速度計，記錄平面內與平面外振動；橋上設超音波風速計量測風速風向，再加雨量計記錄降雨強度。只有當大振幅與中等風速、特定風向及降雨同時出現，才能歸因於雨風振動；若大振幅出現在無雨強風時，可能是抖振、乾索馳振或橋面運動引起的參數共振，對策也不同。長期資料還能告訴工程師哪些索最容易振動，作為優先加裝阻尼器的依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雨量計與斜索加速度計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The most reliable evidence of whether stay vibration is rain–wind induced, and whether remedies work, is synchronised field data. Biaxial accelerometers on representative stays record in-plane and out-of-plane motion; an ultrasonic anemometer on the deck measures wind speed and direction; a rain gauge logs rainfall intensity. Only when large amplitudes coincide with moderate wind, a particular direction and rainfall can the motion be attributed to rain–wind excitation; large amplitudes in strong dry wind may instead be buffeting, dry galloping or parametric resonance from deck motion, needing different remedies. Long-term data also show which stays vibrate most readily, setting priorities for damper retrofits. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rain gauge and stay accelerometers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：由加速度換算振幅 A = a/(2πf)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Amplitude from acceleration A = a/(2πf)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雨量計與斜索加速度計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rain gauge and stay accelerometers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨
knowledge.titleEn: Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain
knowledge.text: 要確認斜索振動是否為雨風振動、判斷對策是否有效，最可靠的證據是現場同步資料。代表性斜索上裝雙軸加速度計，記錄平面內與平面外振動；橋上設超音波風速計量測風速風向，再加雨量計記錄降雨強度。
knowledge.textEn: The most reliable evidence of whether stay vibration is rain–wind induced, and whether remedies work, is synchronised field data. Biaxial accelerometers on representative stays record in-plane and out-of-plane motion; an ultrasonic anemometer on the deck measures wind speed and direction; a rain gauge logs rainfall intensity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain" is correct?
options: 只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。
要確認斜索振動是否為雨風振動、判斷對策是否有效，最可靠的證據是現場同步資料。
阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。
optionsEn: An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration.
The most reliable evidence of whether stay vibration is rain–wind induced, and whether remedies work, is synchronised field data.
A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge.
quiz.explanation: 要確認斜索振動是否為雨風振動、判斷對策是否有效，最可靠的證據是現場同步資料。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The most reliable evidence of whether stay vibration is rain–wind induced, and whether remedies work, is synchronised field data. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雨量計與斜索加速度計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rain gauge and stay accelerometers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：由加速度換算振幅 A = a/(2πf)²。若加速度峰值 a = 5 m/s²、頻率 f = 1.1 Hz，(2π×1.1)² ≈ 47.8，A ≈ 5/47.8 ≈ 0.105 m，即約 105 mm；同樣加速度在 3.3 Hz 時振幅只有約 12 mm，所以必須同時看頻率才能判讀振幅。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Amplitude from acceleration A = a/(2πf)². For a peak a = 5 m/s² at f = 1.1 Hz, (2π×1.1)² ≈ 47.8 and A ≈ 5/47.8 ≈ 0.105 m, about 105 mm; the same acceleration at 3.3 Hz is only about 12 mm, so frequency must be read with acceleration to judge amplitude. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認各感測器時間同步、加速度計方向與安裝位置有照片紀錄；以事件觸發保存原始資料，並用頻譜與時間歷程同時判讀主要振動頻率、振幅與持續時間，與風速、風向、雨量做關聯分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm time synchronisation across sensors and record accelerometer orientation and mounting position with photographs; store raw data on event triggers and read dominant frequency, amplitude and duration from both spectra and time histories, correlating them with wind speed, direction and rainfall.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 由加速度換算振幅 A = a/(2πf)²。若加速度峰值 a = 5 m/s²、頻率 f = 1.1 Hz，(2π×1.1)² ≈ 47.8，A ≈ 5/47.8 ≈ 0.105 m，即約 105 mm；同樣加速度在 3.3 Hz 時振幅只有約 12 mm，所以必須同時看頻率才能判讀振幅。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Amplitude from acceleration A = a/(2πf)². For a peak a = 5 m/s² at f = 1.1 Hz, (2π×1.1)² ≈ 47.8 and A ≈ 5/47.8 ≈ 0.105 m, about 105 mm; the same acceleration at 3.3 Hz is only about 12 mm, so frequency must be read with acceleration to judge amplitude. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。
斜索越重越粗就越穩定，所以只要加大索徑就能解決雨風振動。
由加速度換算振幅 A = a/(2πf)²。
optionsEn: Dampers are passive and last for the full design life once installed.
Heavier, thicker stays are always more stable, so a larger diameter solves rain–wind vibration.
Amplitude from acceleration A = a/(2πf)².
quiz.explanation: 由加速度換算振幅 A = a/(2πf)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Amplitude from acceleration A = a/(2πf)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雨量計與斜索加速度計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rain gauge and stay accelerometers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認各感測器時間同步、加速度計方向與安裝位置有照片紀錄；以事件觸發保存原始資料，並用頻譜與時間歷程同時判讀主要振動頻率、振幅與持續時間，與風速、風向、雨量做關聯分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm time synchronisation across sensors and record accelerometer orientation and mounting position with photographs; store raw data on event triggers and read dominant frequency, amplitude and duration from both spectra and time histories, correlating them with wind speed, direction and rainfall. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測計畫要列出感測器清單、取樣率、觸發條件與資料保存期限，並在通車初期至少涵蓋一個完整的風雨季節；監測報告要把事件依機制分類，作為對策設計與驗收的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring plan should list sensors, sampling rates, trigger conditions and data retention, covering at least one full wind-and-rain season after opening; reports should classify events by mechanism as the basis for remedy design and acceptance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沒有雨量計，所有大振幅事件都無法分類，可能對錯誤的機制下對策；加速度計方向記錄錯誤會把平面內與平面外振動混淆，誤判阻尼器的效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a rain gauge, large-amplitude events cannot be classified, inviting remedies for the wrong mechanism; misrecorded accelerometer orientation confuses in-plane and out-of-plane motion and misjudges damper effectiveness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認各感測器時間同步、加速度計方向與安裝位置有照片紀錄；以事件觸發保存原始資料，並用頻譜與時間歷程同時判讀主要振動頻率、振幅與持續時間，與風速、風向、雨量做關聯分析。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm time synchronisation across sensors and record accelerometer orientation and mounting position with photographs; store raw data on event triggers and read dominant frequency, amplitude and duration from both spectra and time histories, correlating them with wind speed, direction and rainfall.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測計畫要列出感測器清單、取樣率、觸發條件與資料保存期限，並在通車初期至少涵蓋一個完整的風雨季節；監測報告要把事件依機制分類，作為對策設計與驗收的依據。
knowledge.textEn: The monitoring plan should list sensors, sampling rates, trigger conditions and data retention, covering at least one full wind-and-rain season after opening; reports should classify events by mechanism as the basis for remedy design and acceptance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain"?
options: 確認各感測器時間同步、加速度計方向與安裝位置有照片紀錄。
