量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。
optionsEn: Confirm time synchronisation across sensors and record accelerometer orientation and mounting position with photographs.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Dampers work best right at the anchorage, where the stay is steadiest.
quiz.explanation: 確認各感測器時間同步、加速度計方向與安裝位置有照片紀錄；以事件觸發保存原始資料，並用頻譜與時間歷程同時判讀主要振動頻率、振幅與持續時間，與風速、風向、雨量做關聯分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm time synchronisation across sensors and record accelerometer orientation and mounting position with photographs; store raw data on event triggers and read dominant frequency, amplitude and duration from both spectra and time histories, correlating them with wind speed, direction and rainfall. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雨量計與斜索加速度計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rain gauge and stay accelerometers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沒有雨量計，所有大振幅事件都無法分類，可能對錯誤的機制下對策；加速度計方向記錄錯誤會把平面內與平面外振動混淆，誤判阻尼器的效果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a rain gauge, large-amplitude events cannot be classified, inviting remedies for the wrong mechanism; misrecorded accelerometer orientation confuses in-plane and out-of-plane motion and misjudges damper effectiveness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長期資料還能告訴工程師哪些索最容易振動，作為優先加裝阻尼器的依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long-term data also show which stays vibrate most readily, setting priorities for damper retrofits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有雨量計，所有大振幅事件都無法分類，可能對錯誤的機制下對策；加速度計方向記錄錯誤會把平面內與平面外振動混淆，誤判阻尼器的效果。
knowledge.textEn: Without a rain gauge, large-amplitude events cannot be classified, inviting remedies for the wrong mechanism; misrecorded accelerometer orientation confuses in-plane and out-of-plane motion and misjudges damper effectiveness.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若沒有雨量計，所有大振幅事件都無法分類，可能對錯誤的機制下對策；加速度計方向記錄錯誤會把平面內與平面外振動混淆，誤判阻尼器的效果。
阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Without a rain gauge, large-amplitude events cannot be classified, inviting remedies for the wrong mechanism.
A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有雨量計，所有大振幅事件都無法分類，可能對錯誤的機制下對策；加速度計方向記錄錯誤會把平面內與平面外振動混淆，誤判阻尼器的效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a rain gauge, large-amplitude events cannot be classified, inviting remedies for the wrong mechanism; misrecorded accelerometer orientation confuses in-plane and out-of-plane motion and misjudges damper effectiveness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Accepting added damping by free decay: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「自由衰減試驗」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-decay test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器或交叉索裝好之後，必須以現場試驗證明斜索真的得到足夠的阻尼。最常用的是自由衰減試驗：以人工或拉繩把索拉到一定振幅後放開，記錄振幅逐週期遞減的過程，用對數遞減率換算阻尼比。試驗要針對目標模態激振，並在低風、無雨時進行，以免外力干擾衰減曲線；振幅也要接近實際關心的範圍，因為阻尼器的摩擦與非線性會讓小振幅與大振幅的阻尼不同。驗收時把量到的阻尼代回史庫頓數，確認達到設計門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「自由衰減試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After dampers or cross-ties are fitted, field tests must prove the stay actually has enough damping. The commonest is the free-decay test: pull the stay to an amplitude by hand or rope, release it and record the amplitude decreasing cycle by cycle, converting the logarithmic decrement to a damping ratio. The test should excite the target mode, in low wind and no rain so external forces do not distort the decay, and at amplitudes near the range of interest, because damper friction and nonlinearity make damping differ between small and large amplitudes. Acceptance substitutes the measured damping into the Scruton number to confirm the design threshold is met. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Free-decay test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Logarithmic decrement δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「自由衰減試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Free-decay test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼
knowledge.titleEn: Accepting added damping by free decay
knowledge.text: 阻尼器或交叉索裝好之後，必須以現場試驗證明斜索真的得到足夠的阻尼。最常用的是自由衰減試驗：以人工或拉繩把索拉到一定振幅後放開，記錄振幅逐週期遞減的過程，用對數遞減率換算阻尼比。
knowledge.textEn: After dampers or cross-ties are fitted, field tests must prove the stay actually has enough damping. The commonest is the free-decay test: pull the stay to an amplitude by hand or rope, release it and record the amplitude decreasing cycle by cycle, converting the logarithmic decrement to a damping ratio.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Accepting added damping by free decay" is correct?
options: 阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。
斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。
阻尼器或交叉索裝好之後，必須以現場試驗證明斜索真的得到足夠的阻尼。
optionsEn: A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge.
Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue.
After dampers or cross-ties are fitted, field tests must prove the stay actually has enough damping.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器或交叉索裝好之後，必須以現場試驗證明斜索真的得到足夠的阻尼。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After dampers or cross-ties are fitted, field tests must prove the stay actually has enough damping. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Accepting added damping by free decay: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由衰減試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free-decay test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n)。振幅 10 個週期由 100 mm 降到 30 mm：δ = ln(100/30)/10 ≈ 0.120，ζ = δ/(2π) ≈ 1.92%。代入單元 2 的參數，Sc = 60×0.0192/0.032 ≈ 36，高於約 10 的門檻。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Logarithmic decrement δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n). Amplitude falling from 100 mm to 30 mm in 10 cycles gives δ = ln(100/30)/10 ≈ 0.120 and ζ = δ/(2π) ≈ 1.92%. With unit 2’s parameters, Sc = 60×0.0192/0.032 ≈ 36, above the threshold of about 10. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每根受測索至少重複三次並取平均，檢查衰減曲線是否為單一指數（若出現轉折，可能是阻尼器摩擦或拍頻）；同時記錄風速與溫度，並把結果與阻尼器安裝前的基準比較，列入驗收報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat at least three times per stay and average, checking that the decay is a single exponential (a kink may indicate damper friction or beating between modes); record wind and temperature and compare with the pre-installation baseline in the acceptance report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n)。振幅 10 個週期由 100 mm 降到 30 mm：δ = ln(100/30)/10 ≈ 0.120，ζ = δ/(2π) ≈ 1.92%。代入單元 2 的參數，Sc = 60×0.0192/0.032 ≈ 36，高於約 10 的門檻。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Logarithmic decrement δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n). Amplitude falling from 100 mm to 30 mm in 10 cycles gives δ = ln(100/30)/10 ≈ 0.120 and ζ = δ/(2π) ≈ 1.92%. With unit 2’s parameters, Sc = 60×0.0192/0.032 ≈ 36, above the threshold of about 10. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Accepting added damping by free decay", which statement holds?
options: 對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n)。
雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。
套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。
optionsEn: Logarithmic decrement δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n).
Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration.
The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects.
quiz.explanation: 對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Logarithmic decrement δ = (1/n)·ln(A₀/A_n). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Accepting added damping by free decay: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由衰減試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free-decay test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每根受測索至少重複三次並取平均，檢查衰減曲線是否為單一指數（若出現轉折，可能是阻尼器摩擦或拍頻）；同時記錄風速與溫度，並把結果與阻尼器安裝前的基準比較，列入驗收報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat at least three times per stay and average, checking that the decay is a single exponential (a kink may indicate damper friction or beating between modes); record wind and temperature and compare with the pre-installation baseline in the acceptance report. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收計畫要規定受測索的抽樣比例、激振方法、振幅範圍、天候條件與允收值；高空激振作業須使用經核可的設備與安全措施，由主管工程師核准後執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The acceptance plan should set the sampling rate of stays tested, excitation method, amplitude range, weather conditions and acceptance values; excitation at height must use approved equipment and safety measures, authorised by the responsible engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在有風時做試驗，風的持續輸入使衰減變慢，量到的阻尼偏低而誤判不合格；或在兩個相近模態同時被激發時出現拍頻，用單一指數擬合會得到錯誤的阻尼值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing in wind slows the decay through continued input and understates damping, causing a false failure; exciting two close modes together produces beating, and a single exponential fit gives the wrong damping. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每根受測索至少重複三次並取平均，檢查衰減曲線是否為單一指數（若出現轉折，可能是阻尼器摩擦或拍頻）；同時記錄風速與溫度，並把結果與阻尼器安裝前的基準比較，列入驗收報告。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat at least three times per stay and average, checking that the decay is a single exponential (a kink may indicate damper friction or beating between modes); record wind and temperature and compare with the pre-installation baseline in the acceptance report.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 驗收計畫要規定受測索的抽樣比例、激振方法、振幅範圍、天候條件與允收值；高空激振作業須使用經核可的設備與安全措施，由主管工程師核准後執行。
knowledge.textEn: The acceptance plan should set the sampling rate of stays tested, excitation method, amplitude range, weather conditions and acceptance values; excitation at height must use approved equipment and safety measures, authorised by the responsible engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Accepting added damping by free decay"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
每根受測索至少重複三次並取平均，檢查衰減曲線是否為單一指數（若出現轉折，可能是阻尼器摩擦或拍頻）。
交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Repeat at least three times per stay and average, checking that the decay is a single exponential (a kink may indicate damper friction or beating between modes).
Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation.
quiz.explanation: 每根受測索至少重複三次並取平均，檢查衰減曲線是否為單一指數（若出現轉折，可能是阻尼器摩擦或拍頻）；同時記錄風速與溫度，並把結果與阻尼器安裝前的基準比較，列入驗收報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat at least three times per stay and average, checking that the decay is a single exponential (a kink may indicate damper friction or beating between modes); record wind and temperature and compare with the pre-installation baseline in the acceptance report. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Accepting added damping by free decay: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由衰減試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free-decay test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在有風時做試驗，風的持續輸入使衰減變慢，量到的阻尼偏低而誤判不合格；或在兩個相近模態同時被激發時出現拍頻，用單一指數擬合會得到錯誤的阻尼值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing in wind slows the decay through continued input and understates damping, causing a false failure; exciting two close modes together produces beating, and a single exponential fit gives the wrong damping. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收時把量到的阻尼代回史庫頓數，確認達到設計門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance substitutes the measured damping into the Scruton number to confirm the design threshold is met.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器有出廠試驗報告，就不需要在橋上做衰減試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A damper with a factory test report needs no decay test on the bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在有風時做試驗，風的持續輸入使衰減變慢，量到的阻尼偏低而誤判不合格；或在兩個相近模態同時被激發時出現拍頻，用單一指數擬合會得到錯誤的阻尼值。
knowledge.textEn: Testing in wind slows the decay through continued input and understates damping, causing a false failure; exciting two close modes together produces beating, and a single exponential fit gives the wrong damping.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「以自由衰減驗收附加阻尼」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Accepting added damping by free decay" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。
在有風時做試驗，風的持續輸入使衰減變慢，量到的阻尼偏低而誤判不合格；或在兩個相近模態同時被激發時出現拍頻，用單一指數擬合會得到錯誤的阻尼值。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue.
Testing in wind slows the decay through continued input and understates damping, causing a false failure.
quiz.explanation: 在有風時做試驗，風的持續輸入使衰減變慢，量到的阻尼偏低而誤判不合格；或在兩個相近模態同時被激發時出現拍頻，用單一指數擬合會得到錯誤的阻尼值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing in wind slows the decay through continued input and understates damping, causing a false failure; exciting two close modes together produces beating, and a single exponential fit gives the wrong damping. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞」與「阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bending fatigue at the anchor exit from vibration" and "Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bending fatigue at the anchor exit from vibration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「錨口導向器」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor-exit deviator” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜索振動時，索在錨具出口處被迫轉角，鋼絞線在此承受軸向應力之外的彎曲應力；振動頻率約 1 Hz 的雨風振動每小時就有數千次循環，累積多年後可能達到疲勞範圍。錨具出口通常設有導向器或濾彎裝置，讓轉角分散在一段長度上，降低局部曲率；供應商公開資料也提到為較大型鋼腱設置彎曲濾波器或導向器以限制彎曲應力。因此抑制振動不只是使用者感受的問題，而是保護錨口鋼絞線疲勞壽命的關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錨口導向器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When a stay vibrates, it is forced to rotate at the anchorage exit, and strands there see bending stress on top of axial stress; rain–wind vibration at about 1 Hz produces thousands of cycles per hour and over years can accumulate into the fatigue range. Anchor exits usually have deviators or bending filters that spread the rotation over a length and reduce local curvature; supplier material also mentions bending filters or deviators to limit bending stress in larger tendons. Suppressing vibration is therefore not just about user perception but key to protecting the fatigue life of strands at the anchor exit. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Anchor-exit deviator” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某索每年有 50 小時處於 1.2 Hz 的雨風振動，年循環數 = 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000 次，20 年約 4.32×10⁶ 次，已達鋼材 S–N 曲線的高循環範圍；若加裝阻尼器使振動時數降為 5 小時，循環數降為十分之一。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a stay spends 50 hours a year in rain–wind vibration at 1.2 Hz, the annual cycle count is 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000, about 4.32×10⁶ over 20 years, already in the high-cycle range of steel S–N curves; a damper retrofit cutting vibration to 5 hours a year reduces cycles tenfold.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「錨口導向器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Anchor-exit deviator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞
knowledge.titleEn: Bending fatigue at the anchor exit from vibration
knowledge.text: 斜索振動時，索在錨具出口處被迫轉角，鋼絞線在此承受軸向應力之外的彎曲應力；振動頻率約 1 Hz 的雨風振動每小時就有數千次循環，累積多年後可能達到疲勞範圍。錨具出口通常設有導向器或濾彎裝置，讓轉角分散在一段長度上，降低局部曲率；供應商公開資料也提到為較大型鋼腱設置彎曲濾波器或導向器以限制彎曲應力。
knowledge.textEn: When a stay vibrates, it is forced to rotate at the anchorage exit, and strands there see bending stress on top of axial stress; rain–wind vibration at about 1 Hz produces thousands of cycles per hour and over years can accumulate into the fatigue range. Anchor exits usually have deviators or bending filters that spread the rotation over a length and reduce local curvature; supplier material also mentions bending filters or deviators to limit bending stress in larger tendons.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bending fatigue at the anchor exit from vibration" is correct?
options: 斜索振動時，索在錨具出口處被迫轉角，鋼絞線在此承受軸向應力之外的彎曲應力；振動頻率約 1 Hz 的雨風振動每小時就有數千次循環，累積多年後可能達到疲勞範圍。
斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。
阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。
optionsEn: When a stay vibrates, it is forced to rotate at the anchorage exit, and strands there see bending stress on top of axial stress.
Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue.
Dampers are passive and last for the full design life once installed.
quiz.explanation: 斜索振動時，索在錨具出口處被迫轉角，鋼絞線在此承受軸向應力之外的彎曲應力；振動頻率約 1 Hz 的雨風振動每小時就有數千次循環，累積多年後可能達到疲勞範圍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When a stay vibrates, it is forced to rotate at the anchorage exit, and strands there see bending stress on top of axial stress; rain–wind vibration at about 1 Hz produces thousands of cycles per hour and over years can accumulate into the fatigue range. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bending fatigue at the anchor exit from vibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨口導向器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor-exit deviator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某索每年有 50 小時處於 1.2 Hz 的雨風振動，年循環數 = 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000 次，20 年約 4.32×10⁶ 次，已達鋼材 S–N 曲線的高循環範圍；若加裝阻尼器使振動時數降為 5 小時，循環數降為十分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If a stay spends 50 hours a year in rain–wind vibration at 1.2 Hz, the annual cycle count is 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000, about 4.32×10⁶ over 20 years, already in the high-cycle range of steel S–N curves; a damper retrofit cutting vibration to 5 hours a year reduces cycles tenfold. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以錨口附近的應變計量測振動時的彎曲應變範圍，配合監測統計的振動時數，以 S–N 曲線與 Miner 法則估算累積損傷；定期打開錨具保護蓋檢查錨口附近的鋼絞線、夾片與導向器磨耗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Gauge bending strain ranges near the anchor exit during vibration and combine with monitored vibration hours to estimate cumulative damage by S–N curves and Miner’s rule; periodically open anchorage caps to inspect strands, wedges and deviator wear near the exit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若某索每年有 50 小時處於 1.2 Hz 的雨風振動，年循環數 = 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000 次，20 年約 4.32×10⁶ 次，已達鋼材 S–N 曲線的高循環範圍；若加裝阻尼器使振動時數降為 5 小時，循環數降為十分之一。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If a stay spends 50 hours a year in rain–wind vibration at 1.2 Hz, the annual cycle count is 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000, about 4.32×10⁶ over 20 years, already in the high-cycle range of steel S–N curves; a damper retrofit cutting vibration to 5 hours a year reduces cycles tenfold. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

阻尼器裝在越靠近錨具的位置越好，因為那裡索最穩定。

If a stay spends 50 hours a year in rain–wind vibration at 1.2 Hz, the annual cycle count is 1.2×3,600×50 = 216,000, about 4.32×10⁶ over 20 years, already in the high-cycle range of steel S–N curves.

steps.title: 振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bending fatigue at the anchor exit from vibration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨口導向器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor-exit deviator” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以錨口附近的應變計量測振動時的彎曲應變範圍，配合監測統計的振動時數，以 S–N 曲線與 Miner 法則估算累積損傷；定期打開錨具保護蓋檢查錨口附近的鋼絞線、夾片與導向器磨耗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Gauge bending strain ranges near the anchor exit during vibration and combine with monitored vibration hours to estimate cumulative damage by S–N curves and Miner’s rule; periodically open anchorage caps to inspect strands, wedges and deviator wear near the exit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜索系統的疲勞試驗要包含錨口轉角條件，導向器與濾彎裝置列為可檢查與可更換構件；監測系統應統計每根索的大振幅時數，超過門檻時排入錨口專項檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stay-system fatigue tests should include anchor-exit rotation, with deviators and bending filters inspectable and replaceable; monitoring should count large-amplitude hours per stay and trigger a special anchor-exit inspection when a threshold is exceeded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導向器缺失或磨損，錨口處鋼絞線在反覆彎曲下出現斷絲，斷絲又使剩餘鋼絞線受力增加；由於位置隱蔽，若不定期檢查，可能等到多股斷裂才被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A missing or worn deviator lets strands at the anchor exit break wires under repeated bending, raising force in the remaining strands; because the location is hidden, without regular inspection the damage may be found only after several strands have failed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bending fatigue at the anchor exit from vibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨口導向器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchor-exit deviator” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導向器缺失或磨損，錨口處鋼絞線在反覆彎曲下出現斷絲，斷絲又使剩餘鋼絞線受力增加；由於位置隱蔽，若不定期檢查，可能等到多股斷裂才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A missing or worn deviator lets strands at the anchor exit break wires under repeated bending, raising force in the remaining strands; because the location is hidden, without regular inspection the damage may be found only after several strands have failed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此抑制振動不只是使用者感受的問題，而是保護錨口鋼絞線疲勞壽命的關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Suppressing vibration is therefore not just about user perception but key to protecting the fatigue life of strands at the anchor exit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索只承受軸向拉力，所以振動不會造成彎曲疲勞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stays carry only axial tension, so vibration cannot cause bending fatigue." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「振動造成的錨口彎曲疲勞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。

steps.title: 阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「阻尼器累積行程」如何影響斜張索雨風振動抑制的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damper cumulative stroke” governs force, deformation or durability in “Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜索阻尼器是長期反覆運動的機械元件，其耐久常以累積行程表示：供應商公開資料列出內置油壓阻尼器約 30 km、彈性體與外置油壓阻尼器約 100 km 的累積行程耐久。油壓阻尼器的密封會磨耗漏油，彈性體會老化硬化，連接銷與支架會鬆動。阻尼器失效時外觀往往看不出來，斜索卻會在下一場風雨中恢復振動。因此維護要結合定期檢查、監測資料中的振幅趨勢與事件後檢查，並把阻尼器的更換視為設計年限內的計畫性工作，而不是故障才處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「阻尼器累積行程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stay dampers are mechanical parts in constant reciprocating motion, and their durability is often expressed as cumulative stroke: a supplier lists about 30 km for internal hydraulic dampers and about 100 km for elastomeric and external hydraulic types. Hydraulic seals wear and leak, elastomers age and stiffen, and pins and brackets loosen. A failed damper often looks normal, yet the stay vibrates again in the next storm. Maintenance therefore combines periodic inspection, amplitude trends from monitoring and post-event checks, and treats damper replacement as planned work within the design life rather than a response to failure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Damper cumulative stroke” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：阻尼器處振幅 5 mm、頻率 1.5 Hz 時，每週期行程 4×5 = 20 mm，每小時 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 5 mm amplitude at the damper and 1.5 Hz, each cycle travels 4×5 = 20 mm, about 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m per hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dampers are passive and last for the full design life once installed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「阻尼器累積行程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Damper cumulative stroke”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 斜索阻尼器是長期反覆運動的機械元件，其耐久常以累積行程表示：供應商公開資料列出內置油壓阻尼器約 30 km、彈性體與外置油壓阻尼器約 100 km 的累積行程耐久。油壓阻尼器的密封會磨耗漏油，彈性體會老化硬化，連接銷與支架會鬆動。

Hydraulic seals wear and leak, elastomers age and stiffen, and pins and brackets loosen.

knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks" is correct?

steps.title: 阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「阻尼器累積行程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damper cumulative stroke” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：阻尼器處振幅 5 mm、頻率 1.5 Hz 時，每週期行程 4×5 = 20 mm，每小時 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m。耐久 30 km 的阻尼器約可承受 30,000/108 ≈ 278 小時此強度的振動；100 km 型約 926 小時。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 5 mm amplitude at the damper and 1.5 Hz, each cycle travels 4×5 = 20 mm, about 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m per hour. A 30 km damper withstands about 30,000/108 ≈ 278 hours of such vibration; a 100 km type about 926 hours. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期目視檢查漏油、密封、支架與連接銷，並以監測資料估算每個阻尼器的累積行程，接近耐久值時排定更換；強風或颱風等事件後，抽查阻尼器行程極限是否被撞擊並複測代表性斜索的阻尼。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect periodically for leaks, seals, brackets and pins, estimate each damper’s cumulative stroke from monitoring data and schedule replacement as it nears its rating; after strong-wind events check whether stroke limits were struck and re-measure damping on representative stays.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 阻尼器處振幅 5 mm、頻率 1.5 Hz 時，每週期行程 4×5 = 20 mm，每小時 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m。耐久 30 km 的阻尼器約可承受 30,000/108 ≈ 278 小時此強度的振動；100 km 型約 926 小時。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 5 mm amplitude at the damper and 1.5 Hz, each cycle travels 4×5 = 20 mm, about 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m per hour. A 30 km damper withstands about 30,000/108 ≈ 278 hours of such vibration; a 100 km type about 926 hours. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks", which statement holds?
options: 套管表面處理越粗糙，抑振效果越好且沒有副作用。
交叉索只是把斜索綁在一起，不需要計算預拉力。
阻尼器處振幅 5 mm、頻率 1.5 Hz 時，每週期行程 4×5 = 20 mm，每小時 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m。
optionsEn: The rougher the duct surface, the better the suppression, with no side effects.
Cross-ties just tie stays together and need no pretension calculation.
With 5 mm amplitude at the damper and 1.5 Hz, each cycle travels 4×5 = 20 mm, about 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m per hour.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器處振幅 5 mm、頻率 1.5 Hz 時，每週期行程 4×5 = 20 mm，每小時 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 5 mm amplitude at the damper and 1.5 Hz, each cycle travels 4×5 = 20 mm, about 1.5×3,600×20 mm ≈ 108 m per hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「阻尼器累積行程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Damper cumulative stroke” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期目視檢查漏油、密封、支架與連接銷，並以監測資料估算每個阻尼器的累積行程，接近耐久值時排定更換；強風或颱風等事件後，抽查阻尼器行程極限是否被撞擊並複測代表性斜索的阻尼。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect periodically for leaks, seals, brackets and pins, estimate each damper’s cumulative stroke from monitoring data and schedule replacement as it nears its rating; after strong-wind events check whether stroke limits were struck and re-measure damping on representative stays. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件要列出每個阻尼器的型號、設定係數、行程、耐久值、安裝日期與更換程序，並提供備品清單；維護紀錄應把阻尼器檢查結果與監測振幅趨勢放在同一資料庫中比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should list each damper’s type, coefficient setting, stroke, durability rating, installation date and replacement procedure, with a spares list; maintenance records should compare inspection findings with monitored amplitude trends in one database.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：阻尼器漏油後阻尼係數下降，斜索在風雨中振動加劇，錨口疲勞與套管磨損加速；若沒有累積行程的估算，更換只能等到振動被民眾發現，屆時已累積可觀的疲勞損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A leaking damper loses coefficient, stay vibration grows in wind and rain, and anchor-exit fatigue and duct wear accelerate; without cumulative-stroke estimates replacement waits until the public notices vibration, by which time considerable fatigue damage has accrued. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期目視檢查漏油、密封、支架與連接銷，並以監測資料估算每個阻尼器的累積行程，接近耐久值時排定更換；強風或颱風等事件後，抽查阻尼器行程極限是否被撞擊並複測代表性斜索的阻尼。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect periodically for leaks, seals, brackets and pins, estimate each damper’s cumulative stroke from monitoring data and schedule replacement as it nears its rating; after strong-wind events check whether stroke limits were struck and re-measure damping on representative stays.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件要列出每個阻尼器的型號、設定係數、行程、耐久值、安裝日期與更換程序，並提供備品清單；維護紀錄應把阻尼器檢查結果與監測振幅趨勢放在同一資料庫中比對。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should list each damper’s type, coefficient setting, stroke, durability rating, installation date and replacement procedure, with a spares list; maintenance records should compare inspection findings with monitored amplitude trends in one database.

quiz.question: 要驗證「阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks"?
options: 定期目視檢查漏油、密封、支架與連接銷，並以監測資料估算每個阻尼器的累積行程，接近耐久值時排定更換。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要有風速計和加速度計，就足以判斷斜索振動的原因。
optionsEn: Inspect periodically for leaks, seals, brackets and pins, estimate each damper’s cumulative stroke from monitoring data and schedule replacement as it nears its rating.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An anemometer and accelerometers are enough to diagnose the cause of stay vibration.
quiz.explanation: 定期目視檢查漏油、密封、支架與連接銷，並以監測資料估算每個阻尼器的累積行程，接近耐久值時排定更換；強風或颱風等事件後，抽查阻尼器行程極限是否被撞擊並複測代表性斜索的阻尼。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect periodically for leaks, seals, brackets and pins, estimate each damper’s cumulative stroke from monitoring data and schedule replacement as it nears its rating; after strong-wind events check whether stroke limits were struck and re-measure damping on representative stays. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「阻尼器累積行程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Damper cumulative stroke” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器漏油後阻尼係數下降，斜索在風雨中振動加劇，錨口疲勞與套管磨損加速；若沒有累積行程的估算，更換只能等到振動被民眾發現，屆時已累積可觀的疲勞損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A leaking damper loses coefficient, stay vibration grows in wind and rain, and anchor-exit fatigue and duct wear accelerate; without cumulative-stroke estimates replacement waits until the public notices vibration, by which time considerable fatigue damage has accrued. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此維護要結合定期檢查、監測資料中的振幅趨勢與事件後檢查，並把阻尼器的更換視為設計年限內的計畫性工作，而不是故障才處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance therefore combines periodic inspection, amplitude trends from monitoring and post-event checks, and treats damper replacement as planned work within the design life rather than a response to failure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器是被動元件，裝好後可以使用到橋梁設計年限結束。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dampers are passive and last for the full design life once installed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 阻尼器漏油後阻尼係數下降，斜索在風雨中振動加劇，錨口疲勞與套管磨損加速；若沒有累積行程的估算，更換只能等到振動被民眾發現，屆時已累積可觀的疲勞損傷。
knowledge.textEn: A leaking damper loses coefficient, stay vibration grows in wind and rain, and anchor-exit fatigue and duct wear accelerate; without cumulative-stroke estimates replacement waits until the public notices vibration, by which time considerable fatigue damage has accrued.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「阻尼器耐久、維護與事件後檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Damper durability, maintenance and post-event checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
阻尼器漏油後阻尼係數下降，斜索在風雨中振動加劇，錨口疲勞與套管磨損加速；若沒有累積行程的估算，更換只能等到振動被民眾發現，屆時已累積可觀的疲勞損傷。
雨水只是增加斜索重量，不會引起振動。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A leaking damper loses coefficient, stay vibration grows in wind and rain, and anchor-exit fatigue and duct wear accelerate.
Rain only adds weight to a stay and cannot cause vibration.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器漏油後阻尼係數下降，斜索在風雨中振動加劇，錨口疲勞與套管磨損加速；若沒有累積行程的估算，更換只能等到振動被民眾發現，屆時已累積可觀的疲勞損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A leaking damper loses coefficient, stay vibration grows in wind and rain, and anchor-exit fatigue and duct wear accelerate; without cumulative-stroke estimates replacement waits until the public notices vibration, by which time considerable fatigue damage has accrued. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 金門大橋（金門）
summary: 金門大橋跨越金烈水道連接大金門與小金門，全長約 5.4 公里，主橋為五塔六跨預力箱梁脊背橋，最大跨徑 200 公尺。本課從海況與荷載出發，拆解脊背索的受力分工、花崗片麻岩中的大口徑基樁、鋼箱圍堰樁帽、興達港預鑄節塊的海運與懸臂吊裝、索力量測與載重試驗，最後談海洋耐久與營運交接。
summaryEn: Kinmen Bridge crosses the Kinmen–Lieyu channel between Greater and Lesser Kinmen; the route is about 5.4 km long and the main bridge is a five-tower, six-span prestressed box-girder extradosed bridge with a longest span of 200 m. Starting from sea conditions and loads, the course unpacks how extradosed stays share load, large-diameter piles in granitic gneiss, steel box cofferdam pile caps, sea transport and cantilever erection of segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour, stay-force measurement and load testing, and finally marine durability and operational handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一個 200 m 跨的脊背橋跨，箱梁恆載 w = 300 kN/m，假設脊背索承擔 30% 的恆載，每跨共 16 根索。索承擔的總垂直力 = 300×200×0.3 = 18,000 kN，每根 V = 18,000/16 = 1,125 kN。索角 20° 時索力 T = V/sin20° = 1,125/0.342 ≈ 3,289 kN，送入箱梁的水平壓力 H = T·cos20° ≈ 3,091 kN。單股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線面積 140 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa：以 0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa 計需 3,289,000/(1,116×140) ≈ 21.1，取 22 股；若因應力幅大改用 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa，需約 28.1，取 29 股。若把索角提高到 25°，T ≈ 2,662 kN，以 0.6 f_pu 計只需約 17.0，取 18 股，但橋塔要更高。數值為教學假設，不代表金門大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 200 m extradosed span has a girder dead load w = 300 kN/m, and the stays are assumed to carry 30% of it with 16 stays per span. The total vertical stay force is 300×200×0.3 = 18,000 kN, so each stay carries V = 18,000/16 = 1,125 kN. At 20° the stay force is T = V/sin20° = 1,125/0.342 ≈ 3,289 kN and the horizontal compression into the girder is H = T·cos20° ≈ 3,091 kN. With 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² and f_pu = 1,860 MPa, 0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa needs 3,289,000/(1,116×140) ≈ 21.1, so 22 strands; if a large stress range forces 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa, about 28.1 are needed, so 29 strands. Raising the angle to 25° gives T ≈ 2,662 kN and only about 17.0, so 18 strands, at 0.6 f_pu, but the towers must be taller. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of Kinmen Bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「金烈水道海況與荷載組合」與「五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Channel conditions and load cases" and "Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 金烈水道海況與荷載組合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Channel conditions and load cases: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「深槽區鋼套管」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deep-channel steel casing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 金門大橋跨越金烈水道，深槽區水深約 22 至 23 公尺，最大潮差約 6 公尺，海流可達約 1.6 m/s，冬季有東北季風、春季有濃霧、夏秋有颱風。對基礎與施工臨時結構而言，海流拖曳力、波浪力與潮位變化同時作用；對上部結構則以颱風風壓、地震與溫度為主。設計時要把永久狀態（營運、地震、颱風、船舶撞擊）與施工狀態（鋼套管、作業平台、懸臂）的荷載組合分開列出，因為施工中的臨時結構常比完工結構更脆弱，而且暴露在海上的時間以年計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「深槽區鋼套管」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Kinmen Bridge crosses the Kinmen–Lieyu channel, where the deep trough is about 22 to 23 m deep, the maximum tidal range is about 6 m and currents reach about 1.6 m/s, with the northeast monsoon in winter, fog in spring and typhoons in summer and autumn. Foundations and temporary works feel current drag, wave forces and tide changes at the same time, while the superstructure is governed by typhoon wind, earthquake and temperature. Design must list permanent states (service, earthquake, typhoon, ship impact) separately from construction states (steel casings, work platforms, cantilevers), because temporary structures are often more vulnerable than the finished bridge and stay exposed at sea for years. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deep-channel steel casing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：海流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Current drag F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「深槽區鋼套管」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deep-channel steel casing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 金烈水道海況與荷載組合
knowledge.text: 金門大橋跨越金烈水道，深槽區水深約 22 至 23 公尺，最大潮差約 6 公尺，海流可達約 1.6 m/s，冬季有東北季風、春季有濃霧、夏秋有颱風。對基礎與施工臨時結構而言，海流拖曳力、波浪力與潮位變化同時作用；對上部結構則以颱風風壓、地震與溫度為主。
knowledge.textEn: Kinmen Bridge crosses the Kinmen–Lieyu channel, where the deep trough is about 22 to 23 m deep, the maximum tidal range is about 6 m and currents reach about 1.6 m/s, with the northeast monsoon in winter, fog in spring and typhoons in summer and autumn. Foundations and temporary works feel current drag, wave forces and tide changes at the same time, while the superstructure is governed by typhoon wind, earthquake and temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「金烈水道海況與荷載組合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Channel conditions and load cases" is correct?
options: 海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。
金門大橋跨越金烈水道，深槽區水深約 22 至 23 公尺，最大潮差約 6 公尺，海流可達約 1.6 m/s，冬季有東北季風、春季有濃霧、夏秋有颱風。
脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。
optionsEn: Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge.

Kinmen Bridge crosses the Kinmen–Lieyu channel, where the deep trough is about 22 to 23 m deep, the maximum tidal range is about 6 m and currents reach about 1.6 m/s, with the northeast monsoon in winter, fog in spring and typhoons in summer and autumn.
An extradosed bridge is just a cable-stayed bridge with short towers and is designed the same way.
quiz.explanation: 金門大橋跨越金烈水道，深槽區水深約 22 至 23 公尺，最大潮差約 6 公尺，海流可達約 1.6 m/s，冬季有東北季風、春季有濃霧、夏秋有颱風。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Kinmen Bridge crosses the Kinmen–Lieyu channel, where the deep trough is about 22 to 23 m deep, the maximum tidal range is about 6 m and currents reach about 1.6 m/s, with the northeast monsoon in winter, fog in spring and typhoons in summer and autumn. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 金烈水道海況與荷載組合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Channel conditions and load cases: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「深槽區鋼套管」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deep-channel steel casing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：海流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U²。取 ρ = 1,025 kg/m³、C_D = 1.0、外套管直徑 D = 3.0 m、水深 h = 23 m、流速 U = 1.6 m/s，F = 0.5×1,025×1.0×3.0×23×1.6² ≈ 90.5 kN；若合力作用在半水深，海床處彎矩約 90.5×11.5 ≈ 1,041 kN·m。流速加倍時拖曳力變為 4 倍，約 362 kN。C_D、D 與作用點為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Current drag F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U². With ρ = 1,025 kg/m³, C_D = 1.0, outer casing diameter D = 3.0 m, water depth h = 23 m and U = 1.6 m/s, F = 0.5×1,025×1.0×3.0×23×1.6² ≈ 90.5 kN; acting at mid-depth it gives a seabed moment of about 90.5×11.5 ≈ 1,041 kN·m. Doubling the velocity quadruples the drag to about 362 kN. C_D, D and the point of action are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以聲學都卜勒流速剖面儀（ADCP）與潮位站資料建立設計流速剖面，套管定位時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測位置與垂直度，並比較漲退潮最急時套管頂偏位與計算撓度；作業平台與臨時結構的荷載檢核經工程師簽認後才能使用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the design current profile from acoustic Doppler current profiler (ADCP) surveys and tide-gauge records, measure casing position and verticality with GNSS and inclinometers during placement, and compare casing-top drift at peak flood and ebb with the calculated deflection; platforms and temporary works are used only after their load checks are signed off by an engineer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 海流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U²。取 ρ = 1,025 kg/m³、C_D = 1.0、外套管直徑 D = 3.0 m、水深 h = 23 m、流速 U = 1.6 m/s，F = 0.5×1,025×1.0×3.0×23×1.6² ≈ 90.5 kN；若合力作用在半水深，海床處彎矩約 90.5×11.5 ≈ 1,041 kN·m。流速加倍時拖曳力變為 4 倍，約 362 kN。C_D、D 與作用點為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Current drag F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U². With ρ = 1,025 kg/m³, C_D = 1.0, outer casing diameter D = 3.0 m, water depth h = 23 m and U = 1.6 m/s, F = 0.5×1,025×1.0×3.0×23×1.6² ≈ 90.5 kN; acting at mid-depth it gives a seabed moment of about 90.5×11.5 ≈ 1,041 kN·m. Doubling the velocity quadruples the drag to about 362 kN. C_D, D and the point of action are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「金烈水道海況與荷載組合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Channel conditions and load cases", which statement holds?
options: 鋼箱圍堰只是擋水的模板，抽水時不會產生很大的力。
平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。
海流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U²。
optionsEn: A steel box cofferdam is only a formwork that keeps water out, so dewatering creates no large forces.
In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending.
Current drag F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U².
quiz.explanation: 海流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Current drag F = ½ρ·C_D·D·h·U². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 金烈水道海況與荷載組合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Channel conditions and load cases: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「深槽區鋼套管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deep-channel steel casing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以聲學都卜勒流速剖面儀（ADCP）與潮位站資料建立設計流速剖面，套管定位時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測位置與垂直度，並比較漲退潮最急時套管頂偏位與計算撓度；作業平台與臨時結構的荷載檢核經工程師簽認後才能使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the design current profile from acoustic Doppler current profiler (ADCP) surveys and tide-gauge records, measure casing position and verticality with GNSS and inclinometers during placement, and compare casing-top drift at peak flood and ebb with the calculated deflection; platforms and temporary works are used only after their load checks are signed off by an engineer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：海事工程應建立潮流與氣象作業門檻表（流速、風速、浪高、能見度），每日開工前檢核，超過門檻即停止吊裝與定位；颱風警報發布前完成船機撤離與臨時結構加固，並由監造單位確認紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Marine works need an operating-limit table for current, wind, wave height and visibility, checked before each shift, with lifting and positioning stopped when a limit is exceeded; before a typhoon warning, vessels are withdrawn and temporary works secured, with records confirmed by the supervising engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以平均流速而非尖峰流速設計臨時套管與平台，漲退潮最急時套管偏移、鑽孔偏斜，樁身垂直度超出容許值，鋼筋籠無法順利下放或基樁偏心受力；颱風來襲前若未撤離施工船機，船舶走錨也可能撞擊已完成的墩柱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing temporary casings and platforms for mean rather than peak current lets the casing drift and the bore wander at peak flow, so pile verticality exceeds tolerance, reinforcement cages cannot be lowered cleanly or the pile is loaded eccentrically; work vessels not withdrawn before a typhoon can drag anchor and strike finished piers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以聲學都卜勒流速剖面儀（ADCP）與潮位站資料建立設計流速剖面，套管定位時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測位置與垂直度，並比較漲退潮最急時套管頂偏位與計算撓度；作業平台與臨時結構的荷載檢核經工程師簽認後才能使用。
knowledge.textEn: Build the design current profile from acoustic Doppler current profiler (ADCP) surveys and tide-gauge records, measure casing position and verticality with GNSS and inclinometers during placement, and compare casing-top drift at peak flood and ebb with the calculated deflection; platforms and temporary works are used only after their load checks are signed off by an engineer.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 海事工程應建立潮流與氣象作業門檻表（流速、風速、浪高、能見度），每日開工前檢核，超過門檻即停止吊裝與定位；颱風警報發布前完成船機撤離與臨時結構加固，並由監造單位確認紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Marine works need an operating-limit table for current, wind, wave height and visibility, checked before each shift, with lifting and positioning stopped when a limit is exceeded; before a typhoon warning, vessels are withdrawn and temporary works secured, with records confirmed by the supervising engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「金烈水道海況與荷載組合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Channel conditions and load cases"?
options: 以聲學都卜勒流速剖面儀（ADCP）與潮位站資料建立設計流速剖面，套管定位時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測位置與垂直度，並比較漲退潮最急時套管頂偏位與計算撓度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。
optionsEn: Build the design current profile from acoustic Doppler current profiler (ADCP) surveys and tide-gauge records, measure casing position and verticality with GNSS and inclinometers during placement, and compare casing-top drift at peak flood and ebb with the calculated deflection.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking.
quiz.explanation: 以聲學都卜勒流速剖面儀（ADCP）與潮位站資料建立設計流速剖面，套管定位時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測位置與垂直度，並比較漲退潮最急時套管頂偏位與計算撓度；作業平台與臨時結構的荷載檢核經工程師簽認後才能使用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the design current profile from acoustic Doppler current profiler (ADCP) surveys and tide-gauge records, measure casing position and verticality with GNSS and inclinometers during placement, and compare casing-top drift at peak flood and ebb with the calculated deflection; platforms and temporary works are used only after their load checks are signed off by an engineer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 金烈水道海況與荷載組合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Channel conditions and load cases: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「深槽區鋼套管」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deep-channel steel casing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以平均流速而非尖峰流速設計臨時套管與平台，漲退潮最急時套管偏移、鑽孔偏斜，樁身垂直度超出容許值，鋼筋籠無法順利下放或基樁偏心受力；颱風來襲前若未撤離施工船機，船舶走錨也可能撞擊已完成的墩柱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing temporary casings and platforms for mean rather than peak current lets the casing drift and the bore wander at peak flow, so pile verticality exceeds tolerance, reinforcement cages cannot be lowered cleanly or the pile is loaded eccentrically; work vessels not withdrawn before a typhoon can drag anchor and strike finished piers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計時要把永久狀態（營運、地震、颱風、船舶撞擊）與施工狀態（鋼套管、作業平台、懸臂）的荷載組合分開列出，因為施工中的臨時結構常比完工結構更脆弱，而且暴露在海上的時間以年計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design must list permanent states (service, earthquake, typhoon, ship impact) separately from construction states (steel casings, work platforms, cantilevers), because temporary structures are often more vulnerable than the finished bridge and stay exposed at sea for years.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以平均流速而非尖峰流速設計臨時套管與平台，漲退潮最急時套管偏移、鑽孔偏斜，樁身垂直度超出容許值，鋼筋籠無法順利下放或基樁偏心受力；颱風來襲前若未撤離施工船機，船舶走錨也可能撞擊已完成的墩柱。
knowledge.textEn: Designing temporary casings and platforms for mean rather than peak current lets the casing drift and the bore wander at peak flow, so pile verticality exceeds tolerance, reinforcement cages cannot be lowered cleanly or the pile is loaded eccentrically; work vessels not withdrawn before a typhoon can drag anchor and strike finished piers.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「金烈水道海況與荷載組合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Channel conditions and load cases" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若以平均流速而非尖峰流速設計臨時套管與平台，漲退潮最急時套管偏移、鑽孔偏斜，樁身垂直度超出容許值，鋼筋籠無法順利下放或基樁偏心受力。
脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Designing temporary casings and platforms for mean rather than peak current lets the casing drift and the bore wander at peak flow, so pile verticality exceeds tolerance, reinforcement cages cannot be lowered cleanly or the pile is loaded eccentrically.
An extradosed bridge is just a cable-stayed bridge with short towers and is designed the same way.
quiz.explanation: 若以平均流速而非尖峰流速設計臨時套管與平台，漲退潮最急時套管偏移、鑽孔偏斜，樁身垂直度超出容許值，鋼筋籠無法順利下放或基樁偏心受力；颱風來襲前若未撤離施工船機，船舶走錨也可能撞擊已完成的墩柱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing temporary casings and platforms for mean rather than peak current lets the casing drift and the bore wander at peak flow, so pile verticality exceeds tolerance, reinforcement cages cannot be lowered cleanly or the pile is loaded eccentrically; work vessels not withdrawn before a typhoon can drag anchor and strike finished piers. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「脊背索與低矮橋塔」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Extradosed stays and low towers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主橋為五塔六跨預力混凝土箱梁脊背橋，跨徑配置為 125 + 4×200 + 125 公尺，主橋長 1,050 公尺。脊背橋介於梁橋與斜張橋之間：橋塔較矮，脊背索以平緩角度錨在箱梁上，作用像體外預力，把水平壓力送入梁內並提供部分垂直支撐，箱梁仍需足夠梁深承擔大部分彎矩。索角平緩使活載造成的索應力幅較小，疲勞要求較寬鬆，部分準則因此允許較高的索應力比例。多塔連續時，中間塔沒有錨碇跨平衡，不對稱活載下要靠箱梁與墩塔勁度控制變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「脊背索與低矮橋塔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main bridge is a five-tower, six-span prestressed concrete box-girder extradosed bridge with spans of 125 + 4×200 + 125 m and a length of 1,050 m. An extradosed bridge sits between a girder bridge and a cable-stayed bridge: towers are short and stays anchor into the girder at a shallow angle, acting like external prestress that pushes compression into the girder and adds partial vertical support, while the girder still needs enough depth to carry most of the bending. The shallow angle keeps the live-load stress range in the stays small, so fatigue demands are milder and some guidelines allow a higher stress ratio. With several towers in a row, the inner towers have no anchor span to balance them, so girder and tower stiffness must control deformation under unbalanced live load. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Extradosed stays and low towers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：索力 T = 5,000 kN、索角 20° 時，垂直分量 V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN，水平壓力 H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN；斜張橋常見的 35° 則 V ≈ 2,868 kN、H ≈ 4,096 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a stay force T = 5,000 kN at 20°, the vertical component is V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN and the horizontal compression H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN; at a typical cable-stayed angle of 35°, V ≈ 2,868 kN and H ≈ 4,096 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An extradosed bridge is just a cable-stayed bridge with short towers and is designed the same way." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「脊背索與低矮橋塔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Extradosed stays and low towers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工
knowledge.titleEn: Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge

An extradosed bridge sits between a girder bridge and a cable-stayed bridge: towers are short and stays anchor into the girder at a shallow angle, acting like external prestress that pushes compression into the girder and adds partial vertical support, while the girder still needs enough depth to carry most of the bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge" is correct?
options: 脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。
只要基樁打到設計高程，就代表已經進入足夠的岩盤。
主橋為五塔六跨預力混凝土箱梁脊背橋，跨徑配置為 125 + 4×200 + 125 公尺，主橋長 1,050 公尺。

Reaching the design toe level means the pile is socketed into enough rock.
