quiz.explanation: 主橋為五塔六跨預力混凝土箱梁脊背橋，跨徑配置為 125 + 4×200 + 125 公尺，主橋長 1,050 公尺。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The main bridge is a five-tower, six-span prestressed concrete box-girder extradosed bridge with spans of 125 + 4×200 + 125 m and a length of 1,050 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「脊背索與低矮橋塔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Extradosed stays and low towers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：索力 T = 5,000 kN、索角 20° 時，垂直分量 V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN，水平壓力 H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN；斜張橋常見的 35° 則 V ≈ 2,868 kN、H ≈ 4,096 kN。以 f_pu = 1,860 MPa 計，0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa，0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a stay force T = 5,000 kN at 20°, the vertical component is V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN and the horizontal compression H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN; at a typical cable-stayed angle of 35°, V ≈ 2,868 kN and H ≈ 4,096 kN. With f_pu = 1,860 MPa, 0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa and 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全橋有限元素模型比較有無脊背索時的箱梁彎矩包絡與撓度，確認索與梁各自承擔的比例；設計審查時逐根檢查活載應力幅，據以決定該索採用脊背索或斜張索的容許應力與疲勞試驗要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare girder moment envelopes and deflections with and without the stays in a whole-bridge finite-element model to confirm the share carried by stays and girder; in design review check the live-load stress range of every stay to decide whether extradosed or cable-stayed allowable stresses and fatigue-test requirements apply.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 索力 T = 5,000 kN、索角 20° 時，垂直分量 V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN，水平壓力 H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN；斜張橋常見的 35° 則 V ≈ 2,868 kN、H ≈ 4,096 kN。以 f_pu = 1,860 MPa 計，0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa，0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a stay force T = 5,000 kN at 20°, the vertical component is V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN and the horizontal compression H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN; at a typical cable-stayed angle of 35°, V ≈ 2,868 kN and H ≈ 4,096 kN. With f_pu = 1,860 MPa, 0.6 f_pu = 1,116 MPa and 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge", which statement holds?
options: 索力 T = 5,000 kN、索角 20° 時，垂直分量 V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN，水平壓力 H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN。
預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。
只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。
optionsEn: For a stay force T = 5,000 kN at 20°, the vertical component is V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN and the horizontal compression H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN.
Factory-precast segments are so precise that no geometry control is needed on site.
Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length.
quiz.explanation: 索力 T = 5,000 kN、索角 20° 時，垂直分量 V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN，水平壓力 H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN；斜張橋常見的 35° 則 V ≈ 2,868 kN、H ≈ 4,096 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a stay force T = 5,000 kN at 20°, the vertical component is V = T·sin20° ≈ 1,710 kN and the horizontal compression H = T·cos20° ≈ 4,698 kN; at a typical cable-stayed angle of 35°, V ≈ 2,868 kN and H ≈ 4,096 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「脊背索與低矮橋塔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Extradosed stays and low towers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全橋有限元素模型比較有無脊背索時的箱梁彎矩包絡與撓度，確認索與梁各自承擔的比例；設計審查時逐根檢查活載應力幅，據以決定該索採用脊背索或斜張索的容許應力與疲勞試驗要求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare girder moment envelopes and deflections with and without the stays in a whole-bridge finite-element model to confirm the share carried by stays and girder; in design review check the live-load stress range of every stay to decide whether extradosed or cable-stayed allowable stresses and fatigue-test requirements apply. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計報告應列出每根索的活載應力幅並據以分類，寫明採用的容許應力比例與準則來源；多塔橋另列不對稱活載工況的塔頂位移與梁體應力檢核，並把結果交給施工監控作為比對基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design report should tabulate the live-load stress range of each stay and classify it, stating the allowable stress ratio and its source guideline; multi-tower bridges also need a separate check of tower-top drift and girder stress under unbalanced live load, handed to construction monitoring as a reference.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把脊背索當成斜張索、以高應力幅假設設計，可能過度保守；反之若實際應力幅偏大卻採用較高容許應力，錨頭與塔頂鞍座可能提早疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating extradosed stays as cable-stays with a high assumed stress range can be over-conservative; conversely, using the higher allowable stress where the real range is large can fatigue anchorages and tower saddles early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全橋有限元素模型比較有無脊背索時的箱梁彎矩包絡與撓度，確認索與梁各自承擔的比例；設計審查時逐根檢查活載應力幅，據以決定該索採用脊背索或斜張索的容許應力與疲勞試驗要求。
knowledge.textEn: Compare girder moment envelopes and deflections with and without the stays in a whole-bridge finite-element model to confirm the share carried by stays and girder; in design review check the live-load stress range of every stay to decide whether extradosed or cable-stayed allowable stresses and fatigue-test requirements apply.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計報告應列出每根索的活載應力幅並據以分類，寫明採用的容許應力比例與準則來源；多塔橋另列不對稱活載工況的塔頂位移與梁體應力檢核，並把結果交給施工監控作為比對基準。
knowledge.textEn: The design report should tabulate the live-load stress range of each stay and classify it, stating the allowable stress ratio and its source guideline; multi-tower bridges also need a separate check of tower-top drift and girder stress under unbalanced live load, handed to construction monitoring as a reference.

quiz.question: 要驗證「五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以全橋有限元素模型比較有無脊背索時的箱梁彎矩包絡與撓度，確認索與梁各自承擔的比例。
混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compare girder moment envelopes and deflections with and without the stays in a whole-bridge finite-element model to confirm the share carried by stays and girder.
Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode.
quiz.explanation: 以全橋有限元素模型比較有無脊背索時的箱梁彎矩包絡與撓度，確認索與梁各自承擔的比例；設計審查時逐根檢查活載應力幅，據以決定該索採用脊背索或斜張索的容許應力與疲勞試驗要求。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare girder moment envelopes and deflections with and without the stays in a whole-bridge finite-element model to confirm the share carried by stays and girder; in design review check the live-load stress range of every stay to decide whether extradosed or cable-stayed allowable stresses and fatigue-test requirements apply. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「脊背索與低矮橋塔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Extradosed stays and low towers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把脊背索當成斜張索、以高應力幅假設設計，可能過度保守；反之若實際應力幅偏大卻採用較高容許應力，錨頭與塔頂鞍座可能提早疲勞。多塔體系忽略不對稱活載時，中間塔頂偏移與箱梁開裂會超出預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating extradosed stays as cable-stays with a high assumed stress range can be over-conservative; conversely, using the higher allowable stress where the real range is large can fatigue anchorages and tower saddles early. Ignoring unbalanced live load in a multi-tower system lets inner-tower drift and girder cracking exceed expectations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多塔連續時，中間塔沒有錨碇跨平衡，不對稱活載下要靠箱梁與墩塔勁度控制變形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With several towers in a row, the inner towers have no anchor span to balance them, so girder and tower stiffness must control deformation under unbalanced live load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An extradosed bridge is just a cable-stayed bridge with short towers and is designed the same way." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把脊背索當成斜張索、以高應力幅假設設計，可能過度保守；反之若實際應力幅偏大卻採用較高容許應力，錨頭與塔頂鞍座可能提早疲勞。多塔體系忽略不對稱活載時，中間塔頂偏移與箱梁開裂會超出預期。
knowledge.textEn: Treating extradosed stays as cable-stays with a high assumed stress range can be over-conservative; conversely, using the higher allowable stress where the real range is large can fatigue anchorages and tower saddles early. Ignoring unbalanced live load in a multi-tower system lets inner-tower drift and girder cracking exceed expectations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「五塔六跨脊背橋的受力分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load sharing in the five-tower extradosed bridge" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要基樁打到設計高程，就代表已經進入足夠的岩盤。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reaching the design toe level means the pile is socketed into enough rock.
Treating extradosed stays as cable-stays with a high assumed stress range can be over-conservative.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「花崗片麻岩中的全套管基樁」與「鋼箱圍堰與海中樁帽」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 花崗片麻岩中的全套管基樁：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cased bored piles in granitic gneiss: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「2.5 m 基樁嵌岩段」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2.5 m pile rock socket” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 金門大橋約有 532 支基樁，主橋樁徑 2.5 公尺，邊橋 2.0 公尺，引橋 1.5 公尺，以全套管場鑄鋼筋混凝土樁施工。海床下是堅硬且傾斜、深度變化大的花崗片麻岩，大口徑基樁必須貫入岩盤，以嵌岩段側阻力與端承力承擔墩柱的垂直力與彎矩。岩面傾斜時，套管下端只有一側先碰到岩盤，容易造成鑽頭偏斜、樁底不完整或套管無法密封，因此每支樁的入岩深度要依實測岩面調整，而不是套用統一樁長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「2.5 m 基樁嵌岩段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Kinmen Bridge has about 532 piles: 2.5 m diameter under the main bridge, 2.0 m under the side bridges and 1.5 m under the approaches, all built as fully cased cast-in-place reinforced-concrete piles. Beneath the seabed lies hard granitic gneiss with a sloping, variable rock head, so large piles must penetrate the rock and carry pier axial force and moment through socket side resistance and end bearing. On a sloping rock face the casing touches rock on one side first, which can deflect the bit, leave an incomplete toe or prevent sealing, so each pile's socket length must follow the rock head actually found rather than a uniform pile length. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “2.5 m pile rock socket” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：嵌岩側阻 Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s，取 D = 2.5 m、L_s = 6 m、f_s = 1.0 MPa：Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN；端承 q_b = 5 MPa、A_b = π×2.5²/4 ≈ 4.91 m²，Q_b ≈ 24,500 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Socket side resistance Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s with D = 2.5 m, L_s = 6 m and f_s = 1.0 MPa gives Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN; end bearing with q_b = 5 MPa on A_b = π×2.5²/4 ≈ 4.91 m² gives Q_b ≈ 24,500 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要基樁打到設計高程，就代表已經進入足夠的岩盤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching the design toe level means the pile is socketed into enough rock." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「2.5 m 基樁嵌岩段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “2.5 m pile rock socket”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 花崗片麻岩中的全套管基樁：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cased bored piles in granitic gneiss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「2.5 m 基樁嵌岩段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2.5 m pile rock socket” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：嵌岩側阻 Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s，取 D = 2.5 m、L_s = 6 m、f_s = 1.0 MPa：Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN；端承 q_b = 5 MPa、A_b = π×2.5²/4 ≈ 4.91 m²，Q_b ≈ 24,500 kN。合計約 71,700 kN，安全係數 2.5 時容許約 28,700 kN。f_s、q_b、L_s 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Socket side resistance Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s with D = 2.5 m, L_s = 6 m and f_s = 1.0 MPa gives Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN; end bearing with q_b = 5 MPa on A_b = π×2.5²/4 ≈ 4.91 m² gives Q_b ≈ 24,500 kN. The total is about 71,700 kN, or about 28,700 kN allowable with a factor of safety of 2.5. f_s, q_b and L_s are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鑽掘時逐樁記錄入岩深度、岩屑性質與鑽進速率，並與地質鑽探柱狀圖比對；完成後以超音波井測檢查樁身完整性，抽樣鑽心確認樁底與岩盤接觸，代表性墩位以動態或雙向荷重試驗驗證承載力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During boring, log socket depth, cuttings and penetration rate for every pile and compare with borehole logs; afterwards check integrity by cross-hole sonic logging, core selected piles to confirm toe contact with rock, and verify capacity at representative piers by dynamic or bidirectional load tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 嵌岩側阻 Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s，取 D = 2.5 m、L_s = 6 m、f_s = 1.0 MPa：Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN；端承 q_b = 5 MPa、A_b = π×2.5²/4 ≈ 4.91 m²，Q_b ≈ 24,500 kN。合計約 71,700 kN，安全係數 2.5 時容許約 28,700 kN。f_s、q_b、L_s 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Socket side resistance Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s with D = 2.5 m, L_s = 6 m and f_s = 1.0 MPa gives Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN; end bearing with q_b = 5 MPa on A_b = π×2.5²/4 ≈ 4.91 m² gives Q_b ≈ 24,500 kN. The total is about 71,700 kN, or about 28,700 kN allowable with a factor of safety of 2.5. f_s, q_b and L_s are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「花崗片麻岩中的全套管基樁」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。
載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。
optionsEn: In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending.
Socket side resistance Q_s = π·D·L_s·f_s with D = 2.5 m, L_s = 6 m and f_s = 1.0 MPa gives Q_s = π×2.5×6×1,000 ≈ 47,100 kN.
If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking.

steps.title: 花崗片麻岩中的全套管基樁：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cased bored piles in granitic gneiss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「2.5 m 基樁嵌岩段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “2.5 m pile rock socket” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鑽掘時逐樁記錄入岩深度、岩屑性質與鑽進速率，並與地質鑽探柱狀圖比對；完成後以超音波井測檢查樁身完整性，抽樣鑽心確認樁底與岩盤接觸，代表性墩位以動態或雙向荷重試驗驗證承載力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During boring, log socket depth, cuttings and penetration rate for every pile and compare with borehole logs; afterwards check integrity by cross-hole sonic logging, core selected piles to confirm toe contact with rock, and verify capacity at representative piers by dynamic or bidirectional load tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範應把入岩深度而非樁底高程列為停止條件，由地質工程師在現場確認岩性與岩面後簽認；清孔與沉泥厚度檢查列為澆置混凝土前的停留點，未合格不得澆置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should make socket length into rock, not toe elevation, the termination criterion, signed off on site by a geotechnical engineer who has confirmed the rock type and rock head; base cleaning and sediment-thickness checks are a hold point before concreting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樁底殘留沉泥或岩屑時，端承力大幅下降，基樁受載後產生額外沉陷；岩面傾斜使樁趾一側懸空、嵌岩有效長度不足，墩柱出現不均勻沉陷與樁帽開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sediment or cuttings left at the toe sharply reduce end bearing and cause extra settlement under load; a sloping rock head that leaves one side of the toe unsupported shortens the effective socket, producing differential pier settlement and pile-cap cracking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 花崗片麻岩中的全套管基樁：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cased bored piles in granitic gneiss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「2.5 m 基樁嵌岩段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.observation: 連結機制：岩面傾斜時，套管下端只有一側先碰到岩盤，容易造成鑽頭偏斜、樁底不完整或套管無法密封，因此每支樁的入岩深度要依實測岩面調整，而不是套用統一樁長。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: On a sloping rock face the casing touches rock on one side first, which can deflect the bit, leave an incomplete toe or prevent sealing, so each pile's socket length must follow the rock head actually found rather than a uniform pile length.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要基樁打到設計高程，就代表已經進入足夠的岩盤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樁底殘留沉泥或岩屑時，端承力大幅下降，基樁受載後產生額外沉陷；岩面傾斜使樁趾一側懸空、嵌岩有效長度不足，墩柱出現不均勻沉陷與樁帽開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Sediment or cuttings left at the toe sharply reduce end bearing and cause extra settlement under load; a sloping rock head that leaves one side of the toe unsupported shortens the effective socket, producing differential pier settlement and pile-cap cracking.

steps.title: 鋼箱圍堰與海中樁帽：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel box cofferdams and marine pile caps: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼箱圍堰封底混凝土」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel box cofferdam seal” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 深槽區主橋與邊橋的樁帽以鋼箱圍堰施工，公開報導稱是國內首次採用。鋼箱在海上組裝後下放包住樁頭，先在水下澆置封底混凝土，再抽乾箱內海水，讓樁帽在乾燥環境中綁筋與澆置。抽水後海水壓力從下方頂住封底板，所以封底混凝土必須靠自重、與樁身的握裹以及鋼箱摩擦共同抵抗上浮；報導提到下放時須抵抗約 4,000 公噸的海水浮力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼箱圍堰封底混凝土」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pile caps of the main and side bridges in the deep trough were built inside steel box cofferdams, reported as a first in Taiwan. The box is assembled at sea and lowered around the pile heads, a seal slab is concreted underwater, and the box is then pumped dry so the cap can be reinforced and cast in the dry. After dewatering, sea pressure pushes up on the seal slab, so its self-weight, its bond to the piles and friction on the box walls must together resist uplift; reports mention about 4,000 t of buoyancy to overcome during lowering. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Steel box cofferdam seal” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：上浮壓力 p = ρ·g·h = 1.025×9.81×6.5 ≈ 65.4 kPa；底面積 A = 30×20 = 600 m² 時總上浮力約 39,200 kN，約 4,000 公噸。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Uplift pressure p = ρ·g·h = 1.025×9.81×6.5 ≈ 65.4 kPa; on A = 30×20 = 600 m² the total uplift is about 39,200 kN, or about 4,000 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼箱圍堰只是擋水的模板，抽水時不會產生很大的力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel box cofferdam is only a formwork that keeps water out, so dewatering creates no large forces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼箱圍堰封底混凝土」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 鋼箱圍堰與海中樁帽：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel box cofferdams and marine pile caps: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼箱圍堰封底混凝土」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel box cofferdam seal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：上浮壓力 p = ρ·g·h = 1.025×9.81×6.5 ≈ 65.4 kPa；底面積 A = 30×20 = 600 m² 時總上浮力約 39,200 kN，約 4,000 公噸。只靠自重需封底厚 65.4/24 ≈ 2.7 m；若封底只取 1.5 m，其餘 (65.4 − 36)×600 ≈ 17,600 kN 須由樁身握裹承擔。尺寸與水頭為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Uplift pressure p = ρ·g·h = 1.025×9.81×6.5 ≈ 65.4 kPa; on A = 30×20 = 600 m² the total uplift is about 39,200 kN, or about 4,000 t. Self-weight alone would need a seal 65.4/24 ≈ 2.7 m thick; with a 1.5 m seal, the remaining (65.4 − 36)×600 ≈ 17,600 kN must be carried by pile bond. Dimensions and head are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：封底混凝土以導管法連續澆置，持續量測澆置面高程與導管埋深；抽水分階段進行，每階段量測箱內水位、封底板變形、鋼箱應變與滲漏量，與設計上浮檢核比對，確認無異常後才進入下一階段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place the seal by tremie continuously while measuring concrete level and tremie embedment; dewater in stages and at each stage record inner water level, seal-slab deformation, box strains and leakage, comparing them with the uplift check before proceeding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Self-weight alone would need a seal 65.4/24 ≈ 2.7 m thick; with a 1.5 m seal, the remaining (65.4 − 36)×600 ≈ 17,600 kN must be carried by pile bond. Dimensions and head are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 鋼箱圍堰與海中樁帽：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel box cofferdams and marine pile caps: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼箱圍堰封底混凝土」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel box cofferdam seal” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 封底混凝土以導管法連續澆置，持續量測澆置面高程與導管埋深；抽水分階段進行，每階段量測箱內水位、封底板變形、鋼箱應變與滲漏量，與設計上浮檢核比對，確認無異常後才進入下一階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place the seal by tremie continuously while measuring concrete level and tremie embedment; dewater in stages and at each stage record inner water level, seal-slab deformation, box strains and leakage, comparing them with the uplift check before proceeding. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：抽水作業列為停留點：封底強度達標、潛水員檢查封底面與樁身介面、量測儀器就位後，由工程師核准分段抽水；每階段設停止條件，例如滲水量或變形超過預警值即停止並回灌。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make dewatering a hold point: once the seal reaches strength, divers have checked the seal and pile interfaces and instruments are installed, the engineer authorises staged pumping; each stage has stop criteria, such as leakage or deformation beyond alert values triggering a halt and re-flooding.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：封底混凝土夾泥或厚度不足時，抽水後封底板開裂、湧水甚至整體上浮；鋼箱下放偏位會使樁頭與箱壁碰撞，樁帽保護層不足，日後成為海水滲入的弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A seal containing mud lenses or built too thin can crack, let water burst in or even float the whole box after dewatering; a box lowered off position can clash with pile heads and leave thin cover on the cap, a future path for seawater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instructionEn: A seal containing mud lenses or built too thin can crack, let water burst in or even float the whole box after dewatering; a box lowered off position can clash with pile heads and leave thin cover on the cap, a future path for seawater. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抽水後海水壓力從下方頂住封底板，所以封底混凝土必須靠自重、與樁身的握裹以及鋼箱摩擦共同抵抗上浮；報導提到下放時須抵抗約 4,000 公噸的海水浮力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After dewatering, sea pressure pushes up on the seal slab, so its self-weight, its bond to the piles and friction on the box walls must together resist uplift; reports mention about 4,000 t of buoyancy to overcome during lowering.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼箱圍堰只是擋水的模板，抽水時不會產生很大的力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel box cofferdam is only a formwork that keeps water out, so dewatering creates no large forces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 封底混凝土夾泥或厚度不足時，抽水後封底板開裂、湧水甚至整體上浮；鋼箱下放偏位會使樁頭與箱壁碰撞，樁帽保護層不足，日後成為海水滲入的弱點。
knowledge.textEn: A seal containing mud lenses or built too thin can crack, let water burst in or even float the whole box after dewatering; a box lowered off position can clash with pile heads and leave thin cover on the cap, a future path for seawater.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼箱圍堰與海中樁帽」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel box cofferdams and marine pile caps" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
封底混凝土夾泥或厚度不足時，抽水後封底板開裂、湧水甚至整體上浮；鋼箱下放偏位會使樁頭與箱壁碰撞，樁帽保護層不足，日後成為海水滲入的弱點。
預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A seal containing mud lenses or built too thin can crack, let water burst in or even float the whole box after dewatering.

quiz.explanationEn: A seal containing mud lenses or built too thin can crack, let water burst in or even float the whole box after dewatering; a box lowered off position can clash with pile heads and leave thin cover on the cap, a future path for seawater. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸」與「平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped" and "Balanced-cantilever erection and closure": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「短線匹配澆鑄台座」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Short-line match-casting cell” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出，上部結構使用 376 塊預鑄節塊，於高雄興達港生產後以船舶運到金門吊裝。預鑄節塊通常以短線匹配澆鑄：新節塊緊貼前一塊已完成的節塊澆置，接縫面完全吻合，到現場再依相同順序拼裝。這讓混凝土品質與養護在工廠條件下控制，但每一塊的幾何誤差會沿懸臂累積，所以澆鑄台座的測量與修正是全橋線形的源頭。長距離海運還增加堆置、繫固與天候窗口的不確定性，生產節奏必須與吊裝節奏協調。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「短線匹配澆鑄台座」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public reports state that the superstructure used 376 precast segments, produced at Hsing-ta Harbour in Kaohsiung and shipped to Kinmen for erection. Such segments are usually short-line match-cast: each new segment is cast against the previous one so the joint faces fit exactly, and they are erected in the same order on site. Concrete quality and curing are controlled under factory conditions, but each segment's geometric error accumulates along the cantilever, so survey and correction in the casting cell are the source of the whole bridge's alignment. Long sea transport adds uncertainty in storage, sea-fastening and weather windows, so production must be paced with erection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Short-line match-casting cell” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若第 2 號節塊接縫有 0.5 mrad 的角度誤差，其後懸臂長度 95 m，懸臂端偏差 Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm；同樣誤差若出現在倒數第二塊、其後只剩 5 m，只造成約 2.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the joint of segment 2 has a 0.5 mrad angular error and 95 m of cantilever follows it, the tip deviates by Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm; the same error in the second-last segment, with only 5 m beyond, causes about 2.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Factory-precast segments are so precise that no geometry control is needed on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「短線匹配澆鑄台座」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Short-line match-casting cell”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸
knowledge.titleEn: Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出，上部結構使用 376 塊預鑄節塊，於高雄興達港生產後以船舶運到金門吊裝。預鑄節塊通常以短線匹配澆鑄：新節塊緊貼前一塊已完成的節塊澆置，接縫面完全吻合，到現場再依相同順序拼裝。
knowledge.textEn: Public reports state that the superstructure used 376 precast segments, produced at Hsing-ta Harbour in Kaohsiung and shipped to Kinmen for erection. Such segments are usually short-line match-cast: each new segment is cast against the previous one so the joint faces fit exactly, and they are erected in the same order on site.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Factory-precast segments are so precise that no geometry control is needed on site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped" is correct?
options: 預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。
平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。
公開資料指出，上部結構使用 376 塊預鑄節塊，於高雄興達港生產後以船舶運到金門吊裝。
optionsEn: Factory-precast segments are so precise that no geometry control is needed on site.
In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending.
Public reports state that the superstructure used 376 precast segments, produced at Hsing-ta Harbour in Kaohsiung and shipped to Kinmen for erection.

quiz.explanationEn: Public reports state that the superstructure used 376 precast segments, produced at Hsing-ta Harbour in Kaohsiung and shipped to Kinmen for erection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「短線匹配澆鑄台座」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Short-line match-casting cell” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若第 2 號節塊接縫有 0.5 mrad 的角度誤差，其後懸臂長度 95 m，懸臂端偏差 Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm；同樣誤差若出現在倒數第二塊、其後只剩 5 m，只造成約 2.5 mm。越靠近墩頂的誤差影響越大。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the joint of segment 2 has a 0.5 mrad angular error and 95 m of cantilever follows it, the tip deviates by Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm; the same error in the second-last segment, with only 5 m beyond, causes about 2.5 mm. Errors near the pier matter most. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每塊澆置後量測匹配節塊上的控制點高程與平面位置，以幾何控制程式比較實測與理論，於下一塊澆置時修正匹配節塊位置；出廠前檢查剪力鍵、預力孔道位置與強度紀錄，裝船時確認支墊與繫固符合計畫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each cast, survey the control points on the match-cast segment in level and plan, compare with theory in the geometry-control software and correct the match segment's position for the next cast; before shipment check shear keys, duct positions and strength records, and confirm bearing pads and sea-fastening against the plan.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若第 2 號節塊接縫有 0.5 mrad 的角度誤差，其後懸臂長度 95 m，懸臂端偏差 Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm；同樣誤差若出現在倒數第二塊、其後只剩 5 m，只造成約 2.5 mm。越靠近墩頂的誤差影響越大。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the joint of segment 2 has a 0.5 mrad angular error and 95 m of cantilever follows it, the tip deviates by Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm; the same error in the second-last segment, with only 5 m beyond, causes about 2.5 mm. Errors near the pier matter most. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped", which statement holds?
options: 若第 2 號節塊接縫有 0.5 mrad 的角度誤差，其後懸臂長度 95 m，懸臂端偏差 Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm。
載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。
伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。
optionsEn: If the joint of segment 2 has a 0.5 mrad angular error and 95 m of cantilever follows it, the tip deviates by Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm.
If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking.
Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally.

quiz.explanationEn: If the joint of segment 2 has a 0.5 mrad angular error and 95 m of cantilever follows it, the tip deviates by Δ = θ·L = 0.0005×95 ≈ 0.0475 m = 47.5 mm; the same error in the second-last segment, with only 5 m beyond, causes about 2.5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「短線匹配澆鑄台座」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Short-line match-casting cell” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每塊澆置後量測匹配節塊上的控制點高程與平面位置，以幾何控制程式比較實測與理論，於下一塊澆置時修正匹配節塊位置；出廠前檢查剪力鍵、預力孔道位置與強度紀錄，裝船時確認支墊與繫固符合計畫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each cast, survey the control points on the match-cast segment in level and plan, compare with theory in the geometry-control software and correct the match segment's position for the next cast; before shipment check shear keys, duct positions and strength records, and confirm bearing pads and sea-fastening against the plan. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：幾何控制應由獨立的測量與分析小組負責，每塊節塊建立理論、實測與修正三欄紀錄；運輸與吊裝前定義吊點、支墊位置與繫固方式，並確認混凝土強度已達吊裝規定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Geometry control belongs to an independent survey and analysis team that keeps a theory, as-cast and correction record for every segment; lifting points, support positions and sea-fastening are defined before transport, and concrete strength must meet the lifting requirement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若量測只記錄誤差而不在後續節塊修正，偏差累積到懸臂端，合龍時高程差過大，只能以強制頂撐或加厚合龍段處理並造成附加應力；運輸時繫固不良則可能使節塊邊角破損、剪力鍵受損而影響接縫傳力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If errors are merely recorded and not corrected in later segments, they accumulate to the tip and the closure shows a large level difference, forcing jacking or a thickened closure with added stresses; poor sea-fastening can chip edges and damage shear keys, impairing joint load transfer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每塊澆置後量測匹配節塊上的控制點高程與平面位置，以幾何控制程式比較實測與理論，於下一塊澆置時修正匹配節塊位置；出廠前檢查剪力鍵、預力孔道位置與強度紀錄，裝船時確認支墊與繫固符合計畫。
knowledge.textEn: After each cast, survey the control points on the match-cast segment in level and plan, compare with theory in the geometry-control software and correct the match segment's position for the next cast; before shipment check shear keys, duct positions and strength records, and confirm bearing pads and sea-fastening against the plan.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 幾何控制應由獨立的測量與分析小組負責，每塊節塊建立理論、實測與修正三欄紀錄；運輸與吊裝前定義吊點、支墊位置與繫固方式，並確認混凝土強度已達吊裝規定。

After each cast, survey the control points on the match-cast segment in level and plan, compare with theory in the geometry-control software and correct the match segment's position for the next cast.
An extradosed bridge is just a cable-stayed bridge with short towers and is designed the same way.
quiz.explanation: 每塊澆置後量測匹配節塊上的控制點高程與平面位置，以幾何控制程式比較實測與理論，於下一塊澆置時修正匹配節塊位置；出廠前檢查剪力鍵、預力孔道位置與強度紀錄，裝船時確認支墊與繫固符合計畫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each cast, survey the control points on the match-cast segment in level and plan, compare with theory in the geometry-control software and correct the match segment's position for the next cast; before shipment check shear keys, duct positions and strength records, and confirm bearing pads and sea-fastening against the plan. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「短線匹配澆鑄台座」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Short-line match-casting cell” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若量測只記錄誤差而不在後續節塊修正，偏差累積到懸臂端，合龍時高程差過大，只能以強制頂撐或加厚合龍段處理並造成附加應力；運輸時繫固不良則可能使節塊邊角破損、剪力鍵受損而影響接縫傳力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If errors are merely recorded and not corrected in later segments, they accumulate to the tip and the closure shows a large level difference, forcing jacking or a thickened closure with added stresses; poor sea-fastening can chip edges and damage shear keys, impairing joint load transfer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長距離海運還增加堆置、繫固與天候窗口的不確定性，生產節奏必須與吊裝節奏協調。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long sea transport adds uncertainty in storage, sea-fastening and weather windows, so production must be paced with erection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Factory-precast segments are so precise that no geometry control is needed on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若量測只記錄誤差而不在後續節塊修正，偏差累積到懸臂端，合龍時高程差過大，只能以強制頂撐或加厚合龍段處理並造成附加應力；運輸時繫固不良則可能使節塊邊角破損、剪力鍵受損而影響接縫傳力。
knowledge.textEn: If errors are merely recorded and not corrected in later segments, they accumulate to the tip and the closure shows a large level difference, forcing jacking or a thickened closure with added stresses; poor sea-fastening can chip edges and damage shear keys, impairing joint load transfer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「興達港預鑄節塊與海上運輸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Segments precast at Hsing-ta Harbour and shipped" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。
若量測只記錄誤差而不在後續節塊修正，偏差累積到懸臂端，合龍時高程差過大，只能以強制頂撐或加厚合龍段處理並造成附加應力。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending.

If errors are merely recorded and not corrected in later segments, they accumulate to the tip and the closure shows a large level difference, forcing jacking or a thickened closure with added stresses.
quiz.explanation: 若量測只記錄誤差而不在後續節塊修正，偏差累積到懸臂端，合龍時高程差過大，只能以強制頂撐或加厚合龍段處理並造成附加應力；運輸時繫固不良則可能使節塊邊角破損、剪力鍵受損而影響接縫傳力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If errors are merely recorded and not corrected in later segments, they accumulate to the tip and the closure shows a large level difference, forcing jacking or a thickened closure with added stresses; poor sea-fastening can chip edges and damage shear keys, impairing joint load transfer. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever erection and closure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩頂懸臂不平衡彎矩」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unbalanced moment at pier head” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主橋與邊橋採懸臂工法：節塊從墩頂向兩側對稱吊裝，以預力鋼腱把新節塊壓緊在已完成的懸臂上，直到相鄰懸臂在跨中接近，再澆置合龍段使結構連續。施工中墩柱與基礎要承擔兩側重量差、吊裝設備與風荷載，常以臨時錨定、臨時支撐或墩梁臨時固結來穩定。合龍後結構由懸臂體系轉為連續體系，預力、溫度與潛變效應重新分配。金門大橋在 2022 年 7 月 22 日完成全橋合龍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩頂懸臂不平衡彎矩」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main and side bridges were built by the cantilever method: segments are erected symmetrically outward from each pier head and stressed against the completed cantilever until neighbouring cantilevers meet near mid-span, where a closure pour makes the girder continuous. During erection the pier and foundation carry the weight imbalance, lifting equipment and wind, usually stabilised by temporary ties, props or a temporary pier–girder fixity. After closure the structure changes from cantilevers to a continuous system, redistributing prestress, temperature and creep effects. Kinmen Bridge achieved full closure on 22 July 2022. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Unbalanced moment at pier head” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一側先吊一塊 1,500 kN 節塊、距墩中心 95 m 時，不平衡彎矩 M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m；若臨時錨定的力臂為 4 m，需拉力約 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lifting one 1,500 kN segment on one side at 95 m from the pier centre gives an unbalanced moment M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m; with a 4 m lever arm, the temporary tie must carry about 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墩頂懸臂不平衡彎矩」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Unbalanced moment at pier head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍
knowledge.text: 主橋與邊橋採懸臂工法：節塊從墩頂向兩側對稱吊裝，以預力鋼腱把新節塊壓緊在已完成的懸臂上，直到相鄰懸臂在跨中接近，再澆置合龍段使結構連續。施工中墩柱與基礎要承擔兩側重量差、吊裝設備與風荷載，常以臨時錨定、臨時支撐或墩梁臨時固結來穩定。
knowledge.textEn: The main and side bridges were built by the cantilever method: segments are erected symmetrically outward from each pier head and stressed against the completed cantilever until neighbouring cantilevers meet near mid-span, where a closure pour makes the girder continuous. During erection the pier and foundation carry the weight imbalance, lifting equipment and wind, usually stabilised by temporary ties, props or a temporary pier–girder fixity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Balanced-cantilever erection and closure" is correct?
options: 主橋與邊橋採懸臂工法：節塊從墩頂向兩側對稱吊裝，以預力鋼腱把新節塊壓緊在已完成的懸臂上，直到相鄰懸臂在跨中接近，再澆置合龍段使結構連續。
平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。
只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。
optionsEn: The main and side bridges were built by the cantilever method: segments are erected symmetrically outward from each pier head and stressed against the completed cantilever until neighbouring cantilevers meet near mid-span, where a closure pour makes the girder continuous.
In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending.
Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length.
quiz.explanation: 主橋與邊橋採懸臂工法：節塊從墩頂向兩側對稱吊裝，以預力鋼腱把新節塊壓緊在已完成的懸臂上，直到相鄰懸臂在跨中接近，再澆置合龍段使結構連續。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The main and side bridges were built by the cantilever method: segments are erected symmetrically outward from each pier head and stressed against the completed cantilever until neighbouring cantilevers meet near mid-span, where a closure pour makes the girder continuous. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever erection and closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩頂懸臂不平衡彎矩」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unbalanced moment at pier head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一側先吊一塊 1,500 kN 節塊、距墩中心 95 m 時，不平衡彎矩 M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m；若臨時錨定的力臂為 4 m，需拉力約 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN。節塊重量與力臂為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lifting one 1,500 kN segment on one side at 95 m from the pier centre gives an unbalanced moment M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m; with a 4 m lever arm, the temporary tie must carry about 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN. Segment weight and lever arm are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次吊裝前以施工階段分析核對允許的不平衡量，吊裝中量測墩頂傾斜與懸臂端高程；合龍前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端相對高程與間距隨溫度的變化，選擇溫度穩定時段鎖定合龍段並澆置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before every lift, check the permitted imbalance against the construction-stage analysis, and monitor pier-head tilt and tip levels during lifting; before closure, record the relative level and gap of the two tips against temperature for 24 hours and lock and cast the closure in a thermally stable window.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一側先吊一塊 1,500 kN 節塊、距墩中心 95 m 時，不平衡彎矩 M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m；若臨時錨定的力臂為 4 m，需拉力約 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN。節塊重量與力臂為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting one 1,500 kN segment on one side at 95 m from the pier centre gives an unbalanced moment M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m; with a 4 m lever arm, the temporary tie must carry about 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN. Segment weight and lever arm are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Balanced-cantilever erection and closure", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。
一側先吊一塊 1,500 kN 節塊、距墩中心 95 m 時，不平衡彎矩 M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m。
海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。
optionsEn: Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode.
Lifting one 1,500 kN segment on one side at 95 m from the pier centre gives an unbalanced moment M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m.
Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge.
quiz.explanation: 一側先吊一塊 1,500 kN 節塊、距墩中心 95 m 時，不平衡彎矩 M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m；若臨時錨定的力臂為 4 m，需拉力約 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Lifting one 1,500 kN segment on one side at 95 m from the pier centre gives an unbalanced moment M = W·a = 1,500×95 = 142,500 kN·m; with a 4 m lever arm, the temporary tie must carry about 142,500/4 ≈ 35,600 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever erection and closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩頂懸臂不平衡彎矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unbalanced moment at pier head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次吊裝前以施工階段分析核對允許的不平衡量，吊裝中量測墩頂傾斜與懸臂端高程；合龍前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端相對高程與間距隨溫度的變化，選擇溫度穩定時段鎖定合龍段並澆置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before every lift, check the permitted imbalance against the construction-stage analysis, and monitor pier-head tilt and tip levels during lifting; before closure, record the relative level and gap of the two tips against temperature for 24 hours and lock and cast the closure in a thermally stable window. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫應明訂允許的最大不平衡節塊數、吊具重量與風速上限，合龍段設臨時鎖定裝置；合龍時段與預力張拉順序列為停留點，由設計單位與監造共同核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection plan should state the maximum number of unbalanced segments, rigging weight and wind limit, and provide temporary locking at the closure; the closure window and stressing sequence are hold points approved jointly by the designer and the supervising engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊裝順序錯誤或一側吊具重量超出計畫，墩頂不平衡彎矩超過臨時錨定能力，懸臂可能傾覆；合龍時段選在日照急劇變化時，合龍段混凝土在硬化中受到拉伸而開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong lifting sequence or heavier rigging on one side can push the unbalanced moment past the temporary tie capacity and overturn the cantilever; closing during rapid solar heating can pull the closure concrete apart while it hardens and crack it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次吊裝前以施工階段分析核對允許的不平衡量，吊裝中量測墩頂傾斜與懸臂端高程；合龍前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端相對高程與間距隨溫度的變化，選擇溫度穩定時段鎖定合龍段並澆置。
knowledge.textEn: Before every lift, check the permitted imbalance against the construction-stage analysis, and monitor pier-head tilt and tip levels during lifting; before closure, record the relative level and gap of the two tips against temperature for 24 hours and lock and cast the closure in a thermally stable window.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫應明訂允許的最大不平衡節塊數、吊具重量與風速上限，合龍段設臨時鎖定裝置；合龍時段與預力張拉順序列為停留點，由設計單位與監造共同核准。
knowledge.textEn: The erection plan should state the maximum number of unbalanced segments, rigging weight and wind limit, and provide temporary locking at the closure; the closure window and stressing sequence are hold points approved jointly by the designer and the supervising engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Balanced-cantilever erection and closure"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要基樁打到設計高程，就代表已經進入足夠的岩盤。
每次吊裝前以施工階段分析核對允許的不平衡量，吊裝中量測墩頂傾斜與懸臂端高程。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Reaching the design toe level means the pile is socketed into enough rock.
Before every lift, check the permitted imbalance against the construction-stage analysis, and monitor pier-head tilt and tip levels during lifting.
quiz.explanation: 每次吊裝前以施工階段分析核對允許的不平衡量，吊裝中量測墩頂傾斜與懸臂端高程；合龍前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端相對高程與間距隨溫度的變化，選擇溫度穩定時段鎖定合龍段並澆置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before every lift, check the permitted imbalance against the construction-stage analysis, and monitor pier-head tilt and tip levels during lifting; before closure, record the relative level and gap of the two tips against temperature for 24 hours and lock and cast the closure in a thermally stable window. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Balanced-cantilever erection and closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩頂懸臂不平衡彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unbalanced moment at pier head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊裝順序錯誤或一側吊具重量超出計畫，墩頂不平衡彎矩超過臨時錨定能力，懸臂可能傾覆；合龍時段選在日照急劇變化時，合龍段混凝土在硬化中受到拉伸而開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A wrong lifting sequence or heavier rigging on one side can push the unbalanced moment past the temporary tie capacity and overturn the cantilever; closing during rapid solar heating can pull the closure concrete apart while it hardens and crack it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：金門大橋在 2022 年 7 月 22 日完成全橋合龍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Kinmen Bridge achieved full closure on 22 July 2022.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊裝順序錯誤或一側吊具重量超出計畫，墩頂不平衡彎矩超過臨時錨定能力，懸臂可能傾覆；合龍時段選在日照急劇變化時，合龍段混凝土在硬化中受到拉伸而開裂。
knowledge.textEn: A wrong lifting sequence or heavier rigging on one side can push the unbalanced moment past the temporary tie capacity and overturn the cantilever; closing during rapid solar heating can pull the closure concrete apart while it hardens and crack it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「平衡懸臂吊裝與全橋合龍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Balanced-cantilever erection and closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 吊裝順序錯誤或一側吊具重量超出計畫，墩頂不平衡彎矩超過臨時錨定能力，懸臂可能傾覆；合龍時段選在日照急劇變化時，合龍段混凝土在硬化中受到拉伸而開裂。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。
optionsEn: A wrong lifting sequence or heavier rigging on one side can push the unbalanced moment past the temporary tie capacity and overturn the cantilever.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝順序錯誤或一側吊具重量超出計畫，墩頂不平衡彎矩超過臨時錨定能力，懸臂可能傾覆；合龍時段選在日照急劇變化時，合龍段混凝土在硬化中受到拉伸而開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A wrong lifting sequence or heavier rigging on one side can push the unbalanced moment past the temporary tie capacity and overturn the cantilever; closing during rapid solar heating can pull the closure concrete apart while it hardens and crack it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「脊背索索力量測與調整」與「線形驗收與通車前載重試驗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stay-force measurement and adjustment" and "Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 脊背索索力量測與調整：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stay-force measurement and adjustment: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「脊背索頻率量測」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stay frequency measurement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 脊背索的初張力決定箱梁應力分布與線形，因此施工中與完工後都要量測索力。最常用的是振動法：以加速度計量測索的自然頻率，再由弦振動公式換算張力；但脊背索比斜張索短而粗，彎曲勁度、減振器與錨具邊界條件的影響較大，必須修正。另一種直接方法是以千斤頂做頂升試驗，量測錨頭開始離開承壓板時的油壓。兩種方法互相校正後，頻率法才適合用於長期監測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「脊背索頻率量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The initial tension in the stays sets the girder's stress distribution and profile, so stay forces are measured during construction and after completion. The usual method is vibration-based: accelerometers record the stay's natural frequencies, which a taut-string formula converts to tension. Extradosed stays are shorter and stiffer than cable-stays, so bending stiffness, dampers and anchorage boundary conditions matter more and must be corrected. A direct alternative is the lift-off test, reading jack pressure when the anchor head just separates from its bearing plate. Only after the two methods are cross-calibrated is the frequency method fit for long-term monitoring. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stay frequency measurement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：張緊弦公式 T = 4·m·L²·f₁²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taut-string formula T = 4·m·L²·f₁².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「脊背索頻率量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stay frequency measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 脊背索索力量測與調整
knowledge.text: 脊背索的初張力決定箱梁應力分布與線形，因此施工中與完工後都要量測索力。最常用的是振動法：以加速度計量測索的自然頻率，再由弦振動公式換算張力；但脊背索比斜張索短而粗，彎曲勁度、減振器與錨具邊界條件的影響較大，必須修正。
knowledge.textEn: The initial tension in the stays sets the girder's stress distribution and profile, so stay forces are measured during construction and after completion. The usual method is vibration-based: accelerometers record the stay's natural frequencies, which a taut-string formula converts to tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「脊背索索力量測與調整」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stay-force measurement and adjustment" is correct?
options: 只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。
脊背索的初張力決定箱梁應力分布與線形，因此施工中與完工後都要量測索力。
載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。
optionsEn: Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length.
The initial tension in the stays sets the girder's stress distribution and profile, so stay forces are measured during construction and after completion.
If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking.
quiz.explanation: 脊背索的初張力決定箱梁應力分布與線形，因此施工中與完工後都要量測索力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The initial tension in the stays sets the girder's stress distribution and profile, so stay forces are measured during construction and after completion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 脊背索索力量測與調整：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stay-force measurement and adjustment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「脊背索頻率量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stay frequency measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：張緊弦公式 T = 4·m·L²·f₁²。取單位長質量 m = 60 kg/m、自由長度 L = 60 m、實測第一頻率 f₁ = 2.5 Hz：T = 4×60×60²×2.5² = 5,400,000 N ≈ 5.4 MN。因 T ∝ f²，頻率量測誤差 2% 會造成約 4% 的索力誤差。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taut-string formula T = 4·m·L²·f₁². With m = 60 kg/m, free length L = 60 m and a measured first frequency f₁ = 2.5 Hz, T = 4×60×60²×2.5² = 5,400,000 N ≈ 5.4 MN. Because T ∝ f², a 2% frequency error gives about a 4% force error. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每根索取前三階頻率，檢查是否接近整數倍以判斷彎曲勁度影響；抽樣以頂升試驗校正頻率法，記錄溫度與施工階段；與設計索力的差異須在規定允差內（例如 ±5%），否則依調索程序調整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record the first three frequencies of each stay and check how close they are to integer multiples to judge bending-stiffness effects; calibrate the frequency method by lift-off tests on a sample, noting temperature and construction stage; deviations from design forces must be within the specified tolerance, such as ±5%, or the stay is adjusted under the retensioning procedure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 張緊弦公式 T = 4·m·L²·f₁²。取單位長質量 m = 60 kg/m、自由長度 L = 60 m、實測第一頻率 f₁ = 2.5 Hz：T = 4×60×60²×2.5² = 5,400,000 N ≈ 5.4 MN。因 T ∝ f²，頻率量測誤差 2% 會造成約 4% 的索力誤差。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Taut-string formula T = 4·m·L²·f₁². With m = 60 kg/m, free length L = 60 m and a measured first frequency f₁ = 2.5 Hz, T = 4×60×60²×2.5² = 5,400,000 N ≈ 5.4 MN. Because T ∝ f², a 2% frequency error gives about a 4% force error. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「脊背索索力量測與調整」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stay-force measurement and adjustment", which statement holds?
options: 伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。
脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。
張緊弦公式 T = 4·m·L²·f₁²。
optionsEn: Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally.
An extradosed bridge is just a cable-stayed bridge with short towers and is designed the same way.
Taut-string formula T = 4·m·L²·f₁².
quiz.explanation: 張緊弦公式 T = 4·m·L²·f₁²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Taut-string formula T = 4·m·L²·f₁². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 脊背索索力量測與調整：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stay-force measurement and adjustment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「脊背索頻率量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stay frequency measurement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每根索取前三階頻率，檢查是否接近整數倍以判斷彎曲勁度影響；抽樣以頂升試驗校正頻率法，記錄溫度與施工階段；與設計索力的差異須在規定允差內（例如 ±5%），否則依調索程序調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record the first three frequencies of each stay and check how close they are to integer multiples to judge bending-stiffness effects; calibrate the frequency method by lift-off tests on a sample, noting temperature and construction stage; deviations from design forces must be within the specified tolerance, such as ±5%, or the stay is adjusted under the retensioning procedure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索力驗收報告應附原始頻譜、採用的有效長度與修正方法、量測溫度與施工階段；調索須依設計提供的順序與允差執行，最終索力表由設計單位確認後納入竣工資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The stay-force acceptance report should attach raw spectra, the effective length and correction method, temperature and construction stage; retensioning follows the designer's sequence and tolerances, and the final force table is confirmed by the designer and filed with the as-built records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略彎曲勁度、減振器與套管對有效長度的影響時，短索換算索力可能偏差一成以上，據此調索反而使箱梁應力偏離設計；錨頭夾片咬合不良則會在長期使用後滑移，使索力逐年下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring bending stiffness and the effect of dampers and guide pipes on effective length can misjudge short-stay forces by more than ten percent, so retensioning on that basis drives girder stresses away from design; poorly seated wedges can slip over years of service and let the force decline. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每根索取前三階頻率，檢查是否接近整數倍以判斷彎曲勁度影響；抽樣以頂升試驗校正頻率法，記錄溫度與施工階段；與設計索力的差異須在規定允差內（例如 ±5%），否則依調索程序調整。
knowledge.textEn: Record the first three frequencies of each stay and check how close they are to integer multiples to judge bending-stiffness effects; calibrate the frequency method by lift-off tests on a sample, noting temperature and construction stage; deviations from design forces must be within the specified tolerance, such as ±5%, or the stay is adjusted under the retensioning procedure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 索力驗收報告應附原始頻譜、採用的有效長度與修正方法、量測溫度與施工階段；調索須依設計提供的順序與允差執行，最終索力表由設計單位確認後納入竣工資料。
knowledge.textEn: The stay-force acceptance report should attach raw spectra, the effective length and correction method, temperature and construction stage; retensioning follows the designer's sequence and tolerances, and the final force table is confirmed by the designer and filed with the as-built records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「脊背索索力量測與調整」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stay-force measurement and adjustment"?
options: 每根索取前三階頻率，檢查是否接近整數倍以判斷彎曲勁度影響。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼箱圍堰只是擋水的模板，抽水時不會產生很大的力。
optionsEn: Record the first three frequencies of each stay and check how close they are to integer multiples to judge bending-stiffness effects.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A steel box cofferdam is only a formwork that keeps water out, so dewatering creates no large forces.
quiz.explanation: 每根索取前三階頻率，檢查是否接近整數倍以判斷彎曲勁度影響；抽樣以頂升試驗校正頻率法，記錄溫度與施工階段；與設計索力的差異須在規定允差內（例如 ±5%），否則依調索程序調整。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record the first three frequencies of each stay and check how close they are to integer multiples to judge bending-stiffness effects; calibrate the frequency method by lift-off tests on a sample, noting temperature and construction stage; deviations from design forces must be within the specified tolerance, such as ±5%, or the stay is adjusted under the retensioning procedure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 脊背索索力量測與調整：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stay-force measurement and adjustment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「脊背索頻率量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stay frequency measurement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略彎曲勁度、減振器與套管對有效長度的影響時，短索換算索力可能偏差一成以上，據此調索反而使箱梁應力偏離設計；錨頭夾片咬合不良則會在長期使用後滑移，使索力逐年下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring bending stiffness and the effect of dampers and guide pipes on effective length can misjudge short-stay forces by more than ten percent, so retensioning on that basis drives girder stresses away from design; poorly seated wedges can slip over years of service and let the force decline. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩種方法互相校正後，頻率法才適合用於長期監測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Only after the two methods are cross-calibrated is the frequency method fit for long-term monitoring.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略彎曲勁度、減振器與套管對有效長度的影響時，短索換算索力可能偏差一成以上，據此調索反而使箱梁應力偏離設計；錨頭夾片咬合不良則會在長期使用後滑移，使索力逐年下降。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring bending stiffness and the effect of dampers and guide pipes on effective length can misjudge short-stay forces by more than ten percent, so retensioning on that basis drives girder stresses away from design; poorly seated wedges can slip over years of service and let the force decline.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
