quiz.question: 在「脊背索索力量測與調整」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stay-force measurement and adjustment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略彎曲勁度、減振器與套管對有效長度的影響時，短索換算索力可能偏差一成以上，據此調索反而使箱梁應力偏離設計。
載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Ignoring bending stiffness and the effect of dampers and guide pipes on effective length can misjudge short-stay forces by more than ten percent, so retensioning on that basis drives girder stresses away from design.
If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking.
quiz.explanation: 忽略彎曲勁度、減振器與套管對有效長度的影響時，短索換算索力可能偏差一成以上，據此調索反而使箱梁應力偏離設計；錨頭夾片咬合不良則會在長期使用後滑移，使索力逐年下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring bending stiffness and the effect of dampers and guide pipes on effective length can misjudge short-stay forces by more than ten percent, so retensioning on that basis drives girder stresses away from design; poorly seated wedges can slip over years of service and let the force decline. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 線形驗收與通車前載重試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「跨中撓度與校驗係數」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mid-span deflection and check ratio” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 通車前要確認完成的橋梁與設計模型一致：一是線形，量測橋面高程與預拱是否符合考慮潛變後的目標；二是以已過磅的載重車做靜態與動態試驗，比對實測撓度、應變與自然頻率。實測值通常略小於計算值，因為實際混凝土勁度、鋪面與護欄都提供額外勁度；若實測大於計算，可能代表開裂、支承異常或模型假設錯誤。卸載後的殘餘變形也很重要，它顯示結構是否仍在彈性範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跨中撓度與校驗係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before opening, engineers confirm that the finished bridge matches the design model: first the profile, checking deck levels and camber against targets that allow for creep; second, static and dynamic tests with weighed trucks, comparing measured deflections, strains and natural frequencies. Measured values are usually slightly below predictions because actual concrete stiffness, surfacing and barriers add stiffness; values above prediction may signal cracking, bearing problems or wrong model assumptions. Residual deformation after unloading also matters, showing whether the structure stayed elastic. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mid-span deflection and check ratio” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：校驗係數 η = 實測/計算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Check ratio η = measured/calculated.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「跨中撓度與校驗係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mid-span deflection and check ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 線形驗收與通車前載重試驗
knowledge.titleEn: Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test
knowledge.text: 通車前要確認完成的橋梁與設計模型一致：一是線形，量測橋面高程與預拱是否符合考慮潛變後的目標；二是以已過磅的載重車做靜態與動態試驗，比對實測撓度、應變與自然頻率。實測值通常略小於計算值，因為實際混凝土勁度、鋪面與護欄都提供額外勁度；若實測大於計算，可能代表開裂、支承異常或模型假設錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Before opening, engineers confirm that the finished bridge matches the design model: first the profile, checking deck levels and camber against targets that allow for creep; second, static and dynamic tests with weighed trucks, comparing measured deflections, strains and natural frequencies. Measured values are usually slightly below predictions because actual concrete stiffness, surfacing and barriers add stiffness; values above prediction may signal cracking, bearing problems or wrong model assumptions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「線形驗收與通車前載重試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test" is correct?
options: 載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。
混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。
通車前要確認完成的橋梁與設計模型一致：一是線形，量測橋面高程與預拱是否符合考慮潛變後的目標；二是以已過磅的載重車做靜態與動態試驗，比對實測撓度、應變與自然頻率。
optionsEn: If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking.
Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode.
Before opening, engineers confirm that the finished bridge matches the design model: first the profile, checking deck levels and camber against targets that allow for creep.
quiz.explanation: 通車前要確認完成的橋梁與設計模型一致：一是線形，量測橋面高程與預拱是否符合考慮潛變後的目標；二是以已過磅的載重車做靜態與動態試驗，比對實測撓度、應變與自然頻率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before opening, engineers confirm that the finished bridge matches the design model: first the profile, checking deck levels and camber against targets that allow for creep; second, static and dynamic tests with weighed trucks, comparing measured deflections, strains and natural frequencies. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 線形驗收與通車前載重試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨中撓度與校驗係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mid-span deflection and check ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：校驗係數 η = 實測/計算。某 200 m 跨跨中計算撓度 45 mm、實測 38 mm，η = 38/45 ≈ 0.84；卸載後殘餘 3 mm，殘餘比 3/38 ≈ 7.9%。預拱量級可由懸臂端 δ = P·L³/(3EI) 估計：P = 1,500 kN、L = 95 m、E = 35 GPa、I = 150 m⁴，δ ≈ 82 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Check ratio η = measured/calculated. A 200 m span with 45 mm calculated and 38 mm measured mid-span deflection gives η = 38/45 ≈ 0.84; 3 mm residual after unloading gives 3/38 ≈ 7.9%. Camber magnitude can be estimated from a cantilever tip δ = P·L³/(3EI) with P = 1,500 kN, L = 95 m, E = 35 GPa and I = 150 m⁴, giving δ ≈ 82 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗前依有限元素模型決定車位與加載分級，先預載消除間隙；量測採精密水準、全站儀或位移計並同步記錄溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set truck positions and load steps from the finite-element model, preload to close gaps, then measure with precise levelling, total stations or displacement transducers while recording temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 校驗係數 η = 實測/計算。某 200 m 跨跨中計算撓度 45 mm、實測 38 mm，η = 38/45 ≈ 0.84；卸載後殘餘 3 mm，殘餘比 3/38 ≈ 7.9%。預拱量級可由懸臂端 δ = P·L³/(3EI) 估計：P = 1,500 kN、L = 95 m、E = 35 GPa、I = 150 m⁴，δ ≈ 82 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Check ratio η = measured/calculated. A 200 m span with 45 mm calculated and 38 mm measured mid-span deflection gives η = 38/45 ≈ 0.84; 3 mm residual after unloading gives 3/38 ≈ 7.9%. Camber magnitude can be estimated from a cantilever tip δ = P·L³/(3EI) with P = 1,500 kN, L = 95 m, E = 35 GPa and I = 150 m⁴, giving δ ≈ 82 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「線形驗收與通車前載重試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test", which statement holds?
options: 校驗係數 η = 實測/計算。
海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。
只要基樁打到設計高程，就代表已經進入足夠的岩盤。
optionsEn: Check ratio η = measured/calculated.
Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge.
Reaching the design toe level means the pile is socketed into enough rock.
quiz.explanation: 校驗係數 η = 實測/計算。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Check ratio η = measured/calculated. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 線形驗收與通車前載重試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨中撓度與校驗係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mid-span deflection and check ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗前依有限元素模型決定車位與加載分級，先預載消除間隙；量測採精密水準、全站儀或位移計並同步記錄溫度。允收常以校驗係數小於 1.0、殘餘比低於規定值（例如 20%）且無新增裂縫為準，結果寫入竣工基準資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set truck positions and load steps from the finite-element model, preload to close gaps, then measure with precise levelling, total stations or displacement transducers while recording temperature. Acceptance usually requires a check ratio below 1.0, a residual ratio below the specified value such as 20% and no new cracks; the results enter the as-built baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：載重試驗計畫須明訂車輛過磅、分級加載、每級穩定時間、停止條件與允收標準，並把試驗結果、線形量測與索力表一起納入竣工基準檔案，作為日後監測比較的起點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The load-test plan must specify truck weighing, load steps, hold time per step, stop criteria and acceptance limits, and the results go into the as-built baseline together with the profile survey and stay-force table as the starting point for future monitoring.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗在日照強烈時進行而未做溫度修正，熱變形可能與載重撓度同量級而造成誤判；載重車未逐輛過磅，計算值本身就有誤差，校驗係數失去意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing in strong sun without temperature correction can produce thermal movements as large as the load deflection and lead to misjudgement; trucks not individually weighed make the calculated values wrong and the check ratio meaningless. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗前依有限元素模型決定車位與加載分級，先預載消除間隙；量測採精密水準、全站儀或位移計並同步記錄溫度。允收常以校驗係數小於 1.0、殘餘比低於規定值（例如 20%）且無新增裂縫為準，結果寫入竣工基準資料。
knowledge.textEn: Set truck positions and load steps from the finite-element model, preload to close gaps, then measure with precise levelling, total stations or displacement transducers while recording temperature. Acceptance usually requires a check ratio below 1.0, a residual ratio below the specified value such as 20% and no new cracks; the results enter the as-built baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 載重試驗計畫須明訂車輛過磅、分級加載、每級穩定時間、停止條件與允收標準，並把試驗結果、線形量測與索力表一起納入竣工基準檔案，作為日後監測比較的起點。
knowledge.textEn: The load-test plan must specify truck weighing, load steps, hold time per step, stop criteria and acceptance limits, and the results go into the as-built baseline together with the profile survey and stay-force table as the starting point for future monitoring.

quiz.question: 要驗證「線形驗收與通車前載重試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
試驗前依有限元素模型決定車位與加載分級，先預載消除間隙；量測採精密水準、全站儀或位移計並同步記錄溫度。
預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Set truck positions and load steps from the finite-element model, preload to close gaps, then measure with precise levelling, total stations or displacement transducers while recording temperature.
Factory-precast segments are so precise that no geometry control is needed on site.
quiz.explanation: 試驗前依有限元素模型決定車位與加載分級，先預載消除間隙；量測採精密水準、全站儀或位移計並同步記錄溫度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Set truck positions and load steps from the finite-element model, preload to close gaps, then measure with precise levelling, total stations or displacement transducers while recording temperature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 線形驗收與通車前載重試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨中撓度與校驗係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mid-span deflection and check ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試驗在日照強烈時進行而未做溫度修正，熱變形可能與載重撓度同量級而造成誤判；載重車未逐輛過磅，計算值本身就有誤差，校驗係數失去意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing in strong sun without temperature correction can produce thermal movements as large as the load deflection and lead to misjudgement; trucks not individually weighed make the calculated values wrong and the check ratio meaningless. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：卸載後的殘餘變形也很重要，它顯示結構是否仍在彈性範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Residual deformation after unloading also matters, showing whether the structure stayed elastic.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「載重試驗只要撓度小於計算值，就不必再檢查其他量測結果。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If load-test deflections are below the calculated values, no other measurement needs checking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試驗在日照強烈時進行而未做溫度修正，熱變形可能與載重撓度同量級而造成誤判；載重車未逐輛過磅，計算值本身就有誤差，校驗係數失去意義。
knowledge.textEn: Testing in strong sun without temperature correction can produce thermal movements as large as the load deflection and lead to misjudgement; trucks not individually weighed make the calculated values wrong and the check ratio meaningless.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「線形驗收與通車前載重試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Profile acceptance and pre-opening load test" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。
試驗在日照強烈時進行而未做溫度修正，熱變形可能與載重撓度同量級而造成誤判；載重車未逐輛過磅，計算值本身就有誤差，校驗係數失去意義。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode.
Testing in strong sun without temperature correction can produce thermal movements as large as the load deflection and lead to misjudgement.
quiz.explanation: 試驗在日照強烈時進行而未做溫度修正，熱變形可能與載重撓度同量級而造成誤判；載重車未逐輛過磅，計算值本身就有誤差，校驗係數失去意義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing in strong sun without temperature correction can produce thermal movements as large as the load deflection and lead to misjudgement; trucks not individually weighed make the calculated values wrong and the check ratio meaningless. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計」與「伸縮縫、支承與營運交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Concrete durability in the strait" and "Joints, bearings and operational handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete durability in the strait: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土保護層與氯離子」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete cover and chlorides” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 金門大橋位於海峽中，飛沫帶與潮汐帶的混凝土同時受氯離子滲透、乾濕循環與鹽霧作用；氯離子到達鋼筋位置並超過臨界含量後，鈍化膜破壞，鋼筋開始腐蝕，鏽蝕膨脹使保護層剝落。耐久對策包括加大保護層、降低水膠比、使用卜作嵐材料降低擴散係數、環氧樹脂塗布或耐蝕鋼筋、表面保護與陰極防蝕，2013 年國道新建工程局的考察報告也列出這些方向。不同高程的暴露差異很大，墩柱潮汐帶與樁帽頂面通常最嚴重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混凝土保護層與氯離子」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Kinmen Bridge stands in a strait where concrete in the splash and tidal zones suffers chloride ingress, wetting and drying and salt spray; once chlorides reach the reinforcement above a critical content, the passive film breaks down, the bars corrode and expanding rust spalls the cover. Countermeasures include larger cover, lower water–binder ratio, pozzolans to lower diffusivity, epoxy-coated or corrosion-resistant bars, surface protection and cathodic protection, directions also listed in a 2013 study report of the national expressway engineering bureau. Exposure varies strongly with elevation, and the tidal zone of piers and the top of pile caps are usually worst. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete cover and chlorides” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混凝土保護層與氯離子」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete cover and chlorides”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計
knowledge.text: 金門大橋位於海峽中，飛沫帶與潮汐帶的混凝土同時受氯離子滲透、乾濕循環與鹽霧作用；氯離子到達鋼筋位置並超過臨界含量後，鈍化膜破壞，鋼筋開始腐蝕，鏽蝕膨脹使保護層剝落。耐久對策包括加大保護層、降低水膠比、使用卜作嵐材料降低擴散係數、環氧樹脂塗布或耐蝕鋼筋、表面保護與陰極防蝕，2013 年國道新建工程局的考察報告也列出這些方向。
knowledge.textEn: Kinmen Bridge stands in a strait where concrete in the splash and tidal zones suffers chloride ingress, wetting and drying and salt spray; once chlorides reach the reinforcement above a critical content, the passive film breaks down, the bars corrode and expanding rust spalls the cover. Countermeasures include larger cover, lower water–binder ratio, pozzolans to lower diffusivity, epoxy-coated or corrosion-resistant bars, surface protection and cathodic protection, directions also listed in a 2013 study report of the national expressway engineering bureau.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concrete durability in the strait" is correct?
options: 金門大橋位於海峽中，飛沫帶與潮汐帶的混凝土同時受氯離子滲透、乾濕循環與鹽霧作用。
混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。
伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。
optionsEn: Kinmen Bridge stands in a strait where concrete in the splash and tidal zones suffers chloride ingress, wetting and drying and salt spray.
Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode.
Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally.
quiz.explanation: 金門大橋位於海峽中，飛沫帶與潮汐帶的混凝土同時受氯離子滲透、乾濕循環與鹽霧作用；氯離子到達鋼筋位置並超過臨界含量後，鈍化膜破壞，鋼筋開始腐蝕，鏽蝕膨脹使保護層剝落。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Kinmen Bridge stands in a strait where concrete in the splash and tidal zones suffers chloride ingress, wetting and drying and salt spray; once chlorides reach the reinforcement above a critical content, the passive film breaks down, the bars corrode and expanding rust spalls the cover. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concrete durability in the strait: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土保護層與氯離子」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete cover and chlorides” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。取保護層 x = 75 mm、擴散係數 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、t = 100 年：√(D·t) ≈ 0.0562 m，x/(2√(D·t)) ≈ 0.668，C/C_s ≈ 0.345；若 D 為 3×10⁻¹² m²/s，C/C_s 升到約 0.586。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. With cover x = 75 mm, diffusivity D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and t = 100 years, √(D·t) ≈ 0.0562 m, x/(2√(D·t)) ≈ 0.668 and C/C_s ≈ 0.345; with D = 3×10⁻¹² m²/s, C/C_s rises to about 0.586. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工時以保護層測定儀抽檢鋼筋保護層，以快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗驗證配比；營運後定期在潮汐帶與飛沫帶鑽取粉末，量測氯離子濃度剖面並擬合實際擴散係數，與設計假設比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During construction, spot-check cover with a covermeter and verify the mix by rapid chloride permeability or diffusion tests; in service, periodically drill powder samples in the tidal and splash zones, measure chloride profiles, fit the actual diffusivity and compare it with the design assumption.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。取保護層 x = 75 mm、擴散係數 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、t = 100 年：√(D·t) ≈ 0.0562 m，x/(2√(D·t)) ≈ 0.668，C/C_s ≈ 0.345；若 D 為 3×10⁻¹² m²/s，C/C_s 升到約 0.586。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. With cover x = 75 mm, diffusivity D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and t = 100 years, √(D·t) ≈ 0.0562 m, x/(2√(D·t)) ≈ 0.668 and C/C_s ≈ 0.345; with D = 3×10⁻¹² m²/s, C/C_s rises to about 0.586. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Concrete durability in the strait", which statement holds?
options: 脊背橋只是橋塔比較矮的斜張橋，設計方法完全一樣。
Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。
鋼箱圍堰只是擋水的模板，抽水時不會產生很大的力。
optionsEn: An extradosed bridge is just a cable-stayed bridge with short towers and is designed the same way.
Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))].
A steel box cofferdam is only a formwork that keeps water out, so dewatering creates no large forces.
quiz.explanation: Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Fick's second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concrete durability in the strait: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土保護層與氯離子」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete cover and chlorides” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工時以保護層測定儀抽檢鋼筋保護層，以快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗驗證配比；營運後定期在潮汐帶與飛沫帶鑽取粉末，量測氯離子濃度剖面並擬合實際擴散係數，與設計假設比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During construction, spot-check cover with a covermeter and verify the mix by rapid chloride permeability or diffusion tests; in service, periodically drill powder samples in the tidal and splash zones, measure chloride profiles, fit the actual diffusivity and compare it with the design assumption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範應把保護層量測與間隔物檢查列為澆置前停留點，潮汐帶的接縫與修補須使用經認可的材料；在代表性位置預埋耐久監測探頭或預留取樣點，建立長期氯離子資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should make cover measurement and spacer inspection a hold point before concreting, and require approved materials for joints and repairs in the tidal zone; durability probes or sampling points at representative locations build a long-term chloride record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：保護層不足或局部蜂窩處，氯離子在十幾年內就到達鋼筋，出現鏽水、裂縫與剝落；樁帽頂面若排水不良、乾濕交替，腐蝕會集中在不易檢查的部位，發現時已需大範圍修補。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Where cover is thin or honeycombed, chlorides reach the steel within a decade or two, causing rust stains, cracks and spalls; poorly drained pile-cap tops that wet and dry concentrate corrosion where inspection is hard, so damage is found only when large repairs are needed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工時以保護層測定儀抽檢鋼筋保護層，以快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗驗證配比；營運後定期在潮汐帶與飛沫帶鑽取粉末，量測氯離子濃度剖面並擬合實際擴散係數，與設計假設比較。
knowledge.textEn: During construction, spot-check cover with a covermeter and verify the mix by rapid chloride permeability or diffusion tests; in service, periodically drill powder samples in the tidal and splash zones, measure chloride profiles, fit the actual diffusivity and compare it with the design assumption.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工規範應把保護層量測與間隔物檢查列為澆置前停留點，潮汐帶的接縫與修補須使用經認可的材料；在代表性位置預埋耐久監測探頭或預留取樣點，建立長期氯離子資料。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should make cover measurement and spacer inspection a hold point before concreting, and require approved materials for joints and repairs in the tidal zone; durability probes or sampling points at representative locations build a long-term chloride record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concrete durability in the strait"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
平衡懸臂工法兩側永遠等重，所以墩柱不會受到彎矩。
施工時以保護層測定儀抽檢鋼筋保護層，以快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗驗證配比。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
In balanced cantilever erection both sides are always equal, so the pier never sees bending.
During construction, spot-check cover with a covermeter and verify the mix by rapid chloride permeability or diffusion tests.
quiz.explanation: 施工時以保護層測定儀抽檢鋼筋保護層，以快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗驗證配比；營運後定期在潮汐帶與飛沫帶鑽取粉末，量測氯離子濃度剖面並擬合實際擴散係數，與設計假設比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During construction, spot-check cover with a covermeter and verify the mix by rapid chloride permeability or diffusion tests; in service, periodically drill powder samples in the tidal and splash zones, measure chloride profiles, fit the actual diffusivity and compare it with the design assumption. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete durability in the strait: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土保護層與氯離子」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete cover and chlorides” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 保護層不足或局部蜂窩處，氯離子在十幾年內就到達鋼筋，出現鏽水、裂縫與剝落；樁帽頂面若排水不良、乾濕交替，腐蝕會集中在不易檢查的部位，發現時已需大範圍修補。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Where cover is thin or honeycombed, chlorides reach the steel within a decade or two, causing rust stains, cracks and spalls; poorly drained pile-cap tops that wet and dry concentrate corrosion where inspection is hard, so damage is found only when large repairs are needed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：不同高程的暴露差異很大，墩柱潮汐帶與樁帽頂面通常最嚴重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Exposure varies strongly with elevation, and the tidal zone of piers and the top of pile caps are usually worst.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度越高，就一定不會發生鋼筋腐蝕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher concrete strength alone guarantees the reinforcement will not corrode." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 保護層不足或局部蜂窩處，氯離子在十幾年內就到達鋼筋，出現鏽水、裂縫與剝落；樁帽頂面若排水不良、乾濕交替，腐蝕會集中在不易檢查的部位，發現時已需大範圍修補。
knowledge.textEn: Where cover is thin or honeycombed, chlorides reach the steel within a decade or two, causing rust stains, cracks and spalls; poorly drained pile-cap tops that wet and dry concentrate corrosion where inspection is hard, so damage is found only when large repairs are needed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「海峽環境的混凝土耐久設計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete durability in the strait" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 保護層不足或局部蜂窩處，氯離子在十幾年內就到達鋼筋，出現鏽水、裂縫與剝落；樁帽頂面若排水不良、乾濕交替，腐蝕會集中在不易檢查的部位，發現時已需大範圍修補。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。
optionsEn: Where cover is thin or honeycombed, chlorides reach the steel within a decade or two, causing rust stains, cracks and spalls.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally.
quiz.explanation: 保護層不足或局部蜂窩處，氯離子在十幾年內就到達鋼筋，出現鏽水、裂縫與剝落；樁帽頂面若排水不良、乾濕交替，腐蝕會集中在不易檢查的部位，發現時已需大範圍修補。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Where cover is thin or honeycombed, chlorides reach the steel within a decade or two, causing rust stains, cracks and spalls; poorly drained pile-cap tops that wet and dry concentrate corrosion where inspection is hard, so damage is found only when large repairs are needed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 伸縮縫、支承與營運交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joints, bearings and operational handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮縫與支承行程」如何影響金門大橋（金門）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint and bearing travel” governs force, deformation or durability in “Kinmen Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 全橋由主橋、兩側邊橋與多個引橋單元組成，各單元之間以伸縮縫分隔，支承配置決定每個單元哪裡固定、哪裡可滑動。溫度、乾縮與潛變讓梁體長度持續變化，伸縮縫與滑動支承必須提供足夠行程，同時承受車輛衝擊與鹽霧侵蝕。交接時管理單位需要的不只是竣工圖，還包括各單元固定點位置、支承與伸縮縫設計行程、竣工時的初始開口與當時溫度，作為日後判斷異常位移的基準；公開報導也提到通車後將依強風情況實施交通管制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「伸縮縫與支承行程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The crossing consists of the main bridge, two side bridges and several approach units separated by expansion joints, and the bearing layout decides where each unit is fixed and where it slides. Temperature, shrinkage and creep keep changing girder length, so joints and sliding bearings need enough travel while resisting traffic impact and salt spray. At handover the operator needs more than as-built drawings: the fixed point of each unit, design travel of bearings and joints, and the initial joint openings with the temperature at completion, as the baseline for spotting abnormal movement; public reports also note traffic control during strong winds after opening. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint and bearing travel” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設一個 1,050 m 連續單元以中央為不動點，端部受影響長度 525 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a 1,050 m continuous unit fixed at its centre, so 525 m acts on each end.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「伸縮縫與支承行程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joint and bearing travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 伸縮縫、支承與營運交接
knowledge.text: 全橋由主橋、兩側邊橋與多個引橋單元組成，各單元之間以伸縮縫分隔，支承配置決定每個單元哪裡固定、哪裡可滑動。溫度、乾縮與潛變讓梁體長度持續變化，伸縮縫與滑動支承必須提供足夠行程，同時承受車輛衝擊與鹽霧侵蝕。
knowledge.textEn: The crossing consists of the main bridge, two side bridges and several approach units separated by expansion joints, and the bearing layout decides where each unit is fixed and where it slides. Temperature, shrinkage and creep keep changing girder length, so joints and sliding bearings need enough travel while resisting traffic impact and salt spray.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「伸縮縫、支承與營運交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joints, bearings and operational handover" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。
全橋由主橋、兩側邊橋與多個引橋單元組成，各單元之間以伸縮縫分隔，支承配置決定每個單元哪裡固定、哪裡可滑動。
海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。
optionsEn: Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally.
The crossing consists of the main bridge, two side bridges and several approach units separated by expansion joints, and the bearing layout decides where each unit is fixed and where it slides.
Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge.
quiz.explanation: 全橋由主橋、兩側邊橋與多個引橋單元組成，各單元之間以伸縮縫分隔，支承配置決定每個單元哪裡固定、哪裡可滑動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The crossing consists of the main bridge, two side bridges and several approach units separated by expansion joints, and the bearing layout decides where each unit is fixed and where it slides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 伸縮縫、支承與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joints, bearings and operational handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮縫與支承行程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint and bearing travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設一個 1,050 m 連續單元以中央為不動點，端部受影響長度 525 m。溫度變化 30 °C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×525×30 ≈ 0.158 m；乾縮與潛變應變 250×10⁻⁶：250×10⁻⁶×525 ≈ 0.131 m，伸縮縫需涵蓋兩者再加安裝誤差。單元劃分與參數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a 1,050 m continuous unit fixed at its centre, so 525 m acts on each end. A 30 °C change gives ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×525×30 ≈ 0.158 m; shrinkage and creep strain of 250×10⁻⁶ add 250×10⁻⁶×525 ≈ 0.131 m, and the joint must cover both plus installation tolerance. Unit layout and parameters are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：竣工時記錄每道伸縮縫開口與當時梁溫；營運後在不同季節重測，繪出開口與溫度的關係，斜率應接近 α·L，若偏離或出現持續漂移，代表支承卡滯或墩柱位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record every joint opening with girder temperature at completion; re-measure in different seasons and plot opening against temperature, whose slope should approach α·L, while deviation or steady drift signals seized bearings or pier movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設一個 1,050 m 連續單元以中央為不動點，端部受影響長度 525 m。溫度變化 30 °C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×525×30 ≈ 0.158 m；乾縮與潛變應變 250×10⁻⁶：250×10⁻⁶×525 ≈ 0.131 m，伸縮縫需涵蓋兩者再加安裝誤差。單元劃分與參數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 1,050 m continuous unit fixed at its centre, so 525 m acts on each end. A 30 °C change gives ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×525×30 ≈ 0.158 m; shrinkage and creep strain of 250×10⁻⁶ add 250×10⁻⁶×525 ≈ 0.131 m, and the joint must cover both plus installation tolerance. Unit layout and parameters are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「伸縮縫、支承與營運交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joints, bearings and operational handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要基樁打到設計高程，就代表已經進入足夠的岩盤。
預鑄節塊在工廠做得很精準，現場就不需要幾何控制。
假設一個 1,050 m 連續單元以中央為不動點，端部受影響長度 525 m。
optionsEn: Reaching the design toe level means the pile is socketed into enough rock.
Factory-precast segments are so precise that no geometry control is needed on site.
Assume a 1,050 m continuous unit fixed at its centre, so 525 m acts on each end.
quiz.explanation: 假設一個 1,050 m 連續單元以中央為不動點，端部受影響長度 525 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a 1,050 m continuous unit fixed at its centre, so 525 m acts on each end. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 伸縮縫、支承與營運交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joints, bearings and operational handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮縫與支承行程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint and bearing travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 竣工時記錄每道伸縮縫開口與當時梁溫；營運後在不同季節重測，繪出開口與溫度的關係，斜率應接近 α·L，若偏離或出現持續漂移，代表支承卡滯或墩柱位移。支承檢查滑動面磨耗、錨栓與防塵罩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record every joint opening with girder temperature at completion; re-measure in different seasons and plot opening against temperature, whose slope should approach α·L, while deviation or steady drift signals seized bearings or pier movement. Inspect bearing sliding surfaces for wear, anchor bolts and dust covers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接清冊應包含伸縮縫與支承的型號、行程、初始設定與溫度、更換程序與交通維持計畫，以及索力基準與載重試驗資料；並約定巡查週期與颱風、地震後的特別檢查表，明訂由哪個單位簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The handover register should list joint and bearing types, travel, initial settings and temperatures, replacement procedures and traffic-management plans, together with the stay-force baseline and load-test data; it should also fix inspection intervals and special post-typhoon and post-earthquake checklists, naming who signs them off.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承滑動面因鹽霧腐蝕或積砂而卡滯，溫度力轉移到墩柱造成裂縫；伸縮縫行程不足時夏季頂死、冬季開口過大，車輛衝擊破壞錨定混凝土並使雨水與鹽分流到支承。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sliding surfaces seized by salt corrosion or trapped sand transfer thermal forces into the piers and crack them; joints with too little travel close up in summer and gape in winter, and traffic impact breaks the anchoring concrete and lets water and salt reach the bearings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 竣工時記錄每道伸縮縫開口與當時梁溫；營運後在不同季節重測，繪出開口與溫度的關係，斜率應接近 α·L，若偏離或出現持續漂移，代表支承卡滯或墩柱位移。支承檢查滑動面磨耗、錨栓與防塵罩。
knowledge.textEn: Record every joint opening with girder temperature at completion; re-measure in different seasons and plot opening against temperature, whose slope should approach α·L, while deviation or steady drift signals seized bearings or pier movement. Inspect bearing sliding surfaces for wear, anchor bolts and dust covers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接清冊應包含伸縮縫與支承的型號、行程、初始設定與溫度、更換程序與交通維持計畫，以及索力基準與載重試驗資料；並約定巡查週期與颱風、地震後的特別檢查表，明訂由哪個單位簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The handover register should list joint and bearing types, travel, initial settings and temperatures, replacement procedures and traffic-management plans, together with the stay-force baseline and load-test data; it should also fix inspection intervals and special post-typhoon and post-earthquake checklists, naming who signs them off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「伸縮縫、支承與營運交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joints, bearings and operational handover"?
options: 竣工時記錄每道伸縮縫開口與當時梁溫；營運後在不同季節重測，繪出開口與溫度的關係，斜率應接近 α·L，若偏離或出現持續漂移，代表支承卡滯或墩柱位移。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要量到索的頻率，就能用同一個公式精確換算任何長度的索力。
optionsEn: Record every joint opening with girder temperature at completion.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Once a stay's frequency is measured, one formula gives an exact force for any stay length.
quiz.explanation: 竣工時記錄每道伸縮縫開口與當時梁溫；營運後在不同季節重測，繪出開口與溫度的關係，斜率應接近 α·L，若偏離或出現持續漂移，代表支承卡滯或墩柱位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record every joint opening with girder temperature at completion; re-measure in different seasons and plot opening against temperature, whose slope should approach α·L, while deviation or steady drift signals seized bearings or pier movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 伸縮縫、支承與營運交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joints, bearings and operational handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮縫與支承行程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint and bearing travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承滑動面因鹽霧腐蝕或積砂而卡滯，溫度力轉移到墩柱造成裂縫；伸縮縫行程不足時夏季頂死、冬季開口過大，車輛衝擊破壞錨定混凝土並使雨水與鹽分流到支承。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sliding surfaces seized by salt corrosion or trapped sand transfer thermal forces into the piers and crack them; joints with too little travel close up in summer and gape in winter, and traffic impact breaks the anchoring concrete and lets water and salt reach the bearings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時管理單位需要的不只是竣工圖，還包括各單元固定點位置、支承與伸縮縫設計行程、竣工時的初始開口與當時溫度，作為日後判斷異常位移的基準；公開報導也提到通車後將依強風情況實施交通管制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At handover the operator needs more than as-built drawings: the fixed point of each unit, design travel of bearings and joints, and the initial joint openings with the temperature at completion, as the baseline for spotting abnormal movement; public reports also note traffic control during strong winds after opening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫只是行車舒適性的配件，損壞時不影響結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Expansion joints only affect ride comfort, so their damage does not matter structurally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支承滑動面因鹽霧腐蝕或積砂而卡滯，溫度力轉移到墩柱造成裂縫；伸縮縫行程不足時夏季頂死、冬季開口過大，車輛衝擊破壞錨定混凝土並使雨水與鹽分流到支承。
knowledge.textEn: Sliding surfaces seized by salt corrosion or trapped sand transfer thermal forces into the piers and crack them; joints with too little travel close up in summer and gape in winter, and traffic impact breaks the anchoring concrete and lets water and salt reach the bearings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「伸縮縫、支承與營運交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joints, bearings and operational handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
支承滑動面因鹽霧腐蝕或積砂而卡滯，溫度力轉移到墩柱造成裂縫；伸縮縫行程不足時夏季頂死、冬季開口過大，車輛衝擊破壞錨定混凝土並使雨水與鹽分流到支承。
海上橋梁的基礎設計只要考慮完工後的營運荷載就足夠。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Sliding surfaces seized by salt corrosion or trapped sand transfer thermal forces into the piers and crack them.
Designing a marine bridge foundation only needs the in-service loads of the finished bridge.
quiz.explanation: 支承滑動面因鹽霧腐蝕或積砂而卡滯，溫度力轉移到墩柱造成裂縫；伸縮縫行程不足時夏季頂死、冬季開口過大，車輛衝擊破壞錨定混凝土並使雨水與鹽分流到支承。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sliding surfaces seized by salt corrosion or trapped sand transfer thermal forces into the piers and crack them; joints with too little travel close up in summer and gape in winter, and traffic impact breaks the anchoring concrete and lets water and salt reach the bearings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 米約高架橋
summary: 米約高架橋以七座混凝土高墩、七座鋼塔與 2,460 公尺連續鋼箱梁跨越法國塔恩河谷，最高墩約 245 公尺、塔頂高 343 公尺。本課從河谷高空風與多跨斜張體系的勁度問題出發，分析雙肢橋墩、正交異性鋼箱梁與 154 根單股斜索，再拆解由兩岸頂推、經臨時鋼墩把跨徑減半的施工法與合龍，最後談斜索監測、載重試驗、鋼橋面疲勞與特許經營期的維護。
summaryEn: The Millau Viaduct crosses the Tarn valley in France on seven concrete piers, seven steel pylons and a 2,460 m continuous steel box deck, with the tallest pier about 245 m and the pylon tops at 343 m. The course starts with high-level valley wind and the stiffness problem of multi-span cable-stayed bridges, examines split-shaft piers, the orthotropic steel box and 154 monostrand stays, then unpacks launching from both abutments over temporary towers that halve the spans and the closure, ending with stay monitoring, load testing, deck fatigue and maintenance through the concession.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
