knowledge.textEn: The steel deck was assembled on platforms at both ends and launched about 1,743 m from the south and 717 m from the north. The 342 m spans were too long for launching, so telescopic temporary steel towers at mid-span cut the cantilever to about 171 m, the tallest roughly 170–180 m high; the P2–P3 span over the Tarn had no temporary tower and the cantilever was carried instead by pylons already fitted on P2 and P3 with permanent stays installed in advance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂推只是把梁往前推，主要風險是推力不夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Launching is just pushing the deck forward, and the main risk is insufficient push force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙向頂推與臨時墩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Launching from both sides over temporary towers" is correct?
options: 頂推只是把梁往前推，主要風險是推力不夠。
兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。
鋼箱梁在兩岸平台上組裝，由南岸頂推約 1,743 公尺、北岸約 717 公尺。
optionsEn: Launching is just pushing the deck forward, and the main risk is insufficient push force.
Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter.
The steel deck was assembled on platforms at both ends and launched about 1,743 m from the south and 717 m from the north.
quiz.explanation: 鋼箱梁在兩岸平台上組裝，由南岸頂推約 1,743 公尺、北岸約 717 公尺。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The steel deck was assembled on platforms at both ends and launched about 1,743 m from the south and 717 m from the north. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙向頂推與臨時墩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Launching from both sides over temporary towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂推器與臨時鋼墩」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Launching units and temporary towers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋼梁自重 w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m。無鼻樑時 171 m 懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m，是同跨簡支跨中彎矩 w·L²/8 ≈ 5.25×10⁵ kN·m 的 4 倍。每循環 600 mm、4 分鐘，推過 171 m 需 285 個循環，約 19 小時純推進時間（約 9 m/h）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Deck self-weight w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m. Without a nose, a 171 m cantilever has a root moment M = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m, four times the simple-span mid-span moment w·L²/8 ≈ 5.25×10⁵ kN·m. At 600 mm per four-minute cycle, 171 m needs 285 cycles, about 19 hours of pushing (about 9 m/h). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次頂推前確認風速預報與允許窗口，頂推中即時監測各頂推器的頂升力、推力與梁底高程，並以測量確認懸臂端到達下一支點時的下垂量與鼻樑回收；臨時墩的伸縮與垂直度在每段頂推後重新量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each launch confirm the wind forecast and permitted window; during launching monitor lift and push forces and soffit levels at every unit in real time, survey the cantilever tip sag and nose recovery as it reaches the next support, and re-measure temporary-tower extension and verticality after each launch.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鋼梁自重 w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m。無鼻樑時 171 m 懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m，是同跨簡支跨中彎矩 w·L²/8 ≈ 5.25×10⁵ kN·m 的 4 倍。每循環 600 mm、4 分鐘，推過 171 m 需 285 個循環，約 19 小時純推進時間（約 9 m/h）。
knowledge.textEn: Deck self-weight w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m. Without a nose, a 171 m cantilever has a root moment M = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m, four times the simple-span mid-span moment w·L²/8 ≈ 5.25×10⁵ kN·m. At 600 mm per four-minute cycle, 171 m needs 285 cycles, about 19 hours of pushing (about 9 m/h).

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙向頂推與臨時墩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Launching from both sides over temporary towers", which statement holds?
options: 載重試驗只要量跨中撓度就能證明多跨斜張橋的性能。
支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。
optionsEn: Deck self-weight w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m.
Measuring mid-span deflection alone proves the performance of a multi-span cable-stayed bridge.
Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement.
quiz.explanation: 鋼梁自重 w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Deck self-weight w ≈ 14.6 t/m×9.81 ≈ 143.6 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙向頂推與臨時墩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Launching from both sides over temporary towers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂推器與臨時鋼墩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Launching units and temporary towers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次頂推前確認風速預報與允許窗口，頂推中即時監測各頂推器的頂升力、推力與梁底高程，並以測量確認懸臂端到達下一支點時的下垂量與鼻樑回收；臨時墩的伸縮與垂直度在每段頂推後重新量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each launch confirm the wind forecast and permitted window; during launching monitor lift and push forces and soffit levels at every unit in real time, survey the cantilever tip sag and nose recovery as it reaches the next support, and re-measure temporary-tower extension and verticality after each launch. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：頂推作業程序應列出天候窗口、每循環的停止條件（推力、頂升力、偏位、風速超限）、通訊失效時的安全狀態，以及每段頂推完成後的檢查清單；啟動每次頂推須由施工工程師與設計代表共同簽核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The launching procedure should set weather windows, stop criteria per cycle (push or lift force, misalignment, wind speed), a safe state on loss of communication and an inspection checklist after each launch; every launch is released only with joint sign-off by the construction engineer and the designer's representative.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若各墩頂推器不同步，梁體在某一支點被拖拉或卡住，臨時墩頂受到額外水平力而傾斜；懸臂端下垂超出鼻樑可回收的範圍時，梁無法上到下一支點，只能停在最危險的長懸臂狀態等待處理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the units fall out of sync, the deck drags or jams at one support and a temporary tower takes extra horizontal force and tilts; if tip sag exceeds what the nose can recover, the deck cannot ride onto the next support and is stuck in its most critical long-cantilever state. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次頂推前確認風速預報與允許窗口，頂推中即時監測各頂推器的頂升力、推力與梁底高程，並以測量確認懸臂端到達下一支點時的下垂量與鼻樑回收；臨時墩的伸縮與垂直度在每段頂推後重新量測。
knowledge.textEn: Before each launch confirm the wind forecast and permitted window; during launching monitor lift and push forces and soffit levels at every unit in real time, survey the cantilever tip sag and nose recovery as it reaches the next support, and re-measure temporary-tower extension and verticality after each launch.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 頂推作業程序應列出天候窗口、每循環的停止條件（推力、頂升力、偏位、風速超限）、通訊失效時的安全狀態，以及每段頂推完成後的檢查清單；啟動每次頂推須由施工工程師與設計代表共同簽核。
knowledge.textEn: The launching procedure should set weather windows, stop criteria per cycle (push or lift force, misalignment, wind speed), a safe state on loss of communication and an inspection checklist after each launch; every launch is released only with joint sign-off by the construction engineer and the designer's representative.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙向頂推與臨時墩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Launching from both sides over temporary towers"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每次頂推前確認風速預報與允許窗口，頂推中即時監測各頂推器的頂升力、推力與梁底高程，並以測量確認懸臂端到達下一支點時的下垂量與鼻樑回收。
橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before each launch confirm the wind forecast and permitted window.
The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes.
quiz.explanation: 每次頂推前確認風速預報與允許窗口，頂推中即時監測各頂推器的頂升力、推力與梁底高程，並以測量確認懸臂端到達下一支點時的下垂量與鼻樑回收；臨時墩的伸縮與垂直度在每段頂推後重新量測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each launch confirm the wind forecast and permitted window; during launching monitor lift and push forces and soffit levels at every unit in real time, survey the cantilever tip sag and nose recovery as it reaches the next support, and re-measure temporary-tower extension and verticality after each launch. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙向頂推與臨時墩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Launching from both sides over temporary towers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂推器與臨時鋼墩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Launching units and temporary towers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若各墩頂推器不同步，梁體在某一支點被拖拉或卡住，臨時墩頂受到額外水平力而傾斜；懸臂端下垂超出鼻樑可回收的範圍時，梁無法上到下一支點，只能停在最危險的長懸臂狀態等待處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the units fall out of sync, the deck drags or jams at one support and a temporary tower takes extra horizontal force and tilts; if tip sag exceeds what the nose can recover, the deck cannot ride onto the next support and is stuck in its most critical long-cantilever state. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每座墩頂的頂推器先把梁頂起再向前推，公開報導稱每個循環推進 600 mm、約 4 分鐘，全程共 18 次頂推作業，由中央控制室同步各墩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A launching unit on each support lifted the deck and pushed it forward; trade reports cite 600 mm per cycle in about four minutes, with 18 launch operations in all, synchronised from a central control room.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂推只是把梁往前推，主要風險是推力不夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Launching is just pushing the deck forward, and the main risk is insufficient push force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若各墩頂推器不同步，梁體在某一支點被拖拉或卡住，臨時墩頂受到額外水平力而傾斜；懸臂端下垂超出鼻樑可回收的範圍時，梁無法上到下一支點，只能停在最危險的長懸臂狀態等待處理。
knowledge.textEn: If the units fall out of sync, the deck drags or jams at one support and a temporary tower takes extra horizontal force and tilts; if tip sag exceeds what the nose can recover, the deck cannot ride onto the next support and is stuck in its most critical long-cantilever state.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙向頂推與臨時墩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Launching from both sides over temporary towers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。
若各墩頂推器不同步，梁體在某一支點被拖拉或卡住，臨時墩頂受到額外水平力而傾斜。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter.
If the units fall out of sync, the deck drags or jams at one support and a temporary tower takes extra horizontal force and tilts.
quiz.explanation: 若各墩頂推器不同步，梁體在某一支點被拖拉或卡住，臨時墩頂受到額外水平力而傾斜；懸臂端下垂超出鼻樑可回收的範圍時，梁無法上到下一支點，只能停在最危險的長懸臂狀態等待處理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the units fall out of sync, the deck drags or jams at one support and a temporary tower takes extra horizontal force and tilts; if tip sag exceeds what the nose can recover, the deck cannot ride onto the next support and is stuck in its most critical long-cantilever state. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure, pylons and stays in place: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「河谷中央合龍段」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mid-valley closure joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 南北兩段鋼梁在 2004 年 5 月 28 日於塔恩河上方約 268 公尺處接合，之後才把各鋼塔與其餘斜索安裝到位：公開資料指出，頂推階段先在 P3、P2 安裝 24 根頂推用斜索，其餘 130 根在 2004 年 6 月至 8 月間安裝。合龍前兩段鋼梁都是自由端，溫度變化直接改變間隙與高程差；合龍後梁成為連續體，再透過斜索張拉把恆載重新分配，並把臨時墩卸載移除。這個體系轉換的順序決定最終梁體應力與線形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「河谷中央合龍段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The north and south deck sections met on 28 May 2004 about 268 m above the Tarn, after which the remaining pylons and stays were completed: published data say 24 launching stays were first installed on P3 and P2, and the other 130 between June and August 2004. Before closure both deck ends are free, so temperature directly changes the gap and level difference; after closure the deck is continuous, stay tensioning redistributes dead load and the temporary towers are unloaded and removed. The sequence of this system change determines final deck stresses and profile. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mid-valley closure joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：南段長 1,743 m，鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，每 1 °C 端部伸縮 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm；兩段若溫差 5 °C，間隙改變約 105 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The south section is 1,743 m long; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C its end moves 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm per °C, so a 5 °C change shifts the gap by about 105 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「河谷中央合龍段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mid-valley closure joint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位
knowledge.titleEn: Closure, pylons and stays in place
knowledge.text: 南北兩段鋼梁在 2004 年 5 月 28 日於塔恩河上方約 268 公尺處接合，之後才把各鋼塔與其餘斜索安裝到位：公開資料指出，頂推階段先在 P3、P2 安裝 24 根頂推用斜索，其餘 130 根在 2004 年 6 月至 8 月間安裝。合龍前兩段鋼梁都是自由端，溫度變化直接改變間隙與高程差；合龍後梁成為連續體，再透過斜索張拉把恆載重新分配，並把臨時墩卸載移除。
knowledge.textEn: The north and south deck sections met on 28 May 2004 about 268 m above the Tarn, after which the remaining pylons and stays were completed: published data say 24 launching stays were first installed on P3 and P2, and the other 130 between June and August 2004. Before closure both deck ends are free, so temperature directly changes the gap and level difference; after closure the deck is continuous, stay tensioning redistributes dead load and the temporary towers are unloaded and removed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure, pylons and stays in place" is correct?
options: 南北兩段鋼梁在 2004 年 5 月 28 日於塔恩河上方約 268 公尺處接合，之後才把各鋼塔與其餘斜索安裝到位：公開資料指出，頂推階段先在 P3、P2 安裝 24 根頂推用斜索，其餘 130 根在 2004 年 6 月至 8 月間安裝。
兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。
斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。
optionsEn: The north and south deck sections met on 28 May 2004 about 268 m above the Tarn, after which the remaining pylons and stays were completed: published data say 24 launching stays were first installed on P3 and P2, and the other 130 between June and August 2004.
Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter.
Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 南北兩段鋼梁在 2004 年 5 月 28 日於塔恩河上方約 268 公尺處接合，之後才把各鋼塔與其餘斜索安裝到位：公開資料指出，頂推階段先在 P3、P2 安裝 24 根頂推用斜索，其餘 130 根在 2004 年 6 月至 8 月間安裝。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The north and south deck sections met on 28 May 2004 about 268 m above the Tarn, after which the remaining pylons and stays were completed: published data say 24 launching stays were first installed on P3 and P2, and the other 130 between June and August 2004. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure, pylons and stays in place: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「河谷中央合龍段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mid-valley closure joint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：南段長 1,743 m，鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，每 1 °C 端部伸縮 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm；兩段若溫差 5 °C，間隙改變約 105 mm。因此合龍常選在夜間或清晨溫度穩定時，以臨時連接器先鎖定再焊接。溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The south section is 1,743 m long; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C its end moves 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm per °C, so a 5 °C change shifts the gap by about 105 mm. Closure is therefore made at night or dawn when temperatures are stable, locking with temporary connectors before welding. The temperature change is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段；鎖定後量測焊接前後的偏位與應變，臨時墩卸載時逐步記錄各支點反力與梁體高程，確認與施工階段分析一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window; after locking, measure offsets and strains before and after welding, and during temporary-tower unloading log support reactions and deck levels step by step against the staged analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 南段長 1,743 m，鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，每 1 °C 端部伸縮 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm；兩段若溫差 5 °C，間隙改變約 105 mm。因此合龍常選在夜間或清晨溫度穩定時，以臨時連接器先鎖定再焊接。溫差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The south section is 1,743 m long; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C its end moves 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm per °C, so a 5 °C change shifts the gap by about 105 mm. Closure is therefore made at night or dawn when temperatures are stable, locking with temporary connectors before welding. The temperature change is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closure, pylons and stays in place", which statement holds?
options: 鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。
風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。
optionsEn: Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect.
The south section is 1,743 m long.
Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure.
quiz.explanation: 南段長 1,743 m，鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，每 1 °C 端部伸縮 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm；兩段若溫差 5 °C，間隙改變約 105 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The south section is 1,743 m long; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C its end moves 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,743 ≈ 0.0209 m = 20.9 mm per °C, so a 5 °C change shifts the gap by about 105 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure, pylons and stays in place: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「河谷中央合龍段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mid-valley closure joint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段；鎖定後量測焊接前後的偏位與應變，臨時墩卸載時逐步記錄各支點反力與梁體高程，確認與施工階段分析一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window; after locking, measure offsets and strains before and after welding, and during temporary-tower unloading log support reactions and deck levels step by step against the staged analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合龍與體系轉換應有獨立的程序書：鎖定時段、焊接順序、斜索張拉與臨時墩卸載的步驟與每步允許偏差；每一步完成後由監控小組比對量測與預測，偏差超過預警即暫停，由設計單位決定修正方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Closure and system change need a dedicated procedure: locking window, welding sequence, stay tensioning and temporary-tower unloading steps with tolerances; after each step the monitoring team compares measurements with predictions and stops at alert deviations, leaving the correction to the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses; unloading temporary towers in the wrong order can momentarily overload neighbouring stays or bearings, causing unexpected twist or local buckling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段；鎖定後量測焊接前後的偏位與應變，臨時墩卸載時逐步記錄各支點反力與梁體高程，確認與施工階段分析一致。
knowledge.textEn: Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window; after locking, measure offsets and strains before and after welding, and during temporary-tower unloading log support reactions and deck levels step by step against the staged analysis.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合龍與體系轉換應有獨立的程序書：鎖定時段、焊接順序、斜索張拉與臨時墩卸載的步驟與每步允許偏差；每一步完成後由監控小組比對量測與預測，偏差超過預警即暫停，由設計單位決定修正方案。
knowledge.textEn: Closure and system change need a dedicated procedure: locking window, welding sequence, stay tensioning and temporary-tower unloading steps with tolerances; after each step the monitoring team compares measurements with predictions and stops at alert deviations, leaving the correction to the designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closure, pylons and stays in place"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
全部改用高強度鋼一定最省錢、最安全。
合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice.
Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window.
quiz.explanation: 合龍前連續量測兩端間隙、高程與梁溫至少一個晝夜循環，建立間隙—溫度關係並預測合龍時段；鎖定後量測焊接前後的偏位與應變，臨時墩卸載時逐步記錄各支點反力與梁體高程，確認與施工階段分析一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before closure, record gap, levels and steel temperature for at least one day–night cycle to build a gap–temperature relation and predict the window; after locking, measure offsets and strains before and after welding, and during temporary-tower unloading log support reactions and deck levels step by step against the staged analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closure, pylons and stays in place: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「河谷中央合龍段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mid-valley closure joint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses; unloading temporary towers in the wrong order can momentarily overload neighbouring stays or bearings, causing unexpected twist or local buckling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個體系轉換的順序決定最終梁體應力與線形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The sequence of this system change determines final deck stresses and profile.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。
knowledge.textEn: Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses; unloading temporary towers in the wrong order can momentarily overload neighbouring stays or bearings, causing unexpected twist or local buckling.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合龍、鋼塔與斜索就位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closure, pylons and stays in place" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。
optionsEn: Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 在溫度快速變化時強行焊接合龍，焊道冷卻中受拉而開裂或產生鎖入應力；臨時墩卸載順序錯誤則讓相鄰斜索或支承瞬間超載，梁體出現不預期的扭轉或局部屈曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forcing a closure weld while temperatures change quickly can crack the cooling weld or lock in stresses; unloading temporary towers in the wrong order can momentarily overload neighbouring stays or bearings, causing unexpected twist or local buckling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」與「通車前載重試驗與量測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring" and "Pre-opening load test and measurement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜索振動、阻尼與監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stay vibration, damping and monitoring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斜索阻尼器與監測索」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stay dampers and instrumented stays” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。米約的斜索保護套表面有螺旋肋以抑制風雨振，每根索在橋面上方約 1 公尺處裝設阻尼器，頂推期間還曾以臨時橫向繫索提高頻率與阻尼。公開技術文章也指出，P3 南側有 6 根斜索裝設量測儀器，平均風速超過 15 m/s 或加速度超過 1.5 m/s² 時自動記錄，錨板上另有 12 個聲波感測器偵測斷絲。這些量測把設計假設轉成可追蹤的營運資料。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斜索阻尼器與監測索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long stays are light and have very low inherent damping, so rain–wind, vortex shedding or deck motion can drive large vibrations. Millau's sheaths carry helical ridges against rain–wind vibration, each stay has a damper about 1 m above the deck, and temporary cross-ties raised frequencies and damping during launching. A published paper adds that six stays on the south side of P3 are instrumented, recording automatically when mean wind exceeds 15 m/s or acceleration exceeds 1.5 m/s², and 12 acoustic sensors on anchor plates listen for wire breaks. These measurements turn design assumptions into traceable operating data. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stay dampers and instrumented stays” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：外加阻尼器最佳附加阻尼比約 ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An external damper gives an optimum added damping ratio of about ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斜索阻尼器與監測索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stay dampers and instrumented stays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斜索振動、阻尼與監測
knowledge.text: 長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。米約的斜索保護套表面有螺旋肋以抑制風雨振，每根索在橋面上方約 1 公尺處裝設阻尼器，頂推期間還曾以臨時橫向繫索提高頻率與阻尼。
knowledge.textEn: Long stays are light and have very low inherent damping, so rain–wind, vortex shedding or deck motion can drive large vibrations. Millau's sheaths carry helical ridges against rain–wind vibration, each stay has a damper about 1 m above the deck, and temporary cross-ties raised frequencies and damping during launching.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring" is correct?
options: 斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。
長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。
載重試驗只要量跨中撓度就能證明多跨斜張橋的性能。
optionsEn: Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter.
Long stays are light and have very low inherent damping, so rain–wind, vortex shedding or deck motion can drive large vibrations.
Measuring mid-span deflection alone proves the performance of a multi-span cable-stayed bridge.
quiz.explanation: 長斜索質量輕、本身阻尼很低，在風雨、渦流或橋面振動激勵下容易大幅振動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long stays are light and have very low inherent damping, so rain–wind, vortex shedding or deck motion can drive large vibrations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜索振動、阻尼與監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stay vibration, damping and monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜索阻尼器與監測索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stay dampers and instrumented stays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：外加阻尼器最佳附加阻尼比約 ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L。取阻尼器距錨點 x_d = 2.5 m、索長 L = 120 m，ζ ≈ 0.5×2.5/120 ≈ 1.04%。Scruton 數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²)，m = 100 kg/m、D = 0.25 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3，高於常用的風雨振門檻 10。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An external damper gives an optimum added damping ratio of about ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L. With x_d = 2.5 m from the anchorage and L = 120 m, ζ ≈ 0.5×2.5/120 ≈ 1.04%. The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) with m = 100 kg/m, D = 0.25 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ is Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3, above the commonly used rain–wind threshold of 10. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝阻尼器前後分別做自由衰減試驗（以繩索拉離後釋放），量測各階模態的阻尼比，與設計目標比較；營運中定期下載監測索的加速度與風速紀錄，確認觸發事件的振幅、頻率與風況，聲波事件則逐一比對位置與時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run free-decay tests (pull with a rope and release) before and after damper installation, measuring modal damping ratios against the target; in service download instrumented-stay accelerations with wind records to examine triggered events by amplitude, frequency and wind condition, and locate and time-stamp every acoustic event.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 外加阻尼器最佳附加阻尼比約 ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L。取阻尼器距錨點 x_d = 2.5 m、索長 L = 120 m，ζ ≈ 0.5×2.5/120 ≈ 1.04%。Scruton 數 Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²)，m = 100 kg/m、D = 0.25 m、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³，Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3，高於常用的風雨振門檻 10。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: An external damper gives an optimum added damping ratio of about ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L. With x_d = 2.5 m from the anchorage and L = 120 m, ζ ≈ 0.5×2.5/120 ≈ 1.04%. The Scruton number Sc = m·ζ/(ρ·D²) with m = 100 kg/m, D = 0.25 m and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ is Sc = 100×0.0104/(1.25×0.0625) ≈ 13.3, above the commonly used rain–wind threshold of 10. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring", which statement holds?
options: 支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。
橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。
外加阻尼器最佳附加阻尼比約 ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L。
optionsEn: Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement.
The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes.
An external damper gives an optimum added damping ratio of about ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L.
quiz.explanation: 外加阻尼器最佳附加阻尼比約 ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An external damper gives an optimum added damping ratio of about ζ ≈ 0.5·x_d/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜索振動、阻尼與監測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stay vibration, damping and monitoring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斜索阻尼器與監測索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stay dampers and instrumented stays” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝阻尼器前後分別做自由衰減試驗（以繩索拉離後釋放），量測各階模態的阻尼比，與設計目標比較；營運中定期下載監測索的加速度與風速紀錄，確認觸發事件的振幅、頻率與風況，聲波事件則逐一比對位置與時間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run free-decay tests (pull with a rope and release) before and after damper installation, measuring modal damping ratios against the target; in service download instrumented-stay accelerations with wind records to examine triggered events by amplitude, frequency and wind condition, and locate and time-stamp every acoustic event. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：阻尼器應列入定期檢查清單（漏油、連接、行程痕跡），每次檢查後抽測衰減；監測系統要指定負責判讀的人員、觸發後的通報流程與資料保存期限，並與斜索檢查結果交叉比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Dampers belong on the routine checklist for leaks, connections and stroke marks, with spot decay tests after inspections; the monitoring system needs named analysts, a notification flow after triggers and a data-retention period, cross-checked against stay inspections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：阻尼器漏油、連接鬆脫或被誤鎖時，附加阻尼消失，斜索在特定風雨條件下大幅振動，錨具與保護套承受反覆彎折；聲波系統若無人判讀，斷絲事件會被忽略直到目視發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A leaking, loose or accidentally locked damper removes the added damping, so the stay vibrates strongly in certain rain–wind conditions and anchorages and sheaths are flexed repeatedly; an acoustic system nobody interprets lets wire breaks go unnoticed until visual inspection finds them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝阻尼器前後分別做自由衰減試驗（以繩索拉離後釋放），量測各階模態的阻尼比，與設計目標比較；營運中定期下載監測索的加速度與風速紀錄，確認觸發事件的振幅、頻率與風況，聲波事件則逐一比對位置與時間。
knowledge.textEn: Run free-decay tests (pull with a rope and release) before and after damper installation, measuring modal damping ratios against the target; in service download instrumented-stay accelerations with wind records to examine triggered events by amplitude, frequency and wind condition, and locate and time-stamp every acoustic event.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 阻尼器應列入定期檢查清單（漏油、連接、行程痕跡），每次檢查後抽測衰減；監測系統要指定負責判讀的人員、觸發後的通報流程與資料保存期限，並與斜索檢查結果交叉比對。
knowledge.textEn: Dampers belong on the routine checklist for leaks, connections and stroke marks, with spot decay tests after inspections; the monitoring system needs named analysts, a notification flow after triggers and a data-retention period, cross-checked against stay inspections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring"?
options: 安裝阻尼器前後分別做自由衰減試驗（以繩索拉離後釋放），量測各階模態的阻尼比，與設計目標比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
斜索容許應力越高越好，只要強度夠就不必考慮疲勞。
optionsEn: Run free-decay tests (pull with a rope and release) before and after damper installation, measuring modal damping ratios against the target.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The higher the allowable stay stress the better; fatigue need not be checked if strength is sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 安裝阻尼器前後分別做自由衰減試驗（以繩索拉離後釋放），量測各階模態的阻尼比，與設計目標比較；營運中定期下載監測索的加速度與風速紀錄，確認觸發事件的振幅、頻率與風況，聲波事件則逐一比對位置與時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run free-decay tests (pull with a rope and release) before and after damper installation, measuring modal damping ratios against the target; in service download instrumented-stay accelerations with wind records to examine triggered events by amplitude, frequency and wind condition, and locate and time-stamp every acoustic event. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜索振動、阻尼與監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stay vibration, damping and monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜索阻尼器與監測索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stay dampers and instrumented stays” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器漏油、連接鬆脫或被誤鎖時，附加阻尼消失，斜索在特定風雨條件下大幅振動，錨具與保護套承受反覆彎折；聲波系統若無人判讀，斷絲事件會被忽略直到目視發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A leaking, loose or accidentally locked damper removes the added damping, so the stay vibrates strongly in certain rain–wind conditions and anchorages and sheaths are flexed repeatedly; an acoustic system nobody interprets lets wire breaks go unnoticed until visual inspection finds them. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些量測把設計假設轉成可追蹤的營運資料。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These measurements turn design assumptions into traceable operating data.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 阻尼器漏油、連接鬆脫或被誤鎖時，附加阻尼消失，斜索在特定風雨條件下大幅振動，錨具與保護套承受反覆彎折；聲波系統若無人判讀，斷絲事件會被忽略直到目視發現。
knowledge.textEn: A leaking, loose or accidentally locked damper removes the added damping, so the stay vibrates strongly in certain rain–wind conditions and anchorages and sheaths are flexed repeatedly; an acoustic system nobody interprets lets wire breaks go unnoticed until visual inspection finds them.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
阻尼器漏油、連接鬆脫或被誤鎖時，附加阻尼消失，斜索在特定風雨條件下大幅振動，錨具與保護套承受反覆彎折；聲波系統若無人判讀，斷絲事件會被忽略直到目視發現。
載重試驗只要量跨中撓度就能證明多跨斜張橋的性能。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A leaking, loose or accidentally locked damper removes the added damping, so the stay vibrates strongly in certain rain–wind conditions and anchorages and sheaths are flexed repeatedly.
Measuring mid-span deflection alone proves the performance of a multi-span cable-stayed bridge.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器漏油、連接鬆脫或被誤鎖時，附加阻尼消失，斜索在特定風雨條件下大幅振動，錨具與保護套承受反覆彎折；聲波系統若無人判讀，斷絲事件會被忽略直到目視發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A leaking, loose or accidentally locked damper removes the added damping, so the stay vibrates strongly in certain rain–wind conditions and anchorages and sheaths are flexed repeatedly; an acoustic system nobody interprets lets wire breaks go unnoticed until visual inspection finds them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通車前載重試驗與量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pre-opening load test and measurement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「完工載重試驗車隊」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Completion test truck fleet” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料顯示米約高架橋於 2004 年 11 月 17 日開始載重試驗，同年 12 月通車。對多跨斜張橋而言，載重試驗不只是量跨中撓度，更重要的是確認不對稱載重下的塔頂位移、斜索索力變化與墩頂轉角是否符合模型，因為這正是多跨體系的關鍵行為。鋼梁對溫度很敏感，日照會讓頂板比底板熱，產生與載重同量級的撓度，因此量測必須搭配溫度紀錄或選在溫度穩定的時段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「完工載重試驗車隊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public records show Millau's load testing began on 17 November 2004, with opening in December. For a multi-span cable-stayed bridge, the test is not only about mid-span deflection but about confirming pylon-top sway, stay-force changes and pier-head rotation under unbalanced load against the model, since this is the system's defining behaviour. A steel deck is very temperature-sensitive: sun heats the top plate more than the bottom and causes deflections as large as the test load's, so measurements need temperature records or a thermally stable time window. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Completion test truck fleet” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設一跨 342 m 上放置 20 輛、每輛 32 t 的試驗車，總載重 P = 20×32×9.81 ≈ 6,278 kN，相當於 6,278/342 ≈ 18.4 kN/m，約為鋼梁自重 143.6 kN/m 的 12.8%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 20 trucks of 32 t on one 342 m span: P = 20×32×9.81 ≈ 6,278 kN, or 6,278/342 ≈ 18.4 kN/m, about 12.8% of the 143.6 kN/m steel deck self-weight.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「載重試驗只要量跨中撓度就能證明多跨斜張橋的性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Measuring mid-span deflection alone proves the performance of a multi-span cable-stayed bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「完工載重試驗車隊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Completion test truck fleet”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通車前載重試驗與量測
knowledge.text: 公開資料顯示米約高架橋於 2004 年 11 月 17 日開始載重試驗，同年 12 月通車。對多跨斜張橋而言，載重試驗不只是量跨中撓度，更重要的是確認不對稱載重下的塔頂位移、斜索索力變化與墩頂轉角是否符合模型，因為這正是多跨體系的關鍵行為。
knowledge.textEn: Public records show Millau's load testing began on 17 November 2004, with opening in December. For a multi-span cable-stayed bridge, the test is not only about mid-span deflection but about confirming pylon-top sway, stay-force changes and pier-head rotation under unbalanced load against the model, since this is the system's defining behaviour.

Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect.
Public records show Millau's load testing began on 17 November 2004, with opening in December.

steps.title: 通車前載重試驗與量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pre-opening load test and measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「完工載重試驗車隊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Completion test truck fleet” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設一跨 342 m 上放置 20 輛、每輛 32 t 的試驗車，總載重 P = 20×32×9.81 ≈ 6,278 kN，相當於 6,278/342 ≈ 18.4 kN/m，約為鋼梁自重 143.6 kN/m 的 12.8%。只載一跨、相鄰跨空載時，可檢驗多跨體系最不利的不對稱反應。車數與車重為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 20 trucks of 32 t on one 342 m span: P = 20×32×9.81 ≈ 6,278 kN, or 6,278/342 ≈ 18.4 kN/m, about 12.8% of the 143.6 kN/m steel deck self-weight. Loading one span with neighbours empty tests the multi-span system's most unfavourable unbalanced response. Truck count and weight are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫依模型選定加載排列，量測項目包含跨中撓度、塔頂位移（GNSS 或全站儀）、代表性斜索索力與墩頂傾斜，並同步記錄梁溫；以實測與預測比值及卸載後回復情形作為允收依據，結果成為竣工基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Choose load arrangements from the model and measure mid-span deflection, pylon-top sway by GNSS or total station, selected stay forces and pier-head tilt while logging deck temperature; accept on the ratio of measured to predicted values and recovery after unloading, and keep the results as the as-built baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設一跨 342 m 上放置 20 輛、每輛 32 t 的試驗車，總載重 P = 20×32×9.81 ≈ 6,278 kN，相當於 6,278/342 ≈ 18.4 kN/m，約為鋼梁自重 143.6 kN/m 的 12.8%。只載一跨、相鄰跨空載時，可檢驗多跨體系最不利的不對稱反應。車數與車重為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 20 trucks of 32 t on one 342 m span: P = 20×32×9.81 ≈ 6,278 kN, or 6,278/342 ≈ 18.4 kN/m, about 12.8% of the 143.6 kN/m steel deck self-weight. Loading one span with neighbours empty tests the multi-span system's most unfavourable unbalanced response. Truck count and weight are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通車前載重試驗與量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。

Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure.
Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice.
