steps.title: 通車前載重試驗與量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pre-opening load test and measurement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「完工載重試驗車隊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Completion test truck fleet” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫依模型選定加載排列，量測項目包含跨中撓度、塔頂位移（GNSS 或全站儀）、代表性斜索索力與墩頂傾斜，並同步記錄梁溫；以實測與預測比值及卸載後回復情形作為允收依據，結果成為竣工基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Choose load arrangements from the model and measure mid-span deflection, pylon-top sway by GNSS or total station, selected stay forces and pier-head tilt while logging deck temperature; accept on the ratio of measured to predicted values and recovery after unloading, and keep the results as the as-built baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗前公布車輛過磅紀錄、加載排列與停止條件，試驗中由獨立量測團隊與設計代表即時比對；試驗報告須附溫度修正方法與原始資料，交給營運單位作為長期監測的零點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Publish weighbridge tickets, load arrangements and stop criteria before testing, compare results in real time with an independent survey team and the designer's representative, and attach the temperature-correction method and raw data to the report as the zero point for long-term monitoring.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量撓度而不量索力與塔頂位移，可能錯過斜索索力分配偏離設計的情況；在日照劇烈時段試驗而不修正溫度，會把熱變形誤認為結構勁度問題，導致錯誤的調索或補強決策。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring deflection alone while ignoring stay forces and pylon sway can miss a stay-force distribution that departs from design; testing in strong sun without temperature correction can mistake thermal movement for a stiffness problem and trigger wrong retensioning or strengthening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫依模型選定加載排列，量測項目包含跨中撓度、塔頂位移（GNSS 或全站儀）、代表性斜索索力與墩頂傾斜，並同步記錄梁溫；以實測與預測比值及卸載後回復情形作為允收依據，結果成為竣工基準。
knowledge.textEn: Choose load arrangements from the model and measure mid-span deflection, pylon-top sway by GNSS or total station, selected stay forces and pier-head tilt while logging deck temperature; accept on the ratio of measured to predicted values and recovery after unloading, and keep the results as the as-built baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗前公布車輛過磅紀錄、加載排列與停止條件，試驗中由獨立量測團隊與設計代表即時比對；試驗報告須附溫度修正方法與原始資料，交給營運單位作為長期監測的零點。
knowledge.textEn: Publish weighbridge tickets, load arrangements and stop criteria before testing, compare results in real time with an independent survey team and the designer's representative, and attach the temperature-correction method and raw data to the report as the zero point for long-term monitoring.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通車前載重試驗與量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pre-opening load test and measurement"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
試驗計畫依模型選定加載排列，量測項目包含跨中撓度、塔頂位移（GNSS 或全站儀）、代表性斜索索力與墩頂傾斜，並同步記錄梁溫。
頂推只是把梁往前推，主要風險是推力不夠。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Choose load arrangements from the model and measure mid-span deflection, pylon-top sway by GNSS or total station, selected stay forces and pier-head tilt while logging deck temperature.
Launching is just pushing the deck forward, and the main risk is insufficient push force.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫依模型選定加載排列，量測項目包含跨中撓度、塔頂位移（GNSS 或全站儀）、代表性斜索索力與墩頂傾斜，並同步記錄梁溫；以實測與預測比值及卸載後回復情形作為允收依據，結果成為竣工基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Choose load arrangements from the model and measure mid-span deflection, pylon-top sway by GNSS or total station, selected stay forces and pier-head tilt while logging deck temperature; accept on the ratio of measured to predicted values and recovery after unloading, and keep the results as the as-built baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通車前載重試驗與量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pre-opening load test and measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「完工載重試驗車隊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Completion test truck fleet” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量撓度而不量索力與塔頂位移，可能錯過斜索索力分配偏離設計的情況；在日照劇烈時段試驗而不修正溫度，會把熱變形誤認為結構勁度問題，導致錯誤的調索或補強決策。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring deflection alone while ignoring stay forces and pylon sway can miss a stay-force distribution that departs from design; testing in strong sun without temperature correction can mistake thermal movement for a stiffness problem and trigger wrong retensioning or strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼梁對溫度很敏感，日照會讓頂板比底板熱，產生與載重同量級的撓度，因此量測必須搭配溫度紀錄或選在溫度穩定的時段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A steel deck is very temperature-sensitive: sun heats the top plate more than the bottom and causes deflections as large as the test load's, so measurements need temperature records or a thermally stable time window.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「載重試驗只要量跨中撓度就能證明多跨斜張橋的性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Measuring mid-span deflection alone proves the performance of a multi-span cable-stayed bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量撓度而不量索力與塔頂位移，可能錯過斜索索力分配偏離設計的情況；在日照劇烈時段試驗而不修正溫度，會把熱變形誤認為結構勁度問題，導致錯誤的調索或補強決策。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring deflection alone while ignoring stay forces and pylon sway can miss a stay-force distribution that departs from design; testing in strong sun without temperature correction can mistake thermal movement for a stiffness problem and trigger wrong retensioning or strengthening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通車前載重試驗與量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pre-opening load test and measurement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。
只量撓度而不量索力與塔頂位移，可能錯過斜索索力分配偏離設計的情況；在日照劇烈時段試驗而不修正溫度，會把熱變形誤認為結構勁度問題，導致錯誤的調索或補強決策。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect.
Measuring deflection alone while ignoring stay forces and pylon sway can miss a stay-force distribution that departs from design.
quiz.explanation: 只量撓度而不量索力與塔頂位移，可能錯過斜索索力分配偏離設計的情況；在日照劇烈時段試驗而不修正溫度，會把熱變形誤認為結構勁度問題，導致錯誤的調索或補強決策。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring deflection alone while ignoring stay forces and pylon sway can miss a stay-force distribution that departs from design; testing in strong sun without temperature correction can mistake thermal movement for a stiffness problem and trigger wrong retensioning or strengthening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面」與「支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steel deck fatigue and surfacing" and "Bearings, joints and concession maintenance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel deck fatigue and surfacing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「正交異性橋面焊縫」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orthotropic deck welds” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性鋼橋面直接承受車輪荷載，頂板只有十幾公釐厚（公開資料：12 至 14 mm），輪載在加勁肋與頂板的焊縫、加勁肋穿過橫隔板的開孔處產生局部彎曲應力；每一輛重車通過都是一次應力循環，數十年累積下來就是疲勞問題。鋪面不只是行車表面，它與鋼板共同作用可以分散輪壓、降低焊縫應力幅，同時保護鋼板免於水與除冰鹽。因此鋪面材料、厚度與黏結品質都是疲勞設計的一部分，而不是後期才決定的裝修項目。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「正交異性橋面焊縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An orthotropic steel deck carries wheel loads directly through a top plate only about a dozen millimetres thick (published: 12 to 14 mm), so wheels cause local bending stresses at rib-to-deck welds and at rib cut-outs in the diaphragms; every heavy vehicle is a stress cycle, and decades of them make fatigue the governing issue. Surfacing is not just a running layer: acting with the plate it spreads wheel pressure, lowers weld stress ranges and protects the steel from water and de-icing salt. Surfacing material, thickness and bond quality are therefore part of fatigue design, not a finish chosen later. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Orthotropic deck welds” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「正交異性橋面焊縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Orthotropic deck welds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面
knowledge.text: 正交異性鋼橋面直接承受車輪荷載，頂板只有十幾公釐厚（公開資料：12 至 14 mm），輪載在加勁肋與頂板的焊縫、加勁肋穿過橫隔板的開孔處產生局部彎曲應力；每一輛重車通過都是一次應力循環，數十年累積下來就是疲勞問題。鋪面不只是行車表面，它與鋼板共同作用可以分散輪壓、降低焊縫應力幅，同時保護鋼板免於水與除冰鹽。
knowledge.textEn: An orthotropic steel deck carries wheel loads directly through a top plate only about a dozen millimetres thick (published: 12 to 14 mm), so wheels cause local bending stresses at rib-to-deck welds and at rib cut-outs in the diaphragms; every heavy vehicle is a stress cycle, and decades of them make fatigue the governing issue. Surfacing is not just a running layer: acting with the plate it spreads wheel pressure, lowers weld stress ranges and protects the steel from water and de-icing salt.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steel deck fatigue and surfacing" is correct?
options: 正交異性鋼橋面直接承受車輪荷載，頂板只有十幾公釐厚（公開資料：12 至 14 mm），輪載在加勁肋與頂板的焊縫、加勁肋穿過橫隔板的開孔處產生局部彎曲應力。
鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。
支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。
optionsEn: An orthotropic steel deck carries wheel loads directly through a top plate only about a dozen millimetres thick (published: 12 to 14 mm), so wheels cause local bending stresses at rib-to-deck welds and at rib cut-outs in the diaphragms.
Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect.
Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性鋼橋面直接承受車輪荷載，頂板只有十幾公釐厚（公開資料：12 至 14 mm），輪載在加勁肋與頂板的焊縫、加勁肋穿過橫隔板的開孔處產生局部彎曲應力；每一輛重車通過都是一次應力循環，數十年累積下來就是疲勞問題。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An orthotropic steel deck carries wheel loads directly through a top plate only about a dozen millimetres thick (published: 12 to 14 mm), so wheels cause local bending stresses at rib-to-deck welds and at rib cut-outs in the diaphragms; every heavy vehicle is a stress cycle, and decades of them make fatigue the governing issue. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel deck fatigue and surfacing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「正交異性橋面焊縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orthotropic deck welds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa、實際應力幅 Δσ = 50 MPa 時，N = 2×10⁶×(71/50)³ ≈ 5.73×10⁶ 次；若鋪面劣化使應力幅升到 60 MPa，N ≈ 3.31×10⁶ 次，壽命約減少 42%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. For detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa and an actual range Δσ = 50 MPa, N = 2×10⁶×(71/50)³ ≈ 5.73×10⁶ cycles; if degraded surfacing raises the range to 60 MPa, N ≈ 3.31×10⁶ cycles, about 42% less life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以應變計量測重車通過時加勁肋焊縫附近的應力歷時，用雨流計數換算等效應力幅，與設計假設比較；定期以目視、磁粒或相位陣列超音波檢查焊趾與開孔處的裂紋，並檢查鋪面裂縫、剝離與排水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Strain-gauge rib welds under heavy traffic, convert the histories to equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design assumptions; periodically inspect weld toes and cut-outs by visual, magnetic-particle or phased-array ultrasonic testing, and check the surfacing for cracks, debonding and drainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa、實際應力幅 Δσ = 50 MPa 時，N = 2×10⁶×(71/50)³ ≈ 5.73×10⁶ 次；若鋪面劣化使應力幅升到 60 MPa，N ≈ 3.31×10⁶ 次，壽命約減少 42%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. For detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa and an actual range Δσ = 50 MPa, N = 2×10⁶×(71/50)³ ≈ 5.73×10⁶ cycles; if degraded surfacing raises the range to 60 MPa, N ≈ 3.31×10⁶ cycles, about 42% less life. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel deck fatigue and surfacing", which statement holds?
options: 橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。
S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。
斜索容許應力越高越好，只要強度夠就不必考慮疲勞。
optionsEn: The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes.
S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³.
The higher the allowable stay stress the better; fatigue need not be checked if strength is sufficient.
quiz.explanation: S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel deck fatigue and surfacing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「正交異性橋面焊縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orthotropic deck welds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以應變計量測重車通過時加勁肋焊縫附近的應力歷時，用雨流計數換算等效應力幅，與設計假設比較；定期以目視、磁粒或相位陣列超音波檢查焊趾與開孔處的裂紋，並檢查鋪面裂縫、剝離與排水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Strain-gauge rib welds under heavy traffic, convert the histories to equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design assumptions; periodically inspect weld toes and cut-outs by visual, magnetic-particle or phased-array ultrasonic testing, and check the surfacing for cracks, debonding and drainage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護計畫應把鋪面狀況與焊縫檢查放在同一張表，重車車道與輪跡帶列為優先檢查區；鋪面更換時規定黏結層試驗與厚度允差，避免施工機具在鋼板上造成刻痕。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance plan should track surfacing condition and weld inspection together, prioritising heavy lanes and wheel paths; resurfacing specifications must include bond tests and thickness tolerances and protect the plate from gouging by equipment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A weld-toe crack growing through the top plate eventually penetrates under the surfacing, letting water into the box and causing corrosion; debonded or rutted surfacing concentrates wheel pressure and speeds crack growth in a vicious circle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以應變計量測重車通過時加勁肋焊縫附近的應力歷時，用雨流計數換算等效應力幅，與設計假設比較；定期以目視、磁粒或相位陣列超音波檢查焊趾與開孔處的裂紋，並檢查鋪面裂縫、剝離與排水。
knowledge.textEn: Strain-gauge rib welds under heavy traffic, convert the histories to equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design assumptions; periodically inspect weld toes and cut-outs by visual, magnetic-particle or phased-array ultrasonic testing, and check the surfacing for cracks, debonding and drainage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護計畫應把鋪面狀況與焊縫檢查放在同一張表，重車車道與輪跡帶列為優先檢查區；鋪面更換時規定黏結層試驗與厚度允差，避免施工機具在鋼板上造成刻痕。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance plan should track surfacing condition and weld inspection together, prioritising heavy lanes and wheel paths; resurfacing specifications must include bond tests and thickness tolerances and protect the plate from gouging by equipment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steel deck fatigue and surfacing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。
以應變計量測重車通過時加勁肋焊縫附近的應力歷時，用雨流計數換算等效應力幅，與設計假設比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter.
Strain-gauge rib welds under heavy traffic, convert the histories to equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design assumptions.
quiz.explanation: 以應變計量測重車通過時加勁肋焊縫附近的應力歷時，用雨流計數換算等效應力幅，與設計假設比較；定期以目視、磁粒或相位陣列超音波檢查焊趾與開孔處的裂紋，並檢查鋪面裂縫、剝離與排水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Strain-gauge rib welds under heavy traffic, convert the histories to equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design assumptions; periodically inspect weld toes and cut-outs by visual, magnetic-particle or phased-array ultrasonic testing, and check the surfacing for cracks, debonding and drainage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel deck fatigue and surfacing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「正交異性橋面焊縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orthotropic deck welds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A weld-toe crack growing through the top plate eventually penetrates under the surfacing, letting water into the box and causing corrosion; debonded or rutted surfacing concentrates wheel pressure and speeds crack growth in a vicious circle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此鋪面材料、厚度與黏結品質都是疲勞設計的一部分，而不是後期才決定的裝修項目。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surfacing material, thickness and bond quality are therefore part of fatigue design, not a finish chosen later.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。
knowledge.textEn: A weld-toe crack growing through the top plate eventually penetrates under the surfacing, letting water into the box and causing corrosion; debonded or rutted surfacing concentrates wheel pressure and speeds crack growth in a vicious circle.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼橋面疲勞與鋪面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel deck fatigue and surfacing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。
optionsEn: A weld-toe crack growing through the top plate eventually penetrates under the surfacing, letting water into the box and causing corrosion.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement.
quiz.explanation: 焊趾裂紋若沿頂板厚度方向擴展，最後會在鋪面下貫穿頂板，水分從裂縫進入箱內造成腐蝕；鋪面剝離或車轍讓輪壓更集中，加速裂紋成長，形成惡性循環。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A weld-toe crack growing through the top plate eventually penetrates under the surfacing, letting water into the box and causing corrosion; debonded or rutted surfacing concentrates wheel pressure and speeds crack growth in a vicious circle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bearings, joints and concession maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spherical bearings and end joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼梁在各墩頂以支承傳力，公開資料記載使用新型球面支承，墩頂反力在不對稱載重與極端風況下可達約 100 MN，並需考慮上拔。梁的溫度伸縮在兩端橋台由伸縮縫吸收，伸縮量是全橋最大的。米約由 Eiffage 以特許經營方式興建與營運，鋼材供應商資料提到特許期含施工共 78 年；在這麼長的期間內，支承滑動面、伸縮縫、斜索與塗裝都要更換或翻修，因此設計時就必須預留頂升點、更換空間與交通維持方式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The deck bears on each pier head through bearings; published data mention a new type of spherical bearing, pier-head reactions up to about 100 MN under unbalanced loads and extreme wind, and uplift to be considered. Thermal movement is taken by expansion joints at the two abutments, which see the bridge's largest movements. Millau was built and is operated by Eiffage under a concession that the steel supplier reports as 78 years including construction; over such a period, bearing sliding surfaces, joints, stays and coatings must be replaced or refurbished, so jacking points, replacement space and traffic arrangements must be designed in from the start. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spherical bearings and end joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03; with a pier-head reaction N = 100 MN, sliding transfers F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN horizontally to the pier head.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spherical bearings and end joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護
knowledge.text: 鋼梁在各墩頂以支承傳力，公開資料記載使用新型球面支承，墩頂反力在不對稱載重與極端風況下可達約 100 MN，並需考慮上拔。梁的溫度伸縮在兩端橋台由伸縮縫吸收，伸縮量是全橋最大的。
knowledge.textEn: The deck bears on each pier head through bearings; published data mention a new type of spherical bearing, pier-head reactions up to about 100 MN under unbalanced loads and extreme wind, and uplift to be considered. Thermal movement is taken by expansion joints at the two abutments, which see the bridge's largest movements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bearings, joints and concession maintenance" is correct?
options: 支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。
鋼梁在各墩頂以支承傳力，公開資料記載使用新型球面支承，墩頂反力在不對稱載重與極端風況下可達約 100 MN，並需考慮上拔。
風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。
optionsEn: Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement.
The deck bears on each pier head through bearings.
Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure.
quiz.explanation: 鋼梁在各墩頂以支承傳力，公開資料記載使用新型球面支承，墩頂反力在不對稱載重與極端風況下可達約 100 MN，並需考慮上拔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The deck bears on each pier head through bearings; published data mention a new type of spherical bearing, pier-head reactions up to about 100 MN under unbalanced loads and extreme wind, and uplift to be considered. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bearings, joints and concession maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spherical bearings and end joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。橋台處以中央為不動點、半長 1,230 m、溫差 35 °C，伸縮量 ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m。μ 與溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03; with a pier-head reaction N = 100 MN, sliding transfers F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN horizontally to the pier head. At an abutment, with the deck fixed at the centre, a half-length of 1,230 m and a 35 °C range give ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m. μ and the temperature range are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期量測各支承的滑動位置與傾角、伸縮縫開口與梁溫，繪出位移—溫度關係判斷是否卡滯；支承更換前以頂升試驗確認反力與千斤頂位置，伸縮縫檢查齒板、防水帶與錨栓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Regularly measure bearing displacements and rotations, joint openings and deck temperature, plotting movement against temperature to detect seizure; before replacing a bearing confirm the reaction and jack positions by a trial lift, and inspect joint fingers, seals and anchors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。橋台處以中央為不動點、半長 1,230 m、溫差 35 °C，伸縮量 ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m。μ 與溫差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03; with a pier-head reaction N = 100 MN, sliding transfers F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN horizontally to the pier head. At an abutment, with the deck fixed at the centre, a half-length of 1,230 m and a 35 °C range give ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,230×35 ≈ 0.52 m. μ and the temperature range are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bearings, joints and concession maintenance", which statement holds?
options: 全部改用高強度鋼一定最省錢、最安全。
頂推只是把梁往前推，主要風險是推力不夠。
PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。
optionsEn: Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice.
Launching is just pushing the deck forward, and the main risk is insufficient push force.
For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03.
quiz.explanation: PTFE 滑動球面支承在低溫時摩擦係數取 μ = 0.03，墩頂反力 N = 100 MN，滑動時傳到墩頂的水平力 F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a PTFE spherical sliding bearing at low temperature take μ = 0.03; with a pier-head reaction N = 100 MN, sliding transfers F = μ·N = 0.03×100 = 3 MN horizontally to the pier head. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bearings, joints and concession maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spherical bearings and end joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期量測各支承的滑動位置與傾角、伸縮縫開口與梁溫，繪出位移—溫度關係判斷是否卡滯；支承更換前以頂升試驗確認反力與千斤頂位置，伸縮縫檢查齒板、防水帶與錨栓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Regularly measure bearing displacements and rotations, joint openings and deck temperature, plotting movement against temperature to detect seizure; before replacing a bearing confirm the reaction and jack positions by a trial lift, and inspect joint fingers, seals and anchors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：特許營運的維護手冊應列出可更換構件清單、頂升點與容許頂升量、更換時的交通配置與天候限制；每次更換後更新竣工資料與監測基準，並在特許期末交接時提供完整的構件履歷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The concession maintenance manual should list replaceable components, jacking points and permitted lifts, traffic layouts and weather limits for replacement; after each replacement update as-built records and monitoring baselines, and hand over complete component histories at the end of the concession.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承滑動面磨耗或被異物卡住時，溫度力無法釋放，墩頂水平力遠超設計值，薄肢橋墩可能開裂；伸縮縫錨固鬆脫則在重車衝擊下逐步破壞並讓水進入箱梁端部。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A worn or obstructed sliding surface stops thermal relief, so horizontal force at the pier head far exceeds design and the slender shafts may crack; loose joint anchorage fails progressively under heavy-vehicle impact and lets water into the box ends. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期量測各支承的滑動位置與傾角、伸縮縫開口與梁溫，繪出位移—溫度關係判斷是否卡滯；支承更換前以頂升試驗確認反力與千斤頂位置，伸縮縫檢查齒板、防水帶與錨栓。
knowledge.textEn: Regularly measure bearing displacements and rotations, joint openings and deck temperature, plotting movement against temperature to detect seizure; before replacing a bearing confirm the reaction and jack positions by a trial lift, and inspect joint fingers, seals and anchors.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 特許營運的維護手冊應列出可更換構件清單、頂升點與容許頂升量、更換時的交通配置與天候限制；每次更換後更新竣工資料與監測基準，並在特許期末交接時提供完整的構件履歷。
knowledge.textEn: The concession maintenance manual should list replaceable components, jacking points and permitted lifts, traffic layouts and weather limits for replacement; after each replacement update as-built records and monitoring baselines, and hand over complete component histories at the end of the concession.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bearings, joints and concession maintenance"?
options: 定期量測各支承的滑動位置與傾角、伸縮縫開口與梁溫，繪出位移—溫度關係判斷是否卡滯；支承更換前以頂升試驗確認反力與千斤頂位置，伸縮縫檢查齒板、防水帶與錨栓。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。
optionsEn: Regularly measure bearing displacements and rotations, joint openings and deck temperature, plotting movement against temperature to detect seizure.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 定期量測各支承的滑動位置與傾角、伸縮縫開口與梁溫，繪出位移—溫度關係判斷是否卡滯；支承更換前以頂升試驗確認反力與千斤頂位置，伸縮縫檢查齒板、防水帶與錨栓。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Regularly measure bearing displacements and rotations, joint openings and deck temperature, plotting movement against temperature to detect seizure; before replacing a bearing confirm the reaction and jack positions by a trial lift, and inspect joint fingers, seals and anchors. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bearings, joints and concession maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「球面支承與端部伸縮縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spherical bearings and end joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承滑動面磨耗或被異物卡住時，溫度力無法釋放，墩頂水平力遠超設計值，薄肢橋墩可能開裂；伸縮縫錨固鬆脫則在重車衝擊下逐步破壞並讓水進入箱梁端部。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A worn or obstructed sliding surface stops thermal relief, so horizontal force at the pier head far exceeds design and the slender shafts may crack; loose joint anchorage fails progressively under heavy-vehicle impact and lets water into the box ends. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：米約由 Eiffage 以特許經營方式興建與營運，鋼材供應商資料提到特許期含施工共 78 年；在這麼長的期間內，支承滑動面、伸縮縫、斜索與塗裝都要更換或翻修，因此設計時就必須預留頂升點、更換空間與交通維持方式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Millau was built and is operated by Eiffage under a concession that the steel supplier reports as 78 years including construction; over such a period, bearing sliding surfaces, joints, stays and coatings must be replaced or refurbished, so jacking points, replacement space and traffic arrangements must be designed in from the start.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支承與伸縮縫是耐用到設計年限的永久構件，不需要規劃更換。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bearings and joints are permanent parts that last the full design life without planned replacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支承滑動面磨耗或被異物卡住時，溫度力無法釋放，墩頂水平力遠超設計值，薄肢橋墩可能開裂；伸縮縫錨固鬆脫則在重車衝擊下逐步破壞並讓水進入箱梁端部。
knowledge.textEn: A worn or obstructed sliding surface stops thermal relief, so horizontal force at the pier head far exceeds design and the slender shafts may crack; loose joint anchorage fails progressively under heavy-vehicle impact and lets water into the box ends.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支承、伸縮縫與特許期維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bearings, joints and concession maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
支承滑動面磨耗或被異物卡住時，溫度力無法釋放，墩頂水平力遠超設計值，薄肢橋墩可能開裂；伸縮縫錨固鬆脫則在重車衝擊下逐步破壞並讓水進入箱梁端部。
風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A worn or obstructed sliding surface stops thermal relief, so horizontal force at the pier head far exceeds design and the slender shafts may crack.
Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure.
quiz.explanation: 支承滑動面磨耗或被異物卡住時，溫度力無法釋放，墩頂水平力遠超設計值，薄肢橋墩可能開裂；伸縮縫錨固鬆脫則在重車衝擊下逐步破壞並讓水進入箱梁端部。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A worn or obstructed sliding surface stops thermal relief, so horizontal force at the pier head far exceeds design and the slender shafts may crack; loose joint anchorage fails progressively under heavy-vehicle impact and lets water into the box ends. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 厄勒海峽大橋
summary: 厄勒海峽大橋是連接丹麥與瑞典固定通道的橋梁段，全長約 7,845 公尺，主跨 490 公尺的斜張高橋與兩側 140 公尺跨的引橋都採用上層公路、下層鐵路的鋼—混凝土複合桁架。本課從海峽零阻水要求、雙層桁架與豎琴式斜索的荷載路徑出發，拆解石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱、204 公尺混凝土橋塔、Svanen 浮吊整跨吊裝與主跨合龍，再談鐵路制動力、船撞風險、疲勞防蝕與鋼軌伸縮調節器的交接。
summaryEn: The Øresund Bridge is the bridge section of the fixed link between Denmark and Sweden: about 7,845 m long, with a cable-stayed high bridge of 490 m main span and approach viaducts of 140 m spans, all built as steel–concrete composite trusses carrying a motorway above and a railway below. The course starts from the strait's zero-blocking requirement and the load path through double-deck trusses and harp stays, then covers precast caissons on limestone, the 204 m concrete pylons, full-span lifts by the floating crane Svanen and main-span closure, ending with rail braking, ship-impact risk, fatigue and corrosion, and the handover of rail expansion devices.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 豎琴式斜索設計練習：塔上錨距 12 m、梁上錨距 20 m，索角 θ = arctan(12/20) ≈ 31.0°，sinθ ≈ 0.514。若每個索面在每公尺承受 w = 200 kN/m，每根索支撐 20 m，索力 T = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN。單股 7 根 5 mm 鋼線面積約 137.4 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa，以 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa 設計，需要 7,775,000/(837×137.4) ≈ 67.6，取 68 股，實際應力約 832 MPa。若 w 增加到 215 kN/m，T ≈ 8,358 kN，需約 72.7，取 73 股。活載使索力增加 15%（約 1,166 kN）時，200 m 長、68 股的索彈性伸長 ΔL = ΔT·L/(E·A) = 1,166,000×200/(195,000×9,346) ≈ 0.128 m，這是橋面撓度的一部分。數值為教學假設，不代表厄勒海峽大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Harp-stay exercise: with anchor spacings of 12 m on the pylon and 20 m on the girder, θ = arctan(12/20) ≈ 31.0° and sinθ ≈ 0.514. If each cable plane carries w = 200 kN/m and each stay supports 20 m, T = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN. One strand of seven 5 mm wires has about 137.4 mm²; with f_pu = 1,860 MPa and design at 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa, 7,775,000/(837×137.4) ≈ 67.6, so 68 strands at an actual stress of about 832 MPa. If w rises to 215 kN/m, T ≈ 8,358 kN and about 72.7, so 73 strands, are needed. When live load raises the force by 15% (about 1,166 kN), a 200 m, 68-strand stay stretches ΔL = ΔT·L/(E·A) = 1,166,000×200/(195,000×9,346) ≈ 0.128 m elastically, part of the deck deflection. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Øresund design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「零阻水要求與海峽環境」與「公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The zero-blocking requirement" and "Double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 零阻水要求與海峽環境：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The zero-blocking requirement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋墩阻水斷面」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pier blockage cross-section” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 厄勒海峽是北海鹹水流入波羅的海的主要通道之一，任何固定通道若減少水流，就可能改變波羅的海的鹽度與溶氧。因此丹麥與瑞典要求通道對水流、鹽分與氧氣交換的淨影響為零：設計者先修整橋墩、沉箱與人工島形狀，把計算阻水率由約 2.3% 降到約 0.5%，剩下的部分以補償性浚挖加深海床抵銷。這個要求直接影響結構：橋墩數量與尺寸、沉箱外形、引橋跨徑都要在阻水與造價之間取捨，橋梁設計成為海洋環境工程的一部分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋墩阻水斷面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Øresund is one of the main routes by which North Sea salt water enters the Baltic, so a fixed link that reduced flow could change Baltic salinity and oxygen. Denmark and Sweden therefore required zero net effect on flow, salt and oxygen exchange: designers first trimmed piers, caissons and the artificial island, cutting calculated blocking from about 2.3% to about 0.5%, and offset the rest by compensation dredging that deepened the seabed. The rule shaped the structure directly: number and size of piers, caisson outlines and approach span lengths were traded between blocking and cost, making bridge design part of marine environmental engineering. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pier blockage cross-section” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設某檢核斷面過水面積 A = 60,000 m²，殘餘阻水 0.5% 相當於損失 ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m²；若在 3,000 m 寬的補償區把海床平均加深 0.10 m，即可補回 300 m²，補償區長 2,000 m 時浚挖量約 0.10×3,000×2,000 = 600,000 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take a check section with a flow area A = 60,000 m²; residual blocking of 0.5% loses ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋墩阻水斷面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pier blockage cross-section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 零阻水要求與海峽環境
knowledge.text: 厄勒海峽是北海鹹水流入波羅的海的主要通道之一，任何固定通道若減少水流，就可能改變波羅的海的鹽度與溶氧。因此丹麥與瑞典要求通道對水流、鹽分與氧氣交換的淨影響為零：設計者先修整橋墩、沉箱與人工島形狀，把計算阻水率由約 2.3% 降到約 0.5%，剩下的部分以補償性浚挖加深海床抵銷。
knowledge.textEn: The Øresund is one of the main routes by which North Sea salt water enters the Baltic, so a fixed link that reduced flow could change Baltic salinity and oxygen. Denmark and Sweden therefore required zero net effect on flow, salt and oxygen exchange: designers first trimmed piers, caissons and the artificial island, cutting calculated blocking from about 2.3% to about 0.5%, and offset the rest by compensation dredging that deepened the seabed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「零阻水要求與海峽環境」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The zero-blocking requirement" is correct?
options: 橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。
厄勒海峽是北海鹹水流入波羅的海的主要通道之一，任何固定通道若減少水流，就可能改變波羅的海的鹽度與溶氧。
鐵路與公路共用一座橋時，只要把兩種荷載相加就完成設計。
optionsEn: Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow.
The Øresund is one of the main routes by which North Sea salt water enters the Baltic, so a fixed link that reduced flow could change Baltic salinity and oxygen.
When rail and road share a bridge, simply adding the two loads completes the design.
quiz.explanation: 厄勒海峽是北海鹹水流入波羅的海的主要通道之一，任何固定通道若減少水流，就可能改變波羅的海的鹽度與溶氧。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Øresund is one of the main routes by which North Sea salt water enters the Baltic, so a fixed link that reduced flow could change Baltic salinity and oxygen. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 零阻水要求與海峽環境：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The zero-blocking requirement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋墩阻水斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pier blockage cross-section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設某檢核斷面過水面積 A = 60,000 m²，殘餘阻水 0.5% 相當於損失 ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m²；若在 3,000 m 寬的補償區把海床平均加深 0.10 m，即可補回 300 m²，補償區長 2,000 m 時浚挖量約 0.10×3,000×2,000 = 600,000 m³。斷面與尺寸為教學假設；全工程浚挖約 750 萬 m³，包含隧道溝槽與造島。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take a check section with a flow area A = 60,000 m²; residual blocking of 0.5% loses ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m². Deepening a 3,000 m wide compensation zone by an average 0.10 m restores 300 m², and over 2,000 m of length that is about 0.10×3,000×2,000 = 600,000 m³ of dredging. Section and sizes are teaching assumptions; the whole project dredged about 7.5 million m³, including the tunnel trench and reclamation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以水理數值模型與物理模型比較建設前後的流量、鹽度與水位差，計算每個構造物的阻水貢獻；施工中監測浚挖溢散的懸浮物，完工後以多音束測深確認補償區的實際斷面，並以長期海流觀測驗證零阻水目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare flow, salinity and water-level differences before and after construction with numerical and physical hydraulic models, computing the blocking contribution of each structure; during works monitor suspended sediment spill from dredging, after completion confirm the compensation zone by multibeam survey, and verify the zero-blocking goal by long-term current measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 設某檢核斷面過水面積 A = 60,000 m²，殘餘阻水 0.5% 相當於損失 ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m²；若在 3,000 m 寬的補償區把海床平均加深 0.10 m，即可補回 300 m²，補償區長 2,000 m 時浚挖量約 0.10×3,000×2,000 = 600,000 m³。斷面與尺寸為教學假設；全工程浚挖約 750 萬 m³，包含隧道溝槽與造島。
knowledge.textEn: Take a check section with a flow area A = 60,000 m²; residual blocking of 0.5% loses ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m². Deepening a 3,000 m wide compensation zone by an average 0.10 m restores 300 m², and over 2,000 m of length that is about 0.10×3,000×2,000 = 600,000 m³ of dredging. Section and sizes are teaching assumptions; the whole project dredged about 7.5 million m³, including the tunnel trench and reclamation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「零阻水要求與海峽環境」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The zero-blocking requirement", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土橋塔只受壓，不需要擔心錨碇區的局部應力。
斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。
設某檢核斷面過水面積 A = 60,000 m²，殘餘阻水 0.5% 相當於損失 ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m²。
optionsEn: A concrete pylon is only in compression, so local stresses at the anchorages are no concern.
If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right.
Take a check section with a flow area A = 60,000 m²; residual blocking of 0.5% loses ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m².
quiz.explanation: 設某檢核斷面過水面積 A = 60,000 m²，殘餘阻水 0.5% 相當於損失 ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m²；若在 3,000 m 寬的補償區把海床平均加深 0.10 m，即可補回 300 m²，補償區長 2,000 m 時浚挖量約 0.10×3,000×2,000 = 600,000 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take a check section with a flow area A = 60,000 m²; residual blocking of 0.5% loses ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 零阻水要求與海峽環境：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The zero-blocking requirement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋墩阻水斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pier blockage cross-section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以水理數值模型與物理模型比較建設前後的流量、鹽度與水位差，計算每個構造物的阻水貢獻；施工中監測浚挖溢散的懸浮物，完工後以多音束測深確認補償區的實際斷面，並以長期海流觀測驗證零阻水目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare flow, salinity and water-level differences before and after construction with numerical and physical hydraulic models, computing the blocking contribution of each structure; during works monitor suspended sediment spill from dredging, after completion confirm the compensation zone by multibeam survey, and verify the zero-blocking goal by long-term current measurements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：環境要求應轉成結構設計的量化指標（每座墩的阻水當量、施工期臨時阻水上限），納入設計審查與施工許可；任何改變墩形或增加臨時構造物的變更，都須重新計算阻水並經環境主管機關同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Environmental requirements should become quantified design criteria, such as the blocking equivalent of each pier and a temporary blocking limit during works, included in design review and permits; any change to pier shape or added temporary works needs a recalculated blocking figure and environmental-authority approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若施工中臨時平台、圍堰或堆置物超出計畫，阻水在施工期就超過允許值；補償浚挖若不足或日後淤積回填，長期淨阻水不為零，可能引起環境責任與追加浚挖，甚至限制日後增建或補強的空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Temporary platforms, cofferdams or stockpiles beyond plan can exceed the allowed blocking during construction; insufficient compensation dredging or later siltation leaves a net long-term blockage, triggering environmental liability, extra dredging and even limiting future additions or strengthening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以水理數值模型與物理模型比較建設前後的流量、鹽度與水位差，計算每個構造物的阻水貢獻；施工中監測浚挖溢散的懸浮物，完工後以多音束測深確認補償區的實際斷面，並以長期海流觀測驗證零阻水目標。
knowledge.textEn: Compare flow, salinity and water-level differences before and after construction with numerical and physical hydraulic models, computing the blocking contribution of each structure; during works monitor suspended sediment spill from dredging, after completion confirm the compensation zone by multibeam survey, and verify the zero-blocking goal by long-term current measurements.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 環境要求應轉成結構設計的量化指標（每座墩的阻水當量、施工期臨時阻水上限），納入設計審查與施工許可；任何改變墩形或增加臨時構造物的變更，都須重新計算阻水並經環境主管機關同意。
knowledge.textEn: Environmental requirements should become quantified design criteria, such as the blocking equivalent of each pier and a temporary blocking limit during works, included in design review and permits; any change to pier shape or added temporary works needs a recalculated blocking figure and environmental-authority approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「零阻水要求與海峽環境」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The zero-blocking requirement"?
options: 以水理數值模型與物理模型比較建設前後的流量、鹽度與水位差，計算每個構造物的阻水貢獻。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。
optionsEn: Compare flow, salinity and water-level differences before and after construction with numerical and physical hydraulic models, computing the blocking contribution of each structure.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection.
quiz.explanation: 以水理數值模型與物理模型比較建設前後的流量、鹽度與水位差，計算每個構造物的阻水貢獻；施工中監測浚挖溢散的懸浮物，完工後以多音束測深確認補償區的實際斷面，並以長期海流觀測驗證零阻水目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare flow, salinity and water-level differences before and after construction with numerical and physical hydraulic models, computing the blocking contribution of each structure; during works monitor suspended sediment spill from dredging, after completion confirm the compensation zone by multibeam survey, and verify the zero-blocking goal by long-term current measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 零阻水要求與海峽環境：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The zero-blocking requirement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋墩阻水斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pier blockage cross-section” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若施工中臨時平台、圍堰或堆置物超出計畫，阻水在施工期就超過允許值；補償浚挖若不足或日後淤積回填，長期淨阻水不為零，可能引起環境責任與追加浚挖，甚至限制日後增建或補強的空間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary platforms, cofferdams or stockpiles beyond plan can exceed the allowed blocking during construction; insufficient compensation dredging or later siltation leaves a net long-term blockage, triggering environmental liability, extra dredging and even limiting future additions or strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個要求直接影響結構：橋墩數量與尺寸、沉箱外形、引橋跨徑都要在阻水與造價之間取捨，橋梁設計成為海洋環境工程的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The rule shaped the structure directly: number and size of piers, caisson outlines and approach span lengths were traded between blocking and cost, making bridge design part of marine environmental engineering.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙層鋼桁與豎琴式斜索」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-deck truss and harp stays” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 厄勒海峽大橋的上部結構是鋼—混凝土複合桁架：上層混凝土橋面板承載四線道公路並作為桁架上弦的一部分，下層桁架內承載雙軌鐵路。高橋為主跨 490 公尺、邊跨 160 與 141 公尺的斜張橋，斜索以豎琴式排列，在桁架上每 20 公尺錨碇一處、在塔上每 12 公尺一處，邊跨另設橋墩限制主跨撓度。雙層桁架提供很大的梁深，使鐵路所需的勁度與撓度限制容易達成；豎琴式斜索角度一致，視覺整齊，但對塔的彎矩較扇形配置敏感，因此邊跨墩的布置很重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙層鋼桁與豎琴式斜索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The superstructure is a steel–concrete composite truss: the upper concrete deck carries a four-lane motorway and acts as part of the top chord, and the lower deck inside the truss carries a double-track railway. The high bridge is cable-stayed with a 490 m main span and 160 m and 141 m side spans; its stays form a harp, anchored every 20 m on the truss and every 12 m on the pylons, with side-span piers limiting main-span deflection. The deep double-deck truss makes the stiffness and deflection limits needed for rail easy to meet; harp stays share one angle and look orderly, but make the pylons more sensitive to bending than a fan, so the side-span piers matter. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Double-deck truss and harp stays” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：豎琴式斜索的角度由錨距決定：tanθ = 12/20 = 0.6，θ ≈ 31.0°，sinθ ≈ 0.514。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The harp angle follows from the anchor spacings: tanθ = 12/20 = 0.6, θ ≈ 31.0° and sinθ ≈ 0.514.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鐵路與公路共用一座橋時，只要把兩種荷載相加就完成設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When rail and road share a bridge, simply adding the two loads completes the design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙層鋼桁與豎琴式斜索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Double-deck truss and harp stays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋

steps.title: 公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙層鋼桁與豎琴式斜索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-deck truss and harp stays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：豎琴式斜索的角度由錨距決定：tanθ = 12/20 = 0.6，θ ≈ 31.0°，sinθ ≈ 0.514。若每個索面承受 w = 200 kN/m，每根索支撐 20 m，索力 T = w·s/sinθ = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN；73 股鋼絞線的破斷力約 18,660 kN，利用率約 42%。w 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The harp angle follows from the anchor spacings: tanθ = 12/20 = 0.6, θ ≈ 31.0° and sinθ ≈ 0.514. If each cable plane carries w = 200 kN/m and each stay supports 20 m, the stay force is T = w·s/sinθ = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN; a 73-strand stay breaks at about 18,660 kN, a utilisation of about 42%. w is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全橋模型比較公路與鐵路荷載的不同排列（雙軌列車交會、單側公路滿載）下的桁架弦桿力、斜索力與撓度；鐵路的撓度、扭轉與端部轉角須逐項對照鐵路規範的限值，並在完工時以列車試驗量測驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare chord forces, stay forces and deflections for combinations of road and rail loading, such as two trains passing and one carriageway fully loaded, in a whole-bridge model; check rail deflection, twist and end-rotation limits item by item against railway criteria and verify them by train tests at completion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 豎琴式斜索的角度由錨距決定：tanθ = 12/20 = 0.6，θ ≈ 31.0°，sinθ ≈ 0.514。若每個索面承受 w = 200 kN/m，每根索支撐 20 m，索力 T = w·s/sinθ = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN；73 股鋼絞線的破斷力約 18,660 kN，利用率約 42%。w 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The harp angle follows from the anchor spacings: tanθ = 12/20 = 0.6, θ ≈ 31.0° and sinθ ≈ 0.514. If each cable plane carries w = 200 kN/m and each stay supports 20 m, the stay force is T = w·s/sinθ = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN; a 73-strand stay breaks at about 18,660 kN, a utilisation of about 42%. w is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.
