steps.title: 公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙層鋼桁與豎琴式斜索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Double-deck truss and harp stays” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全橋模型比較公路與鐵路荷載的不同排列（雙軌列車交會、單側公路滿載）下的桁架弦桿力、斜索力與撓度；鐵路的撓度、扭轉與端部轉角須逐項對照鐵路規範的限值，並在完工時以列車試驗量測驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare chord forces, stay forces and deflections for combinations of road and rail loading, such as two trains passing and one carriageway fully loaded, in a whole-bridge model; check rail deflection, twist and end-rotation limits item by item against railway criteria and verify them by train tests at completion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準應把鐵路的撓度、扭轉、加速度與端轉角限值列為與強度同等的控制條件，並由鐵路主管機關參與審查；斜索錨距與邊跨墩配置在初步設計就以勁度需求決定，而不是只看外觀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should make rail deflection, twist, acceleration and end-rotation limits governing criteria equal to strength, with the railway authority in the review; stay spacing and side-span piers should be set by stiffness needs at preliminary design, not by appearance alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以公路荷載設計而低估列車的集中載重與動力放大，桁架節點與鐵路縱梁的疲勞會提早出現；豎琴式斜索若邊跨墩配置不足，塔身彎矩與主跨撓度超過鐵路允許值，列車必須限速。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing for road load alone while underestimating concentrated train loads and dynamic amplification brings early fatigue at truss joints and rail stringers; with too few side-span piers, a harp arrangement lets pylon bending and main-span deflection exceed rail limits, forcing speed restrictions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全橋模型比較公路與鐵路荷載的不同排列（雙軌列車交會、單側公路滿載）下的桁架弦桿力、斜索力與撓度；鐵路的撓度、扭轉與端部轉角須逐項對照鐵路規範的限值，並在完工時以列車試驗量測驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare chord forces, stay forces and deflections for combinations of road and rail loading, such as two trains passing and one carriageway fully loaded, in a whole-bridge model; check rail deflection, twist and end-rotation limits item by item against railway criteria and verify them by train tests at completion.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準應把鐵路的撓度、扭轉、加速度與端轉角限值列為與強度同等的控制條件，並由鐵路主管機關參與審查；斜索錨距與邊跨墩配置在初步設計就以勁度需求決定，而不是只看外觀。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should make rail deflection, twist, acceleration and end-rotation limits governing criteria equal to strength, with the railway authority in the review; stay spacing and side-span piers should be set by stiffness needs at preliminary design, not by appearance alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以全橋模型比較公路與鐵路荷載的不同排列（雙軌列車交會、單側公路滿載）下的桁架弦桿力、斜索力與撓度。
鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compare chord forces, stay forces and deflections for combinations of road and rail loading, such as two trains passing and one carriageway fully loaded, in a whole-bridge model.
A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems.
quiz.explanation: 以全橋模型比較公路與鐵路荷載的不同排列（雙軌列車交會、單側公路滿載）下的桁架弦桿力、斜索力與撓度；鐵路的撓度、扭轉與端部轉角須逐項對照鐵路規範的限值，並在完工時以列車試驗量測驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare chord forces, stay forces and deflections for combinations of road and rail loading, such as two trains passing and one carriageway fully loaded, in a whole-bridge model; check rail deflection, twist and end-rotation limits item by item against railway criteria and verify them by train tests at completion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙層鋼桁與豎琴式斜索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Double-deck truss and harp stays” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以公路荷載設計而低估列車的集中載重與動力放大，桁架節點與鐵路縱梁的疲勞會提早出現；豎琴式斜索若邊跨墩配置不足，塔身彎矩與主跨撓度超過鐵路允許值，列車必須限速。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing for road load alone while underestimating concentrated train loads and dynamic amplification brings early fatigue at truss joints and rail stringers; with too few side-span piers, a harp arrangement lets pylon bending and main-span deflection exceed rail limits, forcing speed restrictions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雙層桁架提供很大的梁深，使鐵路所需的勁度與撓度限制容易達成；豎琴式斜索角度一致，視覺整齊，但對塔的彎矩較扇形配置敏感，因此邊跨墩的布置很重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The deep double-deck truss makes the stiffness and deflection limits needed for rail easy to meet; harp stays share one angle and look orderly, but make the pylons more sensitive to bending than a fan, so the side-span piers matter.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鐵路與公路共用一座橋時，只要把兩種荷載相加就完成設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When rail and road share a bridge, simply adding the two loads completes the design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以公路荷載設計而低估列車的集中載重與動力放大，桁架節點與鐵路縱梁的疲勞會提早出現；豎琴式斜索若邊跨墩配置不足，塔身彎矩與主跨撓度超過鐵路允許值，列車必須限速。
knowledge.textEn: Designing for road load alone while underestimating concentrated train loads and dynamic amplification brings early fatigue at truss joints and rail stringers; with too few side-span piers, a harp arrangement lets pylon bending and main-span deflection exceed rail limits, forcing speed restrictions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
預鑄沉箱又重又大，放到海床上自然就會穩固。
若只以公路荷載設計而低估列車的集中載重與動力放大，桁架節點與鐵路縱梁的疲勞會提早出現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A precast caisson is so heavy that it becomes stable simply by being set on the seabed.
Designing for road load alone while underestimating concentrated train loads and dynamic amplification brings early fatigue at truss joints and rail stringers.
quiz.explanation: 若只以公路荷載設計而低估列車的集中載重與動力放大，桁架節點與鐵路縱梁的疲勞會提早出現；豎琴式斜索若邊跨墩配置不足，塔身彎矩與主跨撓度超過鐵路允許值，列車必須限速。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing for road load alone while underestimating concentrated train loads and dynamic amplification brings early fatigue at truss joints and rail stringers; with too few side-span piers, a harp arrangement lets pylon bending and main-span deflection exceed rail limits, forcing speed restrictions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預鑄沉箱基礎與定位」與「204 公尺混凝土橋塔與斜索」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Precast caisson foundations and placement" and "The 204 m pylons and their stays": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預鑄沉箱基礎與定位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Precast caisson foundations and placement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Precast caissons on limestone” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋塔與邊跨墩的基礎是坐落在海平面下約 14 至 17 公尺堅硬石灰岩上的預鑄混凝土沉箱，引橋墩也以類似的大型預鑄件施工。沉箱在岸上或乾塢中製作，以浮吊或浮運移到現場，下放到事先浚挖整平的基床上，再以灌漿填滿底部空隙，讓荷載均勻傳到岩盤。這種作法把大部分混凝土工作移到陸上，減少海上作業時間，但對基床平整度、下放定位與底部灌漿品質要求很高，因為坐落後幾乎無法再調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pylon and side-span pier foundations are precast concrete caissons seated on hard limestone about 14 to 17 m below sea level, and approach piers used similar large precast units. Caissons are cast on shore or in dry dock, moved by floating crane or towing, lowered onto a pre-dredged and levelled bed, and grouted underneath to fill voids so load spreads evenly into the rock. Most concrete work moves ashore and time at sea is reduced, but bed flatness, placing accuracy and underbase grouting become critical because a seated caisson can hardly be adjusted afterwards. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Precast caissons on limestone” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：沉箱底面若有 1 mm/m（1:1,000）的傾斜，從沉箱底到墩頂共 65 m 時，墩頂水平偏差 = 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm，已接近支承與梁段對接可容許的量級。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A base tilt of 1 mm/m (1:1,000) over 65 m from caisson base to pier top gives a horizontal offset of 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm at the pier head, close to what bearings and girder fit-up can tolerate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄沉箱又重又大，放到海床上自然就會穩固。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A precast caisson is so heavy that it becomes stable simply by being set on the seabed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Precast caissons on limestone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預鑄沉箱基礎與定位
knowledge.text: 橋塔與邊跨墩的基礎是坐落在海平面下約 14 至 17 公尺堅硬石灰岩上的預鑄混凝土沉箱，引橋墩也以類似的大型預鑄件施工。沉箱在岸上或乾塢中製作，以浮吊或浮運移到現場，下放到事先浚挖整平的基床上，再以灌漿填滿底部空隙，讓荷載均勻傳到岩盤。
knowledge.textEn: The pylon and side-span pier foundations are precast concrete caissons seated on hard limestone about 14 to 17 m below sea level, and approach piers used similar large precast units. Caissons are cast on shore or in dry dock, moved by floating crane or towing, lowered onto a pre-dredged and levelled bed, and grouted underneath to fill voids so load spreads evenly into the rock.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預鑄沉箱又重又大，放到海床上自然就會穩固。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A precast caisson is so heavy that it becomes stable simply by being set on the seabed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預鑄沉箱基礎與定位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Precast caisson foundations and placement" is correct?
options: 橋塔與邊跨墩的基礎是坐落在海平面下約 14 至 17 公尺堅硬石灰岩上的預鑄混凝土沉箱，引橋墩也以類似的大型預鑄件施工。
預鑄沉箱又重又大，放到海床上自然就會穩固。
混凝土橋塔只受壓，不需要擔心錨碇區的局部應力。
optionsEn: The pylon and side-span pier foundations are precast concrete caissons seated on hard limestone about 14 to 17 m below sea level, and approach piers used similar large precast units.
A precast caisson is so heavy that it becomes stable simply by being set on the seabed.
A concrete pylon is only in compression, so local stresses at the anchorages are no concern.
quiz.explanation: 橋塔與邊跨墩的基礎是坐落在海平面下約 14 至 17 公尺堅硬石灰岩上的預鑄混凝土沉箱，引橋墩也以類似的大型預鑄件施工。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The pylon and side-span pier foundations are precast concrete caissons seated on hard limestone about 14 to 17 m below sea level, and approach piers used similar large precast units. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預鑄沉箱基礎與定位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Precast caisson foundations and placement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Precast caissons on limestone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：沉箱底面若有 1 mm/m（1:1,000）的傾斜，從沉箱底到墩頂共 65 m 時，墩頂水平偏差 = 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm，已接近支承與梁段對接可容許的量級。若傾斜減為 0.3 mm/m，偏差降到約 20 mm。高度與允差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A base tilt of 1 mm/m (1:1,000) over 65 m from caisson base to pier top gives a horizontal offset of 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm at the pier head, close to what bearings and girder fit-up can tolerate. Reducing the tilt to 0.3 mm/m cuts it to about 20 mm. Height and tolerance are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：下放前以多音束測深與潛水檢查確認基床高程與平整度，下放時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀即時監控位置與傾角；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力，與計算的空隙體積比較，完成後檢查溢漿口並量測沉箱頂高程與傾斜，合格後才安裝墩身。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lowering confirm bed level and flatness by multibeam survey and divers; during lowering monitor position and tilt by GNSS and inclinometers in real time; during grouting record volume and pressure against the calculated void volume, then check vents and measure caisson-top level and tilt, installing the pier shaft only after acceptance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 沉箱底面若有 1 mm/m（1:1,000）的傾斜，從沉箱底到墩頂共 65 m 時，墩頂水平偏差 = 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm，已接近支承與梁段對接可容許的量級。若傾斜減為 0.3 mm/m，偏差降到約 20 mm。高度與允差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A base tilt of 1 mm/m (1:1,000) over 65 m from caisson base to pier top gives a horizontal offset of 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm at the pier head, close to what bearings and girder fit-up can tolerate. Reducing the tilt to 0.3 mm/m cuts it to about 20 mm. Height and tolerance are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預鑄沉箱基礎與定位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Precast caisson foundations and placement", which statement holds?
options: 斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。
沉箱底面若有 1 mm/m（1:1,000）的傾斜，從沉箱底到墩頂共 65 m 時，墩頂水平偏差 = 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm，已接近支承與梁段對接可容許的量級。
只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。
optionsEn: If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right.

A base tilt of 1 mm/m (1:1,000) over 65 m from caisson base to pier top gives a horizontal offset of 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm at the pier head, close to what bearings and girder fit-up can tolerate.
A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection.
quiz.explanation: 沉箱底面若有 1 mm/m（1:1,000）的傾斜，從沉箱底到墩頂共 65 m 時，墩頂水平偏差 = 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm，已接近支承與梁段對接可容許的量級。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A base tilt of 1 mm/m (1:1,000) over 65 m from caisson base to pier top gives a horizontal offset of 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm at the pier head, close to what bearings and girder fit-up can tolerate. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預鑄沉箱基礎與定位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Precast caisson foundations and placement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Precast caissons on limestone” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 下放前以多音束測深與潛水檢查確認基床高程與平整度，下放時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀即時監控位置與傾角；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力，與計算的空隙體積比較，完成後檢查溢漿口並量測沉箱頂高程與傾斜，合格後才安裝墩身。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lowering confirm bed level and flatness by multibeam survey and divers; during lowering monitor position and tilt by GNSS and inclinometers in real time; during grouting record volume and pressure against the calculated void volume, then check vents and measure caisson-top level and tilt, installing the pier shaft only after acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：沉箱安裝程序應把基床驗收、下放定位、灌漿與坐落後量測列為依序的停留點，每一步有書面允差與簽認；灌漿配比與溢漿判定標準須事先試驗，並保留潛水檢查影像。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The caisson procedure should make bed acceptance, positioning, grouting and post-seating survey sequential hold points, each with written tolerances and sign-off; grout mixes and vent criteria are trialled in advance and diver inspection videos kept.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基床上殘留軟泥或石塊時，沉箱局部支承、受力集中，日後產生傾斜與不均勻沉陷；底部灌漿不完整讓空隙被海流掏刷，長期下來支承面積減少，墩頂偏位逐年增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Soft mud or boulders left on the bed give point support and stress concentrations, leading to tilt and differential settlement; incomplete underbase grout leaves voids that currents scour, shrinking the bearing area and increasing pier-top offset year by year. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 下放前以多音束測深與潛水檢查確認基床高程與平整度，下放時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀即時監控位置與傾角；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力，與計算的空隙體積比較，完成後檢查溢漿口並量測沉箱頂高程與傾斜，合格後才安裝墩身。
knowledge.textEn: Before lowering confirm bed level and flatness by multibeam survey and divers; during lowering monitor position and tilt by GNSS and inclinometers in real time; during grouting record volume and pressure against the calculated void volume, then check vents and measure caisson-top level and tilt, installing the pier shaft only after acceptance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 沉箱安裝程序應把基床驗收、下放定位、灌漿與坐落後量測列為依序的停留點，每一步有書面允差與簽認；灌漿配比與溢漿判定標準須事先試驗，並保留潛水檢查影像。
knowledge.textEn: The caisson procedure should make bed acceptance, positioning, grouting and post-seating survey sequential hold points, each with written tolerances and sign-off; grout mixes and vent criteria are trialled in advance and diver inspection videos kept.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預鑄沉箱基礎與定位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Precast caisson foundations and placement"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。
下放前以多音束測深與潛水檢查確認基床高程與平整度，下放時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀即時監控位置與傾角。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length.
Before lowering confirm bed level and flatness by multibeam survey and divers.
quiz.explanation: 下放前以多音束測深與潛水檢查確認基床高程與平整度，下放時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀即時監控位置與傾角；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力，與計算的空隙體積比較，完成後檢查溢漿口並量測沉箱頂高程與傾斜，合格後才安裝墩身。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before lowering confirm bed level and flatness by multibeam survey and divers; during lowering monitor position and tilt by GNSS and inclinometers in real time; during grouting record volume and pressure against the calculated void volume, then check vents and measure caisson-top level and tilt, installing the pier shaft only after acceptance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預鑄沉箱基礎與定位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Precast caisson foundations and placement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Precast caissons on limestone” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基床上殘留軟泥或石塊時，沉箱局部支承、受力集中，日後產生傾斜與不均勻沉陷；底部灌漿不完整讓空隙被海流掏刷，長期下來支承面積減少，墩頂偏位逐年增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Soft mud or boulders left on the bed give point support and stress concentrations, leading to tilt and differential settlement; incomplete underbase grout leaves voids that currents scour, shrinking the bearing area and increasing pier-top offset year by year. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種作法把大部分混凝土工作移到陸上，減少海上作業時間，但對基床平整度、下放定位與底部灌漿品質要求很高，因為坐落後幾乎無法再調整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Most concrete work moves ashore and time at sea is reduced, but bed flatness, placing accuracy and underbase grouting become critical because a seated caisson can hardly be adjusted afterwards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預鑄沉箱又重又大，放到海床上自然就會穩固。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A precast caisson is so heavy that it becomes stable simply by being set on the seabed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Soft mud or boulders left on the bed give point support and stress concentrations, leading to tilt and differential settlement; incomplete underbase grout leaves voids that currents scour, shrinking the bearing area and increasing pier-top offset year by year.

quiz.question: 在「預鑄沉箱基礎與定位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Precast caisson foundations and placement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 基床上殘留軟泥或石塊時，沉箱局部支承、受力集中，日後產生傾斜與不均勻沉陷；底部灌漿不完整讓空隙被海流掏刷，長期下來支承面積減少，墩頂偏位逐年增加。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
混凝土橋塔只受壓，不需要擔心錨碇區的局部應力。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

steps.title: 204 公尺混凝土橋塔與斜索：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The 204 m pylons and their stays: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土橋塔與錨箱」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete pylons and anchor boxes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩座混凝土橋塔高約 204 公尺，是唯一沒有在陸上預製的主要構件：以自升式模板每次澆置 4 公尺，每節約 7 至 10 天，塔柱下方 17 公尺為實心，以上為中空五邊形斷面，每支塔柱約用 4,335 立方公尺混凝土與 800 公噸鋼筋。斜索錨碇在預埋於塔柱內的鋼錨箱上，把集中的索力分散到混凝土。全橋共 160 根斜索，每根 68 至 73 股、每股 7 根直徑 5 mm 鍍鋅塗蠟鋼線並有塑膠套管，斜索總重約 2,150 公噸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混凝土橋塔與錨箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The two concrete pylons, about 204 m tall, were the only major components not prefabricated on land: self-climbing forms cast 4 m lifts every 7 to 10 days, the legs are solid for the lowest 17 m and hollow pentagons above, and each leg used about 4,335 m³ of concrete and 800 t of reinforcement. Stays anchor in steel anchor boxes cast into the legs, spreading concentrated stay forces into the concrete. The bridge has 160 stays, each of 68 to 73 strands made of seven 5 mm galvanised, waxed wires in plastic sheathing, with about 2,150 t of cable in total. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete pylons and anchor boxes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單股 7 根 5 mm 鋼線面積 = 7×π×2.5² ≈ 137.4 mm²；以 f_pu = 1,860 MPa 計，73 股破斷力 ≈ 73×137.4×1,860 ≈ 18,660 kN，約 1,900 公噸，與公開的每索約 2,000 公噸同量級。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One strand of seven 5 mm wires has 7×π×2.5² ≈ 137.4 mm²; with f_pu = 1,860 MPa, 73 strands break at about 73×137.4×1,860 ≈ 18,660 kN, about 1,900 t, consistent in magnitude with the published figure of about 2,000 t per cable.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土橋塔只受壓，不需要擔心錨碇區的局部應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A concrete pylon is only in compression, so local stresses at the anchorages are no concern." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混凝土橋塔與錨箱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete pylons and anchor boxes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 204 公尺混凝土橋塔與斜索：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 204 m pylons and their stays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土橋塔與錨箱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete pylons and anchor boxes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單股 7 根 5 mm 鋼線面積 = 7×π×2.5² ≈ 137.4 mm²；以 f_pu = 1,860 MPa 計，73 股破斷力 ≈ 73×137.4×1,860 ≈ 18,660 kN，約 1,900 公噸，與公開的每索約 2,000 公噸同量級。塔柱 204 m ÷ 4 m ≈ 51 次澆置，每次 7 至 10 天，約需 357 至 510 天。f_pu 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One strand of seven 5 mm wires has 7×π×2.5² ≈ 137.4 mm²; with f_pu = 1,860 MPa, 73 strands break at about 73×137.4×1,860 ≈ 18,660 kN, about 1,900 t, consistent in magnitude with the published figure of about 2,000 t per cable. A 204 m leg needs 204 ÷ 4 ≈ 51 lifts at 7 to 10 days each, about 357 to 510 days. f_pu is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次澆置前以測量確認塔柱軸線與錨箱位置，修正日照與自重造成的塔身偏移；錨箱焊縫與剪力釘做無損檢測，混凝土強度與溫度紀錄逐節保存；斜索張拉後以測力計或頻率法確認索力，與設計索力表比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each lift survey the leg axis and anchor-box positions, correcting for sun and self-weight lean; test anchor-box welds and studs non-destructively, keep strength and temperature records for every lift, and after stressing confirm stay forces by load cell or frequency methods against the design table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 每次澆置前以測量確認塔柱軸線與錨箱位置，修正日照與自重造成的塔身偏移；錨箱焊縫與剪力釘做無損檢測，混凝土強度與溫度紀錄逐節保存；斜索張拉後以測力計或頻率法確認索力，與設計索力表比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each lift survey the leg axis and anchor-box positions, correcting for sun and self-weight lean; test anchor-box welds and studs non-destructively, keep strength and temperature records for every lift, and after stressing confirm stay forces by load cell or frequency methods against the design table. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塔柱施工應有逐節的測量與校正程序，考慮施工時溫度與自重變形；錨箱製作、安裝與灌注各設檢驗停留點，斜索張拉完成後提交索力與塔身線形的竣工紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pylon construction needs a lift-by-lift survey and correction procedure that accounts for temperature and self-weight deformation; anchor-box fabrication, installation and concreting each get a hold point, and as-built stay forces and pylon geometry are submitted after stressing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨箱位置誤差累積時，斜索角度偏離設計，索力與梁段高程無法同時達標；錨箱與混凝土之間的剪力傳遞不足，會在錨碇區產生劈裂裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕鋼錨箱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accumulated anchor-box position errors change stay angles so that stay forces and deck levels cannot both reach target; inadequate shear transfer between anchor boxes and concrete causes splitting cracks in the anchorage zone, through which water reaches and corrodes the steel boxes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow.

steps.title: 204 公尺混凝土橋塔與斜索：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The 204 m pylons and their stays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土橋塔與錨箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete pylons and anchor boxes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨箱位置誤差累積時，斜索角度偏離設計，索力與梁段高程無法同時達標；錨箱與混凝土之間的剪力傳遞不足，會在錨碇區產生劈裂裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕鋼錨箱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accumulated anchor-box position errors change stay angles so that stay forces and deck levels cannot both reach target; inadequate shear transfer between anchor boxes and concrete causes splitting cracks in the anchorage zone, through which water reaches and corrodes the steel boxes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：全橋共 160 根斜索，每根 68 至 73 股、每股 7 根直徑 5 mm 鍍鋅塗蠟鋼線並有塑膠套管，斜索總重約 2,150 公噸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The bridge has 160 stays, each of 68 to 73 strands made of seven 5 mm galvanised, waxed wires in plastic sheathing, with about 2,150 t of cable in total.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土橋塔只受壓，不需要擔心錨碇區的局部應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A concrete pylon is only in compression, so local stresses at the anchorages are no concern." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨箱位置誤差累積時，斜索角度偏離設計，索力與梁段高程無法同時達標；錨箱與混凝土之間的剪力傳遞不足，會在錨碇區產生劈裂裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕鋼錨箱。
knowledge.textEn: Accumulated anchor-box position errors change stay angles so that stay forces and deck levels cannot both reach target; inadequate shear transfer between anchor boxes and concrete causes splitting cracks in the anchorage zone, through which water reaches and corrodes the steel boxes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「204 公尺混凝土橋塔與斜索」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The 204 m pylons and their stays" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
錨箱位置誤差累積時，斜索角度偏離設計，索力與梁段高程無法同時達標；錨箱與混凝土之間的剪力傳遞不足，會在錨碇區產生劈裂裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕鋼錨箱。
只要浮吊額定能力大於梁段重量，就可以在任何海況下吊裝。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Accumulated anchor-box position errors change stay angles so that stay forces and deck levels cannot both reach target.
If the floating crane's rating exceeds the span weight, lifting is safe in any sea state.
quiz.explanation: 錨箱位置誤差累積時，斜索角度偏離設計，索力與梁段高程無法同時達標；錨箱與混凝土之間的剪力傳遞不足，會在錨碇區產生劈裂裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕鋼錨箱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accumulated anchor-box position errors change stay angles so that stay forces and deck levels cannot both reach target; inadequate shear transfer between anchor boxes and concrete causes splitting cracks in the anchorage zone, through which water reaches and corrodes the steel boxes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「整跨預製與浮吊安裝」與「高橋主跨架設與合龍」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection" and "Erecting and closing the high bridge": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 整跨預製與浮吊安裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「Svanen 浮吊與整跨鋼桁」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Svanen and full-span trusses” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 厄勒海峽大橋約九成以大型預製件組成。引橋 49 段鋼桁梁在西班牙加的斯製造、連同混凝土橋面拖運北上，高橋 8 段鋼桁梁在瑞典卡爾斯克魯納製造，再到馬爾默加上公路橋面；自航式浮吊 Svanen 負責吊放所有梁段、沉箱與墩身。業界報導指出，Svanen 不含吊具的能力約 8,700 公噸，最重一次吊放是含鐵路設施的完整引橋段，約 7,464 公噸。整跨吊裝把海上作業縮短為定位與連接，但每次吊放都是接近設備極限的重件作業，天候窗口與動態放大必須嚴格控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「Svanen 浮吊與整跨鋼桁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: About ninety percent of the bridge consists of large precast units. The 49 approach truss spans were built in Cádiz, Spain, and towed north with their concrete decks, while 8 high-bridge girders were built in Karlskrona, Sweden, and received their motorway deck in Malmö; the self-propelled floating crane Svanen placed all spans, caissons and pier shafts. Trade reports put Svanen's capacity at about 8,700 t without rigging, and the heaviest lift, a complete approach span with rail equipment, at about 7,464 t. Full-span lifting reduces work at sea to positioning and connection, but every lift is a heavy operation near the equipment's limit, so weather windows and dynamic amplification must be tightly controlled. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Svanen and full-span trusses” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Utilisation is 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要浮吊額定能力大於梁段重量，就可以在任何海況下吊裝。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the floating crane's rating exceeds the span weight, lifting is safe in any sea state." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「Svanen 浮吊與整跨鋼桁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Svanen and full-span trusses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 整跨預製與浮吊安裝
knowledge.text: 厄勒海峽大橋約九成以大型預製件組成。引橋 49 段鋼桁梁在西班牙加的斯製造、連同混凝土橋面拖運北上，高橋 8 段鋼桁梁在瑞典卡爾斯克魯納製造，再到馬爾默加上公路橋面；自航式浮吊 Svanen 負責吊放所有梁段、沉箱與墩身。
knowledge.textEn: About ninety percent of the bridge consists of large precast units. The 49 approach truss spans were built in Cádiz, Spain, and towed north with their concrete decks, while 8 high-bridge girders were built in Karlskrona, Sweden, and received their motorway deck in Malmö; the self-propelled floating crane Svanen placed all spans, caissons and pier shafts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要浮吊額定能力大於梁段重量，就可以在任何海況下吊裝。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the floating crane's rating exceeds the span weight, lifting is safe in any sea state. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「整跨預製與浮吊安裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection" is correct?
options: 只要浮吊額定能力大於梁段重量，就可以在任何海況下吊裝。
斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。
厄勒海峽大橋約九成以大型預製件組成。
optionsEn: If the floating crane's rating exceeds the span weight, lifting is safe in any sea state.
If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right.
About ninety percent of the bridge consists of large precast units.
quiz.explanation: 厄勒海峽大橋約九成以大型預製件組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: About ninety percent of the bridge consists of large precast units. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 整跨預製與浮吊安裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Svanen 浮吊與整跨鋼桁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Svanen and full-span trusses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：利用率 = 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%。若波浪造成 10% 的動態放大，等效吊重 7,464×1.1 ≈ 8,210 t，已超過含吊具的額定約 8,200 t，因此重件只能在近乎靜海的窗口吊放，使動態放大低於約 1.09。放大係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Utilisation is 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%. If waves add 10% dynamic amplification, the effective load is 7,464×1.1 ≈ 8,210 t, beyond the rating of about 8,200 t including rigging, so the heaviest lifts must wait for near-calm windows that keep amplification below about 1.09. The amplification factor is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次吊放前以秤重或千斤頂油壓確認實際重量與重心，並依海象預報確認浪高、風速與流速在允許範圍；吊放中監測吊索力與船體姿態，落墩時量測梁端位置與支承接觸，與設計允差比較後才鬆鉤。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each lift confirm actual weight and centre of gravity by weighing or jack pressures and check forecast wave height, wind and current against limits; during the lift monitor sling forces and vessel motion, and on landing measure span-end position and bearing contact against tolerances before releasing the hooks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 利用率 = 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%。若波浪造成 10% 的動態放大，等效吊重 7,464×1.1 ≈ 8,210 t，已超過含吊具的額定約 8,200 t，因此重件只能在近乎靜海的窗口吊放，使動態放大低於約 1.09。放大係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Utilisation is 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%. If waves add 10% dynamic amplification, the effective load is 7,464×1.1 ≈ 8,210 t, beyond the rating of about 8,200 t including rigging, so the heaviest lifts must wait for near-calm windows that keep amplification below about 1.09. The amplification factor is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「整跨預製與浮吊安裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection", which statement holds?
options: 只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。
長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。
optionsEn: Utilisation is 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%.
A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection.
Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length.
quiz.explanationEn: Utilisation is 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 整跨預製與浮吊安裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「Svanen 浮吊與整跨鋼桁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Svanen and full-span trusses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次吊放前以秤重或千斤頂油壓確認實際重量與重心，並依海象預報確認浪高、風速與流速在允許範圍；吊放中監測吊索力與船體姿態，落墩時量測梁端位置與支承接觸，與設計允差比較後才鬆鉤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each lift confirm actual weight and centre of gravity by weighing or jack pressures and check forecast wave height, wind and current against limits; during the lift monitor sling forces and vessel motion, and on landing measure span-end position and bearing contact against tolerances before releasing the hooks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重件吊裝計畫應包含秤重程序、重心計算、海象作業門檻、吊具第三方認證與中止準則，並由海事保險鑑定人或獨立工程師審查；每次吊放前召開開工會議確認所有門檻條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The heavy-lift plan should include weighing, centre-of-gravity calculation, metocean limits, third-party certified rigging and abort criteria, reviewed by a marine warranty surveyor or independent engineer; a pre-lift meeting confirms every limit before each lift.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：實際重量或重心與計算不符時，吊具偏載、梁段傾斜，可能撞擊墩頂或已完成的梁段；在動態放大過大的海況硬吊，吊索與吊點可能超載失效，造成重件落海的重大事故。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If actual weight or centre of gravity differs from calculation, the rigging is loaded unevenly and the span tilts, risking impact with pier heads or adjacent spans; forcing a lift in seas with excessive amplification can overload slings and lifting points and drop the span into the sea. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 整跨預製與浮吊安裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Svanen 浮吊與整跨鋼桁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Svanen and full-span trusses” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 實際重量或重心與計算不符時，吊具偏載、梁段傾斜，可能撞擊墩頂或已完成的梁段；在動態放大過大的海況硬吊，吊索與吊點可能超載失效，造成重件落海的重大事故。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If actual weight or centre of gravity differs from calculation, the rigging is loaded unevenly and the span tilts, risking impact with pier heads or adjacent spans; forcing a lift in seas with excessive amplification can overload slings and lifting points and drop the span into the sea. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整跨吊裝把海上作業縮短為定位與連接，但每次吊放都是接近設備極限的重件作業，天候窗口與動態放大必須嚴格控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Full-span lifting reduces work at sea to positioning and connection, but every lift is a heavy operation near the equipment's limit, so weather windows and dynamic amplification must be tightly controlled.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要浮吊額定能力大於梁段重量，就可以在任何海況下吊裝。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the floating crane's rating exceeds the span weight, lifting is safe in any sea state." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 實際重量或重心與計算不符時，吊具偏載、梁段傾斜，可能撞擊墩頂或已完成的梁段；在動態放大過大的海況硬吊，吊索與吊點可能超載失效，造成重件落海的重大事故。
knowledge.textEn: If actual weight or centre of gravity differs from calculation, the rigging is loaded unevenly and the span tilts, risking impact with pier heads or adjacent spans; forcing a lift in seas with excessive amplification can overload slings and lifting points and drop the span into the sea.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「整跨預製與浮吊安裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。
實際重量或重心與計算不符時，吊具偏載、梁段傾斜，可能撞擊墩頂或已完成的梁段；在動態放大過大的海況硬吊，吊索與吊點可能超載失效，造成重件落海的重大事故。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right.
If actual weight or centre of gravity differs from calculation, the rigging is loaded unevenly and the span tilts, risking impact with pier heads or adjacent spans.
quiz.explanation: 實際重量或重心與計算不符時，吊具偏載、梁段傾斜，可能撞擊墩頂或已完成的梁段；在動態放大過大的海況硬吊，吊索與吊點可能超載失效，造成重件落海的重大事故。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If actual weight or centre of gravity differs from calculation, the rigging is loaded unevenly and the span tilts, risking impact with pier heads or adjacent spans; forcing a lift in seas with excessive amplification can overload slings and lifting points and drop the span into the sea. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高橋主跨架設與合龍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Erecting and closing the high bridge: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主跨懸臂端合龍」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Main-span closure” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高橋的鋼桁梁以大型節段預製，在現場吊裝後從兩座橋塔向主跨中央逐段延伸並掛上斜索，邊跨則有中間墩支撐。每加一段鋼桁，就要依計算順序張拉對應的斜索，讓懸臂端高程與塔頂偏位維持在預測曲線上；最後在 490 公尺主跨中央接合，公開資料記載最後一段橋跨於 1999 年 8 月就位。合龍前兩端懸臂都會隨溫度與日照伸縮、上下擺動，接合需要選在溫度穩定的時段並以臨時連接器先鎖定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主跨懸臂端合龍」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The high-bridge truss was prefabricated in large sections, lifted on site and extended section by section from the two pylons toward mid-span while the stays were attached, with intermediate piers supporting the side spans. Each new truss section was followed by stressing its stays in the calculated order so that tip level and pylon-top sway stayed on the predicted curves; the halves were finally joined at the centre of the 490 m span, with the last bridge span recorded in place in August 1999. Before closure both cantilevers move with temperature and sun, so the joint must be made in a thermally stable window and locked first with temporary connectors. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Main-span closure” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩懸臂各長約 245 m，鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，若兩端在合龍時段內溫度變化 8 °C，合龍間隙改變 ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm，遠大於螺栓孔或焊接坡口的容許誤差（數毫米），所以必須等溫度穩定或以千斤頂強制對位。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each cantilever is about 245 m long; with steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, an 8 °C change during the closure window alters the gap by ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm, far beyond the few millimetres allowed by bolt holes or weld preparations, so closure waits for stable temperature or uses jacks to force alignment.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「主跨懸臂端合龍」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Main-span closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Erecting and closing the high bridge

Each new truss section was followed by stressing its stays in the calculated order so that tip level and pylon-top sway stayed on the predicted curves; the halves were finally joined at the centre of the 490 m span, with the last bridge span recorded in place in August 1999.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高橋主跨架設與合龍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Erecting and closing the high bridge" is correct?
options: 高橋的鋼桁梁以大型節段預製，在現場吊裝後從兩座橋塔向主跨中央逐段延伸並掛上斜索，邊跨則有中間墩支撐。

optionsEn: The high-bridge truss was prefabricated in large sections, lifted on site and extended section by section from the two pylons toward mid-span while the stays were attached, with intermediate piers supporting the side spans.
If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right.

steps.title: 高橋主跨架設與合龍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Erecting and closing the high bridge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主跨懸臂端合龍」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Main-span closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩懸臂各長約 245 m，鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，若兩端在合龍時段內溫度變化 8 °C，合龍間隙改變 ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm，遠大於螺栓孔或焊接坡口的容許誤差（數毫米），所以必須等溫度穩定或以千斤頂強制對位。溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each cantilever is about 245 m long; with steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, an 8 °C change during the closure window alters the gap by ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm, far beyond the few millimetres allowed by bolt holes or weld preparations, so closure waits for stable temperature or uses jacks to force alignment. The temperature change is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每段架設與張拉後量測懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與代表性索力，與施工階段分析比較並更新下一步的張拉量；合龍前至少量測一個晝夜的間隙與溫度關係，鎖定後記錄連接器受力，完成連接再量測全跨線形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each section and stressing step, measure tip level, pylon-top sway and selected stay forces, compare with the staged analysis and update the next stressing values; before closure record gap versus temperature over at least one day–night cycle, log connector forces after locking, and survey the full span profile once connected.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩懸臂各長約 245 m，鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，若兩端在合龍時段內溫度變化 8 °C，合龍間隙改變 ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm，遠大於螺栓孔或焊接坡口的容許誤差（數毫米），所以必須等溫度穩定或以千斤頂強制對位。溫差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Each cantilever is about 245 m long; with steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, an 8 °C change during the closure window alters the gap by ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm, far beyond the few millimetres allowed by bolt holes or weld preparations, so closure waits for stable temperature or uses jacks to force alignment. The temperature change is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高橋主跨架設與合龍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Erecting and closing the high bridge", which statement holds?
options: 鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。
兩懸臂各長約 245 m，鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，若兩端在合龍時段內溫度變化 8 °C，合龍間隙改變 ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm，遠大於螺栓孔或焊接坡口的容許誤差（數毫米），所以必須等溫度穩定或以千斤頂強制對位。
橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。
optionsEn: A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems.
Each cantilever is about 245 m long.
Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow.
quiz.explanation: 兩懸臂各長約 245 m，鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，若兩端在合龍時段內溫度變化 8 °C，合龍間隙改變 ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm，遠大於螺栓孔或焊接坡口的容許誤差（數毫米），所以必須等溫度穩定或以千斤頂強制對位。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Each cantilever is about 245 m long; with steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, an 8 °C change during the closure window alters the gap by ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm, far beyond the few millimetres allowed by bolt holes or weld preparations, so closure waits for stable temperature or uses jacks to force alignment. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高橋主跨架設與合龍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Erecting and closing the high bridge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主跨懸臂端合龍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Main-span closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每段架設與張拉後量測懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與代表性索力，與施工階段分析比較並更新下一步的張拉量；合龍前至少量測一個晝夜的間隙與溫度關係，鎖定後記錄連接器受力，完成連接再量測全跨線形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each section and stressing step, measure tip level, pylon-top sway and selected stay forces, compare with the staged analysis and update the next stressing values; before closure record gap versus temperature over at least one day–night cycle, log connector forces after locking, and survey the full span profile once connected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工監控應同時以索力與高程雙控制，並設定兩者的允差與優先順序；合龍程序列出鎖定溫度範圍、連接順序與強制對位的最大千斤頂力，由設計單位核准後執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construction control should use both stay force and level, with tolerances and a priority between them; the closure procedure lists the locking temperature range, connection sequence and maximum jack force for forced alignment, approved by the designer before execution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依張拉力控制而不看高程，或只看高程而不看索力，兩者誤差會互相轉移，合龍時懸臂端高程差過大，需要大幅調索；強制對位時千斤頂力過大會在節點留下鎖入應力，日後在疲勞上顯現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Controlling by force alone without levels, or levels alone without forces, shifts error from one to the other, leaving a large level difference at closure that needs major retensioning; excessive jacking to force alignment locks stresses into joints that later show up as fatigue problems. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每段架設與張拉後量測懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與代表性索力，與施工階段分析比較並更新下一步的張拉量；合龍前至少量測一個晝夜的間隙與溫度關係，鎖定後記錄連接器受力，完成連接再量測全跨線形。
knowledge.textEn: After each section and stressing step, measure tip level, pylon-top sway and selected stay forces, compare with the staged analysis and update the next stressing values; before closure record gap versus temperature over at least one day–night cycle, log connector forces after locking, and survey the full span profile once connected.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工監控應同時以索力與高程雙控制，並設定兩者的允差與優先順序；合龍程序列出鎖定溫度範圍、連接順序與強制對位的最大千斤頂力，由設計單位核准後執行。
knowledge.textEn: Construction control should use both stay force and level, with tolerances and a priority between them; the closure procedure lists the locking temperature range, connection sequence and maximum jack force for forced alignment, approved by the designer before execution.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高橋主跨架設與合龍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Erecting and closing the high bridge"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
預鑄沉箱又重又大，放到海床上自然就會穩固。
每段架設與張拉後量測懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與代表性索力，與施工階段分析比較並更新下一步的張拉量。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A precast caisson is so heavy that it becomes stable simply by being set on the seabed.
After each section and stressing step, measure tip level, pylon-top sway and selected stay forces, compare with the staged analysis and update the next stressing values.
quiz.explanation: 每段架設與張拉後量測懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與代表性索力，與施工階段分析比較並更新下一步的張拉量；合龍前至少量測一個晝夜的間隙與溫度關係，鎖定後記錄連接器受力，完成連接再量測全跨線形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each section and stressing step, measure tip level, pylon-top sway and selected stay forces, compare with the staged analysis and update the next stressing values; before closure record gap versus temperature over at least one day–night cycle, log connector forces after locking, and survey the full span profile once connected. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高橋主跨架設與合龍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Erecting and closing the high bridge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主跨懸臂端合龍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Main-span closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依張拉力控制而不看高程，或只看高程而不看索力，兩者誤差會互相轉移，合龍時懸臂端高程差過大，需要大幅調索；強制對位時千斤頂力過大會在節點留下鎖入應力，日後在疲勞上顯現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Controlling by force alone without levels, or levels alone without forces, shifts error from one to the other, leaving a large level difference at closure that needs major retensioning; excessive jacking to force alignment locks stresses into joints that later show up as fatigue problems. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：合龍前兩端懸臂都會隨溫度與日照伸縮、上下擺動，接合需要選在溫度穩定的時段並以臨時連接器先鎖定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before closure both cantilevers move with temperature and sun, so the joint must be made in a thermally stable window and locked first with temporary connectors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依張拉力控制而不看高程，或只看高程而不看索力，兩者誤差會互相轉移，合龍時懸臂端高程差過大，需要大幅調索；強制對位時千斤頂力過大會在節點留下鎖入應力，日後在疲勞上顯現。
knowledge.textEn: Controlling by force alone without levels, or levels alone without forces, shifts error from one to the other, leaving a large level difference at closure that needs major retensioning; excessive jacking to force alignment locks stresses into joints that later show up as fatigue problems.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高橋主跨架設與合龍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Erecting and closing the high bridge" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只依張拉力控制而不看高程，或只看高程而不看索力，兩者誤差會互相轉移，合龍時懸臂端高程差過大，需要大幅調索。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
鐵路的制動力很小，與橋梁自重相比可以忽略。
optionsEn: Controlling by force alone without levels, or levels alone without forces, shifts error from one to the other, leaving a large level difference at closure that needs major retensioning.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Rail braking forces are tiny compared with self-weight and can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 若只依張拉力控制而不看高程，或只看高程而不看索力，兩者誤差會互相轉移，合龍時懸臂端高程差過大，需要大幅調索；強制對位時千斤頂力過大會在節點留下鎖入應力，日後在疲勞上顯現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Controlling by force alone without levels, or levels alone without forces, shifts error from one to the other, leaving a large level difference at closure that needs major retensioning; excessive jacking to force alignment locks stresses into joints that later show up as fatigue problems. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」與「船舶撞擊風險與防撞島」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response" and "Ship-impact risk and protective islands": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail loads, braking and dynamic response: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鐵路制動力與縱向約束」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail braking and longitudinal restraint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 列車在橋上煞車或起動時，鋼軌把縱向力傳到橋面，再經支承與固定墩傳到基礎，所以每個連續單元都需要明確的縱向固定點。鐵路也對橋梁動態敏感：列車通過的頻率若接近橋梁的振動頻率，會出現共振放大，影響乘坐舒適與道床穩定。雙層桁架的大梁深提供高勁度，但支承、固定墩與鋼軌之間的縱向交互作用仍需專門分析，因為溫度伸縮、列車制動與鋼軌應力會互相疊加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鐵路制動力與縱向約束」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When trains brake or accelerate on the bridge, the rails pass longitudinal force into the deck, then through bearings and fixed piers to the foundations, so every continuous unit needs a clear longitudinal fixed point. Rail is also sensitive to dynamics: if axle passage frequencies approach a bridge frequency, resonance amplifies response, affecting comfort and track stability. The deep double-deck truss gives high stiffness, but longitudinal interaction between bearings, fixed piers and rails still needs dedicated analysis because thermal movement, braking and rail stresses add together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rail braking and longitudinal restraint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：依 EN 1991-2 的特徵值，制動力 Q_lbk = 20 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 6,000 kN），起動力 Q_lak = 33 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 1,000 kN）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using EN 1991-2 characteristic values, braking Q_lbk = 20 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 6,000 kN) and traction Q_lak = 33 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 1,000 kN).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鐵路的制動力很小，與橋梁自重相比可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rail braking forces are tiny compared with self-weight and can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鐵路制動力與縱向約束」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rail braking and longitudinal restraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測
knowledge.titleEn: Rail loads, braking and dynamic response
knowledge.text: 列車在橋上煞車或起動時，鋼軌把縱向力傳到橋面，再經支承與固定墩傳到基礎，所以每個連續單元都需要明確的縱向固定點。鐵路也對橋梁動態敏感：列車通過的頻率若接近橋梁的振動頻率，會出現共振放大，影響乘坐舒適與道床穩定。
knowledge.textEn: When trains brake or accelerate on the bridge, the rails pass longitudinal force into the deck, then through bearings and fixed piers to the foundations, so every continuous unit needs a clear longitudinal fixed point. Rail is also sensitive to dynamics: if axle passage frequencies approach a bridge frequency, resonance amplifies response, affecting comfort and track stability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鐵路的制動力很小，與橋梁自重相比可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rail braking forces are tiny compared with self-weight and can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response" is correct?
options: 鐵路的制動力很小，與橋梁自重相比可以忽略。
列車在橋上煞車或起動時，鋼軌把縱向力傳到橋面，再經支承與固定墩傳到基礎，所以每個連續單元都需要明確的縱向固定點。
只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。
optionsEn: Rail braking forces are tiny compared with self-weight and can be ignored.

When trains brake or accelerate on the bridge, the rails pass longitudinal force into the deck, then through bearings and fixed piers to the foundations, so every continuous unit needs a clear longitudinal fixed point.
A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection.
quiz.explanation: 列車在橋上煞車或起動時，鋼軌把縱向力傳到橋面，再經支承與固定墩傳到基礎，所以每個連續單元都需要明確的縱向固定點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When trains brake or accelerate on the bridge, the rails pass longitudinal force into the deck, then through bearings and fixed piers to the foundations, so every continuous unit needs a clear longitudinal fixed point. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail loads, braking and dynamic response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鐵路制動力與縱向約束」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail braking and longitudinal restraint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：依 EN 1991-2 的特徵值，制動力 Q_lbk = 20 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 6,000 kN），起動力 Q_lak = 33 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 1,000 kN）。一個 140 m 引橋跨：制動力 20×140 = 2,800 kN，起動力 33×140 = 4,620 kN 但取上限 1,000 kN。固定墩須承擔 2,800 kN 的縱向力加溫度與摩擦力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using EN 1991-2 characteristic values, braking Q_lbk = 20 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 6,000 kN) and traction Q_lak = 33 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 1,000 kN). On one 140 m approach span, braking is 20×140 = 2,800 kN, and traction 33×140 = 4,620 kN is capped at 1,000 kN. The fixed pier must take the 2,800 kN plus thermal and friction forces. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：完工前以實際列車在不同速度下通過，量測橋面加速度、跨中撓度、支承縱向位移與鋼軌應力，並與動態分析比較；鐵路主管機關依量測確認橋面加速度與鋼軌附加應力在限值內後，才開放營運速度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before opening, run trains at several speeds while measuring deck acceleration, mid-span deflection, longitudinal bearing movement and rail stresses, comparing them with dynamic analysis; the railway authority releases operating speeds only after confirming deck accelerations and additional rail stresses are within limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 依 EN 1991-2 的特徵值，制動力 Q_lbk = 20 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 6,000 kN），起動力 Q_lak = 33 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 1,000 kN）。一個 140 m 引橋跨：制動力 20×140 = 2,800 kN，起動力 33×140 = 4,620 kN 但取上限 1,000 kN。固定墩須承擔 2,800 kN 的縱向力加溫度與摩擦力。
knowledge.textEn: Using EN 1991-2 characteristic values, braking Q_lbk = 20 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 6,000 kN) and traction Q_lak = 33 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 1,000 kN). On one 140 m approach span, braking is 20×140 = 2,800 kN, and traction 33×140 = 4,620 kN is capped at 1,000 kN. The fixed pier must take the 2,800 kN plus thermal and friction forces.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response", which statement holds?
options: 長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。
鐵路與公路共用一座橋時，只要把兩種荷載相加就完成設計。
依 EN 1991-2 的特徵值，制動力 Q_lbk = 20 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 6,000 kN），起動力 Q_lak = 33 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 1,000 kN）。
optionsEn: Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length.
When rail and road share a bridge, simply adding the two loads completes the design.
Using EN 1991-2 characteristic values, braking Q_lbk = 20 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 6,000 kN) and traction Q_lak = 33 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 1,000 kN).
quiz.explanation: 依 EN 1991-2 的特徵值，制動力 Q_lbk = 20 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 6,000 kN），起動力 Q_lak = 33 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 1,000 kN）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Using EN 1991-2 characteristic values, braking Q_lbk = 20 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 6,000 kN) and traction Q_lak = 33 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 1,000 kN). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail loads, braking and dynamic response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鐵路制動力與縱向約束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail braking and longitudinal restraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 完工前以實際列車在不同速度下通過，量測橋面加速度、跨中撓度、支承縱向位移與鋼軌應力，並與動態分析比較；鐵路主管機關依量測確認橋面加速度與鋼軌附加應力在限值內後，才開放營運速度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before opening, run trains at several speeds while measuring deck acceleration, mid-span deflection, longitudinal bearing movement and rail stresses, comparing them with dynamic analysis; the railway authority releases operating speeds only after confirming deck accelerations and additional rail stresses are within limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鐵路橋設計應由結構與軌道工程師共同完成縱向交互作用分析，明訂固定墩位置、支承摩擦假設與鋼軌伸縮調節器位置；營運前的列車試驗計畫須經鐵路主管機關核准並列為開放營運的停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Rail bridges need a joint structural–track analysis of longitudinal interaction that fixes the fixed piers, bearing friction assumptions and rail expansion device locations; the pre-opening train test plan is approved by the railway authority and is a hold point before operation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：固定墩或縱向約束不足時，列車制動使梁體縱向滑移，支承與伸縮裝置受損；若忽略鋼軌與橋梁的交互作用，夏季高溫加上制動可能使鋼軌附加壓應力過大，增加軌道挫屈風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With an inadequate fixed pier or restraint, braking slides the deck longitudinally and damages bearings and expansion devices; ignoring rail–bridge interaction can let summer heat plus braking raise additional compressive rail stress enough to increase track-buckling risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 完工前以實際列車在不同速度下通過，量測橋面加速度、跨中撓度、支承縱向位移與鋼軌應力，並與動態分析比較；鐵路主管機關依量測確認橋面加速度與鋼軌附加應力在限值內後，才開放營運速度。
knowledge.textEn: Before opening, run trains at several speeds while measuring deck acceleration, mid-span deflection, longitudinal bearing movement and rail stresses, comparing them with dynamic analysis; the railway authority releases operating speeds only after confirming deck accelerations and additional rail stresses are within limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鐵路橋設計應由結構與軌道工程師共同完成縱向交互作用分析，明訂固定墩位置、支承摩擦假設與鋼軌伸縮調節器位置；營運前的列車試驗計畫須經鐵路主管機關核准並列為開放營運的停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Rail bridges need a joint structural–track analysis of longitudinal interaction that fixes the fixed piers, bearing friction assumptions and rail expansion device locations; the pre-opening train test plan is approved by the railway authority and is a hold point before operation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response"?
options: 完工前以實際列車在不同速度下通過，量測橋面加速度、跨中撓度、支承縱向位移與鋼軌應力，並與動態分析比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
