optionsEn: Before opening, run trains at several speeds while measuring deck acceleration, mid-span deflection, longitudinal bearing movement and rail stresses, comparing them with dynamic analysis.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A concrete pylon is only in compression, so local stresses at the anchorages are no concern.
quiz.explanation: 完工前以實際列車在不同速度下通過，量測橋面加速度、跨中撓度、支承縱向位移與鋼軌應力，並與動態分析比較；鐵路主管機關依量測確認橋面加速度與鋼軌附加應力在限值內後，才開放營運速度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before opening, run trains at several speeds while measuring deck acceleration, mid-span deflection, longitudinal bearing movement and rail stresses, comparing them with dynamic analysis; the railway authority releases operating speeds only after confirming deck accelerations and additional rail stresses are within limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rail loads, braking and dynamic response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鐵路制動力與縱向約束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail braking and longitudinal restraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 固定墩或縱向約束不足時，列車制動使梁體縱向滑移，支承與伸縮裝置受損；若忽略鋼軌與橋梁的交互作用，夏季高溫加上制動可能使鋼軌附加壓應力過大，增加軌道挫屈風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With an inadequate fixed pier or restraint, braking slides the deck longitudinally and damages bearings and expansion devices; ignoring rail–bridge interaction can let summer heat plus braking raise additional compressive rail stress enough to increase track-buckling risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雙層桁架的大梁深提供高勁度，但支承、固定墩與鋼軌之間的縱向交互作用仍需專門分析，因為溫度伸縮、列車制動與鋼軌應力會互相疊加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The deep double-deck truss gives high stiffness, but longitudinal interaction between bearings, fixed piers and rails still needs dedicated analysis because thermal movement, braking and rail stresses add together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鐵路的制動力很小，與橋梁自重相比可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rail braking forces are tiny compared with self-weight and can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 固定墩或縱向約束不足時，列車制動使梁體縱向滑移，支承與伸縮裝置受損；若忽略鋼軌與橋梁的交互作用，夏季高溫加上制動可能使鋼軌附加壓應力過大，增加軌道挫屈風險。
knowledge.textEn: With an inadequate fixed pier or restraint, braking slides the deck longitudinally and damages bearings and expansion devices; ignoring rail–bridge interaction can let summer heat plus braking raise additional compressive rail stress enough to increase track-buckling risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
固定墩或縱向約束不足時，列車制動使梁體縱向滑移，支承與伸縮裝置受損；若忽略鋼軌與橋梁的交互作用，夏季高溫加上制動可能使鋼軌附加壓應力過大，增加軌道挫屈風險。
只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
With an inadequate fixed pier or restraint, braking slides the deck longitudinally and damages bearings and expansion devices.
A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection.
quiz.explanation: 固定墩或縱向約束不足時，列車制動使梁體縱向滑移，支承與伸縮裝置受損；若忽略鋼軌與橋梁的交互作用，夏季高溫加上制動可能使鋼軌附加壓應力過大，增加軌道挫屈風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With an inadequate fixed pier or restraint, braking slides the deck longitudinally and damages bearings and expansion devices; ignoring rail–bridge interaction can let summer heat plus braking raise additional compressive rail stress enough to increase track-buckling risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 船舶撞擊風險與防撞島：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ship-impact risk and protective islands: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「防撞人工島」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Protective islands” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 厄勒海峽是繁忙航道，公開資料指出德羅格登航道每年約 4 萬艘船通過，高橋下方的弗林特航道約佔一成。橋墩與橋塔若被大型船舶撞擊，可能造成倒塌與人命傷亡，因此設計者在橋塔與鄰近橋墩周圍設置人工島，使偏航船舶先擱淺或被導開，而不是直接撞上結構。船撞設計通常以風險法進行：估計每年經過的船數、偏航機率、撞到特定構造物的幾何機率與撞擊後倒塌機率，乘積須低於可接受的年頻率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「防撞人工島」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Øresund is a busy waterway: published data cite about 40,000 ships a year through the Drogden channel, with the Flinte channel under the high bridge carrying about a tenth. A large ship striking a pier or pylon could cause collapse and loss of life, so designers placed artificial islands around the pylons and nearby piers so that an errant ship grounds or is deflected before reaching the structure. Ship-impact design usually follows a risk method: estimate annual vessel passages, the probability of aberrancy, the geometric probability of hitting a given element and the probability of collapse given a hit, whose product must fall below an acceptable annual frequency. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Protective islands” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：年倒塌頻率 AF = N·PA·PG·PC。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Annual collapse frequency AF = N·PA·PG·PC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「防撞人工島」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Protective islands”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 船舶撞擊風險與防撞島
knowledge.text: 厄勒海峽是繁忙航道，公開資料指出德羅格登航道每年約 4 萬艘船通過，高橋下方的弗林特航道約佔一成。橋墩與橋塔若被大型船舶撞擊，可能造成倒塌與人命傷亡，因此設計者在橋塔與鄰近橋墩周圍設置人工島，使偏航船舶先擱淺或被導開，而不是直接撞上結構。
knowledge.textEn: The Øresund is a busy waterway: published data cite about 40,000 ships a year through the Drogden channel, with the Flinte channel under the high bridge carrying about a tenth. A large ship striking a pier or pylon could cause collapse and loss of life, so designers placed artificial islands around the pylons and nearby piers so that an errant ship grounds or is deflected before reaching the structure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「船舶撞擊風險與防撞島」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ship-impact risk and protective islands" is correct?
options: 只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。
鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。
厄勒海峽是繁忙航道，公開資料指出德羅格登航道每年約 4 萬艘船通過，高橋下方的弗林特航道約佔一成。
optionsEn: A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection.
A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems.
The Øresund is a busy waterway: published data cite about 40,000 ships a year through the Drogden channel, with the Flinte channel under the high bridge carrying about a tenth.
quiz.explanation: 厄勒海峽是繁忙航道，公開資料指出德羅格登航道每年約 4 萬艘船通過，高橋下方的弗林特航道約佔一成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Øresund is a busy waterway: published data cite about 40,000 ships a year through the Drogden channel, with the Flinte channel under the high bridge carrying about a tenth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 船舶撞擊風險與防撞島：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ship-impact risk and protective islands: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防撞人工島」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Protective islands” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：年倒塌頻率 AF = N·PA·PG·PC。取 N = 4,000 艘/年、PA = 1×10⁻⁴、PG = 0.05、PC = 0.1：AF = 4,000×10⁻⁴×0.05×0.1 = 2.0×10⁻³ /年，遠高於常用的 1×10⁻⁴；人工島使船舶到達結構的幾何機率降到 PG = 0.002 時，AF = 8×10⁻⁵ /年。機率值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Annual collapse frequency AF = N·PA·PG·PC. With N = 4,000 ships a year, PA = 1×10⁻⁴, PG = 0.05 and PC = 0.1, AF = 4,000×10⁻⁴×0.05×0.1 = 2.0×10⁻³ per year, far above the commonly used 1×10⁻⁴; islands that cut the geometric probability to PG = 0.002 give AF = 8×10⁻⁵ per year. Probabilities are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以航道交通調查、船型分布與航跡資料建立風險模型，對每座墩與塔計算撞擊能量與年頻率；人工島與護岸以船舶擱淺模擬或船撞數值分析檢核其吸能與阻擋效果，並把結果與業主訂定的風險準則逐項比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the risk model from vessel traffic surveys, fleet distributions and track data, computing impact energy and annual frequency for every pier and pylon; check the islands and revetments by grounding simulations or ship-collision analyses for energy absorption and stopping effect, comparing results item by item with the owner's risk criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 年倒塌頻率 AF = N·PA·PG·PC。取 N = 4,000 艘/年、PA = 1×10⁻⁴、PG = 0.05、PC = 0.1：AF = 4,000×10⁻⁴×0.05×0.1 = 2.0×10⁻³ /年，遠高於常用的 1×10⁻⁴；人工島使船舶到達結構的幾何機率降到 PG = 0.002 時，AF = 8×10⁻⁵ /年。機率值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Annual collapse frequency AF = N·PA·PG·PC. With N = 4,000 ships a year, PA = 1×10⁻⁴, PG = 0.05 and PC = 0.1, AF = 4,000×10⁻⁴×0.05×0.1 = 2.0×10⁻³ per year, far above the commonly used 1×10⁻⁴; islands that cut the geometric probability to PG = 0.002 give AF = 8×10⁻⁵ per year. Probabilities are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「船舶撞擊風險與防撞島」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ship-impact risk and protective islands", which statement holds?
options: 年倒塌頻率 AF = N·PA·PG·PC。
橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。
預鑄沉箱又重又大，放到海床上自然就會穩固。
optionsEn: Annual collapse frequency AF = N·PA·PG·PC.
Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow.
A precast caisson is so heavy that it becomes stable simply by being set on the seabed.
quiz.explanation: 年倒塌頻率 AF = N·PA·PG·PC。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual collapse frequency AF = N·PA·PG·PC. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 船舶撞擊風險與防撞島：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ship-impact risk and protective islands: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防撞人工島」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Protective islands” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以航道交通調查、船型分布與航跡資料建立風險模型，對每座墩與塔計算撞擊能量與年頻率；人工島與護岸以船舶擱淺模擬或船撞數值分析檢核其吸能與阻擋效果，並把結果與業主訂定的風險準則逐項比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the risk model from vessel traffic surveys, fleet distributions and track data, computing impact energy and annual frequency for every pier and pylon; check the islands and revetments by grounding simulations or ship-collision analyses for energy absorption and stopping effect, comparing results item by item with the owner's risk criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應在設計基準中訂定可接受的年倒塌頻率與設計船舶，並要求營運期定期更新航道交通資料重新評估；防撞島、導航燈與船舶交通管理系統屬於同一套防護體系，任何一項變更都要重新檢核整體風險。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should fix the acceptable annual collapse frequency and design vessels in the design basis and require periodic reassessment with updated traffic data; protective islands, navigation lights and vessel traffic management form one protection system, so changing any of them requires a fresh overall risk check.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以單一設計船舶的撞擊力設計橋墩而不做風險分析，可能在交通量最高或最脆弱的位置留下風險缺口；航道船型日後變大而未重新評估，原本足夠的防護可能不再有效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing piers for one design vessel's impact force without risk analysis can leave a gap at the busiest or most vulnerable positions; if the fleet grows larger without reassessment, protection that was once adequate may no longer suffice. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以航道交通調查、船型分布與航跡資料建立風險模型，對每座墩與塔計算撞擊能量與年頻率；人工島與護岸以船舶擱淺模擬或船撞數值分析檢核其吸能與阻擋效果，並把結果與業主訂定的風險準則逐項比較。
knowledge.textEn: Build the risk model from vessel traffic surveys, fleet distributions and track data, computing impact energy and annual frequency for every pier and pylon; check the islands and revetments by grounding simulations or ship-collision analyses for energy absorption and stopping effect, comparing results item by item with the owner's risk criteria.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主應在設計基準中訂定可接受的年倒塌頻率與設計船舶，並要求營運期定期更新航道交通資料重新評估；防撞島、導航燈與船舶交通管理系統屬於同一套防護體系，任何一項變更都要重新檢核整體風險。
knowledge.textEn: The owner should fix the acceptable annual collapse frequency and design vessels in the design basis and require periodic reassessment with updated traffic data; protective islands, navigation lights and vessel traffic management form one protection system, so changing any of them requires a fresh overall risk check.

quiz.question: 要驗證「船舶撞擊風險與防撞島」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ship-impact risk and protective islands"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以航道交通調查、船型分布與航跡資料建立風險模型，對每座墩與塔計算撞擊能量與年頻率。
只要浮吊額定能力大於梁段重量，就可以在任何海況下吊裝。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Build the risk model from vessel traffic surveys, fleet distributions and track data, computing impact energy and annual frequency for every pier and pylon.
If the floating crane's rating exceeds the span weight, lifting is safe in any sea state.
quiz.explanation: 以航道交通調查、船型分布與航跡資料建立風險模型，對每座墩與塔計算撞擊能量與年頻率；人工島與護岸以船舶擱淺模擬或船撞數值分析檢核其吸能與阻擋效果，並把結果與業主訂定的風險準則逐項比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the risk model from vessel traffic surveys, fleet distributions and track data, computing impact energy and annual frequency for every pier and pylon; check the islands and revetments by grounding simulations or ship-collision analyses for energy absorption and stopping effect, comparing results item by item with the owner's risk criteria. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 船舶撞擊風險與防撞島：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ship-impact risk and protective islands: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防撞人工島」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Protective islands” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以單一設計船舶的撞擊力設計橋墩而不做風險分析，可能在交通量最高或最脆弱的位置留下風險缺口；航道船型日後變大而未重新評估，原本足夠的防護可能不再有效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing piers for one design vessel's impact force without risk analysis can leave a gap at the busiest or most vulnerable positions; if the fleet grows larger without reassessment, protection that was once adequate may no longer suffice. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：船撞設計通常以風險法進行：估計每年經過的船數、偏航機率、撞到特定構造物的幾何機率與撞擊後倒塌機率，乘積須低於可接受的年頻率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ship-impact design usually follows a risk method: estimate annual vessel passages, the probability of aberrancy, the geometric probability of hitting a given element and the probability of collapse given a hit, whose product must fall below an acceptable annual frequency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以單一設計船舶的撞擊力設計橋墩而不做風險分析，可能在交通量最高或最脆弱的位置留下風險缺口；航道船型日後變大而未重新評估，原本足夠的防護可能不再有效。
knowledge.textEn: Designing piers for one design vessel's impact force without risk analysis can leave a gap at the busiest or most vulnerable positions; if the fleet grows larger without reassessment, protection that was once adequate may no longer suffice.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「船舶撞擊風險與防撞島」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ship-impact risk and protective islands" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。
若只以單一設計船舶的撞擊力設計橋墩而不做風險分析，可能在交通量最高或最脆弱的位置留下風險缺口；航道船型日後變大而未重新評估，原本足夠的防護可能不再有效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems.
Designing piers for one design vessel's impact force without risk analysis can leave a gap at the busiest or most vulnerable positions.
quiz.explanation: 若只以單一設計船舶的撞擊力設計橋墩而不做風險分析，可能在交通量最高或最脆弱的位置留下風險缺口；航道船型日後變大而未重新評估，原本足夠的防護可能不再有效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing piers for one design vessel's impact force without risk analysis can leave a gap at the busiest or most vulnerable positions; if the fleet grows larger without reassessment, protection that was once adequate may no longer suffice. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕」與「鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles" and "Rail expansion devices and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鐵路縱梁疲勞細節」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail stringer fatigue details” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鐵路荷載重複性高、軸重大，每列車通過都在縱梁、橫梁與桁架節點產生多次應力循環，因此鋼桁的設計壽命常由疲勞而不是強度控制。焊接細節的類別決定可承受的應力幅：橫向角焊、加勁板端部與開孔處是常見的弱點。海峽環境的鹽霧又會讓塗裝劣化、在節點縫隙形成腐蝕，腐蝕坑會成為新的疲勞起點。斜索則以鍍鋅、塗蠟與塑膠套管多層防護，重點在於讓水無法積在錨頭與套管接頭。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鐵路縱梁疲勞細節」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rail loading is highly repetitive with heavy axles, and every train produces several stress cycles in stringers, cross-girders and truss joints, so the life of a steel truss is often governed by fatigue rather than strength. The detail category sets the tolerable stress range, with transverse fillet welds, stiffener ends and cut-outs as common weak points. Salt spray in the strait degrades coatings and drives crevice corrosion at joints, and corrosion pits become new fatigue initiation sites. Stays rely on layered protection of galvanising, wax and plastic sheathing, the key being that water cannot collect at anchor heads or sheath joints. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rail stringer fatigue details” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EN 1993-1-9：細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa，等幅疲勞限 Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa（5×10⁶ 次）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1993-1-9: for detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa the constant-amplitude limit is Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa at 5×10⁶ cycles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鐵路縱梁疲勞細節」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rail stringer fatigue details”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕
knowledge.titleEn: Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles
knowledge.text: 鐵路荷載重複性高、軸重大，每列車通過都在縱梁、橫梁與桁架節點產生多次應力循環，因此鋼桁的設計壽命常由疲勞而不是強度控制。焊接細節的類別決定可承受的應力幅：橫向角焊、加勁板端部與開孔處是常見的弱點。
knowledge.textEn: Rail loading is highly repetitive with heavy axles, and every train produces several stress cycles in stringers, cross-girders and truss joints, so the life of a steel truss is often governed by fatigue rather than strength. The detail category sets the tolerable stress range, with transverse fillet welds, stiffener ends and cut-outs as common weak points.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles" is correct?
options: 鐵路荷載重複性高、軸重大，每列車通過都在縱梁、橫梁與桁架節點產生多次應力循環，因此鋼桁的設計壽命常由疲勞而不是強度控制。
鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。
長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。
optionsEn: Rail loading is highly repetitive with heavy axles, and every train produces several stress cycles in stringers, cross-girders and truss joints, so the life of a steel truss is often governed by fatigue rather than strength.
A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems.
Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length.
quiz.explanation: 鐵路荷載重複性高、軸重大，每列車通過都在縱梁、橫梁與桁架節點產生多次應力循環，因此鋼桁的設計壽命常由疲勞而不是強度控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rail loading is highly repetitive with heavy axles, and every train produces several stress cycles in stringers, cross-girders and truss joints, so the life of a steel truss is often governed by fatigue rather than strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鐵路縱梁疲勞細節」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail stringer fatigue details” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-9：細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa，等幅疲勞限 Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa（5×10⁶ 次）。若 100 年內有 200 列車/日 × 365 × 100 = 7.3×10⁶ 次主要循環，m = 5 段延伸得 Δσ ≈ 52.3×(5×10⁶/7.3×10⁶)^(1/5) ≈ 48.5 MPa。交通量與單一循環假設為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1993-1-9: for detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa the constant-amplitude limit is Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa at 5×10⁶ cycles. With 200 trains a day × 365 × 100 = 7.3×10⁶ main cycles in 100 years, extending with slope m = 5 gives Δσ ≈ 52.3×(5×10⁶/7.3×10⁶)^(1/5) ≈ 48.5 MPa. Traffic and one-cycle-per-train are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以應變計量測列車通過時代表性細節的應力歷時，用雨流計數求等效應力幅並與設計值比較；定期檢查節點、焊趾與塗裝，以磁粒或超音波檢測可疑裂紋，並量測塗膜厚度與鏽蝕等級建立劣化趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Strain-gauge representative details under train passages, derive equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design; inspect joints, weld toes and coatings regularly, test suspect cracks by magnetic particle or ultrasonics, and measure coating thickness and rust grade to build deterioration trends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EN 1993-1-9：細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa，等幅疲勞限 Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa（5×10⁶ 次）。若 100 年內有 200 列車/日 × 365 × 100 = 7.3×10⁶ 次主要循環，m = 5 段延伸得 Δσ ≈ 52.3×(5×10⁶/7.3×10⁶)^(1/5) ≈ 48.5 MPa。交通量與單一循環假設為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: EN 1993-1-9: for detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa the constant-amplitude limit is Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa at 5×10⁶ cycles. With 200 trains a day × 365 × 100 = 7.3×10⁶ main cycles in 100 years, extending with slope m = 5 gives Δσ ≈ 52.3×(5×10⁶/7.3×10⁶)^(1/5) ≈ 48.5 MPa. Traffic and one-cycle-per-train are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles", which statement holds?
options: 鐵路與公路共用一座橋時，只要把兩種荷載相加就完成設計。
EN 1993-1-9：細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa，等幅疲勞限 Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa（5×10⁶ 次）。
混凝土橋塔只受壓，不需要擔心錨碇區的局部應力。
optionsEn: When rail and road share a bridge, simply adding the two loads completes the design.
EN 1993-1-9: for detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa the constant-amplitude limit is Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa at 5×10⁶ cycles.
A concrete pylon is only in compression, so local stresses at the anchorages are no concern.
quiz.explanation: EN 1993-1-9：細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa，等幅疲勞限 Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa（5×10⁶ 次）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: EN 1993-1-9: for detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa the constant-amplitude limit is Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa at 5×10⁶ cycles. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鐵路縱梁疲勞細節」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail stringer fatigue details” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以應變計量測列車通過時代表性細節的應力歷時，用雨流計數求等效應力幅並與設計值比較；定期檢查節點、焊趾與塗裝，以磁粒或超音波檢測可疑裂紋，並量測塗膜厚度與鏽蝕等級建立劣化趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Strain-gauge representative details under train passages, derive equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design; inspect joints, weld toes and coatings regularly, test suspect cracks by magnetic particle or ultrasonics, and measure coating thickness and rust grade to build deterioration trends. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢查計畫應依疲勞細節類別與實測應力幅排定優先順序，最敏感的細節縮短檢查週期；塗裝維修與疲勞檢查同時規劃，噴砂後先做裂紋檢測再重新塗裝，避免把裂紋封在漆膜下。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection plan should prioritise details by category and measured stress range, shortening intervals for the most sensitive; schedule repainting together with fatigue inspection, testing for cracks after blasting and before recoating so cracks are not sealed under paint.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：疲勞裂紋若出現在縱梁與橫梁連接處而未被發現，裂紋擴展可能導致縱梁失去支撐、軌道沉陷；塗裝失效處的腐蝕坑讓疲勞強度再降一級，原本足夠的壽命大幅縮短。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An undetected fatigue crack at a stringer-to-cross-girder connection can grow until the stringer loses support and the track settles; corrosion pits where coating has failed lower fatigue strength by another category, sharply shortening a life that was once adequate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以應變計量測列車通過時代表性細節的應力歷時，用雨流計數求等效應力幅並與設計值比較；定期檢查節點、焊趾與塗裝，以磁粒或超音波檢測可疑裂紋，並量測塗膜厚度與鏽蝕等級建立劣化趨勢。

knowledge.text: 檢查計畫應依疲勞細節類別與實測應力幅排定優先順序，最敏感的細節縮短檢查週期；塗裝維修與疲勞檢查同時規劃，噴砂後先做裂紋檢測再重新塗裝，避免把裂紋封在漆膜下。

quiz.question: 要驗證「鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。
以應變計量測列車通過時代表性細節的應力歷時，用雨流計數求等效應力幅並與設計值比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right.
Strain-gauge representative details under train passages, derive equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design.
quiz.explanation: 以應變計量測列車通過時代表性細節的應力歷時，用雨流計數求等效應力幅並與設計值比較；定期檢查節點、焊趾與塗裝，以磁粒或超音波檢測可疑裂紋，並量測塗膜厚度與鏽蝕等級建立劣化趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Strain-gauge representative details under train passages, derive equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design; inspect joints, weld toes and coatings regularly, test suspect cracks by magnetic particle or ultrasonics, and measure coating thickness and rust grade to build deterioration trends. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鐵路縱梁疲勞細節」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail stringer fatigue details” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 疲勞裂紋若出現在縱梁與橫梁連接處而未被發現，裂紋擴展可能導致縱梁失去支撐、軌道沉陷；塗裝失效處的腐蝕坑讓疲勞強度再降一級，原本足夠的壽命大幅縮短。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An undetected fatigue crack at a stringer-to-cross-girder connection can grow until the stringer loses support and the track settles; corrosion pits where coating has failed lower fatigue strength by another category, sharply shortening a life that was once adequate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：斜索則以鍍鋅、塗蠟與塑膠套管多層防護，重點在於讓水無法積在錨頭與套管接頭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stays rely on layered protection of galvanising, wax and plastic sheathing, the key being that water cannot collect at anchor heads or sheath joints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 疲勞裂紋若出現在縱梁與橫梁連接處而未被發現，裂紋擴展可能導致縱梁失去支撐、軌道沉陷；塗裝失效處的腐蝕坑讓疲勞強度再降一級，原本足夠的壽命大幅縮短。
knowledge.textEn: An undetected fatigue crack at a stringer-to-cross-girder connection can grow until the stringer loses support and the track settles; corrosion pits where coating has failed lower fatigue strength by another category, sharply shortening a life that was once adequate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 疲勞裂紋若出現在縱梁與橫梁連接處而未被發現，裂紋擴展可能導致縱梁失去支撐、軌道沉陷；塗裝失效處的腐蝕坑讓疲勞強度再降一級，原本足夠的壽命大幅縮短。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。
optionsEn: An undetected fatigue crack at a stringer-to-cross-girder connection can grow until the stringer loses support and the track settles.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length.
quiz.explanation: 疲勞裂紋若出現在縱梁與橫梁連接處而未被發現，裂紋擴展可能導致縱梁失去支撐、軌道沉陷；塗裝失效處的腐蝕坑讓疲勞強度再降一級，原本足夠的壽命大幅縮短。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An undetected fatigue crack at a stringer-to-cross-girder connection can grow until the stringer loses support and the track settles; corrosion pits where coating has failed lower fatigue strength by another category, sharply shortening a life that was once adequate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail expansion devices and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼軌伸縮調節器」如何影響厄勒海峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail expansion devices” governs force, deformation or durability in “Oresund Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 長焊鋼軌只能吸收有限的橋梁伸縮，當連續單元太長、梁端伸縮量超過鋼軌與道床可承受的範圍，就必須在梁端設置鋼軌伸縮調節器，讓兩段鋼軌相對滑動。斜張高橋長 1,092 公尺，加上溫度、列車制動與潛變的影響，梁端的縱向位移遠大於一般短跨。交接時營運單位需要完整的伸縮紀錄：各單元的固定點、伸縮縫與調節器的設計行程、竣工時的設定值與溫度，以及檢查與更換程序，才能判斷日後的位移是否正常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼軌伸縮調節器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Continuous welded rail can absorb only limited bridge movement; when a continuous unit is so long that end movement exceeds what rail and ballast can take, rail expansion devices are needed at the deck ends so the two rails can slide relative to each other. The cable-stayed high bridge is 1,092 m long, and with temperature, braking and creep its end movements are far larger than for short spans. At handover the operator needs complete movement records: fixed points of each unit, design travel of joints and rail devices, set values and temperatures at completion, and inspection and replacement procedures, to judge whether later movements are normal. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rail expansion devices” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：高橋長 1,092 m，若以中央為不動點，梁端受影響長度 546 m；鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、溫差 40 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×546×40 ≈ 0.262 m = 262 mm，遠超過長焊鋼軌在無調節器下通常可容許的梁端伸縮，因此需設鋼軌伸縮調節器。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The high bridge is 1,092 m long; fixed at the centre, each end is driven by 546 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼軌伸縮調節器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rail expansion devices”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接
knowledge.text: 長焊鋼軌只能吸收有限的橋梁伸縮，當連續單元太長、梁端伸縮量超過鋼軌與道床可承受的範圍，就必須在梁端設置鋼軌伸縮調節器，讓兩段鋼軌相對滑動。斜張高橋長 1,092 公尺，加上溫度、列車制動與潛變的影響，梁端的縱向位移遠大於一般短跨。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rail expansion devices and handover" is correct?
options: 長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。
長焊鋼軌只能吸收有限的橋梁伸縮，當連續單元太長、梁端伸縮量超過鋼軌與道床可承受的範圍，就必須在梁端設置鋼軌伸縮調節器，讓兩段鋼軌相對滑動。
橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。
optionsEn: Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length.
Continuous welded rail can absorb only limited bridge movement.
Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow.
quiz.explanation: 長焊鋼軌只能吸收有限的橋梁伸縮，當連續單元太長、梁端伸縮量超過鋼軌與道床可承受的範圍，就必須在梁端設置鋼軌伸縮調節器，讓兩段鋼軌相對滑動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail expansion devices and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼軌伸縮調節器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail expansion devices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：高橋長 1,092 m，若以中央為不動點，梁端受影響長度 546 m；鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、溫差 40 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×546×40 ≈ 0.262 m = 262 mm，遠超過長焊鋼軌在無調節器下通常可容許的梁端伸縮，因此需設鋼軌伸縮調節器。固定點與溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The high bridge is 1,092 m long; fixed at the centre, each end is driven by 546 m. With α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and a 40 °C range, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×546×40 ≈ 0.262 m = 262 mm, far beyond the end movement continuous welded rail can usually accept without a device, so rail expansion devices are needed. Fixed point and range are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：竣工時記錄調節器尖軌位置、伸縮縫開口與梁溫；營運中按季節量測並繪出位移與溫度關係，斜率偏離或出現殘餘漂移即檢查支承與固定墩；鐵路單位同步量測軌距、軌向與鋼軌溫度，確認調節器滑動順暢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At completion record switch-blade positions of the rail devices, joint openings and deck temperature; in service measure seasonally and plot movement against temperature, inspecting bearings and fixed piers if the slope departs or drift appears; the railway operator measures gauge, alignment and rail temperature at the same time to confirm the devices slide freely.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail expansion devices and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼軌伸縮調節器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail expansion devices” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 竣工時記錄調節器尖軌位置、伸縮縫開口與梁溫；營運中按季節量測並繪出位移與溫度關係，斜率偏離或出現殘餘漂移即檢查支承與固定墩；鐵路單位同步量測軌距、軌向與鋼軌溫度，確認調節器滑動順暢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At completion record switch-blade positions of the rail devices, joint openings and deck temperature; in service measure seasonally and plot movement against temperature, inspecting bearings and fixed piers if the slope departs or drift appears; the railway operator measures gauge, alignment and rail temperature at the same time to confirm the devices slide freely. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應整合公路與鐵路兩套資料：伸縮縫與調節器的型號、行程、設定溫度、更換程序與封閉時段，以及斜索索力、橋塔線形與船撞防護的基準；並約定公路與鐵路營運單位之間的通報與聯合檢查機制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should merge road and rail documentation: types, travel, set temperatures, replacement procedures and possession windows for joints and rail devices, plus baselines for stay forces, pylon geometry and ship-impact protection, and agree a notification and joint-inspection protocol between road and rail operators.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：調節器卡滯或設定位置錯誤時，夏季高溫可能使尖軌頂死、鋼軌承受過大壓力，冬季則開口過大影響行車；若伸縮紀錄在交接時遺失，管理單位無法分辨正常溫度位移與支承或基礎異常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A seized or mis-set rail device can jam in summer heat and overstress the rails, or open too far in winter and affect running; if movement records are lost at handover, the operator cannot tell normal thermal movement from bearing or foundation problems. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 竣工時記錄調節器尖軌位置、伸縮縫開口與梁溫；營運中按季節量測並繪出位移與溫度關係，斜率偏離或出現殘餘漂移即檢查支承與固定墩；鐵路單位同步量測軌距、軌向與鋼軌溫度，確認調節器滑動順暢。
knowledge.textEn: At completion record switch-blade positions of the rail devices, joint openings and deck temperature; in service measure seasonally and plot movement against temperature, inspecting bearings and fixed piers if the slope departs or drift appears; the railway operator measures gauge, alignment and rail temperature at the same time to confirm the devices slide freely.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應整合公路與鐵路兩套資料：伸縮縫與調節器的型號、行程、設定溫度、更換程序與封閉時段，以及斜索索力、橋塔線形與船撞防護的基準；並約定公路與鐵路營運單位之間的通報與聯合檢查機制。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should merge road and rail documentation: types, travel, set temperatures, replacement procedures and possession windows for joints and rail devices, plus baselines for stay forces, pylon geometry and ship-impact protection, and agree a notification and joint-inspection protocol between road and rail operators.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rail expansion devices and handover"?
options: 竣工時記錄調節器尖軌位置、伸縮縫開口與梁溫。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鐵路的制動力很小，與橋梁自重相比可以忽略。
optionsEn: At completion record switch-blade positions of the rail devices, joint openings and deck temperature.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Rail braking forces are tiny compared with self-weight and can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 竣工時記錄調節器尖軌位置、伸縮縫開口與梁溫；營運中按季節量測並繪出位移與溫度關係，斜率偏離或出現殘餘漂移即檢查支承與固定墩；鐵路單位同步量測軌距、軌向與鋼軌溫度，確認調節器滑動順暢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At completion record switch-blade positions of the rail devices, joint openings and deck temperature; in service measure seasonally and plot movement against temperature, inspecting bearings and fixed piers if the slope departs or drift appears; the railway operator measures gauge, alignment and rail temperature at the same time to confirm the devices slide freely. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rail expansion devices and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼軌伸縮調節器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail expansion devices” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 調節器卡滯或設定位置錯誤時，夏季高溫可能使尖軌頂死、鋼軌承受過大壓力，冬季則開口過大影響行車；若伸縮紀錄在交接時遺失，管理單位無法分辨正常溫度位移與支承或基礎異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized or mis-set rail device can jam in summer heat and overstress the rails, or open too far in winter and affect running; if movement records are lost at handover, the operator cannot tell normal thermal movement from bearing or foundation problems. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時營運單位需要完整的伸縮紀錄：各單元的固定點、伸縮縫與調節器的設計行程、竣工時的設定值與溫度，以及檢查與更換程序，才能判斷日後的位移是否正常。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At handover the operator needs complete movement records: fixed points of each unit, design travel of joints and rail devices, set values and temperatures at completion, and inspection and replacement procedures, to judge whether later movements are normal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 調節器卡滯或設定位置錯誤時，夏季高溫可能使尖軌頂死、鋼軌承受過大壓力，冬季則開口過大影響行車；若伸縮紀錄在交接時遺失，管理單位無法分辨正常溫度位移與支承或基礎異常。
knowledge.textEn: A seized or mis-set rail device can jam in summer heat and overstress the rails, or open too far in winter and affect running; if movement records are lost at handover, the operator cannot tell normal thermal movement from bearing or foundation problems.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rail expansion devices and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
調節器卡滯或設定位置錯誤時，夏季高溫可能使尖軌頂死、鋼軌承受過大壓力，冬季則開口過大影響行車。
橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A seized or mis-set rail device can jam in summer heat and overstress the rails, or open too far in winter and affect running.
Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow.
quiz.explanation: 調節器卡滯或設定位置錯誤時，夏季高溫可能使尖軌頂死、鋼軌承受過大壓力，冬季則開口過大影響行車；若伸縮紀錄在交接時遺失，管理單位無法分辨正常溫度位移與支承或基礎異常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A seized or mis-set rail device can jam in summer heat and overstress the rails, or open too far in winter and affect running; if movement records are lost at handover, the operator cannot tell normal thermal movement from bearing or foundation problems. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
